summary: A new Weather Channel Android app uses IBM mesh-networking technology to relay emergency information directly between phones when mobile networks fail. Designed for developing countries, it uses Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, works on older 2G networks, and is launching in Asia, Latin America and Africa. Its reach depends on enough people using the app; IBM uses digital signatures to verify messages.

XYZprinting is presenting the $19,950 MfgPro220 xPF 3D printer at Rapid + TCT 2018. It has a 16-liter build volume and is intended for prototyping, tooling and end-use parts. Its software and sensors support performance optimization, diagnostics and monitoring, while on-board and cloud controls enable remote operation. XYZprinting also announced a partnership with BEGO and Nexa3D to develop, manufacture and sell a high-speed dental printer.

Collagen production declines with age, prompting interest in supplements for skin and other health benefits. Supplements are mostly animal-derived, and hydrolysed collagen may be easier to absorb. Studies suggest benefits for skin, nails, bones and joints, but research is ongoing. A balanced diet containing nutrients needed for collagen production remains the most reliable way to support the body’s natural collagen levels.

Tesla Motors reported $1.15 billion in revenue for the quarter ended March 31, 2016, up from $939.9 million a year earlier. Its net loss widened to $282.3 million from $154.2 million, while gross margin fell to 22.0% from 27.7%. Tesla produced 15,510 vehicles during the quarter and received more than 325,000 Model 3 reservations within a week of its unveiling. It held $1.44 billion in cash and cash equivalents at quarter-end. Tesla targeted 80,000–90,000 Model S and Model X deliveries in 2016 and 500,000 vehicles built in 2018, while expecting 2016 capital spending to exceed its previous $1.5 billion estimate by approximately 50%.

Sensient Technologies reported quarterly earnings of $0.80 per share, exceeding the $0.78 consensus estimate. Its net margin was 9.13%, and return on equity was 16.73%. The company announced a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share, payable March 1 to shareholders of record February 7. KeyCorp raised its price target to $84 and maintained an “overweight” rating, while Zacks upgraded the stock from “sell” to “hold.” Sensient manufactures and markets colors, flavors and fragrances.

The president returns a bill granting states public land or land scrip to support colleges teaching agriculture and the mechanic arts, calling it inexpedient and unconstitutional. He argues that selling the scrip would reduce federal land revenue, encourage speculation that harms settlers, and weaken the separation between federal and state responsibilities. He also doubts the federal government could ensure the funds serve their intended purpose and says new colleges could harm existing institutions. In his view, Congress may grant land to promote settlement and the sale of remaining public lands, but not give it to states for colleges generally.

The lecture introduces discrete stochastic processes and emphasizes that choosing a useful probability model for an uncertain situation can be harder than solving a well-specified mathematical problem. It urges balancing simplicity with realism and examining a model’s assumptions, particularly when decisions involve risk. The course covers counting and Poisson processes, Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, and martingales, with applications including networks and queuing. The lecture also reviews Kolmogorov’s probability axioms, independent events, and random variables. It defines a random variable as a function from sample points to real values and explains why distribution functions apply even when a variable has neither a probability mass function nor a density. The professor stresses the value of proofs for understanding complicated systems.
A non-peer-reviewed technical report presents bioimpedance phase angle clusters as an alternative to body mass index and cautions against using the research to guide clinical practice.

Bethesda Softworks announced that Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus will launch for Nintendo Switch on June 29, digitally and physically. Even the cartridge version requires a download and microSD storage. The game previously released for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC in October.

A November 2016 grant from Blue Cross Blue Shield of Mississippi funded a new physical education building at Bell Academy, built by parent and community volunteers. Teacher Joyce Aycock and students say the indoor space allows more activities without the noise and space limitations they previously faced. A horizontal rock-climbing wall is planned before the building’s Friday ribbon cutting.

The Department of Higher Education and Training is working to integrate NSFAS with college and university systems after delayed student payments sparked protests. Minister Naledi Pandor said problems exchanging registration data have delayed funding agreements and that unresolved cases must be addressed urgently. The government allocated nearly R7.2bn in additional bursary funding for 2018 and R105m to strengthen NSFAS administration. The DA said it would seek an urgent meeting with NSFAS, arguing that officials had not explained how many students were affected, why payments were delayed or when they would be made.

The football drive concept pairs a 10–12-yard basic route with a 3–4-yard shallow cross from the same side, creating a triangle read that stresses linebackers. The receivers keep moving against man coverage but settle into open spaces against zone. The concept works well against man and can create opportunities against Cover 4, while Cover 2 and Cover 3 put more defenders underneath and limit big plays. The quarterback checks the post before the snap, then progresses from the go route to the shallow cross, basic route and running back check-down. Drive can also be used with bunch formations or as an outlet alongside other passing concepts.

The council says it is coordinating roadworks and utility maintenance to reduce congestion around Southway, Tamerton Foliot and the Derriford Transport Scheme. Measures include restricting some temporary signals to off-peak hours, suspending Tavistock Road bus-lane restrictions to maintain two traffic lanes, and adjusting signals at George Junction. It is reviewing changes at Budshead Roundabout, including lane markings and signs, subject to a safety review. Planned roadworks are listed online and publicised through council channels.

The author argues that ADT is undervalued relative to newly listed Verisure, citing revenue growth, improving profitability, recurring revenue, partnerships, debt reduction and share buybacks. Customer churn and flat subscriber numbers remain challenges, though ADT is investing in AI, remote assistance and smart-home solutions. The author estimates 33% or more potential upside using a 12–14x P/E valuation and discloses a long position in ADT.

The document describes AMD VCEK certificates and the Key Distribution System (KDS) used to retrieve them for SEV-SNP environments. A VCEK certificate is an X.509v3 certificate tied to a chip and TCB version, issued through a product-specific chain of AMD Root Key and AMD SEV Key certificates. The KDS provides HTTPS endpoints for VCEK certificates, certificate chains, and revocation lists. VCEK certificates are generated on request, and clients can request certificates for future security patch levels to cache them before firmware updates.

Allen reported that Hong Chong-oo assassinated Korean refugee Kim Ok-kiun in Shanghai and was returned to Korea, where Kim’s body was mutilated. In a separate Tokyo case, Japanese police forcibly removed a suspect named Hong from the Korean legation after officials refused to surrender him. Sill reported uprisings against oppressive officials in three southern Korean provinces. The Korean government sent troops, requested an American ship at Chemulpo, and asked that American missionaries be recalled from the interior because it could not assure their protection.

Mauricio Pochettino named a 26-player U.S. men’s national team roster for October friendlies in Austin and Commerce City. Christian Pulisic headlines the squad after scoring six goals for AC Milan this season. Weston McKennie returns for the first time since March, and Antonee Robinson receives his first call-up of 2025 after knee surgery.

The passage describes a vehicle radar sensing system that uses a two-dimensional array of transmitting and receiving antennas with MIMO processing to detect nearby objects. An illustrated array of 12 transmitters and 16 receivers provides 192 virtual receivers, improving horizontal and vertical sensing accuracy and resolution. The system may support driver-assistance functions and provide alerts or vehicle-control outputs.

Jennifer Thompson mistakenly identified Ronald Cotton as the man who raped her, leading to his conviction. Eleven years later, DNA testing matched another man, Bobby Poole. Thompson says the case shows how traumatic experiences and questioning can affect memory. She and Cotton later reconciled and became close friends. Thompson founded Healing Justice, which brings harmed parties together to share their stories.

Joe Bryant’s Week 10 fantasy football newsletter evaluates passing and rushing matchups, using recent defensive statistics and injury updates to help readers make lineup decisions. It highlights favorable matchups for the Saints’ passing game, Peyton Manning and several running backs, while warning about defenses such as Pittsburgh and Baltimore. It also notes that Jeff George will start for Washington in place of the injured Brad Johnson and introduces a receiver pass-target statistic.

The speaker describes a tight-checking series in which Hasek’s puck handling has made it difficult to sustain possession. Detroit’s adjustments and offensive ability have punished defensive breakdowns. The team plans to refocus on tighter defensive play, review mistakes on video, and follow the coaching staff’s lineup decisions.

UPMSP will announce the 2018 Class 10 and 12 results on April 29 at 12:30 pm. Students can check them on upresults.nic.in or upmspresults.up.nic.in using their roll numbers, or request them by SMS. The exams ran from February 6 to February 22 and March 12, respectively.

An Oct. 15 paycheck for 1.3 million active-duty service members could pressure Congress and the White House to end the shutdown or pass temporary funding, according to Goldman Sachs economists. Analysts also cite potential disruptions to benefits, airports and government services as reasons for compromise, though they warn the shutdown could continue into November.

Russia’s central bank cut its key rate to 9.25% from 9.75%, its second cut this year, and signaled further gradual reductions. It expects inflation to fall to 4% by the end of 2017 and remain at that level through 2019.

Ghana’s major gold miners welcome new government tests to certify export values, the Chamber of Mines said. Officials from the Precious Minerals Marketing Company can now observe gold pours, take samples and participate in pre-shipment procedures. The measures aim to improve oversight and taxation. Ghana has also reported about $5 billion in unaccounted-for gold export revenue.

On the opening night of the 2025 World Grand Prix of Darts, Rob Cross beat Nijman in a deciding leg. Ratajski won 2-0, Menzies eliminated the eighth seed, and Cullen came from behind in the second set to beat James Wade 2-0.

The study fabricated NbN coplanar-waveguide resonators on n-doped Si/SiGe quantum-well wafers, using a deep etch in the resonator gaps intended to reduce microwave loss. Two chips had resonances near 5.04–5.60 GHz at 50 mK. Internal quality factors increased with input power and remained stable across measurements spanning two years. Loss analysis found that TLS defects contribute to dissipation, while largely power-independent losses associated with scattering dominate; quasiparticle losses become more apparent at higher temperatures. The estimated maximum relaxation time for a gatemon using this wafer and design is about 14 ns, indicating that further improvements are needed.

A diverse workforce can help businesses understand varied markets, but subconscious biases may cause employers to overlook qualified applicants. Studies cited in the passage found hiring disparities linked to gender and to names suggesting race or ethnicity. To reduce bias, employers can write job postings that describe desired behaviors rather than personality traits, remove names from resumes, and use skills-based challenges before collecting other applicant information. They should compare qualifications systematically and examine negative interview impressions to ensure prejudice is not influencing their decisions.

A report says students at an Edina, Minnesota, elementary school participate in a project about skin color as part of instruction on “white privilege.” The passage also describes an article by Shreena Gandhi and Lillie Wolff arguing that yoga practice in the United States is linked to white supremacy, colonialism and cultural appropriation.

China’s foreign exchange regulator said capital outflow pressure eased somewhat in 2016 and the yuan’s exchange rate would become more flexible in 2017. Authorities plan to attract more capital inflows. Final data showed a $196.4 billion current account surplus and a $26.3 billion capital and financial account surplus in 2016.

The author argues that well-supported tutoring can improve learning while encouraging tutors to become teachers. Teach For America’s Ignite Fellowship has trained more than 5,500 virtual tutors across over 40 communities. Its students’ math and reading scores grew at up to 2.5 and three times expected rates, respectively. The program pairs tutors with training and coaching, using technology to connect them with students. Cited research found that Ignite tutors were nearly three times as likely to apply to Teach For America’s teacher program; 550 fellows have joined its teaching corps.

Founded by Jeff Bezos, Amazon launched as an online bookstore in 1995 and went public in 1997. It expanded into other products and services through new offerings and acquisitions, introduced Prime in 2005, developed devices including the Kindle, and built Amazon Web Services (AWS) from its computing infrastructure. Some initiatives, including the Fire Phone, failed.

Amazon prioritized customer experience, market leadership, and long-term free cash flow over short-term profitability. By its IPO’s 20th anniversary in 2017, its market capitalization was $458 billion, while cumulative net income from 1997 through 2016 was $4.9 billion. In 2016, Amazon reported $136 billion in sales, $2.4 billion in net income, and $9.7 billion in free cash flow. AWS generated $3.1 billion of the company’s $4.2 billion in operating income that year.

Mary Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell and Shimon Sakaguchi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine for work on regulatory T cells, which prevent the immune system from attacking the body. Sakaguchi identified the cells in 1995; Brunkow and Ramsdell linked a mutation to autoimmune disease. Scientists are studying how to use regulatory T cells to treat immune-related conditions.

Ethereum’s proposed enshrined Proposer–Builder Separation removes reliance on trusted relays and gives more time for blob propagation. Its separate payload and blob deadlines also let a winning builder withhold data after committing to a block, preventing an unfavorable block from becoming canonical without an additional protocol penalty.

The study finds that this “free option” could harm network liveness, distort on-chain prices and impose losses on liquidity providers. In historical blocks, exercising it would have been profitable in 0.82% of cases with an eight-second window, with higher rates during volatile periods. Shorter windows and builder penalties both reduced exercise rates in the authors’ analyses, but could respectively weaken scalability or raise barriers to builder participation.

In his farewell address, the President thanks the American people and his colleagues, expresses confidence in the country, and pledges support for his successor. He says the presidency depends on public consent and warns that special interests can obscure the common good. He urges continued military strength alongside efforts to reduce nuclear weapons, protect the planet’s resources, and defend human rights at home and abroad. He calls on Americans to uphold democratic values through an uncertain period and says he will continue working for the freedom of the American hostages in Iran.

An email compiles reports that Enron replaced CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeff McMahon on October 24, 2001, to restore investor confidence. The SEC was examining transactions with partnerships Fastow had managed, and investors questioned Enron’s disclosures and potential liabilities. Enron shares fell 17% that day to $16.41. Several analysts downgraded the stock, and shareholder lawsuits alleged misconduct.
Geary County deputies arrested Isaac Torgerson on suspicion of aggravated assault after witnesses reported that a pickup passenger waved a gun toward their vehicle near Fort Riley.

The Yankees will start Paul Goldschmidt at first base and bat him sixth in ALDS Game 4 against the Blue Jays, benching Ben Rice with their season on the line. Toronto will use Louis Varland as an opener. Rice has started all three games of the series and could enter later as a pinch-hitter or catcher.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2020 Form 10-K describes its software, cloud services, devices, gaming, and advertising businesses, reported in three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The company emphasizes investment in cloud computing, AI, productivity tools, and gaming. It reports approximately 163,000 full-time employees as of June 30, 2020. The filing discusses COVID-19’s uncertain effects, competition, cybersecurity and privacy risks, and commitments to sustainability, racial equity, and digital skills.

Temu resumed direct shipping from China after temporarily limiting US shoppers to products in local warehouses amid tariff changes. The author ordered toys and received them without extra fees, though some broke or failed to work as expected.

Donnell Gibson, a behavior intervention specialist and junior varsity basketball coach at Como Park Senior High, helps students navigate life so they can focus on school. After rescuing a family of 10 from a 2015 house fire, he shifted his plans from opening a recreation center to founding a program that mentors young African-American men through speakers, college tours and basketball. Gibson draws on his experiences with homelessness and the encouragement of his high school principal to motivate students.

The meeting was upbeat and focused on changes to the game plan. The speaker said the team needs to use its speed and skating more effectively. Despite not playing its best in the last two games, it had chances to win, helped by a teammate’s strong play. The speaker emphasized mental preparation, individual responsibilities and home-crowd energy.

An October 23, 2001, collection of news reports focuses on Enron’s transactions with partnerships managed by its finance chief. The SEC sought information about the deals, which were linked to a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity. Enron shares fell sharply, while analysts remained divided. A law firm announced an investor class action alleging misleading disclosures, and Bloomberg reported that Enron had sought a $750 million loan from Citigroup. A Texas Monthly article examined the company’s growth, culture and setbacks. Other reports covered Enron’s power-project dispute in India and complaints by AES about an Indian state government.

Donchian Channels use the highest high and lowest low over a chosen period to identify potential breakouts. The passage reports that they work better as a trend-following indicator for commodities and currencies than for stocks. In its stock backtests, a trend-following strategy underperformed buy-and-hold, while a mean-reversion approach showed promising results. The channels resemble Bollinger Bands but can produce different backtest results.

Steven Kean forwarded a collection of February 23 articles on California’s electricity crisis. Gov. Gray Davis announced a tentative $2.7 billion agreement to buy Southern California Edison’s transmission lines, while negotiations with PG&E remained difficult. State power purchases were mounting, and regulators and utilities disputed how the state would be repaid. Small generators agreed to proposed price cuts, and California lifted its power alerts for the first time since January 13, though officials urged continued conservation. Other articles covered opposition to proposed power lines near Lake Elsinore and Republican efforts to challenge Davis over the crisis.

The passage examines whether microtubule dynamics can help anticipate drug resistance in advanced prostate cancer. It describes an imaging algorithm that tracks fluorescent markers on growing microtubule tips and infers periods of growth, pause, and shortening. In prostate cancer cells expressing the treatment-resistant ARv7 variant, average microtubule growth speed was 24.6 µm/min, compared with 16.2 µm/min in cells expressing wild-type androgen receptor. The passage also reports small circulating tumor cells that may be missed by size-based detection methods, and experiments linking pVHL and GSK3β activity to microtubule dynamics during quiescence.

The author proposes combining measurements in patient-derived organoids with gene expression and treatment outcomes to identify drug susceptibility and resistance mechanisms. Additional approaches discussed include modifying organoid culture conditions, sensitizing resistant cells to treatment, and measuring drug-induced microtubule bundles. These proposed approaches require further validation against patient responses.

The passage cautions that a market rebound does not make every stock a buy. Nvidia bounced from its rising 50-day trendline after strong earnings, which traders view as a positive technical signal. Micron is also rallying, but its shares remain below a bearish 50-day moving average. The passage warns that resistance near $84 could halt Micron’s rebound.

Hungary’s education system includes compulsory schooling, selective school admissions, and specialized teacher preparation. Its special education system dates to 1802, and subsequent laws have expanded educational rights and support for students with disabilities. In 2019, more than 88,000 students had special educational needs, and 60% were educated in inclusive settings. Parents make the final decision about school placement after a professional committee recommends services and placement. Special education teachers complete specialized university training, while general education teachers receive little training in teaching students with disabilities. The article identifies difficulties with diagnosis, inaccessible school buildings, limited inclusion, low teacher pay, and teacher attrition. It recommends improving diagnosis, accessibility, teacher training, pay, and retention.

President Trump said some federal workers furloughed during the seven-day government shutdown might not receive back pay. A draft White House memo questioned whether retroactive pay is guaranteed, despite earlier administration guidance and a 2019 law saying furloughed employees shall be paid. Democrats are seeking an extension of Affordable Care Act tax credits in a funding deal. Trump also warned of substantial permanent layoffs if the shutdown continues, while a federal workers’ union disputed the administration’s position on back pay.

Canadian lumber shares fell after BMO downgraded West Fraser, Interfor and Canfor, citing U.S. duties, a stronger Canadian dollar and litigation. BMO said a near-term resolution of the lumber dispute was unlikely and earnings faced pressure, though it viewed the stocks’ three- to five-year prospects more positively.

Select Security acquired Charlotte-based Intelligent Technology Inc. and Carolina Security Group, adding nearly 1,000 customers and team members. It will consolidate its western North Carolina operations at a new downtown Charlotte branch.

At the University of Virginia, President Reagan invoked Thomas Jefferson’s commitment to self-government, free inquiry and tolerance. He described the spread of democracy and free-market policies, progress in U.S.–Soviet relations, arms control and regional conflicts. He cautioned that fundamental differences with the Soviet Union remained and urged continued military strength, verification of agreements and cooperation between Congress and the President on foreign policy.

In questions afterward, Reagan said Soviet actions should be judged against its promises and that the PLO’s acceptance of U.S. conditions was a step toward Middle East negotiations, not peace itself. He defended his administration’s policies on terrorism, military readiness, tax cuts and deregulation; urged young people to vote; and said he planned to remain active after leaving office.

Japan’s economy grew at an annualised 4% in the second quarter, exceeding expectations. Strong consumer spending and investment, including spending tied to the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, helped offset a drop in exports.

The May 16, 2001 VentureWire newsletter reports on venture financing, layoffs, acquisitions, product launches and fund activity. Buzzsaw.com cut 30% of its staff while seeking a $20 million round; UGO Networks acquired Bla-Bla.com; and EYP Mission Critical Facilities raised $57.5 million to spin off from its parent. Flatiron Partners planned to move into J.P. Morgan Chase offices to reduce costs. Other reports include Metiom’s Chapter 11 filing, Mybiz.com’s closure, several companies’ new funding, and PSINet Ventures’ decision to stop making new deals and manage its portfolio.

Scientists at Newcastle University have 3D printed human corneas using a bio-ink made from donor corneal stem cells, alginate and collagen. Printing took less than 10 minutes, and the cells subsequently grew. The researchers also showed they could print a cornea to match a patient’s eye measurements. The technique could help address the worldwide shortage of transplant corneas, but further testing is needed, and clinical use remains several years away.

The passage lists archival, online, and published sources for documents on foreign policy, including the personal papers of Alexander Haig and Donald Regan. It provides source notes for 1980 campaign statements and speeches by Ronald Reagan and George Bush, with dates, locations, archival references, and related press coverage.

A Greater Manchester study evaluated a data-driven method for prioritising AI-detected chest X-ray findings that may indicate lung cancer. Researchers analysed 1,282 X-rays from patients with confirmed lung cancer and 13,802 primary-care referrals, comparing three prioritisation strategies. The strategy combining finding prevalence with clinical judgement achieved 95.87% sensitivity, 79.11% estimated specificity and a 99.95% negative predictive value. The estimates relied on an assumed cancer prevalence in the referral cohort and were not validated against individual diagnoses. External validation and studies of effects on reporting workflows are needed.

Galveston County regularly tests water at 52 beach locations for bacteria associated with feces, which can enter the Gulf through storm runoff. An advisory near Galveston Beach’s 57th Street was issued Thursday and lifted Friday after samples came back clear. Officials advise avoiding water under advisory because it can cause illness and checking current conditions before visiting.

The monthly Non-Farm Payrolls report measures changes in US non-agricultural employment and is usually released on the first Friday at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time. Traders compare its figures with expectations because the report can cause volatility across bond, stock, forex, and commodity markets. Stronger-than-expected employment is generally viewed as positive for the US economy and dollar, but may weigh on bonds amid expectations of higher interest rates. The passage’s backtests found a 0.09% average same-day gain for SPY and a 0.02% average loss for TLT. It concludes that these results do not establish a reliable way to trade the report.

The ICRC launched a nationwide campaign in Islamabad urging motorists to give way to ambulances. Supported by more than 30 partner organizations, it will use public pledges, media and awareness activities through December 2017. The campaign also aims to highlight challenges faced by ambulance staff and assess changes in motorists’ behaviour. A previous ambulance campaign in 2016 recorded a 16% impact in an observational study.

A 70-mile-wide radar mass over Colorado, initially mistaken for birds, was identified as swarms of migrating Painted Lady butterflies. National Weather Service forecasters said flying insects are rarely detected by radar.

With the Mariners–Tigers ALDS tied 1-1, rain delayed Game 3 in Detroit from its scheduled 4:08 p.m. ET start. The Tigers later said first pitch was expected at 7 p.m. ET. The game was moved to FS2 and will also air on MLB Network and the Fox One App.

The lecture examines how adjacency-matrix eigenvalues measure pseudorandomness in regular graphs. It computes the eigenvalues of Paley graphs to show they are explicit pseudorandom Cayley graphs. For Cayley graphs, it presents a theorem equating small discrepancy with small nontrivial eigenvalues up to a constant factor; the proof uses Grothendieck’s inequality and group symmetries. It then establishes the Alon–Boppana bound: for fixed degree \(d\) and growing graph size, the second eigenvalue is at least \(2\sqrt{d-1}-o(1)\). Two proofs are outlined, using explicit vectors and counts of closed walks.

Rite-Hite’s Uni-Dox Inflatable Shelter accommodates varied truck and trailer configurations. Its bags inflate around a secured trailer, then manually deflate and retract before departure using a counterweight system. Draft pads and optional dock-control feedback help reduce damage. The PitMaster Under-leveler Seal helps keep debris and pests out.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2022 reports net sales of $117.2 billion, down 5% from a year earlier, and net income of $30.0 billion, down from $34.6 billion. iPhone and Mac sales declined, while iPad and Services sales rose. Apple attributed the sales decline partly to weaker foreign currencies and reported that COVID-related disruption reduced capacity at its primary iPhone 14 Pro assembly facility. Operating cash flow was $34.0 billion; Apple repurchased $19.0 billion of stock and paid $3.8 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents.

The passage argues that falling interest rates could support housing-related stocks over the next one to four years. It says homebuilders and home-improvement stocks have historically outperformed the broader market during falling-rate periods, except during the subprime crisis. Tariffs currently favor domestic manufacturers, though trade deals could change that. The author notes housing-crisis risks but says leverage appears lower than in 2007.

Bridgeton National Bank sued Hepner on a renewed $1,400 promissory note. Hepner alleged that the original note arose from a fraudulent stock sale and that the bank’s cashier knew of the fraud and a promise not to negotiate the note. The trial court excluded evidence of the cashier’s knowledge and directed a verdict for the bank. Citing New Jersey precedent, the reviewing court held that the cashier’s knowledge was not attributable to the bank and denied a new trial.

The passage documents AMD AGESA interfaces for event logging, processor and memory initialization, graphics configuration, operating-system tables, and suspend and resume. It describes when each procedure runs, its parameters, dependencies, status codes, and the different tasks assigned to the boot processor and application processors. The host environment must provide services including stack setup, memory allocation, resets, SPD reads, and application-processor task dispatch. Platform behavior can be customized through build options, configuration settings, parameter changes, and call-outs.

The speaker recalls first following hockey in Birmingham and names Ron Hextall as his favorite player. He says the NHL playoffs have been exciting, especially overtime games, while the NBA playoffs have been less enjoyable to watch and broadcast. Discussing Kevin Durant, he argues that great teammates make the game easier by sharing responsibility, as he experienced after moving to Phoenix. He places teams that win multiple championships above those that win only once, emphasizing how difficult sustained winning is.

The appellate court upheld the dismissal of the first jury after the prosecutor repeatedly accused defense counsel of criminal conduct, rejecting Montlake’s former-jeopardy claim. It found that questioning an alibi witness about unpaid rent was improper but reversed the conviction on another ground: the trial judge wrongly instructed jurors that the alibi had to prove the defendants could not have been at the crime scene. A new trial was granted.

CMD55 makes the next command application-specific (ACMD); later commands are regular commands unless another CMD55 is issued. CMD6 checks or switches card functions, including access mode, command system, driver strength, and power limit. Its status data reports supported and selected functions, busy status, and maximum current or power consumption.

CMD8 checks host-voltage compatibility during initialization. SDSC cards use byte addresses, while SDHC and SDXC cards use 512-byte block addresses. The passage also specifies command and response formats, CRC protection, clock control, timeout conditions, and card-status fields.

Speed Class, UHS Speed Grade, and Video Speed Class describe recording performance. Allocation Units and Recording Units govern Speed Class recording; SDXC Speed Class requires writes to entirely free Allocation Units. CMD20 supports Speed Class recording control and is mandatory for SDXC cards.

The October 12, 2000 Haas alumni jobs bulletin lists 20 openings across technology, finance, retail, healthcare, education, and consulting. It provides locations, qualifications, job descriptions, and application contacts, and notes that Haas has not researched the listed employers or search firms.

Using U.S. death records from 1999–2020, the study compared mortality among non-Hispanic Black and White people under 85. It estimated 1.81 million excess deaths and nearly 82 million excess years of potential life lost among Black people. Disparities narrowed through the early 2010s, then stalled and rose sharply in 2020. Heart disease was the leading contributor to excess mortality, while infants had the greatest disparity in years of potential life lost. The authors propose annual reporting of excess deaths and life-years lost to track progress.

One police officer and two Barrio 18 gunmen were killed when gang members attacked officers searching for illegal weapons in San Salvador. Eight officers suffered superficial gunshot wounds; four were released from the hospital, and the others were expected to leave within a week.

NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2019 revenue of $3.18 billion, up 21% year over year, and net income of $1.23 billion, up 47%. GPU revenue rose 25% to $2.77 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue fell 3% to $407 million. For the first nine months, revenue reached $9.51 billion and net income $3.58 billion. NVIDIA returned $1.13 billion to shareholders through repurchases and dividends during that period.
A 30-year-old man died after being found injured at an Aroland First Nation residence. Police charged a 26-year-old local man with assault with a weapon and continue investigating.

Japan’s government upgraded its assessment of business sentiment in April after a Bank of Japan survey showed stronger confidence among major manufacturers. It kept its overall view that the economy is recovering gradually despite pockets of weakness. Exports and factory output have improved, but overseas uncertainty and financial-market fluctuations remain concerns.

Comcast abandoned its bid for most of Twenty-First Century Fox’s assets, saying it lacked the engagement needed to make an offer. Disney remains the sole suitor for the $40 billion-plus deal, with negotiations continuing and a possible agreement this month.

Thirty-seven lawyers, including 10 incoming partners, are moving from Cadwalader to Orrick. The group specializes in collateralized loan obligations and asset-backed lending and will work in Charlotte, London, Washington, D.C., and New York. Bloomberg Law reported that Cadwalader has lost nearly a fifth of its partnership this year, even after new hires. The firm has added a second managing partner and is hiring to strengthen core practices.

Colleges are preparing for demonstrations on the anniversary of the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas attacks. Columbia is requiring advance protest plans and temporarily limiting guest passes. The University of Maryland has restricted campus access, while its Students for Justice in Palestine group plans a teach-in and sit-in.

Tesla Motors filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release on April 3, 2015, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The release was furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01, not deemed filed. Chief Financial Officer Deepak Ahuja signed the report.

The speaker calls for renewed national unity, trust, and faith in the American dream. He urges a competent and compassionate government committed to fair laws, equal opportunity, human rights, and human dignity. Abroad, he pledges strength guided by the nation’s values, efforts to build a just and peaceful world, limits on armaments, and progress toward eliminating nuclear weapons.

A simple moving average (SMA) continuously averages an asset’s closing prices over a chosen period to show trend direction and potential support or resistance. Shorter periods respond faster but generate more signals; longer periods are smoother but lag more. Unlike an exponential moving average, an SMA weights every price equally. The passage’s backtests favor buying below short-term SMAs for mean reversion and buying above long-term SMAs for trend-following. A 200-day crossover strategy returned 7.89% annually with a 28% maximum drawdown. SMAs can give false or delayed signals, particularly in volatile or range-bound markets, so the passage suggests backtesting settings and using other indicators for confirmation.

The passage describes example multicarrier wireless communication systems, including carrier aggregation, multi-connectivity, timing alignment, and LTE–5G interworking. It outlines how base stations and wireless devices may configure serving cells, protocol layers, logical channels, and scheduling resources. Logical channels may be mapped to particular transmission intervals, numerologies, or cells, with priorities used to allocate uplink grants. It also describes configuring and switching downlink and uplink bandwidth parts, including default bandwidth parts and control-channel monitoring. For operation in unlicensed spectrum, it discusses listen-before-talk procedures for assessing channel availability.

The randomized, open-label DAWN-plasma trial compared standard care plus four units of convalescent plasma with standard care alone in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. The full analysis included 320 plasma recipients and 163 controls. On Day 15, the proportions alive and free of mechanical ventilation were similar: 83.7% and 84.1%, respectively. No significant differences were found in secondary outcomes or serious adverse events. Transfusion-related side effects were reported in 19 plasma recipients. The intervention did not alter the course of neutralizing-antibody titers.

A prospective study followed 228 adults undergoing surgery for suspected acute intestinal obstruction at three Dar es Salaam referral hospitals from December 2021 to July 2022. Adhesions were the most frequent surgical diagnosis, followed by hernias, volvulus and abdominal tumors. Of the patients, 173 (76%) were discharged home, 20 (9%) developed superficial surgical site infections, and 12 (5.3%) died. Outcomes were unknown for 12 patients.

Averaging down means buying more shares after their price falls, lowering the average purchase price and the price needed to break even. It does not erase losses: the price must still rise, and further declines increase exposure and potential losses. The passage says it may fit a planned, long-term entry strategy but is risky when done solely because a stock has fallen. In a backtest using SPY, an averaging-down strategy produced nearly the same ending capital as a strategy without it, with smoother performance and smaller drawdowns. The passage favors testing strategies before using them and identifies stocks as its preferred market for averaging down.

Yahoo is in advanced talks to sell AOL to Bending Spoons for about $1.4 billion, though no deal is signed. Music labels are negotiating AI licensing terms. Berkshire Hathaway is buying Occidental Petroleum’s chemical business for $9.7 billion. Tesla reported record third-quarter deliveries of 497,100 vehicles, above estimates. September job cuts fell from August, but year-to-date cuts are the highest since 2020. Caterpillar shares have gained 32% this year amid demand for power and infrastructure linked to AI. Wedbush expects AI spending to spur tech acquisitions.

Following the consolidation of eight Aberdeen funds, the renamed fund began trading as AEF on April 30, 2018. Its emerging-markets equity income strategy seeks current income and long-term capital appreciation; it was not using leverage. As of May 25, Tencent was its largest holding at 6.45%, and cash represented 5.81% of the portfolio. A tender offer and special distribution could change the reported holdings, which are unaudited.

San Francisco State University’s Department of Biology will host Personalized Medicine 10.0 on June 2, 2017. Titled “Has It Changed Your Life?”, the conference will revisit a decade of topics and predictions and consider the field’s future. Sessions will address subjects including genomics, sequencing, gene therapy, genome editing, and the business and ethics of personalized medicine. Opening keynote speaker Amylynne Santiago Volker will discuss genetic sequencing and the challenges of its clinical use and insurance coverage. Registration is open to students, professionals, and the public.

Therapeutic antibodies must combine effective target binding with properties such as thermostability, low hydrophobicity, and good expression. Because experimental refinement is costly and data are limited, the passage considers Bayesian optimization for antibody engineering. It proposes examining whether structural information improves optimization, which properties benefit, and how structural and sequence-only models compare. It also introduces a protein language model “soft constraint” for incorporating sequence-only prior information.

Cleveland police were searching for Steve Stephens after he allegedly shot and killed 74-year-old Robert Godwin Sr. and recorded the attack on Facebook Live. Stephens cited his ex-girlfriend, Joy Lane, who expressed condolences to Godwin’s family and requested privacy.

In 2,097 Project Baseline Health Study participants, researchers compared a chest X-ray-based biological aging measure, CXR-Age, with two DNA methylation clocks. Higher CXR-Age acceleration was associated with greater coronary artery calcium, poorer pulmonary and physical function, and greater disability. DNAm PhenoAge showed some similar associations, while Horvath Age showed no significant associations with these outcomes. CXR-Age and DNAm PhenoAge acceleration were not significantly associated with each other. Protein analyses identified associations with CXR-Age and DNAm PhenoAge, including a shared association with CDH13. The observational study lacked longitudinal outcomes and may not generalize to other populations; prospective research is needed to assess clinical use.

This non-peer-reviewed preprint describes PhenoID, a transformer-based pipeline that extracts abnormal findings from dysmorphology examination notes and maps them to Human Phenotype Ontology terms. The researchers annotated 3,826 observations from 1,655 individuals. PhenoID achieved an F1 score of 0.717 for normalization, outperforming six competing systems; its score rose to 0.820 when given the correct text spans. Error analysis identified challenges with span extraction, descriptive findings and ontology terms. The authors note that the dataset’s limited diversity of note authors may affect performance elsewhere.

Valeant Pharmaceuticals shares fell 0.3% in the most recent session and closed at $16.73. Eighteen analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $16.75, ranging from $8 to $35. Their recommendations included three Buy, two Outperform, seven Hold and six Underperform ratings. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation was 2.83. Its 14-period average true range was 0.7, and its relative strength index was 43.3. Valeant’s market capitalization was $5.85 billion; 7.02 million shares traded in the previous session, compared with an average of nearly 13.9 million.

A SpaceX Falcon 9 is set to carry Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s Spaceborne Computer to the International Space Station. The off-the-shelf supercomputer can make one trillion calculations per second and uses software, rather than added hardware protection, to respond to hazards such as radiation. Researchers plan to test it for a year. If it works, onboard processing could reduce the amount of satellite-image data sent to Earth and support future Mars missions, where communication delays could hinder astronauts.

The passage describes a method for classifying objects from 3D point clouds, including those generated by LIDAR. It extracts surface-based features and compares spin-image and covariance-matrix classifications. When those classifications disagree, it compares the point cloud with models of only the proposed classes to select the closest fit. The assigned class can then guide a device’s operation. Experiments reported generally high classification rates for several objects, including cones, boxes, pipes and toy guns.

Researchers found that limiting a nutrient used by malaria parasites allowed competition between drug-sensitive and drug-resistant strains to help control resistance in mice. With the nutrient available, drug treatment failed in 40 percent of mice infected with sensitive parasites as resistant strains emerged; with the nutrient limited, no infections rebounded. Limiting the nutrient did not eliminate resistant parasites when they were alone, but stopped their growth when sensitive parasites were also present. The researchers describe this as a proof of principle and say further work must identify suitable resources and intervention strategies for other infections.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended April 1, 2017 reports net sales of $52.9 billion, up 5% from a year earlier, and net income of $11.0 billion, up from $10.5 billion. Services and Mac sales grew, while iPad sales and Greater China sales declined. At quarter-end, Apple held $15.2 billion in cash and cash equivalents and reported $334.5 billion in total assets. During the quarter, it spent $7.0 billion repurchasing shares, paid $3.0 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents, and issued $11.0 billion in long-term debt.

London–St. Thomas’s unemployment rate rose slightly to 5.5 per cent in September, while its labour force fell by 3,000. The number of people working or seeking work was down 9,300 from a year earlier, and the area ranked last among 15 major Ontario cities for employment among adults aged 25–54. A King’s University College study found that only about half of working adults had permanent full-time jobs with benefits. It linked precarious work, particularly common among young adults and minorities, to stress, depression and difficulties in family life.

Children’s mobile-phone ownership varies across countries and ages. In one European study, 46% of children ages 9 to 16 owned smartphones; a US report found that 45% of children ages 10 to 12 had smartphones with service plans. Studies also reported substantial ownership among children in South Korea and rising ownership in Ghana, Malawi and South Africa. Access and school restrictions differed across countries, and children often used Wi-Fi to reduce costs. The American Academy of Pediatrics says there is no single right age for a child’s first phone. It recommends age-based limits on young children’s digital media use, monitoring content and keeping mealtimes screen-free.

NVIDIA’s passage describes the Blackwell-based GeForce RTX 50 Series. FP4 support reduces AI model memory requirements, while fourth-generation RT Cores, Mega Geometry, Linear Swept Spheres and improved Shader Execution Reordering target more efficient ray tracing. An AI Management Processor schedules GPU workloads. Other updates include 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, DisplayPort 2.1b support and power-saving features.

DLSS 4 adds Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for image reconstruction. New neural-shader tools and techniques address materials, textures, lighting, skin and faces. The passage also outlines GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and their associated RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti and 5070 products.

The passage presents a new, computationally efficient potential for simulating hydrogen and helium in irradiated tungsten, a candidate fusion-reactor material. It focuses on gas binding to vacancies and voids and on defect relaxation volumes, which are important for gas retention and swelling. Building on an existing tungsten–hydrogen potential, the authors add helium interactions and fit the model to density functional theory data, including new calculations for hydrogen–helium defects. The fitting also accounts for gaseous interactions and high-pressure helium. The authors state that existing potentials inadequately describe some relaxation volumes and void properties, and compare their new model with two of them.

The Renewable Energy Alaska Project is training residents of five Southeast Alaska communities to conduct $25 household energy assessments, offering a less detailed but cheaper alternative to private audits. Trainees identify changes such as LED bulbs and insulated coffee pots that can lower bills in diesel-powered villages. An assessment of a Juneau home found simple adjustments could cut its electric bill by nearly 10%. The Home Energy Leader Program runs through July 31.

A royal commission exposed widespread misconduct in bank and AMP financial planning, including falsely witnessed superannuation documents. Despite years of scandals and inquiries, the findings prompted public shock and reversals from opponents of the commission.

Republic Services has charged Southern Nevada commercial property owners trash fees that were not explicitly approved by local lawmakers, although local ordinances assign those officials responsibility for approving fees not already covered. Las Vegas plans to introduce an ordinance codifying several charges. Republic says it reports the fees to municipalities annually and considers that process approval. A Henderson official said the charges might violate its ordinance, while Clark County said commissioner approval is unnecessary. The total collected is unknown.

The passage describes an implantable medical device, exemplified by a cochlear implant, designed to limit rotation of its magnet when an external magnetic field, such as one from an MRI machine, applies torque. In several embodiments, the magnet sits between plates that move apart during initial rotation; resistance from an elastomeric housing or springs limits further rotation. The magnet may also revolve within a container, and a slit in the housing may allow its insertion or removal.

Dell CEO Michael Dell said demand for AI computing power remains strong, though he expects AI data centers could eventually be overbuilt. Dell shares rose more than 3% Tuesday after the company raised its long-term revenue and profit growth expectations. It plans to ship $20 billion in AI servers in fiscal 2026, twice last year’s sales.

Using European genome-wide association data, this preprint applied Mendelian randomization to examine links among gut microbiota, plasma metabolites, and fibromyalgia. Four microbial taxa were associated with lower fibromyalgia risk and two with higher risk. The analysis identified 82 associated plasma metabolites, highlighting caffeine, α-linolenic acid, GLP-1, and incretin pathways. It also identified 2,3-dihydroxypyridine and palmitoylcholine as potential mediators of microbial associations with fibromyalgia. The authors note limited generalizability beyond European populations and call for experimental and clinical validation.

Guinness is partnering with former Arsenal footballer Thierry Henry for its Made of Black campaign, its first partnership with a footballer. Henry will work with Guinness in Nigeria and across Africa to spotlight people who embody the campaign’s spirit. Guinness also plans football and music events for fans and will continue sponsoring EPL broadcasts on DStv.

The passage reports backtests of three candlestick patterns on the SPY ETF from 1993 to October 2021. Using an exit rule based on a close above the previous day’s high, the Bearish Engulfing Pattern produced a 5% compound annual growth rate, Three Outside Down 2.3%, and Bullish Harami 3.1%. The authors say these patterns performed well relative to others they tested, while cautioning that many candlestick patterns lack quantified evidence of predictive value.

Turkish prosecutors issued detention warrants for 133 Finance and Labor Ministry personnel, four of them still on active duty, over alleged Gülen movement links and use of the ByLock messaging app. Separate investigations led to the detention of 14 women, at least 18 teachers, 19 military personnel and 16 other people across several provinces. The investigations followed the July 2016 failed coup attempt, which the Turkish government blames on the movement; Fethullah Gülen denies involvement. According to the Justice Ministry, 50,510 people had been arrested and 169,013 faced legal proceedings on coup charges as of July 13.

The proposed agreement sets minimum quantities for Congo products purchased by the United Kingdom and United States, allows further purchases, and provides for agreed prices and customary payment. Britain would protect purchased products from unfavorable customs treatment, while both governments would seek to supply the Congo within wartime limits. Belgium would restrict transactions aiding enemy powers and coordinate Congo export licensing with British-administered African territories. In a subsequent message, the U.S. State Department requested agreed price information, questioned payment for unshipped goods without warehouse receipts, rejected a shipping guarantee, and proposed an option on the entire output of listed products and a provision for Congo development work.
The appellants withdrew their appeal from two New York County Supreme Court orders under a January 11, 2010 stipulation.

Microsoft’s board amended its proxy access bylaw on September 20, 2016, clarifying how fund groups meet the 3% ownership threshold and certain indemnification provisions. The amendments also extend the recall period for loaned shares from three to five business days, remove a share-recall requirement at nomination, and lower the voting support needed to re-nominate a candidate from 25% to 15%. Microsoft’s 2016 annual shareholders meeting is scheduled for November 30, with a September 30 voting record date.

The passage lists articles on market timing strategies, indicators, and backtests, including models by Nelson Freeburg, Richard Fabian, Yale Hirsch, and Sy Harding. It says most investors should not try to time the market because most attempts are unsuccessful. The site is managed by traders Hakan Samuelsson and Oddmund Groette with their team.

Leaked benchmarks show Nvidia’s $3,000 Titan V outperforming the Titan Xp and GTX 1080 Ti in Fire Strike and delivering high frame rates in several games at 1440p. The Volta-based card also targets AI work, placing it in the prosumer and developer market.

Sunderland manager David Moyes urged his players to create more chances for Jermain Defoe and contribute goals as the club fights relegation. Defoe has scored 14 of Sunderland’s 24 league goals. Sunderland are seven points from safety with 10 games remaining and have won once in their last 11 league matches.

Erie Federal Credit Union has reopened the former Glenwood School as its corporate headquarters and ninth branch after an 18-month renovation. The full-service location includes a community meeting room and preserves elements of the school’s history. The project returns the property to the tax rolls and leaves room for future growth.

After belugas Qila and Aurora died from an unidentified toxin at the Vancouver Aquarium in 2016, researchers used their DNA to sequence a complete beluga genome. They say it could support research and conservation of the species.

The passage describes RSI and IBS as indicators used in short-term mean-reversion strategies, while ADX measures trend strength without indicating direction. It reports backtests of each indicator and a combined strategy. The combined strategy averaged 0.86% per trade in SPY while invested 14% of the time; in QQQ, it averaged 1.3% per trade. The passage emphasizes keeping strategies simple and notes that no trading strategy guarantees profits.

The Chaikin Oscillator measures momentum in the accumulation/distribution line by subtracting a longer exponential moving average from a shorter one. Its position relative to zero can indicate buying or selling pressure, while divergences may signal potential reversals. In the passage’s S&P 500 tests, a zero-crossing strategy returned a 2.4% annualized growth rate over twenty years. The authors found no significant value in the strategies they tested, though they note that other criteria might produce different results.

Zach Parise and Andy Greene said the team was disappointed to lose its home games despite creating scoring chances, but hoped to refocus and rebound. They cited missed chances and turnovers as problems, while saying road travel could help the team focus. They described the opponent as hard-forechecking with a strong penalty kill and said better execution, sharper passing and more shots were needed. Greene said the team had an upbeat practice and was ready for the game.

The passage argues that Marine Le Pen’s chances in France’s presidential election could improve as rival François Fillon faces a payroll scandal and unrest follows a young man’s allegation of police rape. The officers have not been charged, and an internal investigation called the incident an accident. Nearly 250 people have been arrested amid protests against police brutality. The author suggests further unrest could benefit Le Pen’s anti-immigration, tough-on-crime campaign, while still considering her victory unlikely.

Citadel Securities hired Anthony Cronin to lead European Treasuries trading, extending its market-making coverage across Europe, parts of Asia and the Middle East. The firm is expanding its dollar-rates business and expects its roughly 100 Treasuries clients in Asia and Europe to double this year. It traded $6 trillion in Treasuries in 2017, up from $5 trillion in 2016. Citadel Securities may seek primary-dealer status after adding the required products.
TCI Fund Management valued Zodiac Aerospace at 7–10 euros per share after its first-half loss and urged Safran to abandon its takeover bid, arguing that an offer above 10 euros would destroy value.
Dwyane Wade, Gabrielle Union and Wade’s son Zion visited Miami’s Frost Museum of Science, enjoying a planetarium show, fish and stingrays. Wade also responded to a critic on Twitter.

University of Kansas researcher Brock Ternes surveyed 864 Kansans and found that well ownership was significantly associated with increased watering during droughts, though conservation varied by well type. He said well owners may use groundwater to sustain crops when rainfall is inadequate, despite being more aware of their water supplies. His findings suggest researchers should study well owners as a distinct group when examining drought responses.

The passage describes an autonomous vehicle management system designed to perform operations safely. It uses sensor data to maintain an internal map of the vehicle and its environment, then plans and controls actions according to goals and safety considerations. The system can simulate possible future scenarios, adjust sensor behavior to obtain relevant data, and use AI models for perception and planning. It also assesses confidence in AI predictions, provides safeguards for reinforcement-learning decisions, and can communicate planned actions and their reasons to users.

Leon Cooperman says the bull market has entered a risky stage marked by crowd-driven buying and excessive valuations, particularly for artificial intelligence companies. The S&P 500 has risen almost 40% from its April lows, while the Buffett Indicator stands at 217%. Despite his concerns about stocks, Cooperman considers government bonds riskier because inflation erodes their returns.
The SEC phase establishes 32-bit execution and a stack using AMD_ENABLE_UEFI_STACK. A PEIM initializes processor components and publishes the AmdCpuEarlyInit PPI.

Several school districts approved teacher raises before finding they lacked the funds to pay for them. Philadelphia sought permission to borrow up to $1.5 billion amid a state budget impasse. Baltimore County and Fairfax County renegotiated promised raises after funding shortfalls. Chicago considered delaying raises but approved a budget that closed its $734 million gap and said it would meet its contract obligations.
Tippecanoe Middle School released its principal’s list and honor roll for sixth-, seventh- and eighth-grade students for the second grading period of the 2017–18 school year.

C-BerryTrans is a GPL-licensed C++ program that calculates Berry curvature, anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) and anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC) directly from WIEN2k eigenvalues and momentum-matrix elements, without Wannier interpolation. It integrates Berry curvature over the full Brillouin zone, using occupation weighting for AHC and entropy-related weighting for ANC. OpenMP parallelization, batched k-point processing and binary storage support dense meshes; stored curvature enables faster calculations across temperature and chemical-potential ranges. The code was tested on Fe, Pd, Fe3Al and Co2FeAl against reported values. Its intrinsic-response framework does not capture extrinsic scattering mechanisms.

The passage describes methods for ACK/NACK feedback when a user equipment (UE) receives transmissions from multiple transmission reception points (TRPs). A base station can tell the UE when to monitor each TRP’s control channel, whether feedback may be bundled, how to bundle it, and whether downlink assignment indices count grants jointly or separately across TRPs. The UE uses this information to determine its feedback codebook and sends either joint ACK/NACK feedback or separate feedback for individual TRPs.

The November 17, 2000 VentureWire reports layoffs at govWorks, Whitney & Co.’s plan for a $2.5 billion global fund, and a merger between PlanetOut and Gay.com’s parent company. It covers numerous financing rounds, including Tridium’s $20 million round funded equally by Enron North America and kRoad Ventures. Other items include BeautyJungle’s closure, TheStreet.com’s shutdown of its U.K. venture, acquisitions, executive appointments, and new venture capital funds.

Seven children awaiting Big Brothers Big Sisters mentors assembled new bicycles with local law enforcement officers and other volunteers in Hamilton. Organizers said the event offered teamwork and mentoring while helping build bridges between Trenton children and law enforcement. Each team will also build a bicycle to donate to another child. A community foundation grant funded the materials.

CompareCards compares credit cards offering introductory 0% APR periods, cash back, travel rewards and sign-up bonuses. The listed offers have different eligibility requirements, balance-transfer fees and variable APRs after introductory periods end. The site says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not influence its ratings or reviews.

World stocks and the dollar rose on Monday as U.S.-North Korea tensions eased after driving sharp losses the previous week. European and most Asian shares gained, while U.S. futures pointed to a higher open. Japanese shares fell despite strong second-quarter growth, amid concern about the yen’s recent rise. The dollar recovered against the yen and Swiss franc, and government bond yields rose as investors considered what stronger growth could mean for central-bank policies. Softer-than-forecast Chinese economic data weighed on oil prices.

The Single/Double Offense uses double and down screens to free shooters, creating open shots if defenders fail to disrupt the screens. The passage describes two defensive approaches. NBA teams generally prefer “show and recover” over switching to avoid leaving smaller defenders against bigger post players: defenders force shooters wide, then recover to deny passes to screeners, while teammates pressure the ball and protect the weak side. An aggressive alternative uses switches and wing traps to disrupt the offense’s planned routes. Defenders deny passes, rotate to cover the post and weak side, and may trap a post player who receives the ball on a mismatch.

The passage proposes a hybrid method for analyzing antennas interacting with large structures. It models the environment with the method of moments and represents the antenna with a generalized scattering matrix, reducing the need to include antenna details in the larger numerical system. It develops coupling through equivalent currents and spherical-wave expansions, and describes variants for reflectors and structures suited to spherical-wave modeling.

UBS says it will continue increasing dividends and buying back shares despite Swiss regulators’ calls for larger capital buffers following its Credit Suisse takeover. CEO Sergio Ermotti said the bank has time to build capital without restricting payouts. UBS plans a $2 billion share repurchase programme from mid-2025 to 2027 and expects to complete systems consolidation in Switzerland by early 2026.

Reykjavik has endured an unusually wet, gray summer, with rain every day in May and just 70 hours of sunshine in June. Meteorologists must look back to 1914 for a worse May and June. High pressure bringing heat to parts of Europe has shifted clouds and rain toward Iceland. The weather has prompted last-minute beach holiday bookings and hurt some outdoor businesses, though campers at a Reykjavik site have generally adjusted.

Swiss Economic Affairs Minister Johann Schneider-Ammann said his ministry would consider arms-industry requests for longer export licences and permission to export to countries in internal armed conflict. The industry says current rules threaten jobs and disadvantage it against European competitors. A campaign group warned that easing the rules would undermine Swiss neutrality.

Russian authorities seized the American bark *Cape Horn Pigeon* while it was cruising for whales and took it to Vladivostok. Captain Scullun said his crew was left without food or shelter; Russian naval authorities said he had declined what was offered. The Russian ministry disputed his claimed $45,000 in lost profits and proposed $2,500 for actual losses from the temporary detention. A U.S. diplomat requested an investigation and assistance for the crew. Russia later reported the bark’s release and said the inquiry into the crew’s treatment was continuing.

Louisville officials advise residents not to set off neighborhood fireworks on Independence Day. Fireworks smoke can worsen air quality and respiratory problems; airborne and exploding fireworks are illegal in city limits. Fireworks smoke last pushed Louisville above federal pollution limits on Independence Day in 2015.

The lecture uses the Weierstrass M-test to show that power series converge uniformly on closed intervals strictly inside their radius of convergence. There, they can be integrated and differentiated term by term; the differentiated series has the same radius of convergence.

It then proves the Weierstrass approximation theorem: every continuous function on [0, 1] is the uniform limit of polynomials. The proof constructs polynomials using normalized kernels that concentrate near zero and shows they converge uniformly to the function.

Apple’s 2019 Form 10-K reports net sales of $260.2 billion, down 2% from 2018, and net income of $55.3 billion. Lower iPhone sales drove the decline, partly offset by growth in Services and Wearables, Home and Accessories. Total gross margin fell to 37.8% from 38.3%. Apple repurchased $67.1 billion of stock and paid $14.1 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the year. The filing describes Apple’s products, services and geographic segments, and identifies risks including competition, component supply constraints, trade disputes, currency fluctuations, data security and legal proceedings.

Markets turned risk-off despite stronger-than-expected corporate earnings. GDP exceeded forecasts, but tariff-related distortions complicated its interpretation, while weak consumer spending, disappointing payroll growth and sharp downward revisions raised concerns about economic slowing. The Fed signaled patience amid inflation and labor-market uncertainty, even as markets increasingly expected rate cuts. Major indexes fell, and weakening volume, market breadth and sector performance pointed to a possible correction.

The court held that earlier use of a similar overhead railway defeated the patent’s first three claims. It found the fourth claim, covering a track with branches, a switch, and a traveler, valid and infringed by the defendant’s railway.
Justice Wolfe delivered the opinion in two cases; it was filed April 7, 1932.

In his address, President Trump argued that national sovereignty and patriotism are essential to freedom and peace. He highlighted U.S. economic policies and called for fairer trade, criticizing China’s trade practices and urging reform of the World Trade Organization. He defended sanctions on Iran, called for North Korea to denuclearize, and said the United States would continue seeking peace in Afghanistan. He advocated stronger borders and regional cooperation against human smuggling, condemned Venezuela’s government, and rejected socialism. He also described U.S. efforts to protect free speech, religious liberty and LGBTQ people, advance women’s economic opportunities, and uphold national authority over abortion and gun rights.

Kenyon College’s Whiteness Group, run through its multicultural center, aims to educate students about whiteness and encourage anti-racist action. Its rules invite unpopular opinions but prohibit white members from asking people of color questions, directing them to seek answers themselves. Founder Juniper Cruz said the goal is sustainable activism beyond social media posts. About 50 students attended the first meeting.

A majority of Supreme Court justices appeared skeptical of Colorado’s ban on conversion therapy for minors during arguments in a challenge brought by counselor Kaley Chiles. Chiles argues the law discriminates against her speech; Colorado says it regulates a medical treatment associated with harm. The justices also questioned whether Chiles can sue when the state has not enforced the ban against her. Several suggested that, if the law receives stricter constitutional review, lower courts should consider it first.

A citizen science study collected 50 household tap-water samples across 19 Chinese provinces or regions from December 2020 to August 2021. Microbial DNA was detected in 22 samples. Sequencing revealed diverse microbial communities and detected potentially pathogenic bacteria in every PCR-positive sample. Samples collected after the 2021 Henan floods and Typhoon In-Fa contained pathogenic species or toxin-producing cyanobacteria. The study was limited in sample size and had not been peer reviewed.

The speaker recalls disappointment at falling short in the finals but happiness for his brother’s win. Playing together has been rewarding, especially spending time with family off the ice. He credits his line’s trust and continuity, and says strong goaltending has been crucial for both teams.
Sixteen years after a crash near the Mexican border left a young Mexican man unidentified and in a vegetative state, a woman saw his photo online and asked whether he might be her cousin Gilberto.

Quarters coverage uses four deep defenders and three underneath defenders, allowing safeties to help against both passes and runs. The passage identifies the flats and deep middle as its main vulnerabilities. Offenses can test outside linebackers with routes to the flats, use play-action to exploit safeties who react to runs, and draw safeties away from the middle. Overload concepts can also create one-on-one matchups and strain defenders’ assignments. Five example plays illustrate these approaches.

DDR2/DDR3 controller data strobes synchronize transfers for each byte of the 32-bit bus, acting as outputs during writes and inputs during reads. The passage lists DDR[0] on-die termination and DDR[1] terminal functions. It also describes internal pullups and pulldowns that are enabled during reset and disabled or changed when reset is released.

Dr. Pasvolsky said respect for treaties was inherent in the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals but could be stated explicitly. The Honduran ambassador supported its inclusion, while the Chilean ambassador questioned whether the principle was already part of international law. After correcting the previous meeting’s minutes, participants discussed the Security Council. Pasvolsky said it must be both effective and representative, with more nonpermanent than permanent members, and advised against prescribing selection rules at this stage. The Brazilian ambassador called for permanent Latin American representation and emphasized the proposed organization’s preventive purpose.

Child care academies in at least 11 North Carolina counties offer two- to six-week, low-cost training to help address educator shortages. One model prepares graduates to work in licensed child care facilities; another provides a transferable credential qualifying them as lead teachers. Programs are run through local partnerships and funded by grants and other sources. A $1.476 million state expansion pilot passed the House but was not included in the legislation signed in August. Separate grants of up to $50,000 are available for as many as 10 colleges or universities to run academies in 2025–26.

The passage describes an automated object-sortation system intended to reduce reliance on manual sorting and fixed bin assignments. Robots acquire and identify objects, then place them in intermediate bins dynamically assigned to destinations. A controller can reassign bins after they are emptied, using information about incoming objects, bin contents and sorting activity. Embodiments use conveyors, cameras and shuttle carriages to move objects to bins, with multiple sorting stations available to increase capacity.
Caffeine levels vary across coffee chains. The passage reports 9 mg for McDonald’s coffee, 12.7 mg for Dunkin’ Donuts, 16.7 mg for Peet’s, 20.6 mg for Starbucks, and 54.2 mg per ounce for Deathwish.

In *Morris v. Scott*, the court held that a malicious-prosecution action may proceed even if the original court lacked jurisdiction, provided malice and falsehood are the basis of the claim and arrest is alleged as a consequence. It reversed the nonsuit, ruling that Morris’s offered evidence should have been admitted, and ordered a new trial.

The post-election stock rally faces risks from historically high valuations and uncertainty over whether the Trump administration can deliver tax cuts, infrastructure spending and deregulation after its healthcare bill failed. Confidence has risen, but economic growth forecasts remain weak, while some Federal Reserve officials have flagged expensive assets and possible faster tightening. The author argues that current valuations imply poor future returns and expects piecemeal tax reform rather than a broad rise in growth and inflation.

The lecture introduces smart contracts as digitally specified promises carried out through protocols, while noting that they may be neither legally binding contracts nor especially “smart.” It contrasts Ethereum’s account-based, programmable design and changeable monetary policy with Bitcoin’s transaction-based design, then surveys decentralized applications and initial coin offerings. The lecturer reports limited dApp use and substantial ICO failures and fraud concerns.

Larry Lessig explains that law can impose terms on contracts and determine whether they are enforceable, even when performance is automated. Smart contracts may reduce enforcement and transaction costs, but code can conflict with legal policy. Requiring every outcome to be specified could also make some contracts harder to negotiate, since ambiguity can be useful. The discussion closes with questions about verifying real-world events, whether blockchain adds value, and how courts and lawyers will interpret code.

Pompey expect to be asked by the Football Association about smoke bombs released by Charlton fans during Saturday’s 1-0 defeat at Fratton Park. The club could be fined if the FA is dissatisfied with its handling of the incidents. Chief executive Mark Catlin said smoke bombs are prohibited and can be difficult to detect.

The passage describes GHCB communication between SEV-ES or SEV-SNP guests and hypervisors. SEV-SNP guests must register a vCPU’s GHCB guest physical address before using it and may request a preferred address or unregister one. Negotiation examples show guests determining the encryption bit, configuring shared GHCB pages, and using VMGEXIT.

For non-automatic exits, guests provide required state through GHCB fields and mark valid fields in a bitmap; hypervisors return results or errors. The passage also specifies handling for I/O, MSR and MMIO accesses, page state changes, and SEV-SNP firmware guest requests. Page state changes track progress so interrupted requests can resume. Firmware requests use shared request and response pages, with precautions concerning response validation, rate limiting, and message sequence numbers.
