Three former D.C. corrections employees alleged they were fired for speaking to the media about halfway-house conditions. Before trial, the parties tentatively agreed to a $625,000 payment, but disputed whether settlement also required the plaintiffs’ re-enrollment in the retirement system. The court found no mutual agreement on that material term and denied the motion to enforce the settlement, including as to one plaintiff separately. It gave the plaintiffs until September 9, 2002, to accept $625,000 without retirement benefits or reject the offer and proceed toward trial.

The passage describes lower highs and lower lows as a downtrend pattern that its backtests treat as a short-term reversal signal. Tests entered long after one or more consecutive daily bars with lower highs and lows, then exited after a set holding period. Across SPY, GLD, and TLT, longer holding periods generally produced higher average returns. Additional weak days slightly improved SPY results but did little for GLD or TLT. A three-day SPY test increased average gains and profit factor.

After two days to regroup, the team wants to improve by putting more traffic in front of Roberto to make scoring easier. Having learned from the first game, they hope to win the next one, return home with a split, and regain confidence.

Niantic will add 80 second-generation Pokémon to Pokémon Go later this week, bringing the game’s second-generation total to 88. The update will also introduce berries that slow Pokémon or increase Candy from successful catches, new avatar clothing, and new ways Pokémon react during battles. Twelve second-generation Pokémon, including six legendaries, will remain unavailable.

Collagen production declines with age, prompting interest in supplements for skin, bone and joint health. Supplements are commonly sourced from animals, including fish, cows, pigs and chickens; hydrolysed collagen may be easier to digest and absorb. Studies suggest potential benefits for skin, nails, bones, joints and muscles, but research is ongoing, and evidence for hair growth is limited to mice. Dosage depends on the intended benefit. A balanced diet rich in nutrients needed to make collagen is described as the most reliable way to support the body’s natural collagen levels.

The Midline Option has the quarterback read an interior defensive lineman and either hand off to a fullback running through the A-gap or keep the ball through the B-gap. Reading rather than blocking that defender is its main advantage; its main risk is exposing the quarterback to frequent hits. Against both 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, blocking assignments create lanes while wingback motion can suggest a veer play. Variations include a Flexbone formation with a receiver instead of a tight end and Midline “Follow,” which adds a wingback as a lead blocker in short-yardage situations.

Backtests using ETFs tracking German stocks (EWG) and the Euro Stoxx 50 (FEZ) found stronger performance around Christmas than during an average week. Average gains per trade were 2.1% for EWG and 1.5% for FEZ, with 81% win rates for both. Recent returns were weaker than earlier results, and the article cautions that past performance does not guarantee a future rally.

At IHRMP’s ninth graduation ceremony in Accra, President Dr. Edward Kwapong urged HR practitioners to prioritize professional certification over academic qualifications. The institute graduated 136 associate and nine certified members. Guest speaker Irene Asare said AI, robotics and people can work together to improve organizational productivity.

Trend Micro found 89 malicious Chrome extensions affecting more than 423,000 users and forming the Droidclub botnet. The extensions displayed ads and injected session-replay scripts into visited sites, potentially exposing information entered into forms. An earlier version also secretly mined cryptocurrency. Droidclub made its extensions difficult to report or uninstall. After Trend Micro contacted Google and Cloudflare, the extensions were removed from the Chrome Web Store and disabled on affected users’ devices.

In a controlled malaria infection study of 19 semi-immune Gambian men, researchers examined how pre-existing immunity relates to *P. falciparum* var gene expression. Volunteers with stronger antibody responses generally had lower peak parasite levels and expressed a narrower range of var genes; the two participants who best controlled infection were in this group. Var expression changed rapidly during infection. In culture, parasite samples tended toward a diverse expression pattern, though samples from volunteers with stronger antibody responses converged more slowly. Pre-existing antibodies against PfEMP1 domains were moderately associated with reduced expression of corresponding var genes. Volunteers with weaker initial responses gained recognition of many more PfEMP1 domains after infection, but antibody gains were not clearly linked to the intensity of var gene expression. The research is a preprint that has not been peer reviewed.

Tesla delivered the first 30 Model 3 cars to employee buyers, and CEO Elon Musk said advance reservations exceeded 500,000. The base model costs $35,000 and travels 220 miles per charge; a $44,000 version has a 310-mile range. Musk warned that early production would be difficult as Tesla aims to build 500,000 vehicles next year, nearly six times its 2016 output. Production problems could increase financial risks, while steady deliveries could help the loss-making company fund its operations.

Soccer formations arrange players to defend and attack. Coaches choose them based on team size, player skills, and their ability to teach the tactics. In 11-a-side games, formation numbers list the ten field players as defenders, midfielders, and forwards; for example, 4-3-3 means four defenders, three midfielders, and three forwards. Youth games use the same shorthand, though smaller teams may need different arrangements. U.S. Soccer recommends formations for several age groups. Coaches should explain and diagram how their chosen formation will work.

Twelve-year-old Billy Caldwell’s return to Northern Ireland from London has been delayed despite a short-term Home Office licence for cannabis oil to treat his epilepsy. His mother says the licence needs ratification by Northern Ireland’s Department of Health before they can travel. The department says it is working to resolve the matter promptly.

Hubble imaged NGC 6000, a spiral galaxy 102 million light-years away in Scorpius. Its yellow center contains older stars, while its blue spiral arms host young, massive stars. The image was taken during a survey of supernova sites and also shows four streaks from an asteroid crossing Hubble’s field of view.

On May 12, 2021, Amazon closed the sale of $18.5 billion in notes maturing from 2023 to 2061. The aggregate public offering price was $18.437 billion, with estimated net proceeds of $18.395 billion before offering expenses. Amazon intends to allocate an amount equal to the net proceeds from its $1 billion sustainability notes to eligible green or social projects.
William Riley’s petition for certiorari was dismissed after his death. All the justices concurred.

Thirteen-year-old Time for Kids reporter Benje Choucroun asked White House press secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders what the administration had done and would do to prevent school shootings. Sanders, her voice quavering, said the administration took school safety seriously and that a presidential commission was meeting to discuss ways to protect students.

IDC says HPCaaS will become more important for global hybrid collaboration amid labor shortages and digitalization. Effective collaboration requires integrated, data-based development and a shared information source, while upgrading engineering workstations is costly.
A webinar on October 18, 2017, will examine how recruitment metrics, HR strategy, and candidate experience can improve hiring productivity, quality, and retention. It does not offer CEU credit.

Eric Thames homered for a club record-tying fifth straight game, breaking a third-inning tie as the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Chicago Cubs 6-3 on Monday. Ryan Braun and Jeff Bandy also homered. Chase Anderson earned the win, and Neftali Felix recorded his fifth save. Milwaukee has won six of seven games, while Chicago has lost four straight.

In his inaugural address, the speaker pledges to serve only one term and to limit executive power. He describes the Constitution as a grant of restricted authority from the people, with individual rights and powers reserved to the states. He would use the veto chiefly to protect the Constitution, guard against hasty legislation, and defend minorities. He also calls for congressional control of revenue, limits on political activity by federal officers, a free press, and protection of District of Columbia residents’ rights. Opposing an exclusively metallic currency, he urges harmony among the states, restraint in party conflict, peaceful foreign relations, and justice toward Indigenous peoples.
After losing a one-goal lead, the team held on without collapsing. The speaker considered the game balanced and credited Sergei’s timely goal with the win.

Riverton Investment Corporation sought a tax refund after the IRS disallowed deductions for payments to buy back employees’ stock, treating them as stock redemptions rather than compensation. The court found the stock agreement ambiguous and admitted evidence showing that permanent restrictions on resale price and ownership prevented a stock transfer for tax purposes. Because the later payments were not redemptions, the court granted summary judgment to Riverton and denied the United States’ motions.

Distributed-system patterns help developers learn from prior experience, establish a shared vocabulary, and build reusable components. On a single machine, containers can be separated to isolate resources, define ownership, and simplify updates. Sidecars add functionality to applications; ambassadors broker their external connections; and adapters provide consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, or health checks.

Across machines, replicated load-balanced services improve availability and scale. They can use readiness checks, session tracking, caching, and SSL termination. Sharded services divide requests and state among machines when one machine cannot hold all the data. Sharded caches can use storage more efficiently than replicated caches, but shard failures or upgrades may affect performance. Replicating individual shards improves resilience at the cost of greater complexity.

Six teachers at two schools were suspended after surprise visits by Education Minister Th Radheshyam. Three had used an unauthorized private building and failed to hold normal classes; three were absent without notice.

Conformis shares fell 6.47% in the most recent session and closed at $1.30. Six analysts’ 12-month price targets average $5, ranging from $4 to $6. Among seven recommendations, two are Buy, one Outperform, three Hold and one Underperform. The stock’s 14-period average true range is 0.16, with weekly volatility of 7.15% and monthly volatility of 6.12%. Its relative strength index is 18.89. Conformis has a market capitalization of $56.95 million and 43.81 million shares outstanding.

Facebook announced it has hired the team behind London-based Bloomsbury AI, whose technology reads documents and answers questions about them. Facebook said the team will strengthen its natural-language processing research. TechCrunch reported that Facebook was interested in the technology for combating fake news and other content issues.

Patrick Cullen, 33, was sentenced to four years in prison, with the final year suspended, for robbing a 21-year-old woman of her handbag on Wolfe Tone Street on July 11. She fell and cut her finger while resisting. The court heard Cullen admitted the offence, and the handbag was recovered.

LeBron James says entering his 23rd NBA season on an expiring Lakers contract will not affect his play. He is excited about the team’s additions and says success will require daily attention to detail. Still recovering from a knee sprain and managing recurring foot issues, he may have limited participation in training camp as he prepares for the season. James has not set a retirement date; he says his decision will depend on his health and whether he remains motivated by the preparation.

A creditor obtained a judgment for family necessaries against a married woman and levied on her land without first obtaining a judgment and unsatisfied execution against her husband. The court held that this statutory prerequisite to liability of her property was unmet and affirmed the injunction against the levy and sale.

Using evaluations from nine experts, the study applied the spherical fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to rank factors affecting online higher education quality in Vietnam. Pedagogical integration ranked first (23.6%), followed by student engagement (21.2%), digital resource accessibility (20.3%), adaptability and innovation (18.4%), and technological infrastructure (16.5%). The authors recommend combining teaching methods with technology while improving engagement and equitable access. They note that expert evaluations may not capture other stakeholders’ perspectives.

Mike Hoffman scored the only goal of a six-round shootout, using a one-handed move to give the Ottawa Senators a 4-3 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday. Rookie Colin White earned his first NHL point with an assist on Matt Duchene’s goal. Defenceman Johnny Oduya earned a $250,000 bonus by playing his 41st game of the season. Coach Guy Boucher praised Flyers centre Sean Couturier, whom he coached in junior hockey. Calgary Flames scout Don Maloney attended the game amid reported interest in Ottawa’s Zack Smith and Jean-Gabriel Pageau.

The Mets missed the playoffs after a strong start and late-season pitching struggles. Kodai Senga made one start last year because of injuries and struggled this season, including in Triple-A. GM David Stearns said he could not count on Senga making 30 starts next year.
At 0134 GMT on Feb. 2, the ringgit led daily gains against the dollar, rising 0.4%. It was up 4.12% in 2018, while the peso was down 3.39%.

South Carolina biologists satellite-tagged Harry-Etta, an 820-pound tiger shark, in St. Helena Sound. An ultrasound confirmed she is pregnant—the first known pregnant tiger shark among the 15 the team has satellite-tagged in the state. Researchers hope to track her movements to learn about tiger shark migration and habitats used during gestation. The public can follow her on OCEARCH’s Global Shark Tracker.

A review of more than 140 studies reports that people ingest an estimated 39,000–52,000 microplastic particles annually, while bottled-water drinkers may ingest 90,000 more than tap-water drinkers. Plastic bottles can shed particles during production, storage, transport and use. These particles may enter the bloodstream and organs and are linked to several health risks, but long-term effects remain poorly understood. Researcher Sarah Sajedi calls for greater public education and attention to single-use water bottles.

On January 5, 1838, President Martin Van Buren warned that U.S. citizens were increasingly aiding insurgents in Canada, including an armed force at Navy Island. He urged those involved to return home and said unlawful interference would bring arrest and punishment, with no assistance from the U.S. government.

Offensive linemen create running lanes and protect the quarterback, making their coordinated play central to an offense’s success. The five players must communicate and adjust to defensive formations and pressure while using strength, technique, athleticism, and awareness. Though they rarely receive the attention given to skill-position players, they are often blamed when an offense struggles. The passage names Jim Otto, John Hannah, and Anthony Munoz as notable offensive linemen.

As programs grew more complex, object-oriented patterns provided reusable designs and a shared vocabulary. Open source communities further highlighted software development as a collaborative effort. Distributed-system patterns offer technology-independent guidance, help developers learn from prior work, and support reusable components.

The passage describes three single-node container patterns. Sidecars augment applications, for example by adding HTTPS, synchronizing configuration, or providing monitoring tools. Ambassadors broker an application’s external connections, including routing to sharded storage and splitting requests for experiments. Adapters make differing applications conform to common monitoring, logging, or health-check interfaces.

For multi-node systems, microservices allow components to be developed and scaled independently but make design and debugging harder. Replicated, load-balanced services provide redundancy and scale; readiness probes keep unprepared replicas from receiving traffic. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharded services divide requests or data among machines, increasing storage capacity but making failures and upgrades more consequential. Replicating individual shards can improve resilience.

In a study of 81 healthy adults, researchers applied electrical stimulation to the prefrontal cortex for 20 minutes or gave a control group 30 seconds of low-current pulses. The next day, stimulated participants reported lower likelihoods of committing physical or sexual assault and judged both acts more morally wrong than the control group did. A researcher not involved in the study cautioned that lower stated intentions do not establish a reduction in actual violence.

A fossil found by elk hunter David Bradt in Montana in 2010 has been identified as a new species of elasmosaur that lived about 70 million years ago. Unlike most elasmosaurs, it had a neck about 7½ feet long rather than up to 18 feet. The nearly complete fossil, described in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology, challenges assumptions about how elasmosaur necks evolved.

After a webinar hosted by three accreditors, the author welcomes their proposed “default to yes” approach to transfer credits but finds it unclear what would change in practice. The accreditors are urging, not requiring, colleges to accept more credits, and the author argues that competition among accreditors makes mandates harder to impose. AI could speed up transcript reviews and let students receive transfer-credit decisions alongside admission and financial aid offers. The author supports the direction of the shift but wants a concrete plan.

Coach Sutter said the series has been close, with breaks and first goals shaping the games. He praised his team’s first period but said they must finish their chances and limit goals against. He described one goal as a screened shot following a missed coverage assignment and said the home team faces pressure.

The seventh annual Julia’s Hope Cup and Carnival takes place Feb. 17 at Chippawa Park in Welland. Created in memory of Julia Turner, it raises money for The Hope Centre. The event includes pond hockey, a tournament for children ages six to 12, food, games and a silent auction. Last year, it raised $20,000.

CBS drama *Doubt* premieres February 15 at 10/9c. At Isaiah Roth and Associates, attorney Sadie Ellis defends pediatric surgeon Billy Brennan against a murder accusation stemming from 24 years earlier while grappling with her feelings for him and her professional duty.

The lecture develops algebraic tools for studying finite fields and Reed–Solomon codes. It defines subgroups and cosets, shows that distinct cosets partition a group, and uses this to explain why a subgroup’s size divides the size of a finite group. Coset addition produces quotient groups, including the integers modulo \(n\).

A field has an abelian group under addition, an abelian group of nonzero elements under multiplication, and a distributive law. Integers modulo a prime form a finite field; every finite field of prime size is isomorphic to one of these. Every finite field also contains a prime subfield, whose size is its characteristic. The lecture then defines polynomials over a field, explains their addition and multiplication, and shows that only nonzero constant polynomials have multiplicative inverses.
Houston Dash captain Carli Lloyd injured her ankle against FC Kansas City. X-rays were negative, and the team has not said how many games she may miss.

Jersey defended well after taking the lead, and the speaker’s team struggled to create offense. With Peter unavailable, they will focus on playing a solid road game and building on their effective power play.

Two teenagers who allegedly stole a van from the Smoky Mountain Children’s Home were arrested Sunday after a police chase across East Tennessee ended in a crash near Chickamauga Dam. Authorities reported no serious injuries.

A security aide to Ebonyi Governor David Umahi allegedly slapped an FRSC officer during an argument over access to the PDP convention venue. The FRSC said it had received no official report. Newsmen also observed security personnel taking money to admit people without accreditation.

Cirque du Soleil will donate US$500,000 to families of the Las Vegas shooting victims and give 5,000 show tickets, valued at US$500,000, to first responders. It also plans to raise more funds at a benefit show.

The OS can bind a driver to the ACPI-defined TMPM device using HID AMDI0095. A page migration driver must enable PAGEMIGRATION_EN in every available IOMMU. TMPM uses a mailbox-backed ring buffer for parallel commands, whose execution order is not guaranteed. Firmware advances the read pointer on completion; PM_Status TOGGLE signals completion of RB_Ctl changes.

WIRED discusses five stories: Death threats prompted Rutgers professor Mark Bray to try to leave the US, but his flight reservation was canceled for reasons that remain unclear. ICE is seeking contractors for a proposed round-the-clock social media surveillance program. A study found that AI companion chatbots used emotionally manipulative responses to goodbye messages 37 percent of the time. Parents seeking information about leucovorin after an FDA announcement encountered confusion and misinformation in a Facebook group. An OpenAI post about its internal tools coincided with declines in several software companies’ shares, prompting discussion of whether AI infrastructure spending signals a bubble.

In his first Independence Day eve address as president, Ram Nath Kovind paid tribute to freedom fighters and urged citizens to help build a “New India” by 2022. He called for shared responsibility in keeping the country clean, ending open defecation, supporting girls’ education, helping people access government schemes and educating underprivileged children. Kovind also urged people to follow laws and pay taxes, saying GST would simplify transactions and demonetisation had supported efforts to build an honest society.

GoDaddy gave The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain, citing a terms-of-service violation after the neo-Nazi website published an article denigrating Heather Heyer, who was killed during violence surrounding a white nationalist rally in Charlottesville.

Former Southport MP John Pugh fears Homebase’s closure and a planned 60,000 sq ft Sainsbury’s at Meols Cop could lead to further job losses as town-centre shops face competition. Sainsbury’s proposes creating 400 jobs, but Pugh says Sefton Council’s support for the store could harm the town centre.

A 12-month study of more than 24,000 Slimming World members with obesity found that those who set the most ambitious weight-loss goals lost an average of 19% of their body weight, compared with 11% among those aiming to lose less than 10%. Researchers suggest reconsidering guidance that favors realistic targets and emphasize the importance of regular support.

Tesla’s 2021 Form 10-K describes two segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. Its products include electric vehicles, solar energy systems, and Powerwall and Megapack batteries. Tesla sells vehicles directly, operates charging and service networks, and manufactures in California, Nevada, New York and Shanghai, with factories in Berlin and Texas planned to begin production in 2022. The filing discusses technology development, government incentives, regulation, competition and its 99,290 full-time employees. It identifies risks including pandemic-related disruptions, supply shortages, production delays, expansion costs, product defects and liability claims.

WIRED tested carry-on suitcases, personal-item bags, duffels, and backpacks on flights, assessing size, weight, durability, wheels, handles, and zippers. Its picks include the lightweight, affordable Travelpro Maxlite 5; the expandable Peak Design Roller Pro; durable Rimowa and Briggs & Riley cases; and bags suited to children, under-seat storage, or backpacking. The guide advises travelers to check their airline’s size limits before buying. It notes that quality hardware and warranty coverage matter more than whether a suitcase has a soft or hard shell.

In a forwarded October 5, 2000, *Inside UT Football* newsletter, Dallas Morning News writer Chip Brown discusses the upcoming Texas–Oklahoma game and answers readers’ questions about Texas’s quarterback rotation, offense, defense, special teams, injuries, coaching criticism and future prospects. Brown predicts a 24–20 Texas win.

Attendance at Biloxi Shuckers’ opening series rose 21 percent from last year. A Johnny Davis catch featured as SportsCenter’s top play. The team returns to MGM Park April 22, with a benefit jersey auction and new weekly promotions.

Long snappers deliver quick, accurate snaps to holders for extra points and field goals at about 7 yards and to punters at about 15 yards. They also cover punts and may make tackles. The role requires consistency, balance, athleticism and physicality; NFL teams reserve one roster spot for it. Errant snaps can lead to missed field goals or blocked punts.

Colorado’s Prescription Drug Affordability Board voted to cap what government agencies and commercial health plans pay for Amgen’s arthritis drug Enbrel at $600 per unit. That equals about $30,350 per person annually, compared with roughly $53,000 paid by the average state insurance plan in 2023.

Shelley Corman asked Ricki Winters to add a contact after receiving a forwarded PAKK adoption digest. Its 24 messages discuss discounted airfare to Kazakhstan and Russia, accommodations, HIV-testing requirements, travel to Taraz, and differing views on adjusting adopted children’s ages or school placement.

Researchers developed a 15-item, approximately 10-minute Language Phenotype Assessment (LPA) to measure command, modifier, and syntactic comprehension using physical objects. In 116 typically developing children, half attained these levels by ages 1.6, 3.0, and 3.7 years, respectively; all attained the syntactic level by age five. The LPA showed high internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and inter-observer agreement, and its scores correlated with a parent-reported checklist. Among children with autism aged five or older, 39% attained the syntactic level on the LPA. The authors propose the assessment for identifying and monitoring language deficits. The study is a preprint that has not been peer reviewed.

The Trump administration’s nuclear policy review largely retains Obama-era plans to modernize the U.S. arsenal and adhere to existing arms-control agreements, without calling for a net increase in strategic nuclear weapons. It takes a tougher stance toward Russia, proposing smaller-yield warheads on some submarine-launched missiles and, later, a nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile to deter a limited nuclear attack in Europe. The review also identifies North Korea as a grave threat and China as a potential nuclear adversary. Arms-control groups criticized the policy, warning that it could blur the line between nuclear and conventional warfare.
In a satirical account, ministers negotiating with the DUP consider abolishing line dancing after rejecting other concessions. A Brexit supporter welcomes the idea.

Lexus priced both UK versions of the 2017 LC coupe—the V8 LC500 and hybrid LC500h—from £76,595. The LC500 produces 467hp, while the LC500h produces 354hp. More than a third of this year’s UK allocation has been pre-ordered. Optional Sport and Sport+ packages add styling and performance features.

The passage describes a robotic transport system with a multi-gripper end effector whose vacuum regions can operate independently. Image data helps identify target objects, select gripping regions, and plan movement between pickup and drop-off locations. The system can grip and release multiple objects simultaneously or sequentially. Vision, force, and pressure sensors can monitor object positions and gripping strength; if a grip is insufficient, the robot can attempt to regrip the object or stop the transfer.

An EducationNext poll found support for forming charter schools fell from 51% to 39% in one year, while support for vouchers and tax-credit scholarships rose. The charter decline crossed party and racial lines. Republicans were more likely to support an issue when told Trump backed it, while Democrats were less likely, but his overall influence was nearly nil. Despite partisan differences on school choice, similar shares of Republicans and Democrats gave their local public schools an A or B.

The Fraser Institute will release a study on February 16 examining whether British Columbia’s carbon tax revenues are offset by other tax reductions, as promised when the tax was introduced in 2008. The study comes as provinces face a federal carbon-pricing requirement by 2018.

The De’Longhi Rivelia automatic latte maker is $200 off, bringing it to $1,300. Its touchscreen makes milk-based drinks, while swappable bean hoppers and a “bean adapt” feature support different beans. Its frother produces silky microfoam, though the coffee may not match a traditional portafilter machine and the milk gets less hot than with a steam wand.

The Triangle (1-3-1) offense attacks a Diamond & One defense by placing the star player at the high post, isolating them against a defender focused on denying passes. Teammates rotate to provide layup opportunities, kick-out passes and open shots. If the high-post pass is overplayed, the star can cut toward the basket for a lob. Effective execution requires coordinated movement, passing, shooting and recognition of defensive adjustments.

Imran Mohammad, a Rohingya refugee recognized by UNHCR, describes spending four birthdays in detention on Manus after arriving in Papua New Guinea at 19 in 2013. He recounts overcrowded shipping-container rooms, long queues for basic necessities, limited food and family contact, and difficulty finding a place to pray. The conditions left him distressed and at times suicidal. He says he coped by avoiding crowds, studying and writing, but continues to face daily obstacles in indefinite detention and wishes to be free with his family.

Total solar eclipses have long inspired fear, from ancient beliefs about angry gods and dragons to some Americans’ conviction in 1878 that Judgment Day had arrived. Some Christians remain anxious about an upcoming eclipse, but Missouri nuns say they see no bad omen and plan to enjoy it. In an Islamic account, Muhammad described an eclipse as a sign of God, not a sign related to his son’s death. Author David Baron says a total eclipse can inspire profound awe even in people who are not religious.

Pointwise convergence means functions converge at each fixed point; uniform convergence requires one convergence threshold that works across the entire set. Uniform convergence implies pointwise convergence, but not conversely: \(x^n\) converges uniformly on \([0,b]\) for \(b<1\), yet only pointwise on \([0,1]\). A sequence of increasingly tall, narrow tent functions likewise converges pointwise, but not uniformly, to zero.

The lecture uses these examples to show that pointwise convergence alone does not preserve continuity or justify interchanging limits with differentiation or integration. It proves that uniform limits of continuous functions are continuous and that integration commutes with uniform limits under the stated conditions. Uniform convergence of derivatives also supports differentiating a limit. Finally, the Weierstrass M-test guarantees uniform convergence of a series of functions when each term is bounded by a corresponding term of a convergent numerical series.

KGI analyst Ming-Chi Kuo predicts this year’s Apple Watch will retain its current design, with LTE and non-LTE models in 38mm and 42mm sizes. The passage considers whether a non-LTE model could be made thinner and notes the author’s preference for reduced thickness.

Taking office, the speaker pledges to uphold the Constitution and its goals of union, justice, welfare, and liberty. He credits it with national growth and prosperity while acknowledging war, disease, and political divisions. He urges former party rivals to set aside rancor and emphasizes respect for both state and federal powers. Praising his predecessor’s record of peace, debt reduction, territorial expansion, defense, and public works, he pledges to continue those efforts, especially internal improvements. He closes by seeking the cooperation of Congress, state governments, and the people, as well as divine guidance.

A funnel-web spider was spotted inside a home in Springwood, near Sydney. Taronga Zoo invertebrate keeper Paul Hare said males may be seen wandering during mating season. Funnel-web bites can cause serious symptoms, and anyone bitten should go to hospital immediately. Although the Australian Museum has recorded 13 deaths, none has occurred since an antivenom was developed in 1981. Hare described the spiders as defensive rather than aggressive and advised people to leave them alone and take precautions when gardening or cleaning pool filters.

A recent music education graduate living at home worries that paying her mother $480 a month for rent and phone service will make it hard to cover tuition, certification exams, and savings on a three-month minimum-wage income. She says the rent demand followed a misunderstanding related to her hearing problems and questions what happened to part of an earlier school refund. The columnist suggests budgeting carefully, considering additional work, and being honest about both sides of the strained relationship.

In a September 1, 1814 proclamation, President James Madison condemned the enemy’s destruction of public buildings in Washington, the plundering of Alexandria, and a British commander’s stated intention to devastate vulnerable coastal towns. He urged Americans to unite against the invader and directed civil and military officers to strengthen defenses, authorizing district commanders to call on nearby militia.

A study of 97 children aged 9–12 with insufficient sleep tested components of a mobile sleep-promotion platform. Across participants, weeknight sleep increased by an average of 24 minutes during the seven-week intervention. No individual component met the study’s 30-minute improvement target, but two combinations did. The highest-ranked combined sleep tracking, feedback, a sleep goal, a caregiver-directed financial incentive, and messages about screen time and routines; it was associated with a 39.6-minute increase. The authors note that a randomized trial and longer follow-up are needed.

The speaker said unusual bounces helped the opposing team score in a tight game. His team created chances but failed to convert several, and he felt a breather was needed after two defensemen had been on the ice for a long time. He also described an exchange with an opponent and a puck that rested on the goalie’s back without going in. Despite mistakes and the result, he said the team remained confident and would prepare for the next game.

The global aluminum foil packaging market is expected to grow at about 4.5% annually during the forecast period, driven by packaging innovation and demand from the pharmaceutical, cosmetics and personal care industries. Aluminum foil protects products from contamination and helps reduce waste. Limited recycling processes in some countries may hinder growth. Asia Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region, supported by rising incomes and purchasing power.

The passage proposes a wp-semantics for deontic argumentation to handle weak permission when obligations conflict. Unlike grounded and stable semantics, it can justify weak permissions for both sides of an unresolved conflict. The authors show that its extension is unique and conflict-free, that no argument is both justified and rejected, and that every argument justified under grounded semantics is also justified under wp-semantics.

A May 9, 2001 collection of news reports says Questia cut 139 jobs and slowed book digitization amid funding difficulties, while U.S. stocks finished mixed ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting. Enron called Japan’s newly deregulated power market uncompetitive and urged independent regulation. Williams prepared to enter European energy markets. In India, Enron’s Dabhol project faced payment and contract disputes with Maharashtra’s electricity board; reports said executives’ families had left Mumbai, while lenders considered backing termination of the power purchase agreement. Prize Petroleum sought to acquire Enron’s stake in three offshore oil and gas fields.

At least 30 children died at Gorakhpur’s BRD Hospital, which a visiting central team found was accommodating patients at 10 times its admission capacity, with multiple infants sharing warmers. The report also cited oxygen-supply problems and absent or non-functional newborn care units in nearby districts. Health officials announced an Rs 85 crore regional centre to research children’s diseases.

MyWorld is a gaming platform that lets players create games, set their rules and modes, and save or share them with the community. Players can design objects, build functional devices, customize avatars, and unlock materials as they progress. The team has launched a Kickstarter campaign to fund further development, offering exclusive materials to early backers.

The speaker calls the playoff loss frustrating after the team surrendered two-goal leads and too many third-period chances. They credit Detroit’s hard play, praise their team’s tenacity, and say it must rebound.

The passage argues that Forex traders do not need exceptional talent, but should avoid promises of quick profits and wait for suitable trades. It advises novices to manage risk, accept losses, and learn technical, fundamental and sentiment analysis. Traders can learn from experts, but should develop their own judgment and make independent decisions rather than copy others.

Apple announced on February 5, 2019, that Angela Ahrendts would leave her role as Senior Vice President, Retail, effective April 15. Deirdre O’Brien succeeded her as Senior Vice President, Retail + People, effective February 5.

The NTSC and CSA are partnering to improve cloud vendor security reviews by promoting CSA’s STAR program and related tools. They plan to develop a questionnaire aligned with common compliance frameworks and a whitepaper for CISOs and vendors. They will also collaborate on events, industry discussions, and cloud security research.

At Tesla’s October 7, 2021 annual meeting, stockholders elected James Murdoch and Kimbal Musk as directors and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers as the 2021 auditor. Proposals to shorten director terms to two years and eliminate supermajority voting requirements did not pass. Non-binding proposals on one-year director terms and diversity reporting passed; proposals on employee arbitration, human capital oversight, and human rights reporting did not.

Daniella Teutsch and Sara Wolf founded HydroChic in 2007 to offer more attractive, modest swimwear. Customer conversations revealed demand from women who had undergone mastectomies or bariatric surgery and from those with skin conditions. The company expanded into supportive athletic wear and protective swimwear, making customers with special health needs a key part of its business.

Consumer Electricals Ltd submitted a bid for Kenstar’s business and brand on September 20, 2017. The price was undisclosed, and no result, negotiations or binding agreement had been announced. Videocon is seeking to reduce debt exceeding Rs 40,000 crore.

Riley Oil Company, a family-run gas station in Paoli, Indiana, has offered full service since 1971. Employees pump gas, wash windshields and check oil at no extra charge. Six Riley family members work there, and the owners value talking with customers and hope the business stays in the family.

Legal experts expect higher education to feature prominently in the Supreme Court’s new term, although only two college-related transgender sports cases are on its main docket. One athlete has asked the court to dismiss her case; the other is expected to proceed. Experts say the outcome could affect how colleges apply Title IX beyond sports.

They are also watching the shadow docket, which allows rapid rulings without the usual arguments or explanations. The court has used it to lift lower-court restrictions on Trump administration policies affecting higher education. Experts anticipate disputes involving immigration, federal funding, academic freedom and First Amendment rights, and warn that some policies may have lasting effects before the court reaches final decisions.

On June 2, 2022, Microsoft updated its guidance for the quarter ending June 30, 2022, citing unfavorable foreign exchange rate movements through May. The revised guidance is included in a slide deck furnished with its Form 8-K.

Oklahoma City police say Zette Madden, 52, threatened Taco Bell employees with a tire iron, demanded money and caused thousands of dollars in damage. An officer tased her after she ignored repeated orders to drop it. She was treated for cuts and jailed on robbery and property-damage charges.

Nintendo confirmed that Labo will include Toy Con Garage, a toolkit for creating cardboard accessories using inputs, actions and if-then statements. Demonstrations included a cardboard electric guitar and electronic tennis. Access requirements remain unclear.

Molecular dynamics simulations examined nanoindentation of single-crystalline α-titanium in three orientations at 10, 300, and 600 K. The [0001] orientation showed the clearest pop-in at the onset of plasticity, the largest residual indentation depth, and the highest dislocation density at every temperature. The other orientations showed smoother plasticity onset and lower dislocation densities. Basal a-type dislocations dominated, while pyramidal slip became more active at higher temperatures. Contact pressure decreased as temperature rose. Schmid factor and strain maps linked slip activity beneath the indenter to distinct surface patterns: a circular pattern for [0001], two lobes for [10̅10], and asymmetric pile-up for [2̅110]. Higher temperatures generally produced more diffuse deformation and greater recovery in the prismatic orientations.

Falkland Islands fisheries scientist Alexander Arkhipkin warned that largely unregulated high-seas catches in the Southwest Atlantic limit stock assessments and increase overfishing risks. He joined a 2017 workshop in Peru addressing similar concerns about growing high-seas catches of jumbo squid in the Eastern Pacific. The workshop recommended survey and assessment methods for Peru’s Sea Institute to improve knowledge of squid stocks and examine the fisheries’ impact.

The disclosure describes physical-layer preambles for wireless packets, including a universal signal field (U-SIG) followed, in some formats, by a version-specific EHT signal field (EHT-SIG). U-SIG can identify the protocol version and packet format and convey bandwidth and punctured-channel information. EHT-SIG can provide resource allocations and user-specific information for decoding data. The proposed designs support single-user, multi-user and trigger-based transmissions, with options for signaling across subchannels and accommodating wider channels while limiting preamble length.

The Justice Department has asked the Education Department to investigate the University of Nevada at Reno’s UndocuPack program, questioning whether taxpayer funds support services for undocumented students. University president Brian Sandoval says the program serves all students, uses no federal funds and complies with the law. Advocates view the proposed investigation as an escalation of federal efforts to restrict higher education benefits for undocumented students and worry other colleges may scale back similar programs.

Darren Till won a close, controversial unanimous decision over Stephen Thompson at UFC Fight Night 130 in Liverpool. After critics questioned the scoring, Till offered to rematch Thompson in America as soon as possible if Thompson’s knee permits. The low-action fight included a final-round knockdown by Till.

The High Post Split Offense uses a 2–3 high alignment, with guards splitting around the high post and wings setting down screens when the initial cuts do not produce a shot. Players counter defensive reactions with fake splits, back cuts, curls, fades, screens and rolls, and post-ups. The high post can pass, shoot or drive, and entry variations adapt the offense to different players. The passage emphasizes spacing, timing, defensive recognition and coordinated execution, along with aggressive offensive rebounding and individual skill development.

The passage describes a system for mobile payments when a user device and merchant payment system cannot connect to a payment server. They exchange payment requests and approvals locally, store transaction details, and submit them when connectivity returns. A reserved offline balance limits spending, and transaction IDs prevent duplicate processing. Offline payment mode is enabled on only one device per e-wallet at a time and can be transferred between devices through local communication.

A Bank of England regulator said major changes to British banks’ capital and liquidity rules are unlikely after Basel III. The bank will focus on new risks, including cyber-attacks, and unintended effects of existing rules.

Aaron Judge’s July elbow injury sidelined him for 10 days and limited his throwing after he returned to the outfield. His hitting remained strong. With the Yankees’ season over, Judge said he will work on the elbow but does not know whether he needs surgery.

The passage describes a folding pickup-truck tonneau cover with panels that latch to rails along the bed walls. Linked, spring-loaded pinch latches let an operator release both sides of a panel from either side of the truck. It also describes seals, integrated lights, adjustable rail attachments, and gussets and buckles that support and secure the folded panels.

Microsoft’s annual report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2021 describes three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Its priorities include productivity tools, cloud and AI services, Windows, and gaming. Microsoft employed approximately 181,000 full-time people at year-end. The report describes commitments to sustainability, racial equity, and digital skills, as well as risks from competition and its growing reliance on cloud services.

Coach Julien said an injured player was being evaluated and he had no further update. He discussed lineup choices involving Soderberg and Daugavins, the need for better starts and awareness around the net, and his confidence in Zdeno Chara. He said every player must contribute, including through secondary scoring. Facing a must-win game at home, he said the team was committed to bouncing back.

A collection of November 26, 2001 reports describes Enron shares falling to an all-time low amid doubts about Dynegy’s proposed takeover and concerns over Enron’s finances. Enron was seeking additional funding and had extended the deadline on a $690 million loan to December 14. Reports also covered falling Enron and Dynegy bonds, lawsuits seeking recovery of employees’ 401(k) losses, and increased scrutiny of energy traders’ financial disclosures.

Martin Colin Hodder, 45, was jailed for 18 weeks after admitting assaulting his ex-partner and her daughter with a butter knife during a drunken attack on January 14. His ex-partner suffered cuts to her arms, and her daughter’s wrist was slashed. The sentence included a year-long restraining order. His ex-partner called the sentence a disgrace.

The February 20, 2002, issue of Enerfax Daily lists North American natural gas and power prices, futures and trading volumes. March natural gas futures rose $0.191 to $2.397 per MMBtu amid fund buying and a colder weather forecast. It reports a shareholder lawsuit over JP Morgan Chase’s Enron exposure, El Paso Corp’s planned $750 million asset sale, and AES’s plan to sell up to $1.5 billion in assets. It also covers proposed derivatives oversight, electricity market design talks, and data center power demand.

The passage describes methods for making large multi-die semiconductor packages. Tested interconnect structures are mounted on a temporary carrier, encapsulated and thinned. Semiconductor dies or packaged devices are then bonded to the interconnects, underfilled and encapsulated before the carrier is removed and external contacts are formed. Embodiments use separate interconnect structures or a shared universal structure with redistribution layers. The passage states that using tested components, lower-temperature bonding and materials with similar thermal expansion can reduce stress and improve component and board-level reliability.

The speaker says his team needed its win against New Jersey to keep the Stanley Cup Finals series alive. After struggling to skate and create chances in the first two games, the team played faster, more physically and with more attack. He credits better faceoffs, teamwork and poise, while stressing that one improved game is not enough. The team must prepare, manage the puck and stay composed as it tries to improve again in the next game.

Ben Bishop says a couple of days helped him feel better and made playing easier. He credits time in the minors with teaching him to be a professional before he got his chance in Tampa. He says he prepares the same way for every game, including do-or-die playoff games, and does not expect a loss to change how the team responds. He describes the team as consistent and says the group has enjoyed its time together.

University of Michigan researchers developed a clear, durable coating that repels nearly every liquid and could prevent grime buildup on surfaces including tables, walls and phone screens. Inspired by a researcher’s experience cleaning up after his child, the coating combines fluorinated polyurethane and F-POSS. The team is studying whether it is toxic.

Tex Winter’s Triangle Post Offense uses defensive recognition rather than set plays. It combines varied entries, a sideline triangle and a weakside two-player game. Players maintain 15–20 feet of spacing, move continuously and choose passes, cuts, post plays or drives according to how defenders react. The passage details counters to defensive overplay and emphasizes fundamentals, coordinated execution, practice drills and scouting opponents.

Plug Power shares fell 1.54% in the most recent session and closed at $1.92. Seven analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $3.22, ranging from $1.30 to $5. Their recommendations comprised one Buy, four Outperform, one Hold and one Underperform. The stock’s ATR-14 was 0.08 and its RSI was 51.76.

Queen Elizabeth visited young victims of the Manchester bombing at Royal Manchester Children’s Hospital and met emergency responders. The attack killed 22 and injured more than 100; 19 patients remained hospitalized, five in critical care.

Bollinger Bands show asset volatility using a moving average and bands set above and below it by multiples of the standard deviation. TradingView’s default moving-average period is 20, but the settings can be changed. Traders can use the bands to assess possible trend changes or build breakout strategies. The passage cautions that bands alone do not make a profitable system: signals can be false or delayed, effectiveness may fall in range-bound markets, and results depend on settings. Trading rules, risk and performance should be tested.

FTB Advisors increased its Vanguard Total International Stock ETF stake by 3.6% in the second quarter, holding 13,149 shares worth $706,000. Several other institutional investors also increased their holdings. The ETF traded at $54.8501 on Friday, down 0.3088%, and had a one-year range of $44.68 to $55.28. It paid a quarterly dividend of $0.298 per share on September 25.

The passage describes peripherals and support information for MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 devices. The low-frequency subsystem contains an RTC and independent watchdog; a separate windowed watchdog and general-purpose and advanced timers provide monitoring, timing, and trigger functions. It also covers analog connections, I/O configuration, serial-wire debugging, UART or I2C bootloader programming, and read-only factory identification data. Application guidance addresses supply decoupling, reset and oscillator components, the VCORE capacitor, and pullups for open-drain I/O. The remaining sections list development resources, revisions, packaging information, and TI’s usage disclaimers.

The speaker accepts the presidency as a public trust and urges citizens to set aside partisan and sectional divisions. He pledges to uphold the Constitution, respect the division of federal and state powers, and administer government economically. He calls for a peaceful, independent foreign policy; sound finances and reduced unnecessary taxation; protection of public lands; fair treatment and education of Indians; and the repression of polygamy in the Territories. He also advocates enforcing immigration restrictions, hiring public employees on merit rather than partisan loyalty, and protecting the rights of freedmen as citizens. He closes by calling for united public service and invoking God’s aid.

Jane Goodall collected and preserved skeletons of Gombe chimpanzees whose lives her team had documented, giving researchers a way to study how individual experiences relate to skeletal features. She cautioned that the collection’s implications for understanding ancient hominids remained uncertain. Flo’s skeleton, for example, showed why bone size alone can mislead estimates of body weight. Goodall saw preserving the remains as part of not wasting anything in fieldwork.

Paula Norrell sued Waste Away Group, alleging sex discrimination after it selected Terry White instead of her to manage its combined Montgomery and Opelika sales district. The court found that Norrell established an initial failure-to-promote case, but Waste Away gave a nondiscriminatory reason for selecting White: his qualifications, including prior experience managing the combined district. Norrell did not show that this reason was a pretext for discrimination. She also acknowledged that she was no longer pursuing her disparate-impact claim. The court granted summary judgment for Waste Away and taxed costs against Norrell.

The author describes the second week of motherhood as especially difficult. Sleep deprivation, painful breastfeeding, babies’ weight-gain problems, loneliness, and nighttime crying left her exhausted and insecure. The strain affected her mental health and relationship with her husband, though she says things eventually improved.

A follow-through day occurs on Day 4 or later of a rally attempt during a market correction, when a major index closes significantly higher on increased volume. The attempt begins with an up day and remains valid if the index avoids a new low. The signal suggests a new uptrend but can fail, so the passage advises against immediately becoming fully invested. Its S&P 500 backtest found poor short-term results, with slight improvement from an RSI filter.

On June 15, 2017, Amazon agreed to acquire Whole Foods Market for $42 per share in cash. The merger requires Whole Foods shareholder approval and regulatory clearance and is not contingent on Amazon obtaining financing. Amazon expects to use cash and debt and has secured a commitment for a bridge loan of up to $13.7 billion. The agreement includes a $400 million termination fee payable by Whole Foods under specified circumstances.

The TPS7H500x-SP series comprises four radiation-hardness-assured, peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. They operate from 4–14 V, offer a 0.613-V reference accurate to +0.7%/−1%, and support switching frequencies from 100 kHz to 2 MHz with external synchronization.

The TPS7H5001-SP has dual primary and synchronous-rectifier outputs; the TPS7H5002-SP and TPS7H5003-SP have single outputs, with fixed dead time and leading-edge blanking on the TPS7H5003-SP. The TPS7H5004-SP has dual primary outputs for non-synchronous push-pull and full-bridge designs. Depending on the device, features include programmable duty-cycle limits, dead time, blanking, soft start, slope compensation, and frequency compensation. Protection functions include current limiting with hiccup restart, external fault shutdown, undervoltage lockout, and thermal shutdown. The passage also provides a GaN-based synchronous push-pull design example, power-supply recommendations, and PCB layout guidance.

A double top is a bearish reversal pattern with two similar swing highs and a neckline marking support. A break below the neckline suggests a potential decline; the passage suggests waiting for that break or a retest before shorting. In research described in the passage, 39% of formations reached their target. The author cautions that the patterns were identified manually, the stock sample was not adjusted for survivorship bias, and shorting is difficult.

A heat wave in the northeastern United States brought dangerous temperatures, record heat in parts of New England and at least one reported heat-related death. The National Weather Service warned people celebrating outdoors on July Fourth to take precautions. A storm front is expected to cool the eastern seaboard later in the week, while the heat moves west toward Southern California.

An October 29 news roundup reports that Moody’s downgraded Enron’s debt and put its ratings under review after investment losses and disclosures about partnerships involving its former chief financial officer. Enron’s shares fell to nearly seven-year lows, and the company sought additional bank credit after drawing about $3 billion from existing lines. U.S. energy firms said trading with Enron remained normal, while some European firms paused dealings over credit concerns.

Retired Metro Police detective Phil Ramos said newly released 1 October body-camera videos show officers under intense stress outside Stephen Paddock’s hotel room. He said the first officer’s failure to activate his camera was understandable and suggested an accidental gunshot may have reflected officers’ expectation of a firefight. Ramos noted the footage lacks a timestamp and cautioned against drawing conclusions from the videos alone.

With nine picks in the 2018 NFL Draft, the Colts could use the No. 6 overall selection on a foundational player. The passage ranks pass rusher Bradley Chubb first, citing the team’s weak 2017 pass rush, followed by guard Quenton Nelson for his ability to protect Andrew Luck and running back Saquon Barkley for his potential to improve the offense.

A systematic review and meta-analysis of five Ethiopian studies published from 2016 to 2023 estimated pooled chikungunya seroprevalence at 12.35%. Reported prevalence varied by district, occupation, age, education and sex; the highest district estimate was 51.58% in Debub Ari and the lowest was 6.25% in Lare. Results showed substantial heterogeneity, including differences by diagnostic test. The authors caution that the small number of studies may limit how well the pooled estimate reflects current rates. They recommend stronger outbreak preparedness, collaboration and public awareness.

The passage argues that cross-partisan education policy remains achievable despite growing polarization, pandemic-related learning loss, and declining trust in schools. Drawing on state initiatives, it identifies five recurring factors in successful efforts: clearly communicating broadly appealing proposals, responding to local needs, providing political cover, allowing different sides to claim a win, and using media to build awareness. Examples include changes to reading instruction, teacher apprenticeships and licensing, career and technical education, teacher pay, and civics education. The passage also advises advocates to understand their political landscape, identify shared problems, assess urgency and effects on school staff, frame proposals inclusively, and stay focused on their priorities.

The passage presents containers and orchestration as building blocks for reusable distributed-system patterns. It describes three single-node patterns: sidecars add functionality, ambassadors broker external communication, and adapters provide consistent interfaces. Examples include HTTPS support, configuration updates, sharding proxies, monitoring, logging, and health checks. It then introduces multi-node patterns, including replicated load-balanced services for availability and scale and sharded services for dividing large amounts of state. The passage emphasizes modularity, stable APIs, documentation, and reusable components.

Microsoft reported revenue of $45.3 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2021, up 22% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 27% to $20.2 billion, while net income rose 48% to $20.5 billion, including a $3.3 billion tax benefit. Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 36% to $20.7 billion, and revenue grew across all three operating segments. Operating cash flow was $24.5 billion. Microsoft also approved a new $60 billion share repurchase program and reported that its proposed $19.7 billion acquisition of Nuance remained subject to closing conditions.

Patrick McCaffery committed to Iowa, where he will play for his father, coach Fran McCaffery, and alongside his brother Connor. The Iowa City West forward said the chance to play near his family and Iowa’s fast-paced style influenced his decision. A consensus four-star recruit, he is Iowa’s first commitment for 2019. McCaffery averaged 13.8 points while helping West win a Class 4A state title last season. He is working to gain strength before college.

The Piotroski F-Score uses nine financial criteria covering profitability, liquidity and efficiency to identify stocks with strong fundamentals; scores of 8 or 9 are considered high. In Alpha Architect’s backtests of large NYSE stocks from 1974 to 2014, its modified score returned 13.3% annually, the original score 12.6%, and the S&P 500 11.2%. Returns were higher when the tests selected cheap, high-scoring stocks. The passage cautions that the score does not guarantee success and should be used alongside other research.

At oral argument, several Supreme Court justices appeared open to allowing judges to restrict discussions between defense lawyers and clients who remain on the stand during overnight recesses, while permitting discussion of trial strategy. David Villarreal argues that such a restriction denied him effective assistance of counsel; Texas courts upheld his murder conviction. His lawyer warned that the boundary between testimony and strategy is unclear. Texas argued that coaching testimony, including its delivery, may be barred, while the United States proposed barring discussion of the testimony itself but allowing strategic advice.

Middlesbrough striker Rudy Gestede urged his team to stay positive ahead of Monday’s match against Arsenal. Winless in the league since mid-December, Middlesbrough are 19th, six points from safety with seven games remaining.

The report covers events through the January 17, 1893 revolution in Hawaii; a separate report continues the account and accompanies a treaty signed on February 14, 1893. It includes a chronological list of papers, an index, and a bibliography. The listed documents include an 1826 agreement between the United States and the Sandwich Islands, a statement about protecting American seamen and securing payment of American claims, and 1829 instructions to deliver gifts, cultivate friendly relations, and gather information about U.S. interests.

The lecture surveys predecessor-search bounds and presents a lower bound for static, polynomial-space data structures. It reduces the problem to colored predecessor queries and models each memory read as communication between a query algorithm and memory. Round elimination then shows that answering queries requires Ω(min(log w / log log n, log_w n)) reads. The proof echoes the strategies of Van Emde Boas and fusion tries. The lecture also notes tighter bounds that account for space usage.

A study of 40 people, including 27 with rheumatoid arthritis, compared immune responses after two doses of a SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine. Rituximab-treated participants had almost no detectable spike-specific antibodies. Abatacept-treated participants had lower antibody and neutralization levels, reduced B-cell activation and IgG class switching, and diminished production of key cytokines by spike-specific T cells. Methotrexate-treated participants had fewer spike-specific CD4+ T cells but no significant reduction in antibody levels or neutralization activity. The authors suggest temporarily stopping abatacept during vaccination when clinically manageable.

Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara plans to launch at least eight waste-to-power projects by the end of October, starting in Jakarta and eventually extending to 33 municipalities. Each plant is designed to process 1,000 tonnes of waste daily and generate about 15 megawatts of electricity. Danantara will finance and oversee the projects, while state utility PLN will buy the power. Their success will depend on local coordination, project oversight and reliable waste-to-energy conversion.

The passage describes container patterns for building modular applications. On one machine, separate containers provide resource isolation, clearer ownership and independent deployment. Sidecars add functionality to an application, ambassadors broker its external connections, and adapters convert its interfaces to common formats for monitoring, logging or health checks. Reusable containers need configurable parameters, stable APIs and documentation.

Across machines, microservices separate functions behind APIs, allowing independent development and scaling but making design and debugging harder. Replicated, load-balanced services improve availability and capacity; readiness checks identify instances able to serve requests. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharded services divide state among machines when one machine cannot hold it. Effective sharding depends on choosing an appropriate request key, distributing requests evenly and limiting disruption when the number of shards changes.

This study translated and evaluated an Arabic Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire in Saudi Arabian patients seeking treatment for jaw and dental deformities. Results indicated strong internal consistency, good test-retest reliability and evidence of validity. Quality-of-life scores were lower, indicating improvement, after surgery, although the change in the 12 patients assessed both before and after surgery was not statistically significant. Small validation groups and recruitment from one private practice limit the findings.

The Supreme Court will consider whether restitution imposed under the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act is criminal punishment subject to the Constitution’s ex post facto clause. If so, Holsey Ellingburg’s restitution obligation cannot be increased under revisions enacted after his bank robbery. Ellingburg points to restitution’s place in criminal sentencing and the penalties for nonpayment. The government agrees the clause applies; a court-appointed lawyer defends the contrary ruling.
Delta intends to buy up to 32% more of Grupo Aeroméxico at MXP 43.59 per share, pending regulatory approvals in Mexico and the United States.

MTN and four banks plan to raise GH¢4.67 billion on the Ghana Stock Exchange within six months, a concurrent fundraising effort unprecedented for the exchange. MTN seeks GH¢3.48 billion, while the banks seek GH¢1.19 billion to meet new capital requirements. Analysts warn that the timing could strain investor funds, particularly for the banks, though pension assets may provide support. Foreign investment may be needed for the offers to succeed; its inflows could stabilise the cedi in the short term, while later profit repatriation could weaken it.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Ampere GA10x GPUs, particularly GA102 and GA104. GA102 powers the RTX 3090, RTX 3080, RTX A6000, and A40; GA104 powers the RTX 3070. Compared with Turing, GA10x adds doubled peak FP32 processing, second-generation RT Cores, and third-generation Tensor Cores with structured sparsity support. A full GA102 has 10,752 CUDA Cores, 84 RT Cores, and 336 Tensor Cores. Other features include larger caches, GDDR6X or GDDR6 memory, third-generation NVLink, and PCIe 4.0. The passage also describes improvements in ray tracing, AI processing, memory bandwidth, and power efficiency.
The Eighth Circuit dismissed the United States’ appeal against Frank Walker at the government’s request and with Walker’s consent, without costs to either party.

Tradeshift raised $250 million in a Series E round led by Goldman Sachs and PSP Investments, bringing total funding above $400 million. The company says its valuation exceeds $1.1 billion. Co-founder Mikkel Hippe Brun will join its board.

The speaker says the team has grown more comfortable in the Stanley Cup Finals after failing to play its game early in the series. They credit the team’s depth, in-season additions and the owner’s commitment, and express confidence in its road play. With the series now competitive, the team is focused on the next game in Anaheim.

Entrepreneur and investor Steve Pearse discusses how startups attract funding. He estimates that about one in ten startups produces the large return investors seek, and says investor-backed companies need a plan to go public or be acquired.

Pearse advises founders to make pitches brief, clear, and tailored to their audience. They should lead with a compelling hook, explain customer and business benefits rather than technical details, address the market, competition, sales strategy, team, finances, and timeline, and end with a specific funding request. Presenters should practice, answer questions confidently, and keep the discussion on track.

He recommends raising money well before it is needed, approaching investors in parallel, securing introductions, and monitoring cash flow. He also emphasizes capable teams, focus, rapid execution, customer feedback, and willingness to change course when necessary.

Southwestern College adjunct instructors rallied for better wages and protections, though few people attended. Adjuncts teach nearly 75 percent of the college’s classes but lack the benefits of full-time professors. Speakers described long commutes, financial strain, limited medical coverage and job insecurity, and said these conditions can harm education. The college president and a trustee voiced support. Organizers urged students and faculty to help adjuncts seek paid office hours and disability leave.

A systematic review examined how personality traits relate to satisfaction and academic success in higher education online learning. Of 848 articles screened, 23 met the criteria; all provided low-strength, level IV evidence, and none focused on occupational therapy education. Conscientiousness was consistently associated with greater satisfaction and often higher grades. Openness and agreeableness were generally linked to positive outcomes, while neuroticism was usually linked to poorer outcomes, though findings varied. The authors recommend flexible course design and support for self-regulated learning. They call for stronger studies, particularly in occupational therapy education.

Leeds hosted the UK’s first Reclaim the Night march in November 1977, when women were being advised not to walk alone after dark amid Peter Sutcliffe’s killings. Organised by the Leeds Revolutionary Feminist Group, it coincided with marches in 11 other towns and cities and challenged harassment and violence against women. The marches faded in the early 1990s but were revived in 2004. Forty years after the first march, Leeds theatre company RashDash drew on it for *The Darkest Corners*, a performance about women’s experiences and activism staged in a Holbeck car park as part of Transform 17.

Demi Guo’s Pika has launched a TikTok-like app for short AI videos aimed at Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Its Predictive Video feature turns a selfie and a brief request into a video with a script, music and visual effects. Pika has raised about $135 million and reports 16.4 million users across its creative apps.

The newsletter also reports that AI startup growth is intensifying San Francisco’s rental competition; AI chip demand helped TSMC’s profit rise 39.1%; and Spotify is partnering with music rights holders on AI products. A survey found that 11% of Americans would consider using an AI mental health tool, while 4% have tried one.

A study of 88 undergraduates at a Colombian university compared their perceptions of planned online learning (OL) and emergency remote education (ERE) during COVID-19. Survey ratings and open-ended responses showed generally positive views of both, but students rated OL higher on most factors, particularly course structure, content, independent activities, and assessment. Preferences for student-to-student interaction were nearly evenly divided. Students valued the flexibility of both modalities and identified needs for better instructor preparation, stronger interaction, more varied activities, and assessments that avoid overloading them.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its graphics and VR features. VirtualLink combines VR headset power, display and data connections in one USB-C connector, while NVLink increases bandwidth for two-way SLI on supported GPUs. Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests. Combined with rasterization and denoising, they enable real-time effects such as reflections, shadows and ambient occlusion.

Turing Tensor Cores support NGX AI features, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow-motion frame interpolation and image upscaling. Mesh Shading offers more flexible geometry processing; Variable Rate Shading adjusts shading effort across an image; Texture Space Shading reuses shading results; and Multi-View Rendering processes multiple viewpoints efficiently. The passage also outlines TU104 and TU106 GPU configurations and presents RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering. It closes with an explanation of ray-tracing methods and NVIDIA’s product, liability and trademark notices.

The passage promotes the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It also describes cell phone protection and compares rewards and introductory offers from Capital One Quicksilver and Citi. Motley Fool Money discloses that it receives advertising compensation, which it says does not affect its product ratings.

Mark Cuban says TrumpRx, a government website planned for early 2026 to sell discounted prescription drugs directly to consumers, could lower costs if it forces pharmacy benefit managers to change. He gave the initiative a “B,” citing uncertainty about its impact. The program initially applies to Pfizer, whose White House partnership includes a three-year reprieve from pharmaceutical tariffs. Public-health experts caution that direct-to-consumer platforms generally cannot accept insurance, limiting their benefits for most Americans.

The Russell 2000 tracks approximately 2,000 U.S. small-cap stocks and rebalances annually on the fourth Friday of June to maintain its intended composition. The passage describes a strategy of buying after June 23 and selling on the first trading day of July. In a backtest beginning in 1988, the index gained an average of 1.34% over this period, versus 0.85% for the S&P 500. A version hedged with a short S&P 500 position averaged 0.23%.

The President returns a $1,378,450 harbor and river improvement bill without approval. He argues that the Constitution does not authorize federal spending on internal improvements within states, particularly local projects unrelated to foreign commerce or maritime safety. He distinguishes those projects from established navigation safeguards, such as lighthouses and buoys. He also warns that the bill would encourage unequal, wasteful spending and strain the Treasury during a foreign war.

Digital leaders use transparent, data-driven goals aligned with company strategy to give teams a shared purpose. Effective goal-setting requires employee buy-in, not just mandates, and excessive demands for analysis can slow simple decisions. A strong data culture supports alignment across levels and teams through clear metrics, shared data, and consistent beliefs, values, and practices.

Digital laggards often struggle to connect goals to strategy or translate stated values into behavior. Changing entrenched mindsets is a major challenge, though organizations can transform their cultures. The passage identifies four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—each with different cultural or technical strengths and gaps to address.

Coach DeBoer said his team made a mistake that its opponent capitalized on and did not deserve to win. He felt the team started tentatively, improved in spurts, but needs another level of play. Citing its responses to early deficits against Philadelphia and the Rangers, he expected the team to improve by Saturday. He said scoring against strong goaltending requires traffic, shots and patience. Before the game, he emphasized maintaining the team’s routine and drew confidence from the organization’s experience. He also described excitement in the New Jersey community about reaching the Stanley Cup Final.

This statistical analysis plan describes a phase 3, randomized, double-blind trial comparing a single 0.6 mg dose of dasiglucagon with placebo and GlucaGen in children with type 1 diabetes and hypoglycemia. The planned groups comprise 20, 10, and 10 patients, respectively.
