The primary endpoint is time to a plasma glucose increase of at least 20 mg/dL within 45 minutes without rescue IV glucose; secondary endpoints assess recovery rates and glucose changes at earlier time points. The primary analysis uses the full analysis set and a stratified log-rank test, with sensitivity and supportive analyses planned. Safety analyses cover adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings, local tolerability, and immunogenicity. The plan also specifies pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analyses, data handling, reporting, and quality control.

The coach says Boston deserved to win, citing strong goaltending, defense and timely goals. His team is disappointed but gave its best effort, and he does not blame injuries. In remarks before the seventh game, he says Jeff will have an opportunity to play, expects both teams to manage their nerves, and remains focused on his team’s game. He also reflects on the difficulty of reaching the Stanley Cup Final and his excitement at the opportunity.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 1, 2018, announcing a press release and data sheet on its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2018. Both are attached as exhibits. Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri signed the report.

Reports say Queen Elizabeth II is considering handing royal duties to Prince Charles when she turns 95. A royal commentator said preparations for a possible regency are advancing; under the Regency Act, Charles could exercise royal powers while the Queen remains alive. Clarence House declined to comment.

In an April 12, 2021 Form 8-K, Microsoft announced a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications for $56 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $19.7 billion, including Nuance’s net debt. The filing includes the announcement press release and an investor presentation as exhibits.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs introduce GDDR6X memory, which uses PAM4 signaling to reach up to 936 GB/s of peak bandwidth. RTX IO, working with Microsoft DirectStorage, moves game-asset decompression to the GPU to reduce CPU demands and speed loading. The architecture also improves shading, ray tracing and AI performance, and supports high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and hardware video encoding.

The passage describes the A40 data-center GPU and RTX A6000 workstation GPU, including their 48 GB memory configurations and support for paired GPUs with 96 GB of combined memory. It also outlines the GeForce RTX 3090 and 3070, GDDR6X error detection and replay for overclocking, and NVIDIA’s product disclaimers.

The passage describes a short-term mean-reversion pattern in SPY: it tends to rise after a down day and fall after an up day. A backtest of buying after a down day and selling after an up day is reported to perform well, while momentum is described as more relevant over longer periods.

The Office of Management and Budget identified 4,132 to 4,232 federal workers for layoffs during the government shutdown. Its filing lists cuts at the Commerce, Health and Human Services, Housing and Urban Development, Homeland Security, and Treasury departments; the Education Department also confirmed employees would be affected. A federal workers’ union challenged the layoffs in court. Other employees remain furloughed or are working without pay, and many are concerned about their jobs and finances.

The passage cites arbitration awards to support measuring damages for a vessel’s wrongful detention by its lost use, including probable catch or interrupted trade. It argues that the Bering Sea Commission applied this measure in claims by Canadian sealers. It also states that a government agent may not forcibly enlist people from a friendly nation’s ship into public service, and quotes a rule against enrolling aliens without their consent for ordinary national or political purposes.

Chennai resident Punith Kumar, 19, ranked first in India and third internationally in the ACCA Chartered Accountant final P2 exam. He studied while completing a paid internship, crediting a rigorous routine and support from his mentor. He plans to finish his remaining papers by September and eventually start a company.

Ofcom has proposed automatic compensation, paid in cash or as bill credit, for fixed broadband and landline customers whose faults are not repaired quickly, whose new service starts late, or whose engineer misses an appointment. Ofcom estimates that up to 2.6 million more customers could receive up to £185 million annually. The proposal’s supporters urge swift action and better service. Consultation closes on 5 June, with a decision expected around year-end.

The January 21 Option Investor Newsletter reports a sharp decline in the Dow and Nasdaq amid Internet-stock selling, global currency concerns and profit-taking. It warns that stocks can fall after favorable earnings reports and urges caution before opening positions. The newsletter reviews call and put picks, drops several call picks, and introduces Vodafone and Qwest calls alongside four options-spread plays.

A federal judge ruled that a provision of the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances Act protecting religious worship can apply to Falun Gong practitioners who say they are harassed by the Chinese Anti-Cult World Alliance in Queens. Judge Jack Weinstein rejected the alliance’s constitutional challenge, finding that interference with worship can affect interstate commerce. He also said the law’s protection of places of worship should not be limited to formal buildings. Weinstein certified the ruling for appeal before a planned two-month trial.

The passage says book bans are spreading from U.S. public schools into higher education. It cites a PEN America report recording 22,810 instances of school book banning from 2021 to 2025, and describes removed books, challenged course readings, proposed syllabus requirements and course audits at colleges. It argues that Trump administration policies and a proposed compact for universities threaten academic freedom. The author calls on educators, librarians and others to work together against censorship.

The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe said the official exchange rate remains one bond note to one US dollar and urged the public to use licensed agencies for currency transactions. Governor John Mangudya said 45 institutions are licensed and noted arrests under a new law against illegal forex trading. He also urged people to report retailers who accept only cash, saying the bank and police would act against them.

The 2017 Sonora High School Athletic Hall of Fame will honor 12 former Wildcats and coaches for achievements spanning nearly 70 years of school sports. The inductees competed or coached in sports including football, basketball, baseball, wrestling, volleyball, tennis and soccer. The public banquet and awards ceremony will be held November 4 at the Sonora Elks Lodge. Tickets cost $40, or $20 for children 12 and under.

The Arkansas Supreme Court affirmed a $10,000 judgment for the widow and children of a railroad switchman fatally injured when an engine struck a coal car with a missing coupler. The court held that the car remained in interstate commerce while being moved for repairs and that the missing coupler caused the injury. It also upheld the denial of removal to federal court, allowed one action to recover both pecuniary losses and the deceased’s pain and suffering, and permitted the widow to testify about his contributions.

The Carter administration used MONs for significant changes to approved covert-action findings, while entirely new actions required new presidential findings. The 1980 Intelligence Oversight Act limited routine notification to the two congressional intelligence committees and allowed restricted prior notice in extraordinary circumstances. The passage then lists January 1983 records on U.S.–Soviet policy, including Shultz’s proposed four-part agenda of human rights, arms control, regional issues, and bilateral relations.

The dollar reached a three-week high against a currency basket on Monday after New York Fed President William Dudley reaffirmed plans for interest rate increases, lifting Treasury yields. March U.S. job growth missed forecasts, but unemployment fell to 4.5 percent. The euro weakened amid uncertainty over France’s presidential election, while geopolitical tensions involving Syria and North Korea remained in focus. Speculators’ net long dollar positions fell to their lowest level since late February.

The passage derives a spectral quantum Cramér–Rao bound for estimating time-dependent phase signals using two finite-bandwidth squeezed-state inputs. Without losses, the bound exhibits Heisenberg scaling at high photon occupancy per mode. It also describes how two homodyne records can be squared and subtracted to recover a signal, and presents an unbiased linearized maximum-likelihood estimator using filtered records.

Chronic hepatitis C can progress to cirrhosis and is associated with an increased risk of type 2 diabetes. This study aimed to assess whether the prognostic nutritional index (PNI), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) predict outcomes in patients with both hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis and type 2 diabetes. It included 56 patients with both conditions, 85 with cirrhosis, and 85 with type 2 diabetes. The 56 patients with both conditions were classified by their prognosis after six months of treatment. PNI, NLR, and PLR were calculated from laboratory results obtained at admission.

A National Academies report says editing DNA passed to future generations should be considered only to prevent serious, strongly heritable diseases, not to enhance traits. Such germline editing is illegal in the United States. The report calls for trials only when reasonable alternatives are unavailable, with demonstrated risks and benefits, public oversight and long-term monitoring of subsequent generations. It also urges continued public debate as CRISPR-Cas9 makes gene editing more feasible.

UK university staff are entering a fourth week of strikes over the planned end of the defined benefit aspect of their pensions. With talks unresolved, UCU has announced 14 more strike days, potentially affecting exams between April and June. UCU also criticised the University of Edinburgh for asking law lecturers to provide recordings of lectures missed during the strikes.

The Rubber Band strategy is a contrarian, mean-reversion approach to stocks that seeks to trade when prices appear overbought or oversold. Traders may use Keltner Channels, Bollinger Bands or momentum oscillators. With Keltner Channels, prices below the lower band suggest a potential buy, while prices above the upper band suggest a potential sell; the middle band can serve as a profit target. A backtest of an XLP strategy reported 328 trades, a 0.45% average gain per trade, 6.1% CAGR and 16% maximum drawdown.

Singapore police arrested 23 people during a May 21–27 operation in Yishun, Ang Mo Kio and Sengkang. Eight women were suspected of advertising sexual services, 14 men were arrested for gambling offences, and one man for drink-driving. Investigations are ongoing.

Aiden Markram said he is honoured to captain South Africa after Faf du Plessis was sidelined by a finger injury. He expects added pressure but will rely on senior players and du Plessis’s advice. With the Proteas trailing India 1-0, Markram wants an improved performance in the second ODI.

Using ADNI data, the study tested machine-learning models combining baseline cognitive scores, demographics, APOE4, plasma biomarkers, and MRI to predict cognitive decline in people without dementia. Adding plasma biomarkers and MRI improved prediction of memory decline: the correlation between predicted and observed rates rose from 0.38 in the basic model to 0.50 in the combined model. NfL and p-tau181 contributed more than Aβ42/40. Memory-based predictions were also associated with progression to MCI or dementia, though cognitive decline was harder to predict in cognitively unimpaired participants than in those with MCI. The study notes that its AD-focused biomarkers and cohort may limit applicability to other dementias and cognitive domains.

Saints open their Anglo-Welsh Cup campaign away to Exeter Chiefs on November 4, then host the Dragons, visit Sale Sharks and host Harlequins. Grouped with Saracens, Scarlets and Worcester Warriors, they must finish top of their pool to reach the semi-finals.

CoreLogic reported that U.S. home prices rose 7.1% from May 2017 to May 2018 and 1.1% from April. Limited supply, especially of entry-level homes, contributed to higher prices, while rising mortgage rates discouraged some owners from selling. In May, 40% of the 100 largest metropolitan markets were overvalued. CoreLogic forecast a 5.1% national price increase by May 2019.

The passage describes a vehicle monitoring system that estimates driver attention by combining driving and distraction workloads, optionally relative to a maximum workload. It processes camera, vehicle-control, environmental, and other inputs to assess factors such as gaze, drowsiness, and road complexity. Input weights and confidence levels may be adjusted through testing or use. The system may display images, alert drivers to hazards, or, when specified risk conditions are met, take control to avoid an object.

The passage proposes using baseline prevalence, environmental data and preventive chemotherapy history to design lower-cost soil-transmitted helminth impact surveys. A geostatistical model predicts prevalence, while treatment-history models project changes and help compare sampling designs. In simulations using data from Kenya, Zimbabwe and Sierra Leone, the proposed approach matched the accuracy of conventional surveys with an average estimated cost reduction of 80%. Projected prevalence aligned more closely with observed results in Kenya than in the other two countries.

Shonda Rhimes’ production company, Shondaland, has signed a deal to create new shows for Netflix. Her existing series, including “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Scandal,” will continue airing on ABC. Financial terms and the deal’s duration were not disclosed.

TeraAgent extends BioDynaMo to run agent-based simulations across multiple servers. It partitions simulation space and uses tailored serialization and delta encoding to reduce the overhead of exchanging agent data. In tests, it simulated 501.51 billion agents on 84,096 CPU cores. Its serialization was 110× faster than ROOT IO at the median, and delta encoding reduced transferred data by up to 3.5×, though it did not further reduce overall runtime on the tested high-bandwidth supercomputer. TeraAgent also achieved an 8× higher agent-update rate per CPU core than Biocellion and made ParaView in-situ visualization 39× faster than with BioDynaMo.

Alere said its financial statements for 2013–2015 should not be relied upon because of misstatements, primarily involving revenue recognition in South Korea. It also identified a Japanese transaction that recorded about $1 million in 2013 instead of 2012. Alere expects revenue-recognition control weaknesses to remain unresolved and may miss its May 15 quarterly filing deadline.

Google added speech recognition for 30 languages and locales, bringing its total to 119. The expansion includes eight Indian languages, Swahili and Amharic, and is available in Gboard for Android, Voice Search and the Cloud Speech API. Google plans to add the languages to other products later. It trained the technology using speech samples from native speakers and machine learning.

The American Academy of Pediatrics says five types of tests commonly ordered for children who are short, overweight or showing signs of early puberty are not always necessary, especially when the children are otherwise healthy. It advises doctors to consider a child’s growth pattern and other symptoms before ordering hormone or endocrine tests, vitamin D screening, thyroid or insulin tests, or thyroid ultrasounds. Some tests may be appropriate when specific signs suggest an underlying condition.

The passage describes a method for displaying markers on virtual items selected by a user or teammate directly in a virtual scene. A terminal renders the marker near the item using information that a server may share with teammates whose virtual objects are within visible distance. Markers can indicate the marking user, item type, and distance; they may also appear on a map and disappear after a set duration. The passage also describes an apparatus, computer device, and storage medium for implementing the method.

Letters published by Grassroots Leadership describe women’s experiences in immigration detention and the anguish of being separated from their children. One anonymous Guatemalan woman said she spent eight days in a holding center without bathing or brushing her teeth and went 21 days without knowing her children’s whereabouts. Her lawyer said the children were released to their father on June 19 and the woman was released from custody on June 26. Other women wrote about missing their children and seeking reunification. ICE said it could not address specific mistreatment claims without the writers’ identities and facility names.

A Texas judge ordered Texas State University to reinstate history professor Thomas Alter, who was fired for allegedly inciting violence during a virtual conference speech. He will not teach or receive pay while the university reviews his case and his lawsuit continues.

Pairs trading buys one asset and sells a historically related asset to profit when the difference between their prices, or spread, changes. It aims to reduce dependence on market direction, but differences in the assets’ behavior mean it is not necessarily market-neutral. Pair selection may consider correlation, cointegration, and company fundamentals. Risks include spreads that do not converge, leverage, shorting costs, commissions, slippage, and sudden losses. The passage reports positive results from some simple backtests, but says its KO/PEP and GS/MS backtests returned less than buying and holding the S&P 500. It concludes that pairs trading can still be profitable, though easy opportunities have diminished.

Henrik Lundqvist said a last-second first-period goal was difficult, but his team created chances afterward and remained close in the series. He said deflections contributed to goals against him, though he needs to raise his level. Despite the difficult position, he believes the team can turn the series around by focusing on tomorrow’s game, starting well and earning a win. He praised the opponent’s defense and goaltending and said his team needs traffic in front of the net.

A study of blood samples from 40 ALS patients and 28 people without ALS found stronger T cell responses to the protein C9orf72 in patients, particularly those with C9orf72 mutations. Among patients with these responses, higher production of the anti-inflammatory molecule IL-10 was linked to longer predicted survival. The findings suggest immune responses may matter in ALS, but do not establish whether they drive the disease or result from it. Researchers plan larger studies and tests of that question.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2016, reports revenue of $2.30 billion and net income of $21.9 million, compared with revenue of $936.8 million and a net loss of $229.9 million a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2016, Tesla reported a $553.6 million net loss. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $3.08 billion at September 30. Tesla produced approximately 25,180 vehicles during the quarter and continued expanding Model X production. It also disclosed a proposed acquisition of SolarCity, subject to closing conditions, and plans to expand Model 3 production and the Gigafactory.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% year to date, but slipped 1.6% on August’s first trading day. Longer-term trend indicators remained healthy, while weakening short-term breadth and a seasonal rise in volatility and credit spreads signaled caution. Investors were increasing their exposure to technology stocks, and U.S. electricity demand reached a new high.

Cryptocurrency-related crime appears to be rising in Japan despite a decline in reported crime overall. The theft of 523 million NEM coins from Coincheck, which said it lost ¥58 billion, followed an FSA warning about its security. Other concerns include alleged fraud, ransomware and initial coin offerings (ICOs). The FSA has warned that ICO tokens can rapidly lose value and may be used in fraud, while ICO regulation in Japan remains uncertain. Facebook has banned ICO ads, and U.S. authorities have halted an allegedly fraudulent ICO.

The speaker prioritizes preventing goals, avoiding turnovers, and winning two more games over personal records. Prior experience helps with media attention, which can be enjoyable but sometimes excessive.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Secretary Abid Majeed ordered committees headed by paediatricians to oversee an October measles vaccination campaign targeting 4.3 million children aged nine to 59 months. He called for public awareness efforts, staff training, adequate supplies and systems to address adverse effects. Officials said the campaign follows rising measles cases across the province.

Auswide Bank emerged from Queensland building societies, listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in 1994, and became a bank in 2015. Its mission emphasizes customer service and the “power of small.” At June 30, 2020, it reported AUD3.789 billion in assets, AUD3.206 billion in net loans and advances, and AUD18.5 million in annual net profit after tax. The case lists representative fiscal 2021 transactions involving shares, borrowing, deposits, loans, expenses, a loan sale, dividends, depreciation, and loan impairment. It asks readers to record the transactions and calculate a 2021 balance sheet, net income, and cash flow.

Motivate added 250 electric pedal-assist bikes to Ford GoBike stations in San Francisco. The bikes are intended to make the city’s hills easier to navigate, attract more riders and encourage longer trips. Transit officials hope bike-share can help people travel between homes or workplaces and transit stops without cars. The e-bikes are available only in San Francisco for now; Motivate says it worked with the city on station locations and bike numbers.

IDC says simulations, modeling, data analytics, and high-performance computing (HPC) can help manufacturers accelerate development, optimize operations, and create digital products and business models. It recommends a shared data strategy, an HPC operating model suited to each enterprise’s needs, and attention to scalability, security, energy efficiency, and external expertise. The white paper draws on a December 2021 survey of 200 decision makers at large industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

A report commissioned by Ontario Premier Kathleen Wynne recommends eliminating provincewide Grade 3 and Grade 9 EQAO tests, changing Grade 6 testing, and ending the requirement that high school students pass a literacy test to graduate. Education Minister Indira Naidoo-Harris said further consultation was needed before implementing the recommendations, after the June 7 election. The report favors a larger role for classroom assessment and calls for tests to be more accessible to First Nations students. EQAO, which was not consulted during the review, warned that eliminating Grade 3 testing would remove substantial independent data used to improve elementary schools. The passage argues that reduced standardized testing would weaken accountability and make learning problems harder to identify.

The Ayoub Sisters credit their musical education in Scotland with helping them build successful classical music careers and want other young musicians to have free access to tuition. Music tuition charges and cuts vary across Scotland: Renfrewshire has increased spending and keeps lessons free, while Clackmannanshire has doubled its fee. Campaigners warn that costs restrict access, and the EIS reports a sharp decline in music teachers. The Scottish government funds primary-school music through the Youth Music Initiative, but says councils decide whether to charge for additional tuition.

The speaker values joining Detroit and winning the Stanley Cup, hopes to return next year, and respects a longtime coach who is retiring. Without the earlier controversy, the speaker is better able to enjoy the experience.

The Angels will not retain manager Ron Washington for 2026, and interim manager Ray Montgomery will not receive the full-time role. Washington missed much of 2025 after quadruple-bypass surgery, but said he is healthy and wants to keep managing. He said the team attributed its decision to performance, not his health. The Angels finished 72-90, their 10th consecutive losing season.

Toy Lykins challenged the unions’ use of dues he was required to pay as a condition of employment for purposes beyond collective bargaining, contract administration, and grievance adjustment. The district court denied the unions’ summary judgment motion, finding a justiciable controversy and rejecting their argument that Lykins had failed to pursue available financial-report remedies. It held that the National Labor Relations Act does not authorize spending a dissenter’s required dues on political or ideological purposes, but deferred deciding which expenditures, if any, must be refunded. A later order removed the memorandum’s jurisdiction discussion and withdrew the requirement that Lykins amend his complaint.

The lecture explains how causal systems described by linear constant-coefficient difference equations can be implemented as digital networks using delays, coefficient multiplications, and additions. It compares block diagrams with signal flow graphs, where branches represent operations and node values are sums of incoming branch outputs. The resulting equations can be written in matrix form, separating coefficient branches from delay branches and expressing a higher-order difference equation as coupled first-order equations. Node variables can be computed sequentially when the coefficient matrix has no nonzero entries on or above its main diagonal. A delay-free loop prevents sequential computation, though its equations may still be solvable.

A Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey found that more than one in four U.S. public school teachers lack basic materials or staffing support. Nearly two-thirds reported shortages of teaching assistants or similar staff, and 62% reported insufficient mental health resources or special educators. Teachers with adequate resources were more likely to be satisfied at work than those without them (77% versus 44%). Teachers in low-income schools reported greater shortages of laptops and printing supplies. About half said their professional development was not grounded in students’ needs or learning.

In June 1843, Britain stated that its occupation of the Sandwich Islands was unauthorized and promised an inquiry. The passage describes competition among American, British, and French interests in Hawaii, while portraying the United States as supportive of Hawaiian independence. Hawaiian envoys sought international recognition; in December 1842, the United States recognized Hawaii’s independence and opposed foreign interference without establishing a formal treaty. On November 28, 1843, Britain and France agreed to regard the islands as independent and not take possession of them. Their agreement did not protect Hawaii against third powers.

Elliott Management, which owns about 6 percent of NXP Semiconductors, said NXP is worth US$135 per share, above Qualcomm’s US$110-per-share offer. Elliott argued the offer limits NXP’s valuation and said it had retained UBS to analyze the company.

After a 2-0 defeat to Spurs, Manchester United host Huddersfield seeking to protect their top-four position. Alexis Sanchez is set for his home debut, while Jose Mourinho will address Marouane Fellaini’s fitness and his touchline exchange with Paul Pogba.

Robert Cyrus Garrison was convicted of first-degree rape and sentenced to 30 years in prison. The Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals held that an instruction about good-time credits was improper and prejudicial to sentencing, but did not warrant reversal. It reduced his sentence to 15 years and otherwise affirmed the judgment.

An exploratory case study examined the Washington Education Association’s first union-led teacher residency program during the 2023–24 academic year. Created to address special education teacher shortages and limited workforce diversity, the non-university-affiliated program enrolled 16 residents in three Washington school districts.

The 18-month program combined flexible coursework, four nine-week classroom placements, competency-based assessments, mentoring, coaching, and training in culturally responsive practices and educational technology. Residents received a salary of at least $40,000 and benefits, and committed to working in their placement district for three years after licensure. The study drew on interviews, observations, program materials, and a technology needs assessment.

Because the inaugural cohort had not completed the program, certification and teacher-retention rates could not be calculated. The study’s short duration and small sample also limit the generalizability of its findings.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU and its architecture for AI, HPC, and data analytics. Compared with the V100, it offers higher Tensor Core performance, support for additional data formats, larger caches, faster memory, and improved multi-GPU connectivity. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated instances. CUDA features include asynchronous copy, barriers, and task graph acceleration. The A100’s 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity can double Tensor Core throughput for deep neural networks.

The Japan Society of Technology Education developed a new framework for technology and engineering education to inform future curriculum reform and clarify the field’s role in STEAM education. A survey of 1,656 Japanese junior high school students found positive views of Technology classes but limited exploration of technology and weak links between design problem-solving and abilities for technological innovation and governance.

The framework emphasizes engineering science, connections between physical and cyber technologies, and a triple-loop design process covering needs exploration, technical exploration, and creation. It also proposes a STEAM learning model centered on designing products or systems to address real-world problems. In an evaluation by 90 society members, most proposals received mean agreement scores above 3 on a four-point scale; feedback prompted a revision of the definition of engineering. The authors state that the framework’s effects still need to be tested in classrooms and that implementation will require teacher education and training.

NVIDIA reported that its Compensation Committee approved a new performance-based restricted stock unit notice and agreement on March 6, 2019, and adopted a fiscal 2020 variable compensation plan on March 8. The plan offers eligible executive officers cash awards based on fiscal 2020 revenue goals, generally requiring employment through the payment date. Target awards at base operating plan achievement are $1.1 million for Jen-Hsun Huang, $300,000 for Colette Kress, $650,000 for Ajay Puri, and $250,000 each for Debora Shoquist and Timothy Teter.

Tesla appointed Zachary Kirkhorn chief financial officer, succeeding Deepak Ahuja, and Vaibhav Taneja chief accounting officer on March 13, 2019. Kirkhorn previously held finance roles at Tesla; Taneja was its corporate controller. Kirkhorn will receive $12 million in stock options and $4 million in restricted stock units. Taneja will receive $6 million and $2 million, respectively. Both grants will vest over four years under Tesla’s standard equity policies.

A state audit found that former Duquesne School District superintendent Barbara McDonnell authorized about $41,000 in unapproved, interest-free personal loans to herself and three employees. The loans were repaid, but the auditor general referred the matter to the State Ethics Commission. The audit also identified missing documentation for $1.3 million in transportation reimbursements and at least $180,000 in state overpayments.

Accepting the Republican presidential nomination, the speaker calls for constitutional, party-led government and restored congressional authority. He opposes joining a world government or military alliance while supporting peace, reduced armaments and cooperation among nations. At home, he urges greater production, economic restraint, cooperation among labor, management and capital, and support for farmers, transportation and private enterprise. He also advocates civil liberties, law enforcement, veterans’ aid, equal rights for Black citizens and women’s suffrage.

The Port Hardy Secondary School senior girls’ soccer team placed second at the Island Championships and qualified for provincials for the first time. They beat Duncan Christian 6-1, lost 5-4 to Glenlyon Norfolk, then defeated St. Andrews 3-1 in overtime to secure a provincial berth. They lost the final 4-3 to Glenlyon Norfolk. The team will compete at the BC Single A High School Provincials in Penticton from May 31 to June 3.

Christian Pulisic scored early and set up Jozy Altidore as the United States beat Panama 4-0 in World Cup qualifying Friday. Altidore scored twice, and Bobby Wood added the fourth goal. The win ended a three-match qualifying winless streak and moved the U.S. two points ahead of Panama into third place, the region’s final automatic qualifying spot.

On September 1, 1900, Secretary of State John Hay certified that the annexed documents were true copies from State Department files. In testimony, Captain George O. Baker said the Ochotsk Sea whaling season generally ran from mid-August to mid-October, with September the best period. He expected a seasonal catch of six to ten right whales. Baker said worsening weather would make returning from Vladivostok to the whaling grounds on October 1 impractical. He estimated that nine whales would yield about 900 barrels of oil and 10,000 pounds of bone.

Maine lobstermen formed Lobster 207 with the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers in 2013 after low prices, regulatory pressures, and limited influence over their industry prompted organizing. The group became both a union local and a marketing cooperative. With union support, members gained a stronger voice in state politics and contributed to several legislative victories. In 2017, the cooperative bought a $4 million wholesale lobster business, financed with help from the union, its locals, a lender, and the seller. The purchase let members market their catch and potentially share profits. By November 2017, Lobster 207 represented about 550 lobstermen, though only 250 were current on dues. Its long-term economic benefits remained uncertain as members faced debt, expansion decisions, and the unfamiliar demands of overseeing a wholesale business.

The passage argues that Trump’s approach to military authority, immigration and the judiciary conflicts with concerns expressed in the Declaration of Independence. It says the Founders favored civilian control of the military, immigration and judicial independence, and disputes Trump’s claims about immigration and wages.

Berkshire Hathaway is reportedly considering buying Occidental’s OxyChem petrochemical unit for about $10 billion. The deal could be Berkshire’s largest since 2022. Berkshire holds a 28.2% stake in Occidental and has $344 billion in cash.

Alpha-N Performance upgraded a BMW M4 Coupe to 560 horsepower with revised software, GTS-derived drivetrain and stability-control settings, adjustable suspension, lighter wheels, carbon-fiber bodywork and Recaro seats. The modified car completed a Nürburgring bridge-to-gantry lap in 7:20. The price was not disclosed.

Joel Greenblatt’s Magic Formula ranks stocks by return on capital and earnings yield to identify financially strong, potentially undervalued companies. A backtest of the 30 highest-ranked stocks among large US companies reported 30.8% annual returns from 1988 to 2004, versus 12.4% for the S&P 500. Other tests reported strong results in several Nordic markets, but a 1999–2023 backtest showed substantial underperformance after 2014. Critics cite possible small-cap bias, omitted transaction costs and the formula’s failure to account for company-specific factors. Past results do not guarantee future performance.

The lecture contrasts Unix privilege mechanisms with capabilities. A Fortran compiler with permission to write system files became a “confused deputy” when a user directed its output to a protected file. Capabilities address this risk by making authority explicit: possession of an unforgeable capability, such as a file descriptor, grants access to a specific object, potentially with restricted operations.

Capsicum uses capabilities to sandbox vulnerable application components. After `cap_enter`, a process cannot access global namespaces such as file paths, network addresses or process IDs without appropriate capabilities. Its library also helps start sandboxes with explicitly selected file descriptors and fresh memory. Examples include isolating tcpdump’s packet parser and gzip’s decompression code.

The lecture notes limits: developers must grant appropriate capabilities, directory access can still require Unix permission checks, and sandboxed programs may need outside services for later connections or DNS queries. Security also depends on correctly enforcing restrictions across kernel system calls.

Northern New York will be mostly sunny Monday and Tuesday, with highs in the 20s to lower 30s and overnight lows near zero to the teens. Partly sunny days and partly cloudy nights follow through Saturday, with highs generally in the 30s. Some areas have a 30 percent chance of snow showers Sunday; eastern Essex may see snow or rain showers.

Roundhill Investments relaunched its meme-stock ETF under the MEME ticker on Wednesday. Its previous version debuted near a Nasdaq peak in 2021 and closed in 2023. A market technician called the relaunch a possible sign of investor exuberance. The new fund includes quantum computing stocks and fell more than 2% Wednesday afternoon.

The lecture designs a digital low-pass filter from analog Butterworth filters using impulse invariance and the bilinear transformation. Butterworth filters have a monotonic response determined by cutoff frequency and order; higher orders produce a sharper transition. The digital specifications require no more than 1 dB loss through 0.2π and at least 15 dB attenuation from 0.3π.

Both methods require a sixth-order filter. For impulse invariance, the design meets the passband limit and exceeds the stopband requirement to allow for aliasing, which proves minimal in this example. The bilinear method pre-warps the frequency limits, meets the stopband requirement exactly, and provides greater attenuation at higher frequencies. The sampling parameter T does not affect the resulting digital design.

Thokozani Khupe was elected leader of a breakaway MDC faction at an extraordinary congress. She defended the election of Linda Masarira as spokesperson against complaints that Masarira had been imposed, and accused male critics of fearing women’s participation in politics. Khupe said she did not regret splitting from Nelson Chamisa, whom she and her allies accuse of seizing the party leadership after Morgan Tsvangirai’s death. Chamisa has asked the Bulawayo High Court to stop Khupe’s faction from using the MDC name and trademark. The dispute matters ahead of nominations because the electoral commission says parties cannot use the same name and symbols without a court resolution.

Walmart will offer eligible U.S. Walmart and Sam’s Club employees associate’s or bachelor’s degrees in business or supply chain management for $1 a day, covering the remaining tuition, fees and books. Workers qualify after 90 days and must attend one of three designated universities. About 1.4 million workers are eligible; Walmart expects 68,000 to participate over five years.

Defensive ends line up at the edge of the offensive line and help stop the run and disrupt passing plays. They defend assigned gaps, pressure quarterbacks, and can cause sacks, hurried throws, batted passes, and fumbles. The position calls for strength, quickness, recognition, and consistent technique. Effective pass rushers can create pressure without frequent blitzes, allowing defenses to keep more players in coverage. The passage names Reggie White, Bruce Smith, and Dwight Freeney as notable defensive ends.

Sierra Linarducci’s father bought $10,000 in bitcoin when it was worth $4,000 per coin. After its value quadrupled, the investment covered her Indiana wedding and a surprise bridal shower. He pays vendors through a BitPay card rather than with bitcoin directly. The passage also notes bitcoin’s sharp price swings: financial experts warn investors to risk only what they can afford to lose, while some investors see potential in bitcoin and its underlying blockchain technology.

Utah County has contracted former federal public defender Kathryn N. Nester to represent Tyler James Robinson, 22, who is accused of fatally shooting Charlie Kirk at Utah Valley University on Sept. 10. Robinson could face the death penalty if convicted. The defense contract is expected to cost $750,000 over the next year, while prosecutors anticipate about $600,000 in additional expenses.

After two poor games, the team won twice at home, with its third and fourth lines contributing. The speaker says the team is moving the puck better and must create more chances while playing patient, disciplined defense. Early road success built confidence.

The Inquiry is assembling maps and studies of resources, populations, trade, frontiers, military geography, international law, and economics for use at a peace conference. Its Executive Committee plans to edit the material into concise briefs, with costs limited largely to necessary paid staff and supplies. A December 1917 memorandum assesses Allied military setbacks in Europe and says an invasion of Austria-Hungary is no longer possible. It argues that Allied control of Saloniki, Baghdad, Palestine, and Arabia has obstructed parts of the Berlin–Baghdad project, provided those areas remain outside German control.
AncestryDNA research suggests Britons have an average of 16,000 relatives up to eighth cousins, though most know only 1% of their family. The North West has the largest average, at 20,000 relatives.

The TLV321x comparators hold their outputs low during power-on reset, which lasts up to 32 µs after the supply crosses 1.65 V. After the delay, the output reflects the differential input. Propagation delay varies with input transition and overdrive voltage; smaller overdrive generally increases delay. External hysteresis can reduce output chatter near the switching threshold, with resistor-network configurations described for inverting and non-inverting circuits. The passage also describes a low-side current-sensing application and recommends close supply bypassing, stable power, and careful trace routing to prevent ringing, false triggers, and oscillation. TI states that application guidance must be validated by customers.

The President urges the United States to uphold democracy through just laws at home and support for weaker nations abroad. He calls on Congress to address domestic injustices, pass a revised national budget bill, limit expenditures, maintain tax revenues, reduce war debt, and simplify income and profits taxes. He reports improved federal finances but warns that approaching debt maturities and payments to railroads constrain further progress.

He also urges better medical care, training, and employment assistance for disabled veterans; measures to support agriculture and chemical manufacturing; and regulation and labeling of cold-storage goods. Internationally, he proposes a supervised loan to Armenia and asks Congress to grant the Philippines independence, saying it has met the condition Congress set.

The passage describes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) protocol for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests. These features protect guest register state from the hypervisor; the GHCB lets guests selectively share state needed to handle non-automatic exits. The specification defines the shared GHCB page, protocol negotiation, hypervisor feature advertisement, guest physical address registration for SEV-SNP, and required behavior for guests and hypervisors. It also covers error handling, boot and interrupt considerations, and requests for operations such as page state changes. Later revisions add support for features including APIC ID lists, multiple VMPL levels, trusted I/O, and Secure AVIC.

On August 21, a total solar eclipse will cross the United States from Oregon to South Carolina, while other parts of North America will see a partial eclipse. The moon will pass between Earth and the sun, casting shadows that determine where each type of eclipse is visible.

The passage describes LASIK as a pain-free vision correction surgery with immediate results and a quick return to most activities. It says the procedure may reduce spending on glasses, contacts and eye check-ups, and advises consulting a surgeon before resuming activities.

The passage lists diplomatic and wartime issues involving the United States and other countries. Several Latin American countries, China, Siam, and Liberia severed relations with or declared war on Germany in 1917. Other matters included German ships held in neutral ports, naval cooperation, submarine warfare, trade restrictions, and a proposed Latin American congress. It also identifies disputes over British controls on neutral shipping and mail, neutral duties concerning recruitment and armed merchant ships, passport rules, and the return and representation of diplomats after relations were severed.

The Zipper offense uses a ball-side down screen to free shooters while creating opportunities for drives, post-ups, ball reversal, and weakside attacks. A point guard dribbles to a wing as shooters move off screens, then chooses a drive or pass based on the defense. The offense includes counters to overplays, switches, and double teams, and can flow into several other offensive actions. Effective execution depends on coordinated screening, timing, communication, and practice.
The appeals court denied Neuman’s petition, finding no legal error in the circuit court’s decision upholding the refusal of a fence/wall variance.
The May 2021 amendment documents changes to the final analyses. Of 499 patients assessed, 489 were randomized; 434 attended the Day 15 visit and 423 attended the Day 30 visit.

The paper studies how to transport theorems about LF typing judgements between schematically defined context families. It develops context schema subsumption, drawing on type subordination, and uses it to justify a sound transportation rule for the L𝐿𝐹 logic. The authors discuss integrating the rule into the Adelfa proof assistant and illustrating its use with examples.

Researchers developed MeTro, an elastic surgical glue designed to seal wounds in moving tissues such as lungs, arteries and the heart. It sets within 60 seconds under UV light and has been successfully tested on rodent and pig lungs. Clinical testing is the next step.

Amazon’s Chime enters a crowded communications market with voice, video, chat and online meetings. It supports conferences of up to 100 people, screen sharing, recording and personalized meeting URLs. Native apps span Android, iOS, Mac OS and Windows, with scheduling integrations for Google Calendar and Outlook. Attendees can switch devices during a meeting without disconnecting.

Apple’s fiscal 2020 Form 10-K reports net sales of $274.5 billion, up 6% from 2019, and net income of $57.4 billion. Sales growth was driven primarily by Services and Wearables, Home and Accessories. Apple sells smartphones, computers, tablets, wearables and related services. COVID-19 disrupted its operations and temporarily closed stores, while its future impact remained uncertain. During 2020, Apple repurchased $72.5 billion of stock, paid $14.1 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents, and completed a four-for-one stock split.

A proposal would place the Organization in an internationalized district near Geneva. In a memorandum for the President before Colonel Stanley’s January visit, Pasvolsky said official talks would concern the Anglo-American Caribbean Commission, while informal discussions might address dependent territories. U.S. views under consideration favored distinguishing trust territories from colonies, independence for capable dependencies, international accountability, and a declaration of administrative standards. Both sides favored advisory regional commissions, though U.S. participation and their relationship to the proposed international organization remained undecided.

Coaches should teach the rules and safety considerations of soccer tackling before teaching techniques. A legal tackle attempts to dispossess an opponent without violating Law 12. Defenders should position themselves, contain the attacker and choose an appropriate moment and technique. Referees assess contact and force; careless challenges can result in a direct free kick, reckless challenges in a caution, and challenges using excessive force in a sending-off. A foul in the defender’s penalty area results in a penalty kick. Contacting the ball first does not excuse illegal contact. Coaching should emphasize timing, control, safe technique and avoiding tackles likely to injure an opponent.

Bruce Bochy and the Texas Rangers mutually agreed to end his managerial tenure after three seasons. He led the franchise to its first World Series title in 2023, but the Rangers missed the playoffs in the next two seasons and finished 81-81 this year. Texas offered Bochy a front-office advisory role. Skip Schumaker is a potential replacement, though the team has not begun its search.

Cover 3 uses four underneath defenders and three deep-zone defenders to limit downfield passes while allowing an extra defender to help stop the run. Its pre-snap alignment can also disguise coverage. Offenses target its vulnerable seams and flats with quick throws, RPOs, four-vertical routes and flood concepts. The passage illustrates these approaches through plays from Ole Miss, Michigan, Oklahoma and BYU.

U.S. Treasury yields fell to a five-month low after President Trump said he wanted interest rates to remain low. The dollar initially slumped on his comment that it was “getting too strong,” then recovered. European stocks declined, led by banks hurt by a flatter yield curve. Strong Chinese trade data and Trump’s decision not to label China a currency manipulator supported Asian shares. Investors also remained uneasy about France’s presidential election. Oil edged higher, while gold was little changed near a five-month high.

Twelve-year-old Charlotte Olson collected more than 2,000 books through donations from neighbors and local businesses. She delivered 1,303 books to Cooper University Health System’s Read and Reach Out program and raised $250 to buy more. The program gives books to young patients and serves more than 75,000 children annually across New Jersey.

The NR7 strategy enters after a day with a narrow trading range, but it has no defined exit rule. The authors tested their own version on the SPY ETF from its 1993 inception. It produced a 7.8% compound annual growth rate, a 0.27% average gain across 899 trades, and a 25% maximum drawdown. Adding an undisclosed parameter raised the average gain per trade to 0.46% and reduced drawdown to 13%, with fewer trades. The authors say NR7 may diversify strategies that buy on weakness, but caution against excessive optimization and faulty price data.

In his final annual message to Congress, the President reports national prosperity and urges respect for the Union, the Constitution, and the equal rights of states. He condemns sectional agitation over slavery, defends the repeal of the territorial restriction in the Kansas–Nebraska Act, and says federal forces have restored tranquillity in Kansas without bloodshed by U.S. troops. He argues that the President cannot oversee territorial elections.

He reports strong federal revenues and reduced public debt, urges lower customs revenue and revisions to Treasury laws, and recommends improvements to the Army and Navy. Foreign relations remain generally amicable, though disputes persist over trade, maritime rights, and injuries to U.S. citizens. He describes negotiations with Britain and other powers and calls for indemnity and stronger protection of U.S. citizens and transit across the Isthmus of Panama.

The speaker says the United States entered the war unprepared but must fight to defend its rights and security. They argue that the outcome will be decided on Europe’s western front and that America must continue fighting even if its allies fail. They call for sacrifice, national unity, and a renewed commitment to freedom and justice.

North Wales Police made 55 drink-driving and 40 drug-driving arrests in just over two weeks of a summer campaign launched on 14 June. Officers increased patrols and used intelligence-led tactics to identify offenders. Police urged the public to report suspected impaired drivers.

SIG appointed Ernst & Young as its auditor as Britain’s accounting watchdog investigated Deloitte’s audits of SIG’s 2015 and 2016 statements. SIG is reviewing historic accounts after allegations of overstated profits. First-half revenue rose 0.6%, and the company maintained its full-year underlying profit expectations.

Canada’s S&P/TSX composite rose for a seventh straight day to a record high, led by financial shares after strong Canadian and U.S. economic data. U.S. stocks opened little changed as investors weighed the data and Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen’s comments that delaying an interest-rate increase would be unwise. Oil prices fell as a report of sharply higher U.S. crude inventories raised supply concerns despite strong OPEC compliance with production cuts. A stronger U.S. dollar also pressured oil.

Alexei Ponikarovsky calls tomorrow’s game a must-win and says the team remains positive despite trailing in a close series. He says they need to get shots past blockers, create rebounds and crowd the goalie, recalling that they overcame two shutouts to beat the Rangers.

The passage traces the 2008 financial crisis to the collapse of the U.S. housing market after years of rising prices, easier lending, high-risk mortgages, and growing household debt. Mortgage defaults drove down housing prices and the value of mortgage-related securities, leaving banks exposed. Uncertainty about losses and counterparties then restricted lending and spread the crisis through the financial system.

The passage identifies deregulation, complex and lightly regulated derivatives, close ties between Wall Street and Washington, and strong global demand for investments as contributing factors. Andrew Lo emphasizes how prosperity encouraged risk-taking and how fear deepened the subsequent freeze in credit. Simon Johnson argues that powerful financial institutions took excessive risks with implicit government backing.

The U.S. government responded with financial assistance, a program to purchase troubled assets, and stress tests of major banks. Johnson advocated temporary government control to clean up and break apart troubled banks before returning them to private ownership. Lo proposed more effective regulation, greater transparency, improved risk management and corporate governance, and changes to finance education. By spring 2009, the effectiveness of the government’s response and the crisis’s full consequences remained uncertain.

Cambridgeshire Short Mat bowls’ first fixture after the AGM was a ladies-versus-men triples match. The ladies won 20–16, with 163 shots to 157. CMB BC also won a close Ivan Henson Memorial Trophy final against March Town, taking the match 3–2 and winning 66–62 on shots.

The study develops a neodymium model atom and calculates non-local thermodynamic equilibrium (NLTE) abundance corrections for metal-poor FGK stars. Tests indicate that missing high-energy atomic levels have negligible effects on the corrections. Across the calculated grid, corrections range from −0.3 to +0.5 dex and vary with stellar parameters and spectral lines. Optical corrections are generally positive, especially for blue lines in cool, metal-poor giants, while near-infrared H-band corrections can be negative. The authors conclude that NLTE modeling is important for reliable neodymium abundance measurements and recommend higher-excitation lines when possible.

At a Toronto rally attended by nearly 2,000 supporters, new Ontario Progressive Conservative leader Doug Ford said he could win a majority by attracting voters beyond his party. He criticized Liberal Premier Kathleen Wynne’s financial management and health-care spending promises. Ford pledged to revive manufacturing, develop northern mining projects, cut taxes and hydro rates, and roll back regulations. His former leadership rivals joined him onstage, while supporters praised his relatability and fiscal proposals.

The passage specifies the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), a 4 KB shared page used by SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests to communicate with a hypervisor while limiting exposed guest state. It describes protocol versions, feature advertisement, negotiation, GHCB address registration, and MSR and VMGEXIT requests. Supported operations include page state changes, firmware guest requests, AP management, trusted I/O, Secure AVIC, and termination. It also defines how guests and hypervisors handle non-automatic exits and errors. For SEV-SNP restricted injection, it specifies a shared #HV doorbell page for interrupt notifications and end-of-interrupt handling.

In his inaugural address, the speaker thanks President Clinton and Vice President Gore and describes the peaceful transfer of power as an American tradition. He says the nation is united by ideals of freedom, equality and opportunity, while acknowledging that failing schools, prejudice and poverty leave some citizens behind. He pledges to pursue justice and unity through civility, courage, compassion and personal responsibility. His priorities include improving schools, reforming Social Security and Medicare, reducing taxes, strengthening defenses and confronting weapons of mass destruction. He calls on government, community institutions and citizens to serve those in need and work for the common good.

Curtis Granderson hit his 300th career homer to break a tie in a five-run eighth inning, lifting the Mets to a 9-4 win over the Cubs. Lucas Duda added a three-run homer as New York rallied from a 4-1 deficit and took two of three in the series. Mets starter Matt Harvey allowed three homers in four innings and said he would see a doctor about his arm. Second baseman Neil Walker left with a leg injury.

The speaker credits his longtime French-speaking coach with helping him develop, communicate openly and stay confident. He says veteran goalie John has adapted well to a backup role and helped the team. Discussing a game, he emphasizes staying positive after early setbacks and says penalty killing and special teams helped shift momentum.

The release of *Fifty Shades Darker* has prompted lingerie retailers to promote bondage-inspired products, including Coco de Mer’s official collection and an Ann Summers advertising campaign. Online sellers continue to dominate sales. After the first film’s 2015 release, Ann Summers reported a year-on-year increase of over 42 percent in online bondage-product sales, while Bondara reported an average 30 percent rise across its products. Webgains reported that online sales of sex toys, bondage products and lingerie have risen 62 percent year on year since 2014.

In July 2020, the NHL and its players’ association negotiated both a return-to-play plan after the COVID-19 interruption and an extension of their collective bargaining agreement through 2025–26. The 2013 agreement allocated players 50% of league revenue, with payments to players or salary clawbacks depending on actual revenue and compensation. In the 2020 talks, player representative Emilie Castonguay and NHL Commissioner Gary Bettman faced renewed questions about how to measure revenue and compensation, including ticket sales, broadcasting rights, concessions, salaries, bonuses, deferred pay, and contract buyouts. Failure to reach a timely agreement risked lost games.

The passage highlights five Green Monday laptop deals: an HP Envy x360 convertible for $700, a VR-ready 14-inch Razer Blade gaming laptop for $1,600, an HP Laptop 14t for $190, a Dell I3567-3964BLK for $380, and a 14-inch Lenovo touchscreen 2-in-1 for $330. Their listed savings range from $70 to $200. The deals span basic-use, convertible, and gaming models, and availability may change as the holidays approach.

James Johnson’s murder conviction and life sentence were affirmed after his second trial. The court rejected his objection to jurors who had been struck or allegedly disqualified at the first trial because he identified no specific disqualification. It held that his statements about his father’s life insurance and bank money were admissible as possible evidence of motive. The court also upheld an instruction describing Johnson’s position that his father had been murdered but that he was innocent, and found the verdict supported by the evidence.

The Ninth Circuit granted Singh’s petition in part and remanded because the BIA had not considered his challenge to an adverse-credibility finding. It granted Kaur’s petition and remanded after the government conceded that her adverse-credibility finding lacked record support. The BIA must reconsider their claims as directed.

An NPR/Marist poll found that 30 percent of Americans earn money in addition to their full-time jobs. Museum worker Emily Doherty performs at historical sites to help cover expenses and student loans, but the work leaves little time for friends or family. Milwaukee therapist Jon Jacobs switched from bartending to driving for Lyft, accepting less pay for more time with his children. Doherty hopes to become financially stable enough to work less and visit her family in Maine.

On July 19, 2018, Microsoft filed a Form 8-K announcing that it had issued a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2018. The release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The speaker says putting the puck behind defenders rattled the opposition, but their own team lost its way after the second goal, became frustrated and took penalties. Despite being outplayed and losing in overtime, they remain confident their goalie will bounce back.

At its February 26, 2020 annual meeting, Apple shareholders elected seven directors, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the 2020 independent auditor, and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. They rejected three shareholder proposals concerning proxy access, sustainability and executive compensation, and freedom of expression.

Researchers have created hybrid embryos using frozen northern white rhino sperm and southern white rhino eggs, a step toward breeding the critically endangered subspecies. They plan to collect eggs from the two surviving females, use preserved sperm to create northern white rhino embryos, and implant them in southern white rhino surrogates. They are also investigating whether frozen skin cells can be turned into eggs. Critics question the cost and urge greater focus on other endangered rhinos, while researchers acknowledge risks in collecting eggs from the remaining females.

A Texas Monthly article traces Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a major energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. Skilling’s Gas Bank and trading strategy drove growth, while aggressive hiring, large bonuses and forced employee rankings shaped its culture. Enron expanded into electricity, international power projects, water and telecommunications, but several ventures faltered. In 2001, California’s energy crisis, the telecommunications downturn and questions about Enron’s accounting contributed to a falling stock price. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, citing personal sacrifices, and Lay returned promising a greater focus on Enron’s core business and changes to its employee-review system.

This volume documents the intellectual foundations of Reagan administration foreign policy through a representative selection of official records and public statements from across its eight years. It emphasizes officials’ perspectives and recurring themes, including a proposed reset of U.S. foreign policy, an activist bipartisan approach, and restraint and reciprocity in U.S.-Soviet relations. Footnotes and editorial notes identify sources and provide context. An advisory committee oversees the series’ editorial process. Declassification review, completed in 2022, withheld no documents in full and made minor excisions in three.

Ryshonda Harper Beechem became Pelahatchie’s first black mayor in 2017, winning by 12 votes. Her relationship with the town’s five-member board of aldermen has become publicly hostile. The board cut her annual salary from $12,000 to $3,000, citing budget needs, and has frequently overridden her vetoes. Beechem disputes the need for the cuts and has questioned the board’s financial dealings amid a state auditor’s investigation into alleged misappropriation of funds. Several town clerks resigned, and the board accepted Beechem’s veto of its proposed replacement. Residents debate the conflict online, including the town’s finances, Beechem’s conduct and whether race plays a role.

The Cleveland Indians beat the Minnesota Twins 3–1. Danny Salazar allowed one run over six innings and struck out seven, while Cleveland’s bullpen pitched three scoreless innings. Michael Brantley tied the game with an RBI groundout and added a solo home run; Edwin Encarnacion drove in the go-ahead run. The teams play again tomorrow, with Josh Tomlin facing Phil Hughes.

This prospective study compared changes in health-related quality of life from 24 to 36 months after treatment among 199 head and neck cancer survivors assessed before COVID-19 and 119 assessed during the pandemic. Overall, the groups showed no significant difference in change. Some subgroups differed: women had reduced physical activity; survivors receiving multimodality treatment reported greater appetite loss; those with moderate or severe comorbidity had worse swallowing; and those with a history of major depression had greater fear of recurrence. Survivors living alone reported less painkiller use, those with disease progression reported fewer financial problems, and those with higher body mass index reported less emotional loneliness. The findings do not apply to patients diagnosed and treated during the pandemic.

Twitter shares fell 9 percent after its fourth-quarter revenue of $717 million missed Wall Street expectations and its first-quarter guidance fell short of estimates. Earnings of 16 cents per share exceeded expectations. Monthly active users rose 4 percent year-over-year to 319 million, while advertising revenue slipped slightly to $638 million.

Women make up 11 percent of the information security workforce, and 51 percent of female cybersecurity employees surveyed reported experiencing discrimination. The passage also cites negative feedback in male-dominated settings and limited educator support as barriers. Glance Pay executives say an inclusive workplace supports innovation and business growth, including the company’s expansion into the United States. The passage calls for addressing bias, encouraging young women to enter technology, and building peer networks. Glance Technologies operates Glance Pay, a mobile payment system with merchant services and anti-fraud technology.

Text2MBL translates precise textual descriptions of modular building layouts into executable BIM code. Its action-based approach organizes modules, units, rooms, and architectural elements so layouts can be generated in Autodesk Revit. The authors implemented a proof-of-concept system, curated 198 verified designs with two descriptions each, and fine-tuned language models to generate the code. They evaluate executable validity, fidelity to the text, and geometric consistency.

In a retrospective study of 297 ALS patients in Bonn and 49 in Essen, higher serum cardiac troponin T (cTnT) was associated with poorer respiratory function. In the Bonn cohort, cTnT correlated negatively with the respiratory component of the ALS functional rating scale and with several pulmonary function measures, particularly slow and forced vital capacity. These key associations were also observed in the smaller Essen cohort, though not all reached statistical significance. cTnT showed moderate accuracy in identifying clinically relevant declines in respiratory measures, while neurofilament light chain did not correlate with respiratory function. The authors propose cTnT as a complementary ALS biomarker but note that the observational study cannot establish causality.

Paralyzed Veterans of America thanked retiring Deputy Secretary Tom Bowman for his service and said it looks forward to working with Acting VA Secretary Peter O’Rourke. It identified implementation of the VA MISSION Act as a priority and expressed concern that leadership changes could hinder it.

The passage explains common football pass routes and how coaches use route trees to teach them, noting that teams may assign routes differently. Short routes such as the hitch, slant, quick out, stick, flat and whip aim to give quarterbacks quick throws or stretch coverage. Option routes let receivers choose a path based on the defense but require close coordination with the quarterback. Vertical routes include the go, seam, corner, post and post-corner, which attack deeper areas or exploit defenders’ positioning. Intermediate routes such as the square out, dig, curl and comeback rely on cuts and, often, precise timing. Drag and shallow cross routes move receivers across the field, creating chances to catch the ball while running.

A modeling study in Brazil found that screening formerly incarcerated people for tuberculosis infection and offering preventive treatment would reduce TB cases and deaths and be cost-effective compared with no screening. A tuberculin skin test followed by a three-month isoniazid–rifapentine regimen was estimated to avert 31 lifetime TB cases and 4.1 deaths per 1,000 people, at $242 per disability-adjusted life year averted. Benefits were greatest for younger people, those incarcerated longer, and those screened soon after release.

AC Milan coach Gennaro Gattuso urged his team to stay grounded despite three straight Serie A wins and a six-game unbeaten run. With Milan seventh, he said talk of Champions League qualification was premature and praised the squad’s unity and Patrick Cutrone’s contribution. Ahead of Sunday’s match, Gattuso warned that Udinese are physically strong and quick on the counterattack.

The speaker describes a Stanley Cup loss as the hardest of their career, despite a strong season and a team that never quit. They say the game was tight, they came close to tying it, and Khabibulin made crucial saves. The team overcame injuries, but the speaker is disappointed by their own lack of contribution in the last two games. They expect the loss to linger and eventually motivate the young team.

This passage introduces the 2018 ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States: Diplomatic Papers, 1945, Volume I: General: The United Nations*. It describes the ebook’s features and citation guidance, names the volume’s editors, and sets out principles requiring comprehensive, historically objective documentation of major U.S. foreign policy decisions, subject to security considerations. It also explains that the *Foreign Relations* series briefly lists selected public foreign policy documents for 1945–1949, before a companion series begins in 1950.

The passage describes embodiments for operating wireless devices, including reduced-capability devices, and base stations in wireless communications systems, particularly for device access control. It outlines 5G network architecture, protocol layers, radio resources, RRC states, random access, carrier aggregation, reference signals, beam management, and device components. It also describes how base stations may configure wireless devices through control messages and parameters.

Joshua Thomas Teeter, 20, faces charges in Cerro Gordo County over the alleged theft of two snowmobiles and property from another trailer in Mason City. He is also charged in Worth County over an alleged safe theft. Other suspects have been charged in both counties.

A three-dimensional finite element model compared arterial tissue with collagen fibers that either terminated at a wall-thickness transition or continued across it. Under uniaxial loading, continuous fibers produced more uniform stretch and stress: at a tissue stretch of 1.5, the thick-to-thin stretch difference was 0.68%, versus 20% with abrupt terminations. Continuous fibers also increased local fiber density in the thin region, improving load sharing. Fiber tortuosity delayed collagen engagement, so wall thickness had a stronger effect at lower stretches. The study concludes that fiber architecture is important for modeling tissue mechanics, while noting that its idealized simulations require experimental validation.

The passage specifies conservative handling of incomplete adverse-event and medication dates, formulas for derived measures, and SAS quality-control requirements covering programs, logs, outputs, datasets, data verification, and documentation. It also lists planned tables, figures, and listings for patient characteristics, plasma glucose recovery, adverse events, safety assessments, and pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analyses. The displayed table and figure descriptions are templates, not study results.

The Supreme Court deferred the Trump administration’s request to let President Donald Trump fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook and will hear arguments in January 2026. A federal judge’s order keeping Cook in office remains in effect.

Trump cited mortgage-fraud allegations involving loans Cook obtained before joining the board; Cook denies them. The judge found Cook was likely to succeed in arguing that the allegations did not constitute the legally required “cause” for removal and that she was entitled to notice and an opportunity to be heard. The administration disputes the judge’s authority to keep her in office. The Supreme Court’s forthcoming decision will address the request to pause that order, not the underlying merits of Cook’s challenge.

LG says its SJ9500 Super UHD TV delivers its best 4K LCD picture quality yet. Its Nano Cell technology is designed to improve color, contrast and off-angle viewing. The TV supports several HDR formats and can simulate HDR for standard content. LG also announced the SJ8500 and SJ8000 with similar features. Pricing and release dates have not been announced.
The passage lists perspective, side, front, back, top, and bottom views of a carabiner.

The February 26, 2002, issue of Enerfax Daily reports natural gas and power prices alongside energy-industry news. March natural gas futures fell 6% to $2.307 per MMBtu, while next-day gas prices were generally flat to slightly higher. California asked FERC to void 32 long-term power contracts it considers overpriced. Other reports cover Arthur Andersen partners seeking new jobs amid Enron-related lawsuits, questions raised by a videotape of former Enron CEO Jeffrey Skilling, Williams Communications’ possible bankruptcy, Centrica’s planned acquisition of NewPower Holdings, and Dynegy’s plan to sell shares in a limited partnership.

The speaker says playing on the road requires following the team’s routine, though the upcoming game is exciting and likely to be intense. They credit the team’s depth, positive outlook and experience for its ability to stay focused through setbacks. Memories of last year’s accident involving longtime teammate Vladi and team helper Sergei remain important, and the speaker hopes to finish the series on Tuesday. They also say their negotiations involved only one person and that they have tried to fit into the team without disrupting its routine.

The passage introduces a patent application concerning non-invasive transcutaneous facial nerve stimulation to artificially elicit eye blinks, particularly in people with acute facial paralysis. It reviews facial nerve function, Bell’s palsy, blinking, dry eye syndrome, electrical stimulation, and electrode technologies. It also describes networking, wireless communication, smartphones, and messaging technologies as background.

Nelson Freeburg’s PENTAD Timing Model is a US stock-market strategy that uses four stock indices and an advance/decline line to generate weekly buy and sell signals. It uses moving-average envelopes and slopes: entering the market requires unanimous approval, while at least two opposing votes trigger an exit. The passage outlines a backtest but provides no results.

Asteroid 2025 TF, estimated at 1–3 meters wide, passed 428 km above Antarctica on October 1 and was detected hours later. It posed no danger. Follow-up observations by ESA astronomers established the timing and distance of its closest approach with high precision.

The Mortgage Collaborative added Strategic Compliance Partners to its preferred partner network to provide mortgage compliance support to member lenders. Strategic Compliance Partners offers attorney-led compliance management services and technologies. The Mortgage Collaborative’s network includes more than 110 lenders with annual origination volume exceeding $190 billion.

Rumors that large numbers of Tong Hâk planned to march on Seoul and expel foreigners could not be verified. Officials denied the reports, though some appeared uneasy; British and German gunboats left Chemulpo after their representatives found no clear evidence of danger. About forty Tong Hâk petitioners gathered at the palace, seeking recognition of their religion and, reportedly, a reversal of its founder’s condemnation. Their leader, Pak Siung-ho, described its teachings and denied hostility to foreigners. The writer also reported, while cautioning that the claims might be exaggerated, that some supporters were hostile to Roman Catholics.

The Facebook-Cambridge Analytica controversy brought data surveillance into public debate. The passage argues that inadequate consent is not the central concern: personal data can enable “personalized choice architecture,” using microtargeting to influence people’s decisions. While this approach could encourage beneficial behavior, its misuse could undermine individual autonomy and democratic elections.
