The author calls for systemic solutions addressing its social, economic, technical, legal and ethical implications.

General Electric said CFO Jeff Bornstein, marketing executive Beth Comstock and international executive John Rice will leave as new CEO John Flannery reshapes the struggling company’s leadership. Jamie Miller will become CFO on Nov. 1, and Pascal Schweitzer will serve as interim head of transportation. Flannery is reviewing GE’s businesses and cutting costs amid pressure from activist investor Trian Fund Management. GE is expected to lower its financial projections when he presents long-term turnaround plans in November.

Supervalu shares fell 3.04% to $14.36. Eight analyst price targets averaged $25.75, ranging from $14 to $55. Among the recommendations listed, one was Buy, one Outperform, seven Hold, two Underperform and none Sell. The stock’s 14-period ATR was 0.78, and its RSI was 42.74. Supervalu’s market capitalization was $558.46 million; 1.72 million shares traded, above its 1.47 million average.

Tesla’s Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release on April 2, 2022, furnished under the results of operations and Regulation FD disclosure items. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn signed the report on April 4.

The statistical analysis plan specifies how plasma dasiglucagon, GlucaGen, and glucose measurements will be handled and presented, including sampling times, values below quantification limits, pharmacokinetic metrics, and glucose-response analyses. It also outlines analyses of glucose recovery and rescue IV glucose use.

Safety analyses will cover exposure, injection-site tolerability, adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings, and immunogenicity. The plan defines treatment-emergent adverse events and describes how missing causality assessments will be handled. Appendices provide presentation standards, SAS programming quality-control requirements, and planned tables, figures, and listings.

On Aug. 21, 2017, a solar eclipse will cross the United States. A roughly 70-mile-wide path will experience totality, while other areas will see a partial eclipse. The moon’s shadow will reach Oregon at 10:16 a.m. PT and leave the Atlantic coast at 2:49 p.m. ET. During totality, the sky will darken, stars may appear and temperatures will drop.

Looking at the sun requires proper eclipse glasses or an indirect viewing method, except during the brief period when the moon completely covers it. The passage points to NASA’s interactive map for local viewing times, the American Astronomical Society’s list of reputable glasses vendors, and several livestreams.

The webinar introduces responsible sourcing in the cable value chain as cable demand and ESG requirements grow. Industry representatives will discuss supply-chain challenges, human-rights commitments and standards, beginning with Nexans’ approach.

The coach said his young team benefited from staying relaxed despite nerves and a nine-day layoff. Against defensively strong Dallas, he emphasized limiting neutral-zone turnovers, forechecking, disciplined play and special teams. He expected to match Peca against Modano when possible. After the game, he said early penalties and sluggishness hurt his team, but it improved in the third period and found a way to win. He credited penalty killing, a strong goaltending performance and the team’s persistence.

Alabama’s special Senate election pits Republican Roy Moore, a former state chief justice accused of sexual misconduct with teenage girls decades ago, against Democrat Doug Jones, a former federal prosecutor known for prosecuting two men responsible for the 1963 Birmingham church bombing. Moore denies the allegations. Jones and his supporters frame the vote as a chance to change Alabama’s reputation, while Moore’s supporters emphasize conservative values and President Donald Trump’s agenda. Republican Sen. Richard Shelby said he did not vote for Moore, but Trump is urging conservatives to back him. Both parties are watching for signs of what the result could mean for future elections.

The dollar held gains after Treasury Secretary Mnuchin said Trump’s comments on its strength did not signal a currency war. The euro traded narrowly ahead of France’s election, while sterling fell amid speculation that Prime Minister May could call an early election. The Australian dollar weakened after dovish central bank minutes and falling iron ore prices; the US dollar also rose against the Canadian dollar. Weak US Treasury yields and obstacles to healthcare and tax reform tempered expectations for stronger growth.

Williams & Connolly said hackers used a zero-day attack to access a small number of attorney email accounts. The firm found no evidence that confidential client data was taken from elsewhere in its systems and said it has blocked the threat actor. It believes the hackers are affiliated with a nation-state actor.

The Dow and S&P 500 fell as the 10-year Treasury yield briefly reached 3%. The author argues that central banks’ shift from buying assets to removing liquidity could drive broad asset-price declines and a market crash. He recommends rules-based trading over buy-and-hold investing, citing eight trades this year by his Sentiment Table Strategy that gained about 15% collectively. He also urges investors unable to trade proactively to protect their portfolios.

A randomized trial compared radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) plus an eight-week rehabilitation program with sham rESWT plus the same program in athletes with acute type 3b hamstring injuries. After four of 40 participants were excluded because their diagnoses could not be confirmed, 18 remained in each group. Mean time to return to sport was 25.4 days with rESWT versus 28.3 days with sham treatment, a statistically significant difference. Satisfaction and six-month re-injury rates did not differ significantly. The authors note the small sample and retrospective diagnostic exclusions as limitations.

Polkadot is a proposed framework for connecting heterogeneous parachains through a relay chain. Collators assemble candidate parachain blocks, and bonded validators check their validity and data availability before consensus determines which candidates enter relay-chain blocks. Nominators back validators with stake, while fishermen report misconduct; penalties address invalid blocks and other failures. The relay chain also routes asynchronous transactions between parachains through queues. By separating transaction execution from consensus, the framework aims to provide interoperability, scalability and shared security.

AnveshanaAI is a proposed adaptive AI/ML learning platform combining generated challenges, sandboxed coding assessment, simulations, viva-style interaction, progress tracking, and instructor analytics. Its dataset contains 10,845 question–answer pairs across 26 subject categories, with difficulty and Bloom’s taxonomy annotations. The reported evaluation found broad annotation coverage and question–answer semantic coherence. A Mistral-7B model fine-tuned on the dataset showed declining training and validation loss; quantitative evaluation reported perplexity of 2.04 and a BERTScore F1 of 0.427. Token-importance analysis highlighted terms relevant to the educational prompts.

German negotiator Schnurre said an agreement would intensify trade with Finland, including German supplies of coal, iron and artificial wool, while payment arrangements would be addressed later. In a February 1942 memorandum, Finland said it had permitted German troop transit in 1940 because of Soviet pressure. It described German military activity from Finland after June 1941 as co-belligerency without political commitments, and said its war aimed to protect its existence and security while preserving friendly relations with the United States. Asked about the memorandum, Foreign Minister Witting characterized the June 1941 Soviet attack as part of aggression dating from 1939 and said destroying Bolshevism was also a Finnish war aim.

U.S. stocks fell Tuesday after Caterpillar said it did not expect to exceed its first-quarter per-share profit during the rest of 2018. Investors also worried that rising oil and other costs could slow profit growth. The Dow closed down 424.56 points, while the S&P 500 fell 1.3 percent and the Nasdaq lost 1.7 percent. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly reached 3 percent for the first time since January 2014.

This specification update lists silicon issues in the AMD Geode CS5535 revision A3 and their effects and workarounds. The device does not meet the cited USB over-voltage requirement and needs external protection. Other issues can cause missed interrupts, failed or corrupted IDE transfers, unreliable USB operation with clock gating enabled, ACPI register access hangs, and failures involving wake events, LPC transactions, SMBus status, and sleep-state controls. Several problems depend on particular settings or access sequences. Recommended measures include disabling clock gating for affected functions, using DWORD-aligned IDE descriptors, avoiding byte access to specified ACPI registers, following the normal UDMA command sequence, and applying the register settings or software workarounds described for individual issues.

Microsoft filed an October 26, 2015 Form 8-K recasting three years of financial information through June 30, 2015 to reflect its new reporting segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The changes do not restate its audited financial statements or update disclosures for subsequent events.

A concrete dome containing radioactive waste from US nuclear tests at Enewetak Atoll is releasing contaminated water into the Pacific, according to veterans who worked on the cleanup. They say the crater was not lined before waste was deposited and fear rising seas and storms could worsen the leakage. A draughtsman who worked on the dome says structural damage is minimal but that it was designed to slow, not stop, radiation migration. Cleanup veterans are seeking US government help for health problems they attribute to radiation exposure and say they lacked protective equipment. Experts say the danger depends on how much radioactivity escapes and reaches people through food, water or other exposure.

In Jane Richmond v. Walter M. Richmond, the court granted a divorce for Walter’s adultery and placed their three children in Jane’s care. The chancellor held that alimony depends on each case’s circumstances, not solely on current rents or the wife’s needs, and that property should be valued at the date of the master’s report. After considering evidence of reduced property value and greater debts, the court set annual payments at $250 for Jane and $130 for each child, payable half-yearly. Walter was ordered to provide security and pay Jane’s costs. The decree made the payments a lien on his New Jersey property and allowed either party to seek changes if circumstances changed.

Nursery school headteachers warn that hundreds of schools could close if £60 million a year in supplementary funding ends after 2020. They say funding cuts and rising costs have forced staffing reductions and threaten provision for children with special needs. Around 400 council-funded nursery schools remain in England, with more than six in ten in deprived areas. Children and Families Minister Nadhim Zahawi said the government is working with nursery leaders and urged councils not to make premature decisions. Conservative MPs also called for funding certainty.

The author argues that Exxon Mobil is a buy after its share price fell near its 2015 lows. The case rests on its 4.1% dividend yield, year-over-year cash flow growth, discounted valuation and signs of stabilization in oil and natural gas prices. The author expects potential dividend increases and earnings growth, but notes that Exxon’s earnings projections remain debatable. A drop below the stock’s support level near $71.60 would be concerning. The author discloses a long position in Exxon.

Stefon Diggs caught 10 passes for 146 yards in the Patriots’ win over his former team, the Bills. He became the first Patriots player since Julian Edelman to record consecutive 100-yard receiving games in a season.

The passage describes a display apparatus with a flexible vibration module on the rear of its display panel. Alternating piezoelectric inorganic portions and flexible organic portions let the module vibrate the panel to produce sound or haptic feedback while resisting impact. The portions can have different shapes and sizes, and composite layers can be stacked to adjust vibration and sound characteristics. Separate modules and partitions can produce left and right sound channels. Manufacturing involves forming the composite, adding electrodes, polarizing the piezoelectric portions, and applying protective films.

Mega Geometry enables GPU-driven cluster generation and fast BVH construction for subdivision surfaces. By mapping tessellation to cluster generation, it supports rapid BVH rebuilding for animated surfaces and changing viewpoints.

The theorem of irrelevance reduces detection in independent white Gaussian noise to the received components corresponding to the signal’s degrees of freedom. This makes noise analysis a finite-dimensional vector problem, regardless of the orthonormal waveforms used. For independent inputs and noise components, detecting each signal separately gives the same maximum-likelihood decisions as detecting the full sequence. When inputs are dependent, as in error-correction coding, using the full observation can reduce error probability.

The lecture compares orthogonal, simplex, and biorthogonal signal sets, including their energy and error-probability tradeoffs. It then analyzes orthogonal signaling and shows that, when energy per bit exceeds the stated channel-capacity threshold, error probability falls exponentially as the number of bits per signal grows.

The lecture concludes by introducing wireless communication. Unlike the earlier noise model, wireless channels vary over time and involve interference. Cellular networks connect mobiles through base stations and a wired network; later lectures will examine their physical channels, including how channel behavior changes with motion and frequency.

Kalidou Koulibaly headed a stoppage-time winner as Napoli beat Juventus away, cutting the Serie A leaders’ advantage to one point with four games remaining. Juventus lost Giorgio Chiellini to injury early on, and both teams missed chances before Koulibaly scored from a late corner. Juventus next visit Inter, while Napoli face Fiorentina.
TopoSPAM provides intracellular and tissue-scale simulation models, including active and passive materials and tissue morphogenesis, with high-performance computing and interactive visualization.

Oklahoma received federal approval for a voluntary program to seek rebates from drugmakers when medicines fail to perform as claimed. Its healthcare authority has contacted 20 companies; 10 are in active discussions or contract negotiations.

The December 7, 2000, VentureWire reports that Providence Equity Partners closed a $2.8 billion fund, Insight Capital Partners was raising $750 million, and Caspian Networks raised $85 million. It also covers other startup funding, acquisitions, mergers and executive appointments. Setbacks include HarvardNet ending DSL services and cutting 280 jobs, Exp.com cutting 17 jobs, and CarsDirect.com withdrawing its IPO.

Cornwall parent Jerica Devos has spent about $70 on supplies for her son’s Grade 1 class and questions why families at some Prince Edward Island schools instead pay a flat fee capped at $40. She also objects to her school’s requests for particular brands and colours. The Public Schools Branch provides a province-wide supply-list template, but schools can adjust quantities and specify colours and brands. Parents can opt out of a flat fee and buy supplies themselves, but cannot choose a fee at schools that require purchases. Branch director Parker Grimmer encouraged parents to raise concerns with their school or the branch.

A bullish engulfing pattern consists of a small bearish candlestick followed by a larger bullish candlestick that engulfs it. It typically appears after a downward price swing, often near support, and signals a potential upward reversal. The passage recommends seeking confirmation and considering broader market conditions before trading. It also emphasizes defined entry and exit rules, risk management, and backtesting with historical price data.

At a March 21, 2018 special meeting, Tesla stockholders approved a performance-based stock option award granted to CEO Elon Musk on January 21. The award met all three required voting standards, receiving approximately 81% of votes cast, 80% of voting power present and entitled to vote, and 73% of votes cast excluding shares owned by Elon and Kimbal Musk.

In a prospective study of 264 adults hospitalized with COVID-19, researchers assessed whether baseline lung ultrasound findings predicted worsening illness. A higher mean lung ultrasound score, calculated from available lung zones, was associated with subsequent need for ICU-level care and 28-day mortality, but not the combined outcome of ventilation or death. More A lines were associated with lower risk, while pleural abnormalities were associated with higher risk. The findings suggest lung ultrasound may help identify patients needing higher levels of care, though some analyses had small samples and wide confidence intervals.

Todd Kimberlain forwarded a file Jim Gross found listing watch and warning areas for storms from 1963 to 1998. Gross provided the record format and codes for hurricane, storm, gale and tropical storm watches and warnings, and said he assumed the file was complete for the continental United States.

An international study found that established alien species have increased worldwide for 200 years, with 37% of recorded introductions occurring between 1970 and 2014. Introduction rates vary by organism group and are linked to human activities, including horticulture and global trade. Using more than 45,000 first-detection records, researchers found little sign of a slowdown except for mammals and fishes. They warn of harm to native ecosystems and call for more effective prevention policies.

A researcher said maintaining a 5% weight loss requires consuming 10% fewer calories, which may help explain weight regain. The passage also highlights dMeetings, a self-paced education option for diabetes patients.

Lenovo’s Legion Go S with SteamOS is $120 off. The reviewer found it easier to use than the Windows version and more powerful than an aging Steam Deck, though newer games may need settings adjustments. It has comfortable grips, a bright 120-Hz IPS screen, 1 TB of storage, 32 GB of memory, and a MicroSD slot.

In a Providence community health system study, pathologists initiated comprehensive genomic profiling at diagnosis for 3,216 patients with advanced solid cancers. Results were available earlier for clinical decision-making than with the previous testing workflow. Guideline-based actionable biomarkers were found in 49% of cases. Profiling matched 53% of patients to at least one assessed clinical-trial arm, versus 26% using a simulated 50-gene panel. Among patients with documented treatment, targeted therapies and immunotherapies were widely used. Median overall survival was 25 months for patients receiving targeted therapy and 17 months for those receiving chemotherapy alone. The authors note continuing gaps in actionable findings and access to testing and treatment.

Mercedes-Benz has introduced a Grand Edition package for non-AMG GLS models, featuring distinctive wheels and badges, nappa leather, unique wood trim and exclusive leather colours. The €8,250 upgrade is available to order, with deliveries beginning in March 2018.
Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on April 26, 2022, announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2022. The filing includes the company’s press release as Exhibit 99.1.

President George Washington declares that conciliation has failed to end opposition to federal laws in western Pennsylvania and that violence threatens further enforcement. Militia from New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Virginia are moving to the region. He promises protection to those who rely on the government and honors qualifying claims to indemnity. He urges citizens to uphold the Constitution and laws, warns against aiding the insurgents, and calls on officers and citizens to bring offenders before the law.

Czech central bank board member Toms Nidetzky expects one more interest rate hike this year, likely after further debate toward year-end, but sees no need to act now. Inflation has slowed, and fellow board member Vojtech Benda also sees no need for a near-term increase.

Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko appeared at a Kiev news conference Wednesday, a day after police reported he had been shot dead. Ukraine’s security service said it had staged his death to foil a murder plot and alleged that Russian security services paid a Ukrainian citizen $40,000 to arrange the killing. Babchenko, a Kremlin critic, had left Russia in 2017 after receiving death threats.

An infant sustained Erb’s palsy during delivery, and a jury found a municipal hospital and staff member negligent. The plaintiff accepted reduced damages after a post-trial motion. The appellate court upheld the reduced award, rejecting defendants’ claim that it was excessive and declining to reinstate the jury’s original future pain-and-suffering award.

FoLix is an FDA-cleared, nonsurgical laser treatment that stimulates existing hair follicles. It is best suited to early or moderate hair loss, not complete baldness or extensive scarring. Sessions take 20 to 30 minutes with little downtime and cost $750 to $1,250 each. Patients typically need three to six sessions in the first year and up to two annually afterward. Temporary redness, scalp sensitivity, or shedding may occur. Doctors recommend consulting a physician about the cause of hair loss before treatment.

This qualitative study interviewed seven visually impaired students in professional music education in Turkey about distance education during COVID-19. Courses were generally taught synchronously, but some students relied on recordings. Participants reported that materials often failed to account for their needs, leaving some dependent on parents, friends or large print; exam accommodations also varied. They identified flexibility as a benefit, while inaccessible content, technical problems and poor sound synchronization hindered music lessons. The study recommends accessible materials and platforms, assistive tools, technical support and instruction tailored to students’ needs.

At the Palm Beach round of the Florida Winter Tour ROK Edition, Birel ART / PSL drivers Ryan Norberg and Scott Davidson won the ROK Senior and ROK Shifter Master finals, respectively. Norberg also regained the ROK Senior Championship lead. Teammates Igor Pushkin, Ryan MacDermid and Justin Aresneu finished fifth, tenth and twelfth in their classes. The team next competes in the tour’s Rotax edition.

The speaker expressed confidence in both goaltenders and said the team must better support a goalie who has battled for them. Despite good scoring chances, the team needs persistence and better execution against a strong opponent. The speaker said media commentary does not affect the team and described its play as tentative rather than unphysical, while cautioning against penalties and poor positioning.

Protesters gathered across the U.S. against racism and white supremacy after deadly violence in Charlottesville, Virginia. Demonstrations included marches in Denver and New York, arrests in Seattle, and a Charlottesville vigil.

The speaker says the team missed scoring chances but must stay positive and prepare for the important third game. They need to avoid lapses and turnovers against an opponent that capitalizes on them, while continuing to believe in themselves.

A three-judge federal court ruled that Hale County, Alabama, is covered by the Voting Rights Act because Alabama’s designation extends to its political subdivisions. The county’s 1965, 1971, and 1973 laws changing county commission elections from district to at-large voting lacked required federal preclearance and were therefore unenforceable. The court allowed the November 1976 election to proceed, with commissioners serving provisionally, and ordered the county to submit the laws for review. Unless the changes were approved, commissioners were to be elected by district. Actions taken by previously elected commissioners remained valid.

Anna Gasser won gold in the Olympic debut of women’s Big Air snowboarding, overtaking Jamie Anderson with a final double cork 1080 that scored a day-high 96. Anderson, who led entering the last round, finished second after failing to land her final jump. Zoi Sadowski Synnott took bronze, New Zealand’s first Winter Olympic medal in 26 years.

The passage argues that Hillary Clinton is unfit for office, blaming her for U.S. involvement in Libya and linking that intervention to later slave auctions there. It cites allegations about her private email server, an FBI cover-up, media support for the Clintons, and numerous other scandals. The author invokes Christopher Hitchens’s criticism of Clinton and questions why she has not faced prosecution.

The passage describes flexible cables for carrying DC and high-frequency signals in cryogenic quantum computing systems. The cables can contain multiple shielded striplines and connect to rigid circuit boards, electronic components, or quantum processing units. Proposed configurations include integrated filters and attenuators, stiffeners, compliant electrical joints, and superconducting or non-superconducting conductors. The designs aim to accommodate more signal connections while managing thermal load, space, and assembly.

A Teagasc survey of 314 male farmers in south-east Ireland found that 20% had never consulted a doctor and 39% reported ill health in the past year. Farmers had higher mortality from cardiovascular disease and cancer than other occupational groups. Reported rheumatoid arthritis was three times the national average for Irish males.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs double peak FP32 processing per streaming multiprocessor compared with Turing. Second-generation RT Cores improve ray tracing, support concurrent workloads and accelerate motion blur, while third-generation Tensor Cores add TF32, BF16 and structured sparsity for AI workloads. The architecture also introduces faster GDDR6X memory, PCIe 4.0, third-generation NVLink and larger L1 caches.

RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression with Microsoft DirectStorage to reduce CPU work when loading assets. GA10x GPUs support high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and hardware video encoding. The passage describes these features across GeForce RTX 30-series, RTX A6000 and A40 products; the A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.

In the randomized LIVE-AIR trial, lenzilumab improved survival without invasive mechanical ventilation through day 28 among adults hospitalized with COVID-19 pneumonia, compared with placebo. The benefit was greatest among participants with baseline C-reactive protein (CRP) below 150 mg/L; elevated baseline CRP was the strongest predictor of ventilation or death. Most CRP subgroup analyses were post hoc and not prospectively powered.

Former New York judge Louis L. Nock joined Anderson Kill on the day state ethics regulators agreed to drop charges if he resigned and never again accepted judicial office. Complaints alleged that he mistreated court staff and threatened grievances and a criminal complaint unless the charges were dismissed. Nock denied the allegations. His lawyer said Nock had already planned to leave the bench, and both his lawyer and Anderson Kill emphasized that the commission made no finding of wrongdoing.

The speaker calls the final the biggest game the team can play after a long playoff run. They expect nerves but feel calm and excited. An injured teammate has remained involved, and his return would mean a lot. Fans and the city have strongly supported the team.

Research by disability activist Doug Paulley found that only eight of Scotland’s 32 councils have created or expect to create the wheelchair-accessible taxi lists needed for a new anti-discrimination law to apply by the recommended October deadline. Eighteen councils are undecided or have no plans to create a list. Paulley and Muscular Dystrophy UK are urging councils to act so disabled passengers receive the law’s protections.

The White House confirmed plans to withdraw Kathleen Hartnett White’s nomination to chair the Council on Environmental Quality. White, a climate change skeptic who has opposed stricter pollution limits, faced criticism for her views on fossil fuels and pollution and for her ties to a think tank funded by fossil-fuel companies. Her nomination had stalled in the Senate. Senator Tom Carper welcomed its withdrawal and urged the administration to nominate an environmental and public health advocate.

Donna Adelson, 75, was sentenced to life in prison plus 30 years for her role in the 2014 murder of her former son-in-law, Florida State University law professor Dan Markel. She denied involvement, prompting the judge to cite her “utter lack of remorse.” Prosecutors said the killing was intended to help Adelson’s daughter move to South Florida with her children. Adelson’s husband also maintained her innocence.

Ray tracing realistically simulates lighting but has been too computationally intensive for real-time gaming on a single GPU, leaving games reliant on rasterization. Turing GPUs use new RT Cores to enable real-time ray-traced effects.

A cross-sectional study of 217 female students at Nigeria’s NTA TV College found that 55.3% had good contraceptive knowledge, 47.5% had a good attitude, and 50.7% had good contraceptive practice. Nearly 74% had had sex. Friends and the internet were the main information sources; condoms and oral pills were the most commonly used methods. Fear of side effects was the leading reason for non-use. Age predicted knowledge; diploma enrolment, living off-campus and knowledge predicted attitude; and Plateau State indigeneity and prior sexual activity predicted practice. The authors recommend improved advocacy and youth-friendly sexual and reproductive health services.

A study of 35 public pension plans found wide differences in annualized returns from 2008 to 2012, ranging from 15% to −4.2%. The research linked stronger governance practices—including organizational stability, engaged boards, frequent meetings, and staff involvement—to better investment performance. Plans in the top fifth of governance scores outperformed those in the bottom fifth by nearly two to one. Investment expenses and required contribution rates were not statistically significant in the study’s model.

Hui Ying Financial Holdings reported 2017 revenue of $46.50 million, up 88.4% from restated 2016 results, and net income of $15.27 million, up from $3.44 million. The company facilitated $1.31 billion in loans, a 59.9% increase, across 23,263 loans. Operating expenses rose to $28.55 million, while operating income reached $17.95 million. At year-end, cash and cash equivalents totaled $12.68 million, and outstanding loan balances were $436.3 million.

Chrissy Teigen, pregnant with her second child, says she has long had stretch marks on her thighs but none on her belly. She spends 10–15 minutes each night applying products, including coconut oil and Lumière de Vie concentrate, to help prevent marks during pregnancy. Her husband and daughter help, and she says stretch marks are common among the models she has worked with.

A study of 9,859 UK adolescents aged 10 to 15 found that girls used social media more than boys and experienced a larger decline in well-being. Girls who used social media for at least an hour a day by age 10 had lower well-being at 15; researchers found no comparable association among boys. The researchers said the link may be underestimated because usage was self-reported and recorded only for school days.

A January 26, 2001, email circulated articles mentioning Enron. They covered California’s power crisis and renewed interest in wind energy, including Enron’s wind farms; a possible missed payment to Enron’s Dabhol Power unit by a Maharashtra utility; and criticism of Enron’s political ties. Other reports said Enron shares rose on its profit forecast and described employee concerns about a new performance-ranking system.

With Chris Pronger serving a one-game suspension, the coach said Joe DiPenta would play and Jackman and other defensemen would take on more minutes. Chris Kunitz was a game-time decision. The coach said the team needed to reduce undisciplined penalties and play its best game. After an emotional, penalty-filled start, the team improved its forechecking and team play, helped by its goaltender and contributions from Huskins, Teemu Selanne and Dustin Penner. Despite taking a series lead, the coach emphasized preparing for the next game.

A free domestic violence support group for women survivors meets Tuesdays at noon; call 541-400-0186 for details. AARP offers free walk-in tax assistance in Hood River and The Dalles. Registration is open for the Feb. 24 Chess for Success tournament for K–12 students. Hood River Valley High School Girl Up is collecting clean bras for women in need throughout February.

Pakistan Volleyball Federation chairman Chaudhry Mohammad Yaqoob urged the federal government to build a sports complex in Abbottabad, where moderate summer weather would allow national training camps and international events. He criticized the cost and location of the Narowal Sports Complex and noted that Islamabad’s Liaquat Gymnasium lacks air conditioning. Yaqoob also called for more accommodation at Islamabad’s Pakistan Sports Complex and an early volleyball camp for the Asian Games, saying the remaining preparation time was insufficient. He said Iranian coach Hamid Movahedi would join the camps in Peshawar.

The President returns the river and harbor appropriations bill unsigned. Although it funds valuable projects, he objects that some appropriations benefit only localities and exceed constitutional authority. He also argues that the bill’s $18.7 million total is excessive for one fiscal year and cannot be spent economically. He suggests appropriating half the amount and allowing the Secretary of War, under presidential direction, to select projects within the bill’s limits.

The Federal Government laid the foundation for the Assumpta Science Centre in Owerri, one of several planned projects in the South-East. Science and Technology Minister Ogbonnaya Onu said the ministry had signed an agreement with the Vatican’s Pontifical Council for Culture on the centre. He said the government aims to use science and innovation to support development and diversify the economy. He thanked the Ofekata community for donating land, while Imo State Governor Rochas Okorocha pledged support for the project’s speedy completion.

Chicago granted landmark status to the former Johnson Publishing Company headquarters, longtime home of Ebony and Jet. 3L Real Estate bought the building for $10 million and plans a $20 million conversion into 150 apartments, preserving its Ebony and Jet signs. Work is scheduled to begin in 2018 and finish the following year.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. Slope compensation mitigates subharmonic oscillation; the recommended setting equals the inductor’s falling current slope. The controllers support Type 2A or Type 2B frequency compensation and stop switching above a typical junction temperature of 175°C, restarting below 160°C.

A synchronous push-pull design example using the TPS7H5001-SP specifies 500-kHz switching, a 5-V output, approximately 25-ns dead time, and selected transformer, GaN FET, filtering, current-sensing, and compensation components. The controllers require a regulated, bypassed 4-V to 14-V supply. Layout guidance emphasizes separating noisy switching paths from sensitive signals, minimizing switching loops, and placing bypass and compensation components close to the controller. TI states that customers must validate their designs and that the application information is not part of the component specification.

The Eagles practiced Monday ahead of Thursday’s preseason game against Buffalo. Philadelphia traded Jordan Matthews and a third-round pick to the Bills for cornerback Ronald Darby, who joined the first-team defense Sunday but is still learning its calls. Alshon Jeffery’s availability and the starters’ playing time remain uncertain.

CJ Affiliate is a free-to-join network that connects advertisers with publishers, tracks sales and leads, and handles commission payments. Publishers need a website or social media profile with relevant content and an audience in the US or Canada. After completing their profile and payment details, they can apply to programs, promote approved links, and monitor results through reporting tools. CJ offers programs across many niches and tools such as banners and product feeds. The guide notes that its many options can present a learning curve and that approval may be strict.

In the opening lecture of MIT’s manufacturing process control course, Duane Boning outlines the course logistics and its emphasis on quality and variation. Students are expected to have experience with a manufacturing process and some familiarity with probability and statistics. Materials are distributed through the course website. Assessment consists of individual problem sets, two quizzes, and a collaborative team project; there is no final exam.

The course uses semiconductor fabrication alongside mechanical and other processes to examine how variation arises and affects product quality. It focuses primarily on unit processes, using statistical process control to detect disturbances, design of experiments and empirical models to improve robustness, and feedback control to compensate for variation. Boning describes manufacturing as the transformation of a workpiece through equipment and a process environment, with outputs affected by controllable settings and other process parameters.

The study translated and culturally adapted the Waterloo Footedness Questionnaire–Revised into Arabic, then tested it with 290 Arabic-speaking adults in Saudi Arabia. Participants found it clear and relevant. The Arabic version showed a single-factor structure, strong internal consistency, and excellent test–retest reliability. The authors conclude it is a valid and reliable measure of footedness, while recommending further testing in other Arabic-speaking countries and populations.

The passage describes TMS320DM8127 device configuration and operating requirements. It covers analog TV output pins, supply connections, boot-mode selection, pin multiplexing, and pullup and pulldown guidance. It also outlines power domains and sequencing, reset behavior, clock sources and PLL limits, and interrupt routing. Later sections describe peripheral timing and features, including DCAN, EDMA, JTAG and trace, and the Ethernet MAC switch.

CoreWeave shares rose as much as 8% after it introduced tools for developers building AI agents. Its new serverless reinforcement learning service automatically adjusts computing capacity. CoreWeave said tests showed faster training at 40% lower cost than using Nvidia H100 GPUs locally, without affecting model quality. The launch follows its $1 billion acquisition of Weights and Biases.

Lasting peace, the speaker argues, requires equal rights for nations regardless of size or strength, governments based on the consent of the governed, and protection against transferring peoples between sovereignties without their consent. He calls for an independent Poland, security for peoples under hostile governments, access to trade routes, and freedom of the seas. He also urges limits on naval and land armaments, saying nations must make concessions and plan for peace rather than war.

President Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo is expected to deliver the State of the Nation Address in Parliament on February 8, 2018. Parliament will adjourn early the previous day for preparations. Members have been asked to arrive by 9:15 a.m. and not bring guests into the chamber.

The passage describes a seasonal silver strategy that holds silver from December through February and again from July through August. It suggests that orders from industrial users early in the year may contribute to silver’s seasonal pattern. In a backtest beginning in 2001, the strategy returned 3.9% more per year than buy and hold, with a smaller maximum drawdown (-23.34% versus -71.65%).

India’s selectors face a difficult task choosing a T20I squad for the upcoming England series because several players are injured or may be rested. The article expects KL Rahul and Shikhar Dhawan to open, with Rishabh Pant among the contenders for another opening spot. It identifies Virat Kohli and MS Dhoni as middle-order certainties and suggests opportunities for Karun Nair, Suresh Raina and domestic performers. With established bowlers unavailable or likely to be rested, it also projects chances for Kuldeep Yadav and Shahbaz Nadeem. The series is India’s last limited-overs contest before the Champions Trophy.

The passage describes video encoding methods that let SDR and HDR systems use the same bitstream. An encoder uses HDR and reference SDR versions of a video to find a color-volume transform that produces SDR values substantially matching the reference when displayed. In one embodiment, it encodes SDR values and supplies metadata so HDR decoders can reconstruct HDR values. In another, it encodes HDR values and supplies metadata so SDR decoders can convert them for display. The transform may account for target SDR display properties and be represented by tone-mapping parameters, scaling factors, or lookup tables.

A March 2001 email compiles articles on California’s energy crisis. Gov. Gray Davis sought another $500 million for state power purchases as Edison and PG&E began repaying the state. Regulators approved rate increases of up to 46%, while lawmakers considered conservation measures and faster power-plant approvals amid concerns about summer blackouts and environmental impacts. Other articles describe efforts to improve blackout warnings, political criticism of Davis, President Bush’s energy and climate positions, and Canada’s offer to increase U.S. energy supplies.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with integrated analog front ends, a buffered reference, programmable input ranges, alarms, and a multiSPI interface. They use an internal 4.096V reference by default or an external 4.096V reference selected through a register bit. The passage specifies reference decoupling and cautions against using reference outputs to drive external loads.

The ADC supports single-ended and differential, bipolar and unipolar inputs, with straight-binary output. Programmable input alarms and fixed AVDD alarms can be read through a pin, registers, or output-data flags. The devices operate in RESET, acquisition, and conversion states and support NAP and power-down modes.

The interface supports standard SPI, dual-output and source-synchronous read protocols, and multiple devices in a daisy chain. Configuration registers control these functions, while 32-bit transfer frames carry commands and data. An application example combines the ADS8681W with a multiplexer for an eight-channel industrial input module. The passage also provides power-supply decoupling and PCB-layout recommendations.

Sprint and the Sprint Foundation will provide free devices and wireless service to 180,000 low-income high school students in more than 1,300 schools across 32 states this school year. The five-year 1Million Project aims to connect one million students without home internet. Participants will receive 3GB of high-speed data monthly for up to four years.

After using sunbeds once or twice a week for two years, 20-year-old model Ella Ravenscroft had four changing moles removed. She now warns about skin cancer risks and says she will use fake tan instead. The passage advises seeing a doctor about unusual changes in moles or other skin growths, noting that sunbed use increases melanoma risk.

A federal judge temporarily halted Trump administration layoffs tied to the government shutdown after unions sued, alleging the administration unlawfully used the shutdown to cut staff. An October 10 filing listed 4,132 to 4,232 workers for layoffs across several agencies, while budget director Russell Vought said the total could reach about 10,000. Many other federal workers remain furloughed or without pay. The administration can appeal the ruling.

The city’s $75,000 contract with LIHI covered its first four months operating and providing case management at Camp Second Chance. The camp is self-managed, but campers cannot veto LIHI decisions; they staff the gate, and minors cannot stay. This year’s contract was not yet finalized, and the camp’s renewal status was being sought.

Josie Goodenow will speak about native bees and European honeybees at the Laguna Beach Garden Club on Friday, Oct. 13. She will discuss ways to increase bee populations and improve yard health. The meeting begins at 10 a.m. at Laguna Presbyterian Church; first-time guests may attend free.

Hexane is a crude-oil-derived solvent used to extract vegetable oils and in cleaning agents, gasoline, rubber, glues, and cement. Excess inhalation can cause weakness, numbness, blurred vision, headaches, and fatigue; OSHA sets a workplace exposure limit of 500 ppm. A sodium hydroxide and methanol process has been used as an alternative for extracting soybean oil, though high seed moisture increases methanol use. The passage identifies China as a dominant hexane producer and consumer and expects demand to rise with refined cooking oil and automotive rubber production.

Gulf stocks mostly fell Wednesday, led by a 2.3 percent drop in Qatar as investors took profits in major banks that had risen after MSCI announced higher weightings. Dubai fell 0.5 percent, dropping below its level before the UAE announced planned visa and foreign-ownership changes, though DXB Entertainments rose. Abu Dhabi declined 0.4 percent. Saudi Arabia edged up 0.1 percent, helped by Al Tayyar after it announced early loan repayment. Egypt’s index fell 1.4 percent.

Nicole Sciortino and Vincent Licciardello were charged with endangering their two children, ages 10 and 11, after police found them home alone in Dunmore, Pennsylvania. Investigators said the children were unsupervised for three days while Sciortino was in Florida; Licciardello occasionally dropped off food. Police described the home as deplorable. Both parents were released on unsecured bail, and the children are staying with family friends.
Jon Klemm is described as underrated, Greg de Vries as a solid defenseman after a strong year, and Skoula as a promising defenseman. An unnamed forward is praised for his production and talent.

In 24 patients with advanced lung cancer evaluated for suspected leptomeningeal disease, cerebrospinal fluid tumor-derived DNA (CSF-tDNA) testing was more sensitive than cytology (91.7% versus 81.8%). Detectable CSF-tDNA was associated with poorer overall survival. Resistance mutations found in blood were often absent from matched CSF. In a 12-patient osimertinib cohort, CSF-tDNA levels during treatment were associated with central nervous system progression. These findings suggest CSF-tDNA testing may aid diagnosis and monitoring, though the study had limited samples at the time of resistance.

Medication non-adherence is common among patients undergoing hemodialysis and is associated with poorer management of chronic kidney disease complications and higher mortality. Evidence that person-centered care improves adherence remains limited. This multicenter, cross-sectional study examined relationships among person-centered care, trust in physicians, and medication adherence in Japanese hemodialysis patients, including whether trust mediates any relationship. Participants at six facilities completed questionnaires between April 2022 and February 2023; adherence was measured with the Japanese ASK-12 scale.

NVIDIA entered an underwriting agreement on June 14, 2021, to issue $5 billion in unsecured senior notes across four series maturing in 2023, 2024, 2028 and 2031. The offering generated approximately $4.98 billion in net proceeds, intended for general corporate purposes, potentially including debt repayment. The notes carry interest rates from 0.309% to 2.000% and are governed by an indenture containing redemption terms, covenants and change-of-control repurchase provisions.

Archive360 announced that its Archive2Azure managed compliance storage solution for Microsoft Azure and FastCollect for PSTs were finalists in the 2017 DBTA Readers’ Choice Awards for Best Cloud Storage Solution and Best Data Storage Solution, respectively. Archive2Azure manages migrated legacy data in Azure, while FastCollect automates PST discovery, migration, storage and auditing. Winners were to be featured in August 2017.

Thirty-three people had been executed in the United States in 2025 as of Tuesday morning, the highest annual total in about a decade. Victor Tony Jones has asked the Supreme Court to block his scheduled execution in Florida; if it proceeds, he would be the state’s 13th execution this year. The court has denied more than 30 emergency requests to postpone executions this year, though it ruled in favor of death row inmates in three cases during its previous term. In the term ahead, the justices will consider how courts should assess multiple IQ scores in determining whether a capital defendant is intellectually disabled and cannot be executed.

Tesla entered the U.S. auto industry with a plan to move from luxury electric vehicles to lower-priced, higher-volume models. Its Roadster, Model S and Model X preceded the $35,000 Model 3, which attracted hundreds of thousands of reservations. Scaling Model 3 production proved difficult: Tesla’s highly automated, vertically integrated factories encountered bottlenecks, delays and quality problems. By 2018, production had reached about 5,000 cars a week, but Tesla was recording substantial losses and its future remained disputed.

The broader industry faced high entry costs, low automaker returns and shifts toward electric vehicles, autonomous driving, connectivity and alternatives to private car ownership. Tesla distinguished itself through direct sales, its charging network and software updates, while established automakers expanded their own electric-vehicle plans. Tesla also proposed a future autonomous ride-sharing service, though its ability to survive and thrive remained uncertain.

A July 2001 collection of articles reports Enron’s No. 16 Fortune Global 500 ranking, its effect on a corporate revenue survey, and its involvement in Western power markets and potential emissions trading. Other reports cover Kobe Steel’s power expansion, Enron’s canceled Miami-Dade plant plan, and Karl Rove’s meetings with Enron while holding its stock. Two articles examine stock sales by Enron executives and losses in its broadband business.

Coach Sutter says the teams are closely matched and expects both to play hard in the next game. He describes the opponent as bigger and quicker up front, but says his team will stick to its approach: forecheck in groups, manage the puck and avoid penalties. Ice conditions and players’ shifts can affect play, while chasing individual matchups can leave players tired or out of position. He notes that the home team has the last change.
Footage shows the 2018 Jaguar F-Pace SVR testing at the Nürburgring. The passage says it may use a 5.0-liter supercharged V8 from the F-Type SVR or F-Type R.

NHS Digital recorded 719 hospital admissions for eating disorders in Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly in 2016–17, including two children under 10. Women and girls accounted for 94% of admissions; anorexia accounted for 45% and bulimia for 24%. Admissions were more than double the 298 recorded in 2010–11. Charities called the figures worrying and urged early support, while cautioning that admissions alone cannot show whether eating disorders have become more common.

DLSS 4 replaces CNN-based models with transformer models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA. The passage reports improved frame-to-frame stability, detail in motion, lighting, and reduced ghosting and denoising artifacts. NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture also supports neural shaders through graphics-shader access to Tensor Cores. Described applications include neural materials, texture compression, radiance caching for indirect lighting, skin rendering, and AI-generated faces. The passage outlines the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products. It concludes with specifications-related disclaimers, usage restrictions, and trademark notices.
The figures show multiple views of an electric fat tire bike; broken lines indicate unclaimed portions.
Sid Sivakumar edited the puzzle. August Miller is a vegetable farmer and crossword constructor; Rapp is a research administrator and former biologist who constructs puzzles.

The North Carolina Court of Appeals affirmed the dismissal of Lewis Williamson’s appeal challenging Surf City’s closure of a 20-foot portion of North Shore Drive. Williamson conceded that the town followed the required procedures and that ownership of the closed street vested in the adjoining property owners. The court held that the town’s intent to build public facilities on its portion did not invalidate the closure. It also rejected Williamson’s argument that the statute permits closing only an entire street.

The passage describes a rotating shaft mechanism for a foldable mobile terminal. Swing arms connected to the housings move with connecting rods around a main shaft, driving support plates to form space for the flexible display when folded. The mechanism is designed to make its folded thickness approximately equal to that of the stacked housings. Engaging gears synchronize the housings, while optional cams limit rotation positions. A flexible blocking layer can cover openings in the shaft assembly. The display may be attached to the housings alone or also to the support plates.

MKM Partners raised its Tutor Perini price target from $31 to $34 and maintained a buy rating. The stock had a consensus buy rating and a $27.29 consensus price target, with four analysts rating it hold and four buy. Shares opened Wednesday at $28. Tutor Perini’s latest quarterly earnings of $0.57 per share missed estimates by $0.05, while revenue fell 0.6% year over year. COO James A. Frost sold 7,500 shares in December. Hedge funds and other institutional investors owned 82.52% of the stock.

The study develops hybrid forecasting models for daily COVID-19 confirmed cases and deaths in the USA, India, Brazil, Russia, and the UK. It argues that combining linear and nonlinear methods can better handle the datasets’ dynamic patterns than single models. Using country-level data ending January 15, 2021, the authors report strong forecasting performance for the hybrid ARNNS and SVMAR models for confirmed cases and deaths, respectively. The preprint has not been peer reviewed.
A Kuwaiti court sentenced two parents to death for torturing their three-year-old daughter until she died. The verdict remains subject to review by appeals and supreme courts.

The passage says seasonal weakness, thin trading and institutional rebalancing may pressure markets, while earnings momentum and optimism could fade in August. It notes a bullish divergence in bond fund TLT despite resistance and suggests that a dollar drop below 98 could favor commodities. The author advises watching yields, gold, the dollar and July trading ranges for market direction.

The United States opposed using armed force to collect ordinary contract debts owed to its citizens, while acknowledging that fraud, wrongdoing, or treaty violations might justify force. At Rio, its representatives supported asking the Second Hague Conference to examine debt collection and peaceful alternatives, since that conference would include both creditor and debtor nations. The passage also describes how United States–Mexican mediation ended a war among Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras. The Rio Conference praised the mediation, which the passage presents as an example of American republics acting together to promote peace.

Royalty North Partners granted 35,000 stock options to directors, officers, employees and consultants, exercisable at C$1.47 per share until October 6, 2022. It also awarded 37,500 restricted share rights to certain directors and senior officers, vesting over two years. The company finances private mid-market businesses through royalty investments.
Dr. Ian K. Smith’s *The Clean 20* presents a clean-eating program built around twenty accessible foods. It includes daily meal plans, 60 recipes and substitutions, and 20-minute workouts.

The Manchester, Sheffield and Lincolnshire Railway opened the Lincoln–Grimsby line in 1848 to serve Grimsby’s port and distribute fish. Its River Witham bridge at Stamp End was designed by John Fowler using then-new tubular iron girders. An engineering report describes it as Britain’s oldest bridge of its type still carrying trains. As trains grew heavier, the bridge was reinforced and its side spans replaced, mainly in 1903 and 1948; a new steel deck was added in 1968. Network Rail has now replaced it in a £7 million project.

Kirigami-inspired parachutes use concentric cuts in Mylar disks to unfurl during a fall. In laboratory tests, they landed closer to targets than traditional parachutes or uncut disks, regardless of their initial orientation. A drone test showed one slowing a water bottle’s descent. They produce less drag than similarly sized traditional parachutes but could be useful for aid drops or package delivery.

The North Carolina Court of Appeals reversed the dismissal of drug charges against Ryan Jeffery Adams. The trial court had found prosecution barred by double jeopardy after a tax judgment on the seized drugs was docketed and partially paid. The appellate court held that controlling North Carolina precedents upheld the drug tax, while the Fourth Circuit decision cited by Adams was not binding on state courts.

Intraday trading involves buying and selling financial instruments within one trading day, using approaches such as scalping or day trading. The passage recommends liquid markets, a quantified and backtested plan, and regular reviews of trading results. It says most intraday traders lose money and that intraday strategies are difficult to backtest. Its example crude-oil strategy performed poorly in a historical test but improved in a later, smaller test. In the US, stock traders designated as pattern day traders must maintain at least $25,000 in margin-account equity.

Netflix shares fell 0.68% in premarket trading Monday despite a deal for Shonda Rhimes to create future shows for the platform. Her existing ABC shows will remain there. The deal follows Disney’s plan to remove its movies and Netflix’s acquisition of Millarworld. A Barron’s article warning about competition and debt may have contributed to the decline.
The Ohio Supreme Court reversed the court of appeals’ judgment based on State v. Szefcyk, decided the same day.

In a study of 1,411 emergency-department patients in North Rhine-Westphalia in August–September 2022, 95.6% had detectable SARS-CoV-2 spike IgG, while 67.7% were vaccinated according to German recommendations. Neutralizing activity was detected against Wu01 in 94.4% and BA.4/5 in 84.9% of participants; in a representative subsample, 73.8% had activity against BQ.1.1. Neutralization against BQ.1.1 was 23.6-fold lower than against Wu01. Spike IgG levels and previous vaccination or infection helped predict neutralization, but spike IgG was less reliable for assessing neutralization against immune-evasive variants at low levels. The study population was not representative of the general population.

The Buck Sweep is a Wing-T misdirection run that uses two pulling blockers to create a lane off-tackle or outside. Its fakes can obscure who has the ball, while angled blocks help smaller linemen move defenders. The play depends on precise timing, spacing and pullers who can block in space. Against both 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, the guards pull to form an alley for the tailback, though other blocking assignments differ. Shotgun and I-Wing versions mainly change backfield action; the shotgun version can also allow a quarterback keeper.

A planned Gmail redesign and slower visible progress on Inbox have raised concerns that Google might discontinue the alternative email app. Google says the Gmail changes will not affect Inbox and describes it as a place to test email features. The passage also notes recent Inbox additions, including AI-powered highlights, unsubscribe suggestions, and follow-up prompts. Inbox retains features distinct from Gmail, such as message bundles and integrated reminders. Although its future is uncertain, the passage says there is no current indication that Google plans to discontinue it.

Reusable containers need clear documentation, including Dockerfile comments, parameter defaults, and image labels. Single-node patterns separate concerns: sidecars extend applications, ambassadors broker external connections and route requests, and adapters provide consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks.

Multi-node systems use replicated services for availability and scale, sharding when data exceeds one machine’s capacity, and scatter/gather to process requests in parallel. Replicated services can add readiness checks, caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination. Sharded systems require careful routing keys and may replicate shards for resilience. Scatter/gather can reduce processing time, but overhead and slow or failed nodes limit its benefits.

Microservices enable independent development and scaling but complicate debugging and design. Event-driven functions simplify deployment and automatic scaling while requiring independent functions to communicate over the network and store state externally.

Freelance writer Oobah Butler listed his London garden shed as an appointment-only restaurant on TripAdvisor to test how far a fake listing could rise. With a website, staged food photos and fake reviews from family and friends, “The Shed at Dulwich” climbed from last place to No. 1 among London restaurants in November. Butler turned away callers seeking reservations, then opened it for one night, serving inexpensive instant food to actors and other guests. TripAdvisor said it had penalized the listing and removed some reviews before Butler published his account. The hoax raised questions about the platform’s ability to detect fake businesses.

This preprint describes a study using a wearable high-density electromyography sleeve to examine forearm muscle coordination during attempted hand and wrist movements. Researchers recorded activity from seven people with chronic stroke and seven able-bodied participants, then analyzed co-contraction, muscle coupling, and muscle synergies. The study explores whether these measures relate to functional movement ability after stroke.

The passage projects the shiitake mushroom market to reach USD 35.4 billion by 2023, growing at 15.31% annually. Asia Pacific held 82.54% of the market in 2017, with China accounting for 97% of regional sales. Demand is linked to nutritional and medicinal uses, and pharmaceutical applications are projected to grow fastest.

Port Gregory experienced repeated power outages from Thursday evening into Monday, leaving one resident’s neighbour unable to use a breathing machine and causing about $500 in frozen-food losses. Western Power said storm demands delayed a detailed inspection and that the network was vulnerable to salt and dust buildup. Customers without power for 12 consecutive hours could claim a payment capped at $80.

Sonali Bendre Behl said tests prompted by a persistent pain revealed high-grade cancer that had spread. She is undergoing treatment in New York and said she is grateful for her family’s and friends’ support.

The passage argues that competing nationalist aims have undermined Allied coordination, contributing to misunderstandings with Russia and military setbacks for Italy and Rumania. It contends that sustained unity requires broader popular consent, shared purposes and a shift toward moderate-left politics. Because victory on the Western Front would require exhausting Germany’s reserves, the Allies must maintain morale, manage resources and counter German diplomacy. The passage predicts a German winter peace initiative followed by an Allied summer offensive intended to drive German forces back, recapture northern France, destroy submarine bases and threaten German territory. It identifies the relative reserves of men, including emerging American forces, as the deeper military issue.

The dollar reached multiweek highs against the yen and euro after September wages rose 0.5%, despite a hurricane-related decline of 33,000 jobs. Traders raised the estimated likelihood of a December Federal Reserve rate increase to 93%, from 84% Thursday.

Apple plans to reduce its $163 billion net cash position to approximately zero over time, using the greater access to foreign cash provided by tax reform. The company has not announced how it will do so. Possible approaches discussed in the passage include larger dividends or share repurchases, while Apple could repay, refinance or retain its existing debt until maturity. It plans to provide more detail when it reports second-quarter results.

Cryogenic 4D-STEM maps show that SrTiO3 develops local polar nanodomains below its structural transition near 105 K, despite lacking long-range ferroelectric order. At 69 K, the domains have a characteristic size of about 20 nm and show spatial correlations at roughly 25 nm. Below about 40 K, they become smaller, more fragmented and less periodically ordered; their characteristic size is about 14 nm at 35 K. Polarization was mapped from asymmetries in electron-diffraction Kikuchi bands, whose relationship to polarization was confirmed by simulations.

The S&P 500 fell 0.11% on Friday, ending a six-day streak of record closes, while the Nasdaq edged up to a sixth straight record close. U.S. nonfarm payrolls fell by 33,000 in September as hurricanes disrupted employment, though wages rose more than expected. Walgreens and CVS each dropped 4.9% amid reports that Amazon may sell prescription drugs. Costco fell 6% after reporting lower gross margins. Despite Friday’s decline, the S&P 500 gained 1.2% for the week.

PIMS employees continued their strike for a fifth day, demanding that the hospital be separated from Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University. Protesters sealed Vice Chancellor Javed Akram’s office and forced him out. Officials said outstanding issues with an amendment bill had been resolved and its summary would be sent to the prime minister for approval. Akram and the CADD minister urged protesters to end the strike for patients’ sake, but the employees vowed to continue until their demand is met.

Peruvian police are considering expelling two foreign tourists whom the interior ministry accuses of inciting rural protests against Hudbay Minerals’ Constancia copper mine. Protesters previously blocked highways while demanding development projects they said the company had promised. The two foreigners could not be reached for comment.

Dinbych overcame a 12-10 halftime deficit to beat Wrexham in a competitive Division Two (North) match. Wrexham matched the hosts try-for-try and earned a losing bonus point, but Dinbych retained possession in the closing minutes to secure the win. In Division Three (North), Dinbych 2nds also earned a losing bonus point in a 16-10 defeat at Flint.

The speaker says Anaheim is accustomed to loud road arenas, though the media attention is unusual. After a poor game against the Devils, the team plans to skate and work harder, make life more difficult for New Jersey’s defense, and get more shots on Brodeur. The speaker says the team will remain patient and stick to the approach that has helped it persevere in close playoff games.

A mapping review of 67 U.S. studies found that occupational therapy fieldwork research focused disproportionately on Level II experiences, instructional methods, and learner characteristics and competencies. Occupational therapy assistant and Level I fieldwork were underrepresented, while no studies mapped to theory building, signature pedagogies, or diversity, inclusion, and equity. The authors recommend collaborative research on these gaps and more explicit inclusion of fieldwork in future education research agendas.

Singapore Airlines will restart nonstop Singapore–Newark flights on Oct. 12, making the 9,537-mile route the world’s longest by distance. The airline ended the service in 2013 because it could not operate it profitably with its Airbus A340 aircraft. The new flights will use Airbus A350-900ULR jets with 67 business-class and 94 premium-economy seats, but no standard coach seats. Service will begin three times weekly, with daily flights expected a week later. Scheduled flight times exceed 18 hours each way.

Fior Markets’ report examines the global cooking oil market from 2017 to 2022, covering trends, forecasts, market size, competitors, product and application segments, and regional markets. It also addresses supply chains, trade, pricing, market drivers, challenges, and opportunities.

Archaeologists discovered a 4,400-year-old tomb near the pyramids outside Cairo that likely belonged to Hetpet, a high-ranking official of Egypt’s 5th Dynasty. Its wall paintings depict hunting, fishing and monkeys. Excavations are underway for another tomb believed to be hers in Giza’s western necropolis.

The lecture examines how collective Thomson scattering spectra reveal plasma properties. When the scattering wavelength is shorter than the electron Debye length, the spectrum reflects individual electrons and their velocity distribution. At larger collective-scattering parameters, resonances reveal electron plasma waves and ion-acoustic waves. Their positions, widths, and strengths provide information about temperature, density, and ion charge, depending on the regime.

Electron–ion drift makes the ion-acoustic peaks asymmetric, allowing the local current component along the scattering wave vector to be inferred. Collisions, spatial or velocity variations within the measurement volume, and a finite collection angle can alter or broaden spectra and lead to incorrect interpretations. Smaller measurement volumes and collection angles reduce these effects but also reduce the scattered-light signal.

A federal judge rejected the government’s request to delay transgender enlistment in the military, allowing it to begin January 1, 2018. The Pentagon is preparing to comply, while the Justice Department reviews its legal options.

A flaw in older Atlassian Jira and Confluence deployments can expose AWS access keys through server-side request forgery, potentially enabling attackers to take over hosted instances. Atlassian has fixed the bug, but researcher Robert Wiggins found more than a dozen major organizations still running vulnerable versions. Several secured or shut down their servers after being contacted; at least three remain vulnerable. Updating the software is recommended.

Texas will replace STAAR in 2027–28 with three shorter tests during the school year and ban certain practice tests. Supporters say the changes will reduce testing pressure and give teachers faster results. Parents, educators and administrators worry that three exams could increase stress, especially if strict STAAR testing rules continue. They also note that school ratings will initially remain heavily tied to test results. Some want more teacher input and less restrictive testing conditions.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs and related products. RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move compressed game data from SSDs to GPUs for decompression, reducing CPU work. Ampere adds improvements in shading, ray tracing and AI, alongside GDDR6X memory, high-resolution display support, and hardware video decoding and encoding. The A40 targets data-center workloads, while the RTX A6000 targets professional workstations; both support configurations with 96GB of combined GPU memory. The passage also covers the RTX 3090 and 3070, GDDR6X error detection during overclocking, performance comparisons, and product disclaimers.

The study examines Turkey’s centralized education administration and proposes a local education boards model. Researchers compared education systems in Turkey and 15 other OECD countries and surveyed 421 teachers and administrators in Adana’s Seyhan district. Of those surveyed, 61.5% preferred local administration, and 61% favored elected boards or commissions. The proposed model would involve education stakeholders in provincial, district, vocational and school boards, transfer implementation duties to local bodies, and leave national policy, monitoring and oversight to the ministry. The authors recommend pilot studies to test the model.

Spotify, Comcast, and Oracle recently announced co-CEO arrangements, though the model remains uncommon: about 1.2% of Russell 3000 companies have co-CEOs. One study found higher average annual shareholder returns among companies with two CEOs, but experts warn that unclear responsibilities, power imbalances, and conflicting strategies can undermine the arrangement. Clear governance and strong collaboration are key to making it work.

England qualified for the 2018 World Cup after a 1-0 win over Slovenia, but the passage criticizes their cautious play under Gareth Southgate. It argues that Dele Alli should play as No. 10, Raheem Sterling should stay on the wing, and Southgate should test a more attacking formation in friendlies against Brazil and Germany to reduce the risk of another early tournament exit.

NVIDIA reported revenue of $1.305 billion and net income of $246 million for the quarter ended October 25, 2015, up from $1.225 billion and $173 million a year earlier. For the first nine months, revenue rose to $3.609 billion, while net income fell to $406 million from $437 million. GPU revenue grew, offsetting a decline in Tegra Processor revenue. NVIDIA recorded $97 million in nine-month restructuring charges as it wound down Icera modem operations. It returned $604 million to shareholders through repurchases and dividends during the period and remained involved in patent disputes with Samsung and Qualcomm.

This 1902 *Foreign Relations of the United States* appendix contains a U.S. memorandum supporting indemnity claims by the owners, officers, and crews of four American vessels arrested and seized by Russian officials. The claims were submitted to an arbitrator under a 1900 agreement between the United States and Russia. Accompanying letters transmit an English translation of the memorandum and propose its publication as a public document.

The New York Court of Claims awarded $99,550 plus interest for four appropriations of Brubaker property for the St. Lawrence River project. It excluded project-related increases in value from the award for land taken in 1955, but included proximity-related value for later takings. The awards were $32,000, $100, $39,750, and $27,700, respectively.

The passage describes a display device with pixel and opposing electrodes, alternating organic and inorganic encapsulation layers, and a planarization layer covering the encapsulation’s sloping edge. The planarization layer has a steeper edge and provides a flatter surface for patterns such as touch electrodes and wiring. The described embodiments aim to expand the area available for those patterns, reduce areas where touch cannot be sensed, and limit parasitic capacitance while the encapsulation blocks moisture.

The study used microscale four-point probes inside a scanning electron microscope to measure resistivity in Al-Mg-Si alloys and distinguish grain interiors from regions containing Si or Mg₂Si precipitates. Grain-interior resistivity depended on heat treatment but was similar across compositions given the same treatment. Si and Mg₂Si precipitates had similar effects on measured resistivity, while greater precipitate volume increased bulk resistivity. Bulk resistivity rose linearly with total Si and Mg content, with coefficients dependent on heat treatment; treatment at 350°C for 72 hours produced the lowest bulk resistivity among the conditions tested.

The passage describes two ways to defend the UCLA offense. In the NBA-style “show and recover” approach, defenders force the high-post cutter behind the screen, briefly impede the cut, then recover while teammates protect the basket and defend down screens. The “SOS” approach traps the wing after the first pass, exploiting the point guard’s low-post cut, then rotates defenders as the ball leaves the passer’s hands.

A substantial majority of justices appeared inclined to let Rep. Michael Bost challenge an Illinois law counting mail-in ballots received up to 14 days after Election Day, despite lower courts’ ruling that he lacked standing. The justices disagreed on what harm a candidate must allege: some considered electoral disadvantage sufficient, while others questioned whether Bost could show an effect on the outcome. The court also discussed campaign expenses and the difficulties of resolving such challenges after an election.

Y-Cross is a flexible Air Raid drop-back concept that can be run from various formations and adapted to personnel. Its core routes are a post, deep crosser and running back route to the boundary flat, with optional backside routes. It creates opportunities for deep shots and intermediate completions, particularly against man coverage and Cover 4; the passage identifies Cover 3 as a less favorable matchup. The quarterback typically reads the post, then the crosser, then a running back check-down or backside dig. Variations include a post-wheel combination, using a slot receiver as the crosser, and adding a curl-flat option against one-high defenses.

Bitcoin rose to a six-week high on Tuesday, gaining 4.4 percent to $9,340.88, as reports of growing interest from major financial institutions lifted cryptocurrency sentiment. The total digital-currency market capitalization reached $427 billion, its highest since early March. Trading volume hit $28 billion over 24 hours, though market participants warned that regulatory challenges remain.
