Wichita Falls recorded 25 DWI arrests from January 1 to March 19, down from 38 in 2017 and 39 in 2016. Five arrests were made over St. Patrick’s Day weekend. Sgt. Harold McClure suggested greater awareness, sober drivers and police presence may be contributing; ridesharing may also play a role.

EUR/USD is the world’s most traded currency pair, offering high liquidity and extensive market information, but the passage stresses that trading it profitably is difficult. Its exchange rate is influenced by interest rates, inflation, economic data, central bank policies and geopolitical events. Traders may combine fundamental, technical and sentiment analysis, but the passage recommends clear rules and backtesting. It describes short- and long-term strategies, notes increased activity when European and U.S. sessions overlap, and emphasizes position sizing, cautious use of leverage, broker selection and demo-account practice.

Hurricanes Maria, Harvey and Irma exposed lasting health hazards, including contaminated floodwater, chemical releases, mold, mosquito-borne disease risks, unsafe structures and power outages. The passage argues that better planning and prevention could reduce harm before, during and after natural disasters. It calls for public education, stronger infrastructure and better protection of industrial sites and electrical grids. Despite upgrades to Florida’s grid, Irma left half the state’s customers without power.

The Trump administration’s proposed $100,000 fee for new H-1B visas could make it harder for colleges to hire researchers, doctors and other skilled workers. As of June 30, more than 16,000 college and university employees held approved H-1B visas, concentrated largely at research universities. Officials argue employers abuse the program to avoid hiring Americans, while higher education groups say it supports essential hiring. Current visa holders are unaffected, and it remains unclear whether universities will have to pay the fee or qualify for exemptions.

The passage says seasonal weakness, thin trading and institutional rebalancing are pressuring markets. It discusses technical levels for bond prices and the dollar, and suggests that falling yields could allow stocks to keep rising. It also presents movements in the dollar, yields and gold as indicators to watch for changes in market risk.

At its San Diego convention, the California Democratic Party endorsed Dave Min to challenge Rep. Mimi Walters and Hans Keirstead to challenge Rep. Dana Rohrabacher, despite opposition from other Democratic candidates. Min’s endorsement survived a challenge and a floor vote. Keirstead’s opponents said they were prevented from submitting signatures to force a floor vote. No candidate reached the endorsement threshold in three other targeted Southern California House races or in the governor and U.S. Senate races.

This study analyzed citations to 35 journal articles on AI in STEM education indexed in Dimensions from 2020 to 2024. It reports that 15 articles published in 2024 received 234 citations. The United States had the most documents and citations, while a mixed-reality AI study was the most-cited article. The passage highlights AI’s potential for personalized learning and teacher support, alongside concerns about privacy, AI literacy, and student engagement. The authors note that the database, timeframe, and use of citation counts limit the analysis.

Five European research organizations are campaigning to establish October 10 as International Coccolithophore Day. These microscopic ocean algae produce oxygen, support marine food webs, and help regulate carbon through calcium carbonate plates that sink to the seafloor and preserve records of past climates. Researchers are studying how the organisms and their interactions affect ocean carbon storage, while changes in seawater temperature, chemistry, and nutrients threaten their survival. The campaign aims to raise public and policy awareness of their importance.

A Tennessee mother’s video of her son Keaton describing bullying at school drew more than 18 million views and widespread support. Athletes and entertainers offered encouragement and invitations, while a fundraising page for his future education raised more than $29,000.

Gunmen kidnapped 52 farmers, most of them Uzbek, from three villages in Afghanistan’s Jowzjan province. The motive was unclear. Provincial police blamed Taliban fighters who control much of the district and said local elders were seeking the farmers’ release. A Taliban spokesman said he could not confirm the report.

On June 28, 2021, NVIDIA simplified its corporate structure by repatriating economic rights to certain non-U.S. intellectual property through a subsidiary’s domestication. It raised its expected second-quarter fiscal 2022 GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates from 10% to 13%, plus or minus 1%, excluding discrete items, and expects a $250 million to $300 million one-time tax benefit from the domestication.

A review of Voluntary National Reviews from 18 Eastern Mediterranean countries found that all had mechanisms to monitor Sustainable Development Goals, but reporting on health indicators varied. Maternal, neonatal and under-5 mortality were among the most commonly reported indicators; trend data were limited. Fourteen reviews identified data availability as a challenge. The study calls for stronger health information systems, particularly civil registration and vital statistics systems and population-based surveys.

Gold trading involves speculating on price changes through instruments such as futures, options, stocks and ETFs; most trades are cash settled. Gold is also used as a store of value and sometimes as a hedge. The passage describes a GLD weekend strategy tested from late 2004 to September 2021. Buying at Thursday’s close and selling at Friday’s close averaged 0.14% per trade; selling at Monday’s open averaged 0.19%. The author considers these basic versions difficult to trade but says adding a parameter improves the strategy.

Tesla Motors’ Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2015, reports quarterly revenue of $955.0 million, up from $769.3 million a year earlier, primarily due to increased Model S deliveries. Gross margin fell from 27.7% to 22.3%, and net loss widened from $61.9 million to $184.2 million. For the first six months of 2015, operating activities used $291.3 million in cash; cash and cash equivalents totaled $1.15 billion at quarter-end. Tesla expected to deliver 50,000–55,000 Model S and Model X vehicles in 2015 and projected approximately $1.5 billion in capital expenditures. The filing notes risks related to the Model X production ramp, financing programs and Gigafactory construction.

A study of UK primary care records compared symptoms and prescriptions before diagnoses of Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies, with selected findings checked in UK Biobank data. All three conditions showed symptoms years before diagnosis, but their profiles differed: memory problems were more frequent before Alzheimer’s, tremor before Parkinson’s, and several symptoms, including falls and hallucinations, were more strongly associated with Lewy body dementia. Statins were prescribed less often before Parkinson’s than before the dementia-related conditions, a finding also observed in UK Biobank. Among Parkinson’s patients, prior prescriptions for cholesterol, constipation, depression and psychosis treatments were associated with a dementia diagnosis within five years. The study could not establish whether medication associations were causal.

The NFL fined Cowboys owner Jerry Jones $250,000 after video showed him making an obscene gesture toward fans during Dallas’ win at MetLife Stadium. Jones said it was accidental and that he meant to give Cowboys fans a thumbs-up. The team is likely to appeal and has until Friday to decide.

The article argues that gold’s recent rally has not been matched by mining stocks, which it interprets as a bearish signal. It also points to a potential US dollar rally and weakness in stocks, drawing a comparison with 2008. The page includes advertisements, reader comments and trading-risk disclosures.
The team controlled the first two periods but let up in the third, allowing its opponent to rally. It plans to regroup before tomorrow’s game and improve its power play.

A rare white moose filmed in Sweden drew worldwide attention and comparisons to fantasy creatures. The BBC says about 100 white moose live in Sweden and their white fur results from a genetic mutation, not albinism.

Princeton researchers and collaborators developed Diag2Diag, an AI tool that uses readings from fusion sensors to generate detailed synthetic data where measurements are missing or limited. Using experimental data from the DIII-D facility, it revealed temperature and density changes at the plasma edge that support a theory of how magnetic perturbations suppress damaging energy bursts. The researchers say the tool could improve plasma monitoring while reducing the number of sensors needed in future fusion reactors.

The passage compares ten AI writing tools, including Jasper, Copy.ai, Frase, Article Forge, Rytr, CopySmith, Hypotenuse, Kafkai, and Peppertype. It describes uses such as blog writing, marketing copy, product descriptions, and SEO optimization, alongside features, pricing, free trials, and limitations. The author favors Jasper and discloses that the article contains affiliate links.

The Supreme Court declined to hear Ghislaine Maxwell’s appeal concerning a 2007 non-prosecution agreement with Jeffrey Epstein. Maxwell argued that its protection for potential co-conspirators barred charges against her nationwide; the 2nd Circuit held that it did not.

Origin PC’s new Eon15-S gaming laptop starts at $999 with Nvidia 1050Ti graphics, an Intel Core i3 processor and a 120GB SSD. An extra $100 upgrades it to a Core i5 and twice the storage. It has an IPS display, 24/7 US-based lifetime support and a one-year warranty.

The strategy buys at the close when IBS is below 0.25 and the close is below the previous five days’ lowest low, then exits after five days. From January 1993 to the passage’s present, it recorded 309 winners in 517 trades and averaged 0.46% per trade. Profitability peaked at three to seven days; a five-day exit produced a 10.76% annualized return while spending less time in the market than buy and hold. Recent performance was weaker. A short-selling variation yielded almost 10% over the same period.

Neural Radiance Cache uses small neural networks trained on live game data to estimate indirect lighting from path-traced rays after one bounce. By inferring later bounces instead of tracing them, it reduces GPU work while improving performance and indirect lighting quality.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with an integrated analog input driver and buffered voltage reference. They default to an internal 4.096V reference but can use an external 4.096V reference. The passage specifies reference decoupling and cautions that solder reflow can shift the internal reference voltage.

The devices support single-ended and differential, bipolar and unipolar inputs, with straight-binary output. Programmable input alarms and fixed AVDD alarms monitor voltage limits; alarm flags can be read through a pin, registers, or the data output. A multiSPI interface supports standard SPI, dual-output, source-synchronous, and daisy-chain connections. The passage describes reset, acquisition, conversion, NAP, and power-down operation, along with 32-bit transfer frames and nine configuration registers. It also provides an eight-channel industrial input-module example and power-supply decoupling and PCB-layout recommendations.
The Washington Court of Appeals reversed and remanded a Spokane County Superior Court judgment in State v. Douglas John Nelson.

The Sal6830™ is a point-of-care RT-PCR test that uses saliva patients deposit directly into a sealed cartridge and returns results in about 30 minutes. At two clinics, healthcare workers without laboratory training obtained the expected results for all valid blinded samples; one positive sample produced an invalid result. In a 119-patient comparison with a nasopharyngeal-swab test, Sal6830™ had 87.2% positive, 97.2% negative, and 93.3% overall agreement. Nine healthcare workers reported that it was easy to use and interpret without technical support.

The passage describes a voice-directed system that lets multiple inspectors work on different unfinished sections of one asset’s inspection plan. A site computer assigns sections to inspectors’ portable devices, which provide spoken instructions and collect spoken updates. The site computer receives the results and forwards them to a host computer. Assignments may account for sections that do not interfere with one another, priorities, and inspector qualifications.

The speaker celebrates winning the Stanley Cup after a grueling playoff run, praises Buffalo’s young team, and credits experienced teammates who played through injuries. Having won the Cup ten years earlier, the speaker says this victory brought a deeper appreciation of the effort and adversity involved.

The passage argues that judges need not be historians to apply *Bruen*’s Second Amendment test. It says the amendment’s text and existing precedent resolve many questions, while historical legal records can help identify traditions of firearm regulation. When the evidence remains uncertain, judges must still decide cases and can use legal tools such as burdens of persuasion. The author contrasts this approach with means-ends scrutiny, which weighs a law’s objectives against its restrictions.

Many ovarian cancer cases in the UK are diagnosed late, sometimes after emergency admission. The four main symptoms are persistent bloating, feeling full quickly or having difficulty eating, needing to urinate more often or urgently, and persistent abdominal or pelvic pain. Because these symptoms can resemble other conditions, Ovarian Cancer Action urges people to discuss persistent or unusual changes with a doctor. There is no routine screening test, and a CA-125 test cannot diagnose ovarian cancer on its own. A symptom diary or online checker may help people identify patterns and seek advice sooner.

The professor urges students to judge poker decisions by expected results rather than individual outcomes. He contrasts reading an opponent’s specific hand with estimating their range, then describes optimal play as considering both players’ ranges to avoid being exploited. Examples use pot odds and equity to assess calls.

The lecture explains that blinds and antes create an incentive to compete for pots, while effective stack size, position, and equity shape decisions. The professor recommends raising rather than calling when no one has entered the pot, playing more hands from later positions, and often going all in with short effective stacks. He also distinguishes bluffing with weak hands from value betting with strong ones and recommends PokerStove for studying equity.

Dylan Drysdale, Tim Loughran and Garry Cullum won their class titles at the final round of the 2017 Molecule ProKart Series at KartSport Hamilton. Drysdale secured the Wifiplus KZ2 title by four points over Aaron Wilson, who won the final race and the round. Loughran won the Aarque Group KZ2 Masters round and title after points leader Enrico van der Griend crashed. Cullum won every KZ2 Restricted race at the round, securing a record fourth class title by 20 points over Regan Hall.

Hurricane Maria struck Puerto Rico in September 2017, causing widespread flooding, infrastructure damage, power outages and major agricultural losses. The passage proposes a semiparametric Poisson model to estimate excess deaths by cause and post-hurricane period. It accounts for population displacement, yearly mortality trends and within-year variation, with the aim of identifying how long the emergency affected mortality for different causes.

Nasa is considering using its proposed HAMMER spacecraft to deploy a nuclear device against asteroid Bennu if it threatens Earth. Bennu has a 1-in-2,700 chance of striking Earth on September 21, 2135.

Hendrik Bessembinder’s study found that only 43% of U.S. stocks outperformed one-month Treasury Bills between 1926 and 2015. Although stock market returns were strong overall, a small number of stocks drove much of the gain, while the median stock performed poorly. A study of Norway’s stock market found a similar concentration of value creation. The passage recommends passive funds or diversification for investors.

When a player appears injured and the referee allows play to continue, a player may kick the ball out so the injured player can receive assistance. The other team then takes the throw-in and, as a courtesy, returns possession without either team exploiting the exchange. If the referee stops play for an injury, play restarts with a dropped ball; players can similarly return possession to the team that had it.

DryShips raised $14.5 million of a requested $30 million through stock sales from April 10–17, issuing 7.9 million shares and diluting existing shares by 16.8%. As of April 17, $173.4 million remained under the offering, compared with a $106 million equity market capitalization. The author says weak demand could impede further sales and estimates that completing the offering at the recent pace would take 54 trading days and require about 105.7 million additional shares. The author expects DryShips to seek debt financing and warns that trading the stock is extremely risky.

The May 17, 2001 VentureWire reports Tahoe Networks’ $38 million launch funding, Startups.com’s shift in business model and staff cuts, Hermes’ $965 million private-investment allocation, and OffRoad Capital’s restructuring and layoffs. It also covers venture financings, closures, product launches, acquisitions, executive appointments, and venture fund news.

The author is reconsidering a bearish view of US equities, citing signs of stronger market breadth despite concerns about low VIX levels. The article presents 21 charts supporting that reassessment. The author discloses long positions in US equities and VIX.

At a Teachers’ Union of Ireland conference, general secretary John MacGabhann advised teachers against Facebook friendships with students, saying they could compromise professional boundaries. He urged caution with social media posts and online disputes, warning that hasty comments could have professional or legal consequences. He also criticised employers who expect staff to respond to messages at all hours and advised teachers not to respond to unreasonable contact.

The passage describes e-maintenance as a way to monitor equipment, predict degradation and connect maintenance decisions with manufacturing and business systems. It proposes reconfigurable maintenance that adapts to changing products and production configurations, supports cooperation between companies, and uses shared diagnostic knowledge. Modular monitoring, historical data and expert systems are presented as tools for detecting adverse conditions and guiding corrective action. The stated aim is to improve reliability and quality while reducing downtime and costs.

The speaker thanks the people for their confidence and pledges to serve within the Constitution’s limits. He promises peaceful and honorable foreign relations, respect for states’ reserved powers, economical management of public revenue, and efforts to reduce the national debt. He calls for fair treatment of agriculture, commerce, and manufacturing; constitutional support for improvements and knowledge; and a military subordinate to civilian authority, with a strong militia as the chief defense. He also pledges just treatment of Indian tribes and reforms to prevent federal patronage from interfering with elections and appointments. He seeks capable public officers and asks for the support of other branches of government and his fellow citizens.

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said India’s accession to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation strengthened its potential to stabilise Central and South Asia and address the Afghanistan crisis. He praised India’s foreign policy, called current bilateral trade unsatisfactory, and cited a $30 billion trade target for 2025 and increased defence technology transfers. Lavrov argued that the US strategy of using force in Afghanistan would fail, denied Russian support for the Taliban, and said a political solution requires negotiations involving the Afghan government, the Taliban and influential neighbours.

The passage examines how TRNC presidents’ statements and Education Council decisions have shaped education policy, particularly its role in Turkish Cypriot identity. Presidential priorities have varied: Denktaş and Tatar emphasized national identity and ties with Turkey; Talat focused on European integration; Eroğlu on cooperation with Turkey and technical education; and Akıncı on multiculturalism and dialogue. History textbooks have often presented a one-sided account of the Cyprus conflict, while reforms toward more pluralistic narratives have faced political and social resistance. The passage recommends politically independent, scientifically grounded education policies that address local needs and present history from multiple perspectives.

A letter bearing the signature of fired federal prosecutor Michael Ben’Ary said a false social media post apparently led to his dismissal during a terrorism prosecution. The letter accused Justice Department leaders of prioritizing punishment of President Trump’s perceived enemies over national security.
The speaker expects the opposing team to play hard at home to extend the series. Their team’s focus is preparing well and starting strong for a chance to end the series.
Yandex will report its second-quarter 2018 financial results on July 26, 2018. Management will discuss the results in a conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

New England Patriots receiver Malcolm Mitchell taught himself to read better after struggling with literacy in college, starting with children’s books. He later founded Read with Malcolm to promote reading and provide books to children in underserved communities. Mitchell, who also wrote *The Magician’s Hat*, will receive America’s Promise Alliance’s Promise Hero Award for his literacy work.

The passage describes a one-day digital accessibility workshop in India for 73 software engineers, educators, and UX designers. Five modules covered accessibility principles, design, development, reporting, and teaching, alongside hands-on activities and demonstrations. Participants reported high engagement and confidence; all said they would recommend the workshop. Feedback called for more advanced, role-specific, and practice-based training. The authors recommend preparatory materials, follow-up opportunities, and assessing whether participants apply what they learned at work.

The passage argues that the Supreme Court is likely to uphold President Trump’s firing of FTC Commissioner Rebecca Kelly Slaughter without overturning *Humphrey’s Executor*, the precedent protecting some agency officials from removal without cause. It says the modern FTC has gained substantial enforcement and rulemaking powers and may no longer fit the precedent’s description of a largely nonexecutive, expert agency. The court could instead distinguish agencies by the powers they exercise, while preserving the Federal Reserve’s independence.

Alexa can help with cleaning by scheduling tasks through Cleaning Buddy, ordering supplies from Amazon, and controlling compatible robot vacuums by voice. It can also book laundry pickup through Laundrapp, where available, or provide stain-removal advice through skills.

In a parliamentary response to the State of the Nation Address, DA leader Mmusi Maimane accused President Jacob Zuma and the ANC of using “radical socio-economic transformation” to enrich politically connected elites rather than help ordinary South Africans. He cited the deaths of 94 mental health patients, youth unemployment and concerns about land, mining and nuclear policies. Maimane outlined a DA “Rescue Plan” focused on education, training, private-sector job creation, land ownership, policing, healthcare and measures to reduce corruption and government spending.

MIT researchers developed a prime-editing system called vPE that reduced unintended DNA errors by modifying Cas9 and stabilizing the RNA template. In mouse and human cells, errors fell to about one in 101 edits in one mode and one in 543 in another—up to 60 times fewer than with the original system. The team is working to improve editing efficiency and delivery to specific tissues.

D.A.N. Joint Venture III sought to deny Ambrozy Jerry Fasolak’s Chapter 7 discharge, alleging fraudulent transfers, inadequate financial records, false oaths, and unexplained asset losses. The court found that, although Fasolak transferred funds to his wife and made inaccurate bankruptcy disclosures, the plaintiff had not proved fraudulent intent or the other grounds for denial. It ruled for Fasolak on all counts and ordered his discharge.

The study examines defects introduced by electropolishing highly polished niobium surfaces for superconducting radio-frequency cavities. White-light interferometry and atomic force microscopy reveal intergranular steps up to 70 nm high with local slopes approaching 50°. Sequential measurements indicate that these defects depend primarily on grain orientation rather than the amount of material removed.

London-theory calculations show that the steps can enhance magnetic fields and suppress the superheating field, limiting achievable peak fields. Diffusion simulations also show reduced impurity concentration near step bottoms, where vortex penetration is favored. The authors conclude that smoother surfaces are needed to improve high-field performance and the uniformity of shallow impurity treatments.

British police declared a major incident after a man and woman in their 40s were found unconscious in Amesbury and hospitalized in critical condition following exposure to an unknown substance. Counterterrorism officers are assisting local police. Amesbury is near Salisbury, where Sergei and Yulia Skripal were poisoned in March. Police have not determined whether a crime occurred.

After at least 51 people were detained by ICE agents in the Austin–San Antonio area, Austin ISD lawyers told staff not to share unvetted resources with students or discuss controversial issues on district property. Schools reported student anxiety. School board Vice President Paul Saldana criticized the memo, while Education Austin distributed immigration guidance and urged the district to communicate it clearly to families.

Horseback polo originated in Persia more than 20 centuries ago and reached the United States through India and England. The Milwaukee Polo Club, founded in the Milwaukee area in 1923, has operated in Hartland for more than 20 years. It presents polo as an accessible sport: matches cost $5 to watch, with free admission for children, and usually last about two hours. Play depends on safe field conditions. On days without matches, members may offer horse demonstrations and answer questions. Club representative Thomas Esser says players manage their horses’ workloads and rest.
A 13-year-old girl was hospitalized in serious but stable condition after being shot in the thigh while sitting in an open garage in Guildford, Sydney. Police believe the shooting was not random.

The speaker emphasizes preparation, focus and execution over momentum or speculation. He says championship opportunities are rare in a salary-cap league, making injuries, depth and player development especially important. Both teams have contributed throughout their lineups, and his team must handle the puck better, limit turnovers and start well in Pittsburgh. He praises Ozzie’s response to adversity and describes winning and making sacrifices for teammates as the basis of team unity. He urges the players to enjoy the opportunity while staying focused, noting that the closely matched series is far from over.

Penny stocks are shares priced below $5, most commonly traded over the counter rather than on major exchanges. The passage warns that many involve unproven or struggling businesses, limited financial disclosure, low liquidity and high volatility. Thin trading also makes them vulnerable to scams, including pump-and-dump schemes. It recommends avoiding penny stocks or thoroughly researching the risks before trading them.

Sen. Mark Warner accused Republicans of using the Nunes memo to undermine Robert Mueller’s investigation and the FBI. He said he and Sen. Richard Burr were denied access before its release and criticized the initial decision to block a Democratic response. House Speaker Paul Ryan supported releasing that response. Warner also warned that the president’s failure to acknowledge Russian election meddling leaves the country less safe.

Digital leaders foster learning and responsible experimentation, share governed data, use measurable goals, and align teams around a common strategy. These practices can give employees flexibility while supporting collaboration and data-driven decisions. Digital laggards tend to favor short-term training, restrict data access, set poorly grounded goals, and emphasize process or individual judgment, which can hinder innovation and alignment.

Cultural change takes sustained effort, and digital leaders also face tensions between risk-taking, deadlines, and excessive analysis. The passage describes a pharmaceutical team that safely experimented with automated compliance checks and a retailer that introduced real-time sales reporting. It identifies four data-culture patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—each with different strengths and areas for improvement.

The passage studies fairness in many-to-one matching when teams and participants may have tied preferences. It introduces team-justified envy-freeness up to one participant, which discounts envy involving participants who strictly prefer their assigned team. A polynomial-time algorithm produces allocations that satisfy this criterion, participant-justified envy-freeness, balancedness, and Pareto optimality. With additional tie-breaking, it is group-strategyproof for participants. The algorithm generalizes both round-robin allocation and Gale–Shapley matching. An extension accommodating team quotas and preferences for remaining unassigned also guarantees stability, Pareto optimality, team fairness, and participant group-strategyproofness.

The ATR trailing stop is a technical indicator that sets dynamic stop-loss levels based on average true range, a measure of price volatility. Its calculation typically multiplies ATR by 3.5, then subtracts the result from the previous close for long positions or adds it for short positions. Traders use it to manage risk, identify potential exits and entries, and respond to possible trend reversals when prices breach stop levels. It can be applied to stocks, but its focus on current volatility may not fully account for past performance or price movements.

Texas A&M has had a first-round NFL draft pick every year since 2011, but the streak depends on receiver Christian Kirk, who is projected as a fringe first-round selection. Kirk plans to watch Thursday’s draft from Arizona. Safety Armani Watts is projected for the middle rounds, while receiver Damion Ratley could be selected late. Defensive tackle Zaycoven Henderson’s pending criminal case may keep him from being drafted.

The speaker reviews a century of constitutional government, arguing that the Union survived civil war and that its laws are supreme while states retain local self-government. He calls for equal protection and free suffrage for formerly enslaved citizens, and for universal education to address voter illiteracy. He urges reconciliation over settled disputes.

On economic policy, he supports sound currency, redemption of paper notes in coin, careful debt refinancing, and greater attention to agriculture, manufacturing, transportation, and American interests in any interoceanic canal. He calls on Congress to prohibit criminal practices in the territories while respecting religious freedom and to regulate civil-service tenure and removals. His administration, he pledges, will enforce federal law, practice economy, and require faithful public service.

Drew Faust will step down as Harvard’s president on June 30, 2018, after 11 years, and return to her scholarship after a sabbatical. Harvard credits her with restoring trust on campus, expanding financial aid and overseeing a fundraising campaign that has raised $8 billion. Her tenure has also faced disputes over social clubs, campus diversity and the endowment’s investment losses. Harvard plans to form a committee to find her successor.

Alphabet agreed to pay $24.5 million to settle Trump’s lawsuit over YouTube’s suspension of his account after the January 6, 2021, Capitol riot. Trump directed his $22 million share to a nonprofit for the National Mall and toward a White House ballroom; co-plaintiffs will receive $2.5 million. YouTube restored his account in March 2023. Alphabet admitted no liability or fault.

Michigan State Superintendent Michael Rice is retiring after leading the state’s education department since 2019. In a recent interview, he urged lawmakers to stop allowing schools to count up to seven teacher professional development days as instructional days, arguing that students need the full 180 days required by law.

Rice said Michigan has made progress on preschool enrollment, school funding equity, graduation rates and teacher recruitment, but has not fully met its education goals. Reading achievement remains a concern, and he called for mandatory science-of-reading training for K-5 teachers, pointing to Mississippi’s gains. Teacher shortages have eased, he said, but persist in some communities. Sue Carnell will serve as interim superintendent until Glenn Maleyko starts.

The Ghana Football Association removed Vice President George Afriyie after he announced plans to contest the 2019 GFA election. His dismissal followed reported disagreements with president Kwesi Nyantakyi and Afriyie’s earlier removal as head of the Black Stars Management Committee. Afriyie says his Executive Committee experience qualifies him to lead the association. The contest has divided committee members, while Nyantakyi’s plans for re-election remain uncertain.
Researchers report that cheetahs have disappeared from 91 percent of their historic range. A southern African population assessment supports calls to list them as Endangered.

June 2001 reports describe a dispute between Enron’s Dabhol Power Company and the Maharashtra State Electricity Board over costly power, payments and their power purchase agreement. Lenders asked Stone & Webster to assess the cost of suspending the project’s nearly completed second phase and formed a committee to negotiate with MSEB. Enron indicated willingness to reduce its projected rate of return from 16% to 11%. DPC challenged a regulatory order restricting arbitration and use of an escrow account, while efforts continued to secure buyers for the plant’s power.

Eight years after graduating, the author remembers enjoying college, meeting exceptional people, and taking fascinating classes. Looking back, they regret not taking advantage of more opportunities or realizing how much time they had for adventure.

Peter Lynch managed Fidelity’s Magellan Fund from 1977 to 1990, producing average annual returns of about 29% and outperforming the S&P 500 in all but two years. His strategy was to “invest in what you understand”: research companies with clear businesses, promising products and sound fundamentals rather than predict markets or react to short-term prices. He sought undervalued, often overlooked companies and grouped stocks as slow-growing, moderately growing, fast-growing, cyclical, recovering from crisis, or holding undervalued assets. Lynch emphasized growth stocks but diversified across categories, reviewed holdings quarterly and adjusted positions when prices diverged from fundamentals. The passage notes that he had access to Fidelity’s extensive research resources and company management.

The coach says the series has featured momentum swings and strong play from both teams. He is impressed by his team’s resilience through injuries and sees the upcoming Stanley Cup Final game as an exciting opportunity. He expects his team to be more comfortable and assertive at home, while stressing that players must stay poised, execute and avoid dwelling on the prize. He values the Red Wings’ history and lessons learned from former players. He also appreciates sharing the experience with Detroit fans during difficult economic times and says Hossa should focus on doing his part rather than scoring.

The Himachal Pradesh Board of Secondary Education declared its 2018 Class 12 results on April 24. Students can check their results at hpbose.org using their roll number or by texting HP12ROLLNUMBER to 56263. The Class 12 examinations ran from March 6 to March 29.

Liverpool open the 2017/18 Premier League season at Watford on August 12 and finish at home to Brighton on May 13. They host Everton on December 9 and Manchester United on October 14. Dates may change.

Seven more candidates qualified on Feb. 14 for the race to replace Tom Price in Georgia’s 6th Congressional District, bringing the field to 15 with one day of qualifying remaining. The special election is April 18, with a runoff scheduled for June 20.

The study used ovitrap egg counts and weather data to forecast invasive Aedes mosquito abundance in two Basque Country provinces, Gipuzkoa and Bizkaia. Araba was excluded because its egg-count data were insufficient for reliable model fitting. Egg counts were strongly associated with temperature, while humidity and precipitation showed weaker relationships. Adding lagged weather variables and egg counts improved most models. Random Forest fit the training data best, but a Gaussian generalized linear model performed best on 2023 test data; unusually high egg counts in Bizkaia complicated testing. The authors emphasize continued local surveillance to improve forecasts and inform mosquito control.

The Geminid meteor shower peaks Wednesday night, with the best viewing from midnight to 4 a.m. Thursday. Up to 50 meteors may be visible. A smaller crescent moon should improve viewing as Earth passes through debris from asteroid Phaethon.

The U.S. Geological Survey awarded Caltech and six other institutions $4.9 million to develop ShakeAlert, a West Coast earthquake-warning system, and announced about $1 million in sensor purchases. The system aims to give residents seconds to seek shelter or limit damage.

A British study found that high-risk smokers invited to CT lung cancer screening were more likely to quit than those not invited: 10 percent versus 5 percent after two weeks, and 15 percent versus 5 percent after two years. A clear scan did not appear to reduce motivation to quit. The researchers noted that participants volunteered and may already have been considering quitting. They concluded that screening could provide an opportunity to support smoking cessation, particularly alongside other interventions.

Northwestern’s 66-59 upset of Wisconsin has brought its first NCAA tournament bid closer and increased media attention. Coach Chris Collins and players cautioned that the team must stay focused on its remaining games. Northwestern next hosts Maryland without Scottie Lindsey, who is expected to miss a fourth straight game with mono.

Valmet’s board approved a share-based incentive plan for key employees covering 2018–2020. For 2018, rewards depend on Comparable EBITA margin and growth in orders for its Services and Automation businesses. Rewards will be paid in shares and cash in 2019, with shares subject to a two-year transfer restriction. The plan covers approximately 120 participants, and total rewards are capped at approximately 586,000 shares before taxes and related costs.

A Denver federal jury found that former radio host David Mueller assaulted and battered Taylor Swift by groping her during a 2013 preconcert photo session. It awarded Swift the $1 she sought and found that her mother and manager had not improperly interfered with Mueller’s employment. Mueller had sued after the accusation led to his firing; the judge dismissed his claim against Swift before the verdict. Swift said she would donate to organizations that help sexual assault victims defend themselves.

A survey of 202 Illinois daycare staff found that nutrition, exercise and brushing teeth ranked above sun protection as health lessons for young children. About half of programs provided sunscreen, but most of those did not let children apply it themselves. Some used spray sunscreen, sometimes spraying it directly on children’s faces despite the risk of inhalation or eye exposure. Most programs reported no sunburns and followed guidelines for avoiding excessive heat. The authors cautioned that findings from Illinois may not apply elsewhere. Experts called for more sun-safety education and said parents could help by providing sunscreen and protective clothing.

American Airlines’ Net SAAver email lists roundtrip domestic and international weekend fares. Domestic departures are November 30–December 1, 2001; international departures are November 29–30. Returns are December 3 or 4, and tickets must be purchased by November 23. It also advertises Thanksgiving fares requiring purchase by November 21, AAdvantage awards, vacation and hotel offers, and Hertz rental specials. Fares exclude certain taxes and fees; seats are limited and tickets are nonrefundable.

Lawyer Angela B. Ryan describes how colleagues and opposing counsel touched her pregnant belly without consent, including during a court hearing, while others laughed. She says the touching undermined her autonomy and was treated as acceptable despite workplace harassment standards and legal protections against pregnancy-based discrimination. Reflecting on her earlier judgments of pregnant colleagues, Ryan calls on the legal profession to address unwanted touching through training, policies and a clear rule: do not touch a pregnant person without explicit consent.

The speaker says the team has improved its puck management and play despite scoring few goals. After two straight wins, the team feels confident, but is focused on Thursday’s game against a strong home opponent. A ten-day layoff affected its timing, not its conditioning. The speaker praises the goaltender’s playoff performance, says both teams are comfortable with their defensive matchups, and notes that either team can come back after conceding first.
Pete Hegseth summoned hundreds of generals and admirals to argue for changing a military he called soft and “woke.”

On Christmas Eve 2012, Chris Hadfield hid cards from crewmates’ families aboard the International Space Station for the crew to find on Christmas. The astronauts marked the holiday with fruitcake that would not crumble in microgravity, a special meal, stockings and a small artificial tree. Hadfield says preparing for holidays mattered to the crew’s psychological health; American and Russian crewmates chose celebrations from their respective cultures.

The passage describes SD memory card commands and host requirements for writing, erasing, protection, initialization, and data transfer. ACMD23 can speed multiple-block writes by specifying blocks to pre-erase; ACMD22 reports how many blocks were successfully written after an error. ERASE, DISCARD, and full-user-area logical erase use CMD32, CMD33, and CMD38, with support checks, command-order requirements, and different treatment of resulting data.

Write protection includes a mechanical switch, optional internal protection, and password-based locking. Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password and requires COP Unlock for certain operations. CMD55 identifies the following command as application-specific, while CMD6 checks or switches functions such as bus speed, driver strength, and power limit. The passage also specifies differences between SDSC and SDHC/SDXC addressing, bus-clock and CRC requirements, command formats and responses, and read, write, and erase timeouts.
Voting began Wednesday in 69 of Uttarakhand’s 70 assembly seats, with over 74 lakh voters eligible. Polling in Karnaprayag was postponed to March 9 after a candidate’s death.
The A100 has 192 KB of L1 cache and shared memory per SM, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/s bandwidth, and a 40 MB L2 cache with residency controls.

A bowler was injured when a splinter from an uneven, worn approach floor entered his finger as he delivered a ball. The court held that the evidence allowed the jury to find the alley proprietor negligent and did not establish contributory negligence by the bowler. It upheld the refusal of the proprietor’s requested instructions and ordered judgment for the bowler on the $750 verdict.

Samsung announced three new Galaxy A smartphones—A3, A5 and A7—its first product unveiling since the Galaxy Note 7 launch. The lower-cost phones add water and dust resistance and a 16-megapixel camera. They are set to launch in Russia later this month before expanding to other markets; pricing has not been announced.

After the July 4 flood killed 25 Camp Mystic campers and two counselors, including Chloe Childress, grieving parents organized to push for stronger camp safety rules. Gov. Greg Abbott signed bills requiring floodplain restrictions for overnight cabins, weather alerts and emergency training. The parents hope the changes will protect other children, though their grief remains.

These 1902 rules state that only the Secretary of State may issue U.S. passports, and only to people who owe allegiance to the United States; declaring an intention to become a citizen is insufficient. Applicants in the United States must submit a sworn application with identifying details, an oath of allegiance, and a credible witness’s certification. Applicants abroad or in insular possessions apply through specified U.S. officials. People born abroad to U.S. fathers, naturalized citizens, women claiming status through husbands, and children claiming citizenship through a parent’s naturalization must provide additional evidence. Residents of insular possessions must also substantiate their birth, residence, and allegiance with two witnesses.
China launched a visa for young professionals and graduates of top science and technology universities as the US imposed a $100,000 H-1B fee. The move drew xenophobic backlash.

The passage describes L4 peripheral memory maps and a TILER extended address range that adds 4 GB for rotated and mirrored frame-buffer views. The full range is accessible only to the HDVPSS and ISS subsystems; other masters can access one view through a 512 MB region. It also explains what the terminal-function tables record, including pin multiplexing and pull states. Several boot-mode pins are sampled at reset for GPMC and reset-output settings, then function as GPMC data/address pins.

The passage describes how large language models could help social scientists synthesize research data, analyze responses and explore new hypotheses. It also notes concerns about biased or inaccurate simulations, misinformation and the validity of AI-generated theories, emphasizing human oversight. For AI governance, it calls for forward-looking regulation developed through cooperation among policymakers, industry and academia, alongside channels for users and developers to report emerging risks and inform timely updates.

An international survey of 747 people with primary ciliary dyskinesia found that 92% reported diagnostic testing, but test use and recall varied substantially between countries. Among participants older than five, 36% reported nasal nitric oxide measurement, biopsy, and genetic testing. People diagnosed after 2010 reported more tests than those diagnosed before 2000; those with situs abnormalities reported fewer. Because the data were self-reported, test histories could not be verified. The authors recommend reviewing results with patients and considering supplementary testing where diagnostic work-up is incomplete.

Halliburton reported first-quarter net income of $46 million, reversing a year-earlier loss. Adjusted earnings of 41 cents per share met expectations, while revenue of $5.74 billion fell short of forecasts.

A federal judge rejected a challenge to the Biden-era gainful-employment rule, siding with the Education Department. The rule requires for-profit and nondegree programs to show that graduates can afford loan payments and earn more than high school graduates. Programs failing for two consecutive years could lose federal aid. An industry representative called for revisions, while a student advocacy group welcomed the ruling.

Prava Chatterjee challenged a settlement of her deceased seaman son’s claim, alleging that her son-in-law lacked authority to sign the release and that her signature on his power of attorney was forged. The Third Circuit held that Indian law governs the power of attorney, while federal maritime law governs the release and requires shipowners to prove its validity. It upheld the district court’s exclusion of testimony from an earlier commission but found that refusing a new commission denied Chatterjee a fair opportunity to present evidence. The court vacated the denial of her petition and remanded for testimony to be taken in India.

NAFTA has supported Canadian growth and transformed manufacturing, making its modernization a federal priority. Its renegotiation also highlights Canada’s reliance on North American markets, while exports to most other free-trade partners have not grown since agreements were signed. The passage argues that further agreements alone will not increase prosperity. It calls for a plan to improve Canada’s tax and regulatory competitiveness, address non-tariff trade barriers, choose partners with strong business ties, build on existing supply chains, and make export support easier for small and medium-sized manufacturers to access.

International student arrivals in the U.S. fell 19 percent in August compared with August 2024, according to National Travel and Tourism Office data. The figure does not include students who stayed in the U.S. over the summer or arrived in September, so it does not directly measure enrollment. It also conflicts with September SEVIS data showing a 0.8 percent enrollment increase, whose accuracy some experts question. Arrivals fell particularly sharply from Africa, Asia and the Middle East. Experts cite visa delays and warn that the eventual enrollment decline could exceed 20 percent. A clearer picture is expected from institutions’ self-reported data in mid-November.

A New Delhi court deferred until July 6 its consideration of the ED’s money-laundering chargesheet against Karti Chidambaram and two companies in the Aircel-Maxis case. The ED alleges that the deal’s foreign investment was presented as Rs 180 crore instead of Rs 3,565.91 crore, bypassing the authority required for larger investments. Karti has interim protection from arrest until July 10.

Pokémon GO’s Solstice Event boosts XP for catches and accurate throws, with discounted Lucky Eggs raising those rewards further. Unlike evolution-based XP gains, the bonuses encourage players to catch Pokémon and practice their throws. The author says they may help casual and midcore players level up before an upcoming gym update.

The speaker says a player probably will not play tomorrow but declines to confirm his status. He sees no fatigue factor, says replay evidence was inconclusive, and believes playing at home or on the road has had little impact. He says home distractions may have affected some top players early in the previous game.

Ahead of a cabinet meeting at Chequers, Conservative MP Andrea Jenkyns warned that a Brexit deal leaving Britain closely aligned with EU rules would be “catastrophic” for her party. Jacob Rees-Mogg urged Theresa May to keep her promises to leave the single market and customs union. Remain-supporting MPs argue that a pragmatic approach is needed to avoid disruption to businesses and borders. Environment Secretary Michael Gove said he expected May to uphold her commitments and the cabinet to agree on a united position.

Reporting to Congress after the Crimea Conference, the speaker says the United States, Britain, and Soviet Union agreed on closer military coordination to hasten Germany’s unconditional surrender and on plans to occupy and disarm Germany, end Nazism, punish war criminals, and require reparations in kind.

The three powers also resolved outstanding issues concerning a proposed international security organization and agreed to work jointly on political and economic problems in liberated areas. Their agreement on Poland calls for a broader provisional government, free elections, and territorial changes. France was invited to take part in Germany’s occupation and the future security organization.

A conference in San Francisco will consider a charter for the organization. The speaker urges Congress and the American people to support the Yalta agreements and accept a continuing responsibility for peace. He cautions that the wars are not yet won and that defeating Japan may require a long struggle.

After nearly quadrupling from its post-crisis lows, the S&P 500 had gone more than 60 trading days without a new high. The author argues that market conditions may be changing as the Federal Reserve continues tightening policy and volatility remains elevated. The share of trading days with moves greater than 1% rose from 3.19% in 2017 to 39.24% through the first 79 trading days of 2018. While strong projected earnings could support stocks, the author warns that sustained volatility may signal a bull-market top and urges investors to consider risks that current forecasts may not capture.

Guyana will host the Caribbean Water and Wastewater Association’s 26th Annual Conference and Exhibition from October 16 to 20. The forum will address water, wastewater and waste management, review a regional waste management action plan, and present the Caribbean’s position on water governance. More than 250 delegates are expected.

The Bogleheads 3 Fund Portfolio uses low-cost index funds for U.S. stocks, international stocks, and U.S. bonds. The 4 Fund Portfolio adds international bonds. Both seek diversification and long-term growth, though stock markets and interest rates affect their performance. In the article’s backtests, a 50% VTI, 30% VEU, and 20% BND allocation returned 7.6% annually with a 28% maximum drawdown. A 50% VTI, 30% VEU, 10% BND, and 10% IXUS allocation returned 7.8% annually with a 31% maximum drawdown.

Drug repurposing may accelerate treatment development for rare diseases. Using Elsevier’s biomedical knowledge graph, the passage compares open- and controlled-access literature relevant to repurposing. Open-access contributions have grown, but both sources contribute substantially. Facts from the two sources have similar citation rates, while roughly half of graph relations have only one supporting reference. The authors call for additional measures of confidence in those relations.

The LG V35 ThinQ is a premium smartphone with a Snapdragon 845 processor, 6GB of RAM, a 6-inch OLED display, and a headphone jack. It has dual 16MP rear cameras with AI-assisted features, water and dust resistance, and 64GB or 128GB of expandable storage. Pricing and release details have not been announced.
Iraq has begun airstrikes on Islamic State-held Tal Afar, west of Mosul, and plans a ground assault after the air campaign, an Iraqi Defence Ministry spokesman said.

Managed by Q launched in New York in 2014 to provide offices with cleaning, maintenance, and supplies through a digital dashboard. After finding that subcontractors delivered inconsistent service, it hired and trained operators directly, offered above-industry-standard pay and benefits, and emphasized transparency, customer feedback, and an inclusive workplace.

By July 2015, Q had expanded to Chicago and San Francisco, raised $17.4 million, and reported customer retention above 90%. CEO Dan Teran faced a growth choice: enter more cities or deepen service and customer relationships in existing markets. He sought to preserve Q’s employment model and culture while scaling.

The speaker launches a nationwide appeal to protect unemployed Americans and their families from hunger and cold during the coming winter. A national organization led by Walter Gifford will coordinate with state and local agencies and volunteer groups to raise funds for work, direct relief, and health services. Federal public works support nearly 700,000 families, but the speaker says voluntary giving remains essential. He urges each community to meet its needs through mutual help and asks Americans to make Thanksgiving a day when they can say they have relieved the fears of those in distress.

The lecture connects control charts to repeated hypothesis tests. The false-alarm probability, alpha, determines control limits and the average run length before a false alarm; beta is the probability of missing a process shift. Increasing sample size can reduce beta while control limits are adjusted to preserve alpha. An alarm alone cannot establish whether a shift occurred, so the measurement and process should be investigated.

The lecturer distinguishes statistically determined control limits from design specification limits. Process capability measures compare process variation with specifications: Cp measures spread, while Cpk also accounts for how far the process mean is from the target. A quality loss function penalizes both variation and deviation from the target. The lecture closes by introducing moving-average and cumulative-sum charts for detecting smaller changes.

Lawmakers plan to use President Donald Trump’s first State of the Union address to highlight several issues. Many Democratic women will wear black in solidarity with the movement against sexual harassment. Democrats have invited young immigrants protected under DACA, while a Republican lawmaker invited the president of a company developing a border-wall prototype. At least eight Democrats plan to boycott the speech. Bill Nye will attend as the guest of Trump’s NASA nominee, Rep. Jim Bridenstine. Rep. Joe Kennedy of Massachusetts will deliver the Democratic response.

The passage lists document and telegram references dated January through September 1942, with locations, dispatch times, and, for some telegrams, receipt times. Most entries are from Washington or Helsinki; others are from Kuibyshev (Moscow), Stockholm, London, and Ankara.

Sarahah, a free Android and iOS app, lets people send anonymous messages to user profiles. Already popular in Egypt and Saudi Arabia, it has recently gained attention elsewhere. Its reviews are sharply divided, with users reporting hateful comments despite its goal of providing constructive feedback. Privacy settings allow users to limit who can find or message them and to block senders. Its popularity may be short-lived, as with earlier anonymous messaging apps.

Detective Mike Wissbaum inhaled heroin mixed with fentanyl while giving rescue breaths to an overdose victim in eastern Missouri. Both were hospitalized and recovered. Police warned of risks to first responders.

The study measured tungsten oxidation from 400 to 1050°C and tungsten trioxide sublimation in synthetic air. Oxidation shifted from parabolic to linear growth, producing non-protective oxide scales. Above 600°C, voids and cracks formed, while preferential oxidation at specimen edges increased the risk of oxide spalling. Raman analysis identified a 30–50 nm inner WO2 layer, a 10–20 µm WO2.72 layer, and an outer WO2.9/WO3 layer. The authors suggest that WO2 may help explain the low detritiation efficiency reported for JET tungsten tiles.

Katie Albert describes the second half of her study-abroad semester in Florence, where she is improving her Italian, creating paintings and drawings, and taking part in cooking classes and trips to Siena, Pisa and Lucca. During spring break, she visited seven countries in 10 days. A highlight was exploring Becherbach, Germany, where her ancestors lived; she ended the trip paragliding near the Swiss-French border. Back in Florence, she visited Croatia for rafting, cliff diving and sightseeing, reaching her milestone of 20 countries by age 20. With three weeks remaining, she feels torn between leaving Florence and returning home.

Joseph Nicholson, originally sentenced to life with no parole for 25 years for the 2007 stabbing death of 16-year-old Joey Tanner, will be resentenced after the Ontario Court of Appeal reduced his conviction from first- to second-degree murder. The court found the trial judge had not adequately instructed the jury. Nicholson was also convicted of attempting to murder Tanner’s friend. The Crown seeks parole eligibility after 16 years. Tanner’s parents described their continuing grief, while Nicholson apologized and said he wanted to rehabilitate himself. Justice Guy Di Tomaso will impose the new sentence Aug. 11.

The PGA848 is a precision programmable-gain instrumentation amplifier with a single-ended output and eight gain settings from 0.5V/V to 100V/V. Its linear input range extends to within 3V of either supply. A sample design uses it to drive a 16-bit, 1MSPS ADS8860 SAR ADC, with three filters for interference reduction, bandwidth control, and ADC settling. A REF6250 reference and OPA192 buffer set the PGA848 REF pin to the ADC’s 2.5V midscale.

Nominal performance is specified with ±15V input-stage and output-stage supplies; supply voltages above 40V permanently damage the device. The passage recommends matched input paths, local supply bypass capacitors, separation of sensitive traces, and measures to limit leakage, parasitic capacitance, and thermal effects.

Australia’s childcare subsidies will be replaced on July 2 by a single payment based on family income and parents’ activity. Of about 1.2 million eligible families, 489,000 had not updated their Centrelink details through myGov and could have payments withheld until they do. Both parents generally must work, study, volunteer or seek work for at least eight hours a fortnight. Subsidies range from 85 per cent of fees for families earning $66,958 or less to none for those earning more than $351,248. The annual rebate cap will be removed for households earning under $186,958 and raised for those above that threshold. Exemptions and additional support are available, and children must meet immunisation requirements. Labor says one in four families will be worse off.

Jeffing, developed by Olympian Jeff Galloway in the 1970s, alternates running with planned walking breaks. Physical therapist Dr John Gallucci Jr says it can build aerobic endurance while reducing fatigue and physical stress, making running more manageable for beginners and useful for experienced runners on long runs or during recovery weeks. He suggests beginners alternate 1–2 minutes of running and walking, then adjust gradually. Poor form or increasing intervals or mileage too quickly can still cause injury.

Sharon Haliwell died by suicide at her Wigan home after two mental health assessments identified a continuing risk. An error prevented her referral for counselling, and the coroner raised concerns about communication between teams at North West Boroughs NHS Foundation Trust. The trust said it was training staff, improving alerts across patient systems and updating procedures for sharing risk information.

The passage surveys how matroids, multinets, and algebraic invariants relate to hyperplane arrangements. It defines matroids through independent sets and flats, describes multinets and nets as partitions with specified rank-two flats, and connects 3-nets to Latin squares and finite groups. It also introduces the Orlik–Solomon and holonomy Lie algebras, resonance varieties, and Koszul modules, highlighting their topological interpretations for realizable matroids and open questions about non-realizable ones.

The passage reports that SPY performed poorly on the last trading day of each month from 1993 to July 2021. Holding from the previous close to that day’s close averaged a 0.06% loss, compared with a 0.04% average daily gain overall. Overnight returns averaged a 0.04% gain, while returns from the last day’s open to close averaged a 0.11% loss, with gains in 42% of cases.

The American Heart Association’s Go Red For Women campaign encourages women to take heart health seriously. Tiffany Gholston, born with a heart murmur and fitted with a pacemaker at 20, stays active, eats well and meditates. She also raises awareness and funds for research.

The speaker says the Stanley Cup Final is a race to four wins in which adrenaline outweighs fatigue. Although the team has not won a game yet, it has rebounded from setbacks before and has experienced players. The Sykora–Elias–Arnott line plays well together, but the speaker believes physical defense can contain it. The speaker also defends Joe’s play, saying his line creates offensive pressure despite his lack of goals.

Presenter Anna Ryder Richardson says the financial pressures and demanding work of running Manor House Wildlife Park in Wales contributed to the end of her marriage to Colin MacDougall. They bought the rundown zoo in 2008 and renovated it, but the workload, public attention and a 2010 accident at the park added to their difficulties. Anna plans to move with their daughters to a farmhouse near Bordeaux, while Colin will continue managing the zoo. She is also returning to television as a co-presenter of *60 Minute Makeover*.

The passage lists education and youth-related headlines, including plans to reopen a west Texas girls’ camp where 27 children and counselors died in July floods. Other headlines cover school integration, academic recovery, student achievements and education policy.

Hackers released unaired episodes of several HBO shows, including “Curb Your Enthusiasm,” but no new “Game of Thrones” material. HBO said it was not communicating with the hackers, who had sought a multimillion-dollar ransom.

The passage highlights the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and a 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It also describes cell phone protection and compares offers from Capital One Quicksilver and Citi Double Cash. Approval is not guaranteed, and Motley Fool Money discloses that partner compensation may affect which offers appear, but not its product ratings.

Albert Einstein College of Medicine researchers found that heat and capsaicin activate temperature-sensitive receptors on appetite-suppressing neurons in the hypothalamus of mice. Exercise raised the mice’s body and brain temperatures and reduced their food intake by about half. The reduction did not occur in mice whose neurons lacked the receptors, suggesting that increased body temperature can signal the brain to curb eating.

The Texas Supreme Court denied Anna Black’s application for writ of error, leaving intact a judgment for the Department of Labor and Standards. It declined to endorse the appellate court’s distinction between late-identified documents and witnesses, and emphasized that good cause for admitting such evidence must be shown in the record.

Researchers propose using a global network of mobile phones and low-cost radio receivers to detect fast radio bursts from within the Milky Way. Simultaneous signals could be sent to a central system, where their timing and frequencies could help identify a burst and locate its source. The researchers estimate that a Galactic burst may occur once every 30 to 1,500 years, though a repeating source could be active now.

McLaren says it has addressed the reliability problems that disrupted pre-season testing and heads to the Australian Grand Prix confident its new car can improve. Fernando Alonso sees promise in the MCL33, though the team says its competitive position remains uncertain.

After eight years in the league, the speaker celebrates winning his first Stanley Cup and thanks his teammates, including Larry Murphy, coach Scotty, and his family for their support. He says he feels healthy and motivated to keep playing. He also hopes to bring the Cup to Moscow to encourage interest and investment in Russian hockey.
On October 26, 2017, Microsoft filed a Form 8-K announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2017. Its press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage describes systems and methods for evaluating and adapting radiotherapy plans using imaging data acquired immediately before or during treatment. PET and other imaging modalities can provide biological, physiological, and anatomical measurements that are compared with approved ranges, plan quality indices, or bounded dose-volume histograms. If a plan no longer meets treatment criteria, the system may notify clinicians, recommend changes, or adjust radiation dose, target geometry, or treatment scheduling. Adaptation may occur before, during, or between treatment sessions.

Early forecasts leave uncertain whether clouds will obscure Monday’s partial solar eclipse in Philadelphia. The National Weather Service says forecasts should be more reliable by Friday. Philadelphia is outside the path of totality; the nearest state in that path is South Carolina.

On March 22, 2016, NVIDIA entered into a $500 million accelerated share repurchase agreement with Barclays, initially receiving 12,108,715 shares. The agreement is part of NVIDIA’s plan to return $1 billion to shareholders through dividends and repurchases during the fiscal year. Final settlement may involve additional shares or a cash payment, depending on NVIDIA’s share price.

The passage lists English-language reports by governments participating in the 1945 San Francisco Conference and describes a compilation tracing the United States’ role in developing the UN Charter. It follows US policy recommendations through early May, then documents the Conference’s policy development, negotiations, debates, and drafting until the Charter’s signing on June 26. Emphasizing informal discussions and how agreements were reached, the compilation draws on delegation and major-power meeting notes, correspondence, reports, and other records. Some meeting notes were not approved verbatim minutes, and indicated omissions were made to save space.

Intel is in early talks to manufacture chips for AMD, according to Semafor. The potential deal would be a significant customer win for Intel’s foundry business, though the amount of manufacturing is unclear. Intel shares rose 7% Wednesday, while AMD shares gained over 1%. Intel declined to comment, and AMD called the report rumor or speculation.
Microsoft’s July 18, 2019 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2019. The release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The May 18 articles report that Saudi Arabia selected eight international companies for three natural-gas projects requiring about $25 billion in investment. Exxon Mobil, Shell, BP and Phillips were chosen for South Ghawar; Exxon will lead a Red Sea project involving Enron and Occidental; and Shell, TotalFinaElf and Conoco were chosen for Shaybah. Leaders for South Ghawar and Shaybah had not been named. Other articles report falling western U.S. forward-power prices after California signed $43 billion in long-term contracts, and increased options selling amid expectations of a flat stock market.

Steven Kean said Enron’s role in defending the Export-Import Bank was smaller than a Wall Street Journal article suggested. John Hardy said Enron was not leading the lobbying effort but needed Ex-Im and OPIC support for projects. Kean said budget cuts had reduced the effort, though project-finance work remained. The forwarded news roundup also covered Dutch gas trading, California power deals and utility debts, Sierra Pacific’s proposed purchase of an Enron utility, and falling U.S. natural gas prices.
Huddersfield Giants followed a pre-season win at Warrington with a 28-16 season-opening victory at Widnes. Coach Rick Stone wants further improvement ahead of their home game against Salford.

The Stack Offense places players in two stacks near the free throw line, keeping the ball with three ballhandlers while two post players screen. Ballhandlers penetrate to a wing, where a teammate pops out for a pass. They may drive when the basket is unprotected; post players can roll for passes or layups. Overplayed receivers back cut, while a post player can step out to relieve pressure before the stacks reset.

A video in which sixth-grader Keaton Jones described being bullied at Horace Maynard Middle School went viral and drew public and celebrity support. Principal Greg Clay said he had not known of repeated bullying, but the incident Jones described had been resolved and action taken with the other children involved. The school planned an assembly on bullying and a separate talk in January.

A secret-shopper telephone survey of 335 New York City pharmacies assessed whether pharmacists would fill hypothetical, electronically prescribed, nameless expedited partner therapy (EPT) prescriptions. Forty percent reported awareness of EPT, and about 30% were willing to dispense a nameless prescription. Among potentially fillable prescriptions, 46% followed New York State guidelines. EPT awareness was higher at national chains and in more socioeconomically vulnerable neighborhoods, but neither neighborhood vulnerability nor chlamydia incidence was associated with willingness to dispense nameless EPT. The authors call for pharmacist education and improvements to prescribing practices, while noting that hypothetical phone inquiries may not reflect actual dispensing.

The coach said the team shortens third-period shifts so players return to the bench with energy left. Lineup options remain open, though Sydor’s physical play may favor him. Hull is doubtful for the next game because playing could worsen his injury; Hogue is progressing and may be evaluated after the pregame warmup. The coach said specific injury details are withheld to protect players, while the team tries to be clear about who is available.

The team uses its shutdown pair against whichever opposing offensive players are most effective and wants to keep Peca away from its net. Players discussed their failure to make enough physical and mental sacrifices in a previous loss to Colorado and want a stronger effort. The coach also described a compromise with Hull: he retains offensive freedom with the puck but must follow the team’s approach without it.

The passage describes a hardware-aware machine learning model swapping system. It monitors model performance and changing hardware, environmental, and network conditions, then searches a pool of subnets derived from a larger model. A replacement must meet performance and system constraints; among suitable candidates, the system selects the one with the lowest data-transfer cost by favoring overlap with the deployed model’s parameters. This approach aims to reduce memory writes, energy use, and communication overhead while adapting inference to changing conditions. The passage also describes configuration options, performance metrics, example applications, and possible hardware implementations.

Skinimalism simplifies skincare by using a few well-chosen products suited to the skin’s needs instead of layering many ingredients. Dr Hazel Parkinson says this approach can help protect the skin barrier, reduce irritation, and cut waste and costs. Most people can benefit from a balanced routine, but conditions such as acne, rosacea and hyperpigmentation may still require targeted treatments. She advises adjusting products to individual needs and removing one or two steps at a time when switching routines.

In a six-month study of one man with epilepsy, smartphone touchscreen interactions became faster when anti-seizure medication was tapered and slowed again after it was restarted. Interactions also slowed on the day of a convulsive seizure compared with the preceding three days. The authors suggest touchscreen data may help track medication- and seizure-related behavioural changes, but say cohort studies are needed to assess whether the findings generalise.

A University of Connecticut study found that nicotine-based e-cigarette vapor caused DNA damage comparable to smoke from unfiltered cigarettes in a 3D-printed screening device. Potential damage increased with the number of puffs and varied with vapor intake and additives. The researchers are planning further toxicity-screening work.

Wide receivers are increasingly valued as offenses rely more on passing; six were selected in the first 20 picks of the 2022 NFL draft. Their primary job is to get open and catch passes, which requires route-running, coordination, speed, reliable hands, and a strong connection with the quarterback. They also block on running plays. Receivers vary in size and build, but effective ones consistently beat defenders and can force defenses to adjust their coverage. The passage names Jerry Rice, Randy Moss, and Steve Largent as notable receivers.

Microsoft reported revenue of $29.1 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2018, up 19% from a year earlier. Net income rose 34% to $8.8 billion, and diluted earnings per share increased to $1.14. Revenue grew in all three segments, led by 24% growth in Intelligent Cloud; commercial cloud revenue rose 47% to $8.5 billion. Operating cash flow was $13.7 billion, and cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $135.9 billion. Microsoft’s effective tax rate fell from 18% to 14%. Its planned $7.5 billion acquisition of GitHub was expected to close by the end of October 2018.

PerovSegNet is a YOLOv8-based model for segmenting perovskite, lead iodide, and defects in scanning electron microscopy images. Its two modules improve multi-scale feature extraction and preserve fine details during downsampling. Trained on PerovData, a dataset of 10,994 images augmented from 40 manually labeled samples, it achieved 87.3% mAP@0.5 and 80.0% mAP@0.5:0.95, outperforming the compared models. It also produces measurements of material areas and counts. An analysis of published studies found correlations between these measurements and solar-cell efficiency, but the authors caution that the correlations do not establish causality.

The passage describes backtesting a monthly momentum strategy in Python using sector ETFs. It uses adjusted historical prices, ranks ETFs by their past nine-month performance, and holds the top three in an equally weighted portfolio. The strategy compounded at 9.89% annually, compared with 9.46% for SPY, producing little additional return under these rules.
