Market Basket, a New England supermarket chain, combined low prices and high sales volume with customer service, employee profit sharing, bonuses, internal promotion, and close supplier relationships. By 2014, it had 71 stores, 25,000 employees, and $4.6 billion in revenue.

A longstanding dispute between branches of the Demoulas family led the board to fire CEO Arthur T. Demoulas in June 2014. Employees feared that his departure would threaten the company’s business model. Headquarters, warehouse, and delivery workers walked out, while store employees, customers, and vendors joined a six-week protest demanding his reinstatement. Sales fell sharply, and suppliers and nearby businesses suffered losses.

In August, Arthur T. and his family agreed to buy the rival family’s 50.5% stake for $1.6 billion, and he returned with his management team. Operations recovered within weeks, but the purchase left the company with substantial debt and raised questions about its ability to maintain its prices, employee benefits, and growth.

The Evening Star is a three-candle bearish reversal pattern that forms during an upward price swing: a tall bullish candle, a small candle gapping above it, and a bearish candle closing below the first candle’s midpoint. Traders may confirm it with resistance levels, trendlines or indicators before taking short positions. The pattern can give false signals, so the passage emphasizes backtesting and risk management, including stop-loss orders. Choice of timeframe and indicators depends on the trader’s approach.

The passage argues that university English curricula should incorporate global issues to develop students’ communication skills and awareness of other cultures. In an 18-week study, 372 non-English majors at three Taiwanese universities discussed topics including climate change, health, culture and conflict. Survey responses showed that 95% considered globalization education important, 96% said the topics motivated English learning, and 79% supported including them in formal curricula. Students identified global warming, energy and environmental protection as especially important. The authors recommend selecting topics relevant to students’ fields and using discussion, media and other interactive activities.

Authorities say 92-year-old Anna Mae Blessing fatally shot her 72-year-old son at their Arizona home amid a dispute over his plan to move her to assisted living. His girlfriend disarmed Blessing after she pointed a gun at her. Blessing was arrested and charged with first-degree murder, aggravated assault and kidnapping.

The passage argues that business-derived practices in American public education—including bureaucracy, standardized testing and charter schools—have not produced broad academic gains. It also argues that diagnosing learning disabilities can reinforce stigma and fixed beliefs about students’ abilities, although diagnosis can help when paired with support and treatment.

The author presents problem-solving as central to learning: students develop and test explanations through interaction, feedback and reflection. The passage proposes restructuring education around this process. Teachers and mentors would help students identify problems, test solutions and assess progress toward their own goals; administrators would use a similar approach to address barriers beyond the classroom. The proposed aim is to help all students become self-directed learners.

Minister Richard Bruton said 12 autism units are expected in Sligo, Leitrim and Donegal during the 2018/19 school year: five primary and seven post-primary classes. Leitrim’s ASD special classes have increased from two to five since 2011. Placement requires a professional report, and oversubscribed schools must use fair, non-discriminatory selection policies. The NCSE advises parents to apply early.

The passage argues that damages for unjustified detention of a whaling vessel may include lost catch, while noting that the Costa Rica Packet’s mate could have taken command and continued whaling. Cited collision cases hold that owners may recover for a vessel’s lost use during repairs, measured by market hire when available or by evidence of expected earnings otherwise. The passage says this approach was applied to whaling ships forced to abandon voyages after capture by the Confederate cruiser Shenandoah.

The study examined chemical polishing of CZT and CZTS crystals with selenium contents from 0 to 0.1 using a 5% bromine–methanol solution. Average etching rates over eight minutes fell from 24 μm/min without selenium to 18, 15 and 13 μm/min as selenium content increased. The authors attribute the decrease to strengthening of the crystal structure and report agreement with their thermodynamic model at low selenium concentration. Etching also depended on initial surface condition and solution movement: stirring increased the rate, while prolonged etching could worsen surface roughness. The findings are intended to guide processing of CZTS detector elements.

Hartman argues that INF deployment, originally intended to reassure Europeans, has become divisive and unlikely, and urges an arms control agreement with the Soviets instead. The author rejects this assessment, arguing that deployment is now a test of NATO’s viability. He recommends retaining the zero-zero option, deploying as scheduled unless the Soviets substantially change their position, and considering asymmetrical reductions only after such a change.

In a separate meeting, the Secretary and Dobrynin agreed to meet regularly on U.S.-Soviet issues and discussed a possible foreign ministers’ meeting and a summit that would produce concrete results. Dobrynin argued that foreign ministers should resolve major arms control problems that negotiators could not.

Crystal Palace host Newcastle at Selhurst Park on Sunday. Both managers are dissatisfied with their transfer-window business. Palace have lost Bakary Sako to a broken ankle, while Newcastle’s new signing Islam Slimani is doubtful with a thigh injury.

Massey University Press launched the second edition of *The New Zealand Land and Food Annual* at National Field Days. Edited by Professor Claire Massey, it features 31 contributors discussing sustainable food production. The book highlights environmental impacts, concerns about current farming practices, and the challenge of growing New Zealand’s $33 billion land and food sector within planetary boundaries.

The passage outlines a statistical analysis plan for a trial comparing treatment groups. It specifies summaries and plots of drug and plasma glucose concentrations, with plasma glucose response measured as area under the effect curve above baseline from 0 to 30 minutes. Safety analyses cover treatment exposure, rescue glucose, injection-site reactions, adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings, and immunogenicity. It also defines handling of missing adverse-event information and describes planned tables, figures, listings, data calculations, and SAS programming quality-control checks. The plan adds sensitivity and supportive analyses for the primary efficacy parameter and revises terminology for secondary efficacy variables.

Vanuatu’s Reserve Bank may investigate AFIC, a savings and loan scheme promising 50% interest, amid questions about its finances. Ambae’s volcanic alert is being lowered from level 4 to 3 as eruptions remain stable. Relief supplies have been collected for evacuees. New teacher salary scales begin in 2018, and 21 retired teachers received medals.

Sixteen Miami Valley seniors graduated from a Book of Mormon seminary course May 20 at a Latter-day Saints church in Huber Heights. More than 100 students attended with their families. The program is open to high school students, and 11 local volunteers taught this year’s classes.

Small-body reservoirs are potential sources of exocomets. The Solar System contains diverse reservoirs, from asteroids to trans-Neptunian objects and the Oort cloud, whose orbits and compositions provide evidence about planetesimal formation and later evolution. Around young stars, dust grows in protoplanetary discs, while concentrated pebbles may collapse gravitationally into planetesimals; important details of this process remain uncertain. Stellar mass, disc temperatures, snowlines, chemical evolution and the birth-cluster environment influence where planetesimals form and what they contain.

After disc gas disperses, remnant solids form debris discs that can supply exocomets. Collisions gradually deplete these discs, and planetary interactions can alter small-body orbits. Exocomets are most often detected around A-type stars, but small-body reservoirs are likely around stars of many masses. Solar System observations help test formation models, although interpreting present-day bodies requires accounting for their subsequent evolution. Major unresolved questions include the masses and origins of debris discs, the dominant sources of exocomets, and the formation and composition of Oort-cloud analogues.

Amazon’s 2019 Form 10-K describes its North America, International, and AWS segments, which serve consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, and content creators. Net sales rose from $232.9 billion in 2018 to $280.5 billion in 2019; net income rose from $10.1 billion to $11.6 billion. Operating cash flow increased from $30.7 billion to $38.5 billion. The report identifies risks including intense competition, international regulation, fulfillment and inventory challenges, security breaches, litigation, and tax liabilities. Amazon employed approximately 798,000 full-time and part-time people at year-end 2019.

State Department circulars clarify that passport applicants need not promise to return to the United States within two years, though passports should not be issued to those who do not intend to return. Passports are valid for two years and may be renewed upon a satisfactory application. During a mission head’s absence, the first secretary ordinarily takes temporary charge; placing a second or third secretary in charge requires prior consultation with the Department. An executive order prohibits diplomatic and consular officers from attacking or publicly criticizing one another, allowing charges only in communications to the Department.

The passage describes a push-pull converter design using TPS7H500x-SP controllers. Selected values include a 49.9-kΩ leading-edge blanking resistor, 33-nF soft-start capacitor for approximately 7.5 ms, 2.5 transformer turns ratio, 40-µH primary inductance, 0.47-µH output inductor, and approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance. The design targets a 35% maximum duty cycle and begins cycle-by-cycle current limiting at roughly 35 A. It uses 170-V primary and 80-V synchronous-rectifier GaN FETs, Type 2A compensation with a 10-kHz target crossover frequency, and a 102-kΩ slope-compensation resistor.

The controllers operate from a 4–14 V supply. Layout guidance emphasizes separating sensitive signals from switching noise, minimizing switching loops, separating analog and power grounds, and placing bypass components close to the controller. The passage also includes documentation, revision, packaging, and disclaimer information.

Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen disputed President Trump’s claims that Dodd-Frank had stifled bank lending or weakened US banks, citing healthy lending and stronger bank capital. She supported easing burdens on community banks rather than repealing the law. Yellen also urged sustainable fiscal policies and warned that delaying interest-rate increases could require faster rises later.

Anthology is restructuring after its acquisition-driven expansion left it with more than $1 billion in debt and difficult-to-manage products. Its revenue fell by $80 million over two years, while rising interest rates increased pressure. Investors are providing $50 million as the company focuses on Blackboard and sells other businesses, with Encoura and Ellucian lined up as initial bidders. Analysts say expected cross-selling between Anthology’s software products did not materialize. The breakup is not expected to disrupt customers and reflects a broader shift toward more sustainable, modular education technology.

DAWN-PLASMA is a randomized, open-label phase 2 multicenter trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of convalescent plasma plus standard care versus standard care alone in hospitalized adults with COVID-19. Its outcomes follow a WHO trial template to support data pooling.

Germany’s education system is largely governed by its federal states and offers several secondary school tracks. Special schools for students with disabilities developed alongside mainstream schools, and efforts to expand inclusion have grown, though many students still attend specialized schools. The passage reports that 33.6% of children with disabilities are included in elementary schools and 14.9% in secondary schools. Teachers complete university study and supervised in-school training; special education preparation places greater emphasis on pedagogy and behavior management. Continuing challenges include uneven inclusion, limited funding and accessibility, teachers’ attitudes, and the difficulty of providing inclusive education within an ability-based secondary system.

During talks in Warsaw, German Chancellor Angela Merkel said she hoped Poland and the EU would resolve their dispute over Poland’s judicial changes, which could lead to sanctions. Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki said an agreement required understanding on both sides. The leaders called for European unity and discussed a response to the poisoning of a former Russian spy and his daughter in Britain.

The passage describes methods for forming transistors, including FinFETs, with replacement metal gates and contact plugs. At least one of the gate electrode, source/drain contact plug, or gate contact plug contains cobalt or metal silicide on a metal nitride barrier layer. The passage states that these materials adhere well to titanium nitride and can reduce resistivity and corrosion compared with tungsten, improving transistor performance at small dimensions.

The Education Department confirmed that employees will be affected by federal layoffs during the government shutdown, but did not say how many or which offices. Sources said the Office of Federal Student Aid would be spared, while other offices could face cuts. A senior department leader said the Office of Management and Budget directed the layoffs. The department faced an earlier round of layoffs in March, and the latest cuts have already been challenged in court. A union leader pledged to fight them. The Department of Health and Human Services also confirmed layoffs across multiple divisions.

OpenAI’s invite-only iOS app Sora uses Sora 2 to generate short videos with sound and a TikTok-like feed. Users can create digital likenesses, choose who may use them in videos, and view clips made with their likeness. WIRED’s tests found that some videos looked and sounded convincing despite errors. OpenAI says it has safeguards against misuse and harmful content, but testing found inconsistent restrictions, including on some copyrighted characters.

The passage describes embodiments of an off-road utility vehicle with a frame, side-by-side seating, a cargo box, and front and rear suspension systems. A central feature is a rear left A-arm whose pivot axis lies to the right of the vehicle’s longitudinal centerline. It also details options for the drivetrain, brakes, steering, roll-over protection structure, fuel and cooling systems, and body panels. In some embodiments, passenger seat bases can be removed and stowed behind the seat backs.

In four experiments in the US and India, mothers were more likely to choose daughters and fathers sons when allocating a prize or entering a school-supply raffle. Researchers suggested that parents may identify more strongly with children of the same sex. More than 90 percent of participants said they did not favor one child over another.

The speaker emphasizes the urgency of winning tomorrow and appreciates the support of Colorado fans. He recalls discussing playing with Ray during the Olympics and says Ray’s trade to the Avalanche brought leadership, raised expectations and set an example through hard work and unselfishness.

Several universities are testing MicroMasters programs that offer online coursework at a lower cost than a full master’s degree. MIT’s supply chain management MicroMasters certification costs $1,350, compared with $67,938 for a year of its master’s program. Students seeking the full degree must also gain admission and complete a semester on campus at full cost. Some employers recognize the courses, while MIT uses students’ online performance to help assess applicants for its blended program.

The passage describes TMS320DM814x device resources and pin configuration. Its 128 hardware spinlocks support synchronization, while a mailbox uses message queues and interrupts for processor communication. It outlines unified memory maps, including extended TILER addressing, and documents peripheral pin functions, multiplexing, pull resistors, and power requirements. Boot configuration is sampled from BTMODE pins at reset; the selected boot modes are attempted in order until one succeeds. PINCNTL registers control pin multiplexing, and unused inputs should be kept from floating.

NVIDIA RTX Blackwell builds on earlier AI technologies to improve graphics and support neural rendering and shading. NVIDIA says its DLSS technologies boost frame rates and reduce rendering costs. Blackwell’s generative AI capabilities are intended to help developers create game content and help designers explore options. The architecture honors mathematician and statistician David H. Blackwell.

The coach said goaltending did not cause the team’s losses and that Kris Letang will not return for the series. Archie was added for his energy and speed, while Carter Rowney has played strong minutes. The staff has adjusted line combinations to improve balance and secondary scoring, noting Phil’s chemistry with Geno. Although the team lost its last game, the coach considered it one of its strongest in the series, citing missed scoring chances and some preventable goals. He expects the team to learn from it and respond.

STAT’s personnel feature highlights enGene’s hiring of Hussein Sweiti as chief medical officer. He previously served as global medical head of oncology clinical development at Johnson & Johnson. STAT also invites readers to submit personnel changes.

At Amazon’s May 30, 2018 annual meeting, shareholders elected nine directors, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the 2018 independent auditor, and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. They rejected proposals requiring an independent board chair and changing vote-counting practices for shareholder proposals.

PIM Capital specializes in structuring and administering funds for alternative investments and cross-border opportunities, particularly in emerging markets. It says tailored structures and local expertise help clients navigate regulatory differences, grey-listing and currency volatility. With offices in Sub-Saharan Africa, Mauritius and Guernsey, the firm serves clients ranging from emerging wealth businesses to large global asset managers and emphasizes long-term partnerships over standardized services.

Tom Davis developed the Boston zone offense, which gained national recognition while he coached Boston College. Players keep one position but switch sides, reducing the assignments they must learn. The offense begins with dribble penetration, emphasizes low-post scoring, and uses both overload and spreading tactics. Its five roles are a ballhandler, baseline runner, low post, outside shooter, and weakside rebounder. Ball reversal and baseline cuts create passing and shooting opportunities. The offense calls for accurate passing and post feeds, while using skip passes, cuts, and dribble penetration when defenders deny passes or pressure the perimeter.

Hawaiʻi is using charter schools to expand tuition-free preschool access as it works toward offering preschool to all 3- and 4-year-olds by 2032. Waikīkī Community Preschool became the state’s first private preschool to convert to a charter this year. It now serves 98 children at full capacity and can offer teachers public-school pay and benefits.

Advocates say charter funding could help retain educators and stabilize existing preschools, but the current $171,000 per classroom does not cover many programs’ costs. Waikīkī and another charter preschool expect budget shortfalls and are relying on fundraising. Licensing requirements also pose staffing challenges. The state plans additional preschool classrooms, though construction funding is limited to schools on government-owned land.
Foreign portfolio investors bid Rs 5,898 crore for Rs 3,360 crore in corporate bond investment limits. The cut-off bid rose to 15.25 basis points from eight in the previous auction.

The author says day trading can be profitable but is difficult and requires patience, preparation, discipline, and systematic work. Their trading from 2002 to May 2012 included strong years and a later slowdown; their best 1% of trading days accounted for 11% of total profits. They attribute more recent difficulties partly to changing markets and automated trading, which prompted them to test new strategies. The author warns that losses and psychological pressures can undermine traders and recommends trying swing trading before day trading.

Femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy measurements of Sm0.7Er0.3FeO3 show enhanced quasi-ferromagnetic magnon fluctuations and a lower magnon frequency where the free-energy potential softens during its spin reorientation transition. Picosecond random telegraph noise also appears near the transition. Applying a magnetic field suppresses fluctuations and increases the magnon frequency, consistent with a stiffer potential. Atomistic spin-noise and Monte Carlo simulations reproduce these trends.

The passage describes camera modules with a molded base formed integrally on a circuit board or on a circuit board and photosensitive element. The base has a sloped light window that provides a light path while reducing demolding friction, damage, and stray-light effects. It also provides mounting surfaces for camera components. The passage describes molds with trapezoidal or stepped light-window-forming blocks, manufacturing methods, and assembly arrays intended for large-scale production.

Hawaii’s reciprocity treaty with the United States was signed in 1875 and took effect in 1876. Britain and Germany raised claims under favored-nation provisions in earlier treaties with Hawaii, but Hawaii ultimately affirmed that the United States held exclusive privileges under the reciprocity treaty. Subsequent disputes over its interpretation were settled diplomatically, while a domestic scandal caused rapid ministerial changes. The United States was also asked to assist with liquor enforcement in the Ralik Islands and negotiations between Hawaii and Japan. In 1881, the U.S. minister reported that Britain continued to press its claim.

The speaker celebrates a difficult back-to-back win with returning teammates, family and friends. He praises the group’s willingness to do whatever was needed, especially defensemen who stepped up when a key player was lost. He also credits Geno, both goaltenders and Guentz for their playoff contributions, and says it was special to pass the trophy to a longtime player who had never played a playoff game.

David Hardt presents a framework for understanding and controlling manufacturing processes through the energy exchanged between equipment and material. Geometry can change through removal, addition, deformation, or formation, using mechanical, electrical, thermal, or chemical energy. In serial processes, a localized interaction moves across the material; in parallel processes, energy acts over a larger area at once. Serial processes are often more flexible, while parallel processes can achieve higher production rates.

To explain variation, Hardt distinguishes equipment and material properties from their transient states. Equipment states are often readily controlled, while material properties, material states, and equipment properties can introduce uncertainty. The lecture uses machining, molding, rolling, and other processes to show how these distinctions affect quality and control.

The lecture explains why neutral atoms attract despite having no permanent dipole moments. Quantum zero-point fluctuations create correlated dipoles, producing a short-range van der Waals potential proportional to 1/R⁶. At longer distances, electromagnetic propagation changes the potential to the Casimir–Polder form, proportional to 1/R⁷. The transition occurs around the wavelength of an atomic resonance. Coupled LC circuits illustrate the role of zero-point energy, while fourth-order photon-exchange diagrams provide another description of both regimes.

A survey of 63 academic staff and administrators at Kuwait University examined their views on AI in education. Respondents showed moderate acceptance of AI, and most had no prior experience teaching with it. They identified potential uses in data analysis, personalized teaching and distance education, while citing a lack of suitable teaching materials and expertise as major challenges. The study recommends addressing these challenges before expanding AI’s role in education and notes that it did not include students’ perspectives.

The passage describes a tendency for markets to rebound after a weak Monday. One Turnaround Tuesday strategy buys when Monday closes at least 1% below Friday’s close and sells at Tuesday’s close. The cited backtests found buying on weak Mondays profitable, while buying after strong Mondays performed poorly. The passage notes that its closing-price backtests use prices unavailable until after the fact.
Sears borrowed $100 million from affiliates of CEO Eddie Lampert’s hedge fund, with up to $100 million more available. Amid falling sales, it plans to close more than 300 stores in 2017.

The lecture introduces risk preferences through expected utility, which evaluates uncertain choices by weighting the utility of final outcomes by their probabilities. In this model, diminishing marginal utility of wealth makes people risk averse. People often reduce risk through insurance but may accept risk for higher expected returns or through gambling. Risk aversion can be measured using certainty equivalents, gamble choices, or insurance choices. The lecture highlights a limitation: rejecting small gambles can imply implausibly extreme aversion to large gambles under expected utility. It closes by introducing a study that uses homeowners’ deductible choices to estimate risk aversion.

R. L. Wells was convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to two years in prison. The court dismissed his appeal because his appeal bond was approved by a different judge, rather than the judge who tried the case, as required by law.

CSUSB student veterans describe education benefits available during and after military service. Active-duty tuition assistance pays up to $4,500 annually, though training can interrupt coursework. Eligible service members and veterans may receive up to four years of Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, including full tuition at public schools. The Montgomery GI Bill provides payments based on course load, but students pay their own education expenses. Veterans generally have 10–15 years after leaving service to use GI Bill benefits and can resume them after a break from school.

Democrats say they will not support a Republican spending bill unless it extends enhanced Obamacare tax credits set to expire at the end of 2025. Republicans want to address the credits after a funding resolution passes. Trump is set to meet with congressional leaders Monday ahead of a potential government shutdown early Wednesday.

H&M said March sales rose 6 percent in local currencies, below its preliminary estimate, adding to doubts about its 10–15 percent full-year growth target. The retailer faces intense competition and has continued opening stores despite weak sales. It is investing in a more flexible supply chain and expanding higher-priced brands. Its shares have fallen about 26 percent over the past year.

In *Shircliff v. The State*, the court upheld an indictment alleging a conspiracy to bribe a township trustee to hire a teacher, ruling that it need not allege a school vacancy. It declined to review challenges involving a continuance and evidence because the bill of exceptions was not part of the record. Shircliff’s objection to a co-defendant’s discharge to testify came too late because it had not been raised below. The court presumed that the special judge who entered judgment was properly appointed. Finding no reversible error, it affirmed the judgment.

Background and policy memoranda for Roosevelt and the American delegation at the Malta and Yalta Conferences were completed on January 16, 1945, and presented to the President as the “Yalta Briefing Book.” In a later conversation, Leo Pasvolsky and the Soviet Ambassador reviewed the Dumbarton Oaks proposals, including Security Council voting and regional dispute settlement. The Ambassador considered the proposed court substantially settled and said Moscow was studying its details. They also discussed dependent areas, colonial administration, international trusteeship, and possible forums for further discussion. Pasvolsky said trusteeship belonged on the United Nations Conference agenda, while broader colonial questions might be addressed separately.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2022 Form 10-K describes three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Its products and services span software, cloud computing, devices, gaming, advertising, and business applications. The company emphasizes investment in AI, security, hybrid work, and cloud infrastructure. It completed its acquisition of Nuance in March 2022 and announced plans to acquire Activision Blizzard in January 2022. Microsoft employed approximately 221,000 people as of June 30, 2022. The filing also outlines sustainability and racial equity commitments and warns that intense competition and the shift toward cloud-based services pose risks.

In Leslie B. Canion v. United States, the court accepted the parties’ stipulation concerning glassware, furniture, and smoker’s articles exported from France. It held that foreign value was the proper valuation basis: invoice unit values plus 12.44% and packing costs for invoiced merchandise, and 337 French francs per box plus 12.44% and packing for 40 excess boxes of item 21008.

Connor McDavid signed a two-year, $25 million extension with the Edmonton Oilers, and defenseman Jake Walman signed a seven-year, $49 million extension. McDavid, 28, has 1,082 career points and has led Edmonton to two consecutive Stanley Cup Finals.

The U.S. is providing more than $55,000 to preserve 3,000–5,000 belongings of prisoners held at Cambodia’s Tuol Sleng prison under the Khmer Rouge. The items are deteriorating; officials say preservation will protect evidence of victims’ experiences and help educate young Cambodians. Some will be displayed at the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum.

NVIDIA reported first-quarter fiscal 2019 revenue of $3.21 billion, up 66% year over year, and net income of $1.24 billion, up 145%. Diluted earnings were $1.98 per share, and gross margin rose to 64.5%. GPU revenue reached $2.77 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue was $442 million. Operating cash flow was $1.45 billion. At April 29, 2018, cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $7.30 billion. NVIDIA repurchased $655 million of shares and paid $91 million in dividends during the quarter.

Amazon reported first-quarter 2016 net sales of $29.1 billion, up 28% from a year earlier. Operating income rose to $1.1 billion from $255 million, and net income was $513 million, compared with a $57 million loss. North America sales were $17.0 billion, International sales were $9.6 billion, and AWS sales were $2.6 billion. AWS operating income rose to $604 million, while International recorded a $121 million operating loss. Operating activities used $2.2 billion in cash during the quarter. At March 31, cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $15.9 billion. The filing also describes ongoing legal and tax disputes.

U.S. plans for dependent areas aimed to advance self-government, economic and social standards, security, and nondiscriminatory treatment. A 1943 draft proposed trusteeship for mandated or detached territories and a timetable for colonial independence. After British objections and further revisions, trusteeship was omitted from the Dumbarton Oaks discussions to avoid difficult territorial questions, with consideration deferred. In a separate letter, Leo Pasvolsky welcomed British acceptance of the President’s proposal on Security Council voting. Secretary of War Stimson urged the major powers to reach an understanding on fundamental issues before a general meeting and warned that wartime territorial or trusteeship discussions could provoke disputes and jeopardize the war effort.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its approach to hybrid rendering, which combines rasterization, real-time ray tracing and AI. RT Cores accelerate bounding-volume hierarchy traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests; denoising reduces the rays needed to produce usable images. The passage presents applications in shadows, ambient occlusion and reflections, and states that Turing ray tracing is about ten times faster than software ray tracing on Pascal GPUs.

It also describes NGX features accelerated by Tensor Cores, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow-motion video and image upscaling. Other Turing features include mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading and multi-view rendering, with uses in complex scenes and VR. The passage outlines TU104 and TU106 configurations, proposes RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric, and closes with product specifications and NVIDIA’s legal notices.

Apple reported first-quarter fiscal 2016 net sales of $75.9 billion, up 2% year over year, and net income of $18.4 billion, up from $18.0 billion. Diluted earnings per share rose to $3.28 from $3.06. Services sales increased 26% and Other Products sales 62%, while iPad sales fell 21%. Greater China sales rose 14%; Americas sales fell 4%.

Operating cash flow was $27.5 billion, compared with $33.7 billion a year earlier. At December 26, 2015, Apple held $215.7 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. During the quarter, it spent $6.9 billion repurchasing shares and $3.0 billion on dividends and dividend equivalents.

The President informs Congress that Georgia surveyors have entered Creek territory protected by a treaty and federal law. He has ordered federal officials to prosecute the surveyors through civil courts and instructed the U.S. agent to assure the Creeks of protection while urging them to avoid hostilities. He has withheld military force to avert a clash with Georgia, whose authorities authorized the surveys. If the encroachments continue and other legal measures fail, he says he will enforce federal law with the force available to him. He asks Congress to consider whether further legislation is needed.

AT&T plans to activate its nationwide LTE-M network by the end of June to connect Internet of Things devices. Designed for small data transmissions, LTE-M uses less energy than standard LTE and can reach farther into buildings. PepsiCo demonstrated connected soda fountains that track drink preferences; RM2 showed pallets that can be tracked during transport; and Capstone Metering showed water meters that can detect problems such as leaks. AT&T said the devices should have little effect on other network users. It has not announced pricing for companies connecting devices.

The Rock Springs City Council will hold a public hearing May 1 at 7 p.m. at City Hall on proposed rules allowing downtown restaurants to add outdoor dining decks. The decks would require approval, operate seasonally from May through October, and meet sidewalk, safety and maintenance requirements.

The speaker expects the Detroit Red Wings to prepare better and says making the most of limited power-play chances is important. He describes another player as more confident and comfortable than when they played together in Magnitogorsk. He also discusses recovering from a long injury, the frustration of watching his team lose, and changes that improved its playoff chances. Facing the team that beat them last year adds to what he calls a highly competitive series.

Tesla introduced lower-priced versions of its Model Y SUV and Model 3 sedan, starting just under $40,000 and around $37,000, respectively. The standard Model Y costs about $5,000 less than the previous entry-level version, omits several higher-end features and has an estimated 321-mile range. The launches come amid slumping auto sales, increased competition and the end of federal EV tax credits. Tesla shares fell about 3% Tuesday after rising 5% Monday amid anticipation of the announcement.

The passage surveys patterns for container-based distributed systems. An **ambassador** container brokers an application’s external connections, including routing to sharded storage, discovering services and splitting experimental traffic. An **adapter** container converts an application’s monitoring, logging or health-check interface into a common format without modifying the application.

Multi-node systems can use microservices to separate teams, releases and scaling, though their distributed nature complicates design and debugging. Replicated, load-balanced services improve availability and capacity; readiness probes identify instances able to serve requests. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate layers.

Sharded services divide data among machines. Cache design must account for failures, hit rates and routing; replicated shards improve resilience, while carefully chosen shard keys and consistent hashing reduce disruption when shards change. The **scatter/gather** pattern distributes parts of a request across nodes and combines their results, but overhead and slow or failed nodes limit its benefits. Finally, function-as-a-service simplifies deployment and automatic scaling for event-driven code, while posing monitoring challenges and fitting poorly with long-running processing or substantial in-memory state.

Pakistan has halted work on three CPEC road projects after China stopped funding them. A parliamentary committee said the projects had not been abandoned and would resume once China approved a revised financial mechanism. The funding halt followed Pakistan’s rejection of Chinese terms for a dam project and its refusal to allow yuan trading at Gwadar Port.

Tigers manager A.J. Hinch says Tarik Skubal will not pitch in Wednesday’s elimination Game 4 against the Mariners. Skubal, who allowed two runs over seven innings in Game 2, is preparing to start a potential Game 5. Detroit’s high-leverage relievers will be available for Game 4.

A retrospective study of 290 patients who underwent coronary artery bypass grafting from 2017 to 2021 examined postoperative complications and their association with shunt and internal thoracic artery use. Hydrothorax and arrhythmia were among the reported complications; five patients died. Older age was associated with more complications and longer hospital stays. Longer cardiopulmonary bypass and aortic cross-clamp times were also associated with more complications. Patients with preoperative progressive angina or post-myocardial infarction sclerosis had more complications. Neither the number of shunts nor the number of internal thoracic arteries used was significantly associated with the number of complications.

The passage advocates a gradual national inheritance tax that rises with the size of a gift or bequest, remains small for moderate inheritances, and may account for the recipient’s kinship. It cites earlier federal inheritance taxes and Supreme Court decisions upholding them. It also supports seeking a constitutional national income tax despite the Court’s 1894 ruling against one, and favors attempting legislation before considering a constitutional amendment.

Lego DC Super Villains has been announced with a trailer. Players can create a villain and work with DC villains to save a city in a parallel universe without its superheroes. The game releases October 16, 2018, for PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch, with special editions offering bonus characters.

The speaker says Jarome has long been a top right winger and has improved by becoming the Flames’ leader rather than carrying the pressure to score. He discusses adjusting players’ minutes and defensive pairings, praises veteran and underrated players, and says the team improved after a poor first period. Looking ahead, he wants the team to focus on its own improvements rather than its opponents’ strengths. He dismisses rest and ice conditions as excuses and praises an experienced official’s rapport with players.

The speaker credits playoff success to confidence at home, resilience through adversity, and a team that grew together after roster changes. John played a key defensive role, especially when Joe went down. Injuries, travel and two seven-game series took a toll, making the Stanley Cup win especially satisfying. The speaker says a Mighty Ducks player deserved the Conn Smythe, acknowledges a previous missed opportunity, and hopes the team will keep winning, while saying it is too soon to call it a dynasty.

Coach Sutter said Kopitar’s two-way play, playmaking and heavy minutes have been important. He praised Justin’s tenacity and several players’ reliability and leadership. Sutter attributed the team’s continued playoff run to preparation and a complete team effort rather than star power, while noting that its young players still have more to learn. He said playing a first Stanley Cup Final game is a major adjustment and described both teams as fast.

Only two in five U.S. households report good or excellent progress toward their savings needs. America Saves Week, held February 27–March 4, 2017, promotes saving through daily themes, activities and resources.

The court affirmed a $100 judgment for Lewis Roberts in his false-imprisonment action against attorneys who had him arrested on an execution arising from a creditor’s suit against him as an assignee. The creditor’s suit sought an accounting and distribution of assigned assets, including amounts the assignees should have collected. It was not simply an action for money received in a fiduciary capacity under section 179 of the Code, so the execution against Roberts’s person was unauthorized.

Nvidia will continue sponsoring H-1B workers despite Trump’s new $100,000 fee for new applicants. Applying the fee to its 2025 approvals would cost an estimated $147.3 million, though current visa holders and renewals are exempt. CEO Jensen Huang called legal immigration essential but said the fee “probably sets the bar a little too high.”

This review protocol examines how serial PCR cycle threshold values and other measures of viral burden relate to infectious SARS-CoV-2 detected by viral culture in solid-organ and hematopoietic stem-cell transplant recipients. It will search studies published through December 2021 and include those reporting both respiratory-sample viral burden and culture results. Researchers will assess study quality and summarize findings narratively rather than pool data, because laboratory methods vary. The review will also consider whether patient characteristics, vaccination, symptoms and disease course affect viral burden or infectious-virus detection.

Reelected to office, the speaker thanks citizens for their confidence and pledges to merit it. He argues that coastal fortifications and a stronger navy can deter invasion while supporting peace. He favors continued neutrality in Spain’s conflict with its South American colonies, welcomes the treaty acquiring Florida, and reviews relations with Britain, France, and other powers. Although the United States has paid down substantial debt, falling revenue may require internal taxes if the shortfall persists. He urges Congress to provide land, education, and support for Indian tribes under a new policy. He closes by praising representative government, territorial expansion, and the country’s prospects.

In 2011, St. Olaf student Erik Brust began developing JonnyPops to honor a frozen-treat idea he had shared with his cousin Jonathan Jeffrey, who died before it became a business. Brust and classmate Connor Wray created fruit-and-cream pops with simple ingredients and began selling them around the Twin Cities in 2012. They expanded into food-service distribution, launched in Minnesota grocery stores in 2014, and now have 10,000 distribution points nationwide. Both founders were named to Forbes’ 2018 “30 Under 30” list. JonnyPops has introduced a customer-inspired Delights line and promotes acts of kindness through messages on its sticks while partnering with retailers to raise money for addiction treatment organizations.

Lincolnshire County Council has approved a new strategy to support young people leaving care. Its support includes help with university costs and driving licences, while some district councils offer council tax discounts for care leavers aged 18 to 21. The council’s leaving care services budget is about £1.2 million and currently supports 300 young people.

On October 6, analysts raised price targets for AdvanSix ($46), Deckers ($80), New Oriental Education ($100), Netflix ($215), Plug Power ($4), Constellation Brands ($235 and $226), 2U ($66) and Yum China ($45). They lowered targets for Ascena Retail Group ($2.50) and Rite Aid ($2.25). Analysts also issued targets for Covestro (€64), BASF (€96), Costco ($185), Evonik (€29), Inovio ($13), Linde (€175), Eli Lilly ($86), Lanxess (€65), Mallinckrodt ($70) and Wacker Chemie (€110).

A 245-million-year-old fossil from southwestern China contains a Dinocephalosaurus embryo, indicating that the long-necked, fish-eating marine reptile gave birth to live young. Researchers say it is the first known archosauromorph to do so. Evidence also suggests it determined its offspring’s sex genetically rather than through nest temperature.

The speaker mourns the murdered President and affirms that constitutional succession preserves the stability of government. He pledges to learn from his predecessor’s example and pursue his goals. Citing national prosperity, stable policies, and peaceful foreign relations, he sees no need for a special session of Congress. He accepts the presidency while acknowledging its responsibilities and seeking divine guidance and the people’s support.

Farmers State Bank sued Samuel J. Lydick on a $3,000 promissory note. Lydick alleged that fraudulent representations about stock had induced him to sign earlier notes and sought damages from the bank and its officer, Everett Martin. The jury found that the bank acquired the note in good faith, for value, before maturity and without notice of a defect, and ruled for Martin on the fraud claim. The court held that the remaining claim lacked sufficient evidence, found no error in the jury instructions, and affirmed the judgment.

PenFed Credit Union President and CEO James Schenck received Volunteer Alexandria’s Large Business Philanthropist of the Year award. He credited PenFed’s 2,500 employees and their “People Helping People” philosophy. PenFed and its foundation recently donated to organizations supporting wounded warriors, military families, veterans and veteran entrepreneurs. Since 2001, the foundation has provided more than $30 million in financial support to the military community. Schenck serves as the foundation’s CEO without compensation and volunteers with other organizations.

China has modernised its armed forces to support its global ambitions, protect regional and economic interests, and counter the US military presence in the Indo-Pacific. The passage says the PLA has become a more capable force since the late 1990s, while China has grown more willing to use it. How China will use its military power in the future remains uncertain.

Amazon Prime Day runs October 7–8, with early discounts already available. WIRED highlights deals on hand-tested products, including an iPad, MacBook Air, power banks, an Arlo security camera, and a Kindle Scribe. WIRED says its editors select products independently but it may receive compensation from retailers or purchases through its links.

Latin American stocks rebounded Monday as U.S.–North Korea tensions eased after officials played down the prospect of imminent war. Mexico’s main stock index rose about 1.1%, while Brazil’s Bovespa reached its highest level since May. Currency moves were subdued: the Mexican peso firmed ahead of NAFTA talks, and the Brazilian real fluctuated before an expected revision to government fiscal targets.

New sanctions on North Korea may further hinder trading in its defaulted debt, which has seen no trades at specialist firm Exotix for three to four years. The roughly $1 billion in loans has been in default since the 1980s and has never been restructured. Securities created from the debt rose briefly on hopes of economic opening after Kim Jong-un took power, but trading effectively froze after sanctions imposed in 2013. An expert estimates interest arrears at four to five times the outstanding principal.

Court documents say a Facebook argument involving Jennifer Bartell’s daughter led four people to Bartell’s Portsmouth home after a planned meeting failed to happen. A fight broke out, and Joshua Bowen allegedly shot Bartell on March 14. Bowen faces charges, while the other three are charged as accessories after the fact.

The passage describes a modular framework for AI-assisted X-ray diffraction and absorption spectroscopy experiments across multiple synchrotron beamlines. AI agents process data and suggest measurements, while human-controlled adjudicators screen requests and preserve researcher oversight. A live experiment mapped Al-Ni-Pt thin films on two beamlines, demonstrating real-time coordination but also revealing that early agent settings overconcentrated measurements in localized areas. A digital twin was then used to test mapping strategies. In simulated campaigns, AI-driven mapping resolved phase boundaries more effectively than geometric grids or random sampling, reaching 98.9% model accuracy after collecting 5% of possible measurements.

Let’s Grow Kids ended operations in October after a planned decade of advocacy for improved child care in Vermont. Its leaders say the deadline sharpened its focus, attracted funding and staff, and prompted it to build partnerships for work after its closure. The organization supported Act 76, Vermont’s 2023 law expanding child care access and tuition assistance. More than 100 child care programs have since opened, adding over 1,000 spaces. Permanent organizations and former staff will continue implementation and advocacy. Vermont’s system is not fully universal, and some families remain ineligible for subsidies.

Researchers used deep learning to identify dust devils in more than 50,000 images from European Mars orbiters, then tracked about 300 in stereo images. They found that dust devils and nearby winds can reach 160 km/h, faster than previously measured. The findings suggest winds may lift more dust into Mars’s atmosphere than thought and could improve climate models and planning for future landed missions.

A federal judge dismissed Spencer Elden’s lawsuit over Nirvana’s 1991 album cover, which depicts him naked underwater as a baby. The judge ruled that the image was not child pornography, finding that nudity alone did not make it sexually suggestive.

A Florida Museum study found that lice parasitizing primates and humans have maintained vitamin-producing bacterial partners for at least 20 to 25 million years. Researchers sequenced symbiont genomes from human, chimpanzee, gorilla and red colobus monkey lice. The small genomes show extensive remodeling, with much of their genetic material devoted to producing vitamins that lice cannot obtain from blood.

A study of 54 adults newly diagnosed with ADHD compared baseline resting-state brain scans with symptom changes measured about three years later. Lower connectivity between the nucleus accumbens and right paracingulate gyrus was associated with more severe symptoms at diagnosis; lower connectivity with the right anterior insula predicted greater improvement. Connectivity with the right posterior insula showed opposite relationships with improvement among patients who continued stimulants and those who discontinued them. The authors note the small sample and call for larger studies to test whether these patterns can help predict outcomes.

A state audit found that pricing errors on seven products led Utah’s alcohol department to overcharge business customers $1,161 and lose $186 on other sales. The department plans to refund the overcharges and has added a pricing check. Auditors also found a missed $4.6 million transfer to state programs, which the department corrected.

In 1793, a yellow fever epidemic killed about 5,000 people—more than 10 percent of Philadelphia’s population. Physicians did not yet know that mosquitoes transmitted the disease, and their treatments and quarantines failed. After the mosquito’s role was discovered, officials improved drainage, sanitation and public education. Brazil has faced its worst human yellow fever outbreak in decades, with at least 326 confirmed cases and 220 deaths reported since December 2016. An effective yellow fever vaccine is available, and researchers are using it to inform development of Zika vaccines.

QoCGM is an open-source MATLAB tool that preprocesses continuous glucose monitoring data and calculates metrics covering glucose control, risk, variability, and complexity. It can analyze daytime and nighttime patterns and day-to-day variation. In an example using first-week data from 324 people with insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, many metrics overlapped, while some captured distinct information. Daytime and nighttime time-in-range metrics also differed. Further research is needed to assess the clinical implications.

Gulf Island Fabrication faces weak offshore markets and operational problems, including vessel delays that contributed to a $24.3 million fourth-quarter loss. Its shares have fallen about 40%, leaving its market capitalization near $120 million. The author argues that the company trades at a substantial discount to book value, citing a proposed $55 million sale of its Texas South Yard and interest in another facility. The sales remain uncertain, as do potential new contracts and an equity raise. The author considers valuation, rather than an operating turnaround, the main reason the shares may be attractive.

Rachael Caplan, 29, has severe Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS), which causes constant pain and has left her largely bedridden in her parents’ home. Her symptoms began with a hip injury during law school, but she did not receive a diagnosis until about a year and a half later. A doctor and patient advocate say early diagnosis is crucial because treatment becomes less likely to reverse the disease as it progresses. Standard treatments have worsened Caplan’s symptoms, though she says green light therapy has eased pain in her head and helped her sleep. Her friends and family are using social media to raise awareness of CRPS. Caplan hopes her story leads to quicker diagnoses, better treatments and, ultimately, her own remission.

Dunkin’ Donuts will launch its fall menu Aug. 28, bringing back pumpkin products and adding maple pecan drinks, pumpkin cream cheese and a maple sugar bacon breakfast sandwich. The company says new and limited-time products have helped boost sales amid seven consecutive quarters of better-than-expected earnings.

The passage argues that postwar negotiations will hinge on access to raw materials, transport, markets and credit, which are needed for reconstruction and to avert unrest during demobilization. Allied control of overseas supplies gives them leverage over Germany, whose eastern ambitions depend on those resources. It describes two German approaches: Kühlmann’s group favors accommodation with Western powers, while the Fatherland Party favors military and naval force. Belgium is central to their dispute because control of it would offer commercial and strategic advantages, including limiting Britain’s ability to send an army to France.

Sarasota County sought review of a Department of Administration statement that a proposed crude oil splitter in Manatee County was not subject to development-of-regional-impact requirements. The appellate court denied the petition without deciding that question, holding that the county lacked standing to initiate the statutory process and that an unfavorable declaratory statement alone did not establish standing for judicial review. A concurring judge identified other avenues the county could pursue. The dissenting judge would have granted review, concluding that the Department had wrongly treated its list of presumed developments of regional impact as exhaustive.

ICICI Bank said its mortgage loan portfolio reached Rs 1.5 trillion, making it the largest private-sector player in the segment. The portfolio accounts for half its retail loans, and the bank aims to grow it to Rs 2 trillion by FY20. It is expanding digital approvals and loan-processing centres, with much of the growth coming from smaller towns.

A player was given a day off. The speaker said the team must improve its second periods after two games in Boston. Two players are playing better than their point totals suggest, but opposing goaltending and defense have limited them. The team will focus on executing its plan tomorrow and recognizes how physically demanding winning the trophy is.

A model fitted to vaccine-effectiveness data from England estimated how protection from three COVID-19 vaccines waned against Delta and Omicron. It found that higher immunity was needed to prevent mild disease than hospitalisation or death, and estimated a 6.5-fold reduction in vaccine-induced immunity against Omicron relative to Delta. Protection against Omicron declined over time after boosting. Using antibody data, the model predicted that a Moderna bivalent booster would provide more sustained protection than the original vaccine, particularly against hospitalisation. The authors caution that their projections may not apply where infection-induced immunity differs, and that missing immunological measurements and uncertainty about the causes of recorded hospitalisations limit the analysis.

Larry Connors’ R3 is a mean-reversion ETF strategy that enters when price is above its 200-day moving average and the two-day RSI meets specified decline and oversold conditions; it exits when RSI exceeds 70. A backtest across 25 ETFs from 2000 through December 2020 produced 992 trades, a 75% win rate, 6.47% annualized growth and a 16% maximum drawdown. The reported tests excluded commissions and slippage.

Nigeria’s financial-system liquidity remained negative last week amid central bank market operations and foreign-exchange sales. Short-term lending rates rose sharply, while treasury-bill yields climbed to 18.5% and domestic bond yields edged higher. This week, N62.4 billion in treasury bills is expected to mature and be rolled over, alongside an N168.1 billion open market operation maturity.

The naira held steady at the official and parallel-market rates and appreciated on the NAFEX market. The federal government approved a plan, subject to National Assembly approval, to issue dollar-backed treasury instruments with longer maturities to ease debt-repayment pressure and borrowing costs. It also approved a 2018–2020 fiscal framework. The Bankers’ Committee said the importers’ and exporters’ foreign-exchange window had attracted $4 billion since April.

A survey of 2,000 British adults found that respondents wake an average of three times a night, while one in 10 wake seven to 10 times. Reported disruptions include needing the toilet (47%), a partner’s snoring (41%), being crowded in bed (25%) and discomfort (19%). A psychologist said bedtime routines and the sleeping environment can affect whether people return to sleep after stirring.

Six Texas public university systems are reviewing courses, syllabi or programs after conservative politicians criticized a Texas A&M lesson on gender identity that was not mentioned in its course description. Officials cite legal compliance, though no current state or federal law prohibits public university professors from teaching about transgender identity. It remains unclear whether the reviews will lead to courses being changed or removed.

Faculty also face scrutiny through publicly accessible syllabi. Texas law requires public universities to publish certain syllabus details, and some institutions make them searchable through Simple Syllabus. A University of Houston lecturer said a conservative news site used the platform to identify his courses.
The Eighth Circuit denied Earl Ringo’s petitions for panel and en banc rehearing. Judge Bye would grant en banc rehearing.

Love in the Time of Chasmosaurs is a dinosaur-focused website featuring scientific reports, paleoart, and humorous reviews of books and other prehistoric-themed media. It also covers museum exhibits worldwide. Active since 2009, it posts nearly weekly and publishes monthly dinosaur-news roundups.

A non-peer-reviewed study examined glucose control two weeks after an mRNA COVID-19 booster in healthy, pre-diabetic and diabetic adults. Immune responses were similar across groups, but the authors reported worsened measures of glucose control and insulin resistance in pre-diabetic and diabetic participants. In mice, repeated vaccination impaired glucose tolerance and insulin signaling; metformin improved these measures without significantly changing measured immune responses. The experiments were not randomized or blinded.

Despite clear screening results and no symptoms, Olivia Munn was diagnosed with stage 1 breast cancer at 43 after a two-minute risk assessment showed a 37% lifetime risk and prompted further screening. The assessment also led to her mother’s diagnosis. Munn says the assessment should be standard care.

Hugh Jackman said he is undergoing treatment for basal cell carcinoma again, after at least four previous treatments. He said frequent body checks and doctors have helped, and urged fans to wear sunscreen. His upcoming films remain scheduled for release.

Comic book creator Stan Lee, 95, was hospitalized after experiencing shortness of breath and an irregular heartbeat at home. His condition remained stable, and he has been discharged, though he will return for monitoring. His representative said he is doing well.

New Progressive Conservative leader Doug Ford launched his election campaign at a crowded Toronto Congress Centre rally. Defeated leadership rivals Christine Elliott, Caroline Mulroney and Tanya Granic Allen attended, with Elliott embracing him onstage. Ford criticized Premier Kathleen Wynne and the Liberals over government spending and promised prosperity for all Ontarians. Party candidates expressed optimism about his message, while one volunteer warned the election would be difficult.

Valeant, J. Michael Pearson, Pershing Square and William Ackman entered a litigation management agreement concerning a California class action related to Allergan litigation. Valeant and Pershing Square will split the first $10 million in subsequent legal costs, and the parties exchanged mutual releases of claims.

Severe storms spawned at least three confirmed tornadoes in northern Alabama on Monday night, damaging homes and Jacksonville State University, downing trees and causing power outages. Limestone County reported no injuries. Forecasters warned that more than 29 million people across the Southeast could face powerful tornadoes, damaging winds and large hail as the storms moved east. Tornado warnings remained in parts of Alabama and Tennessee, while northern Georgia was under a tornado watch. Schools closed early, and the University of Alabama suspended evening operations.

In a study of 101 cardiomyopathy patients and 101 healthy controls, patients had higher levels of CRP, TNF-α, MDA, GPX and NT-proBNP. TNF-α correlated with GPX and MDA, while NT-proBNP correlated with GPX and MDA. The authors conclude that inflammation and oxidative stress are linked in cardiomyopathy patients.

Before the Stanley Cup final game, the speaker said the team needed to rely on its preparation, habits and usual routine rather than change how it played because of the stakes. After the win, he credited blocked shots, goaltending and contributions throughout the team. He said a knee injury left him unable to stop or turn properly, so he watched rather than risk hurting the team. He expressed gratitude to his family, coaches, teammates, veteran players and loyal Pittsburgh fans, and said the team was happy to finish the job after the previous year’s disappointment.

Premier Li Keqiang said China would widen access to its services and manufacturing sectors, lower import tariffs, and allow domestic and foreign firms to compete fairly. He also pledged no forced technology transfers and stronger intellectual property protection. His remarks came amid concerns about a potential trade war following US tariff announcements.

Amadeus FiRe AG corrected a voting-rights notification: following a share transaction on 9 February 2017, BNP Paribas Investment Partners S.A.’s holding fell from 5.003% to 4.99%, representing 259,295 voting rights. It reported no voting rights through instruments.

Ajman’s ruler reduced the tourism tax paid by hotels and tourism companies from 10% to 7%, effective immediately through December 31. The decree aims to promote tourism and improve the emirate’s investment environment.
Apple filed a Form 8-K on January 31, 2017, announcing a press release and data sheet covering its first fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2016. The documents are attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2.

Soccer passing directions describe the ball’s intended path from a passer to a teammate. Terms cover forward, angled, sideways and backward passes, with variations such as diagonal, square, wide, long and short. The passage also defines terms for passes toward the center or goalposts, passes between defenders, possession passes and switches to the opposite side of the field.

At Huntington University Hospital, about 71% of patients undergoing aortic valve replacement or coronary artery bypass grafting received blood transfusions in 2011–2013, compared with a national average of 48.9%. A cited study associated transfusions with lower long-term survival. Dr. Frank Young was appointed to lead a project to reduce blood-product use during and after cardiac surgery by two-thirds by the end of 2014, with projected annual savings of $2.5 million.

Young proposed techniques using patients’ own blood and measures to prevent bleeding. He had support from administrators and some clinical staff, but faced skepticism from veteran surgeons. Because surgical teams spanned separate reporting structures and no team members reported to him, he needed to persuade colleagues to change their practices and sustain those changes.

Mark Haedicke asks to be removed from the State Bar of Michigan e-Journal mailing list. His reply includes the October 25, 2000 edition, which contains legal case summaries, practice listings, classifieds, professional news, bar events, and subscription instructions.

This statistical analysis plan compares dasiglucagon 0.6 mg with placebo, with GlucaGen as a reference. The planned sample is 20 patients receiving dasiglucagon and 10 each receiving placebo or GlucaGen. The primary endpoint is time to a ≥20 mg/dL plasma glucose increase within 45 minutes without rescue IV glucose; secondary endpoints assess recovery rates and glucose changes at 10, 15, 20, and 30 minutes.

Primary efficacy analysis uses the full analysis set and a stratified log-rank test, with hierarchical testing of secondary endpoints at a two-sided 0.05 significance level. Sensitivity and supportive analyses are planned. Safety analyses use patients who received at least one dose and cover adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECGs, local tolerability, and immunogenicity. The plan also specifies pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analyses, handling of missing data, reporting formats, and programming quality controls.

Meb Faber’s Three-Way Momentum/Trend-Following Model invests equally in stocks, bonds, and gold when each asset’s three-month moving average exceeds its ten-month moving average. The passage reports annual returns of 13% from 1971 to 2015. A backtest using SPY, TLT, and GLD from 2006 returned 8.9% annually with an 18% maximum drawdown, though returns since 2015 were 5.3% annually. The passage emphasizes the strategy’s relatively low drawdowns and says nearby moving-average settings produced similar results.

Samsung Galaxy J5 Prime has begun receiving the Android 7.0 Nougat update over the air in the UAE, according to SamMobile. An official rollout in India may take longer. The update adds improved multi-window use, notifications, quick settings and battery optimisation. The phone launched in India at Rs 14,900 with Android 6.0 Marshmallow.

RaySearch and Eckert & Ziegler BEBIG have agreed to integrate RayStation treatment planning and RayCare oncology information systems with BEBIG’s brachytherapy systems, enabling BEBIG to offer treatment devices, planning and information management together.

The 48-inch LG C4 OLED is $800 on Amazon for Prime Day, its lowest price cited in the passage. It offers strong picture quality, solid reflection handling, four HDMI inputs supporting variable refresh rates up to 144 Hz with select PCs, and LG’s webOS interface. It is less bright than newer flagship models. The 65-inch version is also discounted to $1,300.

Peloton launched five updated fitness products, including equipment with AI coaching, as it seeks to revive its post-pandemic business. Equipment prices rose, and its monthly membership fee increased by $5 to $49.99. Peloton shares closed down 3.67% on the launch day.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Friday, with the Dow dropping more than 650 points below 26,000 and recording its worst week in two years. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors sold amid concerns that stronger-than-expected job and wage growth would prompt the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates more than anticipated. Trump, who had previously touted stock market gains, did not address the downturn on Twitter. Experts attributed the decline to economic fundamentals rather than the release of a controversial House GOP memo.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs increase raster performance by moving ROPs into the GPC and expand SM capabilities with twice Turing’s peak FP32 rate, larger L1 cache and greater shared-memory bandwidth. Second-generation RT Cores double ray-triangle intersection throughput, support concurrent workloads and accelerate ray-traced motion blur. Third-generation Tensor Cores add precision modes and structured sparsity, while DLSS uses them to improve rendering performance.

The architecture also introduces GDDR6X memory with up to 936 GB/s of peak bandwidth. RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression with DirectStorage to reduce CPU work during asset loading. The passage describes GA10x display, video decoding and encoding features, alongside GeForce RTX gaming cards and the A40 and RTX A6000 professional GPUs.

The lecture examines why people may hold optimistic beliefs, avoid unwelcome information, or update beliefs inaccurately. Optimism can provide immediate benefits but may distort decisions or lead to disappointment. Studies discussed show biased responses to feedback and effects of overconfidence on financial choices. The lecture then explains how difficult Bayesian updating can lead people to use shortcuts, producing the gambler’s fallacy, hot-hand fallacy, base-rate neglect, and errors based on representativeness or availability. Effective responses to misinformation depend on whether people miss information, hold mistaken theories, resist learning, or struggle to update their beliefs.

The lecture evaluates two developments from the perspectives of developers, tenants and governments. Winthrop Center’s Passive House design faced limited market recognition: State Street chose a competing building for its floor plate, office amenities and rent. COVID-19 disrupted Winthrop’s financing and construction, but replacement financing allowed work to resume. The lecturer argues that the project also helped inform stricter building-energy requirements and encouraged other Passive House proposals.

For 425 Park Avenue, L&L considered investing in ventilation, filtration and wellness certification to attract office tenants. The class debated whether potential rent premiums and tenant health benefits justified uncertain costs, and how to reach tenants willing to pay for them. Citadel leased space at a reported record price, but retaining part of the existing structure caused major delays and costs; the project’s equity was ultimately wiped out.

The speaker praises Oskar and Barbie’s on-ice intelligence and says their reunited line communicates well. The team has improved during each series and aims to win the next game in a best-of-three situation. After playing with better structure and benefiting from key saves, they plan to review video and keep improving.

Researchers built a topological insulator laser from interconnected optical waveguide rings. Exciting the outer rings confines light to the edge, while the rings’ arrangement creates a protected state that resists scattering from defects. Compared with a laser using an unprotected edge state, the protected laser remained operational when rings were removed, was more efficient, and did not produce additional colors as power increased. The work addresses common laser problems such as unstable output and unwanted colors at higher power.

The coach said the team’s last game was one of its few poor playoff performances, citing weak offense, defense, physicality, quickness and special teams. He expressed confidence in goaltender Michael and said the team has played better at home, while at times allowing dangerous chances on the road. He declined to discuss lineups, expected the team to respond in its next game, and anticipated strong performances from Mike Richards and Jeff, who has missed substantial time with injuries. He said the team’s past challenges can help motivate its pursuit of a championship.

Law enforcement agencies have spent two years planning security for Super Bowl LII in downtown Minneapolis. Minneapolis police are coordinating with federal, state and local agencies, including the FBI, which is handling counterterrorism efforts. Security measures include increased patrols, fencing, credential checks and screening that begins hours before the game. Some fans will be prescreened indoors away from the stadium because of the forecast cold. More than 400 Minnesota National Guard members have also been called up to help.

The passage calls for a complete reorganization of Alaska’s government and supports the planned Alaska Yukon Pacific Exposition as a way to develop Alaska and expand American commerce in the Pacific. It argues that nations should pursue their interests while treating trading partners fairly and acting with justice toward other nations. It also urges fair treatment of lawful immigrants regardless of their origins or religion. In particular, it condemns hostility toward Japanese people in the United States, including their exclusion from San Francisco public schools, and calls for the same courtesy toward them that Americans receive in Japan.

Accern reported positive Friday news coverage for Waterstone Financial, with a sentiment score of 0.26, but said the coverage was somewhat unlikely to affect its share price soon. BidaskClub downgraded the stock to “hold,” while Sandler O’Neill upgraded it to “buy” and lowered its price target. Shares traded at $19.45 Friday. The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share, payable November 2.

The study recorded medical problems after doses of BNT162b1, BNT162b2, BNT162b2SA, or placebo; problems were not necessarily caused by vaccination. In Phase 1, a few participants had temporarily low lymphocyte counts after Dose 1. Injection-site reactions and systemic events generally resolved quickly and were mostly mild or moderate. Injection-site pain, tiredness, and headache were the most common reported reactions.

The tested 10-, 20-, and 30-µg doses of BNT162b1 and BNT162b2 were generally well tolerated, but the 100-µg BNT162b1 dose was stopped after Dose 1 because of reactions. BNT162b2 at 30 µg was selected for Phase 2/3. Serious medical problems were uncommon; researchers considered some in participants aged 16 or older possibly vaccine-related. No one died in Phase 1. Deaths occurred in Phase 2/3 from different causes, and researchers did not believe BNT162b2 caused them.

Neutral particle diagnostics use neutrals created from plasma ions to measure the ion distribution in a fusion plasma’s core. Charge exchange with edge neutrals or an injected neutral beam can produce these particles, but ionization and further charge exchange may prevent them from escaping. The lecture estimates that core measurements require relatively low plasma density.

In passive charge-exchange diagnostics, escaping neutrals are converted to ions and separated by velocity to estimate ion temperature and detect fast ions, though the signal is line-integrated. A neutral beam provides a more localized measurement. It also enables charge-exchange spectroscopy of impurities, revealing their density, temperature and flow; beam emission spectroscopy, which probes density fluctuations; and motional Stark effect measurements, which help determine magnetic-field direction and reconstruct current profiles.

Toyota gave ChassisCo greater responsibility for sourcing parts and assembling the more complex 2003 Suprima rear suspension cradle after earlier successful launches. ChassisCo lacked sufficient project management, supplier oversight, parts tracking, tuning expertise and launch resources. Increased automation, stringent quality requirements and aggressive price targets compounded the difficulties. Toyota also underestimated the gap between ChassisCo’s capabilities and its new responsibilities and discovered second-tier supplier problems late.

The Suprima launched on time in September 2003, but ChassisCo’s Athens plant initially produced at barely 60% of the target rate. Defects, downtime, overtime and nonconforming parts persisted through 2004 despite extensive Toyota support.
