By November, Toyota was concerned about critical welds and the plant’s inability to track defective cradles, while ChassisCo said it lacked resources and was losing money. The case asks how both companies should resolve the crisis.

McGill University researchers developed DOLPHIN, an AI tool that examines how genes are assembled from exons in single cells to reveal disease markers missed by conventional gene-level analysis. In a test using pancreatic cancer data, it found more than 800 previously missed markers and distinguished aggressive cancers from less severe cases. Researchers say the tool could eventually help doctors detect disease earlier, guide treatment and develop virtual cell models. They plan to test it on millions of cells.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% year to date, but fell 1.6% on the first day of August. The passage describes the longer-term market trend as healthy while warning that weakening short-term technical indicators, rising volatility and credit spreads, and growing concentration in tech stocks could signal further pressure.

Radiopharmaceutical therapy often uses fixed dosing despite differences between patients. Physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models use patient data to predict drug distribution, absorbed doses, and treatment responses, potentially supporting personalized planning. The passage outlines verification, validation, and uncertainty quantification methods needed to assess these models. It also describes added challenges for theranostic digital twins, which require repeated patient data and ongoing model evaluation. Clear standards for PBPK models in radiopharmaceutical therapy remain to be established.

The speaker says both teams are strong and similar, and that the opponent has speed and scoring threats throughout its lineup. With the series at 2–1 and most games close, they expect the opponent to improve. They credit Larry’s clear, heartfelt coaching and emphasize matching the opponent’s effort, playing a simple, patient team game, and sticking to the game plan despite setbacks.

The author downgrades Alibaba from Buy to Hold after a rally brought shares near fair value. AI and cloud growth remains strong, while reinvestment pressures profitability. The author says mixed fundamentals justify a more cautious stance.

XTANT-3 simulations of irradiated phlogopite predict hydrogen migration at an absorbed dose of about 0.17 eV/atom, close to the experimental damage dose of about 0.2 eV/atom. Electron-phonon coupling cools the electrons and suppresses some nonthermal damage, raising the damage threshold. At about 0.4 eV/atom, magnesium also becomes mobile while other sublattices remain stable; at 0.5 eV/atom, the lattice disorders. The electronic bandgap collapses near 0.9 eV/atom, producing a metallic state. At higher doses, nonthermal acceleration rapidly heats the atoms.

The coach says he believes in his players through their ups and downs and trusts the team’s leadership to keep them focused on the next game. He recalls being excited for his opportunity with the then-new San Jose Sharks. Though pleased with their position, the team knows it has more work to do and respects San Jose. He credits the team’s success to staying in the moment and playing a close-knit, trusting team defense. He also praises Phil’s consistent offensive and defensive contributions and his growth into a two-way player.

Amazon’s April 23, 2015 Form 8-K announces its first-quarter 2015 financial results and reports three segments beginning that quarter: North America, International, and AWS. The segment change does not affect consolidated results. Exhibits include the earnings press release, non-GAAP information, and historical segment data.

The speaker says the team plays best when everyone follows the same plan: putting the puck deep, playing patient defense and limiting mistakes. He emphasizes shared responsibility for wins and losses, rather than blaming individuals. His line communicates openly, while Claude’s playoff experience and Jason’s leadership help the team.

The passage proposes a Bayesian-persuasion framework for evaluating how LLMs strategically reveal information to influence decisions. It measures persuasion gains and information disclosure, and uses existing human-persuasion datasets to build opinion-change benchmarks with LLM senders and receivers. A study with 45 participants supports the plausibility of the environments. Experiments find that stronger models achieve higher persuasion gains and more adaptive disclosure, while reinforcement learning improves smaller models’ performance, including across different receiver architectures.

The Clock is a basketball offense built around a 1-3-1 passing attack, crisp ball movement and simple player rotations. A pass from the wing to the corner triggers a basket cut; a wing dribble toward the corner triggers a corner back cut. Ball reversal attacks the weak side when the defense prevents a shot, cut or post pass. The offense offers options against 1-3-1 and 1-2-2 zones. Against a corner double team, its “Cat” counter shifts to a 2-1-2 alignment and relies on passing. Late-clock options include “Vegas,” using a double screen for a shot, and “Back,” seeking a weakside lob.

The passage describes multiple views of an exercise apparatus design, including mirror-image sides. A symbolic break indicates that the band’s length beyond the break is not claimed; broken-line portions are also excluded from the claimed design.

Roosevelt urged Congress to reduce unnecessary government printing, extend merit-based appointments to the District of Columbia, and establish fitness-based consular appointments and promotions. He described the White House’s restoration as a way to preserve its historic character. State Department circulars instructed officers to apply passport rules consistently: loyal Americans abroad should not be denied protection solely because they cannot give a definite return date, but those who have effectively abandoned U.S. residence and citizenship should not receive it.

Bitcoin and cryptocurrency-related stocks have fallen sharply. Long Blockchain, formerly Long Island Iced Tea, has lost nearly 55% since its surge after announcing a shift to blockchain. It abandoned plans to buy bitcoin mining equipment and will focus on a merger with Stater Blockchain. Bitcoin briefly fell below $8,000 Friday amid fears of tighter regulation. Shares of Riot Blockchain, LongFin and Nodechain have also declined substantially this year.

Baker & McKenzie’s October 15, 2001 Global Employment Law Alert summarizes employment-law and workplace developments across six regions. Topics include pensions, discrimination, privacy, immigration, union rights, workplace safety, and legislation, alongside job cuts following the September 11 attacks. The alert links to further information and states that it is not legal advice.

The passage describes a configurable multiplexer that lets an external device connect to vehicle communication buses with different connector pinout configurations using one cable. After detecting a connection, the device determines the vehicle’s pinout either by querying a remote vehicle data index with an identifier or by comparing observed bus signals with known configurations, potentially using checksums. It then configures the multiplexer to connect pins with matching functions.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture, focusing on the TU102 and the smaller TU104 and TU106. Turing combines rasterization with RT Cores for real-time ray tracing and Tensor Cores for AI workloads, including Deep Learning Super Sampling. Its streaming multiprocessors can execute floating-point and integer instructions concurrently, while changes to caching, GDDR6 memory, and compression improve memory performance. TU102 and TU104 support NVLink for multi-GPU communication; TU106 does not.

The passage also covers Turing features for video, displays, VR, and rendering, including VirtualLink, mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering. It describes the Tesla T4’s inference capabilities and explains how bounding volume hierarchies, RT Cores, and denoising make ray-traced effects more practical in real time.

On August 31, 2016, two Tesla subsidiaries entered into a loan and security agreement with Deutsche Bank to support Tesla Finance’s direct vehicle leasing program. They may borrow up to $300 million, secured by proceeds from specified leases and related vehicles. Borrowing is scheduled to end August 31, 2017, with outstanding amounts due September 20, 2018, subject to the agreement’s terms. No amount was outstanding at signing. Tesla is not a guarantor; the agreement is expected to reduce its leasing-related cash needs and potential fundraising dilution.

NVIDIA describes Blackwell’s DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three additional frames per traditionally rendered frame. Its updated AI models reduce processing and VRAM use, while hardware-based frame pacing manages display timing. DLSS 4 also introduces transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA, with reported improvements in image stability, motion detail, and lighting.

Blackwell supports developer-created neural shaders through Tensor Cores accessible to graphics shaders. Applications described include neural materials and texture compression, a radiance cache for indirect lighting, subsurface scattering for skin, and generative AI for faces. The passage also outlines the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and associated GeForce RTX 50-series products. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability as detailed in its notices.

Bad Bunny’s selection to headline the Super Bowl LX halftime show has drawn criticism from right-wing commentators over his Spanish-language music and opposition to Trump administration policies. A Homeland Security adviser also warned that immigration enforcement could occur at the event. Bad Bunny has said he avoided the continental US on his world tour because he feared ICE raids targeting concertgoers. The passage describes the NFL’s choice as part of an effort to reach younger and more diverse audiences, while framing the backlash as a dispute over cultural identity.

The passage describes equality of opportunity in education as access to educational services without discrimination, while recognizing students’ differing abilities and needs. It identifies economic, geographical, political, individual, and social factors as barriers to equal access and achievement. In Turkey, it highlights inadequate schools, economic difficulties, poorly equipped learning environments, and cultural and social factors affecting motivation.

The passage recommends improving access and learning environments, reducing achievement gaps between regions and school types, and making quality education available in every school. It also calls for stronger teacher preparation, education planning based on scientific studies, and wider access to high-standard preschool education.

Patterns help developers build reusable components for distributed systems. On a single machine, grouping containers can isolate resources, clarify ownership, and separate concerns. Three patterns use this approach: a **sidecar** adds functionality to an application, an **ambassador** brokers its external connections, and an **adapter** converts its interfaces to common formats for tasks such as monitoring and logging. Reusable containers need parameters, stable APIs, and documentation.

Across machines, microservices allow components to be developed and scaled independently, but make design and debugging harder. Replicated, load-balanced services provide redundancy and scale; readiness probes keep unprepared instances from serving requests. Caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination can be added in separate serving layers.

Sharded services assign subsets of requests or data to different shards, often to store more state than one machine can hold. Sharded caches can use memory more efficiently than replicated caches, but shard failures may reduce capacity or increase latency. Replicating shards can improve resilience. Effective sharding depends on a deterministic, evenly distributed function and a key that groups requests with identical results.

The speaker describes a gifted player who shoots more than he passes, then says the opposing team’s speed, active defense, positioning and hard work have made the series difficult. Their own team has played well in spurts but needs sustained effort, trust in its game plan and contributions from everyone. Facing a crucial game, the speaker says the opponent appears hungrier.

Tesla Motors reported that Chief Financial Officer Deepak Ahuja plans to retire after seven years. He will remain in the role while helping select a successor and complete the transition. At its June 9, 2015 annual meeting, stockholders elected Antonio J. Gracias and Kimbal Musk as directors, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor for 2015, and rejected two stockholder proposals.

NVIDIA’s RTX Blackwell architecture unifies INT32 and FP32 cores, increasing throughput for many integer operations, and adds more texture units and faster point sampling. RTX 50-series GPUs use GDDR7 memory, with built-in single-bit error correction, and fifth-generation Tensor Cores that support FP4 and FP6 operations.

Blackwell’s fourth-generation RT Cores add support for Mega Geometry and Linear Swept Spheres, while Shader Execution Reordering 2.0 improves workload organization. An AI Management Processor schedules GPU contexts. The architecture also adds 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, DisplayPort 2.1b support, and power-management improvements.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for image reconstruction. New neural-shader tools support techniques including neural texture compression, lighting, materials, skin, and faces. The passage also outlines the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products.

Introduced by Pete Newell in the late 1950s, the Reverse Action Offense uses guard-around cuts, ball reversals and weakside post screens to create shots and post-up opportunities. It can begin with passes or dribbles, with entries chosen according to the defense. Players read defensive positioning and use cuts, screens, drives, passes and post moves to counter overplays, switches, help defense and double teams. The offense also includes sideline-triangle post options and quick-hitting weakside plays for late-game situations.

NVIDIA GPUs support gaming, content creation, high-performance computing, and AI. The Turing architecture improves graphics performance through redesigned processors and GDDR6 support, while combining rasterization, real-time ray tracing, AI, and simulation. Its Tensor Cores enable neural-network-based graphics effects.

A collection of October 2001 news reports focuses on Enron’s falling share price and questions about its financing. Enron said it expected to repay about $3.3 billion in notes through asset sales, but might issue stock if proceeds fell short. During an investor call, CEO Kenneth Lay defended CFO Andrew Fastow while declining to detail partnership transactions under SEC inquiry. Analysts questioned Enron’s disclosures and potential shareholder dilution. Other reports cover a proposed Enron loan, its asset sale in India, and a House stimulus bill that could provide the company a tax refund.

A defensive wall places players shoulder-to-shoulder to block part of the goal during a nearby free kick, allowing the goalkeeper to cover the other side. The goalkeeper decides whether to build one and how many players it needs, based chiefly on the ball’s position. Defenders must act quickly because attackers may take a free kick before the wall is ready.

Defenders generally must stay at least 10 yards from the ball until it is kicked, though they may stand on their own goal line between the posts. For a traditional wall, an anchor lines up with the ball and near post while the goalkeeper directs adjustments. Alternatively, a designated player beyond the ball can position the anchor, leaving the goalkeeper free to watch the ball. Wall players must avoid gaps and react immediately after the kick. Rare indirect free kicks less than 10 yards from goal require a wall on the goal line.

A reverse deceives a defense by moving the ball one way before handing or tossing it to a player heading the opposite way. It can produce a big gain but risks lost yardage if poorly executed. The passage describes a Panthers reverse that became a touchdown, a Cardinals fake reverse that let Kyler Murray run, a Purdue reverse screen that ended in a touchdown, and a reverse pass in which the quarterback caught a touchdown throw. Blocking and defensive reactions are central to these plays.

November 2001 news reports focus on efforts to sell Enron and its partners’ 85% stake in Dabhol Power Company. Tata Power and BSES expressed interest and began due diligence, while Indian lenders sought a price of at least $700 million. Discussions covered tariff reductions, lender concessions, tax relief, separating the LNG facility and granting the buyer electricity distribution rights; MSEB opposed giving up profitable distribution areas. MSEB also declined to attend a Dabhol board meeting amid disputes over payments and termination notices. Other reports covered a planned arbitration meeting, a court order temporarily blocking the encashment of customs guarantees, Enron’s accounting disclosures and revised arrangements for the LNG Laxmi tanker.

The Kansas court affirmed summary judgment for Farmway Credit Union. Melvin Douglas had defaulted on secured debts and, before his death, agreed that Farmway could sell the collateral. His heirs cooperated after his death. The court held that Farmway could exhaust its security without filing an estate claim or foreclosure action, despite the administrator’s right to possess estate property. It did not decide whether a creditor could use self-help repossession without such an agreement. Summary judgment was not premature because the relevant facts were undisputed.

An IDC survey of 200 industrial decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland examines how simulation, modeling, data analysis, and high-performance computing (HPC) support manufacturing. Digital twins can help monitor products and processes, test scenarios, and enable new services. Respondents report that limited computing capacity delays calculations; 81% view HPC as a game changer for product and process innovation.

The paper identifies security, costs, energy consumption, technical complexity, and skills shortages as HPC challenges. It says cloud-based HPC and HPC as a Service can offer scalable computing capacity and flexibility, while in-house or hybrid approaches may better suit some data and security requirements. IDC recommends a shared data strategy and evaluating HPC options according to performance, utilization, cost, security, and energy efficiency.

Packers coach Mike McCarthy praised Damarious Randall’s offseason work, particularly at nickel corner, as Randall seeks to rebound from an injury-plagued, inconsistent second season. With Davon House returning and Kevin King drafted, Randall may play primarily in the slot. The passage cautions that offseason performance may not carry into the regular season.

After Virgin America’s final revenue flights Tuesday night, Alaska Airlines will remove Virgin branding from 29 airports in the U.S. and Mexico. Beginning Wednesday, the airlines will use one flight network, website, app, call center and airport check-in system. Alaska expects the transition to go smoothly, though repainting Virgin America aircraft and retrofitting their cabins will continue through 2019.

Counter is a run play that initially resembles Power in one direction before sending the runner the other way. A pulling guard kicks out an edge defender, while a fullback leads through the resulting lane. It can exploit defenses that overpursue and give the offense more blockers at the point of attack. Its slower development leaves it vulnerable to penetration, and defenders can force the runner outside. The passage outlines blocking assignments against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts and describes GT Counter, which uses a tackle as the lead blocker, and a triple-option variation.

China criticized a U.S. nuclear strategy review that cast Beijing as a potential adversary, urging Washington to reduce its much larger arsenal and promote stability. China’s Defense Ministry said its nuclear arsenal is the minimum needed for security and pledged never to use nuclear weapons first. The U.S. review said it aims to prevent Beijing from viewing limited nuclear use as acceptable.

Arch Manning’s first four games as Texas’s full-time quarterback have been uneven: strong passing performances against San Jose State and Sam Houston State, but struggles against Ohio State and UTEP. He has completed 61.3% of his passes for 888 yards, nine touchdowns and three interceptions. His strong 2024 start had raised expectations.

Fisher Chiropractic in Sacramento offers massage and chiropractic services for back pain. The company says it provides individualized care at affordable prices. Its website describes its services, displays client reviews, and provides email and location information.

On February 9, 2015, Microsoft entered an underwriting agreement to issue $10.75 billion of senior unsecured notes maturing from 2020 to 2055, with interest rates ranging from 1.850% to 4.000%. Interest is payable semiannually beginning August 12, 2015. Microsoft may redeem the notes under conditions described in the prospectus supplement.

The passage says seasonal weakness, thin trading, institutional tax-loss selling and rebalancing may pressure markets. It examines bond yields, TLT, the dollar and gold as signals for the market’s direction, noting that TLT faces resistance despite a bullish technical divergence. It also says a weaker dollar could support commodities. The analysis is presented for educational purposes, not as trading advice.

The paper develops a crystallographic framework for analyzing coexisting cubic and tetragonal phases in ferroelectrics. It describes how the volume ratio of tetragonal domains can enable a mismatch-free interface with the cubic phase and derives orientation relationships and predicted Bragg-peak splitting for 24 variants. High-resolution X-ray reciprocal-space maps of PMN-35PT agree with the predicted splitting. The observed independent diffraction peaks support an adaptive-state-like arrangement without requiring domain miniaturization.

The passage describes how digital twins and shared, cloud-based engineering workstations can improve manufacturing development, collaboration and analysis. A Bridgestone representative says a virtual tire-development environment can cut development time by up to 50%.

As simulations grow more complex, limited computing capacity can force manufacturers to trade accuracy for speed. In an IDC survey, 81% of respondents viewed high-performance computing (HPC) as a game changer for product and process innovation. More than a quarter of surveyed enterprises already used professional HPC infrastructure, while another 39% planned or piloted it.

HPC users face security, cost, energy-consumption, performance and skills challenges. The passage presents cloud-based and hybrid HPC as ways to improve scalability and flexibility, while noting that cloud systems still require trained personnel.

The passage projects significant growth in the probiotics chewables market. It describes chewables as supplements intended to support digestive and immune health and segments the market by digestive or immune support, child or adult use, and region. Listed manufacturers include Jarrow Formulas, Culturelle, and Natrol.

Paradox Interactive raised prices for select games in some regions by up to 40%, citing currency shifts and a desire for more equal pricing. After a consumer backlash, it offered free DLC when refunds proved impractical. Chief product officer Johan Sjöberg apologized and said the company is reviewing how it sets prices and communicates changes. Paradox is also seeking games suited to both PC and consoles, while waiting for a clearer third-party market on Nintendo Switch. Its new mobile studio aims to adapt the company’s deep, complex games for smartphones without diverting its focus from PC.

At Apple’s February 23, 2021 annual meeting, shareholders elected eight directors, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the 2021 independent auditor, and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. They rejected proposals on shareholder proxy access amendments and changes to the executive compensation program.

The design pairs a 16-bit ADS8681W SAR ADC with an eight-channel MUX36D08 differential multiplexer for fast voltage, current, or temperature sensing. The ADC provides rapid settling, integrated signal conditioning, safety features, and enhanced SPI communication.

South Bend estimated that filling low lands would cost $9,500, partly because it expected to obtain material from federal dredging work. When that material was deposited only in part of the district, the city hired a private contractor to complete the fill, raising the actual cost to $89,199.92. Property owners challenged the resulting assessments. The court held that the preliminary estimate did not limit assessments for actual bona fide costs, found the ordinance sufficient and the assessed benefits supported by the evidence, and affirmed the judgment.
Pius Suter scored three goals and Jonas Hiller made 25 saves as Switzerland shut out host South Korea 8-0. Switzerland next faces the Czech Republic.

Reagan campaigned against Ford in the 1976 Republican primaries but lost the nomination on the convention’s first ballot. He congratulated Ford and urged Republicans to unite around their platform, warning about threats to freedom and nuclear destruction. The passage also introduces Jeane Kirkpatrick’s 1979 article criticizing the Carter administration’s foreign policy, citing Soviet military growth and expanding influence alongside a declining U.S. position.

XO Training Ltd has proposed a members-only ice sports training centre at Unit 2 Pipers Court in Thatcham. The facility would serve athletes in ice hockey, figure skating, speed skating and sledge hockey, rather than the general public. XO says it would employ 20 staff, at least 13 locally. West Berkshire Council is expected to decide on the plans by August 2.

A survey of 90 grade 1–5 mathematics teachers in Al Ain, UAE, found that teachers generally felt confident using digital tools for distance education. They also reported increased preparation time and stress, alongside concerns about student communication, motivation and learning. Although 64.4% enjoyed teaching mathematics online, 76.7% preferred face-to-face teaching. The study recommends stronger teacher support and training and further research on student engagement. Its limitations include a small sample and a setting in which online teaching was mandatory and teachers had substantial support.

BA.2.86 has 33 spike mutations relative to BA.2. Using pseudoviruses and serum from 30 healthcare workers, the study found that BA.2.86 and its descendant JN.1 substantially evaded antibodies elicited by earlier vaccinations, with greater escape by JN.1. An XBB.1.5-adapted booster increased neutralization of both to similar levels. Testing 33 single-mutation reversions implicated the MPLF insertion at position 16 and mutations at positions 356, 460, 483, 484, 486 and 621 in BA.2.86’s antibody escape. The study was limited to pseudoviruses, single mutations and a cohort with potentially varied infection histories.

SEV-ES and SEV-SNP protect guest register state from direct hypervisor access. For non-automatic exits, the guest selectively shares the state needed by the hypervisor through a 4 KB decrypted Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB). The document standardizes the GHCB, required exits, and related guest operations. Version 2 adds initial SEV-SNP support and hypervisor feature advertisement. Later revisions address 64-bit guest-request sequence numbers, error reporting, a VLEK certificate GUID, APIC ID lists, multiple VMPL levels, and page-state-change notification for SEV-ES guests.

Mayank Jaggi finished sixth in the $1,100 No-Limit Hold’em event at the 2018 Wynn Summer Classic in Las Vegas, earning INR 38.68 lakh, his career-best payout. The event drew 2,197 entries, exceeding its $1 million guaranteed prize pool. Athanasios Polychronopoulos won the title after three days of play.

The speaker says their team created more scoring chances in the second game but needs to finish them. The opponent is skilled, physical and strong in faceoffs and puck battles. To score and win, the team needs more players near the net to reach rebounds and convert better-quality chances.
The Broncos ended a 37-game streak without a 100-yard rusher in a 28-3 Monday night win over the Bengals. They outgained Cincinnati by 353 yards and improved to 2-2.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 26, 2022 reports net sales of $97.3 billion, up 9% from a year earlier, and net income of $25.0 billion, up from $23.6 billion. Growth in Services, iPhone and Mac drove the sales increase, while iPad sales declined. For the first six months of fiscal 2022, net sales were $221.2 billion and net income was $59.6 billion. Apple repurchased $22.9 billion of shares and paid $3.6 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the quarter. The company reported continuing COVID-19-related operational and supply disruptions.

Langmuir probes are conductors placed in plasma to measure current as their voltage changes. Electrons initially charge a probe negatively until it reaches the floating potential, where net current is zero. This differs from the plasma potential because the probe creates a sheath. Sheath theory relates currents measured at the probe to plasma density and electron temperature.

A single probe can estimate these properties from the current–voltage curve near the floating potential and the ion saturation current. A double probe limits current and reduces the risk of overheating, but still requires a voltage sweep. A triple probe uses three simultaneous measurements without sweeping, improving time resolution while relying on the accuracy of its current–voltage model. Measurement uncertainties include identifying ion saturation current, interference between nearby probes, and effects of magnetic fields and collisions.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July, bringing its year-to-date gain to 7.8%, before slipping 1.6% on August’s first trading day. Short-term technical indicators show early weakness, while medium- and longer-term trends remain healthy. The passage also notes rising volatility and credit spreads, greater investor concentration in tech stocks, and record-high US electricity demand.

A Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey found that more than one in four U.S. public school teachers lack basic materials or staffing support needed to teach effectively. Nearly two-thirds reported shortages of teaching assistants or similar staff, and 62% reported insufficient mental health resources or special educators. Job satisfaction was 77% among teachers with adequate resources, compared with 44% among those without. Teachers in low-income schools were more likely to report shortages of laptops and printing resources. About half said their professional development was not grounded in students’ needs or learning.

A preprint describes a structured Patient Report Template designed to streamline nursing handoffs and access to electronic health record information. In a survey of 106 University of Iowa Health Care nurses, most template components were rated useful, particularly patient identification, safety information, medications, and care actions. Nurses reported low comfort and trust in AI-generated reports but expected moderate utility. Because the study assessed perceived usefulness rather than use in clinical practice, the authors call for usability testing and validation of AI-generated reports’ accuracy.
The speaker says a shot went in at the right time after a difficult stretch. They emphasize staying confident and credit their father’s support.

A physically strong, smart player had another solid game. The speaker said the first and third periods were better than the second, when the team did not create enough scoring chances. They urged continued aggressive play and said physical incidents should not distract the team or prompt retaliation.

Applications log to different destinations and in different formats, complicating log collection in containerized systems. An adapter container can redirect file logs to stdout and convert varied formats into a consistent structure. For third-party containers, this avoids maintaining a modified image and allows adapters to be reused.

CompareCards compares credit cards offering introductory 0% APR periods, cash back, travel rewards and sign-up bonuses. The listed offers have different eligibility requirements, balance transfer fees and variable APRs after introductory periods end. The site says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not influence its ratings or reviews.

The patent depicts three sequential images of an animated graphical user interface. The display screen shown in broken lines and the timing and process of transitions are not part of the claimed design.

The passage describes a turn-of-the-month strategy that buys at the close of the fifth-last trading day of a month and sells at the close of the third trading day of the next. It reports that, in S&P 500 backtests since 1960, the strategy outperformed buy-and-hold with lower drawdowns while invested about one-third of the time. Results vary across other markets; the effect was weak or absent for gold. The passage suggests fund inflows or rebalancing as possible causes but says the cause is uncertain.

A comparison of eight major oil companies finds that revenues, margins and operating cash flows improved as oil prices rose from their 2016 lows. From the second quarter of 2015 to the second quarter of 2017, their aggregate oil production increased 5.3% and natural gas production increased 9.7%. Lower upstream capital spending also helped all eight report positive net operating cash flow in the second quarter of 2017. The passage says narrowing global supply and demand and declining inventories point to a gradual market recovery. It concludes that the majors can be profitable at roughly $50 per barrel if they remain disciplined in capital spending.

The speaker expects a close, exciting series against Dallas, saying both teams are physical, disciplined and strong in goal. Special teams could decide it, making it important to avoid penalties against Dallas’s power play. The speaker credits positional play and goaltending for low-scoring but exciting games and says the team will stick to its style. After a difficult stretch and a coaching change, the team grew stronger through discipline and learning from mistakes. Winning a second championship is difficult, and contributions from veterans and rookies alike are essential.

Fifteen Sacred Heart Academy students and five chaperones spent spring break in Alajuelita, Costa Rica, on a mission trip combining Spanish practice with community service. The students played with neighborhood children, brought them meals and visited a senior center. They said the trip strengthened their Spanish and helped them build relationships with residents.

The Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly passed a Rs 95,666.97 crore budget for 2018-19 by voice vote, 20 per cent larger than the previous year’s. Finance Minister Haseeb Drabu linked the appropriation bill to expenditure reforms, including deadlines for releasing funds, mandatory use of the Budget Estimation Allocation Management System for payments, and a 60-day limit for departmental procurement plans. The bill also prioritizes certain centrally sponsored scheme and project costs and bars departments from hiring new casual or need-based workers.

In a note conveyed through neutral governments, Germany responds to its adversaries’ rejection of its December 12 proposal for early peace negotiations. It maintains that the offer was sincere and that talks could prevent further bloodshed, while noting that its adversaries offered no counterproposals. The note disputes their stated grounds for refusing negotiations and accuses them of territorial ambitions, violations of international law, mistreatment of prisoners, and deportations of civilians.

The passage introduces PATCH, a network-growth model combining preferential attachment, triadic closure, and homophily to study segregation and unequal visibility. Simulations identify homophily as the main driver of segregation and disparities between groups, while preferential attachment drives unequal numbers of connections. Unbiased triadic closure can moderate segregation and group disparities, but its effects depend on the other mechanisms. Across three scientific collaboration and citation networks, observed gender inequalities are best reproduced when both global and friends-of-friends links are influenced by popularity and gender homophily. The model does not fully capture the networks’ degree inequality, and the authors caution that interventions targeting one mechanism may have unintended effects.

This systematic review examined the prevalence of metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) and its association with HbA1c among adults with type 2 diabetes in Africa. Searches through December 6, 2023, yielded 10 eligible observational studies from six countries, involving 1,667 participants. Nine studies were cross-sectional, and most diagnosed MAFLD using ultrasonography. The review planned pooled estimates of prevalence and HbA1c association, but the provided passage does not report those results.

Researchers found that dandelion seeds detach more easily when pulled upward at an angle than when pulled downward. Microscopic imaging revealed an off-center tether surrounded by horseshoe-shaped shielding. A force tilting the seed toward the shield’s open side can release it, while force in the opposite direction helps it remain attached. This structure may help seeds catch upward gusts.

SD Memory Card reads transfer clock-synchronized, CRC-protected blocks of up to 512 bytes. CMD17 reads one block; CMD18 reads consecutive blocks until stopped by CMD12. Reads with block-length or address errors are rejected. Power loss does not destroy data except during host-issued write or erase operations.
At its March 14 luncheon, the Rotary Club of Greenwich donated $5,000 to Greenwich United Way’s Reading Champions program for tutor supplies, books and year-end awards for children.

The Supreme Court announced that it will publish Collegium recommendations on judicial appointments, transfers and elevations, along with its reasons, on its website when they are sent to the government. The move follows criticism of the Collegium’s lack of transparency. Reasons for recommendations concerning the Madras and Kerala High Courts have already been posted online, though the decision to publish them has itself drawn criticism from some in the judicial community.

Drug addiction has high rates of overdose and treatment dropout. The passage argues that self-reports and urine toxicology have limitations for assessing treatment outcomes, while cognitive-behavioral measures of drug bias may offer useful markers. The study tests whether picture-choice and verbal-fluency measures predict four-month treatment adherence among residential inpatients with opioid use disorder better than demographic and conventional addiction measures. It includes 59 inpatients and 29 age- and sex-matched healthy controls. The researchers hypothesize that inpatients will show greater drug bias and that these measures will better inform treatment completion.

The passage describes SD memory card commands, status fields, timing, and performance requirements. CMD6, mandatory for cards compliant with version 1.10 or later, checks and switches functions across six groups, including access mode and power limit. CMD8 checks voltage compatibility during initialization of version 2.00 or later cards. SDSC cards use byte addresses for memory access, while SDHC and SDXC cards use 512-byte block addresses.

It also specifies CRC protection, command responses, read and write timeouts, and clock-control rules. Speed Class, UHS Speed Grade, and Video Speed Class describe recording performance. Their requirements include allocation and recording units, write and read performance, and measurement conditions. SDXC Speed Class recording uses entirely free allocation units and requires CMD20 to start recording.

The TLV321x and TLV322x are single-, dual-, and quad-channel high-speed comparators with 40ns propagation delay, 40µA quiescent current per channel, and a 1.8V to 5V supply range. Their inputs operate 200mV beyond the supply rails, and the devices are specified from −40°C to 125°C. TLV321x devices have push-pull outputs; TLV322x devices have open-drain outputs that support logic-level translation. The family includes 1.8mV internal hysteresis and power-on reset. Applications include current sensing and zero-cross detection. The data sheet recommends input current limiting, supply bypassing, and high-speed PCB layout practices.

Hurricane Irma threatened Atlantic coast ports that handle major U.S. agricultural exports; nearly half of U.S. poultry exports transit through the five listed ports. Savannah handles 32 percent of poultry exports, Miami 31 percent of grapefruit exports, and Jacksonville 25 percent of beer and ale exports.

The June 8, 2001, CongressDailyAM reports that House appropriators’ proposed FY02 spending allocations largely follow President Bush’s requests, while House leaders plan to keep an FY01 supplemental bill near his proposed level despite calls for more defense funding. House Republicans expect to advance energy, prescription drug and campaign finance bills despite Democratic control of the Senate. Rep. Steve Largent plans to resign in November to run for Oklahoma governor, and Rep. Asa Hutchinson’s expected departure may hinder a business liability bill. Other reports cover ergonomics forums, FDA warnings about mailed prescription drugs, possible generic-drug reforms, European concerns over a U.S. steel investigation, Senate organizing talks, and Bush’s intended nomination of Jo Anne Barnhart to lead the Social Security Administration.

This non-peer-reviewed study used 7-tesla magnetic resonance spectroscopy to compare brain metabolites in 64 people with a history of psychosis, 42 first-degree relatives, and 43 controls. Occipital NAA was lower in the psychosis and relative groups, though the difference for relatives was no longer significant after accounting for demographic factors. Prefrontal NAAG was lower in the psychosis group, but that difference also lost significance after adjustment. Prefrontal glucose was higher in the psychosis group than in controls; higher brain glucose was associated with greater psychiatric symptoms and abnormalities in visual task performance. GABA and glutamate did not differ significantly across groups. Metabolite measurements were relatively stable in participants who underwent repeat scans.

The passage profiles boxers who competed in mixed martial arts with varied results. Holly Holm became a UFC bantamweight champion after knocking out Ronda Rousey, while James Toney lost his only MMA fight to Randy Couture. Ray Mercer, Heather Hardy and Mia St. John won their MMA debuts but did not continue competing. Ricardo Mayorga lost three MMA fights, while Marcus Davis and Chris Lytle built longer MMA careers without winning major titles.

The lecture introduces the Z-transform to address cases where the discrete-time Fourier transform does not converge. Defined as the sum of \(x[n]z^{-n}\), it equals the Fourier transform on the unit circle when that circle lies in its region of convergence. For exponential sequences, Z-transforms can be described by poles and zeros, but the region of convergence is also needed to identify the sequence. That region relates to whether a sequence is left-sided, right-sided, or two-sided. The lecture also connects it to system stability and causality, and shows that the Z-transform maps convolution to multiplication.

The MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 documentation describes SRAM, up to 45 GPIO pins, configurable pin routing, analog peripherals, communications interfaces, timers, watchdogs, an RTC, security features, and serial-wire debugging. SRAM provides zero-wait-state access and retains data in RUN, SLEEP, STOP, and STANDBY modes, but not SHUTDOWN. The 12-bit ADC supports conversions up to 1.6 Msps with an external reference. Communications peripherals include UART, I2C, and SPI.

The passage also covers factory identification and calibration data, recommended power-supply and reset-pin connections, development resources, package information, and revisions made in September 2025. TI states that customers are responsible for validating their application designs.

The device uses Windows Media DRM to protect content. If its DRM software is compromised, content owners may ask Microsoft to revoke its ability to obtain new licenses; playback of unprotected content is unaffected.

SanDisk’s license permits personal use of the software on one computer or device at a time and restricts modification, reverse engineering, and redistribution. The software is provided without warranties, and liability is limited. SanDisk may terminate the license for violations, after which all copies must be deleted or destroyed. The device should not be discarded with unsorted household waste.

Source Energy Services is seeking about C$250 million in an IPO at a valuation of roughly C$1 billion as recovering oil drilling boosts demand for fracking sand. It plans to fund a Wisconsin facility acquisition, repay debt and cover other capital expenditures.

The Tenth Circuit affirmed the INS’s reinstatement of Alejandro Mendez Suarez’s 1996 exclusion order after his unlawful reentry in 1999. It held that the district court properly transferred his challenge for appellate review and that reinstatement did not apply the statute retroactively because his reentry occurred after its effective date. The court found him ineligible for adjustment of status because he had sought admission through misrepresentation. It could not grant relief concerning his Colorado criminal case or review the original exclusion order, and it found no prejudice from the alleged due-process defect in the reinstatement procedure.

Ashby Fields Primary School in Daventry is consulting parents on a proposal to close at 1.15pm on Fridays, cutting two hours from the school week. The school says the change could give teachers more development time and help address heavy workloads. Parent Kelly Holmes raised concerns about lost lesson time and the cost and availability of childcare for working parents. Governors will review feedback before deciding whether to develop a formal proposal; consultation results are expected in May.

Apple’s fiscal first-quarter 2024 net sales rose 2% year over year to $119.6 billion, while net income increased to $33.9 billion from $30.0 billion. Higher iPhone and Services sales offset declines in iPad and Wearables, Home and Accessories. Gross margin rose to 45.9% from 43.0%. Apple generated $39.9 billion in operating cash flow, repurchased $20.5 billion of shares and paid $3.8 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents.

CompareCards compares credit cards offering introductory 0% APR periods, cash back, travel rewards and sign-up bonuses. The listed offers have different eligibility requirements, balance-transfer fees and rates after the introductory period. The passage explains that fixed APRs generally remain stable, while variable APRs can change with prevailing rates. CompareCards says issuer compensation does not influence its ratings or reviews.

A systematic review and meta-analysis of 25 studies found that women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) had higher prevalences of anxiety, depression and eating disorders than women without PCOS. The higher prevalence of postpartum depression was not statistically significant. Estimated additional direct U.S. healthcare costs in 2021 were $1.939 billion for anxiety, $1.678 billion for depression and $0.644 billion for eating disorders. The eating-disorder association was no longer significant after adjustment for possible publication bias. Including previously assessed conditions, the study estimated PCOS-related direct healthcare costs at more than $15 billion annually, with mental health disorders accounting for approximately 28%. The authors noted that their estimates exclude indirect and intangible costs.

A question given to 11-year-old Chinese pupils asked the age of a ship’s captain carrying 26 sheep and 10 goats. Pupils and adults offered various answers, but the Shunqing Education Department confirmed there was no answer. It said the question was intended to allow different responses.

A collection of October 2001 articles reports that Enron faced a shareholder class action and an SEC inquiry into transactions with partnerships managed by its chief financial officer. Charges and the unwinding of partnership investments reduced shareholder equity by about $1.2 billion, while Enron’s shares fell sharply. Analysts remained largely positive, but investors questioned the company’s disclosures and financing. Enron reportedly sought a $750 million loan as its debt faced possible downgrade. A Texas Monthly article examined Enron’s growth, culture and setbacks. Other articles described AES’s dispute with an Indian state government and Enron’s separate Dabhol power-project dispute.

Michael Coren argues that opposition to sex education, including organized resistance from some religious groups in Ontario and Alberta, often rests on misunderstandings. He says modern classes help children understand their feelings, set bodily boundaries, and recognize and report abuse. He attributes much resistance to fear and cultural taboos, and says schools can support parents in educating children.

On September 14, 1901, President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed September 19, the day of President McKinley’s burial, a national day of mourning and prayer. He urged Americans to gather in places of worship to honor McKinley’s memory.

Alex Caruso has played 25 games for the Lakers on a two-way contract and is nearing the 45-day limit for time with the NBA team. Coach Luke Walton said the arrangement has helped the Lakers maintain continuity while developing Caruso. His deal extends through next season. Caruso has also averaged 19 points and 7.4 assists for the South Bay Lakers.

A May 16, 2001, collection of energy news reports describes criticism of limited disclosure and unequal access to Vice President Cheney’s energy task force, alongside its expected recommendations to expand fuel production. It also covers Texaco’s proposed offshore Louisiana LNG terminal, Enron’s agreement to drop a lawsuit after its trades were included in Alberta gas-price indexes, and Enron’s call for further electricity-market reform in Japan. Other reports address power shortages and investment concerns in Chile and Brazil, Saudi gas-project negotiations, and the dispute over Enron’s Dabhol power project in India.

On March 7, 2018, NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted a fiscal 2019 variable compensation plan offering eligible executives cash awards tied to revenue goals at threshold, base, and stretch levels. Participants generally must remain employed through the payment date. At base-plan achievement, target awards range from $250,000 for Debora Shoquist and Timothy Teter to $1.1 million for CEO Jen-Hsun Huang. The plan is filed as Exhibit 10.1.

Israel established a separate Druze school system in the 1970s to strengthen Druze identity and ties to the state. The system introduced Druze-specific curricula and expanded educational resources. Druze matriculation eligibility subsequently rose, reaching about 89% in 2022.

In interviews, nine Druze principals, supervisors, and trainee principals credited strong teaching and leadership, sustained efforts to improve, and sociocultural changes, particularly expanded opportunities for women. They disagreed on whether separation itself drove higher achievement. They also said high schools need to better prepare students for higher education. The study notes that its convenience samples and subjective interview accounts limit its conclusions.

Williams Jones & Associates cut its Star Bulk Carriers stake by 52.6% in the second quarter, leaving 31,600 shares valued at $311,000. Other institutional investors reported new or increased holdings; institutions and hedge funds owned 75.03% of the stock. Star Bulk shares opened at $10.28 on Friday, and analysts’ consensus rating was “Buy,” with an average target price of $12.80. The shipping company operated 73 dry bulk vessels as of December 31, 2016.

The government has restricted poultry movement within seven kilometers of San Luis, Pampanga, and plans to cull chickens following a bird flu outbreak. Agriculture Secretary Manny Piñol said a Luzon-wide ban on fowl shipments is precautionary and that further tests will determine whether the virus is H5N6. Health officials said transmission to humans is remote, advised precautions and proper cooking, and deployed epidemiologists to monitor farm workers for symptoms.

Resource Generation works with about 500 wealthy Americans aged 18 to 35 to examine how they acquired their wealth and direct money to grassroots groups fighting social, economic and racial injustice. Members share “money stories,” learn how to evaluate organizations and support campaigns on issues including taxes and workers’ rights. The nonprofit does not pool or distribute members’ money; it emphasizes giving affected communities control over how funds are spent. Members quoted in the passage describe becoming more open about their privilege and increasing their giving. Executive director Iimay Ho argues that voluntary philanthropy alone cannot restructure the economy, while economist Richard Reeves praises members’ efforts to use their wealth and influence to challenge inequality.

A survey of 4,594 participants in France, Belgium and Italy informed a model of COVID-19 testing and isolation during winter 2022/2023. Participants generally reported high willingness to test and isolate, but willingness to test fell when tests carried a cost. Under the modeled conditions, French and Belgian protocols reduced transmission by about 17–18%, while the Italian protocol reduced it by about 24% but required longer isolation. None alone brought the reproductive number below 1. Belgian rules required fewer tests than French rules with similar effectiveness. The study also projected that fall boosters would increase vaccine-conferred protection, although reported early uptake was lower than survey respondents’ stated willingness. The authors noted possible survey self-selection bias and that the model did not estimate hospital impacts.

Two contributors offer opposing views on Alcoa after its split from Arconic. One sees growth potential in higher bauxite shipments and new supply contracts, despite a fourth-quarter loss. The other argues that falling asset values, possible further write-downs, trade-policy risks, and low aluminum prices make Alcoa’s profitability difficult to assess.

Vienna topped Mercer’s 231-city quality-of-life survey for the ninth consecutive year, while Baghdad remained last. The survey assesses factors including stability, healthcare, education and transport to help employers set international staff allowances. Zurich ranked second, with Auckland and Munich tied for third. London fell to 41st, and the report noted substantial improvements in some eastern European cities.

The speaker contrasts playoff comebacks with the Olympics’ quarterfinal elimination, describing the tournaments as different and draining. They say their coach gives focused players freedom but finds ways to regain their attention when they lose their edge. Their relationship has involved mutual understanding with few words.

The articles describe California’s energy crisis: federal regulators asked suppliers to justify prices or face possible refunds, while officials argued the proposed amounts were too small. Creditors threatened bankruptcy proceedings against Southern California Edison, and the state’s water department faced criticism over its costly power purchases. Other reports covered relaxed emissions limits for a San Diego power plant, changes to PG&E’s rolling-blackout exemptions, and groups invoking the crisis to challenge state rules. A separate article discussed OPEC’s production cut and calls for more U.S. oil output.

The lecture argues that sustainability efforts are most durable when integrated with a company’s strategy, rather than driven mainly by rankings, stakeholder pressure, morality, reputation, or vague long-term goals. Companies should prioritize issues connected to their competitive strengths and use life-cycle analysis to identify significant impacts, including those among suppliers and customers. Examples contrast carmakers’ focus on vehicle use with food companies’ efforts to reach deeply into agricultural supply chains. Turning priorities into practice requires reliable measures, credible targets, incentives, and supplier criteria introduced after suppliers can collect the needed data.

A collection of November 11, 2001 articles reports that Dynegy agreed to acquire Enron after accounting revisions, mounting debt and an SEC investigation undermined investor confidence. The articles examine Enron’s partnerships, the potential impact on Houston, and challenges facing energy companies amid California’s electricity crisis. Other reports cover stock market gains, growing scrutiny of corporate earnings disclosures, and criticism of proposed economic stimulus bills.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2017 reports revenue of $2.70 billion, up from $1.15 billion a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $330.3 million, compared with $282.3 million. Quarter-end cash was $4.01 billion. Tesla acquired Grohmann Engineering, issued $977.5 million in convertible notes and raised $399.6 million through a common-stock offering. The filing also describes Tesla’s automotive and energy businesses, debt, accounting policies and legal proceedings.

Tamil Nadu’s sugar output is expected to fall from about 1 million tonnes this season to 600,000 tonnes in 2017/18 after severe drought. Farmers facing crop losses and debt have protested in New Delhi. India’s sugar output forecast for the year to September 2017 was cut to 20.3 million tonnes.

Erik Demaine introduces a course on the mathematics and algorithms of folding and unfolding linkages, paper, and polyhedra. It examines whether structures can fold and how to design structures that achieve a desired shape, with results ranging from universal constructions to computationally hard problems. Applications include robotics, manufacturing, medicine, biology, and sculpture. Examples include linkage motion, origami design, polyhedron unfolding, self-folding sheets, and hinged dissections. The course includes lectures, problem sets, a project, and optional sessions devoted to open problems.

A Metrocosm animation uses a Yale-led dataset to show cities’ earliest recorded populations, with records dating to 3700 BC. The dataset extends urban population analysis beyond 1950 but is incomplete and unevenly represented. The passage reports that 54 percent of people live in cities today.

The passage introduces an adaptive coupling of cell-centered finite volume (CCFV) and discontinuous Galerkin (DG) methods for steady convection-diffusion problems. When a DG cell average violates prescribed bounds, the method switches a small neighborhood to CCFV. Once cell averages satisfy the bounds within a tolerance, conservative slope limiters can bound the full solution without modifying those averages. The passage also specifies the model equation, FV–DG mesh partition, mesh admissibility requirements, and notation for the coupled discretization.

At Microsoft’s November 28, 2018 annual shareholders meeting, 6.72 billion of 7.68 billion eligible shares were voted. Shareholders re-elected all 14 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as the independent auditor for fiscal 2019.

The course examines how to build secure systems through research-paper discussions and labs, beginning with web-server buffer overflows. The professor describes security in terms of a policy, a threat model specifying assumptions about attackers, and mechanisms that enforce the policy. Security is difficult because it must hold against many possible attacks, and weaknesses may emerge as systems or assumptions change.

Examples include account-recovery policies that weaken authentication, interacting recovery procedures that enabled account compromise, outdated cryptographic assumptions, and implementation errors involving password-guessing limits, access checks, random-number generation, and certificate-name encoding. A buffer-overflow demonstration shows how excessive input can overwrite a return address and redirect execution. The lecture closes by noting that reducing the number of components responsible for enforcing a security policy can limit the effects of mechanism bugs.

The author disputes Keith E. Whittington’s call for professors to exercise discretion after Kirk’s assassination, arguing that occasional off-topic or offensive remarks should not cost them academic freedom. The author says restrictions on classroom speech could enable viewpoint discrimination and that the 1970 Interpretive Comments recognize controversy as central to academic inquiry. Rather than encouraging self-censorship, the author urges protection of academic freedom for all professors, including those whose views are unpopular.

British consumer credit complaints rose to 7,281 in the quarter ending June 30, from 5,846 a year earlier, the Financial Ombudsman Service said. Payday loans accounted for nearly half, and the ombudsman criticised lenders’ checks on borrowers’ ability to repay. Payment protection insurance remained the most complained-about area, with 42,401 new cases.

Racehorse owner Gary Leafe is seeking $8,300 from Wyong Race Club for training and feed costs after dogs attacked his filly Eyes To Heaven at the track. The filly is expected to recover and race again. The club says it wants to settle but has asked for a breakdown of the claim.

Hugh Bowman is appealing two careless-riding suspensions in hopes of riding Winx in the Apollo Stakes. Elsewhere, Bye See won at Rosehill ahead of trainer Michael Tubman’s 70th birthday, while stewards questioned Corey Brown’s ride on Exceltic in the Canonbury Stakes. Trainers also outlined autumn plans for Menari and Terravista, and Kinky Boom shortened in Golden Slipper betting after winning at Caulfield.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2018 reports revenue of $4.00 billion, up from $2.79 billion a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $717.5 million, compared with $336.4 million. At June 30, Tesla reported $27.91 billion in assets and $22.64 billion in liabilities. During the first six months of 2018, operating activities used $528.0 million in cash. Tesla also adopted a new revenue standard that changed the accounting for certain vehicle sales with resale value guarantees.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2016 reports revenue of $20.5 billion and net income of $3.8 billion, down from $21.7 billion and $5.0 billion a year earlier. For the nine-month period, revenue was $64.7 billion and net income was $13.7 billion. At quarter-end, cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $105.6 billion, while long-term debt was $40.9 billion.

Microsoft reported that its commercial cloud annualized revenue run rate exceeded $10 billion, Azure revenue grew 110% year over year, and Windows 10 was active on more than 270 million devices. The company had deferred a net $4.6 billion in Windows 10 revenue and reported results under three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

The study uses first-principles calculations to examine excitons in WSe₂/CrI₃ bilayers and magnetic trilayers. Its QSGŴ calculations predict type I band alignment, preserving WSe₂’s A and B excitons, and identify new magnetic interlayer excitons between them. These interlayer excitons are substantially brighter than CrI₃’s intralayer magnetic excitons. Proximity-induced splitting of the WSe₂ excitons depends strongly on band alignment and magnetic configuration, with the largest splitting in the ferromagnetic trilayer.

Michael Liersch of JPMorgan says investing need not be complicated. He recommends making a budget to decide how much to save and invest, viewing reduced spending as progress toward future goals, and staying patient through market swings. He also suggests seeking a second opinion from someone with a different perspective and starting with small steps, such as paying down a credit card or automating savings.

Asia-Pacific stocks rose as U.S. officials downplayed the risk of conflict with North Korea, while U.S. stocks recorded their largest weekly loss in months amid tensions and disappointing earnings. Japan’s economy grew at a 4.0% annualized rate in the second quarter. U.S. inflation remained subdued, and Dallas Fed President Robert Kaplan sought clearer signs of inflation before supporting further rate increases.

Molecular-dynamics simulations find that Zr-substituted barium titanate supports polar topological textures. In an ordered 12.5% Zr superlattice, chemically distinct layers alternate between −2 antiskyrmions and +4 skyrmions, with fractional charges at aligned vortex cores. Random Zr substitution preserves nontrivial textures but distorts them and makes their charge vary along the nanodomains. Intrinsic thermal stability generally decreases with Zr substitution; in the ordered superlattice, a local electric field can create and maintain +4 textures at 293 K, but they do not persist without the field.

The May 24 news roundup focuses on the Dabhol power dispute. Renegotiation committee chairman Madhav Godbole resigned after Sharad Pawar criticised the committee, then withdrew his resignation after Maharashtra’s cabinet affirmed its confidence in him. The cancelled talks were expected to resume the following week. The central government said it would support a settlement acceptable to Dabhol Power Company and the Maharashtra State Electricity Board and reassured lenders. Maharashtra referred disputes to its electricity regulator, while officials considered using the Power Trading Corporation to sell surplus Dabhol power. An extract from the Godbole committee’s report criticised the project’s design and questioned whether Maharashtra could absorb its output.

The Poland Local Board of Education dissolved teacher Cassandra Kibler’s contract after her teaching license was revoked. She had been on unpaid leave during an investigation into an alleged inappropriate relationship with a student. The board also heard two proposals to reduce facility costs through school closures, grade relocations and possible construction. It took no action on the proposals and will review them.

Pershing Square’s US long 13F portfolio rose slightly to $6.01 billion in Q2 2017 and remained concentrated in seven positions. Restaurant Brands International, Chipotle Mexican Grill and Mondelēz International accounted for about 71% of its value. The fund added Automatic Data Processing, sold its remaining reported Air Products shares, increased Howard Hughes through a warrant conversion and reduced Mondelēz. Other reported positions were unchanged. Pershing Square also held investments outside its 13F report, including Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
Simone Askew became West Point’s first black woman to serve as first captain, leading its 4,400 cadets. She encourages aspiring women leaders to seek mentorship.

The May 7–8 news roundup covers rising power costs in California, where an appeals ruling could let Enron supply public universities through utilities rather than the spot market. Enron said it might buy U.K. power plants to reduce trading risk. In India, its Dabhol project faced payment disputes, possible lender lawsuits and a customs-duty dispute; Dabhol agreed to meet a Maharashtra committee on May 11. Other reports covered Scottish Power’s restructuring, Northern Border’s purchase of Midwestern Gas and BP’s consideration of a Tampa natural-gas terminal.

The passage argues that reproduction numbers can misrepresent viral spread because they track detected cases without accounting for changes in testing. It proposes an acceleration index that compares the share of cumulative cases detected in a period with the share of cumulative tests performed in that period—equivalently, daily positivity relative to average positivity. The authors show that the reproduction number overestimates acceleration when test intensity exceeds infectivity intensity and underestimates it when the reverse holds. Analyses of France and five other countries find substantial discrepancies between the measures. The authors recommend tracking the acceleration index or combining the reproduction number with test and infectivity intensities. They note that the index’s accuracy depends on sufficient testing.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2017 Form 10-K describes a strategy centered on productivity, intelligent cloud services, and more personal computing. Its three reporting segments are Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, encompassing products and services such as Office, LinkedIn, Azure, Windows, Surface, Xbox, and search advertising. Microsoft completed its $27.0 billion acquisition of LinkedIn in December 2016. Research and development expense was $13.0 billion in fiscal 2017, and the company employed approximately 124,000 people as of June 30, 2017. The filing identifies risks including intense competition, challenges in expanding cloud services, cybersecurity and privacy threats, regulatory requirements, intellectual property disputes, and product quality or supply problems.

Syrian rebels faced a Wednesday deadline to respond to Russian terms for surrendering remaining territory in southern Daraa, with military operations expected to resume if talks failed. Russia, which backs the Syrian government’s two-week offensive, rejected rebel proposals for a ceasefire, army withdrawal from captured towns and safe passage for people unwilling to live under government control. More than 30 towns had already agreed to return to government control, which had expanded to about 60 percent of Daraa province. The offensive had displaced an estimated 270,000 to 330,000 people and killed more than 140 civilians. Jordan and Israel kept their borders closed to those fleeing, while Human Rights Watch urged them to admit asylum-seekers.

The speaker says the NHL long viewed Las Vegas as a promising market, despite delays involving an arena, ownership and the economy. Early fan enthusiasm and the team’s success reinforced that view. The speaker calls the expansion team’s Stanley Cup Final appearance positive for hockey, not a judgment on other teams. They also say a separate process has no set timetable or connection to Seattle, scientists lack enough information to establish an unspecified link, and community outreach remains important.

NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2020 revenue of $2.58 billion, down 17% year over year but up 16% from the prior quarter. Net income was $552 million, down 50% year over year, and diluted earnings were $0.90 per share. Gaming and Data Center revenue declined from a year earlier, while Automotive revenue increased. NVIDIA held $8.47 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities on July 28, 2019. Its proposed $6.9 billion acquisition of Mellanox remained subject to regulatory approval.

The CBI told the Supreme Court it had opened a preliminary inquiry into the alleged SSC CGL Tier II 2017 paper leak. The court declined to monitor the probe but allowed petitioners to return if dissatisfied.

A study of Ethiopian secondary education analyzed three national policy documents and interviewed two school leaders and 17 teachers at a regular and a special day school. The education policy and curriculum framework describe differentiation through school types, streams and fields of study; an earlier guideline emphasizes adapting curriculum components in inclusive classrooms. Leaders’ and teachers’ understandings varied, sometimes aligning with policy and sometimes reflecting limited awareness. The study found that special schools select high achievers but may teach subjects similar to those in regular schools. It calls for clearer, more coherent policy and greater flexibility in subjects and difficulty levels to address students’ varied needs.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on February 24, 2021, announcing results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 31, 2021. The filing includes a press release and CFO commentary as exhibits; both are furnished, not filed.

Former FBI Deputy Director Andrew McCabe was fired on March 16, two days before his planned early retirement, following an internal investigation into his approval of unauthorized media disclosures. His dismissal may delay access to an estimated $60,000 annual pension until age 57 and eight months and cost him health coverage in the meantime. The pension is part of the Federal Employees Retirement System, which bases benefits on service and salary. Lawmakers proposed short-term federal jobs to help him qualify, but a former law enforcement official disputed whether those jobs would suffice. McCabe may appeal.

ISDA’s June 4, 2001 press report covers criticism of proposed Basel II capital rules, including concerns about costs, competitive disparities and the 2004 implementation deadline. It also reports ISDA work on credit-derivatives documentation and corporate-successor issues, banks’ withdrawal from Argentina’s debt swap, a dispute over California’s power-grid operator, and uses of structured options products.

The St. Louis Blues have a largely committed core costing $47.425 million, with the passage highlighting favorable deals for Vladimir Tarasenko, Alex Pietrangelo, Colton Parayko and Jake Allen. Upcoming contracts could force decisions about several defensemen, Paul Stastny and Robby Fabbri. Despite concerns about some players and a lack of additional scoring, the team’s contracts leave it in a good position.

After Illinois reported a human West Nile virus case in mid-May, two months earlier than last year, the Macon Mosquito Abatement District set traps at 19 locations. A Decatur lab can test captured mosquitoes and enable treatment within 24 hours, compared with a week previously. Macon County has reported no human cases this year, but a mosquito batch tested positive in June.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week and was set to rebound modestly on Monday, though the article warns a deeper correction remains possible. Oil also declined after OPEC+ announced another production increase. Upcoming earnings, trade uncertainty and signs of weaker fuel demand add to the risks, prompting a call for careful position management.

No. 15 Florida beat Auburn 114-95 on Tuesday for its seventh straight win, pulling away after a 50-50 halftime tie. Canyon Barry scored a season-high 30 points, though his school-record streak of made free throws ended at 42. Florida center John Egnubu left with a knee injury and did not return.

An Islamic State car bomb killed 24 people and wounded 67 in Baghdad’s Sadr City on January 2, 2017. As Iraqi forces fought to retake Mosul, militants attacked positions north of Baghdad, killed at least 16 pro-government fighters and cut a strategic road linking Mosul to the capital. Clashes continued in Mosul, where Iraqi forces had retaken a quarter of the city. A separate Baghdad blast killed one civilian and wounded nine.

The whaling bark Cape Horn Pigeon sailed on December 7, 1891. Before entering the Okhotsk Sea, its captain had asked Russia for permission to whale in certain bays, but permission was not granted. On September 10, 1892, a Russian naval officer seized the bark while it was whaling on the open sea, claiming the Okhotsk Sea was closed. Despite the captain’s protest, the crew was compelled to navigate the officer’s vessel to Vladivostok. Russian authorities detained the bark until October 1. After the captain notified the U.S. legation, it contacted Russia’s foreign ministry, which reported the bark’s release.

Using China Education Panel Survey data from 13,981 students, the study finds a significant positive correlation between parental education and children’s cognitive ability. Each additional year in the higher-educated parent’s schooling is associated with a 0.019-point increase in the child’s cognitive ability score. Educational expectations and parent-child companionship partially mediate the relationship. The association is stronger for girls than boys, for urban than rural children, and for children with lower cognitive ability.

The passage describes stackless, register-based procedures for creating and removing a pre-memory stack. Stack initialization divides the available region among processor cores, maps it into global address space, sets applicable MTRRs, and creates a UEFI_SEC_PEI_HAND_OFF instance. It reports success, stack reentry, or an unknown processor family. Stack removal disables cache-as-RAM mode and flushes cache lines after the stack has been relocated to main memory. The passage also describes AmdCreateStruct, which allocates and initializes parameter structures using pre-memory cache-as-RAM storage, post-memory DRAM, or host-provided storage.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture, including the GA102 and GA104 GPUs, builds on Turing with higher FP32 throughput, second-generation RT Cores and third-generation Tensor Cores. The passage reports up to twice the ray-tracing performance, hardware acceleration for ray-traced motion blur, and Tensor Core support for new data types and structured sparsity. GA10x features also include GDDR6X memory, PCIe 4.0, RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression, 8K display support, AV1 hardware decoding and hardware video encoding.

GA102 powers the GeForce RTX 3090 and RTX 3080, as well as the professional RTX A6000 and data-center A40; GA104 powers the RTX 3070. The A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.

The lecture examines public-market financing for sustainable real estate through REITs and green bonds.
