REITs pool investors’ money in income-producing property and offer liquidity, diversification, and tax benefits, but investors have less control than with direct ownership. REIT models vary by country; China initially used them mainly to finance infrastructure.

Institutional investors, particularly those interviewed in Europe, were described as a force behind REITs’ sustainability targets. Studies cited in the lecture associate greener portfolios with stronger returns and lower financing costs, though the lecturer cautions that these relationships do not necessarily establish causation. Green bonds raise money for stated environmental investments and may reduce issuers’ borrowing costs.

The lecture emphasizes that credible sustainability claims require measurement, disclosure, and verification. GRESB benchmarks portfolio-level sustainability, but differing ESG ratings can produce inconsistent assessments.

Tristan Walker founded Walker & Co. after struggling to find shaving products suited to his hair and skin. Its Bevel shaving line and Form women’s line are designed with people of color in mind. Walker hopes to make the beauty industry more inclusive and end segregated beauty aisles. A former Foursquare executive and entrepreneur-in-residence at Andreessen Horowitz, he also founded Code2040 to expand opportunities for young people of color in tech. He says his greatest business concern is losing patience with slow industry change. His advice to aspiring entrepreneurs is to work on a problem they are especially suited to solve.

Dividend aristocrats are US companies that have increased their dividends for at least 25 consecutive years. The ProShares S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats ETF holds 52 companies. The passage highlights nine, including AT&T, Chevron, AbbVie, Exxon Mobil, Procter & Gamble, Walmart, Coca-Cola and McDonald’s, with indicative gross yields ranging from 2.89% to 4.61%. The article states that it is for educational and informational purposes, not investment, tax or legal advice.

The course uses Sean Carroll’s general relativity textbook, with other books suggested as supplements. Grades come entirely from 11 problem sets. The first half develops the mathematical foundations needed for Einstein’s field equations; the second applies them to topics including cosmology, black holes, neutron stars, and gravitational waves.

The lecture defines spacetime as a manifold of events endowed with a metric: events specify where and when something happens, while the metric provides a notion of distance between them. It introduces inertial reference frames as lattices of measuring rods and clocks synchronized using light signals. In the course’s units, the speed of light is set to one. The lecture then distinguishes geometric objects from their observer-dependent coordinates, describes how Lorentz transformations relate observers’ components, and defines a spacetime vector by its transformation law.

Patty’s saves helped the team withstand early penalty trouble and carry momentum into the second period. After scoring a second goal, they kept skating and played their style. They look forward to playing at home and plan to play patiently rather than force opportunities.
The headphones are shown from seven views; broken-line features are not claimed.

The study compared deep-learning breast-density predictions from standard-dose and approximately 10%-dose mammograms in 147 women aged 31–45. Models were trained on standard-dose and simulated low-dose images from a separate dataset. Predictions were highly similar, particularly when results from two image views and multiple models were averaged. Differences were greater for denser breasts and smaller breast areas; low-dose models generally predicted lower density in these cases. Age and dose ratio showed no relationship with prediction differences. The authors conclude that low-dose density estimation is promising, but systematic differences require further investigation.

Google announced Partner Interconnect, which lets organizations connect on-premises data centers to Google Cloud through 23 partners for hybrid cloud deployments. Unlike Dedicated Interconnect’s 10Gbps full circuits, it offers connections from 50Mbps to 10Gbps. The connections avoid the public internet and offer greater routing control, but data is not encrypted by default. General availability is expected in the coming weeks.

The bundle contains three short-selling strategies backtested on SPY, XLP, and SMH, with entries and exits at the close or next open. It includes plain-English rules and code. Short Strategy 1 recorded 125 trades, a 0.72% average gain per trade, 2.9% compound annual growth, and an 11% maximum drawdown. Combined results allow one position at a time.

Tecomaria capensis, or Cape honeysuckle, is a popular garden and hedging plant native to parts of southern and tropical Africa. It is a scrambling shrub or small tree with compound leaves and trumpet-shaped flowers in orange-red, lighter orange or pale yellow forms. Its conservation status is Least Concern. Game and livestock browse it, while sunbirds, butterflies and honey-bees visit it. The plant is used in traditional medicine, and its wood is used to make protective necklets worn by nursing mothers at social functions. It grows in well-drained soil and benefits from regular pruning.

MSPM0Gx51x MCUs are ultra-low-power, 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ devices operating at up to 80MHz. They offer up to 512KB flash, 128KB SRAM, dual CAN-FD controllers, cybersecurity features, and integrated ADCs, a DAC, and comparators. TI supports development with kits, an SDK, reference designs, training, and online forums.

GroceryDB analyzes more than 50,000 products listed by Walmart, Target, and Whole Foods in May 2021. Its machine-learning Food Processing Score (FPro) uses nutrition facts to assign a continuous processing score. Most products in all three stores scored as highly processed, though Whole Foods offered more minimally processed options and choices varied by food category. Higher processing was generally associated with a lower price per calorie, but the relationship differed across categories. An Ingredient Processing Score examines how individual ingredients relate to product processing levels. The authors note that nutrition facts cannot capture every change caused by processing and provide GroceryDB and a tool for finding less processed alternatives publicly.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its graphics features. VirtualLink uses a single USB-C connector for VR headsets, while NVLink increases bandwidth for two-way SLI on supported GPUs. Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests; hybrid rendering combines ray tracing with rasterization, and denoising reduces the rays needed per pixel.

Turing Tensor Cores support NGX AI features, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and resolution upscaling. Other features include mesh shading to reduce CPU draw-call bottlenecks, variable-rate and texture-space shading to manage shading work, and multi-view rendering for VR and other uses. The passage also outlines the TU104 and TU106 GPUs and introduces RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering.
CTP N.V. published a slide deck for its Analyst/Investor Day. The page also includes Seeking Alpha transcript-team information and article links.

A self-driving Uber SUV struck and killed 49-year-old Elaine Herzberg in Tempe, Arizona, while she was walking a bicycle outside a crosswalk. The vehicle was in autonomous mode with a backup driver behind the wheel. Uber suspended its autonomous road tests in four cities, and local and federal investigators are examining the crash. Police have not determined fault. The death, described as the first involving a fully autonomous test vehicle, has raised questions about safety and regulation.

After Willie Tyler’s obstruction-of-justice convictions were vacated because of legal errors, the district court denied his motions to dismiss the indictment before retrial. It held that testimony about a statement by the murder victim could be admitted without violating the Confrontation Clause because it would not be offered for its truth. The court also held that double jeopardy did not bar retrial after convictions were vacated for legal error. Tyler’s due process claims failed because he had not established prosecutorial misconduct warranting dismissal or prejudice from the delayed disclosure of evidence.

NVIDIA reported $6.70 billion in revenue for the quarter ended July 31, 2022, up 3% year over year, while net income fell 72% to $656 million. Data Center revenue rose 61%, but Gaming revenue fell 33%. Gross margin declined to 43.5%, primarily due to $1.34 billion in inventory-related and warranty charges. NVIDIA also recorded a $1.35 billion cost in the first quarter following the termination of its planned Arm acquisition. It repurchased $3.35 billion of shares during the quarter and disclosed new U.S. export license requirements for certain products shipped to China and Russia.

From 1961 to 1962, the Special Group (Augmented) oversaw Operation Mongoose, a covert program aimed at overthrowing Castro. Kennedy also created a separate group to set broad counterinsurgency policy. In 1964, the Special Group 5412 became the 303 Committee without changing its responsibilities. It reviewed some covert actions, but the 1976 Church Committee reported that most CIA projects were not considered individually.

Under Nixon, approved covert actions became subject to annual review, and the approval body was renamed the 40 Committee. It focused on major projects, though Nixon directed a covert effort against Chilean President Allende without its approval. The 1974 Hughes-Ryan amendment required a presidential finding and notification to Congress before appropriated funds could be spent on a covert action.

The lecture examines security attacks through their economic incentives, focusing on spam. Sending spam is cheap despite very low click and purchase rates, so defenses may help by raising attackers’ costs. A case study of text-message spam in China illustrates how low operating costs, limited penalties, and carrier revenue can sustain it.

The spam ecosystem has three stages: advertising messages, supporting links with DNS and web servers, and processing purchases. Attackers use botnets, compromised accounts, redirects, and distributed infrastructure to evade filtering and takedowns. CAPTCHAs can be solved cheaply, while stricter checks can inconvenience legitimate users.

Payment processing may offer a stronger point of intervention because relatively few banks serve spammers. Chargeback penalties encourage spammers to classify transactions accurately and deliver purchased goods. After researchers studied these transactions, Visa tightened some policies. The lecture also discusses the ethical questions raised by test purchases and companies’ legally contested efforts to disrupt botnets themselves.

Hurricane Helene severely flooded four western North Carolina schools in September 2024. Atkinson Elementary reopened that December after students temporarily attended the Boys & Girls Club. Old Fort Elementary reopened for the 2025–26 school year after repairs and a year at a nearby school. Valle Crucis students remain in temporary locations while construction of a new school is delayed. Micaville Elementary closed permanently, and the district is expanding other schools to accommodate students. District leaders described ongoing drainage, infrastructure and funding concerns, alongside efforts to improve emergency communication and flood resilience.

Children’s access to phones varies across countries. One family found that few of their daughter’s Berlin classmates owned phones, while she was the only child without a smartphone in her California fourth-grade class. Studies cited in the passage report smartphone ownership among 46% of surveyed European children ages 9 to 16 and 45% of US children ages 10 to 12. Rates also differ across South Korea, Taiwan and African countries. The American Academy of Pediatrics says there is no single right age for a child’s first phone. It recommends limits on young children’s screen time and keeping meals and the hour before bedtime screen-free.

Anglogold Ashanti shares fell 0.35% in the most recent session and closed at $11.24. Four analysts’ 12-month price targets average $13.89, ranging from $11.50 to $16.91. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation is 2. Its 14-period ATR is 0.33, RSI is 56.57, and market capitalization is $4.66 billion. In the previous session, 2.91 million shares traded, near the 2.92 million average.

Chongqing’s online tax systems let residents and businesses submit documents, complete property-tax procedures and pay taxes without repeated office visits. Nearly 90 percent of businesses in the city’s nine central districts use the property-tax system, which has cut average waits from 83 to 15 minutes. The bureau says almost 95 percent of transactions can be completed online, and more than 1.2 million people have paid taxes by mobile phone this year.

The coach said his team lost the first two playoff games against New Jersey despite seeking favorable matchups and had not played its best. A player challenged the team to respond. At home, the team skated better, managed the puck more effectively and channeled its emotions more productively. The coach praised several players’ contributions but stressed that one better game did not settle the series.

U.S. stocks rose modestly on Friday despite a prolonged federal shutdown that has delayed key economic reports. Technology and growth shares led gains, while investors relied on private data and watched stalled congressional negotiations. Analysts said continued shutdown uncertainty could increase volatility, with next week’s market direction likely to depend on progress toward a resolution.

Kinder Morgan plans to resume dividend increases after cutting its dividend during the oil downturn. The passage says the company has reduced debt and intends to fund dividends and growth projects through internally generated cash rather than new debt or equity. Its extensive North American pipeline and terminal network supports a backlog of mostly fee-based projects. The author views these plans favorably but says investors should watch whether Kinder Morgan delivers the promised dividend increases and continues its growth plan.

Hong introduces quantum field theory as the study of quantum dynamics of fields, including the description of photons and quantum electrodynamics. The course develops fundamental concepts before later courses focus on techniques. He advises students to strengthen their quantum mechanics, connect formalism to physical questions, and build intuition through problem sets.

The lecture then introduces locality: interactions propagate between neighboring points rather than acting at a distance. Fields assign dynamical variables to points in space, and local equations, such as Maxwell’s equations, involve fields and their derivatives at the same point. Hong extends the action principle from mechanics to classical fields, defining a Lagrangian density, canonical momentum density, Hamiltonian density, and equations of motion obtained by varying the action. He gives Maxwell theory, Einstein gravity, and scalar fields as examples. For a scalar field, a quadratic potential leads to the Klein–Gordon equation; more complicated potentials can produce nonlinear equations.

President Trump said the U.S. will add a 100% tariff on China and restrict exports of critical software starting November 1, or sooner if China takes further action. The tariff would raise the total rate to 130%. His announcement followed China’s new rare-earth export restrictions. The S&P 500 fell 2.7% as trade tensions intensified.

The passage presents a quantum framework for generalized linear model sparsification. It constructs a small weighted subset that approximately preserves the loss for all solutions in a specified range. Using multiscale leverage-score estimates and quantum importance sampling, the algorithm gives speedups in the number of data points over classical methods for suitable loss functions. Applications include linear, multiple, ridge, lasso, Huber, ℓp, and γp regression.

Tesla Motors reported that it released its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2016, in a shareholder letter posted on its website on August 3, 2016. The letter is attached to its Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Jason Wheeler.

Snowy plover nests have been spotted at Clatsop Spit for the first time in decades, three years after a half-mile beach area was designated for the species. Biologists say the sighting connects western Washington and northern Oregon populations.

Monster Hunter World’s monsters, character models and environments are detailed, but weak contrast, clipping and motion blur detract from its presentation. Digital Foundry found disappointing performance on the base PS4 and Xbox One, with the Xbox One faring worse. On PS4 Pro and Xbox One X, results vary by mode: the Pro generally performs better in Resolution mode, while the One X performs better in Frame-rate and Graphics modes. Some distant visual assets are missing on the One X outside Graphics mode. The passage concludes that, despite enjoyable gameplay, the game’s visuals and performance are technically disappointing.

The Flex offense uses continuous baseline and down screens to create open shots while keeping two rebounders on the weakside. Its “pick the picker” action combines a baseline cut with a down screen, then repeats after ball reversal. Options include corner passes, post isolation, back cuts against overplay, and lob passes. High-post rub, shuffle-cut, and dribble-clear actions can initiate the offense. A “pop” variation lets a cutter move to the elbow for a shot. Offensive rebounders are urged to anticipate misses, get inside, and make repeated efforts.

The Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game against the Texans because of a hamstring injury. Cooper Rush will make his first start for Baltimore, which is 1-3 and has ruled out several other players. The Ravens are 4-10 without Jackson since 2018.

Early tests of Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme on a reference laptop showed strong multi-core and integrated graphics performance. Its Cinebench multi-core score was 62% higher than the base Apple M4’s, though its single-core score remained behind the M4. Graphics benchmarks also exceeded results for Intel Lunar Lake and the M4, but gaming compatibility remains a concern. The tested chip is the top-tier model; the standard X2 Elite was not tested. Performance in smaller laptops and everyday applications remains unverified.

Trump told young TikTok users they “owe me big” for helping keep the app available in the U.S., despite having pushed to ban it during his first presidency. A 2024 law requires TikTok to sell its U.S. operations or face a ban. Trump has since approved a proposed sale to an American consortium, though the deal remains pending.
The court granted Denny Jenkins a belated appeal of his October 5, 2015, judgment and sentence. The trial court must appoint appellate counsel if he qualifies.

Cynthia Nixon announced her candidacy for New York governor on March 19, 2018. The actress and activist plans to challenge incumbent Andrew Cuomo and says her campaign will not accept corporate contributions.

DSS Consulting reorganized into regional, cross-functional teams to develop new services and reach larger school districts. Chris Peterson assembled a cohesive Southwest Region team that developed an integrated budgeting and planning system for small districts. The team completed a product ready for beta testing despite limited support from DSS specialists.

In an update, Meg Cooke praised Chris’s leadership but asked about regional demand, other teams’ services, and the system’s appeal to larger districts. Chris said her team had focused on its project, had not yet surveyed the region, and might need to expand the system for larger districts. Meg later cancelled the project, citing limited capacity for new products, lack of reported interest from other regions, and doubts about large-district demand. She said Chris’s team would focus on marketing rather than product development and asked whether Chris wanted to lead it or return to the IT practice group.

A December 2000 McKinsey memorandum surveys electric-power privatization and restructuring from June through November 2000 across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa. It reports expanding competition, utility unbundling and foreign investment, though progress varies by country. European markets are consolidating as they liberalize; Asian governments are resuming reforms after the economic crisis; Latin American privatizations face currency and drought-related pressures; and many African and Middle Eastern countries are opening generation to independent producers.

The October 12, 2000 VentureWire reports that Weiss Peck & Greer Venture Partners became Lightspeed Venture Partners and closed a $1 billion fund. Mayfield, Palm and Delphi formed MobileAria to develop hands-free wireless Internet services for cars, while Nth Power raised a $120.5 million energy fund. ThoughtWorks raised $28 million; Kozmo.com and Urbanfetch.com ended merger talks; and MaMaMedia cut staff while seeking financing. The issue also covers other funding rounds, acquisitions, executive appointments and venture capital fund news.

A study of 24,849 U.S. patients with soft-tissue sarcoma, including heart cancer, used SEER data from 2000–2018 to examine survival and develop prediction nomograms. Survival differed by sarcoma type: myxofibrosarcoma had the highest reported survival rate and spindle cell sarcoma the lowest. Older age and advanced cancer stage were associated with higher mortality. Surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy were associated with better survival, while findings for primary systemic therapy conflicted. The authors noted missing clinical details and said the nomograms require validation in other cohorts.

Canada’s S&P/TSX composite fell 85.80 points to 16,335.15 Thursday, retreating from a record high amid trade fears and a 2.11 per cent drop in energy stocks. Investors expected OPEC to increase production, pressuring oil prices. Mining stocks also declined, while cannabis stocks lifted the health-care index. U.S. markets closed lower, and the Canadian dollar slipped to 75.13 cents US.

After riders reported needles on BART trains, including one woman who said a syringe pricked her, BART announced it would add five members to its 14-person rapid response cleaning team. The agency also plans to launch mobile reporting for bio-hazards. BART received 10 train-cleanliness complaints in the previous two weeks.
The court struck the respondent’s answer in a mandamus case because it was filed one day late.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on October 23, 2019, reporting that it had issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2019. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1.

Queensland’s cyclone season remains active, with weather models showing possible low-pressure systems near the Gulf of Carpentaria and Coral Sea ahead of Easter. The Bureau of Meteorology says their development remains uncertain and expects the Coral Sea low to stay well offshore. The Sunshine Coast is forecast to have increasing showers and south-easterly winds over the coming days.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on November 2, 2017, announcing a press release and data sheet on its fourth-quarter financial results for the period ended September 30, 2017. The documents are attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2.

The speaker describes the nation’s recovery after the Great War and urges it to learn from its history while maintaining independence and helping other countries. He favors a defensive military, arms limits, international consultation, arbitration, and participation in the Permanent Court of International Justice, while avoiding foreign political entanglements. He argues that lasting peace also requires economic opportunity and a shared desire for peace.

At home, he calls for responsible party government, protection of constitutional institutions, obedience to law, reduced public spending, and lower, reformed taxes. He supports private ownership, praises improving employment and transportation, and notes that agriculture has recovered slowly. He closes by affirming tolerance, religious freedom, and the pursuit of peace, prosperity, and justice.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on August 24, 2022, announcing results for the quarter ended July 31, 2022. It furnished a press release and commentary by CFO Colette M. Kress as exhibits. The company stated that these materials are not deemed filed under the specified securities laws.

Rep. Trey Gowdy said he saw no evidence that the FBI planted a spy in Trump’s 2016 campaign. After a Justice Department and FBI briefing, he said the agency acted appropriately on information it received. Trump has called reports about a government informant “spygate,” while his legal team has sought classified information about the investigation’s origins.

Australian business investment grew 0.4 per cent in the first quarter, below the expected 1 per cent. Buildings and structures investment fell, while equipment investment rose. Next year’s $87.7 billion spending estimate remained below forecasts.

The lecture examines lightweight natural structures. Iris and cattail leaves, sea kelp, bird skulls, cuttlefish shells, and horseshoe crab and tortoise shells have sandwich-like layers that reduce material use while providing mechanical support; some also aid buoyancy. Tests of iris leaves produced stiffness estimates in the same order of magnitude as measurements. The lecture also describes palm stems, which develop thicker cell walls and denser tissue toward their outer edge as they grow. Using measured properties, the professor calculated that this density gradient makes a stem 2.5 times stiffer than a uniform-density stem of the same mass.

The lecture proves Cantor’s theorem that every set has smaller cardinality than its power set. It then introduces ordered sets, upper and lower bounds, supremum, infimum, and the least upper bound property as preparation for describing the real numbers. The integers have this property, but the rational numbers do not: the set of positive rational numbers whose squares are less than 2 has no rational supremum. The lecture begins proving that any such supremum would have to square to 2 and leaves the proof’s completion for the next lecture.

The study evaluates temperature scaling as a post-training calibration method for brain-tumor classification from MRI scans. A lightweight CNN trained on a composite dataset, and later a ResNet50 model, were tested with Gaussian, Poisson, salt-and-pepper, speckle, and uniform noise. The reported results generally show lower negative log-likelihood and expected calibration error after calibration, while classification performance remains largely stable. Some individual conditions, including the clean baseline, show mixed metric changes. The authors propose further testing on larger datasets and comparisons with other calibration methods.

This case study examined how two middle grades teacher candidates used translanguaging during a year-long student-teaching experience and how their ESL coursework prepared them. Both valued multilingual students’ languages and felt they had learned useful strategies, but struggled to apply translanguaging in their classrooms. Their cooperating teachers rarely modeled its use, and both candidates finished feeling unprepared to fully meet multilingual learners’ needs. The authors identify a gap between coursework and classroom practice and recommend translanguaging training for cooperating teachers, alongside further research focused on middle grades.

This introductory industrial organization lecture links theory with empirical work and begins with monopoly pricing. A single-product monopolist sets marginal revenue equal to marginal cost, with its markup determined by demand elasticity. Monopoly can create deadweight loss and may raise concerns about production, quality, rent seeking, and transfers from consumers.

For firms selling multiple products, pricing must account for how a price change affects sales of other products: substitutes can support higher markups, while complements can lead to below-cost pricing. The lecture compares a monopolist’s choice of product quality, based on the marginal consumer, with a social planner’s choice, based on average benefits.

It then examines durable goods. Although a monopolist with commitment power would not lower prices to sell to later buyers in the model presented, an inability to commit can produce falling prices and lower profits. Finally, information-design examples show how controlling what consumers learn about a product can change prices, profits, and consumer surplus.

The speaker says the team had an extra day with family and practiced well. Although they sometimes struggled to start regular-season games with focus, the speaker says that is no longer an issue in the playoffs.

George Herbert and two friends recovered a bicycle after confronting a suspected thief in central Bristol on Sunday evening. Herbert has reported the incident to police and is keeping the white mountain bike while they try to find its owner. Anyone claiming it must provide a matching description or photo.

RDRAND and RDSEED read hardware-generated values through relatively slow MMIO access. For latency-sensitive applications, seeding a software PRNG with a hardware value can improve performance and security. The AMD Secure RNG library simplifies access to the hardware generator in AMD Zen processors.

Cboe began offering bitcoin futures on Sunday, marking the first trading of a bitcoin-backed security on a government-regulated exchange. The contracts let investors bet on bitcoin’s price without owning it. Bitcoin rose above $16,000 after trading began, while next-month futures traded above $18,000. The launch followed sharp price swings and renewed warnings of a bubble.

NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2021 revenue of $4.73 billion, up 57% year over year, and net income of $1.34 billion, up 49%. Gaming and Data Center revenue rose to $2.27 billion and $1.90 billion, respectively. NVIDIA completed its $7.13 billion Mellanox acquisition in April 2020; Mellanox contributed 13% of quarterly revenue. NVIDIA also agreed to acquire Arm in a transaction valued at $40 billion, subject to closing conditions. The company said stronger work-from-home demand benefited Gaming and Data Center, while the COVID-19 pandemic continued to pose supply and demand risks.

Ford began exploring electric vehicles soon after its founding but repeatedly shelved projects. It later expanded EV investment plans and launched the Mustang Mach-E, F-150 Lightning, and E-Transit. Facing weaker consumer enthusiasm and competitor pricing pressure, Ford delayed $12 billion in planned EV investment in 2023.

Ford separately reported its Model e EV business for the first time in its 2023 full-year results. Model e’s loss before interest and taxes rose from $0.9 billion in 2021 to $4.7 billion in 2023. Ford’s 2023 R&D expense was $8.2 billion. Under U.S. GAAP, R&D costs are expensed as incurred; under IFRS, qualifying development costs can be capitalized and expensed later.

HCPEA named Dr. Terry Woodward its next president. A director since 2014, Woodward co-founded Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s healthcare private equity practice in 2009. The nonprofit association says its members manage more than $1 trillion in assets and have started over 1,500 healthcare businesses. It will hold its inaugural Healthcare Forum in June in Park City, Utah.

North American cannabis stocks fell sharply during the week: the North American Marijuana Index lost 27.2 percent, the United States Marijuana Index dropped 18.1 percent, and two cannabis ETFs declined. Investor Alan Brochstein cited Canadian stock offerings, concerns about Aphria’s purchase of Nuuvera, and selling in speculative U.S. stocks. The passage also reports financing by MassRoots and ABCANN, the DOJA–Tokyo Smoke merger, iAnthus’s acquisition of Citiva, and the launch of a cannabis-focused venture fund.

Billionaire investor Jeff Greene says low interest rates have helped sustain the long-running stock market rally and that rising rates, potentially driven by new fiscal policies, could slow the economy and threaten gains. He argues cheap borrowing has benefited investors more than tax cuts would. Although Trump’s policy promises helped lift markets to records, Greene says weak economic growth does not justify substantially higher rates and expects rates to rise slowly.

The UAE said its first reactor at the Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant would begin operating in late 2019 or early 2020, a further delay for the Arab world’s first atomic power station. All four reactors are under construction. Once operational, they are expected to supply about 25 percent of the UAE’s electricity needs.

Divergence trading compares price swings with indicators to identify possible shifts in momentum. Classical bullish divergence occurs when price makes a lower low while an indicator makes a higher low; classical bearish divergence reverses that pattern. Hidden divergence generally appears during trend pullbacks and may signal continuation. Common indicators include RSI, MACD, the Stochastic Oscillator, and CCI. The passage recommends confirming signals with other analysis, managing risk, and backtesting before trading. Its SPY backtest reported favorable results across several settings, but noted relatively few trades and possible curve fitting.

The Tenth Circuit affirmed the dismissal of Charles A. Meeker’s § 1983 complaint arising from a child abuse investigation and the transfer of custody of his four daughters. Prior unsuccessful suits barred his claims against most defendants, and the guardian ad litem was not acting under color of state law. The court also held that Meeker, appearing without an attorney, could not represent his minor daughters.

For the UC1825B-SP, TI recommends short, thick power traces, closely placed power components, and ground planes to reduce EMI and noise. Switching-current loops should run in the same direction in both power states. The output stages require a designated power-ground area; VCC should be bypassed to power ground, while VREF and analog circuitry should be bypassed to signal ground. The passage also provides documentation and support information, ESD precautions, packaging notes, and disclaimers stating that product information and resources may change and are provided without warranty.

The Missouri Court of Appeals affirmed summary judgment for the Bank of St. Louis and its employees in Harvey Euge’s malicious-prosecution suit. Although Euge’s bogus-check conviction had been reversed because the check was drawn on an existing, funded account, the court held that the reversal did not eliminate probable cause for the prosecution. Euge did not dispute the underlying facts or show that the conviction resulted from false testimony or other improper means.

On May 29, 1865, President Andrew Johnson appointed William W. Holden provisional governor of North Carolina to help loyal residents restore a republican state government and its constitutional relationship with the United States. Holden was to arrange a convention of loyal delegates to amend the state constitution. Delegates and those electing them had to take the presidential amnesty oath and meet North Carolina’s pre-secession voter qualifications. Johnson directed military and naval personnel to assist without obstructing the effort and ordered federal departments and courts to resume applicable operations in the state.

The passage introduces video object segmentation-aware audio generation, which lets users select a video object for sound synthesis. Its SAGANet model adds a control module to pretrained MMAudio, combining global video context with a detailed view of the selected object. The authors also introduce Segmented Music Solos, a dataset of instrument performances with segmentation masks. In their evaluation, SAGANet trained on single-instrument videos generated audio for selected instruments in multi-instrument scenes and improved semantic and temporal alignment over the base model.

Britain’s FTSE 100 rose 0.6 percent on Monday, recovering from a three-month low as banks and miners gained. Mid caps rose 0.8 percent. TUI reached a record high after a broker upgrade, while downgrades weighed on Experian and G4S. Weaker oil prices limited the FTSE’s gains.

A senior Iranian Revolutionary Guards commander said the Guards were ready to prevent regional oil exports if US pressure stopped Iranian oil sales, endorsing President Hassan Rouhani’s apparent threat to disrupt neighbouring countries’ shipments. After withdrawing from the 2015 nuclear deal, Washington told countries to halt Iranian oil imports by Nov. 4 or face financial measures. An Iranian oil official said the pressure would raise global prices and hurt US consumers. Rouhani said Iran would remain in the deal if the other signatories guaranteed its benefits. Their foreign ministers were due to meet Iranian officials in Vienna on Friday.

Tom Petty died at 66 after a cardiac arrest, but his cause of death was deferred pending further tests. His family removed life support after learning he had no brain activity. Musicians and fans paid tribute to the Heartbreakers and Traveling Wilburys member.

The court held that David Lewis illegally withdrew $505.58 from his mother’s bank account after her death. Although he claimed she owed him money, he could not satisfy that claim by taking estate assets; he must present it through the succession proceedings. The court reversed the dismissal and awarded the executor $505.58 plus interest and costs, but found the rent claim unproved.

The passage presents an ontology-based method for robots to compare alternative plans and explain their differences. It extends an existing ontology to represent plan cost, expected duration and number of tasks, then uses logical rules to infer when one plan is better. Its ACXON algorithm generates contrastive narratives by selecting divergent knowledge at varying levels of detail. In an evaluation involving 30 pairs of plans, ACXON generally used less knowledge and produced narratives requiring less time to communicate than the baseline. Detailed narratives remained lengthy, prompting a proposed refinement to select knowledge more narrowly.

A study of 27,500 middle-aged and older UK Biobank participants linked poorer self-reported sleep to brains that appeared older on MRI scans. Each one-point drop in a healthy sleep score corresponded to about six months of additional apparent brain age; people with poor sleep averaged one year older. Low-grade inflammation explained just over 10% of the association. The researchers noted that self-reported sleep and the UK Biobank’s healthier-than-average participants limit the findings.

The Directorate General of Goods and Services Tax Intelligence has reportedly demanded over Rs 6,000 crore from banks for services provided to customers who maintain minimum balances. The retrospective demand covers more than five years and values those services using charges imposed on customers who fall below the minimum. Banks are likely to challenge it; if upheld, they may pass the cost to customers.

The author argues that recurring Treasury liquidity patterns help explain the saying “Sell in May and come back in November.” The passage links a relatively consistent May stock-market boost to tax refunds and a less consistent November boost to Treasury buybacks. It suggests that 2018 tax changes and a market retrace could strengthen the May effect, while acknowledging that the size of these effects varies and that the February and November patterns need more research.

The RSPCA investigated 2,902 animal-cruelty complaints in Nottinghamshire in 2017, about eight a day and roughly eight percent fewer than in 2016. Most reports concerned dogs, followed by cats and horses. Cases included two kittens beaten to death by their owner, who was jailed for 20 weeks, and 40 animals found in stacked cages without food or water. The charity urged the public to keep reporting concerns.

Weak gravitational lensing constrains cosmology, but uncertainties in galaxy intrinsic alignments and baryonic feedback limit its precision. Focusing on intrinsic alignments, the paper introduces a simulation pipeline that applies several alignment models to the same N-body simulation and produces cosmic shear catalogues and maps. It uses these outputs to validate two-point shear correlations and study how alignment models and source clustering affect non-Gaussian lensing statistics.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2019, reports quarterly revenue of $6.30 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $143 million. For the first nine months of 2019, revenue was $17.19 billion and the net loss attributable to common stockholders was $967 million. At September 30, Tesla reported $5.34 billion in cash and cash equivalents and $32.80 billion in total assets. The filing also describes its adoption of new lease accounting rules and its acquisition of Maxwell Technologies.

At a ceremony for the signing of a declaration of principles on interim Palestinian self-government, the speaker praises Israeli and Palestinian leaders for pursuing reconciliation after decades of conflict. The speech recalls the Camp David accords and Madrid negotiations, thanks Norway for helping foster the agreement, and pledges U.S. support for its implementation. It acknowledges the difficult work ahead and urges both sides to build security, cooperation and a peaceful future for their children.

Oil fell below US$56 a barrel after an industry report showed U.S. crude inventories rose by 9.9 million barrels, raising doubts that production cuts have tightened supply. OPEC achieved over 90 per cent compliance with its cuts in January, but rising U.S. stocks and output limited price gains. A stronger U.S. dollar also pressured oil.

The paper presents a uniform method for finding codensity presentations of monads. Its main theorem shows that a dual adjunction, a dense functor, and a suitable equivalence yield a codensity presentation, reducing many proofs to established density and duality results. The method recovers presentations for ultrafilter, Vietoris, and probability monads and produces new ones for filter, lower Vietoris, and expectation monads. For probability monads, identifying the required dual adjunction relies on representation theorems. The authors propose extending the framework to monad extensions and applying it to further Vietoris-type monads.

The passage commemorates Henry Clay’s nearly fifty years in public life, including service in Congress and as secretary of state. It credits his eloquence and efforts at compromise with helping address the War of 1812, Missouri’s admission, Nullification, and disputes over slavery in newly acquired territory. The speaker describes Clay as devoted to liberty and preserving the Union. Although Clay owned slaves, he supported gradual emancipation in Kentucky and the American Colonization Society.

Restoration Affiliates (RA) was founded in 2011 by four independent restoration companies seeking to serve customers nationwide and share resources during catastrophes while retaining local expertise. By fall 2013, it had 21 members with combined revenue of $300 million. Its equal-shareholder structure emphasized cooperation, referrals and service quality. ARS founder Rich Piltch saw RA as a way to meet customers’ growing demand for national coverage without becoming solely a referral company.

A three-year nationwide contract with Forest City Enterprises demonstrated RA’s potential. Members still needed to resolve questions about oversight, communication systems, consistent service and pricing, competing disaster-planning software, referral fees, overlapping territories and marketing.
The passage collects quotes criticizing taxation, banks’ control of debt, and corporate tax breaks. It also questions patriotism and says education shapes perception while mistakes offer lessons.

Kingston Police charged a 14-year-old girl with mischief after she damaged her grandmother’s home during an outburst over a phone that was not working. Police caught her after a foot chase and released her to her mother with conditions and a court date.

On January 30, 2017, Microsoft entered an underwriting agreement to issue $17 billion in senior unsecured notes across seven series, with interest rates from 1.850% to 4.500% and maturities from 2020 to 2057. Interest is payable semiannually beginning August 6, 2017. The notes will rank equally with Microsoft’s other unsecured, unsubordinated debt.

Harvard Law School visiting professor Carlos Portugal Gouvêa was arrested Oct. 1 after firing a pellet gun near a Jewish temple during a Yom Kippur service. He told police he was hunting rats. The temple locked down, and he was charged with several offenses, including property damage. Harvard placed him on administrative leave. Police and synagogue officials said they did not believe antisemitism was a factor.

Jacob Hackin became the first person prosecuted for dog fouling in a Cambridge park after failing to clear up after his dog at Midsummer Common and not paying a fixed penalty notice. He pleaded guilty and was ordered to pay a £75 fine, £125 in council costs and a £30 victim surcharge.

Kelly Keefe will become ERC’s president on Jan. 1, the first woman to lead the organization in its 97-year history. Keefe, currently vice president of training, consulting, and coaching services, will succeed Pat Perry, who will remain chairman.

The passage describes a virtual object machine learning system that generates labeled training images from rigged 3D models. By varying poses, textures, backgrounds, lighting, and camera angles, it creates images with tracked key points for training classifiers to recognize objects and their gestures or poses. The system may operate within a messaging application, where classifications of captured images or videos can inform media overlays. The passage also describes the messaging system’s content storage, collections, temporary access controls, and supporting software and hardware architecture.

At Kevin Mallory’s espionage trial, prosecutors alleged that the former CIA case officer gave a Chinese agent classified information, including details about human assets, for $25,000. They said investigators found undeclared cash after a Shanghai trip, incriminating phone messages and classified documents on discs at his home. Mallory’s lawyers said he intended to feed the Chinese false documents and expose their intelligence operation. Two witnesses testified that he contacted CIA associates about the Chinese offer before the airport inspection that prosecutors said prompted his cover story. Mallory faces up to life in prison.

Sen. John McCain criticized President Trump’s approval of the GOP-Nunes memo’s release, calling it a partisan attack on the FBI and Justice Department that could deepen divisions. The memo alleges FBI surveillance abuses in its investigation of former Trump adviser Carter Page. Democrats called for the release of their own memo.

*Upgrade* follows Grey Trace, a man left paralyzed after a violent attack, who receives an experimental processor called STEM. It restores his movement and gives him mechanical precision, which he uses to pursue revenge. The review praises the film’s science-fiction ideas, action and portrayal of artificial intelligence’s dangers. It finds the central mystery predictable and suggests the story needed more development, but considers the film highly entertaining despite its graphic violence.

The message reports correspondence with Hawaiian agents and describes the islands’ importance to Pacific shipping, especially American vessels. It supports Hawaii’s independence, opposes any foreign takeover, and recommends funding a U.S. consul there.

It also discusses a British treaty opening four Chinese ports to British merchants, while leaving American access unresolved. Citing growing U.S.–China trade, the message recommends funding a commissioner in China to protect American citizens and pursue contact with Chinese authorities.

The US Department of State advised citizens against surgery in Azerbaijan and urged them to bring sufficient prescription medicine. Azerbaijani Health Ministry spokesperson Safaya Ahmadova said the advice did not reflect the country’s healthcare, citing foreign patients treated there. She also disputed the department’s tuberculosis report, saying Azerbaijan’s figures decline yearly.

Thabane Sigadla, 24, received an effective 38-year prison sentence for two carjackings and possession of an unlicensed firearm and ammunition. Police arrested him after a June 2017 hijacking in New Germany.

Nanyang Polytechnic researchers have developed a process that uses bacteria to turn coffee waste into PHA, a biodegradable plastic. By genetically modifying the bacteria and using cheaper, more environmentally friendly solvents, they obtained roughly 1g to 3g of pure PHA from 100g of coffee waste. The team has completed laboratory experiments and is seeking industrial partners, with hopes of commercialising the process in three to five years.

AI-Noether proposes an abductive reasoning method for reconciling scientific formulae with incomplete background theory when both are expressible as polynomial equations. It decomposes the equations’ solution space and tests candidate missing axioms to determine whether they make a formula derivable, without requiring data for those axioms. Tests on physical theories recovered nearly all individually removed axioms; recovery was less reliable when two or three axioms were missing. The authors propose extending the method beyond polynomial laws.

The Iowa Supreme Court held that Gary Kehde could seek judicial review of his unemployment claim without first requesting an administrative rehearing. It also held that Dubuque Packing Company’s withdrawal of its protest did not change the facts determining his eligibility. Although the record did not establish that Kehde knew the company rule, substantial evidence showed that his possession of a lit marijuana cigarette on company premises constituted misconduct. The court reversed the district court’s award of benefits and remanded the case.

A regulation American football field is 120 yards long and 53.3 yards wide, including two 10-yard end zones separated by 100 yards of open field. Goal lines mark the end zones; yard lines and numbers help track progress, while hash marks guide ball placement. Hash-mark spacing and number placement vary among NFL, college and high school fields. Sideline boundaries define the field and help keep people clear of play. To score a touchdown, the ball must cross the goal line; catches in the end zone require control and at least one foot in bounds, or two in the NFL.

At the 2018 IMF/World Bank Spring Meetings, an IMF official praised Ghana’s “Ghana beyond Aid” vision and economic performance. Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta outlined plans to increase domestic revenue and invest in job creation and higher incomes.

Industry-sponsored clinical trials have become increasingly complex, adding burdens for participants and staff. Merck tested a “Lean Design” approach in workshops on six trial protocols, rebuilding schedules of assessment from essential elements and questioning additional tests, their timing, and sample sizes. Faro software estimated the effects of proposed changes on time, cost, and complexity. Recommendations could reduce participant time by 4–47 hours per trial; one cardiovascular trial had a projected saving of nearly $120 million. Teams adopted only some changes, partly because protocols were already in late development. Merck subsequently began applying the approach across therapeutic areas, while noting that its results need testing at other companies.

A broker sued a prospective purchaser for a commission after unsuccessfully negotiating a property purchase. Another broker obtained an offer the purchaser accepted. Because the plaintiff neither brought about the sale nor proved a special agreement requiring the purchaser to pay a commission, the judgment for the plaintiff was reversed and a new trial granted.

Patient advocacy groups asked the U.K.’s antitrust regulator to investigate drugmakers and their lobbying group over alleged coordination to raise medicine prices. The passage also flags fourth-quarter biotech events and a U.S. government shutdown expected to furlough more than 32,000 HHS employees.

A March 2018 test of 124 VPN and proxy providers found that 20 leaked users’ IP addresses through WebRTC, while 101 kept them hidden. The passage says the list is incomplete and recommends testing unlisted services. If a leak occurs, users can disable WebRTC in their browser or install an add-on. It also lists services reported to prevent WebRTC leaks, including ExpressVPN, NordVPN and StrongVPN.

MoviePass offers subscribers a movie ticket per day for $6.95 a month with a yearlong commitment, despite reported service problems. The company says its ticket purchases represented 13.21% of *Roman J. Israel, Esq.*’s domestic opening-weekend box office and 10% of *Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri*’s. It also reported higher shares in the second week for several films. MoviePass has signed a marketing and revenue agreement with an independent distributor whose identity it has not disclosed. Its parent company has said it plans to use subscriber viewing data to target marketing.

In a reappraisement appeal concerning Christmas tree ornaments imported from Germany, the court relied on stipulated similarities to an earlier Woolworth case. It held that the ornaments’ dutiable values were their unit invoice prices plus 3% social assessments and, when applicable, packing and shipment-preparation costs reported as dutiable. The appeal concerning other merchandise was dismissed.

MRC Vaudreuil-Soulanges officials reassured residents that locally collected recyclables remain valued despite a global recycling crisis caused by China’s stricter import standards. The MRC sends about 17,000 tonnes of recyclables to Tricentris, which says it is improving material quality and diversifying its markets. Officials urged residents to keep recycling and sort materials carefully, pointing them to the MRC’s online sorting tool.

Molecular dynamics simulations of niobium at 300 K compared radiation damage from 1–75 keV collisions using four interatomic potentials. Surviving defects increased with collision energy, and cascades began splitting into subcascades around 20 keV. Vacancies clustered more than interstitials. The potentials predicted different damage morphologies: EAM produced a mix of loops and rings, FS-2 favored large 1/2⟨111⟩ loops, and FS-1 and SNAP produced more compact C15-like structures.

Asteroid 2025 TF, estimated at 1 to 3 meters wide, passed 428 km above Antarctica on October 1. The Catalina Sky Survey detected it hours later, and ESA astronomers used follow-up observations to determine its trajectory precisely. The asteroid posed no danger; tracking close passes like this helps scientists improve detection and prediction systems.

The passage describes a non-occluding intravascular blood pump designed to reduce blood-cell damage from shear stress. Its motor-driven impeller sits inside a shroud supported by pillars. Proposed features include a flared inlet, a longer inlet and impeller hub, revised blade geometry, and pillars aligned with outgoing flow. Simulations and tests identified stress hotspots and guided successive prototypes. The improved design reduced predicted shear stress and hemolytic potential while maintaining hydraulic output. At the desired operating speed of 20,000 rpm, its measured normalized index of hemolysis improved by 78% compared with the initial design.

Live Nation is offering $20 all-in tickets to more than 1,500 shows during National Concert Week, April 30 through May 8. More than 1.5 million tickets across various genres will be available on its website.

Winning the first game builds confidence and forces the other team to adjust. The break after the San Jose win allowed time to enjoy it and was not a disadvantage. A day-to-day player remains valuable for faceoffs and penalty killing. The speaker expects a tough matchup but emphasizes reaching the team’s potential.

Horsell Lodge near Woking provides short-term respite, long-term residential and dementia care tailored to residents’ histories. Residents may bring personal possessions. Prospective residents are advised to check its suitability; the home supplied the service information.

A Federal High Court in Katsina ordered former Governor Ibrahim Shema held in EFCC custody until April 27, when it will hear his bail application. Shema pleaded not guilty to 26 fraud-related counts involving the alleged misappropriation of about N5.7 billion in SURE-P funds.

The reviewer found the Pixel Watch 4 a capable outdoor smartwatch for $349–$399. Its battery lasted a weekend in testing, it charged quickly, and it offered easy-to-use offline Google Maps and useful Fitbit sleep tracking. With an active carrier plan, it can contact emergency services by satellite in the contiguous US. The Apple Watch Ultra 3 is more rugged, supports diving and offers satellite texting in more countries, but costs about twice as much. The Pixel Watch 4 failed to detect one hard fall during testing.

Conventional genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of machine-learning-imputed phenotypes can produce false-positive associations: in a type 2 diabetes analysis, 81% of significant loci identified using imputed outcomes failed to replicate in a GWAS of measured outcomes. The authors introduce POP-GWAS, which combines GWAS results from measured and imputed phenotypes to correct associations at each genetic variant. Simulations and the diabetes analysis showed improved power while maintaining valid inference. Applied to bone mineral density at 14 skeletal sites, POP-GWAS identified 188 loci, compared with 135 from conventional GWAS; subsequent meta-analyses brought the total to 303, including 89 novel loci.

Jason Day will face Louis Oosthuizen in the group stage of the WGC-Match Play in Texas, a rematch of their 2016 final. Fellow Australians Marc Leishman and Cameron Smith have drawn separate groups. Smith needs a strong finish to secure a Masters invitation.

The study presents a method for designing dilute polyisobutylene-based Boger fluids with targeted shear modulus, relaxation time, and first normal stress difference coefficient. Rheological measurements establish how these properties vary with polymer concentration, molecular weight, and solvent viscosity. The measured relationships differ from theoretical predictions but enable a design matrix that maps target properties to fluid compositions. Tests produced fluids with nearly constant relaxation time and varied modulus, nearly constant modulus and varied relaxation time, or similar normal stress coefficients despite substantially different viscosities.

The passage develops semiring semantics for propositional, first-order, and existential second-order logic, and defines a semiring analogue of NP using nondeterministic polynomial-time BSS machines. It states and begins proving a version of Fagin’s theorem: over the semirings considered, existential second-order logic characterizes this complexity class. The article also announces analogues of Cook’s theorem and a completeness result for the true existential theory of a semiring.

Idaho’s Week 7 high school football rankings changed little at the top after Week 6 games. No. 1 Bishop Kelly edged Columbia 22-20, and No. 4 Eagle beat Mountain View 21-14 to remain undefeated. Minico and unbeaten Ririe entered the rankings, replacing Middleton and Capital. Sandpoint dropped from No. 15 after a 50-9 loss to Coeur d’Alene, while Owyhee improved to 5-0 for the first time in program history.

The Supreme Court is returning from its summer recess for its “long conference,” where justices will review accumulated petitions before the 2025–26 term begins October 6. Justice Clarence Thomas questioned uncritical reliance on precedent, while former Justice Anthony Kennedy voiced concern about increasingly antagonistic discourse and opinions. The court has allowed the Trump administration to withhold nearly $4 billion in foreign aid, and the administration has asked it to review the legality of Trump’s birthright-citizenship order. A response is also due on the administration’s request to end protected status for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelans.

The NBA released its full 2017–18 schedule and national TV listings, with game times in Eastern time. The listed games run from October through April on TNT, ESPN, ABC and NBA TV. Christmas Day features five games, including Cleveland at Golden State and Houston at Oklahoma City.

The passage lists Bengali transliteration mappings for digits, signs, and punctuation. A following tilde produces a literal symbol instead of the Bengali character. It also explains how ZWJ and ZWNJ affect consonant rendering and how ZWJ separates vowels.

Enron grew from a troubled pipeline company into a major energy trader after Jeff Skilling developed its Gas Bank and expanded trading into electricity and other markets. Its aggressive culture rewarded rapid profits but fostered internal competition, while its accounting practices drew scrutiny. By 2001, costly international projects, California’s energy crisis, a telecommunications downturn and analysts’ questions had contributed to a falling stock price. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, and Ken Lay returned, promising to focus innovation closer to Enron’s core business.

Euro zone stocks opened 2017 at their highest in more than a year after factory activity grew at its fastest pace in over five years. Italy’s shares led gains, while yields on lower-rated euro zone bonds fell. The euro slipped as the dollar strengthened. Thin holiday trading could increase volatility. An Islamic State attack in Istanbul had little market impact, though the Turkish lira weakened. China’s manufacturing growth slowed slightly in December, and bitcoin rose above US$1,000 for the first time since late 2013.

Apple’s 2015 Form 10-K covers the fiscal year ended September 26, 2015. The company designs and sells devices, software and services worldwide, reporting operations across five geographic segments. In 2015, indirect channels generated 74% of net sales, international sales accounted for 65%, and research and development expense was $8.1 billion. Apple had approximately 110,000 full-time equivalent employees. The filing describes risks involving competition, component supply, outsourced manufacturing, cybersecurity, currency fluctuations, taxes and litigation. It also reports $11.4 billion in dividends paid during 2015.

The passage argues that Francesca’s Holdings could withstand challenges facing apparel retailers, including e-commerce, excess store capacity and trade-policy uncertainty. The company has no debt, $48 million in cash and approximately $57.6 million in free cash flow. In its first quarter, sales rose 1% as new stores offset a 5% decline in comparable-store sales, while net income fell. The author views Francesca’s as profitable but acknowledges fierce competition and mixed valuation measures. The author projects share-price gains over one to five years and discloses no position in the company.

Callinex Mines filed a preliminary economic assessment for its Nash Creek and Superjack projects in New Brunswick. The assessment outlines a 10-year open-pit operation and estimates a 34.1% pre-tax internal rate of return and C$230 million pre-tax net present value, based on C$168 million in pre-production costs. Callinex plans to begin drilling near Nash Creek to investigate potential satellite deposits. The assessment includes inferred resources and is preliminary; there is no certainty its projections will be realized.

Oil prices fell after Israel and Hamas agreed to pause fighting in Gaza, allowing hostages to be freed in exchange for Palestinian prisoners. U.S. stocks moved little near record highs, while gold remained near its record and Treasury yields rose slightly. Delta shares gained after strong earnings and an upbeat forecast; Akero Therapeutics shares jumped after Novo Nordisk announced a $4.7 billion acquisition. European markets were mixed, while most Asian stocks rose.

Offsites may focus on alignment or celebration rather than breakthroughs. For breakthroughs, the passage recommends disrupting routines to foster connections, centering a meaningful shared purpose, and aligning people and activities with it. Yarrow Kraner’s HATCH experiences use unfamiliar communal settings, a diverse group, and programs designed to spark creativity, deepen relationships, and turn ideas into practical actions.

In 2015, 58 private college presidents received more than $1 million in compensation, up from 39 in 2014. Average pay rose 9% to $570,000, compared with 3%–4% growth for the average American worker. Four Ohio college presidents ranked among the top 100, led by Dayton’s Daniel Curran at more than $2.4 million.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022, reports revenue of $18.76 billion, up from $10.39 billion a year earlier, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.32 billion, up from $438 million. At quarter-end, Tesla had $66.04 billion in assets, $17.51 billion in cash and cash equivalents, and $34.09 billion in stockholders’ equity. Operating activities provided $4.00 billion in cash. The filing also discusses supply-chain disruptions and inflation, debt repayments, equity awards, and ongoing litigation and investigations.

Using gene expression and genetic data from 1,032 African-ancestry and 801 European-ancestry participants, the study examined genes associated with general cognitive function, white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and Alzheimer’s disease (AD). After fine-mapping, it identified 266 genes associated with cognitive function, 23 with WMH, and 69 with AD in a European-ancestry GWAS; 82, 12, and 45, respectively, had not been identified in the corresponding original GWAS analyses. An African-ancestry AD GWAS yielded two fine-mapped genes, APOE and PVRL2. ICA1L was associated with both WMH and AD, with lower expression linked to greater risk. Limitations include reliance on blood-derived cell lines and predominantly European-ancestry GWAS data.

A June 2001 collection of news articles reports that Enron and Commonwealth Edison agreed to supply electricity to Chicago and 47 suburbs, with Enron providing 60% of the contracted power. Enron Broadband participated in a $30 million investment in AP Engines. Lenders met over Enron’s troubled Dabhol power project in India amid disputes over unpaid bills and power prices; India’s prime minister expressed confidence that the dispute could be resolved. Other articles mention Enron’s additional London office lease and its lobbying for direct access to electricity suppliers in California.

The African Union Commission held its first Start Up Fest to discuss youth entrepreneurship, start-up and tech-hub needs, and public-private support. Speakers emphasized the roles of small enterprises, education, infrastructure, technology and access to capital in improving competitiveness and employment. Participants agreed to continue discussions on creating an African Association of Community Innovation Hub at a side event during the 2018 Transform Africa Summit in Kigali. The Commission will work with i4Policy and other participants to draft the agenda.

Chiefs defensive lineman Chris Jones said he mistakenly thought Trevor Lawrence was down and stopped pursuing him before Lawrence scored the Jaguars’ game-winning touchdown. Jones called it a learning lesson and said it would not happen again. He also said he had deactivated his social media accounts before the game, not to avoid criticism afterward.

A study comparing vaccinated people with and without prior or breakthrough COVID-19 found that combined vaccination and infection produced higher antibody levels and stronger neutralization of SARS-CoV-2 variants than vaccination alone. Among participants with hybrid immunity, longer intervals between infection and vaccination—up to 404 days—were associated with higher neutralizing titers and broader variant cross-neutralization, regardless of exposure order. The authors caution that intentional infection is not a reasonable way to gain immunity because of the risks of severe illness, long-term complications, and death.

DPI (UK), a Castle Donington maker of aluminium frames and lightboxes, has received a grant of more than £12,200 from the Collaborate business scheme. The funding will help it buy an automated saw to produce larger structures in-house, shorten contract times and increase output. The company, which grew by 37 per cent last year, expects the investment eventually to create jobs.

President Trump called the House-passed health care bill “mean” after previously praising it, frustrating conservatives he had pressed to support it. Senate Republicans remain divided over Medicaid expansion, coverage requirements and subsidies as they draft their own version. Senator John Cornyn said passage by July 4 was a goal but could take until the end of July.

Andrew Lo introduces Finance Theory as a practical framework for business and personal decisions. He identifies two central tasks—valuing and managing assets—and argues that time and risk make those tasks challenging. An auction of an unidentified package illustrates how markets establish prices with limited information. The course will use accounting statements and cash flows to examine households, financial intermediaries, corporations, and capital markets. It will cover valuation, risk, and corporate finance. Lo emphasizes that students must practice solving problems and apply the ideas to their own decisions. Grades will reflect participation, a case study, a midterm, and a cumulative final exam.

An ARDD report praised Jordanian agencies and UNHCR for rapidly providing free legal services, documentation support and legal awareness programmes to Syrian refugees. It said camp legal sections offer specialised services and that legal support helps protect refugees’ rights and access to other services. ARDD CEO Samar Muhareb cited continuing challenges, including access to formal work, limited funding and insufficient evaluation of legal aid. A recent registration campaign has registered 25,000 refugees with UNHCR.

The passage describes a system that lets clients analyze private databases without direct access to sensitive records. It checks each query against a privacy budget, modifies the query using specified differential-privacy parameters, and returns a privacy-preserving result. Supported analyses include statistics, visualizations, predictive models, model testing, and synthetic databases. A validation engine can assess whether a query meets the specified privacy requirements.

Moody’s said India could meet its 3.3% fiscal deficit target for the year ending March 2019 by cutting planned capital spending, despite revenue and spending risks. Most respondents to a Moody’s–ICRA poll expected the target to be missed. They also identified rising oil prices as an economic risk and viewed the bank recapitalisation package as insufficient.
Sensors reveal how greater noctule bats snatch songbirds from the night sky.

Texas Instruments cautions that electrostatic discharge can damage the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 and recommends appropriate handling. The September 2025 revision removed DGS32 package information and updated specifications, CPU features, and device tables. Packaging guidance says thermal pads must be soldered to the circuit board and provides recommendations for vias and solder paste. Mechanical and ordering information is subject to change. TI provides its technical resources “as is” and states that developers are responsible for selecting, designing, validating, and testing their applications.

TyreWatch, launched on 16 May at Harwell in Oxfordshire, monitors fleet tyre pressure and temperature using wheel-rim sensors. It sends data by cellular and satellite connections to a server that identifies concerning trends and issues maintenance or critical alerts. Monitoring continues when vehicles are parked, and the system can integrate with existing vehicle technology. TyreWatch says testing showed it prevented 95% of tyre-related breakdowns. It was developed by a four-member consortium with £1.2 million in government funding for an intelligent tyre telematics solution for planned autonomous and platooned commercial vehicles.

Jammu and Kashmir Deputy Chief Minister Nirmal Singh said the government is considering skill development courses and an optional curriculum paper. Visiting two women’s colleges, he praised students’ vocational projects and urged colleges to strengthen technical skills and entrepreneurship.

Japanese government bonds firmed on Friday after a two-year auction drew stronger demand than the previous sale. The 10-year yield held steady, while two-, five-, 20- and 30-year yields fell. Investors awaited details of the Bank of Japan’s May bond purchases. The BOJ had left policy unchanged on Thursday and offered its most optimistic economic assessment in nine years. March core consumer prices rose for a third month, but more slowly than expected.

Against a box-and-one defense, where four defenders guard zones and a “chaser” denies a star player the ball, a ballhandling star can use double mid screens in a “horns” alignment to drive either direction. If the drive is stopped, the star can pass to a rolling screener or a corner shooter; screeners can also pop out. If no shot develops, a reversal pass can initiate single/double screen action. Effective execution requires coordinated screening, defensive reads, timing and practice. Teams are advised to scout defenders and vary their alignments.

A former Washington Walmart employee returned for a safe he had allegedly tried to steal. Employees found heroin and Xanax inside. He told deputies the drugs were his and was booked for unlawful possession of a controlled substance.

In a retrospective review of 30 adrenalectomy specimens, normal adult adrenal veins showed asymmetrical smooth muscle bundles resembling arterial fibromuscular dysplasia. Vascular changes consistent with segmental arterial mediolysis were common in adrenal cortical adenomas and pheochromocytomas; hemorrhage and thrombosis were the most common complications. No fibromuscular dysplasia-like lesions were found in arteries outside the adrenal glands, and none of nine fetal cases showed the asymmetrical muscle bundles. The authors suggest that the adrenal tissue environment, hormones or hormone receptors may contribute to these vascular changes and warrant further investigation.

Donna Adelson, 75, was sentenced to life in prison plus 30 years for her role in the 2014 murder of her former son-in-law, Florida State University law professor Dan Markel. She denied involvement, prompting the judge to warn that he could consider her “utter lack of remorse.” Prosecutors alleged the murder was intended to help her daughter move to South Florida with Markel’s children. Adelson’s husband also maintained her innocence.

The address reports peace at home and generally amicable foreign relations, while noting the Russia–Ottoman war and unrest in parts of the Americas. It describes unresolved indemnity claims against France, progress on claims against Denmark, and planned arbitration of the northeastern boundary dispute with Great Britain. British trade restrictions remain a concern, and a commercial treaty with Austria is ready for signature.

Treasury receipts exceeded expectations. More than $12 million was applied to public debt and interest during the year, and the address projects sufficient revenue in 1829 to reduce the debt further. It defends protection for domestic industry while calling for revisions if the tariff unfairly burdens any section of the Union.

The address asks Congress to consider relations with Indian tribes and the competing claims it describes over land and sovereignty. It reviews progress on fortifications, public works, naval improvements, and the growth of the postal system. It also requests support for a Pacific survey expedition, legislation for the new District penitentiary, and earlier, improved arrangements for the next census.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on October 26, 2021, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2021. The release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Two pieces of ammunition found in a Litchfield High School bathroom prompted a soft lockdown at the high and middle schools. Police responded, and students were dismissed to parents.

The passage argues that the Yankees reflect baseball’s growing emphasis on relievers over starting pitchers, citing Aroldis Chapman’s contract and the team’s bullpen history. It questions whether highly paid starters provide value when managers remove them early, and cites low pitch counts and declining quality-start totals. John Smoltz advocates letting starters pitch more. The passage also says frequent bullpen changes lengthen games and notes that the commissioner has considered limits on reliever use.

Cloud architectures have expanded manufacturers’ HPC options beyond custom and prebuilt systems. The passage identifies public cloud and hybrid HPC as ways to increase performance and flexibility without relying entirely on in-house infrastructure. HPC as a Service (HPCaaS) can reduce upfront investment, provide access to current technology and support collaboration and new business models, though cloud HPC still requires skilled personnel. Security needs may favor keeping sensitive workloads in-house.

IDC recommends assessing operating models against utilization, cost, performance, flexibility, security and available skills. It also recommends a shared data strategy, scalable and energy-efficient solutions, and external expertise where needed. The findings draw on a December 2021 survey of 200 decision makers at industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

The Supertrend indicator, created by Oliver Seban, uses price and Average True Range to signal trend direction and reversals. It is a lagging indicator whose settings and usefulness depend on the market and timeframe. A weekly, long-only S&P 500 backtest using a 10-period ATR and multiplier of 3 reported a 65.79% winning-trade rate and a 24.6% maximum drawdown, compared with 56.24% for buy and hold.
