The passage cautions that results can vary and that false signals can occur, particularly in choppy or volatile markets.

Nathan Calvin, general counsel of the three-person AI policy nonprofit Encode, accused OpenAI of using subpoenas to intimidate critics during debate over California’s AI safety law, SB 53. Encode, which supported some of Elon Musk’s arguments in his lawsuit against OpenAI, says it is not funded by Musk and refused to turn over documents. Calvin also alleged that OpenAI sought to weaken the law’s safety and transparency requirements. OpenAI’s chief strategy officer said the subpoenas were a standard way to investigate possible ties between Encode and parties with interests opposed to OpenAI. The allegations drew concern from current and former OpenAI personnel and other AI safety advocates.

A study of 10 flights found that window-seat passengers moved around less often, supporting advice to stay seated to reduce contact with potentially infectious people. Modeling suggested that passengers seated closest to a sick person faced the highest risk, while about one person on a 150-passenger flight would be infected. The researchers observed only one person coughing and detected none of the 18 cold and flu viruses they tested for. Outside researchers said the small study could not establish general risks. Boeing initiated and funded the research.

Case Western Reserve University researchers estimate that childhood exposure to domestic violence costs the United States more than $55 billion annually. An estimated 15.5 million children are exposed each year. The study puts the lifetime economic cost per exposed child at nearly $50,000, reflecting higher health-care and violent-crime costs and lost productivity associated with lower educational attainment. Researchers say the findings could help policymakers assess prevention and treatment efforts.

The message reports that the country is at peace and public health has improved, while the worldwide depression continues to cause hardship. It credits private, state, and federal relief efforts and emergency credit measures with easing distress and supporting recovery.

It calls for continued recovery measures until the depression passes, followed by an end to emergency agencies. Its immediate priorities are reducing government spending and balancing the federal budget, reorganizing the banking system, and cooperating with other nations on economic recovery. Proposed economies include limiting federal public works, reorganizing agencies, and reducing some government pay and veterans’ payments; additional tax revenue is also proposed.

The message argues that banking failures have deepened economic distress and that temporary financial assistance cannot substitute for reform. It supports international disarmament and economic cooperation while opposing suspension of upcoming war-debt payments. It concludes that government should protect opportunity and encourage voluntary cooperation, with direct federal intervention limited to emergencies.

Cromwell and four employees sought to stop NASD Regulation from compelling interviews during its investigation of Pallet stock trading, arguing that it was acting for federal prosecutors and had misused grand jury materials. The court found that Regulation’s enforcement staff issued the interview demands independently, despite contacts with prosecutors and a separate NASD unit assisting criminal investigations. It also found no credible evidence that unauthorized staff received or used protected grand jury materials. The court declined to enjoin the interviews but noted that Regulation’s administrative and physical arrangements had raised enough doubt about the investigations’ separation to require a trial.

Canadian Blood Services will open Canada’s largest blood donation clinic at Calgary’s Eau Claire Market on July 10, replacing its 18-bed clinic with a 20-bed facility. Amid a national shortage, O-negative supplies are below three days. The organization needs 50,000 more donations to reach its July 1 goal of 150,000.

The Shepherd Express argues that We Energies’ rates rose from among the Midwest’s lowest to its highest as the Public Service Commission approved utility requests for increases. It criticizes the company’s executive pay and spending on power plants, and says municipal utilities can provide power at lower cost. The Citizens Utility Board and a new business group, the Initiative for Competitive Energy, are pressing for lower prices. We Energies has proposed a rate freeze through 2019, but both groups say a rollback may be needed.

Defending champion F2 Logistics faces Generika-Ayala today, seeking a fourth straight win and the No. 2 seed in the next round of the PSL Grand Prix. Generika-Ayala earned its first win over Smart after four losses. Sta. Lucia also faces winless Smart, with several teams still competing for positions in the standings.

Market Research Future forecasts significant growth in the blowout preventer market by 2021, driven by oil and gas demand, offshore exploration and higher safety standards. The report examines annular and RAM preventers for land and offshore wells. It expects the Middle East to dominate due to onshore drilling and Asia-Pacific to see high growth.

The Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 describes SD Memory Card interfaces, commands, registers, operation, performance classes and hardware requirements. Cards include read/write and ROM types, with SDSC capacity up to 2 GB, SDHC above 2 GB through 32 GB, and SDXC above 32 GB through 2 TB. The specification covers SD, SPI, UHS-I and UHS-II interfaces, including initialization, voltage switching and block transfers. It also describes security, cache, self-maintenance and command-queue features. The simplified document is provided “AS-IS” without warranties; implementation may require licenses, including SD-3C licenses when specified earlier SD versions are used.

Prince’s music became available on Spotify after his death, despite his opposition to the platform, prompting mixed reactions. The passage also discusses artists who resist Spotify: Taylor Swift objects to how it values music; Garth Brooks keeps his music off Spotify and iTunes; Thom Yorke criticizes the service; Beyoncé’s *Lemonade* is on competing service Tidal; and Joanna Newsom condemns Spotify.

European stocks edged higher on Tuesday, led by energy shares as Brent crude rose after the Forties pipeline shutdown. Investors awaited interest rate decisions from the US Federal Reserve, Bank of England and European Central Bank later in the week.

Lake Lugano, in Switzerland’s Italian-speaking Ticino region, offers a quieter alternative to nearby Lake Como. Visitors can explore lakeside villages such as Gandria and Morcote by ferry, hike trails around the lake and nearby mountains, visit parks and art museums, and enjoy local food and wine. The area is known for its mild climate, alpine scenery and relaxed pace.

Outgoing Federal Reserve chair Janet Yellen said stock valuations were elevated but declined to call them a bubble, urging investors to diversify. Despite a sharp Wall Street drop, she described the US economy and job market as strong. Yellen said she was disappointed not to receive a second term; Jerome Powell will replace her.

Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and Public Safety Minister Ralph Goodale expressed condolences after a van struck pedestrians in Toronto, killing 10 and injuring 15. They praised first responders and said investigators had found no evidence of a terrorism or national security link. Toronto police arrested 25-year-old Alek Minassian, who was due in court Tuesday.

The budget proposes taxing transfers of unlisted shares using the higher of the sale price or fair market value. Officials are expected to calculate fair market value using net asset value, partly to address undervalued property sales through companies. The proposal has concerned start-ups and investors who frequently sell stakes.

Dunas Capital, founded in Spain in 2016, managed about €4.5 billion in assets as of July 2025. Its investment approach emphasizes capital preservation, value investing across asset classes, and volatility-based risk management. The firm offers four mutual funds with different return targets and risk limits, alongside alternative investments in infrastructure, renewable energy, transportation and agriculture.

The court dismissed the exceptions and confirmed the estate account, holding that the will’s unqualified gift to “grandchildren” included the children of an afterborn child. It found no language excluding them and held that “per stirpes” determined shares, not eligibility. Dissenting, Judges Steakne and Sinkler argued that the will contemplated only descendants of the four children it named, and that including the afterborn child’s descendants contradicted the testator’s intent.

FULE logically erases the entire user area on supported SDHC and SDXC cards, but is unavailable through SPI. The host must check FULE_SUPPORT and issue CMD32, CMD33, then CMD38 with argument 00000002h. Invalid sequences set status errors; incomplete area selection triggers ERASE. DAT0 remains low during FULE.

Former Katsina State Governor Ibrahim Shehu Shema was remanded in EFCC custody over 26 charges of alleged money laundering involving N5.7 billion in SURE-P funds. He pleaded not guilty. A Federal High Court judge set April 27, 2018, to hear his written bail application.

AMD’s specification defines the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), a shared page through which SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests selectively expose information to a hypervisor during non-automatic exits. It covers protocol negotiation, feature advertisement, GHCB registration, VMGEXIT handling, page-state changes, SNP guest requests, AP booting, interrupts, and newer trusted-I/O and Secure AVIC features. SEV-SNP guests must register their GHCB address before use. The document also states that the specification is provided “as is,” restricts its use and distribution, and disclaims warranties and liability.

A June 26, 2001 news roundup covers California’s electricity crisis. Federally mediated talks began over the state’s demand for $8.9 billion in refunds, which power suppliers disputed. Governor Gray Davis met with new federal energy regulators and raised allegations by former Duke Energy workers that the company reduced output during shortages; Duke denied wrongdoing. Other articles examine a proposed suspension of customers’ ability to choose alternative electricity providers, growing interest in solar-powered homes, and uncertainty over whether planned power plants will be built or lower prices.

Dogs of the Dow invests equal amounts in the 10 highest-dividend-yielding stocks in the Dow Jones Industrial Average and rebalances annually. Popularized by Michael B. O’Higgins in 1991, it can be implemented through individual stocks, ETFs or a mutual fund. The passage’s backtests show it underperformed the S&P 500: a $10,000 investment from August 1998 grew to $32,000, versus $60,000 for the S&P 500. A second backtest found that three related ETFs also lagged the S&P 500 from April 2014.

U.S. home prices rose in February 2018, according to the S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller indices. The National Index gained 6.3% year over year, while the 10-City and 20-City Composites rose 6.5% and 6.8%, respectively. Seattle had the largest annual increase among the 20 cities at 12.7%, followed by Las Vegas at 11.6% and San Francisco at 10.1%. All 20 cities recorded monthly increases before and after seasonal adjustment.

COVIDFast is a high-throughput, RNA-extraction-free RT-qPCR assay for detecting SARS-CoV-2 in anterior nasal swabs (SwabFAST) or saliva (SalivaFAST). Its sample-specific buffers and shared collection vials support streamlined processing. Both tests had a confirmed detection limit of 4 viral copies/µL. Compared with testing that included RNA extraction, positive and negative agreement were 100% for swabs and 98.8% and 99.4%, respectively, for saliva. By December 23, 2021, the laboratory had performed 409,883 COVIDFast tests, with an overall positive rate of 8.10%.

Coach Quenneville said the team’s playoff run has been difficult, but its experienced core, resilience and depth have helped it advance. He praised Hossa’s consistent all-around play and Kimmo’s reliability. After liking aspects of the previous game, he said the team must improve its quickness against a strong forecheck while keeping its usual preparation and focusing on each shift rather than the outcome.

Dr. Betteys’ beneficiary sued Ætna for death benefits and weekly disability indemnity under his accident policy. The insurer recalled its death-proof forms and denied liability, excusing proof of death. That denial did not waive the policy’s separate deadline for filing suit over death benefits, even though an agent encouraged the beneficiary to gather further evidence. The court reversed the judgment for the beneficiary because her death-benefit suit was untimely and ordered a new trial on the weekly indemnity claim.

Austria’s Financial Market Authority raised its forecast for proceeds from selling Heta’s assets to 8.6 billion euros, from 6 billion, citing better-than-expected sales. The increase benefits Austria, which funded Carinthia’s buyback of Heta bonds. The authority expects an initial payment of about 4 billion euros to Heta creditors soon.

At a preliminary inquiry into the alleged robbery-related murders of Phyllis Caesar and Constance Fraser in Georgetown in October 2017, four current or former police officers testified. Imran Khan and Steven Andrews questioned the witnesses; Phillip Suffrien was represented by counsel. The inquiry continues Monday.

The passage presents a DNN-Transformer-Autoencoder framework for assessing corporate tax risk. It combines static enterprise attributes, financial time series, and anomaly detection to classify firms as low, medium, or high risk. On a dataset of approximately 12,000 enterprises, it achieved 0.91 accuracy, 0.86 recall, and 0.88 F1, outperforming the compared models. The study notes limitations in its input features and computational demands.

The passage presents a theoretical framework linking the orbital angular moment of coupled magnons and phonons to the quantum geometry of their wavefunctions. In a honeycomb antiferromagnet model, magnetoelastic coupling allows orbital angular moment to transfer between magnons and out-of-plane phonons, even without lattice rotation. The authors predict that a temperature or strain gradient could produce a measurable transverse voltage, offering a way to probe this orbital effect.

The passage describes SD Memory Card commands and operating rules. CMD19 tunes sampling timing for supported hosts. CMD7 selects a card for transfer; read and write operations use block commands, CRC checks, and busy indications, with CMD12 available to stop transfers. Erase, DISCARD, and full-user-area logical erase use CMD32, CMD33, and CMD38, with different support requirements and timeouts.

Write protection includes a mechanical switch, card protection, and password locking through CMD42. Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password and restricts force erase and password clearing when that password is set. CMD55 identifies the next command as application-specific, while CMD6 checks or switches functions such as speed mode and power limit. The passage also specifies differences between SDSC byte addressing and SDHC/SDXC block addressing, clock-control rules, CRC methods, and read and write timeout conditions.

The IMF urged Saudi Arabia to phase in economic reforms and price increases more gradually to avoid harming growth. Amid lower oil income, it expects a budget deficit of nine percent of GDP and near-zero growth this year. While Riyadh aims to balance its budget by 2019, the IMF recommended 2022. Existing austerity measures include higher excise taxes, utility prices and expatriate labour fees; further price hikes and a five-percent VAT are planned.

A value area is the price range where 70% of trading volume occurred during a given period. Traders use it to identify potential support, resistance, breakouts, and reversals across different timeframes. Risks include false signals and changing value areas; suggested precautions include stop-loss orders and position sizing. The passage does not provide a backtest.

The passage lists education-related headlines, led by the arrest of the superintendent of Iowa’s largest school district by Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Other topics include school integration, college access, student achievement and youth stories.

The study develops a first-principles-based embedded cluster expansion and canonical Monte Carlo framework to calculate finite-temperature equilibrium vacancy concentrations in nine-component refractory alloys. Adding group 4 elements substantially increases vacancy concentrations relative to alloys containing only group 5 and 6 elements. Vacancy concentrations also depend on short-range order and bonding: favorable bonds suppress vacancy formation, while unfavorable bonds promote it. Comparisons with calculations based on a single special quasi-random structure show that the latter can underestimate vacancy concentrations. The framework applies to dilute vacancies and does not include vibrational contributions or vacancy clusters.

Scientists and volunteers will study next Monday’s total solar eclipse along a path from Oregon to South Carolina. Using telescopes, satellites, planes and balloons, they will examine the sun’s corona and the eclipse’s effects on weather, animals and plants. Citizen projects will collect solar images and observations. Researchers hope to better understand the corona, which is much hotter than the sun’s surface. Past eclipses helped reveal helium’s spectrum and provided evidence for Einstein’s theory of relativity.

The court held that an execution conveying a debtor’s land follows the same rules as a deed and includes buildings owned by the debtor, even if they rest on blocks. Because the levy’s written returns reserved no buildings, parol evidence of an intended exception was inadmissible. The court upheld the plaintiff’s verdict for the value of the removed barn and shop.

A Danish study of 1.3 million children found that those born to mothers with rheumatoid arthritis had higher risks of rheumatoid arthritis, thyroid disease and epilepsy. Researchers urged doctors to pay particular attention to these conditions in exposed children.

The passage describes video encoding and decoding methods that combine intra prediction with non-separable transforms. For a directionally predicted block, coding information identifies a nominal mode and an angular offset; together they determine the prediction direction. The nominal mode selects a transform set, and a signaled index can select a non-separable transform within that set. The block is reconstructed using the resulting direction and transform. The disclosure also describes transform selection for non-directional modes, including smooth, recursive-filtering, and chroma-from-luma modes, and discusses reduced non-separable secondary transforms that operate on selected transform coefficients.

A study of 1,099 young adults found that those who continued or occasionally consumed energy drinks were more likely to use cocaine or prescription stimulants non-medically. Researchers said the reason for the association remains unclear.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020 reports revenue of $35.0 billion, up from $30.6 billion a year earlier, and net income of $10.8 billion, up from $8.8 billion. Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.40 from $1.14. Commercial cloud revenue increased 39% to $13.3 billion, while Azure revenue grew 59%. Microsoft said COVID-19 had minimal net impact on quarterly revenue: increased cloud usage and demand for remote-work products were partly offset by slower licensing and lower advertising spending. As of March 31, the company held $137.6 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments.

The 2018 Scottish Accountancy & Finance Awards recognise accountants’ contributions to public and private organisations. Sarah Heaney will present the awards, with entertainment from DNA. Tickets cost £132 plus VAT individually, or £1,200–£1,440 plus VAT per table.

The speaker fondly recalls Detroit as his first team, where he enjoyed the city and reached the semifinals twice. His first trade, to Washington, was a shock, and the team initially struggled. He says it has since improved and believes playing away may help manage excitement.

Azerbaijan aims to increase honey and beekeeping-product exports as global demand is expected to grow, Agriculture Minister Heydar Asadov said. He cited demand for Azerbaijani organic honey, reported six tonnes sold last year, and said proposals for greater state support for beekeeping would be submitted.

The study examines Hungarian higher education and lecturers’ employment since 1990. Student numbers expanded rapidly, then declined amid demographic changes and more restrictive admissions and funding policies. Lecturer numbers did not fall at the same rate, leaving Hungary with a relatively low student–teacher ratio over the past decade.

Successive laws tightened academic qualifications and performance requirements. The number of university and college professors fell substantially between 2005 and 2020. Most state universities were later transferred to public foundations, changing lecturers’ employment status and increasing pay while linking it to performance evaluations.

The study finds that doctoral graduates entering academic teaching and research have lower lifetime earnings than graduates working in business. Hungary also ranks relatively poorly in international comparisons of doctoral student numbers, raising concerns about the future supply of educators and researchers.

Marc Ó Sé says an injury-free James O’Donoghue could be a major boost for Kerry. O’Donoghue scored nine points against Clare on his return, and Ó Sé expects regular games to build his confidence and strengthen Kerry’s attack alongside Paul Geaney.

The Texas Education Agency is investigating hundreds of teachers’ social media posts about Charlie Kirk’s killing and may pursue license sanctions. Commissioner Mike Morath called the comments “reprehensible and inappropriate,” while Gov. Greg Abbott defended the investigation. Legal experts and education advocates say the response threatens teachers’ free speech rights. They argue that disciplining teachers for personal comments requires consideration of whether the speech significantly disrupted their work, and warn that political pressure could discourage educators from speaking on public issues.

Bond trading strategies are systematic approaches to buying and selling bonds for income, capital preservation or appreciation. Bond prices generally fall when interest rates rise, creating risks for traders. The passage presents backtests of Treasury bond ETF strategies and argues that adding bond strategies to stock strategies can improve diversification and reduce drawdowns. It identifies poor risk management, inadequate diversification and misjudged interest-rate movements as common mistakes. It also discusses day trading and automation, and suggests dollar-cost averaging as a strategy for beginners.

Northwest Natural confirmed talks to acquire Enron’s Portland General Electric, though no agreement was assured. Reports valued a potential deal at about $1.8 billion in cash and stock plus assumed debt, with financing and approvals unresolved. Other reports said Enron planned to cut about 500 European jobs. In India, BG Group’s proposed purchase of Enron’s offshore assets faced a dispute over operatorship, while Tata Power considered buying Enron’s stake in the troubled Dabhol Power project.

Bitcoin fell below US$8,000 before recovering to US$8,715, leaving it down 21 per cent for the week and more than half its December peak. Regulatory threats, a US$500 million exchange theft and Facebook’s cryptocurrency ad ban weighed on the market; Ripple, Ether and Litecoin also fell.

Microsoft announced on July 1, 2020, that Chief Accounting Officer Frank H. Brod would step down July 31 and remain through September 30 to assist with the transition. Alice L. Jolla, Microsoft’s corporate controller since 2014, will become Chief Accounting Officer on July 31. She will receive a $1.5 million stock award vesting quarterly, subject to continued employment.

Best Hope Services says it will launch Nigeria’s first online trade exhibition on May 1 to promote local innovations. The fair will let exhibitors showcase products and visitors attend remotely. Organizers urged Nigerians to register ahead of the event, which will cover sectors including technology, automobiles and electronics.

After ABC canceled the *Roseanne* reboot over Roseanne Barr’s racist tweet about former Obama adviser Valerie Jarrett, President Trump criticized the network for not apologizing to him for statements made about him on ABC. Disney CEO Bob Iger had called Jarrett to apologize and tell her the show was being canceled. Democratic lawmakers criticized Trump’s response. Jarrett said she hoped the incident would be a teaching moment and that both the president and individual citizens have a responsibility to push back against such comments.

Microsoft is reportedly developing Polaris, a modular Windows 10 version for desktops, laptops and 2-in-1 devices built on Windows Core OS. It would use a new interface called CShell and run UWP apps rather than traditional desktop programs. Unlike Windows 10 S, users would not be able to upgrade it to Windows 10 Pro. Microsoft is reportedly exploring remote virtualization for legacy apps, and Windows Central suggests Polaris could appear in 2019.

Researchers found that polypropylene’s mechanical properties depend on molecular regularity, or isotacticity, and on how the material is cooled. Tests of films with different isotacticity levels showed that these factors affect crystallinity and elastic modulus. The findings could help manufacturers produce polypropylene with targeted properties, such as elasticity or hardness.

The speaker says the United States and China share interests in trade, modernization, peace, and concern over the Soviet military buildup, but disagree on Taiwan. He proposes expanding ties with China, cooperating with Western Pacific partners, and opposing regional aggression. He criticizes President Carter’s concessions during normalization and pledges to conduct relations with Taiwan under the Taiwan Relations Act. He describes the Act as supporting peaceful relations, defensive weapons for Taiwan, resistance to coercion, and congressionally funded and overseen U.S. relations with Taiwan.

The JACL Kakehashi Program will select up to 200 young Japanese American and Asian American students or graduates for visits to Japan aimed at strengthening U.S.–Japan relations. Applicants must be 18–25; Japanese passport holders are ineligible. Application deadlines are Oct. 9 for the December trip and Jan. 2 for the March 2018 trip.

Wal-Mart’s reported bid for online clothing retailer Bonobos is part of its effort to expand in fashion e-commerce, attract younger shoppers and compete with Amazon. If completed, it would be Wal-Mart’s fourth acquisition of a small online clothing or accessories brand since early 2017. Despite its large brick-and-mortar clothing business, Wal-Mart has struggled to attract online apparel shoppers; online sales account for about 3 percent of its total sales. One retail consultant said the acquisitions remain too small to have a material impact.

This week’s making tips include adding magnets to tester wires for difficult hookups, using an old motor as a filming turntable, fitting a hobby knife to a compass, and marking unreliable material edges with squiggly lines. The column also points to instructions for using a drill press as a drum sander and recommends an inexpensive flexible-neck LED workbench lamp.

Disordered materials are difficult to model because simulations may not reproduce experimental structures. Reverse Monte Carlo methods can improve agreement but may be computationally expensive or produce unphysical structures. The article introduces molecular augmented dynamics, a modified molecular dynamics method that combines interatomic and experimental potentials to seek low-energy structures matching experimental data. It presents linearly scaling, analytic experimental forces for X-ray and neutron diffraction, pair distribution functions, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, accounting for thermal broadening.

The “Drive & Kick” offense uses a three-player weave from a 3-2 spread. Players drive toward the basket for a layup or, if stopped, pass outside and replace the receiver. Corner passes can continue the action, while a corner player can back cut when their defender helps against the drive.

The Housing Authority of the City of Santa Barbara won a Gold Nugget Award for Bradley Studios, a 54-unit affordable housing development built in 2012. The project serves low- and extremely low-income residents with special needs and offers on-site mental health, addiction, job-training and life-skills services.

Intel released Coffee Lake desktop processors and Z370 chipsets, with motherboard vendors selling compatible boards worldwide. It plans additional desktop, notebook and enterprise products through 2018, plus Gemini Lake processors in November 2017. Cannon Lake is expected in mid-2018 and Ice Lake in 2019; Intel said its first 10nm products would ship near year-end.

On May 30, 1976, Kent Howerton won the AMA 500cc National Motocross opener in New York, where six brands filled the top six places. In 1982, Ricky Johnson won the High Point 250 National and Darrell Shultz won the 500 class. Yamaha was cutting its racing budget, while riders questioned the value of the Trans-USA Championship. Ross Pederson won the 1987 Montreal Supercross.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU for AI, high-performance computing, and data analytics. Based on the Ampere architecture, it adds third-generation Tensor Cores supporting several data formats and structured sparsity, which can double Tensor Core throughput. The A100 has 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, and faster NVLink and PCIe connections than the V100. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances. CUDA 11 supports features including task graphs, asynchronous copies and barriers, and L2 cache controls. The DGX A100 system combines eight A100 GPUs for workloads ranging from individual jobs to large clusters.

Spatial analysis of skin biopsies from patients in Sri Lanka, Brazil and India identified myeloid-cell niches expressing the immune regulators IDO1 and PD-L1. These niches included dendritic cells and CCL18+ macrophages near CD8+ memory T cells and regulatory T cells. Across the forms of dermal leishmaniasis studied, IL32 was among five genes associated with IDO1 and PD-L1 expression. In Sri Lankan patients treated with sodium stibogluconate, lower numbers of IL-32+ CD8+ T cells were associated with earlier cure. The study could not directly test the proposed cellular mechanisms.

A study of 206 education faculty teachers at a Spanish university found high overall self-reported empathy, with high perspective taking and empathic concern, and moderate personal distress. Female participants scored significantly higher across all empathy dimensions. Contract status, teaching experience, degree taught and campus were not associated with empathy. Prior non-university teaching experience was associated with higher scores in three empathy dimensions, but not with higher overall empathy. The authors caution that the limited sample and possible social desirability bias restrict generalisation.

Acting CDC director Jim O’Neill called for replacing the combined measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine with three separate shots. The passage says there is no evidence that separate shots are safer or more effective. Experts warn that separating them could leave children vulnerable to infection, and single-disease vaccines are no longer available in the U.S. Developing them would likely take years. A 2017 study found lower completion rates among children receiving separate vaccines than among those receiving a combination vaccine.

The Department opposes dividing or decentralizing the proposed international organization before it is firmly established, fearing this would complicate its creation and weaken its effectiveness. At the February 21 Mexico City conference, the United States seeks discussion of the Dumbarton Oaks proposals without making inconsistent commitments; it has also discussed them with Latin American ambassadors to gather views and support. The proposals call for an international court of justice based on the existing court’s statute or a new statute derived from it. Because the existing court remains in operation and any change would affect states outside the new organization, the passage recommends an early meeting of about fifteen jurists to draft a statute and alternative procedures for implementing it.

UNC Chapel Hill placed professor Dwayne Dixon on leave while it investigates allegations that he advocated politically motivated violence. The move followed attention to fliers at Georgetown University promoting a gun club affiliated with Redneck Revolt, a group Dixon previously belonged to. A Turning Point USA spokesperson called for Dixon’s firing after linking his past membership to the group. UNC did not say what prompted its investigation. Dixon told a student newspaper he left Redneck Revolt in 2018. A petition and the North Carolina chapter of the American Association of University Professors have called for his reinstatement, arguing that the connection to the fliers is unsubstantiated.

The MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 are low-power, 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers operating at up to 32MHz, with up to 64KB flash and 8KB SRAM. They operate from 1.62V to 3.6V and from −40°C to 125°C. Integrated features include a 12-bit ADC, comparator, temperature sensor, DMA, timers, watchdogs, real-time clock, GPIO, and UART, SPI, and I2C interfaces.

Five operating modes—RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN—offer different power and functionality levels. The data sheet also describes clocking, memory, security, debugging, device identification, and peripheral configuration. Its application guidance specifies supply decoupling and reset-pin components. Additional sections cover development resources, revision history, and packaging information.

Three Illinois men were shot dead at point-blank range during Larry’s Fun Fest at Great Lakes Dragaway near Union Grove, Wisconsin, on Aug. 13, 2017. Kenosha County Sheriff David Beth said the victims were gang members and that investigators suspected the killings were gang-related, but the shooter’s identity and motive remained unknown. Authorities were searching for a man seen fleeing the scene. The event drew about 15,000 people.

The AMD Secure RNG library provides APIs for obtaining single random values or arrays through the RDRAND and RDSEED instructions. It abstracts low-level access, supports retry attempts and failure handling, and includes hardware-support checks. Hardware reads are relatively slow compared with software PRNGs, so latency-sensitive applications can use hardware-generated values to seed a PRNG.

Coach Quenneville expects a challenging series against an opponent he describes as patient, positionally strong and on a roll. He says his team must play to its strengths, make it difficult for the opposing goalie to see pucks, and manage the opponent’s point shooters and Chara. Stan Bowman praises Corey Crawford’s consistent goaltending and Bryan Bickell’s development. Both credit the team’s progress to continuity, maturing players, coaching and contributions throughout the organization. Quenneville says the team has gained enthusiasm during the playoffs and praises Sharp’s productive, consistent play.

A bearish engulfing pattern forms after an uptrend when a bearish candle’s body fully engulfs the preceding bullish candle’s body. It suggests a possible shift toward selling, but does not guarantee a reversal. Traders may check other indicators, momentum and market context before acting, and manage risk with stop-loss orders and position sizing. The passage reports a 55–65% stock-market win rate, while also noting that S&P 500 backtests found bullish outcomes despite the pattern’s name.

A federal appeals court stayed an injunction blocking the Education Department from firing half the 550 employees in its Office for Civil Rights. The court cited a Supreme Court ruling allowing broader department layoffs to proceed, while acknowledging a district judge’s concern that the cuts could hinder civil rights enforcement.

Carolina Herrera appointed Lisa Arnold vice president of retail and Thea Terenik vice president of global merchandising. Both are based in New York and report to president Emilie Rubinfeld. Arnold will oversee global retail and client service; Terenik will lead brand positioning and product strategy. They previously worked at Chanel and Calvin Klein, respectively.

The 50 EMA strategy uses the 50-day exponential moving average to identify medium-term trends and generate trading signals. Traders may confirm signals with indicators such as RSI or MACD. In the passage’s backtests, a moving-average crossover performed poorly across several assets. On the S&P 500 cash index, it returned 6.8% annually versus 7.3% for buy and hold, but had a smaller maximum drawdown. Using the 50 EMA as a filter with a second indicator produced stronger reported results for QQQ and SPY, though the QQQ backtest excluded slippage and commissions. The passage recommends backtesting settings and timeframes.

British shares fell on Thursday after Federal Reserve minutes indicated it could shrink its balance sheet later this year. Banks weighed on the FTSE 100, while Pearson dropped after an Exane downgrade and as it traded ex-dividend. Allied Minds hit a record low below its IPO price following funding cuts for seven portfolio companies. Real estate stocks and miners rose, while Tullow Oil and BTG gained.

After Charlie Kirk’s murder, Trump administration officials and allies intensified accusations that nonprofits fund or support political violence. The Justice Department is reportedly considering an investigation of Open Society Foundations, which rejects the accusations and says its work is peaceful and lawful. Nonprofits and funders have been preparing for possible action against them by reviewing compliance, planning legal challenges and emergency funding, and considering mergers, relocation or giving up tax-exempt status. Some funders are accelerating grants, while nonprofit leaders warn that the threats could strain resources and prompt organizations to censor themselves or change their work.

U.S. manufacturing has nearly 390,000 open jobs, but growing automation means many require skills displaced workers lack. As technology and global pressures reshape workplaces, workers struggle to adapt while those with in-demand training and knowledge benefit.

Emory University researchers found that mice fed the probiotic Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG for two weeks showed an improved liver antioxidant response after receiving high doses of acetaminophen. The study identified the protein Nrf2 as important in protecting against oxidative damage. Researchers said human studies are needed to determine whether the findings apply to people.

A pre-post study examined orthopaedic and trauma facility referrals to Kenyatta National Hospital before and after Kenya’s national referral guidelines were enforced in July 2021. It reviewed 468 patient charts across two five-month periods. Referrals from lower-tier facilities, particularly tiers II and III, declined significantly, while referrals from higher tiers increased. Forty-three facilities stopped referring patients directly to the hospital; most were private or in tiers II–IV. Changes in referrals from government versus private facilities were not statistically significant. Reported reasons for referral included limited staffing, infrastructure, equipment and supplies, finances, and patient preference. The authors recommend continued enforcement of the guidelines and stronger staffing capacity at referring facilities.

A March 2001 news roundup covers Enron and energy markets. CEO Jeff Skilling attributed Enron’s falling share price to investors’ retreat from high-valuation stocks, while an analyst also cited concerns about its broadband business. Enron awarded Chairman Kenneth Lay a $7 million bonus and Skilling $5.6 million for 2000. Other reports describe proposed online trading of Colonial Pipeline products, a request for U.S. regulators to address coordination between regional power grids, and Enron-related power projects in Nigeria and Japan. California regulators approved an electricity rate increase that Skilling said could help reduce power shortfalls. Viacom abandoned plans to spin off its remaining Blockbuster stake after Blockbuster’s video-on-demand venture with Enron ended.

The 1-2-2 zone is presented as a defense against outside shooting that also positions defenders for fast breaks and can protect a late lead. The point starts up top, wings at the elbows, and baseline defenders above the blocks. Defenders shift with passes: the nearest player guards the ball, others cover the post, middle, passing lanes, or weakside rebounding positions. They collapse if the ball enters the middle. Options include denying a return pass or helping the post from the corner, trapping in the corner, switching to a 2-1-2 after the first pass, or extending into a press.

Mesh shading moves geometry processing from the CPU to parallel GPU programs, enabling more objects and new geometry algorithms. Variable Rate Shading adjusts shading effort to improve efficiency. Texture-space shading caches results for reuse. Multi-View Rendering supports multiple views with different origins or directions in one pass.

The Sustainable Development Goals and Incheon Declaration envision inclusive, equitable, quality education and lifelong learning by 2030. Education is also presented as a means of achieving other development goals. Before COVID-19, major gaps remained in access, quality and equality, with 258 million school-age children out of school. Pandemic-related closures affected about 91% of students worldwide, disrupting learning and threatening to deepen existing inequalities. The shift to distance education also accelerated the use of technology. The paper calls on Comparative and International Education scholars to study these changes across different contexts and identify how technology can support the 2030 education goals while addressing weaknesses within their field.

Closson sought to foreclose a lien for lumber used in a house built by Worley. Closson had also signed a bond guaranteeing Worley’s performance. The court held that Worley’s obligation to complete the house included paying for materials and leaving it free of liens, making Closson liable under the bond. Closson’s liability was a sufficient defense to his lien claim. Notice of acceptance was unnecessary, and Closson bore the burden of proving any harmful failure to notify him of default. The judgment for the defendants was affirmed.

Texas Tech posted, then removed, an FAQ clarifying policies that restrict faculty speech and teaching about transgender identity. The FAQ said the directives do not affect independent research, advised against syllabus statements of LGBTQ allyship or pronoun language, and permitted relevant classroom discussions if instructors do not advocate a view. Faculty were not told why the FAQ was removed. A Health Sciences Center faculty member said instructors there have received no written guidance and worry that the restrictions could hinder students’ preparation for certification exams covering transgender patient care. The Texas conference of the AAUP criticized the policies as a threat to academic freedom.

The passage promotes the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and 0% introductory APR on purchases and qualifying balance transfers for 12 months. It also describes cell phone protection and compares offers from Capital One and Citi. Motley Fool Money says it receives advertiser compensation but that compensation does not influence its product ratings; it does not cover every available offer.
NVIDIA’s January 28, 2019 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release and shareholder letter updating guidance for the quarter ended January 27, 2019. Both documents are attached as exhibits.

VentureWire’s June 7, 2001 newsletter reports that FreeMarkets and Adexa canceled a planned $340 million acquisition, replacing it with a $6 million investment and a strategic relationship. inVentures and Redwood Partners merged, ChipData raised $23 million, and Bob Lisbonne joined Matrix Partners. Other reports cover venture funding, acquisitions, executive appointments and setbacks, including Music.com’s shutdown and Wapit’s bankruptcy filing.

Delta Insurance says South Island technology businesses are growing, particularly in Christchurch, Dunedin, Nelson and Queenstown. It aims to strengthen ties with the sector through Canterbury Tech membership and offers technology, cyber, liability and environmental risk coverage. Its cyber insurance includes risk assessments and expert support, while local underwriter Karl Samson works with South Island brokers.
A traditional yogurt-making method in Bulgaria and Turkey uses live ants and their bacteria to acidify and thicken warmed milk. Frozen or dehydrated ants work less well.

After W. T. Hay’s bankruptcy discharge, Deposit National Bank sought to execute its earlier judgment against property Hay had conveyed through his brother to his wife, alleging fraud. Hay sought to stop the sale, but the court held he lacked standing because he claimed no interest in the property and the execution did not affect his rights. It did not decide whether the bank could proceed or whether a sale would pass title. The appeal was dismissed at Hay’s costs.

The passage calls for a firmer but more active U.S. dialogue with the Soviet Union in 1983. It urges verifiable arms reductions, serious negotiations, and public emphasis on Soviet obstacles to agreement. On regional issues, it proposes testing Soviet intentions on Afghanistan while maintaining U.S. positions elsewhere. It favors private diplomacy on human rights, economic steps that do not strengthen Soviet military power, and reciprocal cultural access. It also proposes expanded contacts at several levels, potentially leading to a summit if relations warrant, without weakening established U.S. policy.

MacKenzie Scott is continuing to fund education equity through large, unrestricted gifts to scholarship providers serving underrepresented students. Recent recipients include 10,000 Degrees and Native Forward. She also gave $70 million to UNCF to strengthen endowments at 37 historically Black colleges and universities. Scott has donated more than $19 billion over five years.

The passage describes systems and methods for planning vehicle routes using maps whose node information is updated according to other vehicles’ motion. For automated guided vehicles, nodes near stationary vehicles may be made costly or impassable, while nodes on moving vehicles’ planned routes may receive higher costs. The system selects available start and destination nodes, calculates route costs using factors such as node weights, distance, and turns, and replans when a proposed route conflicts with another vehicle’s route. It also describes assigning tasks to available vehicles.

Apple Inc. reported that it issued $7 billion in senior unsecured notes on November 13, 2017. The six series carry interest rates of 1.800% to 3.750% and mature between 2019 and 2047. Interest is payable semiannually. The filing includes the underwriting agreement, note forms, a legal opinion and a computation of Apple’s ratio of earnings to fixed charges.

Best Buy has discounted the Lenovo Legion 7i Gen 10 by $220 to $1,650. The laptop features a bright, color-accurate OLED display, a 115-watt RTX 5060 GPU, and a well-regarded keyboard and trackpad. Its battery lasted less than five hours in a video playback test, and lower-powered RTX 5060 laptops cost less.
The Jerusalem Post asks readers to support its open-access journalism for $5 a month, offering fewer ads, premium content, a Hebrew-learning magazine and a digital edition of the newspaper.

Cu-doped and undoped NiO thin films were deposited on ITO-coated glass by spray pyrolysis at 450 °C for 1.5 minutes and tested as LPG sensors. Cu doping expanded the lattice, reduced crystallite size from 21 to 20 nm, and narrowed the optical bandgap from 3.70 to 3.65 eV. Raman and photoluminescence results indicated structural changes and increased defects. At 5 V, LPG sensitivity was 1.8 for Cu-doped NiO versus 1.3 for undoped NiO.

The passage documents AMD AGESA firmware integration across processor initialization, memory setup, late boot, suspend, and resume. It describes PPIs and HOBs that signal initialization milestones, PEIM and DXE driver responsibilities, build files and configuration options, and procedures for creating stacks and parameter structures. It also outlines platform settings for processors, memory, graphics, PCIe, and chipset devices. Host environments must provide services including memory-buffer management, resets, DIMM SPD reads, and execution of tasks on application processors.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on February 1, 2018, announcing its fourth-quarter and full-year 2017 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

The National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) was founded in 2012 after two U.S. professional women’s soccer leagues folded. With support from U.S. Soccer and controls on spending, it prioritized stability. By 2020, it had nine teams but still faced limited media coverage, uneven attendance and concerns about player pay.

Lisa Baird became commissioner in March 2020, just as COVID-19 disrupted the season. She worked with owners, players, staff and medical experts to develop safety protocols and a new competition format. The league staged the Challenge Cup in Utah from June 27 to July 26, becoming the first U.S. professional league to return to play. More than 2,000 tests during the tournament yielded no positive cases. A Fall Series followed.

In 2020, NWSL television viewership rose 493% over 2019, and the league gained sponsors and planned new teams. Entering 2021, its priorities included expanding fan engagement and media exposure, negotiating a collective bargaining agreement, developing a new brand and defining its relationship with U.S. Soccer.

Alek Minassian, 25, appeared in a Toronto court charged with 10 counts of first-degree murder after a rental van struck pedestrians, killing 10 and injuring 15. Officials said the attack did not pose a national security threat, and its motive remained unclear. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau urged Canadians to stand united as mourners left flowers and messages at a memorial.

The passage calls for practical education that prepares farmers for work, citizenship, and cooperation. It argues that farmer associations provide economic and social benefits and help the Department of Agriculture deliver assistance, including efforts against the boll weevil and cattle fever tick. It praises irrigation and forest preservation policies and urges protection of additional forests. It also recommends funding preliminary work on a memorial amphitheater at Arlington and giving Congress authority over marriage, divorce, and polygamy.

U.S. airlines canceled a record-low 1.17% of scheduled domestic flights in 2016. Mishandled baggage and involuntary bumping also reached their lowest recorded rates. On-time arrivals rose to 81.4% from 79.9% in 2015, while traveler complaints fell 11.3%.

Researchers at Oregon Health & Science University report that a technique used to create mouse eggs from adult skin cells has been mostly unsuccessful with human cells. They developed a process to reduce chromosome numbers, but significant obstacles remain before the method could be clinically tested.

AMC management proposes doubling authorized shares to 1.1 billion, which could dilute shareholders. Despite debt refinancings, net debt remains above $3 billion, while weak box office revenue, losses, negative equity and cash burn weigh on its valuation.

A study of 19 mothers found that watching videos of their own babies prompted dopamine release in their brains. Mothers who released more dopamine were more responsive to their infants’ needs, suggesting the chemical plays a role in mother-child bonding and caregiving. Researchers said responsive care is important for infant brain development, but further research is needed to determine whether similar responses occur in fathers and other caregivers. The study was small and could not establish whether mothers were predisposed to bond more strongly with their children.

The June 8, 2001, CongressDailyAM reports that House appropriators’ proposed FY02 spending allocations largely follow President Bush’s requests, though some programs would receive more. House appropriations leaders also plan to keep an FY01 supplemental bill at the president’s requested level despite calls for more defense funding.

House Republican leaders say the Democratic takeover of the Senate is unlikely to change their legislative approach. Rep. Steve Largent plans to resign in November to run for Oklahoma governor, while Rep. Asa Hutchinson’s expected departure could slow business-liability legislation. Other reports cover planned ergonomics forums, FDA warnings about imported drugs sent by mail, debate over generic-drug patent rules, European concerns about a U.S. steel-import investigation, and Senate negotiations over the handling of Bush nominees. The issue also lists upcoming congressional hearings and events.

Trauma is common among postsecondary students and can affect attendance, learning, relationships, and daily routines. Healthcare students may also experience secondary traumatic stress through their training. This literature review describes trauma-informed care (TIC) in health professions education, particularly occupational therapy (OT). It outlines principles including safety, trust, peer support, collaboration, empowerment, and respect for cultural and historical experiences. Recommended practices include faculty training, student participation, clear communication, advance notice of potentially distressing content, self-care instruction, and support services. Studies of simulation-based TIC training reported gains in OT students’ knowledge and self-efficacy. The paper encourages OT educators to evaluate their practices and adopt supportive approaches while maintaining academic expectations.

Researchers transferred nuclei from human skin cells into donor eggs and used a chemical to help the cells shed chromosomes. Some fertilized cells formed early embryos, but none had the correct chromosome sets or were viable. The proof-of-concept technique could eventually help people facing infertility, but researchers say it is too inefficient and risky for clinical use.

Deletions of the malaria parasite genes *pfhrp2* and *pfhrp3* can cause false-negative results on widely used HRP2-based rapid diagnostic tests. This study updates a malaria transmission model to assess where deletions may spread and cause clinically relevant infections to be misdiagnosed. Malaria prevalence was the strongest modelled driver of selection, with lower-prevalence regions generally at greater risk. Based on current estimates of deletion prevalence, the model predicts that at least one region in 29 of 49 African countries could reach, or has already reached, a 5% misdiagnosis threshold within 20 years. It projects spread from the Horn of Africa through East Africa and increases in parts of West Africa. The authors caution that gaps in surveillance, uncertain prevalence estimates and simplified assumptions about parasite movement limit confidence in the timelines. The risk maps are intended to help prioritize surveillance and consideration of alternative tests.

A July 31 IEP news email compiles reports on California’s energy crisis. They cover criticism of Gov. Gray Davis’ long-term power contracts and proposed Southern California Edison bailout; a preliminary SEC inquiry into advisers’ energy-stock trading; San Francisco public-power ballot measures; and a federal ruling that could limit California’s electricity refunds to under $4 billion. Other reports discuss electricity deregulation in Texas and a proposed Baltimore Gas and Electric restructuring.

Gas colic occurs when gas produced during normal hindgut fermentation builds up in a horse’s large colon. Although described as the least serious form of colic, it can lead to complications. The passage identifies restricted forage, confinement, stress, dehydration, ulcers, inadequate exercise, and abrupt feed changes as possible contributors. It recommends continuous access to forage, more turnout and movement, and gradual changes to hay and feed. Slow feeders may help maintain forage access when pasture is limited.

The lecture models protein backbones as fixed-angle chains whose links can rotate around bonds. It examines four problems: endpoint span, flattening, connectivity between flat states, and locked chains. Finding minimum or maximum span in a flat state and deciding whether a chain has a non-self-intersecting flat state are NP-hard; several three-dimensional questions remain open. Orthogonal and obtuse open chains are flat-state connected, while some constrained linkages are not. A model of protein production through a cone yields an algorithm connecting producible configurations and flat states through a canonical configuration, without specifying the forces that fold proteins.

Newark police are seeking the public’s help locating nine suspects in seven unsolved shootings and robberies dating back to June 2016. The cases include a grocery-store robbery involving three suspects and a shooting that wounded three people. Public Safety Director Anthony Ambrose said tips can be submitted confidentially and may lead to a reward.

Asus launched the Zenfone 5Z in India in three variants priced from Rs. 29,999 to Rs. 36,999. The Flipkart-exclusive phone goes on sale July 15. It features a 6.2-inch notched display, Snapdragon 845 processor, dual rear cameras, Android Oreo and a 3300mAh battery. Launch offers include an ICICI card discount, Jio cashback and additional data.

In *People v Helzer*, the court upheld Richard Helzer’s two gross indecency convictions but set aside the sexual delinquency finding. It held that sexual delinquency is an alternate sentencing matter that, unless the defendant waives a jury, must be decided by a separate jury after conviction on the principal charge. Helzer was entitled to 20 peremptory challenges for that jury, but only five for the gross indecency jury. The case was remanded for a new sexual delinquency hearing if the prosecutor pursued the charge. Chief Justice Kavanagh dissented, arguing that the sexual delinquency statute was unconstitutionally vague.

American Girl is releasing its first male doll, Logan Everett, a drummer in a new contemporary series. The company says fans have requested a boy character for decades. Colonial-era doll Felicity Merriman will return, while filmmaker Z Yang and World War II-era Nanea will debut later in 2017.

The University of Manchester’s Students’ Union opened Earth Week with a panel on climate change and migration. Asad Rehman argued that poorer countries bear disproportionate harm and that people displaced by climate-related disasters need legal protection. Martin Empson urged people to support campaigns through protests, petitions, letters or donations, and called for environmental and migration movements to work together.

The American Cancer Society’s updated guideline recommends that adults at average risk begin colorectal cancer screening at age 45, citing rising rates in younger adults and modeling that favors an earlier start. The age-45 recommendation is qualified because direct evidence for adults 45–49 is limited; screening from age 50 is a strong recommendation. Adults may choose among recommended stool-based tests and visual exams, with timely colonoscopy after a positive non-colonoscopy result. Healthy adults with a life expectancy exceeding 10 years should continue screening through age 75. Decisions for ages 76–85 should be individualized, and screening after 85 is discouraged.

European wholesale power prices fell on Tuesday as wind supply increased and demand eased. German and French Wednesday baseload prices dropped 16% and 20%, respectively, while forward contracts tracked lower coal prices. Traders also cited improved French nuclear supply and expectations of sharply lower demand next week.

Tesla issued $127.5 million in additional 2.375% convertible senior notes due March 2022 after underwriters exercised their option in full. In related transactions, Tesla paid approximately $26.6 million for note hedges intended to reduce potential dilution or offset certain conversion payments. It also received approximately $6.9 million from warrants allowing counterparties to acquire up to approximately 0.8 million shares at an adjustable $655-per-share strike price.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines rasterization, real-time ray tracing and AI-based image processing. Its GDDR6 memory, larger caches and compression deliver about 50% more effective bandwidth than Pascal in the TU102-based comparison. Turing also adds 8K display support, improved video encoding and decoding, and VirtualLink connectivity for VR headsets. TU102 and TU104 use NVLink for two-GPU SLI.

Dedicated RT Cores accelerate ray tracing, while hybrid rendering, BVH structures and denoising reduce its computational demands. Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting and super-resolution. Mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading and multi-view rendering give developers more control over rendering efficiency and quality, including in VR. The passage also describes TU104 and TU106 GPUs, the Tesla T4, and an RTX-OPS metric for hybrid-rendering workloads.

Canada’s Privacy Commissioner has opened a formal investigation into Uber’s 2016 data breach, which exposed information belonging to more than 57 million riders and drivers worldwide. Uber has not disclosed how many Canadians were affected. Authorities elsewhere are also investigating. The breach remained secret for over a year, and Uber paid the thieves $100,000.

The passage summarizes Robert Stuart’s criticism of a BBC documentary about an alleged 2013 incendiary attack near Aleppo. It questions the injuries shown, conflicting victim counts and accounts of when the attack occurred. It also raises concerns about the backgrounds and affiliations of medical personnel in the footage. The author argues that these issues cast doubt on the documentary’s account.

Radical-pair spin relaxation is relevant to quantum computing, spintronics and avian magnetoreception, but simulations face mixed nuclear states, exponentially growing state spaces and long propagation times. The passage introduces tensor-network methods for modelling two-electron radical pairs coupled to nuclear spins. Stochastic matrix product states use sampled initial spin configurations, while matrix product density operators offer deterministic evaluation at greater computational cost. These representations compress the wavefunction or density operator and are used to study spin evolution and spin-selective reactions.

An international team is trying to rescue 12 boys and their soccer coach from a flooded Thai cave, where they were found alive after nine days. A cave rescue expert says waiting for water to recede is usually safest, but monsoon rains could keep this cave flooded for months. The group is weak after going without food and is receiving it gradually. Rescuers could wait while supplying them, seek another entrance, drill one, or attempt a dangerous dive. Whether they can safely remain in the cave depends on the risk of further flooding.

Terry Rozier scored a career-high 31 points in his second start, and Jayson Tatum added a career-high 27 as the injury-depleted Celtics beat the Hawks 119-110. Boston outscored Atlanta 41-20 in the third quarter to take control. Taurean Prince scored a career-high 31 for Atlanta, which has lost five of six.

Frank Hoffman agreed in a plea agreement to pay restitution up to $53,653.45. After a contested hearing, the court ordered him to pay $40,933.45, and his direct appeal was dismissed. The Arizona Supreme Court affirmed, holding that a post-judgment restitution order within a plea agreement’s cap is part of the sentence and cannot be directly appealed under A.R.S. § 13-4033(B). Hoffman may seek review through Rule 32 post-conviction relief proceedings.

President-elect Donald Trump tweeted on January 2, 2017, that CNN had used the “worst cover photo” of him for its book *Unprecedented*, though he said he hoped the book did well. The tweet drew replies criticizing his focus on the photo and posting other awkward images of him. The passage also describes attention to his other recent Twitter activity.

The Bank of Japan is unlikely to rush out of its ultra-loose monetary policy despite solid growth, according to sources familiar with its thinking. Policymakers fear that signaling an exit could sharply strengthen the yen and hurt the export-reliant economy, while inflation remains well below the bank’s 2 percent target. A possible increase in yield targets next year would likely be modest rather than the start of a sustained rate-hike cycle. Prolonged easing, however, strains banks and leaves the BOJ with fewer tools to respond to a downturn.

Apple’s fiscal first-quarter 2022 Form 10-Q reports net sales of $123.9 billion, up 11% from the prior-year quarter, and net income of $34.6 billion, up from $28.8 billion. Growth was driven primarily by iPhone, Services and Mac sales. Gross margin rose to 43.8% from 39.8%. Apple generated $47.0 billion in operating cash flow, repurchased $20.4 billion of stock and paid $3.7 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. The company said pandemic-related disruptions affected some suppliers and sales.

U.S. stock futures edged higher ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision and Janet Yellen’s remarks. Tuesday’s options volume was near average. Apple shares gained nearly 1% after CEO Tim Cook confirmed work on autonomous systems. Tesla options activity rose following two reports, while Micron rebounded after a bullish research note.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 31, 2018, reporting that it issued a press release and data sheet on its third-quarter financial results for the period ended June 30, 2018. Both documents were attached as exhibits.

This preprint describes a blood test that identifies circulating glial cells using GFAP and OLIG2 markers to help distinguish glial malignancies from benign brain tumors and other cancers. Across blinded case-control and prospective studies, reported sensitivity ranged from 92.9% to 100%, with 100% specificity. The test uses a peripheral blood sample and could support diagnosis when tissue biopsy is difficult, but it does not determine tumor subtype or grade and does not detect some rarer malignancies. The study was funded by Datar Cancer Genetics Private Limited, which employs several authors.

The speaker credits his father and coaches for their support, describes Buffalo’s growing hockey scene, and says he enjoys both scoring and setting up teammates. He is willing to play wing or center, chose the OHL over college, and would like to bring a Stanley Cup to Buffalo.

Carleton University is hiring a chair to teach and research conjuring arts, focusing on perception, deception and the history of magic. The five-year renewable position is funded by a $2 million Slaight Family Foundation grant matched by the university and will include developing a digital magic archive. Separately, a University of London experiment found that a magician’s misleading gesture made participants less likely to identify a trick’s solution, suggesting that an initial explanation can make alternatives harder to consider.

Adam Henrique and Travis Zajac described the Kings as a deep, physical team with strong goaltending and puck-moving defensemen. They said their own team was tentative early in the first game, gave away pucks and struggled to sustain its forecheck, but improved as the game went on and still had a chance to win. They expect to execute better by getting pucks behind the defense and generating shots through their cycle.

Energy Central’s November 23, 2001 daily edition compiles electric-power and gas-industry news. Stories cover Enron’s financial difficulties and proposed Dynegy acquisition, California electricity regulation and budgets, utility acquisitions, rates, power-plant projects, and international energy developments. It also includes restructuring headlines and a California grid load forecast.

Former U.S. Sen. Mark Begich’s campaign for Alaska governor has raised concerns among some Democrats and independents that he and independent Gov. Bill Walker could split the vote and help the Republican nominee win. Walker, who won in 2014 on a unity ticket with Democrat Byron Mallott, plans to bypass the primary and run with Mallott again. Former state Sen. Mike Dunleavy is seen as an early favorite for the Republican nomination. Begich says he would not run if he did not think he could win and argues Walker has lacked a broader vision for Alaska. Democratic party leaders reject the idea that Begich’s candidacy makes a three-way race unwinnable.

The Sixth Circuit affirmed Dr. Howard Ellzey’s convictions for conspiring to illegally distribute controlled substances and eleven counts of illegal distribution. Evidence showed that he routinely issued amphetamine prescriptions to diet patients after brief visits, sometimes allowing the same person to obtain prescriptions at both of his offices in one day. A DEA survey found that he wrote 29,000 of 39,000 Schedule II prescriptions filled by six Memphis drugstores during the period studied. The court found sufficient evidence and rejected his challenges to the admission of the prescriptions, the indictment’s wording, testimony, and jury procedures.

U.S. stocks rallied after Trump’s election on hopes for tax cuts, infrastructure spending and deregulation, but gains slowed after he took office as proposals faced obstacles. From the election to inauguration, hospital stocks fell 7.1%, while infrastructure stocks rose 13%, bank stocks 20.8% and small-cap stocks 12.6%. Since inauguration, all four measures have risen, by 4.1%, 2.4%, 3.1% and 5.3%, respectively. A stalled healthcare repeal helped hospitals recover, while the absence of an infrastructure package and doubts about deregulation tempered other gains. Tax-cut hopes continued to support stocks, though the healthcare setback raised doubts about Trump’s ability to enact his plans.

The author describes living with panic disorder and managing it through therapy, medication, and professional guidance. Unlike persistent anxiety, a panic attack is a brief burst of intense fear; attacks associated with panic disorder may have no apparent trigger. Recognizing symptoms such as a pounding heart, shortness of breath, dizziness, and fear of dying can help, though a physical exam is important to rule out other problems. Mental health professionals recommend carrying reassuring facts or mantras, imagining panic sensations as passing waves, using games or audio for distraction, and practicing slow, deep breathing daily so it is easier to use during an attack.

This week’s mobile game deals include *A Good Snowman is Hard to Build* (£2.99/$2.99, iOS/Android), *Assassin’s Creed Identity* (99p/99c, iOS/Android), *Kensho* (£1.99/$1.99, iOS), *Royal Trouble* (£1.99/$1.99 or less, iOS/Android), *Runic Rampage* (£2.19/$2.49, Android), and *Warhammer 40,000* (£4.99/$4.99, iOS). *Ace Attorney* titles and *Spite & Malic HD* are free on iOS. Deals may change during the week.

Using 2019 National Survey of Early Care and Education data, the study examined recent child care and early education searches by 1,190 households with a child under six that considered multiple providers. Analysis of families’ first two reported information sources identified five search types, centered on local referral organizations, internet searches, known providers, social media, or friends and family. Friends and family were the most commonly used source overall, followed by internet searches.

Search types differed in whether families sought information about types of care, whether the child had a condition affecting care, and geographic region. They were otherwise largely similar across the family and child characteristics examined. The findings are limited by recording no more than two sources and by an analytic sample that differed from the broader household population.

Ganton, Mulgrave and Ebberston won their respective Division Two, Division One and Premier Division finals at the T20 Cayley Cup Finals Day at North Marine Road. Ganton beat Kirkbymoorside by nine wickets, Mulgrave defeated Sherburn by 28 runs, and Ebberston beat Filey by six wickets.

Swarthmore students face high expectations and often take their mistakes too seriously. The passage argues that students can pursue excellence while accepting mistakes, learning from them, and laughing at themselves. It also urges them to give others the benefit of the doubt and seek clarification before judging potentially offensive remarks. Laughter will not solve everything, but it can help students cope with an intense environment.

A.J. Brown said he wants the ball when the Eagles’ offense struggles, emphasizing that his frustration is about helping the team rather than boosting his statistics. He has exceeded 30 receiving yards only once this season, while DeVonta Smith has not surpassed 60 yards in a game. Philadelphia is 4-0.

The NVIDIA A100 GPU has 40 GB of ECC-protected HBM2 memory delivering 1555 GB/s and a 40 MB L2 cache. Compared with the Tesla V100, it offers more SMs, higher Tensor Core performance, and greater memory and cache bandwidth. Asynchronous copies, barriers, cache residency controls, compression, and CUDA task graphs aim to improve data movement and execution efficiency.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide an A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. The A100 also supports third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, hardware JPEG and video decoding, and optical-flow acceleration. An eight-GPU DGX A100 system can provide up to 5 PFLOPS of AI performance. The passage also describes the A100’s support for fine-grained structured sparsity and NVIDIA’s CUDA and DGX software tools.

The lecturer advises students to do problem 8.1, says 8.2 requires more background, and defers 8.3 until the BCJR algorithm is covered. The lecture constructs Reed–Muller codes using the self-inverse binary Hadamard transform and compares simple graphical realizations with cycles against more complex cycle-free realizations. It then introduces sum-product decoding: on cycle-free graphs, the algorithm computes exact a posteriori probabilities; on graphs with cycles, it becomes iterative and approximate. These probabilities support bit decisions and provide soft information for decoding larger codes. The sum-product algorithm will be continued next time.

San Diego County confirmed its first human West Nile virus case of the year in a Spring Valley woman. California has reported 231 illnesses and 12 deaths this year. County officials advise residents to use mosquito repellent, wear protective clothing and remove standing water where mosquitoes can breed.

In a laboratory experiment, bumblebee queens fed syrup containing field-relevant traces of the neonicotinoid pesticide thiamethoxam were 26 percent less likely to lay eggs than unexposed queens. Researchers warn that reduced reproduction could threaten wild populations, but say the pesticide’s impact in the wild relative to other threats remains unclear. The findings may bolster calls to restrict neonicotinoids. The European Union is considering making a temporary moratorium permanent, while pesticide companies and some farmers argue the restrictions have reduced canola yields and increased spraying of other pesticides.

The lecture demonstrates Shellshock, in which attacker-controlled HTTP headers can become Bash environment variables and trigger command execution, and cross-site scripting, in which untrusted content runs code in a victim page. It surveys defenses including browser filters, HTTP-only cookies, separate domains for untrusted content, sanitization, simpler markup languages, Content Security Policy, and disabling content sniffing. These defenses have limitations, particularly because web languages and browser parsing are complex.

The professor also discusses SQL injection, unsafe file paths, and the risks of using cookies for session management. Alternatives include authenticating requests with message authentication codes, DOM storage, and client certificates, each with trade-offs. Further examples show how inconsistent URL parsing and GIF files containing executable JAR content can create vulnerabilities. Finally, the lecture describes attacks that infer browsing history through visited-link colors, cache and DNS timing, and rendering behavior.

Asian equities were mostly lower after the Federal Reserve raised rates by 25 basis points and outlined plans to unwind its balance sheet. Markets viewed the move as dovish and questioned whether the Fed would make three hikes this year. Oil prices fell to a seven-month low, while Toshiba shares declined amid legal action by Western Digital subsidiaries. Stronger-than-expected Australian jobs data lifted the Australian dollar; weaker-than-expected New Zealand GDP weighed on the kiwi.

Junior County, the No. 4 shooting guard in the 2026 recruiting class, committed to UConn after visiting campus. The Wasatch Academy guard cited his connection with coach Dan Hurley and confidence in his development there. County is UConn’s first commitment for 2026.

The November 14, 2000 VentureWire reports that Apax merged its European and Israeli units and pledged $600 million for Israeli investments. New Edge Networks cut 135 jobs; KSolutions raised $50 million; and Cisco acquired wireless chipmaker Radiata for $295 million. The issue also covers numerous funding rounds, acquisitions, closures, layoffs, product and company-name changes, executive appointments, and venture capital personnel news.
