This retrospective multicentre study used brain MRI and deep learning to distinguish ageing-related from multiple sclerosis-specific brain damage. Models were developed using scans from 4,392 patients and assessed with a longitudinal cohort of 252 patients. Patients’ brains appeared about eight years older than predicted by a healthy-ageing model. The gap between brain-predicted and reported disease duration was largely independent of the brain-age gap; both were associated with physical disability, and their changes independently explained disability worsening. A multiple sclerosis-specific brain-age gap did not add significantly to the conventional brain-age measure. The authors propose the disease-duration gap as a potential marker of disease severity and progression, while noting uncertainty in reported disease onset, possible treatment-related bias, and the need for further clinical validation.

The discovery of Richard III’s remains beneath a Leicester car park changed the lives of several people connected to it. Dominic Smee, whose spine curved much like Richard’s, portrayed the king in a documentary and gained confidence. Michael Ibsen, a descendant of Richard’s sister, supplied DNA that helped confirm the remains and was later asked to make Richard’s coffin. Car park attendant Mike Mistry witnessed the excavation and met visitors from around the world. Musician Ian Churchward turned the discovery into inspiration for several Richard III albums.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. Device-dependent duty-cycle limits are configured through DCL; the TPS7H5004-SP supports only a 50% maximum. CS_ILIM controls PWM operation and overcurrent protection. Sustained overcurrent triggers cycle-by-cycle limiting, followed by a timed shutdown and restart governed by the HICC capacitor. The FAULT pin supports additional external protections, while thermal shutdown stops switching above 175°C typical.

The passage describes slope and frequency compensation, then gives a 500-kHz synchronous push-pull GaN converter design example with component-selection guidance. It also recommends a regulated 4–14-V controller supply, close bypass capacitors, separation of sensitive signals from switching noise, and careful grounding and PCB layout.

Beijing ordered 15 real estate websites to remove misleading advertising, promises of rising investment returns, feng shui content and financing advice by Wednesday. The order follows higher down-payment requirements, shorter mortgage terms and a ban on third-home purchases aimed at cooling the housing market.

The passage introduces the Situation Calculus as a framework for describing actions and change, including successor state axioms that address the frame problem. It distinguishes Markovian theories, in which actions depend on the current situation, from non-Markovian theories, which can refer to past situations. The paper uses the latter to model a taxonomy of obligations. It outlines the calculus, illustrates its action and fluent axioms with a door-opening example, and describes an obligation fluent that represents which situations are deontically accessible from a given situation.

The report argues that California’s nonpartisan primary system and rising independent registration have weakened party affiliation without necessarily reducing ideological polarization. It warns that further weakening parties could produce more fragmented elections.

A Quinnipiac poll puts Sen. Ted Cruz ahead of Beto O’Rourke, 50% to 39%, in Texas. The report also says House Republicans are emphasizing immigration in campaign ads, while Democrats focus on health care and social programs. President Trump continued to question the FBI’s use of a confidential source in the Russia investigation despite Rep. Trey Gowdy’s assessment that the FBI acted appropriately.

Researchers combined fungal fossils with 17 rare gene transfers to estimate that the common ancestor of living fungi dates to roughly 1.4–0.9 billion years ago, long before land plants. The findings suggest ancient fungi may have partnered with algae, broken down rock and recycled nutrients, helping form primitive soils and prepare land for plants.

The passage argues that U.S. strategic superiority helped avert war during the 1962 Cuban missile crisis, but that later policymakers underestimated a Soviet military buildup. It criticizes the Carter administration’s responses to Soviet activity in Cuba and Afghanistan, warning that perceived weakness has damaged U.S. credibility and alliances. The speaker calls for a measured restoration of conventional and strategic military strength, firm opposition to terrorism, closer consultation with allies, and an uncompromising defense of U.S. principles as the path to peace.

An October 2001 collection of Enron-related news reports says a partnership organized by CFO Andrew Fastow made millions in transactions with Enron, raising conflict-of-interest questions. Enron reported a $618 million third-quarter loss and a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity linked to ending partnership-related deals. NewPower revised its agreement with Enron subsidiaries to reduce its cash-collateral requirements temporarily. Other reports note Enron’s lobbying spending, planned staff cuts at Enron Metals in Europe, and a December court hearing on an Enron-promoted power company’s dispute in India.

United Airlines emphasized uncrowded lounges and seatback entertainment as it seeks to attract premium travelers, implicitly contrasting itself with Delta’s crowded Sky Clubs and American’s reliance on passengers’ devices. United said its screens are installed on more than 146,000 seats across 765 aircraft. Its third-quarter premium cabin revenue rose about 6% year over year, compared with Delta’s 9%.

MusConv is a paid tool for transferring Spotify playlists to Amazon Music. Users select a Spotify playlist, choose Amazon Music as the destination, and click “Transfer.” Its Basic, Professional, and Ultimate subscriptions offer different features, including CSV export, batch importing, and duplicate-track deletion.

China’s top official in Hong Kong warned that the city must not be used to undermine mainland stability, amid tensions over an independence movement and the ousting of two pro-independence lawmakers. Concerns about eroding freedoms have grown following the detention of five booksellers on the mainland. Leader Leung Chun-ying will not seek another term; former security chief Regina Ip plans to run.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated July 23, 2015, announcing its second-quarter 2015 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

During National Health Center Week, Springfield’s Caring Health Center highlighted its care for more than 20,000 people. Its Elected Officials Day brought representatives and community leaders together to discuss community health centers. The week ends August 19.

The Competition and Markets Authority said some care homes may be breaking consumer law by charging self-funding residents unfair fees, including after death or before admission. It also raised concerns about eviction threats, undisclosed prices and barriers to complaints. The watchdog is bringing a test case and may recommend tighter legislation.

The passage describes noninvasive physiological monitors that combine optical sensor data from multiple patient sites to produce a single measurement, rather than processing each site independently. It also describes sensors with multiple photodetectors arranged to follow a measurement site’s three-dimensional contour. These configurations may provide more data, improve measurement robustness, and help indicate whether a sensor is positioned correctly. Parameters discussed include oxygen saturation, pulse rate, hemoglobin measures, and glucose.

After his grandfather died of heart disease, seven-year-old Joseph Nyberg started “Heart Cents,” collecting pennies and dollars for St. Joseph’s heart patients. He raised more than $200; a patient’s family matched his fundraising, and another family donated $250, bringing the total to $672.14. The money will help cover costs such as transportation and co-pays. Joseph hopes to continue the collection in his grandfather’s memory.

The passage describes a surgical robotic wrist with two transverse rotation axes between proximal and distal joints. Torque sensors on the transverse axes measure forces applied to an attached instrument or end effector; additional sensors may measure torque at the other joints. A processor can use the readings for force feedback to the surgeon. The wrist is designed to provide a wide range of motion while avoiding joint-motion problems associated with an earlier wrist design.

A valid write requires at least 32 SCLKs per data transfer frame. After power-up or asynchronous reset, the device uses SPI-00-S for reads and writes. Other SPI-compatible protocols are selected through SDI_MODE; single-SDO reads require SDO_MODE = 00b. In SPI-compatible transfers, RVS remains low. Dual SDO mode is enabled through SDO1_CONFIG. A long frame with SDO_CNTL_REG[7:0] = 00h produces daisy-chain operation.

The study examined blockchain courses at 533 US universities with AACSB-accredited business schools and found that 151 offered at least one, totaling 361 courses. Most courses were undergraduate-level and focused on blockchain fundamentals, digital assets and cryptocurrencies, or technical development. Offerings spanned multiple disciplines, particularly business and computer science, and some addressed connections with AI and other emerging technologies. The passage emphasizes that enterprise blockchain integration requires technical, social, methodological, and personal skills. It recommends further research comparing course content with industry needs and tracking how offerings change over time.

Ohio education regulators are reviewing a former employee’s claim that the now-closed online charter school Electronic Classroom of Tomorrow used software to inflate student attendance hours tied to state funding. The state had previously found that the school owed $60 million for over-reporting students in 2015–2016 and assessed a further $19 million penalty for 2016–2017. Regulators said they had challenged how the school claimed hours using the software. A former school spokesman dismissed the allegations, while the state auditor’s office said it considered the employee’s concerns in an unreleased audit. Some officials called for a criminal investigation.
Nobel Prizes honor discoveries but leave much of science unseen. Katalin Karikó won a 2023 medicine prize.

CoreLogic reported that house prices rose year over year through May by 8.3 percent in Los Angeles County, 8.2 percent in Riverside and San Bernardino counties, and 6.2 percent in Orange County. California prices rose 8.9 percent, compared with 7.1 percent nationally. CoreLogic attributed rising prices partly to limited supply, as homeowners with low-rate mortgages are reluctant to sell.

Distributed systems consist of components running on multiple machines, but their patterns often begin with groups of containers on a single machine. Splitting an application into containers provides resource isolation, clear team ownership, and separation of concerns. It can protect user-facing services from lower-priority background tasks, enable components such as Git synchronization tools to be reused, and allow smaller, more reliable deployments. The single-node patterns described assume that containers can be reliably scheduled together and can optionally share resources. Kubernetes calls such a tightly grouped set of containers a pod.

The Combo defense combines aggressive outside pass denial with two inside players zoning for backside support against spread offenses. The on-ball defender steers dribblers toward the sideline or baseline; inside defenders help against penetration or traps. When a dribbler gives up the ball, defenders deny return passes. If the dribbler picks up the ball, defenders smother the ball handler and deny passing options.

In his final Oval Office address, the President thanks Americans and his administration for eight years of service. He cites gains in employment, education, health coverage, public safety, environmental protection, and the federal budget. Looking ahead, he urges continued fiscal responsibility, American leadership in a connected world, and action on global poverty and security threats. He also calls for unity and fair treatment of all Americans as the country grows more diverse. He wishes President-elect George W. Bush well and says he hopes to continue serving as a citizen.

Mikel Obi said Nigeria’s Super Eagles will give their best against England in a June 2, 2018 friendly at Wembley, ahead of the World Cup. Nigeria will also play the Czech Republic before facing Croatia, Iceland and Argentina in Group D.

United Distributors sued Airco Appliance & Hardware, its president Burke, and Willis to recover an unpaid $3,107.82 note, relying on a credit guarantee Willis had signed. Willis signed while considering a half interest in Airco but withdrew before becoming a shareholder. The plaintiff was informed of his decision, though it retained the guarantee without his knowledge. The Louisiana Supreme Court held that Willis’s reason for signing the guarantee had failed, making it ineffective, and affirmed the dismissal of the suit against him.

Johnson & Johnson’s first-quarter sales fell slightly short of analyst estimates, while adjusted earnings per share met expectations. The company raised its 2017 sales and earnings guidance to include the estimated impact of the Actelion transaction, but Remicade sales fell 6% year over year, and several consumer units reported declines. The author considers the stock reasonably valued but sees limited upside and downside risk, concluding that better value may be available elsewhere.

The passage documents AGESA procedures for processor, cache, and memory initialization across boot, suspend, and resume. Stackless assembler routines establish and remove a per-core pre-memory stack; most other procedures require a stack. Boot routines perform reset and processor initialization, configure execution cache, initialize memory, transfer hand-off data to main memory, configure graphics, and generate operating-system information tables. Suspend routines save processor context, while resume routines restore memory and silicon state.

It also describes structure allocation, diagnostic and address-lookup services, event logging, and host-environment call-outs for memory buffers, resets, SPD reads, AP tasks, and platform-specific controls. Procedures have specified timing and dependencies; several run on all cores, while others are performed by the BSP. Some cache and APIC provisions apply only to x86-64 APUs, and the Platform Security Processor handles DRAM initialization on the specified AArch64 APUs.

Kesha publicly supported Taylor Swift during her legal dispute with former DJ David Mueller, whose lawsuit against Swift was dismissed while her $1 assault-and-battery countersuit remained pending. Swift had donated $250,000 to Kesha in 2016 during Kesha’s legal battle with producer Dr. Luke.

ConocoPhillips plans to sell its San Juan Basin assets to a Hilcorp Energy affiliate for $2.7 billion in cash, with up to $300 million more tied to natural gas prices. The sale follows a $13.3 billion Canadian asset sale and would reduce ConocoPhillips’ exposure to natural gas. Together, the sales are expected to lower 2017 production by 25.4% from its earlier forecast; the San Juan sale would also reduce operating cash flow and result in a noncash impairment. Management says the proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. The author views the deal favorably but says its value depends on how the cash is used.
The passage describes four graphical user interface embodiments and an electronic device displaying the first. Broken lines show the screen or device but are not part of the claimed design.

The passage outlines work for the peace conference on boundaries, governments, economic arrangements, and protection of minorities and vulnerable peoples. The Inquiry would provide indexed data, maps, reports, analysis, and trained staff, while other bodies would handle tasks such as prisoner repatriation and armaments. In subsequent correspondence, S. E. Mezes requests a proposed agreement among American republics; Secretary of State Robert Lansing sends it confidentially. The draft treaty seeks to guarantee territorial integrity and political independence, clarify boundaries, and settle disputes peacefully.

Brayan Rocchio’s eighth-inning home run sparked a five-run rally as the Cleveland Guardians beat the Detroit Tigers to force a decisive Game 3 of their AL Wild Card Series. Detroit stranded 15 baserunners, a team playoff record.

VIX futures are Cboe Futures Exchange contracts based on the VIX Index, which measures expected U.S. equity-market volatility over the next 30 days. Traders use them to speculate on volatility, hedge equity risk, or diversify portfolios. Prices are affected by stock-market cycles and by contango or backwardation, but futures do not precisely track the spot VIX. Full contracts equal the index value multiplied by $1,000; mini contracts are one-tenth that size. Both settle financially. Trading requires a funded futures-broker account, and leverage can magnify losses. The passage reports no VIX futures backtest the authors considered worth trading.

Elliott Wave theory describes asset prices as patterns of impulse waves moving with a trend and corrective waves moving against it. Impulse waves have five sub-waves; corrective waves have three. Traders use the patterns, sometimes alongside moving averages and momentum indicators, to assess potential price movements. The passage says wave interpretation is subjective, provides no certainty, and lacks clear entry and exit signals, making the strategy difficult to backtest. The timeframe used depends on the trader’s style.

The study developed simultaneous ADF-EDS-EELS tomography to map the 3D structure, chemical composition, and Mn and Co valence states of NCM111 battery cathode particles while reducing electron exposure and alignment errors. Across 0, 50, 100, and 200 cycles, composition changed largely uniformly throughout particles, whereas transition-metal segregation and valence-state differences were concentrated near surfaces. Oxygen content fell sharply after 200 cycles, alongside a transition toward rock-salt structure and increases in lower Mn and Co valence states. The findings identify structural transitions, metal migration, and dissolution-driven segregation as interacting degradation processes.

The justices debated whether restitution under the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act is criminal punishment, which would bar applying the law to increase Holsey Ellingburg’s punishment for an earlier offense. Ellingburg and the government argued against applying the law, while a court-appointed attorney defended his sentence. Justice Samuel Alito emphasized restitution’s victim-focused, civil features; Justices Elena Kagan and Ketanji Brown Jackson stressed its place in criminal sentencing. The author predicts the justices will reject applying the law to Ellingburg.

The Indiana Court of Appeals affirmed the denial of Mumma Brothers Drilling Co.’s tax refund claim. Mumma was subject to sales or use tax on equipment it installed in water wells. The court held that the claimed exemption for machinery used to extract tangible property did not apply because there was no evidence that customers resold the water they extracted. It also reaffirmed that part of the refund claim was barred by the statute of limitations.

The passage examines how microtubule dynamics relate to drug resistance in advanced prostate cancer. It describes an image-analysis method that tracks fluorescent markers on growing microtubule tips and uses it to measure growth, pausing and shortening. In prostate cancer cells, the ARv7 variant was associated with faster microtubule growth than wild-type AR. The passage also reports links between microtubule behavior and taxane response, including effects involving ERG, BRCA1, pVHL and GSK3β. It describes difficulties culturing patient-derived prostate tumor organoids and detecting small circulating tumor cells. The author proposes combining microtubule measurements, gene-expression data and organoid drug tests to anticipate resistance and guide treatment selection; these proposed clinical applications remain to be validated.

The speaker says the team raised its level of play to win and must do so again on Monday. He prepares by wearing headphones and focusing without distractions, and says past experiences help him move forward. He credits teammates for blocking shots, killing penalties and limiting second chances. He is focused on winning the Stanley Cup rather than outside expectations.

The Eleventh Circuit affirmed Alexis Perez’s 51-month sentence for conspiracy to commit mail fraud. It held that a three-level reduction for an incomplete conspiracy was unwarranted because the conspirators had taken crucial steps and were close to executing their plan. It also upheld the denial of a minor-role reduction, finding that Perez was involved in planning and preparation and had not shown he was less culpable than most other conspirators.

Verizon shares closed Friday down $0.37 at $48.81 despite $56.85 million in net inflows, the 11th highest among tracked companies. Analysts’ average rating was “Hold,” with a $52.86 average price target. Call-option purchases on Thursday were about 524% above typical volume. Verizon’s latest quarterly earnings matched estimates at $0.96 per share, while revenue of $30.55 billion exceeded expectations. The company raised its quarterly dividend from $0.58 to $0.59 per share, payable November 1st. Hedge funds and other institutional investors owned 62.24% of its stock.

A day trading price action strategy uses patterns in intraday price movements to identify trade entries and exits. Traders examine trends, price swings, chart patterns, and candlesticks, sometimes alongside indicators. Strategies discussed include trend following, breakouts, reversals, and scalping. The passage recommends coding trading rules and backtesting them, while noting that price action strategies can be difficult to test and may perform differently across markets. Its example showed poor historical results but positive results in a small out-of-sample test.

Spanish police freed over 20 transsexuals recruited through fake “Miss Trans” competitions in Venezuela and forced into prostitution and drug dealing in Spain to repay debts. Fourteen suspects were arrested.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs and related products. RTX IO, used with Microsoft DirectStorage, moves game-asset decompression from the CPU to the GPU to address storage bottlenecks. Ampere adds improvements in shading, ray tracing and AI processing, alongside support for GDDR6X memory, high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and hardware video encoding. The A40 targets data-center visual computing and virtualized workloads, while the RTX A6000 targets professional workstations; both offer 48GB of memory and support combining two GPUs through NVLink. The passage also outlines GeForce RTX 3090 and 3070 specifications and describes Error Detection and Replay for GDDR6X memory overclocking.

The passage recommends reducing credit card use, following a spending plan and building an emergency fund. It advises cutting nonessential expenses, putting extra money toward debt, paying high-interest balances first and redirecting payments to remaining balances. Gradual lifestyle changes may make the process more manageable.

The bill lets district and charter schools propose innovative education plans and seek waivers of state board rules. It permits certain funding and private support, sets requirements for approving and ending plans, and requires annual reporting. With no known local applications or approved plans, the report recommends that the State Board publicize the program, provide application guidance, and promote it through existing channels.

Google marked German physicist Max Born’s 135th birthday with a Doodle. Born made major contributions to quantum mechanics, including the Born Rule, which uses probability to predict measurement outcomes. He received the 1954 Nobel Prize for his work. A professor at the University of Göttingen, he maintained a long friendship with Albert Einstein despite their scientific differences. Born emigrated to England in 1933 after Jewish academics were barred from working in Germany. He died in 1970 at age 87.

UK employment rose by 109,000 in the three months to April, taking the employment rate to a joint-record 74.8%. But annual regular earnings growth slowed to 1.7% while consumer prices rose 2.9%, reducing real pay and putting pressure on household spending. Uncertainty following the general election may also weaken business confidence. Easing growth in companies’ input costs suggests inflation could cool later in the year, though there is little sign of stronger wage growth. The passage suggests the Bank of England is likely to keep interest rates unchanged.

NEMA warned of possible flooding in parts of Enugu, Anambra and Ebonyi states, citing forecasts by NIHSA and NiMET. It identified Enugu South and East and Anambra’s Aguata, Idemili North and Ogbaru as highly probable flood-risk areas, and listed several areas in Ebonyi as prone to flooding. Residents were urged to prepare early.

On December 21, 2015, Apple’s board amended its bylaws to allow a shareholder or group of up to 20 shareholders holding at least 3% of its shares for three years to include director nominees for up to 20% of the board in annual meeting proxy materials, subject to bylaw requirements. The amendments also update advance-notice provisions and make clarifying changes.

Schoenfeld told Finnish Foreign Minister Witting that reports of a more favorable American attitude toward Finland were misleading. Witting described Finland’s strategic aims, including control of the Karelian and Onega Isthmuses, as defensive necessities. Schoenfeld argued that security required sound political foundations and reported that Witting seemed uncertain what Finland could do. In a separate note, the Secretary of State said American citizens employed by Finnish diplomatic offices were subject to his January 3 request and that Finnish consular personnel must make the specified inquiries before leaving their consular cities.

The passage describes how a host BIOS interfaces with AGESA software through a bridge and dispatcher, while AGESA calls host services through a call-out port and router. The host must establish a stack, supply configuration headers, implement required call-outs, and preserve data across initialization stages. It outlines UEFI build integration, platform configuration, Cache-as-RAM stack procedures, and AGESA entry points for processor and memory initialization, late-boot tables, suspend, and resume.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2015 Form 10-K describes its GPU and Tegra Processor businesses, which serve gaming, enterprise, high-performance computing and cloud, and automotive markets. Revenue rose to $4.68 billion from $4.13 billion in fiscal 2014, while net income rose to $630.6 million from $440.0 million. NVIDIA returned $1.00 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends. The company uses third parties to manufacture its products and identifies competition, customer concentration, supply constraints, intellectual property disputes and international operations as risks. In 2014, NVIDIA filed patent lawsuits against Qualcomm and Samsung; Samsung subsequently filed a patent complaint against NVIDIA and Velocity Micro.

Al-Qaida-linked militants downed a Russian Su-25 fighter jet in Syria’s Idlib province on Saturday and killed its pilot after he ejected and resisted capture. The incident came amid intense airstrikes and a Syrian government offensive in Idlib that the U.N. says has displaced more than 270,000 people since Dec. 15. Separately, fighting continued around Afrin, where Turkey said three of its soldiers were killed in connection with its operation against a Syrian Kurdish militia. Turkey called for the militia to leave Manbij and for the United States to disengage from it.

DBS expects Indian government bond yields to face further, though more modest, upward pressure from increased issuance and rising developed-market yields. Easing inflation reduces the urgency for rate hikes, supporting shorter-term bonds, while DBS remains neutral-to-negative on longer-term bonds. The bank also expects India’s widening current account deficit and financing needs to leave the rupee vulnerable to rising US rates, forecasting depreciation towards 67 this year.

Research reviewed in the passage links mentoring—through school and afterschool programs, peer programs, and relationships with teachers and other adults—to improved attendance, grades, school connection, and educational attainment. The passage says pandemic disruptions increased students’ academic and emotional challenges, particularly for marginalized groups. It also notes that mentoring relationships are unequally available: youth of color, low-income youth, and youth whose parents have limited education report less support. It calls for public and private investment to expand access to quality mentoring.

The President declined to submit the 1853 Tehuantepec transit convention with Mexico for Senate ratification. He objected to its long-term guarantees for a private company’s construction, property, and capital, including a requirement for one year’s notice before withdrawing protection. He also said the convention conflicted with the United States’ 1850 agreement with Great Britain.

Xiaomi’s Redmi 5 goes on sale in India at 12 pm through Amazon India, Mi.com and Mi Home stores, with over 4 lakh units expected to be available. The 2GB/16GB, 3GB/32GB and 4GB/64GB versions cost Rs 7,999, Rs 8,999 and Rs 10,999, respectively. It has a 5.7-inch HD+ display, Snapdragon 450 processor, 3300mAh battery, 12MP rear camera and 5MP front camera with selfie flash. It runs Android 7.1.2 with MIUI 9.

A longitudinal evaluation followed 11 SARS-CoV-2-positive nursing home residents from October 2020 to April 2021; 10 received two Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine doses. Before vaccination, nine of 10 residents with blood samples had detectable Pan-Ig, IgG, and IgA antibodies. Pan-Ig and IgG remained elevated after infection, while IgM and IgA began declining after about 30 days. At first antibody detection, some residents remained RT-PCR-positive, but none had positive viral cultures. All vaccinated participants had detectable Pan-Ig, IgG, and IgA afterward, with higher titers than before vaccination. The small sample and limited follow-up constrained the findings.

The Colts lost 13-7 in overtime after a penalty erased a late conversion in blizzard conditions. The game left players fatigued ahead of Thursday’s matchup with Denver. Indianapolis has blown six leads, lost four straight for the first time under coach Chuck Pagano, and been eliminated from playoff contention, renewing questions about his future.

The court affirmed dismissal of Lever Brothers’ opposition to Thrift-D-Lux Cleaners’ service-mark application. Lever Brothers relied on its earlier “Lux” trademark for soaps and detergents and its “Lux Laundry” program. The court found that “Thrift-D-Lux” suggests thrift and “de luxe” quality rather than “Thrifty Lux.” Given the common use of “de luxe,” the tenuous relationship between the parties’ goods and services, and the lack of evidence of confusion, Lever Brothers had not shown that registration would damage it.

Oclaro reported 47% revenue growth and earnings of $0.79 per share, while its gross margin rose to 39%. Demand is shifting toward newer products: 100G accounts for 81% of revenue, and QSFP28 sales doubled sequentially, while older product sales declined. China revenue fell 11% sequentially, and management expects further weakness before potential demand for newer transceivers emerges in 2018.

The passage argues that Oclaro’s position in high-speed products and limited legacy business could help offset industry cycles. It also notes the company’s cash holdings, lack of debt and valuation of less than 11 times fiscal 2017 earnings.

An outside day occurs when a price bar exceeds the previous day’s high and low. Depending on its direction and the prevailing trend, traders may interpret it as a continuation or reversal signal, but the pattern is context-dependent and should be backtested. In the passage’s SPY day-trading backtests, the average open-to-close gain after an outside day was zero; conditioning on a higher or lower prior close produced averages of −0.07% and +0.06%, respectively. The passage concludes that outside days showed little use for day trading in the strategies tested.

Aziz Ansari says he uses a flip phone, has not had email for about 10 years, and hails taxis instead of using an app. He says living with less technology gives him space to think and write, though he acknowledges it is not realistic for everyone. He is wary of ChatGPT, saying it can replace critical thinking and human conversation.

The court affirmed judgment for the Pennsylvania assignees of Thompson Oil Company’s judgment. Their good-faith assignment, made before a New York creditor’s attachment, left Thompson with no attachable interest. The assignees were neither parties to the New York proceedings nor subject to that court’s jurisdiction, so the garnishees’ payment under the New York judgment did not bar the assignees’ claim. The defendants also waived their objection to the order requiring production of the New York record.

A Nassau County jury acquitted Jasmine Copeland, 18, of manslaughter, gang assault and other charges in the 2014 stabbing death of Abbigale Thomas, 17, during a Freeport brawl. Prosecutors alleged Copeland stabbed Thomas after an online dispute escalated. Her attorney said Copeland carried a knife but did not use it.

In his inaugural address, the President thanks Ronald Reagan and reflects on the continuity of American democracy since George Washington. He calls freedom, free markets and free elections foundations for a more just and prosperous world. At home, he urges service to others, community action on social problems, a balanced federal budget and renewed cooperation between Congress and the Executive. Abroad, he pledges to protect peace, honor commitments and maintain alliances while continuing closer relations with the Soviet Union. He also vows to confront drugs and asks Americans to meet the future with unity, diversity and generosity.

Northern Ireland’s health service faces staffing shortages, rising costs and long hospital waits; 83,392 people had waited over a year for a first hospital appointment at the end of March. An additional £30m was allocated to ease pressure. Patient recalls and care-home findings highlighted further problems. Reforms proposed in 2016 lack a health minister to lead them following Stormont’s collapse.

Marian Gaborik and Dwight King said their team needs better starts after overcoming two-goal deficits in three consecutive games with overtime. They expect a tough game at the Rangers’ home arena, where Gaborik will play for the first time since being traded. King emphasized rest, creating traffic in front of goaltenders, and shifting momentum quickly. Both said the team remains confident but must improve its play.

In a final lecture on stochastic methods, William Green explains how Metropolis Monte Carlo evaluates high-dimensional integrals, including those arising from Boltzmann distributions and Bayesian parameter estimates. He warns that poorly chosen step sizes can prevent adequate sampling and recommends checking results against rough expectations and runs from different initial states. Monte Carlo can provide approximate answers quickly, but precision requires many more samples.

For systems with time-dependent probabilities and enormous numbers of states, Green describes kinetic Monte Carlo and the Gillespie algorithm. He discusses sampling initial conditions, tracking useful averages during simulations, and simplifying processes that are too fast or too rare to model efficiently. Molecular dynamics instead follows atomic motion in physical time, making it useful for sufficiently fast processes but difficult to apply to slow changes. Green concludes that the method should fit the problem being studied.

The passage describes a proposed approach to detecting gastric cancer by measuring DNA methylation in differentially methylated regions and comparing it with controls. It reports 123 candidate markers and identifies smaller panels for testing gastric tissue, plasma, and other samples. A three-marker plasma panel—ELMO1, ZNF569, and C13orf18—detected gastric cancer with 86% sensitivity at 100% specificity in the reported study. The passage also describes assay methods, reagents, kits, and computer systems for interpreting results.

Zeta Global has agreed to acquire Marigold’s enterprise software business for $325 million, its largest acquisition to date. The deal includes Marigold’s Loyalty brand and its Cheetah Digital, Sailthru, and Selligent platforms. Zeta says the acquisition will expand its Fortune 500 customer base, strengthen its presence in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and add loyalty products to its services. Marigold will retain its business serving small and midsize companies.

Buchanan sought Supreme Court review of his New York murder conviction, arguing that a juror’s illness and the jurors’ separation during deliberations made the verdict invalid. The state courts denied a new trial after considering conflicting evidence about the juror’s condition and the separation. The Supreme Court held that the juror’s competency was a factual question it could not review on a writ of error and denied the application.

GMB, Unison and Unite have notified East Dunbartonshire Council of strikes affecting refuse collections from July 12 to 15. Working-to-rule and overtime bans also continue. The council is assessing disruption and plans further talks after four days of industrial action last month disrupted services.

James Horne alleged that New York’s revocation of his medical license discriminated against him because of his adult Attention Deficit Disorder. The court held that his complaint, including his request to regain his license, challenged the administrative revocation decision and therefore required a timely CPLR article 78 proceeding. It affirmed summary judgment dismissing the complaint and did not address res judicata or collateral estoppel.

A study identifies 50 objects, mostly old rocket bodies, that pose the greatest risk of generating more debris in low-Earth orbit. Removing all 50 could halve that risk; removing the top 10 could cut it by 30 percent. Russia and the Soviet Union account for 34 objects on the list. Meanwhile, 26 rocket bodies abandoned since January 2024 will remain in orbit for more than 25 years, including 21 launched by China. Debris-removal missions are technically feasible, but who would pay for them remains uncertain.

AI chipmaker Cerebras withdrew its IPO plans just over a year after filing its prospectus, days after raising $1.1 billion at an $8.1 billion valuation. The company said it still hopes to go public soon. A spokesperson said the prospectus was outdated and the government shutdown did not influence the decision.

A UN report highlights nature-based solutions to growing water challenges, warning that up to five billion people could face poor access to water by 2050. It praises community-led restoration in Rajasthan, where water-harvesting structures and regeneration of soils and forests raised groundwater levels, expanded productive farmland and increased forest cover. The report also recognizes women’s leadership in securing safe freshwater. Other examples include China’s Sponge City project, which aims to recycle 70 per cent of rainwater.

Six-year-old Ryan has become a major YouTube star through “Ryan ToysReview,” where his parents post videos of him opening and playing with toys. The channel began in 2015 and grew rapidly after a video featuring more than 100 toys went viral. Forbes ranked Ryan eighth among the highest-paid YouTube entrepreneurs, estimating $11 million in revenue from June 2016 to June 2017. His videos earn money through ads and can influence toy purchases. His parents say they donate most of the reviewed toys to charity. Some young viewers watch for hours and describe Ryan as a friend.

Michael Cohen removed “personal attorney to President Donald J. Trump” from his Twitter biography, though it remained on LinkedIn. The change followed an ABC News interview in which Cohen, under criminal investigation, said he put family and country before loyalty to Trump and defended the FBI agents who searched his properties.

WIRED’s Pixel guide recommends the $499 Pixel 9a for most people, citing its cameras, battery life, and seven years of software support. The Pixel 10 adds a 5X zoom camera, faster performance, and magnetic Qi2 charging. The Pixel 10 Pro models offer stronger cameras and additional video features, while the Pro XL adds faster charging. The $1,799 Pixel 10 Pro Fold offers a folding screen but lacks some Pro features. The guide also suggests buying discounted Pixel 9 models, choosing magnetic-compatible cases for Pixel 10 phones, and exploring Pixel software features for calls, photography, translation, accessibility, and security.

The passage describes the AGESA software interface for host BIOS integration. Hosts should call only published functions, establish a stack before interface calls, and avoid changing cache controls during Cache-As-RAM operation. AGESA calls return status codes ranging from success to fatal; the host implements the indicated response, and the event log retains the 16 most recent events.

For binary modules, a host bridge calls the AGESA dispatcher, while a call-out router directs AGESA requests to host procedures. The passage also describes UEFI initialization modules, build options, and platform configuration. Published procedures cover processor and memory initialization, configuration, diagnostic queries, event-log access, late boot tables, and saving and restoring state for suspend and resume.

The speakers say the series is not over despite a tough opponent and that the team is playing better. They remain confident in Marc, acknowledge some frustration, and hope a first win at home, with different matchups and a different lineup, will build momentum.

The speaker says Peter’s aggressive system took a month or two to become second nature, but improved the team’s conditioning and has been effective. Despite limited time off, the speaker expects no letdown in the finals. They describe the teams as evenly matched and say success will require consistent defense, shots through traffic and gritty goals rather than a fast-paced exchange of chances. The speaker also praises an opposing player’s competitiveness, versatility and leadership, calling him one of the world’s best.

In *Lewis v. Bayer AG*, the court certified a Pennsylvania class of Baycol users who had not been diagnosed with rhabdomyolysis or congestive heart disease to pursue medical monitoring. It denied certification of the other proposed classes and claims, finding that individual factual or legal issues predominated or that the proposed representatives lacked typical claims. Arthur Conner, Milton Angert, and Lisa Frost were appointed class representatives.

The passage describes methods and apparatuses for downlink assignments in wireless communications. A user device monitors control-channel candidates in different control resource sets, uses received assignments to determine data-channel resources and demodulation reference signal locations, and decodes the scheduled data. It also describes associating search spaces and monitoring occasions so multiple control channels can carry the same control information. Additional embodiments address repeated transmissions from multiple transmission points, transmission configuration states, and acknowledgment resources.

A defensive switch occurs when the first defender is beaten: the supporting defender calls “switch” and takes the ball carrier, while the first defender moves to cover the supporter’s mark or position. The supporter should stay goalside, behind and toward the field’s center, adjusting position without overrunning the play and communicating when support is available. Instruction progresses from positioning and movement drills to half-speed and full-speed scenarios, including switches down the sideline and toward the inside. Defenders normally return to their original assignments once the immediate play ends.

Apple is reportedly preparing a “blush gold” iPhone 8 for its September keynote. A leak also suggests 64GB and 128GB storage options, an edge-to-edge screen, no home button, and wireless charging. “Blush Gold” may be an internal name rather than the final product name.

The passage outlines a study of whether the COVID-19 pandemic affected special education due process hearings involving Pennsylvania city local education agencies. It cites pandemic-era IDEA compliance concerns and notes that the pandemic’s influence on these hearings remains unclear. Using publicly available hearing decisions uploaded from March 16, 2018, to March 15, 2022, the study will compare hearing frequency and ruling outcomes before and after March 16, 2020, and examine remedies owed afterward. The researchers identified 323 nonduplicate decisions for review before excluding hearings that do not involve city agencies.

Air Force cyber leaders say adapting to rapid change requires flexible operations, diverse skills and openness to new ideas. The Maryland Air National Guard’s 175th Cyberspace Operations Group draws on members’ civilian expertise to strengthen defensive and offensive missions and has supported state, federal and military operations. Its leaders say collaboration across ranks and the Guard’s 2017 Innovations Program help turn new ideas into practice. They also warn that slow hiring, personnel rotation and promotion paths that pull specialists away from technical work make it harder to retain cyber talent.

The report outlines global pyridine market sales, revenue, prices, growth and market share from 2012 to 2022 across six regions. It covers major manufacturers, chemically synthesized and coal-tar-extracted pyridine, and applications in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals and chemical synthesis. Market valuations and projected growth rates are shown only as placeholders.

The lecture compares model-free control methods. Policy gradients provide a direct, convergent local search but can require many trials because their updates have high variance. Value-function methods can reuse data and learn faster, but changing a value estimate can abruptly change a policy and cause instability.

Actor–critic methods combine a policy with a value estimate. The estimate provides a comparison for trial outcomes that can reduce update variance, while slower policy changes retain the convergence advantages of policy gradients.

Tedrake illustrates the approach with Toddler, an underactuated walking robot. It updated its policy after each footstep, learned to walk on level ground within minutes, recovered from disturbances, and adapted to changes in terrain. Retaining a learned value estimate made subsequent learning substantially faster.

The Georgia Court of Appeals affirmed an order granting Ricky Rau sole legal and physical custody of his three children. The majority held that Kathrine Clark’s appellate brief did not adequately identify or support claims of error and that, without a hearing transcript, it had to presume the trial court’s proceedings were proper. Dissenting judges argued that Clark had sufficiently challenged the order and that it should be vacated and remanded because it did not determine whether the custody change was in the children’s best interest.

WHO data from 1,622 urban locations in 92 countries show that Delhi’s average PM 2.5 concentration is 150 micrograms per cubic metre, compared with London’s 16. A population-weighted analysis ranks Pakistan, Qatar and Afghanistan as having the most polluted urban areas, while Australia, Brunei and New Zealand have the least polluted. The rankings reflect city air quality, not conditions across entire countries.

The passage defines a bear market as a period when the S&P 500 trades below its 200-day moving average. By that measure, it says bear markets have occurred about twice a year since 1960, lasted 25 trading days on average, and accounted for 30% of trading time. It recommends that traders backtest strategies across market cycles, follow their plans, and prepare to trade both long and short. It advises long-term investors to keep buying rather than stop because prices have fallen.

Under a bilateral trade deal, the United States allows imports of cooked poultry from China in exchange for Chinese imports of U.S. beef and liquefied natural gas. Restricting imports to cooked poultry addresses concerns about avian influenza in raw birds. Proper cooking prevents viral and bacterial risks, but undercooking or cross-contamination can cause illness. The passage also raises concerns about antibiotic residues and heavy metals in Chinese poultry, noting limited public safety data. U.S. inspectors require eligible Chinese plants to meet equivalent safeguards and audit them at least annually. Because cooked poultry is exempt from country-of-origin labeling, consumers may not know where it was produced.

Tesla’s May 13, 2019 Form 8-K reports a press release announcing the final consideration for its offer to exchange Maxwell Technologies shares for Tesla shares. The filing includes the press release and two legal opinions on U.S. federal income tax consequences of the offer and subsequent merger.

The passage describes UC1825B-SP converter design and PCB layout guidance. Diode voltage ratings should exceed calculated stress to allow for parasitic spikes, while push-pull MOSFET ratings should be about 2.5–3 times the input voltage. The design uses output capacitance and a 500-nH filter inductor to reduce ripple, Type IIB compensation, and a sense resistor for current limiting. Layout guidance emphasizes low-EMI inductors, short and thick power traces, separation of feedback traces from noise sources, nearby capacitors, and carefully arranged ground planes. The passage also includes test conditions, documentation and support information, ESD precautions, ordering notes, and TI disclaimers.

Strength training can build muscle, strength and endurance, but poor technique, repetitive movements or increasing workout intensity too quickly can cause injuries, including rotator cuff and hamstring injuries, herniated discs, tendonitis and tennis elbow. Warming up, cooling down, using proper form, stretching and increasing intensity gradually can help reduce the risk. Stop exercising if you feel pain, and consult a doctor if it persists. A qualified instructor can help you start a suitable routine.

The passage criticizes celebrities, including KISS, who reportedly declined to perform at Donald Trump’s inauguration. It says Jackie Evancho, the Radio City Rockettes and the Mormon Tabernacle Choir would participate, and quotes Bristol Palin criticizing celebrities who refused.

NVIDIA’s passage describes Blackwell GPU features for AI, rendering, video and power efficiency. FP4 reduces FLUX.dev’s VRAM requirement from over 23GB to under 10GB, allowing it to run on more GeForce RTX GPUs. Fourth-generation RT Cores accelerate ray tracing; Mega Geometry uses triangle clusters and partitioned acceleration structures to handle detailed, changing scenes more efficiently. Hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres improves strand rendering, while SER 2.0 improves workload reordering and the AI Management Processor schedules GPU contexts.

Blackwell adds 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, improved NVENC and NVDEC, and DisplayPort 2.1b. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster frequency switching and quicker entry into deep sleep. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for image reconstruction. Cooperative Vectors enable neural shaders, including techniques for materials, texture compression, lighting, skin and faces. The passage also outlines GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products.

Human Rights Watch says Turkish border guards shot at, beat and turned back Syrians fleeing escalating violence, with some denied medical assistance. Turkey’s border is closed to Syrian refugees except for critical medical cases. A war monitor reported 40 civilians killed in four days of intensified bombing in north-west Syria. Shelling and air raids also killed civilians in Douma, while food and medicine shortages worsened conditions for 400,000 people in besieged eastern Ghouta.

A decision-analytic study of hypothetical women at risk of hereditary breast cancer found that testing seven genes instead of BRCA1 and BRCA2 alone, followed by appropriate risk-reduction care, could improve life expectancy cost-effectively. For women tested at ages 50 and 40, the added cost was $69,920 and $48,328 per quality-adjusted life-year gained, respectively—levels considered cost-effective under World Health Organization guidelines.

Contact switching is central to the SOS Pressure Defense. Defenders call “Screen–Over–Switch,” hedge into the cutter’s path, and exchange assignments. The system aims to deny passes and quick shots, disrupt screening plays, and reduce hesitation and fouls; mismatches prompt immediate traps.

On off-ball screens, defenders make contact switches and take SNUGGLE pass-denial positions. For baseline screens, they switch when the cutter goes low but not when the cutter goes high. Above the free-throw line extended, on-ball screens receive an aggressive switch to deny jump shots and middle penetration. Below it, defenders trap the ballhandler near baseline or corner checkpoints, then close out on a pass from the trap.

Shop & Save Market has signed a letter of intent to open a grocery store in South Shore’s vacant former Dominick’s at Jeffery Plaza. Owner Cezary Jakubowski said the deal is not final and the store could open in 18 to 24 months. Mayor Rahm Emanuel said more than $10 million in city tax increment financing would help fund the development. Shop & Save hopes to buy the entire plaza, retain its tenants and attract others. The Dominick’s has been vacant since 2014.

The passage describes the device’s power management, resets, clocks, interrupts, peripheral interfaces, and electrical timing requirements. SmartReflex supports dynamic voltage and frequency scaling across independently selectable operating performance points; adaptive voltage scaling is marked as unsupported. It also specifies SRAM shutdown behavior, standby mode, I/O voltages, supply sequencing, filtering, and decoupling.

Reset options include power-on, warm, watchdog, software, test, and local resets, with provisions for PCIe and Ethernet switch reset isolation. Clocking uses external inputs or crystals, on-chip PLLs, and selectable outputs, subject to frequency limits. The passage also covers interrupt controllers, DMA, debugging, and interfaces including CAN, Ethernet, GPIO, memory, and HDMI, along with their timing and PCB-layout guidance.

Whitworth University will lower annual tuition from $54,000 to $26,900 next fall and publish a merit-scholarship scale based solely on grade point average. Officials say the change is intended to give families clearer cost information, not to address enrollment declines. Research on similar tuition resets has found no overall enrollment increase but has linked them to more Pell-eligible students. Experts say high sticker prices persist partly because they can signal quality. University leaders report positive feedback from families.

The passage describes storage arrays and clusters that use controllers, flash storage, NVRAM, and network connections to store data for client devices. Controllers can manage flash allocation, wear leveling, and garbage collection, while stored energy can preserve buffered data during power loss. In clustered embodiments, distributed authorities manage data placement, and erasure coding and redundant metadata support recovery from failures. Storage nodes can be added or removed, with authorities and workloads redistributed. The passage also describes connecting a storage system to a cloud services provider and lists drawings concerning big data analytics and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Plantation police arrested Eric Robinson, 46, on a first-degree murder charge after his roommate’s body was found in a dumpster near a shopping center. Neighbors described repeated disturbances involving Robinson and a woman who lived with them. The victim’s name is being withheld until his family is notified.

A study found that bumblebee queens exposed to the pesticide thiamethoxam were 26 per cent less likely to lay eggs and start colonies. Researcher Nigel Raine’s models suggest this could increase the risk of population extinction. A parasite tested in the experiment had little effect.

Mediclinic’s shares rose after it reported performance in line with expectations in Switzerland, southern Africa and Dubai. Middle East revenue fell 8% amid Abu Dhabi challenges, but improvement is expected.

Tony Robinson has become patron of the John Cracknell Youth Enterprise Bank, which offers grants of up to £1,000 to young people in parts of Yorkshire. More than 400 have received funding. Robinson has supported small businesses for over 30 years.

Five English clubs—Manchester City, Manchester United, Liverpool, Tottenham and Chelsea—have reached the Champions League last 16, a first for one country. In the draw in Nyon, group runners-up Chelsea can face only Paris St Germain, Barcelona or Besiktas. The other four English clubs won their groups; Bayern Munich and Juventus are among their potential opponents, while City, United and Liverpool could draw Real Madrid. The Europa League draw follows an hour later. Arsenal, the only remaining English side, are seeded and could face Celtic.

At a murder trial, prosecutors said Redvers Bickley stabbed his housemate, Tyler Denton, to death after a birthday gathering at their home in Rhyl. They said he also attacked Tyler’s sisters, Cody and Shannen, and their father, Paul, who survived serious injuries. Bickley admits killing Tyler but denies murder and attempting to murder her father and sisters. The trial continues.

Ankit admitted to killing Sheelu and her cousin Shivani at their Bulandshahr home after Sheelu rejected his marriage proposal. Police said he strangled Sheelu, killed Shivani after she witnessed the attack, and burned their bodies.

The article traces Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a dominant energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. It describes a culture that rewarded rapid deals and aggressive competition, alongside concerns about its accounting and costly ventures. In 2001, California’s energy crisis, a telecommunications downturn and analysts’ questions contributed to a falling stock price. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, citing personal sacrifices, and Lay returned to the role promising a stronger focus on Enron’s core business.

Coach DeBoer said his team improved its defensive-zone coverage and believes the series is closer than the results suggest. He cited the players’ belief in each other and experience with momentum shifts, said he would stick with the current group, praised Pavelski’s leadership, and expressed confidence in the team’s road play despite the difficulty of the next game.

TCGX closed a $1.3 billion fund amid an investor surge. European officials are working to finalize a major pharmaceutical policy overhaul intended to improve access to medicines while keeping the region attractive to drugmakers. The passage also reports an FDA agreement to study a Covid-19 prevention antibody, with top-line results expected in mid-2026.

In this prospective study of 157 patients hospitalized for acute decompensated heart failure, bioimpedance spectroscopy measured fluid status at admission and discharge. Patients with reduced ejection fraction had greater reductions in the overhydration-to-extracellular-water ratio than other patients. However, bioimpedance measurements did not significantly predict major adverse cardiovascular events or heart failure hospitalization over an average 10.7-month follow-up. The single-center study’s small sample and lack of a control group limit its conclusions.

The David Swensen Portfolio, or Yale Model, diversifies across stocks, bonds, and alternative investments while emphasizing risk management and low-cost passive funds. The passage reports that Yale’s portfolio returned 12.5% annually from 1985 to 2020, compared with 9.7% for the S&P 500. A separate ETF backtest returned 6.23% annually and underperformed the S&P 500, though it had lower drawdowns. The passage cautions that historical results do not guarantee future performance and that investors should consider their goals and risk tolerance.

The study introduces TOPIC, a crystal-structure prediction algorithm that uses corner-sharing bond constraints to search efficiently for lithium-oxide solid-state electrolytes. It reproduces known structures with up to 192 atoms per unit cell and identifies previously unreported polymorphs. Screening found 92 candidates with potentially high ionic conductivity; DFT-based validation yielded 15 candidates. Lower lithium ratios generally favor corner-sharing frameworks, which showed higher conductivity than non-corner-sharing structures. The strongest reported candidate, Li4Hf2Si3O12, has a predicted room-temperature ionic conductivity of 14.09 mS cm−1.

NVIDIA reported fiscal 2018 second-quarter revenue of $2.23 billion, up 56% year over year, and net income of $583 million, up from $261 million. Diluted earnings were $0.92 per share. GPU revenue rose 59% to $1.90 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue rose 101% to $333 million. Growth was driven by gaming, datacenter, professional visualization and Tegra products. For the six months ended July 30, 2017, revenue was $4.17 billion and net income was $1.09 billion. NVIDIA held $5.88 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at quarter-end. During the first half, it spent $758 million on share repurchases and paid $166 million in dividends.

The NVIDIA A100 GPU has 108 SMs and 432 Tensor Cores, delivering up to 312 TFLOPS of dense mixed-precision FP16/FP32 performance and 19.5 TFLOPS of FP64 performance. Its Tensor Cores support TF32, BF16 and FP64 alongside earlier formats. TF32 enables Tensor Core acceleration for AI training by default, while FP16 or BF16 mixed precision offers higher throughput. A100’s 2:4 structured sparsity doubles Tensor Core compute throughput by skipping zero values.

The GPU includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, and features designed to improve data movement and Tensor Core utilization. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide an A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 and CUDA 11 features support multi-GPU communication and programming. The eight-GPU DGX A100 system combines these capabilities for AI and HPC workloads.

BrainWorking Recursive Therapy (BWRT) is now offered in Dunstable for anxiety and related mental health conditions. Practitioner Keith Tunstall says the therapy aims to interrupt reactions to triggers before conscious awareness. He offers free initial consultations and confidential appointments, including by Skype or FaceTime.

The lecture explains how wireless channels differ from fixed, free-space links. A moving receiver produces a Doppler shift that frequency recovery can track, but signals arriving along multiple paths can have different Doppler shifts and periodically cancel, causing fast fading. Reflections also create path-dependent delays and attenuation that are impractical to calculate precisely for a cellular system. The professor models the channel instead as a slowly time-varying filter whose output combines delayed, attenuated copies of the input. At baseband, differences among the paths’ Doppler shifts determine how long the channel behaves approximately like a time-invariant system and how often its response must be measured.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020 reports net sales of $75.5 billion, up 26% from a year earlier, while net income fell from $3.6 billion to $2.5 billion. Operating income declined from $4.4 billion to $4.0 billion. AWS sales and operating income rose, while North American operating income fell and the International operating loss widened. Operating cash flow was $3.1 billion for the quarter. Amazon said COVID-19 increased demand for essential products but also raised fulfillment and shipping costs and disrupted supply chains.

After Ontario recognized an 18th-century treaty in 2013, Haudenosaunee hunters gained six days of annual access to Short Hills Provincial Park to harvest deer with bows. Hunters say the harvest provides traditional food, supports ceremonies and passes on cultural skills. Meat is shared with longhouses and elders, while provincial biologists assist with the harvest.

Protesters object to hunting in the park, and hunters report jeers and vandalism. Some supporters view the protests as an attack on Indigenous culture. The park’s deer population was estimated at about 400 in 2016, above its stated carrying capacity of 50; a biologist says the deer have damaged plants and trees.

Sterling Bank’s 2017 loans and advances rose 27% to N598.1 billion despite a broader decline in lending among banks. Gross earnings reached N133.5 billion, profit after tax rose to N8.521 billion, and customer deposits grew 17.1% to N684.8 billion. Its non-performing loan ratio fell to 6.2%, while total assets reached N1.1 trillion. The bank launched the online lending platform Specta and said its plans would focus on efficiency, digitisation and specialised support for health, education, agriculture, renewable energy and transport.

The speaker said the game was more defensive than the last one. Two quick goals hurt their team, including a shot screened by a defender. They played well in the third period but could not score. Despite the loss, they remain confident about returning home, where they have played well.

Amazon.com closed a sale of $8.25 billion in notes on December 1, 2022. The five series carry interest rates of 4.550% to 4.700% and mature between 2024 and 2032. The aggregate public offering price was $8.246 billion, with estimated net proceeds of approximately $8.235 billion after underwriting discounts and before offering expenses.

French and German wholesale electricity prices for Monday delivery rose to 36 euros/MWh as forecasts of weaker German wind output pointed to lower renewable generation. Demand in both countries was expected to remain broadly flat. Germany’s year-ahead power price was unchanged, while France’s rose. Czech day-ahead prices also climbed to 36 euros/MWh.

NASA will require employees working on Artemis missions with SpaceX and Blue Origin to continue through the government shutdown. They must record their hours and are expected to be paid after funding resumes. NASA also plans to support International Space Station operations and operational satellites, while furloughing about 15,000 employees and keeping about 3,000 working part or full time.

About 27 staff at the Prestwick Budgens face uncertainty after its owner, Food Retail Operations Ltd, entered administration, affecting almost 900 employees nationwide. Administrators said all 34 stores remain open while they seek interested parties. Former owner Co-op has offered to step in if no buyer is found.

Neo Performance Materials appeared attractive because of its low valuation and Magnequench’s position in rare-earth magnetic powders, which could benefit from growing use of permanent-magnet motors in electric vehicles. However, patents covering most Magnequench products expired in December 2017, creating a risk of increased competition and lower revenue and earnings. The author therefore declined to invest, while noting that the impact remained uncertain.

The speaker praises a player’s skating, size, skill, work ethic and leadership, noting that he is scoring more goals this year. Facing him is challenging and requires alert, physical play and sound positioning.

March gasoline demand reached a record 9.6 million barrels per day, while U.S. exports remained high. Falling inventories helped push the national average gas price up two cents for the week to $2.55, 26 cents above a year ago. Prices rose across much of the South and Southeast, though the region remained among the cheapest.

Aftab said 15–20 people assaulted him and another Kashmiri student after they left a mosque in Mahenderhgarh. They reported the incident to their university. Police lodged an FIR, and Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti called for action and a probe.

Microsoft reported revenue of $23.8 billion and net income of $5.0 billion for the quarter ended December 31, 2015, down from $26.5 billion and $5.9 billion a year earlier. Diluted earnings per share fell from $0.71 to $0.62. Revenue declined primarily because of Windows 10 revenue deferrals and unfavorable currency effects. Intelligent Cloud revenue grew, while More Personal Computing revenue fell. For the six-month period, revenue was $44.2 billion and net income was $9.6 billion. At December 31, Microsoft held $102.6 billion in cash and short-term investments.

The speaker says injuries and dwindling energy made the series harder, while crediting the opposing team’s performance. Donovan sprained his MCL, and Robyn injured his ankle. The speaker praised the officials, congratulated the Tampa organization and expressed pride in the players.

The speaker said the team struggled defensively, missed scoring chances and allowed the opponent to capitalize on power plays. The goaltender played well despite a long absence, but the team did not give him its best effort.

The author contrasts Nicaraguan students’ demands for civil liberties with what they describe as restrictions on debate at Canadian universities. They cite Lindsay Shepherd’s treatment at Wilfrid Laurier University after she showed a video of Jordan Peterson. The author argues that similar attitudes have shaped workplace harassment practices, where unpleasant exchanges and legitimate performance management may be mistaken for legal harassment. They add that stress leave requires a medically qualifying disability and that abuse of leave need not be tolerated.

The lecture studies how gluing a polygon’s boundary can produce convex polyhedra, using gluing trees to represent the gluings. It defines finitely many combinatorial types even when actual gluings form continuous families. General and edge-to-edge polygons can have exponentially many gluing types, while polygons whose angles stay a constant amount below 360 degrees have only polynomially many. Dynamic programming gives a cubic-time decision algorithm for edge-to-edge gluings; whether general gluings can be decided in polynomial time remains open. Enumeration takes exponential time in general but polynomial time for bounded-sharpness polygons. As an example, a cross has five edge-to-edge outcomes and 85 gluings overall, producing 23 distinct polyhedra.

Founded by Marshall University students and faculty in 1993, the Tri State Psychology Conference gives students experience submitting and presenting research. Its 25th-anniversary event will be held April 20 at West Liberty University. Attendance is free.

The Nigerian Immigration Service told an Abuja court that suspended Supreme Court Justice Sylvester Ngwuta used two similar standard passports interchangeably after reporting one lost and receiving a replacement. A witness said Ngwuta did not return the original when he found it and that using both violated immigration law. Forensic analysis found no forgery in the six passports in his possession. The trial was adjourned until October 20.

NES Global Talent seeks an onshore Performance Specialist for a six-month contract in Aberdeen. The role covers PSCM performance planning, financial and non-financial reporting, compliance, risk management and recommendations to leadership. Applicants need finance, accounting and procurement knowledge, strong analytical and communication skills, and advanced Excel skills.

The Rangers are focusing their search for Bruce Bochy’s replacement on Skip Schumaker, a special adviser to the team and former National League Manager of the Year. Texas has begun a formal interview process but has not pursued external candidates. Bochy’s three-year stint ended after the Rangers finished 81-81, two seasons after winning their first World Series title.

Russia’s foreign ministry said the U.S. missile defence site in Romania and planned site in Poland violate the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Force Treaty. The U.S. says the systems protect against rogue states.

Because #HV ignores interrupt shadows, a guest should execute HLT with interrupts disabled and check interrupt state immediately after resuming. The host should promptly re-enter a halted guest if events are pending.

Guests configure the per-vCPU #HV doorbell page through GHCB VMGEXIT requests. The host presents ready interrupts and non-maskable events through the page, signals #HV when required, and tracks acknowledgements and EOI state. Guests must atomically acknowledge pending events, validate interrupt vectors, and complete EOIs by clearing NoEoiRequired or writing the APIC register. Non-cooperative behavior can cause missed notifications or denial of service; guest misbehavior does not compromise host integrity.

Vernon, Penticton and Powell River each took 2-0 leads in their BCHL playoff series with wins over Wenatchee, Trail and Victoria. Vernon held Wenatchee’s high-scoring offence to one goal in a 3-1 win, while Penticton scored five power-play goals in a 7-2 victory. Powell River beat Victoria 3-2 for its second straight road win. Surrey evened its series with Prince George at 1-1, winning 3-2 behind 46 saves from Mario Cavaliere. Surrey also announced that Jackson Ross has committed to Colorado College.

The passage considers whether LLMs can help social scientists develop hypotheses and theories, while noting concerns about originality, validity, and oversimplifying human behavior. It also describes AI governance challenges, including misinformation, deepfakes, bias, differing national regulations, and risks that emerge only during use. It calls for forward-looking regulation developed through cooperation among policymakers, industry, academia, developers, and users, with channels to report issues and update guidelines promptly.

Martin Braithwaite left Middlesbrough in January for Bordeaux, seeking regular playing time to strengthen his chances of making Denmark’s World Cup squad. The writer argues he could instead have fought for a place under Tony Pulis and helped Boro pursue promotion. Whether leaving was the right decision remains uncertain.

ASTROCO is a self-supervised encoder for stellar light curves that combines self-attention, depthwise convolutions, and gating to capture long-range and local features. It reconstructs masked measurements during training and mixes features from multiple layers to produce sequence embeddings. On the MACHO R-band dataset, its small and large variants achieved lower reconstruction error and higher macro-F1 classification scores than Astromer v1 and v2. The smaller variant also used less training time and hardware than those baselines.

The speaker says his team played poorly in a winnable loss to Anaheim, turning over the puck, mishandling it and losing defensive coverage. Anaheim’s physical forecheck created problems, and the team needs better support in its own end and a stronger response to that pressure. He also criticizes the team’s five-on-three play and says its best players need to produce against Anaheim’s checking line. He expects the team to follow its plan and play better in the next game, while seeking clarification on how the rules will be applied.

The 2017/18 Carlsberg UK Northamptonshire Food and Drink Awards honoured local producers, dining venues and culinary workers at a dinner in Northampton on November 15. The evening opened with a tribute to Antonio Carluccio, who had died the previous week, and recognised five venues for helping customers make healthier choices. The Hopping Hare won Food Pub of the Year, while its chef Arturs Dzerins was runner-up for Young Chef of the Year. Other winners included The Folly for Restaurant of the Year and Great Service, Workbridge Coffee Shop for Independent Café / Tea Room, and Richard Walker for Chef of the Year.
Las Vegas Valley residents mailing last-minute tax returns have until 10 p.m. Tuesday to get them postmarked. The Sunset Road postal facility will offer a drive-up drop-off area.

Girlfriends is preparing corsages, flowers and other accessories for Liberal High School’s April 22 prom and several other school proms. Employee Kenna McNeil said the shop has received nearly 100 orders and began preparations around March 1 to allow time for supplies to arrive. Many students order close to prom; the shop took 20 to 30 tuxedo and corsage orders in the past few days.

The passage compares three ways to defend the Triangle Offense. Basic NBA “show and recover” defense packs the lane, contests cuts and screens, and encourages perimeter shots. SOS disruption applies extended pressure, denies passes, fronts the post, and switches to interrupt offensive movement. All-out SOS disruption traps the wing after the first pass, forcing the offense out of its planned routes; defenders then rotate to cover passes out of the trap.

The speaker says brief defensive lapses led to quick goals, though their team otherwise played well and created chances. They remain confident after the loss but say they must play consistently and work hard to score against a strong defensive team.

Fishermen in central Vietnam clashed with police while trying to file lawsuits against Formosa over a toxic waste dump that killed tonnes of fish and damaged their livelihoods. Although Formosa paid Vietnam’s government $500 million, the fishermen said they had received no compensation. Witnesses reported injuries and brief detentions.

Digital leaders use relevant data to set goals, track progress, and evaluate performance, often alongside 360-degree reviews. Clear, measurable goals give teams flexibility to experiment and find creative ways to achieve them.
