Hollywood is looking to the summer movie season to revive a box office that is down nearly 3 percent after a weak summer last year. “Avengers: Infinity War” and “Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom” headline a slate of major franchise releases, but industry observers warn that too many blockbusters may compete for the same audiences. Studios are also offering female-led films, comedies, documentaries and independent releases. With ticket sales at a 25-year low in 2017 and competition for viewers growing, distributors say variety and careful release scheduling matter.

The passage surveys twelve NFDI4DS shared tasks: seven completed, one ongoing, and four in development. They address challenges including scholarly information extraction, question answering, fact-checking, ontology learning, scientific web discourse, clinical prognosis, and algorithm benchmarking. Through community-based evaluation, the tasks aim to advance methods and support FAIR, transparent, reproducible, and interoperable research data infrastructure.

On July 19, 2016, Microsoft filed a Form 8-K reporting that it had issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2016. The release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

On May 17, the Colchester-Milton Rotary Club joined other volunteers to plant saplings along the Winooski River at Pine Island Farm. Organized by the Intervale Center, the project supplemented a 2014 planting and aimed to reduce erosion and greenhouse gases. The effort answered Rotary International’s challenge to plant a tree for every member. The local club had also planted trees at Porters Point School and hopes to undertake similar projects in Milton.

Motley Fool Money highlights the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card’s unlimited 2% cash rewards, $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and $0 annual fee. It offers 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 18.99%, 23.99%, or 28.99%. The passage also lists cell phone protection, compares other rewards cards, and discloses advertising relationships.

Wall Street stocks surrendered early gains Thursday as Treasury yields rose and technology shares retreated. The Dow rose 0.14 percent, while the S&P 500 fell 0.06 percent and the Nasdaq dropped 0.35 percent. The Federal Reserve held rates steady but expressed concern about inflation; economic data added to those concerns. Banks gained as higher yields lifted financial shares. Corporate earnings remained strong overall, though UPS fell after reporting higher shipping costs. After-hours results lifted Amazon shares, while Alphabet and Apple declined.

This study examines the 2015–2025 Times Higher Education world rankings of five universities in each of ten populous Asian countries. Using document analysis, it finds that the selected Chinese and Japanese universities generally ranked highest, Russian universities were relatively stable, and Indian universities generally improved. Rankings for universities in several other countries were stable or declined; Bangladeshi universities appeared only in recent years, while Vietnamese universities generally declined. The study recommends stronger international partnerships, marketing and funding. Its scope is limited to selected universities and one ranking system.

A study of 75 middle-school students found that experimental groups improved their attention-test performance after physical education programs: both classes identified more targets in 30 seconds, while only the class with four weekly PE hours improved over 120 seconds. Control groups showed no significant changes. The effects of specific activities and longer-term outcomes remain unclear.

Free-agent receiver Odell Beckham Jr. accepted a six-game NFL suspension for violating its performance-enhancing drugs policy. He says he did not knowingly take a banned substance and hopes to return this season. He is eligible to play in Week 12.

The lecture explains how renormalization of a heavy-to-light current in an effective theory produces Sudakov double logarithms. Its cusp anomalous dimension arises from a kink in Wilson lines and controls the leading logarithms; higher-order accuracy requires additional anomalous dimensions and matching corrections. When each collinear direction has one building block, momentum labels are fixed by external kinematics and evolution is multiplicative. Operators with two fields in the same direction instead have integral evolution equations. The lecture then begins a deep-inelastic-scattering analysis in the Breit frame, identifying collinear quark and gluon operators and relating proton matrix elements of the quark operator to parton distribution functions.

The UK’s Competition and Markets Authority has designated Google Search with Strategic Market Status after a 10-month investigation, giving it greater power to impose competition measures. Proposed changes include offering users a choice of search engines, fairer ranking processes, easier data transfers, and requiring permission to use publishers’ content in AI Overviews. The CMA says Google handles more than 90 percent of UK general search queries. Google warns that some interventions could hinder innovation or harm businesses. The designation covers Search, including some news features and Discover, but not Google News or Gemini.

The passage describes distributed-system patterns as technology-independent blueprints that help developers learn from prior experience, share a vocabulary, and build reusable components. Containers support these patterns by separating resources, ownership, and concerns.

Three single-node patterns pair an application container with another container: a **sidecar** adds functionality, an **ambassador** brokers external communication, and an **adapter** presents a consistent interface. Examples include HTTPS for legacy services, routing to storage shards, and standardized monitoring. Reusable containers require clear parameters, stable APIs, and documentation.

Multi-node patterns include replicated, load-balanced services for availability and scale, and sharded services that divide requests and state among machines. The passage also discusses readiness checks, caching and SSL termination layers, and the performance and failure trade-offs of sharded caches.

The passage describes a method for configuring deep neural network hardware to perform activation functions using programmable lookup tables. Calibration data is processed by a hardware representation, and inputs to each activation module are monitored to determine their expected range. Lookup data is then generated for that range and loaded into the hardware, making fuller use of table entries. The passage also describes interpolation between stored values, handling inputs outside the calibrated range, and updating lookup data between hardware passes.

A study of 198 honey samples worldwide found neonicotinoid pesticides in 75%, indicating widespread bee exposure. North America had the highest proportion of affected samples at 86%. Previous studies found these pesticides can impair bees’ brain function and slow colony growth.

Missouri’s Rockwood School District keeps students together for grade-level reading lessons, then uses flexible groups, specialist interventions, and enrichment to address individual needs. The author argues that this approach avoids the risks of grouping students by reading ability across grades. At the end of the 2024–25 school year, Rockwood kindergarteners exceeded national proficiency averages in every measured skill group, while first and second graders exceeded them in nearly every domain. The author cautions that the model may not work everywhere.

The passage reviews studies on higher education quality, particularly online learning during COVID-19. It identifies technological access, teaching practices, student support, leadership, and institutional adaptability as important considerations. It also discusses quality assurance, rankings, equity, internationalization, curriculum development, and emerging technologies, noting both benefits and limitations. The conclusion calls for critical engagement and collaboration as digital platforms and new publication models reshape scholarly communication.

The NVIDIA A100 architecture targets HPC and AI workloads with third-generation Tensor Cores, expanded memory resources, and GPU partitioning. Its FP64 Tensor Cores reach a peak of 19.5 TFLOPS, 2.5 times the Tesla V100’s FP64 performance. In tests of mixed-precision iterative refinement, TF32 delivered a 2.0× geometric-mean speedup over an FP64 solver. A100’s 2:4 structured sparsity halves the weight data footprint and doubles Sparse Tensor Core math throughput by skipping zeros.

A100 includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, and controls for retaining reused data in L2. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/s total bandwidth per GPU. CUDA 11 supports A100 features including asynchronous copies, barriers, and task graphs. The eight-GPU DGX A100 system combines these capabilities for training, inference, and HPC workloads.

Platinum futures are exchange-traded contracts used to speculate on platinum prices, diversify a portfolio, or hedge exposure. CME Globex contracts represent 50 troy ounces, are physically settled, and have a $5 tick size. Platinum prices are affected by supply and demand, political and economic conditions, production costs, and demand from industries including automotive and jewelry.

The passage reports two strategy backtests: a combined long-and-short strategy with 473 trades, a 64% win rate, and an average gain of 0.57%; and a seasonal strategy with 60 trades, a 75% win rate, and an average gain of 0.66%. It cautions that commodity strategies can be difficult to sustain and that leverage can magnify losses. It recommends evaluating strategies through backtesting, risk management, and their correlation with other investments.

Teach For America’s Ignite Fellowship argues that well-supported, relationship-focused tutoring can improve learning while introducing college students to teaching. Its virtual tutors have worked in more than 40 communities; participating middle school math students’ test scores grew at up to 2.5 times the expected rate, and elementary readers progressed up to three times faster than average. The article emphasizes school-based training and coaching, with technology used to connect tutors and students rather than replace relationships. It cites research finding that Ignite tutoring nearly triples the likelihood of applying to Teach For America’s teacher program. Since Ignite launched, 550 fellows have joined its teaching corps.

The president returns an immigration bill without approval. He argues that its literacy test would not reliably identify dangerous or desirable immigrants and would unjustly exclude people willing to work. He also finds the exceptions for relatives unclear and inadequate. He objects to provisions criminalizing certain cross-border work and employment, warning that they could disrupt neighboring communities, invite retaliation, and be difficult to enforce because of vague wording. He concludes that the bill is unnecessarily harsh and could harm citizens.

China announced it would close its domestic ivory market by the end of 2017. Elephant populations have fallen sharply as poachers exploit an exemption for ivory obtained before the 1989 international trade ban. Conservationists say reducing demand in China, the world’s largest ivory market, could curb poaching and encourage other countries to restrict trade.

The study introduces GeoSQL-Bench, a 14,178-task benchmark, and GeoSQL-Eval, an automated framework for evaluating language models’ PostGIS query generation. It evaluates 24 models and strategies across conceptual knowledge, SQL structure, semantic alignment, execution accuracy, and robustness. General-purpose and reasoning-enhanced models perform best overall, but correct syntax often fails to translate into executable or accurate queries. Function calls, parameter matching, and table-schema retrieval remain major challenges; underspecified requests further reduce accuracy. The study also releases a public leaderboard and identifies broader function coverage, additional spatial databases, and more models as areas for future work.

At Dumbarton Oaks in October 1944, representatives of the United States, Britain, and China informally discussed dissolving the League of Nations and transferring functions to a new United Nations organization. They agreed to exchange papers, but none had been received. The League’s Supervisory Committee began arranging a Conciliation Committee to confer with a group designated by the United Nations Conference. The document recommends that the United States take no initiative on liquidation unless Britain or China proposes another procedure.

At a January 31, 1945 meeting on the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals, Chile’s ambassador sought to correct an earlier meeting record concerning language about respect for international treaties. He said its importance had been agreed upon, though its placement had not.

Kyle Busch won his third straight 2018 NASCAR Cup race at Richmond but said he hopes he is not peaking too early. He credited his short-track experience and work with Kyle Busch Motorsports for helping his strong start. Busch said a fourth consecutive win would be harder at Talladega because restrictor-plate racing can be unpredictable.

Researchers tested biosecurity software with about 76,000 AI-designed variants of 72 harmful proteins. Many variants evaded existing screens, but software patches improved detection, including for genes split into fragments. The updated models still missed about 3 percent of variants. The tests were entirely computational, so it is unclear whether the variants would function as proteins. An industry expert said attempts to produce malicious proteins are rare.

NVIDIA’s May 10, 2018 Form 8-K reports the release of its results for the quarter ended April 29, 2018. The release and CFO commentary by Colette M. Kress are attached as exhibits and furnished, not filed.

Hurricane Katrina left lasting damage in New Orleans’ Lower Ninth Ward, where many residents have struggled to return and rebuild. The city is adapting to flooding through raised homes, evacuation centers, community gardens and plans to capture stormwater rather than pump it away. Louisiana’s $50 billion Coastal Master Plan prioritizes wetlands restoration, flood defenses and, in some cases, relocation. The state also faces land loss and subsidence linked to oil and gas extraction, while rising seas pose a growing threat. Residents with fewer resources may find it harder to adapt.

Boston leads the life sciences industry in lab space and attracts billions in venture capital and federal research funding. Federal funding cuts and threats to higher education are challenging its competitive edge.
Roma are reportedly interested in Manchester United winger Adnan Januzaj as a possible replacement for Mohamed Salah. Januzaj failed to score in 25 Premier League appearances on loan at Sunderland.

The cup and handle is a bullish continuation pattern: a rounded, U-shaped cup forms after a rally, followed by a smaller downward-drifting handle. A breakout above the handle’s resistance signals a possible continuation of the uptrend; rising volume can help confirm it. An inverted version signals potential continuation of a downtrend.

Traders may use the pattern alongside market context and other indicators, placing stop-loss orders below the handle or cup. High volatility can make the pattern harder to identify. The passage reports mixed backtest results, including underperformance against the S&P 500 in one test, and says it could not establish the pattern’s profitability with strict trading rules.

A higher-order self-energy diagram contains a loop integral that diverges logarithmically at infinite momentum, making its uncorrected predictions unusable. Introducing a cutoff separates the calculable contribution from the remaining divergence. Renormalization then expresses physical masses and couplings as bare values plus corrections; experiments evaluate these quantities at specific scales. Electromagnetic, weak, and strong couplings vary with energy and do not appear to converge at very high scales. New particles could change how the couplings vary and might allow them to meet at one scale, but whether this occurs is unknown.

Brendan Burns’s 2018 O’Reilly book *Designing Distributed Systems* is available for various uses. The publisher and author disclaim responsibility for errors or damages and place responsibility for complying with applicable licenses on readers.

The lecture proves the induced graph removal lemma: if a graph has sufficiently few induced copies of a fixed graph H, it can be made induced H-free by adding or deleting a small number of edges. The usual regularity-lemma proof faces an obstacle because changing edges in irregular pairs can create induced copies that the counting lemma cannot control.

To address this, the lecture develops a strong regularity lemma that produces a regular partition and a much more regular refinement with similar energies. A corollary supplies substantial subsets of the partition parts whose every pair, including each subset with itself, is regular. These subsets support the cleaning and counting steps of the induced removal proof.

The lecture also states a colored-edge version and an infinite removal lemma for possibly infinite families of forbidden induced subgraphs. Finally, it connects removal lemmas to property testing: random sampling can distinguish triangle-free graphs from graphs far from triangle-free, and the infinite removal lemma implies that every hereditary graph property is testable.

Dollar-cost averaging invests fixed amounts at regular intervals, while lump sum investing puts the full amount into the market immediately. The passage describes backtesting a diversified lump sum buy-and-hold portfolio and argues that investing earlier and remaining invested for at least ten years has historically offered a higher chance of success. It says the before-crisis lump sum investment produced more total profit than the after-crisis investment.

NeoWorld generates an expandable, interactive virtual world from a single image. It uses object-centric Gaussian layers for efficient scene representation and progressively reconstructs relevant objects in 3D as users explore or issue prompts. A language model interprets commands for object manipulation and animation. In the reported evaluations, NeoWorld improved 3D consistency, scene quality, segmentation accuracy, and prompt-aligned animation compared with the tested world-generation baselines. Its limitations include errors from segmentation, 3D reconstruction, object alignment, and misinterpreted prompts, which can propagate through its pipeline.

Senator Sherwin Gatchalian urged DepEd to address longstanding delays in public school teachers’ performance-based bonuses. Teachers have yet to receive their 2016–2017 bonuses; a DepEd official cited failed biddings and delayed clearance processing.

Former Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe returned home amid allegations from President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s administration linking his allies to a June 24 bombing at a Bulawayo rally that killed two people and injured more than 40. Police were still investigating, and Mnangagwa said his suspicion of the G40 faction was a hunch. A source close to Mugabe’s family said they were unperturbed. Mugabe, forced from office by a military intervention in November, has called Mnangagwa’s administration illegitimate. His nephew Patrick Zhuwao warned that the bombing could be used to justify a crackdown on perceived opponents.

A collection of June 2001 news reports focuses on California’s energy crisis, including high natural-gas prices, pipeline constraints, disputed electricity-pricing controls and a state Senate investigation seeking records from power companies, including Enron. Several articles discuss a PBS documentary on deregulation and the crisis. Other reports cover lenders’ efforts to keep Enron’s disputed Dabhol power project in India operating, Marathon’s acquisition of Enron’s stake in a Saudi gas venture, and a contested proposal to use Connecticut conservation funds for a fuel-cell project involving Enron.

Apple’s February 2015 Form 8-K reports an underwriting agreement with Goldman, Sachs & Co. and Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. for $6.5 billion in senior unsecured notes: $500 million in floating-rate notes due 2020 and fixed-rate notes of $1.25 billion at 1.55% due 2020, $1.25 billion at 2.15% due 2022, $1.5 billion at 2.50% due 2025, and $2 billion at 3.45% due 2045. Interest is payable quarterly on the floating-rate notes and semiannually on the fixed-rate notes.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition device with per-channel input clamps, programmable gain and low-pass filtering, and common-mode rejection. Input clamps support swings up to ±18V; above that threshold, input current must remain within ±10mA. A continuous sampling clock is required, and a synchronization signal can align sampling across multiple devices. The device supports internal or external references, configurable data formats, two- or four-lane SDR or DDR output, data randomization, averaging, and test patterns. Speed-boost mode samples one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS. The passage also describes SPI configuration and daisy-chaining, initialization, power supplies, layout recommendations, and an ATE application example.

The study developed a whole-body model to predict how four first-line tuberculosis drugs—rifampicin, ethambutol, isoniazid and pyrazinamide—distribute over time, including in the pleura and lymph nodes, two common extrapulmonary sites. The model was calibrated and validated against available plasma and lung concentration data. It reasonably predicted reported pleural concentrations for three drugs but overpredicted rifampicin there. Simulations found that rifampicin and isoniazid generally exceeded their critical concentrations, while ethambutol fell below its threshold at several sites and pyrazinamide did not reach its threshold in any simulated compartment. The authors note that limited tissue data, simplified lymph-node representation and omitted drug interactions constrain the predictions. They call for further measurements to validate the model and inform extrapulmonary TB treatment.

The Federal Reserve raised its federal funds rate target by 0.25 percentage points to 1–1.25 percent, its second increase in six months. The rate had remained near zero for seven years after the 2007 financial crisis.

GBMC neonatologist Dr. Maria Pane cares for critically ill newborns and includes parents in rounds. She values her team’s collaboration and supports the Father’s Day 5K fundraiser for the neonatal intensive care unit.

Microsoft reported revenue of $24.54 billion and net income of $6.58 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2017, up from $21.93 billion and $5.67 billion a year earlier. Diluted earnings per share rose to $0.84 from $0.72, and operating cash flow was $12.44 billion. Revenue grew in Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud, while More Personal Computing revenue was nearly unchanged. Microsoft early adopted new revenue-recognition and lease standards and restated prior results. As of September 30, it held $138.47 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments.

Researchers combined South Korean and Taiwanese stroke registries into a dataset of 9,941 patients treated with endovascular thrombectomy. Taiwanese patients had more vascular risk factors and more severe strokes, and were less likely to be functionally independent at 90 days. Patients aged 80 or older had lower rates of favorable recovery and successful recanalization, and higher mortality than younger patients, but similar rates of symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage. Pre-stroke independence and stroke severity were important predictors of outcomes. The authors caution that differences between registries, unavailable imaging and follow-up data, and the retrospective analysis limit interpretation.

Amazon’s net sales rose 7% year over year to $121.2 billion in the second quarter of 2022, while operating income fell to $3.3 billion from $7.7 billion. The company reported a $2.0 billion net loss, including a $3.9 billion valuation loss on its Rivian investment. North America and International posted operating losses, while AWS operating income increased to $5.7 billion. Amazon acquired MGM in March for approximately $6.1 billion, net of cash acquired, and repurchased $6.0 billion of stock during the first half of 2022.

The Georgia Court of Appeals affirmed Robert Pearl Bryson’s convictions for aggravated sodomy, aggravated child molestation, child molestation, and failure to register as a sex offender. It found the evidence sufficient, rejected his challenges to the indictment and the trial court’s rulings on counsel withdrawal, severance, and a no-contest plea, and held that he had waived his ineffective-assistance claim.

The paper develops a framework for evaluating enterprise AI innovation through its relationship with big data, advanced analytics, and digital platforms. Drawing on a literature review and expert interviews, it proposes an AI/big-data/analytics value chain and five maturity levels, ranging from human-led initial analytics to machine-controlled advanced analytics. The framework is intended to support planning and assessment of AI-based automation and changing human–machine roles.

This study compared portable retinal images taken before and after pupil dilation in 327 patients to assess image quality and AI-based diabetic retinopathy detection. More dilated images were gradable than undilated images (82.1% versus 55.6%). Among 597 gradable image pairs, AI accuracy was 82.91% with dilation and 79.23% without it, but the performance difference was not statistically significant. Dilation produced fewer false positives. Older age, longer diabetes duration, hypertension, male sex, and Indigenous identity were associated with poorer undilated image quality. The authors note limitations including paired-image selection, a single camera model, and one dataset.

Image registration aligns a moving image with a fixed image, but high-resolution volumes can exceed the memory capacity of existing methods. The paper introduces Flash Fused Distributed Primitives (FFDP), which reduces memory use in interpolation and similarity calculations and distributes images and deformation fields across GPUs. Its single-GPU components accommodate problems up to 64 times larger than existing algorithms. Using eight A6000 GPUs, FFDP registered a 250 µm in-vivo MRI to a 100 µm ex-vivo brain volume in about 58 seconds. On a simulated 250 µm dataset, it achieved higher registration accuracy than the evaluated alternatives while requiring up to 500 times fewer GPU-hours.

The lecture introduces probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs), which let a randomized verifier check a few locations of a proof rather than read it all. It defines completeness, soundness, randomness and query complexity, and describes nonadaptive verification.

For 3SAT, the lecturer constructs a PCP by laying out low-degree extensions of the witness and circuit layers, together with possible transcripts of the GKR protocol’s sumchecks. The verifier follows a GKR verification path using oracle queries. The construction aims for an efficiently generated, polynomial-size proof with completeness 1, soundness 1/2, and polylogarithmic randomness and query complexity. Its soundness analysis uses a union bound over the sumchecks; the lecturer also identifies a needed low-degree test for the input-layer extension. After a break, the lecture is set to turn to cryptography and computational soundness.

This specification update lists CS5535 Revision A3 issues affecting SSMI timing, IDE and UDMA transfers, S3 wake inputs, RTC RAM reads, LPC and legacy DMA access, USB clock gating, keyboard and mouse emulation, SMB status, GPIO writes after suspend, and sleep-state signals. Recommended workarounds include generating SSMIs with the Geode GX processor, following the normal UDMA command sequence, using PWRBTN# for S3 wake, disabling USB clock gating, using DWORD-aligned ATAC addresses, and setting sleep-signal delays below the PM_SED delay. Some issues have no resolution. AMD also states product and warranty limitations.

The Mississippi Supreme Court affirmed Ulysses S. Gandy’s second manslaughter conviction and ten-year sentence after a collision that killed three people. Although testimony conflicted, the court found sufficient evidence for the jury to conclude that Gandy was intoxicated and drove into the wrong lane, constituting culpable negligence. It also found no reversible error in refusing his proposed intoxication instruction, admitting sketches of the scene as witnesses observed it, or allowing the jury to deliberate without a food recess.

Texas Instruments warns that electrostatic discharge can damage the integrated circuits and recommends proper handling. The May 2025 revision changed the ADS8685W and ADS8689W status from Advance Information to Production Data. Mechanical, packaging, and ordering information may change without notice. The passage also defines ordering-related terms and states that TI provides technical resources “as is”; developers are responsible for selecting, designing, validating, and testing their applications.

EUR/USD rose for a fourth session toward 1.1840 as the dollar weakened following Friday’s US inflation figures. Traders await ECB and FOMC minutes for guidance on QE tapering and balance-sheet reduction.

The study developed a model linking Google Community Mobility Reports to SARS-CoV-2 transmission and fitted it to hospitalization data from Norway, Sweden, Bavaria and Berlin. It examined activity in workplaces, transit stations, grocery and pharmacy locations, and retail and recreation locations, while accounting for temperature and virus variants.

The model attributed 39% of infections in Norway, 60% in Sweden and about 65% in the two German regions to contacts captured by these mobility categories. Transit stations and workplaces had the largest estimated contributions at pre-pandemic activity levels in Norway and Sweden; retail and recreation ranked highest in the German regions. A 20°C temperature increase was associated with lower transmissibility, while the Delta variant was associated with higher transmissibility. The authors caution that assumptions about the relationship between mobility and infectious contacts, along with possible measurement errors, limit interpretation of the settings’ relative importance.

A collection of July 2001 articles covers Enron and the California electricity crisis. State records show that some public and private suppliers charged California higher average prices than several companies criticized by Governor Gray Davis. A Senate investigator sought permission to release Duke Energy bidding data, while refund talks between California and power suppliers ended without agreement. In India, Dabhol Power’s chief executive resigned amid a payment dispute that had halted power purchases and construction; Enron chairman Kenneth Lay met officials to seek a resolution. Other reports cover Enron’s investment in Tropic Networks, its stock outlook, and investigations into Western electricity prices.
The Patriots struggled offensively against the Dolphins but trailed by only seven in the final minute. Stephen Gostkowski’s unusual onside kick failed, and Miami recovered to win.

Grief is a personal response to losing someone or something important, including changes in health, independence or home. It may begin before an expected death, and people can experience shifting emotions rather than a fixed sequence of stages. Reactions after a death may include numbness, disbelief, relief, longing, guilt, anger, sadness and disrupted sleep. Moving after a bereavement can add to grief and may separate someone from local support. There is no set length of time for grieving, though intense feelings generally ease. Friends, family, a GP or specialist organisations can provide support.

Accepting his party’s presidential nomination, the speaker contrasts its vision of limited government, individual freedom, economic growth and military strength with what he describes as his opponents’ record of inflation, taxation and spending. He credits his administration with lower inflation and taxes, job growth, stronger defenses and improved alliances. He calls for spending controls, a balanced-budget amendment, tax reform and negotiations to reduce nuclear arms. He rejects bigotry within his party and closes with images of the Olympic torch and Statue of Liberty as symbols of American opportunity and hope.

Ocean acidification harms some shell-building organisms, but periwinkle sea snails showed signs of adaptation when exposed to conditions predicted for 2100. Their metabolism declined, yet they made shells faster by producing less-dense inner layers and developed less-soluble shells that may better withstand harsher conditions.

Researchers improved the optical quality of hexagonal boron nitride by making crystals with 99 percent isotopically pure boron. Reduced optical losses tripled the distance that light-coupled vibrations can travel through the crystal, potentially improving hyperlens imaging resolution by about tenfold. The researchers calculate that a lens made from the material could image objects as small as 30 nanometers. Such lenses could eventually allow detailed, nonharmful imaging of living cells in their natural environments.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition system with configurable analog inputs and data interfaces. Simple averaging improves SNR but halves the output data rate; moving averaging does not change it. Fixed, ramp, and alternating test patterns support interface debugging. Speed-boost mode samples a selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS while the other six channels remain idle.

The passage describes reset and initialization, register configuration through SPI or daisy-chain SPI, and an ATE application. For that application, it reports 0.0015% total unadjusted error after calibration at 25°C ±5°C and 7.5µs settling to 99.95% of full scale in wide-bandwidth mode. It also provides power-supply and board-layout guidance.

To beat an offside trap, attackers must recognize defenders moving up, stay onside when a pass is made, and use the space left behind them. Players caught offside should avoid interfering with play. Options include dribbling through without passing, timing through passes and runs, checking back for a pass, and using short or back passes to buy time. On free kicks, fakes can reveal the trap, while a designated attacker can return for a short pass. Attackers should also recognize when a defender fails to move up and be ready for a possible one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
The court reversed Roldán’s judgment and acquitted him, applying its decision in a nearly identical case that differed only in the loan amount.

A Barron’s article argues Netflix could lose more than half its value, citing new competition, cash spending, debt and accounting practices. The passage counters that Netflix has grown despite competitors, raised prices while retaining subscribers, and benefits from its large customer base. It acknowledges that the stock is expensive and could decline.

China has blacklisted Canadian research firm TechInsights and nine subsidiaries after it published an analysis of Huawei’s AI chips. Citing national security and strategic-industry concerns, China barred its organisations from doing business or sharing data with the firm. The restrictions limit TechInsights’ access to Chinese clients and research partners.

Chef Shannon Bard announced that she and her husband, Tom, have permanently closed their Portland restaurant Zapoteca after six years to spend more time with their children. They continue to operate two Kennebunk restaurants, a cooking school and a catering company.

Ryan Kerr, 26, of Evercreech admitted attacking a man twice, punching the man’s mother and assaulting another man at The George Hotel. The court heard he showed no remorse. After his lawyer requested psychiatric reports, Judge David Ticehurst remanded Kerr in custody while considering his sentence.

A study found that nearly 17,000 children under 6 were treated in emergency rooms for window-blind injuries from 1990 to 2015. Most injuries were minor, but cord entanglement accounted for most of the 271 deaths. Researchers and safety advocates called for blinds with inaccessible cords and mandatory safety rules, arguing that supervision and cord safety kits are insufficient. A proposed revision to voluntary standards would require pre-made blinds to be cordless or have inaccessible cords, while still allowing cords in custom products.

The study evaluated whether adding high-volume, high-antibody-titer convalescent plasma early in hospitalization improved outcomes for patients with COVID-19 compared with supportive care alone. Investigators hypothesized it would reduce the need for mechanical ventilation and also assessed clinical severity, oxygenation, ventilation, hospitalization, and safety. The passage notes that prior trials and a meta-analysis found no mortality benefit, though results varied. Ethics committees approved the protocol, informed consent was required, and the study followed established ethical and clinical practice guidelines.

Lubrizol is investing US$80 million to expand its engineered polymers TPU production and technology in North America, Europe and Asia, citing increased demand. New North American capacity is expected later in 2018, new lines have opened in Songjiang, China, and further expansions are planned in Asia and Europe in 2019.

Peterborough City Council says it brought 179 long-term empty private homes back into use last year, bringing the five-year total to 663. Its leader, Cllr John Holdich, also highlighted a £4 million pledge for homes for homeless families and invited comments on the council’s Phase Two budget proposals. He said government grants have fallen by 80 per cent over eight years and argued that outdated population figures leave the growing city unfairly funded. The council reports fewer littering fines and less unauthorised city-centre cycling six months after introducing two Public Space Protection Orders. A new service, CHUMS, will support children and young people with mental health needs.

The NAAIM Exposure Index measures the average U.S. equity exposure reported weekly by active investment managers; its indicator line uses a two-week moving average. High readings suggest bullish sentiment and low readings bearish sentiment, but the index is not predictive. The passage’s backtests found that strategies based on the index generally performed poorly as contrarian strategies.

Jeff Horn will defend his WBO welterweight title against Gary Corcoran in Brisbane on Wednesday. A win could lead to major fights in 2018, potentially against Terence Crawford. Horn hopes the defense will counter criticism of his disputed July victory over Manny Pacquiao, but says he is focused on Corcoran first. Corcoran, ranked 10th by the WBO, is seeking his first world title. Accusations of head-butting and threats of biting have marked the fight’s buildup.

Manchester City host Burnley at the Etihad Stadium on Jan. 2, seeking a win to keep pace in the title race. Sergio Aguero returns for City, while Burnley, just above the relegation zone, will look to Andre Gray and Sam Vokes for goals.

Trump announced a deal under which Pfizer will offer lower drug prices to Medicaid and patients and launch new medicines at prices comparable to those in other countries. Pfizer may avoid certain import tariffs if it continues investing in U.S. manufacturing. Experts say the deal’s effect on affordability and Medicaid budgets remains unclear. Sanofi also confirmed a European Commission investigation into potentially anticompetitive activity.

Apple Inc. issued $1 billion in 3.000% senior unsecured notes on June 20, 2017. The notes mature June 20, 2027, with interest payable semiannually beginning December 20, 2017. The Form 8-K includes the underwriting agreement, note documents and a legal opinion.

Facebook published a detailed version of its community standards, explaining what posts it allows on subjects including drugs, bullying and violence. It will also let users appeal the removal of individual posts and provide specific reasons for more takedowns. The company says it regularly reviews its rules with input from outside experts and plans public forums for further feedback. The standards are separate from procedures for restricting content under local laws and do not prohibit false information.

In this non-peer-reviewed study, EEG responses to median nerve stimulation were compared in 19 adults with Tourette syndrome and matched healthy controls. The Tourette group showed greater trial-by-trial response variability and a flatter EEG power-spectrum slope at higher frequencies. Their P100 response was larger and associated with tic impairment, while the timing and topography of most early responses were similar between groups. Stimulation reduced relative variability and increased phase coherence in both groups. The authors suggest that sensorimotor activity may be less stable at rest in Tourette syndrome but become more stable following stimulation.

A federal jury unanimously found that retired Little Rock police lieutenant David Hudson did not use unreasonable force when he punched Jon “Chris” Erwin seven times and took him to the ground outside a restaurant in October 2011. The encounter was recorded and widely viewed online. Hudson testified that Erwin resisted arrest and put his hands on him; Erwin denied resisting, and his attorney argued that Hudson could have de-escalated the encounter. Erwin received stitches for facial injuries. Misdemeanor charges against him were later dropped for procedural reasons. Before trial, Erwin settled claims against the city and the restaurant’s owner; settlement details were unavailable.

Finnish irritation with German troops grew, but Finland remained dependent on Germany for military supplies and food, while German influence over its press persisted. War weariness and food shortages fueled labor demands, socialist unrest, and doubts about holding Soviet Karelia. A Soviet official said he had not heard of rumored talks with Finland. In a separate conversation, a U.S. official warned a Finnish representative that censorship and press attacks on the United States could strain Finland’s support abroad. The representative agreed to urge greater care in Helsinki.

A Texas Monthly article forwarded to Enron employees traces the company’s transformation from a debt-burdened pipeline business into a major energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. Skilling’s Gas Bank helped Enron build a dominant natural-gas trading business, while its expansion into electricity, broadband and other markets fueled rapid growth. The article describes an aggressive culture that rewarded quick profits and ranked employees harshly. By 2001, troubled overseas projects, California’s energy crisis, a telecommunications downturn and questions about accounting had weakened investor confidence and driven down Enron’s stock. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, and Lay returned promising a greater focus on Enron’s core business.

Amazon reported first-quarter 2018 net sales of $51.0 billion, up 43% from a year earlier, and net income of $1.63 billion, up from $724 million. Operating income rose to $1.93 billion. North America and AWS reported operating income of $1.15 billion and $1.40 billion, respectively, while International reported a $622 million operating loss. Operating activities used $1.79 billion in cash during the quarter. Amazon acquired Ring in April 2018 for approximately $900 million in cash, net of cash acquired.

The paper identifies reusable ontology design patterns for process modeling in materials science and engineering. It defines three requirements—process structure, data and resources, and project goals and roles—and uses expert-reviewed patterns to evaluate a baseline extraction method combining semantic similarity with ontology modularization. P-PLAN scored highest for process and resource patterns; PMDcore supported all three categories. The method shows promise, but its results depend on annotation quality and requirement wording, and it processes ontologies independently.

Florida State linebacker Ethan Pritchard was released from the hospital nearly six weeks after being shot in the head in what authorities described as a case of mistaken identity. He is alert, responsive and able to communicate, and has moved to a rehabilitation facility in Jacksonville. Four people were arrested in connection with the shooting.

The coach says frequent penalties have disrupted the series’ flow and made it difficult to judge either team’s style, though calls affect both teams. His team needs to move the puck faster, reach defensive positions sooner and send more shots toward the net. Its power play has generated little offense against an intelligent penalty kill. He credits a trade involving Hedican and Kevyn Adams with improving the structure of the defense. He discusses balancing line matchups and ice time, says he sees no change in the team after a loss, and generally avoids advising goaltenders on technique. He describes his coaching approach as adaptable, reliant on his staff and rooted in his enjoyment of hockey.

GoDaddy gave neo-Nazi website The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain after publisher Andrew Anglin posted an article mocking Heather Heyer, who was killed at a Charlottesville white nationalist rally. GoDaddy said the article could incite further violence and violated its terms of service. The company manages the site’s domain but does not host its content. A contributor said a subsequent post claiming the site had been hacked was a prank and that the site had an alternate domain. The Daily Stormer has organized online harassment campaigns, and Anglin faces a lawsuit over one such campaign.

Old Forge High School students Christian Killino, Iain Kerrigan and Kole Barbetti organized a Math-a-thon that raised $3,864 for St. Jude’s Research Hospital. Rosemarie Corigliano was installed as president of the Wayne Memorial Hospital Auxiliary, whose new board has two fundraisers planned. At a Scranton City DAR meeting focused on conservation, fifth-generation beekeeper Hannah Perry Burgess presented a program on honey bees.

A federal appeals court ruled that the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service lacks authority under the Lacey Act to ban trade in certain giant snakes between continental states. The ruling leaves federal import restrictions and state laws intact. The reptile keepers association, which challenged the ban, said the decision would let owners travel with their snakes. Wildlife officials are reviewing the ruling; conservationists warned it could affect efforts to limit the spread of invasive species.

Fad diets may cause temporary weight loss but are not presented as sustainable. Dietician Bonnie Taub-Dix recommends building a healthy relationship with food, practicing moderation, and avoiding restrictive rules that leave people feeling deprived.

The passage warns that weakening family life and declining birth rates threaten the nation. It urges Congress to support American shipping, particularly direct mail and steamship connections with South America. It also calls for revising currency laws, arguing that seasonal interest-rate spikes and credit shortages harm commerce. One proposed remedy would let national banks issue heavily taxed notes for use during financial stringency.

The coach said his team began playing better after Holik’s second-period chance, as the pace slowed and they held onto the puck more. He considered the second overtime their best period and said improved possession and faceoffs helped build confidence. The long game left players exhausted, but prior playoff experience helped them cope. With New Jersey needing one win and his team needing two, he said they must outplay New Jersey in more areas, including emotionally, to win the next game.

Gold Coast have signed veteran fullback Michael Gordon to a two-year NRL deal after his release from the Sydney Roosters. He fills the vacancy left by Jarryd Hayne’s move to Parramatta and is expected to take on goal-kicking duties. The move also brings Gordon back to his home region.

In a STAT podcast interview, biotech scientist and social media creator Morgan “Dr. Noc” McSweeney describes using engaging, research-based videos to explain health topics. He aims to reach people who are confused rather than those firmly opposed to his views, and says nuance and occasional personal details can help build trust. He argues that more experts and public health institutions should make accessible content, while acknowledging that doing so takes time and practice.

A July 2021 Salmonella Typhimurium outbreak linked to an Eid al-Adha barbecue and lunches in Cardiff affected 22 people; 12 sought emergency care and six were admitted to hospital. An investigation identified the traditional raw liver dish marrara as the most likely vehicle of infection. Salmonella sequences from leftover lamb, local butchers and the supplying abattoir matched those from cases, but no raw liver samples were available and the point of contamination could not be established. Public Health Wales worked with communities to develop multilingual food-safety messages. The authors recommend that outbreak investigations consider culturally relevant dishes beyond those on routine questionnaires.

The Coppock Curve, introduced by E.S.C. Coppock in 1965, is a long-term stock-market momentum indicator. It uses a 10-month weighted moving average of the sum of 11- and 14-month rates of change. The described strategy enters when the curve crosses above zero and exits when it crosses below. A monthly S&P 500 backtest since 1960 produced 12 trades, all profitable. The passage reports lower drawdowns, less time in the market, and higher risk-adjusted returns than buy-and-hold, while noting the small number of trades.

Nick Foles has led the Eagles to Super Bowl LII after Carson Wentz injured his knee. Even if Foles delivers Philadelphia its first Super Bowl win, the passage says Wentz is expected to reclaim the starting job if he recovers as anticipated. That leaves the Eagles to decide whether to keep Foles as a valuable backup or trade him while his value is high. Foles has not demanded a starting role, and his future remains uncertain regardless of the Super Bowl result.

The author wrote the book to make distributed systems easier to build. Containers and orchestrators enable reusable components and shared patterns, reducing repeated work. The book collects those patterns to help developers build reliable distributed systems more efficiently.

The speaker says the team has not consistently played with full effort and that its only win came when it did. They say the team focused on defense against Pittsburgh but is now too focused on scoring. Despite creating chances, blocked and missed shots and poor decisions about when to shoot or pass have hurt them. The priority is to play for each other and not be outworked.

The UND University Senate’s executive committee will consider whether to support a draft NDSU Faculty Senate resolution circulated to North Dakota’s 11 public campuses. The resolution cites a “crisis of confidence” over budget cuts, consolidation efforts and perceived lack of support from state higher education leaders. It calls for stronger collaboration and a summit on the system’s future. UND Senate chair Dana Harsell said changing circumstances could make the resolution moot.

The passage describes L4 peripheral memory maps and a TILER extended address range used for rotated and mirrored frame-buffer views. The full extended range is accessible only to the HDVPSS and ISS subsystems; other masters can access one view through the base memory map. It also explains that terminal-function tables document pin assignments, multiplexing, electrical characteristics, and functions. Boot-configuration pins are sampled at reset to select settings including GPMC, watchdog output, XIP, Ethernet PHY, and ARM boot modes, then serve as GPMC data/address pins.

Energy Central’s February 20, 2002 Research Report Watch lists recently published power-industry research, reports newly posted to its site, and a white paper. Topics include utility markets and companies, customer services, deregulation, e-commerce, and transmission investment. The newsletter provides report descriptions, prices, ordering information, and unsubscribe instructions.

Addressing the 100th Congress on the Constitution’s bicentennial, the President cited lower inflation and interest rates and nearly 13 million new jobs, while acknowledging that unemployment remained too high. He accepted responsibility for mistakes in the unsuccessful Iran initiative and pledged to investigate them.

He urged Congress to support defense and foreign assistance, Afghan self-determination, Nicaraguan freedom fighters, arms-reduction negotiations, and the Strategic Defense Initiative. He also advocated free and fair trade. At home, he called for a balanced-budget amendment, a line-item veto, and adherence to deficit-reduction targets rather than higher taxes. He announced proposals on welfare reform, protection against catastrophic illness for older Americans, competitiveness, education, and worker retraining. He closed by describing the Constitution’s “We the people” as the principle that makes government accountable to citizens and by expressing confidence in America’s future.

A wind advisory covers the Lubbock-area forecast zones until 7 a.m. Monday, with strong winds and blowing dust Sunday night and windy conditions Monday. Mostly clear or sunny weather follows. After cooler temperatures Monday night and Tuesday, highs rise into the 80s and lower 90s by Thursday and Friday. Saturday night brings a 20% chance of thunderstorms in King, Garza, Kent and Stonewall counties.

Gold rose above $4,000 per ounce as weak U.S. economic data strengthened expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts and investors sought safety amid global uncertainty. Central-bank buying and geopolitical tensions also supported prices. Analysts warned that stronger U.S. growth or hawkish Fed signals could cause a short-term correction.

The lecture examines how capital markets finance sustainable real estate. Tenant demand, operating savings, regulation and investor perceptions of risk can affect a building’s cash flow, financing costs and value. Investors compare expected returns with their weighted cost of capital and allocate funds among assets; demand for green buildings can also change their returns over time.

On the debt side, the lecture links climate hazards to falling property values and mortgage default risk. It notes a dilemma: pricing that risk into mortgages could increase costs for lower-income borrowers in vulnerable areas. Energy-efficient buildings, by contrast, may reduce utility bills and default risk. The lecture describes green mortgages and loans that provide funds upfront for renovations expected to raise property values. It closes by introducing private equity funds and how firms incorporate ESG considerations into investment decisions and property management.

Havant Borough Council has banned bouncy castles and other inflatables on its land pending an inquiry into an inflatable trampoline explosion in Norfolk that killed three-year-old Ava-May Littleboy. The council said it had recorded no similar incidents locally.

Italian and Spanish Wikipedia blocked access to articles on 3 July to protest a proposed EU copyright directive ahead of a 5 July parliamentary vote. The proposal includes content-filtering requirements and a “link tax.” Critics warned that vague provisions could restrict sharing, linking and access to Wikipedia, while supporters said the changes could address an imbalance in the copyright system.

Michael Leighton recalls that his daughter was born the day before a game he played poorly after traveling alone to Philadelphia. He credits Jeff Reese with changing his style. Rested after a break, he says his team is anxious to start the series, plans to defend against its opponent’s skilled leaders, and will attack goalie Niemi as it has other goalies. Leighton says winning the Stanley Cup, not just the conference final, is his goal. He also discusses past stomach and groin surgery and expects a physical series against a team he respects.

Patrick Kane says Chicago is considering lineup changes but has not decided whether they will last. He plans to use his speed against Chara rather than focus on the matchup. Kane expects a tough Stanley Cup Final against a team that defended well against Pittsburgh, and says Chicago will need contributions from its depth. He reflects on the difficulty of seeing another team win the Cup, says he has become a more well-rounded player, and credits teammates’ back-checking for setting an example. His approach in the final is to seek the puck and make plays.

U.S. Treasury bears recovered some losses on Wednesday after political turmoil in Italy drove investors into government bonds on Tuesday and forced traders to close short positions. Open interest in major Treasury and interest-rate futures fell by more than 400,000 contracts that day. The 10-year yield rose to 2.855 percent on Wednesday from 2.759 percent on Tuesday, but remained below its recent seven-year high. Analysts said bearish bets remained vulnerable to political developments in Italy and Spain.

The Boy Scouts’ Twin Rivers Council is enrolling girls in Cub Scouts ahead of the program’s nationwide opening to girls in fall 2018. It hopes to enroll up to 125 girls in kindergarten through third grade by March 31, giving them time to prepare for summer camp. The council says the change will let siblings participate in Scouting together.

Audi’s forthcoming flagship Q8 SUV is expected to debut in Shanghai in early June. Its design closely follows the 2017 Q8 Concept, with a prominent grille and full-width taillights. It will use Volkswagen Group’s MLB platform; Audi has not confirmed its production powertrain.

The S&P 500 gained 2.2% in July, bringing its year-to-date gain to 7.8%, but fell 1.6% on August’s first day. Short-term technical indicators suggest caution, while longer-term trends remain healthy. Volatility and credit spreads are rising seasonally, investors are increasing their exposure to tech stocks, and US electricity demand has reached a new high.

SpaceX launched an unmanned Falcon 9 from Florida on Monday, sending a Dragon capsule with 6,400 pounds of cargo to the International Space Station. The cargo includes experiments, 20 mice and ice cream for the crew. Dragon is due Wednesday.

John Balentine argues that Earth Day has shifted from practical activities such as litter cleanup toward environmental politics. He criticizes what he calls “Big Environment” for prioritizing environmental concerns over economic ones and for fundraising through fear. He cites South Portland’s oil-sands ordinance and Maine wind farms as examples of policies he considers costly or harmful. He suggests marking Earth Day by collecting litter and enjoying the outdoors.

Legislators approved $20 million in supplementary funding, split between government reserves and the Environment Protection Fund. The Health Ministry requested $8 million for rising healthcare costs. Officials discussed policy options, and Chris Saunders abstained on the fund withdrawal.

A blitz sends five or more defenders into the offensive backfield to pressure the quarterback or stop a run. It can disrupt plays quickly, but sending extra rushers leaves fewer defenders in coverage. Variations include zone, safety, cornerback, zero and run blitzes, each using different rushers or coverage arrangements. Offenses can counter with quick passes, a mobile quarterback or extra blockers.

The passage highlights five Indian films whose visual effects enhanced romantic scenes: *Baahubali* used butterflies, forests and a waterfall; *Befikre* created a cliffside kiss; *Shivaay* depicted a snowy mountain setting; *Sanam Re* added snow to green scenery; and *Prem Ratan Dhan Payo* used effects for a fortress and double-role scenes.
Antarctic krill eject more plastic-contaminated food, but the impact on their carbon-sequestering role remains unclear.

The AAII sentiment index surveys members weekly about the stock market’s direction over the next six months. Backtests in the passage found that buying the S&P 500 after a bull-bear spread below −20 produced an average four-week gain of 1.03% per trade. A spread above 20 produced 0.52%, while a spread above 40 produced a 0.33% loss. The passage concludes that bearish readings were followed by stronger returns than bullish readings, but suggests other indicators may be better for short-term trading.

NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended October 30, 2016 reported revenue of $2.00 billion, up 54% from a year earlier, and net income of $542 million, up 120%. Diluted earnings were $0.83 per share, and gross margin was 59.0%. Growth was driven by gaming, datacenter, professional visualization and automotive systems. GPU revenue rose 53% to $1.70 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue rose 87% to $241 million.

For the first nine months of fiscal 2017, NVIDIA reported revenue of $4.74 billion and net income of $1.01 billion. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $6.67 billion at quarter-end. The company returned $694 million to shareholders through repurchases and dividends during those nine months and issued $2.00 billion in long-term notes during the quarter.

Residents of Greensboro’s Cottage Grove community report deteriorating conditions at Avalon Trace Apartments, including sewage leaks, inadequate heating, roaches and mold. Researchers have found a statistical correlation between substandard housing and asthma in the community. A $250,000 grant will support a partnership to map asthma hot spots and connect residents with services. Cone Health is matching the grant, and the county health department provides other health programs.

Coach Sutter says adding top-end offensive players helps in the playoffs if they are up to speed, though removing younger players is difficult. He says lineup decisions depend on the score and that a team can play better in a loss than a win. He sees little change in his team’s emotions and credits veterans with helping younger players refocus during breaks. He emphasizes nutrition, hydration and routine during travel. Sutter says the finals have been close, confidence is not a concern, and small actions during each shift could decide a game.

The Miami Hurricane editorial board urges schools to fund student newsrooms without controlling their reporting. It says defunding publications or absorbing them into academic programs threatens editorial independence, deprives students of practical experience and limits opportunities to learn how a free press works. Supporting the #SaveStudentNewsrooms movement, the board asks readers to read and share student journalism and watch for threats to its survival.
China’s July power generation rose 8.6% year on year to a monthly record of 604.7 billion kWh, driven by thermal power. January–July generation increased 6.8% to 3.57 trillion kWh.

Rapid technological and social change makes lifelong learning essential for Romanian librarians, as initial Library and Information Science (LIS) education cannot meet all specialised workplace requirements. Training routes include an LIS degree, a degree in another field followed by postgraduate LIS study, and assessment of competences acquired outside formal education. Library visits, professional events and mentorship offer additional learning opportunities, but few libraries fund staff training despite a legal requirement for public libraries.

Romania’s occupational standard for librarians with higher education sets out the profession’s activities and competences and supports assessment for hiring and promotion. The passage calls for greater attention to internationalisation, information literacy, reading promotion and skills for working with children. It also identifies low pay and negative stereotypes as obstacles to attracting young people to LIS.

The passage introduces an information-design model that adds framing to Bayesian persuasion. A sender can choose language that shapes a receiver’s belief, a signaling scheme that updates that belief, or both. Using an LLM-inspired framing-to-belief oracle, the authors find that optimizing framing alone for a fixed recommendation scheme is computationally hard and sensitive to belief-estimation errors. Jointly optimizing framing and recommendations is more robust, and they provide a quasi-polynomial-time approximation scheme. A practical method combines LLMs with analytical optimization. In realtor and clothing-brand case studies, it performs well according to LLM evaluations; human-subject results are less pronounced and more variable but broadly match the predicted effects.
Jaguars defensive lineman Travon Walker underwent left wrist surgery after being injured in Sunday’s win over the 49ers. Coach Liam Coen said Walker is day-to-day and could play against the Chiefs.

The Imperial Government disputed allegations about its conduct in Belgium, blamed Belgium and other powers for its wartime fate, and held its adversaries responsible for rejecting a path to peace. The Persian minister welcomed the U.S. President’s peace initiative, described fighting within neutral Persia, and sought U.S. help protecting Persia’s integrity and rights. The U.S. ambassador in Turkey reported that the German ambassador feared a proposed deportation of Greeks would cause hardship and deaths, said German influence over Turkish officials was limited, and was willing to help prevent the deportation of women and children.
Pasteurization inactivates H5N1 bird flu virus in milk, though viral proteins remain.

The speaker says his veteran team is confident but must play hard against the defending Stanley Cup champions, who have a balanced lineup, strong defense and a good goalie. He emphasizes shooting from anywhere, especially in overtime, and credits different teammates for stepping up. He hopes his playoff scoring will earn wider recognition and says his speed and shot are strengths, while crediting his teammates for creating chances.

The speaker says the team missed several good chances, was shut out and needs to skate better, create more opportunities and score. Although it outshot its opponent, the team felt it beat itself in a close Stanley Cup Finals game. The speaker notes the opponent had more power plays but declines to dwell on officiating. The series is now best of three.

The passage describes patterns for building container-based distributed systems. An **adapter container** gives applications a consistent interface without modifying them, supporting monitoring, logging, and health checks. This separation also enables reuse and independent updates.

For multi-node systems, microservices separate functions behind defined APIs, allowing independent development and scaling, but making design and debugging harder. **Replicated, load-balanced services** improve availability and capacity; readiness probes keep unprepared instances from receiving requests. Additional layers can provide caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination.

**Sharded services** divide data or requests among machines when one machine cannot hold the required state. Choosing an appropriate shard key matters, and consistent hashing reduces remapping when shard counts change. Replicating shards improves resilience. The **scatter/gather pattern** distributes work across nodes and combines their results, reducing processing time, although per-node overhead and slow responses limit its benefits.

Finally, event-driven functions simplify deployment and automatic scaling for discrete tasks such as request transformation and event handling. Their limitations include operational complexity, difficulty with long-running work or substantial in-memory data, and potentially unfavorable costs under sustained load.

The Department of Education says it will not currently negotiate its proposed list of 10 professional degrees, though it could expand the list through future rule making. Programs left off the list, including some health-care graduate programs, would face lower federal student loan caps. Committee members warned that the limits could reduce enrollment and access to fields such as mental health, and submitted an alternative definition for discussion. The department says its approach aims to curb excessive graduate borrowing.

Drake University’s Student Activities Board selects Painted Street designs for the Relays based on creativity and how well they incorporate the theme announced at Blitz Day. Organizations submit designs for the 54-square display and, if selected, buy their own paint and equipment. For small groups such as the Disability Action and Awareness Committee, the cost can be significant. Student organizers describe painting over the previous year’s squares as emotional but enjoy seeing the new theme take shape.

An analysis of 2023–24 campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at 100 top-grossing law firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms found that 92.45% went to Democrats, up from a roughly 6-to-1 Democratic-to-Republican ratio in 2017–20. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb had the highest Democratic share (99.7%), while Nelson Mullins had the lowest (66.4%).

NASA approved ESA’s $114.4 million JUICE mission to explore Jupiter and its moons Ganymede, Callisto and Europa. Scheduled to launch in 2022 and reach Jupiter in 2030, the probe will spend three years studying the region and the moons’ habitability. NASA will contribute instruments and components.

Olusola Simeon pleaded guilty to assaulting and injuring his girlfriend, Fadunsi Alaba, in Osogbo after she came to live with him and found his wife and children. The court remanded him pending sentencing on August 3.

The passage criticizes DC lawmaker Trayon White for blaming Jews for weather conditions and cites antisemitic remarks by Nation of Islam leader Louis Farrakhan. It then describes reported connections between Farrakhan and nine Democratic figures: Barack Obama, Keith Ellison, Maxine Waters, Barbara Lee, Danny Davis, André Carson, James Clyburn, Al Green, and Gregory Meeks.
Grande Prairie resident Wally Adams, 29, was arrested in Calgary on Aug. 3 and charged with possession and making available child pornography. Released from custody, he is due in court Sept. 27.

San Juan High School baseball coaches say someone posing as part of their program solicited sponsorships from local businesses. An auto repair shop paid about $1,400 for a team sign that the coaches say was not legitimate. The team filed a police report, shared the solicitation flyer to warn others, and urges businesses to verify requests directly with schools or programs before contributing.

The lecture examines the second-order wave equation, whose solutions travel in opposite directions at speeds c and −c. It compares the continuous equation with a semidiscrete version, showing that spatial differences introduce dispersion and second-order error. For a fully discrete leapfrog method, stability depends on the Courant ratio: it is stable when the ratio is below 1 and unstable when it exceeds 1. The lecture closes by introducing staggered grids as the next topic.

The S&P/TSX Composite Index rose 0.08 percent to 15,564.28 on April 24, led by gains in CN Rail and precious metals miners as gold prices steadied. Restaurant Brands, Teck Resources and Barrick Gold also gained. Seven of the index’s 10 sectors rose. Mitel Networks was the largest percentage gainer, while Prairiesky Royal was the largest decliner.

The study investigates defect engineering in CVD-grown monolayer MoS₂ using a 1 MeV electron beam at exposure times of 30, 60 and 120 seconds. Raman, XPS, KPFM and photoluminescence measurements indicate that longer exposure increases sulfur-vacancy-related defects and oxygen bonding, raises the work function and produces p-type behavior. Defect-bound emission grows while overall photoluminescence weakens; valley polarization falls from 62% in the as-grown sample to 38% after 120 seconds. First-principles calculations support the finding that oxygen interactions at vacancy sites create acceptor levels associated with the defect emission.

George McPhee and the Vegas coach describe building a competitive expansion team by selecting promising players, making deals and hiring a patient leader who could relate to players. They chose a six-player leadership group rather than a captain. Road wins in Dallas and Nashville strengthened the team’s confidence, though it had set no target for wins.

They also discuss the community’s response to a tragedy and the team’s efforts to honor and support those affected. Looking ahead to the Stanley Cup Final, they emphasize preparing for the next game. They describe their opponent as a strong team, with Backstrom among several players to watch.

Tencent added Batman to Arena of Valor alongside a new eight-minute Death Match mode for five two-player teams. The update also introduced Valor TV for watching matches and improved the lobby, friends list and messaging systems.

The Wing-T offense uses misdirection, similar-looking plays, varied formations and a diverse running game to make defenses react rather than attack. Developed by Harold “Tubby” Raymond at the University of Delaware, it typically relies on two capable running backs, an athletic quarterback and quick linemen who can pull and trap. Its strengths include slowing aggressive defenses and allowing adjustments; its main weakness is a limited traditional dropback passing game. Common formations include the Wing, Wing-Slot and unbalanced sets. Runs include the Buck Sweep, Down and Trap, while passes include the Waggle, receiver option routes and play-action throws. The traditional Wing-T remains common in high school football but is rare in major college football, where some coaches use its principles in spread offenses.

Vishay Intertechnology shares rose 2.08% in the latest session and closed at $19.65. Four analyst price targets averaged $20 for the next 12 months, ranging from $18 to $22. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation was 3.75. Its 14-period Average True Range was 0.55, weekly volatility was 2.47%, monthly volatility was 2.50%, and RSI was 53.51. Vishay’s market capitalization was $2.83 billion, with 144.15 million shares outstanding. Previous-session volume was 1.23 million shares, below its roughly 1.5 million-share average.

Gold prices are influenced by supply and demand, the US dollar, inflation, and investor behavior. From 1955 to 2022, gold reached 80 monthly all-time highs, though it also went more than 14 years without a new high. A backtested strategy focused on new highs had lower returns, but spent only about a third of the time in the market and nearly halved the maximum drawdown.

Japanese and Chinese forces were increasing in Korea, with Japanese troops occupying Seoul and nearby strategic routes while Chinese troops were encamped south of the city. Japan said it would not withdraw without guarantees against further Chinese interference and later demanded changes to Korea’s government and policy. The account alleges that China notified Japan of its troop deployment only after the troops arrived, contrary to an 1885 convention requiring prior written notice and withdrawal once a disturbance was settled.

Foreign representatives proposed that both sides withdraw. China replied that its troops would remain because Japan refused to withdraw. As conflict appeared imminent, Mr. Sill agreed to offer asylum to Korea’s royal family and officials if necessary and secured a larger guard for the legation.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit data-acquisition converters with an integrated analog front end and reference. They acquire an input signal between conversions; a rising CONVST/CS edge starts a conversion, and a falling edge starts a data-transfer frame. Register writes require a valid 32-bit command, while shorter frames can read selected output bits.

The devices provide nine configuration registers and support SPI-compatible and source-synchronous data transfers, with single- or dual-bit output. Output data can contain conversion results, register data, fixed patterns, and selected flags. Programmable features include input range, alarms, NAP mode, and power-down mode.

The passage also describes an eight-channel industrial input design using an ADS8681W and a differential multiplexer, along with power-supply decoupling and PCB layout recommendations.

Scale AI cut a Dallas team of more than a dozen contractors who worked on generalist AI tasks, saying demand is shifting toward specialized, expert-level training. The company offered four weeks of severance, healthcare coverage through October, and an invitation to work on its freelance platform, Outlier. Scale AI said the cuts affect a small fraction of its workforce and will not affect customer delivery.

ADA incidence will be summarized by treatment group without statistical tests. It includes treatment-induced and treatment-boosted cases (≥5-fold titer increase) divided by evaluable patients; unscheduled dosing-visit results are considered.

The passage gives ADS9803 board-layout guidance: separate digital lines from analog and reference signals, place bypass and reference capacitors close to their pins, and avoid vias between those pins and capacitors. It also describes TI development tools, documentation updates, support forums, ESD precautions, and packaging and ordering information. TI states that its resources are provided “as is,” may change, and leave developers responsible for validating their applications.
The team started well and had a chance to win, but fell short in the third. The speaker said they need to limit turnovers and make smarter plays with the puck.

A Tennessee judge sentenced Christopher Drone Bassett to life plus 35 years for the 2015 death of 15-year-old Zaevion Dobson, who shielded friends from gunfire. Richard Gregory Williams III received 143 years and Kipling Deshawn Colbert 109 years. Their totals include sentences for other charges.

The passage tests a long-only strategy for the BOTZ robotics and AI ETF using short-term Donchian Channels and an exponential moving average (EMA) to filter signals. In daily backtests beginning in September 2016, several Donchian settings were profitable on paper, and adding an EMA generally improved results.
