Goldman Sachs expects increased mining spending to support the company, while potential infrastructure spending and improving economic conditions could also help. However, the article says much of that optimism is reflected in the share price. Caterpillar’s revenue, earnings and excess cash flow declined in 2016, and the company forecasts further revenue and adjusted earnings declines this year. The author urges investor caution, citing those pressures, the stock’s valuation and uncertainty over US infrastructure legislation.

Global stocks slipped Monday as the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield neared 3 percent, raising investor concerns, while falling commodity prices weighed on materials shares. Aluminum dropped after the United States suggested it might ease sanctions on Russia’s Rusal. The stronger dollar added pressure on commodities. European stocks rose, U.S. stocks were little changed, and oil recovered from earlier losses. Investors also awaited earnings from more than 180 S&P 500 companies this week.

Tesla’s April 20, 2022 Form 8-K reports that it posted its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2022. The First Quarter 2022 Update is attached as Exhibit 99.1; the filing provides no financial figures.

The passage introduces mechanical, packaging, and ordering information for TI devices and notes that it may change without notice. It explains product status, preproduction parts, RoHS values, lead finishes, moisture sensitivity ratings, and part markings. TI says some information relies on third parties and limits its liability. Its technical resources are provided “as is” for skilled developers, who are responsible for selecting products and validating their applications.

EchoingECG is a probabilistic framework for learning cardiac information from ECGs using paired ECHO data and text. It uses PCME++ to model uncertainty and accommodate the many-to-many relationships between ECG segments and ECHO frames or reports. ECHO-CLIP serves as a teacher to transfer ECHO-based information to ECG representations, reducing reliance on large annotated datasets. The authors report that this approach supports uncertainty-aware evaluation of downstream tasks.

Chris King, 57, attended his first Leeds Rhinos match at Headingley after receiving a pioneering double hand transplant following a workplace accident. Applauded at half-time, he drew the winning golden gamble ticket and said he enjoyed the Rhinos’ 42-22 victory over Widnes Vikings.

Henry L. Stimson advised against raising territorial adjustments or trusteeships until the war had progressed further and Russia had entered the Pacific war. He warned that excluding Pacific areas of interest from discussion would create distrust, and said meaningful trusteeship talks required fuller knowledge of the territories involved. The passage also cites the Cairo Declaration’s statement that Japan would lose Pacific islands it had seized since 1914.

At a January 1945 meeting with representatives of American republics, Under Secretary Grew discussed the planned Mexico City conference, strengthening the inter-American system, and comments on the Dumbarton Oaks proposals. He argued that preserving peace might require the use of force.

The U.S. Patent and Trademark Office rejected Crocs’ design patent because another company filed a similar patent earlier, ending its five-year lawsuit against USA Dawgs. Crocs plans to appeal amid store closures and declining revenue.

The Shippers Group celebrated the opening of a 540,000-square-foot distribution facility in Austell on September 15. It offers warehousing, transportation, packaging and e-commerce fulfillment, bringing the company’s total warehouse space in Georgia to 1.5 million square feet.

A pilot study tested a streamlined workflow for analyzing optical genome mapping (OGM) data with VIA software in 10 myeloid malignancy cases. OGM detected every variant reported by standard-of-care testing and identified additional reportable findings in five of the six positive cases. Reviewers unanimously reported and classified the five guideline-defined sentinel variants as Tier 1A, although decisions on other variants varied. Technologist review averaged 25.2 minutes for negative cases, 28.5 minutes for simple cases, and 47.3 minutes for complex cases.

A community has backed St. Patrick’s Catholic Primary School headteacher Mark Ryan after a report wrongly claimed he took a two-week term-time holiday abroad and had warned a parent she could be fined for a family holiday. Ryan said governors approved three days’ leave to attend a close family friend’s wedding as an exceptional circumstance under school policy. He said the inaccurate report distressed his family and the school. Governors, staff, parents and the parish priest expressed their support.

The Mets are overhauling their coaching staff after missing the playoffs despite an expensive roster. Manager Carlos Mendoza will return, but pitching coach Jeremy Hefner, three other coaches, and departing bench and catching coaches will not. Pitching and defense were major problems as the team went 38-55 over its final 93 games.

This bibliometric study examines digital accessibility in education using Web of Science, Scopus and ERIC records from 2013–2024. Publications on digital accessibility rose from 12 in 2013 to 502 in 2024; education-related publications rose from 4 to 339. Scopus contains most records. Journal articles predominate, English is the main publication language, and higher education receives the most attention. The United States, United Kingdom and Spain contribute the most publications. Citation patterns are uneven, with limited connections among many authors, documents and countries. The study calls for more collaboration and research on accessibility across educational levels, including computer literacy and support for students with disabilities.

Apple remains the most valuable public company and has neared a $1 trillion market value, but Amazon is closing the gap. Amazon’s share value rose $260 billion in 2018, narrowing Apple’s lead to about 10 percent.

World stocks and U.S. equities fell Tuesday after the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield crossed 3 percent for the first time since January 2014. Strong earnings from Verizon and Caterpillar were offset by higher yields and a drop in Alphabet shares. Brent crude briefly rose above $75 a barrel, supported by production cuts, strong demand and the prospect of renewed U.S. sanctions on Iran.

Yale Hirsch’s Best 6 Months Timing Model is an active strategy that enters and exits markets on signals rather than staying invested continuously. The passage describes a backtest using a diversified portfolio of stocks, bonds, REITs and commodities. Over the tested period, the strategy’s maximum drawdown was 27.27%, compared with 47.77% for buy and hold. Hirsch founded the Hirsch Organization and created the Stock Trader’s Almanac, which presented research on seasonal market patterns.

Home Capital Group is seeking a roughly $2 billion bank loan to replace an expensive emergency credit line. It has approached Canada’s six largest banks, though not all are expected to participate. Depositors have withdrawn 95 per cent of funds from its high-interest savings accounts since March 27. Withdrawals accelerated after securities regulators accused the company of misleading investors, allegations it disputes, but have slowed since mid-May.

Social influencers are credible social media users with large followings who may help pizzerias reach people despite Facebook’s reduced feed visibility. Potential local influencers include food bloggers and critics, pizza enthusiasts, community leaders, and local media personalities or entertainers.

The paper argues that luck egalitarianism explains why educational disparities caused by circumstances beyond a child’s control are unfair, but pursuing fairness alone can leave people without support after poor choices or stigmatize those receiving help. It proposes adding fresh starts, sufficient educational resources, and respect. Future empirical research should examine opportunities to resume education, whether children meet basic educational needs, and how classroom practices may cause humiliation.

The speaker argues that the United States needs stronger military power to deter threats and preserve peace without surrendering freedom. He criticizes the Carter administration for allowing American strength to decline while, he claims, Soviet influence and military spending grow. He describes the Vietnam War as a noble cause, urges respect for its veterans, and argues that future wars should be fought with the means and determination to win. He points to the period after World War II as an example of military strength supporting peace.

The liquidating trustee sued to recover alleged fraudulent conveyances under SIBC’s confirmed reorganization plan. Defendants sought dismissal, arguing that the trustee lacked standing and that any recovery would not benefit creditors equally. The bankruptcy court denied the motion. It held that the plan authorized the trustee to enforce these claims under § 1123(b), and that recoveries could benefit impaired unsecured creditors by increasing the value of their ownership rights in SIBC’s successor and potentially improving distributions to holders of Contingent Interest Certificates.

The Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 9-5 in Game 1 of their NL Division Series. Justin Turner homered and tied a Dodgers postseason record with five RBIs. Clayton Kershaw earned his first playoff win at Dodger Stadium despite allowing four solo home runs. Arizona starter Taijuan Walker lasted one inning. Rich Hill and Robbie Ray are scheduled to start Game 2.

The IMF urged China to put financial stability ahead of growth targets, warning that rapid credit growth and expanding wealth management products pose risks. It recommended stronger coordination among regulators, a financial stability sub-committee, and more resources for banking supervision. In a severely adverse scenario, its tests found that 33 banks could face a capital shortfall equal to 2.5 percent of GDP. China’s central bank said the tests did not reflect the whole picture.

In *Hardin v. White*, the court held that an injunction bond need not equal twice the judgment when the injunction seeks only to stop the sale of specific property, rather than collection of the judgment. It also held that a creditor who sold real estate under an execution for part of a debt could not sell the debtor’s right of redemption to collect the remainder of that same debt. On rehearing, the court found that the use of a decree from a different action did not change the result and affirmed the judgment.

Chrissy Teigen discussed her anxiety and postpartum depression, both diagnosed shortly after her daughter Luna was born. She said she experienced postpartum depression for four months and now takes an antidepressant. Despite ongoing bad days, she does not want the condition to stop her from expanding her family.

Islamic banking is growing rapidly, with the passage reporting annual growth of 19.7 percent and $3trn in capital. Sharia-compliant services are expanding globally, including in non-Muslim-majority countries. Many Islamic banks are investing in digital banking to meet customer demand. The 2017 World Finance Islamic Finance Awards recognize institutions for innovation and adaptability.

The young writer fears violence against innocent people and is especially concerned about bullying at school and online. Students may be afraid to report it, while some adults dismiss it. The writer urges people to address bullying at home and school, treat others kindly, and make the world better for future generations.

An email circulated articles on California’s energy crisis. Federal regulators told power suppliers to justify February prices or face $55 million in potential refunds, drawing criticism that the action was too limited. Unpaid creditors threatened to force Southern California Edison into bankruptcy, while the state’s Department of Water Resources struggled with costly power purchases. Other articles covered changes to rolling-blackout exemptions, relaxed emissions limits for a San Diego power plant, groups invoking the crisis to challenge state rules, and calls for increased U.S. oil production after an OPEC output cut.

The author returned to school part-time in their 40s to study journalism, unsure of their career goal but open to new opportunities. Learning digital skills, earning good grades, and joining campus activities helped them rediscover a love of studying and heal from the effects of earlier bullying. After graduating, they accepted an opportunity to study digital storytelling in graduate school and work as a research assistant.

The coach credited the players’ preparation, determination and leadership for an inspired win, calling it the team’s best game of the series so far. He praised Sid’s drive and example, Jake’s poise and hockey sense, Matt Murray’s timely saves, and Hornqvist’s physical play and net-front presence. He said the team has improved with each game, values its home support and expects rest between games to benefit both teams. Its focus now is on preparing for the next game.

Sickle cell disease (SCD) is an inherited, lifelong disorder that produces abnormal, sickle-shaped red blood cells. These cells do not last as long as normal cells and can block blood vessels, reducing blood flow and causing problems throughout the body. SCD affects people of all backgrounds; about 100,000 people in the United States have it.

Symptoms and complications include sudden episodes of severe pain, anemia, infections, stroke and acute chest syndrome. Smoking increases the risk of pain episodes and acute chest syndrome. A blood test can diagnose SCD, often through newborn screening in the United States.

Care focuses on preventing complications through regular checkups, screening, vaccinations and, for young children, antibiotics. Pain treatments, medications that increase fetal hemoglobin, and blood transfusions may also be used. Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation is the only permanent treatment described, but it carries risks and is usually reserved for severe cases. Lifestyle measures include avoiding tobacco smoke, eating a balanced diet, resting and exercising regularly.

AppLovin shares fell sharply after Bloomberg reported that the SEC is investigating the mobile advertising company’s data-collection practices and whether it violated agreements governing targeted ads. The reported probe follows a whistleblower complaint and short-seller reports. AppLovin’s stock had risen about 80% this year after gaining more than 700% in 2024.

Coach Quenneville called the series against Boston fast-paced and hard-fought. He said Toews’ availability for the next game remained uncertain because of an upper-body injury. He praised Corey’s steadiness, Kane’s offensive skill and the chemistry of Kane’s line with Bickell and Toews. Quenneville emphasized balanced scoring, forechecking, speed and better face-offs, while cautioning against giving up quality chances. He hoped the team could use its return home to sustain its momentum.
Thousands of cases of Budget $aver Cherry Pineapple Monster Pops and Sugar Free Twin Pops were recalled over possible Listeria contamination. The ice pops were distributed in 15 states.

University of Exeter researchers say the Fal oyster fishery’s sail-driven boats and hand-hauled dredges help prevent overfishing by limiting how much can be caught. They estimate motorising the fleet would increase fishing activity nine-fold. Although oyster stocks have declined, the researchers identify disease and motorised fishing as the biggest threats to the fishery’s survival.

A Gallup poll found 44 percent of Americans believed Donald Trump could prevent major scandals, compared with 74 percent for incoming President Obama and 77 percent for George W. Bush. Trump drew less confidence than recent incoming presidents across every surveyed duty.

FOX 17 News seeks a meteorologist and multimedia journalist in West Michigan to deliver forecasts, cover breaking news, create stories for broadcast and digital platforms, and engage with local communities. Applicants need at least two years of weather forecasting, reporting or multimedia journalism experience in a commercial TV newsroom, plus strong production and social media skills. Apply online through Tribune Media with a demo reel link and proof of digital journalism skills.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 30, 2017 reports net sales of $88.3 billion, up 13% from a year earlier, and net income of $20.1 billion, up from $17.9 billion. Diluted earnings per share rose to $3.89 from $3.36. Sales increased in every geographic segment, led by iPhone, Services and Other Products; iPhone unit sales fell 1%. Apple generated $28.3 billion in operating cash flow, repurchased $10.1 billion of stock and paid $3.3 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. Its $7.0 billion income-tax provision included a $2.6 billion provisional estimate related to changes in U.S. tax law.

The passage argues that stocks are the most suitable asset class for building wealth, citing a study in which they substantially outperformed bonds, bills, and gold from 1801 to 2021. It proposes building a diversified stock-ETF portfolio and evaluating it through backtesting. The author notes that stocks can suffer large drawdowns, which may prompt investors to sell, but distinguishes temporary declines from permanent losses. The excerpt does not provide the proposed portfolio’s weights or backtest results.

The team missed several chances despite creating pressure late in the game and overtime. The opponent scored on an overtime opportunity. The loss was painful, but the speaker called it a learning experience and said the season’s challenges brought the group closer.

On October 22, 2001, Enron shares fell 21% to $20.65 after the SEC requested information about transactions involving partnerships run by CFO Andrew Fastow. Enron pledged cooperation and said its board had approved the arrangements. Shareholders filed lawsuits alleging conflicts of interest and financial losses. Broader U.S. stocks rose on better-than-expected earnings, while UniPrime announced a letter of intent involving an Enron-owned wind park lease.

Heikin Ashi is a Japanese charting technique that smooths price movements to highlight trends and consolidation. Its candles use calculated values rather than actual trading prices, so their plotted prices cannot be traded directly, and their signals lag. The passage tests a monthly S&P 500 strategy that buys when the Heikin Ashi close crosses above its open and sells on the reverse cross; it reports a 49.4% win ratio. A separate strategy using an ADX filter reports 5.27% annual growth with 5% market exposure. The passage concludes that Heikin Ashi works mostly on longer time frames.

World stocks rose toward record highs on Monday as strong U.S. employment and Chinese trade data supported optimism about global growth. Equity volatility neared a record low, while bitcoin futures debuted at a premium to the cryptocurrency’s price. Currency and bond markets were cautious ahead of central bank meetings; the Federal Reserve was expected to raise rates, while the Bank of England and European Central Bank were expected to hold steady. Oil prices slipped amid signs of increased U.S. drilling.
Fabinho reiterated his desire to leave Monaco after their win over Dijon, despite vice-president Vadim Vasilyev saying he and Thomas Lemar would not be sold this transfer window.

FHA lenders review both spouses’ credit and count both spouses’ debts when qualifying a married applicant, even if only one spouse is on the loan. This applies to purchases and refinances and can reduce borrowing power. The requirement does not apply to single or engaged applicants. The passage suggests considering a conventional loan if a spouse’s debt makes FHA qualification difficult.

The article says gold rallied as the US dollar fell, but mining stocks and silver showed little response. Its author views miners’ weakness, a potential dollar rebound and recent stock-market declines as bearish signals, drawing a comparison with 2008. The page also includes market headlines, investment promotions, reader comments and trading-risk disclosures.

Trinidad and Tobago won their first men’s 4x400 metres relay world title in London, ending the United States’ run of six successive titles. Lalonde Gordon passed Fred Kerley on the final straight as Trinidad finished in 2:58.12, the year’s fastest time. The U.S. took silver and Britain bronze.

A 16-year-old in Waterloo, Iowa, asked a salon to shave her severely matted hair after depression had left her unable to brush it. Student hairdresser Kayley Olson instead spent 13 hours over two days untangling and restyling it. The teenager said the result made her feel like herself again and that she would smile for her school portrait.

In a resurfaced 2013 video, Allison Mack says she wants to be remembered for her joy and praises JNess, a NXIVM-affiliated women’s group. Mack was arrested in April on sex-trafficking and forced-labor charges, weeks after NXIVM founder Keith Raniere was arrested on sex-trafficking charges.

A forwarded collection of October 22, 2001 news reports says Enron shares fell about 21% after the SEC requested information on transactions involving partnerships run by CFO Andrew Fastow. Enron pledged to cooperate and said its board had approved the arrangements. Shareholders filed lawsuits alleging conflicts of interest, fiduciary breaches and securities fraud. The reports also describe Enron’s recent quarterly loss and a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity tied to unwinding partnership transactions. Separately, U.S. stocks rose on better-than-expected earnings news, and UniPrime announced a letter of intent involving a wind-park lease owned by an Enron subsidiary.

The Side Screen is a continuous on-ball screening offense designed to create drives, shots, passes to cutters, and opportunities for spot-up shooters. It can begin with a dribble to the wing or a pass followed by a clearing cut. Ball reversal and back cuts sustain the action. Against defenses that show and recover, switch, or trap, the offense uses screener rolls, mismatches, or passes through the high post.

Kieran Trippier called England’s penalty shootout victory over Colombia “the best feeling of my career.” After a 1-1 draw, he converted England’s fourth penalty, Jordan Pickford saved Carlos Bacca’s attempt, and Eric Dier scored the winner. Trippier praised the team’s spirit, while Dele Alli said his thigh condition was “all good.”

The lectures address nuclear arms control and nonproliferation, beginning with India and Pakistan. Vipin Narang explains deterrence and argues that nuclear weapons have constrained India’s conventional responses to attacks it attributes to Pakistan-based militant groups. He traces India’s program partly to its conflict with China and Pakistan’s program to its 1971 defeat by India. After both countries tested nuclear weapons in 1998, India adopted a policy of no first use and assured retaliation, while Pakistan threatened early nuclear use to deter India’s superior conventional forces.

Narang discusses the 1999 Kargil War, the 2001 attack on India’s parliament, and the 2008 Bombay attacks as crises in which escalation was a concern. He concludes that militant attacks, active arms development, and the possibility of nuclear escalation make the relationship unstable, while political obstacles have hindered a settlement.

A study of 195 Ugandan health facilities found that smaller, rural and for-profit providers struggle to sustain HIV treatment despite support for medicines, equipment and training. Major barriers include staff shortages, donor reporting requirements and unreliable antiretroviral supplies. Funding tends to favour larger hospitals, which patients may also prefer for their wider services. The author suggests mentoring smaller facilities, government agreements with for-profit providers, targeted salary support and greater government funding to reduce dependence on donors.

The socket cover latches the lever closed, and support tabs cradle it. Lever actuation force must be below 3.6 kgf, pin displacement below 1.0 mm, and the socket must retain electrical and mechanical integrity after 50 actuation and de-actuation cycles. The passage sets visual requirements for solder balls, contacts, the cover, base, and lever. Each contact must carry 1.5 A with less than a 30°C temperature rise; initial and final circuit resistance must not exceed 25 mΩ per contact. It also specifies limits for inductance, capacitance, impedance, propagation-delay skew, dielectric withstanding voltage, and insulation resistance.

AIRSS generates chemically informed random structures. MINSEP sets minimum atomic separations and TARGVOL sets target volume; two-stage optimization removes overlaps, then adjusts lattice and atomic positions.

Corn futures are CME-traded contracts to deliver corn at a pre-agreed price and date. Full contracts cover 5,000 bushels and mini contracts 1,000; settlement is by physical delivery, though speculators can close or roll positions before expiry. Prices are affected by weather, crop and supply reports, and demand from China. The passage describes seasonal trading backtests with mixed results, including one with a 70% maximum drawdown. Leverage can magnify losses. Corn CFDs offer price exposure without delivery, but are agreements with brokers rather than exchange-traded futures contracts.

The Supreme Court will hear arguments on Oct. 6 over whether Delaware’s affidavit-of-merit requirement for medical malpractice claims applies in federal court. Lower courts dismissed Harold Berk’s claim because he lacked an affidavit from a medical professional. Berk argues that federal procedural rules set the requirements for bringing his case; the doctor and hospital argue that Delaware’s statute does not conflict with those rules. Civil procedure professors contend that applying such statutes would disrupt federal court procedures. The decision could affect malpractice claims brought in federal courts.

The President informs Congress that South Carolina has declared federal import duties null and void within the state, enacted measures to prevent their collection after February 1, and prepared military forces. Its ordinance threatens withdrawal from the Union if the federal government uses force to enforce the laws. He argues that South Carolina cannot set aside federal law unilaterally and has not exhausted constitutional means of redress. While supporting consideration of changes to revenue policy, he asks Congress to strengthen customs enforcement, protect federal officers and citizens through federal courts, and authorize force if necessary to execute the laws.

The speaker said the opponent’s skilled puck movement made its power play effective and that special teams were the difference. Their team carried play at times, especially late in the second period, but the opponent regained momentum. The speaker questioned a late call, said players needed better positioning and more caution about penalties, and called for a strong effort Thursday.

A study of the Karius Test evaluated 19,739 plasma samples from 16,172 hospitalized patients. The test, which sequences microbial cell-free DNA, produced valid results for 96% of samples, with a median reporting time of 26 hours after laboratory receipt. Of 18,690 analyzed reports, 58% identified at least one microbe, comprising 701 distinct taxa across bacteria, fungi, viruses, and parasites. The authors highlight its ability to detect uncommon pathogens, but note that missing comparison-test and clinical-outcome data prevent conclusions about its impact on patient care. They call for further studies and diagnostic stewardship to guide its use.

This pilot study tested whether a convolutional neural network could distinguish benign from malignant thyroid nodules in ultrasound images. Using a small, imbalanced public dataset, the researchers combined pre-trained VGG-16 and Inception v3 models and used image augmentation and class weighting during training. The model achieved 87.5% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve of 0.929. The authors identify the dataset’s size and imbalance as limitations and suggest that a larger dataset could improve the model. The preprint has not been peer reviewed.

Coach Julien said the Bruins battled back to force overtime but lost after an average performance marked by poor decisions, puck movement and defensive coverage. He credited Chicago’s play and said Boston must refocus and improve in the next game rather than dwell on results. He praised Patrice Bergeron’s two-way play, discussed Jagr’s contributions and work habits, and emphasized players’ adaptability and commitment to their roles.

India’s opposition Congress party elected Rahul Gandhi unopposed as its president, succeeding his mother Sonia ahead of the 2019 national election. Congress hopes state elections will help revive the party after its heavy 2014 defeat by Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s party. A November survey found Modi remained far more popular than Gandhi.

NVIDIA reported $2.22 billion in revenue for the quarter ended April 28, 2019, down 31% year over year. Net income fell 68% to $394 million, or $0.64 per diluted share. Gaming and data center revenue declined, and the prior-year quarter included $289 million in cryptocurrency mining processor revenue. Gross margin fell to 58.4%, while operating expenses rose 21% to $938 million. NVIDIA held $7.80 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at quarter-end and paid $97 million in dividends. It also agreed to acquire Mellanox for approximately $6.9 billion, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

The passage says the relationship between interest rates and stocks is not consistently inverse and has become more positive since the 2000s. In its S&P 500 backtest, holding stocks when rates were falling produced much better returns than holding them when rates were rising, though the falling-rate strategy performed better before the 1990s than in the 2000s and 2010s. The index data excluded dividends.

A 2016 Hiscox survey of small businesses found U.S. entrepreneurs were motivated more by flexible hours, control and remote work than by money. Most U.S. respondents reported revenue, profit and customer growth, and 23 percent planned to hire. Challenges included harder access to bank funding, limited succession planning and concerns about government policy and political instability. Oregon offers loan and guarantee programs for small businesses, while Bend and the state reported strong job growth. The passage characterizes U.S. entrepreneurship as cautiously optimistic.

IFC Films promoted Mark Boxer to executive vice president of sales and distribution and Lauren Schwartz to senior vice president of publicity and promotions. Boxer oversees distribution, while Schwartz develops promotional campaigns.

The Apple Watch Series 3 with LTE has strengthened Apple’s wearable-market lead despite limited availability. Pre-orders open May 4 in Denmark, Sweden and India, with deliveries a week later. Three will support it in Denmark and Sweden; Reliance Jio and Airtel will support it in India. Pricing is unannounced.

President Barack Obama said he would deliver a farewell address in Chicago on Jan. 10 to thank supporters and reflect on his eight years in office. Donald Trump, who pledged to undo several Obama policies, will be sworn in on Jan. 20. Obama has sought a smooth transition despite their differences.

The MMA Manifesto’s middleweight rankings place UFC champion Michael Bisping first, followed by Luke Rockhold and Yoel Romero. Chris Weidman and Ronaldo “Jacare” Souza tie for fourth; Gegard Mousasi, Robert Whittaker, Anderson Silva, Vitor Belfort and newcomer Kelvin Gastelum complete the top ten. Belfort and Gastelum are scheduled to fight on March 11. Derek Brunson dropped out. Suspended fighters and those inactive for at least 12 months without a scheduled fight are excluded.

Marquez Charter Elementary reopened on a temporary campus nearly nine months after the Palisades fire, becoming the first public school destroyed in the January fires to bring students back to its site. Its roughly 130 students had been sharing another school’s campus; enrollment has fallen about 58% since the fire. The temporary campus has 19 classrooms, a kitchen, a library and play areas. Marquez’s temporary facilities and permanent rebuild are expected to cost roughly $202.6 million, with completion slated for 2028. District officials cited parent feedback in the decision to reopen, though some parents raised concerns about environmental risks and commutes. Other fire-damaged schools remain displaced, and Pasadena Unified has no timeline for rebuilding its affected campuses.

Open education aims to make learning more accessible and affordable through resources and practices such as OER, MOOCs, open textbooks, and open-access journals. This study analyzed 402 English-language publications from Web of Science using co-citation and co-word analyses. It identified research themes concerning the evolution of open education, OER, adoption, MOOCs, and the implementation of open educational practices. Emerging topics include blended learning, pandemic-era openness, inclusive digital pedagogy, and online collaboration. The passage highlights potential benefits in cost, access, and flexible learning, alongside barriers including unequal internet access, faculty resistance, and limited institutional support. The study’s limitations include its reliance on one database, subjective cluster interpretation, and limited accounting for regional and institutional differences.

The OHL strategy uses a session’s opening price and its high and low in the first few minutes to guide intraday stock trades. An open equal to the low signals a potential buy; an open equal to the high signals a potential sell. It is typically used on short timeframes, sometimes with central pivot range levels. The passage’s S&P 500 and crude oil backtests suggest early price movement has some predictive value, but the results do not establish a tradable strategy.

First-principles defect calculations are computationally expensive, while graph-based machine-learning force fields can struggle with large supercells and non-local interactions. The passage introduces ADAPT, a graph-free Transformer that uses atomic coordinates and features to predict forces and energies for silicon defects. It reports state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming pretrained models and a model retrained on the same data, with training costs two orders of magnitude lower than message-passing architectures.

Nearly 88 per cent of 33 Irish listed companies met or beat earnings expectations, with average earnings per share growth of 8 per cent despite sterling’s decline. Aryzta, Ryanair, Tullow Oil and IFG Group missed forecasts. The Iseq reached a 15-month high but underperformed other European markets amid Brexit concerns. Irish Continental Group led major stocks’ gains, while Aryzta fell the most.

Owen Sound Foodland is among 87 Ontario grocery stores authorized to begin selling beer and cider in April, bringing the provincial total to 370. Its new 34,000-square-foot store is tentatively set to open March 22, with expanded food and delivery services. Staffing is expected to rise from 100 to about 160 employees.

The Tigers have used a closer-by-committee approach, and Powell suggests they pursue Suarez if he opts out this offseason. Suarez recorded a 2.97 ERA, 75 strikeouts and 40 saves in 70 appearances this season.

The passage introduces a neural solver for partial differential equations on complex, multi-patch CAD geometries. It combines physics-informed neural networks with isogeometric analysis, using NURBS maps to transfer solutions from reference domains to physical patches. Patch-specific and interface ansatz functions are designed to maintain solution continuity and strongly impose Dirichlet boundary conditions; working on reference domains also normalizes network inputs. Training minimizes a discretized energy functional. The proposed applications are a 2D quadrupole-magnet model and a 3D mechanical-holder model.

This study surveyed 2,371 parents in Turkey about compulsory K–12 distance education during the COVID-19 pandemic. Of 2,304 parents who described their overall view, 57.7% were positive, citing continued learning and health protection, while 42.3% were negative, citing inadequate instruction and technical difficulties. Most did not consider distance education a replacement for face-to-face schooling. Parents reported difficulties with student adaptation, discipline, internet access and devices; they also valued opportunities to review lessons. Their suggestions included exams, richer content, longer lessons and continued use of distance education to support classroom teaching. The study recommends improving infrastructure, access and digital literacy to reduce inequality.
The speaker saw growth but remembers the loss. They credit the opposing team’s toughness, discipline and shared responsibility, and reflect on a missed chance that might have changed the outcome.

Manchester United manager Jose Mourinho urged Marouane Fellaini to sign a new contract amid a stand-off over his future. Fellaini faces another spell out with a knee injury and will miss the Huddersfield match. Further tests will determine whether he can play against Sevilla.

The November 2, 2000 Haas alumni jobs bulletin lists 17 sets of openings in marketing, finance, business development, technology and operations, with locations, qualifications, job descriptions and application contacts. It also announces upcoming Haas events, offers career-advising and subscription information, and notes that the school has not researched the listed employers or search firms.

The Executive Yuan plans to close the nearly century-old Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission by year’s end, transferring most of its functions and staff to the Ministry of Culture and six employees to the Mainland Affairs Council. Its services will continue under other agencies, and the government plans to seek repeal of the law authorizing it. Lawmakers differed over the proposal: one opposed transferring functions to the council, while others raised concerns about cross-strait relations or urged swift legal abolition.

Renewable energy output fluctuates, complicating grid operations and requiring backup power. Using turbulence theory and wind-plant data, Prof. Mahesh Bandi explained why wind-power fluctuations follow the same statistical pattern as wind-speed fluctuations despite being measured differently. He found that geographically dispersed wind plants can offset short-timescale fluctuations, but shared long-timescale wind patterns cause their output to rise or fall together. Data from Texas and Ireland supported this limit on “geographic smoothing.” The finding could improve estimates of backup-power needs and inform regional energy planning.

Oxygen-containing rare-earth hydride films show color-neutral photochromism and are potential smart-window materials. In yttrium oxyhydride films, illumination caused rapid photodarkening during the first 2–3 minutes, followed by slower darkening. A two-phase exponential model fit the transmittance data better than a single-phase model. Electron energy loss spectra suggested more free or mobile hydrogen in photochromic films than in opaque films. The authors associate the fast process with possible local structural changes and the slow process with hydrogen migration or diffusion, while noting that the processes’ exact origins remain unresolved.
Tesla filed a Form 8-K on January 26, 2022, announcing that it had posted its fourth-quarter and full-year 2021 financial results on its website. The update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

Merger arbitrage seeks to profit from the gap between a takeover target’s share price and the acquisition offer. It requires assessing whether a deal will close and monitoring risks such as regulatory challenges, financing problems and market conditions. The IQ Merger Arbitrage ETF and The Merger Fund had lower returns than the S&P 500 over the periods cited, but also substantially lower volatility. In a study of 835 deals from 2000 to 2020, 89% closed, and the blended average return on long exposure was 1.5% per deal. The passage concludes that the strategy can offer returns less tied to the broader market, but is difficult to execute through deal-by-deal analysis.

U.S. investor Paul Kazarian praised Portugal’s and Greece’s Socialist governments for improving their finances after the debt crisis. His firm, Japonica Partners, is a major holder of Greek bonds and has opened a Lisbon office to explore investments in Portugal’s real estate and technology sectors. Kazarian sees opportunities to help Portuguese businesses expand globally and said the office will also consider investments elsewhere in Europe.

The federal government shut down Wednesday after Congress failed to pass a funding extension. Most school programs should continue in the short term, including Title I and special education funding, but some districts could face cash-flow problems. A prolonged shutdown could disrupt Head Start and nutrition programs. Civil rights investigations and work on regulations and guidance at the Education Department will pause, and some charter school openings could be delayed. The Trump administration has also directed agencies to consider additional mass layoffs.

Chicago wheat rose 0.9% to $4.54-3/4 a bushel on Tuesday after its biggest three-day decline since 2013. Rain and snow brought moisture to drought-hit winter wheat areas in the southern U.S. Plains, though Kansas and Texas crop ratings declined. Corn and soybeans edged higher after recent losses; some analysts cited rain in Argentina’s crop areas as pressure on corn. Most of Ukraine’s winter grain crops were reported in good or satisfactory condition.

Arkansas Gov. Asa Hutchinson’s son, William Asa Hutchinson III, was arrested on charges of driving while intoxicated, speeding and violating implied consent. He was released on $1,626 bond and has court hearings scheduled for Wednesday and July 19. A previous DWI conviction was dismissed over citation errors.

The study examined commercial nickel-rich NMC/graphite coin cells cycled at 1C, 2C and 3C using electrochemical testing, XRD, SEM, EDS and lithium nuclear reaction analysis (Li-NRA). After 278 cycles, capacity fell from about 200 mAh to about 42 mAh, with the greatest decline during 3C cycling. The cycled cathode showed structural and surface changes, while the graphite anode showed roughening, cracks and signs of lithium accumulation. Li-NRA measured a bulk lithium loss of 1.86 × 10²² atoms/cm³ in the cathode and a gain of 1.38 × 10²² atoms/cm³ in the anode, demonstrating its use for depth-resolved lithium quantification.

The Education Department will convene committees to rewrite two Obama-era rules on student loan forgiveness for college misconduct and graduates’ ability to repay loans. Education Secretary Betsy DeVos called the rules confusing and unfair, but said nearly 16,000 pending borrower-defense claims would be fulfilled. Eight states and the District of Columbia sought to preserve the rules in court. Consumer advocates warned that revisions could weaken protections for students, while an industry group supported the move.

The University of Calgary Chess Club will host the annual Battle of Alberta tournament Feb. 18–19, with 30–40 players expected. The event follows World Chess Federation rules and is open to students, independent players and non-students. Registration costs $10 for university students and $15 for non-students.

The Panthers agreed to a five-year, $80 million deal with defensive tackle Kawann Short, ending a year-long negotiation. The extension and additions of veterans including Julius Peppers reflect Carolina’s focus on winning now. Questions remain on offense as Cam Newton recovers from shoulder surgery and the team makes changes at receiver and tackle. With the No. 8 draft pick, the passage argues the Panthers should add a playmaker to help Newton, naming Leonard Fournette, Christian McCaffrey and O.J. Howard as options.

T-bills traded slightly higher amid strong liquidity from a N300bn bond maturity. The CBN’s N49.60bn auction was oversubscribed, while OBB and OVN rates fell. The interbank exchange rate held steady, but the I&E rate depreciated and reserves declined. Sovereign bonds weakened, particularly the 2047s. An OMO auction was expected.

The passage describes systems built around a cache-coherent switch on chip that uses Compute Express Link (CXL) to share memory, accelerators, storage, and other resources within and between servers. The switch can route data and maintain cache coherency while reducing processor involvement. Described embodiments also cover resource allocation, memory pooling and prefetching, CXL-to-Ethernet communication, compression, security, erasure coding, and related packet formats.

Sugar futures trade on ICE and CME, with contracts representing 112,000 pounds of sugar. ICE contracts settle by physical delivery, while CME contracts settle in cash. Traders use futures to speculate, diversify or hedge; sugar CFDs offer another way to trade price movements. Sugar prices are affected by crops and inventories, weather, government policies, ethanol demand and oil prices. The passage describes an ATR channel breakout strategy whose backtest was positive but inconsistent, and says the authors do not currently trade a sugar strategy. Leverage can magnify losses. The cited all-time high for ICE sugar futures was 66.00 US cents per pound in November 1974, and the low was 2.63 cents in June 1985.

Prime Day discounts make the 13-inch M4 MacBook Air, at $800, the article’s best MacBook deal. The older M1 Air is $600, though a new entry-level model may replace it. MacBook Pro discounts are smaller, around 10 percent, and buyers seeking maximum performance may prefer to wait for the M5 models, whose release timing remains uncertain.

In a November 27, 1806 proclamation, President Thomas Jefferson warned that people were preparing an unlawful military expedition against Spanish dominions. He ordered participants to stop, directed officials to investigate, seize supplies, and prosecute offenders, and called on citizens to assist the authorities.

The Supreme Court appeared inclined to give police more leeway to enter homes without a warrant when they reasonably believe someone needs emergency help. The case arose after Montana officers entered William Case’s home following reports that he had threatened suicide and shot him. Justices questioned Case’s proposed probable-cause requirement but disagreed on whether to apply an “objectively reasonable” standard themselves or return the case to state court. A decision is expected by late June or early July.
Kano Pillars drew 1-1 with Niger Tornadoes in a rescheduled league match in Kano. Andrew Ikefe scored in the 19th minute before Junior Lokosa equalised from a penalty in the 81st.

Microsoft reported revenue of $33.1 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2019, up 14% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 27% to $12.7 billion, and net income rose 21% to $10.7 billion. Diluted earnings per share were $1.38, compared with $1.14. Revenue increased across all three segments, led by Intelligent Cloud. Commercial cloud revenue grew 36% to $11.6 billion. Microsoft ended the quarter with $136.6 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments, and approved a new $40 billion share repurchase program.

Market structure trading analyzes price movements through swing highs and lows, support and resistance, and trendlines. It distinguishes trending, ranging, and consolidating markets to help traders consider entries and exits. The passage describes breakout and pullback trading, alongside candlesticks, volume, Fibonacci retracements, multiple time frames, and harmonic patterns as analytical tools. Risk management includes stop-loss orders and adjusting position sizes to market conditions. It notes that some techniques are difficult to backtest and recommends testing strategies before relying on them.

DS is adding a 225hp PureTech petrol engine and eight-speed automatic gearbox to its UK DS 7 Crossback range. The engine is said to reduce fuel consumption by 6%, while the gearbox includes an ECO mode. Available on Ultra Prestige, Prestige and PERFORMANCE Line models, it starts at £34,990. The SUV’s launch range also includes another petrol engine and two diesels; a 300hp petrol-electric hybrid is planned.

The President sends Congress dispatches from envoy Mr. Wise describing how American vessels and British intermediaries help Brazilian slave dealers evade laws against the slave trade. Vessels are nominally chartered, carry goods to Africa, and are handed over to crews who transport enslaved people to Brazil, while the organizers often escape punishment. The President urges consideration of stronger measures and Wise’s proposals for cooperation with Britain. He also criticizes Britain’s practice of sending captured Africans to the West Indies as apprentices rather than returning them to Africa, arguing that it may perpetuate the trade.
After her 3-year-old daughter Chloe, who has asthma, was hospitalized with RSV following a Christmas dinner with a sick cousin, Laura urged parents to keep sick children home.

The writer claims that many Hawaiian residents favor annexation to the United States and that the sovereign’s death without an heir could create an opportunity to pursue it peacefully, with U.S. approval. He argues that Hawaii’s location would make it valuable for naval protection and Pacific trade, while warning that another power might seize the islands. He also cites the declining native population, Americans’ economic influence, and the possibility of acquiring sovereignty at limited cost.

On Flag Day, June 14, 2017, developers marked the start of construction to convert Verona’s former Annin Flag factory into Annin Lofts. The plant operated from 1919 to 2013. The project will preserve the historic building, add a neighboring building and create 112 rental apartments. Its architect expected completion within 12 to 14 months. Former employees and Annin’s president described the change as emotional.

The President describes widespread prosperity and peace, crediting Americans’ enterprise and character alongside federal economy and administration. Tax reductions and debt repayment have accompanied rising national income, but a narrow projected surplus leads him to oppose new spending without new revenue.

He reports progress in arbitration and relations with Nicaragua, Chile, Peru, Mexico, and China, and urges support for a treaty renouncing war. He recommends defensive naval replacements without increasing military personnel. For agriculture, he proposes research, cooperative marketing, and a federal farm board to help handle certain surpluses, while opposing subsidies and price fixing. He also discusses improvements in aviation, shipping, transportation, waterways, and public buildings, alongside veterans’ relief, conservation, immigration, education, and public health. He calls for state cooperation in enforcing prohibition and warns that continued prosperity depends on public confidence, sustained effort, and responsible conduct abroad.

The speaker says a glove save on Brett Hull’s rebound from Mike Modano’s shot helped turn the game, after which his team scored twice quickly and took control. He praises Kenny’s hard work and says it was emotional to see him score in the Stanley Cup final. Despite the win, he says the team respects its opponent and expects a fresh start next game.

Sienna Senior Living announced a February 2017 dividend of $0.075 per common share, payable March 15 to shareholders of record on February 28. Shareholders may receive cash or reinvest through its optional plan, which offers shares at a 3% discount.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 26, 2016, reports net sales of $50.6 billion, down 13% from a year earlier, and net income of $10.5 billion, down from $13.6 billion. Lower iPhone sales and weaker foreign currencies were the primary drivers of the sales decline, while Services sales rose 20%. For the first six months of fiscal 2016, Apple generated $39.1 billion in operating cash flow. At quarter-end, it held $232.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. During the quarter, Apple repurchased $7.0 billion of stock, paid approximately $2.9 billion in dividends and issued $15.5 billion in long-term debt.

British discussions with Belgium on renewing a purchase agreement for Congo materials faced two obstacles: higher competing US offers to producers and a lack of coordinated Belgian requests for machinery, steel, and other goods needed to sustain production. Britain sought increased production of several raw materials and a comprehensive Belgian requirements program. To coordinate Congo supplies and UK and US purchases, Britain proposed joint negotiations with the Belgian Minister of Colonies. US and British representatives meeting in Washington unanimously supported that approach.

Nigeria has begun automatically exchanging tax information with foreign countries, including the United Kingdom, on Nigerians’ overseas assets. Finance Minister Kemi Adeosun said authorities are using the data to verify declarations under the Voluntary Assets and Income Declaration Scheme and contact potential tax defaulters. Nigeria has also requested specific information on offshore accounts and trusts. A tax policy committee reported proposed reforms aligned with government plans, aimed at raising revenue, simplifying taxes and supporting small businesses. Its work produced two executive orders and five proposed amendment bills.

Eleven Ursuline High students and six adults plan to visit Nicaragua April 2–8 to help families with food, housing, home visits and house construction. School officials say the trip fosters empathy and cultural understanding.

After employee protests and resignations over its involvement in the Pentagon’s Project Maven, Google said it would develop principles for defense and AI contracts using employee feedback. The New York Times reported that the rules would ban AI in weaponry, with details expected in the coming weeks. Internal emails showed executives worried about a backlash, while employees and AI researchers challenged Google’s involvement. A companywide discussion of Project Maven and ethical AI did little to ease employees’ concerns.

Pharmacist Chukwuma Agubata said his research found that fat from ogbono nuts, formulated as microparticles, improved delivery of the anti-malarial drug artemether. He suggested that eating ogbono soup while taking the drug could improve its efficacy and called for support to develop the research further.

A Nationwide Home Insurance survey found that pet owners spend almost £3,500 in their animal’s first year, with costs varying widely by species. It also highlighted potential extra expenses from pet-related accidents; UK pet insurance claims reached £706 million in 2016.

On 9 December, the Palmerston North Rescue Helicopter transported three patients: a man with a suspected spinal injury, a motorcyclist with a fractured leg, and a boy injured on a trampoline. The service relies on sponsors and donations.

New CFPB rules would require payday and auto title lenders to assess whether borrowers can repay within 30 days and would limit repeated account debits. The bureau found that more than 80 percent of payday loans are rolled over or followed by another loan within two weeks. Consumer advocates support the protections, while an industry group warns they would restrict access to credit. The CFPB estimates loan volume could fall by half and many lenders could close. The rules would not take effect until 2019 and could be rolled back by Congress.

The study examines how two preservice language teachers, Laura and Ricardo, reconstructed their professional identities through internship reports and Moodle discussions collected in 2010–2011. Both described a gap between university coursework and public-school teaching and negotiated tensions between their personal beliefs and professional expectations. Laura developed a flexible approach that prioritised students’ needs and adapted teaching methods to classroom conditions. Ricardo became more confident and reflective but ultimately rejected teaching a foreign language, identifying instead as a mother-language teacher. The study presents teacher identity as changing through experience, reflection and social interaction, and identifies Moodle as a space for sharing emotions and experiences.

A study of two Gulf of Alaska marine heatwaves found that changes in plankton communities disrupted the ocean’s biological carbon pump. During both events, carbon particles accumulated near the surface or in the upper twilight zone instead of reaching the deep sea, though the patterns differed. Researchers combined robotic-float data with ship-based plankton surveys and called for sustained ocean monitoring to better understand heatwaves’ effects on carbon storage and marine ecosystems.

Ariel Miranda pitched seven shutout innings in the Mariners’ 6-1 win over the Marlins, allowing four hits, striking out five and walking none for his first win of the season. He began the season in Seattle’s rotation after Drew Smyly was injured. Miranda credited an aggressive approach, built around his fastball. Robinson Cano broke out of a slump with a first-inning homer, and Nelson Cruz followed with another.

Oil prices fell as progress toward a Gaza ceasefire eased concerns about Middle East supply disruptions. Brent dropped about 1.4% to $65.07 a barrel, while WTI fell to $61.55. Rising U.S. inventories and signs of weaker demand added pressure. Analysts expect production growth and global consumption trends to drive prices unless regional tensions return.

Yen Bai plans to expand raw-material supplies and invest in high-tech processing for its agro-forestry-fishery sector. Despite substantial wood, tea, cinnamon and cassava resources, many wood-processing facilities use low-tech equipment that produces lower-quality goods. The province seeks investment in export furniture, other processing facilities and new markets. It targets 850 billion VND in wood-processing revenue by 2020, doubling by 2025, and plans to build cattle-meat processing facilities.

The lecture describes coherent states as minimum-uncertainty states with Poissonian photon-number statistics. It compares three phase-space representations: Q is always positive, P gives a delta function for a coherent state, and the Wigner distribution gives position and momentum distributions through its projections but can be negative. The professor introduces the second-order correlation function, g2, to characterize photon-number fluctuations. Coherent light has g2 = 1, thermal light has g2 = 2, and a single-photon number state has g2 = 0. Attenuating a coherent beam does not create a single-photon state. The lecture outlines single-photon sources using atoms and cavities, then describes how a Hanbury Brown Twiss setup uses a beam splitter and two detectors to measure photon correlations.

Austria-Hungary’s foreign minister rejected the enemy governments’ response to the allied powers’ proposal for peace negotiations. The note said the response avoided discussing how to end the war and dismissed the proposal as insincere without hearing its terms. It asserted that Austria-Hungary and its allies sought defense rather than conquest, accused their adversaries of territorial ambitions, and disputed their appeals to national rights. The government said the adversaries’ refusal to negotiate left them responsible for the war’s continuation. Austria-Hungary and its allies would continue fighting until they secured a peace protecting their peoples’ existence, honor, and development.

Starbucks shares had been roughly flat since late 2015, partly because U.S. comparable-store sales fell short of their previous 5% growth rate. Mobile Order & Pay contributed to congestion at some stores, though management said sales were rebounding. The passage also points to promotions, dividend growth and expansion in China, where Starbucks was opening about 500 stores annually and reported 7% comparable-store sales growth in the latest quarter.

Researchers developed the Grocery Basket Score (GBS) to assess the nutritional composition of entire shopping baskets rather than individual products. Using self-reported dietary data linked to mortality records for 35,462 U.S. participants, they selected separate food and beverage models whose outputs are combined by calorie share. The score rewards fiber and penalizes sugar, saturated fat, sodium, protein, vitamin C and iron deficiencies, and calorie-dense beverages. It correlated with the Nutri-Score across individual products (0.60) and more strongly with the Alternate Healthy Eating Index than calorie-weighted Nutri-Scores did. Limitations include self-reported intake, development using U.S. data, and failure to capture alcohol’s effects beyond calorie density.

Carolina Panthers quarterback Cam Newton apologized after saying he found it “funny” that female reporter Jourdan Rodrigue asked about routes. The comment drew backlash, and he lost an Oikos Greek Yogurt sponsorship. In a video, Newton called his words degrading and disrespectful, took responsibility and said he had learned a lesson.

Mario Batali stepped away from daily operations at his restaurant group after Eater New York reported sexual misconduct allegations involving at least four women over two decades. Batali said the complaints matched his past behavior and apologized. His company said it reprimanded him and required training after an employee reported inappropriate behavior in October. Batali will also leave ABC’s “The Chew” while the network reviews the allegations, and Food Network has paused plans to revive “Molto Mario.”

The court dismissed eight Oklahoma escheat cases without prejudice. Bill Vassar had brought them as county attorney but left office in January 1939, and his successor was not substituted within the six months required by Federal Rule 25(d). The court held that the rule applied despite the plaintiff’s argument that Vassar was only a nominal party.

The Fifth Circuit reversed the dismissal of the Tates’ Chapter 7 case. It held that the bankruptcy means test permits a vehicle ownership deduction even when a debtor has no car loan or lease payment, and remanded for further proceedings.

Liberty Island was evacuated on July Fourth after a person climbed the Statue of Liberty’s base. At least six people were detained for hanging an anti-ICE banner; organizers said the climber was unaffiliated.

FoodSEM is a fine-tuned open-source language model that identifies food mentions and links them to FoodOn, SNOMED-CT, and the Hansard taxonomy. Trained on annotated recipes, scientific abstracts, and artificial examples, it substantially outperformed non-fine-tuned prompting baselines in five-fold evaluation. Its average F1 scores were highest on artificial linking examples and lower on scientific abstracts, where missed food mentions affected linking performance. The model, code, and datasets are publicly available.

In the DAWn-plasma trial, 320 hospitalized COVID-19 patients received convalescent plasma plus standard care and 163 received standard care alone. The intervention did not improve the day-15 primary outcome or other measured outcomes. Adverse events, including serious and fatal events, were similar between groups. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 19 plasma recipients; no TRALI cases were reported. Neutralizing-antibody titres rose by day 6, but the increase was not influenced by treatment.

The guide describes AMD’s TMPM engine, which offloads page migration between physical memory locations while preserving guest physical addresses. It supports migration during DMA activity and migration of protected SNP guest pages. Commands can move up to 128 pages, with per-page status reported for partial success; AMD reports best performance with 128-page commands. TMPM requires an enabled IOMMU, and certain IOMMU structures and command buffers cannot be migrated. Firmware reload requires operations to stop and the ring buffer to be torn down.

Southeast Asian stocks recovered from early losses on Wednesday as investors sought bargains after declines linked to fears of a Sino-U.S. trade war. Indonesia closed 1.8% higher after hitting a 15-month low intraday, while Philippine shares gained over 1% for a fourth straight session ahead of inflation data. Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia also rose.

The TLV321x comparators include ESD protection and a power-on-reset circuit that holds the output low during startup. TI recommends limiting input clamp current to 10 mA or less. Comparator output depends on the relative input and reference voltages; smaller overdrive can increase propagation delay. External hysteresis can reduce output chatter near the switching threshold, with separate resistor-network configurations described for inverting and non-inverting operation. The passage also describes a low-side current-sensing application and recommends close supply bypassing and careful trace routing to reduce ringing, false triggers, and oscillation. TI states that application guidance must be validated by customers and warns that improper ESD handling can damage the device.

The president describes Iraq’s recent election as a step toward democracy but acknowledges continuing violence, casualties, and slower-than-expected reconstruction and security training. He says intelligence about Iraqi weapons of mass destruction was largely wrong while defending the decision to remove Saddam Hussein.

He outlines a strategy to fight insurgents, strengthen Iraqi security forces, support democratic institutions, and rebuild Iraq’s economy and infrastructure. Citing increased Iraqi participation in elections and growing Iraqi military capacity, he argues that progress is being made. He opposes withdrawing before the mission is complete and says future U.S. troop levels will depend on conditions on the ground and military advice, not a fixed timetable. He asks Americans, including opponents of the war, for patience and support while acknowledging the sacrifices of troops and their families.

Jury selection is underway in Isaiah Hagan’s murder trial after an earlier mistrial. Hagan faces four charges related to Halee Rathgeber’s death. Ten of 14 jurors have been chosen, and opening statements are scheduled for Monday.

Michael Daniels, a BMW salesman from Ashford, was jailed for five years and three months for conspiring to steal nine cars worth £210,000. He gave accomplice Alex Tingle spare keys and customers’ addresses, enabling Tingle and Vincent Murphy to take the cars from buyers’ homes. Tingle received a two-year sentence but was due for immediate release after 13 months in custody. Murphy had previously been jailed for 16 months. The judge called Daniels’ actions a “horrendous breach of trust.”

Checkr, founded in 2014 to make background checks faster and more accurate, found that candidates with conviction records were often rejected without consideration of their circumstances. It made fair chance hiring—giving qualified people with records an opportunity to work—a central mission while maintaining its commitment to safe hiring.

Checkr supports that mission through tools that let candidates explain their records, help employers assess convictions in context, and assist candidates seeking expungement. It also hires people with records, runs an apprenticeship program, and funds related work through its corporate social responsibility division and Checkr.org. The case describes employment barriers facing formerly incarcerated people and presents fair chance hiring as a way to expand employers’ talent pools and improve access to stable work.

CEO Daniel Yanisse wants more companies to adopt these practices. He argues that Checkr’s mission must remain aligned with customer value, growth, and profitability for its impact to endure.

Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) hold baskets of assets and trade on stock exchanges throughout the day, unlike mutual funds, which are priced after the market closes. The passage describes strategies including trend following, mean reversion, momentum, sector rotation, and swing trading, and cites SPY, VTI, and IEFA as examples. ETFs offer diversification and trading flexibility, but carry risks including market volatility, low liquidity, tracking errors, and expenses; leveraged ETFs add further risk. The passage recommends assessing these factors and backtesting strategies before trading.

The guide describes AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which helps move pages between physical memory locations while preserving guest physical addresses. It requires an enabled IOMMU and uses a dedicated ring buffer for commands. PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO can migrate hypervisor-owned pages during concurrent DMA and update IOMMU mappings; PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST migrates SNP guest pages but does not support concurrent DMA. Commands can move up to 128 pages and report overall and per-page status. The guide also covers page-state and alignment requirements, driver operation, firmware reload, performance guidance, and error handling.

A girl from Bihar developed drug-resistant tuberculosis after standard medicines failed. Dr Zarir Udvadia recommended Bedaquiline, but government restrictions prevented her from receiving it because she was not from Delhi. Her father petitioned the Delhi High Court, which ordered that she be given the drug. Udvadia says access remains difficult for other patients. The passage notes that powerful drugs can have serious side effects, while missed TB doses can lead to resistance.

Duncan Keith says his teammates work hard and have matured with experience. He credits Rask’s play for his team’s success but hopes his own team can find ways to score, as it has against other goalies. Keith describes his coach as fair, measured and influential. He says a longtime friendship with his defensive partner helps their on-ice chemistry, and that the team has grown together after consecutive first-round losses.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2020 reports net sales of $59.7 billion, up 11% from a year earlier, and net income of $11.3 billion, up from $10.0 billion. Sales grew across all geographic segments and product categories, led by increases in Services, iPad and Mac. For the first nine months of fiscal 2020, net sales were $209.8 billion and net income was $44.7 billion. Apple said COVID-19 disrupted operations and demand, though demand improved in May and June. During the quarter, it repurchased $16.0 billion of stock and paid $3.7 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents.

Count Tisza privately asked Ambassador Penfield to convey his view that the Entente’s peace terms threatened Germany, Austria-Hungary, and Turkey, and that the dual monarchy best accommodated southeastern Europe’s mixed populations. German Ambassador Bernstorff told Colonel House that Germany welcomed President Wilson’s help in arranging a peace conference but would not publish its terms while the Entente maintained its stated demands. Germany intended to proceed with a submarine blockade, citing those demands and restrictions on neutral trade, but said it would safeguard American interests and end the blockade if Wilson’s efforts offered a path to an acceptable peace.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs increase FP32 processing throughput and add second-generation ray-tracing cores, third-generation Tensor Cores, larger L1 caches, and improved support for concurrent workloads. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling to reach data rates of up to 19.5 Gbps and peak bandwidth of 936 GB/sec. The ray-tracing cores accelerate triangle intersection and motion blur, while Tensor Cores support additional precision modes and structured sparsity. RTX IO, working with Microsoft DirectStorage, moves game-asset decompression from the CPU to the GPU.

The passage also describes PCIe 4.0, NVLink, support for high-resolution displays, and hardware video encoding and decoding, including AV1 decoding. The A40 and RTX A6000 target professional workloads; each has 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.
GBP/USD traded in a narrow range after Yellen’s hawkish testimony boosted the dollar. UK jobs data, US economic releases and Fed remarks are expected to influence the pair.

The speaker says the team played more aggressively and physically in Game 2 than in Game 1, tying the series. They want to maintain that intensity at home in Game 3, avoid sitting back, and limit the opponent’s time and space. They expect a hard-fought, low-scoring game, hope for more offensive chances, and anticipate strong support from the home crowd.

Sony’s “Baby Driver” passed $100 million at the domestic box office after seven weeks and earned $67 million overseas. Directed by Edgar Wright, the $34 million film exceeded expectations after its June 28 release. It scored 94% on Rotten Tomatoes, and its soundtrack topped iTunes.

Merck halted a late-stage trial of its Alzheimer’s drug verubecestat after an independent assessment found it had virtually no chance of working in patients with mild-to-moderate disease. The decision follows the failure of Eli Lilly’s solanezumab trial and raises further questions about treatments targeting amyloid plaques. No treatment has been proven to slow Alzheimer’s, but Merck continues to study verubecestat in people with less advanced disease, and other drug trials remain underway.

Following President William Henry Harrison’s death, the speaker assumes the presidency under the Constitution and sets out the principles of his administration. He pledges peaceful and just relations with other nations while maintaining effective military defenses. To prevent concentrated executive power, he calls for separating control of public funds from the presidency and limiting the use of federal appointments and removals for partisan purposes. He favors economical spending, avoiding peacetime debt, clear appropriations, and accountability for misconduct. Though he will enforce existing financial laws, he considers them unwise and supports a constitutional measure from Congress to restore a sound currency. He also pledges to respect the limits of federal power, preserve the balance between the federal government and the states, and protect the Union and its institutions.

The speaker argues that détente and arms control require reciprocal action and that the United States should maintain its defenses while negotiating verifiable nuclear reductions with the Soviet Union. He opposes agreements he believes would permit a one-sided arms buildup, including SALT II, and cites the Austrian State Treaty as an example of successful negotiation. He warns that Soviet efforts threaten NATO, other regions, and the military balance. He calls for Americans to recognize the security challenge and support restoring a margin of safety, arguing that strength can deter war and encourage arms limits.

Vermont City Electric (VCE) uses demand-side management (DSM) programs to reduce electricity demand and costs. After the 2008 economic downturn, it limited 2009 spending on its nine DSM programs to $800,000, below their combined projected cost of $1,035,027. The case asks for a least-cost electricity supply model for 2009–2014 that accounts for changing demand, power sources, costs, and carbon emissions. It then calls for evaluating which DSM programs to implement within the budget, their effects over six years, and their carbon impact.

After Edward Turner refused a chemical test following a drunk-driving arrest, Oklahoma revoked his license for six months. A district court reduced the revocation to three months based on his driving record. The Oklahoma Supreme Court reversed that reduction, holding that the six-month period was mandatory except under a limited exception added in 1975. Dissenting justices argued that the district court had authority to shorten an excessive revocation after reviewing Turner’s driving record.

The passage describes TMS320DM814x device resources, memory mapping, pin functions, and boot configuration. The system MMU remaps C674x accesses and can optionally handle EDMA transfers. Other modules include media and video processing, face detection, spinlocks, and interprocessor mailboxes. It outlines a unified memory map and TILER extended addressing, then details peripheral pins, multiplexing, pull states, and supply requirements. Boot-mode pins are sampled at reset to select a boot sequence and configure options for interfaces such as GPMC and Ethernet. PINCNTL registers control pin multiplexing.

DTE Maharashtra released the MHT CET 2018 syllabus and exam pattern. Scheduled for May, the exam covers admission to engineering, technology, pharmacy and Pharma-D degree courses. Questions will draw 20% from Class XI and 80% from Class XII, with no negative marking. Its difficulty may match JEE.

Xenon Pharmaceuticals’ investor webinar focuses on its Kv7 and Nav1.7 pain-treatment programs. CEO Ian Mortimer introduces the speakers and agenda, including a corporate overview and a discussion of Xenon’s ion-channel drug discovery work. He also cautions that the presentation will include forward-looking statements.

The lecture introduces effective field theory (EFT) as a way to focus on the physics relevant to a particular problem while retaining systematic higher-order corrections. Constructing an EFT requires identifying the relevant degrees of freedom, symmetries, expansion parameters, and leading-order description; consistent power counting is essential. Hydrogen illustrates how heavy particles and other details can be omitted or incorporated as small corrections, although removing particles can also change the definition of a coupling.

In a top-down approach, calculations in a known theory determine a simpler theory through matching. In a bottom-up approach, the simpler theory is built from its degrees of freedom, symmetries, and power counting, with unknown couplings determined separately. The lecture also discusses using EFT to understand logarithms and treating the standard model as an EFT with higher-dimension operators. In this framework, renormalizability requires a finite number of parameters at each order of the expansion.

The passage describes wireless LAN methods for scheduling multi-user uplink and downlink transmissions. It proposes flexible station clustering and resource assignments that can be updated per transmission, supporting OFDMA and MU-MIMO. It also describes null data packet control frames that carry scheduling and response information in signal fields to reduce control overhead.
