Example procedures cover reserving channels, polling stations, assigning sub-channels, confirming readiness, and responding to control frames.

Quinton Tellis’ defense attorney alleges that Panola County District Attorney John Champion offered an unrelated defendant leniency while trying to elicit false testimony about Tellis, who is charged with killing Jessica Chambers in 2014. She has asked that Champion be removed and punished, and that Tellis’ September retrial be delayed and transferred to the state attorney general’s office. Tellis’ first trial ended with a hung jury. Champion declined to discuss the motion before a scheduled court hearing.

The speaker says fan support adds excitement but does not determine success, and that winning matters more than individual ice time. The team’s pursuit of the cup fuels an emotional rivalry, while its dislike of losing and commitment to sacrifice must extend beyond its captain to every player. The speaker says the team deserved its losses because opponents played better, citing its power play among the problems. The opposing team also looked sharper, with better passing and fewer missed chances than in the first game.

James Patterson increased his annual classroom library donations to $2 million, providing 4,000 teachers with $500 each through a program coordinated with Scholastic Book Clubs. More than 80,000 teachers applied.

Xiaomi is set to mark its eighth anniversary with a launch event in Shenzhen featuring the Mi 8, Mi 8 SE and Mi Band 3. The Mi 8 is expected to have a Snapdragon 845 processor, a 6.2-inch notched display, dual rear cameras and MIUI 10. The Mi 8 SE is expected in several storage options, while the Mi Band 3 may add a touchscreen and gesture controls. A teaser suggests the Mi 8 could also launch in India.

During a family road trip to national parks, the author reflects on weather and climate communication. Old Faithful’s estimated eruption window prompts him to argue that forecasts should convey uncertainty more clearly. A visitor approaching a bison despite warnings leads him to consider why people disregard risks, including weather warnings. At Glacier National Park, he is distressed by shrinking glaciers and later encounters a woman who doubts climate change because of a cold night. He explains that local weather does not define global climate change.

Kingwood High School near Houston reopened after more than six months of closure following Hurricane Harvey flooding. Its 2,782 students attended another district school while millions of dollars in damage were repaired and facilities renovated.

A survey of 297 Moroccan primary and secondary teachers found that 130 (43.8%) had stopped using ICT after face-to-face classes resumed following COVID-19. Among those 130 teachers, only 22.3% reported receiving ICT training. They identified limited access to devices, internet connectivity and digital resources, alongside insufficient training and institutional support, as barriers to continued use. The study calls for stronger educational leadership, coordinated platforms, teacher development and improved access to technology.

The draw play briefly imitates a pass before the quarterback hands the ball to a running back. It is most effective when a defense expects a pass and spreads out, creating room for an inside run. Interior blitzes are its main weakness because they can leave a defender unblocked and stop the runner in the backfield; offenses may pair the play with an RPO to address this. Against both 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, linemen initially show pass protection, while receivers sell routes before blocking. Variations include a quarterback draw and a lead draw from Strong-I personnel, which requires the offense to pass regularly from that formation to remain effective.

To limit a star player, deny passes, provide defensive help, trap mismatches, take charges, and box out. Steer the ball away from the star, then make them expend energy defending through drives, screens, and offensive rebounding.

First-principles calculations find that monolayer CrI2 has a stripe antiferromagnetic ground state, which persists in bilayers. The lowest-energy bilayer has BA′ stacking with antiparallel interlayer alignment. Bilayer formation strengthens the dominant in-plane exchange interactions by about 6–10%, while interlayer exchange remains much weaker. Stacking symmetry determines whether Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and in-plane polarization occur: both are enabled by inversion-breaking registries. The calculations identify mechanical sliding as a way to change registry and tune magnetic and electric properties.

Westman said recent Allied reverses had renewed Finnish confidence in German success against Russia, though Finland feared the consequences if Germany became exhausted. He said Finland had misjudged the war’s duration, outcome and British response; further Finnish offensive operations remained uncertain.

In a separate conversation, the Finnish Minister acknowledged that Finland’s alignment with Germany threatened its relations with the United States, possibly leading to a breach. He saw no solution, noting that Finland could not fight both Russia and Germany.

Schoenfeld reported that Finnish newspapers had not mentioned Stalin’s stated aim of recovering the Baltic States and Karelia, and that the Finnish Government was suppressing or distorting Roosevelt’s wartime statements. He also reported that icebound German grain shipments had prompted emergency requisitioning of Finnish seed and food reserves, underscoring Finland’s dependence on Germany for food.

Ian Murray, 74, pleaded guilty to driving without due care and attention after turning into a Hathersage garage and colliding with a cyclist on May 14. The cyclist suffered facial injuries and lingering pins and needles in his hands, but is expected to recover. Murray apologised and said he had not seen the cyclist. Magistrates fined him £185, ordered £115 in costs and surcharge, and added six points to his licence.

A Hylian Shield edition New Nintendo 2DS XL launches exclusively at GameStop on July 2 for $159.99. It includes “The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds” and plays Nintendo 3DS games in 2D and Nintendo DS games. Nintendo reports 72 million 3DS-family sales globally, though its future alongside the Switch remains uncertain.

Distributed applications expose different monitoring interfaces, making unified monitoring difficult. An adapter container can translate each application’s interface into one expected by a general-purpose monitoring system. Keeping the adapter separate allows independent updates, reuse across applications, and dedicated CPU and memory resources.

Soccer players need to understand their formation, their positions, and how those positions interact. The four general positions are goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, and forward. The goalkeeper can handle the ball within their own penalty area; defenders protect the goal, midfielders connect defense and attack, and forwards create scoring opportunities. More specific position names vary with formations and duties. Coaches should choose names and use them consistently. Although players specialize over time, young players should learn all skills and have opportunities to play every position.

Skoltech researchers developed a mathematical model in which memory concepts are represented by collections of neurons called engrams. The model predicts that a seven-dimensional conceptual space stores the most distinct concepts, suggesting seven senses could optimize memory capacity. The researchers caution that applying this result to human senses is highly speculative, but say it may inform robotics and AI.

Larry Williams created the Williams Vix Fix in 2007 as a synthetic VIX for securities beyond major stock indices. It measures price volatility over the previous 22 trading days and, according to the passage, resembles the VIX’s movements. The article reports several backtests on stock-index products, including a QQQ strategy averaging nearly 1% per trade across 352 trades since 1999. It concludes that the indicator appears useful for stock indices but was not tested on other asset classes.

Melania Trump is hosting executives from major technology companies for her first public event on cyberbullying, an issue she named as a priority in 2016. The choice has drawn questions because President Trump often insults people on Twitter. Platforms prohibit harassment but largely depend on user reports, and their efforts have not prevented widespread abuse. Companies face challenges moderating vast amounts of content while protecting expression. A poll found that 41 percent of US adults believed they had experienced online harassment. Bullying laws vary by state, with no federal law addressing it.

Marsha Jackson, RiseEngineer’s new head of internal audit, investigates an anonymous allegation of misconduct in the company’s $1.2 billion Elysium government contract. Her team finds that employees entertained officials, hosted four officials on a Boston visit accompanied by their families, transferred $3 million to a local consultant’s offshore account, and withdrew $5 million in cash, only $1 million of which had documented purposes. An email suggests a salesperson wanted to consult headquarters’ general counsel.

The Elysium subsidiary gives salespeople substantial autonomy and uncapped commissions. Its finance manager handles most accounting and banking, permits transactions with little or no documentation, and does not require separate approval. The case asks how Marsha should assess the allegation and strengthen controls. It notes that the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act prohibits bribery of foreign officials and requires public companies and their subsidiaries to maintain financial records and internal accounting controls.

The passage describes backtesting a Bollinger Band strategy in Python using historical Microsoft data. It calculates bands two standard deviations above and below a 20-day moving average, assigns buy signals below the lower band and sell signals above the upper band, then calculates and plots cumulative returns. The strategy compounded at 2.65% annually while invested 10.6% of the time.

Opera has launched Neon, a subscription AI browser that can carry out tasks such as filling forms, comparing websites and writing code. It offers autonomous page interaction on users’ devices, AI-managed workspaces and reusable prompts. Early access is available, with wider release planned in the coming months. Opera aims to compete in agentic browsing, though reliability, safety and regulatory compliance remain challenges.

Karuna Nundy is a Supreme Court advocate involved in anti-rape and sexual harassment law, representing rape survivors and seeking justice for Bhopal gas tragedy victims. A drafter of Womanifesto, she also works in corporate, property, media and technology law.

A video of Tennessee middle school student Keaton Jones tearfully describing bullying at school went viral, drawing support from athletes, celebrities, politicians and thousands of others. His sister Lakyn said the attention made him happy because it raised awareness of bullying. Reports that his mother had posted images of Confederate flags on Facebook prompted criticism. A fundraiser for Keaton and his mother, which had raised more than $58,000, paused donations while its organizer discussed how to proceed.

The author reiterates a “Buy” rating on Warby Parker, citing retail expansion, customer growth, rising average selling prices and high gross margins despite tariffs. The company raised its FY25 guidance to 14%–15% revenue growth and nearly two points of margin expansion. The author holds a long position in WRBY.

The passage describes a footwear sole structure with an annular cleat set in the medial forefoot, radial cleat sets that include peripheral cleats, and a heel cleat set. Its outsole may use modular forefoot and heel plates made from shells, skeletons, and cleat inserts. A composite midsole, shank, and cradle provide cushioning and support. The cleat arrangement is described as providing traction while allowing rotation about the annular set’s central axis.

The May 18, 2001, State Bar of Michigan e-Journal summarizes court decisions across ten practice areas, including criminal, family, insurance, zoning, tax, and workers’ compensation law. The decisions address sentencing, custody mediation, uninsured-motorist coverage, a residential zoning dispute, and an employer’s knowledge of a workplace hazard. The issue also contains attorney practice listings, classified advertisements, job openings, and subscription information.

The Motz Corporation, a natural and synthetic turf specialist founded in 1977, has become employee-owned through an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). The company says the change gives employees a share in its ownership without changing its management: Joe Motz remains CEO, and the executive team retains its roles. Its business units include The Motz Group and USGreentech.

Coach Julien said his team has played well in the playoffs but wants a more consistent effort after a tougher game decided in overtime. He said the power play has improved through new personnel, confident puck movement and better decisions. He described the team as calm under pressure and confident on the road, while expecting another tight game. Julien said the goals scored on Corey Crawford’s glove side reflected openings rather than a deliberate plan. On coaching, he emphasized being himself, balancing respect for players with authority, and adapting to players’ expectations. He said he trusts several forward lines against top opponents and praised Dennis Seidenberg’s size, strength and ability to play well in big games.
Cleary’s Lewis Williams will seek the Elite Three Nations 91kg title in Rotherham, following stablemate Morgan Ansell’s youth title win. Josh Finch will fight Cameron Hatton on June 8.

This edition draws mainly on Department of State and American Commission to Negotiate Peace records, with related documents from other collections. Except in a few cases, coverage ends with the commission’s departure from Paris on December 9, 1919. Editors plan to publish important records substantially in full while omitting some secondary material. The listed topics include the armistice, American preparations, conference representation, Allied policies, and proposals for a League of Nations. Of the listed conference agreements, the United States ratified three.

Weybridge Orthodontics offers Invisalign for mild-to-moderate tooth misalignment. Treatment uses custom transparent aligners made from 3D images, with each pair worn for 7–10 days; results typically take 12–18 months. The removable aligners can be taken out for meals and brushing. The practice offers consultations and a simulation of expected results.

South32 abandoned its US$200 million purchase of Peabody Energy’s Metropolitan coal mine, saying concessions needed to address Australian steelmakers’ competition concerns would undermine the deal. BlueScope Steel opposed South32 becoming the only large coking-coal supplier to the Illawarra steelmaking hub. Peabody will retain the mine and its Port Kembla coal-terminal stake, and plans to resume shipments at the end of May.

A genetic study found no robust association between vitamin B12 metabolism genes and Parkinson’s disease risk, and no evidence that genetically predicted B12 levels affect disease risk, age at onset, or progression. Analyses were limited to people of European ancestry, and progression analyses had less statistical power. The authors suggest non-genetic factors may contribute to lower B12 levels observed in patients and call for further research.

Research teams have produced muons using laser-driven accelerators much smaller than traditional facilities. The accelerators speed up electrons, which generate muons when they strike dense material. Muons can penetrate solid objects and reveal what is inside, potentially enabling faster scans of shipping containers for contraband. Experiments at Berkeley Lab, in Romania and in Shanghai reported muon production. Researchers have also demonstrated an early imaging application, though laser accelerators are not yet portable.

President Donald Trump met with Jared Isaacman to discuss nominating him again to lead NASA. Trump withdrew Isaacman’s earlier nomination amid a dispute with Elon Musk, citing Isaacman’s political affiliation and close ties to the SpaceX CEO. Isaacman has led two private SpaceX missions.

The passage develops mean-field pseudospin models for two hydrogen-bonded phenyltetrazole crystals, APHTZ and MPHTZ. APHTZ has ferroelectric order along its a axis and antiferroelectric order along its b axis; the model predicts that a b-axis electric field can rotate its net polarization by 90 degrees. MPHTZ has antiferroelectric ordering between chains and undergoes field-induced switching to a ferroelectric state. Both models predict second-order transitions at zero field and tricritical points under switching fields. The calculations agree with available measurements, but limited experimental data leave some model parameters uncertain, particularly for APHTZ. Further measurements are needed to test the predictions.

Niantic says a Pokémon GO update later this week will add over 80 Generation II Pokémon from *Pokémon Gold and Silver*, all discoverable in the wild when the update goes live. It will also add evolution items available from PokéStops, two new berries, avatar clothing and unspecified changes to encounter gameplay. Niantic did not give a more precise release date. The update does not mention improved tracking, trading or player-versus-player battles.

The lecture explains how foam stress–strain curves become energy absorption diagrams. The diagrams identify an optimal “shoulder point,” where a foam absorbs substantial energy at its plateau stress before densification sharply raises the peak stress. They can be built from tests or models and used to compare densities, strain rates and temperatures. Elastomeric foams can share a normalized diagram, while diagrams for foams with a yield point depend on the ratio of solid yield strength to modulus.

Impact-protection examples show how the diagrams help select foam material, density and thickness for packaging and bicycle helmets. In the helmet example, 5%-dense expanded polystyrene is identified as a suitable liner material.

A final case study examines why woodpeckers tolerate repeated pecking impacts measured at up to 1,500g. The lecturer attributes this to their small brain size, brain orientation and short impact duration, rather than a special cushioning material.

Charleston’s council will consider allowing carriage tours to resume after 30 minutes below 95 degrees or with a heat index below 110, replacing the current two-reading rule. One company introduced driver body cameras.

The passage describes a possible German peace policy of gaining supplies and organizing the Near East, which the President’s Buffalo speech seeks to check. It then outlines the Inquiry’s research organization and filing system. The Inquiry aims to assemble reliable material on urgent peace-settlement questions by February 15, 1918, focusing on the region from the Baltic Sea to the Persian Gulf, Central Africa, the Central Powers’ economic needs, and freedom of the seas. It has compiled official government declarations and is examining western press and periodicals for policy statements by opposition figures and social groups.

Volta introduced Tensor Cores with up to 8x mixed-precision matrix multiplication speedup over standard FP32 operations. The Ampere-based A100 has 108 SMs versus V100’s 80 and offers 16x peak mixed-precision performance over standard FP32 operations. Ampere’s optimizations aim to improve Tensor Core utilization and support strong scaling as A100 consumes data 2.5x faster than V100.

Eric Bass forwarded the October 5, 2000, “Inside UT Football” newsletter. Dallas Morning News writer Chip Brown shared Oklahoma coach Bob Stoops’ comments before the Texas–Oklahoma game and answered readers’ questions about Texas’s quarterback rotation, offensive line, defense, special teams and coaching. Brown predicted a 24–20 Texas win and expected Major Applewhite to play most or all of the game.

After a frustrating loss to Detroit, the team regrouped at practice. The speaker said they failed to get the puck deep, struggled in the neutral zone and lacked speed. They need to execute a simple game plan and establish their forecheck. Mistakes contributed to Detroit’s goals, but the speaker said the loss was not primarily the goaltender’s fault. Winning Game 2 would put the series back on even terms.

Nutritional High extended an US$800,000 loan secured by its Pueblo, Colorado, property through April 18, 2018, at 13% annual interest, with renewal and extension fees. It also signed a term sheet for a loan secured by its La Pine, Oregon, property, capped at the lesser of 85% of its appraised value or US$400,000. The proposed Oregon loan carries 13% interest over 18 months and remains subject to lender due diligence. Both arrangements include warrants subject to regulatory approval.

Federal courts plan to use funds not tied to new congressional appropriations to pay staff and maintain most proceedings through Oct. 17 during the shutdown. Judges’ salaries are constitutionally protected. Some courts have delayed civil cases involving the federal government, while others have declined to do so. If available funds run out, courts may require some staff to work without pay and furlough others while maintaining constitutional functions.

The speaker expects a power play opportunity and says a physical player remains useful, though the team needs to get more pucks to the net. Another player will not play tonight. The team wants to pressure its opponents more effectively without losing position. Timely goals, including one from Benny, and Antti’s goaltending helped in the last game, though the speaker wants more puck possession and less time defending. An energy line contributed through forechecking and physical play. Looking ahead to a loud road game, the team aims to improve and draw on its approach in earlier playoff road trips.

Andrew Lo uses Lehman Brothers’ 2007 financial figures and a mortgage example to show how leverage magnifies losses. He discusses rising mortgage payments, defaults, Lehman’s bankruptcy, and the disruption these events caused in financial markets and hiring.

The lecture then distinguishes nominal returns from real returns, which account for inflation, and emphasizes matching nominal cash flows with nominal discount rates and real cash flows with real discount rates. Lo introduces the large fixed-income market, its participants and risks, and explains how present-value calculations price coupon and pure discount bonds.

At NVIDIA’s June 3, 2021 annual meeting, stockholders elected 13 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor for fiscal 2022, and approved increasing authorized common shares from 2 billion to 4 billion. NVIDIA filed the amendment in Delaware on June 4, 2021.

The Supreme Court temporarily allowed the Trump administration to withhold $4 billion in foreign aid while Congress considers a request to rescind the funding. The court said the plaintiffs had not yet shown they could sue under the Impoundment Control Act and stressed that its ruling was not a final decision. The ABA is a plaintiff in the consolidated cases. Justice Elena Kagan dissented, joined by Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Ketanji Brown Jackson.

More than 200 schools in North Wales are closed after snow, ice and overnight temperatures of -8C made travel hazardous. The passage reports 78 closures in Flintshire, 48 in Wrexham, 47 in Denbighshire and 11 in Conwy, with further closures in Gwynedd. Some schools are partially open, while Anglesey lists no weather-related closures. A region-wide yellow ice warning remains in force until 11am.

Boston University Summer Term offers open-enrollment undergraduate and graduate courses in over 75 subjects, with daytime, evening, and online options. It also offers pre-college programs. Sessions run May 23–June 30 and July 3–August 11.

President Donald Trump welcomed French President Emmanuel Macron to the White House on Tuesday for the first state visit of his presidency. Their talks were set to cover the Iran nuclear deal, Syria, security and trade. The leaders praised their countries’ alliance but differ on the Iran agreement: Trump has considered withdrawing, while Macron favors staying in it despite its flaws. After a private dinner at Mount Vernon on Monday, the visit was to culminate in a White House state dinner for about 150 guests.

Tesla reported $939.9 million in revenue for the quarter ended March 31, 2015, up from $620.5 million a year earlier, primarily due to increased Model S deliveries. Gross margin rose to 27.7%, but the net loss widened to $154.2 million as research, development and administrative expenses increased. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $1.51 billion at quarter-end, and operating activities used $131.8 million in cash. Tesla planned to begin Model X deliveries late in the third quarter of 2015 and expected about $1.5 billion in capital expenditures for the year. The filing identified production delays, supply constraints and vehicle demand as risks.

A January 25, 2002, collection of reports covers Enron’s collapse and its aftermath. After Kenneth Lay resigned as chairman and CEO, Enron considered a restructuring specialist to lead the bankrupt company. Reports alleged that some LJM2 investors received confidential information and that Enron Energy Services overstated profits. Congressional investigations examined Arthur Andersen’s destruction of Enron documents, while lawmakers debated 401(k) protections after employees lost retirement savings. Other reports covered a proposed liquidation of Enron Australia, reduced charitable donations, and assistance for laid-off workers.

The passage describes ADS9803 initialization, configuration registers, SPI register access, and multi-device daisy-chain operation. A free-running sampling clock is required before initialization and during normal operation. Speed-boost mode converts one selected analog-input pair at up to 8MSPS while the other six channels remain idle. It also covers input, output, test-pattern, averaging, and correction settings; an ATE application example; power and layout guidance; and TI support and legal information.

Particle has released an LTE module for connected devices that rely on retiring 2G and 3G networks. It includes cloud and SIM support and targets industrial uses such as factory and agricultural sensors. Two certified LTE CAT-M1 models are available; individual modules cost $69, and an $89 evaluation kit includes a board, temperature sensor and accessories.

Light-field imaging captures spatial and directional light information in a single exposure, enabling computational refocusing and rapid 3D reconstruction without conventional scanning. The review describes its optical principles and biomedical applications in microscopy, mesoscopy, and endoscopy. Key limitations include trade-offs among speed, resolution, field of view, and imaging depth, as well as scattering and reconstruction artifacts. Compression, meta-optics, and deep learning offer potential improvements but introduce constraints involving image quality, optical performance, or model reliability.

Panthers kicker Graham Gano missed three of four field goals in a loss to the Buccaneers and complained that Tampa Bay displayed live footage of his kicks on the video board behind the goal posts. A league official said using the board to distract a kicker violates the rules. Gano did not blame it for his misses. Panthers coach Ron Rivera also criticized the board’s repeated slow-motion replay of a post-play incident.

OpenChart-SE is a publicly available corpus of 50 artificial Swedish emergency department records written by physicians and medical students and reviewed for realism. Created to support clinical natural language processing research where real records are difficult to access, it covers varied imagined adult patients. The records cannot provide clinical insights. The project invites further submissions and plans periodic releases after quality control.

The passage calls for teacher education programs to adapt to modern classrooms by integrating technology, fostering critical thinking, supporting diverse learners, and addressing global challenges. It presents TPACK and constructivism as frameworks for effective teaching and emphasizes collaboration and ongoing professional development.

The speaker says playing forward allows more creativity than a defensive role at the point. He plans to keep his game simple, make room for Mike and Jere, and match their energy and physical play. He expects a strong effort from the opposing team and says his team must match it. He credits team-wide commitment to blocking shots and roster depth, which lets other players step in when needed. Despite being ahead, the team is focused on winning one period at a time.

On March 11, 2015, NVIDIA appointed Michael McCaffery and Persis Drell to its board of directors and named McCaffery to the Audit Committee. Each received 10,656 restricted stock units vesting over approximately three years, 2,361 units vesting May 20, 2015, and a $15,625 cash retainer. NVIDIA also entered into indemnity agreements with both directors.

In a March 15, 2021 Form 8-K, Tesla reported that Elon Musk’s title changed to “Technoking of Tesla” and Zach Kirkhorn’s to “Master of Coin.” They retained their positions as Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, respectively.

After 24-year-old Sana Bhat died of leukemia, Srinagar businessmen launched #TwentyRupeesMiracle, a crowdfunding campaign inspired by her family’s successful online appeal for treatment funds. More than 50,000 people signed up to give 20 rupees a month to Lalla Ded Charity. The charity sends donations through local groups to patients who cannot afford treatment. One recipient, 18-year-old Towseef Ahmad Bhat, received medicines and has begun to recover. Sana’s sister hopes the charity’s work will honor her memory.

The IT 40, which tracks 40 major Italian stocks, is trading near its 1998 level. Backtests using the dividend-adjusted EWI ETF found the strongest returns on Tuesdays and Wednesdays and in March and June; Mondays and May performed worst. An end-of-month strategy returned 6.17% annually, compared with 4.71% for buy and hold, while invested about one-third of the time.

BitMine chair Tom Lee says the boom in digital asset treasury companies may already have ended as more firms enter the market. BitMine holds over 3 million Ethereum tokens, about 2.5% of the supply, and aims to reach 5%. Lee argues it offers investors staking rewards and potential inclusion in major stock indexes.

Fiat has introduced the 500 “Spiaggina ’58,” a convertible limited to 1,958 cars, to mark 60 years since the original 500 Jolly Spiaggina. It features Volare Blue paint, vintage-inspired details and modern connectivity. Garage Italia and Pininfarina also created a beach-themed showcar based on the 500C. Fiat marked the anniversary with a video set to “Volare.”

Officers who bring charges against other officers must submit them confidentially to the Department of State. On May 20, 1902, U.S. military occupation of Cuba ended and a republican government led by Tomás Estrada Palma was inaugurated. At Cuba’s request, the United States sought Argentina’s permission for U.S. consuls to represent Cuban interests until Cuban consuls were appointed. Revised passport rules allowed qualified residents of U.S. insular possessions who owed allegiance to the United States to receive passports, subject to application, witness, and fee requirements.

The GST Council set a 0.1% tax on goods bought by merchant exporters for export, with refunds available. It also approved measures to ease exporters’ cash-flow pressures, including tax relief for certain imports and domestic supplies. An e-wallet facility to provide exporters with liquidity may be launched from April 1.

This excerpt describes peripherals and design guidance for the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518. It covers secure storage of up to four AES keys; CRC and math acceleration; UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD communications; low-frequency clock functions, real-time clock and watchdog timers; general-purpose and advanced timers; and analog and digital I/O. It also describes serial-wire debugging, a password-protected UART or I2C boot strap loader, and read-only factory identification and trim data.

The application guidance recommends supply decoupling capacitors, an NRST pullup, and a VCORE capacitor, and specifies an external resistor when SYSOSC frequency correction is used. Later sections list development tools, documentation, revision changes, packaging information, and TI’s notices and disclaimers.

The city of Bisbee sought to recover delinquent city-tax charges retained by Cochise County’s treasurer. The court held that charges collected before June 13, 1931, belonged to the city and that its claim was not time-barred. A 1931 law directed later charges to the county’s general fund. Mandamus could proceed against the treasurer, but not the county or its supervisors. The dismissal was reversed as to the treasurer, and the case was remanded.

The speaker praised the team’s defensive play around the net, acknowledged causing a few difficult rebounds, and said strong defense and favorable bounces helped. They also admired another goaltender’s playoff competitiveness and hoped to emulate it.

AggregateIQ executives told Canadian MPs that the firm was never a Cambridge Analytica subsidiary and had not used improperly obtained Facebook data, disputing claims by former SCL employee Christopher Wylie. They said AggregateIQ placed online ads and built campaign software. The firm worked for four pro-Brexit groups, with Vote Leave paying more than £625,000 for BeLeave work and £100,000 for Veterans for Britain. Chief operating officer Jeff Silvester said AggregateIQ saw no evidence that Vote Leave and BeLeave coordinated the spending and was assured the payment arrangement was legal.

The passage is a Sansa Fuze manual covering the hold switch, charging, power controls, computer connection, and firmware updates. It explains how to transfer and play music, audiobooks, videos, and photos; use FM radio and voice recording; delete files; and customize settings. It warns against disconnecting the player during data transfer and notes that formatting deletes all content. Troubleshooting, support contacts, a one-year limited warranty, and software license terms are also provided.

Several Maharashtra HSC students scored well despite disabilities or demanding work schedules. At NGO Niwant Andh Mukta Vidyasalaya, Kshirsagar Kedar Kailas scored 80.15 per cent, while Vanshika Joshi scored 70.77 per cent despite pain from a leg condition. Of 120 night-school candidates, 104 passed. Akash Dhindle scored 79.23 per cent while working a 10-hour job; Vitthal Ishwarkatti scored 75 per cent after an 11-year study break.

World stocks approached record highs and the dollar extended its winning streak after Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen signaled a possible U.S. interest rate increase at an upcoming meeting. Bank shares helped lift U.S. and European markets, while Asian stocks also rose. Interest rate futures still indicated limited expectations of three U.S. rate increases this year. Sterling fell after weaker UK wage growth data, and a stronger dollar weighed on crude oil prices.

Government use of the software is subject to restricted rights. SanDisk may terminate the license for violations, after which all copies must be deleted or destroyed. The software is not intended for high-risk activities. California and U.S. law govern the agreement, with disputes heard in Santa Clara County. Export restrictions apply. The device should not be disposed of with unsorted household waste.

Side screens can create dribble penetration and post-up mismatches, so the passage says NBA teams generally prefer “show and recover” to switching: the screener’s defender forces the ballhandler wide, then returns to the screener. It also describes three SOS responses. Above the free-throw line, defenders use a contact switch, pass denial and pressure on the ballhandler. Below it, they trap near the baseline or corner while other defenders cover passing options. An all-out disruption traps the point guard before the screen develops, then rotates defenders as passes are made. A pass to the rolling screener can trigger a secondary post trap.

A new Hubble image shows NGC 2775, 67 million light-years away, with a smooth center and a dusty ring of star clusters. Researchers disagree on whether it is a spiral or lenticular galaxy. A long hydrogen-gas tail may be evidence of past mergers. The image adds observations of red light emitted by gas around young stars.

Skinimalism simplifies skincare to a few products chosen for individual needs. According to Dr Hazel Parkinson, it may help protect the skin barrier, reduce irritation, and cut waste and costs. People with acne, rosacea, pigmentation or other concerns may still need targeted ingredients. She recommends adjusting products to skin tolerance and removing steps gradually, allowing two to four weeks to assess the response.

A hunter found a nearly complete fossil of a previously unknown elasmosaur species in northeastern Montana in 2010. The smaller marine reptile lived alongside larger ones, providing evidence that challenges a belief about elasmosaur neck evolution. Researchers say relatively few marine reptile fossils from the region’s ancient inland sea have been excavated.

About 80 protesters gathered outside the Crossroads of the West Gun Show at the Del Mar Fairgrounds, calling for the facility to stop hosting it and denouncing gun violence after the Parkland school shooting. Organizer Rose Ann Sharp said students were bringing new urgency to the issue. Show owner Bob Templeton expected 8,000 to 10,000 attendees, slightly more than in previous years, and attributed the increase to debate over gun legislation. California gun-show purchases require a background check and a 10-day waiting period.

The Centre told the Supreme Court it would extend revised pension benefits to all Major Generals and equivalent ranks, including those who retired before 2006. The court ordered implementation within three months and disposed of a contempt petition seeking One Rank One Pension.

The study tested a simplified, potentially field-deployable method for detecting SARS-CoV-2 in throat swabs using sample pretreatment, random amplification and Nanopore sequencing. Combining DNase I treatment with filtration increased viral reads and genome coverage compared with either treatment alone or no pretreatment. After 20 hours of sequencing, samples with PCR CT values of 30 or lower had 85.8–100% reference-genome coverage; all 14 positive samples were identified as Delta clade. The authors note that testing was limited to SARS-CoV-2 and that reads also appeared in negative controls, possibly during demultiplexing.

Clear, brief calls help soccer players share information quickly during play. Players without the ball, especially those behind it, often have the best view to direct teammates. The passage defines introductory through advanced calls for attacking, defending, positioning, passing, and goalkeeper and defensive-organizer duties. Coaches should teach an age-appropriate team vocabulary that all players understand; teams need not use every listed call. At higher levels, nonverbal signals may help when crowd noise prevents players from hearing one another.

Consumer Reports tested 23 popular U.S. protein powders and shakes and found that more than two-thirds contained more lead per serving than its experts consider safe to consume in a day. Plant-based powders had the highest contamination, averaging about nine times the lead found in dairy-based products. Consumer Reports said lead levels had risen since its 2010 testing and advised against daily use of most powders. The passage notes that supplements receive limited oversight before sale and that most people can meet their protein needs through food.

The passage argues that sales pressure and poorly designed incentives can undermine client-first financial advice. It recommends tying advisor rewards to client satisfaction, compensating advisors when they recommend no purchase, and requiring a minimum level of education.

An IEP news email compiles reports on California’s energy crisis. Despite faster power-plant permitting, only 2,500 of a targeted 5,000 megawatts were expected online by July, leaving summer blackouts likely. PG&E sued California for compensation for seized electricity contracts, while 394,000 customers qualified for its conservation rebates. Other reports cover Duke Energy’s rising earnings, Gov. Gray Davis’s political response to the crisis, and competing legislative plans to keep Southern California Edison out of bankruptcy. A Chicago Tribune editorial argues that easing energy prices call for conservation, environmental protection and fewer barriers to new supply.

U.S. wages and benefits rose 2.6 percent in 2017, up from 2.2 percent in 2016, though quarterly growth slowed slightly at year’s end. Economists said wages should be rising faster with unemployment at 4.1 percent. Hourly wages grew 2.5 percent in 2017, down from 2.9 percent in 2016.

The coach said Calgary played the way it had throughout its run, while his team did not play with enough consistency or tenacity. He said the priority before the next game is to recognize Calgary’s strengths and change the team’s mindset, rather than make major tactical adjustments. He expects a response, but rejects calling the next game a “must win.” He praised Marty’s play despite his lack of scoring and expressed confidence in Nikolai Khabibulin. He also said an incident involving Danny caused no injuries and should not distract from preparation.

Intermediate attacking runs build on timing, movement into open space, communication, and receiving passes. Individual techniques include back-door runs, drifting, doubling back, delaying or repeating a run, and setting up a defender. Runs can also draw defenders away to create space for teammates. Attacking players may exchange positions through horizontal or vertical switches, with communication used to coordinate and reverse them. Players making runs should be ready to receive the ball, anticipate their next move, and move toward a pass to prevent it from being intercepted.

A survey found that US manufacturing and services firms expect continued growth in 2018, with revenues projected to rise 7.8 percent and 6 percent, respectively. More than 60 percent report difficulty filling jobs, and many are raising wages. Both sectors expect modest increases in employment, capital spending and materials costs.

The FDA approved another generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone, allowing three U.S. companies to produce it. The approval drew criticism from anti-abortion groups but is unlikely to change access. Amgen said its cholesterol drug Repatha met two primary goals in a 12,000-patient trial measuring heart disease death, heart attacks, and strokes, though it did not release full results. The Trump administration delayed closing a Medicare drug-price negotiation loophole.

The passage surveys AI tools for writing, image and video creation, coding, search engine optimization, and workflow automation. It describes ChatGPT, DALL-E, Lumen5, Grammarly, OpenAI Codex, Tabnine, Surfer SEO, Zapier, and Compose AI, while also listing Canva and Jasper AI. These tools can save time and improve productivity, but their outputs and suggestions may be inaccurate, unsuitable, or dependent on source material. The passage recommends reviewing their results and choosing tools according to specific needs.

The author criticizes Jerry Coyne for relying on a YouTube video to argue that satellite data support a multiverse, saying the inflation models cited do not establish the varied physical laws Coyne needs for his argument. The passage also stresses reliable evidence and scientific rigor, citing a Nobel Week Dialogue talk by David Gross.

The speaker praises a teammate’s timely goals and composure, and describes a play that led to a goal. The team kept using its speed in the third period, benefited from Pekka’s saves and an empty-net goal, and closed out the game. Calling the win a birthday gift, the speaker says the team must keep improving as the series gets tougher.

Gatwick recorded its busiest July, handling 4.7 million passengers, up 2.4% and marking its 53rd consecutive month of growth. Long-haul passenger numbers rose 10.7% and cargo 20.4%. New routes to North America and Asia are planned.

Apple’s 2017 Form 10-K describes its hardware, software and services business, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, digital content and support. For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2017, international sales accounted for 63% of net sales, while indirect channels accounted for 72%. Research and development expense was $11.6 billion, and the company had approximately 123,000 full-time equivalent employees. The filing identifies risks including intense competition, component shortages, reliance on outsourcing partners, legal and regulatory matters, data security and currency fluctuations.

James Walker Morales escaped Rhode Island’s Wyatt Detention Center on Saturday by climbing a basketball hoop, cutting through fencing and crossing the roof. Officers discovered he was missing three and a half hours later. The facility is on lockdown, two officers are on administrative leave, and authorities continue searching for Morales. Police found bloody prison clothing near an I-95 overpass and believe he may have stolen a car later recovered.

The coach said Ottawa outworked his team, whose discipline, effort and movement fell short despite a chance to win. He disagreed with a ruling that a goal was not kicked in but accepted the call. He credited Ottawa’s supporting players and said his team must regroup and play better. Chris Kunitz has a lower-body injury unrelated to an earlier injury; although doctors have cleared him, coaches will decide whether he is fit to play. The coach also praised O’Donnell’s defensive play and Pahlsson’s checking role.

Rockefeller scientists studying C. elegans found that the tail-spike cell dies in stages: its main body separates and disintegrates, while its extension breaks apart or retracts before being removed. They observed the same process in a worm neuron. The team also found that the protein EFF-1 helps phagocytes seal around cell remnants so they can engulf them.

An Ombudsman Services survey found that one in five British rail passengers is resigned to poor service and estimated that complaints rose 31% to two million last year. Punctuality, customer service and overcrowding were the main concerns. Campaigners called for more effective responses to complaints, while a proposed Bill would establish a rail ombudsman. The Department for Transport cited investment and penalties for poor performance; rail operators acknowledged that some passengers are not getting the service they expect.

Second-quarter filings showed Third Point increased its stakes in Facebook and Alphabet, while Omega Advisors cut its holdings in Facebook, Netflix and Amazon but kept its Alphabet stake unchanged. Jana Partners increased its Whole Foods stake before cashing out after Amazon announced a $13.7 billion acquisition. Facebook and Alphabet shares rose during the second quarter and gained further in the third.

The U.S. government was on track to shut down after midnight as congressional Republicans and Democrats remained divided over a funding bill. Democrats want an extension of enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits included; Republicans seek a bill without those provisions. Both sides blamed the other for the impasse. The Congressional Budget Office estimated that a shutdown would furlough about 750,000 federal workers, whose compensation totals roughly $400 million per day.

The passage describes a multi-threaded, reconfigurable computing architecture intended for compute-intensive applications. Arrays of configurable computing tiles use a synchronous network to form pipelined computation domains and an asynchronous packet network to exchange data and control messages. Each tile has computation circuits, memory, configuration instructions, and thread-control circuitry. The described mechanisms support dynamic configuration, conditional branching, flow control, ordered loop and nested-loop execution, and scheduling threads when data dependencies are complete. Dispatch and memory interfaces connect tile clusters to processors, system memory, and an interconnection network.

Consumer Reports says the prescription weight-loss drug Contrave led to an average of five to nine pounds more weight loss than a placebo over 56 weeks but may pose serious health risks. It recommends discussing weight-loss options with a doctor and focusing on diet, exercise and, when needed, intensive behavioral programs.

The passage covers MSPM0G microcontroller I/O selection, serial-wire debugging, bootloader access, factory identification data, and application guidance. The bootloader supports UART or I2C programming, is password-protected, and can be invoked at boot or by software. TI recommends specific supply decoupling, reset, VCORE, and optional oscillator-correction components; 5V-tolerant open-drain outputs require pullups. It also lists development resources, documentation, revision changes, packaging information, and TI’s usage disclaimers.

Facebook publicly released detailed Community Guidelines explaining what content it removes when users report it. Built around “safety,” “voice,” and “equity,” the rules guide moderators but vary from broad principles to highly specific cases. Teams across the company meet regularly to decide what the guidelines should include.

Penn State and USC are meeting for the 10th time, including their third Rose Bowl matchup; USC leads the series 5-4. Their 1923 game was the first played at the current Rose Bowl Stadium. Pac-12 teams hold a 35-31 head-to-head Rose Bowl record against Big Ten teams. Penn State is 14-11 against California schools overall but 3-5 in California. This game will give Penn State four Rose Bowl appearances, tying Pittsburgh among Pennsylvania-based teams.

Point72 Europe London LLP bought 10,000 Hershey shares worth approximately $1.07 million in the second quarter. Institutional investors held 51.39% of the company’s stock. Analysts’ consensus rating was “Hold,” with a $111.55 target price. Hershey reported quarterly earnings of $1.09 per share, above the $0.90 consensus estimate, on revenue of $1.66 billion. The company announced a quarterly dividend of $0.656 per share, payable December 15.

Arizona police arrested 92-year-old Anna Mae Blessing on suspicion of murdering her 72-year-old son after he planned to move her into assisted living. Investigators said she shot him, then tried to point her guns at his girlfriend, who wrestled them away. Blessing was held on US$500,000 bail.

YbCu1.14Se2 has a well-ordered triangular lattice of magnetic Yb ions and disordered, partially occupied Cu sites. Magnetic susceptibility indicates antiferromagnetic exchange, while specific heat shows no magnetic-ordering transition and is sublinear at low temperatures. Frequency-dependent susceptibility reveals a glass-freezing transition near 0.1 K, and field-dependent measurements show no one-third magnetization plateau. The authors propose that Cu-site disorder produces a distribution of magnetic exchanges and model the specific heat using a distribution of quantum singlets. They note similarities to YbMgGaO4 and theoretical simulations of disordered triangular magnets, suggesting possible common behavior among disordered quantum spin-liquid candidates.

Mark Messier announced Robert “Knobby” Knudsen as the Bridgestone Mark Messier Youth Leadership Award winner, recognizing his work for children, including a Windsor minor hockey program. Knudsen’s son accepted the award. Messier named Dustin Brown, Shane Doan and Ryan Callahan finalists for the Mark Messier Leadership Award, citing their on-ice leadership and community work. In questions afterward, he discussed the difficulty of playoff hockey, the NHL’s emerging talent and the Rangers’ progress, saying the team needed more depth.

After an object fell from a closet and struck Christian Bushman’s chest, she became unresponsive and had no pulse. Her sister-in-law, CPR instructor Cathy Carson, performed CPR until Bushman was breathing when responders arrived. Bushman later learned and taught CPR. The passage also cites a study finding that women are less likely than men to receive bystander CPR.

The authors argue that National Literacy Month should prompt sustained support for literacy programs and help families make reading a daily practice. They highlight Partnership for Growth LA’s culturally responsive books, small classes and civic projects, as well as an alumna who became a civic leader. In a 2023–24 after-school pilot, students’ English Language Arts proficiency rose 14.5 points and chronic absenteeism fell from 47% to 5%. The authors warn that uncertain funding could jeopardize such programs.

Economist Torsten Sløk says the U.S. economy is strengthening despite nine months of forecasts predicting a slowdown. He points to resilient spending and investment, and says slower job growth reflects reduced immigration rather than economic weakness. Morgan Stanley’s Mike Wilson also sees a recovery, though recent private-sector payroll data showed job losses. Sløk warns that strong growth and further Federal Reserve rate cuts could increase inflation, and says economists should reassess their repeated forecasting errors.

The speaker accepts the nation’s highest executive office with gratitude and humility, seeking guidance from the other constitutional authorities. He urges citizens to set aside political divisions, respect majority decisions while protecting minority rights, and reject political intolerance. He calls for a wise, frugal government that protects people from harm while leaving them free to pursue their work. His stated principles include equal justice, representative government, constitutional authority, peace and commerce without entangling alliances, fiscal responsibility, and freedoms of religion, the press, and the person. Acknowledging that he may err, he asks for the public’s indulgence and support as he works for their freedom and prosperity.

The passage proposes bivariate zero-inflated Poisson models for count data with excess zeros and dependent components. A shared inflation factor creates joint zeros, while comonotonic or counter-monotonic shocks allow different strengths of positive or negative dependence. It describes moment-based and likelihood-based estimation, including an EM algorithm. Simulations find that likelihood-based methods generally estimate parameters more accurately than the method of moments, though estimation becomes harder with greater zero inflation. An illustration using Australian disaster counts shows the models capturing excess zeros and dependence in flood–storm and flood–bushfire data.

Nobel Peace Prize winner Beatrice Fihn warned that panic, carelessness or a misinterpreted comment could trigger nuclear attacks that destroy cities. Citing heightened risks from nuclear-armed states, terrorism and cyber warfare, she spoke amid escalating threats between Donald Trump and Kim Jong Un. Her organization, Ican, has worked toward a treaty banning nuclear weapons.

The passage recommends a bearish position on January US$INR futures: sell at 68.20–68.30, with targets of 67.95 and 67.75 and a stop-loss at 68.40. The contract ended at 68.09 as open interest rose. Government bond yields recorded their biggest annual fall in eight years, while the rupee posted a sixth consecutive annual loss against the dollar.

The speaker reports that federal offices and records have moved to the permanent seat of government and asks Congress to consider governing the District of Columbia. He notes the discharge of the temporary army, recommends improvements to the federal judiciary, and reports a ratified treaty with Prussia and continuing negotiations with Britain and France. Despite seeking peaceful relations, he urges continued naval preparedness, stronger port fortifications, and support for domestic arms manufacturing. He reports increased revenue and calls on Congress to protect the institutions he credits with the country’s prosperity and freedom.

Montgomery gas prices rose about 4 cents in a week to $2.18 a gallon, while the national average reached $2.40, its highest since September 2015. GasBuddy cited declining oil inventories and geopolitical tensions. AAA predicted that higher summer demand could push prices up through September.

Zimbabwe’s Health Ministry estimates 44,586 female sex workers aged 15–49, including 6,800 in Bulawayo. Their average HIV prevalence is 55 percent, compared with a national average of 13 percent. The estimates exclude male sex workers and people who have transactional sex. AIDS-related deaths fell from 278 per day in 2005 to 71 per day in 2016. A parliamentarian warned that ignoring key populations could undermine efforts to end HIV and AIDS.

The ADS7828 uses an internal 2.5V or external reference. A 5V supply requires an external 5V reference for full input range; a 2.7V supply can use the internal reference. Lower references reduce LSB size, making errors and noise more significant.

The lecture extends temporal-difference policy evaluation from discrete Markov chains to continuous-state problems using function approximation. Linear approximators combine nonlinear basis functions and allow explicit least-squares solutions; examples include radial basis functions, interpolators, Fourier bases, and robot dynamics that are linear in grouped parameters. TD learning uses eligibility traces based on each parameter’s contribution to recent value estimates. Least-squares temporal difference learning retains data and solves for parameters directly, avoiding a learning rate and initial parameter guess. The lecture notes stronger convergence results for linear than nonlinear function approximation.

The Nevada federal district court granted AAA Nevada Insurance Company summary judgment in a dispute arising from a fatal accident involving its insured, Vinh Chau. It held that AAA’s liability under the policy was limited to $100,000 and that its failure to meet a two-week settlement deadline was not bad faith. AAA had tried unsuccessfully to identify all potential claimants before the deadline, giving it a reasonable basis not to settle. The court also denied the interveners’ request for further discovery and rejected their renewed jurisdictional objection.

GoSun introduced the Fusion, a portable oven that uses solar energy and a 150-watt electric heater to cook indoors, outdoors, or at night. The 10-pound, 3.2-liter oven can feed five people and reach 350°F. GoSun launched a Kickstarter campaign offering deals to early backers.

The passage offers essay-writing advice, including choosing an interesting topic, brainstorming, using reliable sources, developing a thesis, maintaining a formal tone and editing. It also promotes online essay-writing services for students who lack time or struggle with coursework.

The proposed treaty guarantees the parties’ territorial integrity and republican political independence. It calls for amicable settlement or arbitration of territorial disputes, investigation of other unresolved disputes before hostilities, and restrictions on expeditions and arms shipments supporting insurrection. It also sets out ratification and denunciation procedures. In accompanying letters, S. E. Mezes proposes drafting general principles from a confidential enclosure, while Secretary of War Baker argues that postwar Germany must be livable for its people and the wider world.

Most Southeast Asian stock markets fell on March 19 as investors awaited the U.S. Federal Reserve’s policy meeting and projections for future rate hikes. Thailand led declines, while Singapore and Indonesia also slipped. Philippine shares recovered from early losses to close marginally lower. Malaysia edged up, and Vietnam rose for a sixth straight session to its highest close since March 2007.

The Trap play is a quick, downhill run that uses a pulling guard to kick out an interior defensive lineman. Its speed and angle blocks can benefit offenses with smaller linemen, but defenses that squeeze interior gaps can limit it. Against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, blockers create a lane for the fullback while the tailback and quarterback draw defenders’ attention elsewhere. Variations include a shotgun run-pass option and a Wing-T version that shares backfield action with the Buck Sweep.
Hillview Middle School will screen “Sing” outdoors on April 27 at 7:30 p.m. An adult must accompany every eight children. Proceeds benefit LLS and JDRF.

The President urges Congress to work with him on a unified foreign policy amid the crisis in Indochina. He asks for $722 million in emergency military aid and an initial $250 million in economic and humanitarian aid for South Vietnam, as well as authority to protect and evacuate Americans and endangered Vietnamese. He calls on North Vietnam to honor the Paris accords and describes Cambodia’s urgent need for food and ammunition.

Reviewing wider foreign policy, he reaffirms alliances in Asia and Europe, asks Congress to lift its arms embargo on Turkey, and pledges continued efforts toward Middle East peace. He supports arms-control negotiations with the Soviet Union and stronger relations with China, while urging changes to trade restrictions he considers harmful. He also calls for action on energy, hunger, and other global challenges, and for maintaining effective intelligence services and a strong defense.

A University of Edinburgh review found inconsistent, often poorly defined research on biodegradable plastic bags’ life cycles and degradation rates. The findings offer little basis for policy or regulation and do not establish whether biodegradable bags are an environmentally helpful alternative.

Mitsui’s April–December net profit rose 64% to a record 376.8 billion yen, prompting it to raise its full-year forecast to 440 billion yen, citing higher iron ore and coking coal prices. Rival Itochu reported record profit but kept its forecast unchanged, while Sojitz raised its forecast.

The passage says Gary Kleck and Marc Gertz estimated that Americans use guns defensively about 2.5 million times annually, and that unpublished CDC surveys produced similar estimates. It alleges the CDC withheld the findings because they conflicted with the Clinton administration’s gun-control agenda. The author argues that the surveys support private gun ownership and underscore the importance of public education on the issue.

Kinder Morgan rose after Canada agreed to buy a pipeline project, while ZTO Express gained on an Alibaba investment. Bank of America fell as interest rates dropped, and Petrobras declined after Brazil announced diesel-price subsidies.

The passage describes how a host BIOS integrates AGESA software through a 32-bit binary module or source integration. A bridge calls the AGESA dispatcher, while a call-out router lets AGESA request host services. The host must provide a stack, configuration data, required call-outs, and memory allocation; it must also follow Cache-as-RAM restrictions during early initialization.

It outlines UEFI build files and configuration options, along with procedures for processor, memory, graphics, and late-boot initialization. Late initialization generates system information tables. Other procedures save processor context for suspend and restore silicon and processor state during resume. Service functions create and release parameter structures, query system information, update MMIO mappings, and read a 16-entry event log.

Wayne Richert says his wife waited from 5:15 to 11:45 p.m. to see a doctor at Norfolk General Hospital. He urges hospital administrators to let doctors call in help when waits are long. Donna Clarke questions why provincial funding for long-term care beds was announced shortly before the June 7 election and argues that seniors in long-term care should not pay for medications.

The passage describes systems for replacing video content while preserving information added by a set-top box, such as menus, notifications, and playback indicators. A client device can identify the set-top box and original content, including through video fingerprints, then select replacement content and a matching overlay template. The template guides how the device positions, crops, blends, or filters the replacement video and set-top-box information. The system can also adjust replacement playback speed and suspend replacement when the video source changes.

KDKA-TV and WPXI-TV reported on June 22 that sources said video showed Antwon Rose II firing a gun before an officer shot him and that gunshot residue was found on his hands. Allegheny County Police Superintendent Coleman McDonough said both claims were false and cautioned against unverified reports. WPXI initially defended its reporting. After the district attorney’s office criticized the coverage, KDKA retracted its report on June 27, and WPXI apologized on June 28.

Peter DeBoer says a win has kept his team’s season alive and could shift the series after three games without momentum. He praises returning veterans for providing energy and a rookie for rising to the occasion. He says the team needs more scoring, must keep pursuing power-play chances despite strong opposing goaltending and penalty killing, and must end a streak to avoid elimination.

Fair Isaac announced a pricing model that lets mortgage lenders obtain FICO scores through resellers rather than credit bureaus. Lenders will have two pricing options, which Fair Isaac says could eliminate markups. Its shares rose more than 20% on Thursday, while shares of Experian, TransUnion and Equifax fell.

Britain’s coffee sales reached £3.4 billion in 2016, and Costa now has more than 2,000 UK shops. To support its growth, Costa opened a roastery in Basildon, near Tilbury Docks, quadrupling annual roasting capacity to 45,000 tonnes. The facility uses automated packing, monitors roast quality and has sustainability features. Costa tests samples from every incoming bag of beans, typically rejecting about 8 per cent each year. Its blend combines arabica and robusta beans, and the new site can train 3,000 baristas annually.

A class discussion uses palm oil to examine how companies engage stakeholders in complex supply chains. Students consider strategies for supplier GAR involving Greenpeace, certification bodies, customers, governments, farmers and local communities. They identify limited supply-chain transparency, certification costs for small farmers, and uncertainty about demand for certified palm oil as challenges. The lecture contrasts NGO partnerships, company-specific collaborations and industry groups as ways to obtain expertise and coordinate sustainability efforts. It also notes that certification labels vary in rigor and can be difficult for consumers to assess.

YouTube Red announced four spring-debuting original series made with the YouTube Kids app in mind: *Hyperlinked*, *DanTDM Creates A Big Scene*, *The Kings of Atlantis*, and *Fruit Ninja: Frenzy Force*. More shows are planned for 2017. YouTube Kids will also become available on certain internet-connected LG and Samsung Smart TVs.

MSPM0C1105/6 MCUs use a 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ core running at up to 32MHz. They operate from 1.62V to 3.6V and −40°C to 125°C, with up to 64KB flash and 8KB SRAM. They integrate analog, timing, DMA, and UART, SPI, and I2C peripherals.

The Kiss of Death is an S&P 500 sell signal: after falling from an all-time high below its monthly 21-month exponential moving average, the index rebounds above it, then falls below its pre-rebound low. Signals in 1969, 1973, 1978, 2001 and 2008 preceded major bear markets, but a September 2022 signal did not. A backtest starting in 1967, using unadjusted index data and buying back above the 10-month EMA, reported a higher CAGR and nearly half the maximum drawdown of buy-and-hold.

Tesla Motors reported an immaterial error in its 2015 Form 10-K that overstated the Supercharger network’s cost and net book value. The correct net book value at December 31, 2015 was $166.6 million. The error did not affect the consolidated financial statements or notes.

Researchers developed a molecular sensor that releases a thyme-like flavor when it encounters influenza virus activity. In laboratory tests using saliva from people diagnosed with flu, it released the flavor compound within 30 minutes. The team hopes to test it in people and eventually incorporate it into gum or lozenges for accessible screening, potentially before symptoms appear.

Pekkala said most Finns sympathized with the democracies and that support for a separate peace with the Soviet Union was growing, though he could not say when officials would act. He said the Agrarian Party still believed Russia could be defeated. Foreign Minister Witting emphasized Finland’s dependence on Germany for 93% of its imports and suggested Finland had little room to act. Reporting from Sweden, Johnson warned that a Russian offensive and Finnish collapse could prompt calls for Swedish assistance, strengthen pro-German groups and threaten Sweden’s coalition government. Soviet Minister Kollontay shared concerns about the effects on Sweden and favored a cessation of fighting.

Entries for the 12th Harrogate Advertiser Business Awards close at noon on Monday, March 13. Businesses can enter multiple categories through harrogatebusinessawards.co.uk. The black-tie ceremony, featuring dinner and entertainment, will be held at the Royal Hall for the first time on Thursday, April 27. The awards have 10 categories, and their main sponsor is estate agent Verity Frearson.

At a forum for real estate and building professionals, four Baltimore County executive candidates—Vicki Almond, Jim Brochin, Johnny Olszewski Jr. and Al Redmer Jr.—pledged to encourage smart growth and improve development approvals. None endorsed impact fees. They called the approval process cumbersome and discussed making rezoning more predictable and consistent with the county’s master plan. Brochin also pledged to end “pay-to-play politics,” citing developers’ campaign donations. The primary elections are June 26.

The passage reports that SPY gained an average of 0.24% from the close of the last trading day of a month to the close of the first trading day, compared with 0.04% on an average day. It says this unfiltered approach is too unreliable to trade, particularly after 2008–09. A filtered version averaged 0.35% per trade, while a second strategy averaged 1.1% across 61 trades. The passage suggests monthly investment inflows as a possible cause.

The passage describes former professor Robert Oscar Lopez’s shift from defending academic freedom to questioning its value. Lopez argues that tenure protects a select few while leaving adjunct faculty vulnerable, and he calls for cuts to college funding. The author argues that academic freedom has limits and is applied inconsistently, favors trade schools and apprenticeships for many students, and says truth should guide what universities teach.

The passage studies online learning for a profit-maximizing broker in repeated bilateral trade, while requiring truthful participation and non-negative utility for both agents. For independently and identically distributed valuations, which may be correlated between buyer and seller, it presents a polynomial-time algorithm with regret nearly proportional to √T relative to the best mechanism in hindsight; a matching lower bound holds up to logarithmic factors. In the adversarial setting, no algorithm achieves sublinear regret even against a 2/3 + ε fraction of optimal profit. The work also improves the regret bound for the joint ads problem. Learning is challenging because the mechanism space is non-parametric and profit can be highly irregular.
The figures show a cooling fan from multiple views and in an alternative position. Broken lines indicate unclaimed portions.

Mediation analysis examines how an intervention affects an outcome through a mediator. Standard structural equation modeling (SEM) handles latent variables and measurement error but relies on a no-unmeasured-confounding assumption that is often difficult to satisfy. The proposed Rank-Preserving Structural Equation Model (RAPSEM) combines rank-preserving models with latent-variable methods, allowing omitted mediator–outcome confounders if they do not interact with treatment or the mediator. It aims to estimate controlled direct and mediation effects in randomized trials. The passage outlines its model, assumptions, estimation procedure, and planned simulation evaluations.

Hawkin’s Bazaar’s Plymouth shop will close on February 4 after four years on New George Street and six in the West End. Its closing sale offers discounts of at least 50%, with some items reduced by 75%.

The speaker says the team played well, stayed focused through adversity and earned a win that gives it a chance to even the series. He praises Markkanen’s play, his teammates’ skill and work ethic, and coaching adjustments that improved the team’s structure. Although the opposing penalty kill has challenged their power play, he remains confident it will produce. He believes the team can play better and says the organization’s tradition makes the playoff run especially meaningful.

The study tests whether transformers learn transitive reasoning from individual training examples by predicting connectivity between nodes in directed graphs. Transformers generalize better on grid graphs than on disconnected chain graphs. Increasing model size improves performance on grid graphs, while increasing graph size helps more on higher-dimensional grids and disconnected chains with many components. The experiments use synthetic graphs; the authors identify real-world graphs as a subject for future study.

The speaker says having fun despite hard practices has helped the team reach its current position. They praise a teammate’s fearless shot-blocking and dedication, describe growing excitement after a period of rest, and commend a smooth-playing defenseman nominated for a top award.

A 2021 cross-sectional study in Denan district, southeastern Ethiopia, tested 187 residents for visceral leishmaniasis (VL) and surveyed their knowledge and practices. VL seroprevalence was 9.63%. Infection was associated with being aged 19–36, damp household floors, outdoor sleeping, and sleeping near animal shelters. Just over half of participants had heard of VL, and 42% identified sand fly bites as its mode of transmission. Researchers collected 823 sand flies representing 12 species; *Sergentomyia clydei* was most abundant, while *Phlebotomus orientalis*, a known VL vector, was the most common *Phlebotomus* species. The authors call for greater community awareness and further research on VL and sand flies in the area.

Cincinnati handed No. 14 Iowa State its first loss, building a large early lead and recovering a late onside kick after the Cyclones rallied within eight points. It was the Bearcats’ first home win over a ranked opponent since 2021.

After withdrawing a guilty plea, Roy Allen Whisnant requested time to obtain out-of-state witnesses and prepare his defense. The court denied a continuance, and he was tried the next day, convicted of misdemeanor assault with a deadly weapon, and sentenced to two years. The appellate court found that he lacked reasonable preparation time and that jurors may have heard his withdrawn plea. It ordered a new trial.

The Supreme Court will consider whether a defendant may receive separate convictions and sentences under federal firearm provisions Sections 924(c) and 924(j) for the same conduct. Section 924(j) requires a Section 924(c) offense that causes a death through use of a firearm. Barrett and the government argue that Congress did not authorize separate punishments; a court-appointed lawyer argues that Section 924(c)’s consecutive-sentence language permits them. The lower courts allowed both convictions and sentences.

The Second Circuit affirmed summary judgment for Reisdorf Brothers on Patrick and Linda George’s federal environmental claims. The Georges’ evidence did not establish an ongoing or intermittent pollutant discharge under the Clean Water Act, and they neither alleged nor showed a violation of the regulations governing open dumping under the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act. The court also upheld dismissal of their state-law adverse possession claim without prejudice and the denial of Reisdorf’s attorney-fee request.

Vocational education assessment must evaluate both theoretical knowledge and workplace skills. Formative assessment uses timely feedback, self-assessment and peer review to identify learning gaps, though it requires time and teacher judgment. Competence-based assessment measures performance against workplace standards rather than relying solely on academic tests. Authentic tasks and workplace evaluations can make assessment more relevant, while clear criteria, rubrics and collaboration with vocational experts can improve consistency. A comprehensive program combines written tests, technical skills assessments, workplace evaluations, and formative and summative methods across different levels of competence.

MADSEN Cycles makes bucket bikes designed to carry up to four children and some cargo. The rear bucket includes removable bench seats and four seat belts. Available accessories include rain covers, front racks and a padded middle bucket seat that can be used for pets or other purposes.

Jerome Powell takes over as Federal Reserve chair from Janet Yellen on Monday, facing decisions about how quickly to raise interest rates. The US economy is growing, unemployment is at a 17-year low, and wages are rising, while inflation remains below the Fed’s target. Yellen raised rates gradually and began reducing the Fed’s bond holdings. Policymakers have signaled three rate increases this year, with the first widely expected in March, but disagree over how tax cuts and economic growth may affect inflation. Faster increases could unsettle markets.

The Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Washington Capitals 7-4 on Friday for their fourth straight win, moving within four points of Washington in the Metropolitan Division. Phil Kessel scored twice, while Evgeni Malkin had two goals and two assists. Washington erased three deficits, but Pittsburgh scored three unanswered goals in the third period. Alex Ovechkin scored twice for the Capitals.
