Using repeated kidney-function measurements from 8,569 PREVEND participants, researchers modelled changes in KDIGO risk stage and new-onset heart failure over a median 12.6 years; 373 participants developed heart failure. Progression to higher kidney-risk stages increased with age, particularly after age 50, while women had lower rates of progression from intermediate to high or very high risk. Higher stages were associated with greater heart-failure risk. This association weakened with age on a relative scale but strengthened on an absolute scale. The model accounted for possible misclassification of kidney-risk stages. The cohort’s enrichment for elevated urinary albumin and predominantly Caucasian composition limit generalizability.

The study developed a scale to measure prospective teachers’ attitudes toward values education through distance education. Based on responses from 341 Gazi University students, the final scale has 36 items in two factors: “Necessity and Usefulness” and “Feasibility.” Exploratory factor analysis found that the factors explained 63.28% of the variance, and reliability coefficients were .97 and .96, respectively. Because the scale was not additive, each factor should be scored separately. The authors concluded that it provides valid and reliable measurements, while noting limitations related to the predominantly female sample, its single-university setting, and the lack of a comparable external scale.

April 27 Indian press reports say Dabhol Power Company’s board authorised management to issue a notice to terminate its power purchase agreement with Maharashtra State Electricity Board, but no notice had been issued. The move followed disputes over unpaid bills, penalties and power tariffs. MSEB paid Rs 134 crore toward its March bill under protest. Indian lenders and Maharashtra officials favoured renegotiation, while reports differed on foreign lenders’ positions.

Investors can access Australian markets through ETFs, American Depository Receipts, international brokers or stock CFDs. The Australian Securities Exchange is the primary exchange, with more than 2,000 listed companies; the Sydney Stock Exchange is another. The passage gives weekday trading hours as 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Australian Eastern Daylight Time, excluding national holidays.

Using the US-traded EWA ETF as a proxy, the passage reports that several conventional strategies performed poorly, while a seasonal “Santa Claus” strategy had a 92% win rate since 1996. It cautions that this result comes from only one trade per year.

Las Vegas gunman Stephen Paddock bought 1,000 tracer rounds, though investigators do not know whether he used them in the attack that killed 58 people and injured nearly 500. He stockpiled guns, requested a room overlooking the festival and installed cameras. Authorities are investigating whether he planned other attacks; they found ammunition and materials used in explosives in his car. His motive remains unknown. Paddock’s girlfriend said she was unaware of his plans.

Defending a talented post player requires coordinated pressure on the passer, backside help, and traps. Defenders should keep the player from receiving the ball near the basket and steer play toward their weaker side. Full-court pressure, an adjusted 2-3 zone, and a Diamond & One defense are also presented as options.
No. 22 Aledo leads Ryan 2-0 in a Friday night game in Denton, Texas. Aledo scored when Ryan was called for intentional grounding in its own end zone, resulting in a safety.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2017, reports net sales of $37.96 billion, up 25% from a year earlier, while net income fell from $857 million to $197 million. Operating income declined from $1.29 billion to $628 million. AWS sales rose 42% to $4.10 billion, while the International segment recorded a $724 million operating loss. Operating cash flow was $3.83 billion for the quarter. Amazon acquired Souq in May and agreed in June to acquire Whole Foods Market for approximately $13.7 billion, subject to closing conditions. The filing also discusses tax, legal, and other contingencies.

A Federal High Court in Abuja admitted EFCC documents in the trial of Chinese national Li Ya Ping, accused of concealing $300,000 while attempting to fly to Dubai. An EFCC detective testified that customs officers intercepted Li at Abuja airport on March 15, 2018, and handed Li and the seized items over to the EFCC the next day.

The passage identifies Reagan Library, National Security Council, and Department of State files as key sources for studying U.S. policy toward the Soviet Union from January 1983 to March 1985. It also introduces a note on how U.S. covert actions were approved. During the Truman administration, concern about Soviet “psychological warfare” led the National Security Council to assign peacetime covert operations to the CIA in 1947. After State and Defense officials questioned that arrangement, a 1948 directive broadened the CIA’s mandate to covert operations designed to conceal U.S. Government responsibility.

The October 19, 2000 VentureWire reports that St. Paul Venture Capital closed a $1.3 billion fund, idealab! postponed its IPO, Constellation Ventures closed a $350 million fund, and New Edge Networks raised $139.9 million. It also covers other financings, product launches, deals, acquisitions, appointments, and venture fund activity.

Children of obese parents are more likely to become obese, with maternal BMI at conception particularly closely associated with early childhood obesity. Research suggests parental nutrition can affect molecules in eggs and sperm that influence an embryo’s development and later obesity risk. Studies in mice implicate sperm non-coding RNAs and maternally inherited egg mitochondria. Diet, exercise and some treatments have improved egg or sperm quality in mice, but evidence for similar effects in humans remains limited. The passage supports addressing obesity in both prospective mothers and fathers before conception.

Ozzie made key saves despite the opponent’s low shot total and several sharp scoring chances. After taking the lead, the team struggled to build on its first period as the opponent gained momentum in the second.

The passage explains how to troubleshoot unplayable songs, update firmware, transfer and convert music, organize files in MTP mode, play compatible podcasts, and correct missing artist or album information. It provides SanDisk support contacts and outlines a one-year limited warranty for eligible original purchasers, including exclusions and limits on remedies and liability. It also describes Windows Media digital rights management and a software license that restricts copying, modification, and certain uses. Finally, it advises against disposing of the player with unsorted household waste.

Novo Nordisk said it will buy Akero Therapeutics, which develops a treatment for the liver disease MASH, for up to $5.2 billion. The newsletter also says the U.K. is reportedly considering raising drug spending.

Defending a soccer goal kick aims to win the ball in a dangerous area or prevent an easy build-up or long kick. Defenders should cover likely receivers, move aggressively to the ball, attack immediately if they win it, and press high if they do not. Strikers cut off short passes, while midfielders challenge lofted balls and backs provide support.

A goal kick is in play once it is kicked and visibly moves. Opponents generally must remain outside the penalty area until then. Younger players may use build-out lines, which require opponents to retreat and give the kicking team room to play from the back; local rules may vary. Coaches should practice defending short and long kicks, position players according to the kicker’s range, and keep them alert to the ball.

Cornerbacks primarily defend opposing wide receivers and disrupt passing plays. In man coverage, they must follow a receiver’s movements without knowing the planned route; in zone coverage, they help protect areas of the field. They also defend outside runs. The position demands speed, agility, backpedaling and quick turns. Teams typically field two cornerbacks, sometimes adding a third to cover a slot receiver. Strong cornerback play can limit a quarterback’s options and help pass rushers apply pressure. The passage names Deion Sanders, Charles Woodson and Darrell Revis among notable cornerbacks.

Cowboys wide receiver CeeDee Lamb, who has missed two games with a high ankle sprain, did rehab work outside on Wednesday for the first time since his Week 3 injury. His Week 6 status remains uncertain. Stephen Jones said Lamb could return within the next two weeks.

Leicester pharmacist Zameer Ghumra was jailed for six years for disseminating terrorist propaganda after showing a child a beheading video. The court heard he tried to radicalise children and that two boys suffered psychological harm.

Larry Connors’ 3-day high/low strategy buys an ETF after three consecutive days of lower highs and lower lows, subject to criteria involving its 200-day and 5-day moving averages. Originally tested on 20 ETFs through 2008, it was reassessed alongside five additional ETFs. Thirteen of the original 20 performed worse after the initial test, but the strategy still showed some promise. The portfolio test allowed up to five positions, with 20% of equity allocated to each; its worst drawdown occurred in July 2011.

NewMarket’s fuel and lubricant additives business has strong margins and cash flow, but sales have been pressured by longer oil-change intervals, improved fuel efficiency, and limited exposure to faster-growing diesel additives. Its acquisition in Mexico and new Singapore plant could expand its reach in emerging markets, where vehicle volumes are growing. The author expects modest long-term revenue growth and improved free cash flow after the plant is completed, but believes the share price already reflects substantial growth and does not offer an attractive valuation.

Nippon Express said an employee falsified inspection stamps on government-stockpiled rice repackaged after bags became wet or tore, affecting 251 bags. Fifteen bags were sent for livestock feed, with no reported health damage; none reached human consumers, and the remainder will be incinerated. Mitsubishi Corp., which entrusted storage to Nippon Express, received a ministry business improvement order.

The $760 million Bifrost subsea cable is ready for commercial service, connecting Singapore and the U.S. West Coast through Guam, with branches across Southeast Asia and to Oregon. Led by Keppel with Meta and Telin Indonesia, the 20,000-kilometre system is designed to provide over 260 terabits per second of capacity. After weather and regulatory delays, it is expected to increase regional bandwidth and network resilience.

David Jones will not renew model Jesinta Franklin’s contract after two years and has named Victoria Lee its newest ambassador. Fellow ambassador Jessica Gomes’s future with the retailer is reportedly unclear.

Irrfan Khan revealed that he had been diagnosed with a neuro-endocrine tumor and traveled to London for treatment. He later shared a poem on Instagram. The film fraternity asked for privacy for his family. His film *Blackmail* was set for release, while Vishal Bhardwaj postponed another film until Khan’s return.
EON Resources published a slide deck. The chart spans September 25–30, 2025, with values ranging from 0.4121 to 0.5074.

Thirty-seven lawyers, including 10 incoming partners, are moving from Cadwalader to Orrick. They will work in a new Charlotte office and in London, Washington, D.C., and New York. Cadwalader has lost nearly a fifth of its partnership this year and is adding a second managing partner and lawyers to strengthen core practices.

A survey of 147 second-year engineering and technical management students at a Hungarian university examined which skills they value for employment and what they expect from higher education. Both groups prioritized problem-solving, but engineering students placed more emphasis on specialized and technical knowledge, while technical management students favored decision-making and analytical skills. Most respondents valued studying abroad for improving foreign-language skills. The groups did not differ significantly in their views of what drives graduates’ career success, though some expectations of university training differed. The authors recommend integrating technical and interpersonal skills into curricula, while cautioning that the small, non-probability sample limits generalization.

The agreement charges officers and seamen for expenses caused by misconduct and for vessel property lost or damaged through their neglect. The master may reassign those found unfit after a fair trial, with corresponding changes to their shares. Those unable to complete the voyage because of sickness or death receive a share proportional to their service. Crew who fulfill their duties are paid in San Francisco for their share of the catch at specified oil and whalebone rates; the whalebone rate depends on the fleet’s total catch. Bringing distilled liquor aboard, except for medical use, forfeits the violator’s entire share. Officials certified copies of the shipping paper in 1893 and 1900.

Plymouth Argyle beat relegation rivals Gillingham 2-1 through goals from Joel Grant and a 90th-minute winner by Toumani Diagouraga. The win lifted Argyle off the bottom of League One, leaving them in the bottom four only on goal difference. Ryan Taylor impressed on his return from injury, and a youth football initiative brought about 2,700 children and coaches to Home Park. Concerns remain over Argyle’s goalkeepers: injuries forced them to field their seventh of the season. Graham Carey also struggled, though his cross led to the winning goal.

Petronas has approached about a dozen potential buyers, including Shell, ExxonMobil and PTTEP, about an estimated $1 billion stake in Malaysia’s offshore SK316 gas block. It has begun sharing project data and expects bids within weeks. Petronas is seeking partners with technology to develop the block’s fields, including Kasawari, whose high CO2 content requires significant investment. The potential sale comes as Petronas cuts costs amid low oil prices.

Two students were suspended after a teacher saw a Nazi salute directed at a classmate during at least a month of anti-Semitic bullying at Sydney Secondary College. Three students were disciplined for racist behaviour, parents of 18 students were contacted, and support was offered to those targeted.

AMD states that this informational document may contain errors or change without notice. It disclaims warranties and liability, grants no intellectual property license, and directs readers to applicable agreements or sales terms.

The passage contrasts racial income disparities with a larger wealth gap: in 2015, median white family wealth was $171,000, compared with $17,600 for black families. It links part of this gap to differences in homeownership and argues that ownership helps families build equity. The author criticizes Durham affordable-housing policies that produce costly units without giving residents equity, and favors helping people buy, repair, and retain existing homes through partnerships, volunteer labor, and property-tax deferrals. The proposed approach aims to preserve housing and reduce racial wealth disparities.

The speaker said the team started slowly, turned over pucks and lacked the physical play that had brought success earlier in the series. Those mistakes gave the opponent scoring chances and left the goaltender exposed in a seven-goal loss. The team now has time to recover before Wednesday’s home game and a chance to force Game 7.

On May 29, 2001, Maharashtra State Electricity Board stopped buying power from Dabhol Power Company, saying it considered their power purchase agreement void. The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission temporarily barred Dabhol from accessing MSEB’s escrow account or advancing arbitration proceedings. The central government offered undisclosed proposals to help resolve the dispute but said it would not buy Dabhol’s power. Talks on tariffs continued without a settlement. The Centre also sought a 60-day extension to conciliation over an unpaid bill, while Indian and foreign lenders considered their exposure to the project.

Idris Elba works with Project Literacy to raise awareness of adult illiteracy, which he says is widespread and difficult to detect because people may hide it. He describes the importance of reading to his children and says literacy can help incarcerated young people develop self-awareness. The organization also helped former illiterate mother Wanda Steward turn stories she invented for her children into a book. Elba says progress on diversity in Hollywood and society is slow but lasting.

Newfoundland and Labrador school trustees rejected most proposed rural school closures, citing student safety concerns despite projected annual savings of $1.7 million. Four schools will remain open; trustees voted to close an empty school and consolidate two adjoining schools. School reviews will begin again.

On August 2, 2017, Tesla reported its financial results for the quarter ended June 30 by posting its Second Quarter 2017 Shareholder Letter on its website. The letter is attached to its Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.1.

A cross-sectional study of 302 heroin users receiving methadone at a clinic in Dar es Salaam found lung function decline in 28.5%. Restrictive abnormalities were the most common pattern (13.2%), followed by obstructive (11%) and mixed abnormalities (4.3%). Underweight, HIV infection, and a history of pulmonary tuberculosis were associated with greater odds of lung function decline. The authors recommend routine lung function screening for this population.
The order was reversed; the appellant’s ten-dollar costs and disbursements were payable from the estate.

The paper analyzes “personal attention” ASMR videos, using Olivia Kissper’s work to examine how role-play and digital media create mediated intimacy. Drawing on affect and performance studies, it proposes an affect-centered view of sexuality in which watching ASMR videos can be understood as a sexual practice.

The passage argues that slavery is often overlooked in accounts of pedagogy, despite historical links between teaching, surveillance, and control. Drawing on Foucault’s panopticism, it traces these links from enslaved pedagogues in Ancient Greece to racial chattel slavery in the United States, where monitoring, violence, and recordkeeping were used to control labor and restrict education. It also describes “fugitive pedagogy” as practices Black educators developed in response to surveillance and violence.

The author proposes “surveillance pedagogy” as a framework for examining how teaching and learning generate information that can be collected and used to influence behavior. Digital learning platforms extend these practices by extracting and processing student data, often with limited transparency or educator oversight. The framework is intended to help educators study the relationship between slavery’s legacy, digital surveillance, and contemporary education.

At Amazon’s May 25, 2022 annual meeting, shareholders approved a 20-for-1 stock split and a proportionate increase in authorized common shares. The amendment became effective May 27, with split-adjusted trading expected June 6. Shareholders elected all listed directors, ratified Ernst & Young as auditor, and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. All listed shareholder proposals failed.

The passage introduces BALLAST, an active-learning method for placing free-floating ocean drifters to improve estimates of time-dependent currents. It uses a spatio-temporal, vector-output Gaussian process to simulate possible drifter trajectories and an information-gain objective to choose placement locations at predetermined times. The authors also develop a posterior-sampling method for more efficient computation. Numerical results on synthetic and high-fidelity ocean-current models suggest benefits for sequential drifter deployment.

The Citi Simplicity® Card offers 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for 21 months and purchases for 12 months. Afterward, a variable APR of 17.99%–28.74% applies. Balance transfers must be completed within four months and carry a 3% fee (minimum $5); later transfers carry a 5% fee (minimum $5). The card has no annual fee, late fees, or penalty rate. A credit score of 670–850 is recommended, but approval is not guaranteed. Motley Fool Money receives advertising compensation, which may affect offer placement but not its product ratings.

The Pennsylvania Superior Court affirmed Clay Williams’s life sentence for the first-degree murder of Mizael Velez during an attempted robbery. It found Williams’s suppression and evidence-sufficiency claims waived because his appellate statement lacked necessary detail, and his objection to a detective’s reading of a witness statement waived because his brief did not adequately develop it. The court dismissed his ineffective-assistance claims without prejudice to collateral review and denied his petition to remand for further inquiry into a juror’s disclosure.

The Fifth Circuit affirmed Joe Ezeokeke’s 138-month sentence for possessing cocaine with intent to distribute. It upheld an obstruction-of-justice adjustment because his false trial testimony concerned material issues. The court also found that his arguments did not overcome the presumption that his within-guidelines sentence was reasonable.

An Ontario education funding analysis says school fundraising brings in $548 million, averaging $280 per student, while a grant for schools in needy areas provides about $179 per student. The report says fundraising can offset the grant’s intended effect because boards receiving less grant funding tend to raise more money. It also says special education, English-as-a-Second-Language programs and school maintenance have been underfunded for two decades. Although provincial education spending has risen, the Elementary Teachers’ Federation of Ontario is calling for regular reviews of the funding system and more support for students with special education and mental health needs.

In this non-peer-reviewed study of 1,284 Kailuan cohort participants, greater long-term visit-to-visit blood pressure variability was associated with higher cerebral small vessel disease burden, lacunae, and visible perivascular spaces. Pulse pressure variability showed particularly strong associations in participants under 60, while associations with disease burden were more evident among those with hypertension. Because MRI was performed only once, the study could not rule out reverse causation.

The passage cautions that electrostatic discharge can damage the integrated circuits and lists April 2025 revisions to device features, specifications, and documentation. It also provides packaging and assembly guidance, explains ordering information, identifies automotive-qualified variants, and states TI’s resource-use and warranty terms.

A host can set a password to lock a card and later unlock it. Password registers retain their contents through power cycles; cards with a set password lock automatically at power-on. Locked cards permit limited commands but no data access. Lock/unlock requires a selected card in transfer state.

Northmont High School Student Assistance Counselor Sheree Coffman told the Northmont Rotary Club how the school identifies and supports students facing difficulties such as depression, substance abuse and family crises. Its programs combine schoolwide prevention, support for at-risk students and individual intervention. They include an alternative to expulsion, peer support and U.N.I.T.Y. Day, which aims to foster understanding and belonging.

In a lecture marking Bitcoin’s tenth anniversary, Gary Gensler reviews its growth before examining payment systems. He identifies costs, intermediaries, delayed settlement, limited financial inclusion, fraud, privacy and cross-border transfers as pain points. Blockchain could lower verification and networking costs, enable faster finality and support programmable payments, but it also faces challenges involving scalability, transaction costs, error resolution, governance, regulation and adoption.

The class debates whether immediate finality is preferable to consumer protections such as chargebacks, and whether existing payment systems could improve without blockchain. Examples include India’s non-blockchain payment infrastructure and BitPay’s conversion of merchants’ Bitcoin receipts into fiat currency. A proposed use of cryptocurrency as a bridge between fiat currencies might speed cross-border payments, particularly small transfers, but adds exchange costs, volatility risk and liquidity requirements.

Bollinger Bands place upper and lower bands around a moving average using price volatility. The passage describes a ChatGPT-generated strategy that holds SPY while both Bollinger Bands are inside the Keltner Channels and sells when either moves outside. A backtest using SPY data from 1993, unadjusted for dividends and splits, found low, erratic returns and a substantial drawdown.

Geologists found rare geological pipes in western Queensland that may contain platinum, gold, rare earth elements and other minerals used in advanced technologies. The discovery, called the Diamantina Minerals Province, lies in a previously under-explored region. Natural Resources Minister Anthony Lynham said the findings could create economic opportunities and provide a basis for commercial exploration.

Ocwen Financial settled with Connecticut over mortgage servicing issues, bringing its settlements to 28 of 31 jurisdictions that took regulatory action. The agreement includes restrictions on acquiring new servicing rights, a planned move from REALServicing to Black Knight’s platform, and additional Connecticut borrower communications and reporting. Noncompliance with certain terms could trigger a $500,000 fine.

Hubble images show NGC 4536, a galaxy 50 million light-years away in the Virgo constellation, forming stars rapidly and consuming gas. Astronomers are unsure how it acquired so much gas; a galactic collision is possible.

The May 25, 2001 VentureWire People newsletter reports executive appointments across management, venture capital, sales, operations and technology. Nicholas Schacht became president of GlobalLearningSystems; Frank Vaculin, Scott Kauffman and Marco Cupidi were named CEOs of TeaLeaf Technology, Coremetrics and hi-flier, respectively. It also lists executive searches for finance, sales, marketing, engineering and other roles, and notes that the next issue will appear May 29 after Memorial Day.

The article ranks Taylor Swift’s 20 best breakup songs, highlighting how they express anger, regret, yearning, and relief. “All Too Well (10 Minute Version)” tops the list, followed by “Dear John” and “The 1”; three songs from “The Tortured Poets Department” also appear.

At the NATO Parliamentary Assembly’s spring session in Tbilisi, President Paolo Alli emphasized territorial integrity, Georgia’s armed forces reforms and NATO integration. Georgian leaders discussed Euro-Atlantic integration and military improvements. The session was set to adopt a declaration supporting Georgia’s integration.

Sarah Illig was bitten on the arm by a nurse shark while swimming at a Caribbean resort during her honeymoon. Her husband filmed the incident. Illig said she had flesh wounds that were healing well without stitches. The passage describes such bites as rare.

Kent McFarland of the Vermont Center for Ecostudies will discuss mercury along elevational gradients at Lyndon State College on February 15 at 4 p.m. The free, public Natural Science Weekly Seminar series continues through May 3.

A deputy collector certified a copy of the bark Cape Horn Pigeon’s crew list in 1891, and the Secretary of State certified copies of related documents in 1900. The shipping agreement set terms for a voyage from San Francisco lasting no more than twelve months. It specified crew shares, freight costs, interest on advances, duties, and restrictions on trade and leaving the vessel. It also required logbook records of misconduct and disability and imposed pay forfeitures for specified violations.

Novak Djokovic beat qualifier Jaume Munar 7-6(1) 6-4 6-4 in the French Open second round, but said he was dissatisfied with his performance. Djokovic struggled with his serve, which he has repeatedly adjusted since elbow surgery. He said he is not playing at the level he wants but will keep trying. He next faces Roberto Bautista Agut for a place in the last 16.

Tesla’s January 23, 2018 Form 8-K announces a 100% performance-based stock option award granted to CEO and Chairman Elon Musk on January 21. The award requires approval by a majority of votes cast at a special stockholder meeting, excluding shares owned directly or indirectly by Elon or Kimbal Musk. Tesla plans to file a proxy statement and includes its January 23 press release as an exhibit.

Wall Street indexes rose Monday, led by technology and energy stocks as oil prices climbed. Investors expected the Federal Reserve to raise rates later in the week, while markets appeared largely unmoved by an attempted attack at a New York commuter hub. At 2:38 p.m. ET, the Dow was up 0.13 percent, the S&P 500 0.23 percent and the Nasdaq 0.46 percent. CenturyLink and Bluebird Bio gained on company news, while bitcoin-related stocks rose as bitcoin futures began trading in the United States.

Mr. Grew urged nations to support the proposed world organization despite its likely imperfections, warning that another war could destroy entire peoples and civilizations. He also called for a stronger inter-American system before asking Mr. Rockefeller to preside in his absence. Ambassador Mora proposed that states not be obliged to join military operations over distant regional disputes that did not threaten world peace. Dr. Pasvolsky said the Security Council should judge a dispute’s significance and determine which nations would assist. Mexico’s ambassador argued that such decisions should not rest with regions and that forces from uninvolved countries might be preferable. Honduras’s ambassador favored extending inter-American solidarity worldwide. Mora left his proposal open for further discussion, and the meeting turned to proposed amendments to the Dumbarton Oaks articles.

The speaker says the loss was disappointing and an apparent stanchion bounce in overtime was a tough break. Traffic and contact are common, calls do not always go both ways, and the focus is on winning the next game.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2020 Form 10-K describes its GPU and Tegra Processor businesses, which serve gaming, professional visualization, data center and automotive markets. The company develops computing hardware and software but relies on third parties to manufacture, assemble and test its products. Dell accounted for 11% of fiscal 2020 revenue, while sales outside the United States accounted for 92%. NVIDIA had 13,775 employees as of January 26, 2020, and reported $10.90 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at fiscal year-end. The filing discusses risks including competition, cybersecurity, supplier dependence, demand forecasting, international operations, product defects, acquisitions and regulatory changes.

The Czech crown rebounded from an 18-month low against the euro as the central bank’s commitment to cap its value expired on Friday. The bank could remove the cap at any time afterward, leaving investors uncertain about the currency’s direction and bracing for volatility. Czech bonds were mixed, while Polish and Hungarian bond yields remained low. A dealer said investors closing crown positions might move funds into other central European currencies.

The New Jersey Superior Court held that sick pay and wages received for personal and family illness days cannot be deducted from the plaintiff’s lost-wages recovery under the collateral source statute. The plaintiff used accumulated employment benefits while recovering from accident injuries, leaving those benefits unavailable for future use or retirement cash-out. Because she surrendered benefits in exchange for the payments, a lost-wages award would not constitute duplicate recovery.

Nashville’s Stanley Cup Final game against Pittsburgh coincides with CMA Fest. Luke Bryan will open the worldwide telecast with a performance from the rooftop of Tootsie’s Orchid Lounge. Pittsburgh’s PPG Arena is sold out, and screens across Nashville will show the performance and game.

The first speaker pledges to enforce the Taiwan Relations Act, end restrictions on meetings with Taiwanese officials that the Act does not require, and consider the views of both Taiwan and the People’s Republic of China while protecting U.S. interests. In a subsequent address, George Bush argues that the Carter administration has weakened America’s position abroad and calls its portrayal of Ronald Reagan as a potential cause of war false and irresponsible.

The passage argues that Ontario’s education system continues to exclude disabled and marginalized students despite policies promoting inclusion. It traces the history of segregated special education, describes how assessments and Individual Education Plans shape students’ access to services and placements, and notes the disproportionate placement of racialized students in some special education categories. It identifies inadequate planning, funding, teacher training, and policy implementation as barriers. The passage recommends involving disabled students and educators in policy development, improving teacher preparation, and ensuring that inclusive policies are reflected in classroom practice.

The FDA approved a second generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone, allowing three U.S. companies to produce it. The approval drew opposition from anti-abortion groups but is unlikely to change access. Amgen said a 12,000-patient trial found that its cholesterol-lowering drug Repatha prevented a combined measure of heart disease death, heart attack, and a common type of stroke. The company did not release full results.

The passage introduces SafeBehavior, an inference-time defense against jailbreak attacks on large language models. It argues that defenses relying only on input analysis can miss concealed malicious intent. SafeBehavior uses three stages: intention inference screens queries, self-introspection checks generated responses, and self-revision rewrites uncertain responses to reduce risk while preserving user intent. The authors aim to maintain normal task performance and limit computational overhead. They describe an evaluation against five jailbreak attacks and seven existing defenses, and review white-box and black-box attacks alongside prompt-level and model-level defenses.

This excerpt from the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 documentation warns that prototype “X” devices are for internal evaluation, have an undefined end-use failure rate, and should not be used in production; only qualified production devices should be used. It lists development tools, training, documentation, and support resources. The September 2025 revision removed DGS32 package information and updated specifications and device tables. Packaging notes cover thermal-pad soldering, optional vias, and stencil design. TI cautions that electrostatic discharge can damage the devices and provides its resources “as is.”

This qualitative study developed and validated a two-week critical multicultural education module for preservice English language teachers in Türkiye. After a 15-person pilot and revisions, the module was delivered to 86 students, with 10 interviewed afterward. Participants reported more positive attitudes toward diversity, greater understanding of social issues, and increased awareness of critical teaching approaches. They also identified limited time, dense content, and insufficient guidance on taking critical action as challenges. The authors recommend extending the module and conducting further research.

Apple reported that on May 11, 2020, it issued $8.5 billion in senior unsecured notes: $2 billion at 0.750% due 2023, $2.25 billion at 1.125% due 2025, $1.75 billion at 1.650% due 2030, and $2.5 billion at 2.650% due 2050. Interest is payable semiannually beginning November 11, 2020.

Blake Geoffrion won the 2010 Hobey Baker Memorial Award, continuing a hockey family history that includes his father Dan, grandfather Bernie Geoffrion and great-grandfather Howie Morenz. Morenz joined the Montreal Canadiens in 1923 and helped them win three Stanley Cups while earning three Hart Trophies. Traded to Chicago in 1934, he later played for the New York Rangers before returning to Montreal. In January 1937, he broke his leg in a game against Chicago. He died of a heart attack on March 8, and thousands attended his funeral at the Montreal Forum.

An INFINITI-sponsored article proposes five bucket-list challenges: take a solo road trip, start a business, volunteer abroad, face a fear such as skydiving, and pursue a physical goal. It presents these activities as ways to push personal boundaries.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022, reports net sales of $116.4 billion, up 7% from a year earlier, while operating income fell to $3.7 billion from $8.9 billion. The company recorded a $3.8 billion net loss, including a $7.6 billion valuation loss on its Rivian investment. North America and International reported operating losses; AWS operating income rose to $6.5 billion. Operating activities used $2.8 billion in cash. Amazon acquired MGM for approximately $6.1 billion in cash, net of cash acquired, and repurchased $2.7 billion of common stock.

Pakistan’s higher education enrollment grew substantially after the Higher Education Commission was established in 2002, and women’s share of enrollment increased. Using secondary data, the study finds that this growth has not been equitable: access remains concentrated in urban, lower-poverty areas, while rural and poorer populations face limited institutions and enrollment. Gender gaps persist in disadvantaged regions, and high private-university fees further restrict access. The authors recommend more well-resourced public institutions in underserved areas, targeted financial aid, and greater support for disadvantaged students. They note that their analysis focuses on broad access patterns rather than institutional or individual barriers.

Digital leaders build a data culture by encouraging learning and responsible experimentation, sharing governed data, measuring progress, and aligning teams around clear goals. These practices can give employees flexibility while connecting their work to company strategy. Digital laggards more often restrict data, discourage risk, emphasize short-term processes, and set goals that employees struggle to connect to measurable outcomes.

Building a learning mindset takes sustained effort, and even digital leaders face tensions between experimentation and failure or between analysis and timely decisions. The passage describes a pharmaceutical team that automated compliance checks through controlled experimentation and a retailer that introduced real-time sales reporting. It also identifies four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—reflecting different cultural and technical strengths and gaps.

Abington Heights senior Theodore “Ted” Lambert began playing cello in fifth grade after a friend’s suggestion. He has served as principal cellist in school and regional orchestras, earned state-level rankings and was named WVIA artist of the year for performing arts. He also performs at community events and mentors other students. Lambert plans to study chemical engineering at the University of Delaware while continuing to play music.

The WHO said Dengvaxia should be used only for people previously infected with dengue, requiring a test that is not yet available. Sanofi defended the vaccine’s safety and said no deaths had resulted from it. Amid concern over 65 deaths in the vaccination program, Senator Franklin Drilon opposed indicting former President Aquino, arguing that he lacked malice and that Dengvaxia had not been conclusively linked to the deaths. The passage criticizes Drilon’s stance.

Jordan Montgomery pitched four perfect innings in the Yankees’ 3-0 combined no-hitter against the Tigers. Manager Joe Girardi said the left-hander could make the Opening Day roster as a reliever, though his future is as a starter. A return to Triple-A remains likely amid competition for the Yankees’ final two rotation spots.

A Sunshine Coast woman was sexually abused by her stepbrother from age eight to 16. She reported the abuse years later, and he was arrested in 2015. Now 33, he pleaded guilty to rape and child sex offences. He was sentenced to five years in jail and made eligible for parole on August 10, 2015.

The whitepaper was a joint effort by Microsoft Research Asia’s Societal AI team and researchers from industry and academia, with contributions from interns and a design team. The authors thank collaborating researchers and acknowledge Lidong Zhou’s support and suggestions.

LimeWire AI Studio lets users generate and edit images with AI models including Stable Diffusion and DALL-E 2, then publish their creations publicly or for subscribers. Published content is automatically minted as an NFT on Polygon or Algorand. Creators can earn ad revenue and a 2.5% royalty when their content is traded, with earnings paid monthly in LMWR tokens. A free plan offers limited image generation; paid plans cost $9.99–$99 per month and provide more credits and features. LimeWire plans to add AI music and video generation tools.

The lecture introduces linearized gravity as a way to solve Einstein’s field equations for spacetimes close to flat. It treats the metric as a flat background plus a small perturbation and discards terms beyond first order. Infinitesimal coordinate changes act as gauge transformations: they alter the perturbation without changing curvature. Using a trace-reversed perturbation and choosing Lorenz gauge simplifies the field equations to a wave equation. For a static, non-relativistic fluid, the result recovers the Newtonian limit. The lecturer also notes that a rotating body’s mass currents produce an additional gravitational effect and plans to examine dynamic sources and gravitational radiation next.

A study of 32 students, professors, and academic leaders at six Mexican universities found that online learning can expand access, especially for people balancing study with work or family. However, limited internet access, inadequate devices, and uneven institutional resources can deepen disparities. Interviewees also reported challenges with teacher preparation, student engagement, and collaboration. They favored using online learning alongside in-person education, supported by better infrastructure, teacher training, and student services.

An April 2001 collection of articles reports that average U.S. CEO pay reached $13.1 million in 2000 despite weaker returns. Enron’s Jeffrey Skilling received $72.5 million, while Kenneth Lay received $140.8 million. In India, a $22 million payment dispute involving Enron-owned Dabhol deepened as a Maharashtra committee recommended renegotiating both project phases. Other articles cover strong utility earnings after a cold winter, alleged excess profits in California’s power market, emerging electricity trading in France, and plans to privatize Brazil’s Copel.

The writer says esthetician Renée Rouleau previously helped identify their melasma and the cause of breakouts after desert trips. During a later facial, Rouleau recommended her Rapid Response Detox Masque for inflamed skin and premenstrual acne. After using it weekly for a month, the writer reports fewer breakouts and says it leaves their skin glowing. The $61 gel mask contains tea tree oil, Chinese licorice, manuka oil and a salicylic acid complex. Rouleau recommends exfoliating first and leaving the mask on for about 15 minutes.

This AMD Geode CS5535 Revision A3 specification update lists silicon issues, their effects, and available workarounds. Reported failures include system hangs from high PCI I/O addresses or certain interrupt and register accesses; unreliable DMA, UDMA, LPC, USB, and wake-event operation; and incorrect register status or writes. Recommended measures include avoiding affected access patterns, disabling specific clock gating, using DWORD-aligned PRDs and single-transfer DMA, and adjusting software or hardware configurations. Some issues have no operational impact or no resolution.

The passage describes a force transmission mechanism for a teleoperated surgical instrument. A drive pulley moves a cable that rotates a driven pulley, converting rotary input into translation of a rod that actuates an end effector. Exemplary features include cable guides, independently adjustable sheaves for cable pre-tensioning, and a ball joint that permits the rod to rotate with the instrument shaft. Pulley dimensions and joint placement can be selected to provide greater force where the end effector needs it.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. They support soft start, switching frequencies from 100 kHz to 2 MHz, and internal-oscillator, external-synchronization, or primary-secondary operation. Device-dependent features include primary and synchronous-rectifier outputs, programmable duty-cycle limits, dead time, leading-edge blanking, and slope compensation. Protection features include pulse skipping, overcurrent limiting with hiccup restart, external fault shutdown, and thermal shutdown. The passage gives component-selection guidance and a 500-kHz, 5-V synchronous push-pull converter design example using GaN devices. It also recommends external gate drivers, a regulated and bypassed controller supply, and PCB layout practices that limit noise coupling and switching-loop area.

Clarkson College developed an interprofessional education model that emphasizes learning across professions, community involvement, service, and access for online and on-campus students. Its required, zero-credit course combines four online modules on collaborative practice with participation in knowledge, community, and service events. Faculty and staff complete a related course.

Among 428 students who completed the course and all three surveys, 88.6% reported improved ability to collaborate after the online modules. Of those students, 93% perceived further growth after participating in three events. Students’ reflections also described positive experiences with teamwork and communication. The passage attributes implementation to curriculum planning, administrative support, faculty engagement, and ongoing assessment.

The TMS320DM8127 is an integrated digital media processor combining an ARM Cortex-A8 CPU, a C674x DSP, and video and imaging coprocessors. It supports programmable audio and video processing, numerous communication and memory interfaces, and development tools for both processors. The passage describes its subsystems, memory maps, peripheral functions, pin assignments, operating requirements, and data-manual revisions.

Enron said it would restate earnings from 1997 through the first half of 2001 amid an SEC investigation into partnerships managed by former CFO Andrew Fastow, who Enron said received more than $30 million from them. Dynegy confirmed talks about a possible combination but said no terms had been agreed. As Enron’s shares fell and credit ratings were downgraded, some power and gas companies restricted their dealings with it.

The Wisconsin Department of Workforce Development awarded nearly $480,000 to seven projects to train almost 600 Milwaukee residents for local jobs. Part of $4.5 million in state funding announced after unrest in Sherman Park, the projects cover health care, manufacturing, caregiving, construction and customer service.

The lecture examines black holes through the Schwarzschild solution. An infalling body crosses \(r=2GM\) in finite proper time, although Schwarzschild coordinate time places the crossing at infinity. Light emitted near that radius becomes increasingly redshifted, revealing a failure of the time coordinate rather than a physical singularity. Alternative coordinates show that \(r=2GM\) is an event horizon: once crossed, no light or other allowed trajectory can return to the exterior. The tidal singularity lies at \(r=0\).

The lecture also introduces charged Reissner–Nordström and spinning Kerr black holes. The No-Hair theorem states that stationary black holes are described by the Kerr–Newman family, characterized by mass, spin, and charge. During collapse, radiation removes other features as the black hole approaches that form.

Page reported that the Allies’ joint reply to the President’s note would be friendly and sent after Russia approved the draft; he denied reports that Italy had delayed it. Droppers reported that Greece’s preliminary reply was conciliatory but indefinite, and that conditions imposed on Greece had to be accepted within 48 hours and fulfilled before the blockade would be lifted. Sharp received the Allied reply and a separate Belgian note of gratitude to the United States. The Allies planned to publish their reply on January 12. They supported the idea of a league of nations but said peace first required reparation, restitution, and guarantees.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU is designed to accelerate AI, high-performance computing, and data analytics workloads. Its third-generation Tensor Cores support TF32, BF16, FP64, and other data types, while 2:4 structured sparsity can double Tensor Core throughput by skipping zero values. The GPU includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, and controls for cache residency and data compression. Multi-Instance GPU technology can partition one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, and improved fault handling support multi-GPU and multi-tenant systems. CUDA 11 adds support for features including asynchronous copies, barriers, and task-graph acceleration. The DGX A100 system combines eight A100 GPUs for AI workloads.

The October 5, 2000 VentureWire reports Broadcom’s planned $640 million acquisition of Element 14, Sony Broadband’s launch of a digital media incubator, and the launch of GameChange with up to $100 million in investments. It also covers a $200 million first close for a Polish investment fund, Productopia’s closure, and CyOptics’ $57 million financing. Other items report startup funding, product launches, acquisitions, leadership appointments, new venture funds, and corrections to earlier issues.

The passage recommends nine podcasts for learning about personal and business finances. They cover side hustles, passive income, managing money as a young adult, investing, financial planning and understanding markets. Hosts include Nick Loper, Farnoosh Torabi, Pat Flynn, Shannah Compton Game, Joshua Sheats and David Stein.

Stafford Global offers open days and webinars for working professionals interested in online or distance learning. A University of Northampton MBA webinar was scheduled for 1 May 2018. Open-day attendees could receive a free CV review and eligibility assessment.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition system with a source-synchronous output interface. It offers data randomization to reduce interference, averaging modes, and test patterns for interface verification. Speed-boost mode converts a selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS while the other channels remain idle. Configuration uses banked registers accessed through SPI, including a multi-device daisy-chain option; operation after power-up or reset requires an initialization sequence and a free-running sampling clock. An ATE application example reports 0.0015% total unadjusted error at 25°C ±5°C after calibration and 7.5µs settling to 99.95% of full scale in wide-bandwidth mode. The passage also provides power-supply and board-layout guidance.

The December 6, 2000, VentureWire newsletter reports that Oxygen Media is cutting 65 jobs and restructuring its online business; Softbank has reportedly halted investments through two European joint ventures; Innovance Networks raised more than $75 million; and Merrill Lynch launched a venture fund for employees. It also covers numerous startup financings, Babygear.com’s closure and bankruptcy filing, product launches, company renamings, acquisitions, executive appointments, and venture fund news.

U.S. unemployment claims fell by 12,000 to 260,000 in the week ended Sept. 30, though hurricanes made labor-market trends difficult to assess. The August trade deficit narrowed 2.7% to $42.4 billion as exports reached their highest level since December 2014. The smaller deficit could help soften the storms’ expected drag on third-quarter growth. The U.S. trade deficit with China rose 4.0% to $34.9 billion.

California lawmakers advanced a bill to the full Assembly that would require 60 percent of the state’s energy to come from specified renewable sources by 2030 and set a goal of obtaining the rest from carbon-free sources by 2045. Supporters say it would promote clean energy and economic growth; critics warn it could raise electricity costs. Lawmakers are also considering changes to the regional energy grid and utilities’ wildfire liability.

Authorities fatally shot a 28-year-old man in Duarte on Friday while seeking him in connection with a Pasadena birthday-party shooting that injured two teenagers. A woman in his vehicle was shot, expected to survive and arrested on suspicion of possessing narcotics. The 19-year-old victim remained in critical condition; the 16-year-old girl was treated and released.

Mary Chinery-Hesse will become the University of Ghana’s first woman chancellor in August 2018, replacing Kofi Annan. She will also be the first woman to hold the position at a Ghanaian public university. Her previous roles include deputy director general of the International Labour Organization.

NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2022 revenue of $7.10 billion, up 50% year over year, and net income of $2.46 billion, up 84%. Gaming and Data Center revenue rose 42% and 55%, respectively. For the first nine months, revenue was $19.27 billion and net income was $6.75 billion. At October 31, 2021, cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $19.30 billion. NVIDIA’s proposed acquisition of Arm remained subject to regulatory review, with regulators expressing concerns. The company expected supply constraints to continue into fiscal 2023.

Mr. Solanko discussed travel restrictions on Finnish Legation personnel. He was told that Mr. Mikkola need not return early from New York, while Mr. Wrede had already been instructed to return immediately. The Department offered to expedite inquiries about proposed visits. The Finnish Minister later said Helsinki’s restrictions applied to all diplomats and asked that restrictions on him be lifted. A report from Finland said public opinion showed satisfaction at U.S. military reverses in East Asia but alarm at growing U.S. cooperation with the Soviet Union.

William P. Clark argues that expanded U.S.–Soviet talks and a summit are premature without evidence of Soviet concessions. He recommends first testing Moscow’s position in another high-level meeting and warns that intensified dialogue could create public pressure for U.S. concessions. In a separate memorandum, Paula Dobriansky rejects Ambassador Hartman’s proposal to abandon the zero-zero arms-control option. She argues that deterrence requires restoring nuclear parity through arms control and deployments, while noting Hartman’s concern that continued adherence to zero-zero could threaten alliance unity and INF deployment.

The passage presents a constructive formalization of nominal sets in Rocq. It uses setoids, typeclasses, generalized rewriting, and permutations represented as lists of swaps to formalize support, freshness, name abstraction, and finitely supported functions without assuming functional extensionality. It also formalizes the Freshness Theorem and the Freshness Condition for Binders. The authors have derived an α-recursion principle for the λ-calculus; an α-induction principle remains future work.

Accern rated this week’s coverage of Senseonics Holdings somewhat positive, with a sentiment score of 0.19, but said it was somewhat unlikely to affect the share price immediately. Shares rose 5.03% to $3.34 during Friday midday trading. Senseonics develops glucose monitoring systems, including the implantable Eversense system.

Netflix grew from a DVD-rental company into a global streaming leader by licensing content, producing original programming, investing in technology, and expanding internationally. Its culture emphasizes independent decisions, candid feedback, information sharing, high-performing employees, and few rules. As media companies withdrew licensed content and launched competing services, Netflix increased spending on originals.

Netflix viewed India as a potential source of 100 million new subscribers, but had an estimated two million there in 2019. Cheaper mobile data had expanded online viewing, while competitors offered lower prices, advertising-supported access, sports, and content in regional languages. Netflix introduced a $2.85 mobile-only plan and increased investment in Indian content. The case asks whether growth in India would require changes to Netflix’s pricing, advertising policy, content choices, or preference for operating without local partners.

Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez Bezos, a public couple since 2019, have worn complementary outfits at premieres, fashion shows, galas, and other events. Their June 2025 wedding celebrations featured a black tuxedo and lace bridal gown for the ceremony, followed by other eveningwear looks. Months later, they wore matching gray ensembles during Paris Fashion Week.

The newly inaugurated President pledges to execute all laws faithfully, recommend policies to Congress, and use the veto when he judges it necessary. He urges calm, impartial handling of post-rebellion issues and protection of personal, property, religious, and political rights. He calls for paying the public debt, eventually resuming specie payments, collecting revenue responsibly, reducing spending, and rebuilding commerce. He advocates mutual respect in foreign affairs, policies intended to lead Indigenous people toward citizenship, and ratification of the Fifteenth Amendment to address suffrage. He closes by asking citizens to help strengthen the Union.

Linda Farr, 68, received a 20-month sentence suspended for two years after admitting gross negligence manslaughter of her 86-year-old mother, Doreen Shufflebotham. Medical experts estimated that Shufflebotham had not moved from her chair for eight to 12 months before her death in September 2016. She had a fractured femur, an infection and several other serious conditions. Local residents criticised the suspended sentence.

The President calls for national reconciliation and constitutional protection of every citizen’s rights. He urges honest Southern self-government that treats both races equally, cooperation across party and racial lines, and support for free schools. He advocates civil-service reform, a six-year presidential term without reelection, paper currency convertible into coin, and an early return to specie payments. In foreign affairs, he favors noninterference and peaceful arbitration. He welcomes the lawful, peaceful resolution of the disputed presidential election and asks citizens to work together for prosperity, justice, peace, and union.

DISCARD lets SDHC and SDXC cards partially or fully de-allocate blocks; hosts must treat their contents as “don’t care.” Hosts must check DISCARD_SUPPORT before issuing CMD32, CMD33, then CMD38 with argument 00000001h. Sequence or address errors reset the operation. SPI is unsupported, and the busy timeout is 250 ms.

The passage describes stackless assembler procedures that establish and remove a pre-memory stack. Stack initialization allocates a region for each processor core, configures addressing and MTRRs, and creates a UEFI_SEC_PEI_HAND_OFF instance. Stack removal disables Cache-as-RAM mode and flushes cache lines after the stack has moved to main memory. The host must use these procedures to create and remove the stack region.

AmdCreateStruct allocates and initializes a requested structure using pre-memory, post-memory, or host-provided storage; the host must release structures it creates. A separate procedure returns a DIMM’s read or write data-eye bitmap and requires an established stack and operational coherent HyperTransport links.

RADAR routes queries to combinations of reasoning language models and reasoning budgets based on a user’s performance–cost preference. It uses item response theory to estimate query difficulty and configuration ability, then applies multi-objective optimization to select a configuration. The black-box framework makes decisions before generation and can add new configurations through adaptive testing. The passage reports improved performance–cost tradeoffs over existing routers, including on out-of-distribution queries.

Nigel Rothsay learned that a property-transfer error had swapped ownership records for his Masterton home and his neighbour’s after police sought to restrain the neighbour’s property during a methamphetamine investigation. The conveyancing firm denied wrongdoing and blamed other parties. Police said they were working to resolve the situation, which Rothsay said had disrupted his work.

In a farewell address in Chicago, the President thanked Americans for their support and said ordinary people bring about change through participation. He cited economic recovery, expanded health coverage, marriage equality, and foreign-policy accomplishments, while pledging a peaceful transfer of power. He warned that inequality, racial division, disregard for facts, external threats, and civic disengagement endanger democracy. He urged Americans to defend shared values, seek common ground, and remain active citizens. He thanked his family, Vice President Biden, staff, and supporters, and expressed confidence in the next generation.

A slow-moving outflow boundary and Gulf moisture may produce scattered storms this evening. A system to the northwest could bring severe gusts to parts of the Tri-State, though its strength remains uncertain.

Protesters gathered at Laguna’s Main Beach on February 3 to oppose a Trump administration proposal to expand offshore oil and gas drilling. The plan would offer leases in 47 coastal areas from 2019 to 2024, including seven in the Pacific. New California leases would be the first offered since 1984.

Milwaukee ranked 13th among 50 cities in the Campaign for Black Male Achievement’s “Promise of Place” report, with its engagement score rising from 63 to 71 since 2015. The report cited the creation of Milwaukee Public Schools’ Department of Black and Latino Male Achievement and other local efforts. City leaders cautioned that increased engagement has not yet produced higher graduation rates or lower crime rates for black males. The Black Male Achievement Advisory Council is also in limbo following the firing of a city official who supported its work. The MPS department plans to improve school environments, expand manhood academies, promote positive narratives and hire more male teachers of color.

Baylor NAACP is sharing student videos under #myblackhistory to highlight diverse experiences of being African-American and celebrate the present alongside the past. The group also marked the NAACP’s 108th founders day with a screening of “A Raisin in the Sun.” It plans to support more cultural events and strengthen its involvement on campus and in the community.

Reckitt Benckiser shares have fallen at least 15% from their 52-week highs, partly amid concerns about a fatal product incident in South Korea and its $17.9 billion Mead Johnson acquisition. The passage argues that Reckitt’s established brands and profitability support its long-term prospects, though the acquisition has sharply increased its debt ratio. It also cites the $4.2 billion sale of its food business, Mead Johnson’s presence in China, and a 2.37% dividend yield as reasons the shares may appeal to investors.

After Jill Kearns’s injury claim settled, Vigilant and Travelers disputed which insurer should cover Essex Source Realty Group’s $87,500 share. The Third Circuit affirmed that Vigilant’s coverage had priority. It found Travelers’ policy unambiguous: an endorsement made its coverage excess when Essex was an additional insured under another policy, as it was under Vigilant’s.

Healthy U is a six-week workshop on managing chronic health conditions through coping strategies, problem-solving and social support. Sessions meet Tuesdays, March 6–April 10, from 9:30 a.m. to noon at the Preble County Council on Aging in Eaton. Space is limited; advance registration is required at 937-456-4947.

Constable Godknows Dube, 36, who was facing rape charges and due in court on October 26, was found hanging from a tree at Gungwe Police Base on Wednesday morning. A source suspected pressure from the case but said Dube left no suicide note. Police spokesperson Charity Charamba said she had not received a report.

In a two-year study, University of Bonn researchers exposed one group of cichlids to alarm substances signaling predators. Compared with unexposed fish, exposed males grew faster, developed larger eyes and longer dorsal-fin spines, and delayed their conspicuous breeding coloration. By about one year of age, males in both groups were equally colorful. The observed differences were limited to males, which spend more time outside breeding caves.

UBS trades at nearly twice Barclays’ tangible-book valuation, supported by a focused investment bank and stronger wealth management results. Both banks’ capital-markets revenue lagged major U.S. peers, though fixed-income weakness matters more to Barclays. Excluding an African-business writedown, Barclays’ return on tangible equity approached UBS’s, while its core operations matched UBS’s returns. Despite UBS’s wealth-management strength, expected outflows and potential margin pressure make Barclays’ discount look too large.

Six Moffat County students are graduating through online academies or homeschooling: Casey Copeland from Monte Vista Online Academy; Isaiah Harmon, Jessica Johnson and Macie Schrimsher from G.O.A.L. Academy; and Colin Jensen and John Cutler from homeschooling. Copeland earned academic honors, Johnson took college art classes, Jensen was accepted to Western State, and Cutler earned an automotive certificate. Their parents expressed pride in their accomplishments.

To erase multiple write blocks, the host issues CMD32, CMD33, then CMD38. Out-of-sequence commands reset the erase sequence and set status bits. Write-protected sectors remain intact. DAT0 stays low during erasure, and erased data is either 0 or 1, depending on the vendor.

Gympie’s former Winston House nursing home is being redeveloped into a medical care precinct and short-term accommodation facility. More than $500,000 has been budgeted for the project. Its 18 self-contained units are 95 percent occupied, with plans to expand to 30 by December. Completion of the medical facilities awaits council applications.

In a Phase 2/3 study, two 30 µg doses of BNT162b2 were 95% effective against COVID-19 compared with placebo from seven days after the second dose through 3 December 2020. Results were similar regardless of participants’ prior COVID-19 infection status.

The speaker said the league decided Rome’s four-game suspension and that Horton’s absence is a major loss. The team wanted to play hard for Horton and get back in the series. The speaker was unsure about a possible lineup change but felt comfortable playing with Krejci and Lucic. They also said the heat could cause unusual puck bounces, making simple, smart plays important.

Moyale Barracks will host defending champions Be Forward Wanderers in an Independence Day friendly on July 6. Moyale coach Charles Kamanga said the match will test both teams’ strength before they meet in the league.

The Education Department’s inspector general urged the agency to resume reviewing loan-forgiveness claims from students defrauded by for-profit colleges and set deadlines for decisions. The report noted that staff handling claims had shrunk from 19 contractors to six. More than 95,000 claims remain under review, with none approved during Education Secretary Betsy DeVos’ tenure. DeVos says new rules must balance student relief with preventing abuse.

The Big Ten is discussing a private capital deal that could bring at least $2 billion to the conference and its schools, alongside a proposed extension of its grant of rights through 2046. Under the plan, a new entity would manage revenue-generating activities and give an outside investor a small financial stake, while traditional conference decisions would remain with the league. Schools could receive upfront payments of at least nine figures, with amounts still under discussion. No vote has been held, and a deal is not certain.

Seasonal affective disorder (SAD) is recurring depression linked to seasonal changes. Winter SAD is most common; summer SAD is rare. Its exact cause is unknown, though some scientists associate it with changes in sunlight and hormones. Winter symptoms include fatigue, low mood, cravings, weight gain and social withdrawal; summer symptoms include insomnia, appetite loss, weight loss and anxiety. Treatment may include light therapy, medication, psychotherapy and relaxation techniques. Because other conditions can resemble SAD, the passage recommends consulting a physician. Regular exercise, time outdoors, social activity and stress reduction may help prevent or reduce symptoms.

In his final annual message, the President reports peace and prosperity, notes Daniel Webster’s death, and reviews foreign affairs. He seeks a reciprocal fisheries agreement with Britain, describes complaints concerning Cuba while rejecting a proposed pledge never to acquire it, and reports negotiations and commercial efforts involving Mexico, Central and South America, and Japan.

He reports Treasury receipts exceeding expenditures and urges tariff changes to protect domestic industry and reduce customs fraud. He asks Congress to address the unsettled status of Indians in California and Oregon, fund completion of the Mexican boundary survey, and support public works, naval reforms, and other administrative measures.

The President defends the United States’ policy of avoiding interference in other nations’ domestic affairs. He urges the government to support domestic industry and internal commerce while respecting the Constitution and the rights of neighboring states. He closes by expressing gratitude that the country remains at peace and prosperous as he leaves office.

Pitt student Trisha Klan will work Christmas as a patient care technician at Jefferson Hospital. She says the holidays bring more emergency-room patients, including people experiencing depression and people injured in car accidents. Nurse Bethany Peng expects her first Christmas shift at Allegheny General Hospital to be demanding, with seriously ill patients unable to go home. Research assistant Madeline Borsos says hospital decorations help make the holidays feel more like home for patients.

The Arms Index (TRIN) measures market sentiment by comparing advancing and declining stocks with their trading volumes. A reading of 1.0 indicates balance; readings below 1.0 are generally viewed as bullish, while those above 1.0 suggest a bearish bias. Extreme readings may signal overbought or oversold conditions and potential reversals. The passage also describes how divergences between an index and its advance-decline volume line can indicate weakening buying or selling pressure. In the reported backtests, a TRIN strategy averaged 0.39% per trade; adding a second indicator raised that figure to 0.66%. The article recommends backtesting TRIN with other indicators rather than using it alone.

Netflix is raising its standard plan from $9.99 to $10.99 per month and its premium plan from $11.99 to $13.99. New subscribers see the prices now; current subscribers will be notified in mid-October.

The passage presents PAST, a framework for trading computing services between UAVs and ground edge servers under changing demand, mobility, and resource availability. Its PilotAO component uses risk-aware matching to establish advance agreements with overbooking; AdaptAO uses deep reinforcement learning to update agreements and overbooking rates. Simulations using a Chicago taxi dataset show that PAST reduces decision overhead and task completion time compared with online trading and improves upon non-adaptive futures methods in resource utilization and agreement-based task completion. Online trading achieves higher social welfare and resource utilization but incurs greater overhead.
In H. W. Robinson & Co. v. United States, the court held that export value governed reappraisement and set the merchandise’s value at the appraised amounts minus the importer’s additions.

Although U.S. meat consumption was projected to reach a record in 2018, the mix has changed: per capita beef consumption has fallen about one-third since its 1970s peak, while chicken consumption has more than doubled. The shift has likely reduced dietary environmental impacts, though beef still accounts for nearly half of Americans’ dietary footprint. Changes in health concerns, convenience, production and prices have contributed to consumption trends. The passage argues that further reductions in beef consumption and a greater shift toward plant-based foods are needed to meet climate and other environmental goals.

Allergan recalled nearly 170,000 Taytulla birth control packs after discovering some physician samples began with placebo pills instead of active pills, potentially increasing the risk of unintended pregnancy. No resulting pregnancies were known.
The order was affirmed without costs or opinion; three judges dissented, citing insufficient evidence.

Standard Chartered will review whether to resume correspondent banking with Sudan after proposed U.S. sanctions relief. The relief depends on Sudan improving its human rights record and addressing military conflicts. Such banking ties could help Sudan’s struggling economy, but banks may remain cautious.

Most Super Bowl advertisers are avoiding politics and the #MeToo movement, favoring lighthearted ads featuring celebrities to reach an expected audience of more than 111 million. Thirty-second airtime slots cost more than $5 million. Coca-Cola and WeatherTech are exceptions: Coca-Cola’s ad emphasizes inclusion, while WeatherTech promotes its American factory. Most advertisers released their ads in advance, though some have kept their plans undisclosed.

Ensco shares fell 1.16% in the most recent session and closed at $5.98. Analysts’ average 12-month price target was $6.32, with estimates ranging from $3.50 to $9. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation was 2.93. Its 14-period average true range was 0.29, and its RSI was 73.93. Ensco had a market capitalization of $2.63 billion, with 12.14 million shares traded in the previous session.

The lecture examines empirical evidence on price discrimination: whether firms use it, how large its profit gains are, and how it affects consumers. Early gasoline studies attributed some price differences to discrimination, while studies of racial and gender differences in car prices produced conflicting results.

Using detailed car transactions, Scott Morton, Zettelmeyer, and Silva-Risso find demographic price differences much smaller than those reported in an earlier car-dealer audit study. Buyers using Autobytel paid less, and demographic differences largely disappeared among them. The lecturer notes that the data cannot directly establish why the differences arise.

Shiller estimates that demographic-based Netflix pricing would raise profits by 0.3%, while pricing based on browsing data could raise them by 13%. His estimates rely on assumptions about costs and profit maximization because the data lack price variation.

Dubé and Misra use randomized ZipRecruiter prices to estimate demand. They find that its $99 monthly price was below the estimated short-run profit-maximizing uniform price. Their model predicts that feasible personalized pricing would raise profits by about 8%, while a separate estimate of unconstrained personalized pricing predicts lower consumer surplus and social welfare. A follow-up experiment closely matched their short-run predictions, but ZipRecruiter did not adopt personalized pricing. The lecture cautions that such experiments do not capture longer-run or broader market effects.

Research software is central to modern research, but few research-performing organisations have comprehensive policies to sustain it or recognise the people who develop it. The PRO4RS Working Group surveyed institutional policies and resources and found a particular gap in research assessment, where software contributions are rarely addressed substantively. It recommends a layered approach: an optional policy treating research software as a scholarly output, coordinated policies covering its management and recognition, and guidelines to support implementation. Institutions can also document their software outputs, advocate for their value, and engage stakeholders to strengthen policy.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on November 1, 2018, announcing a press release and data sheet on its fourth-quarter financial results for the period ended September 29, 2018. Both documents are attached as exhibits. The report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri.

The Treasury Department is considering a $1 coin featuring President Donald Trump on both sides for the United States’ 250th anniversary. A draft shows his profile on one side and his raised-fist pose after a 2024 assassination attempt on the other. Treasury says no final design has been selected. A law authorizing anniversary coins also prohibits portraits of living people on their reverse, and Treasury did not answer questions about the draft’s legality.

Vanguard said it is prioritizing climate risk in talks with companies and urging them to disclose potential business risks from environmental changes. It also plans to detail discussions on board gender diversity. Walden Asset Management withdrew a proposal reviewing Vanguard’s proxy voting.

Kearny Financial trades at 0.68 times tangible book value, but declining revenues and a recent goodwill charge cloud its apparent bargain price. Asset quality remains strong, with new net charge-offs below 0.05% in FY 2025. The author rates the stock a Hold while its performance improves and it potentially becomes a more attractive takeover target.
