North American markets fell as technology stocks sold off and oil prices declined. The TSX lost 75 points, while the Dow dropped 424. Tim Hortons reported a 0.3% first-quarter sales decline, which its parent attributed to negative media coverage and Roll up the Rim issues.

Bernard Tomic lost 6-3 7-5 to David Ferrer in the Brisbane International’s opening round, citing poor serving and a heavy training load. His ranking will drop after he failed to defend points from last year’s semi-final run. Ferrer will face Australian wildcard Jordan Thompson next. Samantha Stosur also lost in three sets to Garbine Muguruza, while Nicolas Mahut, Svetlana Kutznetsova and Elina Svitolina advanced.

George Brown was appointed U.S. commissioner to the Sandwich Islands in 1843. The King promised Americans privileges equal to those of the most favored nation, but a dispute over an American citizen denied a jury trial, alongside Brown’s objections to British treaty terms, led the King to request Brown’s recall. In 1844, the United States confirmed its recognition of Hawaiian independence. France and Britain revised their treaties in 1846, and Denmark concluded a treaty that the passage describes as the first to acknowledge Hawaiian independence without restriction. Brown’s successor, Ten Eyck, failed to secure a treaty and became involved in disputes over American residents’ rights. He resigned in 1848, and Charles Fames was appointed in 1849.
The speaker says the team must work hard, stick to its game plan and avoid relaxing at home. Despite two hard-fought games, the series is not over until four wins.

On January 27, 2017, NVIDIA’s subsidiary amended an agreement governing construction and leasing of its new Santa Clara headquarters to align it with NVIDIA’s credit agreement. The amendment raised the maximum total leverage ratio from 3.0:1.0 to 3.5:1.0 and eliminated the minimum interest coverage ratio.
The appellate court reversed the order dismissing Rebecca Shumake’s personal injury complaint, finding that the defendants had not met their initial burden of showing entitlement to summary judgment.

A qualitative study examined oral histories conducted by 38 elementary preservice teachers with community members about citizenship-related events and issues. Analysis of the teachers’ post-project reflections found that the interviews deepened their understanding of differing perspectives, prompted empathy and interest in civic action, and increased their willingness to teach citizenship and discuss difficult topics. Some struggled to find interviewees or ask personal questions. The study lacked a pre-project survey and included only four course sections.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU and its Ampere architecture for AI, high-performance computing, and data analytics. Compared with the V100, A100 adds third-generation Tensor Cores supporting TF32, BF16, FP64, and structured sparsity; 40 GB of HBM2 memory; a 40 MB L2 cache; and faster NVLink and PCIe connectivity. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. CUDA 11 supports features including task graph acceleration, asynchronous memory copies and barriers, and L2 cache residency controls. The passage also describes the DGX A100 system, which combines eight A100 GPUs for workloads ranging from individual applications to large clusters.

Dr Malcolm Tunnicliff, who treated 12 Grenfell Tower fire casualties, said his hospital prepared cyanide antidotes because burning foam in older furniture can release toxic gas. Around 60 people were taken to London hospitals, and others remained missing. Fire crews had searched most flats but did not expect to find more survivors. The fire’s cause was unknown, and officials called for an investigation into why it spread so rapidly.

Tom Barrett has more than 30 years of landscape industry experience and has spent 20 years as principal of Green Water Infrastructure. He coaches business leaders and has held senior sales and marketing roles. Barrett describes his leadership as collaborative and strategic, emphasizing relationships, innovation and organizational change. He cites Warren Buffett as a role model, reads widely to learn from others, and believes individuals can lead meaningful change. He argues that business needs integrity and continuous learning rather than a “winner take all” mentality.

NerdWallet compared incomes and estimated mortgage payments in 172 U.S. metro areas for the first quarter of 2018. Decatur, Illinois, was the most affordable: its median home cost $73,000, and the estimated monthly principal-and-interest payment was 7.6% of median household income. San Jose, California, was the least affordable, with a $1.37 million median home price and payments equal to 60.3% of median income. Four of the five least-affordable areas were in California.

The President announced a drawdown of U.S. forces in Afghanistan, saying that pressure on al Qaeda, losses inflicted on the Taliban, and growth in Afghan security forces had enabled the transition. He said 10,000 troops would leave by year’s end and a total of 33,000 by the following summer, reversing the troop surge. Afghan forces would take the lead as the U.S. mission shifted from combat to support, with the transition complete by 2014.

He said the United States would continue targeting terrorists, press Pakistan to address extremist safe havens, and support Afghan-led reconciliation with those who reject al Qaeda and violence and accept Afghanistan’s constitution. Acknowledging the human and financial costs of the wars, he called for a more targeted approach to threats abroad and renewed investment in jobs, infrastructure, energy, and veterans at home.

House Republicans planned to discuss an unfinished spending bill Monday, with government funding set to expire Friday at midnight. Negotiators remained divided over health insurance market measures, a New York–New Jersey rail program and proposed tax-bill corrections. Legislation to change Congress’s sexual harassment reporting process was not expected to be included. White House and congressional negotiators also reached an impasse over DACA protections and border wall funding. Lawmakers may drop contentious provisions to avoid a shutdown.

Applications for PITB Plan9’s 10th Launchpad close June 20. The Lahore event runs July 17–23 and includes a Makeathon, training, workshops and a pitch competition. Applicants must be Pakistani citizens aged 18 or older with a technology-related, product-based idea. Selected teams from outside Lahore must relocate for six months.

The United States and United Kingdom favored considering Belgian Congo requests for supplies, subject to the reasonableness of the requests and available stocks. They proposed that Belgium submit consolidated lists of materials it could provide and supplies it needed, and that technical experts assess conditions in the Congo. Officials planned joint negotiations with the Belgian colonial authorities, possibly leading to a tripartite agreement effective September 1, 1942. Belgian Colonial Minister de Vleeschauwer postponed a contemplated trip to Washington.

The passage contrasts the Duchess of Cambridge’s $8,900 maternity care with childbirth in the United States, where an average delivery costs $12,290 and parents may face substantial bills even with insurance. It reports that U.S. maternal and infant mortality rates are high compared with those of other wealthy countries, despite far greater health spending. It also describes insured Americans facing uncovered medical costs and turning to crowdfunding. The author argues that every mother should be able to give birth in a safe, comfortable setting without worrying about medical bills.

The passage identifies technology integration, ongoing teacher development, innovative teaching methods, cross-cultural perspectives, and inclusive curriculum design as priorities for education. It argues that flexible curricula and teacher training can help meet diverse learners’ needs and prepare students for a changing, interconnected world.

Imperial College Professor David Nutt has developed “alcosynth,” a synthetic alcohol intended to mimic alcohol’s effects without causing a hangover. His team narrowed about 80 substances to five and plans to submit one for food-safety review. They are seeking $11.8 million for final safety checks. Nutt hoped to introduce alcosynth in cocktail bars by 2020 and replace regular alcohol by 2050.

Michael James Costa, 38, has been a fugitive since leaving supervision in Rochester, Minnesota, in April 2017. Authorities advise against confronting him and ask anyone with information to call 911 or 651-361-7777.

Student of the Year celebrations honored students from the Hemet/San Jacinto districts on May 11 and the Banning/Beaumont districts on May 3 for overcoming obstacles and planning their futures. Hemet High’s Cassiopeia Tichy, who has fought cancer, plans to study arts and entertainment at Cal State Fullerton. Beaumont’s Ana Aguirre, who lived with four foster families, has been accepted to UCLA and hopes to become an anesthesiologist. Honorees received scholarships and $100 Walmart gift cards.

This May 3, 2001, news roundup covers Enron and energy markets. California lawmakers considered refusing to buy electricity above certain prices despite blackout risks. Indian lenders sought government help over unpaid bills at Enron’s Dabhol project, whose officials agreed to meet a state panel without committing to renegotiate. Allegheny Energy bought three gas-fired plants from Enron, while Enron Wind agreed to supply turbines for projects in Germany and Spain. Other reports addressed a proposed Enron plant in Florida, U.S. energy policy and forecasts for power-sector profitability.

Apple’s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 describes its products, services, geographic segments and risks. Apple sells smartphones, computers, tablets, wearables, accessories and related services; 37% of 2023 net sales came through direct channels and 63% through indirect channels. It had approximately 161,000 full-time equivalent employees. The filing highlights competition, supply-chain dependence, cybersecurity, legal and regulatory matters, and financial risks. It also describes ongoing Epic Games and Masimo proceedings and reports 106.6 million shares repurchased in the final fiscal quarter.

FishNet++ is a multimodal benchmark for fish recognition containing 99,556 images across 17,393 species, with descriptions, bounding boxes, and key-point annotations. Evaluations show that vision-language models struggle with species-level recognition, particularly for rare species. Diagnostic tests identify gaps in taxonomic knowledge and fine-grained visual perception, despite stronger fish-localization ability. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL on FishNet++ raises its frequent-species accuracy from 6.2% to 37.0%; training it to provide explanations also improves interpretability.

LeBron James announced a “Second Decision” for October 7 at noon EST, prompting speculation about retirement or a business announcement. The uncertainty has briefly shifted attention from the Lakers’ championship goals with Luka Dončić.

The passage describes multi-modal interfaces for electronic devices and digital assistants. Proposed methods let users select and revise displayed words using different input types, disable an output type based on device context, suggest alternative ways to perform a task, and request another input type when a task requires more information. It also describes implementations on devices and computer-readable storage media, along with supporting digital-assistant and touch-interface components.
Judgment reduced by $914.36 plus interest; otherwise affirmed without costs.

Papua New Guinea’s Bougainville region has lifted a decades-old ban on new mining and exploration, allowing applications in Tore, Isina and Jaba but excluding the Panguna copper mine. The ban reflected local concerns about revenue-sharing and environmental impacts.

In his final State of the Union address, President Ford says the Union is good, though it can improve. He praises the peaceful transition to President-elect Carter and says his administration helped restore confidence in government, strengthen alliances, advance diplomacy, and sustain peace.

Ford reports economic recovery, lower inflation, and job growth, while acknowledging that unemployment remains too high. He urges tax changes to encourage investment and jobs. He also warns that dependence on foreign oil has increased and calls for further action on energy. Citing progress in rebuilding military resources, he asks for sustained defense efforts. He closes by emphasizing constitutional checks and balances and expressing hope for the country’s future.

Aaron Rodgers threw for 300 yards and four touchdowns as Green Bay beat Detroit 31-24 to win the NFC North. The Packers finished the regular season on a six-game winning streak and will host the New York Giants in the playoffs. Detroit, which lost its final three games, enters as a wild card and will play at Seattle. Green Bay cornerback Quinten Rollins was taken to a hospital for evaluation after a neck injury; the team said he was conscious and able to move.

The lecture reviews relativistic energy, momentum, Lorentz transformations, and invariant mass. It distinguishes quantities conserved in a reaction from those unchanged between reference frames, and explains how decay products can reveal a parent particle’s mass. Exercises apply these ideas to fixed-target and colliding-beam experiments, particle production, binding energy, decays, and photon scattering.

The passage describes the device’s power management, reset behavior, clocking, interfaces, and board-design requirements. SRAM shutdown reduces leakage but loses stored data; standby turns off switchable power domains. Proper supply sequencing, filtering, decoupling, and stable clocks are required during power-up and reset. It distinguishes power-on, warm, software, watchdog, local, and isolated PCIe and Ethernet resets. Device clocks come from external crystals or clock inputs and feed PLLs with specified frequency limits. Peripheral sections cover interrupt controllers, EDMA, debugging, Ethernet, GPIO, memory control, HDMI, and video processing, along with electrical timing and PCB routing guidance.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs improve shading, ray tracing, and AI performance over the Turing generation through second-generation RT Cores and third-generation Tensor Cores. The A40 targets data-center visual computing and virtualization, while the RTX A6000 targets professional workstations; both can combine two GPUs to provide 96GB of memory. Ampere supports high-resolution displays, HDMI 2.1, hardware video decoding including AV1, and hardware encoding. GeForce RTX 30-series GPUs add features including GDDR6X memory and RTX IO. Error Detection and Replay helps identify the limits of GDDR6X memory overclocking through plateauing performance. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and that customers must assess product suitability for their applications.

Colleges across the U.S. marked Valentine’s Day with cultural stories, campus treats, musical surprises, relationship stories, a rally celebrating love, a date-night guide, a rivalry joke and electronic valentines. Boston University also shared stories from couples who met on campus.

Forecasters say high pressure could bring drier, warmer weather to the UK, with temperatures possibly reaching 25C in the south-east by Sunday or Monday. Confidence is low because Tropical Storm Gert may affect conditions, though it is expected to weaken before reaching the UK. The Met Office says warmer, settled spells are most likely in the south.

This July 2001 collection lists Enron at No. 16 on the Fortune Global 500 and covers falling corporate profits, western power-plant cancellations, emissions trading, and power-market developments in Japan. Enron canceled a proposed Miami-Dade plant while pursuing a Deerfield Beach project stalled by a county moratorium. Other articles examine Karl Rove’s meetings with Enron while he held its stock, share sales by Enron executives who had called the stock undervalued, and losses and reduced expectations in Enron’s broadband business.

Andrew Kahn highlights 10 college basketball conference games to watch, from Villanova at Butler on Jan. 4 to Indiana at Purdue on Feb. 28. The list includes Kansas visiting West Virginia and Baylor as it pursues another Big 12 title, Kentucky at Florida, Indiana at Wisconsin, Louisville at Virginia, North Carolina at Duke, Oregon at UCLA, and Gonzaga at Saint Mary’s. The matchups feature conference contenders, rivalries and teams with strong early-season records.
On August 8, 2022, NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K announcing selected preliminary financial results for the quarter ended July 31, 2022. Its press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

While tuna fishing about 120 kilometres off Tofino, a group including former NHL player Willie Mitchell spotted a large shark they initially thought was a great white. Underwater footage helped Mitchell identify it as an eight- to nine-foot salmon shark. A Vancouver Aquarium biologist said sightings are rare, despite the species being common off B.C., and described the encounter as a good sign for the ecosystem. Experts also said warming waters could bring more sharks, including great whites, farther north.

Sean Combs was sentenced to 50 months in prison and still faces dozens of civil lawsuits. He has denied accusations of sexual assault. The cases could bring further legal costs and reputational damage. Combs says he has lost his businesses and career; he has parted ways with major brand partnerships and media holdings, though he still owns valuable property. A reputation strategist said he is unlikely to regain his former standing.

The President returns a bill suspending Chinese labor immigration for twenty years, arguing that such a lengthy suspension violates the 1880 treaty with China, which permits reasonable limits but not an absolute prohibition. While supporting legislation to regulate immigration, he urges a shorter suspension. He also questions the bill’s registration and passport requirements, notes its lack of provision for Chinese subjects transiting the United States, and warns that the policy could harm trade and relations with Asia.

Academics in Zimbabwe and South Africa say Grace Mugabe’s sociology thesis falls below doctoral standards. Awarded by the University of Zimbabwe in 2014, the PhD came three months after her reported enrolment, while the thesis appeared online four years later. Critics allege plagiarism, shallow analysis and citations published after her graduation. Academics petitioned for an anti-corruption probe, but the commission said no investigation was underway.

The court held that an earlier decree gave Eugene A. Causey fee-simple title to the disputed section 16 lands and bound his children, although they were not yet born when it was issued. Causey held only a life estate in the section 15 land, with the remainder belonging to his children. Because too much timber was removed from that land, the children were awarded $154.84 in damages. The decree was affirmed.

German lawmaker Norbert Röttgen called for suspending Turkey’s EU membership talks while President Erdogan consolidates authoritarian power. Erdogan said a freeze would not matter much to Turkey, amid tensions over cancelled campaign rallies in Europe.

Wall Street closed higher Monday, led by technology and energy shares, as oil prices rose and investors awaited a Federal Reserve rate decision. The Dow gained 0.23%, the S&P 500 rose 0.32% and the Nasdaq added 0.51%. Traders saw an 85% chance of a 25-basis-point rate hike. Apple boosted technology stocks, while energy benefited from higher oil prices following a North Sea pipeline shutdown. Bluebird Bio surged on positive early-stage drug-study results, and bitcoin-related stocks climbed after cryptocurrency futures trading began.

MIT CSAIL researchers developed Pensieve, an AI system that uses a neural network to improve video streaming across changing network conditions. In experiments, it reduced rebuffering by 10–30% and improved quality by 10–25% compared with existing approaches. Users could prioritize quality, speed or data conservation. The team plans to release its code and test Pensieve on VR video.

Two years after Toronto traded him to Pittsburgh, two-time Stanley Cup champion Phil Kessel spent his day with the trophy golfing and eating hot dogs from it. He posted a caption referencing a Toronto Sun column.

Graphene flakes grown with aligned orientations on single-crystal Cu(111)/sapphire do not always merge seamlessly. Microscopy revealed merging lines, and scanning tunneling microscopy identified some as overlapping junctions where one flake lies atop another. After hot-water immersion, copper oxidation beneath some merging regions showed that they permit water transport. Of 122 merging regions assessed, about 45% showed oxidation and 55% did not. These findings challenge the assumption that aligned, stitched graphene forms a uniformly impermeable film and suggest potential filtration applications.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 26, 2017, announcing its third-quarter 2017 financial results. The filing includes the earnings press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

The PGA Tour says player and fan safety is its priority and that security advisers are working with law enforcement before Wednesday’s tournament in Austin. Police are hunting a serial bomber whose attacks have killed two people and injured four, including two hurt by a tripwire-triggered explosion Sunday.

The NCLT directed Bhushan Steel’s creditors to consider employees’ objections to Tata Steel’s acquisition bid and report their decision at final approval. The employees argued Tata Steel was ineligible under insolvency rules. The tribunal declined to accept Tata Steel’s objection to the employees’ application at this stage.

The passage contrasts unsubstantiated affair rumors about Nikki Haley with Nashville Mayor Megan Barry’s admission of an affair with the officer leading her security detail. Barry acknowledged that she should have disclosed the relationship; the passage also says she doubled his overtime pay. It examines whether public defenses of Barry apply different standards to women in power and argues that her restrained apology and emphasis on consent help shape how the scandal is viewed.

The State Department’s Office of the Historian describes its ebook edition of the *Foreign Relations of the United States* series, including its search features, offline access, and recommendation to cite document numbers rather than pages. In the included presidential message, the President describes widespread prosperity and a growing U.S. role in the world. He urges practical regulation to address harms associated with industrial growth without hindering its benefits.

A climate-modeling study projects that human-caused climate change could become as important as natural variability in driving extreme summer heat waves across much of the western United States in the 2020s. Similar effects could emerge around the Great Lakes in the 2030s and in the Great Plains 30–50 years from now.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 12, 2017, attaching its 2016 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1. Senior Vice President David A. Zapolsky signed the report.

Singer Meghan Linsey woke in her Nashville home with a stinging face and a dead spider in her hand. At urgent care, she was diagnosed with a brown recluse spider bite. She experienced severe pain, swelling and a wound beneath her eye that developed dead tissue. After hyperbaric oxygen therapy, new skin began to form. More than two months later, her wound was healing and she had returned to performing. Linsey shared her experience to raise awareness of brown recluse spiders.

High-resolution visual inputs create memory and latency bottlenecks for vision-language models. Existing training-free token pruning methods often use fixed schedules that do not adapt to differences between images and queries. AutoPrune estimates input complexity from early visual–textual mutual information and uses it to set a sample-specific pruning schedule within a specified token or FLOPs budget. The authors report improvements over other training-free methods across vision-language and autonomous-driving tasks. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, it pruned 89% of visual tokens, reduced inference FLOPs by 76.8%, and retained 96.7% of the original average accuracy.

The 1-4 Slice zone offense uses a high alignment, inside post attacks and outside shooters to create passing options and keep zone defenses shifting. After an entry pass, the opposite post slices to the basket, then posts up if no pass arrives. Players can use high-low feeds, baseline feeds, skip passes and ball reversals to seek shots. A high-post give-and-go and wing entries provide further options. Against defensive overplays, the point player can pump fake to trigger a post release or wing back cut.

The passage describes interrupt handling and peripheral interfaces for a TI digital media processor, including DCAN, EDMA, Ethernet, GPIO, external memory, HDMI, video processing, I2C, imaging, and DDR2/DDR3 memory. It lists capabilities, registers, and electrical timing requirements. It also gives PCB design guidance for signal routing, impedance, termination, component placement, and bypass capacitors, particularly for HDMI and DDR memory interfaces. Debug features include advanced event triggering, trace, and JTAG.

Mayor Bill de Blasio urged state lawmakers to extend and expand New York City’s school-zone speed camera program before it expires next month. He also announced a redesign of Park Slope’s Ninth Street, where two children were killed in March. The plan includes protected bike lanes and changes to pedestrian access and loading rules. Officials seek cameras in 150 additional school zones and an extension through 2022.

LeBron James and Stephen Curry remain the NBA’s most prominent stars, but the article says neither has a clear successor as the face of the league. It identifies Victor Wembanyama as a leading candidate, while also considering Luka Doncic, Anthony Edwards, Cooper Flagg and others. Talent, popularity, team context and rivalries could all shape who emerges.

The passage describes electronic devices with glass enclosures that can extend across multiple sides. Displays visible through those sides may present distinct controls or continuous images, while touch and force sensors enable input. The proposed enclosures use single or joined glass members, with seam placement and bonding techniques intended to preserve visibility. Other described features include orientation-dependent interfaces, speakers and microphones, and openings or plugs for device components.

British business headlines include Hermes Fund Managers’ concerns about Tesco’s proposed Booker takeover, Reckitt Benckiser’s business review and Arcadia Group’s rising pension deficit. Other reports cover Twitter’s pursuit of pay-TV deals, Cortexica’s £4 million fundraising, a possible Royal Navy contract for Babcock, and Co-op Group’s plan to value its Co-operative Bank stake at zero.

The lecture describes policy as a way to address market failures in sustainable real estate. Green buildings can provide benefits, such as reduced carbon emissions, that developers cannot fully capture; subsidies, tax rebates, and density bonuses can encourage them. Brown buildings can impose environmental costs, prompting measures such as carbon taxes, energy codes, disclosure requirements, and emissions penalties.

Policy design is difficult: incentives must be large enough to change behavior, while requirements can raise costs and affect housing affordability. The lecture discusses research on how stricter Massachusetts energy codes may affect households, particularly those near an affordability threshold.

The lecture also examines investment in coastal resilience. Miami’s resources may support continued adaptation, while a small North Carolina town struggles to fund recovery. Federal support raises questions about unequal access to funding and whether protection encourages people to remain in risky areas. Managed retreat is presented as a controversial alternative.

Russia said it was awaiting US confirmation for April 24 talks in Geneva with the United States and UN aimed at advancing peace in Syria. The proposed meeting follows US missile strikes on a Syrian air base in response to a nerve gas attack that killed 87 people and was attributed to President Bashar al-Assad’s regime. Russia and Iran warned against further US attacks.

An estimated 666 pilot whales stranded in two pods at New Zealand’s Farewell Spit. More than 300 died; the survivors were re-floated. Authorities closed the beach over health risks from decomposing carcasses and began moving them to an inaccessible area. Workers punctured the bodies to prevent gas buildup. No new strandings were found Tuesday.

The agreement governs software use, preserves remaining terms if one is unenforceable, and applies California and controlling U.S. federal law. Disputes must be heard in Santa Clara County courts. Exports must comply with applicable laws; amendments or waivers require signed writing. Licensors may enforce the agreement as third-party beneficiaries.

The passage argues that philosophy of education often assumes a libertarian view of free will, making its account of autonomy vulnerable to challenges from both determinism and indeterminism. It presents Harry Frankfurt’s view that moral responsibility does not require the ability to act differently. Instead, responsibility can rest on a person’s reflective identification with the desires that guide their actions. The author proposes that this account can explain autonomy and authenticity without relying on libertarian assumptions. For moral education, the passage recommends focusing on young people’s attitudes toward their will and their actions, rather than only on whether they could have chosen otherwise.

Hill sought specific performance after Levine refused to buy land, arguing that a deed provision requiring fifty-foot lot frontage clouded the title. The court held that the provision expired after twenty years and created no enforceable right for other lot owners. Because its interpretation raised no reasonable doubt about the title, the court reversed the dismissal and ordered specific performance, allowing Hill to seek an assessment of damages.

Manchester United are reportedly considering a £50m bid for Fulham’s 17-year-old Ryan Sessegnon, with Fulham looking for a replacement amid interest from United and Tottenham. The Sun also reports that Jose Mourinho has discussed a contract extension with Marouane Fellaini, whose deal expires at the end of the season.

Microsoft plans to add Windows 10 accessibility features, including reorganized Ease of Access settings, size and brightness controls, Narrator improvements, and better eye-control navigation. Some features are available in Insider previews, while others remain in beta. Microsoft says more accessibility features will follow later this year.

Marine heatwaves are prolonged periods of unusually warm water that can occur in any season. An analysis of more than a century of sea-surface temperature data found that marine heatwaves became 34% more frequent and 17% longer between 1925–1954 and 1987–2016. The number of marine heatwave days rose 54% from 1925 to 2016.

Recent events have damaged kelp forests and seagrass meadows, disrupted fisheries and aquaculture, and contributed to coral bleaching. Human-caused climate change has made some marine heatwaves substantially more likely. The passage calls for forecasts to help manage their impacts and for reduced greenhouse gas emissions to limit future warming.

The Carolina Panthers ended their 2016 season 6-10 after a 17-16 loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Carolina scored a late touchdown but failed on a two-point attempt to win. Cam Newton threw three interceptions, and Graham Gano missed three field goals. The defense allowed 300 yards, while younger players David Mayo, Shaq Thompson, James Bradberry and Damiere Byrd contributed. The Panthers will have the eighth pick in the next NFL draft.

Maldives President Yameen Abdul Gayoom said he was open to an early election amid unrest over a Supreme Court order to release and retry opposition politicians, including former President Mohammed Nasheed. The court also reinstated 12 opposition lawmakers, a move that would cost Yameen’s party its parliamentary majority. Parliament’s opening was postponed indefinitely. Yameen said authorities were working to implement the ruling without causing difficulties, while he dismissed two police chiefs after the order. Police broke up protests demanding the prisoners’ release. The United Nations urged the government to respect the ruling and called for all-party talks. Nasheed said he would challenge Yameen for the presidency.

An MIT study suggests 3,000 shared sedans could serve 98% of Manhattan ride demand, potentially reducing congestion and pollution. Riders would wait an average of 2.8 minutes and face 3.5-minute trip delays. The approach would require widespread ride-sharing, which some drivers and riders resist, and could leave many drivers without work.

Scientists used stored sperm from Sudan, the last northern white rhino male, to fertilize southern white rhino eggs, producing two frozen hybrid embryos. Rhino embryo transfer has not yet been developed. Researchers hope to obtain eggs from the two remaining northern white rhino females to create pure embryos, but significant uncertainties remain. A conservation expert warned that reliance on reproductive technology could weaken other conservation efforts.

Kerberos authenticates users and services over an untrusted network using a trusted Key Distribution Center that holds their shared keys. A user first obtains a limited-lifetime ticket for the Ticket Granting Service, allowing later requests for service tickets without retaining the password-derived key. Tickets establish shared keys; services separately decide what access authenticated users receive. Users must trust their workstations, and compromised service keys must be replaced. The lecture also describes weaknesses in Kerberos 4, including offline password guessing, replay and reflection attacks, reliance on encryption for message integrity, and problems with password changes. Kerberos 5 addresses several of these issues.

The passage describes a networked system that processes voice commands detected by multiple devices. Devices score activation commands, and those with the strongest signals provide audio for server interpretation. A group leader may combine their audio and distribute the requested action, or devices may compare scores and response confidence levels to decide which acts. The system can also combine speech segments captured by different devices.

On August 15, 2017, Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the pricing of a previously announced private placement of $16.0 billion in senior unsecured notes. The related press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage describes SD memory card commands, status fields, timing, and performance requirements. Force erase clears the user area, unlocks the card, and clears temporary and group write protection, but does not erase the secure area. Locked cards reject ACMD6. CMD55 identifies the following command as application-specific, while CMD6 checks and switches card functions, including access mode and power limit. SDSC cards use byte addresses for memory access; SDHC and SDXC cards use 512-byte block addresses. The passage also specifies command formats, CRC protection, response types, timeout rules, and card and SD status fields. Its speed-class sections define allocation and recording units, performance measurements, and recording requirements, including SDXC requirements for writing to entirely free allocation units.

The 1945 San Francisco Conference drafted the United Nations Charter using the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals and other government submissions. Delegates from fifty governments unanimously approved the Charter, the Statute of the International Court of Justice, and interim arrangements for a preparatory commission on June 25. The Charter was signed the next day and entered into force on October 24. The United States ratified it in August and enacted legislation for participation in December. The passage also describes the conference’s committee structure and its published documentation.

A year after *Loper Bright* ended *Chevron* deference, the passage identifies three developments to watch. Courts are increasingly using textualist methods to interpret statutes independently. They sometimes treat longstanding agency interpretations as support for their own readings, though the future of this “shadow Skidmore” approach remains uncertain. The major questions doctrine continues to limit broad agency authority, but Justice Kavanaugh has proposed an exception for national security and foreign policy. An upcoming tariff case may test that proposal.

At the World Economic Forum, President Trump invited businesses to invest in the United States, citing job growth, tax cuts, reduced regulations and rising confidence. He called for fair, reciprocal trade and said the United States was open to negotiating bilateral agreements. He also outlined efforts on energy production, defense, terrorism and merit-based immigration, while urging leaders to serve their people. In questions from Klaus Schwab, Trump said tax reform had prompted unexpected worker bonuses and investment. He described his business experience as useful preparation for the presidency and criticized press coverage of his administration.

In a study of 97 patients with unilateral Menière’s disease, the German 17-item Speech, Spatial and Qualities of Hearing Scale showed excellent internal consistency. Its scores were associated with hearing thresholds and speech recognition, supporting its use alongside audiometric tests to assess hearing-related disability. The questionnaire does not capture other burdens of the disease, such as vertigo.

Alabama leads Vanderbilt in the third quarter of their Week 6 matchup. Ty Simpson has thrown touchdown passes to Germie Bernard and Ryan Williams, while Vanderbilt has scored on a Diego Pavia pass to Sedrick Alexander and Alexander’s 65-yard run. Simpson has also thrown his first interception of the season, and Pavia has thrown an interception and lost a fumble. Vanderbilt entered 5-0; Alabama rebounded from a loss to Florida State with a win over Georgia.

Danica Patrick said she should have kept walking after fans booed her at Pocono Raceway, but instead she confronted them and said the boos hurt her feelings. She had declined to sign for a fan who slipped past a barrier because he had disrespected a security guard. Her statement that signing autographs is not her job prompted other NASCAR drivers to weigh in. Kevin Harvick called it a driver’s responsibility, Ryan Blaney said drivers should do it though it is not their job, and Dale Earnhardt Jr. said fan interactions can help him after a disappointing performance.

In a retrospective study of 226 patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage, 33 (15%) experienced rebleeding. Longer time since the first symptoms and higher WFNS scores were independently associated with rebleeding risk; each additional hour was associated with a 0.7% increase in the odds of rebleeding. Rebleeding occurred before aneurysm securing in 9% of patients treated within 24 hours, compared with 21% treated later. The authors emphasize prompt aneurysm treatment but note that the retrospective design and uncertain classification of some rebleeding events limit the findings.

Scaling in means gradually building a trading position according to a plan. Investors may buy as prices fall to lower their average entry price, while short-term traders may add to winning positions. Institutional traders may spread large orders to limit price impact and avoid front-running. Unlike doubling down or Martingale strategies, scaling in is planned rather than an attempt to rescue a losing trade. Scaling out means exiting a position gradually. Scaling in can improve entry prices or increase gains, but prices may reverse or move before a full position is established. The passage reports that its backtest produced a lower CAGR but better capital efficiency with scaling in.

Backtests of TLT, an ETF tracking 20-year Treasury bonds, found negative returns during the first seven trading days of each month and stronger returns afterward. A strategy combining a short position early in the month with a long position later returned 10.2% annually, versus 3.8% for buy-and-hold, with a lower maximum drawdown. The passage also notes that bond prices and interest rates move inversely.

This scoping review examines inflammation and anti-inflammatory approaches to depression, drawing on animal research and 11 clinical studies involving 907 patients. Animal studies identified inflammatory pathways that pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions may affect, but their clinical relevance and long-term effects remain uncertain. Clinical studies reported variable treatment responses; higher baseline inflammation may help identify patients more likely to benefit from some anti-inflammatory treatments. The authors note inconsistent measurement of inflammatory markers, individual differences, safety concerns and costs. They conclude that anti-inflammatory drug strategies currently have limited feasibility and recommend further research on biomarkers and greater attention to non-pharmacological approaches such as exercise.

The passage lists the 1942 *Foreign Relations* volumes and Belgium-related records, including U.S.–Belgian mutual aid and military service agreements. It also describes negotiations to renew an Anglo-Belgian economic agreement concerning the Belgian Congo. The United States sought information because of its interest in Congo products. Talks were delayed by a Belgian official’s death, disputes over prices, and the absence of a Belgian list of desired British goods. Britain sought to coordinate its policy with the United States as demand for Congo products grew.

A Seattle Public Utilities study found that long-lasting, extreme rainstorms have become more frequent and intense over the past 15 years, while the city’s usual drizzle and short showers have largely remained unchanged. A 24-hour storm delivering 4 inches of rain, once classified as a once-in-a-century event, is now projected to occur every 25 years. SPU will use the findings to plan drainage and wastewater projects, since heavy rain can overwhelm pipes and pollute waterways. Officials say the results are consistent with expectations of long-term climate change and underscore the need to prepare for flooding.

A November 29, 2001 news roundup reports that Enron faced a possible record bankruptcy after Dynegy abandoned its takeover and credit agencies downgraded Enron’s debt to junk status. Enron’s European operations entered administration, trading venues restricted its activity, and EnronOnline reopened to let customers unwind positions. Banks, energy companies, funds and derivatives counterparties assessed their exposure, while Enron’s troubles disrupted some power markets and delayed a Houston office project. Enron’s metals business attracted potential buyers, and Senate Majority Leader Tom Daschle called for Congress to investigate the collapse.

Digital laggards often fail to connect company goals to strategy, leaving employees unclear about priorities and contributing to misalignment. Digital leaders use clear metrics, transparent data access, and a learning mindset to align work across teams and organizational levels. Their employees’ day-to-day behavior generally reinforces stated values, while entrenched habits, skill gaps, and limited leadership focus can impede change at lagging firms.

The passage identifies four starting patterns for data transformation: data novices lack both supporting culture and systems; insight-ready firms have a receptive culture but limited technical capabilities; tech-enabled firms have the technology but lack a culture of experimentation; and data-reliant firms risk discouraging critical thinking through overreliance on data.

The passage describes a vehicle assistance system that uses cameras and other sensors to detect faster vehicles approaching from behind. To reduce collision risk, it may warn the driver or control acceleration and lane changes, considering surrounding traffic, available space, speed limits, and driving mode.

NVIDIA reported revenue of $1.153 billion for the quarter ended July 26, 2015, up 5% from a year earlier, while net income fell to $26 million from $128 million. GPU revenue rose 9% to $959 million, driven primarily by high-end gaming products; Tegra Processor revenue fell 19% to $128 million. The quarter included $89 million in charges related to winding down Icera modem operations and a $15 million charge related to a recall of SHIELD tablets. NVIDIA returned $452 million to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends. It also began construction of a new headquarters under an operating lease arrangement.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell’s graphics, AI, video, and power-efficiency features. Mega Geometry builds ray-tracing acceleration structures from triangle clusters and updates partitioned structures to reduce rebuild work. Blackwell RT Cores add faster ray-triangle intersections and hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres, a strand-rendering primitive. Shader Execution Reordering 2.0 improves GPU workload organization, while the AI Management Processor schedules GPU contexts.

Blackwell adds hardware 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, improved NVENC and NVDEC capabilities, and DisplayPort 2.1b support. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster frequency switching, and quicker entry into deep sleep. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer models for image reconstruction. Cooperative Vectors enable graphics shaders to access Tensor Cores for neural techniques, including materials, texture compression, lighting, skin, and faces. The passage also outlines the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products.

The £1,100 Marin Nail Trail 6 is an aluminium trail hardtail offered in two builds, with 27.5in or 29in wheels depending on size. The reviewed XL 29in model has a 120mm RockShox Recon fork, SRAM GX 1×11 drivetrain and Shimano Deore hydraulic brakes. The reviewer found it comfortable, stable and predictable on trails, praised its component selection, and considered the frame a good platform for future upgrades.

Mapbox, which supplies maps for other companies’ apps, announced partnerships with Microsoft, ARM and Intel’s Mobileye to expand its self-driving car tools. Its software will send road-camera data to Microsoft’s Azure for later processing, work with ARM chips to recognize road features faster, and deliver Mobileye’s cloud-based road data to cars while limiting mobile bandwidth use.

The study demonstrates solid-state near-infrared-to-visible photon upconversion using a DIB-SQ:PCBM bulk heterojunction to sensitize rubrene. A 1:3 DIB-SQ:PCBM blend maximized light output; doping rubrene with DBP produced a 1.36% upconversion quantum yield and a threshold intensity of 60.5 mW/cm². Spectroscopic and magnetic-field measurements support a mechanism in which charge-transfer states populate rubrene triplets, directly or through molecular triplets, before triplet-triplet annihilation generates visible emission.

After a serious right-shoulder health scare, Victor Wembanyama spent the offseason pursuing physical and mental growth. He trained in Shaolin Kung Fu and meditation during a 10-day stay at a temple in China, played soccer, and sought advice from Kevin Garnett. In four September workouts with Hakeem Olajuwon, he developed a variation of the “Dream Shake” and other moves. Wembanyama also engaged Spurs fans and visited a Texas community affected by flooding. He says he is ready to return to basketball.

Six former detainees challenged Illinois counties’ practice of charging fees for pretrial release. The district court dismissed their case for lack of standing and denied class certification as moot. The Seventh Circuit reversed, finding that the plaintiffs had standing to pursue individual claims against Kane and DuPage Counties. It also held that a class action against those counties, and potentially 17 others applying the same state statute, required a Rule 23 certification analysis. The case was remanded for further proceedings.

San Diego Unified School District withdrew a resolution to invite Education Secretary Betsy DeVos after objections from its teachers’ union, parents and community partners. The board members who proposed the visit said they wanted DeVos to learn about the district’s public schools. Her confirmation had drawn opposition from groups with differing concerns about education policy and required Vice President Mike Pence to break a Senate tie. Separately, the American Federation of Teachers president condemned protesters who tried to block DeVos from entering a Washington school. At a White House meeting with parents and educators, President Trump advocated school choice, while DeVos said she wanted to hear their ideas.

The court denied a motion to dismiss a devolutive appeal. It held that three transcripts filed under one docket number substantially provided the complete record, that appellants need not name appellees in their appeal petition, and that some appellants’ acquiescence in the judgment did not bar the others’ appeal. The claimed omission of a deceased defendant’s heirs did not justify dismissal.
Kimberly Kirkwood forwarded a holiday chain email encouraging recipients to make a wish and pass it on. The message claims wishes will come true and warns of bad luck if it is not forwarded.

The Woodland Trust’s Nature’s Calendar has recorded 42 signs of spring at more than 1,000 UK locations in 2017. Sightings are fewer than at this point in 2016, which the Trust attributes to a colder January. The records help researchers study seasonal changes and their impact on nature.

The May 23, 2001 State Bar of Michigan e-Journal summarizes appellate decisions in bankruptcy, civil rights, criminal, employment, family, insurance, litigation, zoning, and tort law. Among the rulings, a court held that a state student-loan agency was not immune from a bankruptcy dischargeability action; other decisions addressed criminal convictions, termination of parental rights, and a zoning variance. The issue also contains attorney practice listings, classified advertisements, job openings, and notices of bar events.

Inspector-General of Police Ibrahim Idris warned Ekiti officers not to help politicians manipulate the July 14, 2018 governorship election and urged the public to report misconduct. He said officers found guilty could be dismissed or face legal action. Separately, Mobile Policemen protesting unpaid salaries in Maiduguri accused Idris of corruption and selling promotions.

Denby reported imminent hostilities over Korea but said China sought a peaceful solution. He declined a British request to urge a joint protest against Japan without a Chinese government request, then forwarded Viceroy Li’s request for a joint appeal to withdraw Japanese troops. Sill reported that no fighting had occurred, though about 15,000 Japanese troops and 3,000 transport workers had arrived. He also described Japanese reform proposals and an incident involving a British representative. Sill warned that an admiral’s departure had endangered his promise of asylum to Korea’s king. Gresham said the United States could not intervene by force.

Tesla’s 2017 Form 10-K describes two business segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. Tesla sold the Model S and Model X, began Model 3 deliveries in July 2017, and offered Powerwall, Powerpack and solar systems. It operated manufacturing facilities in California, Nevada, New York and the Netherlands, and had 37,543 full-time employees at year-end. The filing highlights risks involving Model 3 production delays, supplier dependence, battery materials, product performance, expansion costs, regulation and competition.

The Fresh Market named Yvonne Cowser Yancy senior vice president and chief human resources officer. She brings more than 20 years of public- and private-sector HR experience, most recently as Atlanta’s human resources commissioner. She will oversee the retailer’s field and home office HR and benefits functions.

Insurance Australia Group shares fell more than 4% yesterday and reached $8.07 in morning trading amid scrutiny of the financial services sector by the royal commission. No investigation findings specifically concern IAG, though its general counsel has reportedly taken leave and is unlikely to return. The company recently agreed to a $525 million sale and increased its half-year dividend by 7.7%.

The passage describes the device’s power, reset, clocking, interrupt, and peripheral requirements. Core voltage domains support independently selected operating points and real-time dynamic voltage and frequency scaling, subject to supported combinations; adaptive voltage scaling is marked unsupported. It also specifies SRAM shutdown behavior, I/O voltage options, standby mode, supply sequencing, filtering, and decoupling.

Reset procedures distinguish power-on, warm, watchdog, software, local, and test resets, with provisions for PCIe and Ethernet-switch reset isolation. Clocking uses external crystals or clock inputs, PLLs, and selectable outputs, all subject to frequency and timing limits. The passage also covers interrupt controllers, DMA, debugging and trace, Ethernet, GPIO, memory and CAN interfaces, and HDMI capabilities and PCB routing guidance.

Japanese government bond prices fell Friday alongside U.S. Treasuries as investors awaited the Bank of Japan’s April bond-purchase plans. Some expect reduced buying of shorter-dated bonds; five- and 10-year yields rose.

Ángel Bracero was injured when bags of rice fell on him at a Ponce shop. The court accepted findings that he was an independent contractor and that the defendant operated the shop, but reversed the damages judgment because the record did not establish negligence at the time of the accident. It also declined to apply *res ipsa loquitur*, noting that Bracero and other workers had removed bags from the pile. The dissent argued that evidence of a defective pile and a prior warning supported the trial court’s judgment.

WiseGuyReports announced its “Gonorrhea - Pipeline Review, H2 2017,” covering therapeutics under development, drug targets, mechanisms of action, routes of administration, and molecule types. It reports company-developed candidates in Phase III (one), Phase II (one), preclinical development (four), and discovery (one). The guide also profiles companies and drugs, reviews recent developments, and includes dormant and discontinued projects.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% for the year, but fell 1.6% on August’s first trading day. The article says longer-term trends remain healthy while weakening short-term breadth, rising volatility and credit spreads, and heavier exposure to tech stocks warrant caution.

The speaker says the team believes it can win if it plays its best game at home in the Stanley Cup Finals. Every shift matters, and rather than give another speech, players should lead by example and play their game.

In 2011, Akamai was the world’s largest content delivery network, using servers close to end users to improve Internet performance. Despite its global reach, it faced growing competition from local providers in non-U.S. markets, as well as customers developing their own delivery capabilities.

Vice president Charley Dublin was tasked with addressing Akamai’s “localization challenge.” Products, prices, and sales targets set largely at headquarters often did not reflect local demand, competition, or working conditions. Headquarters and local teams also lacked a shared understanding of their respective markets. A 2011 reorganization gave regional managers more scope to coordinate, but product and pricing decisions remained within global functions. Dublin’s proposal needed to determine where and how much Akamai should localize while retaining the processes needed to serve global customers.

Gold prices have risen more than 50% over the past year, increasing costs for jewelry companies, particularly those selling at lower price points. Mejuri, Rowan and other retailers have raised or considered raising prices, while BaubleBar and Alexis Bittar are emphasizing plated alternatives to solid gold. Analysts expect lower interest rates, dollar weakness and political uncertainty to keep supporting gold prices.

The study models a prisoner’s dilemma with cooperation, defection, and opting out, in which players have different available strategy sets. Players adjust strategies through payoff-based introspection, while strategy sets evolve more slowly according to their success. Tournament analysis and simulations in well-mixed and spatial populations show that weak introspection favors sets containing defection or opting out. Stronger introspection generally favors the cooperation-and-loner set, which can sustain mutual cooperation and avoid exploitation. In spatial populations with all seven strategy sets, unconditional cooperation can also dominate at intermediate introspection strengths.

Nearly 600 SUNY Oneonta students and staff attended a memorial for Daniel William Michaels, 18, who died Dec. 3. Attendees shared memories, and more than $17,000 has been raised for a scholarship in his name.

Renault is expected to extend CEO Carlos Ghosn’s contract, pending board and shareholder approval, to give him more time to strengthen its alliance with Nissan and Mitsubishi. Renault also plans to appoint a deputy or operating chief so he can focus on strategy. Despite strong global sales, the alliance faces rivalries and disagreements over technology.

Researchers tested ex vivo susceptibility to nine antimalarial drugs in 1,114 *Plasmodium falciparum* isolates from eastern and northern Uganda collected during 2019–2024, and examined genetic resistance markers. Parasites remained mostly susceptible to commonly used drugs, but susceptibility to dihydroartemisinin and lumefantrine declined modestly, while susceptibility to chloroquine increased. PfK13 C469Y and A675V mutations were associated with reduced susceptibility to dihydroartemisinin and lumefantrine, but not with ring-stage survival results. Pyrimethamine activity was poor. The clinical implications of the declining susceptibilities remain uncertain; the authors recommend continued resistance surveillance.

After Hurricane Maria, Elon Musk said Tesla could help rebuild Puerto Rico’s power grid, subject to approval from its government, stakeholders and residents. Governor Ricardo Rossello invited Musk to discuss the proposal. As of Friday afternoon, just over 10 percent of island residents had power. Tesla had already sent Powerwall batteries to Puerto Rico and cited solar projects on Ta’u and Kaua’i as examples of its work.

A sick Belfast woman asked Feeley’s Fish & Chip Shop to buy cold and flu tablets while delivering her food. The restaurant fulfilled the request and shared the receipt on Facebook, where it drew widespread praise. Feeley’s also offered her a free meal when she recovered.
The speaker says the opponents’ defensive play has limited chances. Despite some power-play opportunities, Pahlsson’s goal decided the game. The team hopes to create more chances at home.
The speaker says the team played well but lost after defensive mistakes and a shorthanded goal. They plan to rest and refocus for Thursday’s game in Jersey.

The passage argues that Meta’s social media business generates cash flow to fund AI investment and that improvements for advertisers could support growth. It describes Meta’s valuation as attractive, citing an estimated FY2025 P/E of 25.4 and an average Wall Street price target implying 22% upside. Meta’s share price has been flat since the author’s previous coverage. The author discloses a long position in Meta.

Roffey beat Cuckfield by ten wickets, bowling them out for 103 before reaching 107 without loss. Stuart Whittingham took 4-35, while Rohit Jagota took 3-17 and scored an unbeaten 64. Roffey are top after four games, level on points with Brighton & Hove. Skipper Matt Davies urged his side to maintain their form ahead of Saturday’s trip to Ifield.

U.S. stocks fell Wednesday after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates and outlined plans to reduce its bond holdings. Lower oil prices weighed on energy shares, while technology stocks also declined. Data showed unexpected drops in May consumer prices and retail sales. Alexion and H&R Block gained on company news.

InVirtuoGen is a discrete flow model that generates molecules from fragmented SMILES by refining all token positions simultaneously. It uses explicit fragment attachment points and randomly shuffles fragments to avoid ordering bias. The authors evaluate it on de novo generation, fragment-constrained generation, property optimization, and lead optimization. They report a better quality–diversity trade-off than the compared models in de novo generation. In fragment-constrained tasks, its average quality, diversity, and uniqueness are competitive, but its validity is lower than GenMol’s. For property optimization, the proposed approach combines a genetic algorithm with reinforcement learning adapted to discrete flows.

The author argues that understanding Nigeria’s ethnic and political history is essential to building an effective national opposition to Buhari’s government. They contrast the approaches of Ahmadu Bello, Nnamdi Azikiwe and Obafemi Awolowo to regional power and national unity, then describe how historical conflicts and alliances shaped later politics. The author contends that a Northern power oligarchy persists but does not represent all Northerners. They reject the idea of a united Southern political bloc and call for an opposition that includes allies across Nigeria.

NVIDIA describes Blackwell GPU features for ray tracing, neural rendering, video, display and power efficiency. Fourth-generation RT Cores accelerate complex geometry through Mega Geometry’s cluster-based acceleration structures and partitioned scene updates, and add hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres for strand-like objects. Shader Execution Reordering 2.0 improves workload organization, while the AI Management Processor schedules GPU graphics and AI tasks.

Blackwell adds hardware encoding and decoding for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC video, an improved NVENC encoder and decoder, and DisplayPort 2.1b support. New power gating, faster frequency switching and quicker entry into sleep states target improved efficiency. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction and anti-aliasing. Neural shaders support techniques including texture compression, lighting approximation, materials, skin and faces.

The passage also outlines the GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products, followed by NVIDIA’s specification, warranty and liability notices.

Ontario’s Financial Accountability Office projects a $4 billion deficit in 2017–2018, contradicting the Liberal government’s balanced-budget claim, and a $9.8 billion deficit by 2021–2022. It cites slower revenue growth, the Fair Hydro Plan’s costs and a pension-accounting dispute that makes fiscal projections harder to assess.

Flipkart co-founder Sachin Bansal is building Billion, a budget brand aimed at shoppers in smaller Indian cities and towns. Flipkart has launched mixers and backpacks under the brand and may add a low-priced smartphone. The project is Bansal’s first major initiative since losing the CEO role in 2016. It also supports Flipkart’s push toward higher-margin private-label products as the company seeks to curb losses and attract new customers.

The speaker says the team played with better energy but needs to adjust its neutral-zone defense to prevent odd-man rushes. Despite bad breaks, the team remains resilient and aims to win its next game in Detroit.

In messages exchanged after the Armistice, British, Japanese, Italian, French, Greek, and U.S. leaders celebrated their shared wartime efforts and ideals. They expressed hopes for closer ties and cooperation in building peace. Lloyd George anticipated collaboration at the peace conference, while the U.S. reply to Greece called for a new international order that would protect the rights of small powers.

E. B. Woolf & Company sought commissions after a broker it employed introduced the purchaser of Alfred Hamburger’s printing plant. The appellate court held that the evidence supported the finding that the brokers procured the sale. It also held that the trial court erred by setting damages below the commission rates supported by testimony. The judgment was reversed, and judgment was entered for $750.

The lecture reviews stopping trials and Wald’s equality, then uses them to explain the elementary renewal theorem: the expected number of arrivals by time \(t\), divided by \(t\), approaches the reciprocal of the mean inter-arrival time. A lower bound follows from Wald’s equality; proving the upper bound requires truncating inter-arrival times.

The professor extends stopping trials to include service times and uses them to identify arrivals to an empty queue as renewal points. Little’s theorem relates the average number of customers in a system to the arrival rate times the average time each customer spends there. For an M/G/1 queue, the Pollaczek–Khinchin formula gives expected waiting time in queue as \(\lambda E[V^2]/[2(1-\rho)]\), where \(\rho=\lambda E[V]\). Thus waiting time depends on both server utilization and the second moment of service time.

Youth suicide remains a concern in China despite declining overall suicide rates. School-based gatekeeper training may help teachers and parents identify and support at-risk students, but evidence of its effects on suicidal behaviour is inconclusive, and existing programs may not fit Chinese schools. This study used a two-round Delphi process in 2022 to seek expert consensus on a culturally and contextually appropriate training program for teachers and parents. Proposed content covers suicide risk and warning signs, communication, assessment, safety planning, routes to support, and barriers to providing help. Experts rated the statements, suggested additions, and reconsidered their ratings after receiving feedback.

The passage reports a scanning tunneling microscopy method for probing magnetic fields attributed to induced magnetic monopoles on three-dimensional topological insulators. Image potential states split on Bi(111), but not on topologically trivial √3-Bi or two-dimensional Bi(110). The splitting varies with the tip’s electric field and is consistent with the authors’ model of an orbital magnetic moment interacting with a monopole-induced field.

The passage projects the global 3D animation market to reach approximately USD 20.5 billion by 2022, growing at about 12% annually from 2016. It identifies demand for movie visual effects, 3D mobile applications, and GPS mapping as growth drivers, while lack of finance is a constraint. North America leads the market, and the passage expects growth in Asia-Pacific and Europe. Applications include entertainment, healthcare, architecture, and education.

Authorities are investigating a fire that destroyed South Carolina Judge Diane Goodstein’s beachfront home and injured at least three family members. Occupants escaped by jumping from the elevated first floor. Goodstein had recently blocked the state election commission from sharing voter registration information with the federal government, but the state Supreme Court reversed her order.

NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture adds hardware encoding and decoding for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC video, improves AV1 and HEVC encoding, and supports DisplayPort 2.1b. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster clock adjustments, and quicker entry into deep sleep states. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also enables neural shaders for techniques including texture compression, lighting, materials, skin, and faces. The passage describes the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products, followed by NVIDIA’s specification and warranty notices.

It outlines merge mode-based and prediction block-based refinement, including search areas, reference pictures, and conditions for applying each method. The stated aims are to improve compression efficiency and reduce the computational complexity of inter prediction.

The goaltender is disappointed by coach Terry’s decision not to play him but says he will support Snowy and the team, work hard in practice, and be ready if needed. He says Terry has changed goaltenders before and does not feel singled out. He takes responsibility for the fourth goal in the last game, says the team played poorly, and believes it needs to adjust against a strong opponent without panicking.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on May 21, 2020, announcing results for the quarter ended April 26, 2020. The filing includes a press release and commentary from Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

Janney Montgomery Scott raised its price target for Pacira Pharmaceuticals from $31 to $34 while maintaining a neutral rating. Analysts’ consensus rating is Hold, with a $63.58 price target. Pacira opened Friday at $32.30. In its latest quarter, the company reported earnings of $0.20 per share, above estimates, and revenue of $68.40 million, up 10% year over year. Several institutional investors increased their holdings. Pacira develops and sells pharmaceutical products, with a focus on non-opioid postsurgical pain control.

An inside day occurs when a trading bar’s high is below the previous bar’s high and its low is above the previous bar’s low. The passage says inside days occur frequently but, based on its backtests, do not reliably predict future prices on their own. An RSI filter improved average gains modestly, while a tested S&P 500 swing strategy averaged 0.45% per trade.

Hartman argues that alliance cohesion and the credibility of the U.S. commitment to defend its allies matter more than the number of intermediate-range missiles deployed in Europe. He warns that insisting on the zero-zero INF proposal could threaten allied support for deployment. He recommends more flexible negotiating proposals while retaining zero-zero as the ultimate goal, preferably without much delay after March 6.

A subsequent memorandum reports Shultz’s proposal for intensified dialogue with Moscow on arms control, regional issues, human rights, and carefully paced bilateral matters, potentially leading to a summit. Clark objects that the approach could prompt piecemeal U.S. concessions without meaningful Soviet responses, raise public expectations, and weaken a firm policy toward the Soviet Union.
GMR Infrastructure reported a Rs565.94 crore net loss for the quarter ended 31 December 2017, compared with a Rs643.44 crore profit a year earlier. Income and expenses both declined.

Heating oil is a seasonal fuel whose demand rises in colder weather. Its futures contracts let producers and consumers hedge price risk and traders speculate. Contracts trade on ICE Futures Europe and CME, each representing 42,000 gallons; ICE settles in cash, while CME uses physical delivery. The minimum price fluctuation is $0.0001 per gallon, or $4.20 per contract. Prices are influenced by weather, crude oil prices, refinery capacity and alternative fuel costs. The passage reports a strategy backtest of 168 trades with a 59% win rate and a $370 average return per trade. It also warns that leverage can magnify losses.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2017 reports revenue of $2.79 billion, up from $1.27 billion a year earlier, and a $336.4 million net loss attributable to common stockholders. At June 30, Tesla held $3.04 billion in cash and cash equivalents against $26.04 billion in total assets and $19.46 billion in liabilities. During the first six months of 2017, operating activities used $270.0 million in cash and investing activities used $2.14 billion. The filing also describes Tesla’s Grohmann acquisition, debt financing, accounting policies, legal proceedings and solar-energy financing arrangements.

Google is testing Chrome’s first UI changes in two years in an experimental setting of the Windows Canary build. Tabs are now nearly rectangular, the active tab is brighter, and the address bar is rounded. Other changes include a separator beside add-on icons and a Google account image. Internal documents reportedly describe moving the new-tab button. It is unclear when the changes will reach the stable version.

The speaker says skating and execution matter more than line matchups against the Devils. Discipline and special teams are vital, while strong defense and pressure in the neutral zone helped contain the Devils’ offense. The team responded to adversity, with net-front pressure and a third-period goal by Ray Bourque contributing to a win. The speaker also praises the referees’ work in the first two games and says Adam Foote is a marked man.

The passage argues that damages for the Cape Horn Pigeon’s seizure and detention should reflect the loss of its use during the whaling season, not speculative profits. Because whaling depends on a brief seasonal opportunity, the average catch is presented as the appropriate measure of the vessel’s value to its owners and crew, who were paid by shares. The passage cites an award for lost passage money in the Williams case and a decision finding that detention caused the Costa Rica Packet’s captain to miss the best part of the whaling season, while noting limits on what he had proved about subsequent losses.

Strength training can build muscle, strength and endurance, but poor technique, repetitive movements or increasing intensity too quickly can cause injuries, including rotator cuff and hamstring injuries, herniated discs, tendonitis and elbow pain. To reduce the risk, warm up, use proper form, work within your ability and increase workout intensity gradually. Cool down and allow time to recover. If pain occurs, stop exercising and rest; consult a doctor if it persists. A qualified instructor can help you plan a routine and perform exercises correctly.

After Bottoms pleaded guilty to theft by receiving and financial transaction card theft, the trial court sentenced her to probation and ordered restitution for all items stolen in related burglaries. The appellate court upheld a continuance of the restitution hearing but ruled that restitution was limited to damages caused by the acts for which Bottoms was sentenced. It reversed and remanded for resentencing; her remaining claim was moot.

The passage extends an ab initio method for calculating spin diffusion length to account for electric fields along periodic directions. It derives a linearized steady-state quantum master equation and uses Wannier functions to compute the field-induced drift term while avoiding difficulties caused by band degeneracies and arbitrary eigenstate phases. The proposed method aims to assess electric-field effects and compare ab initio results with spin-drift model formulas across several materials.

Jonathan Toews and Patrick Kane said the team needs to create offense while playing smarter defensively against Tampa’s speed and playmaking. They saw positives in the previous game but want to limit chances and sustain possession as the Stanley Cup Final continues. Toews said the forwards are comfortable with different line combinations, praised Teuvo Teravainen’s development and Corey’s ability to bounce back, and looked forward to playing at home. Kane praised “Dunks” for his contributions in many situations and said he would focus on making the right play rather than forcing shots. Teravainen said he is learning from experienced teammates and is unconcerned about which opposing goalie starts.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture powers the GA102 and GA104 GPUs used in GeForce, RTX A6000, and A40 products. Compared with Turing, it offers up to twice the performance in several shading, ray-tracing, and AI workloads. Its advances include doubled peak FP32 processing per streaming multiprocessor, second-generation RT Cores with motion-blur acceleration, and third-generation Tensor Cores supporting structured sparsity and new data types. The passage also describes GDDR6X memory, PCIe 4.0, RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression, 8K display support, AV1 hardware decoding, and hardware video encoding. The RTX A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.
In a June 4, 2018 Form 8-K, Microsoft announced a definitive agreement to acquire GitHub for $7.5 billion. The filing includes a press release and an investor presentation about the transaction.

A Middlebury Public Safety officer identified former student Addis Fouche-Channer as a participant in a March protest against Charles Murray, but she said she was not there. The college charged her with violating its protest policy, then dropped the case after reviewing evidence including Wi-Fi logs. Fouche-Channer said the process caused significant stress and accused the officer of racial profiling. The college investigated her complaint, but had not announced a decision as of press time.

The passage argues that declining science proficiency and interest call for more inquiry-based instruction. It recommends that districts adopt high-quality materials and provide sustained, curriculum-based professional learning in which teachers experience the investigations they will teach. School leaders should also give teachers planning time and support as they change their practices.

On May 25, 2016, Microsoft announced plans to streamline its smartphone hardware business, eliminating up to 1,850 positions, including 1,350 at Microsoft Mobile Oy in Finland. It expects to record an approximately $950 million impairment and restructuring charge in the quarter ending June 30, including about $200 million for severance. The actions are expected to be substantially complete by year-end and fully complete by July 2017.

The paper proposes a 5G vehicular cloud framework that assigns offloaded tasks to vehicles or a backup cloud while accounting for deadlines, energy use, and cost. A network-operator controller uses vehicle status reports to select executors, then updates costs and completion times after execution.
