The framework also models uncertain outcomes through a coalitional game to share revenue among the operator, cloud, and vehicle owners. The paper states that its robust core is non-empty and aims to assess emissions savings and incentives for vehicle participation.

Chamomile has a long history of herbal use, and German chamomile (Matricaria recutita) is widely grown. Its flower oil is typically extracted by steam distillation, with yields of 0.2–0.4% of the flowers’ weight. The passage describes the oil as having anti-inflammatory, antiseptic and spasmolytic properties and lists medicinal uses involving relaxation, skin conditions and digestion. It is also used in soaps, cosmetics, beverages and other commercial products.

This unreviewed protocol proposes the Canadian Social Determinants Urban Laboratory, which will link survey, administrative, and area-level data to study health inequalities in Canadian cities and towns. Using a hub and five research nodes, the project will develop indicators of political, economic, environmental, socioeconomic, material, and health-system factors. It will then use decomposition analysis to estimate their relative contributions to income-related differences in self-reported health.
In a November 7, 2018 Form 8-K, Tesla reported that it published a blog post on its website and attached the post as Exhibit 99.1.

A meta-analysis of 333,247 adults found that moderate drinkers had lower overall mortality than abstainers or heavy drinkers during follow-up periods of about eight years. Compared with abstainers, they were roughly 25% less likely to die of heart disease or stroke, but no less likely to die of cancer. Heavy drinkers had about 45% higher cancer mortality than moderate drinkers. The association between moderate drinking and lower mortality was stronger among adults 60 and older and was not observed among adults 18 to 39 or non-Latino Black participants.

Exxon Mobil reported December-quarter earnings of 88 cents per share, below analysts’ $1.04 expectation, and its shares fell 3% in pre-market trading. Full-year earnings were $19.7 billion on revenue of $244.36 billion. The company kept its quarterly dividend at 77 cents and announced plans to invest $50 billion in the U.S. over five years. It aims to triple production in Texas’ Permian Basin, where it expanded its holdings last year. Rising shale output could pressure oil prices, while Goldman Sachs forecast higher prices by summer. Exxon also reported quarterly earnings of $1.6 billion from downstream operations and $1.3 billion from chemicals.

Apple has reportedly shelved a cheaper, lighter Vision Pro to focus on AI smart glasses, though it still plans a headset update with a better chip. The Vision Pro has struggled with its price, bulk and unclear uses. Meta already sells smart glasses, but the passage says broad consumer demand for wearable computers remains unproven.

Good Sam Club CEO and Camping World head Marcus Lemonis bought the bankrupt Gander Mountain chain, renamed it Gander Outdoors, and began reopening 69 stores. Gander Outdoors now uses a version of the Good Sam mascot.

In January 1917, Ambassador Page protested anti-American press coverage and Italian coal-price controls; Italy’s foreign minister said low prices were necessary to sustain the war. Page also reported Vatican criticism of Allied territorial aims and warnings about Russian dominance. From Greece, Minister Droppers reported progress toward a settlement and hopes that the blockade would soon be lifted. In an address to the Senate, President Wilson said his request for belligerents’ peace terms had drawn a proposal for talks from the Central Powers and a more definite response from the Entente. He called for a postwar international agreement to prevent another such conflict.

The Russell 2000 tracks the 2,000 smallest companies in the Russell 3000 and is a benchmark for U.S. small-cap stocks. IWM is an ETF that tracks the index. The index rebalances each June, when its components may change. The passage describes a trading strategy focused on this rebalancing period and says IWM can diverge from the S&P 500 despite their correlation.

Cory Stillman says the team would miss Doug Weight if he cannot play, but other centers can fill in. After a tough loss, the team is using the extra rest to refocus for Saturday and hopes to close out the series. Stillman says they need more traffic at the net, pressure the opposing goalie when he handles the puck, and play better as a team.

Taylor Swift is credited as the sole writer of more than 60 songs across her career, meaning she wrote their lyrics and melodies alone. The passage lists examples from her early albums through “The Tortured Poets Department: The Anthology,” including “Our Song,” “Love Story,” “Dear John,” “Red,” and “The Black Dog.”

The speaker calls winning the Stanley Cup the biggest accomplishment of his career but says he must keep proving himself. He is glad he returned from playing in Finland, though the decision was difficult. During the final against Vancouver, he tried to stay composed after a game-winning goal but admits he felt nervous. He considers the Conn Smythe an honor, while emphasizing that the Stanley Cup was his main goal.

Charles Robert Jenkins, a U.S. Army sergeant who deserted to North Korea in 1965, has died in Japan aged 77. He said he deserted to avoid hazardous duty in South Korea and combat in Vietnam. In North Korea, he married Japanese abductee Hitomi Soga. He joined her in Japan in 2004 with their two daughters, served a 30-day sentence for desertion and settled in Sado.

Several Texas public universities have told faculty to review course materials for compliance with state and federal requirements, creating confusion about what must be removed. Texas Tech system employees were directed not to teach, discuss or acknowledge transgender identity, while San Jacinto College said it had no formal ban, though a faculty member reported a verbal restriction. Texas A&M is also reviewing course content. A FIRE attorney said no federal or state law prohibits public university professors from teaching about transgender identity and called the directives censorship.

Joe Hadzima introduces a course on planning and executing new ventures, emphasizing that a business plan is a dynamic process for building a shared vision, not just a document. The central tasks are creating value and capturing enough of it to sustain the venture. Planning helps entrepreneurs understand customers, markets, resources, risks and how best to use their time. A plan should clearly explain why the opportunity matters, why the timing is right and why the team can deliver. Its executive summary should earn a closer look from readers, while the team must be able to defend the full plan. Hadzima stresses testing key assumptions, setting achievable steps and communicating the venture clearly.

The lecture reviews countable-state Markov processes, relating their steady-state time fractions to an embedded Markov chain and showing how extreme transition rates can make apparent steady-state solutions misleading. It then explains reversibility and uses it to discuss Burke’s theorem: in a stable M/M/1 queue, departures form a Poisson process at the arrival rate. The lecture introduces random walks through threshold-crossing questions, simple and integer walks, and their relationship to renewal processes. It models waiting times in a G/G/1 queue as a random walk constrained to remain nonnegative. Finally, it introduces binary hypothesis testing using repeated, conditionally independent observations and Bayes’ law.

A government scheme launched in 2011 distributes sanitary napkins to girls aged 10–19 in rural areas of 107 districts. An IndiaSpend analysis found poor-quality products, stock shortages and delays of up to three months. It also identified limited awareness efforts, inadequate training for health workers and unsafe disposal of non-biodegradable napkins. National utilisation of scheme funds was 7.36% in 2014–15, 29.8% in 2015–16 and 19.72% in 2016–17. A 2015–16 survey found that 48% of rural women aged 15–24 practised menstrual hygiene.

To disable screenshot drop shadows in macOS High Sierra, run `defaults write com.apple.screencapture disable-shadow true` in Terminal, then `killall SystemUIServer`. If shadows remain, restart your Mac. To restore shadows, replace `true` with `false` and restart SystemUIServer again.

The passage argues that accusations of government “doctoring” an electoral reform Bill are misplaced. It says the Law Commission makes recommendations, while the executive considers them alongside its policies when drafting a Bill for Parliament. Parliament then debates and shapes the Bill. The author urges citizens to wait until it reaches Parliament before making accusations.

Jamie compares caring for the mind to exercising the body: both need regular attention. She says the aim is not constant happiness but accepting that emotions and difficult periods pass. Her seven-step daily routine involves naming an emotion, breathing slowly, writing down and releasing thoughts, practicing gratitude, playing a mindful game, showing compassion, and doing something kind for someone else.

The passage describes SD card interface selection, initialization, data transfer, performance features, protection, and power management. A UHS-II host supports both legacy SD and UHS-II interfaces; if it does not detect the UHS-II signal within the specified timeout, it initializes the card through the SD interface. UHS-II initialization proceeds through PHY initialization, device initialization, enumeration, configuration, and SD-TRAN initialization.

In SD mode, the host verifies operating conditions, initializes compatible cards with ACMD41, and identifies them with CMD2 and CMD3. It then selects cards for data transfer. The passage specifies read, write, erase, DISCARD, and full-user-area logical erase operations, including command sequences and error handling. It also describes password-based locking and optional Card Ownership Protection, which uses a Force Erase Password.

CMD6 checks or switches card functions, including bus speed and power limits. The passage also covers UHS-I voltage switching and tuning, cache, self-maintenance, command queuing, and the FD624 speed mode.

The passage describes classified memoranda and meeting records concerning U.S.–Soviet relations from February to March 1983. Reagan initialed several memoranda. On February 15, he met with Secretary of State Shultz and Soviet Ambassador Dobrynin at the White House and proposed using Shultz as a direct channel to Andropov. Shultz and Dobrynin then met at the Secretary’s office. Later notes record Clark’s skepticism that the Soviets would permit the Pentecostalists to leave and the preparation and forwarding of additional memoranda to Reagan.

At a Business Insider event sponsored by Fidelity Investments, experts said companies preparing for an IPO should focus on operational readiness rather than trying to time the market. They recommended bringing in specialists, planning for regulatory and shareholder requirements, choosing appropriate investors and brokers, and preparing to deliver quarterly results. They also emphasized employee compensation, retention, communication, and financial-planning support. Staying private longer can give companies more time to prepare.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 30, 2020, announcing its second-quarter 2020 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

The passage presents a framework for explaining how spatial averaging can make the dynamics of heterogeneous, interconnected nonlinear systems asymptotically linear. It extends results on ρ-mixing sequences to multivariate and spatial settings, then uses them to study when averaged dynamics become linear time-varying or, under additional stationarity assumptions, linear time-invariant. It also examines convergence rates: averaging is most effective for independent subsystems and less effective as correlations strengthen. The excerpt defines ρ-mixing and residual factors and begins analyzing how correlation decay affects cumulative variance.

The lecture expresses interacting-theory correlation functions as ratios of free-theory expectation values, then expands them in a small interaction. Using a quartic scalar interaction and the two-point function, it applies Wick’s theorem to evaluate terms and shows that some first-order contributions cancel. Feynman diagrams provide a simpler way to organize contractions: propagators represent free two-point functions, vertices represent interactions, and symmetry factors correct for equivalent contractions. The lecture gives rules for translating diagrams into coordinate-space and momentum-space expressions, where momentum is conserved at each vertex.

On June 22, 2016, Apple issued $1.377 billion in 4.15% senior unsecured notes due June 22, 2046. Interest is payable semiannually, beginning December 22, 2016. The Form 8-K includes the subscription agreement, an officer’s certificate, the form of note and a legal opinion as exhibits.

A Netflix documentary follows the months-long harassment of Beal City student Lauryn Licari and her boyfriend through threatening, graphic texts. After local investigators failed to identify the sender, the FBI examined digital evidence from Owen McKenny’s phone. The columnist argues that the documentary illustrates the harm cellphone misuse can cause and wishes it had explained cellphone forensics more fully. He also supports Oklahoma’s trial ban on cellphone use during the school day.

SOS defense pressures ball handlers toward sideline, corner, or baseline checkpoints while denying drives through the middle. Defenders use contact pass denial, front deep post players, and trap in specified situations. Weakside defenders form Helpside I alignments to provide support, deny cuts, and prepare to rotate. When a trap occurs, the remaining defenders form a Triangle I; on a pass out, they rotate and close out to the nearest offensive players. The system also calls for switching on off-ball screens and boxing out with all five defenders on shots.

The passage examines molecule generation with large language models. SELFIES guarantees valid molecules but performs worse than SMILES on other metrics; iterative LLM correction improves SMILES validity while reducing performance elsewhere. The proposed SmiSelf framework converts invalid SMILES through molecular graphs and SELFIES back into valid SMILES. In the reported experiments, it achieved 100% validity while largely preserving other metrics, though correction sometimes distorted molecules relative to their descriptions.

Mike Peca’s Selke Trophy win and other nomination are cited as signs of consistent play. After nine years with the North Stars and Dallas Stars, the speaker welcomes the team’s chance to compete in the Stanley Cup finals. The speaker says unrestricted free agency has helped improve the roster, with additions benefiting both players and the team.

Fitch affirmed Marsh & McLennan’s long-term and senior unsecured debt ratings at ‘A-’ and short-term ratings at ‘F2’, while raising its outlook to Positive. It cited sustained operating improvement, strong liquidity and credit metrics, including a 20% operating margin in 2016. Fitch expects earnings growth but noted manageable litigation and regulatory risks.

The study reports a superconducting diode effect in strained NbSe₂ without an external magnetic field; unstressed regions of the same device showed no such effect. At zero field, the largest measured difference between forward and reverse critical currents was 286 μA, with a diode efficiency of 6.76%. Across devices, the effect showed magnetic-field-even, magnetic-field-odd, or mixed behavior. The authors propose two independent, perpendicular mechanisms: stress-induced structural polarity along the armchair direction for the field-even effect, and magnetic-field-activated valley polarization along the zigzag direction for the field-odd effect.

Researchers found that brown recluse spiders use their spinnerets to form tiny loops in unusually thin, flat silk, making their webs tougher, flexible and sticky enough to trap prey. The team hopes to replicate the structure with synthetic ribbon-shaped fibers for uses including protective space webs, parachute cords and bungee cords. They have developed mathematical models and filed a patent application, but have not yet made a synthetic version.

The Beerepoot family’s Mole Creek home is set for auction after they refused to pay council rates, saying the land belongs to God. Meander Valley Council resolved in March to sell three family properties over $9,332 in outstanding rates. Rates on two were paid in June; the home remains scheduled for auction unless the debt is paid.

OpenAI and Stripe have introduced Instant Checkout in ChatGPT, powered by their open-source Agentic Commerce Protocol. The feature is launching with U.S.-based sellers and is expected to expand to more than a million merchants. Other AI assistants could also adopt the protocol, potentially spreading in-chat shopping. Merchants need detailed, current product feeds to improve their chances of appearing in ChatGPT recommendations, but may face transaction fees and reduced control over customer relationships. The shift also raises questions about how ChatGPT chooses which products to recommend.

Researchers documented about 150 engravings at three rock outcrops in Saudi Arabia’s Nefud Desert, dating from 12,800 to 11,400 years ago. The art includes life-size camels, other animals and human figures, created in four phases. The researchers suggest the engravings were made by early nomadic arrivals as the region grew wetter and may have marked territory or water sources. Excavated objects indicate links to prehistoric peoples in the Eastern Mediterranean, while the engravings’ size and style point to a distinct artistic tradition.

Japanese Finance Minister Taro Aso warned that tensions over North Korea could make the yen unstable despite its safe-haven reputation. He declined to comment on exchange rates, saying markets should set them. Aso also urged the 11 remaining Trans-Pacific Partnership members to proceed without the United States and questioned whether Washington would gain more from bilateral trade deals.

University of Washington astronomer Rory Barnes found that many potentially habitable exoplanets discovered by upcoming telescopes may be tidally locked, with one side permanently facing their star. By considering a wider range of initial rotation rates and planetary properties, he challenged earlier assumptions that limited tidal locking to planets around small, dim stars. Atmospheric winds could moderate the resulting climate extremes, making tidal locking important to assess when searching for life.

Oil prices rose about 1.5% after OPEC+ agreed to increase November output by a modest 137,000 barrels per day, easing oversupply concerns. Analysts viewed the move as support for price stability but warned that uneven demand and rising inventories could limit further gains.

The 2016 Indian Super League finale drew 54,000 spectators in Kochi and 41 million television viewers. The season reached 216 million viewers, up from about 207 million in 2015, including 101 million in rural India. Mumbai and Chennai viewership rose by more than 50 percent. Viewer engagement increased by over 25 percent, digital watchtime reached 2.3 times the previous year’s level, and stadiums averaged more than 84 percent capacity.

An IDC survey of 200 manufacturing decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland finds that simulation, modeling, and data analytics support product development, quality, and innovation. Respondents expect their use to expand, but data silos, outdated simulations, and limited computing capacity constrain results. Eighty-one percent view high-performance computing (HPC) as a game changer for product and process innovation. Many favor external or cloud-based HPC for scalability and flexibility, while citing security, cost, energy use, and skills shortages as challenges. IDC recommends a shared data foundation and an HPC operating model suited to each enterprise’s needs.

In a randomized, double-blind phase III study in India, 416 adults previously vaccinated with COVISHIELD or COVAXIN received a CORBEVAX booster or placebo. At day 28, CORBEVAX recipients had stronger neutralizing antibody, anti-RBD IgG and cellular responses than placebo recipients. Neutralizing antibody titers rose at least twofold in 71% of COVISHIELD-primed and 68% of COVAXIN-primed CORBEVAX recipients. Omicron antibody responses were detected in 91% and 75%, respectively, after boosting. Reported adverse events were mild to moderate; no serious adverse events occurred. The reported immunogenicity findings cover only the first 28 days, with longer follow-up planned.

UK median disposable household income reached £27,300 in the financial year ending in 2017, up 2.3% after inflation from the previous year and £1,600 above its pre-2008 level, according to the Office for National Statistics. Rising wages and employment contributed to the increase. Since the banking crisis, income gains have been greater for the poorest fifth of households than for the richest fifth, and inequality has fallen slightly. A substantial gap remains: average disposable income was £12,748 for the poorest fifth and £65,542 for the richest. Retired households’ incomes rose more slowly than non-retired households’ incomes in the latest year.

Research commissioned by the Association of British Insurers after the Grenfell Tower fire found that British fire-safety tests do not adequately reflect real conditions, including plastics in fires and gaps or vents in cladding. The ABI called for non-combustible construction materials, reformed testing and mandatory sprinklers in certain new buildings. At least 71 people died in the fire.

The study examined 61,698 Scopus-indexed articles with Ukrainian affiliations published from 2020 to 2023, comparing the two years before and during Russia’s full-scale invasion. The share acknowledging funding rose from 21.7% to 28.5%, even as overall article output declined. Articles acknowledging Ukraine’s three principal research funders—the Ministry of Education and Science, the National Academy of Sciences, and the National Research Foundation—also increased.

Foreign co-affiliations became more common, while international co-authorship generally declined among articles funded by these agencies. Poland, Germany, and the United States remained important partners; Russia disappeared from leading partner lists in 2022–2023. Foreign-funded articles had the highest average citation impact. Foreign co-funding was positively associated with citation impact for Academy-funded articles, but the study’s statistical models often had limited explanatory power. Academy-funded articles without foreign co-funding had citation impact statistically indistinguishable from unfunded articles in 2022–2023. The authors call for more effective funding allocation, stronger international engagement, and a centralised database of Ukrainian research grants and outputs.

Automation Anywhere’s Bot Store doubled its number of bots in the two months after launch. With the addition of IQ Bot, developers and partners can offer bots with computer vision, natural language processing and machine learning capabilities to automate document-based processes. Artificial intelligence is the largest bot category, speech-to-text leads downloads, and SAP is the most prevalent application listed.

The passage describes a proximity sensor that uses cured optical-resin drops as lenses over a light emitter and light sensors. An opaque molding compound encapsulates the components and blocks light from passing directly between the emitter and sensors, eliminating the prior-art plastic cap and central barrier. Manufacturing involves assembling multiple sensors on a substrate, dispensing and curing the resin, molding, polishing to expose the lenses, and cutting the array into individual modules. Optional designs add baffles, glass lenses, filters, or a reference light sensor. The passage also describes a plug-in sensor stick that combines proximity, environmental, motion, and wireless sensors.
Private equity billionaire Tony James is backing a newly launched life sciences investment firm led by a former Flagship associate.

The lecture explains that periodic Euclidean time makes black-hole and Rindler horizons regular and corresponds to a finite temperature. Vacuum choice in curved spacetime depends on how a theory is quantized: the Hartle–Hawking vacuum is regular at a black-hole horizon, while the Schwarzschild vacuum can produce singular observables there. In Rindler spacetime, periodic Euclidean time selects the Minkowski vacuum. The lecture derives its thermal appearance to a Rindler observer: the Minkowski vacuum is entangled across the left and right Rindler regions, and tracing out the inaccessible left region gives a thermal density matrix for the right, with inverse temperature \(2\pi\) relative to Rindler time.

Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper will testify at a California Senate hearing on February 14 about Colorado’s experience regulating recreational cannabis. California officials hope to learn about taxes, regulatory timelines and track-and-trace systems as they work toward a January 1, 2018, deadline. State senator Mike McGuire has warned that some required rules and systems may not be ready by then.

Arsenal visit Tottenham on Sunday for the 50th North London derby of Arsene Wenger’s tenure, having won 18, drawn 21 and lost 10 of the previous meetings. A Tottenham fan predicts a 2-1 win but doubts Spurs will overtake Chelsea for the title. An Arsenal supporter says recent wins have boosted confidence and hopes the club can return to the top four while thwarting Tottenham. He predicts a draw and says Wenger’s future remains debated.

Most children come to believe in Santa and abandon that belief by about age eight as their thinking develops and they begin questioning his extraordinary abilities. The passage says fantastical beliefs are associated with positive developmental outcomes, and research suggests children generally react well to learning the truth. Parents can answer questions, invite children to work out explanations themselves, or offer evidence that Santa is fictional. The author recommends following children’s lead and suggests giving modest gifts from Santa so children across different income levels can feel included.

The tax filing deadline is April 17, and taxpayers who need more time can request an extension. Refunds must be claimed within three years; the IRS reported about $1.1 billion in unclaimed 2014 refunds. People who were not required to file may still qualify for a refund or tax credit. Late filing can bring fees, while unpaid taxes can lead to collection notices and asset seizures. The IRS may arrange monthly payments for those unable to pay in full.

Stephen Hawking and Thomas Hertog submitted a draft paper on March 4, ten days before Hawking’s death. It proposes an alternative model of a multiverse theory that could help discover parallel universes and suggests our universe will eventually die as stars lose energy.

Jacques Dubochet, Joachim Frank and Richard Henderson won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing cryo-electron microscopy, which reveals biological molecules in detail. Their advances in freezing samples and producing sharper, three-dimensional images allow scientists to study molecular processes at near-atomic resolution. The Nobel committee said the method aids understanding of life’s chemistry and pharmaceutical development.

The passage describes a linear surgical stapler with an anvil half and a cartridge half that clamp tissue, then cut and staple it during firing. It details pin-trap mechanisms that releasably couple the halves at their proximal ends, including slides, biased pins, C-clips, ejectors, camming surfaces, and a rotatable latch. Several configurations keep the halves coupled while open and allow them to be deliberately separated.

The passage lists trading articles on commodities, gold, currencies, and technical indicators, many featuring rules, futures examples, and backtests. It describes approaches including trend following, mean reversion, spread trading, fundamental analysis, arbitrage, and options trading. Examples include gold moving-average and gap strategies, a copper/gold ratio strategy, and crude oil seasonality. The website is managed by traders Hakan Samuelsson and Oddmund Groette and their team.

SEV-ES and SEV-SNP protect guest register state from direct hypervisor access. The Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) lets guests selectively share state for non-automatic exits. The passage specifies its shared-page layout, protocol negotiation, feature advertisement, guest physical address registration, and VMGEXIT handling. It also describes page-state changes, firmware guest requests, AP creation and booting, trusted I/O, Secure AVIC, and NMI handling. For SEV-SNP Restricted Injection, a shared doorbell page communicates pending interrupts and non-maskable events; the host emulates APIC presentation, acknowledgment, and end-of-interrupt behavior.

The speaker says experience from past playoff series has helped the team feel more relaxed and prepared, though pregame nerves remain. They expect a physical matchup with the Flyers but do not see their team as greatly outsized or at a clear speed disadvantage. Reaching the finals before was exciting, but that experience taught the speaker that the real thrill is winning them.

KeyBanc downgraded Fortinet from Overweight to Sector Weight after its shares rose 23 percent in 2018. Analyst Rob Owens cited uncertainty around the company’s margin-expansion target and a less favorable risk-reward profile, while acknowledging its strength in network security and cloud opportunity.

Sebastian Vettel won the 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix, holding off Valtteri Bottas by 0.699 seconds after Ferrari switched him to a one-stop strategy that left him defending on worn tyres. Lewis Hamilton finished third after starting ninth. Ferrari retired Kimi Raikkonen’s car after it struck a mechanic during a pit stop, while both Red Bull drivers retired in the opening laps. Pierre Gasly finished fourth for Toro Rosso-Honda, followed by Kevin Magnussen. Marcus Ericsson finished ninth, earning Sauber’s first points since the previous year’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

The Stochastic Indicator compares a closing price with its recent price range. Its %K line shows the price’s position in that range, while %D smooths %K. Traders use readings above 80 or below 20, crossovers, and divergence to identify potential reversals, often checking other indicators for confirmation.

A backtest using SPY from 1993 reported 556 trades, an average return of 0.57% per trade, a 2.2 profit factor, and a 19.8% maximum drawdown. Short-lookback overbought and oversold rules outperformed the crossovers tested. The passage cautions that signals can be false or late, especially in ranging, strongly trending, or highly volatile markets, and recommends adjusting settings and managing risk.

Thousands of schools closed nationwide on Monday because of snow. Continued icy weather has kept several schools in and around Warwick District and Rugby Borough closed on Tuesday, and the closure list may be updated.

The passage describes a Python trading strategy combining a 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) with a 5-day simple moving average (SMA). It buys when RSI is below 30 and the closing price is above the SMA, and sells when RSI is above 70 and the closing price is below the SMA. It uses daily Walmart price data from January 2020 to January 2022 to explain signal generation and an equity curve, and discusses applying the strategy to SPY and QQQ.

A retrospective study compared 1,223 matched patients taking GLP-1 receptor agonists with 1,223 not taking them after developing cancer therapy-related cardiac dysfunction. Over one year, the treated group had lower rates of a composite outcome of heart failure exacerbation, death, or hospital or emergency department admission (55.7% versus 68.9%). Mortality, heart failure exacerbations, and hospital admissions were also lower; differences in arrhythmias were not statistically significant. Because the study was observational and follow-up was limited to one year, the findings do not establish causality or long-term effects.

Thursday morning trading was positive: the Nifty rose 26 points to 10,641 and the Sensex gained 88 to 34,994. Banking, telecom, oil and gas, and metal stocks gained, with Reliance Communications up 10 percent. Advances outnumbered declines on both exchanges, while 38 stocks hit 52-week lows.

Saudi Aramco cut May prices for lighter crude grades sold to Asia, including a 30-cent-per-barrel reduction for Arab Light, while leaving medium and heavy grade prices unchanged. The column says the cuts appear aimed at competing with growing supplies of lighter crude from producers outside the OPEC-led output agreement. The Middle East’s share of Asian crude imports fell from 65.9% in January to 61.5% in March, while the share from Western exporters rose. The author suggests continued competition could leave Asia with excess lighter crude and a shortage of heavier grades.

Finland’s minister expressed hope that relations with the United States would not deteriorate. Under Secretary Welles replied that Finland’s assistance to Germany against the Soviet Union was incompatible with normal relations and warned against major new offensives. The Secretary of State then instructed the U.S. minister in Sweden to encourage Swedish officials to urge Finland to avoid further offensives and seek peace or a cessation of fighting. A later telegram reported a new German-Finnish trade agreement intended to support Finland’s wartime economy and increase its deliveries to Germany.
Kirigami-inspired cuts let Mylar disks unfurl into parachutes that could deliver aid or packages.

Jane Goodall warns that wildlife conservation is increasingly urgent, with climate change posing the greatest long-term threat. She remains cautiously optimistic that action is still possible and hopes a new documentary about her early chimpanzee research inspires viewers to protect wildlife.

A video of Tennessee middle schooler Keaton Jones describing bullying drew more than 18 million views by Sunday, while a fundraiser for his education raised over $29,000. Athletes and entertainers offered support, with some inviting him to a game or planning to visit his school.

An analysis of the Phase II JAVELIN Merkel 200 trial found that, among patients with metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma treated with avelumab, lack of disease progression and reduced tumor size correlated with improvements in health-related quality of life.

Enron replaced CFO Andrew Fastow with former treasurer Jeff McMahon on October 24, 2001, saying the change was needed to restore investor confidence. The SEC was examining transactions with partnerships Fastow had run, while investors and analysts questioned Enron’s disclosures and potential liabilities. Enron shares fell 17% that day to $16.41, and several analysts downgraded the stock. Shareholder lawsuits also challenged the company’s handling of the partnerships and its disclosures.

The Capitals’ coach says reaching the Stanley Cup finals has been energizing rather than exhausting. He respects the defending champion Red Wings and coach Scotty Bowman but says his experienced team is not intimidated. He credits veteran players, organizational support and a supportive locker room for the Capitals’ run. He expects to adjust tactics during the series, says teammates are especially motivated to win for Dale Hunter, and views both teams’ goaltenders as strong.

The passage describes a respiratory assistance system that heats and humidifies gases delivered to a patient. Its controller can identify the gas source and system configuration using sensor measurements, breathing and rebreathing patterns, flow rates, or connected components. It can then adjust heater temperature settings to account for differences between ambient air and dry gas supplies, with the aim of maintaining humidity and reducing condensation. The system can also compare a user-selected configuration with sensor findings and alert the user to a mismatch.

CeeDee Lamb has missed two games with a high left ankle sprain but has resumed resistance-band work at practice. ESPN’s Todd Archer says a Week 7 return against Washington is possible, while a Week 6 return appears unlikely without increased practice participation.

A cross-sectional Nigerian study compared cancer-related biomarkers in 248 adults grouped by HIV status and occupational chemical exposure. HIV-positive exposed participants had lower p53 and bcl2 levels than HIV-negative unexposed participants, and higher MDA levels than HIV-negative participants. HIV-positive participants had lower CD4 counts regardless of occupational exposure. HIV status and SOD activity were associated with p53 and bcl2 levels. The study could not establish causality or assess long-term cancer outcomes.
The Third Circuit found no error and affirmed the district court’s judgment.

The passage describes features of the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 microcontrollers, including an ADC-connected temperature sensor, a low-frequency subsystem with a real-time clock and independent watchdog, configurable voltage references, a comparator, security features, CRC, UART, I2C, SPI, timers, and a windowed watchdog. It also covers input/output configuration, serial-wire debugging, and read-only factory constants containing device information and calibration data.

TI’s typical-application guidance specifies power-supply decoupling, an external reset-pin resistor and capacitor, and additional components for certain crystal and open-drain configurations. The passage also lists development resources, revision changes, packaging and assembly notes, and limitations on TI’s application guidance and other resources.

Youth and Sports Minister Solomon Dalung said President Buhari’s 2015 election victory showed that candidates could win without money and signalled a challenge to political “god-fatherism.” Speaking in New York during a UN youth forum, he urged young Nigerians to understand the political system and said the “Not too Young to Run” campaign challenged entrenched leaders. Dalung cited progress in infrastructure, the economy and security, while calling for cooperation with neighbouring countries to restrict armed criminals’ movements. A Nigerian diplomat also praised the government’s progress.

Germany’s Federal Cartel Office is investigating whether Temu’s policies and pricing tools improperly influence independent merchants’ prices and restrict competition. Temu says it complies with European competition law and is cooperating. If violations are confirmed, it could face penalties or be required to change its merchant terms.

Scientists have proposed using wind-powered pumps to spray seawater onto Arctic ice, where it would freeze and thicken the ice. They estimate that 10 million pumps covering 10 percent of the Arctic could add one metre of ice, potentially reducing the risk of ice-free summers. The plan would cost about US$500 billion and require roughly 10 million tons of steel per year. The passage describes rapid Arctic warming and declining sea ice as the motivation, but says the project is unlikely to happen in its current form.

Tesla has introduced stripped-down Standard versions of the Model Y and Model 3, priced at $39,990 and $36,990—about $5,000 less than their Premium counterparts. The cuts do not fully offset the loss of the $7,500 federal EV tax credit. Both models have fewer luxury features; the Model Y Standard also has less power and a shorter estimated range. An Edmunds analyst doubts the price reduction will attract many new buyers. Tesla’s global sales are down 6 percent from last year, while Musk has emphasized autonomous vehicles and robotics as the company’s future.

A study of genomic, clinical, and epidemiological data from Connecticut examined how Omicron lineages replaced one another in 2022. BA.1 spread fastest, while replacement generally slowed later in the year. Estimated infections totaled about 1.5 million for BA.1, more than 2.1 million combined for BA.2, BA.4, and BA.5, and 0.4 million for XBB through January 2023. Viral copy numbers and vaccine breakthrough patterns indicated that neither transmissibility nor immune escape alone explained every replacement. The authors propose that their relative contributions varied with population immunity. They note that the findings are most applicable to populations with similar characteristics and public health conditions.

The passage introduces a study of how employment status, working time and job satisfaction relate to subjective survival probabilities (SSP) among people aged 50 and over in Japan. SSP is associated with mortality but differs from self-rated health, and its relationship with work and employment remains understudied. Japan’s pension and elderly-employment reforms have encouraged later employment, often through reemployment contracts. Using four waves of the Japanese Study of Aging and Retirement from 2007 to 2013, the study examines differences in SSP across employment categories and working conditions, including whether demographic, socioeconomic and health factors affect those relationships. The dataset contains 16,932 observations from 7,082 respondents in ten cities. SSP is measured through respondents’ estimated chances of living to specified ages.

Telltale Games says a new original IP remains in its plans, though it is not among its immediate releases and no details have been announced. The studio is also exploring ways to bring its games to devices and services beyond consoles, mobile, and PC, with more information expected this summer. Telltale says it can work on four projects at once and is developing more Game of Thrones, Minecraft, and Guardians of the Galaxy episodes.

The lecture models entry as firms paying a fixed cost before competing. In homogeneous-goods markets, entry is generally excessive because entrants gain sales from existing firms as well as expanding total output. With differentiated products, entry can be excessive or insufficient, depending on business stealing and the consumer benefits of better matches. A Hotelling-circle example yields twice the socially optimal number of firms; vertical-differentiation outcomes depend on whether different consumers prefer different efficient qualities.

The lecture then discusses a model in which firms learn their costs after entering, helping explain why small firms grow or fail more often and why concentration can correlate with profits without causing them. Finally, it examines a ratings model where limited reviews slow learning about new firms and selectively withholding reviews of highly rated firms can encourage newer firms to attract customers.

Periyar University has published its 2017 UG and PG examination results. Students can check them on the university website or through their colleges. Applications for re-totalling or revaluation must be submitted within 10 days of the result declaration.

This study used 7T sodium MRI, diffusion MRI and intracranial recordings to examine sodium measures and structural connectivity hubs in 23 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy and 21 healthy controls. Patients had higher total sodium concentration (TSC) across brain regions, regardless of whether regions belonged to the epileptogenic zone or were hubs. In both groups, hubs had higher TSC than non-hubs. The sodium signal fraction, *f*, was elevated in patients’ epileptogenic zones but did not differ between hubs and non-hubs. TSC in patients correlated with the extent of the epileptogenic network. The authors conclude that elevated hub TSC is not specific to epilepsy, while elevated *f* may reflect alterations associated with epileptogenic regions.

GAO found that schools identified for comprehensive support and improvement serve higher proportions of low-income and Black students and have much lower math and reading proficiency rates than other public schools. In a nationally generalizable review, 42 percent of improvement plans appeared to address all three requirements GAO examined: a needs assessment, identification of resource inequities, and interventions. GAO did not assess the plans’ legal compliance. The Department of Education has identified state compliance issues through monitoring, but GAO recommended that its staff independently select plans for review. Education agreed and said it would begin doing so in spring 2024.

A Tong Hâk notice denounces Japanese and other foreigners, warns of danger to Korea, and calls on people to unite in expelling them. Japanese Consul Sugimura then warns that Tong Hâk members are traveling toward Seoul and urges Japanese residents to be ready to evacuate women and children. A further message to the Japanese invokes moral teachings and Japan’s past invasion of Korea, condemns interference in Korean affairs, and urges the Japanese to choose peace over danger.

Coach DeBoer said a major injury disrupted a strong start but gave the team a chance to test young players, assess its depth and identify needs before making acquisitions. He said the veteran group needs execution and energy more than inspirational speeches. Limited power-play opportunities have made it hard to establish a rhythm, while Melker’s increased offense reflects confidence and a higher lineup role. DeBoer praised the team’s inclusive leadership and resilience despite extensive travel.

IDT’s September 29, 2025, earnings call addressed financial and operational results for the three and 12 months ended July 31, 2025. The company cautioned that forward-looking statements involve risks and said its earnings release reconciles cited non-GAAP measures with GAAP measures.

Frank Schilbach introduces MIT’s Psychology and Economics course, which uses insights from psychology and other fields to make economic models more realistic and predictive. He contrasts standard assumptions—stable preferences, rational choice, self-control, optimal information processing and narrow self-interest—with examples involving defaults, limited attention, charitable giving and demand for commitment. The aim is not to replace standard economics, but to identify important deviations while keeping models simple and testable.

A classroom laptop policy illustrates the approach: laptops can help with note-taking, but may also distract students and undermine learning. Schilbach describes evidence of lower test scores when computers were allowed and announces an opt-in laptop section. The course will cover preferences, beliefs, attention, mental health, discrimination, policy and poverty.

Britain’s first carbon-neutral new-build church opened in Walsingham in 2006, using rooftop solar panels and a borehole heat-exchange system. A planned PassivHaus church in Sheffield received planning permission but was not built after funding proved difficult and the congregation bought a nearby nightclub instead.

Via Browser is a lightweight, fast, customizable Android browser. It can be installed from the Google Play Store and requires storage and location permissions. Users can change the search engine and enable pull-to-refresh. Do Not Track and ad blocking are enabled by default, while location access is disabled; an incognito mode is also available. Its tab menu provides quick access to open tabs. The author recommends it for its balance of speed, options, and simplicity.

Canon’s EOS 77D adds a 24.2-megapixel Dual Pixel CMOS sensor, 45-point autofocus, an optional beginner-focused interface and low-energy Bluetooth. The passage describes it as sitting awkwardly between the T7i and 80D, without weather sealing. Canon also introduced a more compact but slightly heavier EF-S 18-55mm f4-5.6 IS STM kit lens. The 77D is scheduled for April 2017, starting at $900 for the body.

The Supreme Court denied Google’s request to pause an order requiring changes to Play store policies after a jury found that its practices unlawfully maintained an app-store monopoly. Google must soon allow developers to use their own payment systems for in-app purchases; changes concerning competing app stores are due in July 2026. Google cited security risks and plans to seek Supreme Court review, while Epic Games argued that a pause was unnecessary.

High Prairie Elementary students are learning to use the Overdrive app to access ebooks. Shayla Grey was elected Grade 6M class prime minister. Classes are planting seeds, studying science and reading, researching the Famous Five, and preparing for the Christmas concert. Kindergarten students have received 20 postcards through an international exchange. Grade 5’s Kids Sense Book Sale sold out; students also organized a Remembrance Day assembly and collected for Christmas Shoeboxes. Students are finishing holiday bags for Students Against Drunk Driving and beginning a school kindness campaign.

Automatic Local bus clock gating can prevent a PIC edge-configured input from returning to Idle if its source remains high after an interrupt. Subsequent edges may be missed, potentially causing a system hang or other unexpected behavior.

NVIDIA reported that its proposed acquisition of Mellanox received antitrust approval in China, following approvals in the European Commission and Mexico. The transaction was expected to close on or about April 27, 2020, subject to remaining customary conditions.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2019 Form 10-K describes its GPU and Tegra Processor businesses, which serve gaming, professional visualization, datacenter and automotive markets. The company uses a fabless manufacturing model and relies on third-party suppliers. It reported $7.42 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at fiscal year-end and 13,277 employees. Sales outside the United States accounted for 87% of revenue. The filing identifies risks including competition, changing demand, supplier dependence, cybersecurity, product defects and regulatory matters. As of January 27, 2019, NVIDIA had $7.24 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization.

The passage describes traditional Russian remedies for sunburn: dairy products for redness, egg whites, nettle decoction and watermelon juice for pain, sea buckthorn oil for peeling, vegetables for itching, and sauerkraut for swelling. It also suggests baking soda compresses, oatmeal, a sour cream–lemon mask and vitamin-rich fruit.

Academic code violations remain high at Brown despite prevention efforts, with more than half occurring in computer science. In 2015–16, 49 undergraduates and seven graduate students were charged; sanctions ranged from reprimands to suspension or dismissal, while 13 undergraduates received no violation. The computer science department uses plagiarism-detection software and teaches its collaboration rules. The University requires an academic code tutorial, has expanded orientation guidance for international students, and is considering further integrity initiatives. The Academic Code committee has requested more faculty members to handle its caseload.

Lois Riess is in custody in Texas after a manhunt following the killings of her husband in Minnesota and a woman in Florida whom authorities say she targeted because they looked alike. She faces second-degree murder and theft-related charges in Florida and a felony theft charge in Minnesota; a Minnesota murder charge is pending. A Texas judge ruled that either state may extradite her. Florida could seek the death penalty only if a grand jury indicts her for first-degree murder.

A retrospective cardiac MRI study of 15 adults with excessive left ventricular trabeculation found that blood-filled recesses between trabeculations had a higher ejection fraction than the central cavity (61% versus 44%). Analysis of 4-chamber images, including publicly available cases, also found greater systolic reduction in the recesses. Compared with contouring trabeculations separately, counting them as blood or excluding the recesses from the blood pool lowered measured ejection fraction. Contouring halved the number of patients classified as having an ejection fraction below 40%. The authors note that the small, single-center study requires larger-scale validation.

The Rancho Bernardo Kiwanis Club celebrated 50 years of service to children. Founded in 1967, the 40-member club supports school youth groups and Scouts, raises funds through an annual pancake breakfast, and has contributed to a local playground, Rady Children’s Hospital and transitional homes for Romanian orphans. Club president John O’Rourke said it has helped more than 800,000 children.

The Executive reports that federal authority and property had been seized in several Southern states, which declared their separation from the Union. After initially pursuing peaceful measures, the government attempted to provision Fort Sumter; the fort was attacked before the expedition arrived. The Executive says this made armed resistance necessary and describes calls for troops, a blockade, and a limited suspension of habeas corpus. He rejects secession as unconstitutional, argues that preserving the Union tests whether popular government can withstand rebellion, and asks Congress to authorize at least 400,000 men and $400 million. He says the government’s course after the rebellion will be guided by the Constitution and the laws.

Amazon’s Early Easter Sale reduces the three-camera Netgear Arlo system from £409.99 to £249.99 on 19 March. The expandable system offers motion alerts, night vision, a week of free online video storage, and live viewing through phones or browsers. Its waterproof, battery-powered cameras also work with Alexa.

Blockchain uses distributed ledgers, consensus mechanisms, and cryptography to make transaction records resistant to alteration, but its business value remains debated. Using interviews and archival data from five Chinese blockchain companies, the study identifies five business models: platformer, disintermediator, mediator, transformer, and co-innovator. They create and capture value by providing a platform for applications, changing or improving conventional value chains, or developing solutions for individual organizations. Their challenges include compatibility with existing systems, resistance from market participants, limited transferability of tailored solutions, and the costs of small-scale implementations.

The President said COVID-19 vaccinations and economic conditions had improved, but the Delta variant and nearly 80 million unvaccinated Americans remained serious challenges. He announced a six-part plan to increase vaccinations, protect vaccinated people, keep schools open, expand testing and masking, support small businesses, and improve care for people with COVID-19. Measures include vaccination or weekly testing for workers at large employers, vaccination requirements for healthcare workers and federal employees, paid time off for vaccination, more rapid tests, and increased hospital support and treatments. Booster shots would be available to eligible people once authorized. He also called for vaccination of eligible children and school staff, emphasized equity, and pledged continued vaccine donations abroad.

The Trump administration fired most members of the National Council on the Humanities, leaving four, all Trump appointees. The council advises the National Endowment for the Humanities on grants, policy and funding. Former member Karen Stout said she was disappointed by the firings.

Harvey Ulfers was sentenced to 2 years, 9 months in federal prison for wire fraud and money laundering involving undervalued scrap metal from a John Deere foundry. He was ordered to pay a fine and restitution. Co-conspirator Patrick Williams received 27 months.

This English cohort study assessed how the effectiveness of two COVID-19 vaccine doses changed over time. Third-dose uptake exceeded 90% in the older, clinically vulnerable and 40–64 groups, leaving highly selected two-dose groups; the authors therefore did not interpret their effectiveness estimates beyond 26 weeks. Among adults aged 18–39, estimated effectiveness waned and was negligible against hospitalisation by weeks 35–38 and against positive tests by weeks 15–18, though differences in testing behaviour may have biased the latter estimate. Waning in this group did not appear to change with omicron’s emergence. The study highlights the need to account for additional-dose uptake, selection bias and testing behaviour when interpreting long-term vaccine effectiveness.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2021, reports Q2 net sales of $113.1 billion, up 27% from a year earlier, and net income of $7.8 billion, up from $5.2 billion. Operating income rose to $7.7 billion. For the first six months of 2021, operating cash flow was $16.9 billion, down from $23.7 billion a year earlier. At June 30, Amazon had $360.3 billion in assets and $50.3 billion in long-term debt. It issued $18.5 billion in senior notes in May and agreed to acquire MGM for approximately $8.5 billion, subject to closing conditions.

Halimat Oniru leads Haleem Group, an Abuja-headquartered company operating in four Nigerian states. The passage credits the company with creating jobs in dredging and road construction and praises Oniru’s humanitarian work.

The passage describes a weather forecasting system that combines high-frequency sensor, radar, numerical weather model, and terrestrial and satellite microwave-link data to estimate and forecast precipitation, atmospheric moisture, fog, and runway visual range. Separate components collect and preprocess data, update models, generate forecasts, and distribute reports and alerts. A cadence-based, parallel processing architecture separates data collection from forecasting and organizes results into geographic tile layers. It compares new observations with earlier forecasts, reusing unchanged data and recalculating affected areas to support frequent updates while reducing computation.

Two Oceans Restaurant has stopped selling West Coast Rock Lobster after WWF SASSI classified it as unsustainable. SASSI says less than 2% of the population remains, and SANParks Table Mountain National Park supports the decision.

The passage describes a blockchain certificate-management system in which a certificate authority issues digital certificates but blockchain nodes verify them by consensus before recording them. Nodes similarly verify certificate revocation lists, updates, or individual revocation records, then use locally stored lists to check transaction permissions. The proposed methods, apparatuses, and software aim to reduce reliance on the certificate authority and limit risks if it is compromised.

Parkinson’s disease has ended Linda Ronstadt’s singing career, but she continues to appear at “A Conversation With Linda” events featuring career retrospectives and audience questions. Diagnosed in 2013, she says the disease makes daily tasks, talking and travel difficult; she exercises every day. The passage also revisits her 1977 album *Simple Dreams*, which topped the chart for five weeks, produced three Top 40 hits and won a Grammy for its recording package.

The passage describes watchdog timers, general-purpose and advanced timers, analog and I/O connections, serial-wire debugging, and a UART/I2C boot strap loader for MSPM0G devices. It also covers factory-stored device information and recommended circuit connections, including decoupling capacitors, reset-pin components, and a VCORE capacitor. Later sections list development tools, documentation, revisions, packaging information, and TI’s product and resource disclaimers.

A UK study of 1,314 people with Long Covid found that the 17-item C19-YRSm reliably measures symptoms, functional disability and overall health. Its scores aligned with fatigue measures and detected changes over time more sensitively than a generic health measure. The study proposed preliminary thresholds for meaningful score changes, but noted that these need further confirmation.

Kyle Busch won the Overton’s 400 at Chicago, holding off Kyle Larson by 1.162 seconds for his fifth victory of the season and 48th career Cup Series win. Aric Almirola won Stage 1, and Kevin Harvick won Stage 2. Busch finished those stages 12th and 11th as his team worked to improve his car’s handling. Fast pit stops helped him take the lead in Stage 3; he led 59 laps and prevailed after a final-lap challenge from Larson. The next Cup Series race is July 7 at Daytona.

Department of Transport briefing material says some commercial State company boards believe salary rates set in 2011 are too low to attract or retain chief executives. Government policy also removed certain benefits for new or renewing chief executives and stopped performance-related bonuses, although some existing contracts still contain bonus clauses. Several chief executives are threatening legal action over unpaid bonuses, and the chief executive of Dún Laoghaire Harbour Company has referred the matter to the High Court.

At the San Diego County Fair’s Western-themed exhibit, Kumeyaay Nation members perform songs in their native language on Wednesdays and share information about their culture and present-day communities. The exhibit also includes displays about portrayals of cowboy life, daily entertainment and planned Kumeyaay craft activities for Kids’ Day.

Edmonton police seized $3.2 million worth of carfentanil, the department’s largest recorded seizure, after firefighters found suspicious powder in a southwest basement suite on Jan. 28. Police found 16 kilograms of blue and pink powder containing carfentanil and 12 kilograms of white powder believed to be caffeine. No arrests have been made. The building has been condemned, and police are seeking to speak with the basement tenant as the investigation continues.

The passage describes a push-pull converter design using TPS7H500x-SP controllers. The example targets a 35% maximum duty cycle and uses a 2.5 transformer turns ratio, 40-µH primary inductance, 170-V primary GaN FETs, 80-V synchronous rectifier FETs, and a 0.47-µH output inductor. It uses approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance, including additional capacitance for radiation-induced transients. Cycle-by-cycle current limiting begins at roughly 35 A; Type 2A compensation targets a 10-kHz crossover frequency.

The controllers operate from a 4-V to 14-V supply and require at least 0.1 µF of input bypass capacitance. Layout guidance emphasizes separating sensitive signals from switching noise, minimizing high-current loops, keeping bypass components close to the controller, and connecting analog and power grounds at one point.

After an explosion near Manhattan’s Port Authority Bus Terminal, President Donald Trump called for Congress to end “chain migration” and strengthen immigration security. Police said Akayed Ullah, a Bangladeshi permanent resident who entered the U.S. on a family immigrant visa, detonated a crude device in a subway tunnel. Trump also called for stronger penalties for people convicted of terrorism.

Ruth Negga said she resented how teachers spoke to her and was eager to leave school, though she found the idea of acting freeing despite its rigorous schedule. She credited luck as an important part of her career. Negga received her first Oscar nomination for *Loving*, which portrays the couple whose case led the US Supreme Court to overturn laws against interracial marriage.

The May 30, 2001 VentureWire People newsletter reports executive appointments across technology companies, including new leaders at Solsoft and Gluon Networks and David Morgan’s planned departure from Real Media. It also lists openings in sales, marketing, finance, product management and venture capital.

Joe Bryant’s Week 11 fantasy football report ranks passing and rushing matchups by how strongly they favor offenses or defenses, discusses players, injuries and potential starts, and refers readers to an online cheatsheet for rankings. It closes with a Veterans Day tribute urging readers to thank veterans.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2016 Form 10-K describes its GPU and Tegra Processor businesses, which serve gaming, professional visualization, datacenter and automotive markets. Revenue rose to $5.01 billion from $4.68 billion in fiscal 2015, while net income declined to $614 million from $631 million. NVIDIA reported $5.04 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at year-end. It uses third parties to manufacture its products and identified competition, supplier dependence, customer concentration, product defects and cybersecurity among its risks.

Accepting the Republican presidential nomination in 1956, Eisenhower thanks the convention, praises Nixon and urges Americans to register and vote. He calls the Republican Party the “Party of the Future,” citing its commitment to long-term principles, current challenges, national unity, individual initiative and peace. He points to its approaches to farming, collective bargaining, federalism and equal opportunity. For lasting peace, he advocates national strength, cooperation among free nations and cautious exchanges with people under communist rule.

The passage interprets statistical independence as the expectation that random sampling yields representative samples. It defines superdeterminism as a systematic failure of that expectation and identifies three possible sources: fine-tuned initial conditions, statistical flukes, and laws that exclude certain measurement settings or outcomes. The authors argue that superdeterminism need not be deterministic and that retrocausal theories need not violate statistical independence. They also outline questions about its implications for free will, whether it is conspiratorial, and its scientific status.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on July 26, 2022, announcing that it had issued a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2022. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The World Bank raised its 2025 China growth forecast from 4.5% to 4.8%, citing government stimulus, stronger investment and industrial output, and a modest export recovery. It expects growth to slow in 2026 as fiscal constraints and global trade uncertainty weigh on demand. Property-sector weakness, subdued consumption, local government debt and demographic pressures remain challenges.

A Regina father urged drivers to slow down near puddles after a car splashed slush onto his wife and infant son as they walked along a sidewalk. Splashing pedestrians violates bylaws in Regina and Saskatoon, but police say tickets are difficult to issue without a description of the driver and vehicle and a licence plate number.

Jim Cramer has reversed his bullish view of Snap, citing negative reactions to Snapchat’s redesign and the risk that declining user engagement could drive away advertisers. After giving back gains made following its fourth-quarter results, Snap shares remain too expensive for him, though he would consider buying at a lower price.

Will Ma explains independent chip model (ICM) theory, which estimates tournament stack value using chip shares and payout probabilities. Unlike chip value, monetary value is nonlinear, especially near the payout bubble and at final tables. ICM can favor moving all in first while calling opponents’ all-ins less often; its effects are particularly strong in satellites. Ma applies the model to a final-table hand where a call needs 33% equity by chip value but 39.6% under ICM, supporting his fold. He then reviews the tournament through heads-up play, where ICM no longer applies, and wins.

Chemical analysis of pottery fragments found at Castelluccio, Sicily, identified olive oil residue dating to the Early Bronze Age. Researchers describe it as the oldest chemical evidence of olive oil in Italy, pushing back evidence for systematic production by at least 700 years.

During puberty and early adolescence, children develop a sense of identity while peers become more influential. Insecurity and social exclusion can affect school performance and contribute to depression. Parents can help by listening without judgment and offering reassurance. If a child shows signs of depression, such as falling grades or withdrawal from favorite activities, the passage recommends seeking professional help, starting with a school counselor.

David Luiz went flyboarding while holidaying in Dubai after a season of limited appearances for Chelsea, partly due to knee and ankle problems. He was left out of Brazil’s World Cup squad. Chelsea finished fifth but won the FA Cup.

Running backs are important offensive players whose primary job is to gain yards on handoffs while protecting the football. They also block and catch passes. Effective running backs combine speed, agility, vision, strength, toughness, and receiving ability; teams may use different players for short-yardage and all-purpose roles. The passage names Barry Sanders, Emmitt Smith, Walter Payton, Jim Brown, and Ladanian Tomlinson as notable examples.

Unwanted gifts can be sold, traded or regifted. Kijiji suits electronics and heavy items, eBay or auction houses suit collectibles, and garage sales suit inexpensive household goods. Bunz allows trades but not cash payments. Clear photos, accurate condition labels and descriptions can help online listings; eBay’s sold listings can guide pricing. Searches and trades rise after the holidays, especially on Sundays, while furniture and home decor may sell well when students move in August and September. Gift cards can be sold or traded, though gift-card buyers may pay less than face value. Regifting is appropriate only for new, packaged items the recipient would appreciate, not handmade, personalized or carefully chosen gifts.

Inverse problems on irregular domains require reconstructing PDE-governed physical fields from sparse, noisy observations. The passage introduces GeoFunFlow, which combines a geometric function autoencoder for varying unstructured meshes with a latent diffusion model for conditional posterior sampling. It states that the method has theoretical guarantees under well-trained models and reports accurate, efficient inference on complex-geometry benchmarks. The passage also reviews operator learning and diffusion methods, describes rectified flow for sampling, and formalizes the reconstruction task across varying geometries.

Chelsea manager Antonio Conte says the media questions his future more persistently than those of rival Premier League managers. Despite rumours of his departure and Chelsea’s difficult season, he says he wants to honour the remaining 18 months of his contract. Chelsea are 18 points behind Manchester City and fighting for a top-four finish.

NASA launched Voyager 1 and 2 in 1977 to study Jupiter and Saturn. A rare planetary alignment allowed Voyager 2 to continue to Uranus and Neptune without extra fuel. Together, the probes collected data on four planets and 48 moons. Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012. Both probes carry Golden Records containing information about Earth and humanity.

Researchers in Sweden and Finland developed CORE, a model that uses age, sex and three routine blood-test results to estimate the 10-year risk of severe liver disease. In a study of more than 480,000 people in Stockholm, it distinguished those who developed severe liver disease from those who did not in 88 percent of cases, outperforming the FIB-4 method. It also showed high accuracy in Finnish and UK populations, though further testing is needed in high-risk groups.

Mark Taylor forwarded two parts of an Option Investor newsletter covering the January 19 market. The Nasdaq reached a record close while the Dow rose modestly, amid news of AtHome’s $7 billion agreement to buy Excite and Microsoft earnings above estimates. The newsletter described strength in selected technology sectors but cautioned that broader market indicators remained weak ahead of Greenspan’s testimony. It also reviewed option positions and introduced Ford as a new call play.

DeBeers’s former control of diamond supply weakened as producers began selling independently and regulators challenged its pricing practices. The company shifted toward branding, retail, and selling diamonds from its own operations, while addressing concerns about conflict diamonds.

Meanwhile, chemically identical lab-grown diamonds gained buyers by offering lower prices and an alternative to mining and conflict-related concerns. DeBeers promoted natural diamonds’ distinctiveness, supported methods to detect synthetics, and emphasized mining’s benefits to communities. The case leaves open whether DeBeers should enter the growing synthetic-diamond market.
Chicago hotels must provide panic buttons for employees working alone in guest rooms. A union survey found that 58 percent of 500 workers had experienced sexual harassment by guests.

Amanda Nunes retained her title by defeating Ronda Rousey at UFC 207, handing Rousey her second consecutive loss. Nunes blamed Rousey’s coach, Edmond Tarverdyan, for encouraging her to box rather than rely on her judo. Tarverdyan had faced criticism before. After the fight, Rousey said she needed time to consider her future.

In his final address to the assembly as U.S. president, Biden drew on decades of public service to argue that cooperation can overcome war and division. He urged continued support for Ukraine, responsible management of competition with China, and diplomatic efforts to end the war in Gaza, free hostages, prevent a wider regional war, and pursue a two-state solution. He also called for an end to Sudan’s civil war.

Biden outlined U.S. commitments on food security, health, climate action, development financing, and U.N. Security Council reform. He warned that artificial intelligence offers benefits but requires international safeguards grounded in human dignity. Explaining his decision not to seek another term, he said leaders must put their people before staying in power and closed by urging countries to work together.

The May 10 IEP news digest covers California’s electricity crisis. Rolling blackouts began earlier than expected, while customers faced proposed rate increases that would fall most heavily on high-use households and businesses. Gov. Gray Davis asked power generators to accept 70% of what Southern California Edison owed them to help keep the utility out of bankruptcy; some generators objected. The state Senate approved $13.4 billion in bonds for power purchases, as a shrinking budget surplus raised concerns about spending cuts. Reports also described disputes over unpaid small power plants and growing pressure on federal officials to address energy shortages and prices.

The Bihar School Education Board has released the BETET/BSITET 2011 Special Examination 2016 results for both papers and subject-wise answer keys. Candidates can check results at biharboard.ac.in using their roll number.

Bernstorff reported that Wilson confidentially offered to mediate peace and asked Germany to disclose peace terms that could be made public. Bernstorff urged a brief delay in unrestricted U-boat warfare, warning that starting it immediately would make war with the United States unavoidable, while peace conferences might secure better terms.

In France, Socialist deputies endorsed Wilson’s Senate address and urged their government and other belligerents to pursue his peace initiative. The French press generally supported its principles, though many writers maintained that peace should follow an Allied victory.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2019, reports $4.54 billion in revenue, up from $3.41 billion a year earlier, and a $702.1 million net loss attributable to common stockholders. Cash and cash equivalents fell to $2.20 billion from $3.69 billion at year-end 2018, while operating activities used $639.6 million in cash. Vehicle price adjustments reduced gross profit by $91.7 million through changes to the sales return reserve. Tesla also adopted a new lease accounting standard and disclosed several pending lawsuits.

The passage outlines a statistical analysis plan for a trial comparing dasiglucagon 0.6 mg, placebo, and GlucaGen®. Demographic, medical-history, medication, and baseline characteristics will be summarized by treatment group. The primary endpoint is time to a plasma glucose increase of at least 20 mg/dL within 45 minutes without rescue IV glucose. Secondary endpoints assess recovery and glucose changes at 10, 15, 20, and 30 minutes. Confirmatory comparisons of dasiglucagon and placebo will follow a hierarchical testing order, adjusted for age group and injection site. Analyses will use observed data without imputation; sensitivity and supportive analyses are also specified.

The plan also describes pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic summaries and safety analyses covering exposure, adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings, local tolerability, and immunogenicity. Appendices specify data presentation, programming quality checks, and planned tables, figures, and listings.

Violence against women services are awaiting Ontario’s election outcome amid calls for more investment in assault services, legal supports, shelters and reproductive health. The passage cites recent killings and says gender equity and sexual violence received little attention in the debates. It criticizes one prospective premier’s remarks and response to a question about sexual violence, and notes that the Progressive Conservatives did not answer Ontario Thrive’s gender-equity survey. It calls for economic security measures and school curricula addressing consent and gender-based violence.

Child care academies in at least 11 North Carolina counties offer two- to six-week training to help address early educator shortages, generally at little or no cost to participants. Classroom-ready programs prepare graduates to work in licensed child care facilities; teaching credential programs also qualify them to become lead teachers and provide credit transferable to the state’s community colleges. Local partnerships fund and run the academies, with graduates entering child care jobs or continuing their education. A $1.476 million state expansion pilot passed the House but was not included in legislation signed in August. Separate state grants are available for up to 10 institutions to run academies.

A preprint studied machine-learning detection of Medicare overutilization in ophthalmology using public billing data and a dataset of 663 ophthalmologists labeled by physicians and medical billers. Of six models tested, a stacking ensemble performed best, with an AUROC of 0.907. Applied to 2021 billing data, it predicted that 1,457 of 17,013 ophthalmologists (8.6%) were likely overutilizers and estimated a potential annual loss of $437.1 million. The authors caution that these are model-based estimates, not confirmed fraud findings.
