They identify the small labeled dataset and the need for audits, medical records, and specialty-specific expertise as key limitations.

Sheffield residents are opposing plans to fell 31 trees on Rivelin Valley Road, part of what is said to be the UK’s second-longest lime avenue. The council’s contractor, Amey, is resurfacing roads under a long-term agreement. Campaigners question the need to remove the trees and fear gaps in the avenue. Residents are awaiting an independent panel’s report.

The passage says seasonal weakness, thin trading and institutional rebalancing may pressure markets. It examines bond yields, TLT, the dollar and gold for signs of market direction, noting that lower yields could support a continued stock rally while a weaker dollar could benefit commodities. The author presents the chart analysis for educational purposes, not as trading advice.

Former Infosys CFO V. Balakrishnan said Sebi should decide Infosys’ settlement application over former CFO Rajiv Bansal’s severance payment on legal merits, not the whistleblower’s emotions. The whistleblower opposed settlement and sought prosecution of the board and management over alleged lapses. Infosys said it wanted to resolve allegations that the payment was approved without prior committee consent. Former CFO T.V. Mohandas Pai supported settling the matter. Infosys agreed to pay Bansal Rs17.38 crore in 2015 but paid him Rs5 crore.

The government shutdown continues amid a dispute between Republicans and Democrats over extending enhanced Affordable Care Act premium tax credits through 2025. The credits increased aid for eligible people and expanded eligibility to those with higher incomes.

The lecture uses SCET to describe dijets produced in electron–positron collisions. Small hemisphere invariant masses select two back-to-back collinear jets, while ultrasoft radiation can connect them. The relevant hard, jet, and ultrasoft scales are approximately Q, m, and m²/Q. When the ultrasoft scale is comparable to lambda QCD, the peak region requires a nonperturbative function; when it is much larger, the tail has a perturbative leading-order description with nonperturbative power corrections. The lecturer derives a factorization theorem for hemisphere masses involving hard, jet, and soft functions, and relates it to thrust in the dijet limit. Renormalization-group evolution connects the functions’ preferred scales and resums logarithms of their ratios.
Kerala’s budget allocates ₹970 crore to general education and ₹789 crore to higher education, including ₹614 crore for 138 schools to become centres of excellence.
Apple discontinued the iPod nano and shuffle after years of decline and amid their incompatibility with Apple Music. The iPod helped shape Apple’s ecosystem and influenced the iPhone.
The dollar rallied nearly 4% in under a month, breaking above its 50-day average and yearlong downtrend, though it remains down over 7% this year. Crude fell below $50.

The MAGIC and LST-1 telescopes on La Palma use automated on-site pipelines to deliver next-day analysis results, usually before 14:00 local time. Both process observations for data-quality checks and rapid analysis; MAGIC also produces detection significance, spectra, light curves and sky maps, while comparable steps are being added to LST-1. The pipelines run analyses in parallel and provide tools for monitoring their progress. Their operators identify coordination with observatory systems, human oversight and error recovery as important for future CTAO pipelines.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 16, 2020, attaching its 2019 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1. Senior Vice President David A. Zapolsky signed the report.

OpenAI is introducing ChatGPT parental controls after a lawsuit concerning a California teenager’s death alleged the chatbot provided harmful advice. Linked parent and teen accounts will allow content restrictions, feature limits and risk alerts while keeping transcripts private. OpenAI is also developing age prediction to apply stricter settings to users under 18.

At an informal meeting on a draft agreement, Belgian representatives raised questions about early revision if Belgian territory were liberated, how prices would be set, dollar payments, and shipping for Congo exports. Participants discussed leaving detailed prices to later arrangements and addressing shipping concerns with the relevant transport authorities. They also considered how unfinished transactions under the existing United Kingdom–Belgian agreement would be handled.

The draft agreement would require Belgium to make specified exports from the Belgian Congo and Ruanda Urundi available to buyers in the United Kingdom or United States from September 1, 1942, through December 31, 1943.

The HHLL strategy seeks price-action reversals when an uptrend produces a higher high followed by a lower low, or a downtrend produces a lower low followed by a higher high. Trades are entered when price returns to an earlier high or low. The passage says discretionary identification of swing points makes the strategy difficult to backtest, while the ZigZag indicator uses forward-looking information. A simplified backtest on Philip Morris produced 118 trades, a 9.8% compound annual growth rate, a 1.26% average gain per trade, and a profit factor of 2.2.

Plymouth Studio School is likely to close in September 2018, three years after opening, following viability challenges and an Ofsted rating of “inadequate”. A final decision is expected from the Minister for Schools in July. The school, which focused on academic qualifications and sports careers, is working with Plymouth City Council to find alternative places for pupils and support their transition.

Designs in Mind has taken a permanent lease on Jolt, an Oswestry shop it previously ran as a pop-up. The shop sells homeware and prints, many designed by members referred through a mental health scheme, and offers public printing workshops. The Community Interest Company hopes the shop will generate interest in its makers and help reduce mental health stigma.
Effective February 1, 2017, Tesla Motors, Inc. amended its certificate of incorporation and bylaws solely to change its corporate name to Tesla, Inc.

The President informs Congress that Texas accepted its September 1850 proposals concerning state boundaries, the relinquishment of territorial and federal claims, and a territorial government for New Mexico. Texas enacted its acceptance on November 25, before the December 1 deadline. He welcomes the agreement as a measure of conciliation and peace and notes that territorial governments have been established in the remaining acquired lands.

Fullbacks are primarily blockers in two-back formations, helping create running lanes and protecting the passer. They may occasionally carry the ball in short-yardage situations or catch a short pass. The position calls for toughness and blocking ability and is more common in pro-style offenses than in spread offenses. Although their contributions rarely appear in statistics, fullbacks remain important to teams that emphasize a traditional running game.

BJP MP Shatrughan Sinha criticized his party after its losses in the Rajasthan bypolls, saying the results showed that ordinary people had begun to speak out. He also questioned the budget’s promises and said he felt treated like a stepson by the BJP. Union Minister Babul Supriyo responded by telling Sinha to leave the party.

The speaker remains confident after one loss, saying a brief lapse let a strong opponent capitalize despite good play in the second and third periods. The team aims to win the next game to split the two, needs goals from its third and fourth lines, and cannot afford similar mistakes.

A May 1, 2012 strike drew thousands but did not significantly disrupt business. New strikes planned for Feb. 17 and March 8 seek to oppose Trump administration actions and advance a “feminism for the 99 percent,” respectively. Organizers of the March 8 action favor an inclusive “mass strike” with forms of participation that vary by location, citing barriers to a traditional general strike. The passage points to European strikes that changed government proposals, including a Polish women’s strike that helped defeat an anti-abortion bill. It also notes doubts about whether strikes in the United States can achieve similar results.

Two readers express concern about overcrowded emergency departments, long waits and strained staff. One questions whether reduced access to family doctors and clinics is pushing patients with non-urgent problems into ERs; the other urges people to volunteer in an ER to see the pressures firsthand. Another reader criticizes Ottawa’s recycling boxes for allowing litter to blow away and proposes clear bags instead. The Citizen also invites nominations of local “Capital Builders” who have improved their communities.

The President forwards a conference recommendation for reciprocal trade treaties with other American republics. He notes that over 87 percent of their exports to the United States already enter duty-free, limiting potential concessions. He argues that reliable steamship service, easier currency exchange, and duty rebates could expand trade, and pledges to pursue mutually beneficial agreements after Congress acts on tariff legislation.

A 1948 directive defined covert action to include propaganda, sabotage, subversion, and support for anti-Communist groups, while excluding espionage and conventional military conflict. The CIA’s new Office of Policy Coordination managed these operations, which expanded rapidly during the Korean conflict. In 1951, President Truman created the Psychological Strategy Board, and NSC 10/5 expanded the CIA’s guerrilla-warfare authority. Eisenhower-era directives narrowed the CIA’s independence by requiring coordination and advance policy approval for major programs; the Special Group became the body that reviewed and approved them. After the 1961 Bay of Pigs failure, the group took a larger planning and review role. In 1963, it developed informal criteria for deciding which projects required review.

The May 21, 2001, VentureWire People newsletter reports executive appointments across management, sales, business development, finance, technology and operations. Wellogix named Zeke Zeringue CEO and Fred Weber chairman; EXP Systems named Mark Wright president and CEO. It also lists executive searches for sales, finance, development, engineering and project-management roles, and notes that Nth Orbit is hiring.

Microsoft’s annual report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2018 describes three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The company develops software, cloud services, devices, gaming products, and advertising services, and distributes them through manufacturers, direct sales, and resellers. It reported $14.7 billion in research and development spending and approximately 131,000 full-time employees. Its stated priorities include productivity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and personal computing. The report identifies risks involving competition, cloud execution, cybersecurity, privacy regulation, intellectual property, acquisitions, and litigation.

This collection of May 2001 energy news centers on two disputes. Federal regulator Curtis Hebert said Enron chairman Kenneth Lay offered continued support if Hebert changed his views on electricity deregulation; Lay disputed that account. In India, Maharashtra’s electricity board moved to cancel its power-purchase agreement with Enron’s Dabhol project amid unpaid bills and competing claims about the plant’s performance. Other reports cover California’s energy crisis, Portland General Electric’s rising power costs and a federal hearing into allegations concerning El Paso’s natural-gas prices.

The passage describes SD Memory Card commands and behavior during data transfer. SET_DSR optionally configures identified cards; CMD7 selects one card for transfer or deselects cards. Read and write transfers use blocks and CRC checks, and CMD12 can stop them. Programming may continue after a card is deselected, while DAT0 indicates when a card is busy.

It also specifies command sequences for erase, DISCARD, and full-user-area logical erase; write protection and password-based locking, including Card Ownership Protection; and CMD6 function checking and switching. SDSC cards use byte addresses, while SDHC and SDXC cards use 512-byte block addresses. The passage further defines command extensions, clock control, CRC protection, and read and write timeout behavior.

SBI’s Ecowrap report forecasts average retail inflation of 4.8% in 2017-18, but expects it to remain below 4% through July and calls inflation fears exaggerated. Wholesale inflation eased to 5.7% in March, helped by lower fuel prices and an appreciating rupee. The report expects wholesale inflation to exceed retail inflation through the fiscal year’s fourth quarter.

A Seattle Uber driver returned a woman’s purse after an officer texted him a warning and a selfie, police said. The woman had left her wallet and ID in the car and needed them for a flight later that day.

The Flyers’ coach praised his team’s resilience after its loss to the Chicago Blackhawks and congratulated Chicago on winning the Stanley Cup. He said the Flyers had late chances but could not score, and credited Chicago’s speed, defense and goaltending. In remarks before the game, he said the Flyers needed to channel the home crowd’s energy, manage their nerves and focus on winning one game.

On October 27, 2016, Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K announcing its third-quarter 2016 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

The passage seeks $45,000 for an earlier claim item and $31,000 for the alleged impressment of 31 American crew members by Russians. It describes their treatment at Vladivostok and also requests payment for their forced labor navigating a Russian schooner. Additional claims cover provisions, the crew’s support and related costs, and $3,040 in general expenses. The claimant seeks interest at 6 percent annually from the date of seizure, citing a Bering Sea award as precedent.

The center lines up in the middle of the offensive line, snaps the ball to the quarterback, and directs teammates’ blocking assignments based on the defense. The position requires quick decisions, communication, football knowledge, strength, and agility. Centers block defensive linemen, help protect against blitzes, and support the run game. Though often smaller than other offensive linemen, they play a vital leadership role in protecting the quarterback and creating running opportunities.

The Supreme Court’s October 2025 term includes cases on presidential authority over tariffs, agency officials and birthright citizenship. It will also rehear a Louisiana redistricting case that raises questions about the Voting Rights Act’s disparate-impact protections. Other cases concern Colorado’s ban on conversion therapy, transgender athletes’ participation in school sports and the standard for police entry into a home during a suspected emergency.

The passage describes waveguide devices designed to reduce banding and produce more uniform output illumination in displays. Light is coupled into an optical substrate, travels by total internal reflection, and is extracted; a debanding optic shifts or modifies the light to reduce gaps and overlaps between successive extractions. Proposed optics include gratings, refractive-index and polarization-modifying layers, tilted microdisplays, prisms, and light-absorbing films. The passage also describes stacked color waveguides with input stops to mitigate color banding, and a method for producing debanded illumination. Some embodiments target spatial non-uniformity below 20% or 10% and are intended for head-mounted or head-up displays.

Palestine police arrested two suspects after about 30 cars were broken into Tuesday morning and are searching for others. Police said the targeted cars were unlocked and urged residents to lock their vehicles and report any rummaging, even if nothing was stolen.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 14, 2022, attaching its 2021 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Senior Vice President David A. Zapolsky.

The passage specifies clock, power, timing, and PCB layout requirements for a digital media processor. It covers PLL and SYSCLK limits, interrupt controllers, test and debug interfaces, and peripherals including Ethernet, GPIO, I2C, HDMI, video processing, camera input, and external memory controllers. It also gives routing and termination guidance for high-speed HDMI and DDR2/DDR3 interfaces. Clock frequencies, PLL settings, and module inputs must remain within stated limits, while board-routing delays must be considered in timing analysis.

The October 24, 2000, VentureWire reports that FusionOne was seeking about $100 million in financing, Vanguard Venture Partners closed a $240 million fund, Hotmail co-founder Jack Smith launched Web-server firm Akamba with Richard Burright, and online investment service StockPower shut down. The issue also covers startup financings, product launches, acquisitions and mergers, board and executive appointments, and new venture funds.

High-performance computing (HPC) enables faster, more complex simulations and analyses in manufacturing, supporting product and process innovation. Four in five surveyed industry decision makers consider it a game changer. More than a quarter of surveyed enterprises already use professional HPC infrastructure, while another 39% are planning or piloting deployment.

The Burr Ridge Village Board approved fiscal policies requiring a general-fund reserve of at least 20% of annual operating expenses and limiting spending to available revenue and reserves. Officials said the village has long followed similar practices. The board also renewed administrator Douglas Pollock’s contract with a 2% raise, bringing his salary to $174,000.

The passage describes DLAA, the evolution of GPU shaders, and NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture, which is designed to improve neural-shader performance. It outlines neural techniques for materials, texture compression, indirect lighting, skin rendering, and faces, along with a new API that lets graphics shaders access Tensor Cores. It also lists specifications for the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products. The closing notices address the accuracy and permitted use of the specifications and limit NVIDIA’s warranties and liability.

On November 27, Dynegy confirmed talks to revise its proposed acquisition of Enron amid reports that the $9 billion price could fall to about $5 billion. Credit concerns had sharply reduced Enron’s energy trading, while efforts to secure financing continued. Moody’s kept Enron’s rating unchanged that day, and its shares closed at $4.14.

The passage describes matrimonial sites as an alternative to traditional matchmaking and marriage brokers. It says they can save time and money, offer a wider range of potential partners, and let users search profiles by specific criteria. It also highlights online access, messaging and video chat, wedding advice, and privacy options. The passage states that sites verify profiles and provide detailed information to help users decide whom to get to know.

Carson High School’s 2018 Winterfest features Johnny Depp film-themed activities and a Feb. 10 dance. Junior, sophomore and freshman royalty will be crowned Feb. 8; senior royalty will be crowned at the Feb. 9 boys basketball game.

Larry Connors’ %b strategy is a mean-reversion approach that buys when an ETF closes above its 200-day moving average and %b remains below 0.2 for three consecutive days; it exits when %b closes above 0.8. The test used five-day Bollinger Bands with two standard deviations because Connors did not specify those parameters. A 25-ETF portfolio tested from 2000 through December 2020 produced a 4.84% CAGR and 16% maximum drawdown, with market exposure of 17%. A ten-day lookback raised CAGR to 8.2% but increased drawdown to 24%.

Coach DeBoer said Travis’s Achilles injury and setback were significant losses, but he remains important when healthy. Henrik persuaded DeBoer he was ready to return and gave the team a boost. DeBoer defended the power play despite its lack of goals, saying the team was creating chances and needed better execution. He credited the goaltender’s composure with calming a young defense and said the team still believed it could win. To score more, he wanted more players and pucks around the net.

The Yankees host the Red Sox in Game 1 of their best-of-three AL Wild Card Series on Tuesday, Sept. 30, at 6:08 p.m. ET. SiriusXM carries the New York broadcast on channel 89 and Boston’s on channel 178. The series winner advances to face Toronto in the ALDS.

This non-peer-reviewed study compared whole-blood gene expression in 194 people with virally suppressed HIV receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART) and 361 HIV-negative people. It identified 566 differentially expressed genes, enriched in immune processes and cancer-related pathways, alongside differences in several immune-cell proportions. Comparison with earlier research classified 234 genes as potentially ART-affected, but the study could not separate the effects of ART from chronic HIV infection. Genetic analyses found overlap primarily with inflammatory diseases, with limited evidence of shared genetic risk for the cancers examined. The researchers identified 111 differentially expressed genes targeted by approved or investigational drugs and called for further studies to establish their clinical relevance.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2017, reports quarterly revenue of $2.98 billion and a $619.4 million loss attributable to common stockholders. For the first nine months, revenue was $8.47 billion and the attributable loss was $1.29 billion. At quarter-end, Tesla held $3.53 billion in cash and cash equivalents, with total assets of $28.11 billion and liabilities of $21.93 billion. The filing also describes debt issuances, the Grohmann acquisition, accounting policies, commitments and legal proceedings.

In a case-control study of Thai university students without metabolic syndrome, participants with simple dysmood disorder (SDMD), including first-episode cases, had lower LCAT activity and higher free cholesterol and ApoE levels than healthy controls. These differences persisted among participants without signs of subclinical metabolic syndrome. LCAT’s association with depression severity and suicidal behaviors was mediated by free cholesterol and brooding. Subclinical metabolic syndrome interacted with SDMD in associations involving HDL cholesterol, reverse cholesterol transport, and the ApoB/ApoA ratio. The authors call for prospective research on lipid changes as depression progresses.

More than 250 small earthquakes struck near Brawley, California, beginning on New Year’s Eve. The strongest measured magnitude 3.9. Scientists monitored the swarm because the Brawley Seismic Zone connects the San Andreas and Imperial faults, but the possibility of a larger earthquake had largely receded by Sunday night. Residents reported unease and rattling from the quakes.

The collected reports say the SEC requested information about Enron’s transactions with partnerships formerly run by CFO Andrew Fastow. After Enron disclosed the informal inquiry, its shares fell about 21% to $20.65. Investors and analysts questioned a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity, a $1.01 billion third-quarter write-off, and the clarity of Enron’s disclosures. They also raised concerns about other financing vehicles that could dilute shareholders. Shareholder lawsuits were filed, while Enron said its arrangements had been reviewed and disclosed and that it would cooperate with the SEC.

Real Madrid drew with 17th-placed Levante after debutant Giampaolo Pazzini scored an 89th-minute equaliser. Sergio Ramos and Isco scored for Real, while Emmanuel Boateng scored Levante’s first. The draw leaves Real fourth in La Liga, 18 points behind Barcelona.

The speaker expresses gratitude and humility on assuming the presidency and pledges to follow the Constitution as a compact of compromise that limits federal authority and preserves state powers. He argues that the country has prospered despite predictions that debt, war, territorial growth, political conflict, and disputes over federal and state authority would undermine it. He urges forbearance over slavery, opposes congressional abolition in the District of Columbia against the wishes of slaveholding states, and rejects interference with slavery in states where it exists. He promises friendship and equal trade with other nations, avoidance of alliances, and neutrality in their disputes. He closes by seeking the people’s support and divine protection.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% year to date, but fell 1.6% on August’s first trading day. The article describes the broader market trend as healthy while warning that weakening short-term technicals, rising volatility and credit spreads, and seasonal pressures could pose risks. It also notes growing portfolio concentration in tech stocks and record-high US electricity demand.

A flea flicker disguises a pass as a run: the quarterback hands off, receives the ball back, and throws downfield while defenders react to the apparent run. Receivers may initially appear to block before running routes. The play is credited to coach Bob Zuppke, who used it against Penn in 1925 and later said he had called it in 1910. The passage says intentional grounding can still apply because the quarterback relinquished possession. Examples include Michigan’s touchdown against TCU, a reverse flea flicker involving Baker Mayfield, and a fake flea flicker in which the runner keeps the ball.

The Ordnance Factories Board said it successfully upgraded 130-mm field guns to 155-mm capability at its Nalanda facility and expects an Army order to upgrade 300 guns. It said the indigenous upgrade costs Rs 1 crore per gun and increases range from about 27 km to 36 km.

The lecture examines how elimination creates nonzero entries in large sparse matrices and how reordering can reduce this “fill-in.” It represents matrix structure as a graph, where elimination can create edges between nodes sharing a neighbor. The professor discusses red-black ordering, approximate minimum degree, and graph separators with nested dissection. He shows that reducing bandwidth does not necessarily reduce fill-in. Fill-in can be assessed by counting nonzeros in the factors produced by elimination.

The court held that the Federal Mine Safety and Health Review Commission had authority to review an administrative law judge’s fee award to Contractor’s Sand and Gravel. It reversed the Commission’s decision, however, because the Secretary of Labor was not substantially justified in pursuing a grounding citation unsupported by the regulation or evidence that the equipment was improperly grounded. The court restored the fee award and remanded for consideration of costs incurred in seeking judicial review.

The study uses molecular dynamics simulations of a coarse-grained rod tethered to a sphere to investigate nanoparticle self-assembly. Varying sphere size, temperature and rod interactions produces structures ranging from three-dimensional aggregates to sheets, fibers and small clusters. Larger spheres generally limit growth and reduce structural dimensionality. Lock-and-key rods also form twisted double-helix ribbons whose pitch decreases as sphere size increases. The model reproduces fibers and small aggregates observed for PiPrOx-grafted silica nanoparticles, though its simulated timescale remains shorter than experimental assembly times.

Effective September 11, 2015, Microsoft appointed Bradford L. Smith President and Chief Legal Officer. Smith previously served as General Counsel and Executive Vice President, Legal and Corporate Affairs.

The professor has students play three games used to study social preferences. In the dictator game, one person decides how much to give another. In the ultimatum game, the recipient can accept or reject an offer; rejection leaves both with nothing. In the trust game, an investor sends an amount that is multiplied before the recipient decides how much to return. The class varies stakes, communication, and whether outcomes are public. The professor also demonstrates the strategy method, which records choices for possible situations while implementing selected outcomes. Future classes will examine carefully conducted experiments and whether these games predict real-world behavior.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with integrated input conditioning, programmable gain, filtering, an ADC driver, and an internal or external 4.096V reference. Internal input overvoltage protection is rated to ±20V with AVDD at 5V and ±15V with AVDD floating; external protection is needed for surges, ESD, and EFT.

The devices support configurable bipolar and unipolar input ranges, programmable input alarms, and fixed AVDD alarms at 4.7V and 5.3V. Their multiSPI interface supports standard SPI, single- or dual-output data, source-synchronous transfers, and daisy-chaining. Nine configuration registers control these features, output data, resets, and low-power modes. The passage also provides an eight-channel industrial input design example and recommendations for supply decoupling and PCB layout.

September’s establishment survey showed 33,000 jobs lost, while the household survey reported 906,000 more people working and unemployment falling to 4.2 percent. Labor force participation and wages also rose. Economist Beth Ann Bovino suggested hurricanes may have disrupted business responses to the establishment survey and said future revisions and weather-related rebounds could change the picture.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q reports second-quarter 2020 net sales of $88.9 billion, up from $63.4 billion a year earlier, and net income of $5.2 billion, up from $2.6 billion. Operating cash flow was $20.6 billion. North America, International, and AWS sales all increased. Amazon incurred more than $4 billion in COVID-19-related costs during the quarter, including employee safety measures and additional compensation. As of June 30, cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $71.4 billion, while long-term debt was $33.1 billion.

Giants receiver Malik Nabers’ season-ending ACL and meniscus tears have renewed concerns about MetLife Stadium’s turf. An opposing-team executive and the NFL Players Association raised player-safety concerns, and more than 90% of players surveyed in each of the past two years preferred grass. The NFL says MetLife had one of the league’s lowest injury rates last year and has no plans to replace its playing surface.

A Soviet representative argued that the Charter should provide trusteeship arrangements for detached territories and requested documents on the subject. He maintained that Soviet republics should be initial members of the proposed organization, while associated and neutral nations should not. He found several Latin American proposals acceptable but opposed strengthening the Assembly and Court at the Council’s expense, and criticized objections to permanent members voting on disputes involving them. Pasvolsky offered to provide an analysis of the Council’s functions under the President’s proposed voting formula.

Researchers observed cancer cells sending mitochondria through thin tubes into neighboring fibroblasts. Within 24 hours, the fibroblasts grew faster and increased activity of cancer-linked genes; when injected with cancer cells into mice, they promoted tumor growth. The protein MIRO2 was necessary for this transfer, making it a potential therapeutic target.

The speaker sees no added rivalry or carryover from last year and says a possible player return would not change the team’s focus. They acknowledge the home crowd’s advantage but believe they played well enough to win one of the first two games, despite missed opportunities. They remain confident they can win a game there.

Philosophy of education is often treated as peripheral to educational research, which typically emphasizes empirical methods. This can lead students to question whether philosophical inquiry counts as research, while job insecurity, funding priorities, and publication metrics make the field seem an impractical choice. The passage also challenges the preference for large-scale, generalizable evidence, arguing that it can overlook differences between educational contexts and ethical questions about what should count as effective practice.

These tensions are not new: philosophy of education has long debated its value, methods, and relationship to educational research. The author questions nostalgic accounts of a more secure “golden age” and proposes presenting the field’s internal diversity and self-criticism as strengths. A starting point is to challenge the assumption that educational research must be empirical.

Penn State’s White Building renovations, underway since summer 2016, are expected to finish by late March, with further improvements continuing through the semester. Updates include a new lobby, registration desks, stairwell, elevator, and single entrance to improve traffic flow and safety. Fitness center renovations are not planned.

The global visceral pain market is projected to reach USD 14.22 billion by 2024, driven by an aging population, rising prevalence and greater awareness. North America held the largest share in 2016, while Asia Pacific is projected to grow fastest, at a 6.2% CAGR. Analgesics led therapeutics with a 60.4% share, and Crohn’s disease was the largest indication at 41.4%.

Australian superannuation tax changes taking effect in July include a $1.6 million transfer balance cap, lower annual contribution caps and changes to pension tax exemptions. The passage encourages people to plan ahead and says self-managed super funds are attracting self-employed professionals and younger Australians, including more women.

The President describes the public oath as a mutual commitment to uphold the Constitution, enforce the laws equally, and protect every citizen’s rights. Marking the nation’s first century under the Constitution, he notes its growth and improved living conditions while acknowledging persistent hardship. He supports protective tariffs and the expansion of manufacturing and mining, particularly in the South, alongside equal protection of the ballot regardless of race.

He rejects special enforcement policies for any section of the country and warns that tolerated lawbreaking undermines social order. He calls for more careful naturalization, peaceful diplomacy, and opposition to European control of strategic waterways or colonial expansion in independent American states. Domestically, he urges effective, impartial public service; reduced Treasury surpluses without dismantling the protective tariff; naval and commercial development; better pensions; territorial statehood; and secure, honest elections. He closes by placing justice, education, and patriotism above partisan advantage.

The passage encourages starting to save and invest early, contributing regularly, and reinvesting earnings to benefit from compounding over time. It recommends keeping savings separate from spending money and reviewing a budget to find money to invest. An example compares saving €50 monthly from age 20 with €185 monthly from age 40 to reach €75,000 by age 60, assuming a 5% annual return. The article states that it is for educational purposes, not investment advice, and that its information has not been verified.

The passage proposes a regulator-reported global database for significant AI-related trading incidents. It argues that existing public databases miss financial incidents because regulatory reports are confidential and general databases lack finance-specific measures. The proposed database would use standardised categories and percentage-based metrics while omitting dates and timestamps to protect sensitive information. Testing with 2,999 synthetic records illustrates potential uses in systemic risk monitoring and market manipulation detection. The authors acknowledge that differing reporting practices and reliance on synthetic data limit the analysis.

The players say injuries and a long stretch of hockey have taken a toll, but teammates remain willing to compete. They stayed confident despite outside noise. Garrison describes finding an open teammate on a broken play. After a loss, they view the next game as a must-win and aim to rebound.

The passage specifies the GHCB protocol for communication between SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests and hypervisors. Version 2 adds initial SEV-SNP support and hypervisor feature advertisement; later revisions add capabilities including APIC ID retrieval, multiple VMPL levels, trusted IO, and Secure AVIC. It describes protocol negotiation, GHCB page registration, VMGEXIT handling, page state changes, firmware requests, AP creation, and interrupt delivery through the #HV doorbell page. It also states that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

Sweden’s unemployment rate was unchanged at 7.3 percent in July 2017, but it was 21.8 percent among people born abroad versus 3.9 percent among those born in Sweden. A record 76,561 people were registered in the Introduction Programme for unemployed newcomers, up from 59,362 a year earlier. Officials linked the rise to progress on an asylum-application backlog. Long-term unemployment also increased, largely because of programme participants. The Public Employment Service said it needed additional government funding in 2018 and 2019.

The Finance Ministry amended Rule 80 governing advances to families of government servants who die in service. The advance is capped at Rs. 25,000. The order takes effect from its issue date, and previously sanctioned advances will not be reopened.

The study compares pretrained language models with smaller proprietary Transformers for matching messy point-of-sale transaction text to merchant IDs. Proprietary models achieved comparable or better accuracy with lower processing costs. A deployed proprietary decoder-only model handled previously unmatched transactions, raising overall coverage from 80% to 94% and producing estimated annual savings of $13.2 million.

Derivatives are contracts whose value depends on an underlying asset. Common types include futures, forwards, options, swaps and CFDs. Traders use them to hedge risks or speculate on price movements. Options give buyers the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell an asset at a specified price before expiration.

The passage warns that speculative trading is difficult, particularly when traders use excessive leverage, and recommends understanding a strategy and backtesting it before trading. It describes buying puts to protect a stock portfolio and cites a 1990–2015 backtest in which selling puts produced returns similar to the S&P 500’s, with lower volatility.
Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on July 21, 2015, announcing a press release on its financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2015. The release is included as Exhibit 99.1.

Sunderland manager David Moyes named several inexperienced substitutes for the Liverpool match after injuries ruled out Lamine Kone and Victor Anichebe. Donald Love replaced the suspended Billy Jones, while Jack Rodwell returned to midfield. The bench had just 34 Premier League appearances combined, highlighting Moyes’s need to strengthen his squad despite limited transfer funds.

IHE editors discuss federal higher education policy, including cuts to minority-serving institutions, international student restrictions, student borrowing rules and the administration’s “Compact for Academic Excellence.”

GOG’s 2017 Piñata Madness event sells $3 piñatas containing random games valued at $6–$45. Buyers are generally guaranteed a game they do not already own; those who own every game in the pool receive a copy to give away. GOG has confirmed several titles but has not disclosed the full pool. Piñata contents are determined at purchase. The event runs through August 21, with unopened piñatas automatically opened after August 28. The passage raises concerns about extending loot-box-style purchases to entire games.

The U.S. Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point to 1%–1.25%, its third increase in six months, and plans to begin gradually reducing its $4.5 trillion bond holdings later this year. It expects one more rate hike this year, despite sluggish growth and inflation below its 2% target. Solid hiring and a 4.3% unemployment rate support its decision, though low inflation and political uncertainty could slow future increases. President Trump is expected to fill three Fed board vacancies, potentially changing its rate-setting policy.

California’s gun violence restraining order law produced 190 orders in 2016–17 temporarily removing weapons from people deemed dangerous to themselves or others. Orders initially last 21 days; 17 were extended to a year, and law enforcement failed to serve 31. Police initiated most requests. Senator Marco Rubio proposed a similar national process after the Florida mass shooting.

Taco Cabana and Favor are offering two free breakfast tacos through the Favor app today from 9–11 a.m. within Favor’s Dallas delivery zone. Supplies are limited. Taco Cabana will also offer limited breakfast-taco coupons Friday morning.

The Horns offense uses two high-post screeners to give the ball handler a screen in either direction, create driving lanes, and open outside shots when defenders help. Its primary options are a drive, pull-up jumper, pass to a rolling or posting screener, or kick-out pass to a wing. If the initial action produces no good shot, the offense can reverse the ball into post or side-screen action. The passage describes counters to switches, traps, and other defensive responses, along with several variations. Effective execution depends on footwork, timing, communication, practice, and recognizing how opponents defend screens.

Chess originated in India about 1,500 years ago and is described as a complex strategy game involving planning, decision-making, and anticipating consequences. The passage reviews research linking chess play or instruction to cognitive, academic, and social benefits, particularly in mathematics, concentration, problem-solving, and confidence. It also notes mixed findings and cautions that students’ existing abilities, motivation, practice, and teachers’ efforts may influence results. Many studies lack strong control groups or other features needed to isolate chess’s effects. The passage recommends more rigorous research to clarify those effects and discusses ways to offer chess in schools.

AMD’s Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) applies signed, non-persistent runtime patches to selected AMD firmware and settings without a BIOS reflash or system reboot. It does not update x86 code such as SMM, AGESA, or UEFI. Packages target specific firmware and patch levels, must be reapplied after reboot, and can require customer co-signing. Customers enable SFS, validate patches, and provide a deployment agent. The AMD Security Processor verifies signatures and checks conditions before applying updates.

Blackwell’s faster frequency switching and low-power states aim to improve performance within a power budget. Its deepest sleep state is 10 times faster to enter than Ada’s, and the passage reports up to 50% power savings in a small-language-model inference example.

DLSS 4 adds Multi Frame Generation, which generates up to three frames per rendered frame, and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also introduces support for developer-created neural shaders, with applications including texture compression, lighting, materials, skin, and faces.

The passage describes the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability as detailed in the passage.

Pharmaceutical dosage form testing systems assess tablets’ quality, stability, strength, efficacy, and bioavailability through tests including weight variation, content uniformity, hardness, disintegration, and dissolution. The passage forecasts market growth driven by quality regulations and advanced technology, while high system costs and a shortage of skilled operators may constrain it. North America is expected to lead in revenue; Asia-Pacific excluding China and Japan, and China are described as emerging markets.

Future Market Insights estimates the global surface protection films market at US$1,196.2 million in 2017 and forecasts it to reach US$2,081.6 million by 2027, growing at a 5.7% annual rate. Films 50–100 microns thick account for nearly 38% of market value, while PE holds more than 40% of the base-material market. Construction and interior uses are expected to account for about 56% of the market by 2027. Western Europe had the largest estimated regional revenue share in 2017, at 30.4%.

The passage introduces VERA, a 2,931-episode benchmark for comparing voice and text systems on reasoning tasks under real-time constraints. Across the evaluated systems, voice models show an average accuracy drop of 40.4 percentage points, with the largest gaps on complex tasks. Extended thinking time, clearer speech, and a cascade separating reasoning from narration do not eliminate the gap. The authors suggest a tension between low-latency speech and revisable reasoning, and identify distinct error patterns across voice architectures.

The President asks the Senate to approve envoys to a congress of American nations at Panama, following invitations from Colombia, Mexico, and Central America. He says U.S. participation would not involve alliances or belligerent action. Proposed discussions include fair commerce, maritime neutrality, resistance to new European colonies, and religious liberty. He also hopes attendance will strengthen relations with the southern republics. He nominates Richard C. Anderson and John Sergeant as envoys and William B. Rochester as mission secretary, noting that the mission also requires congressional appropriations.

Hollywood Bowl’s full-year revenue rose almost 9%, while like-for-like sales increased 3.5% and operating cash flow grew more than 16%. Its shares rose nearly 8% following the results. The company declared a full-year and special dividend, opened three centres during the year, and plans further expansion. By contrast, UK Oil & Gas Investments raised £16.5m for a 2018 drilling and testing programme, but its prospects remain uncertain. The author prefers Hollywood Bowl’s cash flow to the risks of oil exploration.

The Seahawks overcame an 11-point deficit to beat the 49ers 25-23 and finish as the NFC’s third seed. Coach Pete Carroll pulled Russell Wilson and other key players in the fourth quarter to keep them fresh for a playoff game against Detroit. The 49ers finished 2-14 and fired coach Chip Kelly and general manager Trent Baalke after the game.

Rohingya fighters interviewed by Reuters said many recent recruits to the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army had little training and attacked Myanmar police posts on Aug. 25 with knives, sticks and unreliable homemade explosives, despite promises of rifles. A Myanmar military counteroffensive drove more than half a million Rohingya into Bangladesh. Some fighters in refugee camps said they would fight again, while refugees expressed both support for and opposition to the insurgency. Myanmar accused ARSA of killing civilians; ARSA denied it. Analysts warned that desperation in the camps could fuel further militancy.

Ronny Jackson’s confirmation hearing to lead the Department of Veterans Affairs was put on hold while senators review allegations of a hostile work environment, improper dispensing of medication, and being drunk on duty while traveling with the president. Jackson said he wants to answer the committee’s questions. President Trump defended him, though he publicly questioned whether Jackson should continue. After meeting with Jackson, the White House said it would fight the allegations and that Jackson had no plans to withdraw. Critics questioned whether the White House had adequately vetted him.

A forwarded collection of October 2001 news reports says Enron replaced CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeff McMahon to restore investor confidence. The change followed an SEC inquiry into partnerships Fastow ran, a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity, and a sharp decline in Enron’s stock. Analysts and investors questioned the partnerships, Enron’s disclosures, and potential liabilities; shareholder lawsuits were also reported.

Gavin will step down as Delta College president in January to lead a national coalition defending equity in higher education. He has held the post since 2021 and has advocated for diversity, equity and inclusion work at community colleges. Trustees will begin selecting a successor soon.

President Donald Trump’s attendance at the Mississippi Civil Rights Museum opening drew criticism from civil rights leaders, some of whom threatened to boycott after his response to the violence in Charlottesville. Jackson Mayor Chokwe Antar Lumumba called the museum a recognition of historic struggle and urged attention to what comes next. The passage describes his goal of expanding public participation through people’s assemblies, which promote Black self-determination and direct democracy. Lumumba won the mayoralty in 2017, following his father, who had also served as mayor.

The Southern Poverty Law Center has released a guide for students responding to alt-right speakers on campus and is sending it to more than 2,000 schools. The guide explains the movement and suggests educating classmates, seeking support and holding peaceful protests. Its central advice is to avoid direct confrontation or violence and deny speakers a spectacle. The SPLC says the guide addresses growing campus tensions and a lack of preparation among students and administrators.

NVIDIA’s GA102 and GA104 are Ampere-architecture GPUs used across the GeForce RTX 30 series and professional RTX A6000 and A40 products. Compared with Turing, GA10x adds doubled peak FP32 processing per streaming multiprocessor, second-generation RT Cores with faster ray tracing and motion-blur acceleration, and third-generation Tensor Cores supporting new data types and structured sparsity. The passage also describes GDDR6X memory, PCIe 4.0, NVLink, RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression, and display and video features including 8K output and hardware AV1 decoding. The RTX A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.

Randall Margraves rushed toward Larry Nassar during a Michigan sentencing hearing after a judge denied his request to confront the former sports doctor in a locked room. Deputies stopped him, and he later apologised, saying he had lost control after hearing two of his daughters describe their abuse. The judge declined to punish him for contempt but said assault was unacceptable. Nassar has pleaded guilty to molesting nine victims in two Michigan counties and has already received sentences that will keep him in prison for life.

The Supreme Court heard arguments on whether it can review a federal prisoner’s dismissed request to file a successive habeas motion and, if so, whether a rule expressly referring to state prisoners also applies to federal prisoners. Michael Bowe and the federal government argue that the rule does not apply to him. An appointed lawyer defended the lower court’s contrary ruling. The justices focused largely on jurisdiction and gave little indication how they would resolve it.

Python is an open-source programming language used to analyze market data, build trading algorithms, backtest strategies and execute trades. Backtesting applies a coded strategy to historical data to assess past performance and identify bugs, but it cannot guarantee future results; trading costs should also be considered. The passage lists frameworks including PyAlgoTrade, Bt, Backtrader, Fastquant, LEAN and Zipline, noting that the best choice depends on the trader’s needs. It recommends testing on in-sample data, reserving out-of-sample data for later evaluation, and analyzing results after optimization. It also argues that beginners may benefit from existing trading software rather than spending excessive time coding.

The TLV32xx comparator inputs operate from 200 mV below V− to 200 mV above V+; input current should be limited to 10 mA. Unused inputs require at least 50 mV differential voltage rather than being tied together. The devices have 1.8 mV internal hysteresis, and external hysteresis can reduce output chatter.

TLV321x push-pull outputs can sink and source current but must not be connected to another output; unused outputs should float. TLV322x open-drain outputs can be pulled up to 0–5.5 V; TI recommends 100 µA–1 mA pull-up current. Output shorts can damage either type. During power-on reset, outputs remain low for up to 32 µs after the supply crosses 1.65 V.

The passage also describes comparator timing, a low-side current-sensing example, and supply bypassing and PCB layout practices to prevent ringing and oscillation. TI states that application guidance is not a component specification and customers must validate their designs.

Electronic Arts will go private in a $55 billion all-cash deal backed by Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners. CEO Andrew Wilson will remain in his role. The deal removes pressure from public shareholders, but observers say EA’s few new owners may make their own demands. Analysts cited competition for “Battlefield 6,” reliance on established franchises, and struggles in mobile gaming as challenges. Going private could give Wilson more room to pursue generative AI and esports.

The speaker is pleased with a close opening win but says the next game against Philadelphia is crucial. Despite sustained pressure and two power-play goals against, the team stayed composed, aided by strong goaltending and defense; Kirk’s goal helped it settle down after the game was tied. Scoring from multiple players has allowed the team to avoid forcing plays. The speaker credits playoff experience for the team’s composure and emphasizes disciplined defense, better penalty killing and strong preparation for the next game.

After a work-related back injury left David Bunch totally and permanently disabled, the Workers’ Compensation Board attributed 15% of his occupational disability to that injury, 30% to the arousal of a previously dormant condition, and 55% to disability existing before the injury. The Kentucky Supreme Court held that employment before an injury does not rule out prior occupational disability. It reversed the Court of Appeals and affirmed the board’s exclusion of the prior 55% from compensation.

The lecture introduces data structures for memory hierarchies, where transferring blocks between cache and slower storage is the main cost. The external-memory model counts these transfers using block size \(B\) and cache size \(M\). Scanning takes about \(N/B\) transfers, while B-trees support searches in \(O(\log_B N)\) transfers. The lecture also outlines bounds for sorting, permuting, and buffer trees.

In the cache-oblivious model, algorithms do not know \(B\) or \(M\), allowing the same algorithm to work across different cache parameters. A static binary search tree stored in van Emde Boas order achieves \(O(\log_B N)\) searches. For dynamic searches and updates, the lecture combines that layout with ordered file maintenance, then uses groups of roughly \(\log N\) items to reduce update costs. The resulting cache-oblivious search tree matches B-tree search and update bounds.

The Swiss National Bank and European Central Bank are assessing a link between Switzerland’s SIC network and the Eurosystem’s TIPS platform to enable faster cross-border payments. Their study will run through 2026 and examine technical, economic, legal and operational feasibility, including settlement risk. Key challenges include liquidity management, cybersecurity and regulatory alignment.

Colorado Boy Scout Troop 1532, formed in 2014 by physician P.J. Parmar, is made up almost entirely of refugee children. Its leaders say camping trips help scouts adjust to American culture while giving them a place to be themselves. Transportation barriers, parents’ work schedules, and difficulty retaining leaders and members have limited regular meetings and rank advancement. Scout Jean Tuyishime’s father says the troop has helped his children learn discipline and respect; Jean hopes to become a leader and help other kids.

Leeds United fell to seventh after a 1-0 home defeat to Wolves, with Nouha Dicko scoring in the 39th minute. Leeds struggled in the first half and, despite dominating after the break, could not equalise. Their play-off hopes remain in their hands, though they may need to win all three remaining games to be sure of qualifying.

The speaker wants more shots and rebounds, saying the team played well despite unfavorable bounces. The focus is now on winning in St. Louis rather than dwelling on the previous game or an uncalled penalty. They say the players’ familiarity and shared system make line changes manageable.

Gold rose above $4,000 per ounce as weaker U.S. economic data fuelled expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts. Lower yields, a softer dollar, central-bank buying and geopolitical uncertainty supported demand for the metal. Analysts warned that stronger U.S. growth or hawkish Fed signals could prompt a short-term correction.

ChatGPT can help traders brainstorm strategies and generate code for backtesting, but its answers may be incorrect and it does not guarantee profitable strategies. The article describes using ChatGPT-generated Python code to backtest a Bollinger Band mean-reversion strategy on adjusted SPY data. The reported results were a 3.20% CAGR, 326 trades, and 45.63% of time spent in the market. The article presents ChatGPT as a starting point for developing trading models, not a trading platform or source of financial advice.

A November 17, 2001 Commissioner.COM fantasy football report lists Luccis Losers’ eight active and seven reserve players, notes injuries to Cameron Cleeland, Rob Johnson and Kurt Warner, and provides NFL player updates and lineup advice. It also includes sports promotions and advertisements.

The coach said the team must play better after two games in Boston, where mistakes hurt them and offense was limited. He expressed confidence in the players and their leadership, while acknowledging the Bruins as a strong opponent. With home-ice advantage, he expects the team to improve its execution, create more traffic and shots against Boston’s goaltender, and revive its power play. He confirmed Roberto will start in goal and attributed late-game scrums in Boston to heightened emotions.

Shedeur Sanders says he is grateful for any role with the Browns and sees a “light at the end of the tunnel” after beginning training camp as the fourth-string quarterback. Following Joe Flacco’s trade, coach Kevin Stefanski has not decided whether Sanders will be the backup to Dillon Gabriel. Offensive coordinator Tommy Rees praised Sanders’ preparation and improvement.

The Supreme Court will consider Michael Bowe’s effort to challenge his federal firearm conviction after later rulings held that neither of the robbery offenses underlying it qualifies as a crime of violence. Bowe must overcome restrictions on successive habeas petitions. He argues that a bar on Supreme Court review of decisions about successive petitions does not apply to federal inmates. He also disputes the 11th Circuit’s use of a rule requiring dismissal of previously raised claims. The government agrees that the latter rule applies only to state inmates but says Bowe cannot meet other requirements for a successive petition. An appointed lawyer will defend the 11th Circuit’s interpretation.

Dean Smith’s “Four Corner” offense spreads players into the corners to isolate a skilled ballhandler, reduce turnovers, and limit opponents’ possessions. The ballhandler drives, passes to a corner when stopped, and seeks a return pass. Baseline players can cut toward the basket; if a return pass is denied, a corner player takes over the drive.

Rush Bowls, a Colorado chain, opened its first St. Louis-area location in the Central West End. It serves blended-fruit bowls with toppings such as granola, acai and peanut butter, alongside 17 smoothies priced at $6.50. Its bowls cost $7.95 and include lighter and dessert-inspired options. Customers order at the counter; the shop has limited seating and is noisy when the blenders run.

Air Canada apologized and offered a C$2,500 trip voucher after a newspaper reported that a 10-year-old had no seat on an oversold flight to Montreal. His family drove to another airport, where their replacement flight was canceled, but eventually reached Montreal and connected to Costa Rica. The story drew attention following the widely publicized removal of a passenger from an overbooked United Airlines flight.

Youth soccer coaches should evaluate players’ skills, preferences, interactions, and enjoyment before choosing a formation and assigning positions. Goalkeepers, defenders, midfielders, and forwards require different abilities, but players should learn every position. Coaches can teach a formation by showing players their locations, moving the team together, and practicing each role’s responsibilities. Placement decisions should balance competitiveness with equal playing time, exposure to different positions, and player development. Coaches should avoid locking young players into roles because their abilities may change.

The passage praises the Army, civil authorities, and cooperating Filipinos for their work in the Philippine Islands. It urges better Army training, marksmanship, a general staff, supply reorganization, and militia reform. It also calls for expanded naval maneuvers, gunnery practice, new ships, and more skilled crews. The speaker argues that a strong, efficient Navy is needed to support American foreign policy, including the Monroe Doctrine, and to protect the proposed isthmian canal.

The passage describes a near-eye waveguide display for VR, AR, or MR systems. A controller coordinates a light source and scanning mirrors or a rotating source waveguide to project image light through an output waveguide to the user’s eyes. Proposed source layouts include one-dimensional, stacked, curved, and sparse arrays; optical isolators can reduce interference between source elements.

EUR/USD fell Tuesday as weaker-than-expected eurozone GDP, industrial production and German economic data weighed on the euro. The dollar strengthened after Fed Chair Janet Yellen said delaying interest-rate increases too long would be unwise. The pair fell below its 50-day moving average, with the passage identifying 1.0500 as the next downside target and 1.0350 if the decline continues.

The passage lists stories about Dita Von Teese’s fragrance launch, a scalp-focused salon, New York holiday windows, Neiman Marcus sales gains and lenders’ concerns about luxury retailers. It also mentions Bergdorf Goodman’s Linda Fargo, a lawsuit involving hairdresser John Barrett, and author Barbara Taylor Bradford.

WTI crude fell to $52.72 a barrel as rising US shale output weighed on prices and undermined Opec-led production cuts. US drillers added rigs for a 13th straight week, while production reached 9.24 million barrels per day. Strong Chinese economic data and hopes of extending the output cuts offered some support.

The passage examines digital transformation in Ethiopian higher education through an analysis of policy documents, reports, and the author’s experience. Ethiopia has adopted national and higher-education ICT strategies and established initiatives including EthERNet, a digital repository, and a digital library. However, these services have limited reach and resources. Universities mainly use technology for administration and services, while its use in teaching and research remains limited. The COVID-19 closures exposed inadequate preparation for online learning. The passage identifies unreliable and costly internet, weak ICT infrastructure, limited digital skills, and resistance to change as major barriers. It concludes that effective digital transformation requires implementation of existing policies alongside improved connectivity, infrastructure, and staff capacity.

Short interest measures the share of outstanding stock sold short, while the short-interest ratio estimates how many days short sellers would need to cover their positions at average trading volume. Research cited in the passage links high short interest to weaker future returns. A short squeeze occurs when short sellers buy back shares as prices rise, potentially driving prices higher still. The passage describes squeezes as rare and difficult to predict, and short selling as risky.

Wisdomtree Invstmnts (NASDAQ:WETF) shares rose 2.43% in the most recent session and closed at $9.68. Nine analysts’ 12-month price targets average $10.75, ranging from $8 to $13.50. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation is 2.55. Its 14-period average true range is 0.34, and its RSI is 57.35. The company has a $1.36 billion market capitalization. Previous-session trading volume was 2.16 million shares, versus an average of about 1.6 million.

A jury will decide whether Tomas Gajowniczek, who denies attempting to murder his partner, Alicja Kalinowska, and causing her serious harm in June 2016, should be found not guilty by reason of insanity. The prosecution said he attacked her while intoxicated by cannabis and argued that drug-induced psychosis does not qualify for that verdict. The defence said he had a mental disorder that left him unable to refrain from his actions, disputing evidence that he was intoxicated. The court heard differing psychiatric opinions. Justice Patrick McCarthy will complete his charge to the jury tomorrow.

In 1850, Lord Palmerston told Hawaiian commissioners that Britain favored Hawaiian independence but recommended U.S. protection or incorporation if self-government failed. The passage recounts Britain’s forced acquisition and restoration of the islands in 1843, French occupations and threats in 1849 and 1851, and Kamehameha III’s conditional deed of cession to the United States during the latter crisis. The deed was later returned. U.S. negotiations in 1854 produced only a proposed protectorate, which Washington rejected. With annexation unresolved, reciprocity remained an alternative, though sugar-state interests obstructed a treaty after the Civil War.

MCW Pro Wrestling’s Spring Fever takes place April 22 in Joppa, Maryland, with a Rey Mysterio meet-and-greet at 4 p.m. and matches at 7:30 p.m. The Ecktourage faces Guns 4 Hire for the vacant tag titles, while Sean Studd and Dante Caballero defend their championships. Tickets are available online, by phone, or at the door.

The speaker looks forward to playing in the Stanley Cup playoffs after a disappointing lineup change against Ottawa. They plan to focus on defense and say they kept practicing despite uncertainty about playing. They describe the opponent as disciplined and hardworking, and say their team’s progress has eased the frustration of limited playing time.

The passage argues that multi-agent reinforcement learning’s reliance on single rewards cannot adequately represent agents with competing objectives, because each agent’s trade-offs depend on others’ strategies. It introduces Multi-Objective Markov Games with vectorial rewards and Pareto-Nash Equilibrium as a solution concept, claiming that equilibria exist in finite games. It also states that Pareto-Nash equilibria correspond to Nash equilibria across linearly scalarized games, enabling use of existing solvers. The authors additionally study computationally weaker equilibrium concepts and propose a decentralized online learning algorithm that converges to a Pareto Correlated Equilibrium.

The speaker says poor ice made passing difficult and that their team must play its best against an aggressive opponent. They did not view a missed late opportunity as a blown play, but said they struggled to adapt after facing Colorado’s counterattacking style.

German inflation rose to 2.2% year-on-year in May, above the expected 1.9% and its highest level since February 2017. Energy prices, up 5.2%, were the main driver; food rose 3.5% and services 1.9%. The article says core inflation likely remained subdued and expects the ECB to extend asset purchases through year-end amid economic and political uncertainty.

Tesla’s Model 3 orders and automotive revenue were growing, and the company expected to expand production. Yet it remained unprofitable, carried substantial debt, and had a market value comparable to much larger automakers. The passage argues that Tesla’s renewable-energy ambitions could justify a different way of assessing its prospects, but competition, production delays, and its high valuation make the investment risky.

Cleveland’s narrow playoff win over Indiana added to concerns about the Cavaliers’ poor record and defense since January. The column contrasts those struggles with LeBron James’s six straight trips to the NBA Finals and his record of reaching the Finals whenever he entered the playoffs as a No. 2 seed. Despite the concerns, the author expects Cleveland to reach the Finals, where it could face Golden State.

Indian shares rose on Monday, ending a five-day losing streak, as global markets recovered and selling pressure eased. The NSE gained 0.83 percent and the BSE 0.82 percent, with banks among the top gainers. DLF surged on talks involving its rental unit, while Sun Pharma and Bharat Petroleum fell after disappointing quarterly results.

The incoming president expresses gratitude and apprehension about his responsibilities and pledges to uphold the Constitution. He advocates limited federal powers, respect for state authority, protection of minority rights, and preservation of the Union and its constitutional compromises. He calls for economical government, repayment of public debt, and tariffs designed primarily to raise revenue while providing incidental protection to domestic industries. He supports annexing Texas and extending U.S. jurisdiction over Oregon, while respecting treaty obligations and other nations’ rights. He also promises strict accountability for public officers and impartial respect for citizens who disagree with him.

The S&P 500 and Dow were nearly flat in early Monday trading after an explosion at New York’s Port Authority; police said one suspect was in custody. The Nasdaq rose 0.28 percent, led by technology shares, while financial stocks fell. Cryptocurrency-related shares surged after bitcoin futures began trading in the United States. Investors expected a Federal Reserve rate increase later in the week, though weak wage growth raised questions about its 2018 plans. Bluebird Bio shares rose on positive early-stage drug results.

Researchers created carbon-related spin defects in hBN by implanting 13C ions and annealing. A defect’s strongly coupled electron and 13C nuclear spins form a controllable two-qubit system. Microwave and radiofrequency pulses selectively drive their transitions, while CPMG dynamical decoupling extends electron-spin coherence from 148 ± 8 ns under Hahn echo to 38 ± 10 µs. Using spin initialization, conditional gates and quantum state tomography, the researchers prepared and characterized all four electron–nuclear Bell states.

Star Bulk Carriers is heavily exposed to Capesize shipping rates, which weakened after disruptions to Brazilian iron exports before recovering in April. It acquired 16 vessels by assuming $310 million in debt and issuing 10.5 million shares. The author estimates the $433 million purchase was below the vessels’ $441 million value. The deal increased cargo capacity by 24% and reduced average fleet age from eight to seven years, while diluting equity by 14%. The author, who holds SBLK shares, estimates net asset value at $12.60 per share and a fair value target of $15.

A judge sided with Humana in its challenge to a Biden-era rule that would have expanded audits of private Medicare plans and recouped billions. The newsletter also mentions doctors’ concerns about a Cigna reimbursement policy and pressure not to test for or report infections.

Momo shares rose more than 15% after strong first-quarter earnings and an upbeat second-quarter revenue outlook, bringing their 2018 gain to nearly 85%. The author favors a bullish options strategy over buying shares: a July $45/$50 call spread financed partly by selling a $40/$35 put spread. At the quoted $1.10 debit, the position could earn $3.90 if shares exceed $50 at expiration. The author discloses holdings in Momo and its derivatives.

Quinstreet shares rose 38.91% in the most recent session and closed at $12.96. Three analysts’ 52-week price targets averaged $9.88, ranging from $8.50 to $12.50. Analyst ratings included one Buy, one Outperform and one Underperform. The stock’s 14-period average true range was 0.67, and its relative strength index was 83.22. Quinstreet’s market capitalization was $575.55 million.

The Santa Barbara Public Library System offers free weekly Spelling Basics workshops through August. Tuesday daytime classes begin July 9 for seventh graders and older; adult-only Wednesday evening classes begin July 10. Walk-ins are welcome.

The lecture defines batch arguments (BARGs) as proof systems that use one proof to establish that multiple NP instances are valid. A BARG is succinct when its proof is shorter than the combined witnesses; it must also satisfy completeness and soundness. The proposed construction starts with PCP proofs for each instance, hashes their columns, and uses a correlation-intractable hash to generate a query non-interactively. Ordinary compressing hashes make soundness difficult to prove, so the construction uses a somewhere statistical binding hash built from fully homomorphic encryption. This binds one PCP row corresponding to an invalid instance, enabling a soundness argument based on PCP verification and correlation intractability.

Tesla filed a Form 8-K reporting that it published a press release on July 2, 2022, concerning results of operations and financial condition. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn signed the report on July 5, 2022.

AAPL is Apple Inc.’s Nasdaq stock ticker. The passage says shares can be bought through a broker and traded during regular market hours, 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET, as well as before and after those hours. Investors can hold shares long-term or use day- and swing-trading strategies. The passage emphasizes researching Apple, developing a trading plan, backtesting strategies, and managing risk; it says trading success is difficult. It reports an annual dividend of $0.82 per share, an average return of approximately 16.1% over the past five years, and that AAPL began trading on December 12, 1980.

The passage proposes a moderately conservative “Stay Rich Portfolio” for preserving wealth after financial independence. It argues that all asset classes can suffer substantial drawdowns and that short-term volatility does not necessarily mean a permanent loss of capital. The proposed portfolio combines U.S. and foreign assets, including stocks, TIPS, and corporate bonds, to diversify exposure. It describes the portfolio as approximately 75% U.S. and 25% foreign exposure and says it is backtested, but provides no numerical results.

The passage argues that revolutionary Marxist regimes create large numbers of refugees, citing the displacement of Chinese residents in Vietnam and comparisons with other countries. It contends that traditional autocracies are more likely to liberalize and that U.S. policy should encourage gradual reform where conditions permit. It warns that Marxist-led insurgencies are unlikely to produce democratic governments. The author identifies consent of the governed and timely elections as signs of democratic movements, and argues that groups portraying the United States as an enemy should be treated as such.

Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels will start Sunday against the Chargers after missing two games with a sprained left knee. He was medically cleared Wednesday, practiced fully all week and will wear a knee brace. Washington will again be without two of its top three receivers.

After being dismissed as White House communications director, Anthony Scaramucci said elements in Washington and the White House were undermining President Trump. He said he had believed the call that led to his dismissal was off the record.

The newsletter reports that NIH awarded grants to 13 autism research teams, with attention to environmental exposures, and announced an $87 million effort to develop organoids as an alternative to animal research. The FDA approved a generic version of mifepristone, drawing opposition from anti-abortion groups and politicians. The Trump administration delayed a policy addressing a potential loophole in Medicare drug-price negotiations. In a commentary, a medicine professor argues that the administration’s rhetoric about autism echoes eugenic thinking.

The lecture reviews covariant and Lie derivatives, Killing vectors, and tensor densities. The metric determinant can convert tensor densities into tensors, including a covariant volume element. It also provides a shortcut for calculating contracted Christoffel symbols and vector divergence, though an analogous simplification generally fails for tensors. Covariant conservation of stress-energy describes local conservation, not an unambiguous global conservation law.

For a freely falling test body, parallel transport of its tangent vector yields the geodesic equation. Its standard form uses an affine parameter; proper time is an affine parameter for timelike motion. A second derivation shows that a timelike geodesic is a stationary-proper-time path between events, on which an observer accumulates the most proper time. The lecture closes by noting future discussion of null trajectories and conserved quantities associated with Killing vectors.

Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez’s Double Seven strategy buys when the close is above its 200-day moving average and at a seven-day low, then sells at a seven-day high, without a stop loss. A backtest on SPY since 1993 found 154 trades, an average gain of 1.18% per trade and a 6.3% annualized return. A broader ETF portfolio also returned 6.3% annually, with most gains before 2010. The article reports overlapping trades in a SPY–QQQ portfolio and poor results when trading the strategy short.
A Dutch-speaking mechanical engineer is sought for a 12-month assignment in Genk, starting in 1–4 weeks. Modelling and thermal experience are essential.
