Biogetica has partnered with Research Needs to study its natural-medicine protocols. The partners plan clinical trials and observational studies in 2018 for HPV, herpes, trigeminal neuralgia, vertigo, tinnitus and cataracts. They say the research will evaluate plant medicines from different cultures, combinations of treatments and the effects of Biogetica’s protocols.

SpaceX targeted February 6 for the first Falcon Heavy launch, with February 7 as a backup date. It planned to land all three first-stage cores, two at Cape Canaveral and one on an Atlantic drone ship. The rocket’s engines had recently passed a hold-down test, but CEO Elon Musk cautioned that it might not reach orbit. A delay beyond February 7 could lead to an indefinite postponement if federal funding expires and a government shutdown prevents launches from government property.

The Tennessee BIG Initiative links genomic data, electronic health records, and environmental information from a predominantly pediatric, diverse Mid-South cohort. Analysis of 13,152 genomes found that 50% of participants had inferred non-European or admixed ancestry and identified 771,717 previously unreported variants. Ancestry varied geographically, while preliminary analyses found higher odds ratios for asthma and obesity among participants identifying as non-White. Self-reported race did not consistently align with inferred genetic ancestry, including among related individuals. The initiative emphasizes community engagement and plans to expand enrollment and adopt pangenomic analysis. The preprint has not been peer reviewed.

The study trains a Fourier Neural Operator to approximate the inverse Hessian in 4D-Var data assimilation. Although the operator alone is generally less accurate than conjugate gradient (CG), using its prediction to initialize CG reduces average relative error by 62% and iterations by 17% on linear-advection test cases. Gains are most pronounced for ill-conditioned problems.

The passage describes SD memory card operation from identification through data transfer. The host uses commands to read card information, select one card at a time, configure functions, and control reads, writes and erases. Reads and writes use block transfers protected by CRC; write and erase operations may signal busy on DAT0. It also specifies command sequences and error handling for erase, DISCARD and full-user-area logical erase, plus write protection, password locking and Card Ownership Protection. Other sections cover bus-width and speed switching, power limits, differences between standard- and high-capacity cards, clock control, and read and write timeouts.

The passage argues that Andropov may have military, economic and political incentives to reach an arms control agreement. It recommends focusing on INF talks, which the author says offer leverage and urgency, while leaving START for later. The author favors a private channel to accommodate Andropov’s preference for secrecy and avoid leaks or resistance within the US administration. An initial letter would acknowledge continuing disagreements, express a shared interest in peace and invite Andropov to pursue nuclear arms reductions.

A commodity trading advisor (CTA) advises on or manages trading in futures, options, and certain currency contracts. CTAs may use discretionary strategies or systematic models that generate trading signals; trend following and momentum are common approaches. The passage emphasizes combining strategies with low correlations to improve risk-adjusted returns, rather than selecting them solely for profitability. It illustrates trend following with a backtest that holds the S&P 500 when it is above its 200-day moving average. CTA strategies still face risks from losses, volatility, and unreliable data, and may require substantial capital or specialized knowledge.

This systematic review examines 70 studies of LLMs in education, grouping their applications into operational tasks, personalization, and interactive learning tools. Reported risks include unreliable or fabricated outputs, bias, privacy concerns, superficial feedback, reduced critical engagement, over-reliance, and weakened student agency. The authors propose mitigation through educator oversight, student verification and AI literacy, more inclusive and transparent model design, and data governance. Their conceptual Interaction–Monitoring–Outcome model describes how risks can compound across the learning cycle. The review notes that its English-language search and predominantly short-term evidence leave long-term and cross-cultural effects uncertain.

The September 14, 2000 VentureWire reports Inktomi’s planned $1.3 billion acquisition of FastForward Networks, Bertelsmann’s $1 billion venture fund, Algorithmics’ $60 million financing and acquisition of Sentry, Artisan Entertainment’s $50 million investment unit, and Privista’s $17 million first round. The issue also covers additional funding, product launches, acquisitions, executive and board appointments, and Vestar Capital’s first European office.

Enron reported a $618 million third-quarter loss after a $1.01 billion charge tied partly to broadband, water and limited-partnership investments. Questions about partnerships overseen by CFO Andrew Fastow prompted an SEC inquiry; Enron replaced Fastow with Jeff McMahon to restore investor confidence. Standard & Poor’s affirmed Enron’s ratings but changed its outlook to negative, while other agencies considered downgrades. Trading partners largely continued business as usual, though they monitored Enron’s credit. Its shares fell sharply amid concerns about its finances and ability to reduce debt. CEO Kenneth Lay resigned from i2 Technologies’ board to focus on Enron.

Hibs defender Darren McGregor said his side’s 3-2 comeback win at Rangers was character-building after they conceded early amid an exceptionally loud Ibrox atmosphere. Simon Murray equalised before Ryan Jack’s red card, a James Tavernier own goal and Vykintas Slivka’s strike put Hibs ahead. McGregor backed Jack’s dismissal and praised Murray, who has scored ten goals in seven competitive matches.

Nova Scotia Community College faculty and support staff ratified six-year agreements with seven-per-cent wage increases. Approval was 55 and 64 per cent, respectively. The agreements also provide options for collecting retirement service awards.

Several Swedish players reflect on a retiring hockey player they describe as a role model and an icon. They praise his professionalism, consistent play over two decades, four Stanley Cups and seven Norris Trophies. One speaker says he has been practicing for several weeks, feels physically ready and hopes for a chance to play.

Soccer coaches should develop, document, and share contingency plans with assistants, players, and parents rather than improvise when problems arise. The passage offers “what if” questions covering communication failures, cancellations, player health and eligibility, practice and game disruptions, injuries, equipment, weather, transportation, and a coach’s absence. It recommends checklists, delegation, prepared backups, and teaching players to plan for contingencies.

A low volatility strategy invests in stocks whose prices fluctuate less than the overall market, often indicated by a beta below 1. Investors can use low volatility funds or select stocks based on historical prices, stable earnings and consistent dividends, while diversifying and periodically rebalancing. The approach generally requires a long time horizon and may experience extended underperformance.

The passage cites research finding that low volatility stocks have outperformed highly volatile stocks across long periods and international markets. It cautions that backtests only estimate past performance and do not predict future returns.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition device with configurable two- or four-lane SDR or DDR output. It provides data and capture clocks, plus a frame clock. Features include output randomization, two averaging modes, test patterns, and a speed-boost mode that converts one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS. Configuration uses banked SPI registers, with support for multiple devices in a daisy chain. Initialization requires register writes and a free-running sampling clock.

An example ATE application reports 0.0015% total unadjusted error after calibration at 25°C ±5°C. The device offers low-noise and wide-bandwidth modes; the latter settles to 99.95% of full scale in 7.5µs. The passage also gives power-supply and layout recommendations and states that application guidance must be validated by users.

A TeamLease survey of nine cities found job loss risk highest in Delhi, followed by Bengaluru and Hyderabad, and lowest in Pune. Industrial manufacturing and allied sectors had the highest risk, followed by construction and real estate, and BPO and IT-enabled services. Healthcare and telecom had the lowest risk.

The Triple RSI strategy is a modified, mean-reversion approach using RSI readings, the 200-day moving average, and buy/sell signals. A backtest on SPY reports 83 trades since 1993, averaging 1.4% per trade, with a 91% win rate and a profit factor of 5. The passage suggests it could complement a buy-and-hold portfolio.

David Wybron, headteacher of Lord Williams’s School in Thame, is urging the Government to rethink new GCSEs, which he says place greater exam pressure on state-school pupils than on their independent-school peers. He wants schools to be able to choose IGCSEs without a league-table penalty. Citing difficulties recruiting teachers, he also calls for all teaching subjects to be added to the visa shortage occupation list. Wybron says rising costs and the funding formula will leave his pupils receiving over £1,000 less each than pupils in well-funded authorities.
Naughty Dog showcased Uncharted: The Lost Legacy at E3 2017, featuring Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross. The full team began work weeks after finishing Uncharted 4.

Defensive tackles line up inside defensive ends and help stop the run and pressure quarterbacks. They penetrate the backfield, make tackles and absorb double teams that free teammates to make plays. Their interior position makes pass rushing difficult, but disrupting the quarterback can help the defense. The role calls for strength, agility, recognition and toughness. The passage cites Aaron Donald and “Mean” Joe Greene as notable defensive tackles.

This AMD Geode CS5535 revision A3 specification update lists silicon issues affecting timers, interrupts, DMA, power management, storage, USB, LPC, SMBus, GPIO and other functions. Some faults can cause hangs, missed interrupts, failed transfers or incorrect register behavior; others have limited or no operational impact. The document describes conditions and implications for each issue and provides workarounds where available, including avoiding certain operating modes or access sequences, changing register settings, and using software or external circuitry.

DFT is computationally costly, while machine-learning force fields offer scalable property prediction. Existing crystal graph representations can miss long-range interactions and map distinct structures to the same representation. The passage proposes PRDNet, which combines graph embeddings with diffraction information generated using a learned pseudo-particle designed to distinguish atomic environments. Its synthetic diffraction patterns are invariant to crystal rotations, reflections, and translations. The authors report state-of-the-art results on crystal property prediction benchmarks including Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and MatBench.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs combine improved ray tracing, shading and AI performance with DLSS, which uses multiple frames to produce higher-resolution images at higher frame rates. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling and delivers up to 936 GB/sec of peak bandwidth. RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move game-asset decompression from the CPU to the GPU. The passage also describes 8K display support, hardware video encoding and AV1 decoding, A40 and RTX A6000 GPUs for professional workloads, and error detection and replay for GDDR6X memory overclocking.

China’s manufacturing activity grew at its fastest pace in eight months in May, with the official PMI rising to 51.9 from 51.4 in April, above forecasts. Production, new orders and export orders strengthened, though small firms’ activity contracted and more manufacturers reported funding pressures. Economists questioned whether the strength would last, citing weak investment, debt controls and trade tensions with the United States. The non-manufacturing PMI edged up to 54.9, while the composite PMI rose to 54.6. Economists expect China’s economic growth to slow to 6.5 percent this year from 6.9 percent in 2017.

Intel shares rose 3% Thursday, bringing their monthly gain above 50% and the value of the U.S. government’s stake to roughly $16 billion. The Trump administration bought a 10% stake in August for $8.9 billion.

The passage describes SD memory card commands, responses, status fields, error handling, timing, and performance specifications. CMD6 checks or switches functions in groups covering access mode, command systems, driver strength, and power limits; hosts should check supported functions and power requirements before switching. CMD8 checks supply-voltage compatibility during initialization. SDSC cards use byte addresses for memory access, while SDHC and SDXC cards use 512-byte block addresses.

The specification also defines command formats and classes, CRC protection, read and write timeouts, and conditions for stopping the bus clock. Card and SD status report errors, operating state, supported features, and performance information. Speed Class, UHS Speed Grade, and Video Speed Class describe recording performance. The passage details allocation and recording units, performance measurement, and SDXC recording procedures using CMD20.

The passage proposes Truthful Text Summarization (TTS), a pipeline designed to reduce manipulation of LLM-generated search summaries. TTS evaluates each source against claims drawn from other sources, scores informative agreement with peers, filters low-scoring documents, and then generates a summary. The authors present theoretical incentives for truthful reporting and report that TTS improves factual accuracy and resistance to adversarial and coordinated uninformative sources compared with the tested baselines.

Lilly Nguyen and Phil De Carlos married at Texas Children’s Hospital on New Year’s Day so their premature son, Lucas, could be part of the occasion. Born at 24 weeks weighing 1 pound, 12 ounces, Lucas remains in the NICU and is growing. The couple visited him after the ceremony.

In his farewell address, President Truman welcomes the peaceful transfer of power to General Eisenhower and asks Americans to support their new President. Recalling the difficult decisions he faced after Roosevelt’s death, he describes the presidency as a demanding job that no one can do alone. He reviews efforts to resist Communist expansion, including aid to Greece and Turkey, the Marshall Plan, alliances, and the decision to defend South Korea. He rejects starting an atomic war, expresses confidence that free societies will prevail, and hopes peace will allow science to reduce poverty. He also cites American prosperity and progress on civil rights, then thanks the public for its support.

The Opportunity Project (TOP) runs early-learning centers for about 600 children in high-poverty areas of Wichita and Derby. A published study found that TOP graduates generally outperformed similar children who did not attend its programs in academics, social skills and attendance through eighth grade. TOP combines child-led learning with scholarships and family support, including access to community resources, education assistance and parent workshops. Single father William Eckels says TOP has helped both his son Elijah and him; he has since advocated for preschool and is considering becoming a teacher.

MIT and the Carnegie Institution for Science have released 20 years of Keck Observatory observations to help the public search for exoplanets. The dataset contains nearly 61,000 measurements of more than 1,600 nearby stars, plus open-source software and a tutorial. Researchers have identified more than 100 potential exoplanets and plan to update the data periodically.

The Trump administration began permanently laying off federal workers on the tenth day of the government shutdown. Trump said the cuts would be extensive, and notices reached workers at the Treasury and Health and Human Services departments, among others. Federal employee unions vowed legal action, while Democratic Senator Chuck Schumer and Republican Senator Susan Collins criticized the layoffs. The shutdown continues amid a dispute over funding legislation: Democrats want an extension of enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits, and competing proposals have repeatedly failed in the Senate.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture adds improved video encoding and decoding, single-connector VR support through VirtualLink, and NVLink for two-way SLI on supported GPUs. Its RT Cores accelerate ray tracing, while hybrid rendering combines ray tracing with rasterization and denoising to produce real-time reflections, shadows, and other lighting effects.

Turing’s Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and super-resolution. Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, and Multi-View Rendering offer ways to improve rendering efficiency and flexibility. The passage also describes the TU104 and TU106 GPUs, a Tesla T4 configuration for inference, and RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering.

Blue Jays star Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was born in Montreal in 1999 and moved to the Dominican Republic with his mother, Riquelma Ramos, as a child. His father, Vladimir Guerrero Sr., is a Baseball Hall of Famer. Guerrero Jr. married Nathalie Guerrero in 2023; they have two daughters, Vlaimel and Vlaishel. His brother Pablo and half-brother Vladi Miguel play in the minor leagues. His uncle Wilton played in MLB and helped teach him baseball, while Hall of Fame pitcher Pedro Martinez is his godfather.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2018 reports second-quarter net sales of $52.9 billion, up from $38.0 billion a year earlier. Net income rose to $2.5 billion from $197 million, and operating income rose to $3.0 billion from $628 million. For the first six months of 2018, net sales were $103.9 billion and net income was $4.2 billion. North America and AWS reported higher operating income, while International reported a smaller operating loss. Amazon acquired Ring in April 2018 for approximately $853 million in cash, net of cash acquired. The filing also discusses accounting changes, tax matters and legal proceedings.

Seattle’s 103-year-old Smith Tower is converting its manually operated elevators to automatic service to improve safety, reliability and accessibility. Owner Unico Properties says the elevators will retain their historic appearance and at least one operator, though operators will no longer be required by mid-2018. Hamilton Beale, an operator since 1999, plans to leave Seattle and move closer to family.

Diedrick Grafing deposited money in savings accounts in trust for Catharine Heilmann, kept the bank books, and drew interest during his lifetime. After his death, his executrices sought to recover one deposit, arguing that he had not intended a present trust. The court held that the deposits created a valid trust: retaining the books and interest did not defeat it, and Heilmann’s interest vested when the deposits were made, even if she was to receive the money after his death. Any obligation she had to distribute funds to others was for those parties to enforce. The judgment for Heilmann was affirmed with costs.

House Democrats Nancy Pelosi and Elijah Cummings cited a fake Michael Flynn tweet while criticizing Republicans’ investigation of the former national security adviser. Both offices later acknowledged the mistake. The New York Times also cited the fake account, then removed the references and corrected its story.

OpenAI reached a $500 billion valuation after current and former employees sold about $6.6 billion in shares to institutional investors. Its valuation rose from roughly $300 billion earlier in 2025, while first-half revenue reached $4.3 billion. The sale gave employees liquidity, but questions remain about sustaining growth, profitability and navigating regulation.

The 123 reversal pattern is a three-swing formation that signals a potential trend change when an uptrend makes a lower high or a downtrend makes a higher low. A break beyond point 2 confirms the pattern. The passage describes entering after the breakout, placing a stop loss beyond point 3, and estimating a profit target from the pattern’s dimensions. Backtests on the gold ETF GLD found more promising results for bullish than bearish reversals, though the strategy’s rules are somewhat subjective.

Gold rallied as the USD Index fell, but mining stocks and silver showed little strength. The article interprets miners’ failure to follow gold as a bearish signal and argues that the USD Index may rise while stocks decline. It compares current conditions to 2008. The page also includes trade-tariff headlines, promotional material and trading-risk disclosures.

Hajime is malware that infects poorly secured internet-of-things devices, competing with Mirai for some of the same targets. A researcher estimates it has infected about 100,000 devices worldwide. Unlike Mirai, Hajime uses a decentralized peer-to-peer network, making its botnet harder to disrupt. Researchers have not observed it launching DDoS attacks, and its operator and purpose remain unknown. Hajime has been found on a narrower range of devices than Mirai, but researchers say it has hindered some of Mirai’s expansion. Patching vulnerable devices could stop infections, though many vendors have not released patches.

The UCLA high post rub offense uses spacing, a high post screen and ball reversal to create inside and outside scoring opportunities. The point guard passes to a wing, cuts off the high post screen and looks for a layup or post-up; if no shot is available, play can continue through reversal passes and down screens. The passage describes counters to defensive positioning, switches, double teams and denied passes. It emphasizes precise execution, defensive reads, coordinated screening and cutting, individual skill development and scouting opponents.

The passage describes cooperative monitoring networks that link separate security systems in response to events under configurable rules. Participating systems can share sensor and camera data, send alerts, and coordinate devices such as lights to track intruders or assist during emergencies. Networks may expand, contract, or disband as events develop. Comparing data across properties can also help distinguish localized equipment failures from broader disruptions or false alarms.

Assuming the presidency under extraordinary circumstances, the speaker acknowledges that Americans did not elect him and asks for their prayers. He pledges to serve all the people, consult Congress on national priorities, pursue peace, and govern with openness and honesty. Declaring the national nightmare over, he calls for healing after Watergate, asks for prayers for Richard Nixon and his family, and reaffirms his promise to uphold the Constitution and do his best for America.

The passage calls for more education and livelihood training on reservations, tailored to individual aptitudes and native industries, alongside strong oversight of government officials. It describes agricultural aid through pest control, new crops, range restoration, and improved fruit shipping. It also urges support for the Smithsonian’s museum and preservation plans, stronger sanitation and social services in Washington, and additional worker and railway safety laws.

Jennifer Cutaia forwarded a widely circulated chain email urging recipients to pass along a message about a seven-year-old girl said to have cancer and a brain tumor. The message claimed that the Make-A-Wish Foundation would donate seven cents for each name on the list.

Andrew Lo recommends net present value (NPV) for capital budgeting, or adjusted present value when accounting for factors such as taxes and project interactions. He explains that payback period overlooks later cash flows, profitability index ignores scale, and internal rate of return (IRR) can produce misleading rankings or multiple or nonexistent usable results. These measures can still provide useful information and remain common in practice. Capital budgeting also requires attention to changing risks, financing limits, competitive responses, and nonfinancial considerations.

Lo then introduces efficient markets, noting that finance models rely on market prices while markets can also fail. As an example of information rapidly entering prices, he describes how Morton Thiokol’s stock fell sharply after the Challenger explosion, months before an investigation identified its O-ring as the cause.

The speaker hopes the team’s depth will limit the effect of Dallas’s heat. After a loss, they say the team must correct its mistakes without getting too high or low. Compared with the first game, the team struggled in the neutral zone and failed to get the puck deep consistently, allowing Dallas’s strong transition game to create chances. The speaker says the team needs to win small battles, cycle the puck, and return to the simple, consistent play that has helped it succeed on the road.

New York City-based Troll Cakes makes chocolate chip brownie cakes decorated with internet insults and sends them anonymously to the commenters who wrote them. It charges $35 to make and ship a cake, plus $25 to find a recipient’s address. A $30 option sends a cake featuring a Trump tweet to the White House.

Travis Zajac says the opposing goalie is quick and active with the puck, so his team needs more traffic and shots. Despite a loss, he believes they can draw confidence from past series and focus on winning tomorrow.

In 116 mother–child pairs, researchers compared maternal and children’s stool microbiome and metabolite profiles with children’s developmental questionnaire scores at ages one, two and three. The maternal gut microbiome predicted scores at age one more strongly than the infant or one-year-old child microbiome. Predictive power declined for age-two scores, and neither maternal nor child microbiomes predicted age-three scores. Some microbial taxa showed different associations with development in mothers and infants. The authors note the limited sample size and call for further validation.

The speaker says entering a Stanley Cup Final with five minutes left was a learning experience. They held the puck too long and made a mistake, but say inactivity is no excuse. They intend to stay prepared and help the team.

Astronomers observed that 14 of Centaurus A’s 16 dwarf satellite galaxies orbit in a common plane, rather than in the roughly spherical distribution predicted by the standard dark matter model. It is the first such observation reported outside the Local Group. Some scientists say it may expose gaps in the model, while others suggest the arrangement could be a statistical fluke or reflect dark matter structures not captured in simulations. Researchers say observations of more distant galaxies are needed.

Quora contributor Michael Barnard argues that recent hurricanes and wildfires will make more voters prioritize climate change. He predicts that migration from affected areas and future extreme weather will shift votes away from Republicans, potentially costing them elections unless they change their position on climate change.

Europe is set to launch Sentinel-3B on Wednesday to monitor oceans alongside its twin, Sentinel-3A. The satellites will track sea levels, temperatures, pollution, sea ice and coastal vegetation, while also monitoring rivers, lakes and wildfires. Sentinel-3B will join the EU- and ESA-funded Copernicus constellation, which provides free environmental data. Brexit has raised uncertainty about Britain’s future participation.

On June 10, 2015, Tesla Motors and Tesla Motors Netherlands entered into a senior secured asset-based revolving credit agreement with seven banks. The facility provides up to $500 million, potentially increasing to $750 million, and includes letter-of-credit and swingline subfacilities. Loans may be used for working capital and general corporate purposes and are due June 10, 2020. Nothing was outstanding at closing. Borrowing availability depends on specified assets, which also secure the obligations. The agreement includes financial reporting requirements, restrictions on certain corporate actions, and provisions allowing lenders to demand repayment and foreclose on collateral after a default, subject to cure rights.

Offensive corner kicks are planned plays with a target, a designated kicker and a suitable service. The passage describes far-post, near-post, medium, top-of-the-arc, short, skip-header and direct-score corners, each targeting a different area or creating a different scoring opportunity. Coaches should select plays, kickers and receivers according to players’ abilities, then practice first without defenders and gradually under game-like conditions. Players should time their runs, account for wind and the goalkeeper, and prepare for rebounds, clearances and counterattacks.

Researchers developed and validated a fluorescent immuno-lectin assay to measure forms of the joint-lubricating protein lubricin with different glycosylation patterns. In matched samples from osteoarthritis patients, lubricin levels were much higher in synovial fluid than in plasma, and its glycosylation differed between the two. Among plasma samples from osteoarthritis patients and controls, only the lubricin form detected by the SNA lectin was significantly lower in patients. Several plasma lubricin glycoforms also correlated with body mass index or age. The authors suggest that the plasma difference could contribute to a combined osteoarthritis biomarker assay, but would not suffice alone.

Crews removed a Confederate statue from outside a Gainesville county building after months of relocation efforts. In the Tampa area, a Confederate memorial park was vandalized with paint. Both incidents came amid debates over Confederate monuments and after violence at a related rally in Charlottesville, Virginia.

A study of 121 adults aged 60 or older in 61 households used repeated saliva testing over two seasons to examine pneumococcal carriage. Pneumococcus was detected in 52 of 1,088 tested samples (4.8%) and in 27 participants (22.3%) at least once. Recent contact with children under 10 was associated with a higher acquisition rate; detectable colonization lasted an average of 17.7 days. Although both adults in some households carried pneumococcus, the study found no clear evidence of adult-to-adult transmission. The authors note that the study was small, participants may not represent the wider community, and some laboratory assays could not reliably identify serotypes.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2019, announcing that it had issued a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2019. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The Double Stack offense counters a Triangle & Two defense, which uses three zone defenders and two players focused on denying shooters the ball. Two posts screen from mid-post positions while the shooters move along the baseline for open shots. Shooters can pop out, curl, fade or back-cut depending on how defenders react. The offense also offers crossing entries, single and double screens, and base and side screen actions. Its success depends on coordinated execution, defensive recognition and practice.

In a phase 2 trial, adding abatacept to standard prevention drugs reduced severe acute graft-versus-host disease after mismatched unrelated donor stem cell transplants. At 100 days, it occurred in 3% of 43 abatacept recipients, compared with 32% and 22% in two groups drawn from a national database. At one year, abatacept recipients also had higher overall and disease-free survival, with no increase in relapse or major uncontrolled infections reported. Results from a second, randomized cohort were pending.
Stoke City defender Geoff Cameron says Saturday’s home match against Hull is a must-win after five games without a victory. Stoke are 13th, eight points above the relegation zone.

In the AEGEAN study, 1,162 subjects initiating apixaban for atrial fibrillation were randomized to standard care or an additional educational program. Mean adherence at 24 weeks was 91.64% and 91.88%, respectively, with no significant difference. Adherence and persistence remained high through 48 weeks but declined over time; neither differed significantly between groups. Safety outcomes were generally similar. Before week 24, adverse events were reported by 51.2% of standard-care subjects and 52.0% of educational-program subjects. The study concluded that the educational program provided no additional adherence or persistence benefit.

The passage describes the GHCB protocol for communication between SEV-ES or SEV-SNP guests and a hypervisor. For non-automatic exits, a guest supplies required state in the GHCB and invokes VMGEXIT; the hypervisor returns results or error information. Both sides mark valid fields in a bitmap and protect GHCB use from preemption and interrupts.

It also specifies SEV-SNP secrets-page and EFI page-sharing mechanisms and describes requests for page-state changes, firmware guest requests, AP creation, doorbell pages, timers, APIC IDs, trusted devices, Secure AVIC, and termination. AP boot procedures account for register state that cannot be changed after measurement and encryption. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported in the described specification.

For restricted injection, a shared #HV doorbell page carries pending interrupt and non-maskable event information. The host presents events through the page, while the guest atomically acknowledges them and signals completion through an EOI assist or a VMGEXIT.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2015, reports third-quarter net sales of $25.4 billion, up from $20.6 billion a year earlier, and net income of $79 million, versus a $437 million loss. For the first nine months, net sales were $71.3 billion and net income was $114 million. AWS third-quarter sales rose to $2.1 billion from $1.2 billion. Operating cash flow for the trailing twelve months was $9.8 billion, and free cash flow was $5.4 billion. The filing also discusses acquisitions, contractual commitments, and ongoing legal and tax disputes.

The speaker says Syria’s civil war has killed more than 100,000 people and displaced millions. He attributes an August 21 chemical attack that killed more than a thousand people to Assad’s government and argues that failing to respond would threaten international rules and U.S. security. He proposes a limited strike to deter further chemical attacks, without deploying American ground troops or seeking to remove Assad. He has asked Congress to postpone a vote on force while the United States pursues a Russian-backed proposal to place Syria’s chemical weapons under international control and destroy them. The military will remain prepared to respond if diplomacy fails.

On New Year’s Eve, suspects kicked in a Milwaukee woman’s front door but fled when her alarm sounded. Police told her they had received similar calls on her street that night. The damaged door had to be boarded up, and she plans to improve her home security.

The speaker praised U.S. military leaders and outlined plans to increase defense spending, modernize weapons, expand the Navy, raise service members’ pay and emphasize merit. He described efforts to negotiate peace in Gaza and Ukraine, urged NATO allies to spend more on defense, and said military strength helps prevent war. He also called for using the military to help secure the border and address crime in U.S. cities.

Several people reported that £3.99 Childs Farm Baby Moisturiser improved their psoriasis or their children’s eczema after other treatments had not helped. One woman said her psoriasis cleared within 24 hours; two mothers described improvements in their daughters’ eczema. A company dermatologist said regular moisturising can soothe eczema and help irritated skin heal.

Wednesday’s movers included declines in Biogen, GameStop, Citizens Financial, Synchronoss and Anadarko, while H&R Block, Southern and Brookdale rose. Falling bond yields weighed on banks but lifted high-dividend stocks; lower oil prices hurt energy companies.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2021, announcing a press release on its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 27, 2021. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri signed the report.

A study of electronic health records for more than 8 million adults compared the 2009 and 2021 equations for estimating kidney function. About 15.3% met the study’s criteria for chronic kidney disease under either equation. The 2021 equation, which removes the race adjustment, identified disease earlier for 24% of Black patients with CKD, compared with 0.7% of non-Black patients. Staging differed most in earlier disease stages and among Black patients. The assessed social factors were not significantly associated with a higher stage under the 2021 equation. The authors note that records may omit care received outside participating health systems.
Clinical trials show two oral GLP-1 drugs helped people with obesity lose weight.

University of Limerick legal experts say proposed communications-data legislation omits two Murray Report recommendations: High Court authorisation for access to journalists’ source data and an independent body to oversee service providers. They also question the effectiveness of retained retrospective reviews, while acknowledging that the bill would require more requests to receive prior judicial authorisation.

After decades of chronic back pain, five spinal fusion surgeries and difficulty with daily activities, 77-year-old Deanna Conley received a spinal cord stimulator implant recommended by Dr. Michael Bottros. Its electrodes stimulate nerves to block pain signals to the brain. Conley says she can now walk without a walker and enjoy activities again. Bottros says nearly all of his 40 to 50 implant patients in the past year have seen remarkable results, though longer-term outcomes remain to be studied.

Clinton County tied for 64th on Site Selection magazine’s 2017 Top 100 Micropolitans list. Ohio had the most communities on the list, with 16. The Clinton County Port Authority submitted four projects representing $70 million in new investment, 150 potential new jobs and 400 retained jobs.

The speaker says the season comes down to one game and doubts home-ice advantage will matter much. The team has bounced back before, but both sides have earned their place. Mental fatigue, emotions and frustration contributed to penalties, while the speaker expects an update on a player after the morning skate. Growing animosity between the teams is described as a normal part of a long series.

Rory McKelvie, 19, was found dead in his hometown of Biggar, Lanarkshire. His mother said he died in his sleep, and police are not treating the death as suspicious. In earlier social media posts, Rory said a doctor had dismissed his mental health concerns and that someone had stopped him from taking his own life. He urged others who were struggling to talk to friends and family.

Trump drew criticism for a tweet defending his writing abilities that contained spelling and word-choice errors. Tony Schwartz, ghostwriter of *The Art of the Deal*, responded by claiming Trump could neither read nor write a book; J.K. Rowling also mocked the tweet. Separately, Trump faced criticism for initially declining to lower flags after an Annapolis newsroom shooting, then ordered them lowered.

Edmonton police charged blogger Barry Kent Winters, 62, with wilfully promoting hatred after years of complaints and a 13-month investigation. His blogs used racist and other abusive language about numerous groups and public figures and included fantasies about violence. The charge is rare in Alberta, and Winters was required to take the blogs down as a condition of pre-trial release. The passage supports denouncing the blogs but questions whether prosecution could undermine free speech or give Winters a larger platform. Constitutional law professor Eric Adams says criminal sanctions on speech may be justified, but the bar for charges should be high.

Arsene Wenger wants to fit Arsenal’s attacking players into his line-up after signing Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and Henrikh Mkhitaryan and renewing Mesut Ozil’s contract, but says the team must improve defensively. He described keeping Ozil as cheaper than buying a replacement. Aubameyang’s fever could delay his debut against Everton, while Wenger said Alexandre Lacazette must compete for his place.

After Paula Larison was injured when a water meter lid slid off its well, she and her husband sued the Water District. The Missouri Court of Appeals held that a factual dispute remained over whether a district employee negligently replaced the lid, and reversed summary judgment on that claim. It affirmed summary judgment on claims that the district knew or should have known of the danger and that res ipsa loquitur applied.

A November 30, 2001 news roundup describes Enron nearing bankruptcy after Dynegy abandoned a takeover and Enron’s credit rating fell to junk status. Energy exchanges in Europe and Australia restricted Enron’s trading, while its European trading business entered administration and faced job losses. Reports describe disrupted power and gas markets, uncertain overseas assets, and potential losses for lenders, insurers and trading partners. The SEC was investigating Enron’s accounting, and a U.S. Senate panel planned a hearing. Dynegy said it would proceed with its disputed acquisition of Enron’s Northern Natural Gas pipeline.

The Strategic National Stockpile stores medicines and supplies for attacks, disease outbreaks, natural disasters and other public health emergencies. Created in 1999, it has been managed largely by the CDC, but a Trump administration plan would move oversight to another Health and Human Services office in October. Supporters say the change will streamline decisions and could improve funding. Public health officials and lawmakers worry it could disrupt distribution partnerships or politicize purchasing decisions. Congress has urged HHS to preserve a strong CDC role. The stockpile’s director says its emergency response will not change.

An Australian study examined spontaneous adverse-event reports and general-practice records for hearing loss, vertigo and tinnitus after COVID-19 vaccination. Compared with baseline periods, general-practice data showed more vertigo presentations within 42 days of mRNA vaccination and more tinnitus presentations after both mRNA and adenovirus-vector vaccination. Hearing loss presentations did not increase. The authors note that incomplete vaccination records and unknown COVID-19 infection histories limit interpretation, and the findings do not establish causality.

The lecture explains how spontaneous symmetry breaking gives gauge bosons mass without adding explicit mass terms. In a toy model, a complex scalar field’s nonzero vacuum expectation value produces a massive gauge boson and scalar field, while a Goldstone boson becomes the gauge boson’s longitudinal component. In the Standard Model, three Goldstone bosons are absorbed by the W and Z bosons; the photon remains massless, and a Higgs boson remains.

Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya sent Corporate Accounts papers instead of Corporate Law papers to BCom (Hons) third-semester exam centres on Monday, delaying the exam by about 30 minutes. The Corporate Accounts exam was scheduled for December 18. Although students reportedly received those papers, university officials denied a leak, saying the bundles were opened but not distributed. They said the paper set could be changed if a complaint was received. The university also said BCom (Hons) would remain under the annual examination system because the higher education department had not directed a return to semesters.

Gold held near $1,247 an ounce on Monday after its biggest weekly decline in more than six months, as investors awaited an expected U.S. Federal Reserve rate increase and guidance on future hikes. Hedge funds and money managers sharply cut net long positions in gold and silver, with silver’s reduction the largest on record. Silver, platinum and palladium prices also fell.

China’s education groups pair prestigious core schools with less advantaged schools to address disparities worsened by the movement of teachers and students toward resource-rich areas. Core schools share staff, training, curricula and management practices. The passage reports improvements in member schools’ educational quality, teachers’ professional development, students’ learning opportunities and access to sought-after schools.

Challenges include the loss of ordinary schools’ distinct identities, difficulty applying core schools’ methods to different circumstances, and financial and staffing pressures on core schools. The passage recommends more equal decision-making among member schools, teacher exchanges, shared online resources, and government funding and incentives. It concludes that sustaining cooperation while preserving each school’s characteristics requires further study.
The court denied John Whitfield’s application to vacate its 1992 decision, finding he had not established ineffective assistance of appellate counsel.

During October’s Fire Prevention Month, fire departments are teaching families to know two ways out of buildings and keep exits, including windows, accessible. Officials urge parents to discuss fire safety with children, practice a home fire drill, and make sure everyone goes outside when alarms sound and stays there.

Adidas and Refinery 29 created one pair of UltraBOOST X shoes for each state, with proceeds from their auctions benefiting Women Win. Female artists designed the shoes, including Lizzie Darden’s peach-themed pair for Georgia. At publication, the Georgia pair’s bid was $350, compared with $1,000 for Ohio’s buckeye-themed pair.

Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days includes sales on nearly all Kindle models. The article recommends the discounted Colorsoft for readers of comics and graphic novels, with its Signature edition adding wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light, and more storage. It praises the second-generation Scribe as both an e-reader and a digital notebook. The Paperwhite is its top general recommendation, while the base Kindle is its budget pick. For children, the Paperwhite Kids includes a cover and six months of Kids+ content; the Colorsoft Kids is not on sale.

The court affirmed Vu Ngo’s conviction on three counts of first-degree robbery. It declined to review his unpreserved claim of discrimination in jury selection. It also upheld the denial of his suppression request, finding the officer’s initial hospital inquiries and brief request that Ngo return were not unlawful detention, and that later information justified continued detention.

The passage describes how SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests negotiate the GHCB protocol, establish an encryption bit, and share a GHCB page with the hypervisor. It explains how guests handle #VC exceptions through VMGEXIT, including required state, validity bits, and error reporting.

It also specifies non-automatic exit requests for MMIO, page-state changes, SNP firmware requests, AP creation, timers, interrupts, and termination. Later sections cover AP boot and reset constraints, NMI handling, debug-register virtualization, and the lack of SMM and nested-virtualization support. For SEV-SNP Restricted Injection, the passage defines a shared #HV doorbell page and host–guest rules for presenting, acknowledging, and completing interrupts.

Britain’s FTSE 100 closed 0.4 percent higher on Wednesday after a choppy session following the formal triggering of Brexit. Sterling’s weakness supported the export-heavy index, while the more domestically focused mid-cap index rose 0.1 percent. 3i Group gained after an analyst upgrade, and London Stock Exchange shares rose despite regulators blocking its proposed merger with Deutsche Boerse. Copper gains supported miners, while gold miners fell as gold prices slipped.

NVIDIA reported that David M. Shannon, Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer and Secretary, plans to retire at the end of 2016. General Counsel Brian E. Cabrera will lead the legal team, while NVIDIA will recruit a human resources leader.

A delivery failure notice says Jeff Dasovich’s February 16, 2001 email could not reach one recipient because the address was rejected as an unknown user. The email circulated a confidential message prepared for Ken Lay’s office to deliver to Senator Brulte. It outlined Enron’s proposed responses to California’s electricity crisis: increasing supply, reducing demand, restoring retail competition, and returning utilities to solvency. It also described concerns about credit risks in Department of Water Resources power contracts and proposed amendments to AB1X or a Public Utilities Commission order to address them.

In a 3T MRI study of 467 people with four epilepsy subtypes and 473 healthy controls, all epilepsy groups had higher perivascular-space volume fractions in the basal ganglia, but not in overall white matter, after accounting for age and sex. Perivascular-space measures were not associated with illness duration. Because the study was cross-sectional, it cannot determine whether the enlargement precedes seizures or results from them.

Dr. Thomas Wilson Ikubese joined the Alliance for New Nigeria on May 29, 2018, and plans to seek its nomination for the 2019 presidential election. His YesWeFit movement said the decision followed the Nigerian Intervention Movement’s adoption of ANN. Ikubese had left the National Conscience Party two weeks earlier, citing over-taxation.

The passage presents a correct-by-construction voter unit for synchronous redundant measurements in avionics control systems. It uses current readings and fault history to identify faults, isolate persistently faulty input units, and select a measurement for the controller while limiting prime-unit switching and the age of retained outputs. The authors define fault assumptions and requirements for identification, isolation, and output reliability, and analyze the theoretical limits of fault identification. They implement and verify the parameterized design in Rocq, with code extractable to OCaml, Haskell, or Scheme. Future work includes redundancy management across hierarchical systems and fault handling for asynchronous units.

Doctors say eye cancer is often detected late in India, making treatment more complex and potentially leading to blindness or death. They call for greater awareness of symptoms and note a shortage of specialist facilities and doctors. Retinoblastoma, a childhood eye cancer, may cause a squint or white pupil; early detection can save sight and life.

AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine helps software move pages between memory tiers and requires an enabled IOMMU. PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO can migrate hypervisor-owned pages during DMA while updating IOMMU mappings; PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST migrates SNP guest pages but does not support concurrent DMA. Commands can move up to 128 pages and are submitted through a ring buffer, with command and per-page status reporting. The guide also specifies page-state and address requirements, driver operation, firmware reload procedures, and error handling.

The study examines how online informal education can support personalized learning in formal design education. Using a literature review and two synchronous computational-design programs, it finds that online workshops and courses offer practical skills, interdisciplinary discussion, collaboration, and flexible access to resources. Their limitations include restricted participation, unequal access to tools and suitable learning environments, reduced face-to-face interaction, and certificates that are not reflected in formal transcripts. The study argues that integrating such programs with higher education could strengthen design learning, while noting that its findings are based on theoretical assessment rather than measured learner outcomes.

The study developed an environmental education model based on multiple intelligences for expanded educational opportunity schools in Nakhon Pathom, Thailand. Surveys and interviews with students, teachers, and school directors identified agricultural chemicals, wastewater, air pollution, and litter as community concerns. Students’ environmental awareness and participation were lower than teachers’ overall environmental learning levels. The model exceeded its 80/80 efficiency criterion, achieving 81.51/82.11. In an evaluation involving 30 students, post-learning scores were significantly higher than pre-learning scores, and students reported high satisfaction. The authors recommend integrating practical, community-based environmental learning across school subjects.

A non-inverting comparator with hysteresis uses two resistors and a voltage reference. Its output switches high when VIN exceeds VIN1 and low when VIN falls below VIN2; hysteresis is the difference between these thresholds.
Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on January 26, 2015, announcing a press release on its financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2014. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

University of Surrey researchers say solar power has become cheaper than coal, gas and wind in sunny countries. Falling battery costs make solar-plus-storage more reliable, while new materials could increase output. Grid congestion remains a challenge, and researchers emphasize smart grids and sustained policy support.

A seven-judge Supreme Court bench held that repeatedly promulgating ordinances subverts the legislative process and is a fraud on the Constitution. It ruled that the President’s and Governors’ decisions to issue ordinances are subject to judicial review. The majority said ordinances must be placed before the legislature, though two judges differed on that question. The case arose from successive Bihar ordinances appointing schoolteachers who were not regularised after the ordinances lapsed. The court said whether rights and obligations survive a lapsed ordinance depends on its construction, and salaries already paid to the teachers should not be recovered.

The strategy sells the S&P 500 after a 20% decline from its all-time high and buys after 18 consecutive closes above its 200-day moving average. A backtest from 1927 generated 12 signals and reported average gains of 9.54% after six months and 21.84% after one year. It outperformed the golden cross strategy on absolute, but not risk-adjusted, returns. The backtest did not use data adjusted for dividends or splits.

The passage contains denunciations of foreign religious teachings as threats to ancestral practices and good government. An anonymous 1893 notice accuses religious leaders of hypocrisy, exploitation, and neglect of parents, orders them to leave, and threatens an attack. In a separate dispatch, Mr. Heard reports that Confucians in Seoul petitioned the king to suppress the Tong Hâk, but did not denounce Western religion. The king said the government would handle the matter and urged the petitioners to study their own principles.

St. George welcomed 11 visitors from its sister city of Ibigawa, Japan, for a five-day visit surrounding the 2017 St. George Marathon. Four delegates will run the race, while the group has attended city events and an international luncheon. St. George plans to send officials and runners to the Ibigawa Marathon in November.

Ola and Uber drivers in Delhi-NCR have threatened a one-day strike on Tuesday over fares and commissions. Their association wants fares raised from Rs 6 to around Rs 20 per km and the 25% company commission abolished. The Delhi High Court barred two unions from disrupting cab services. Two other transport unions said they would not join the strike.

Rain Bird’s waterproof, battery-operated WPX irrigation controller is designed for sites where mains power is impractical. It supports one to six zones and runs for about one year on one 9V battery or up to two years on two.
After a line change, Matt got the puck to Teemu, who set up the speaker for an open-net goal. The team stayed disciplined in the third and finished the game.

A study of nearly 11,500 species across 270 million years found that birds and mammals adapted to changing temperatures two to three times faster than reptiles and amphibians. Their ability to regulate body temperature may have helped them occupy colder regions. Researchers caution that past adaptation may not predict survival amid today’s rapid climate change, especially as animals also face pollution, hunting, habitat loss and invasive species.

Kuwait expects to finish cleaning up an oil spill in its southern Gulf waters this week, its oil minister said. No new oil patches have been found. The spill’s cause and size remain unspecified. Khafji Joint Operations said its facilities were unaffected and planned an aerial survey.

The passage describes an augmented-reality system for image-guided surgery that displays a virtual tool and patient anatomy on a healthcare professional’s head-mounted display. A tracking device monitors markers on the patient and tool to align the image with the patient’s body. A single camera can determine the display’s position and orientation without triangulation. If its view of a marker or tool is blocked, the system can use data from another head-mounted or stationary tracking device. Some embodiments combine tracking data from multiple devices or use an inertial-measurement unit to maintain the display when a marker is obscured.

The passage specifies guest–hypervisor procedures for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP. SNP Run VMPL changes a vCPU’s VMPL using a VMSA associated with the requested level; the hypervisor must return an error if none exists. SEV-TIO lets guests use trusted devices and defines requests, shared data pages, and the return of measurements, certificates, and attestation reports. Secure AVIC lets guests register or unregister private APIC backing pages.

It also describes termination and unsupported-event requests, SEV-ES identification, and AP boot procedures. SNP AP Creation lets a guest supply VMSA pages to create or update AP state and supports vCPU hotplug. NMI handling uses an “NMI Complete” message; debug-register handling depends on hardware virtualization support. SMM and nested virtualization are unsupported.

For restricted-injection guests, a shared #HV doorbell page conveys pending interrupts and non-maskable events. The passage defines its configuration, host and guest interrupt-acknowledgement behavior, EOI assistance, and handling of interrupts around HLT.

After a year of focusing on strong profits and economic growth while discounting risks, investors grew wary. Stocks fell more than 2 percent on Friday after a jobs report suggested rising wages could bring higher inflation. Investors also fear that central banks may withdraw the cheap money that has supported the long-running stock boom. Treasury yields have risen as stocks have fallen.

The passage argues that market declines are routine and that selling in panic during a correction can mean missing a rebound. It says fewer than one in five corrections become bear markets, while the average correction has lasted 54 days. Bear markets have lasted about a year on average. Despite regular declines, the S&P 500 finished with a positive return in 27 of the 36 years from 1980 through 2015. The author urges investors to understand market history, remain patient, and take responsibility for their decisions.
Police arrested two Mill Park teens after a car with stolen numberplates sped through roadworks and was pursued. A third person remains on the run.

The TPS7H500x-SP series comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. Depending on the device, they provide one or two primary switching outputs and optional synchronous-rectifier outputs; external gate drivers are recommended. The controllers offer device-dependent duty-cycle limits, dead-time and leading-edge-blanking settings, pulse skipping, slope compensation, and frequency compensation. Protection functions include cycle-by-cycle current limiting with hiccup restart, an external FAULT input, and thermal shutdown.

The passage presents a 500-kHz synchronous push-pull converter design using the TPS7H5001-SP, including component selections for its transformer, GaN switches, output filter, current sensing, and compensation. It also recommends a regulated, bypassed 4–14-V controller supply and PCB layout practices that separate noisy switching paths from sensitive signals.

The passage advocates moderate reform through government supervision of business, rather than government ownership or a blanket ban on combinations of capital and labor. It argues that combinations should be controlled to prevent public harm and that published railroad agreements approved by the Interstate Commerce Commission should be permitted. It urges Congress to reconsider laws that, according to the Commission, railroads cannot fully obey while operating effectively. On taxation, it distinguishes taxes best levied locally or by states from those better imposed nationally. It proposes graduated inheritance and, if possible, income taxes, while stressing that any new system should distribute burdens more equitably and treat rich and poor with equal justice.

Penn State will stop its Outing Club and two other student-led outdoor clubs from organizing trips next semester after a risk assessment cited remote locations, poor cell service and distance from emergency services. Student leaders said they were not consulted and questioned the decision. The university says student safety is its priority and will continue to offer staff-operated outdoor trips.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2018 reports net sales of $61.1 billion, up 16% from a year earlier, and net income of $13.8 billion, up from $11.0 billion. Higher iPhone, Services and Other Products sales drove the increase; sales rose in every geographic segment. For the first six months of fiscal 2018, net sales were $149.4 billion and net income was $33.9 billion.

At March 31, Apple held $45.1 billion in cash and cash equivalents and reported total assets of $367.5 billion. It repurchased $23.5 billion of stock and paid $3.2 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the quarter. The filing also discusses the effects of U.S. tax-law changes, supply-chain risks and ongoing litigation.

The May 18 news compilation reports that Saudi Arabia selected eight foreign companies for three natural-gas projects requiring about $25 billion in investment. Exxon Mobil will lead the Red Sea project, with Enron and Occidental participating; leaders for the South Ghawar and Shaybah projects had not been announced. Another article argues that falling western U.S. power prices have reduced the value of California’s long-term electricity contracts. An options-market report describes investors selling options amid expectations of a flat stock market and notes bullish trading in Enron options.

Sam Bankman-Fried founded crypto trading firm Alameda Research and later the FTX exchange, which was valued at $32 billion in early 2022. According to an SEC complaint described in the passage, FTX secretly diverted customer funds to Alameda, gave it special trading privileges, and relied on collateral that included large holdings of FTX’s own token, FTT. After Alameda’s balance sheet was leaked in November 2022, FTT’s price plunged, customers rushed to withdraw funds, and FTX filed for bankruptcy on November 11.

The bankruptcy chief reported a severe lack of corporate controls and trustworthy financial information. Bankman-Fried was charged with fraud and other offenses and pleaded not guilty. Alameda CEO Caroline Ellison, FTX co-founder Gary Wang, and engineering executive Nishad Singh pleaded guilty to criminal charges. The collapse also raised questions about oversight by investors, auditors, and regulators.

Android 8.0 Oreo’s Picture-in-Picture mode lets supported apps display video or navigation in a movable floating window while other apps are open. App developers must enable support, and using it in the YouTube app requires YouTube Red. To watch a YouTube video in Picture-in-Picture through Chrome, open YouTube in desktop mode, play a video full-screen, then tap Home. The window can be moved, paused, expanded or dismissed. If the mode does not work in a supported app, check its Picture-in-Picture permission in Settings.
Annual Fund gifts support the rule of law, independent courts, fair representation, efforts to eliminate bias, and access to justice.

The Seventh Circuit affirmed summary judgment against former Orland Park police officer Joseph McGreal. He alleged that he was fired in retaliation for speaking at a village board meeting and that the defendants intentionally inflicted emotional distress. The court found no admissible evidence that the defendants knew of his speech, that their stated reasons for firing him were pretextual, or that their conduct caused severe emotional distress.

The court held that Latham’s 1839 instrument conveyed Henderson an unconditional, undivided half interest in the land, rather than creating an executory contract or a forfeitable estate. Because the claim rested on an executed deed, the defense of stale demand did not apply. The defendants’ three-, five-, and ten-year limitations defenses also failed for lack of qualifying title or possession, evidence of tax payments, or sufficient time and privity. The court reversed the judgment for the defendants and remanded the case to determine the owners’ rights for partition.

Investors face five themes next week: the Bank of England’s rate decision and updated inflation and growth outlook; Australian and New Zealand policy meetings alongside Chinese economic data; a projected widening of the U.S. trade deficit and a possible government shutdown; diverging U.S. and European earnings expectations as major European firms report results; and emerging-market rate decisions. The Bank of England is expected to leave rates unchanged, while Mexico may raise rates and Russia may cut them.

The speaker reports that Britain rejected a proposal to reopen trade if it rescinded its orders against U.S. commerce, while France had not answered a related approach. The embargo therefore remains in force. Congress must decide how to respond to continued violations of neutral rights. Britain has also taken no steps to redress the attack on the Chesapeake.

Relations with other European powers are largely unchanged; negotiations with Spain have paused. Peace continues with the Barbary powers, apart from a dispute with Algiers, and with Indian neighbors. Harbor defenses, gunboats, recruitment, militia readiness, and domestic arms production are discussed, alongside the growth of manufactures during the suspension of foreign commerce.

The speaker reports substantial debt payments and asks Congress to consider future uses for surplus revenue, including public improvements. In a final address to the legislature, he thanks Congress and the public for their support and expresses confidence in the republic’s future.

Kyle Freeland pitched 5 1/3 innings and doubled as the Colorado Rockies beat the San Francisco Giants 11-4 on Tuesday. Every Rockies starter had a hit, and David Dahl added a pinch-hit two-run homer. Evan Longoria homered twice for San Francisco. Giants starter Jeff Samardzija left after one inning with shoulder tightness; rookie Dereck Rodriguez, making his major league debut, later exited after a line drive struck his shin. Three Giants errors helped Colorado score three unearned runs in the fourth.

HoopTactics presents baseline and sideline out-of-bounds plays with multiple shot options that flow into a predetermined continuity if no high-percentage shot is available. For late-game full-court situations, it emphasizes practicing inbounds plays, anticipating defensive pressure and putting the best inbounder and shooters on the court. When time permits, advancing the ball before calling a timeout is preferred. A baseline play can also help get the ball inbounds safely.

After six years on a kidney transplant list, Sam Senseney has found a matching donor: his 18-year-old granddaughter, Maddie Sabourin. Doctors initially considered her too young to donate, but she persuaded them to allow it. The family will meet with doctors next week to set a surgery date, which they hope will be within a month.

The passage describes 5G network architecture and proposes selecting an access and mobility management function (AMF) according to a requested network slice’s isolation level. It distinguishes fully isolated slices from partly isolated slices that share the radio access network, or both the radio access network and AMF. During registration, a device may provide slice selection and isolation information. The radio access network can then obtain an AMF selection from a network repository function, network slice selection function, or unified data management, depending on the example procedure.

James Webb Space Telescope observations of the starless planet SIMP-0136 revealed strong auroras that heat its upper atmosphere. Brightness changes as the planet rotated allowed researchers to measure temperature and chemical variations suggestive of storms. Despite temperatures above 1,500 °C, its sand-like silicate cloud cover remained constant.

Ukraine and Bitfury have agreed to put the government’s electronic data on a blockchain platform. A pilot, expected to launch late this year, will explore uses in state registers, public services, social security, public health and energy. The project is intended to improve transparency and accountability.

E. F. Joy, assignee of a creditor, sought to set aside Louis Helbing’s 1893 gift deed to his wife. Helbing later obtained credit while the deed remained unrecorded and he appeared to own the property. The court held that the relevant question was whether Helbing intended to defraud creditors when he made the gift, not whether his wife knew of any fraud. Delayed recording raised suspicion but did not establish fraudulent intent. The exclusion of evidence about goods found years later did not warrant reversal. The judgment for the Helbings and the order denying a new trial were affirmed.

The passage tests buying SPY and shorting TLT after unusually large, opposite-day moves. A backtest from 2003 to June 2021 found erratic results, with a 1.93% annualized return. Changing the holding period or movement threshold did not meaningfully improve performance, so the article concludes the strategy is not tradeable.

Tropical Storm Nate was expected to strengthen into a hurricane before reaching the U.S. Gulf Coast early Sunday. The storm had killed at least 22 people in Nicaragua and Costa Rica. Louisiana declared a state of emergency, mobilized National Guard troops and ordered evacuations in some coastal areas. Officials also prepared New Orleans’ vulnerable pumping system. Nate is the Atlantic season’s 15th tropical cyclone; September set a record for accumulated cyclone energy.

A retrospective study of 390 patients admitted to a Dublin complex discharge unit from March 2020 to February 2021 found that 237 (60.7%) stayed more than 15 days. Reported reasons for delays included complications of primary diagnoses or multimorbidity, rehabilitation needs, community service issues, patient-centred needs and hospital-acquired infections. Stratified analysis identified complications and patient-centred needs as significant factors. The single-centre study did not examine mortality or readmission in detail.

Bank of England research suggests an interest-paying central bank digital currency could make monetary policy more effective by prompting commercial banks to adjust rates faster. It could also let the Bank buy assets directly from non-banks during quantitative easing. The Bank says it has no current plans to issue one.

The Warren Buffett 90/10 ETF portfolio allocates 90% to low-cost S&P 500 index ETFs and 10% to government bonds, aiming for long-term growth with lower fees and some protection against volatility. In the passage’s backtests, portfolios using SPY with SHY or IEI slightly underperformed SPY alone; the SPY–TLT portfolio performed best of the three and nearly matched SPY. The passage notes that investing carries risk, past performance does not predict future results, and ETF gains and dividends may be taxable.

Consular reports estimate that 600–800 Americans in Cuba lack food, medicine and means of support, particularly in rural areas where people have been displaced from farms. The President asks Congress for at least $50,000 for relief and transportation home for those unable to pay.
OpenAI is preparing a Sora 2 video app with a TikTok-like feed of AI-generated videos, recommendations, likes, comments, and remixes.

The editor acknowledges assistance with archival access, document selection, declassification, and editing. The volume draws on published speeches and policy statements, Reagan Presidential Library collections, White House records, George Shultz’s papers, and Department of State files. These sources document Reagan’s speeches, the 1980 transition, foreign policy planning, diplomatic communications, and discussions among senior officials.

Walmart plans to make drone delivery available in most areas where it operates, moving beyond small-scale tests, though it has not set a timeline. The retailer is expanding its partnership with Alphabet’s Wing to 100 stores in five cities and plans to add locations in Northwest Arkansas. Walmart says it has completed more than 300,000 drone deliveries. Widespread service remains years away because of technical, regulatory, financial and infrastructure challenges.

Richard Milan sued prison officials under § 1983 after they denied him a visit without the written notice required by prison procedures. The court held that the notice requirement did not establish a protected liberty interest or a substantive constitutional violation. It granted summary judgment to the defendants and denied Milan’s motion.

The Golden Cross strategy buys when the 50-day moving average crosses above the 200-day average and sells when it crosses below. A backtest on the S&P 500 since 1960 recorded 33 trades, with 79% winners, an average trade gain of 15.8%, and a 6.8% annual return. That was below buy-and-hold’s 7.2%, but the strategy was invested only 70% of the time and had a lower maximum drawdown: 33% versus 56%. The backtest excluded reinvested dividends.

The passage proposes an e-learning governance framework covering organisational structures, processes, stakeholder communication, and pedagogies and instructional design. It argues that effective governance must consider regulatory, technological, organisational and social conditions together. Information security, risk management and trust are particularly important in e-learning ecosystems. The authors call for further research into the business benefits of improved governance.

In *People v Schaub*, the defendant transferred his ten-month-old daughter to undercover officers in exchange for money. The Michigan Court of Appeals found sufficient evidence that he intended to wholly abandon her, but not that he exposed her to a hazard of personal injury, because he handed her to someone who would care for her. It reversed the reinstatement of the child-abandonment charge and remanded the case. A dissenting judge argued that giving an infant to an uninvestigated stranger presented a risk for a jury to assess.

The study set out to estimate the direct burden of COVID-19 in the Republic of Ireland from March 1, 2020, to February 28, 2021, using disability-adjusted life years (DALYs). It used publicly available mortality and morbidity data to calculate years of life lost and years lived with disability across five health states, including post-acute consequences. Estimates relied on assumptions about unrecorded cases, symptom duration and disability weights.

A cross-sectional study of 424 adults receiving HIV treatment in the Kibungo Referral Hospital catchment area in Rwanda found that 13% reported not adhering to antiretroviral therapy. Non-adherence was associated with being under 31, lacking tertiary education, experiencing stigma, perceiving treatment as ineffective, and not incorporating medication into daily routines. Setting an alarm was not significantly associated with adherence. The study’s cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit its findings.

AI interpretability aims to make model decisions more transparent, improve resource use, and help identify safety risks. Key challenges include the lack of standardized evaluation, the computational cost of current methods, and adapting techniques to real-world settings. The passage proposes controlling language-model behavior with concept activation vectors trained from model activations. Applied during inference, these vectors can enhance or suppress concepts, while an optimization step manages conflicts when adjusting multiple concepts.

New York police are reviewing an incident captured on video in which officers used a stun gun on Dailene Rosario, a pregnant 17-year-old, during an arrest in a Bronx apartment building. Rosario faces charges including resisting arrest, harassment and disorderly conduct.

The passage describes a storage appliance that caches snapshots before storing them in the cloud. It organizes snapshot metadata in key-value stores to support snapshot and file restoration, as well as deletion of unneeded snapshots. In a forever-incremental backup system, ordinary cache eviction may remove unchanged data still needed by recent snapshots, delaying restoration. To reduce this risk, the appliance creates synthetic baseline snapshots and refreshes eviction information for valid cached data. Two approaches are described: copying valid metadata into a recent snapshot, or maintaining a synthetic baseline by moving superseded data into earlier snapshots.

This section provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106. Dimensions are in millimeters, and drawings and specifications may change without notice. Package thermal pads must be soldered to the circuit board; vias are optional.
