The passage also includes notes on solder-paste design, ordering terminology, and TI’s warranty and liability disclaimers.

Rebecca Shumye sued Samuel Felleke to enforce financial support obligations under an immigration affidavit he signed before their marriage. The court held that support must be assessed separately for each year. It granted Felleke summary judgment for 2000, 2001, 2002, 2004, and 2005 because Shumye conceded her income met the applicable threshold. It denied his motion for 2003, 2006, and 2007 because his evidence did not establish that her income met the threshold. The court counted student grants and documented housing subsidies as income, but excluded student loans, the divorce property settlement, and unexplained bank deposits. It denied Shumye’s summary judgment motion because she had not established a breach through undisputed evidence.

The coach says early team struggles unfairly put pressure on goaltender Martin. After Ray Emery returned and the team began winning, Emery kept the starting role. Facing Anaheim, the coach expects a strong opponent, an emotional crowd and a difficult start. He credits his team’s leadership, composure and skating, while stressing that depth, goaltending and adjustments will matter throughout the series. He praises Mike Comrie’s growth into a reliable two-way player and Anton’s emergence as a leading defenseman and shot blocker. He also says leaving his former organization was difficult, though he is proud of its players’ development.

Amazon reported second-quarter 2016 net sales of $30.4 billion, up from $23.2 billion a year earlier, and net income of $857 million, up from $92 million. Operating income rose to $1.3 billion. North America and AWS reported operating income of $702 million and $718 million, respectively, while International reported a $135 million operating loss.

For the first six months of 2016, net sales were $59.5 billion and net income was $1.37 billion. Operating cash flow for the 12 months ended June 30 was $12.7 billion. At June 30, Amazon held $12.5 billion in cash and cash equivalents and reported $8.2 billion in long-term debt. The filing also describes contractual commitments, tax disputes and patent litigation.

The passage describes Molina Healthcare as a government-sponsored insurer focused on Medicaid and dual-eligible members. It argues that contract wins, retention and a low valuation make the stock attractive, while noting risks from policy changes, acquisitions, medical costs and cash flow volatility. The author discloses a long position in Molina.

Asian shares were little changed Tuesday after three sessions of gains, as investors awaited a likely U.S. interest-rate hike and the European Central Bank’s meeting. Stronger-than-expected Chinese credit raised hopes for upcoming retail sales and industrial output figures. Wall Street had risen, led by technology and energy stocks. Despite a widening U.S.–German yield gap, the euro remained up against the dollar this year. Oil prices climbed after a temporary shutdown of a major North Sea pipeline.

In a Notre Dame commencement address, the speaker praises Father Hesburgh and religious leaders honored for defending human rights. He calls for an open, democratic American foreign policy grounded in human freedom and national confidence rather than fear or improper tactics. He outlines five priorities: promoting human rights, strengthening cooperation among democracies, negotiating arms reductions with the Soviet Union, pursuing peace in the Middle East, and limiting nuclear proliferation and conventional arms sales. He also urges cooperation with developing countries, more effective aid, normalized relations with China, and a peaceful transition to majority rule in southern Africa.

The passage studies how delayed reward feedback affects learning in games. In an unconstrained Matching Pennies example, any delay causes optimistic Follow the Regularized Leader (OFTRL) to incur at least Ω(√T) regret and diverge from equilibrium. The proposed weighted OFTRL increases the weight of its reward prediction to counteract the delay. When that weight exceeds the delay by one step, the paper proves O(1) regret and, under stated conditions, convergence of a subsequence of strategies to a Nash equilibrium in poly-matrix zero-sum games. Experiments support these results, though large delays can worsen performance at a finite learning rate.

A study of more than 5,000 US women found that, by age 3, children of obese mothers were nearly 70% more likely to fail fine-motor tests, while children of obese fathers were 75% more likely to fail social-competence measures. Children of extremely obese couples were nearly three times more likely to fail problem-solving tests. The cause remains unknown.

The September 28, 2000 VentureWire reports private-company funding, acquisitions, leadership changes and venture-capital news. Warburg Pincus closed a $2.5 billion international private equity fund, Primus raised $200 million, Goldman Sachs launched a $250 million investment venture, and Hyperchip raised $67 million in a round that included Enron Broadband Services. Gear.com’s president resigned amid layoffs, Sally Ride left Space.com, and Asia Online withdrew its IPO, citing market conditions.

With only two aging wolves left on Isle Royale, scientists estimate the moose population has reached 1,600 and could double within four years. They warn that growing numbers of moose are overbrowsing balsam fir trees and could eventually face starvation. The National Park Service is considering relocating 20 to 30 wolves to the island and expects to decide this fall.

This excerpt provides documentation and support information for MSPM0G devices, including how to subscribe to updates and use TI E2E forums. It cautions that ESD can damage integrated circuits. The April 2025 revision history lists corrections to device features, operating conditions, electrical specifications, and peripheral descriptions. It also includes mechanical and packaging guidance, orderable-part notes, automotive-qualified variants, and disclaimers stating that TI resources are provided “AS IS” and may change without notice.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture increases FP32 processing capacity and adds second-generation RT Cores and third-generation Tensor Cores. The RT Cores improve ray-triangle testing and accelerate ray-traced motion blur; the Tensor Cores support additional precision modes and structured sparsity for AI workloads. Other features include higher-bandwidth GDDR6X memory, PCIe 4.0, third-generation NVLink, and RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression.

The passage describes these technologies across GeForce RTX 30-series, RTX A6000, and A40 GPUs, including applications in gaming, rendering, AI, and data-center work. It also covers support for high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding, video encoding, and GDDR6X memory error detection and replay.

Drew Doughty says he struggled under the pressure of his contract and missing camp, but regained his confidence as the season progressed. He credits the Kings’ playoff success to settled lines and defensive pairings, strong goaltending and teammates playing for one another. Despite losing only two playoff games, he says their path through the Western Conference was difficult. He expects a hard-fought series against New Jersey, which he says has also found its form. Doughty looks forward to the first game and says the Kings’ run has brought them more attention in Los Angeles and drawn new fans to hockey.

The Eagle Creek fire has burned more than 48,000 acres of the Columbia River Gorge, leaving Oneonta Gorge among the most severely affected areas. Geologists warn that burned ground cover and coming winter rains increase the risk of falling rocks, trees and debris, particularly near Oneonta Gorge and Multnomah Falls Lodge. Crews plan protective fencing and tree removal. Oneonta trails remain closed, potentially until September 2018.

The coach said the team won despite generating fewer shots and defending more often than it wanted. He credited its opportunistic scoring and ability to win through possession, counterattacks or special teams, while saying it must skate, execute and control territory more consistently. Coaches reviewed film with the players and will make adjustments for the next game. He praised Kuny’s versatility, Nick’s defensive and special-teams contributions, and Tanger’s input to coaches and teammates while out of the lineup. He said the players remain motivated in the Stanley Cup Finals and must focus on the next game.

Students in the Honor Choir at NRH International Leadership of Texas write their own songs. Their music has been used by teachers in other states, and the choir has been invited to perform at June’s International Children’s Choir Festival in New York.

Peter Blackmore’s August report describes strong sales momentum across Compaq’s regions despite supply challenges. It highlights new Latin American Internet alliances, an 88% year-over-year profit increase in Canada, and a contract worth more than $200 million to build a supercomputer for the U.S. National Nuclear Security Administration. The report also lists customer contracts worldwide, improved market-share rankings, strong storage results, and the Commercial Personal Computing Group’s return to profitability in the second quarter.

The coach says Mike is playing hard and creating chances despite not producing more points. He praises the defense and an unchanged, well-executed penalty kill. He says both teams are playing fast, physical hockey with confidence, leaving little space for scoring chances. He takes responsibility for Ville’s earlier absence from the lineup and credits Ville for staying ready and making the most of his opportunity. With the season’s end in sight, he says the players are focused and does not see fatigue as a factor for either team.

The passage explains how to transfer photos and music to the Sansa c200, manage files, and safely disconnect the player. It covers music and photo playback, FM radio, recording, settings, supported formats, and troubleshooting. It also provides technical support information, warranty and software-license terms, digital rights management notices, and disposal instructions.

Microsoft Research Asia’s Societal AI white paper proposes an interdisciplinary agenda for integrating AI into society harmoniously, synergistically, and resiliently. Its ten research questions address value alignment, fairness, safety, human-AI collaboration, evaluation, interpretability, effects on cognition and work, social science research, and governance. The paper describes research on value evaluation, cross-cultural understanding, jailbreak defenses, dynamic benchmarking, and interpretable control. It also examines risks including bias, misinformation, privacy breaches, over-reliance, and labor disruption. The authors call for collaboration among researchers, industry, policymakers, and users to develop adaptable safeguards and regulation.

Benjamin Graham’s definition of investing requires selecting securities that protect capital and offer an adequate return; purchases that do not meet that standard are speculation. The author says a profitable Ask Jeeves trade was speculative because it ignored downside risk. The passage recommends buying financially sound companies at substantial discounts to intrinsic value, creating a margin of safety against business deterioration or valuation errors. It argues that unpopular companies, including net net stocks, may offer such discounts and rise in price if negative sentiment or temporary problems ease.

Location services on phones, computers and watches can aid navigation but raise privacy concerns. Experimac owner Kurt Peterson recommends turning off location services in device settings, either entirely or for specific apps, and being selective about app followers and shared information. He says opening the App Store turns location services back on, and turning devices off is the only way to go completely off the grid.

The Stack zone offense uses an overload alignment, spacing, movement and defined player roles to create matchup problems and offensive rebounding opportunities. Its continuity begins with the point guard attacking a defender and seeking shots or passes to the wing, baseline or posts. Pass-and-cut actions, post rolls and ball reversals shift the overload when defenders adjust. Flop, exchange, triple-stack and dribble entries offer other ways to initiate the offense. Late-clock specials include “Vegas,” “Back” and “Cat,” a 2-1-2 alignment used against traps or double teams.

The speaker says the playoff games have been close, with strong defense and goaltending making the first goal important. Despite two overtime losses, they believe their team played well and had chances to win. They plan to stay positive, use home ice to their advantage, and focus on winning the next game.

The passage lists 1945 documents and publication references concerning trade agreements, export controls, international economic relations, foreign oil policy, war relief, displaced persons and refugees. It also cites reports on Axis war crimes and countries’ wartime status, followed by a list of papers for the United Nations Conference on International Organization.

Offensive free-kick set pieces should follow the rules and account for the kick’s distance and angle to goal. A direct kick can score without another player touching the ball; an indirect kick cannot. Coaches design plays around the location, type of kick, defensive wall and players’ skills, using options such as shots, crosses, passes and misdirection. Players must know their roles, wait until the referee is ready and prepare for rebounds. Quick free kicks can exploit a defense before it sets a wall. Practice should progress from unopposed plays to live defenders and scrimmages while preserving player creativity.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week and closed Friday at its lowest level since early July, though futures pointed to a rebound on Monday. The passage describes the decline as a possible consolidation while warning that a deeper correction remains possible. Oil also fell amid tariff uncertainty, weaker demand indicators and an OPEC+ agreement to increase September output. Upcoming earnings and economic risks remain in focus.

This document describes the AGESA software interface for host-environment wrapper implementers. It defines call interfaces, build options, binary-module integration, execution requirements, error reporting, and boot-time initialization procedures. The host supplies required platform parameters and may change defaults set by initializer functions. AGESA can be built as a separate binary module or integrated from source; platform build options are specified in a platform options file. Binary-module calls use a host bridge and dispatcher, while call-outs to the host use a router. The document also covers UEFI integration, stack and Cache-As-RAM requirements, and procedures for processor and memory initialization.

Walter Lippmann urged a technical study of armament reduction for the peace conference, arguing that postwar economies could not sustain existing costs and that hidden military preparations would be difficult to detect. Secretary of War Newton D. Baker agreed and proposed asking General Bliss to lead the study, with General Crowder’s help. Lippmann welcomed the plan. In separate correspondence, Secretary of State Robert Lansing sought to coordinate his department’s work with S. E. Mezes, who circulated an outline of urgent subjects for The Inquiry.

After the Las Vegas shooting, WUWF examined Pensacola-area preparedness for mass casualty incidents. The area’s largest recent incident was a 2014 Escambia County jail explosion that killed two people and sent 184 victims to five hospitals. Escambia County Public Safety Director Mike Weaver said responders coordinate patient triage and hospital capacity through dispatch, while hospitals prepare for a surge. Officials debriefed after the jail explosion and conduct regular disaster and active-shooter training. Weaver said the community could respond to another mass casualty incident, though it would be overwhelming and patient care would take time.

Ronald Reagan criticizes President Carter’s response to the American hostages in Iran and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, arguing that it signals weakness and increases the risk of confrontation. He calls for a clear, consistent strategy to preserve peace and freedom, rebuild military strength, strengthen nuclear deterrence, maintain naval superiority, and protect U.S. interests and allies, including in the Persian Gulf.

The court affirmed a decree requiring specific performance of a land sale to Thompson’s assignee. Thompson had agreed to buy through the owner’s agent and later received a title bond before the owner deeded the land to Hunter, who knew of the bond. The court held that Thompson had the prior equity. It also held that Thompson need not deposit the purchase money in court and owed no interest after tender unless the vendor proved he used the money.

Cars.com’s 2018 American-Made Index ranks the Jeep Cherokee first, followed by the Honda Odyssey and Ridgeline. The index considers U.S. assembly, parts, engines, transmissions and factory jobs. Honda and Acura account for four of the top 10 vehicles, illustrating the difficulty of defining “American-made” as tariffs loom.

Florida transportation officials presented two plans to connect the Sawgrass Expressway and I-95 through Deerfield Beach while preserving local access to Southwest 10th Street. The project aims to ease rush-hour congestion but would not begin for at least three years. Residents and the mayor raised concerns about construction, property values and neighborhood impacts.

NOIPolls reports that Nigerian doctors are migrating, mainly to the UK and US, worsening the country’s doctor-to-patient ratio to 1:5,000. About 35,000 of Nigeria’s 72,000 registered doctors practice there. Cited reasons include salary deductions, low job satisfaction, poor pay and opportunities to gain knowledge abroad.

In this non-peer-reviewed study, researchers compared a targeted metagenomic sequencing workflow with a PCR panel using 29 nasopharyngeal samples from people with suspected acute upper respiratory infections. The methods showed high agreement for shared targets, but sequencing detected 44 microorganisms versus 15 by PCR, including SARS-CoV-2, coxsackievirus A and human rhinovirus C. Sequencing identified co-infections in 26 samples. The authors suggest the approach could supplement respiratory diagnostics, while noting that further research is needed to establish the clinical relevance of its findings.

A qualitative case study examined peer mentoring in a 14-week movement education course for physical education teacher candidates in Türkiye. Three peer mentors supported 25 first-year students through group tasks, storytelling, and teaching activities. Mentors completed their responsibilities despite disagreements, while learners sometimes excluded group members who did not contribute. Participants reported that creating and teaching story-based lessons developed their teaching awareness and helped them connect movement skills to daily life. The study recommends extending peer mentoring and storytelling across teacher education programs.

Buffalo initially assessed benefited property owners $1,058.63 to build a sewer and contracted with Randolph for that amount. Unforeseen quicksand made completion at the contract price impossible. To secure completion, the common council agreed to pay Randolph another $588.13 and ordered a second assessment. Property owners challenged it. The court held that the city could increase the contract price under these circumstances and that its charter authorized a further assessment when the first proved insufficient. The order granting a new trial was affirmed, with judgment against the property owners.

The Korean diet emphasizes vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins and fermented foods while limiting processed foods, sugary drinks and unhealthy fats. Its smaller portions and nutrient-rich ingredients may support weight management and gut health. Potential drawbacks include high sodium from condiments and fermented foods, low calcium from limited dairy, and carbohydrate-heavy dishes. Spicy ingredients may also trouble people with digestive issues. The experts recommend adjusting portions and sodium intake to suit individual needs.

The paper proposes an architecture for exchanging structured technical information among industrial enterprises, focusing on plant equipment throughout its lifecycle. An open consortium would agree on business practices and information formats, while a network of mediators would route information; each enterprise would connect through an adapter for its existing systems. Prototype experiments delivered equipment information from suppliers to plant operators for maintenance and renewal projects, reducing manual mapping and conversion. The prototype lacks common APIs, an open consortium and a mediator network. Future work includes forming the consortium, expanding the prototype and covering more information types and industries.

After Week 6 of the 2025 college football season, Penn State and preseason No. 1 Texas dropped out of the Top 25. The reshuffled power rankings examine each team’s offense: Ohio State and Oklahoma need stronger rushing attacks, Miami has struggled to sustain leads, and Oregon’s freshman running backs have bolstered its attack. Texas Tech and Memphis remain undefeated, while Cincinnati’s balanced offense helped it beat Iowa State.

The passage argues that a Russian cruiser violated the rights of the Cape Horn Pigeon’s American crew by forcing them to navigate a Russian vessel to port, then leaving them without suitable food or shelter. It seeks indemnity beyond payment for their labor, plus interest, citing earlier arbitration awards. It also supports a claim for lost whaling income using Captain Scullun’s estimated catch of eight whales, evidence on bone and oil yields, and market prices at the time of seizure.

The Citi Simplicity® Card offers 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for 21 months and purchases for 12 months. Transfers made within four months have a 3% fee (minimum $5); afterward, the fee is 5% (minimum $5). The variable APR after the introductory periods is 17.99%–28.74%. The card has no annual or late fees and no penalty rate. Approval is not guaranteed; the recommended credit score is 670–850. Motley Fool Money receives advertising compensation, which may affect offer placement but, it says, not its ratings.

Pumpkin is a fruit in the Cucurbitaceae family and can be eaten in dishes beyond pie, including soups, salads and baked goods. It is low in calories and provides fibre, iron, potassium, vitamin E and carotenoids. The passage links these nutrients to potential benefits for cardiovascular health, blood pressure, immunity, eye health and cognition.

A 2017 Wiseguyreports report examines the global smart service robots market through 2022. It covers SWOT analysis, manufacturer profiles, production, revenue, pricing and market share. The report distinguishes personal and professional robots, commercial and home uses, and markets in North America, Europe, China, Japan, Southeast Asia and India.

Google is launching three experimental photography apps for Android and iOS, building on technologies used in Motion Stills. Storyboard turns videos into comic layouts on Android; Selfissimo! automatically takes black-and-white selfies on both platforms; and Scrubbies lets iOS users create video loops by changing playback. Google says the technologies remain under active research and that public feedback will help guide future development.

A systematic review of 270 studies maps social-science research on large language models into three themes: LLMs as Social Minds (111 studies), LLM Societies (99), and LLM–Human Interactions (60). Unsupervised clustering and topic modeling produced a stable, interpretable taxonomy that closely aligned with expert classifications. The themes cover mind-like behavior and bias, multi-agent coordination and institutions, and human trust, learning, work, and risks. The authors argue that these are distinct but connected levels of analysis requiring different evidence standards. Limitations include English-only coverage, a September 2025 search cutoff, and potential changes to category boundaries under other methods.

Lincoln County’s Lady Lynx won their Homecoming volleyball match against Laughlin in five sets after winning the first two and losing the next two. Coach Chantel Holt said the team needed to maintain its focus and that substitutions gave more players a chance to play. The Lady Lynx next host Calvary.

The passage specifies guest–hypervisor communication for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP. Version 2 lets guests request a bitmap of optional hypervisor features. Guests establish a shared, page-aligned GHCB and use its MSR protocol for negotiation and requests; SEV-SNP guests must register a GHCB address before using it.

The passage describes VMGEXIT handling, required GHCB fields and validity bits, error reporting, and non-automatic exit events. These events support operations including page-state changes, firmware requests, AP creation, VMPL changes, trusted I/O, and termination. It also covers guest initialization, AP booting, interrupt handling, and the SEV-SNP secrets and CPUID pages.

For restricted interrupt injection, a shared #HV doorbell page communicates pending interrupts and non-maskable events. The host presents events through the page, while the guest acknowledges them atomically and performs end-of-interrupt processing. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported in the specified versions.

The 49ers ruled out quarterback Brock Purdy and receivers Ricky Pearsall and Jauan Jennings for Thursday’s game against the Rams. Mac Jones will start at quarterback as San Francisco faces a short-handed offense and a Rams defense ranked among the league’s best in several measures.

King Salman and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan met in Riyadh to discuss bilateral cooperation and regional and international developments. Erdogan also met Crown Prince Muhammad Bin Naif to discuss regional peace, security and counterterrorism.

The Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine offloads page migration between physical memory locations while preserving guest physical addresses. It can pause DMA traffic during migration and move pages protected by Secure Nested Paging. TMPM requires an enabled IOMMU; software can check the ENGINE_READY status bit to determine availability.

PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO handles pages subject to concurrent DMA, while PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST handles SNP guest pages. A command can move up to 128 pages and reports both overall and per-page status. AMD reports higher bandwidth with commands containing at least 16 pages, with maximum performance at 128.

Some IOMMU data structures, pinned buffers, the ring buffer, and argument pages cannot be migrated. Source and destination system physical addresses must be 4KB-aligned. Firmware reload requires operations to stop and the ring buffer to be torn down; software should check ENGINE_READY before communicating with the firmware.

Amazon reported third-quarter 2016 net sales of $32.7 billion, up from $25.4 billion a year earlier, and net income of $252 million, up from $79 million. For the first nine months of 2016, sales were $92.2 billion and net income was $1.6 billion. AWS sales rose 55% in the quarter to $3.2 billion, while the International segment recorded a $541 million operating loss. Operating cash flow for the trailing twelve months was $14.6 billion. The filing also describes tax disputes, legal proceedings, and investments in fulfillment capacity and technology infrastructure.

The passage describes monitoring of medical problems after lower-dose, standard, and additional BNT162b2 boosters. It defines serious medical problems as life-threatening, requiring hospital care, or causing lasting problems. In Phase 1, two participants had serious medical problems between Dose 1 and six months after Dose 2: one had an inflamed appendix and one had inflamed nerves.
As Taiwan’s avian flu threat rises, health authorities urge residents to cook eggs to at least 70°C, wash hands after handling eggshells, cook poultry thoroughly, and seek medical care for fever.

The president urges Congress to reduce tariffs on Cuban imports through a reciprocal arrangement, citing moral obligations, national interest, and Cuba’s need for economic relief. He notes an urgent appeal from Cuba’s president and says existing law permits a reduction of up to 20 percent. He argues that safeguards can prevent sugar refiners from capturing the benefit, that American industries will not be harmed, and that closer trade will benefit both countries. Because Cuba has accepted special international obligations toward the United States, he asks Congress to grant it corresponding economic concessions and continue the support given since the war with Spain.

A year-long project in England brought together Citizenship student teachers, mentors and Diversity Role Models to develop LGBTQ+-inclusive teaching. Student teachers used lessons on rights and identities during school placements, but reported that transgender identities appeared far less often than sexual orientation in their teaching and school curricula. They linked this gap to public debate, proposed government guidance and limited confidence discussing gender identity.

The authors note that the proposed guidance remained in draft form, while existing statutory guidance and equality law continued to apply. Participants identified human rights and equality law, personal stories, teacher training, and consistent anti-bullying practices as ways to support trans inclusion. They also emphasized representation across school life, rather than only in Citizenship lessons, and the value of partnerships with specialist organizations.

Kinlochleven has received three defibrillators through local fundraising and donations. Residents have completed emergency life support training, and the devices are planned for locations outside the Co-op and GP surgery. The first responders group has raised £2,900 toward its £3,500 target.

England beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties to reach the World Cup quarter-finals after Harry Kane’s opener was cancelled out by Yerry Mina’s late equaliser. Kane, the tournament’s top scorer with six goals, said the team was focused on Saturday’s match against Sweden. Colombia’s Radamel Falcao accused the referee of favouring England, while Diego Maradona called the result a “monumental theft.”

Malaysia’s central bank will allow all resident entities to short-sell government securities from May 2 to improve bond-market liquidity. It will also expand foreign-exchange hedging options for residents and non-bank entities. The bank is considering short-selling for shariah-compliant government bonds and introducing an updated financial-markets code of conduct.

Jones sued McKechnie’s executor, claiming McKechnie had promised to protect him from losses on notes he signed for his son-in-law, Kingsbury. A jury awarded Jones damages. On appeal, the court held that evidence about McKechnie’s refusal to sell hops at a price that could have paid Kingsbury’s debts was unrelated to the disputed promise and likely prejudiced the jury. It reversed the judgment and ordered a new trial.

Magda Enriquez joined the Sandinistas secretly in 1976 after her work with children with special needs exposed her to malnutrition and poverty in Nicaragua. A 1978 land protest, during which pesticide was dropped on peasant families and ten children died before receiving treatment, prompted her to seek military training. She later represented the Nicaraguan Women’s Association on the Council of State. Divorced and raising six children, Enriquez says shared care enables her government work. She acknowledges that women’s problems persist but says the revolution offers opportunities to address them.

Retirees and people pursuing financial independence and early retirement (FIRE) risk exhausting their savings when poor early investment returns coincide with withdrawals. An example portfolio starting at $1 million in 2000 ran out by 2017 with $50,000 annual withdrawals. The passage emphasizes conservative withdrawal rates, diversification and a margin of safety, while noting that historical simulations cannot predict future returns.

Hinsdale South High School seniors were named Illinois State Scholars, a recognition for students in the top 10 percent of Illinois graduating seniors. Selection is based on ACT and SAT scores, unweighted GPA and class size at the end of junior year.

Between weeks 24 and 48, adverse events affected 33.8% of the Primary SOC group, 40.8% of the Secondary SOC group, and 38.6% of the Continued Additional Educational Program group. Two fatal bleeds and 24 deaths were reported overall. Adherence remained high through 48 weeks; proactive education provided no additional benefit.

Appleton couple Andrea and Luke Benrud are encouraging others to learn CPR after Luke used it to keep Andrea alive for seven minutes when she collapsed from an undetected heart defect. Their story was featured online by People Magazine.

Police charged Jonathan Erick Miles after a search of his home allegedly uncovered two marijuana plants, controlled substances and smoking devices. He also faces a child-endangerment charge; police say he was under the influence while caring for his daughter. He was released on $20,000 unsecured bail. Manheim Township police also reported charges against three others involving alleged indecent assault, corruption of minors and a domestic dispute.

Analysts expect the European Central Bank to keep interest rates at historic lows and maintain its planned September end to monthly bond purchases, while cautioning against expectations of a quick exit from stimulus. Eurozone inflation remains below the bank’s target, and a stronger euro, trade tensions and softer business indicators pose risks to growth. Despite these concerns, the ECB and IMF forecast 2.4 per cent eurozone growth in 2018, supporting a gradual withdrawal of stimulus.

Body-camera footage from an August 19 arrest shows Grand Rapids Officer Kevin Penn pressing his rifle’s muzzle against a suspect’s head after the man was tased during a response to an alleged armed robbery. An Internal Affairs report says the suspect complained of pain and another officer moved the rifle away. Penn resigned, and Kent County Prosecutor Chris Becker declined to charge him while stating that the conduct was not condoned.

The passage promotes Professionate, an online event-staffing platform that connects companies with temporary exhibition hosts, trade show models and other event staff. It says employers can browse candidates’ profiles, ratings and reviews, while candidates can post profiles and apply for vacancies directly. Recruitment agencies can also use the portal. Professionate advertises hosting and promotion services for events in Dubai.

A study of 100 adults compared self-reported PCL-5 scores with clinician-administered CAPS-5 assessments of PTSD symptoms. Scores correlated more strongly for females than males, although clinician-assessed symptom severity was similar between sexes. Using PCL-5 alone misclassified PTSD status for 26.8% of males and 11.4% of females. Scores also correlated more strongly among participants with civilian trauma than those with military trauma. The authors advise caution when relying on self-reports, particularly for males, and note that the sample size, geographic scope and small number of females with military trauma limit generalizability.

More than 166,000 Yemeni teachers have gone unpaid since October, and up to 4.5 million children may not finish the school year, UNICEF says. Children out of school face risks of military recruitment or early marriage. The salary crisis followed the government’s relocation of the central bank from Houthi-controlled Sanaa.

A Channel 4 documentary follows five women who report having many orgasms in one sexual encounter and explores possible explanations through arousal, brain-wave and brain-imaging tests. Experts caution that the experiments were not scientific, involved few participants and had no control group. They question whether “super orgasms” differ from multiple orgasms and stress that experiences vary; a high number of orgasms is neither typical nor a goal women should feel pressured to meet.

The FDA approved a second generic version of mifepristone. Amgen said its cholesterol-lowering injection Repatha reduced the combined risk of heart disease death, heart attacks, and strokes in a 12,000-patient trial. The passage also mentions a new NIH office aimed at reducing reliance on animal testing.

Cover 3 is a zone defense with three players covering deep thirds and four covering underneath zones. It aims to limit deep passes while allowing a safety to help defend the run. Its weaknesses include short passes to the flats, seam routes, four-vertical plays, and runs to the perimeter. Variations change the safeties’ responsibilities, add blitz pressure, or use pattern-reading rules to cover developing routes.

A jury found John Jacob Beechwood insolvent and determined that his transfers of a farm to his wife and a business interest to an attorney were acts of bankruptcy. Beechwood argued that, as a farmer, he was exempt from involuntary bankruptcy. The court rejected that defense because, when the acts occurred, his principal income had come from legal and business work rather than personal farming. It ordered that he be adjudicated bankrupt.

The lecture characterizes continuity at a point in three ways: every function is continuous at a point that is not a cluster point of its domain; at a cluster point, continuity means the function’s limit equals its value there; and continuity is equivalent to preserving the limits of sequences converging to that point. It proves sine and cosine are continuous and uses sequences of rational and irrational numbers to show that a function distinguishing them is discontinuous everywhere. The sequential characterization also establishes that sums, products, quotients with nonzero denominators, and compositions of continuous functions are continuous. Applications include powers, polynomials, and a function involving sine. The lecture closes by previewing maximum, minimum, and intermediate value theorems.

The President transmits documents requested by the House concerning the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, including instructions previously withheld over concerns about public disclosure. The commissioners were instructed to seek Mexico’s ratification of the treaty as amended by the U.S. Senate, without negotiating changes. Mexico’s Congress approved it before the commissioners held any conferences with Mexican officials, and ratifications were subsequently exchanged.

The President states that a protocol recording later conversations did not alter the treaty. Its three explanations concerned protections for inhabitants of ceded territories, the continued validity of legitimate Mexican land titles despite deletion of a treaty article, and Mexico’s ability to assign the $12 million owed under the treaty. Because he considered these explanations consistent with the ratified treaty, he took no further action.

The Times reported that officials identified former Trump campaign chairman Paul Manafort on calls under scrutiny. Manafort denied knowingly speaking to Russian intelligence officers or involvement with the Russian government. U.S. intelligence officials suspected Russian involvement in election-related cyberattacks, which Russia denied. Rep. Elijah Cummings expressed concern about possible campaign ties to Russia. The report followed national security adviser Michael Flynn’s resignation over calls with Russia’s ambassador.

Amazon is preparing to cut up to 15% of its human resources staff, with layoffs also likely in other divisions, according to sources. The total number of cuts and their timing are unknown. The plans come as Amazon reduces employee costs while investing heavily in AI. The company declined to comment.

S. E. Mezes reports progress at a Thursday meeting and circulates a memorandum to its attendees. The memorandum proposes research on peace-conference procedures, national aspirations, disputed areas, international governance, laws of war, reparations, trade routes, and diplomacy. A preliminary survey identifies ways the Inquiry could assist a conference, including setting boundaries and governments, assessing states, arranging economic matters, and protecting minorities and weak peoples. It lists regions where these tasks will or may be needed and identifies Poland and Austria-Hungary as requiring work on both boundaries and governments.

The passage describes a study reporting that Bt toxins caused anemia-related blood changes and signs of bone marrow damage in mice, with effects increasing over time. Its authors called for further research into risks to mammals before concluding the toxins are safe. The passage also raises concerns about combined exposure to Bt toxins and glyphosate-based herbicides and advocates action against GM crops.

The speaker calls on Americans to uphold the founding promise of equality through collective action and civic participation. He advocates a strong middle class, education and government reform, social protections, action on climate change, and peaceful engagement abroad alongside national defense. He says the country’s work remains unfinished until women receive equal pay, gay people receive equal treatment under the law, voting is accessible, immigrants are welcomed, and children are safe. He urges citizens to address these challenges together despite political differences.

December incentives on fuel-efficient vehicles include discounts and leases across hybrids, plug-in hybrids, electric cars, diesels and gasoline cars. The 2017 Kia Optima Hybrid offers up to $5,000 off, while the Optima Plug-In leases for $249 per month. The 2017 Chevrolet Volt leases for $273 per month. In California, the 2017 Kia Soul EV offers up to $18,100 off or a $159-per-month lease; Chevrolet also offers Bolt EV leases. Nationwide, buyers can get $4,000 off a 2018 diesel Chevrolet Equinox LT. A Southern California offer puts the Toyota Yaris iA at about $15,000. Lease terms and incentives vary by location.

The passage describes a global meat starter culture market report covering historical and projected revenue, market trends, growth factors, competition, pricing, and investment analysis. It segments products into maturation and surface starters and applications into meat, poultry, seafood, and others. Regional coverage includes the United States, China, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, India, and the rest of the world.

Founded in Cheltenham in 1888, H H Martyn & Co grew from an art-craft firm into a major employer working in metal, stone, wood, ship interiors and engineering. Its commissions included Marble Arch’s iron gates, work for royal residences, the Selfridges frontage and fittings for more than 100 ocean liners. Wartime aircraft production led to the Gloster Aircraft Company, while the firm also made cars and cast sculptures. Bought by Maples of London in the 1930s, Martyn’s faced recession after the Second World War. Maples closed it in 1971 following the decline of British shipbuilding.

On September 9, 2020, Amazon’s board elected retired General Keith B. Alexander as a director and appointed him to its Audit Committee. He received a 288-share restricted stock unit award, vesting in three annual installments subject to continued service, and entered into an indemnification agreement.

Progress Software’s third-quarter 2025 earnings call took place on September 29. Investor relations head Michael Micciche introduced CEO Yogesh Gupta and CFO Anthony Folger, cautioned that forward-looking statements carry risks, and said financial figures discussed would be non-GAAP unless otherwise noted.

In 1826, Captain Thomas ap Catesby Jones resolved issues involving American deserters and residents in Hawaii and negotiated a treaty of friendship, commerce, and navigation. It was Hawaii’s first formally negotiated treaty with a foreign power, though the United States never ratified it. Later U.S. naval visits included an appeal on behalf of persecuted Catholic converts. In 1839, a French commander threatened hostilities unless Hawaiian authorities signed a treaty and protected Catholics; they complied. Following an earlier British-imposed treaty, Lord George Paulet seized the islands in February 1843. A U.S. commodore protested, and a British admiral disavowed the seizure and restored the Hawaiian flag that July.

The passage proposes a Bayesian community-detection framework that recursively splits networks without requiring a predetermined number of communities. It uses MCMC for partitioning and a Bayes factor to decide when to stop. The framework accommodates stochastic block, edge exchangeable, and latent space models. The passage also states consistency results for recursive bipartitioning under specified stochastic block model conditions.

A study found strong evidence of a stratosphere on WASP-121b, a hot Jupiter about 880 light-years away. Using the Hubble Space Telescope, researchers detected glowing water molecules indicating that temperature rises with altitude in the planet’s upper atmosphere. The finding shows that distant exoplanet atmospheres can be studied in detail, though current technology is better suited to large, hot planets than smaller, rocky ones.

The NHS Patient Charter sets out patients’ legal rights, NHS pledges and patient responsibilities. It covers access to care based on need, quality and safety, fair treatment decisions, consent, privacy, choice, and ways to raise complaints or seek redress. It also calls for clear explanations when waiting-time standards are missed or care goes wrong. Patients are asked to look after their health where possible, follow or discuss treatment plans, and treat staff and others respectfully.

Winthrop University will receive $1.1 million as part of a five-year, $20 million National Science Foundation award shared by 10 South Carolina institutions. The funding will support complex-materials research, 36 summer student research experiences, faculty resources and equipment upgrades. Winthrop researchers will study electronic, optical and biomaterials, including materials with potential applications in energy, water treatment and medicine. The university will also offer two-week summer workshops for regional high school teachers.

Average True Range (ATR) measures an asset’s volatility and is commonly used to guide stop-loss placement and position sizing. The passage describes calculating a 14-day ATR in Python and backtesting a strategy that holds SPY when volatility is high and sells when it is low. The strategy performed better than buy-and-hold on a risk-adjusted basis but had nearly the same drawdown; its overall results were described as not very promising.

A University of Bristol study found that the chloroplast lineage split from its closest cyanobacterial ancestor more than 2.1 billion years ago in low-salinity environments. About 200 million years later, chloroplasts formed a close symbiotic relationship with a eukaryotic host. The findings suggest algae first evolved in freshwater before colonising marine environments, where major groups diversified around 800–750 million years ago.

The neo-Nazi website Daily Stormer lost its domain registration with GoDaddy after publishing an article mocking Heather Heyer, who was killed at a Charlottesville counterprotest. GoDaddy said the article could incite further violence. The site moved to Google Domains, but Google also announced it would cancel the registration for violating its terms of service. Separately, a post claimed Anonymous had hacked the site; founder Andrew Anglin later said he had regained control. Anglin also faces a lawsuit over an alleged harassment campaign against a Montana family. His whereabouts remain unknown.

Coach Sutter said the seven-game series against Chicago, including three overtime periods, and a disrupted schedule may have left players tired. Several players were also making their first Stanley Cup Final appearance. He praised Kyle’s energy but said the team must play better and avoid chasing leads. Sutter discussed Mike Richards’s willingness to accept roles, Jonathan’s focus, and a young player’s room to develop. He also noted changes to both teams’ lineups and said he adjusted his lines during the first period because several players were struggling.

A retrospective review of 267 children admitted with clinical measles to Uganda’s Mulago National Referral Hospital in 2018 found that 69.3% developed multiple complications, most commonly severe pneumonia, and 11.3% died. Average treatment costs to the health system were $114.50 per child, including $33.13 in direct healthcare costs and $81.37 in overhead costs. Costs were higher for children with comorbidities, longer stays, or fatal outcomes. The authors recommend promoting measles immunisation and note that diagnoses were not laboratory-confirmed and family costs were not assessed.

On August 17, Expedition 52 cosmonauts Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy are scheduled to leave the ISS for a six-hour spacewalk. They will deploy five nanosatellites, collect residue samples from the station’s exterior, and install handrails and struts. NASA plans to livestream the mission starting at 10:00 a.m. EDT.

The passage describes a recommendation-model training method that adds positive samples to a training set and selects negative samples according to probabilities based on estimated scores, feature-vector distances, and changes in ranking indicators. The trained model scores and ranks objects for recommendation and can generate scores for later training. The passage also describes training and recommendation apparatuses and reports improved ranking results in tests using HUAWEI APPGALLERY data.

Anne-Marie D’Amico, an Invesco employee, was among 10 people killed when a van struck pedestrians in Toronto on Monday. Fifteen others were injured. Police arrested alleged driver Alex Minassian and said the attack appeared deliberate, but his motive remains unknown.

NVIDIA and SoftBank’s seller entities mutually terminated their agreement for NVIDIA to purchase Arm on February 8, 2022, citing significant regulatory challenges. The sellers will retain NVIDIA’s $1.25 billion prepayment, while NVIDIA will retain its 20-year Arm license. NVIDIA expects to record a $1.36 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal 2023.

The passage specifies how SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests communicate with a hypervisor through the GHCB and VMGEXIT. It covers protocol negotiation, CPUID requests, GHCB address registration, non-automatic exits, error reporting, page-state changes, guest requests, and AP management. It also describes SEV-SNP features including restricted injection, timer and IPI requests, trusted-device requests, and Secure AVIC. For restricted injection, a shared #HV doorbell page conveys pending interrupts and non-maskable events; the guest acknowledges them atomically and signals when interrupt service is complete.

The High/Low zone offense combines three-player perimeter passing with two interior players rotating between the basket, short corner, and high post. Their movement creates opportunities for inside passes and outside shots when the defense collapses. Sharp passing, ball reversals, and weakside attacks sustain its continuity. It can begin from several entries, including Dribble Clear, 1-4 Slice, Mid Screen, and Horns. Pin Down, Weakside Double, and Vegas are quick-hitting options for late-clock situations or after timeouts.

The paper presents a prototype for analyzing instant-messaging data in criminal investigations. It combines a Neo4j knowledge graph, audio transcription, entity extraction, and graph and faceted-search interfaces. Tested with data from two investigations, the tools helped investigators explore relationships and search messages and transcripts. Investigators valued the visualizations and transcription capabilities, but preliminary entity-recognition results were weak. The authors plan to improve extraction and search while keeping evidence verifiable against the original data.

Aqua Terra filed a preliminary prospectus for an initial public offering of common shares in all Canadian provinces except Québec. TD Securities, Canaccord Genuity and RBC Capital Markets will co-lead the underwriting. The share count and price remain undetermined, and completion is not assured. Aqua Terra provides oilfield water disposal services in Canada and the United States; no U.S. public offering is planned.

Charlie Tillett explains how entrepreneurs can build financial projections to understand their assumptions, track progress, manage cash and discuss their businesses with investors. He recommends constructing a spreadsheet from the bottom up, using realistic sales and staffing assumptions, quarterly projections and comparisons with similar companies. Revenue, costs, expenses and operating profit should reflect the company’s business model and distribution strategy.

Tillett also explains how venture financing affects ownership: investors seek substantial returns and equity, later funding rounds dilute existing shareholders, and option pools reserve shares for employees. He advises founders to match their financing to the size of their opportunity, plan for future funding needs and use vesting to reward continued contributions.

UNC Chapel Hill reinstated professor Dwayne Dixon after a threat assessment found no basis to conclude he posed a threat or violated university policy. A Turning Point USA spokesperson had called for his firing over his political affiliations.

Major drugmakers are expected to meet with Donald Trump Jr. and administration officials at a summit hosted by BlinkRx, where Trump Jr. is a board member. Some company representatives worry the event signals pressure to work with BlinkRx. Separately, Pfizer’s drug-pricing agreement has prompted other drugmakers to seek White House deals, though their effect on prices remains unknown. A New York panel recommended pausing Medicaid coverage of a Sarepta Duchenne drug.

For bandwidth-limited additive white Gaussian noise channels, coding uses multilevel constellations and Euclidean distance rather than relying on binary codes and Hamming distance. The lecture separates performance gains from shaping the constellation and from choosing its lattice. Spherical shaping offers at most 1.53 dB of gain, while dense lattices can lose effective coding gain because they have many nearest neighbors.

The professor describes Barnes–Wall and Leech lattices, then explains how trellis codes use constellation expansion and set partitioning to improve performance. A simple four-state trellis code achieves 3 dB of coding gain; more complex trellis codes can achieve about 5–6 dB. Combined with shaping, they remain roughly 2–3 dB from the Shannon limit. Multilevel coding and bit-interleaved coded modulation offer ways to approach capacity more closely. The lecture closes by describing coding for these traditional channels as a mature field with remaining theoretical questions.

The lecture examines hot embossing thermoplastic polymers to make low-cost microfluidic devices. It describes how temperature, force, loading time, hold time, material properties, and stamp design affect how well features form. The professor presents fast, simplified models that predict embossed topography and compares them with experiments on several polymers. Test patterns revealed effects of feature size, spacing, temperature, hold time, and material orientation. The lecture also discusses nanoimprint lithography and the challenges of cooling and removing a stamp without damaging features. In a project discussion, the professor suggests weighting competing outputs in a combined optimization objective.

Hetzner has added a 10Gbps direct peering connection at NAP Africa in Isando, complementing its existing links at NAP Africa in Cape Town and JINX. More than 65% of its local traffic now travels through exchange points rather than transit links, and it contributes over 4Gbps of traffic to them. Hetzner says settlement-free peering can reduce connectivity costs and latency while improving resilience, and invites other network operators to peer with it.

The NVIDIA A100 GPU uses third-generation Tensor Cores to accelerate AI and HPC workloads, supporting TF32, BF16, FP64 and other formats. Its 2:4 structured sparsity feature doubles Tensor Core compute throughput by skipping zero values. The A100 has 108 streaming multiprocessors, 40 GB of HBM2 memory and a 40 MB L2 cache. Asynchronous copies, barriers, cache controls and CUDA Task Graph optimizations improve data movement and execution efficiency.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 and SR-IOV support multi-GPU communication and shared access. The passage also describes improved fault handling, image and video decoding, optical flow acceleration, and the eight-GPU DGX A100 system.

In a letter to Delta’s mayor and council, Deborah Jones opposes a proposed 35-storey Scott Road development, arguing that it conflicts with the North Delta Area Plan’s six-storey guidance and stormwater goals. She says its underground parking would leave little room for large trees or rainwater infiltration, harming Cougar Creek and increasing flood and drought risks. Jones urges Delta to require multi-family developments to reserve at least 15 per cent of their land as fully permeable space.

The gold/silver ratio measures how many ounces of silver equal the value of one ounce of gold. Traders use it to assess relative prices, often expecting unusually high or low ratios to revert. Historically fixed by governments, the ratio now fluctuates widely. The passage’s backtests found an erratic GLD strategy, a flat gold–silver pair trade, and no robust profitable strategy based on the ratio.

The passage presents EqDiff-CT, a conditional diffusion model that generates synthetic CT images from CBCT scans for head-and-neck radiotherapy. It uses an attention-enhanced, rotationally equivariant U-Net and non-adversarial training. On the SynthRAD2025 Head & Neck dataset, it outperformed a diffusion model without attention and a CycleGAN baseline on reported image-quality metrics while preserving clinically relevant structures.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) supplies measurements for attestation and applies non-persistent firmware patches through update packages. Packages must match the system’s firmware and patch levels, and no updates are applied unless every component passes validation. A customer deployment agent submits an aligned command buffer and package to ASP firmware, which protects the package memory, verifies applicable signatures, runs the patch, updates patch-level information, and returns a status. Customers can apply patches during boot or system operation. Updates are designed to minimize disruption, though SEV and SEV/ES virtual machines must stop and restart for an SEV firmware update; SEV/SNP virtual machines can continue operating.

Apple reported $53.3 billion in net sales and $11.5 billion in net income for the quarter ended June 30, 2018, up from $45.4 billion and $8.7 billion a year earlier. Sales rose 17%, driven primarily by iPhone, Services and Other Products, and increased in every geographic segment. For the first nine months of fiscal 2018, net sales were $202.7 billion and net income was $45.4 billion. Apple repurchased $20.0 billion of shares during the quarter and authorized a new $100 billion repurchase program. Its third-quarter effective tax rate was 13.3%.

The SteelSeries Arctis GameBuds are on sale at Amazon for $128, nearly $75 off. The reviewer praises their portability, comfort, game-specific equalizer settings, and compatibility with consoles, PCs, and phones. They offer low-latency audio through a USB-C dongle, Bluetooth, and up to 40 hours of battery life with the case.

A CDC report says U.S. illnesses from mosquito, tick and flea bites have tripled since 2004. In Venice, standing water in the canals and Ballona Wetlands can provide mosquito breeding sites, and West Nile virus is present in the area. Most infected people have no symptoms, but some become ill and fewer than one percent develop severe neurological disease. Los Angeles County recorded its highest West Nile case count in the past five years in 2015, with 300 cases. Local officials recommend using insect repellent and removing standing water from yards.

The study produced metal inorganic-organic complex (MIOC) glasses from two hydrogen-bonded crystals, MIOC-4 and MIOC-7, using ligand tuning and melt-quenching. During melting, hydrogen bonds break; in the resulting glasses, metal–ligand bonds remain intact while longer-range molecular order is lost. Mixing the ligands lowered melting points and allowed glass-transition temperatures to be tuned. The approach was also extended to other metals and anions. MIOC-7 glass showed stronger photoluminescence than its crystal, suggesting potential use in anti-counterfeiting.

The speaker expects Dallas to respond strongly after losing the first game and says the team must focus on its preparation rather than past results. Dallas’s skilled players need to be pressured quickly. After the next game, the speaker says Dallas forechecked more aggressively, while their own team made poor decisions with the puck and failed to follow its game plan. A disputed offside preceded a Dallas goal, but the speaker does not blame the loss on that call. With the series tied 1–1, the speaker sees no reason to panic and says the team must play better in Dallas.

The study examines possible sources of influenza A H5 RNA detected in wastewater during the 2024 cattle outbreak. Researchers retrospectively tested 110 wastewater-solids samples collected from a San Francisco treatment plant between September 2023 and May 2024 for total influenza A and H1, H3, and H5 RNA. They developed a model to estimate the contributions from humans, cow’s milk, poultry feces, and wild-bird feces needed to account for measured H5 concentrations.

Weston will see about 70% coverage of the Aug. 21 solar eclipse. The Weston Public Library will distribute free viewers starting Aug. 14, host a pinhole projector workshop Aug. 15, and stream NASA coverage Aug. 21.

James Harden scored 60 points with 10 rebounds and 11 assists, becoming the first NBA player to record a 60-point triple-double as the Houston Rockets beat the Orlando Magic 114-107. He broke Calvin Murphy’s Houston single-game scoring record of 57 points and scored six straight late points after the game was tied at 107. Houston played without Chris Paul and Trevor Ariza, while Eric Gordon left in the second quarter. Mario Hezonja and Marreese Speights scored 17 points each for Orlando, which lost its third straight game.

The passage describes a networked exercise system that delivers live and recorded instructor-led classes, supports communication among instructors and users, and shares performance data for competition. Its example treadmill has a slatted belt, adjustable incline, display, sensors, and separate rotary controls for different functions. User interfaces provide class browsing, performance metrics, and leaderboards.

Effective early offense and press breaks depend on precise execution, spacing, timing, and footwork. Coaches should teach player roles and defensive reads, then use progressive drills and game-speed practice against strong defense. Objectives include advancing the ball quickly under control, attacking pressure and double teams, and flowing into early offense when the break does not produce a good shot. Teams should look to break on every possession, anticipate defensive tactics, and remain alert to adjustments. Immediate defensive pressure can disrupt an opponent’s early offense and create steals and baskets.

The speaker praises a goalie’s composure after a loss and bad goals. He compares Bergeron and Ryan O’Reilly as hardworking, strong on faceoffs and effective on both sides of the puck. He sees similarities between the teams’ defensive, physical styles, stresses staying disciplined after whistles and putting the team first, and says the schedule and travel require two good goalies.

After the Diocese of Covington barred their graduation speeches, Holy Cross High School valedictorian Christian Bales and student council president Katherine Frantz delivered them by bullhorn outside the ceremony. A diocese spokesman said the speeches were submitted late and were political and inconsistent with Catholic teaching. Bales spoke about young people’s ability to shape the world, citing activism by Florida students after a school shooting. He said the decision to bar the speeches ultimately gave his message a wider audience.

The speaker describes supporting an overtime play that ended in a decisive shot and says the team had momentum during a delayed penalty. They are excited to return home and appreciate the town’s support. They say the team must avoid penalties against a strong power play and, when short-handed, focus on details and quick changes. They remain confident others can step in for injured key players.

The ADX measures trend strength and is a lagging indicator developed by Welles Wilder. The article’s backtests found that simple ADX strategies performed reasonably but were less effective than using ADX alongside another indicator. On the S&P 500, a 10-day directional-indicator crossover produced a 5.4% compound annual growth rate, while an ADX breakout strategy produced 3.03%. Adding an ADX filter to another strategy reduced market exposure and increased its profit factor, though overall returns fell on SPY. The article recommends testing strategies before using them.

The passage specifies mechanical, material, inspection, and electrical requirements for Socket 940. Its LCP base and cover support a 940-pin ceramic µPGA package; the cover’s flatness must remain below 0.25 mm. Required markings include the socket identifier, lever directions, pin A01 orientation, supplier symbol, and lot number.

The socket uses gold-over-nickel-plated copper-alloy contacts and tin-lead solder balls for PCB mounting. A stainless steel lever provides tool-free actuation. Package insertion and extraction forces with the lever open must not exceed 2 kgf, and lever actuation force must be below 3.6 kgf. The socket must retain mechanical and electrical integrity after 50 actuation cycles.

Each contact is rated for 1.5 A, and initial and final low-level circuit resistance must not exceed 25 mΩ per contact. The passage also sets limits for inductance, capacitance, impedance, propagation-delay skew, dielectric withstand voltage, and insulation resistance.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs add concurrent ray tracing and compute processing, second-generation RT Cores that accelerate ray-traced motion blur, and third-generation Tensor Cores with new precision modes and structured sparsity. The passage describes performance improvements in ray-traced rendering and DLSS, alongside GDDR6X memory with up to 936 GB/sec of peak bandwidth. RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression with DirectStorage to reduce CPU work during asset loading. GA10x also supports high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding, and hardware video encoding. The passage covers GeForce RTX 30-series and professional A40 and RTX A6000 GPUs, then describes memory error detection and replay for GDDR6X overclocking.

The Trump administration wants to add more than 400 attorneys to US Attorneys’ Offices, but hiring has been slow. From January through August, about 42 people reported becoming assistant US attorneys on LinkedIn, less than half the number in the same period of each of the previous four years. LinkedIn data is incomplete. Current and former prosecutors cited budget pressures, hiring freezes, departures, and concerns about Justice Department turmoil. Some offices are now recruiting, and the reported new hires have strong credentials. Former prosecutors disagree on whether young lawyers should pursue these jobs amid concerns about political interference.

On October 7, 2016, NVIDIA entered into a five-year credit agreement allowing it to borrow, repay and reborrow up to $575 million for working capital and general corporate purposes. Subject to conditions, it may obtain up to $425 million in additional revolving loan or letter-of-credit commitments. Outstanding obligations are due October 7, 2021. The agreement includes interest-rate options, financial covenants and customary default provisions. NVIDIA’s obligations are unsecured senior debt.

A study of 20 million U.S. children and their parents found that, in 99 percent of neighborhoods, black boys earn less as adults than white boys from similar socioeconomic backgrounds. Black and Native American children had the lowest rates of upward economic mobility. Among children raised in the bottom income fifth, 2.5 percent of black children reached the top fifth, compared with 11 percent of white children. The black-white income gap was driven almost entirely by men’s earnings; after accounting for parental income, black women earned slightly more than white women. Neighborhoods mattered, but the gap persisted even in affluent ones.

Future Electronics and NXP will host a free i.MX RT Series Crossover Processor workshop in San Sebastian, Spain, on July 4, 2018. The seminar will introduce the processor family and include hands-on exercises. The i.MX RT 105x processors use a Cortex-M7 core and omit flash memory to allow implementation flexibility.

The speaker celebrates Berlin’s reunification and credits Berliners’ courage with overcoming division and bringing down the Wall. He urges them to build a democratic, prosperous, peaceful Europe and to reject divisions based on race, ethnicity, or religion. Citing political and economic progress and NATO’s Partnership for Peace, he pledges continued American support, including a new embassy in Berlin. He presents the Brandenburg Gate as a gateway to a united Europe and declares that Berlin is free.

The author’s retirement portfolio gained 15% in 2016, including dividends and capital gains but excluding new contributions, versus 11.66% for the S&P 500 with dividends. It outperformed the index every month. Chevron and JPMorgan were among its strongest holdings, while Gilead Sciences and CVS Health were the weakest. The portfolio grew from 27 to 35 companies, with one sale during the year. The author plans to keep buying dividend-paying companies at prices considered below fair value.

President Donald Trump announced a deal under which Pfizer will lower U.S. drug prices, including offering existing drugs to Medicaid patients at the lowest prices available in other developed nations and applying that pricing to new drugs for Medicare, Medicaid and commercial payers. Pfizer will also offer discounted medicines through TrumpRx.gov. In exchange for further investment in U.S. manufacturing, its products will receive a three-year exemption from pharmaceutical-specific tariffs. Pfizer plans to invest $70 billion in domestic manufacturing and research. Trump said he is seeking similar agreements with other drugmakers.

NVIDIA’s board appointed Tim Teter senior vice president, general counsel and secretary on January 18, 2017, contingent on his expected January 23 employment start. He will take over the legal department from David Shannon, who will continue to lead human resources and assist with legal matters until retirement. Teter’s offer includes an $850,000 annual salary, eligibility for $250,000 in targeted annual incentives beginning in fiscal 2018, a conditional $450,000 anniversary bonus, and restricted stock units with a target value of $5.8 million that vest over approximately four years. He is also eligible for employee stock purchase and benefits programs.

A study of Indiana school leaders during 2020–21 found that the COVID-19 pandemic drove growth in virtual education programs. Superintendents and program administrators most often identified maintaining enrollment during the pandemic, credit recovery, and learner flexibility as benefits. Their leading concerns were student engagement and the quality of curriculum and instruction. Interviews also highlighted teacher stress, limited professional development, students’ social-emotional needs, and the importance of parental support. Because the study captures one school year, it cannot establish how Indiana’s virtual programs changed afterward.

The paper studies whether strategies can move from any initial profile to an equilibrium through a finite satisficing path, in which players already making best responses keep their strategies. It introduces a grouped version of these paths and proves their existence when strategy sets are convex and compact, payoffs are continuous and partially analytic, and every sub-game has an equilibrium. It also establishes paths to mixed equilibria for finite-strategy N-player games and finite-state Markov games. The results concern path existence, not convergence of a specified update algorithm.

WIRED lists editor-tested Amazon Big Deal Days discounts under $100 for Prime members on October 7 and 8. The picks span electronics, smart-home devices, pet products, kitchen appliances, household goods, personal care items, and games. WIRED says it may receive compensation through retailer links or purchases.

E-minis are electronically traded futures contracts, generally one-fifth the size of standard contracts, covering indexes, commodities and currencies. Traders use them to speculate or hedge, but leverage can magnify losses. Trading requires a futures broker and sufficient margin; the passage recommends budgeting $13,000–$15,000 for an S&P 500 e-mini contract in its example. A backtested S&P 500 e-mini strategy recorded 163 trades averaging 0.89% through 2021, while 13 trades in 2022 averaged 0.18%. The passage advises traders to backtest a written plan and warns that scalping is highly competitive.

The passage provides support and trademark information, warns that electrostatic discharge can damage the devices, and lists changes made to the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 data sheet between November 2024 and April 2025. It also includes mechanical and packaging guidance, orderable-part notes, automotive-qualified variants, and TI’s disclaimers concerning its technical resources and product information.

Using documents, field observations, and interviews, the study examines Songyang Academy’s history and educational philosophy. Founded as a temple in 484, it became a prominent academy during the Northern Song dynasty, later declining amid unrest and educational reforms. Its teaching emphasized moral character, independent study, questioning, debate, and putting knowledge into practice. The authors argue that these principles align with modern general education and could inform efforts to cultivate well-rounded students.

The passage uses bibliometric analysis to examine competencies for leaders of digital education transformation. It identifies digital literacy, readiness, culture, mindset, and leadership as key areas. In the context of Thailand’s Digital Thailand 4.0 strategy, it describes a shift toward online, hybrid, and project-based learning. Educators are urged to develop digital skills, adapt teaching practices, protect data, collaborate in digital teams, and guide students through change. The passage concludes that technology cannot replace good teachers and calls for further research on preparing future education leaders.

The lecture examines two theoretical problems: protein folding and interlocked chains. In the HP folding model, hydrophobic and hydrophilic nodes form a chain on a lattice, and a fold scores by the number of adjacent hydrophobic nodes that are not consecutive along the chain. Finding an optimal fold is NP-hard, but a one-third approximation algorithm is known. The professor also describes examples with unique optimal folds and open questions about uniqueness and protein design.

For three-dimensional chains, the lecture presents examples of chains that interlock and methods for proving when chains can separate. Unlocking an n-bar chain by cutting vertices requires roughly between n/4 and n/2 cuts in the worst case. Interlocked chains also help construct a proof that deciding whether one chain configuration can move to another is PSPACE-complete. Whether a given chain can be unfolded remains open.

Kobe University researchers found that four orchid species germinated only near decaying logs, where wood-decaying fungi supplied carbon their tiny seeds lack. The seedlings’ fungal partners closely matched those of adults with coral-shaped rhizomes. The findings reveal a carbon pathway from deadwood to orchids, suggest how some species evolved lifelong dependence on fungi, and underscore the importance of deadwood and its fungi for orchid conservation.

A survey of 30 teachers in four public schools in Liloan District found generally positive attitudes toward inclusive education, particularly its social benefits and principles. Most teachers had limited experience teaching learners with special needs and had attended only one or two inclusion trainings. They reported concerns about class sizes, resources, specialist access and other practical supports. Tests found no statistically significant relationship between the demographic factors examined and attitudes. The study recommends sustained professional development, stronger classroom support and resources, and school-specific interventions to help put inclusive principles into practice.

Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School reopened on February 28 after a shooting that killed 17 people. Students returned through heavy security, with grief counselors and therapy animals available; some said the armed presence was unsettling. Classes began with the period during which the shooting occurred, while the building where it happened remained closed. Students and victims’ families continued pressing for gun-law changes. Florida lawmakers advanced a school-safety bill that would raise the minimum age for buying long guns and allow trained, deputized teachers to carry concealed weapons with district approval. The Broward superintendent opposed arming teachers, while an NRA lobbyist opposed the bill’s gun-ownership restrictions. Dick’s Sporting Goods said it would stop selling assault-style rifles and guns to people under 21.

Vertical farming grows crops in stacked layers within controlled environments, using methods such as hydroponics and aeroponics. Demand for food, population growth and reduced reliance on land and water are cited as market drivers, while high startup and lighting costs are obstacles.
