The market is projected to reach approximately USD 6 billion by 2022, with North America holding the largest share and Asia-Pacific growing rapidly.

The speaker calls the honor gratifying, though he was disappointed not to be nominated for the rookie trophy. He delayed joining the Flyers for a year to prepare mentally and physically. After a slow first five games, his confidence grew, helped by the example of hardworking teammates.

A New York appellate court affirmed dismissal of Brian O’Loughlin’s defamation suit against the Patrolmen’s Benevolent Association and its president. After O’Loughlin requested a refund of a $20 contribution toward a memorial for officers killed on duty, the president called him and other officers a “disgrace” and said they had “no feelings.” The court held that these vague statements expressed personal opinion, not actionable fact, and did not misrepresent the basis for that opinion.

The author says their 21-year-old daughter has the skills to become a literature professor but faces extremely scarce full-time faculty jobs. Costs, demographic pressures, generative AI and politics make increased hiring unlikely, while journalism and publishing offer few alternatives. The daughter is interested in librarianship, which the author encourages, and the author asks readers for career advice for talented young people who might otherwise have pursued professorships.

A study examined how a hypothetical 40 percent smaller NIH budget might have affected drug development. It found that more than half of drugs approved from 2000 to 2023 were linked to research that might not have received funding. Fourteen of 557 approved drugs had patents directly citing at-risk NIH grants. Drugs linked to at-risk research were more likely to receive FDA priority review and had a higher average market value than unlinked drugs. The researchers said they could not determine whether particular drugs would have been developed without that funding.

Population growth and rising cereal production are increasing demand for crop protection products. Herbicides dominate the grain and cereal crop protection market, supported by low costs and product development. Crop rotation helps maintain soil nutrients and reduce pest attacks, while excessive use of protection chemicals can harm human health, the environment, and soil productivity. North America is a prominent market, and Asia Pacific is expected to expand rapidly.

The passage describes features of the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 microcontrollers. They offer up to 128KB of zero-wait-state SRAM in two banks, with configurable power control and write-execute protection; up to 93 GPIO pins; configurable pin routing; two 12-bit ADCs; and temperature sensing, voltage-reference, comparator, and DAC peripherals. Security features include AES acceleration, key storage, CRC, firewalls, and a true random number generator. Communication interfaces include UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD. The devices also provide a real-time clock, watchdogs, timers, serial-wire debugging, and a UART- or I2C-based bootloader.

The passage gives application-circuit recommendations, identifies development tools and documentation, and lists changes made in the April 2025 revision. TI states that application designs require customer validation and that its design resources are provided “as is.”
On August 15, 2019, NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K announcing results for the quarter ended July 28, 2019. It furnished a press release and commentary from CFO Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

After her daughter Emilia received months of care at Royal Preston Hospital’s neonatal unit following a premature birth, Kayleigh Gray worked with her employer, Sign Build, to donate 25 pairs of acrylic turtle doves. One dove is intended to stay with a baby on the unit while the other goes home with the parents.

Only 18% of American workers are very confident they are on track for a secure retirement. The passage recommends three checks: estimate retirement income from savings and Social Security, review investment fees, and adjust asset allocation as retirement approaches. It cautions that saving 10% of income may be insufficient, fees can substantially reduce returns, and investments that are too risky or too conservative can undermine retirement income.

The speaker said a shorthanded, second-effort goal was crucial because one goal would not have been enough. As the lower seed, the team knew it needed road wins. The speaker credited key saves and balanced play across four lines, but said the team needed a better first period and should have defended the opponent’s scoring play better.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022, reports third-quarter revenue of $21.45 billion, up from $13.76 billion a year earlier, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.29 billion, up from $1.62 billion. For the first nine months of 2022, revenue was $57.14 billion and operating cash flow was $11.45 billion. At September 30, Tesla reported $74.43 billion in assets and $19.53 billion in cash and cash equivalents. The filing also discusses supply-chain and inflation pressures, an August 2022 three-for-one stock split, debt, stock-based compensation and pending litigation.

An analysis of 2023–2024 campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at 100 top-grossing law firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms found that 92.45% went to Democrats. Democratic-affiliated groups received about $52 million, compared with $4 million for Republican-affiliated groups. The Democratic-to-Republican contribution ratio rose from 6-to-1 in a prior analysis to roughly 12-to-1. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb had the highest Democratic share (99.7%); Nelson Mullins had the lowest (66.4%).

E-mini Russell 2000 Index futures are CME-traded contracts used to speculate on or hedge the performance of U.S. small-cap stocks. Each contract is worth $50 times the index value, trades in quarterly cycles and is cash-settled. The passage describes a strategy around the index’s late-June rebalance; its reported backtest averaged a 1.34% unleveraged gain per trade with a 76% win rate. It also notes that leverage can magnify losses and that interest rates, economic news and component stocks can affect prices.

A Wise Guy Reports study forecasts 4.01% annual growth in the US data center UPS market during 2016–2020. UPS systems provide temporary power during outages and protect data centers from power fluctuations. The report examines centralized, zone-level and rackmount systems, identifying increased outages as a market driver, battery failure as a challenge, and advances in data center infrastructure management as a trend.

Turkey has secured a €974 million loan from international lenders for a central Anatolian highway linking provincial centres and improving access to trade routes. The financing includes environmental and social standards. Officials expect shorter travel times, investment and jobs, though difficult terrain, land disputes and borrowing-cost volatility could delay construction or raise costs.

The speaker says the team must keep its approach and focus on tomorrow night’s chance to win the Stanley Cup. He praises Marian’s contributions, teammates who have stepped into difficult roles, and the support of home fans. He says the players need to manage their excitement, play their best game of the series, and appreciate the unexpected opportunity to compete for the Cup so early in their careers.

Jawed Zia resigned shortly after taking charge of Novartis India and may join rival Abbott India, according to sources. Novartis has not named a replacement and faces a price-collusion investigation involving its diabetes drug Galvus.

The Florida appellate court affirmed AHCA’s dismissal of Glenwood Nursing Center’s request for an administrative hearing. Glenwood filed its request one day after the June 14, 2010, deadline. The court held that AHCA counsel’s agreement to accept a late filing, made after the deadline expired, did not justify equitable tolling. Glenwood’s earlier letter to the federal agency CMS did not constitute a hearing request to AHCA because it was not filed with AHCA’s agency clerk. AHCA’s order also revoked Glenwood’s nursing home license and imposed a $25,000 fine.

The Board of Regents voted unanimously to let special-education students who struggle with academic exams earn local diplomas through an alternative route without meeting minimum English and math Regents exam scores. Students must meet occupational credential requirements, and their district superintendent must determine that they are academically proficient. A temporary provision offers another route for some students graduating in 2017–19. Adopted on an emergency basis, the plan could apply to students graduating as early as January. Parents welcomed the change, while critics questioned its speed and warned it could revive separate academic tracks.

The DAWN protocol proposes a randomized study of convalescent plasma for hospitalized adults with SARS-CoV-2. Antibodies in the plasma might speed viral clearance, but its effectiveness is uncertain and it could worsen ARDS.

The passage explains how to deploy Mattermost, a self-hosted messaging platform, on CentOS 7 using MariaDB and Nginx as an SSL reverse proxy. It covers creating the database and system user, installing and testing Mattermost, configuring a systemd service and Nginx, then creating an administrator account and team. It also describes setting the site URL, enabling email notifications, and restarting the service.

The passage describes wood-type golf club heads with raised, more curved sole portions intended to increase stiffness, reduce mass, and improve acoustics. Embodiments may use lightweight crown and sole inserts, cantilevered perimeter ledges, channels, ribs, and adjustable weights. The saved mass can be redistributed to adjust the center of gravity and moment of inertia, with the aim of improving forgiveness and ball flight.

The passage presents ten backtested swing trading strategies involving the S&P 500, Nasdaq, ETFs, rotation, and moving averages. It defines swing trading as holding positions for days to weeks and recommends backtesting, verifying strategies independently, starting small, and risking only money one can afford to lose. It describes buy-and-hold investing as a cornerstone of savings and suggests swing trading can complement it. The passage says a 200-day moving average can reduce major drawdowns but may produce whipsaw trades and underperform buy-and-hold. It estimates realistic swing trading returns at 5–20%, says most swing traders are unsuccessful, and notes that some strategies and code require a paid subscription.

Federal regulators fined Altaba, formerly Yahoo, $35 million for failing to disclose a 2014 data breach affecting hundreds of millions of accounts until 2016. The SEC said Yahoo failed to properly investigate the breach and left investors uninformed.

A withdrawn, non-peer-reviewed preprint compared six machine-learning models for pancreatic cancer diagnosis using a synthetic dataset. Test accuracy ranged from 76.05% to 76.35%, but sensitivity was poor: Random Forest and Decision Tree detected no positive cases, while SVM had the highest sensitivity at 1.90%. SuperLearner had the highest precision, 66.67%, but only 0.42% sensitivity. The authors identify class imbalance as a major limitation and recommend further optimization and validation with real-world clinical data.

U.S. Treasury yields rose Monday as easing U.S.-North Korea tensions prompted investors to move from government debt into riskier assets. The 10-year yield climbed to about 2.22% from a six-week low Friday. The two-year yield rose to 1.314%, after softer July inflation data had reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase by year-end.

RTX Neural Faces uses a real-time generative AI model to make rasterized faces look more natural. It takes a face and 3D pose data as input and is trained on images showing varied angles, lighting, emotions, and occlusions.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. During overcurrent, the controllers first limit current cycle by cycle, then stop switching and attempt a soft-start restart; the CHICC capacitor sets both timing periods. The FAULT pin supports external protections, while thermal shutdown stops switching above 175°C typical and restarts the power-up sequence below 160°C typical. Slope compensation addresses instability at duty cycles above 50%, and Type 2A or Type 2B frequency compensation can be used.

The passage details a 500-kHz, 5-V synchronous push-pull GaN converter example, including component selection for timing, current sensing, protection, filtering and compensation. It also recommends a regulated 4–14-V controller supply with bypassing and PCB layout practices that separate noisy power paths from sensitive control signals.

Since Churchill’s rail line washed out in spring 2017, 30 families have left the 900-person community amid job losses and rising food and fuel costs. The town’s only school has lost about 40 students, prompting concerns about teaching jobs. There is no timeline for repairing the rail line.

Salesforce announced plans to invest more than $2.2 billion in its French business over five years, expanding staff, real estate and data center capacity. The announcement coincided with President Emmanuel Macron’s state visit to Washington.

A 11Alive study reported that the CDC cut more than $700,000, mostly from HIV prevention funding, in 2016 while spending millions on a failed project. Public health researchers described high HIV levels in Atlanta and said limited healthcare access, costly prevention medication, and stigma can delay testing until the disease has advanced. A Georgia State campaign aims to increase student testing, while a proposed state bill would add HIV/AIDS to conditions covered by medical marijuana.

Research by the Cinnamon Network found that more than 3,500 churches and 200,000 volunteers support health and social care initiatives amid NHS funding and resource pressures. Its report examined 32 church-led projects addressing issues including mental health, obesity and social isolation. Parish nursing, one such project, provides patients with support through nurses recruited by churches. More than 100 parish nurses work with 85 UK churches, with another 100 expected within 18 months. Parish Nursing’s chief executive said the nurses offer preventative care and support rather than replace NHS staff.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2017 reports revenue of $22.09 billion and net income of $4.80 billion, up from $20.53 billion and $3.76 billion a year earlier. Nine-month revenue was $66.63 billion, with net income of $14.69 billion. Microsoft completed its $27.0 billion acquisition of LinkedIn in December 2016; LinkedIn contributed $975 million in quarterly revenue. The report also notes growth in Office 365 commercial and Azure revenue, while Surface revenue declined.

An IDC survey of 200 manufacturing decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland examines how simulation, modeling, data analysis, and high-performance computing (HPC) support product and process development. Respondents identify innovation, faster development, and improved quality as key goals, but report data silos, limited computing capacity, and outdated or inaccurate simulations as challenges. Four in five regard HPC as a game changer for innovation. More than a quarter already use professional HPC infrastructure, while another 39% are planning or piloting it.

Columbiana scored twice in the final 23 seconds to beat Lisbon 49-47 in girls basketball. Alexis Cross tied the game before Kayla Muslovski’s steal and layup secured the win. Both scored 14 points for the undefeated Clippers, who improved to 5-0 overall and 3-0 in league play. Izzy Perez led Lisbon with 17 points. Columbiana also won the junior varsity game 33-23.
According to Alexa, Reddit surpassed Facebook as the third most visited site in the US, behind Google and YouTube. Visitors spend more time daily on Reddit than on Facebook.

The BCCI would oppose replacing the 2021 Champions Trophy in India with a World T20, saying the change could cost it and its stakeholders about $30 million. The proposal may be discussed at ICC Board meetings in Kolkata. The ICC also revised India’s 2019 World Cup schedule after the BCCI moved the IPL earlier to allow a 15-day gap before the tournament. India is scheduled to open against South Africa on June 5 and play Pakistan on June 16.

A thunderstorm dropped hail across northern Mississippi on Monday as 29 million people in the Southeast faced a threat of severe weather. Forecasters warned of damaging winds, large hail and possible strong tornadoes, particularly in northern Alabama. Some schools in Alabama and Tennessee closed early, and Birmingham city offices closed at noon.

Suspected jihadists killed at least 18 people and wounded several in an overnight attack on a restaurant in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Security forces killed both attackers and freed people trapped inside. Officials said the death toll was provisional as the operation continued.

Crude sulfate turpentine is a flammable, water-insoluble byproduct of the Kraft process containing terpene hydrocarbons, chiefly alpha-pinene and beta-pinene, and sulfur compounds. It is used in fragrances, flavors, paint thinning, varnishes, and chemical synthesis. High distillation costs and limited black liquor retrieval may constrain its market growth.

The passage proposes iMOOE for forecasting partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics in unseen conditions without test-time adaptation. It models two proposed invariances: the physical operators governing a system and how those operators combine with parameters and forcing terms. Its mixture of operator experts is trained with prediction, cross-environment risk-equality, and frequency-focused losses. Across five simulated systems and sea surface temperature data, the authors report better zero-shot forecasting than the compared methods. They note that validation covers a limited range of dynamical systems.

Indian stocks gave up most of their early-week gains, with the Nifty closing down 0.3%, although mid- and small-cap indexes rose about 1.5%. Investors were unsettled by potential U.S. trade barriers, interest-rate increases, political developments and the RBI’s discontinuation of certain trade-credit instruments. Tata Sons’ TCS stake sale, grounded IndiGo aircraft and another Punjab National Bank fraud drew attention. February wholesale and retail inflation eased, while January industrial production grew 7.5%. Markets will watch the coming week’s Federal Reserve and Bank of England decisions.
The team is focused on winning each shift and period rather than worrying about the outcome. Players see the chance to win the Cup as an opportunity they must seize.

The passage describes a learning health system playbook for evaluating EHR-integrated Ambient AI, a clinical documentation tool. Its alpha phase involved 20 providers and identified workflow, consent, and coding challenges. A revised note template restored documentation accuracy after it fell from 79% to 35%, while an automated coding review system was developed to reduce manual work. A 24-week, stepped-wedge randomized trial involving 66 providers began in October 2024 to evaluate effects on provider well-being.

The Utah Court of Appeals affirmed summary judgment against Kari Baumann in her healthcare malpractice suit against Kroger and Dr. Tayler. Baumann missed the deadline to disclose expert witnesses, and the district court found no good cause for the failure. The appeals court held that rule 26 permitted exclusion of her late Kroger expert report and declined to consider her unpreserved argument about a report concerning Dr. Tayler.

The lecture examines how interactions shape ultracold Bose gases. For a homogeneous condensate, the Bogoliubov approximation reduces the interacting Hamiltonian to noninteracting quasiparticles. Their dispersion is linear at low momentum and quadratic at high momentum; sound propagation and two-laser spectroscopy can probe these excitations. Interactions also cause quantum depletion, which is small in dilute atomic condensates but large in liquid helium.

For trapped, inhomogeneous condensates, the Gross–Pitaevskii equation describes the macroscopic wave function. Interactions flatten the density, while the healing length characterizes where it changes to meet boundary conditions, including at vortex cores. The equation also describes condensate expansion.

In optical lattices, reduced kinetic energy makes strong-interaction effects accessible. The Bose–Hubbard model balances tunneling against on-site repulsion: tunneling favors a superfluid, while dominant repulsion produces a Mott insulator with definite particle numbers at lattice sites. A mean-field calculation maps the transition, which can be observed through expansion patterns or quantum gas microscopy.

A Northamptonshire couple walked the remaining two minutes home after police stopped their wedding car driver for speeding without insurance. They remained in high spirits and took a selfie with the officer.

The study evaluates DSCHECKER, which uses API documentation and runtime data information to help large language models detect and fix Python data science API misuses. On a dataset of 38 misuses and 38 correct examples, its best configuration achieved a 61.18% detection F1-score and fixed 51.28% of misuses. It also detected misuses in deep learning libraries and outperformed a prior tool on the data science dataset. An agent version that retrieves information on demand achieved a 48.65% detection F1-score and a 39.47% fix rate.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs, including GA102 and GA104, improve on Turing with doubled peak FP32 processing per streaming multiprocessor, second-generation RT Cores and third-generation Tensor Cores. The passage describes faster ray tracing, hardware-accelerated motion blur, structured sparsity for AI workloads, and larger L1 cache and shared memory capacity. GA102 powers the GeForce RTX 3090 and 3080, RTX A6000 and A40; GA104 powers the RTX 3070.

Other features include GDDR6X memory on selected GeForce models, PCIe 4.0, RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression, support for high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and NVENC video encoding. The RTX A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB by connecting two GPUs with NVLink.

The president returns the debt-refunding bill to the House, objecting chiefly to section 5, which would generally require banks to use 3 percent bonds as security for their notes and public deposits. He argues that this would discourage new banks, hinder existing ones, and threaten the national banking system and economic prosperity. He supports prompt debt refunding to reduce interest payments and urges Congress to pass another measure before adjournment.

A study of 2,066 18-year-old twins in England and Wales found that loneliness was associated with twice the likelihood of mental health problems and a 38% higher risk of unemployment. Lonely participants were also more likely to smoke and not exercise. The passage says teenagers and young adults are particularly prone to loneliness, while social media’s effects depend on how it is used. Researchers said the findings underscore the importance of early intervention.

The goalie says Detroit’s three goals in the last game came from strong shots, though he wishes he had been better positioned and hopes to stop similar chances next time. He expects an intense crowd at the next game and says scoring first, maintaining momentum and limiting mistakes will be crucial. He says his family understands the demands of playoff hockey. He also calls facing Dominik, another European goalie, special, while emphasizing that winning the series matters most.

Rams Coach Sean McVay said Todd Gurley will get more preseason carries, with his workload increasing through the third game, to prepare for the Sept. 10 opener against the Colts. Gurley gained two yards on four carries and caught a 10-yard pass against Dallas. McVay said the team will balance Gurley’s need for work in a new system with managing his workload.

Rice University and the Houston Museum of Natural Science expanded their long-running space-science outreach partnership for the 2023–2024 Heliophysics “Big Year.” They distributed eclipse animations and the planetarium show *Totality*, trained teachers, published eclipse activities and safety guidance, and distributed nearly a million eclipse viewers. Reported attendance for *Totality* exceeded 180,000, while live teacher programs reached 5,104 educators.

The partnership also helped coordinate Citizen CATE 2024, which trained community teams to observe the April 2024 total eclipse. More than 80% of its teams observed some or all of totality, and analysis of their data continues. The passage reports more than 250,000 documented views across outreach venues and an estimated total reach exceeding 1.5 million people.

Steven Kean forwarded articles on California’s electricity crisis, noting that the first cited a 1946 Nebraska case relevant to federal approval of the state’s proposed purchase of utility transmission lines. The articles report opposition to that plan, forecasts of summer power shortages, a review of electricity rates, and new long-term power contracts. They also describe a state grid operator’s claim that suppliers overcharged by $562 million, calls for debt forgiveness or temporary price caps, and PG&E’s decision to pay only part of its outstanding power bills.

Camera-trap footage from a Malaysian durian orchard shows that island flying foxes pollinate durian flowers while feeding on nectar, rather than damaging them as previously thought. The study found their visits improved durian reproductive success. Researchers say the finding highlights bats’ value to crops and the importance of conservation, as island flying fox populations are declining and the species is endangered in Malaysia.

A study of 2,480 men followed for an average of 22 years found that those with the highest blood levels of linoleic acid, an omega-6 fatty acid, had a 43% lower risk of premature death than those with the lowest levels. Higher levels were also linked to fewer cardiovascular deaths, but not fewer cancer deaths. Linoleic acid is found in vegetable oils, nuts and seeds.

Ventura police will review their response to earlier reports about a man charged with fatally stabbing a restaurant patron. Residents criticized officials’ handling of homelessness and mental illness.

Mitch Larkin is considering adding the individual medley to his Commonwealth Games trials program after winning the 400m event at the Queensland titles. He says backstroke remains his priority as he seeks to return to world-class form following his Rio Olympics results. After changing coaches and a difficult year, Larkin says his motivation has renewed.

The study uses [11C]carfentanil PET to investigate mu-opioid receptors throughout the human body, extending earlier imaging largely limited to the brain. It also examines the aorta and muscle as potential reference regions. Healthy adults aged 18–45 underwent MRI and 90-minute dynamic whole-body PET scanning. Researchers analyzed selected brain regions, calculated distribution volume ratios, and planned to assess receptor occupancy after naloxone pretreatment.

Canon’s EOS M6 replaces the M3 with an optional viewfinder, a 24.2-megapixel sensor and a flip-up touchscreen. Scheduled for April 2017, it starts at $780 for the body. The passage argues that cheaper Sony models offer similar features, making the M6’s higher price hard to justify.

The professor revisits least-squares duality, showing that optimal solutions satisfy \(b=Ax+w\), and poses a related rectangle-geometry proof. The lecture then examines inverse problems, where small measurement errors can cause large changes in a solution. Examples include estimating velocity from noisy positions, reconstructing Earth or tissue density, identifying obstacles from scattering, and assessing gene importance. Integral equations provide a framework for many such problems; adding a multiple of the identity can improve stability. For noisy least-squares data, Tikhonov regularization adds a penalty proportional to the squared solution size. Its parameter must balance noise sensitivity against excessive smoothing; the professor presents a choice proportional to the noise level raised to the \(2/3\) power.

On Aug. 21, a total solar eclipse will cross the United States from Oregon to South Carolina, the first coast-to-coast crossing in 99 years. Totality will pass through 14 states, lasting up to two minutes and 44 seconds at any one location. NASA and other researchers will study and broadcast the event, while communities along the route plan celebrations and expect large crowds. Viewers will need eye protection before and after totality. A partial eclipse will be visible across a wider area of North and Central America.

An IDC survey of 200 manufacturing decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland found growing use of simulation, modeling, and data analysis to support innovation, quality, and faster development. The paper identifies high-performance computing (HPC) as a way to run more complex calculations faster; 81% of respondents view it as a game changer for product and process innovation. Key challenges include security, cost, energy use, limited computing capacity, and expertise. Many HPC users favor external infrastructure, while cloud-based architectures offer greater scalability and flexibility than fixed in-house systems.

Douglas Haig, 55, was charged with manufacturing and selling armor-piercing ammunition without a license, allegedly including a sale to Stephen Paddock before the October 1 Las Vegas shooting. Investigators found cartridges bearing Haig’s fingerprints and ammunition with tool marks consistent with his equipment in Paddock’s hotel rooms. Paddock killed 58 concert-goers, wounded hundreds and then killed himself. Haig was released on bail pending a hearing.

Colorado coach Deion Sanders was scheduled for a procedure after experiencing leg pain he believes is related to recurring blood clots. He hopes to return to practice the next day and coach Saturday against Iowa State. Sanders said the condition is hereditary; he has previously undergone blood clot procedures and was treated for bladder cancer over the summer.

Additive energy counts pairs of representations of the same sum. Small doubling implies large additive energy by Cauchy–Schwarz, but the converse fails: a structured subset can supply high energy even when the whole set has large doubling. The Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers theorem instead guarantees that a set with large additive energy contains a large subset with small doubling, with polynomial losses in the parameters.

The lecture proves a two-set version through a graphical theorem. Popular sums produce a dense bipartite graph with a small restricted sumset. Dependent random choice and degree-trimming yield large subsets whose every cross-pair is connected by many paths of length three. Each path expresses the pair’s sum using three elements of the restricted sumset, bounding the unrestricted sumset.

Researchers at Rockefeller University kept a tiny slice of gerbil cochlea alive and functional outside the body, allowing them to observe how hair cells amplify sound. They found direct evidence that a mechanical instability called a Hopf bifurcation contributes to this process in mammals. The device may help researchers study hearing loss and explore potential treatments.

Oncosec Medical shares fell 12.71% in the most recent session, closing at $1.58. Three analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $5.33, ranging from $5 to $6, and three rated the stock Outperform. Its 14-period average true range was 0.15, and its relative strength index was 33.61. The company’s market capitalization was $54.72 million. Trading volume reached 4.56 million shares, compared with an average of about 2.4 million.

NVIDIA’s Ampere architecture adds BF16, TF32 and FP64 Tensor Core formats. On A100, FP16 and BF16 provide 16 times FP32’s math throughput. TF32 accelerates AI training by default while reading FP32 data and producing FP32 output.

The passage describes memory arrays with alternating tiers of insulating material and memory cells. Each cell has a transistor with a horizontally oriented channel and a capacitor connected to one source/drain region. Vertical structures can connect capacitor electrodes and the other source/drain regions across tiers. The passage also describes alternative cell arrangements and an example manufacturing process.

The XPIC clears an interrupt request bit late, causing two CPU interrupts instead of one when AEOI is enabled. AEOI applies only to the master PIC and should not be used when nested multilevel interrupts are needed.

The passage describes an automated system that retrieves storage and destination bins and uses a programmable robotic device to move selected objects between them according to a manifest. Gantry systems and conveyors move bins to and from processing locations. A perception system identifies potential grasp points, favoring accessible, flat surfaces and approaches suited to the end effector; recorded grasp outcomes may improve future selections. Embodiments include separate or intermingled bin areas, shared gantries, multiple processing stations, and multiple floors. Computer systems track bin identities and locations and coordinate their movement.
Each digital I/O pin uses a PINCM register to select its function. IOMUX permits one digital function per pin; simultaneous non-IOMUX signals must not contend.

The Louisiana Supreme Court declined to consider Arthur Rhodes’s untimely writ. His post-conviction denial is final, and further state collateral review requires an exception permitting a successive application.

In Pittsburgh, President Biden proposed the roughly $2 trillion American Jobs Plan, spread largely over eight years. He said it would create jobs by investing in transportation, clean energy, water pipes, broadband, housing, care services, and research and development, while supporting unions and communities left behind. He proposed paying for it through corporate tax changes and stronger enforcement, with no federal tax increase for people earning under $400,000. He called for bipartisan cooperation to pass the plan.

The speaker said the team created chances but could not score a third goal. After an unsettled start, it recovered quickly and played with energy, speed and territorial control. The speaker praised its defense against the opponent’s play below the goal line while noting Burns’s offensive threat. Looking ahead, the team plans to manage its emotions, follow its routines and focus on the next task. The speaker also praised Sid’s consistent impact, Geno’s improving play, Sergei’s work with the defense and Matt’s influence on and off the ice.

The passage describes bear markets as shorter and more volatile than bull markets, though prices can take years to recover. It argues that lower prices can benefit long-term buyers, while increased volatility can create opportunities for traders. During the 2000–2003 bear market, the dividend-adjusted S&P 500 fell 45%. The Nasdaq fell more than 80% and took 15 years to recover.

The President said 653 troops, excluding marines, were stationed in Washington to support civil authorities and preserve order around the inauguration. A House committee found no proof of a secret organization planning an attack or disruption, but the House declined to call for the troops’ removal. The President said widespread alarm and rumors justified precautions to protect public property, government archives, the city, and the inauguration. He reported that fears subsided after the first troops arrived.

To attract investors, startup owners should explain the potential return on investment and consider how much equity they are willing to offer. They should present themselves and their team confidently, show evidence of market traction, and identify opportunities that distinguish the business. A detailed plan should support financial projections and address competition, market risks, and the consequences of missing forecasts.

Microsoft Corporation’s July 20, 2017 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2017. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

β-Ga₂O₃ has promising electronic properties but low thermal conductivity complicates device cooling. Using a first-principles-trained machine-learning potential and phonon transport calculations, the study compares uniform strain with strain gradients in thin films and nanowires. In 10-nm films at 300 K, a 0.6%/nm uniaxial gradient reduces thermal conductivity by 31.8–36.6%; a biaxial gradient reduces it by up to 43.3%. These reductions exceed those from the corresponding uniform tensile strains. Gradients increase phonon scattering while changing thermal anisotropy much less than uniform strain, making them important to account for in device thermal modeling.

Hong Kong stocks ended slightly higher Wednesday, with the Hang Seng up 0.2% and the China Enterprises Index up 0.1%. Gains in Tencent, shipping and banking shares offset property-sector weakness. Tighter property curbs and a Moody’s warning underscored risks from a potential downturn.

UCLA researchers found that lactate production helps activate hair follicle stem cells in mice: blocking lactate production prevented activation, while increasing it accelerated the hair cycle. Two drugs applied to mouse skin, RCGD423 and UK5099, promoted lactate production and quicker hair growth through different mechanisms. The findings could inform treatments for hair loss, but the drugs have been tested only preclinically, not in humans, and are not FDA-approved.

Colgate-Palmolive’s outlook has improved, with analysts expecting revenue and profit growth and Argus raising its stock price target. The company has increased its dividend annually since 1964. However, the author remains cautious: e-commerce gives smaller producers access to customers, weakening the shelf-space advantage of large consumer-products companies. Despite Colgate’s loyal customers and improved results, the author considers its valuation too high given the competitive threat.

European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker said India’s 5.7% GDP growth was strong compared with Europe’s 2%, despite domestic criticism. The World Bank called India’s slowdown temporary, while BJP leader Yashwant Sinha urged the government to address economic concerns.

This excerpt of the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 data sheet describes the DEBUGSS, which connects the SWD interface to processor and device debugging, a software mailbox, peripheral debug controls, and security features. It identifies a read-only FACTORY region containing device identification, capabilities, and trim data. Application guidance recommends nearby VDD decoupling capacitors, an external NRST resistor and capacitor, and pullups for certain open-drain I/O uses. The excerpt also lists development resources, explains experimental versus production device prefixes, summarizes September 2025 revisions, and provides packaging, assembly, ordering, ESD, and legal notices.

Officials raised the AJC Peachtree Road Race alert to Code Red, urging runners to slow down, follow instructions and consider stopping. Forecasters expected a dry morning with temperatures in the upper 80s.

Brea police are using a two-seat electric vehicle to patrol The Tracks at Brea trail and the downtown entertainment district. Purchased for about $21,000 with Air Quality Management District funds, it travels up to 25 mph and 98 miles per charge.

The shallow cross concept pairs a 10–12-yard basic route with a shallow drag from the opposite direction, forcing linebackers to account for both. It offers the quarterback underneath options against pressure and works well against man, Tampa 2, and Cover 4, but is less effective against Cover 3. Receivers keep moving against man coverage and may settle in open areas against zone. The quarterback reads downfield first, then progresses through the post, drag, basic, and running back checkdown, moving to the drag and basic sooner under pressure. Bunch and empty-set variations provide additional options.

On Aug. 21, Columbia and the Midlands will be in the path of totality as the moon fully covers the sun, briefly darkening the day. Hundreds of thousands of visitors are expected. WIS will air a special at 7:30 p.m.

The lecture introduces discrete source coding within a digital communication system that uses a binary interface. Source coding converts inputs into symbols through sampling and quantization, then encodes those symbols as bits; the discussion assumes a reliable binary channel. Fixed-length coding needs ⌈log₂ m⌉ bits for an alphabet of m symbols, while coding longer blocks approaches log₂ m bits per symbol. Variable-length coding can assign shorter code words to more probable symbols, but the resulting bit stream must remain uniquely decodable. Prefix-free codes provide immediate decoding, and the Kraft inequality determines which code-word lengths permit them. The lecture closes by introducing discrete memoryless sources, whose symbols are independently selected using the same probability distribution.

BG Group agreed to buy Enron’s offshore Indian oil and gas assets for $388 million, including stakes in the Tapti and Panna/Mukta fields and the CB-OS/1 exploration block. The deal requires Indian government approval and agreement from other stakeholders that BG can operate the fields; ONGC is also seeking that role. Separately, Enron was seeking to sell its stake in the troubled Dabhol Power Project, whose operating company had defaulted on a $24 million interest payment to Indian lenders.

Learning assessment in noncredit continuing education receives less attention than assessment in credit-bearing programs, with satisfaction surveys more common than direct measures of learning. The authors recommend clear, measurable outcomes suited to course length and learners’ prior knowledge. They propose adding learning-focused self-report and quiz questions to surveys and evaluating learners’ work or performances directly. Assessments should be practical, fair, and aligned with outcomes. The authors report using results to improve courses, document their quality, and support requests for resources; they also suggest digital credentials as a way to motivate learners.

The lecture reviews how a Markov chain’s transient and recurrent blocks determine its eigenvalues. It then models state rewards, expected aggregate rewards, and long-run gain. To calculate expected time to reach a state, it makes that state a zero-reward trapping state and solves linear equations. Finally, it introduces dynamic programming: decisions affect both immediate rewards and transition probabilities, and an optimal finite-horizon policy is found by working backward from a final reward.

The lecture examines the business case for green buildings through the incentives of tenants, owners, and developers. Tenants’ willingness to pay can raise rents and building values, while operating costs, financing costs, and risks may fall. Developers must weigh a potential higher sale price against construction costs. Evidence cited shows average rent and sale-price premiums, but results vary widely, and operating-cost findings are inconclusive.

Using Millennium Partners’ projects, the lecturer illustrates how a developer’s priorities can change with market and city needs. The lecture then introduces market failures, focusing on information asymmetry: buyers may not recognize green-building benefits or distinguish genuine performance from greenwashing. A Chinese survey found that providing information increased respondents’ stated willingness to pay. Certification is presented as a way to help buyers identify green buildings.

The patent application describes a method for managing uplink power in high-frequency communications. A first communication node, such as user equipment, reports power parameters or uplink channel state information to a second node, such as a base station. The reports may include maximum power reduction, power headroom, duty cycle, and beam or reference-signal information. The base station uses this information to schedule uplink transmissions while reducing maximum power exposure to the human body. The application also describes reporting triggers, virtual power-headroom reports, and corresponding devices and storage media.

Bill Purswell’s conviction for transporting intoxicating liquor, with a one-year prison sentence, was affirmed. Officers testified that they saw him carrying a jug of whiskey on another person’s property. The court held that Purswell could not challenge a search of premises he did not possess and that the officers’ evidence was admissible because they observed conduct warranting his arrest. His general objection to the jury charge was insufficient. On rehearing, the court rejected his unsupported claim that jurors considered his failure to testify.

Firefly Aerospace shares fell nearly 21% after its Alpha Flight 7 rocket exploded during a test at its Briggs, Texas, facility. The company said all personnel were safe and no other facilities were affected. Its shares have declined more than 50% since last month’s Nasdaq debut.

Power is a gap run play built around a pulling backside guard, a kickout block and double teams that create blocking angles at the point of attack. It can be run from many formations and can suit smaller offensive lines when they execute those angles well. Its main weakness is backside pursuit or penetration, especially through the gap left by the pulling guard. Against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, blocking assignments differ, but both approaches use a pulling guard to block a playside linebacker and a fullback to kick out the edge defender. Variations include a fullhouse formation and a shotgun run-pass option.

The court affirmed the denial of Dairylea Cooperative’s application to quash a grand jury subpoena for corporate records. It found that the appeal was permissible and that the Attorney-General had authority to issue the subpoena following a request from the Commissioner of Agriculture and Markets.

An Enron email forwards a Texas Monthly article tracing the company’s rise from a pipeline business to a dominant energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. The article describes how aggressive hiring, bonuses and employee rankings fostered competition and short-term profit seeking. It attributes Enron’s falling stock price to troubled projects, the collapse of its telecommunications ambitions, criticism over California’s energy crisis and questions about its accounting. Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, and Lay returned, promising a narrower business focus and changes to the company’s culture.

The passage describes LTE sidelink communication and an autonomous resource-selection method for transmitting data, particularly vehicular messages. A transmitting device senses resource reservations and potentially signal energy before data becomes available, then selects resources within a transmission window. It prefers primary subframes, for which sensing information is complete, over secondary subframes, for which transmissions prevented some sensing. Candidates may be ranked by delay and predicted energy. The method can also select resources for scheduling assignments and indicate resources reserved for future transmissions.
South Dakota’s Board of Regents directed staff and university officials to prepare a plan to close Pierre’s Capital University Center for its October meeting. The regents did not vote on closure.

The commentary says municipal credit quality may begin to weaken, though municipal bonds remain a relatively safe asset class often viewed as a flight to quality. It notes that the Fed cut short-term rates in September amid slowing job growth and mixed inflation readings, while many municipalities received upgrades for stronger reserves.

An October 29, 2001 collection of news reports says Moody’s downgraded Enron’s long-term debt to Baa2, two notches above junk, and warned of further cuts. Enron’s shares fell sharply as it sought additional bank credit after drawing about $3 billion the previous week. Disclosures about partnerships involving former CFO Andrew Fastow prompted an SEC inquiry and shareholder lawsuits, while some European energy firms restricted trading with Enron over credit concerns. A separate Moody’s report warned that U.S. corporate credit quality was likely to worsen.

Lorna Gibson introduces a course on cellular materials, including honeycombs, foams, bone, tissue-engineering scaffolds, wood and other natural structures. The course will examine how their structure and processing affect stiffness, strength, failure and applications such as sandwich panels, energy absorption and insulation. Students will complete open-ended projects in pairs. Gibson describes examples of cellular structures in medicine and nature, then outlines ways to make honeycombs and polymer and metal foams.

Newcomers to Canada can prepare for a job search by looking for opportunities before arriving, using career workshops to improve skills and build a network, and considering internships or volunteer work for experience. They should also check whether their credentials need updating and improve their English or French proficiency if needed.

The passage says anecdotal evidence suggests goals are more common during certain five-minute periods: at the start of each half, after goals or significant incidents, near halftime and full time, and at the start and near the end of extra time. It attributes this pattern largely to players’ mental readiness, urgency and reactions to scoring. Coaches are urged to prepare teams for these periods and prevent complacency or discouragement after a goal.

Treetops is a care home near Keynsham town centre for elderly people with dementia. It has three family-sized units, communal spaces, individual care support, a family support group and activities. The listing advises checking whether the home suits individual needs.

The passage argues that Arctic security education should use systems thinking to address the interconnected environmental, geopolitical, economic, and sociocultural challenges of a rapidly changing region. Its proposed model combines interdisciplinary analysis, identification of leverage points, and active learning and assessment through simulations, case studies, reflection, and competency measures. Designed for online graduate education, the framework aims to help professionals anticipate cascading effects, adapt decisions, and develop sustainable security strategies.

The justices debated whether Delaware’s requirements for initiating medical malpractice lawsuits should apply in federal court. Justices Kagan, Jackson and Sotomayor raised concerns that the requirements conflict with federal procedures, while Gorsuch questioned whether courts could apply only parts of the state law. Several other justices said little, leaving the court’s likely ruling unclear.

After meeting Trudeau, Trump said US-Canada trade issues were less severe than those with Mexico and called for tweaks rather than an overhaul. USD/CAD fell despite lower crude prices. The pound led currencies while the euro lagged. Markets next awaited Yellen’s testimony, Chinese inflation data and a speech by Kuroda.

An exploratory study evaluated the usability of eight retail and booking websites operating in Saudi Arabia. Sixty-five trained students assessed navigation, design and content through a questionnaire. Most ratings were positive, but respondents identified problems with internal navigation, inconsistent Arabic–English interfaces, layouts, icon labels, contact information, sitemaps and last-update dates. The author recommends user-centered design improvements and further study, noting that the small sample of evaluators and websites limits generalizability.

DAWN-PLASMA was a phase 2, multicenter, open-label trial comparing standard care plus convalescent plasma with standard care alone in adults hospitalized with COVID-19. Participants were randomized 2:1. The primary endpoint was the proportion alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15; secondary endpoints included clinical status, ventilation, safety and quality of life. Plasma recipients received 800–1,000 mL in four units. Patients already receiving mechanical ventilation were excluded. Five participants withdrew consent and one failed screening before intervention; all six were replaced, and none were lost to follow-up after intervention. The study followed ethics and good clinical practice requirements.
The speaker says the team must battle to the net for pucks, get shots past a big goalie, and, after two days to regroup from a disappointing loss, try to score first tonight.

The creed urges soccer players to stay aware of the ball and other players, communicate with teammates and coaches, move to support play, and give their best effort. It also calls for learning from mistakes, following the rules, reporting injuries, and treating teammates and opponents with respect and sportsmanship.

Bank of Canada senior deputy governor Carolyn Wilkins expects household debt relative to disposable income to stabilize and gradually decline as credit growth slows and labour income rises. The ratio was 170.4 per cent in late 2017, just below its record peak. The central bank remains concerned about debt as it raises interest rates; governor Stephen Poloz said high debt loads have likely made households more sensitive to rate changes.

Blair’s $250,000 bond to buy three buses failed despite receiving 111 votes in favor and 80 against, falling short of the required 60% approval. Other Southwest Oklahoma voters decided municipal and school board races.

In a May 1980 interview, Ronald Reagan questioned the President’s response to a failed mission and called a possible Iranian move toward the Soviet camp a serious threat. Accepting the Republican presidential nomination in July, he pledged to make Americans’ safety his top priority, pursue peace through negotiation, and maintain national strength. In a later address, he told veterans that military preparedness helps preserve peace and warned that America’s margin of safety was disappearing.

Effective basketball press breaks rely on preparation, teamwork and recognizing the press’s weaknesses. Players should spread the floor, advance the ball with crisp passes, attack through the middle and exploit outnumbered situations while protecting the ball and maintaining defensive balance. Clear roles, coordinated timing and accurate inbound and outlet passes help prevent confusion. The passage recommends teaching these skills through progressive drills and game-speed practice against strong defense, then using them consistently so players are ready for pressure throughout a game.

With Jake Browning filling in for Joe Burrow and throwing five interceptions in three games, a writer suggested former Bengals starter Andy Dalton as a possible outside option. Dalton, now a Panthers backup signed through 2026, previously played under Bengals coach Zac Taylor. No trade was reported.

The Pennsylvania Supreme Court affirmed an order requiring the Department of Education to process the First School’s application for aid under Act 109. It held that *Lemon v. Kurtzman* invalidated the Act only as applied to sectarian nonpublic schools. The Act remained enforceable for nonsectarian nonpublic schools because that application was severable, served the Act’s legislative purpose, and had not been impliedly repealed by later laws. The court also held that determining whether a school is sectarian or nonsectarian does not create unconstitutional entanglement between government and religion.

The ADS868xW uses separate AVDD supplies for internal circuits and DVDD for its digital interface. Supply decoupling improves power-supply rejection. NAP and power-down modes reduce consumption at lower throughput rates; power-down disables analog blocks while retaining register contents and an active interface. PCB guidance calls for separating analog signals from digital lines, using nearby bypass and reference capacitors, and providing short ground connections. The passage also covers documentation updates, support resources, ESD precautions, revision history, packaging information, and TI’s terms and disclaimers.

The study demonstrates selective control of three nitrogen-15 nuclear spins neighboring boron-vacancy defects in isotope-enriched hexagonal boron nitride. Electron–nuclear hyperfine coupling separates nuclear-spin transitions and enhances their measured Rabi frequency by about 116 times relative to isolated nitrogen-15 spins. Nuclear-spin Rabi coherence lasts about 12 µs, but optical pumping depolarizes the spins within 1 µs. The authors identify these spins as a potential resource for quantum sensing and other quantum applications.

Tesla Motors’ Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2016 reported revenue of $1.27 billion, up from $955.0 million a year earlier, and a net loss of $293.2 million, compared with $184.2 million. Gross margin fell from 22.3% to 21.6%. Tesla produced 18,345 vehicles during the quarter and continued ramping Model X production.

At June 30, Tesla held $3.25 billion in cash and cash equivalents and $679.8 million in customer deposits, primarily reflecting Model 3 deposits. It raised approximately $1.7 billion through a May stock offering. Tesla targeted 500,000 vehicles in annual production by 2018 and expected approximately $2.25 billion in 2016 capital expenditures. On July 31, it agreed to acquire SolarCity, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

The Office of the Historian’s ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States, 1906, Part I* preserves the printed volume’s content and recommends citing document numbers rather than page numbers. In the annual message, the President describes national prosperity and urges Congress to prohibit corporate campaign contributions and allow government appeals on questions of law in criminal cases, arguing that the latter would help resolve conflicting rulings and prevent obstacles to justice.

Socket 940 has an LCP base and cover with a UL 94 V-0 flammability rating. Cover flatness must remain below 0.25 mm through reflow and testing. A removable overlay supports vacuum pick-and-place, while molded markings identify the socket, lever positions, pin orientation, and supplier.

Contacts use high-strength copper alloy with nickel plating and gold-plated mating areas. The socket attaches by SMT using tin-lead solder balls. A stainless steel lever actuates the contacts; the socket must retain electrical and mechanical integrity after 50 actuation cycles.

Each contact is rated for 1.5 A, and initial and final circuit resistance must not exceed 25 mΩ per contact. The specifications also set limits for inductance, capacitance, impedance, propagation-delay skew, dielectric withstand voltage, and insulation resistance.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2018 reports revenue of $3.41 billion, up from $2.70 billion a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $709.6 million, compared with $330.3 million. Operating activities used $398.4 million in cash. At quarter-end, Tesla held $2.67 billion in cash and cash equivalents, with $27.27 billion in assets and $21.55 billion in liabilities. Tesla adopted a new revenue standard on January 1, changing the timing of revenue recognition for certain vehicle sales with resale value guarantees.

Russia denies responsibility for the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, while British officials say they have evidence Russia continued producing and stockpiling the nerve agent Novichok. The passage urges the West to strengthen sanctions and pursue assets held by Putin’s associates, including through changes to laws shielding Russian money.

Since becoming Speedy’s chief executive in 2015, Russell Down has addressed unreliable equipment data, declining revenue from smaller customers and a repair backlog that left more than half of its products unavailable in September 2015. He has refocused the company on customers, costs, equipment availability and staff engagement. For the six months to September, profits rose 58.8% to £10.8m, while net debt fell. Speedy has also acquired Prolift Access and Platform Sales & Hire to expand its powered-access fleet.

After North Carolina’s 38–10 loss to Clemson, Bill Belichick took responsibility for penalties and defensive lapses that allowed big passing plays. He also cited poor early-down performance behind the team’s third-down struggles. Belichick praised his players’ effort and said they would keep working to improve.

Nevada allocated $36 million in weighted funding for eligible students learning English or living in poverty, with more than $34 million going to Clark County schools. Schools will decide how to spend their shares. Garside Junior High expects more than $450,000 and is considering expanded tutoring and technology. Spending will be tracked, and its effect on student achievement will be analyzed.

Mastitis is a costly dairy disease that damages cows’ mammary tissue and reduces milk production. Antibiotics treat the bacteria but do not repair the tissue. Cornell researchers found that secretions from bovine mammary stem cells promoted processes involved in tissue healing, protected cells from bacterial toxins and showed antimicrobial activity in laboratory studies. They plan to test whether these effects occur in cows with mastitis.

Hyundai and Kia installed a vehicle-to-everything communication system along 14 kilometers of road in Hwaseong to support autonomous driving. They plan to test and improve the system using data gathered by year-end, with the aim of making it operational for a 2020 highway communication project.

The passage proposes coupled SSH chains for braiding topological edge states. Inversion and time-dependent interchain symmetries protect their adiabatic evolution, while braiding determines which chain receives a particle and an accumulated phase controls its distribution between the chain’s ends. In a three-chain system, changing the braiding order changes the destination, demonstrating non-Abelian transport. For two bosons, the proposed process produces an entangled NOON state through Hong-Ou-Mandel interference, with its destination likewise determined by braiding order. The authors suggest photonic waveguide arrays as a platform for testing the protocol.

A corner kick restarts play for the attacking team when a defender sends the entire ball over the end line. The passage recommends teaching young players Law 17, ball placement in the nearest corner arc, a proper run-up and kick, and restrictions on defenders and the kicker. It introduces a play with a corner taker, receiver, and cover player, then has players practice each role and right- and left-footed kicks from both corners. Coaches can later assign roles, add defenders and passing options, and practice more advanced kicks.

The President submits an 1893 treaty to the Senate for annexing the Hawaiian Islands, leaving detailed questions of governance for later resolution. He says the United States did not promote the monarchy’s overthrow, argues that restoring Queen Liliuokalani would be undesirable, and favors annexation over a protectorate to protect U.S. interests and prevent another power from controlling the islands. He urges prompt ratification and calls for future legislation to respect the rights of island residents and foreigners.

Caitlin Bassett says the two-week build-up to Saturday’s Super Netball grand final has been unlike anything she has experienced. Her Sunshine Coast Lightning will face Greater Western Sydney in Brisbane in Bassett’s first national grand final. Lightning captain Geva Mentor has trained against 215cm men’s player Junior Levi to prepare for the Giants’ offence.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures recent gains and losses on a scale from 0 to 100 to identify potentially overbought or oversold conditions. The passage says its backtests found RSI most useful for mean-reverting stock strategies, particularly with short lookback periods and daily bars, but that settings require testing and additional filters can improve results. A two-day RSI strategy on SPY performed slightly worse than buy-and-hold from 1993 to November 2020 while spending less time invested and experiencing a smaller drawdown; that test excluded trading costs and taxes. The passage also describes RSI divergences as difficult to identify before the fact and notes that performance varies across assets.

San Diego police pursued a person matching a shooting suspect’s description in City Heights on Sunday. The driver crashed through school and fire station fences, fled with a gun, and was arrested nearby.

A retrospective study of 671 patients with traumatic brain injury found that 459 were men and 212 were women. Domestic accidents were the most frequently reported cause in both groups, accounting for 294 cases overall. Men were affected at a younger average age than women and had longer hospital stays. The authors reported an association between age and hospitalization length and identified village residence as a risk factor. The study lacked a control group for comparing incidence between men and women.

The passage lists 1945 statements by President Truman on China, national defense, and displaced persons, then describes changes in the Department of State. James F. Byrnes succeeded Edward R. Stettinius, Jr., as Secretary of State, and Dean G. Acheson succeeded Joseph C. Grew as Under Secretary. After Patrick J. Hurley resigned as Ambassador to China, Truman appointed George C. Marshall his personal envoy there. Executive orders transferred international information functions and two Office of Strategic Services branches to the Department. Truman also asked the Secretary of State to lead the development of a coordinated foreign intelligence program.

U.S. stocks fell on Monday as Facebook’s 7.1 percent drop, following reports of improper access to more than 50 million users’ data, led a broader technology selloff. At 12:29 p.m. ET, the S&P 500 was down 1.44 percent and the Dow was down 1.23 percent; all 11 major S&P sectors were lower. Trade-war concerns, political uncertainty and an upcoming Federal Reserve decision also weighed on the market.

Frost Brown Todd and Gibbons plan to merge in January as FBT Gibbons, creating a firm with 800 lawyers in 25 offices, including new offices for Frost Brown Todd in New York and New Jersey. Robert Sartin will chair the merged firm, with Adam Hall and Peter Torcicollo as co-managing partners. Leaders said they will focus first on integration while considering further growth.

NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture adds finer-grained power gating, separate voltage rails, faster clock switching and quicker entry into low-power states. The passage says these changes improve efficiency and can reduce power use during small-language-model inference by up to 50%.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, which can create up to three frames per rendered frame, and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also expands support for neural shaders used in materials, texture compression, lighting, skin and faces.

The passage describes three Blackwell GPUs: flagship GB202, high-end GB203 and performance-segment GB205, used in GeForce RTX 50-series products. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability as detailed in the document.

Sodium cumenesulfonate is a water-soluble hydrotrope used to improve solubility and ingredient compatibility and to adjust cloud point and viscosity in formulated products. Its applications include detergents, cleaners, oilfield fluids, and metal processing. The passage identifies growing industrialization and household detergent use as potential demand drivers, while raw-material price volatility and declining research activity may hinder the market. Heavy exposure may cause eye or respiratory irritation. Liquid products and household applications held major market shares in 2015 and were expected to remain dominant during the forecast period.

Theoretical physicist Stephen Hawking has died, his family said. Diagnosed with ALS at 21, he lived with the disease for more than 50 years and continued his scientific work after losing most of his ability to move and speak. His bestselling book “A Brief History of Time” explained mysteries of space, time and black holes to a wide audience. He pursued a unified theory of physics, though he later suggested one might not exist. His life was portrayed in the film “The Theory of Everything.”

Bemidji beat Thief River Falls 77-45 after leading 45-25 at halftime. Caden Rolfes scored 18 points and Linaes Whiting added 17. Coach Travis Peterson said the win showed progress ahead of the section tournament. Bemidji next plays at Fergus Falls on Feb. 18.

Apple’s February 2016 Form 8-K reports an agreement to issue $12 billion in senior unsecured notes: $1 billion in floating-rate notes due in 2019 and 2021, and $11 billion in fixed-rate notes due from 2018 through 2046. Floating-rate interest is payable quarterly; fixed-rate interest is payable semiannually. The notes will rank equally with Apple’s other unsecured, unsubordinated debt.

An earlier treaty providing for annuities and Hawaii’s admission as a U.S. state failed after Kamehameha III died and his successor opposed it. A reciprocity treaty concluded in 1855 also failed to gain ratification. Negotiations resumed in 1867, when U.S. officials discussed annexation and Seward stated that it should take precedence if it conflicted with reciprocity. The presence of the U.S.S. *Lackawanna* delayed Hawaiian ratification of a new reciprocity treaty until July 30, 1867. The U.S. Senate rejected it in 1870.

Synaptics announced plans to mass-produce Clear ID, a fingerprint sensor embedded beneath smartphone screens for bezel-less designs. The company says it unlocks phones with one touch from various angles and is twice as fast as 3D facial recognition. The passage does not say when it will appear in a smartphone.

Florida State University President John Thrasher appointed a 15-member committee to review policies on campus names, markers and statues. Renisha Gibbs, the university’s chief diversity officer, will chair it. The review follows calls to remove Confederate designations, including a student group’s request to remove a statue of Francis Eppes. The committee will seek community input, and its meetings will be public.

The Supreme Court will hear a case brought by Damon Landor, a Rastafarian prisoner whose dreadlocks were forcibly shaved despite a prior ruling protecting his religious practice. The dispute concerns whether a federal religious-freedom law allows him to seek money damages from the prison officials. The author argues that denying damages would leave prisoners with little practical relief.

The passage also challenges portrayals of religious-freedom cases as consistently partisan, focused on culture-war disputes, or chiefly benefiting religious majorities. It points to unanimous rulings and cases involving a range of religious minorities.

The passage describes container and distributed-system patterns. Reusable sidecars need stable, documented APIs; even subtle configuration changes can break them. Ambassadors broker an application’s external connections, including sharding, service discovery, and request splitting. Adapters give differing applications consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. Across machines, replicated load-balanced services provide redundancy and scale, while caching and SSL termination can add capabilities. Sharded services distribute data that exceeds one machine’s capacity; shard keys and consistent hashing affect routing and resizing. Replicated shards can improve resilience. Scatter/gather distributes parts of a request across nodes and combines their results, though overhead and slow nodes limit its benefits. The passage ends by introducing event-driven, function-as-a-service applications that may run only to handle a request or event.

In his inaugural address, the speaker pledges to uphold the Constitution, preserve the Union, and serve without seeking reelection. He praises the peaceful acceptance of the presidential election and argues that territorial residents should decide slavery for themselves through free votes, subject to the Constitution. He says he will accept the Supreme Court’s decision on when that choice should occur and urges an end to slavery agitation, which he says threatens the Union.

He warns against corruption and waste, proposes using the Treasury surplus for constitutional purposes such as paying the public debt and strengthening the Navy, and favors reserving public lands for settlers at moderate prices. He advocates strict construction of federal powers but supports a military road to defend the Pacific Coast. In foreign affairs, he calls for peace, commerce, noninterference, avoidance of entangling alliances, and territorial expansion only in accordance with justice and honor.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 27, 2022, reporting that it issued a press release about financial results for its first fiscal quarter ended December 25, 2021. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri signed the report.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU is designed to accelerate AI, high-performance computing, and data analytics workloads. Compared with the V100, it adds third-generation Tensor Cores supporting more data formats, structured sparsity that can double Tensor Core throughput, 40 GB of HBM2 memory, and a larger L2 cache. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances, while third-generation NVLink supports larger multi-GPU systems. CUDA 11 adds support for features including asynchronous copies, task graphs, and cache controls. Eight A100 GPUs power the DGX A100 system.

Nearly 3,000 people are expected in Kelowna for the 23rd BMO Okanagan Marathon. Saturday’s events include a timed 5 km run and children’s activities; the marathon, half marathon and 10 km events take place Sunday. The races are staged from City Park, and the marathon course follows Okanagan Lake. Walk-up registration is available Friday and Saturday at the Sports Expo. The event supports the Sunshine Foundation of Canada.

During the government shutdown, air traffic controllers and TSA officers are working without pay while furloughs reduce support for aviation operations. Federal employees say flying remains safe, but warn that mounting strain could slow repairs and cause more delays and cancellations. Workers also fear possible firings and consequences for unions if employees miss work. The FAA says it will slow traffic where staffing is constrained to maintain safety and that air traffic controllers are exempt from workforce reductions.

A New York panel unanimously recommended pausing Medicaid coverage of Sarepta’s Duchenne muscular dystrophy treatment Elevidys amid safety concerns. It advised waiting for updated FDA labeling and evaluating Sarepta’s planned measures to reduce liver-failure risk. The recommendation has not yet been adopted, and some patients under 21 may still receive coverage based on medical necessity.

The passage describes robotic- and navigation-assisted methods for placing a screw in a vertebra. A manipulator aligns a screw and releasably engaged sleeve with a planned insertion trajectory, advances them through soft tissue, and then advances the screw into bone. One sleeve design has a closed, flexible distal end that opens as the screw advances. The system also describes interchangeable surgical tools, drive couplers, and sleeves that provide a working channel. A removable tracking device can attach to a tool secured in a vertebra to check its position after surgical steps that may move the vertebra; one version uses a ratchet to rotate its tracking markers relative to the tool.

The St. John’s Edge beat the London Lightning 123-110 in Game 4, tying their National Basketball League of Canada division final 2-2. Game 5 is Thursday in St. John’s, with Game 6 scheduled for Sunday in London. Charles Hinkle and Coron Williams scored 28 points each for the Edge; Royce White led London with 32. The Edge outscored London 50-38 in the paint, while the Lightning missed 13 free throws. London coach Keith Vassell said he needed to prepare the team better and reconsider his short bench.

The speaker says the team is putting its previous game behind it and focusing on Wednesday’s game, which he calls the biggest of their careers. He says they played well overall despite conceding quick third-period goals, and praises both goaltenders. Confident in their road record, the team plans to forecheck, put pucks deep and pressure the defense. He also welcomes time to rest after travel and looks forward to a missing teammate’s return.

Topshop has removed till display barriers from stores nationwide after 10-year-old Kaden Reddick suffered fatal head injuries in an incident involving one at its Reading store. Police are investigating, with Reading Borough Council assisting on health and safety matters.

Anjuna police are investigating the unnatural deaths of two tourists, Pravin Sundaram of Tamil Nadu and Abdul, reportedly from Kerala. Sundaram collapsed near Vagator; Abdul died after an unknown person brought him to a hospital. The causes remain undetermined, and police have not ruled out drug overdose. Both bodies were sent for autopsy. Police are questioning Sundaram’s friends and trying to trace the person who brought Abdul to hospital. A local minister called for outdoor music parties to stop.

Mothers and their children with Down’s syndrome made a Carpool Karaoke-style video for World Down Syndrome Day to change perceptions of the condition. Conceived by Becky Carless and set to Christina Perri’s “A Thousand Years,” it has received more than 600,000 views and praise from Perri and James Corden.

The speaker presents the transfer of power as an opportunity for national unity and lasting peace. Despite advances in prosperity, science, and civil rights, he says America faces war, division, and a crisis of spirit. He calls for quieter dialogue, equal dignity for black and white Americans, and cooperation between government and citizens to meet domestic needs. Abroad, he pledges open communication, patient diplomacy, reduced armaments, and continued strength in pursuit of peace. Reflecting on the astronauts’ view of Earth, he urges people to recognize their shared destiny and move forward together.
