A qualitative case study interviewed 20 Turkish teachers in Hazro, Turkey, about Turkish lessons and technology during pandemic distance education. None considered the process fully efficient: 70% found it insufficiently efficient, and 30% found it inefficient. Teachers reported that limited internet access and devices reduced attendance and prevented some students from achieving learning goals. They identified reading books, dictionaries, technological materials and skills-based activities as student needs. Phones were the most-used communication tool, and WhatsApp was the most-used application. The study recommends improving infrastructure and access to materials, updating EBA content, supporting face-to-face teaching with distance education, and providing teacher training.

Diana Beresford-Kroeger and her husband, Christian, created an arboretum and organic garden on their property near Merrickville. Raised in Ireland and taught traditional knowledge about nature, she later studied botany, biochemistry and medical research. Concerned about local tree cutting, the couple began identifying and protecting rare plants. She now writes and speaks about trees and climate change. Her Canadian-made documentary, *Call of the Forest*, examines deforestation, while her “Bioplan” urges people to plant trees to reduce atmospheric carbon dioxide.

The FDA announced a nationwide crackdown on illegal sales of Juul e-cigarettes to minors, targeting stores and online retailers. Since March, it has found 40 violations and issued 40 warning letters. The agency also worked with eBay to remove listings and requested documents from Juul’s maker to investigate the products’ appeal to youth. Juul devices contain high levels of nicotine; one cartridge has as much as a pack of cigarettes. The Truth Initiative urged faster regulation, including action on flavors that attract young people.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 1, 2017, reporting that it issued a press release and data sheet on its financial results for the third fiscal quarter ended July 1, 2017. Both documents are attached as exhibits.

A Las Vegas high school student says getting a job helped him reengage with school, earn a 4.0 GPA and develop practical skills and confidence. He cites research linking youth employment to better academic and social outcomes, but notes that internships and jobs remain scarce, particularly for African American youth. He urges governments to encourage businesses to hire young people and address barriers such as transportation and school schedules.

The speaker says a former teammate had the character to become a head coach: he is demanding but honest. He expects a difficult series against a deep, defensively strong opponent, but is excited about his team’s shared goal and its forward depth. He anticipates strong fan support in Ottawa, says modern goalies are skilled and hard to beat, and suggests Giggy receives less recognition because he plays in a smaller market.

BBC1 and ITV have competed for Saturday-night viewers for decades, but launching successful shows in the slot is difficult. Established programmes such as *Strictly Come Dancing* and *The X Factor* dominate, while few newer formats have lasted. As those shows eventually lose audiences, broadcasters face the challenge of finding replacements. Greg Dyke says new shows often fail and their success is hard to predict.

Cases involving Hindu girls converting to Islam and marrying Muslim men have raised alarm in Pakistan’s Sindh province. Families and activists allege abduction and coercion, while the girls often tell courts they acted voluntarily. Ravita Meghwar’s family disputes her account that she chose to elope and convert; a court ruled she could live with her husband.

Lower-caste, low-income Hindus face particular vulnerability, and religious institutions and local power structures are prominent in conversion cases. A 2016 Sindh bill banning forced conversions and conversions before age 18 was not signed into law after opposition from religious groups. Some Hindu families are moving from villages to cities or migrating to India, though reliable counts of those leaving villages are unavailable.

Combination defenses limit outstanding players’ touches and can surprise unprepared teams. In a Box and One, four defenders play a zone while one denies a scorer the ball. A Diamond and One protects the middle but leaves the corners open. A Triangle and Two targets two scorers.

Colony Northstar shares fell 2.3% in the most recent session and closed at $5.94. Five analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $8.80, ranging from $6 to $10. Their ratings comprised one Buy, three Outperform and one Hold. The stock’s 14-period ATR was 0.3, and its RSI was 21.31. Colony Northstar had a $3.32 billion market capitalization; 11.19 million shares traded in the previous session, above the 8.14 million average.

The Dallas Stars coach said the team played two strong periods but made critical third-period puck-support errors that gave New Jersey odd-man rushes. He said New Jersey’s speed and commitment to defending have exposed Dallas when its play slips. To win Thursday and bring the series back home, Dallas must eliminate easy chances, resist forcing plays and stay with its game plan. He expects the players to correct the mistakes and said the team’s leaders must provide the determination needed to continue the series.

A study of 10.3 million patients with opioid prescription claims found that pre-existing psychiatric or behavioural conditions and psychoactive medication use were associated with long-term opioid use. About 1.7% became long-term users, with higher risk among patients with prior substance use disorders.

The NPD Group identified five trends expected to shape Britain’s £57 billion foodservice industry in 2018: smartphone click and collect, investment in staff, personalized loyalty schemes, delivery on brand promises, and tailored recommendations. It said operators could benefit from faster ordering, stronger customer relationships and repeat visits, but success would depend on efficient service, staff training and meeting consumer expectations.

Three chemists, including one from the University of California, Berkeley, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing metal-organic frameworks. These structures combine metal ions and carbon-based molecules and can harvest water or store toxic gases.

Chancellor Angela Merkel agreed to establish transit centers at the German-Austrian border for asylum seekers who had applied in other EU countries, following pressure from Bavarian ally and Interior Minister Horst Seehofer. The deal aimed to preserve her governing coalition amid growing support for the far-right AfD in Bavaria, but the coalition’s Social Democrats objected to the centers. Austria warned it might respond to German expulsions with similar measures, raising concerns about the EU’s open-border system.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU for AI, HPC, and data analytics. Compared with the Tesla V100, it adds third-generation Tensor Cores supporting more data formats, structured sparsity that can double Tensor Core throughput, 40 GB of HBM2 memory, and a larger L2 cache. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances. Faster NVLink and PCIe connections support larger systems, while CUDA 11 adds features including asynchronous copying, barriers, and task-graph optimizations. The DGX A100 combines eight A100 GPUs for training and inference workloads.

The defendant appealed a judgment requiring him to pay for a horse he had used and returned before it died. The appellate court upheld the finding that there was no agreement for a thirty-day trial. It also found that the defendant had accepted the horse and had not proved a breach of warranty. The judgment was affirmed with costs.
The Fourth Circuit affirmed the district court’s denial of Paul Nagy’s Rule 60(b) motion, finding no reversible error.

Falling debris from a Soyuz rocket launched from Baikonur ignited a 15-kilometer-wide steppe fire in Kazakhstan on Wednesday. One debris-clearing worker died and another was hospitalized. The rocket had successfully launched a supply ship to the International Space Station. The fire was extinguished that evening.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q reports third-quarter 2020 net sales of $96.1 billion, up from $70.0 billion a year earlier, and net income of $6.3 billion, up from $2.1 billion. For the first nine months of 2020, net sales were $260.5 billion and net income was $14.1 billion. North America, International and AWS all reported higher third-quarter sales. Amazon incurred more than $2.5 billion in COVID-19-related costs during the quarter. At September 30, total assets were $282.2 billion, and cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $68.4 billion.

The lecture develops binary detection by first considering a single transmitted bit and one noisy observation. A maximum a posteriori (MAP) detector minimizes error by choosing the hypothesis with the higher probability after observing the output. This is equivalent to comparing a likelihood ratio with a threshold set by the hypotheses’ prior probabilities.

For antipodal signals in Gaussian noise, the rule becomes a threshold test on the observation. With equally likely bits, the error probability is \(Q(\sqrt{2E_b/n_0})\). Shifting both signal values without changing their separation leaves the error probability unchanged but increases the energy used. For antipodal vectors, the detector reduces the observation to an inner product with the transmitted vector; for waveforms, a matched filter performs this operation before the same one-dimensional decision rule is applied.

The passage describes methods for controlling ion energy distributions during plasma processing with shaped-pulse bias. Modulating the amplitude and number of voltage pulses controls the energy and relative fraction of ions at each energy. Alternatively, voltage ramps that overcompensate or undercompensate for ion current produce wider energy distributions.

NVIDIA’s Ampere-based GA10x GPUs improve on Turing with doubled peak FP32 processing, second-generation RT Cores for ray tracing and motion blur, and third-generation Tensor Cores that support new data types and structured sparsity. The architecture also adds larger caches, greater memory bandwidth, PCIe 4.0, and improved workload concurrency. GeForce RTX 30-series models use these features for gaming, rendering, and AI applications, while the RTX A6000 and A40 target professional workstations and data centers. RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression to reduce CPU work when loading assets. GA10x GPUs also support high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding, and hardware video encoding.

The Princeton offense is a flexible, team-oriented style built on constant movement, passing, spacing and defensive reads rather than set patterns. Popularized by Pete Carril, it uses exchanges, screens, post action and dribble entries to create open shots, especially through backdoor cuts against defensive overplays. Players need outside shooting, passing and ball-handling skills, conditioning, patience and an unselfish approach. The offense controls tempo while allowing drives and quick opportunities, and it can adapt to different defenses.

A road win gave the team a boost, though it still needs more wins. A shorthanded goal and a strong first period helped set the tone. The speaker credited four-line play, skating and neutral-zone defense, and said the team must play similarly at home in Edmonton to try to force another game.

The passage lists ten AI tools for content creation in 2025: ChatGPT and CopyAI for writing, Canva Magic Studio and Midjourney V6 for visuals, RunwayML and Synthesia for video, Descript for editing, ElevenLabs for voiceovers, Tribescaler for content optimization, and Clickable for ads. It presents them as ways to save time while supporting creators’ own ideas. The article contains affiliate links and says features and pricing may change.

Volunteers in southern New South Wales and the ACT are surveying waterways for near-threatened platypus, providing baseline data for conservation. Waterwatch’s four years of surveys on the Upper Murrumbidgee River suggest numbers there are stable, although volunteers saw no platypus during the latest survey. Waterwatch encourages people to report sightings year-round.

The speaker said the team was outmuscled for much of the second period but improved late, tied the game in the third and scored early in overtime. He praised a versatile player’s performance and Manny’s return, particularly his faceoffs. He said player availability would remain a game-time decision to avoid giving opponents information they could exploit. He also discussed the twins’ different personalities, plans to ease a returning player into the lineup, and the need to avoid offensive-zone penalties and improve the power play.

The court affirmed dismissal of an administrator’s action to collect a New York judgment and prevent the Sivers from conveying Iowa property to their sons. It held that objections to witness competency must state specific grounds and that admissible evidence supported the Sivers’ counterclaim alleging fraud in the underlying land exchange. It also upheld taxing costs against the administrator in her official capacity. Dissenting justices argued that the objections adequately barred the Sivers’ testimony about dealings with the deceased.

The lecture reviews Wald’s identity for random walks and applies threshold-crossing bounds to sequential hypothesis testing. It explains how likelihood ratios provide sufficient statistics, how fixed-sample tests trade off error probabilities, and how sequential tests trade off error probability against the expected number of observations. Differentiating Wald’s identity yields Wald’s equality and a result for zero-mean random walks. The lecture then defines martingales through conditional expectations, gives sum and product examples, illustrates why limits and expectations cannot always be interchanged, and introduces submartingales, supermartingales, and Jensen’s inequality.

Smartphone makers have used bezels, notches and pop-up cameras to make room for selfie cameras, but these approaches have drawbacks. The passage proposes placing the camera behind a transparent OLED screen that turns clear only when the camera is in use. It suggests a filter to prevent the camera from being visible and a small transparent strip to limit costs. Transparent OLED technology has been demonstrated, but not yet adapted for this smartphone use.

A study found that four live ants added to warmed cow’s milk helped produce yogurt, a traditional practice once popular in Bulgaria and Turkey. In an ant mound, warmth supported fermentation overnight. Bacteria, acids and enzymes from the ants helped acidify and thicken the milk; frozen or dehydrated ants worked less well. Researchers caution against trying the method at home because live ants can carry a harmful parasite.

Socket 940 requires visible molded identification, lever-direction and pin A01 orientation markings, a UL symbol, and a lot traceability number. Contacts use high-strength copper alloy with nickel plating and gold-plated mating areas; shipped mating areas must be free of lubricant. The socket attaches to a PCB through tin-lead SMT solder balls, with a solder barrier and a 0.20 mm co-planarity limit.

A stainless steel lever enables toolless actuation. Open-position insertion and extraction forces must not exceed 2 kgf; lever force must be below 3.6 kgf, and pin displacement below 1.0 mm. The socket must retain integrity after 50 cycles and have no specified visual defects. Electrical requirements include 1.5 A per contact, initial and final resistance no greater than 25 mΩ per contact, specified inductance and capacitance limits, 100 Ω ± 10% differential impedance, at least 650 Vac dielectric withstand voltage, and at least 1000 MΩ insulation resistance.

Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) calls for zero tobacco deaths, arguing that smokers are victims of an industry that markets addictive, deadly products. It cites the Cape Town Declaration on Human Rights and a Tobacco-Free World, endorsed by more than 150 organizations, as a sign of growing support for a tobacco-free future.

The passage examines four game-based education projects at the University of Wrocław: a cultural location-based game, a gamified career-management seminar, an entrepreneurship location-based game, and a LARP designed to develop soft skills. Participants reported engagement, cooperation and opportunities to apply knowledge. Evaluations also identified drawbacks, including concerns about lesson effectiveness, mixed responses to competition, and difficulties with unfamiliar locations or complex rules. The passage concludes that games should be selected to suit students’ experience, the subject, available time and costs. Simple games with clear rules can fit into curricula, while more complex games require substantial preparation and may be better suited to funded projects.

The Clark County School District Board of Trustees selected Dr. Jesus Jara as superintendent on May 2, 2018. Jara had served as deputy superintendent of Orange County Public Schools in Florida since 2012. The decision followed a divided meeting in which trustees rejected internal candidate Dr. Mike Barton by a 4–3 vote. Jara said he would listen to the community and work with district staff. Trustees hoped he could arrive before retiring superintendent Pat Skorkowsky left in June, pending negotiations.

The speaker says coach Burns gave him an unexpected chance to play in the Stanley Cup Finals and that he was glad to contribute a goal. Veterans helped him stay calm, while the team’s depth and players stepping up throughout the playoffs made a difference. He credits Marty and an absent teammate whose leadership inspired him, and describes the final moments as an overwhelming celebration.

The command moves SNP guest pages within system physical memory and can replace PAGE_MOVE. A 2M page must be aligned and physically contiguous; otherwise, software must split it into 4K pages before migration. DMA is unsupported during migration, and CPU access must be prevented. Source pages must be Guest-Valid or Guest-Invalid, while destinations must be Pre-Migration. Firmware validates page states and sizes, obtains exclusive RMP access, invalidates and synchronizes the CPU TLB, copies the data, and updates both RMPs. Commands can process up to 128 pages. Errors are reported through command or entry status, the PM_STATUS register, or MCA; hardware errors can leave pages unrecoverable.
The court dismissed the appeal because an order sustaining a demurrer to an amended petition without disposing of the action is not a final, appealable order.

Sydney maths teacher Eddie Woo gained a wide audience after he began filming lessons in 2012 for an ill student. His free WooTube channel now has more than 200,000 subscribers and 12 million views. Named Australia’s Local Hero for 2018 and a finalist for the Global Teacher Prize, Woo has also become a NSW “master teacher,” travelling to share ideas with students and teachers while continuing to teach at Cherrybrook Technology High School. His growing profile has brought enthusiastic crowds, but his brother says the busier schedule keeps him away from his school and family.

The IRS announced inflation-adjusted tax brackets and deductions for 2026 to help prevent taxpayers from moving into higher brackets solely because of inflation. The standard deduction will rise to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly and $16,100 for single filers. The estate tax exemption will increase to $15 million, and taxpayers aged 65 and older will receive a new $6,000 deduction beginning in the 2025 tax year. Analysts say the changes offer limited relief and may not fully offset future inflation.

Huron County library officials proposed working with Central Huron to renovate the Clinton Library, the only county branch that failed to gain accreditation in 2015 because of accessibility and space issues. The project would aim to meet library standards and improve services. The municipality and county would first agree on space and service needs, then prepare draft plans for council and community review. Provincial funding may be possible once the project is ready to proceed. Discussions will continue.

A court heard that Charlie Alliston struck Kim Briggs while riding a fixed-wheel bicycle without a front brake at nearly 20mph on Old Street in February 2016. Briggs died a week later from severe head injuries. Prosecutors said the bike could not lawfully be ridden on the road and that a front brake would have allowed Alliston to stop. Alliston blamed Briggs in online posts. He denies manslaughter and causing bodily harm by wanton or furious driving.

The Sansa Fuze is a portable audio and video player with a 1.9-inch color screen, built-in microphone, microSDHC expansion slot, and FM radio where available. It plays music and audiobooks, displays converted videos and photos, and supports voice recording. Music can be transferred by drag-and-drop or Windows Media Player; photos and videos use Sansa Media Converter. The manual covers playback controls, playlists, slideshows, FM presets, charging, and connecting to a computer. It warns that disconnecting during a transfer can damage the device and formatting deletes its contents. The player is intended for home and personal use.

Elijah Brown scored 27 points, including 17 of New Mexico’s final 19, as the Lobos beat Boise State 78-73 on Tuesday. New Mexico took control with an 11-0 first-half run and held off a late rally. Chandler Hutchison scored a career-high 31 points for Boise State. The win left New Mexico one loss behind Boise State, Colorado State and Nevada in the Mountain West standings.

A retrospective study of more than 2.2 million U.S. pregnancy and postpartum hospitalizations from 2017–2019 found that patients with mood disorders had higher rates of peripartum cardiomyopathy (0.12% versus 0.05%) and adverse cardiac events (0.36% versus 0.14%). These associations remained after adjustment for demographic and clinical factors; maternal death rates did not differ significantly. Because the study used inpatient diagnosis codes and lacked post-discharge data, it could not establish causation or assess long-term outcomes.

A December 2017 Harvard poll found that 65 percent of Americans aged 18–29 favored Democrats, compared with 33 percent favoring Republicans. Among millennials, 14 percent said America was headed in the right direction, 25 percent approved of Trump’s job performance, and 61 percent favored stricter gun laws.

The court affirmed the denial of the union’s requests for counsel fees and costs under New Jersey’s Anti-Injunction Act. The arbitration case fell outside the act because it concerned whether a grievance was arbitrable, not an injunction against unlawful labor activity. The strike case fell within the act, but the injunction had been reversed for procedural defects despite a substantive basis for relief; the court held that reversal did not require an award. The union and Borkowski were granted leave to reapply for ordinary trial-court costs in the arbitration case.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture redesigns the streaming multiprocessor to run floating-point and integer instructions concurrently and share a configurable L1 cache and memory. Tensor Cores accelerate deep-learning workloads, including inference and NGX image features such as DLSS, while RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray-triangle intersection tests. The passage describes hybrid rendering, which combines rasterization, ray tracing and denoising to produce real-time lighting effects.

Other features include GDDR6 memory, larger L2 caches, improved compression, enhanced video and display engines, USB-C VirtualLink for VR, and NVLink for supported multi-GPU configurations. Mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading and multi-view rendering give developers additional ways to manage geometry and shading work. The passage also outlines TU104- and TU106-based products, including the Tesla T4 for inference, and explains basic ray-tracing methods and their use in shadows, ambient occlusion and reflections.

On February 15, 2017, Preempt announced new integrations for its Behavioral Firewall. Data connections with Okta, Azure Active Directory and VPN gateways add context for detecting internal network threats. Integrations with SecureAuth, RSA SecurID, Duo, Google Authenticator and HP Aruba ClearPass expand options to block, notify or challenge users. Preempt says the firewall combines behavioral analytics with automated responses to suspicious activity.

Washington police plan to charge 12 Turkish security agents over violence during President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s visit; seven face felony charges and five face misdemeanors. Two men have been arrested on assault charges related to the May 16 altercation outside the Turkish ambassador’s residence.

The passage explains how to receive weekly documentation-update notifications and find design help through TI E2E forums. It warns that ESD can damage integrated circuits and notes that the May 2025 revision changed ADS8685W and ADS8689W from Advance Information to Production Data. It also describes packaging and ordering information and states that TI resources are provided “as is” and may change without notice.

Mary Meeker’s Internet Trends report shows time spent watching short videos in China rose 360 percent in 2017, approaching time spent on long-form video. Despite that growth, 76 percent of consumers use just one short-video app. Douyin and Kuaishou each report about 100 million daily active users and 52 minutes of viewing per user per day.

The speaker credits teammates for helping him win an individual award but says he would have preferred the Stanley Cup. He is disappointed by the loss, especially because he wanted to win for his mother, who is unwell. He praises the opposing team and its goaltender, notes the importance of home ice and playoff preparation, and says his team will take next season one game at a time.

Apple’s iOS 11.4 update adds AirPlay 2, enabling multi-room streaming from iOS devices, stereo HomePod pairing, and more reliable playback. HomePod also gains Siri calendar support, though anyone can access its personal requests because it lacks individual voice recognition. AirPlay streaming still relies on an iOS device. The update also introduces Messages in iCloud, which synchronizes message history across devices and can free local storage while using more iCloud space.

At NVIDIA’s May 16, 2018 annual meeting, stockholders elected 11 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor. They also approved amendments increasing the share reserves of the 2007 Equity Incentive Plan by 23 million shares and the 2012 Employee Stock Purchase Plan by 13.5 million shares.

In card identification mode, the host resets, checks voltage, identifies, and requests an RCA from each card separately using its CMD line. CMD0 puts cards into Idle State, except those in Inactive State; power-on puts all cards into Idle State. CMD8 verifies operating voltage and communication: a compatible card echoes the voltage and check pattern, while an incompatible card remains idle without responding. CMD8 is required before the first ACMD41 for SDHC or SDXC initialization.

U.S. stocks rebounded Wednesday as investors grew hopeful Italy could form a government without new elections. The S&P 500 and Dow each rose 1.3 percent, while the Nasdaq gained 0.9 percent. The Russell 2000 climbed 1.5 percent to a record high as trade concerns persisted. Banks rallied as Treasury yields rose, and energy shares gained as U.S. crude ended a five-day losing streak. Italian stocks and government bonds also recovered, and the euro rose.

The court reinstated Hartford’s claims that General Accident negotiated a settlement in bad faith, finding sufficient evidence for a jury to consider whether Hartford suffered damages. It affirmed dismissal of Hartford’s claim under Insurance Law § 2601.

A University of Rochester study in mice found that low alcohol doses reduced brain inflammation and improved the glymphatic system’s removal of waste, without changing performance on cognitive or motor tests. Intermediate doses reduced glymphatic function, while prolonged high-dose exposure increased inflammation and impaired cognitive and motor abilities. The study was published in *Scientific Reports*.

Defensive run fits vary by personnel, philosophy, front spacing and coverage, so coaches must turn shared terminology into executable schemes. Even fronts have a B-gap opening; odd fronts have C-gap openings, regardless of their pre-snap alignment. Seven-man spacing leaves the defense one box defender short and often uses two-gap techniques or linebacker adjustments. Eight-man spacing has equal numbers in the box and typically assigns one gap per defender. Nine-man spacing adds an extra run defender. A 3-4 defense can use any of these spacings depending on how its overhang defenders are assigned.

The TPS7H500x-SP series comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency, peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. External synchronization requires a floating RT pin and a clock on SYNC at twice the desired switching frequency. Two controllers can share SYNC to operate synchronized independent converters or a parallel interleaved converter.

Depending on the device, the controllers provide one or two primary switching outputs and synchronous-rectifier outputs. They offer configurable duty-cycle limits, timing, slope compensation and frequency compensation. Pulse skipping addresses minimum-on-time constraints; current limiting, hiccup operation, the FAULT pin and thermal shutdown provide protection.

A TPS7H5001-SP design example describes a 500-kHz, 5-V synchronous push-pull converter using GaN devices. The passage also provides power-supply and PCB-layout guidance, including close placement of bypass capacitors, separation of analog and power grounds, and routing sensitive signals away from switching noise.

Kentucky sophomore forward Wenyen Gabriel announced he will remain in the 2018 NBA draft and begin his professional career rather than return for his junior season. He averaged 6.8 points and 5.4 rebounds per game and led the Wildcats with 40 blocks. Gabriel said positive feedback helped him make the decision, though he was not invited to the NBA scouting combine. With his departure, Kentucky’s 2018-19 roster currently has no scholarship junior or senior.

Child care academies in at least 11 North Carolina counties offer two- to six-week training at little or no cost to participants, aiming to move new educators into classrooms amid staffing shortages. One model qualifies graduates to work in licensed child care facilities; another provides a transferable credential that qualifies them to be lead teachers. Local partnerships and grants fund the programs. A $1.476 million expansion pilot passed the state House but did not enter the signed legislation. Separate state grants are available for up to 10 colleges or universities to run academies in 2025–26.

Andrew Lo says fear and uncertainty are affecting markets, though borrowing rates remain relatively low, and argues that transaction prices are essential for valuing securities. He strongly opposes suspending mark-to-market accounting.

The lecture then turns to hedging. Forward contracts let two parties agree today on an asset, price, and future transaction date, helping firms manage risks such as currency or commodity-price changes. They are customized and binding, but can be illiquid and expose each party to the risk that the other will default. Lo says a forward contract’s initial market value is zero when its price is set through agreement.

Futures contracts standardize these transactions, trade on exchanges, and are marked to market daily, with gains and losses paid as prices change. A clearing organization stands between traders, while margin requirements help limit counterparty risk. Some firms still prefer customized forwards, despite the liquidity and safeguards offered by futures.

The lecture uses dressed atomic states to explain light forces. The two states experience opposite dipole forces; their populations produce attraction under red-detuned light and repulsion under blue-detuned light. A lag in population adjustment produces cooling in blue-detuned light, while fluctuations as atoms switch states cause heating. In a blue-detuned standing wave, atoms can also lose energy through Sisyphus cooling: they tend to climb potential hills before switching states. For a two-level atom, the lecture finds that the lowest temperature remains comparable to the standing-wave potential depth, preventing localization by this cooling method alone.

The lecture compares two methods for optimizing open-loop control trajectories. Shooting methods simulate a system and adjust control parameters using cost gradients, which can be computed by a forward sensitivity method or a forward-backward adjoint method. Direct collocation optimizes states and controls together, imposing system dynamics as explicit constraints. Sequential quadratic programming handles these constraints and avoids choosing a gradient-descent learning rate. Pendulum, acrobot, and path-planning examples illustrate the methods and their susceptibility to local minima. The lecturer notes that open-loop trajectories need feedback stabilization.

A retrospective study of 377 mechanically ventilated COVID-19 patients at a Kuwaiti hospital examined bedside percutaneous tracheostomies performed between March 2020 and March 2022. The mean interval from intubation to tracheostomy was 17.4 days. Complications occurred in 23% of cases, most commonly minor bleeding; no deaths were attributed to the procedure. After tracheostomy, 54% of patients were weaned from sedation and 41% from mechanical ventilation. Overall, 63% died from COVID-19 complications. The study lacked an open-tracheostomy comparison group and long-term follow-up; the authors note that optimal timing remains uncertain.

Panthers coach Bob Boughner said injured goaltenders Roberto Luongo and James Reimer could practice and possibly return to the lineup next week. Harri Sateri has started in their absence, delaying Samuel Montembeault’s NHL debut. Forward Jamie McGinn will return Saturday against Detroit after missing two games with an upper-body injury.

A Norwalk family says an I-35 expansion project affected their only well, leaving them without clean water for two months. They have carried in water for cooking and cannot bathe their children or do laundry at home. The DOT says it is investigating and has offered a hotel and reimbursement for cleaning supplies. To speed up a connection to rural water, the family dug a trench and laid a water line.

Auditor General Daniel Domelevo issued surcharge certificates totalling about GH¢8.89 million to 62 organisations and individuals for state payments lacking supporting documentation between 2013 and 2015. His office said it could not locate those listed and published their names, asking them to collect their certificates by December 20, 2017.
Software patches improve biosecurity screening of DNA orders for AI-designed toxic proteins that evade filters.

Backtests using Yahoo! Finance data from 2014 indicate a positive end-of-month effect in Bitcoin. An optimized strategy averaged 3.3% per trade, with 41.8% compound annual growth, 16% time in the market, and a 25% maximum drawdown. The authors acknowledge some curve-fitting but report higher gains than comparable random periods. A modified strategy produced a smoother equity curve with lower growth; its rules were not disclosed.
AMD says the document is informational, may change or contain errors, provides no warranties or intellectual property licenses, and is subject to applicable sales terms.

U.S. stocks rebounded Monday in light trading, with the Dow gaining 0.6% but remaining below 22,000. The S&P 500 rose 1%, the Nasdaq 1.3% and the Russell 2000 1.5%. Real estate led sector gains, while energy declined. Fiat Chrysler, Nvidia and VMware rose on company-specific news; Herbalife fell. Despite Monday’s gain, the Russell 2000 remained near its 200-day moving average after a sharp selloff. The passage also notes Japan’s Nikkei falling below 20,000 and potential market pressure from North Korea tensions and U.S. trade policy toward China.

Bed Bath & Beyond operated 1,541 stores in North America as of November 2016. Its stock had fallen roughly by half from its 2014–15 highs. The passage identifies stagnant revenue, declining margins, limited competitive advantages and pressure from online retailers as risks, while describing debt as manageable. It argues that dividends and share buybacks, online acquisitions, and the Beyond+ loyalty-program test could support the business. The author estimates an intrinsic value of $54.17 per share under a no-growth scenario but, citing economic and business risks, would consider investing at $32.50.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on November 5, 2015, reporting that it had issued a press release on results for the three and nine months ended October 25, 2015. The filing includes the press release and CFO commentary as exhibits.

The speaker praises Republicans for supporting wartime measures despite their minority status in Congress and promises the party will restore tranquility and security. Addressing two Wyandot County soldiers blinded in the Argonne, he pledges the republic’s continued gratitude and care. He says they fought for American lives, rights, and ideals, and promises that the Stars and Stripes will never be replaced.

The speaker focuses on making saves rather than the opposing goalie. He says familiar surroundings and fans provide a home-ice advantage, and he is learning from playoff experience. He praises Alfy’s leadership and says the team reviewed video and corrections before the next game.

The passage describes ADS9803 reset, power-down, initialization, configuration registers, SPI access, and daisy-chain operation. The eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS device requires a free-running sampling clock; speed-boost mode converts one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS. An ATE application example reports 0.0015% total unadjusted error after calibration and 7.5µs settling in wide-bandwidth mode. The passage also gives power-supply and board-layout guidance and states that TI’s application information and resources have limitations and disclaimers.

Muriel Diaz, 90, trained as a nurse and midwife after teaching in Somerset. She moved to Peru, where she married Alberto and spent six weeks each year nursing at a remote jungle clinic for 18 years. The couple left Peru after 32 years as the threat of terrorism escalated and moved to west Wales in 1995. For the past 20 years, Diaz has volunteered weekly at a Barnardo’s shop in Cardigan, repairing donated clothes. She and her husband have returned to Peru to visit friends and relatives.

After the first week of preseason games, the passage favors Deshaun Watson as Houston’s fantasy quarterback if he starts and predicts DeShone Kizer will win Cleveland’s job.

At running back, it projects Danny Woodhead as Baltimore’s top PPR option, Christian McCaffrey ahead of Jonathan Stewart for fantasy purposes, and Joe Mixon eventually overtaking Jeremy Hill in Cincinnati. It identifies C.J. Anderson, Spencer Ware, Dalvin Cook, Carlos Hyde and Rob Kelley as likely starters. New England’s backfield remains difficult to predict, with Rex Burkhead and Dion Lewis expected to offer the most fantasy value. In New Orleans, Mark Ingram is projected to lead in rushing yards, Adrian Peterson in touchdowns and Alvin Kamara in receptions. Paul Perkins is expected to start for the Giants, while Seattle’s Thomas Rawls and Eddie Lacy should split early-down work.

At receiver, Cameron Meredith is favored to be Chicago’s No. 1 option. Buffalo’s Zay Jones is expected to start opposite Jordan Matthews, with Anquan Boldin playing primarily in the slot.

Yale-New Haven Hospital sought payment for medical services in three cases. The defendants argued that the hospital’s alleged failures to comply with the Hill-Burton Act and Connecticut’s hospital bed funds statute barred collection and supported counterclaims under the Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act. The court held that the statutory defenses were legally valid, that the counterclaims raised factual issues, and that federal law did not preempt them. It denied the hospital’s summary judgment motions.

Barcelona manager Hansi Flick acknowledged that communication with Marc-André ter Stegen could have been handled better during a summer dispute over the goalkeeper’s de-registration and captaincy. Flick said Ter Stegen and the club have since sought genuine communication. Ter Stegen is recovering from back surgery, while Flick said Barcelona chose Joan Garcia as its future goalkeeper.

On June 23, 2017, a Tesla subsidiary amended a revolving credit facility secured by certain SolarCity subsidiary assets and cash flows. The amendment extended the draw period to December 31, 2018, and maturity to December 31, 2019, while reducing lender commitments to $600 million at Tesla’s request.

Joey Chestnut ate 74 hot dogs and buns in 10 minutes at the Nathan’s Famous Hot Dog Eating Contest, surpassing his previous record of 72. An initial tally of 64 missed food on a second plate; a recount confirmed his total. Carmen Cincotti finished second with 64.

The lecture introduces the fast Fourier transform (FFT) as a more efficient way to compute the discrete Fourier transform (DFT). Direct computation requires roughly N² complex multiplications and additions. For N that is a power of two, a decimation-in-time FFT repeatedly splits the input into even- and odd-indexed subsequences, computes smaller DFTs, and combines them using periodicity and butterfly operations. This reduces computation to a quantity proportional to N log₂ N. The resulting flow graph has inputs in bit-reversed order and outputs in sequential order.

NHS cancer screening aims to detect cancer or pre-cancerous changes before symptoms appear, when treatment is more likely to succeed. The three main programmes are cervical screening every five years for people with a cervix aged 25–64, breast screening every three years for women and eligible people aged 50–71, and home bowel screening every two years for people aged 50–74.

Eligible people are invited by post, and NHS screening is free. Results may lead to further tests, including a colposcopy or colonoscopy. People with concerning symptoms should contact a doctor rather than wait for screening. Those with a family history may need checks outside the routine programme; NHS guidance recommends annual mammograms from age 40 for women with neurofibromatosis type 1.

Grigor Dimitrov beat Jared Donaldson in five sets at the French Open despite Donaldson winning a point with an underarm serve while suffering from cramp. Novak Djokovic defeated Jaume Munar in straight sets. Alexander Zverev beat Dusan Lajovic in five sets, while Marco Cecchinato eliminated Marco Trungelliti. Kei Nishikori, David Goffin and Gael Monfils also won on Wednesday.

The Chargers’ future in San Diego hinges on whether the NFL provides more support for a new stadium. Local officials offered $375 million, more than $100 million below what the team sought. Chairman Dean Spanos has asked the league for help but is reportedly leaning toward moving to Los Angeles if none comes. He has until Jan. 15 to decide whether to accept the option to join the Rams there.

Digital piracy offers convenient, low-cost access to content and has resisted technical and legal countermeasures, prompting firms to reconsider distribution. Drawing on archival sources and interviews, the study examines how Spotify and Netflix use subscription streaming, accessible interfaces, content catalogs, consistent quality, recommendations and social features to compete with piracy. It argues that their strongest advantage is improving the experience of finding and consuming content, rather than competing solely on price. Licensing restrictions, limited catalogs and the costs of free access remain challenges. The authors suggest that similar business models may apply to other content categories, while cautioning that industry differences require further study.

Szemerédi’s graph regularity lemma states that, for every ε, every graph has a partition into at most M(ε) parts such that only a small weighted fraction of pairs of parts are not ε-regular. A pair is ε-regular when sufficiently large subsets have nearly the same edge density as the whole pair. Crucially, M depends on ε, not the graph’s size.

The proof repeatedly refines irregular pairs using subsets that witness their irregularity. A bounded energy based on squared edge densities increases by at least ε⁵ at each step, so the process terminates. The resulting bound on the number of parts is extremely large; a theorem of Gowers shows that tower-type bounds are necessary. The lecture also outlines how rebalancing during the proof can produce an equitable partition.

The passage introduces indexed containers as representations of endofunctors on families of sets and reviews their shapes, positions, extents, and morphisms. The work extends Uustalu’s characterization of monoid structures from non-indexed to indexed containers, proving that these structures correspond to monad structures on indexed container functors. It gives examples involving products, indexed state and writer monads, and a free monad for well-scoped λ-terms. The development is formalized in Cubical Agda.

C.J. McCollum scored a career-high 43 points as the Portland Trail Blazers overcame a 12-point halftime deficit to beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 95-89 on Sunday. Portland outscored Minnesota 32-15 in the third quarter despite playing without Damian Lillard for a fourth straight game. Andrew Wiggins led the Timberwolves with 24 points, while Karl-Anthony Towns scored 11 on 3-for-15 shooting.

Sam’s Club will open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. daily starting this weekend, following member feedback. Sunday hours previously ran from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. The first hour is reserved for Plus members, while curbside pickup begins at 7 a.m. Holiday closures and shorter Christmas Eve hours are exceptions.

The Qnap TVS-x73 is a 4-, 6-, or 8-bay NAS with an AMD quad-core processor, up to 64GB of RAM, four Gigabit LAN ports, and two M.2 SSD slots. It supports optional 10GbE networking, delivers up to 1,172 MB/s throughput, and offers 4K video decoding and dual HDMI output.

The Fifth Circuit rejected Mariano Del Cid-Mendez’s constitutional challenge to the illegal-reentry statute because binding precedent foreclosed it. The court vacated his sentence and remanded the case because the district court used mandatory Sentencing Guidelines, and the Government failed to show that the error was harmless.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2015, reports quarterly net sales of $49.6 billion, up 33% from a year earlier, and net income of $10.7 billion, up from $7.7 billion. iPhone sales and Greater China revenue drove growth, while iPad sales declined. For the first nine months of fiscal 2015, net sales totaled $182.2 billion and operating cash flow was $67.8 billion. At quarter-end, Apple reported $273.2 billion in assets and $125.7 billion in shareholders’ equity.
Fred Puhn’s 1981 paperback covers suspension theory, handling modifications, aerodynamics and brake setup for various car layouts. The second-hand copy is listed in very good condition.

The study compared age groups’ shares of COVID-19 ICU admissions before and after the peaks of four Omicron waves in France in 2022. The highest relative-risk estimates shifted from children aged 10–19 in spring, to children aged 0–9 in summer, to those aged 10–19 in autumn, and to adults aged 30–39 in autumn–winter. The authors note uncertainty in using this measure to assess transmission roles. They suggest broader booster vaccination and additional efforts to limit infections among elderly people, including in long-term care facilities.

The speaker says the team needs to get the puck deep and use its young forwards to sustain its cycle game. He praises Ronnie Francis’s professionalism, intelligence and leadership, reflects on seven years of growth alongside his coach, and says playoff results do not always reflect effort. After struggling to score early, he stresses continuing to work through adversity.

An international team led by Harald Ebeling discovered that the galaxy cluster eMACSJ1341.9-2441 magnifies the distant quiescent galaxy eMACSJ1341-QG-1 thirtyfold through gravitational lensing. The record magnification for this rare type of galaxy allows astronomers to study its stars and investigate why it has stopped forming new ones. Follow-up observations are underway.

Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull urged China to use its leverage to curb North Korea’s nuclear and missile ambitions after a failed missile test. His comments preceded US Vice President Mike Pence’s visit to Australia. China has suspended North Korean coal imports but fears that stronger action could destabilize its neighbor.

Southern Illinois defeated Evansville 73-61 on Saturday at the Ford Center after pulling away late. Ryan Taylor and Jaylon Brown scored 19 points each for Evansville, while Mike Rodriguez led Southern Illinois with 20. Evansville led by as many as nine in the first half, but Southern Illinois led 33-31 at halftime and took control late in the second half. Evansville also honored former head coach Jim Crews during the game.
About 400 Brentwood students were sent home Friday after a 9-foot boa constrictor escaped its classroom enclosure through a broken hinge. It was found beneath the floor.

Indian equities rose for a fourth consecutive week, supported by a forecast of normal monsoon rains, strong IT earnings, positive global markets and easing wholesale inflation. The Sensex gained 0.65% to close at 34,415.58, while the Nifty50 rose 0.80% to 10,564.05. Higher crude oil prices, a weaker rupee and selling in banking stocks limited gains amid concerns about a potentially hawkish RBI stance. The rupee closed at 66.13 per dollar, down 92 paise for the week. IT, metals, FMCG and realty led sectoral gains, while PSU banks and energy declined.

Larry Connors’ Multiple Days Up and Multiple Days Down strategy seeks to exploit ETF mean reversion. Its buying rules require an ETF to be above its 200-day moving average, below its 5-day moving average, and down on at least four of the previous five trading days. It sells when the ETF closes above its 5-day moving average, with no stop-loss. In a SPY-and-QQQ test, the strategy made 287 trades, with a 1.82 profit factor, 12% maximum drawdown and 2.4% annualized return. Results varied across ETFs; the short-side SPY-and-QQQ test had a 65% win rate.

During Larry Nassar’s third and final sentencing hearing on assault charges in Michigan, Randall Margraves, whose three daughters said Nassar abused them, lunged at him after a judge refused his request to be alone with Nassar. Sheriff’s deputies restrained Margraves. He later apologized, and the judge said she would not hold him in contempt, while stressing that assault was unacceptable. More than 30 victims had given statements at the hearing. Nassar had previously received sentences of up to 175 years for sexual assault and 60 years for child pornography.

Freeport High School recognized students in grades 9–12 on its second-quarter High Honors and Honors rolls. North Yarmouth Academy listed students from The Forecaster’s coverage area in grades 5–12 who earned Highest Honors, High Honors or Honors during the first semester.

In an Independence Day column, Noozhawk founder Bill Macfadyen emphasizes the First Amendment’s protection of the press and says independent journalism requires resources. He thanks advertisers and Hawks Club members for their support and asks readers to join the club. He notes that contributions are not tax-deductible because Noozhawk is a for-profit business.

Aston Villa beat Burton Albion 3-2 at Villa Park, with goals from Scott Hogan, Albert Adomah and Jack Grealish. An Ahmed Elmohamady own goal and a stoppage-time strike by Liam Boyce kept the match close. Villa’s sixth consecutive win left them third, one point behind second-placed Derby County.

Virginia Chestnuts is a family-run orchard in Nelson County, Virginia, founded by David and Kim Bryant after they tested whether chestnuts would grow on their land. They planted more than 1,600 blight-resistant hybrid trees and, despite weather and insect setbacks, produced a strong harvest in 2017. The Bryants harvest and process the nuts on-site, then sell them fresh, roasted or peeled. Local bakers, brewers, chefs and consumers use the chestnuts in seasonal dishes.

TI’s E2E forums offer design support, but contributor content is not a TI specification. TI cautions that electrostatic discharge can damage integrated circuits. The May 2025 revision changed ADS8685W and ADS8689W from advance information to production data. Mechanical, packaging, and ordering information is subject to change. TI provides technical resources “as is” and states that developers are responsible for product selection, application testing, and compliance with applicable requirements.

A four-year Michigan State University study found that adaptive multi-paddock grazing could offset greenhouse gas emissions during the finishing phase of beef production, while feedlot emissions were higher, primarily because of fertilizer-related nitrogen emissions from feed production. Feedlots produced the same amount of beef on half the land, though managed grazing produced more beef per acre than continuous grazing. Researchers noted that carbon sequestration may decline over time and identified ways to improve environmental practices in both grass- and grain-fed systems.

Mumbai Indians are fielding an unchanged XI against Sunrisers Hyderabad, who bring in Shikhar Dhawan, Mohammad Nabi and Basil Thampi for Ricky Bhui, Deepak Hooda and Billy Stanlake. Stanlake is out for the rest of IPL 2018 with a fractured finger. Both teams seek to recover from recent defeats: Mumbai have lost four of five matches, while Sunrisers have lost two straight after winning their first three. Suryakumar Yadav and Kane Williamson have led their respective teams’ batting efforts.

A near-complete skull of Cifelliodon wahkarmoosuch, an early mammal relative, was discovered in eastern Utah. Researchers say it suggests Pangea’s land connections persisted 15 million years longer than previously thought, allowing these animals to spread across continents. The find also adds evidence that early mammal relatives occupied diverse ecological niches.

At Leander High School’s 2017 prom, winner Keilany Solano spontaneously gave her crown and sash to fellow nominee Abby Cano, saying Cano would be happier and deserved them more. Cano’s mother said the gesture touched her and reflected the kindness her daughter, who has Down syndrome, has experienced at school.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency, peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The devices use a 1.23-V internal reference and a 0.613-V error-amplifier reference. Switching frequency can be set by an internal oscillator, an external clock, or a primary-secondary configuration; supported switching frequencies range from 100 kHz to 2 MHz. Programmable features include soft start, duty-cycle limits, dead time, leading-edge blanking, and slope compensation, with options varying by device. Protection functions include pulse skipping, overcurrent limiting with hiccup restart, external fault shutdown, and thermal shutdown.

The passage also gives component-selection guidance for a 500-kHz, 5-V synchronous push-pull converter using the TPS7H5001-SP, along with power-supply and PCB-layout recommendations.

Maria Sharapova lost to qualifier Vitalia Diatchenko 6-7 (3), 7-6 (3), 6-4 in Wimbledon’s first round after repeatedly surrendering leads. It was Sharapova’s first opening-round loss at Wimbledon. Seven top-10 seeds also exited in the first round, a professional-era record, including two-time champion Petra Kvitova. Players cited unpredictable grass-court bounces, pressure and the transition from clay as possible difficulties.

Samsung is expected to report fourth-quarter 2016 operating profit above market forecasts, driven by strong memory-chip sales. IBK Securities projects $7.21 billion, up 68% from the previous quarter. Samsung plans to release earnings guidance on Friday.

The Second Circuit affirmed the denial of Rodney Nicholson’s habeas petition challenging the exclusion of Darnell Phelps’s hearsay confession from a new-trial motion. The court found the confession insufficiently reliable and held that the state court’s ruling did not violate due process.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) is disabled by default and requires customers to enable it in BIOS. Customers may also require update packages to be co-signed; the BIOS supplies the public verification key during early boot. The ASP verifies applicable customer and AMD signatures before executing a package, and updates are applied only after all required validation succeeds.

Packages must match the system’s firmware versions and patch levels. They can change values, replace firmware images, or update parts of a firmware package. Updates do not persist across reboots, so customers must arrange to reapply them. SFS provides commands to retrieve version information and submit updates, with specified buffer alignment and memory requirements.

SFS updates run alongside x86 and DMA activity and are designed to minimize disruption. SEV updates prevent rollback and require a reboot to revert; SEV or SEV/ES virtual machines must stop and restart for an SEV firmware update.

The third episode of *Marvel’s Inhumans*, “Divide and Conquer,” airs on ABC at 9:00 p.m. ET. After Maximus’s coup, the displaced Inhuman Royal Family must reunite on Earth. Viewers in eligible markets can stream ABC through Sling TV or DirecTV Now. Sling’s ABC package costs $25 per month and is available in eight markets; DirecTV Now’s $35 package offers ABC in 39 markets. Both services offer seven-day free trials.

Helping Hands Hawaii’s Ready to Learn program is holding a school supply drive from June 1 to July 31, 2017, to provide free supplies to low-income and homeless students. American Savings Bank branches will collect donations from June 14 to July 14; donations on each island will benefit local students. As of April 2017, the program had assembled 3,115 supply kits and benefited more than 6,000 students. Students in grades K–12 must be recommended by a case manager at a participating referral organization by June 23. The public can also donate money or volunteer to pack kits.

Federal funding is set to expire Tuesday, putting millions of federal workers at risk of missed paychecks. Members of Congress will continue to be paid because their salaries are funded through mandatory spending, which shutdowns do not affect. A law guarantees retroactive pay to furloughed federal workers. Rep. Angie Craig has proposed temporarily docking lawmakers’ pay during a shutdown.

If Congress does not fund the government, Medicare patients receiving hospital-level care at home must be discharged or returned to hospitals on September 30, 2025, according to CMS guidance. The newsletter also lists health and medicine headlines, but provides no information about MMR vaccines.
The speaker praises one player’s speed, reach and defensive focus on the penalty kill, describes Evgeni as healthy and energized, and calls Zetterberg consistently dangerous and smart.
Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on April 29, 2021, announcing its first-quarter financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures.

A man detonated a pipe bomb strapped to his body in a crowded subway passageway near Times Square during Monday morning rush hour. The suspect and three others suffered non-life-threatening injuries. Authorities identified the suspect as 27-year-old Akayed Ullah and called the blast an attempted terror attack. Officials said he was inspired by the Islamic State group but apparently had no direct contact with it. The explosion disrupted nearby transit service.

The speaker credits a hardworking coaching staff but says the players determine results on the ice. The team has improved by playing harder and smarter, executing well, and keeping its game simple through strong defense and small contributions. Players and coaches respect Cully and recognize the opportunity ahead, but the speaker says nothing has been accomplished yet. The team will focus on what it can control, maintain its routines, and bring its best effort to tomorrow’s game.

Coach Sutter said he entered coaching after he could no longer play and worked through the minors and an organization to become a head coach. He called Brown central to the team’s identity and said Brown wanted to make an impact in the playoffs after a disappointing regular season. Sutter emphasized the sacrifice required to win, expressed pride in his brothers’ six championships, and described his team as one that responds to setbacks. He also noted that several significant players had not previously appeared in a Stanley Cup Final and said lineup decisions were based on the best chance to win.

Tesla delivered a record 497,099 vehicles in the third quarter of 2025, up 7.4% year over year and above forecasts, as U.S. buyers rushed to purchase before the $7,500 federal EV tax credit expired. Incentives also supported sales, but analysts questioned whether demand had shifted from the fourth quarter. Tesla’s European and UK market share weakened, and investor reaction was muted. The company needs nearly 390,000 fourth-quarter deliveries to meet its 1.61 million full-year target.

The UC1825B-SP is a dual-output controller with a sawtooth oscillator. Its RT and CT values set duty cycle and frequency; the example push-pull design uses 10 kΩ and 680 pF for a 215-kHz switching frequency. The passage describes transformer, inductor, clamp, diode, MOSFET, output-filter, compensation, and current-sense selection. It also gives PCB-layout guidance to reduce noise and EMI, including short power traces, separated signal and power grounds, and nearby bypass capacitors. The controller’s input supply range is 10–30 V.

Around 200 people gathered in Nottingham’s market square for a vigil for Mariam Moustafa, 18, who died after an attack outside the intu Victoria Centre. Her father thanked the crowd and called for justice. Speakers and attendees expressed support for her family and called for an end to violence.

Cardinals quarterback Carson Palmer says he feels healthy and excited about the coming season despite a decline in performance in 2016. After joining Arizona in 2013, he posted career-best numbers in 2015, when the team won 13 games. Palmer assesses his health and future after each season and says he wants to keep playing while he can still enjoy the game. Following the Cardinals’ 7-8-1 record in 2016, he welcomes lower expectations and the chance to play as an underdog.

The National Beer Wholesalers Association launched DeliveringLocalJobs.com to highlight the 135,000 people employed in beer distribution across all 50 states. The association says these workers earn $11.2 billion in wages and salaries and help generate $70 billion in U.S. GDP and nearly $13 billion in tax revenue. The site features employee stories, videos and state-by-state economic data.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2022, reports revenue of $52.7 billion, up from $51.7 billion a year earlier, while net income fell to $16.4 billion from $18.8 billion. Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 22% to $27.1 billion. Intelligent Cloud revenue grew, while More Personal Computing revenue declined. The company recorded a $1.2 billion charge related to severance, hardware portfolio changes, and lease consolidation, and announced plans to eliminate approximately 10,000 jobs.

The line to Fusan is interrupted, and Augustine Heard reports concern about unrest, though he doubts there is immediate danger. The U.S.S. *Petrel* arrived at Chemulpo under State Department orders, and its commander agreed to remain for several days. Chinese and Japanese warships are also there. Heard requested ammunition for rifles. A separate order directs authorities to arrest leaders of a movement described as heterodox, prohibit its spread, and enforce the law. It also urges loyalty, filial piety, and willingness to sacrifice one’s life for the king or parents.

The Bollinger Band Squeeze strategy follows a price breakout after the bands contract during low volatility. The passage reports unsuccessful backtests across many assets and variations. On Pepsi, it returned 12.5% versus 14.8% for buy-and-hold while invested 61% of the time. As a breakout strategy, it can have a lower win rate and suffer whipsaws. The passage recommends backtesting for positive expectancy and following tested rules consistently.

Andy has overcome injuries to become a key player, contributing physical play in the playoffs. The speaker expects loud Canucks fans and says Boston must control its emotions and stick to its game. They also expect Newfoundland’s passionate hockey fans to support another team and say it will benefit the economy.

Butterfield reported stronger first-quarter 2018 results, with net interest income rising to $79.9 million, net interest margin increasing to 3.05%, and core return on average tangible common equity reaching 24.3%. Non-interest income declined 6.1% from the prior quarter, while the core efficiency ratio was 62.3%, toward a 60% target. Total assets were approximately $11 billion, and loans reached $4.0 billion.

The bank closed its acquisition of Deutsche Bank’s Global Trust Solutions business and expects to complete its acquisition of Deutsche Bank banking operations in Cayman and the Channel Islands by year-end. Management said the latter deal could increase deposits by as much as 20%. The board authorized a quarterly dividend of $0.38 per common share.

Pedro Russell and his GPS Partners co-founders considered acquiring MedPro Institute, a vocational medical school near Boston. Russell saw an opportunity to attract more students because the school relied largely on word of mouth, but he was unsure how enrollment growth would affect costs. During due diligence, he reviewed expenses including rent, instructor pay, supplies, insurance, internet, and electricity. GPS needed to weigh potential growth against financial sustainability before deciding whether to proceed.

Hammerson rejected Klépierre’s preliminary £4.88bn cash-and-share proposal, which valued it at 615p per share, saying it significantly undervalued the company. Hammerson shares rose about 25% to 545p despite the rejection. The company remains committed to acquiring Intu Properties, from which it expects about £25m in annual synergies. The author considers Hammerson’s valuation attractive but, citing difficult conditions for retail property, prefers to watch developments rather than buy shares.

The speaker regrets what happened to Roli, who had played outstandingly, but sees an opportunity for whoever plays in the Stanley Cup Finals. He says the team has confidence in both players and expects Roli to share insights on shooters. He acknowledges a costly play and a rocky season but says dwelling on the mistake will not help. He plans to stay confident and regain his game-day rhythm.

Bitcoin rose about 2% Friday to $123,874, roughly 1% below its record high, as investors sought hedges during the U.S. government shutdown. It gained 12% for the week. Standard Chartered expects a new high and a subsequent rise to $135,000.

Sen. Cory Booker campaigned in Alabama for Democratic Senate nominee Doug Jones shortly before the election, a visit that could also raise Booker's profile ahead of a possible 2020 presidential bid. African-American voters in Alabama and other Deep South states have played a pivotal role in Democratic primaries. Jones generally kept national Democrats at a distance but welcomed appearances by black lawmakers as he sought to mobilize black voters. Former Gov. Deval Patrick also campaigned for Jones, while Sen. Kamala Harris supported him from outside the state. Some Alabama voters said they appreciated Booker's visit but were not ready to judge his political future.

Dan Le Batard said the Miami Heat believed LeBron James had “checked out” during the 2014 NBA Finals, despite his strong statistics. James left Miami afterward. The passage raises, without answering, whether a similar situation could arise with Cleveland if it reaches the 2018 Finals.

The court reversed a 1931 income-tax deficiency based on preferred shares distributed as a dividend to a common shareholder. The majority held that the Revenue Act of 1928 exempted stock dividends without distinguishing between share classes. It declined to consider alternative grounds for taxing a separate stock redemption because they had not been properly presented or supported by the Board’s findings. Judge L. Hand dissented, arguing that Congress intended the exemption only for dividends it believed could not constitutionally be taxed.

Whitmore’s executors sought to stop trustees from selling land pledged to secure a debt because the creditor had not presented its claim against the estate within the statutory period. The court held that failure to present the claim barred a remedy against the estate but did not extinguish the debt. It reversed the injunction, ruling that the executors could not obtain equitable relief requiring surrender of the security without paying the debt. Justice Crockett dissented, arguing that failure to present the claim also forfeited the lien; Justice McKinstry also dissented.

Matthew James Phelps, 29, called 911 on September 1, saying he had taken Coricidin cough medicine and woken to find his wife Lauren stabbed. She died at a hospital. Investigators found red-stained bedding and an empty Coricidin box in their North Carolina home. Phelps is being held without bail on a first-degree murder charge.

The IRS furloughed about 34,000 workers amid the government shutdown, while 39,870 employees remain on the job. Most operations are closed, and furloughed employees are on non-pay, non-duty status until further notice.

The study reviews public financing for European cleantech start-ups and SMEs, including Horizon 2020 instruments. It identifies loans, equity, grants and guarantees; compares funding conditions and application requirements; and describes support such as coaching and business advice. The EIB and EIF are prominent managers, and some instruments provide funding through intermediaries.

Google canceled the neo-Nazi Daily Stormer’s domain registration, citing its policy against inciting violence, hours after GoDaddy gave the site 24 hours to find a new provider. The actions followed a Daily Stormer article ridiculing Heather Heyer, who was killed while protesting a white-nationalist rally in Charlottesville. YouTube also terminated the site’s channel for hate-speech violations, while Facebook said it removes links to the site unless posts clearly condemn its content. Tucows ended the site’s contact-privacy service. Cloudflare denied hosting Daily Stormer, and its hosting provider remained unclear.

The passage describes optical devices that combine separately fabricated, monochromatic LED arrays to produce multicolored images for displays, including AR glasses. The arrays can be bonded to processor elements that control individual emitters, potentially without adhesive, enabling fine pixel pitches. Mirrors, lenses, or waveguides can superimpose light from different-colored arrays and direct it to a viewer. The passage also describes alternative bonding arrangements and isolation structures that limit light crosstalk between pixels.

Transport Cabinet Secretary James Macharia blamed poor enforcement of existing regulations for disorder in Kenya’s boda boda industry. He said the ministry is working with county transport committees and the traffic department to improve enforcement. MP Simon King’ara proposed a separate motorbike safety authority, arguing that the NTSA is overwhelmed. Nairobi County has recently banned boda boda riders from its central business district.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture doubles peak FP32 throughput per streaming multiprocessor compared with Turing and increases L1 cache capacity and shared-memory bandwidth. Its second-generation RT Cores double ray-triangle intersection testing rates, support concurrent ray tracing and other workloads, and add hardware acceleration for motion blur. Third-generation Tensor Cores add TF32 and BF16 support and structured sparsity, which can double throughput for qualifying matrix operations.

GA10x also introduces GDDR6X memory with up to 936 GB/sec of peak bandwidth. RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression with Microsoft DirectStorage to reduce CPU involvement in loading assets. Other features include support for 8K displays, hardware AV1 decoding, and hardware video encoding. The passage describes GeForce RTX 30-series GPUs alongside the A40 data-center GPU and RTX A6000 workstation GPU.

Tennessee National Wildlife Refuge’s headquarters and Visitor Center will close August 21 for the solar eclipse. Visitors are directed to Cross Creeks National Wildlife Refuge to view totality, expected to last about 55 seconds. Staff will assist with parking and information. Special viewing glasses are needed and will be sold on-site; visitors may bring picnics.

The Louisiana Fourth Circuit Court of Appeal affirmed William Brock’s conviction for molesting his fiancée’s young daughter and his ten-year hard-labor sentence. The court found the evidence sufficient to support the conviction and held that the trial court had not abused its discretion in sentencing him.

The speaker urges Washington residents to aid people affected by the calamity at Johnstown and nearby Pennsylvania communities. Jacksonville has offered $2,000 for Johnstown relief. After hearing from Pennsylvania’s governor that thousands near Williamsport are hungry, homeless and in urgent need of food, the speaker proposes sending provisions there immediately. The speaker also calls for committees to collect clothing and bedding, and money to help people rebuild and furnish their homes. He hopes Washington will respond generously and says he has already made a personal contribution.

This mixed-method study examined 190 Bayburt University education students’ attitudes toward the Research Methods in Education course, using an attitude scale and interviews with 10 students. Attitudes did not differ significantly by department but did differ between first- and fourth-year students. Nine interviewees considered the course necessary, while six said its duration was insufficient. The study recommends offering preparatory courses and increasing the course’s duration.

Centrica’s shares have fallen 35% in a year, leaving an 8.6% dividend yield. The company is pursuing cost savings and a business-model change, but regulatory uncertainty has weighed on investor sentiment. Ventilation supplier Volution reported 11.6% interim revenue growth and a 6.7% rise in adjusted operating profit to £18.3m. It also announced the acquisition of New Zealand supplier Simx Limited. Volution’s 2.2% dividend yield is lower, but its payouts are covered 3.3 times by profit, suggesting scope for growth.

A survey of 133 entry-level occupational therapy students at one urban university found that current mentorship did not adequately meet the needs of students from historically underrepresented groups. Students sought mentors who could offer career guidance, regular support, cultural humility, and help navigating discrimination and microaggressions. BIPOC students placed greater importance on mentors recognizing their biases, while Hispanic/Latinx students reported less effective support across cultural differences. The authors recommend flexible programs combining formal and informal mentorship, diverse mentors, and cultural sensitivity training. Findings are limited by the single-institution, cross-sectional design.

The Colorado Supreme Court held that the district court lacked personal jurisdiction over the Kellners in a fraud and contract-rescission suit. Service at their daughter’s Denver home was invalid because they had never lived there. Service in California was also invalid under a rule limited to Colorado residents. The Kellners’ uncontroverted evidence showed that they had left Colorado intending to settle in California, where they worked, registered to vote, and obtained licenses. The plaintiffs failed to prove they remained Colorado residents. The court granted relief prohibiting the district court from proceeding on that service.

At his final press conference, President Bush thanked the press corps and said he would request the remaining $350 billion in financial rescue funds only if President-elect Obama asked him to. He defended his administration’s response to the financial crisis, saying its actions had begun to thaw credit markets, and wished Obama well as he prepared to take office.

Bush called for a sustainable Gaza cease-fire that would end Hamas rocket fire and arms smuggling. He identified an attack on the United States as the most urgent security threat and said Iran and North Korea remained dangerous. He defended the Iraq troop surge and his tax cuts, while acknowledging mistakes involving the “Mission Accomplished” banner, some of his rhetoric, and the timing of his Social Security proposal. He declined to discuss pardons.

Bush also urged Republicans to be more inclusive, opposed protectionism, defended the federal response to Hurricane Katrina while acknowledging more rebuilding was needed, and said Obama’s election marked progress in race relations. He closed by expressing hope that disagreements with Obama would remain respectful.

The Sensex fell 12.31 points to 28,339.31 on Tuesday, while the Nifty declined 0.14% to 8,792. Five stocks reached new 52-week highs: AIA Engineering, Alkem Laboratories, KEC International, Exide Industries and Kalpataru Power Transmission. AIA and Alkem reported quarterly profit growth of 17.6% and 24.9%, respectively. AIA and Alkem closed higher; the other three closed lower.

The 2017 Royal Rumble is scheduled for the Alamodome, with WWE aiming to sell more than 60,000 tickets. Confirmed matches include AJ Styles defending the WWE Championship against John Cena, Kevin Owens defending the Universal Championship against Roman Reigns while Chris Jericho is suspended above the ring in a shark cage, and the 30-man Royal Rumble.
