Goldberg and Brock Lesnar are confirmed entrants. The Undertaker is expected to appear, while Shawn Michaels is rumoured to have a non-wrestling role.

Shares of U.S. rare earth and critical mineral miners rose after China tightened export restrictions ahead of an expected meeting between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump. The new rules require licenses for certain rare-earth products and uses of Chinese technology. Investors speculated that the Trump administration, which has already taken stakes in several miners, could further support a domestic supply chain.

Lion Air Flight 610 and Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 crashed in 2018 and 2019, killing 346 people. The passage examines the 737 MAX’s MCAS software, which could repeatedly push the aircraft’s nose down using data from a single angle-of-attack sensor. It also describes concerns about Boeing’s compressed development schedule, limited pilot training and FAA oversight. The crashes led to investigations, leadership changes and a 21-month grounding. The FAA cleared the aircraft to return to service in November 2020 with new pilot-training requirements.

Some Bath Rugby fans remained stranded in France three days after their team’s 24–20 Champions Cup loss to Toulon. Snow, ice and wind disrupted flights through Marseille, Nice and other airports, forcing supporters to find alternative routes or wait for later departures. Delays also affected trains, and some fans faced extra time off work, pet-care arrangements or missing a fellow supporter’s funeral. Bath’s team returned to Bristol on a chartered flight on Sunday. Despite the disruption, some supporters said they had enjoyed the trip.

The passage presents HCAR, a three-phase framework for learning constraint models from limited examples. Passive learning generates candidate global constraints and filters fixed-arity candidates. Query-driven refinement then uses machine-learning priors, Bayesian confidence updates, targeted oracle queries, and subset exploration to reject over-fitted global constraints while recovering valid smaller ones. A final active-learning phase identifies remaining fixed-arity constraints. The authors report high accuracy and model coverage with manageable query complexity across diverse benchmarks.

After about seven months away from hockey, Sergei Fedorov wanted to return that season. Selection for the Russian Olympic team helped him resume training. When a North Carolina team made an offer, he hoped Detroit would match it; he was excited when the Red Wings did. He returned to play despite feeling exhausted and recognized how much staying in Detroit mattered to him. He also recalled Scotty Bowman’s speech about Vladi before game three and the team’s joy at seeing Vladi on the ice with the Stanley Cup.

European markets reached record highs as steel and banking shares rose, lifting the STOXX 600 by about 0.5%. Steelmakers benefited from a proposal to reduce tariff-free import quotas, while banks gained amid stable bond yields and improving credit margins. BMW’s weaker outlook weighed on auto stocks. Analysts warned that persistent inflation or renewed trade tensions could threaten the rally.

The study examines orbital and spin Edelstein effects in electron- and hole-doped monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. A perpendicular gate field breaks mirror symmetry, producing chiral orbital and spin textures that generate in-plane magnetic moments under an in-plane current. Calculations using a metal-orbital Hamiltonian fitted to density-functional bands find that the orbital response dominates for electron doping. For hole doping, the Γ valley contributes strongly when occupied; a small compressive strain can make it accessible at lower hole concentrations and enhance both responses. The predicted orbital response exceeds reported values for other studied materials.

On December 12, 2016, NVIDIA agreed with Goldman, Sachs & Co. to terminate 63,259,180.62 warrants issued under 2013 agreements. In exchange, NVIDIA will deliver common shares, with the amount determined by daily volume-weighted average prices from December 13, 2016, through January 31, 2017. The shares will be issued under a registration exemption.

A survey of 404 US mathematics education faculty examined perceived research expectations for tenure and promotion. Expectations varied by institution type, department, and time assigned to research. Respondents reported an average expectation of 1.64 papers per year: about 2.25 at R1 institutions, 1.5 at R2 institutions, and one at other institutions. Research journal articles were the most valued publication type across groups.

Faculty with greater research commitments reported higher publication expectations and were more likely to be expected to pursue and obtain external funding. Compared with education-department respondents, mathematics-department respondents reported slightly lower publication expectations and greater value placed on conference proceedings papers. R2 respondents were more likely than those at R1 or other institutions to report that publication targets were stated in written documents. The authors recommend clearer departmental documents specifying expected publication numbers and how different scholarly activities count toward research expectations.

Chester W. Keltner developed the Keltner Channel in the 1960s. It uses a central moving average and upper and lower bands set by multiples of average true range (ATR); the bands widen and narrow with volatility. Traders use it to assess trends, potential breakouts, reversals, and entry or exit points. Unlike Bollinger Bands, which use standard deviation, Keltner Channels use ATR to set band width. Settings and results vary by market and strategy. One SPY backtest reported a 77% win rate across 288 trades, but the passage cautions that this does not guarantee success.

Government shutdowns have historically had limited, short-lived economic effects, but this one could have a greater impact if President Donald Trump makes some federal furloughs permanent. A prolonged shutdown could also delay key economic reports, including jobs and inflation data, potentially affecting Social Security cost-of-living adjustments and Federal Reserve decisions. Economists generally expect the overall impact to remain mild, though furloughed workers and contractors could face financial strain.

The Bank of England allotted £5.085 billion in six-month repos, its largest amount since March 2020 and more than double the previous week’s figure. The increase comes as the bank encourages repo borrowing while unwinding quantitative easing. Demand remains much greater for seven-day repos, which reached £87.149 billion the previous week.

Richard Fabian’s market timing model is a rule-based, long-term trend-following strategy for the S&P 500. It uses 39-week moving averages for the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and utilities sector, with signals evaluated weekly. The passage does not disclose the specific buy and sell rules. It reports low volatility and maximum drawdown in a backtest, while noting that the backtest began just after the dot-com bubble’s peak and that longer-term returns should be closer to buy-and-hold returns. It emphasizes the importance of following the model consistently.

A Netflix documentary follows Michigan student Lauryn Licari and her boyfriend as they receive months of threatening, graphic texts from an unknown sender. After local investigators fail to identify the sender, the FBI examines cellphone evidence. The columnist says the film could have explained cellphone forensics more thoroughly and argues that widespread phone access can harm students and complicate investigations. He also supports Oklahoma’s trial policy restricting internet-connected devices in schools during the 2025–2026 school year.

Chelsea will face Barcelona in the Champions League last 16 after finishing second in Group C. Barcelona won Group D. The first leg is scheduled for February and the second for March. The teams last met in 2012, when Chelsea advanced 3-2 on aggregate and went on to win the competition.

The lecture uses Voronoi honeycomb models to examine osteoporosis. Random structure has little effect on elastic modulus but lowers compressive strength compared with regular honeycombs. For the same loss of bone mass, removing struts reduces stiffness and strength more than thinning them. The lecture also describes metal foams being explored as porous coatings and substitutes for orthopedic implants, and reviews methods for making them. Finally, it explains how trabecular bone patterns can inform evolutionary studies: similarities between a fossil ilium and human ilia led researchers to suggest the fossil species was bipedal at least some of the time.

A South Carolina House panel advanced a plan to address a $24 billion pension funding gap by raising employee and employer contributions. Local officials objected to the increased costs. Another bill advanced to the House floor would recognize concealed-carry permits from all states. The Senate passed a bill authorizing license plates honoring Coastal Carolina University’s baseball championship, with profits funding scholarships.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2021 reports third-quarter revenue of $13.76 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $1.62 billion, up from $8.77 billion and $331 million a year earlier. For the first nine months, revenue was $36.10 billion and operating cash flow was $6.91 billion. At September 30, Tesla reported $57.83 billion in assets and $16.07 billion in cash and cash equivalents. The filing also discusses supply-chain constraints, debt repayments, and $1.26 billion in digital assets held.

This qualitative study analyzes a teacher-education choir project and an upper-primary mathematics lesson to explore dialogue in classroom practice. Using the concepts of epistemological dialogue, ontological dialogue, Bildung, musicking, and mathematizing, the authors find that both teachers supported participation by listening to students, incorporating their contributions, and remaining open to unexpected outcomes. The study argues that subject learning and personal development can interact in classroom dialogue, while noting that teachers must balance openness with their authority and respect for students’ boundaries.

A 19-year-old woman was sexually assaulted by a man on a train to Taunton on April 8. Other passengers intervened, and the man left with his group at Bridgewater. British Transport Police are appealing for witnesses and information.

The lecture examines gravitational radiation in linearized general relativity. The gauge-invariant, transverse-traceless part of the metric perturbation has two polarizations, called plus and cross. Freely falling bodies can remain fixed in the chosen coordinates as a wave passes, but their relative separation and the travel time of light between them change. LIGO seeks these effects by comparing light reflected along its arms. For a distant source, the lecture derives the quadrupole formula: the radiation field depends on the second time derivative of the source’s quadrupole moment, projected to be transverse and traceless, and decreases with distance.

Winter brings parking congestion around Kensington Park, with no immediate plans to add parking. The council warns drivers before ticketing rule violations and advises carpooling, leaving earlier, or dropping players off before parking.

Researchers identified TRPM8 and TRPP3 as potential targets for increasing brown fat, with possible implications for obesity and diabetes treatment. In human cell cultures, activating TRPM8 promoted brown fat formation, while inhibiting it impeded formation. Disabling TRPP3 prevented brown fat formation but not white fat formation.

The Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission has suspended the 2016 Combined Competitive Preliminary Examination result and withdrawn the main examination notification after candidates reported discrepancies in question papers and answer keys. Independent subject experts will review all papers and keys, despite an earlier expert review. The commission will decide any further action and announce a new main examination date after receiving their findings. The suspended result had declared 6,925 candidates successful.

Lyminster Primary School was rated as requiring improvement after a May Ofsted inspection. Inspectors praised recent leadership changes but said they had not yet had enough impact and teaching was not consistently good. Headteacher Steven McGinley said the school was already addressing the identified issues and was confident it could improve rapidly.

Bluehole’s Xbox One PUBG event, Snipe City, challenges players to collectively make 400,000 kills with the M24 and Kar98 by July 10. Eligible players receive clothing and crates if the community succeeds.

Zacks Investment Research upgraded State Bank Financial Corporation from “sell” to “buy” and set a $30 price target. The stock’s average analyst rating remained “Hold,” with an average target of $25.25. The company reported quarterly earnings of $0.34 per share, above the $0.31 consensus estimate, and paid a $0.14 quarterly dividend. Shares opened at $26.86 on Thursday. State Bank Financial provides community banking services in Georgia.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended April 1, 2023, reports net sales of $94.8 billion, down 3% year over year, and net income of $24.2 billion, down from $25.0 billion. Lower Mac sales and unfavorable currency movements weighed on revenue, partly offset by higher Services sales. For the first six months of fiscal 2023, net sales were $212.0 billion and operating cash flow was $62.6 billion. Apple repurchased $19.1 billion of shares and paid $3.7 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the quarter. On May 4, it announced an additional $90 billion share repurchase authorization and raised its quarterly dividend to $0.24 per share.

The Texas appeals court affirmed John and Mary Lee Geesbreght’s divorce and the award of custody of their children to John. It held that the trial court had jurisdiction and found no reversible error in the custody trial. It reversed the property division because the court valued John’s shares in a professional corporation without considering corporate goodwill, and remanded that issue for a new trial.

NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 29, 2018, reported revenue of $3.12 billion, up 40% from a year earlier, and net income of $1.10 billion, up 89%. Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.76 from $0.92. GPU and Tegra Processor revenue each grew 40% year over year, while lower demand for cryptocurrency-mining GPUs reduced OEM and IP revenue. At quarter-end, cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $7.94 billion. During the first half of fiscal 2019, NVIDIA repurchased $655 million of shares and paid $182 million in dividends.

Asian shares fell Tuesday after a sell-off in U.S. technology stocks, led by Facebook amid scrutiny over improper access to user data. Investors also awaited the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting and weighed concerns about further U.S. trade measures against China. Japan’s Nikkei dropped 1.0 percent, while a broad Asia-Pacific index slipped 0.2 percent. Short-term U.S. Treasury yields rose ahead of an expected Fed rate increase, but the dollar barely gained. The euro rose following a report on European Central Bank policy discussions, and the pound gained after Britain and the EU agreed on a post-Brexit transition period. Oil prices were little changed.

Health workers in Ogun and Lagos are on alert for Lassa fever. Ogun confirmed one case; the patient is responding to treatment, and 66 contacts are under surveillance. Lagos previously reported five cases, two deaths and 150 people under surveillance.

Motorola’s Moto Z Force gained fans for its shatterproof display, larger battery and comfortable design, but was limited by carrier exclusivity. Reports suggest the anticipated Moto Z2 Force, expected around June 2017, may be available beyond Verizon, potentially unlocked or through other carriers.

Researchers tested a longitudinal Grade of Membership (L-GoM) model, previously developed using clinic-based patients, in 273 community-dwelling older adults with Alzheimer’s dementia or mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Using information from each participant’s initial visit, they predicted survival and need for full-time care over 7.5 years and compared the predictions with observed outcomes.

The model’s survival predictions fit the data for participants with MCI and for those whose Alzheimer’s diagnosis remained consistent. Predictions of full-time care generally fit these groups, though some differences occurred. The model did not fit the 32 participants whose initial Alzheimer’s diagnosis was later changed to a non-dementia diagnosis; the authors noted that some diagnoses may have been premature or incorrect. Results support use of the model in this multiethnic community cohort, including people with MCI. The authors called for further validation in other minority populations.

Cleveland Central High School students presented the Purple Christmas Showcase at the Delta Arts Alliance on Friday. The gallery featured photos and biographies drawn from interviews they conducted for the Cleveland Yearbook, along with homecoming photos and interview quotes. The students have worked on the community-based project since September. The display will remain up until Wednesday.
Wall Street headhunters told Business Insider that candidates should be honest with recruiters and consider specializing in an underserved niche that banks value and that offers room for growth.

The speaker argues that the United States should help guarantee lasting international peace, but only if the war ends on terms worth preserving. Agreements between belligerents alone will not suffice; peace requires an organized collective force stronger than any nation or alliance. Rather than a balance of power or a victory imposed on the defeated, the settlement must establish a community of power and a peace between equals.

Microsoft reported revenue of $49.4 billion and net income of $16.7 billion for the quarter ended March 31, 2022, up from $41.7 billion and $15.5 billion a year earlier. Diluted earnings per share rose to $2.22 from $2.03. Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 32% to $23.4 billion. The company completed its $18.8 billion acquisition of Nuance and had agreed to acquire Activision Blizzard in a transaction valued at $68.7 billion, subject to approvals and other conditions.

Before the Golden Knights’ debut as Las Vegas’s first major pro sports franchise, Dallas Stars and Vegas players joined in pregame tributes to the 58 shooting victims, a Stars staff member and announcer Dave Strader.

Fibonacci trading uses retracement, expansion and fan tools to identify potential support and resistance, plan entries and exits, and estimate profit targets. Common retracement levels include 23.6%, 38.2%, 50% and 61.8%. The passage says no timeframe or level is universally best and recommends backtesting. It also notes limited evidence for the strategy: a cited study of Vanguard ETFs found that buy-and-hold outperformed an active Fibonacci retracement strategy.

A Yale-Brookings analysis finds no evidence yet of broad AI-driven disruption in the U.S. labor market, despite reported declines in some AI-exposed entry-level jobs. Researchers say a slowing economy, an aging population and reduced immigration better explain current hiring difficulties. AI may already affect specific workers and industries, but exposure to the technology does not necessarily mean job loss. The authors expect any widespread displacement to take years and to depend on whether companies redesign workflows around AI as a replacement for workers.

Day trading buys and sells financial instruments within one trading day to seek gains from short-term price movements. The passage describes strategies including momentum, range, scalping, breakout, pullback, reversal, gap and news trading. Their effectiveness varies with market conditions, time of day and the market traded. Day trading requires capital, discipline, risk management and emotional control; volatility and leverage can cause substantial losses. Backtesting uses historical data to assess a strategy, but past results do not guarantee future performance. The passage says most day traders do not make money and that expecting a consistent 1% daily return is unrealistic.

U.S. wheat futures fell to their lowest in nearly three weeks on light export demand and forecasts of rain in the southern Plains. Soybeans declined for a fifth day as warmer weather was expected to accelerate planting, while weak exports to China weighed on prices. Corn was nearly unchanged despite planting lagging the five-year average. The USDA reported that 31 percent of the U.S. wheat crop was in good-to-excellent condition, below analysts’ forecasts.

Ukrainian startup Dropla is testing Blue Eyes, AI software that analyzes live drone footage to detect landmines and Russian ambush drones along supply routes. It sends threat coordinates to Ukrainian commanders, who can reroute convoys or destroy drones. Frontline units have tested it since early summer, though its effectiveness has not been disclosed.

Newcastle reportedly plan to renew their interest in Besiktas midfielder Tolgay Arslan this summer. Manchester United manager Jose Mourinho said he expects goalkeeper David de Gea to stay and advised Real Madrid to pursue someone else. Shakhtar Donetsk chief executive Sergei Palkin said midfielder Fred will leave in June for either Manchester City or Manchester United.

The passage traces the expansion of Education Savings Accounts (ESAs) from targeted vouchers to programs available to most or all students in several states. Unlike conventional vouchers, ESAs can fund private-school tuition, homeschooling, pods, and other educational goods and services. The brief links this model to Milton Friedman’s proposal for “divisible vouchers” and notes that ESA allocations are generally below per-pupil public-school spending.

It raises concerns about oversight of purchases and instruction, rising private-school tuition and state costs, and potential effects on public-school budgets, rural communities, students, and staff. It recommends repealing ESA programs or, where that is not possible, limiting their expansion and costs while strengthening spending controls, academic requirements, transparency, and anti-discrimination protections.

Impact venture capital firms have raised $13 billion since 2001, including $10 billion since 2010, to invest in businesses that pursue social or environmental benefits alongside high financial returns. The passage distinguishes these firms from the broader impact-investing category and calls their target businesses “GoodBusiness.” It describes funds investing across environmental solutions, services for underserved emerging markets, ethical consumer products, and overlooked entrepreneurs. The author expects impact VC to grow, but predicts that dedicated funds’ expansion will slow in 10–15 years as traditional VC firms adopt similar investment strategies.
The speaker wants to make the most of playing opportunities rather than wait for an injury. The team feels better after its first Finals game and aims to earn a split.
The Trump administration switched Admiral Harry Harris’s ambassador nomination from Australia to South Korea amid negotiations over North Korea’s nuclear weapons and the Korean War.

The Side Screen Offense uses a ballhandler and screener to create a drive, shot, pass or post opportunity. Their response depends on the defense: the ballhandler may drive, pull up, pass to a rolling or popping screener, or kick out to a shooter. Against traps, the offense spreads the defense and moves the ball with passes. The passage describes High Post Rub, Power and Horns entries, plus several continuity options when the initial action does not produce a shot. Effective execution requires coordination, timing, footwork and practice. Teams are advised to scout defensive tendencies and vary their entries and alignments.

The passage describes a hydraulic-fracturing fluid end designed to address wear and failures associated with traditional housings. It uses replaceable, side-by-side sections, each with a single horizontal bore instead of intersecting bores. A fluid-routing plug directs intake fluid through suction and discharge valves as a reciprocating plunger pressurizes it. The design also describes separate intake manifolds, removable components, seals, and features intended to reduce stress and erosion.

Aldwick councillor Jacqui Maconachie died at home on Friday after a battle with cancer. She served on Arun District Council for 22 years, including as chairman from 2001 to 2002. MP Nick Gibb and council officials paid tribute.

Reports link Real Madrid with Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford, though he is said to be happy at United and not seeking a move. United are also reportedly considering a £40m summer bid for Fulham’s Ryan Sessegnon, who is attracting interest from Tottenham.

A study of South Korean and U.S. cohorts found that more than 99% of people who experienced a first heart attack, stroke, or heart failure had at least one prior cardiovascular risk factor: nonoptimal blood pressure, cholesterol, or blood glucose, or a history of smoking. Researchers said risk levels below clinical treatment thresholds can still matter. A cardiologist not involved in the study said the U.S. health care system invests more in treatment than prevention.

MIG partitions the A100 GPU into up to seven isolated instances, providing multiple clients with predictable performance, defined quality of service, enhanced security, and improved hardware utilization.

The passage describes methods for reducing power use in next-generation wireless networks. A UE receives a power-saving signal specifying a minimum scheduling offset between a control channel and a data channel, then applies that restriction after an application delay. Other proposed mechanisms address HARQ feedback when power-saving settings change and select transmission beams associated with active antenna panels.

The Triangle and Two defense uses three players in a triangle zone while two “chasers” deny passes to assigned opponents. It can target two strong scorers, disrupt set plays, or provide a change of defense. The zone supports chasers against back cuts and drives and can help double-team a strong post player. Against a two-guard front, the triangle can be inverted.

Ryan Walters is leaving his post as Oklahoma’s education chief to lead the national anti-union Teacher Freedom Alliance. His tenure featured Bible-related mandates, disputed curriculum changes, immigration proposals and frequent conflicts with educators and critics. Supporters praised his defense of parental rights, while critics described his culture-war approach as a preview of the Trump administration’s education policies. Despite Walters’ strong support for Trump, he did not receive a federal appointment, and observers questioned whether he could build a national following.

In the UK, divorce and civil partnership dissolution require a court order and proof that the relationship is beyond repair on a legally recognised ground. Grounds listed include adultery, unreasonable behaviour, desertion, and separation for two or five years. Proceedings begin with a petition; where children are involved, a Statement of Arrangements is also filed. Uncomplicated cases may conclude within six months.

Canada’s main stock index edged higher in late-morning trading, supported by financial and materials stocks, while major U.S. indexes fell. The Canadian dollar, crude oil, natural gas, gold and copper all rose.

An April 2001 energy-news digest focuses on California’s electricity crisis. A Cal-ISO study alleged that public and private suppliers earned excess profits in the wholesale market; the suppliers denied wrongdoing. California lawmakers sought temporary federal price caps, but federal regulators and Western states were divided. Southern California Edison agreed to sell its transmission lines to the state for $2.76 billion, pending approval, while PG&E pursued bankruptcy. Other reports covered possible further rate increases, business conservation measures, concerns about a Maryland gas-import facility, and Spain’s plans to avoid a similar electricity crisis.

Seasonal weakness, thin trading, tax-loss selling and institutional rebalancing may pressure markets. The author says Treasury bond prices fell after reaching a key resistance level, though technical indicators remain mixed. Further declines in yields could support bonds and stocks, while a weaker dollar could benefit commodities. The passage urges readers to watch gold, yields, the dollar and July trading ranges for signs of market direction.

Hunter Greene, a 17-year-old pitcher and shortstop, was selected second overall by the Cincinnati Reds in the 2017 amateur draft. His 102-mph fastball and power hitting make him an unusual two-way prospect. The passage also highlights his potential significance for baseball’s efforts to attract African-American players. Greene wants to continue pitching and hitting, but the Reds plan to focus initially on his pitching while allowing him at-bats. He has not yet signed a contract, and his development could take years.
A startup proposes letting anyone run reinforcement learning as interest grows in open-source Chinese AI models.

Ohio State linebacker Arvell Reese has emerged as a potential first-round pick and top-10 candidate in the 2026 NFL Draft. At 6-foot-3 and 243 pounds, he plays multiple roles across the front seven and stands out for his speed, tackling, run defense and ability to spy mobile quarterbacks. His coverage experience is limited, and questions remain about his zone processing, occasional overaggression and how his strength will hold up against NFL linemen. The report projects him as an immediate starter at outside off-ball linebacker.

The longest known woolly rhino horn, found with a skull in Siberian permafrost, is 30 centimeters longer than the previous record holder. Nearby remains date the find to about 19,600 years ago. Seasonal bands in the horn indicate the rhino lived at least 40 years. Researchers think the relatively small skull belonged to a female; the flattened horn may have helped clear snow while feeding.

The lecture explains static fusion trees, which support predecessor and successor searches in O(log base w of n) time using linear space on a word RAM, with polynomial preprocessing. Each tree node stores about w to the 1/5 keys and selects a branch in constant time. It does so by retaining bits that distinguish the keys, using multiplication to compute compact sketches, and comparing multiple sketches in parallel. A second search corrects cases where sketching places a query incorrectly. The lecture also shows how to find the most significant set bit in constant time.

The Supreme Court relisted 17 petitions for another conference, covering parental rights, religious accommodations, Section 230, jury trials, prison conditions, arbitration, criminal appeals, and other constitutional questions. Two California cases were relisted despite the respondents waiving their right to file briefs. Relisting can signal a justice’s interest, but it does not mean the court will grant review.

Tesla’s teaser for a 7 October announcement has prompted speculation about a delayed Roadster or a lower-cost electric vehicle. Reports point to a simplified Model Y designed to reduce production costs by about 20%. A cheaper model could help sustain demand after U.S. EV tax credits expired, though investors remain cautious because of Tesla’s past launch delays.
Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 14, 2018, disclosing a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The disclosure was furnished under Item 7.01, not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.

Sevilla midfielder Pablo Sarabia welcomed the Champions League last-16 draw against Manchester United, saying Manchester City and Paris Saint-Germain were the only teams Sevilla wanted to avoid. He expects a competitive tie but believes Sevilla can advance.

A Children’s Rights Alliance report based on research in greater Dublin found that homelessness and emergency accommodation disrupt children’s education. Some parents must choose between food and travel to school, while children face hunger, exhaustion, absences and difficulty doing homework. The report also links displacement to behavioural and mental health difficulties. It recommends free school travel, funding for school supports and suitable accommodation near children’s schools.

Life cycle assessment (LCA) evaluates a product or service from raw materials through disposal. Its four stages are defining the goal and scope, inventorying inputs and emissions, assessing potential environmental impacts, and interpreting the results. Choices about system boundaries, data, allocation, and the unit of comparison shape an assessment.

A hand-drying study compared dryers and towels per pair of dried hands. Limited data required assumptions about supply chains, drying times, electricity, and recycling, which the researchers tested through sensitivity and uncertainty analyses. The Dyson Airblade generally showed the lowest impact, though the Xlerator performed better in some scenarios. The lecture also distinguishes attributional LCA, which assesses an existing system, from consequential LCA, which models the effects of changes.

On August 26, 2022, the U.S. government imposed an immediate license requirement for NVIDIA’s future exports to China, including Hong Kong, and Russia of A100 and H100 chips, related systems, comparable future chips, and supporting technology. The requirement addresses potential military use or diversion. NVIDIA said it does not sell to Russian customers. The restriction could delay H100 development, affect A100 customer support, and put approximately $400 million in potential China sales included in its third-quarter outlook at risk. NVIDIA is seeking exemptions and licenses and offering Chinese customers alternative products, but approvals are uncertain.

A study of 1,566 school-age children in northeastern Tanzania examined malnutrition risk factors and whether intermittent malaria-prevention treatment improved nutritional status. At baseline, 27% of tested children had malaria; 23% of children aged 5–10 were underweight, 21% of all participants were stunted, and 28% were thin. Malaria was associated with higher odds of stunting, low socioeconomic status with underweight, and recent malaria illness with thinness. Over 20 months of follow-up, neither preventive drug regimen significantly improved weight, height, or BMI compared with standard care. The authors caution that the baseline data cannot establish whether malaria causes stunting and recommend addressing malaria and nutrition together.

Construction at Chadron State’s Elliott Field and Don Beebe Stadium remains on schedule despite rain. June work is expected to include bleachers, field grading, turf preparation, a scoreboard and new lighting, which is expected to be ready for the September 1 season opener. The expanded construction zone has closed traffic between the Nelson Physical Activity Center and Chicoine Center parking lots, though both remain accessible by other routes. The college board is expected to consider starting the track facility’s design phase next month, while fundraising for the sports complex continues.

The report examines the global Angelica seed oil market’s historical, current and projected revenue, production, demand and growth. It covers market drivers, risks, competition and investment analysis, with regional coverage including the United States, China, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia and India. It segments products into therapeutic grade and other types, and applications into medical, spa and relaxation, and other uses.

Tokyo stocks rebounded Wednesday as a weaker yen, gains in U.S. equities and expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike encouraged buying. The Nikkei rose 1.03 percent to 19,437.98, while the Topix gained 0.95 percent to 1,553.69. Exporters and financial shares advanced. Dentsu and Toyo Tire & Rubber rose following positive earnings announcements, while Toshiba fell 8.75 percent after projecting a massive loss in its U.S. nuclear business.

Working adults make up a substantial share of college students and often balance school with jobs and family responsibilities. University of Phoenix president Timothy P. Slottow advises adults considering a return to school to build a support system, consult academic and financial advisers, ask whether prior experience can earn credit, and choose a program whose schedule fits their responsibilities. He says institutions should offer flexibility, structure and career-relevant programs.

A longitudinal study of 691 adults aged 18–45 across four sites in India compared immune responses to Covishield and Covaxin by pre-vaccination serostatus. Both vaccines increased anti-spike antibodies, but Covishield generally produced higher seroconversion rates, antibody levels and responses against SARS-CoV-2 variants. Among initially seronegative participants, seroconversion after two doses was 98.3% with Covishield and 74.4% with Covaxin. In a subset, Covishield significantly increased spike-specific CD4 and CD8 T-cell responses, while Covaxin mainly increased CD4 responses among antibody responders.

Responses differed across cohorts whose vaccination and sampling overlapped with the Omicron wave. This overlap prevented a clear assessment of immune-response durability and limited direct comparisons during that period. The study did not measure some antibody functions, and its immunogenicity findings cannot be used to infer vaccine efficacy.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines rasterization, RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI processing, and improved memory, video, and display systems. Its Tesla T4 GPU targets inference in data centers, enterprises, and edge devices, with 2,560 CUDA Cores, 320 Tensor Cores, and 16 GB of memory. The passage describes higher inference performance and energy efficiency than CPU-based systems.

Other Turing features include GDDR6 memory, NVLink, 8K display and video support, and single-connector VR connectivity through VirtualLink. NGX provides AI-based features including DLSS, image inpainting, slow-motion video, and resolution enhancement. Mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering offer developers additional ways to manage rendering work. The passage explains how hybrid rendering, denoising, bounding volume hierarchies, and RT Cores enable real-time ray-traced effects.

The Yankee concept is a shot play built around a deep post and a dig route from opposite sides of the formation. Often run from heavier sets to draw a one-high safety look, it lets the quarterback read the safety and throw the post if the safety stays low or the dig if he drops deep. It is less effective against two-high coverage, when the quarterback should turn quickly to underneath routes. The progression is post, dig, crosser, then check-down. Variations use shallow crossers or whip routes underneath while keeping the post-dig combination as the main focus.

Overwhelmed by a recent sad event and unexpected responsibilities, the speaker declines to announce a policy, saying his actions will reveal it. He points to his past commitment to free government and popular rights, expresses confidence that the government will survive its present perils, and asks for support.

A study found that rapid glacier melting in two Antarctic regions is preventing surface water from cooling and sinking, allowing warm water to collect beneath ice shelves and drive further melting. Researchers say this feedback could accelerate sea-level rise. It may also reduce Antarctic bottom water, potentially slowing ocean currents and contributing to atmospheric warming and more superstorms. An ice-shelf collapse could produce a rapid sea-level-rise “pulse”; some experts estimate South Florida could see 10 to 30 feet of rise by 2100 in that scenario. The researchers say the process needs further study.

The speaker says excitement about a first Stanley Cup Final led some players to try to do too much, and they need to return to their regular game. They expect a more physical series after the opponent scored five road goals but lost. Their approach is to create traffic in front of the goaltenders, wear down the opponent’s heavily used defensemen, and improve puck possession. The speaker also hopes their team can do more to earn a power play.

Zebronics introduced its portable Buddy speaker for Rs. 1,699. It weighs 630 grams and features 5 W output, Bluetooth, FM radio, USB/MicroSD/AUX connectivity, an LED display, RGB lighting, and up to three hours of battery playback.

The author argues that expanding apprenticeships will not improve access unless more people can enter them. Construction apprenticeships can favor applicants with existing skills, while pre-apprenticeships help participants explore careers, build skills and prepare for entry assessments. The author says these programs need more funding and better outcome tracking. Proposed steps include financial support for barriers such as transportation and childcare, stronger data on placements, and investment from employers, unions, government agencies and philanthropy.

An AI tool called Waldo scanned more than 430,000 cannabis-related Reddit posts and flagged over 28,000 as potentially describing harmful or unexpected effects. Researchers verified problematic experiences in 86 percent of a 250-post sample. In an earlier test, Waldo produced fewer false positives than ChatGPT but did not outperform human reviewers. Researchers say such tools could help public health workers identify problems, though their effectiveness with other products remains uncertain and their use would require privacy protections.

Most surveyed HPC users prefer external infrastructure: 87% use or plan to use it, while 74% operate or plan infrastructure in colocation datacenters. Scientific institutions are used or planned by 43%, but may be unsuitable for time-sensitive work. Only 6% currently have on-premises HPC infrastructure.

The passage compares six swing trading indicators using backtests on SPY and ranks Williams %R highest for its consistent results and low maximum drawdowns. It describes swing trades as lasting from a day to a few weeks and suggests 1–15 days as a typical time frame. The results may differ across assets, and past performance does not guarantee future results.

The passage describes video encoding and decoding methods intended to improve intra- and inter-prediction efficiency. For inter-prediction, motion information and weight prediction parameters may be inherited from neighboring blocks, encoded separately, or derived from reconstructed pixels to account for brightness changes. Motion-vector precision may also be adjusted using adjacent reconstructed pixels. For intra-prediction, the methods include encoding prediction modes through candidates or differences from previous modes and correcting prediction samples using reconstructed pixel areas and correction coefficients. The passage also describes prediction for sub-blocks and outlines the encoding and decoding apparatuses.

This non-peer-reviewed paper presents Robodoc, a prototype medical chatbot that uses OpenAI APIs to select models from users’ text or uploaded images. Its models assess diabetes-related measurements, classify pneumonia from X-rays, and identify retinal conditions from OCT images. Reported testing accuracy was about 90% for the diabetes model, 81% for the pneumonia model, and 91% for the retinal model. Demonstration conversations showed generally appropriate model selection, but also errors in classification and urgency decisions. Appointment scheduling remains a stub function. The author describes the chatbot as a potential assistant, not a replacement for medical professionals.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture combines rasterization, RT Cores and Tensor Cores to support hybrid rendering, real-time ray tracing and AI-based graphics features. RT Cores accelerate ray-tracing calculations; denoising and bounding volume hierarchies reduce the work needed to produce reflections, shadows and ambient occlusion. Tensor Cores support multiple precision modes and power NGX features including DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo and AI Super Rez.

Turing also introduces mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading and expanded multi-view rendering. Its memory improvements include GDDR6, larger caches and improved compression. Updated display and video engines support 8K output and encoding, while VirtualLink provides a single-connector option for VR headsets. NVLink increases bandwidth between supported GPUs used in SLI.

The passage describes TU102, TU104 and TU106 GPUs, including the Tesla T4 for inference workloads, and introduces RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering.

NASA ambassador Theo Wellington told the Wilson County Commission that the total solar eclipse could double the population along its path, including Wilson County. The county fairground is near the path’s center, where totality will last nearly the maximum 2 minutes and 40 seconds. Commissioners also voted to let eligible retiring sheriff’s officers keep their service weapons and approved a $10,000 amendment for training and certifying a school resource officer for Springdale Elementary School before it opens in August.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2015 reported revenue of $20.4 billion, down 12% from a year earlier, and net income of $4.62 billion, up from $4.54 billion. Diluted earnings per share rose to $0.57 from $0.54. Revenue fell primarily because of lower phone revenue and a $1.3 billion Windows 10 revenue deferral, partly offset by growth in Intelligent Cloud. Operating cash flow was $8.59 billion. Microsoft began reporting under three new segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

The passage argues that national success depends on patriotism that puts loyalty to the country above local or class interests, cooperation among workers and employers, and effective education. It urges practical technical and industrial training to improve workers’ skills, opportunities, and ability to compete with trained workers abroad. Although states have primary responsibility for schools, the federal government should make the District of Columbia a model for training and labor legislation. Farmers likewise need practical scientific education, better organization, and more intensive cultivation. The passage stresses that national progress also depends on farmers’ moral, mental, and physical development.

U.S. stocks rose Monday after the Easter weekend, led by technology shares, as China reported first-quarter economic growth of 6.9 percent. By 11:20 a.m. Eastern, the S&P 500 was up 0.5 percent, while the Dow and Nasdaq each gained 0.6 percent. Alere surged after accepting a reduced buyout offer from Abbott, while Eli Lilly and Incyte fell after the FDA declined to approve their rheumatoid arthritis pill. Snyder’s-Lance dropped on a weak forecast, and Arconic rose following its CEO’s departure. Oil prices and Treasury yields edged lower.

The Romanian leu was steady ahead of a central bank decision on whether to raise interest rates for a fourth time this year. Analysts were divided, although many expected a quarter-point increase to 2.75%. The forint and Czech crown firmed as investors reduced some emerging-market currency selling after the yuan rebounded. The leu has been less affected by the regional sell-off, while Romania’s three-month interbank rate has risen above the central bank’s benchmark. In Hungary, concern about inflation and low short-term rates persisted despite a shift in the central bank’s stance.

Two TPS7H500x-SP controllers can operate in primary-secondary mode by connecting the primary’s SYNC output to the secondary’s SYNC input. The primary’s RT pin is populated; the secondary’s is left floating. The controllers can synchronize independent converters or operate an interleaved converter with additional shared pins. Corresponding outputs have a 90° or 270° phase shift.

Singapore’s Straits Times Index rose 0.9 per cent to 3,308.69, joining gains across most major Asian markets. Weak US inflation data raised expectations of a dovish Federal Reserve, while easing US–North Korea tensions supported sentiment. Japan’s Nikkei fell nearly 1 per cent. Analysts cautioned that geopolitical risks could still limit rallies. Locally, OCBC, DBS and several property stocks gained, while UOB slipped. Olam rose after reporting higher quarterly profit; Asian Pay Television Trust gained despite a fall in profit.

At Steven Del Duca’s nomination meeting in Vaughan, former prime minister Jean Chrétien praised Torontonians for coming together after the Yonge St. van attack, which killed 10 people and injured 14. Del Duca urged blood donations and campaign work for the Liberals. Outside, LiUNA Local 183 members protested labour changes in the provincial budget bill.

The passage describes backtesting a MACD strategy on Apple historical data from Yahoo Finance using Python. It calculates the MACD from 12- and 26-period exponential moving averages, then uses a nine-period signal line and histogram to set trading regimes. Returns begin the day after a signal. The strategy achieved a 15.04% annualized return while invested 51.13% of the time, compared with 19.07% annually for buy and hold.
Christian Brothers defensive lineman Bill Norton, a four-star 2019 prospect, committed to Georgia over offers from several major programs. He announced his decision shortly after visiting Tennessee.

Monocular 3D pose estimates remain tied to camera viewpoint, making motion measurements difficult to compare. 3DPCNet is a pose-only module that maps estimated skeletons to a fixed body-centered frame. It combines graph convolution and transformer features to predict a global rotation and an optional joint-position correction. On MM-Fi, it reduced rotation error from 20–22° to 3–4° and positional error by about 27% compared with a geometric baseline. Qualitative TotalCapture comparisons showed closer agreement between pose-derived wrist acceleration and IMU signals. Limitations include dependence on input-pose quality, lack of absolute scale estimation, and possible non-rigid deviations from the correction.

New federal tax withholding tables should leave about 90% of workers with more take-home pay beginning in February, though the amount depends on income, family circumstances and W-4 information. Examples in the passage show increases of about $61 per semi-monthly paycheck for a married worker earning $90,000 with two young children, and $32 for a single worker earning $35,000.

The child tax credit doubles to $2,000 per qualifying child in 2018. Taxpayers are advised to review their withholding because changes to deductions could affect what they owe in 2019. The withholding rate on bonus checks falls from 25% to 22%.

Dick Tuck, a Democratic Party operative known for pranking Richard Nixon, died Monday in Tucson, Arizona, at 94. His stunts included arranging a poorly attended Nixon campaign appearance and planting a critical sign at a 1962 rally. Tuck also worked on Robert F. Kennedy’s 1968 presidential campaign and unsuccessfully sought a California Senate seat in 1966.

Mathieu Henderson ended his four-year OHL career with the Flint Firebirds after a breakout season, ranking ninth among league defencemen with 10 goals and 44 assists. He credited his coaches and improved defensive play for his progress. After Flint’s first-round playoff exit, he played three games for the ECHL’s South Carolina Stingrays. Henderson is considering professional hockey in North America or Europe, or going to school.

The civil aviation ministry has asked the finance ministry to delay GST implementation by two months from its scheduled July 1 rollout. Airlines say they need more time to update ticketing systems and have raised concerns about unclear tax treatment and higher costs. The finance ministry says implementation remains on track.

Online education has expanded in African universities since the 1990s, but limited internet access, weak infrastructure and insufficient digital training hinder its use. War further disrupts higher education by endangering students and staff, damaging facilities and impeding ICT deployment. Online learning can help sustain education during conflict, though it requires investment and support.

A Scopus-based bibliometric study selected 53 publications on wartime and education from 2000–2024; a narrower search including online learning identified five. None originated from an African country. The authors call for more research on wartime online learning in African higher education. They note that using only Scopus and omitting citation and authorship analyses limited the study.

The IRS raised federal income tax brackets for 2026 to account for inflation. The standard deduction will be $32,200 for married couples filing jointly and $16,100 for single filers. The 37% top rate will apply above $640,600 in taxable income for individuals and $768,700 for joint filers. The agency also adjusted other tax provisions.

Egyptian archaeologists unveiled the tomb of Hetpet, an Old Kingdom priestess of Hathor, in Giza’s western cemetery. The Fifth Dynasty tomb contains well-preserved paintings of hunting, fishing, performances and rare scenes featuring monkeys. A purification basin bears Hetpet’s name and titles. Archaeologists plan to continue excavating the site.

The passage describes a data intake and query system that collects machine-generated data, converts it into timestamped events, and indexes and stores those events for searching. Forwarders receive data, indexers process and store it, and search heads coordinate queries. Search-time field extraction preserves flexibility when analyzing minimally processed data, while keyword indexes, parallel searches, summarization tables, and intermediate summaries can accelerate queries and reports. The passage also describes data models, reporting interfaces, security and performance-monitoring applications, and on-premises and cloud-based deployments. Its stated technical focus is optimizing index-file size based on storage conditions, though the provided excerpt does not detail that process.

The lecture reviews Vickrey–Clarke–Groves (VCG) mechanisms, which implement socially optimal outcomes by charging participants for the negative externalities they impose. VCG is not budget balanced and can be impractical when the number of possible allocations is enormous.

The lecture then examines Google’s search advertising. Google ranks advertisers using bids and quality scores, and charges them only when users click. Unlike VCG, its generalized second-price auction does not make truthful bidding optimal. However, a model by Edelman, Ostrovsky, and Schwarz shows an equilibrium in which advertisers shade their bids but make VCG-equivalent payments. This helps explain why bids can remain stable and why the auction selects high-value advertisers.

A subsequent consumer-search model treats ad positions as guidance for users who face costs when clicking links. In that model, reserve prices can improve welfare by making displayed ads more credible, although a search engine’s profit-maximizing reserve price may differ from the consumer-optimal one. The lecture closes with research on how sellers’ prices respond to ad positions and how platforms’ choices about what product information to reveal affect competition.

Amber Enterprises received Sebi approval for an estimated Rs 555-crore IPO, comprising Rs 450 crore in new shares and Rs 105 crore in promoter sales. Proceeds will repay loans and fund general corporate purposes.

The passage specifies how SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests communicate with a hypervisor through the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB). The hypervisor supplies supported protocol versions and the page-table encryption bit position; the guest selects a supported version or terminates. SEV-SNP guests must register a GHCB guest physical address before using it for VMGEXIT.

For non-automatic exits, the guest supplies required state in the GHCB and marks valid fields in a bitmap. The hypervisor returns results or errors through GHCB fields. Defined operations include CPUID requests, page-state changes, SNP firmware requests, AP creation, VMPL changes and termination.

With Restricted Injection enabled, SEV-SNP guests use a shared doorbell page for #HV event notifications. The passage defines how the host presents interrupts and how the guest acknowledges them and signals completion. It also describes AP boot and reset procedures, SNP secrets-page data, and EFI communication of SNP pages. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported under the stated conditions.

SOS full-court pressure aims to disrupt offenses, create turnovers and rushed shots, and control tempo. Its primary “shadow” presses place a second defender behind the on-ball defender; more aggressive “Blitz” presses deny initial passing lanes and trap deep in the backcourt. Success depends on SOS defensive fundamentals, including forcing the ball away from the middle. If the shadow defender cannot position properly or the offense makes a deep or middle outlet pass, half-court rules apply.

The UK and Ukraine discussed strengthening trade and investment after Brexit and maintaining an agreement supporting over £1.7 billion in bilateral trade. Its preferential terms are expected to continue during the EU-UK Implementation Period.

A study of postmortem hippocampal tissue found increased perineuronal net (PNN) densities in people with substance use disorder (SUD) and in rhesus monkeys after chronic alcohol self-administration. In the SUD group, expression of genes related to PNN synthesis, synaptic regulation and parvalbumin increased, while expression of two extracellular-matrix-degrading genes decreased. People with major depressive disorder (MDD) showed decreased PNN densities in parts of CA1; those with both SUD and MDD did not show the same CA1 increase as the SUD-only group. The authors suggest PNNs may stabilize drug-related reward memories, while noting that postmortem measurements cannot establish their functional role.

The speaker saw little difference from the Anaheim game but said the team did not play its game. Officials ruled a disputed play was not a goal, and the team had to accept it. The opponent capitalized on a power play, and the speaker said the team must focus on the next game.

The passage describes computer-based methods for detecting, localizing, and classifying abnormalities in medical images. One method jointly trains localization and classification networks, including versions that use multiple imaging modalities or score lesions. Another deletes different image portions, uses a generative adversarial network to synthesize replacements, selects a synthesized normal image, and compares it with the original to detect an abnormality. It also describes training deep learning models on datasets from multiple clinical sites and selectively adapting them to a deployment site using similarity, uncertainty, and performance comparisons.

Trump tweeted that the Russia investigation had devastated young aides’ lives, though the passage says most departing aides left amid White House infighting. His lawyer Rudy Giuliani said Trump’s team was comfortable with questions about collusion but less comfortable with questions about obstruction. Trump also alleged that FBI informants had spied on his campaign; Sen. Marco Rubio said the FBI appeared to be investigating individuals, not the campaign. Separately, Trump falsely accused The New York Times of using a nonexistent source. The source was a senior administration official who had briefed reporters under White House rules barring use of his name.
With one game left to win the Stanley Cup, the team will focus on preparing to win rather than dwelling on past losses.

A first-year review of the University of Virginia Health System’s thoracic Enhanced Recovery After Surgery program found lower opioid use, shorter hospital stays and reduced costs. Among 139 enrolled patients, morphine-equivalent use fell by 74% in one group and 59% in another without worsening reported pain. Median stays for thoracotomy patients fell by two days, and the program saved more than $1.3 million. Compared with more than 220 earlier patients, participants had no increase in surgical complications or readmissions. Researchers noted limitations in the review, including limited cost detail.

Two Lashkar-e-Jhangvi militants escaped from a court complex on the perimeter of Karachi’s Central Jail. Prison authorities suspended at least 12 officials, requested a police case against them and the prisoners, and launched an investigation. Police teams were sent to find the escapees.

In a separate incident in DHA, a suspected robber died during an exchange of fire with police after an attempted carjacking. The intended victim was seriously injured, and another suspect fled. Karachi police also reported arresting at least 15 people in other operations and recovering weapons and narcotics.

French President Emmanuel Macron visited Nigeria for talks with President Muhammadu Buhari on regional security, intelligence sharing and trade. The leaders were expected to witness an agreement for a reforestation and agricultural project in Ogun State. Macron said Nigeria must address violence by Fulani herdsmen. Separately, a report described two children trafficked from Benin and Mali to Gabon, where one was rescued from a forced marriage.

Culpeper defeated Courtland 2-1 in a nondistrict baseball game Monday, capitalizing on Courtland’s seven errors, including five in the final two innings. Vincent Rivera scored the tying run in the sixth, and Hunter Bowers scored the winner in the seventh. Courtland’s Alex Kobersteen and Culpeper’s Jake Dudley each pitched a complete game with nine strikeouts and two hits allowed. Courtland’s lone run came when Addie Burrow stole home.

The Joseph Rowntree Foundation estimates that a couple with two children needs £40,000 a year for a reasonable standard of living, while a single person needs £18,400. The author argues that redistribution cannot meet these benchmarks and proposes easing childcare and housing regulations, raising tax allowances, reducing government spending, and pursuing economic growth.

USD/JPY fell 2.25% after weak US employment data, with the article identifying 147.13 as support and 147.80 as a level to regain. Markets expect the Bank of England to cut rates to 4.0% despite inflation near twice its target; GBP/USD remains near May’s 1.3135 support. BTC/USD also declined alongside equities, finding support around 112,000. The article says a break above 117,260 could signal renewed gains, while a fall below 110,750 could lead to further losses.

The November 30, 2000 VentureWire reports that 724 Solutions agreed to acquire Tantau Software for approximately $375 million, El Dorado Ventures formed a $250 million fund, and MaMaMedia cut its workforce to 15 employees. It also covers numerous company financings, Blackboard’s planned acquisitions, product launches, leadership appointments, and venture-capital news, including Crosspoint’s postponement of a fund with more than $1 billion in commitments.

The Department of Education will delay two Obama-era rules scheduled for July 1 and convene committees to review them. One tied federal aid to graduates’ employment outcomes; the other outlined loan forgiveness for borrowers misled by colleges. The department says it will honor 16,000 pending claims and hold hearings in July. For-profit colleges have challenged the rules, while Democratic lawmakers oppose the delay.

Greece’s central bank chief urged Athens and its lenders to complete the bailout review by the end of February, warning that further delays could undermine the projected economic recovery and hurt banks. Talks have stalled over reforms, fiscal targets and the IMF’s role. Euro zone finance ministers are expected to discuss the issue next week.

Etisalat Nigeria has not agreed with 13 local banks on restructuring a $1.2 billion loan after missing a payment. Nigerian regulators favor a default deal over receivership to avoid deterring investors and a wider debt crisis.

The aim of an offensive goal kick is to retain possession and begin an attack. A goal kick is taken from the goal area after an attacker last touches the ball over the defending team’s goal line; the ball is in play once kicked and visibly moving.

For young players, smaller fields and build-out lines can help teams play out from the back. Suggested approaches use nearby receivers, dribbling, and passes wide and upfield while avoiding passes across their own goal. Older youth players can choose among receivers according to defensive coverage, while advanced players can use short or deep kicks. Coaches should ensure players are positioned and ready, practice against defenders, and account for field conditions.
Researchers have launched a study to test whether giving new mothers untaxed monthly income improves their children’s emotional and brain development during the first three years of life.

A prospective study at Tesseney Community Hospital in Eritrea recorded 165 scorpion-sting admissions from June 2019 to May 2020; eight patients died. Stings occurred predominantly at night and during summer, usually affecting the feet or hands. Localized pain, sweating and vomiting were the most common symptoms. Adults accounted for most admissions, but children experienced more severe envenomation. The authors recommend prevention education, prompt care and improved access to treatment.

Project Sashakat, endorsed by the Finance Ministry, proposes a five-pronged strategy to speed up resolution of non-performing assets. It includes an asset management company or alternative investment fund approach for cases above Rs 500 crore, and steering committees to oversee time-bound resolution of smaller stressed loans. Loans up to Rs 50 crore would follow a template-based process within 90 days. The panel also proposed an asset trading platform but not a “bad bank.”

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced an agreement to build a Qatari Emiri Air Force facility at Mountain Home Air Force Base in Idaho. Qatari F-15s and pilots will train there with U.S. military personnel. The base already hosts Singaporean F-15s for pilot training.

Random walk theory holds that stock prices move unpredictably, making past prices unreliable for forecasting. The passage presents diversification and passive investment in broad market index funds as alternatives to timing the market. It contrasts the theory with the efficient market hypothesis, which says prices reflect available information, while noting that both question whether investors can consistently outperform the market. In the cited backtests, random entries produced positive results for an S&P 500 ETF but a negative average gain for a gold ETF.

StarCompliance says firms face increasingly complex global and local regulations, rising enforcement costs, and demands for on-demand audit readiness. Its Enterprise platform combines monitoring, reporting, and oversight tools to help financial institutions manage compliance across jurisdictions. The passage argues that automated, locally adaptable compliance programs can reduce risk and support long-term resilience.

Anthurium, a South American plant, filters ammonia and xylene, but its sap and leaves may cause allergies. It needs indirect light, humidity, temperatures of 18–21°C, winter leaf spraying, and periodic repotting.

The report describes a longstanding U.S. policy of opposing foreign aggression in Hawaii and considering annexation. It recounts annexation proposals and discussions from 1851 through the 1870s, including an uncompleted 1854 treaty. After the 1875 reciprocity treaty, U.S. policy emphasized exclusive commercial rights and support for the Hawaiian government while it protected American interests. The report also notes the 1820 appointment of a U.S. agent to oversee commerce, seamen, and American interests in the islands.

The study compares similar U.S. colleges that reopened with in-person, hybrid, or online teaching to assess effects on county COVID-19 cases and deaths. Using staggered reopening dates and data including cellphone mobility, it finds evidence that reopening—especially with in-person teaching—increased cases and deaths over time. The authors note that colleges’ teaching choices may have depended on local COVID-19 rates, complicating comparisons.

The passage identifies postwar economic exclusion as a serious threat to Austria-Hungary and describes potential Allied advantages in Bulgaria, Turkey, German colonies, and Germany’s exclusion from other regions. It argues that the Russian revolution could undermine German influence, while the Vatican, American resources, and public hopes for peace and a league of nations could aid the Allies. It also warns that Germany may shift its expansion eastward into Russia and accept concessions elsewhere to secure those opportunities.

Tesla’s Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release on October 2, 2022, furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn signed the report on October 3, 2022.

Which? says official mpg figures often overstate real-world fuel economy because the NEDC test lacks sustained motorway driving and permits conditions that reduce fuel use. Its tests use repeatable lab conditions, WLTP cold and warm cycles, sustained motorway driving and everyday equipment such as air conditioning. They also measure hybrids and air-polluting emissions, with additional on-road checks when NOx results are suspicious. Which? says the difference in annual fuel costs between the most and least-efficient medium-sized hatchbacks exceeds £800. The passage says WLTP began replacing NEDC in September 2017, with all new UK cars due to have WLTP-based figures by September 2018.

President Harry S. Truman announces Germany’s unconditional surrender, celebrates Europe’s liberation, and honors those who died. He urges Americans to continue working until Japan surrenders and to build a lasting peace with their allies. He proclaims May 13, 1945, a day of prayer to give thanks, seek support for the remaining struggle, and remember the dead.

Navient shares rose 2.27% in the most recent session and closed at $13.51. Nine analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $16.89, ranging from $13.50 to $22. The stock’s reported average brokerage recommendation was 2.75. Its 14-period ATR was 0.41, and its RSI was 51.03. Navient’s market capitalization was $3.55 billion; 5.78 million shares traded, compared with an average of about 2.8 million.

Scotiabank’s 1832 Asset Management agreed to pay an $800,000 fine and $150,000 in investigation costs after an Ontario Securities Commission settlement found it provided excessive promotional benefits to financial advisers from November 2012 to October 2017. The firm said it had begun improving its compliance practices.

The passage studies finitely generated Gorenstein-projective modules over the dual integers Z[ε], rather than attempting to classify all modules over that ring. It identifies Gorenstein-projective modules with torsionless modules, perfect differential structures, and orbits of bounded complexes of free abelian groups, while noting that decompositions into indecomposable objects need not be unique. Its main theorem equates the stable category of these modules with several other categories, including Db(Z)/[1]. Dense functors connect these categories to finite abelian groups and form a cube of commutative squares. The main equivalence also holds over any principal ideal domain.

The president announces an Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders to investigate recent urban unrest and recommend ways to prevent it. He condemns looting and violence, calls for swift law enforcement, and orders expanded riot-control training for the National Guard. He argues that lasting peace also requires action against poverty, discrimination, inadequate housing, poor education, and unemployment. Urging Congress to support city programs, he calls on Americans to reject hatred, help those harmed by the riots, and join a national day of prayer for order and reconciliation.

SARS-CoV-2 sequencing is highly concentrated: as of July 1, 2022, 10% of countries had contributed 90.3% of sequences submitted to GISAID, limiting early estimates of emerging variants elsewhere. The authors developed a Bayesian hierarchical model that pools sequences across countries and variants to estimate prevalence and relative fitness while accounting for geographic differences and sparse data. It estimated that BA.5 had a greater global fitness advantage over BA.2 than BA.4 or BA.2.12.1, though country-specific estimates varied. In retrospective comparisons, the multicountry model produced more stable early estimates and more accurate predictions for BA.5 in Portugal than a single-country model. Its assumptions include random sequencing within countries, correct lineage assignments and constant relative fitness during the modeled period.

During a routine customer call, Vodafone Ghana employee Eunice Ampomah-Manu heard Andrew Kufuor struggling to breathe. She stayed on the line, obtained his wife’s number and contacted her. His wife took him to a clinic. Kufuor later visited Vodafone to thank Eunice, saying she saved his life.

Australia’s Nick Kyrgios will face John Isner in Friday’s Davis Cup quarter-final against the United States in Brisbane, following Jordan Thompson’s match against Jack Sock. Kyrgios and Isner are tied on 218 aces this season, and Isner leads their head-to-head record 2-1. Sam Groth and John Peers will play Sam Querrey and Steve Johnson in Saturday’s doubles, with reverse singles on Sunday. Thompson is playing in place of Bernard Tomic, who declined to participate.

WIRED’s weekly roundup covers five stories: federal workers receiving shutdown messages that blame Democrats; Peter Thiel’s lectures about the Antichrist; Tesla messages encouraging drowsy drivers to use Full Self-Driving despite its requirement for driver attention; scientists creating human eggs from skin cells and using them to form embryos; and OpenAI’s new Sora 2 social video app. The app generates videos from prompts and can create a user’s digital likeness after identity verification. It has controls over who can use that likeness and blocks some content, though the hosts describe inconsistent restrictions on copyrighted characters and potential ways around its filters. They say it remains unclear whether the app will attract lasting interest.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum tunneling and energy quantization in an electric circuit involving billions of electrons. Their 1980s experiments showed quantum effects at a scale once thought impossible and helped lay the foundation for superconducting qubits used in quantum computers.

An IDC survey of 200 industrial decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland found growing use of IT-based simulation, modeling, and data analytics in product development and manufacturing. More than half already use simulation, modeling, or virtual prototyping; 42% use high-performance data analytics. Digital twins can connect operational data with development and help test products and processes virtually.

Complex calculations create demand for high-performance computing (HPC), which 81% of respondents view as a game changer for product and process innovation. More than a quarter of surveyed enterprises already use professional HPC infrastructure, while another 39% plan or are piloting it. Key challenges include security, costs, energy consumption, limited computing capacity, and a shortage of expertise.

The report identifies cloud-based and hybrid HPC as ways to improve scalability and flexibility, while noting that cloud use still requires skilled personnel. IDC recommends a shared data strategy and evaluating HPC options against each enterprise’s performance, security, cost, and sustainability needs.

An October 30, 2001 collection of news reports says Enron shares fell to eight-year lows after Moody’s downgraded its long-term debt, placed its commercial-paper rating under review and Enron sought new credit lines. Investors questioned losses and transactions involving partnerships run by former CFO Andrew Fastow; bond-default insurance costs rose. New CFO Jeff McMahon described plans to expand Enron’s newsprint trading and hedging business despite industry hurdles. Other reports covered falling U.S. stocks, a proposed natural-gas trade-clearing service and a German inquiry into power-balancing charges.

The passage describes a TPS7H500x-SP push-pull converter design. It selects 80-V GaN synchronous rectifiers, a 0.47-µH output inductor, approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance, and components for overcurrent limiting, hiccup timing, frequency compensation, and slope compensation. An RCD clamp limits switch-node voltage, while an optional output filter can reduce ripple. The controllers operate from a regulated 4–14 V supply and require input bypassing. Layout guidance emphasizes separating noisy switching paths from sensitive signals, minimizing high-current loops, separating analog and power grounds, and placing bypass and compensation components near the controller. The passage also lists related documentation, revision changes, packaging information, and handling and warranty notices.

The passage describes the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 microcontrollers’ power management, clocks, DMA, event routing, memory, GPIO, analog functions, security, communications, timers, debugging, and bootloader. It lists up to 512 kB of flash, 128 kB of SRAM, 93 GPIO pins, and two 12-bit ADCs, along with interfaces including UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD. It also provides circuit and layout recommendations, development resources, revision history, packaging information, and TI’s product disclaimers.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on January 25, 2022, announcing a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2021. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed under the Securities Exchange Act.

In February 1998, Christine Peterson proposed “open source” as a more business-friendly term for software whose source code is available under licenses favoring user freedom. The Open Source Definition grew from Bruce Perens’s Debian Free Software Guidelines, though accounts differ on its publication date. Open source has since become widely used across the technology industry, including by major platform companies.
