Red Hat’s Tim Burke says it has shifted from providing alternatives to proprietary software to leading innovation.

Bernstorff reported that the blockade would end if a conference could be arranged on reasonable terms. Gerard reported that Germany had issued a submarine-warfare note and hoped its campaign would bring England to seek terms within two months. Greece announced that the Entente would allow essential food imports while its blockade remained in place. Austria-Hungary said it wanted to preserve relations with the United States, supported a peace without victory, and urged Wilson to press the Entente to accept that basis. It said it could not modify submarine warfare.

Energy storage can shift electricity use to later periods, but its value depends on installation costs, operating costs and efficiency. Lithium-ion batteries suit small-scale use, while pumped hydro provides cheaper large-scale storage. A household battery would need to cost about A$1,000 per kWh to break even under variable electricity rates, or around A$300 per kWh under a flat rate. Reduced peak demand offers limited network savings where overall demand is not growing. Although pumped hydro is cheaper, consumer behaviour could favor distributed batteries.

Apple filed an amendment to its articles of incorporation on August 3, 2020, increasing authorized common shares from 12.6 billion to 50.4 billion. The amendment provides for each outstanding share to split into four shares at 5 p.m. Pacific daylight time on August 28, 2020.
CoachingAmericanSoccer.com offers new players and coaches general on-field guidance covering positioning, ball work, and team functions. Coaches can adapt the rules to their preferences.

The Korean diet emphasizes whole, unprocessed foods, including vegetables, grains, lean proteins and fermented foods, while limiting processed foods, sugary drinks and unhealthy fats. Its plant-based ingredients, fibre and fermented foods may support overall and gut health. Potential drawbacks include sodium in condiments and fermented foods, limited calcium from low dairy intake, and carbohydrate-heavy dishes that may require portion control. Spicy foods may also irritate people with digestive issues.

An Irish Times portrait of Ernest Walton, co-winner of the 1951 Nobel Prize in physics, presents his atom-smashing work and his wish to remain in Ireland without fanfare. The passage contrasts that restraint, reflected in Jack McManus’s photograph of Walton in a Trinity College Dublin laboratory, with the publicity surrounding CERN.

The Sansa Fuze manual explains how to transfer music, photos, and videos; play media; use FM radio and voice recording; delete content; and customize settings. It provides troubleshooting advice, support contacts, a limited one-year warranty, and software license terms.

Bitcoin futures were set to begin trading on Cboe’s exchange, with cash-settled contracts based on Gemini’s bitcoin auction price. The launch followed sharp price swings and drew mixed responses from banks and brokerages: some planned to offer access, while others imposed restrictions or held back. Analysts said regulated futures could broaden participation and eventually improve price discovery or reduce volatility, but warned of uncertain market behavior, pricing and clearing risks, and possible manipulation of the underlying spot market.
The team hopes Horton recovers and acknowledges that Aaron cannot play in the remaining playoffs. After a tough loss, it plans to focus on the next game and make adjustments.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 28, 2021, reporting that it issued a press release on financial results for its fourth fiscal quarter ended September 25, 2021. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri signed the report.

A retrospective study of 109 patients treated for aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage identified three factors associated with shunt-dependent hydrocephalus: age ≥65 years, Hunt and Hess scale ≥3, and surgical clipping rather than endovascular coiling. The researchers used these factors to develop a risk-prediction nomogram, with an area under the curve of 0.753. They noted that the study was retrospective and small, and that the nomogram needs prospective validation.

Nike’s fiscal first-quarter revenue rose 1% to $11.72 billion, beating expectations despite an earlier forecast of a decline. Net income fell 31% to $727 million, and gross margin dropped to 42.2% as the company continued clearing old inventory. Wholesale and North American sales grew, while direct sales and China revenue declined. CEO Elliott Hill said Nike’s turnaround is making progress but remains uneven.

Dolphins receiver Tyreek Hill dislocated his knee during Monday night’s win over the Jets. His left leg twisted under him during a third-quarter tackle, and he was carted off. Hill will remain hospitalized overnight for further tests. He had caught six passes for 67 yards before the injury.

An international team found live giant shipworms, Kuphus polythalamia, in a Philippine lagoon after years of difficulty obtaining specimens. The mud-dwelling mollusks can have shells up to five feet long and consume hydrogen sulfide rather than wood. Researchers are studying microbes in their gills for possible antimicrobial substances. Their life cycle, age and distribution remain unknown.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition device. Its speed-boost mode samples one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS while the other six channels remain idle. The passage describes SPI register access across three banks and configuration of multiple devices in a daisy chain. Register settings also cover data averaging, test patterns, input bandwidth and common-mode range.

An example ATE application reports 0.0015% total unadjusted error at 25°C ±5°C after calibration and 99.95% full-scale settling in 7.5µs in wide-bandwidth mode. The passage also gives power-supply and board-layout recommendations and notes that application guidance is not part of TI’s component specification.

The passage describes a seasonal strategy of holding the iShares MSCI Germany ETF (EWG) only in the fourth quarter, based on its historical monthly returns. It says a backtest since EWG’s inception performed better than buy and hold, but cautions that future results are uncertain. EWG provides U.S. investors access to German stocks; the DAX 40 is Germany’s main stock index.

Warmer, drier conditions are allowing rainbow trout to enter cold northern Rocky Mountain streams where native cutthroat trout live. Researchers found widespread breeding between the species, producing hybrids that survive less well than cutthroats. Hybridization was most common where rainbow trout had been introduced. Some states are removing rainbows to protect cutthroats, whose native genes and adaptive traits could otherwise be lost permanently.

Former INEC official Christian Nwosu told a Lagos Federal High Court that EFCC operatives threatened to detain him unless he stated that he had received N30 million from former Petroleum Minister Dieziani Alison-Madueke. He alleged that they coerced him into surrendering property worth N30 million and paying N5 million in bank drafts. Nwosu also claimed an EFCC prosecutor threatened to have him convicted and jailed if he did not cooperate.

State Street Corporation, which commissioned the “Fearless Girl” statue to promote women in leadership, agreed to a $5 million settlement over allegations that it paid 305 female employees and 15 Black vice presidents less than colleagues in the same positions. The company denies the allegations and says it is committed to equal pay practices.
Clarke, Devoret and Martinis won the 2025 physics Nobel for demonstrating quantum effects in an electric circuit.

Sir John Deane’s sixth form college’s jazz collective performed 1960s soul and classic swing to a packed audience at the Macdonald Portal Hotel in Tarporley. The college’s next event is a classical music performance by 14 students at Arley Hall on February 9.

A nationwide study of Medicare-aged adults found that those living in areas with the highest estimated outdoor trichloroethylene (TCE) levels had a 10% higher risk of Parkinson’s disease than those in the lowest-exposure areas. TCE is an industrial solvent that persists in U.S. air, water and soil. The study shows an association, not causation. Its exposure estimates may not reflect individual lifetime or indoor exposure, and the findings may not apply to younger people.

A swimming advisory for Little Beach in Port Stanley remained in effect Monday after elevated bacteria levels were found. The Elgin St. Thomas Health Unit warned of possible gastrointestinal illness and infection, but said the beach was not closed. Some visitors continued swimming, including one who said she had not noticed the signs.

Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology used machine learning and computer simulations to identify the low-temperature structure of formamidinium lead iodide, a promising but unstable solar-cell material. They found that its molecules become trapped in a semi-stable state as it cools, and worked with researchers at the University of Birmingham to compare the simulations with experiments. The findings could help scientists design and control this material and related halide perovskite mixtures for solar cells.

In a collection of 2016 *Evening Sun* stories, Norwich siblings Evan and Brynn Meek distributed 220 bagged lunches to homeless people in Manhattan. Norwich Police Department officer Thomas Miller accepted a position in Syracuse after eight years of service, during which he and his K9, Nitro, held community events. Tracy A. Price was arrested on charges of torturing, injuring and neglecting a dog and was granted $750 bail.

Coachella attendees used “Find my iPhone” to track a man suspected of stealing more than 100 phones. Security detained Reinaldo De Jesus Henao, 36, and Indio police arrested him on suspicion of grand theft and possession of stolen property.

Wafa Yahia, the Syrian grandmother whose planned visit is central to Hawaii’s challenge to President Trump’s travel ban, arrived in Honolulu after receiving a US immigrant visa. Her son-in-law, a plaintiff in the case, said two of his children had never met her. The legal challenge remains ongoing.
Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on July 27, 2021, announcing a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2021. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

A study suggests distractions can briefly improve mood after a breakup but should be used sparingly because avoidance may hinder recovery. Focusing on negative aspects of the past relationship may also help people move on.

The author struggled to sleep comfortably during pregnancy and bought a U-shaped Leachco pregnancy pillow after seeing a friend recommend it. She found that it supported side-sleeping, let her turn over without readjusting it, and was comfortable on the couch. Its drawbacks were its large size, a scratchy cover, and disrupted blankets. Despite these, she planned to keep using it after giving birth.

Cuba marked the revolution’s 58th anniversary with a Havana parade honoring Fidel Castro, who died in November. Soldiers marched without equipment, and participants carried his photos despite a new law banning monuments and infrastructure named for him. Cuba faces a shrinking economy, Raul Castro’s planned departure and uncertainty over its rapprochement with the United States.

Vale said shareholders converted 84.4 percent of its preferred shares under a plan to create a single class of common stock. The strong response could allow the iron ore producer to join Brazil’s Novo Mercado as early as this year, rather than by 2020, and attract more investors. Vale said it would not offer cash incentives to remaining preferred shareholders. The government will retain a golden share.

A qualitative study interviewed 10 Turkish primary school teachers about virtual inclusive education for students with disabilities during COVID-19. Teachers reported varied attendance and difficulties with engagement, assignments, social interaction, technology and family support; some students experienced no such problems. Teachers used EBA, Zoom, family communication and individualized arrangements to support learning. They recommended better access to devices and internet, stronger parent–teacher cooperation, attention to social development and continued opportunities for in-person education.

An analysis of 48,615 Omicron BA.1 genomes from England, alongside global genomic, epidemiological and mobility data, identified at least 6,455 independent introductions between November 2021 and January 2022. Early introductions accounted for a disproportionate share of infections: those inferred to have occurred before southern African travel restrictions ended represented about 6% of introductions but were linked to roughly 80% of reported BA.1 infections. Importations continued to rise during the restrictions, partly as estimated importation intensity shifted toward the United States.

Greater London and surrounding areas drove the initial expansion across England, while other regions generally peaked later. Population size, distance and mobility were associated with viral lineage movements. Travel between smaller areas and urban hubs also declined as reported cases at the hubs rose. The authors caution that incomplete and uneven genome sampling may have affected estimates of introductions and transmission lineages.

A November 2001 Commissioner.COM fantasy football email provides Week 11 player updates and lineup advice, including a separate report for Luccis Losers. It highlights recommended starters, risky matchups and injuries, and includes several promotional offers.
On August 16, 2018, NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K announcing results for the quarter ended July 29, 2018. The filing includes a press release and commentary from CFO Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

The TLV321/2x comparators consume 40µA per channel and have a 40ns propagation delay. TLV321x devices have push-pull outputs; TLV322x devices have open-drain outputs that can be pulled up to 5.5V independently of the supply voltage. Inputs may extend 200mV beyond either supply rail, with current limited to 10mA. Unused inputs require at least 50mV of differential voltage rather than being tied together.

The devices have 1.8mV of internal hysteresis; external hysteresis can reduce output chatter near a switching threshold. Outputs require high-speed layout practices, and shorts can damage the devices. During power-on reset, outputs remain low for up to 32µs after the supply crosses 1.65V. The passage also describes low-side current sensing and recommends close supply bypassing, careful routing, and ESD precautions.

The paper defines youth as people aged 15–24 and considers how cooperative education (co-op) could develop the hard and soft skills needed in Nigeria’s labor market. Nigerian youth unemployment has risen in recent years, and youth unemployment rates have generally been at least twice total unemployment rates. In 2019, 28% of Nigerian youth were not in employment, education or training.

Co-op integrates academic study with paid work experience through coordinated curricula and partnerships among institutions, employers and governments. Evidence cited, mainly from developed countries, associates participation with better employment outcomes, earnings and matches between jobs and fields of study, though evidence on school-to-work programs overall is mixed.

Nigeria’s existing initiatives include SIWES, SURE-P and N-Power. The paper argues that co-op could complement these programs by more closely aligning tertiary education with employer needs. It proposes piloting an alternating study-and-work model within existing government programs. It also notes that co-op alone cannot resolve youth unemployment and calls for further research on its management and design in Nigeria.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs increase FP32 throughput over Turing and add larger L1 caches, second-generation RT Cores, and third-generation Tensor Cores. The RT Cores double ray–triangle intersection rates and accelerate motion blur, while the Tensor Cores support additional data types and structured sparsity. The passage also describes GDDR6X memory, RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression, improved concurrent workloads, high-resolution display support, and hardware video decoding and encoding. It presents the GeForce RTX 30 series for gaming and the A40 and RTX A6000 for data-center and professional workloads.

The passage examines a constitutional challenge to Louisiana’s second majority-Black congressional district through Justice Barrett’s defense of originalism. The author argues that Supreme Court precedent restricting districts drawn predominantly on racial grounds cannot be justified by the original public meaning of the Fourteenth or Fifteenth Amendments, particularly when a challenge alleges no vote dilution or loss of voting rights. Although precedent deserves respect, the author says that doctrine is difficult to apply and conflicts with enforcement of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act. The author concludes that an originalist court should reconsider the districting doctrine rather than weaken the Act’s vote-dilution protections, while leaving Congress free to prohibit race-based districting by statute.

TI provides technical and design resources as-is, without warranties, for skilled developers using TI products. Users are responsible for product selection, testing and compliance. Resources may change without notice, and their use and reproduction are restricted. TI disclaims liability, requires indemnification and applies its product terms of sale.

The Investors Intelligence Sentiment Index, developed by AW Cohen in 1963, surveys more than 100 market newsletters weekly to classify advisors as bullish, bearish, or expecting a correction. Investors use it as a contrarian indicator, particularly at extremes: bullish readings above 55% suggest excessive optimism, while readings below 35% suggest excessive pessimism. Its report also tracks stocks above their 10- and 30-week moving averages. Unlike the AAII survey, which asks individual investors about the next six months, it focuses on advisors and commentators. The index is available through a Chartcraft subscription.

Euclid police are reviewing video showing an officer repeatedly punching a 25-year-old Black man during a traffic-stop struggle. Police say the man resisted arrest. The officer is on paid leave, and the NAACP is calling for a federal investigation.

Four people, including the suspect, were injured in a Monday morning explosion near New York City’s Port Authority and Times Square. Police said the suspect tried to detonate a homemade device, but it malfunctioned or did not go off as planned. He is in custody, and none of the injuries are life-threatening. The explosion disrupted nearby transit service.

The Rotary Club of Lakewood and Rocky River honored student winners of its speech, music and visual arts contests on April 9. Nicholas Cleary won speech, Angeliki Cintron won music, and Elyza Mihalski won visual arts. Lakewood City Schools also received a national designation for its music education program for the second consecutive year.

Other community announcements include engraved bricks for North Olmsted’s new Fan Walk, free church meals, upcoming school and Beck Center performances, blood drives in memory of Dr. Steve Meadows, genealogy assistance, neighborhood cleanups, a rummage sale and the West Park Historical Society’s grand opening.

The passage reviews six picture books for young children. A 35th-anniversary edition of Rod Campbell’s *Dear Zoo* follows a child seeking a pet from the zoo. Catherine Rayner’s *Solomon and Mortimer* sends two bored crocodiles in search of fun. Paul Stickland’s republished *Ten Terrible Dinosaurs* uses rhyme to count down from ten to one. In Julia Donaldson and Rebecca Cobb’s *The Everywhere Bear*, a classroom teddy is lost and travels out to sea. Morag Hood’s *When Grandad Was a Penguin* centres on a grandad behaving like a penguin, while Lane Smith’s *A Perfect Day* shows how a bear disrupts other animals’ pleasant afternoon.

The United States reached the Davis Cup quarterfinals for the first time at Serbia’s expense, clinching a 3-0 win with a doubles victory. Kazakhstan also advanced 3-0, eliminating Switzerland. France, Croatia, Spain, Germany and Italy each took 2-1 leads after Saturday’s doubles matches, while Hungary kept its tie against Belgium alive. The remaining ties were set to continue with singles matches on Sunday.

The brief argues that counting children who are not enrolled in formal schools overlooks both alternative learning and barriers to education. Using Afghanistan, it describes how conflict, geography, nomadic lifestyles, child labor, disabilities, and restrictions on girls’ schooling shape access. It proposes an “out-of-education children” indicator covering formal, informal, and non-formal pathways, supported by broader data collection, credentialing, collaboration, and equitable funding.

Department of Education employees say their neutral out-of-office replies during the government shutdown were changed without their consent to messages blaming Senate Democrats. Some employees restored the neutral wording, but the partisan message reappeared. It is unclear who made the changes. The Department of Labor also reportedly suggested partisan wording. Experts raised concerns about possible Hatch Act violations, and the Education Department’s press line returned the same partisan reply to WIRED.
Lab tests show that jostling air and methane microbubbles can create tiny sparks that may ignite methane behind swamp will-o’-the-wisps.

AMD Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) lets datacenter operators apply selected firmware fixes at runtime without rebooting. Patches do not persist across reboots and must be reapplied. The AMD Security Processor verifies AMD signatures before applying packages; customers can optionally require co-signatures. SFS tracks package, firmware, and system patch levels to determine whether an update applies. Packages can change registers or firmware images, and deployment aims to minimize disruption.

Passport applicants must swear allegiance to the United States, provide a physical description, and submit a witness’s certificate verifying their identity and affidavit. Additional evidence is required from people born abroad to U.S. fathers, naturalized citizens, certain women and children claiming citizenship through naturalization, and residents of insular possessions. Passports expire after two years; a new application is required for renewal. Eligible wives, minor children, and servants may be included on one passport, but professional titles are excluded. Officials may reject applications for suspected improper purposes or failure to meet the rules. The listed passport fee is $1, with additional application and oath fees.

Archaeologists in Mexico plan to clear a Maya-sealed tunnel at Chichen Itza in hopes of reaching a previously unseen cenote beneath the El Castillo pyramid. Cenotes supplied fresh water and held spiritual importance for the Maya, who made offerings and practiced human sacrifice at some sites. Archaeologist Guillermo de Anda believes the hidden cenote may have represented a symbolic center of the world. His earlier analysis of remains from Chichen Itza’s Sacred Cenote found that about 80% of the victims were children aged 3 to 11, many showing signs of poor health. He says more research is needed to understand why they were placed there.

The court affirmed Ronald Haynes’s conviction for third-degree criminal possession of a weapon following a guilty plea. It found no nonfrivolous appellate issues, granted counsel’s request to withdraw, and held that his appeal waiver barred the claims in his supplemental brief.

Nearly 600 million Africans lack electricity. The EU has announced a €545 million ($636 million) package for renewable energy and electrification projects in Côte d’Ivoire, Cameroon, Lesotho, and Madagascar. The projects aim to expand access, reduce fossil-fuel use, and could create 38 million green jobs by 2030, according to the EU. The funding is part of Global Gateway, which also seeks to counter China’s infrastructure investments and strengthen Europe’s position in a continent rich in minerals needed for the green transition.
Enix Bussey’s convictions were affirmed without an opinion.

Patriarch Theophilos III said the Jerusalem Orthodox Church will appeal an Israeli court ruling upholding a disputed deal to lease three East Jerusalem properties for 99 years to an organization linked to Israeli settlers. The church says the deal was illegal. Theophilos also raised concerns about proposed restrictions on churches’ property rights and called for international intervention.
Photos show contestants spelling words correctly and incorrectly, celebrating and reacting during the third round of the Scripps National Spelling Bee in Oxon Hill, Maryland, on May 30, 2018.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, Greek kindergartens adopted distance education to maintain contact with students. A 2021 questionnaire of 82 kindergarten teachers in Epirus found that most had little prior familiarity with distance education and were hesitant to use it beyond situations where in-person attendance was impossible. Teachers cited inadequate equipment and internet access, children’s difficulty using technology independently, the need for adult supervision, and reduced opportunities for social and psychomotor development. Teachers with advanced ICT certification reported greater prior familiarity with distance education than those without certification; years of service showed no significant relationship with ICT familiarity. The authors recommend improved infrastructure, resources and teacher training, while noting that findings cannot safely be generalized beyond Epirus.

S&P downgraded Bridgeview, Illinois, four notches to junk-level BB-minus, citing debt from its Toyota Park stadium, an approximately $256 million general obligation debt burden and very weak liquidity. The rating is on watch for a further downgrade. Bridgeview is considering restructuring $24.5 million in variable-rate bonds.

ML²B benchmarks language models generating complete machine-learning pipelines from 30 Kaggle competitions translated into 13 languages. Its structured tasks, isolated code grader, and six private competitions support reproducible evaluation and help limit leakage. Results show generally weaker and less reliable performance on non-English tasks, especially in low-resource languages and tabular tasks. Hybrid systems reduce some gaps, but no model performs best across all domains. Static analysis identified potential data leakage in 33 of 554 modular submissions after excluding likely false positives.

A take-a-knee chart helps football coaches decide when a leading offense can kneel to run out the clock. The quarterback takes the snap in victory formation and kneels, keeping the clock running unless the opponent can stop it with a timeout. The passage emphasizes practicing end-of-game clock management and avoiding incomplete passes, which stop the clock. A free chart is offered in PDF and Google Sheets formats.

The passage pairs news headlines with comments, most of which advertise hacking services, including access to accounts, phones and financial records. Other comments describe suspected marital infidelity and a marble-topped coffee table offered for sale.

Amazon’s 2018 Form 10-K describes three operating segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Net sales rose 31% to $232.9 billion in 2018, operating income increased to $12.4 billion, and net income reached $10.1 billion. North America and AWS reported operating income of $7.3 billion each, while International reported a $2.1 billion operating loss. Operating cash flow was $30.7 billion. Amazon employed approximately 647,500 people at year-end. The filing identifies risks including competition, international expansion, fulfillment and inventory management, security breaches, regulation, taxes, and seasonality.

GOLDWOOD PLY is a plywood manufacturer in Yamunanagar, Haryana, offering plywood, block boards, and flush doors across India. The company emphasizes product quality, timely delivery, customer needs, employee growth, and environmental safety.

Mark Palmer forwarded a class-action complaint against several electricity generators and traders, noting that a reporter expected Enron’s suit to look similar. The complaint alleges that the defendants manipulated California’s wholesale electricity market in 2000, inflating prices and harming customers. It seeks damages, restitution and injunctive relief.

The 9-period exponential moving average (EMA) strategy identifies short-term trends: a price move above the EMA signals a buy, while a move below signals a sell. Traders can use indicators such as RSI to confirm signals and manage risk with stop-loss orders and position sizing. In the passage’s backtest, a Bitcoin crossover system made 284 trades averaging 2.65% per trade; adding a 200-day moving-average filter reduced trades to 153 and raised the average gain to 4%. The strategy performed poorly on the S&P 500/SPY, even with the filter.

The passage argues that the Konektadong Pinoy Act could bring new competitors into the Philippine telecom market, threatening PLDT’s profitability as growth slows. Despite PLDT’s attractive valuation, the author prefers to avoid investing.

The passage argues that little-publicized legislation can be important to enforcing the law. It says the government has begun using criminal prosecutions in some trust and interstate commerce cases, with fines and imprisonment producing a deterrent effect despite some failures. In a quoted decision, Judge Holt describes a railroad’s substantial, prolonged rebates as deliberate discrimination that could drive competitors out of business. Because such offenses are difficult to prove and the evidence in this case was clear, he argues for a penalty proportionate to the offense, imposed principally on the corporation.

Joy Williams, a Louisiana registered nurse with over seven years of experience, will be featured in Worldwide Leaders In Healthcare. She earned a practical nursing diploma in 2009 and a bachelor’s degree in nursing in 2016.

MU held its annual Veterans Day wreath-laying ceremony Friday, joining the National Remembrance Day Roll Call to read the names of MU student veterans who were killed. Keynote speaker Col. Roderik Cox and other attendees challenged Hollywood stereotypes of veterans, emphasizing that they are ordinary people. MU Veterans Center director Robert Ross, whose center works with more than 400 student veterans, said the event honored those who died and expressed hope for future peace.

Passports expire two years after issuance, and renewal requires a new application. Eligible accompanying wives, minor children, and servants may share a passport; others need separate passports. Professional titles are omitted. A citizen’s application requires a one-dollar fee, and the Department of State does not obtain foreign visés. The Secretary of State may reject applications for improper purposes or failure to follow the rules.

In U.S. insular possessions, applicants apply to the chief executive. Applicants temporarily abroad apply through U.S. diplomatic or consular officials. Passports are limited to people who owe allegiance to the United States. Applications must be sworn affidavits stating birth, occupation, permanent residence, and intent to return after temporary travel.

Google has launched Gemini Enterprise, a platform for businesses to deploy and customise AI applications on Google Cloud. It offers access to Gemini Ultra models and tools for data governance, security, compliance and oversight. Google is emphasising transparency and data control as it competes for enterprise customers. Its success will depend on reliability, measurable returns and integration with existing systems.

The passage reviews small-group differentiated instruction as a way to address diverse learning needs in elementary and higher education. It describes tailoring content, activities, assessments, and learning environments to students’ readiness, interests, and backgrounds. Small groups can support engagement, discussion, and individualized guidance, while ongoing assessment helps teachers adjust instruction. Implementation differs by setting: elementary teachers typically provide more guidance, while higher education places greater emphasis on independent learning. Challenges include planning time, large classes, limited support, and varied student needs. The review notes insufficient evidence to compare outcomes across settings or assess effects on test scores, and recommends longitudinal research.

The 4-3 defense uses four defensive linemen, three linebackers and four defensive backs. Its one-gap assignments and seven defenders in the box make it strong against the run, while its defensive backs support varied pass coverages. The 3-technique tackle is a key pass rusher. Spread offenses can pull linebackers out of the box or attack the edges, often prompting defenses to replace the Sam linebacker with a nickel defensive back. Common options include linebacker blitzes, Tampa 2 and Cover 3 coverage.

The paper presents the Atlas of Human-AI Interaction, a tool that uses a large language model to extract empirical findings from research abstracts and map them as relationships in a knowledge graph. Of 1,888 papers collected, 1,124 yielded 2,037 findings. The Atlas offers graph, cause-and-effect, and paper views to support literature exploration. Its analysis identifies concentrated research on education, explanation, and trust, alongside opportunities to connect findings across otherwise separate research communities. In a study with 20 researchers, participants valued the tool for exploring research landscapes and discovering connections, but wanted broader paper coverage, more detailed context, and temporal analysis. The authors position it as a complement to, rather than a replacement for, existing literature-review methods.

Mother appealed a dissolution judgment requiring father to pay $31 per month for each of their two children. The court agreed that father’s expenses during extensive visitation should factor into support, but found the award insufficient for the children’s welfare. Because father’s future income was difficult to estimate, the court modified support to $65 per month per child, effective on the decision date.

Ray Dalio’s All Weather Portfolio combines stocks, bonds, and commodities to reduce drawdowns across different economic conditions. In the passage’s backtest from July 2007, it returned 4.5% annually versus 6.7% for the S&P 500, excluding dividends, but experienced smaller drawdowns during the 2008–09 financial crisis, the 2020 Covid-19 sell-off, and the 2022 bear market. The strategy favors stability over maximum returns and may appeal to conservative investors or retirees. The passage recommends rebalancing at least annually and notes that past performance does not guarantee future results.

*Please, Continue (Hamlet)* stages Hamlet’s trial for Polonius’s murder in a real courtroom, with legal professionals arguing the case and an audience jury deciding the verdict. Created by Yan Duyvendak and Roger Bernat, the production adapts to each host country’s legal system and incorporates details from a real criminal case. The creators developed it after researching trials and disagreeing over the real defendant’s guilt. Duyvendak says the show lets audiences experience the complexity of reaching a verdict.
The appellate court affirmed the order with $10 costs and disbursements. Justice Thomas dissented, arguing that the ex parte order deprived the plaintiff of a statutory right to reply.

A systematic review and bibliometric analysis examined 270 English-language Scopus journal articles on the metaverse in education published from 2015 to July 2024. Publications rose sharply after 2021 and peaked in 2023. South Korea, China and the United States produced the most articles; South Korea had the most citations. Prominent research topics included virtual reality, augmented reality, artificial intelligence, immersive learning and technology adoption. The study identified gaps in evidence on long-term educational outcomes and called for longitudinal and cross-cultural research.

Michigan officials encourage residents and organizations to join a voluntary statewide tornado drill at 1 p.m. Wednesday during Severe Weather Awareness Week. They recommend identifying a safe shelter, practicing drills, monitoring weather reports and preparing a 72-hour emergency kit. If severe weather occurs on April 19, the drill will move to 1 p.m. Thursday.

Effective transition defense begins with careful ball handling, good shot selection, offensive rebounding and defensive balance. After a missed shot, turnover or blocked shot, players should sprint back while watching the ball, protect the basket and prevent easy shots. Pressuring the ball handler and disrupting outlet passes can slow a fast break and give teammates time to recover. The passage emphasizes practicing outnumbered situations, assigning clear responsibilities and making transition defense part of full-court scrimmages.

The Navy’s free Pier Pressure app encourages Sailors to make responsible drinking choices by exploring the potential health and career effects of excessive drinking. Part of the Keep What You’ve Earned campaign, it includes interactive gaming, a drink-calorie counter and links to Uber and Lyft.

The passage specifies GHCB communication for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP non-automatic events. Guests and hypervisors must mark supplied fields in VALID_BITMAP and reset it before each event. VMGEXIT processing requires vCPU protection, and the hypervisor reports errors through SW_EXITINFO fields.

It describes event handling for I/O, MSR and MMIO accesses; page-state changes; SNP guest requests; AP creation; doorbell pages, IPIs and timers; APIC ID lists; VMPL changes; trusted-device requests; Secure AVIC; and termination. It also covers SEV-ES identification, AP boot and reset procedures, NMI completion, and debug-register handling. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

For Restricted Injection, a shared #HV doorbell page carries pending events and an end-of-interrupt assist. The passage defines how the host presents events and how the guest atomically acknowledges them, validates vectors, and completes interrupt service.

Florence O. Summers sued Clennon C. Hemsell and his employer, Columbian Fuel Corporation, after an automobile collision killed her husband. A jury awarded his surviving wife, children and mother $30,890. The appellate court held that the damages instructions improperly assumed life expectancies and future support, permitted consideration of a child’s loss of love, and suggested college expenses without sufficient evidence. It also found counsel’s criticism of admissible evidence improper. The court rejected appellants’ arguments concerning sole proximate cause and an independent intervening cause. It reversed the judgment and remanded the case.

Police in Xinjiang’s Pishan County shot dead three knife-wielding assailants after an attack Tuesday that killed five people and injured 10. Authorities said social order had been restored and an investigation launched. The passage also describes previous attacks in Xinjiang and elsewhere in China, and competing claims about Uighur separatism and Beijing’s treatment of Uighurs.

The Dow fell 424.56 points, or 1.74 percent, on Tuesday amid concerns about rising interest rates and Caterpillar’s outlook. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Caterpillar and 3M shares fell, while the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose above 3 percent for the first time in four years.

A researcher found a disabled-by-default keylogging function in Synaptics touchpad drivers on more than 450 HP products. Someone with administrative privileges could enable it to monitor keystrokes. HP released patches, urged affected users to install them, and said neither it nor Synaptics had access to customer data. A separate keylogging vulnerability in HP audio drivers was reported earlier that year.

Philadelphia extended its unbeaten run to four matches, with Bořek Dočkal contributing a goal and two assists against Chicago. Ilsinho also scored after beating Bastian Schweinsteiger. In another match, Josef Martinez scored before Teal Bunbury’s late penalty earned New England a 1-1 draw.

Johnny Juzang is making a case for a Timberwolves roster spot after scoring 20 points in 14 minutes Tuesday and shooting 9-for-15 from three this preseason. On a non-guaranteed contract, he could help replace Nickeil Alexander-Walker, who left this offseason.

Synthetic molecular-line observations of a simulated collapsing prestellar core show that a commonly used line-profile method consistently underestimates the true mass-weighted infall velocity, sometimes by an order of magnitude. The discrepancy depends on the molecular line and aperture used: self-absorption often traces slower-moving outer material rather than the core’s peak infall speed. Optically thin line widths more closely matched the true velocity in this simulation, though the authors caution that this may not hold in turbulent environments.

Effective March 11, 2021, Tesla’s President of Automotive, Jerome Guillen, transitioned to President, Tesla Heavy Trucking. He will lead the Tesla Semi program, including its charging and servicing networks.

A UK medical tribunal removed surgeon Sachiendra Amaragiri from the medical register after finding he abused his position by sending a love letter to a patient. He apologised and said he would appeal.

Researchers at Johns Hopkins and the Mayo Clinic published a guideline for phasing out CK-MB blood testing in patients with suspected heart attacks. They cite evidence that cardiac troponin is a better marker of heart injury and that CK-MB adds no diagnostic value, despite its continued use by many U.S. laboratories. The guideline recommends hospitalwide education, removing CK-MB from routine order sets, adding electronic ordering alerts, and monitoring test use and patient outcomes.

Sony is offering U.S. buyers instant savings of up to $300 on select full-frame cameras, plus up to $500 for trading in an interchangeable-lens camera, through September 30, 2017. Select lenses and accessories have up to $100 off, and shipping is free.

CANSLIM is William O’Neill’s seven-factor stock-selection method, focused on earnings, growth, institutional sponsorship and upward price trends. Backtests show it beat the S&P 500 since 2003, but with greater volatility and drawdowns; recent performance has lagged. Its small-cap bias may help explain earlier gains. The method is difficult to implement and backtest.

Compass Minerals remains rated “Buy” in the passage, which cites rising salt and plant nutrition volumes, cost cuts, and improving cash flow and EBITDA. Its lower valuation than peers suggests upside, while higher debt and leverage remain risks. Management projects further revenue growth in 2025.

The speaker says Rucchin’s two goals, strong goaltending and a solid team effort secured a needed win. After struggling offensively earlier in the finals, he was glad to contribute. He says the team played poorly in its first two games in New Jersey but improved in Anaheim, and must return to its earlier road form and tighten its defense. He plans to keep the same preparation for the next game and lead by example. After a hit, a doctor checked him and cleared him to return. He says the team is close to the Stanley Cup but remains focused on the next game.

Peter Crouch joked on Twitter about the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge presenting their newborn son, drawing thousands of likes and retweets. His wife, Abbey Clancy, replied with a widely appreciated comeback, though the passage does not include either remark. Crystal Palace also joked about an AFP announcement of the birth by replying “Great name!” to its wording, “gives birth to son: palace.”

The Warriors repeatedly overcame slow starts against the Rockets, notably in Games 6 and 7, but could not rally in Games 2, 4 and 5. Analysts Mark Jackson and Jeff Van Gundy said the team’s ability to recover is impressive, but warned that repeatedly falling behind could eventually cost them.

The passage describes a light-emitting diode device with micro LEDs positioned between two electrodes on a thin-film transistor substrate. Bridge patterns connect the LEDs to the electrodes. The LEDs and an underlying passivation pattern have aligned sidewalls, reducing steps that could cause the bridge patterns to break. The manufacturing method aligns the micro LEDs using a voltage difference, then uses one mask process with two etching steps to form the aligned passivation patterns before adding the bridge patterns.

Fired assistant U.S. attorney Michael Ben’Ary said a false social media post apparently prompted his dismissal while he was prosecuting a case related to the 2021 Afghanistan airport bombing. In a letter, he accused Justice Department leadership of prioritizing punishment of President Trump’s perceived enemies over national security.

Investors are buying closed-end equity mutual fund units on exchanges at discounts to their net asset values (NAVs). Holders who need cash before maturity may sell at a discount because trading is limited. Buyers may benefit when the funds redeem at NAV at maturity, alongside any gains before then. The passage cites several schemes trading at discounts of 6–10%. Discounts depend partly on time to maturity and tax considerations. Because many listed funds rarely trade, one adviser suggests looking for schemes with assets exceeding Rs 250 crore.

Three winner-takes-all MLB wild-card Game 3s are set for Thursday, only the second day in baseball history with three such playoff games. Detroit must improve with runners in scoring position after stranding a team postseason-record 15 in Game 2. The Padres-Cubs matchup could hinge on bullpen availability and how long starters Yu Darvish and Jameson Taillon pitch. Boston’s bullpen was heavily used in Game 2, making a short Game 3 start especially challenging against the Yankees.

Aspen is replacing its annual Fourth of July fireworks display with a 15-minute show of 50 drones because of wildfire risk in the drought-hit area. The drones will display patriotic colours over Wagner Park, accompanied by music. Colorado fire authorities have imposed strict restrictions across large parts of the state.

Simon Black says the U.S. national debt surpassed $21 trillion after rising $73 billion in one day, $215 billion in February and more than $1 trillion in six months. He argues that debt is growing faster than the economy and warns that its continued growth could have consequences.

Airbus plans to test a prototype autonomous flying taxi under Project Vahana, aiming to offer short-haul trips by 2021. The company says the vehicle could help commuters avoid congested roads while using clean technology and reducing the need for road infrastructure. Other companies, including Uber, Urban Aeronautics and AeroMobil, are also developing airborne transport concepts.

Meagan Holt uses a writing program at Seattle Children’s to express her feelings about her 3-year-old daughter Madeline, who has Zellweger Syndrome and is expected to die from it. Offered by the Pediatric Advanced Care Team, the donation-funded program encourages parents to journal about their experiences.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on October 27, 2022, announcing its third-quarter 2022 financial results. The filing includes the earnings press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

Jio’s Galaxy Club offers Rs 2,750 cashback in 55 vouchers on the Samsung Galaxy J2 2018 and Galaxy J7 Duo. With eligible Rs 198 or Rs 299 plans, J2 buyers can receive 100GB of additional data, while J7 Duo buyers receive double daily data. The offers run until September 30. The phones launched in India in April at Rs 8,190 and Rs 16,990, respectively, and are available online and offline.

New CFPB rules would require payday and auto title lenders to verify that borrowers can repay loans within 30 days and would limit repeated account debits. A CFPB study found that more than 80 percent of payday loans are rolled over or followed by another loan within two weeks. Consumer advocates say the rules would curb debt traps, while an industry group warns they would restrict access to credit. The CFPB estimates loan volume could fall by half and many stores could close. The rules would take effect in 2019 but could be rolled back by Congress.

Researchers analyzed pretreatment biopsies from 67 sarcoma patients in three immune checkpoint inhibitor trials. Tumors with higher immune-cell infiltration had a higher response rate than those with lower infiltration (30% versus 8.1%) and longer median progression-free survival (3.65 versus 1.7 months). Higher expression of transposable elements and IKZF1 was associated with immune-rich tumors, immune signaling, and longer progression-free survival. Associations with immune activity and survival were also observed in a separate cohort of 190 patients who had not received systemic therapy. The authors propose transposable-element expression and IKZF1 as potential biomarkers, but note that their predictive value and proposed mechanisms require further validation.

The Ravens traded pass rusher Odafe Oweh to the Chargers for safety Alohi Gilman, shaking up a defense that has allowed an NFL-high 35.4 points per game. Oweh has no sacks through five games after recording 10 last season; the trade frees about $8 million in Baltimore’s cap space. Gilman adds experience to the Ravens’ thin safety group, while the Chargers address a greater need at edge rusher.

Happy Home Furnishers is closing its Neath store after 33 years, citing anti-social behaviour, limited free parking and rising business rates. Its director said street works disrupted trade and a council-installed bench attracted disorder; the council said it removed the bench about a year ago and is working with police to improve the town centre. Other traders reported mixed experiences of anti-social behaviour, while some agreed parking is difficult. The Welsh Government said rates relief supports small businesses. Happy Home Furnishers will continue trading elsewhere and may seek another site in Neath.

This exploratory study examined physics teachers’ views of physics education research through interviews with 13 teachers and a survey of 174 teachers in Germany and Austria. Interviewees expressed both appreciation for research and doubts about its practical applicability, often favouring their own experience. Survey analysis identified four profiles: sceptical teachers (14%), uncertain teachers (27%), teachers who valued research but found its offerings insufficient for practice (41%), and research advocates (18%). All profiles expressed some concern about cooperation between researchers and schools. Reading instructional journals more frequently was associated with profile membership; teaching experience, education, school type and doctoral qualifications were not significant predictors. The authors caution that the small, non-representative samples and other methodological limitations restrict interpretation.

At a VAT administrators’ forum in Lilongwe, Malawi’s Treasury Secretary Ben Botolo urged African countries to use modern technology to improve tax compliance and revenue collection. He cited electronic fiscal devices and Malawi’s progress in electronic monitoring. Forum chair Henry Saka called for strategies to address tax evasion. The forum brings together 10 member countries to examine compliance challenges and share solutions.

The President clarifies that his earlier message did not dispute Congress’s authority to regulate the custody and disposition of public money and property. He claims no executive authority over it except as granted by law, and asks the Senate to record this clarification with his earlier message.
The passage lists perspective, front, back, side, top, and bottom views of two analytical instrument designs. Features shown in broken lines are not part of the claimed design.

Retired lawyer Marcel Strigberger recounts recycling law schoolbooks he bought more than 50 years ago. As he considered what to discard, he recalled memorable cases and property-law concepts from his studies. He kept one thick volume to use as a reading stand.

The passage describes a sidelink positioning method in which a network device configures two terminal devices to exchange positioning reference signals. Measurements such as angles of arrival and receive–transmit time differences are combined with the second terminal’s position to determine the first terminal’s position. Either the first terminal or the network device may calculate it, and the second terminal can perform measurements when the first cannot. The passage states that using nearby terminals can improve accuracy and that avoiding core-network transmission of measurements can reduce latency. It also describes related apparatuses, software, and a communication system.

The lecture reviews propagators as correlation functions and, heuristically, particle transition amplitudes. Retarded, advanced, and Feynman functions use different contour prescriptions around poles; equivalent infinitesimal shifts of the poles simplify calculations. In free scalar theory, vacuum n-point functions reduce to sums of products of two-point functions. Composite operators can be singular when fields are multiplied at the same point and require renormalization.

Adding a fourth-power field term introduces interactions, but the resulting nonlinear equation cannot be solved by the earlier free-field method. The lecture therefore introduces weak-coupling perturbation and scattering. The S-matrix gives transition amplitudes between widely separated initial and final particle states; it is unitary and becomes the identity without interactions. Momentum conservation can be factored out to define a scattering amplitude. The LSZ theorem relates that amplitude to time-ordered correlation functions, which the lecture will approach using path integrals.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 25, 2018, announcing its third-quarter 2018 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

Detroit’s speaker says the team must stay focused despite home distractions and be ready to play a complete game against Philadelphia. Both teams have won away from home, so home ice offers no automatic advantage. Penalties put pressure on Detroit, though the speaker says its recent penalties were not foolish and praises the players for avoiding retaliation.

The speaker expresses confidence in goalie Mike’s resilience and experience, says Murphy has paired well with Nick Lidstrom, and credits the forwards’ defensive coverage. Reflecting on a past loss to the Devils, the speaker says Detroit is now a different, more experienced team. The team will continue its pregame travel and rest routine before the next game.

In June 2014, Hertz said it would restate and correct three years of results because of accounting problems, prompting analyst Abby Devins to examine whether fleet depreciation might be significant. Hertz operated more than 700,000 rental cars worldwide at the end of 2013 and had reported record revenue and EBITDA that year. Its vehicles were its largest asset, and depreciation represented about a quarter of expenses from 2011 to 2013. Hertz calculated fleet depreciation using estimated holding periods and residual values, reviewing rates quarterly. Devins gathered Hertz and Avis data from 2006 to 2013 for comparison.

AI could expand learning, creativity, and access to knowledge, but over-reliance may weaken critical thinking and the ability to retain skills independently. The passage calls for AI that augments people, alongside changes to education and safeguards for workers as jobs and collaboration evolve. In social science, large language models could help synthesize data, analyze text, and develop hypotheses, though bias, validity, cost, and misuse remain concerns. The passage advocates human oversight and governance that combines forward-looking regulation with reports from developers and users, supported by cooperation among industry, academia, policymakers, and the public.
Tesla filed a Form 8-K on March 19, 2020, furnishing a press release dated the same day as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn.

During a visit by U.S. Ambassador William Symington, Rivers State Governor Nyesom Wike called for a U.S. visa office in Port Harcourt to serve the South-South and South-East. Wike alleged that the Niger Delta Development Commission diverts resources to political campaigns and said it had failed to act on state project proposals or pay its agreed share of a hospital project. He also called for the cleanup of Ogoni land and expressed interest in U.S. partnerships in agriculture, oil and gas, and industrialization. Symington said he had come to meet residents and learn about the state.

The passage describes use of TLV32xx comparators, which have 1.8 mV of internal hysteresis and push-pull or open-drain output options. Unused inputs should have at least 50 mV differential voltage rather than be tied together. Push-pull outputs must not be connected to other outputs, while open-drain outputs require a pull-up resistor. Output shorts can damage the devices. External hysteresis can reduce chatter near the switching threshold, and smaller overdrive voltages can increase propagation delay. The passage also gives guidance on input protection, power-on reset, supply bypassing, and high-speed PCB layout, and illustrates a low-side current-sensing application. TI states that application guidance must be validated by customers and provides its resources “as is.”

Coach Vigneault said his team must improve after a weak third period against a structured, skilled and physical opponent. The goaltender kept them close, but every player will need to bring his best game. Vigneault plans adjustments for the next game and wants the team to use its strengths, including speed. He also praised Rick’s play and said a defenseman’s stamina and performance have improved during the playoffs.

The passage urges creation of a Cabinet-level commerce department with broad powers to supervise interstate corporations. It calls for reciprocal trade with Cuba, citing the countries’ close political ties and potential mutual benefits, and reports a proposed trade convention with Great Britain concerning Newfoundland. It favors arbitration where possible, praises the Hague tribunal, and notes its successful use by the United States and Mexico. It also recommends consideration of Hawaiian fire claims and urges that construction of an isthmian canal, preferably at Panama, proceed as a policy sustained across administrations while negotiations with Colombia continue.

Woodstock grief specialists advise people mourning a loved one during the holidays to plan which events they can manage, leave gatherings when needed, share memories and be patient with themselves. They suggest creating new traditions while keeping some old ones. The Surviving Suicide Grief Support Group meets twice monthly at Smith-Leroy Funeral Home. Other grief programs are scheduled in Woodstock and Ingersoll.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on October 20, 2016, announcing that it had issued a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2016. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

CPRE Bedfordshire says Central Bedfordshire Council’s plan for 44,000–55,000 homes over 20 years relies heavily on people moving into the area: a Freedom of Information response indicates only 41% of the assessed housing need is for current residents. CPRE warns that development would harm countryside and strain transport. The council says national planning rules require it to account for migration, population change and affordability.

The professor compares the near-certain, gradual consequences of climate change with the low daily probability but potentially catastrophic consequences of nuclear war. He identifies accidental escalation between the United States and Russia, particularly through early-warning errors, and escalation of conventional conflict between India and Pakistan as major pathways to nuclear war. He argues that fear and distrust drove large arsenals and continue to sustain missiles on rapid-launch alert.

The lecture examines the Non-Proliferation Treaty’s obligations to prevent proliferation and pursue disarmament, negotiations over Iran’s nuclear program, and the lack of progress on agreed disarmament steps. The professor questions whether deterrence makes countries more secure, criticizes aspects of Obama’s nuclear policy, and argues that abolition should be assessed by whether it would reduce overall risk. He emphasizes inspections, diplomacy, and further arms-control efforts while acknowledging that abolition is unlikely soon.

President Andrew Johnson sent the House further correspondence about General U. S. Grant’s departure from the War Department after the Senate rejected Edwin Stanton’s suspension. Johnson said Grant had agreed either to remain as acting Secretary of War while Stanton sought a court ruling or to return the office to Johnson before the Senate acted. He enclosed five Cabinet members’ accounts of their January 14 conversation and accused Grant of concealing his intentions and disregarding a presidential order concerning War Department instructions. Grant disputed the charge of insubordination, saying he had interpreted an ambiguous order and had never intended to disobey a clearly communicated legal order. He enclosed correspondence showing other departments continued to deal with Stanton as Secretary of War.

North Carolina fell to 2-3 after a 38-10 loss to Clemson, its third defeat against a Power 4 team. Bill Belichick acknowledged coaching and execution problems but said he would not make structural or personnel changes based on a long-term rebuilding plan. Receiver Shipp rejected the rebuild label, saying his focus is winning games.

Medical students face substantial stress, and this study explored how students in Dubai experienced a six-hour, curriculum-based resilience course. Researchers thematically analyzed reflective essays from 37 fourth-year students and identified three themes: awareness, application, and appraisal. Students described resilience as a skill developed through ongoing practice. They reported using mindfulness, reflection, physical activity, and other coping strategies, while citing limited time, effort, and scepticism as obstacles. Many valued the course and perceived benefits for their well-being and clinical training. Because the study examined one cohort’s reflections, it established students’ perceptions rather than the course’s effectiveness.

The authors argue that community-based programs can complement families and schools in supporting young people’s mental health. Trusted adults in camps, sports leagues and after-school programs are positioned to recognize distress and connect youth with professional help. To do this sustainably, organizations need staff training, referral partnerships, clear protocols and support for frontline workers.

Advocacy is a professional responsibility for special education teachers, and the passage argues that preparation programs should teach it throughout coursework rather than as a standalone lesson. An undergraduate inclusive education course illustrates this approach through policy analysis, reflections, debate, and a persuasive TED-style presentation and paper. These scaffolded activities give students opportunities to practice argumentation, critical thinking, and communication. The passage concludes that such training can help future teachers advocate for students at school and beyond.

Avoyelles Parish is projected to spend $8,123 in state and local revenue per student in 2017-18, the second-lowest amount among Louisiana’s 69 public school districts. Its local contribution is also second-lowest. The statewide average is $9,015. Louisiana’s funding formula directs more state aid to poorer districts and adjusts for student needs. The Senate has requested a study of education costs and potential funding sources.

The lecture introduces real analysis as a course in reading and writing proofs about real numbers, functions, and limits. It defines sets, common number systems, and set operations, then proves one of De Morgan’s laws by showing that each set is a subset of the other. Using the well-ordering property of natural numbers, it proves mathematical induction by contradiction and applies induction to a geometric sum formula and the inequality \((1+c)^n \geq 1+nc\) for \(c \geq -1\).

The lecture examines competition and fairness in digital platforms that serve consumers and third-party merchants or apps while offering their own products. It challenges the view that platforms will always favor a rich ecosystem: prices to consumers or apps may be constrained at zero, and favoring in-house products may protect a platform from future competition. The professor discusses the EU Digital Markets Act’s efforts to improve entry and fair access, as well as the difficulties of regulating global platforms whose products change rapidly.

A model of access charges shows that charges set too low can encourage platforms to exclude rivals, while charges set too high can squeeze them out. The model suggests an optimal charge tied to the benefit an app gains from acquiring a consumer, but measuring that benefit and designing a practical rule remain unresolved.

For decades, Voyager 2 data suggested Uranus had no internal heat. By combining computer modeling with decades of observations, researchers now estimate that it releases about 15% more energy than it receives from the Sun, though far less than Neptune. The finding challenges earlier assumptions and may help scientists investigate Uranus’ history and similar-sized exoplanets.

Ahead of Super Bowl LII between the Patriots and Eagles, the writer invites readers to answer questions about next season’s playoff teams, Kirk Cousins, game statistics, the coin flip and Alan Faneca’s Hall of Fame chances. The passage also recaps responses to the previous week’s questions and lists contest standings, with Alan Tman leading at 48.5 points.

President Ford’s 1976 Executive Order 11905 replaced the 40 Committee with the Operations Advisory Group (OAG), which reviewed covert actions, and barred U.S. Government employees from political assassinations and domestic intelligence activities. Covert-action approval and oversight remained subject to the Hughes-Ryan amendment.

President Carter replaced the OAG with the National Security Council’s Special Coordination Committee (SCC), retaining its procedures. His 1978 order made the Attorney General and budget director full members of the committee when it reviewed covert action and sensitive surveillance. A lower-level Special Activities Working Group reviewed proposals early in his administration but gradually fell out of use; by late 1979, another interagency group chaired by David Aaron handled certain covert actions.

Carter continued using worldwide presidential findings for lower-risk covert operations. CIA- and State Department-cleared documents called “Perspectives” supplied more specific guidance, while riskier operations required separate findings or notifications. Beginning in 1978, worldwide actions were authorized as specific additions to an existing finding.

After Flynn’s exit, Democrats called for an independent investigation into the Trump administration’s ties to Russia. Other developments include a possible shift in U.S. policy on Israeli-Palestinian peace, an arrest in Kim Jong Nam’s death, NATO talks, and concerns about Oroville Dam cracks. The passage also covers risky driving, a Boeing union vote, laser-marked produce, Kate Upton’s swimsuit cover and Rumor’s Westminster win.

Oclaro shares fell 0.99% in the latest session and closed at $9.04. Analysts’ average 12-month price target was $9.27, with estimates ranging from $6.50 to $11.25. The average brokerage recommendation was 2.38. Oclaro’s 14-period Average True Range was 0.29, and its Relative Strength Index was 55.48. The company had a $1.53 billion market capitalization and 169.6 million shares outstanding. Previous-session volume was 1.62 million shares, below the 5.58 million average.

Researchers developed and externally validated three machine-learning models to predict lung restriction from spirometric, demographic, and anthropometric data, using 42,462 pulmonary function tests for development and 24,524 for validation. The best-performing random forest model had a negative predictive value of 88.3% in validation, compared with 72.7% for the guideline-based forced vital capacity threshold. It also reduced, but did not eliminate, the performance gap between non-Hispanic Black and non-Hispanic White patients. However, it excluded the need for static lung-volume measurements in fewer tests than the guideline-based approach and was poorly calibrated in external validation. The authors conclude that machine-learning models may improve the accuracy and equity of interpretation, while noting limitations including the academic-health-system datasets and restricted equity assessment.

The Care Quality Commission rated East of England Ambulance Service NHS Trust as Requires Improvement after a March inspection, while rating its care as Outstanding. Inspectors found progress in safeguarding, understanding of the Mental Capacity Act and incident reporting, but said the trust still missed ambulance response standards. They also reported winter delays, low staff morale and inconsistent procedures. The trust must improve response times, review risk registers and better support staff. Its chief executive acknowledged the challenges and said the trust was working to strengthen local teams.

A pharmacist’s application for a liquor-sale permit was continued to a later court term, where the judge granted it despite a remonstrance. Cox challenged the judge’s jurisdiction because the application was not heard at the first term. The court held that the statutory timing provisions did not require dismissal: courts retain discretion to manage their business, and unresolved applications continue to the next term. Finding no showing of improper postponement or irregular proceedings, the court dismissed Cox’s challenge.

The author used the 2017 Dugan Stock Scoring System to rank non-REIT, non-MLP companies on David Fish’s January 2017 “All CCC” list, then applied thresholds for yield, market cap, valuation, payout, dividend and earnings growth, debt, and score. The system evaluates risk, value, past performance, and future expectations, with a small adjustment for brokers’ sector recommendations. The process identified 21 companies. The author cautions that the article is informational, not investment advice.

Asian stocks were unsettled and the yuan remained near an 11-month low ahead of planned U.S. tariffs on $34 billion of Chinese goods, which Beijing has vowed to match. Wall Street fell Tuesday as technology shares weakened; a chip-sales injunction in China weighed on Micron and other chipmakers. China’s central bank said it was watching currency fluctuations and would seek to keep the yuan stable. The Mexican peso rose after comments from the country’s newly elected president. Oil prices were supported by a larger-than-expected drop in U.S. stockpiles, while copper remained near nine-month lows amid trade concerns.

Tesla’s 2018 Form 10-K describes its automotive and energy generation and storage businesses. The company sold Model S, Model X and Model 3 vehicles, along with Powerwall and Powerpack batteries and solar energy systems. It was expanding Model 3 production and international deliveries, constructing a factory in Shanghai, and planning additional vehicles and increased Solar Roof production. Tesla reported 48,817 full-time employees at year-end 2018. The filing highlights risks involving production and delivery delays, supplier dependence, manufacturing costs, product performance, competition and consumer adoption of electric vehicles.

Temple Grandin, a Colorado State University professor known for her research on animal behavior and livestock handling, will speak at a breakfast event from 7–9 a.m. Friday, Feb. 23, at the Tehama District Fairground in Red Bluff. Breakfast costs $15. For information, contact Josh Davy at 527-3101 or jdavy@ucdavis.edu.

Coach DeBoer said his team has overcome similar deficits and needs a first win to build momentum. He does not plan lineup changes simply because the team is losing. He credited Los Angeles and its goaltender for stopping quality chances, while saying his team must score more, including on the power play. He praised the officiating overall but questioned one call involving a puck he believed was out of sight. He said the team fought until the final buzzer and would do so again Wednesday.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture enables real-time ray tracing on a single GPU through dedicated RT Cores, RTX software, and filtering algorithms. It also adds AI and advanced shading features, inherits CUDA enhancements from Volta, and supports Microsoft’s DirectML and DirectX Raytracing APIs. The TU102 GPU powers the GeForce RTX 2080 Ti and Quadro RTX 6000.

The passage says a balanced diet can support immune function and recovery from infections. It highlights varied fruits and vegetables for vitamins, minerals and fibre; adequate protein for immune defences and repair; and herbs, spices, probiotic foods, nuts and seeds for additional nutrients. Rest and hydration also play important roles.

Israel and Canada signed a modernized free trade agreement to replace their 1997 pact. It will eliminate duties on thousands of additional products and add provisions on labor, the environment, trade and gender, small and medium-sized enterprises, and dispute settlement. The agreement will take effect after ratification by both parliaments. Its stated goal is to double trade between the countries.

Apple’s fiscal second-quarter 2019 net sales fell 5% year over year to $58.0 billion, driven by lower iPhone sales and partly offset by higher Services and Wearables, Home and Accessories sales. Net income was $11.6 billion, down from $13.8 billion, and diluted earnings per share were $2.46. For the first six months, net sales were $142.3 billion and net income was $31.5 billion. Apple repurchased $24.0 billion of stock and paid $3.4 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the quarter.

A Danish study of 4,741 mothers found that children of older mothers had fewer behavioural, social and emotional difficulties at ages seven and 11, but not at 15. The association remained significant after accounting for observed demographic and socioeconomic characteristics. Researchers suggested that older mothers’ psychological maturity and less frequent scolding and physical discipline may contribute to the findings. They also cautioned that later pregnancy carries greater risks of miscarriage, premature birth and deformities.

A PRISMA-guided meta-analysis of 13 studies across eight countries found a positive overall effect of AI-related educational technologies (effect size 0.86; 95% confidence interval [0.45, 1.27]). Chatbots and generative AI had the largest reported subgroup effect (1.02). Online learning and virtual reality had an estimated effect of 0.79, but its confidence interval included zero. The study also tested alternative algorithmic and statistical approaches, which produced similar positive overall estimates. Substantial variation between studies and reported publication bias warrant cautious interpretation.
Scientists fused human skin cells with empty eggs, producing functional eggs that could form early embryos.

The speaker says Fredrik had X-rays after missing a few shifts but returned to finish the game; a report is expected later. Reflecting on the loss, he cites a poor start, inaccurate passing and turnovers that stalled the offense. He says the team needs better shot selection, a stronger forecheck and deeper puck placement. Special-teams play left some players with heavy ice time and others with little, so he may adjust the units. His immediate focus is winning the second game to even the series.
Niu Technologies’ stock has risen sharply in 2025, supported by recent growth. The author rates it a hold, warning that growth may not continue fast enough to justify its valuation.

A Mendelian randomization study using genetic data found that greater genetically determined pericardial adipose tissue was associated with higher risks of cardiovascular disease, heart failure, hypertension, coronary heart disease, ischemic heart disease, ischemic stroke, and venous thromboembolism. Hypertension partly mediated several of these associations. The authors suggest pericardial adipose tissue as a potential therapeutic target but note that the findings need further study and may not apply beyond European populations.

The passage describes proposed CAR T-cell therapies in which Tet1, Tet2 or Tet3 expression or function is reduced to improve cell proliferation and therapeutic activity. It covers gene editing, RNA-based inhibitors, proteins and small molecules, as well as methods for manufacturing and administering modified immune cells. Supporting observations include expansion of a patient’s CAR T-cell clone with a CAR insertion in Tet2 and laboratory findings that Tet2 knockdown reduced 5-hydroxymethylcytosine and promoted expansion of T cells with a stem-cell memory phenotype.

Russian math after-school programs are growing across the United States. The Russian School of Mathematics reports 22,000 students at 40 branches, while smaller programs also operate. Their lessons emphasize reasoning, early algebra and geometry, and understanding why methods work. Parents enroll children for greater challenge, enjoyment of math or dissatisfaction with school instruction; some also fear their children will fall behind peers.

Weekly classes cost about $2,000 a year. Educators say the programs may leave public-school classes with wider differences in students’ preparation and could widen gaps between families that can and cannot afford them. Although honors math enrollment has risen at one school where Russian math is popular, its math department chair says there is no data showing the program caused the increase. Its broader effects remain uncertain.

Three youths were killed during a military search operation in Shopian, where troops also damaged a mosque and four homes. Protests followed, and several civilians were injured.
