Two soldiers were killed in an attack during the operation, while three were injured in Bandipora. Train services remained suspended. Kashmiri leaders opposed changes to Jammu and Kashmir’s status. A civilian injured in a Srinagar explosion died.

A collection of October 2001 reports says the SEC requested information about Enron’s transactions with partnerships formerly run by CFO Andrew Fastow. Enron called the inquiry informal and pledged to cooperate. The request followed a $1.01 billion third-quarter charge, a $618 million loss and a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity linked to unwinding partnership arrangements. Analysts and investors questioned Enron’s disclosures, potential conflicts of interest and risks from other financing vehicles. Enron shares fell about 21% on October 22, closing at $20.65, while shareholders filed lawsuits alleging misconduct.

The passage says sexual harassment is widespread in universities and other workplaces. After an investigation, OAU dismissed Professor Richard Akindele for soliciting sex from a student. It urges institutions to punish misconduct and protect students, while calling on students to avoid sexual entanglements with lecturers.

Tom Evans said his 23-month-old son Alfie had breathed unassisted for nine hours after life support was withdrawn at Alder Hey Children’s Hospital. He said doctors later gave Alfie oxygen and water, but that the toddler would need further support. Alfie’s mother, Kate James, also said he had been given oxygen and water.

A June 4 news roundup covers Enron’s ties to White House officials, its participation in Saudi Arabian gas projects, and disputes involving its power projects in India and Nigeria. Indian lenders planned to seek continued support for Enron’s Dabhol project after Maharashtra’s utility stopped buying its power; the dispute raised concerns about foreign investment. Other reports discuss India’s credit outlook and power reforms, a UK gas-electricity trade involving Enron, and the slow pace of electricity deregulation in Japan. Opinion pieces address energy-company conduct and the possibility that increased supply could lower energy prices.

The study presents a metagenomic sequencing workflow combining HostEL, which depletes human genetic material, with AmpRE, which prepares DNA and RNA for sequencing in one reaction. In spiked plasma, it detected bacteria and fungi down to 70,000 cells/mL, with 96% sensitivity and 96% specificity after HostEL treatment. In 42 clinical plasma samples, results agreed with clinical tests in 93% of cases after excluding 13 low-quality samples. The tested sequencing options offered estimated turnaround times of 13–27 hours. Validation covered a limited range of pathogens and plasma samples; the workflow is not applicable to parasite infections.

The speaker expects a motivated opponent that draws energy from its home crowd and says his team must establish its game early. An extra day off provides rest and a rare chance to practice adjustments. He says winning more faceoffs, staying patient and executing under pressure will help. He praises a versatile teammate whose contributions extend beyond statistics, notes that players are dealing with injuries, and says playoff experience helps the team avoid looking ahead. He also credits more aggressive play for creating chances and values an intense former player’s coaching advice.

In its first year, a free, wheelchair-accessible van transported more than 2,600 Mission Hope Cancer Center patients and traveled over 34,000 miles across the Santa Maria area. Local nonprofit Cruzin’ for Life raised money to retrofit and operate the van, with a $36,000 donation from Santa Maria Energy helping fund it. Mission Hope says the service helps patients get to treatment. Cruzin’ for Life may consider a second van if need and funding allow.

Backtests using NIFTY 50 data starting in 2007 suggest a positive end-of-month effect. A strategy buying at the close of the fifth-last trading day and selling at the close of the second trading day of the next month produced a 10.5% CAGR, with 30% market exposure and a 26% maximum drawdown. The authors note some curve fitting but say results remain reasonably robust when entry and exit days change slightly.

San Juan Mayor Carmen Yulin Cruz called new Hurricane Maria death estimates “a day of collective mourning” and accused Puerto Rico’s government of understating the toll. Harvard researchers estimated 4,645 excess deaths from Sept. 20 to Dec. 31, compared with the official toll of 64. Their household-survey estimate had a wide margin of error. Cruz also criticized President Trump’s response and said Puerto Rico was not prepared for another hurricane.

A woman declared dead by paramedics after a June 24 car crash near Carletonville, South Africa, was found alive hours later in a mortuary refrigerator. Two other occupants died. The ambulance service said she had shown no signs of life and launched an investigation.

Jim Montgomery enters his first full season coaching the Blues after guiding them to the first round of the playoffs following a midseason takeover. St. Louis opens at home on Oct. 9 and plays seven of its first 11 games there. The schedule includes 26 division games, a Feb. 5–25 Olympic break and an April 16 finale in Utah. Key questions include defensive improvement and the development of young forwards.

Celtic’s 2-1 comeback win at Ibrox put them 19 points ahead of Rangers approaching the winter break, with a game in hand. The passage compares the gap with 1925–26, when Celtic finished 20 points ahead under today’s scoring system, and 1985–86, when Rangers finished 22 points behind.

The passage describes an autonomous vehicle with a primary control system and independent auxiliary control units. The primary system uses sensors to plan routes and control driving. Auxiliary units monitor predefined safety conditions or system failures and can independently trigger actions such as braking or steering, potentially overriding the primary system. They can also assess planned trajectories and provide feedback so the primary system can verify or revise them. These separate controls are intended to provide redundant responses to hazards or malfunctions.

The passage reviews research on drama-based teaching and its potential role in STEAM education. It describes a qualitative pilot study in which 19 first-year university students took part in drama activities about the butterfly life cycle and the Indian caste system. Researchers observed creativity, collaboration, problem-solving and motivation, while students reported enjoying the activities. The passage also notes challenges in planning and implementing drama activities. Because the study had a small, narrowly defined group of participants, its findings are preliminary.

Ahead of CES, TrackR announced the colorful, lower-cost pixel tracker, a thinner wallet tracker, and the atlas smart plug, which locates connected trackers by room and supports Alexa. The trackers use smartphone and crowd-sourced locating and have replaceable batteries. Priced at $24.99, $29.99, and $39.99 respectively, all three are expected to launch in spring.

On May 2, 2016, NVIDIA announced a settlement with Samsung that will immediately dismiss all pending intellectual property litigation between them. Each company will license a small number of patents to the other, with no broad cross-licensing or other compensation.

Lightning is not attracted to metal; height, pointed shape and isolation are more important factors in where it strikes. A car’s metal roof and sides, not its tires, provide protection. Lightning can strike up to 10 miles from a storm, hit the same place repeatedly and strike trees, making them unsafe shelter. Most people killed by lightning during leisure activities are on or near water.

Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab has introduced Tinker, an API that automates much of the work of fine-tuning advanced AI models. It currently supports Meta’s Llama and Alibaba’s Qwen, using supervised learning or reinforcement learning, and lets users download the resulting models. The company says it aims to make model training more accessible to researchers and developers. Applications for access are opening, and the API is free for now. Thinking Machines vets users and plans to add automated safeguards against misuse.

Amazon’s 2021 Form 10-K describes three operating segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services. It serves consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, content creators, and advertisers. As of December 31, 2021, Amazon employed approximately 1.6 million full-time and part-time workers. The report identifies risks including intense competition, international regulation, fulfillment and staffing constraints, security breaches, litigation, and taxes. Operating cash flow fell from $66.1 billion in 2020 to $46.3 billion in 2021, while cash capital expenditures rose from $35.0 billion to $55.4 billion. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $96.0 billion at year-end 2021.

Researchers developed deep-learning models to identify extra-prostatic extension (EPE) and seminal vesicle invasion (SVI) on prostate MRI. The models were trained using data from 612 patients and evaluated on a 208-patient internal test set and two external sets. Internal test-set AUCs were 0.719 for EPE and 0.724 for SVI; external AUCs ranged from 0.611 to 0.775. Positive model predictions were associated with lower five-year biochemical recurrence-free survival. Combining the MRI biomarkers with established clinical risk groups reclassified 26.4% of patients and modestly improved discrimination of biochemical recurrence. The study did not assess overall survival or prostate cancer-specific mortality, compare the models with tissue-based classifiers, or include a large number of African American patients.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2015 Form 10-K describes its strategy to expand productivity services, cloud computing, and personal computing through Windows 10. The company operated six segments spanning consumer and commercial software, hardware, and services. Research and development spending was $12.0 billion, or 13% of revenue, and Microsoft employed about 118,000 people at June 30, 2015. It planned to eliminate up to 7,800 positions, primarily in Phone Hardware, and recorded $7.3 billion in goodwill and intangible-asset impairment charges in that segment. Reported risks include intense competition, cloud-service execution, cybersecurity, regulation, intellectual-property disputes, and global operations.

The passage describes reset behavior, clock sources and PLL limits, interrupt controllers, and electrical timing for a DaVinci digital media processor. It covers reset isolation for PCIe and the Ethernet switch, pin behavior during reset, and clock-input requirements. It also outlines features and timing requirements for peripherals including Ethernet, GPIO, memory controllers, HDMI, video processing, imaging, I2C, and DDR2/DDR3, along with PCB routing and signal-integrity guidance.

The President tells Congress that Britain has declined a U.S. proposal to arbitrate its boundary dispute with Venezuela. Britain disputes the Monroe doctrine’s applicability and its standing in international law; the President argues that the doctrine protects U.S. safety and applies to any unjust European acquisition of territory in the Americas. He asks Congress to fund a commission to investigate the boundary and says the United States should resist British control of any land the investigation determines belongs to Venezuela.
On June 3, 2015, Apple entered an underwriting agreement to issue ¥250 billion in 0.350% senior unsecured notes due June 10, 2020. Interest is payable semiannually beginning December 10, 2015.

Michael Flynn resigned after reports that he discussed U.S. sanctions with Russia’s ambassador before Trump’s inauguration. The passage says acting Attorney General Sally Yates warned White House counsel Donald McGahn that the discussions left Flynn vulnerable to blackmail. It also cites a report that Trump knew about the discussions before Vice President Pence, who had publicly defended Flynn. Trump criticized intelligence leaks and dismissed claims of a Russian connection. The passage describes calls for an investigation and speculates that testimony from Flynn or McGahn could clarify what Trump knew and when.

The Power Offense aims to free shooters through baseline crosses and down screens while creating post opportunities. Shooters cross under the basket, then curl off screens as the point guard looks for an open shooter or a screener rolling to the basket. Players adjust to the defense with curls, fades, back cuts, post feeds, screen-and-rolls, and slips. If the initial action produces no shot, the offense can continue through motion, side screens, drive-and-kick, or triangle post action. A single/double variation gives a strong shooter two routes off screens. The passage also emphasizes offensive rebounding, coordinated execution, recognition of defensive adjustments, and practice of screening and post skills.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2015, reports second-quarter net sales of $23.2 billion, up 20% from a year earlier, and net income of $92 million, compared with a $126 million loss. Operating income rose to $464 million from a $15 million loss. AWS sales increased 81% to $1.8 billion. Operating cash flow was $2.0 billion for the quarter, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $14.0 billion at June 30. The filing also describes acquisitions, contractual commitments, and ongoing legal and tax proceedings.

Three Northeast Mississippi residents were recognized or supported last week. Karmel Davis, a Parkway Elementary volunteer and incoming Parent Teacher Organization president, was named the Tupelo Public School District’s 2017 Parent of the Year. Corey Crayton received the keys to a home built by Northeast Mississippi Habitat for Humanity and funded by HomeStretch Furniture. Belden native Noah Barbieri, a Millsaps College junior, was named a Truman Scholar and will receive $30,000 toward graduate school.

Ruston (4-0) traveled to Stephenville (5-0) for a matchup of top-ranked Louisiana and Texas high school football teams. After both teams opened with three-and-outs, Ruston fumbled on its second drive. Stephenville’s Trot Jordan then threw a 19-yard touchdown pass to Jhett Banuelos, and the extra point was good. Ruston won last year’s meeting 63-17.

The speaker says losing a long, hard-fought finals game was difficult, but the team must regroup for the next game. Both goalies played well, and the opponent scored only once in six periods. The team plans to adjust its play, draw on past experience bouncing back and avoid dwelling on missed opportunities.

The Supreme Court’s October 2025 term will address major questions about presidential power, voting rights, civil liberties and criminal procedure. Scheduled cases concern Trump’s authority to impose tariffs and fire agency heads; the administration has also asked the court to review its restrictions on birthright citizenship. The justices will reconsider a Louisiana redistricting dispute that could affect the Voting Rights Act’s disparate-impact protections. Other cases involve Colorado’s conversion-therapy ban, transgender athletes’ participation in sports, and the standard for police entry into a home during a suspected emergency.

DHS has proposed replacing “duration of status,” which lets international students remain in the U.S. until they complete their studies, with a four-year limit and an option to request an extension. The rule would also bar students from changing majors or transferring institutions. DHS says it aims to reduce visa overstays, but commenters argued that students are already monitored and that many degrees and research projects take longer than four years. Universities, hospitals and employers warned of costly extensions and potential disruptions to research, medical training and health care. A small number of comments supported the change. DHS must review more than 15,700 comments before deciding whether to proceed.

A qualitative study interviewed 16 early childhood teachers in Ankara—eight bilingual teachers at private preschools and eight monolingual teachers at state preschools—about bilingualism and bilingual education. All viewed bilingualism as beneficial and supported expanding bilingual schools in Türkiye, though they differed on the needs and experiences of bilingual children. Teachers reported limited knowledge of bilingual education programs and identified shortages of qualified staff and resources. The study recommends teacher training, stronger curricula and parental support, while noting that its small, Ankara-only sample limits the reach of its findings.

AI is raising unresolved questions in drug patent law, including whether it can be named as an inventor and how predictive technology affects what a person skilled in the field would consider obvious. Biotech patent lawyer DeAnn Smith expects future litigation to address these issues.

This review examines biomarkers for earlier lung cancer detection, noting that late diagnosis contributes to high mortality. It identifies circulating tumor DNA (80% sensitivity, 96% specificity) and Ga-Alfatide II PET/CT scans (approximately 85% for both) as promising screening approaches for patients suspected of having lung cancer or at high risk. Other biomarkers show limitations, including low specificity or sensitivity. The authors call for further research and acknowledge that their review was limited to recent U.S. publications.

A comparison of three surveys of primary care physicians found consistent concerns about electronic health records, particularly limited interoperability and time spent documenting care. However, responses differed significantly on many measures, as did respondent characteristics and survey response rates. Some differences persisted within comparable subgroups. The authors suggest that recertification surveys could supplement the National Electronic Health Records Survey, while noting that the compared recertification data covered only family physicians.

In a randomised trial involving 365 people with mild dementia or mild cognitive impairment, a tailored, year-long exercise and functional rehabilitation programme did not improve daily functioning, physical activity, quality of life or most other health outcomes compared with falls-prevention advice. Participants and therapists received the programme well, but a possible reduction in falls was statistically uncertain. The authors suggest that support after diagnosis should focus less on restoring independence and more on helping people live well with dementia.

On August 17, Russian cosmonauts Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy will conduct a spacewalk outside the ISS. They plan to deploy five nanosatellites, collect residue samples, and install handrails and struts. NASA will broadcast the event live.

The court granted Garlock’s summary judgment motion and dismissed Steven Gittens’s ADA disability-discrimination complaint with prejudice. Gittens did not respond to the motion despite an extension and warnings, supporting dismissal for failure to prosecute and obey court orders. The court also found that his 25–30-pound lifting restriction did not establish a disability under the ADA: he remained employed in other positions and had not shown a substantial limitation on working generally. The court found no evidence that Garlock’s stated reasons for reassigning him were pretextual.

The Pocatello-Chubbuck School District will use three public focus groups to gather input on proposed high school boundaries after trustees delayed a decision for more feedback. Enrollment and socioeconomic disparities among its three schools prompted the district to end its two-decade policy allowing students to choose their high school.

The bankruptcy court confirmed the Smiths’ amended Chapter 13 plan with modifications, finding that its different treatment of Chrysler and NBD Bank was justified and that the debtors had acted in good faith. The court reduced interest on Chrysler’s claim from 8% to the 3.9% contract rate and increased monthly plan payments by $75. The debtors must report earnings every six months, devote excess overtime income and any net cash profit-sharing distributions to the plan, and stop voluntary retirement contributions during the plan. Deferred benefits in Mrs. Smith’s ERISA-qualified profit-sharing plan are not disposable income.

Stenabolic (SR9009) is described as an oral synthetic Rev-Erb ligand, not a SARM. The passage claims it affects metabolism, circadian rhythms and muscle mitochondria, potentially increasing endurance and reducing fat storage. It reports that mice given SR9009 ran 50% farther and longer, and cites reductions in several blood markers and an inflammatory cytokine.

The passage calls for swift, lawful punishment instead of lynching and argues that public education, including industrial training, benefits Black students and their communities. It warns that inflammatory speech can encourage mobs and deepen racial hostility. On labor and capital, it condemns both agitation that stirs class hatred and wealthy people who exploit others, urging steady, fair-minded reform instead.

At a Linux Foundation summit, executive director Jim Zemlin highlighted Linux’s widespread use and the value of foundation projects. Hart joined as a Gold member, while the foundation released a free open-source software publication and the Cloud Native Computing Foundation announced 11 new members.

The author questions Snap’s short-term investment value, citing competition from Instagram and Skype, declining app downloads, limited marketer adoption, and quarterly results below expectations. A lock-up expiration could make 1.2 billion shares available for sale and put pressure on the stock. The author expects volatility but notes that shorting also carries risks, and makes no trade recommendation.

The passage contains a blank United States passport application, oath of allegiance, supporting affidavits, and passport form. It then presents a May 1902 dispatch from Buenos Aires summarizing Argentine President Julio A. Roca’s message to Congress. The dispatch says the message gave few details about British-mediated negotiations to limit Argentine and Chilean armaments. It describes costly military expansion in both countries as damaging their credit and economic activity, worsening deficits, and raising the prospect of further taxation.

Safety outcomes were similar across study groups at 24 and 48 weeks. Adverse events and bleeding occurred in all groups, including three fatal bleeding events. Overall, 24 deaths were reported, and no pregnancies were reported. The AEGEAN study found high adherence and persistence with apixaban through 48 weeks; the additional educational program provided no further benefit.

A report linked South Korea’s falling birthrate with rising education levels among married women. Fertility dropped from 2.1 in 1984 to 1.6 in 1987 and stood at 1.24 in 2015. The report also found that married women’s labor-force participation rose from 39 percent in 1974 to 53 percent in 2012.

The “Single/Double” offense attacks a Triangle & Two defense by using screens to free shooters from pass-denying chasers. Shooters coordinate single and double screens and can reverse direction when defenders overplay them. Base and side screens create options for shots, post-ups, rolls and passes when defenders help or rotate. Effective execution requires communication, timing, defensive recognition and practiced screening. The passage also recommends scouting defensive tendencies, varying entries and alignments, and targeting weaker defenders.
Newly analyzed microstructures help dandelion seeds either lift off or hold on for a better breeze, explaining why a puff from one direction may not dislodge every seed.

A study of 114 primary teachers in Attica, Greece, used questionnaires and 27 interviews to examine views on STEM education after its introduction into compulsory schooling. Teachers generally valued STEM for connecting learning to everyday life, encouraging inquiry and collaboration, and offering more students opportunities to participate. However, they reported that students rarely practiced STEM skills in class, despite considering those skills important. Teachers cited insufficient training, materials, equipment and time, and requested practical guidance and support. The study’s limited, convenience sample does not support broad generalizations.

The goalie described stopping a breakaway with an initial save and a follow-up he likened to a soccer goalie save. He said timely saves build confidence, though he was dissatisfied with his play in the first two games of the finals. He also spoke about his long connection to Nashville and the excitement of its crowds.

During construction of Amsterdam’s new subway line, archaeologists excavated about 700,000 discarded objects from the Amstel riverbed, ranging from Neolithic stone axes to cellphones. The finds offer a record of everyday life along the river over centuries. The “Below the Surface” project will display 10,000 objects at Rokin station and provides photographs and data for about 30,000 online. It also produced a book-catalog distributed to the city’s schools.

The passage outlines a statistical analysis plan for a trial comparing dasiglucagon 0.6 mg with placebo, with GlucaGen® comparisons used as supportive analyses. The primary endpoint is time to a ≥20 mg/dL increase in plasma glucose within 45 minutes without rescue IV glucose. Primary and secondary efficacy endpoints will be tested hierarchically in the full analysis set, adjusting or stratifying by age group and injection site as specified. Sensitivity analyses will examine alternative handling of rescue glucose; missing efficacy data will not be imputed.

The plan also specifies analyses of glucose recovery rates and changes, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic measurements, and safety outcomes including adverse events, laboratory results, ECG findings, and immunogenicity. Concomitant medications will be coded using WHODrug. Appendices provide reporting formats, planned tables and listings, and SAS quality-control requirements.

The lecture develops tools for proving Freiman’s theorem. Ruzsa’s modeling lemma places a large subset of a small-doubling set in a small cyclic group. Bogolyubov’s lemma then shows that, for a dense set \(A\), \(2A-2A\) contains a bounded-codimension subspace over \(\mathbb F_2\), or a low-dimensional Bohr set in a cyclic group. The proofs use Fourier analysis and the smoothing effect of repeated addition. Finally, Minkowski’s second theorem is used to show that a Bohr set contains a large proper generalized arithmetic progression. A later lecture will address how to extend this structure to cover the original set.

The passage describes NVIDIA A100 improvements to Tensor Core efficiency, data movement, memory bandwidth, caching and compression. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 and fault-handling features support communication and reliability. CUDA 11 adds support for features including task graphs, asynchronous copies and barriers, and L2 cache residency controls. The passage also covers hardware for JPEG and video decoding, optical flow, and faster atomic operations. DGX A100 combines eight A100 GPUs with NVSwitch for scalable AI workloads. An appendix explains neural-network pruning and the fine-grained structured sparsity supported by A100.

The study developed and tested an online social inclusion questionnaire for mental health supported accommodation. Staff and service users generally found it easy to use and potentially helpful for care planning and discussion. During five months of testing in one London borough, 30 assessments were completed with 28 service users, about 10% of those eligible. No assessments were completed in two areas without implementation support. The study did not establish whether using the tool improves social inclusion or care outcomes.

Japanese universities made limited use of educational ICT before COVID-19, but the pandemic forced a rapid shift to remote classes. MEXT temporarily relaxed limits on remote-learning credits, supported digitalization projects, and later encouraged a return to face-to-face teaching. Instructors adopted online and hybrid formats while facing difficulties with interaction, practical teaching, and assessing students’ understanding. Online assignments increased study time outside class, but also increased students’ workload; broader issues with the credit system remain. Digitalization has expanded lifelong-learning opportunities unevenly across degree and non-degree programs. The passage calls for changes to educational practices and systems alongside technological improvements, while protecting students’ personal information.

In a farewell to Cabinet and White House staff, the President thanks them for their dedicated service and asks them to serve the next President as faithfully. He praises their integrity, saying no one in his administration profited at public expense, and describes government service as a cause more important than money. Recalling Theodore Roosevelt’s perseverance after loss, he urges them to keep serving, give their best, resist discouragement and hatred, and take pride in their work.

The ScottishPower Foundation has donated £95,220 to Sussex Wildlife Trust for Woods Mill’s 50th anniversary. The funding will enable 1,300 more people to attend events, support wildlife identification courses, train 250 wildlife champions and establish a young naturalists club. It will also fund habitat and path improvements and has provided a camera for a kestrel nesting box.

Dalhousie researcher Nancy McLean says native bees are abundant in P.E.I. blueberry fields and may make imported honey bees unnecessary. She is studying plants that could support native bees around fields. Bringing in honey bees is costly, and imported bees can carry parasites.

Steven Kean forwarded Jeffrey McMahon a collection of Enron mentions and congratulated him on stirring debate in the steel industry. The articles report Wisconsin Gas’s planned purchase of a pipeline from Enron subsidiary Northern Natural Gas; unconfirmed speculation about Enron’s role in rising copper stocks; Enron’s sale of its Paladin Resources stake; and its stated intention to trade new coal futures. The final article examines Enron’s proposed steel forward contracts and hedging products. Steel executives and distributors expressed mixed views, citing potential price protection alongside concerns about pricing, inventory control and delivery.

Michael Dell says demand for AI computing infrastructure remains strong, with customers deploying equipment as soon as they receive it. He says access to power, not excess capacity, is limiting some data-center projects. Dell Technologies raised its growth forecasts, though market observers warn that AI-related stock valuations may be stretched. Dell expects overbuilding eventually but sees no sign of it yet.

Siddharth Agrawal has worked for 18 years in his family’s garment and home textile export business, Silkasia. He researches native Indian cattle, invests in rooftop farming and start-ups, and mentors new ventures. With his wife, Vrinda, he created the women’s clothing brand Mayori. He is president of TiE Rajasthan.

Vladimir Putin was declared the winner of Russia’s presidential election with more than three-quarters of the vote, securing another six-year term. Critics called the result predetermined, while the opposition reported pressure on government employees to vote, ballot stuffing and harassment of election monitors. Putin portrayed Russia as resilient despite Western sanctions and described criticism from abroad as part of an anti-Russian campaign. Opposition figures Alexei Navalny and Ksenia Sobchak remained divided. Asked whether he would change the constitution, Putin said he had no plans to do so yet.

The document standardizes the 4 KB Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) for communication between SEV-ES or SEV-SNP guests and hypervisors while limiting exposed guest state. It defines protocol negotiation, hypervisor feature advertisement, GHCB address registration, and handling of non-automatic exits through VMGEXIT. Version 2 adds initial SEV-SNP support; later revisions add features including multiple VMPL levels, trusted I/O, and Secure AVIC. The document also specifies procedures for page-state changes, guest requests, AP booting, and interrupt handling. For SEV-SNP guests using Restricted Injection, a shared doorbell page carries interrupt and non-maskable event notifications.

The Dark Cloud Cover is a two-candle bearish reversal pattern that appears after a price upswing. A bearish candle opens above the previous bullish candle’s close but closes below its midpoint, signaling a possible shift toward bearishness. Traders may use it to consider short sales or closing long positions, particularly during rallies in down-trending markets. It does not guarantee a reversal, so the passage recommends checking subsequent price action, technical indicators, and market conditions, while using risk management. Timeframe choice depends on trading goals; shorter timeframes can produce more false signals.

Tesla Motors reported $936.8 million in revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2015, up from $851.8 million a year earlier, while its net loss widened to $229.9 million from $74.7 million. Gross margin fell to 24.7% from 29.6%. Tesla began Model X deliveries and Tesla Energy product production during the quarter, alongside continued Model S sales. For the first nine months of 2015, operating activities used $494.7 million in cash, and capital expenditures totaled $1.2 billion. Tesla raised approximately $738.3 million net through an August stock offering. The company cited Model X production and supplier constraints as uncertainties in its forecast of 50,000 to 52,000 vehicle deliveries for 2015.

Using roughly 1,000 days of Swift observations, the study examines changes in Fairall 9’s spectral energy distribution and the timing relationship between its ultraviolet and X-ray emission. The optical/UV emission increased substantially, while total coronal X-ray power changed little and its spectrum softened. Fourier analysis found changing lags and coherence, including a low-frequency interval when ultraviolet emission led X-rays. The authors favour an increase in mass-accretion rate accompanied by changes in the inner accretion flow, although their timing model does not rule out stochastic variation within an unchanged system.

A collection of November 2001 articles reports on Enron’s proposed sale to Dynegy after its stock plunged and accounting disclosures prompted a federal investigation. Investors sought clarity on Enron’s debts and partnership liabilities, while employees and pension funds faced losses. Other reports describe financing secured by Enron’s pipelines, potential buyers for its Wessex Water unit, and broader stock-market and investing news.
Alabama voters face a Senate special election between Democrat Doug Jones and Republican Roy Moore, who leads many polls despite sexual misconduct allegations he denies.

Apple reported $78.4 billion in net sales for the quarter ended December 31, 2016, up 3% from a year earlier. Net income fell to $17.9 billion from $18.4 billion, while diluted earnings per share rose to $3.36 from $3.28. iPhone and Services sales increased; iPad sales declined. Sales fell 12% in Greater China but rose in the other geographic segments. Gross margin declined from 40.1% to 38.5%.

Apple generated $27.1 billion in operating cash flow and held $246.1 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at quarter-end. It spent $10.9 billion on share repurchases and $3.1 billion on dividends and dividend equivalents. Apple and Ireland appealed a European Commission decision concerning Irish taxes.

Manny has remained involved with the team during his injury, contributing leadership on and off the ice. His return would be an emotional boost. The speaker also says close teammates can tell him and another person apart more easily than coaches can.

Thousands of Armenian-Americans marched in Los Angeles to commemorate an estimated 1.5 million Armenians who died under the Ottoman Empire starting in 1915. They urged Turkey to recognize the deaths as genocide; Turkey attributes them to civil war and unrest. The marches followed Armenian Prime Minister Serzh Sargsyan’s resignation after anti-government protests.
The speaker says joking about missed shots helps keep the team relaxed. Facing elimination, they are focused on winning one game at a time.

The Jonathan Hunt Chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution honored eight high school Good Citizens for their essays and citizenship qualities. Five attended the tea; the overall winner received a monetary award.

Jane Goodall, a pioneering chimpanzee researcher and conservationist, died of natural causes in her sleep while on tour in California. She was 91. Beginning fieldwork at Gombe in 1960, she documented chimpanzees making and using tools and engaging in warfare, challenging prevailing views of animal behavior. She founded the Jane Goodall Institute in 1977, launched its Roots & Shoots youth program in 1991, and advocated for wildlife protection and better conditions for laboratory chimpanzees.

The paper analyzes South Australia’s 2018 “World Class” public education policy using Bacchi’s policy-analysis framework and departmental documents. It argues that the McKinsey-inspired plan defined improvement through standardized test results and a target on McKinsey’s Universal Scale. School rankings, centrally prescribed priorities and increased oversight reduced principals’ autonomy, particularly in lower-performing schools, while sidelining equity and broader educational purposes. The authors report that reading performance declined and the achievement gap widened during the policy’s first four years. They propose a more democratic approach that values educators’ professional knowledge, responds to local needs and prioritizes equity and inclusion.

The study identifies Mn5Al8 as a distortive polar metal that transforms from a cubic to a polar rhombohedral structure near 880°C. The transformation produces herringbone domains with head-to-head and tail-to-tail boundaries. Electron microscopy and surface measurements show that copper deposition and oxidation vary between boundary types. The authors suggest that polar discontinuities may alter local free-carrier concentrations, although the mechanism remains unclear. A database survey identified at least 134 compounds made solely of metallic elements in polar crystal classes, approximately 20% of which undergo symmetry-reducing transitions.

Argentine defender Federico Allende admitted using a needle against Estudiantes strikers during Sport Pacifico’s 3-2 cup upset. Colombian striker Juan Otero said he was jabbed repeatedly and complained to the referee. Pacifico president Hector Moncada vowed to expel Allende.

STAT’s D.C. Diagnosis is a twice-weekly newsletter on health and medicine policy by Washington correspondent John Wilkerson. The passage highlights a potential government shutdown, Democrats’ focus on ACA tax credits, and other health and biotech headlines.

In July 1889, an uprising led by Robert W. Wilcox and Robert Boyd was defeated. U.S. sailors and marines briefly landed to protect life and property. Hawaii’s supreme court then ruled against the King in a dispute over cabinet authority. Hawaii’s delegate missed the 1890 International American Conference because it adjourned before he could present his credentials. King Kalakaua died in January 1891, and Liliuokalani became Queen. After initial concerns over her cabinet, a court ruling led to a new cabinet that appeared to ease apprehensions. Hawaii later sought to revise its reciprocity treaty with the United States after the sugar tariff was removed.

Churchill High School senior Deanthony Gordley earned his diploma after losing both parents and spending about seven months homeless. NEISD connected him with the McKinney Vento Homeless Project, and local families also helped him. Gordley hopes his achievement encourages others to keep going. He shares his experiences through music.

Stripe is launching Open Issuance, a product that lets businesses create and manage interoperable stablecoins and earn yield on their reserves. The launch follows its $1.1 billion acquisition of Bridge and new U.S. stablecoin legislation. Its announced users—Phantom, Hyperliquid, and MetaMask—are all crypto firms; Stripe says broader adoption by other businesses remains uncertain.

Jalen Carey’s commitment gives Syracuse’s 2018 basketball class two Top 50 recruits alongside Darius Bazley, plus Buddy Boeheim. The passage calls it potentially Syracuse’s best class in at least seven years.

A randomized trial of 25 frontline physicians and nurses with depression and burnout compared eight weeks of mindfulness-based stress reduction (MBSR) alone with MBSR plus group psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy. The combined treatment produced a greater reduction in depressive symptoms two weeks after treatment, alongside improvements in some burnout measures, demoralization and connectedness. No serious adverse events or emergent suicidality occurred. By six months, the difference in depression scores was not significant. The small, predominantly white female sample and unblinded design limit the findings; larger controlled studies are needed.
Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi won the 2025 chemistry Nobel for metal-organic frameworks that trap water, gases and other chemicals.

The 3-2 zone moves the point defender to the free-throw line, allowing wider wing defenders to deny passes while protecting the high post. It can leave the point guard open for outside shots; against a strong shooter, it can shift to a 1-2-2 or 1-3-1 zone. Defenders adjust their positions as the ball moves to a wing or corner. A tall, athletic wing can interchange with the point defender, and the alignment supports fast breaks.

Stock trading strategies use rules to buy and sell stocks or ETFs, generally seeking to profit from shorter-term price movements rather than the long-term growth targeted by buy-and-hold investing. The passage describes approaches including day trading, swing trading, momentum, trend following, arbitrage, mean reversion, and event-driven trading. It emphasizes research, quantified rules, backtesting, discipline, and accounting for trading costs. Algorithms can automate trades, while diversification can help manage risk. The passage cautions that trading only one stock concentrates risk, even though some traders do it to develop familiarity with that stock.

A May 2001 roundup of Enron mentions covers several energy disputes. California universities prepared for possible exam-time blackouts while contesting Enron Energy Services’ early termination of an electricity contract. In India, Dabhol Power Company and Maharashtra officials began talks over power prices and unpaid bills; the state utility said it could not buy an additional 15% stake. Reports also said Enron planned to leave a Gulf gas pipeline project. In Oregon, Representative Peter DeFazio proposed state ownership of Enron’s Portland General Electric, drawing a mixed response.

Cierra Dillard scored 22 points as 11th-seeded Buffalo beat No. 3 Florida State 86-65, reaching the women’s NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 for the first time. Buffalo held Florida State to 33.8 percent shooting and will face defending champion South Carolina on Saturday.

Markets turned risk-off despite strong earnings. GDP exceeded forecasts, but tariff-related distortions complicated its interpretation, while weak consumer spending and disappointing payroll growth raised concerns about a slowing economy. The Fed held to a patient, data-dependent stance amid inflation and labor-market uncertainty. Major indexes fell, market breadth and volume weakened, and the article warned of a possible pullback.

Market Research Future forecasts approximately 4.5% growth in the global organic pigments market during the forecast period. Demand from paints and coatings, plastics, textiles, and printing inks drives the market. The report expects Asia-Pacific to be both the largest and fastest-growing region, with China contributing significantly. It examines market segments, regional forecasts, growth factors, pricing, and competition.

West Midlands house prices rose 7.1% in the year to December, adding about £12,000 to the average property value of £181,000. UK prices rose 7.2%, with England recording 7.7% growth. Within the West Midlands, rises ranged from 10.4% in Wyre Forest and Kidderminster to 3.1% in South Staffordshire. Economist Richard Snook expects house price growth to slow to between 2% and 6% in 2017.

The passage describes a grid-based storage system in which robotic devices retrieve containers stacked beneath rails. Its framework routes services such as power, communications, lighting and fluids to support monitoring and control within the system and, where needed, individual containers. Sensors can monitor structural conditions and detect fire or gas, while connectors or non-contact methods can supply containers with power and other services. The system may also use targeted fire suppression and partitions to isolate sections.

At Nahant’s April 29 Town Meeting, members will consider an ambulance enterprise fund that could support service through fees. The Finance Committee opposes it, citing uncertain benefits and no urgency. Selectman Richard Lombard also opposes it, while Enzo Barile and Chesley Taylor Jr. support it. Members will also consider reversing a 2008 decision on Coast Guard Housing and authorizing its sale; the Finance Committee recommends postponement. The committee supports funding for drainage repairs, public works trucks and pumping stations. The meeting has 41 articles.

UNMC College of Dentistry’s Children’s Dental Day provides free dental care and oral-health education to 159–200 Nebraska children annually. Since 2001, the program has provided more than $3 million in dental work.

On February 8, 2018, NVIDIA issued a press release announcing results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 28, 2018. The Form 8-K includes the press release and commentary from CFO Colette M. Kress as exhibits; both are furnished rather than filed.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, simultaneous-sampling, 20-bit data acquisition system with up to 2MSPS per channel, or 8MSPS for one selected channel pair in speed-boost mode. It supports single-ended and differential bipolar inputs, programmable gain and bandwidth, ±18V input clamp protection, and internal or external voltage references. Configurable features include data averaging, output randomization, test patterns, and two- or four-lane SDR or DDR data output. A continuous sampling clock is required; synchronization supports sampling across multiple devices. Configuration uses SPI, including a daisy-chain option.

The passage reports that James Hodgkinson shot five people at a baseball game, injuring Republican Representative Steve Scalise, before dying after police intervened. It describes Hodgkinson’s anti-Trump views and support for Bernie Sanders. The author argues that hostile media portrayals of Trump may have contributed to the attack and calls for scrutiny of such coverage, while acknowledging that any influence on Hodgkinson is uncertain.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2021 reports net sales of $108.5 billion, up from $75.5 billion a year earlier. Net income rose from $2.5 billion to $8.1 billion, and operating income rose from $4.0 billion to $8.9 billion. Sales increased across North America, International, and AWS. Operating cash flow was $4.2 billion for the quarter. Amazon reported approximately $2.0 billion in COVID-19-related costs and projected second-quarter sales of $110 billion to $116 billion.

Mineral companies owe more than $42 million in delinquent taxes to 12 Wyoming counties, according to a Powder River Basin Resource Council report. Campbell County is owed more than $26 million, and Sheridan County about $7.46 million. The report links unpaid taxes mainly to bankruptcies; county tax debts have low repayment priority, and the payment schedule can delay collection by about 18 months. The shortfalls affect school funding and other public services. The council recommends monthly tax collection, continuing liens, state assistance during bankruptcies and tax-debt checks before asset transfers. Previous legislative proposals to improve collection have failed.

The passage emphasizes boxing out on every free throw, including the shooter, to prevent offensive rebounds. Defenders should step up the lane with feet together and hands raised, maintain inside position, and communicate. Against a strong rebounder, two defenders can box out together. Teams should also practice assignments for made and missed free throws, including an early push.

A Cherokee County community plans to honor school leader Maleka Johnson, who died in a tour boat explosion in the Bahamas while celebrating her 15th wedding anniversary. Her husband, Tiran, was critically injured. Their 12-year-old son was with family in Tennessee, where relatives are now supporting him.
The passage lists nine views of an under-sink organizer with a sliding storage basket. Broken lines show portions excluded from the claimed design.

The incoming president expresses gratitude for his election and acknowledges the responsibilities of office. He pledges to follow the Constitution, seek capable and honest officials, and serve the whole country rather than sectional interests. He calls for an efficient Army and Navy, neutrality in foreign disputes, friendly relations, and diplomacy before force. He plans to recommend measures supporting agriculture, commerce, manufacturing, infrastructure, debt reduction, and economical, accountable government, while recognizing Congress’s legislative authority. He urges conciliation and cooperation to preserve the Union.

US stock options generally expire on the third Friday of each month, or Thursday if Friday is a holiday. Backtests using SPY found above-average returns during options expiration week, though the article says that effect is not tradable on its own. Returns on expiration day itself were negative on average.

For the following week, the tested strategy buys the S&P 500 at the close of expiration Friday and sells at the next Friday’s close. Its returns were below those of an average week and varied by month: August averaged a 0.55% gain, while September averaged a 0.94% loss.

Votes are being counted Thursday in by-elections for four Lok Sabha and 10 Assembly seats. The closely watched Kairana contest pits the BJP against the RLD, backed by the BSP, SP and Congress. In Maharashtra, four major parties campaigned heavily for Palghar and Bhandara-Gondia.

After winning his third London Marathon title, Eliud Kipchoge visited Tottenham Hotspur with coach Patrick Sang and met Victor Wanyama and Mauricio Pochettino. Kipchoge was also crowned World Marathon Majors champion and is expected to attempt the world record in Berlin.

The speaker says their physical play and unusually effective shooting helped win the first game of the Stanley Cup Final, but expects the opponent and goalie Belfour to respond strongly. The team must start the next game ready, stay disciplined and physical, and capitalize on chances. A one-game lead is motivating but does not secure the series; losing the next game would surrender home-ice advantage. The speaker also praises Jason’s growing leadership and his line’s chemistry.

A retrospective study of 1,383 patients treated at a specialist hospital estimated noma incidence in northern Nigeria from 1999 to 2024 at 114.5 cases per 100,000 people. Incidence was highest among children under ten and in Sokoto state, while Kebbi had the highest incidence among young and middle-aged adults. Most patients with active noma presented with gangrene rather than earlier, reversible stages. The authors recommend greater awareness and early screening, while noting that hospital records lacked data from six eligible states or territories.

The lecture explains how companies calculate carbon footprints by combining activity data, such as electricity or fuel use, with emissions factors. It distinguishes direct emissions (scope one), emissions from purchased electricity (scope two), and other indirect emissions (scope three). Organizational boundaries determine which emissions a company reports; scope one and two are generally required under the discussed standard, while scope three is usually optional.

A chair-manufacturer case illustrates how ownership, joint ventures, outsourced transportation, and data limitations affect calculations. It also shows why corporate footprints can be misleading when comparing competitors with different operating models. The professor discusses disclosure decisions, data-quality challenges, and the value of tracking both total emissions and emissions per unit. The lecture closes by introducing value-chain and product-level assessments, which examine emissions beyond a company’s own facilities.

The passage describes a system for securely storing and sharing user data, particularly medical information, while limiting a server’s access to the data and its decryption keys. Client devices encrypt data using a key hierarchy in which password- or security-question-derived keys unlock a master key, which unlocks data encryption keys. Public-key encryption enables sharing with individual recipients; a separate shared-key hierarchy enables group access. Recipients can propose edits, but the data owner must accept them before the shared copy is updated. The passage also describes an option to send encrypted documents through a printer driver.

A study of 13 mathematics education faculty members at Turkish universities examined barriers to distance education after the 2023 earthquake using Q methodology. Their responses formed three perspectives focused on student-related, technology-related and pedagogical barriers; no distinct teacher-related perspective emerged. Participants cited limited student engagement, inadequate access to digital libraries and unreliable online assessment. They considered distance education alone unsuitable for mathematics education and favored combining it with face-to-face teaching.

Telstra boss Andy Penn faces pressure to present a path to improved earnings at the company’s investor day. Its share price has fallen following a forecast update and an S&P Global downgrade. Analysts expect a possible dividend cut in 2019, though recent commentary from UBS and Morgan Stanley has been more positive.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed Noe Martinez Paredes’s guilty-plea conviction and 57-month sentence for a methamphetamine and heroin distribution conspiracy. After independently reviewing the record, it found no arguable grounds for relief and granted his counsel’s motion to withdraw.

Researchers found two bacterial strains on grapevine leaves that degraded guaiacol, a compound associated with wildfire smoke taint in wine, until it was barely detectable after 96 hours. Deleting a gene identified by the researchers stopped one strain from consuming guaiacol. The strains did not grow on similar smoky compounds, so more research is needed before bacteria could address the other compounds that contribute to smoke taint.

Barbeque Nation Hospitality filed for an IPO comprising a Rs 200 crore fresh share issue and an offer for sale of 61.79 lakh shares. It plans to use fresh-issue proceeds for new restaurants in India, loan repayment and general corporate purposes. As of June 2017, it operated 81 restaurants in India and one in Dubai.

Six months after Abby Williams and Libby German were killed near Delphi’s Monon High Bridge, no arrests have been made. Indiana State Police say the case remains active, with investigators following more than 24,000 tips, analyzing crime-scene DNA and reviewing old evidence.

The Senate approved the proposed Philippine Identification System Act on Monday by a 17–2 vote. It would assign citizens and foreign residents a PhilSys number for use across government identification systems, with the Philippine Statistics Authority managing the registry. The bill includes privacy safeguards; P2 billion has been allotted for implementation.

Ajay Bodke of Prabhudas Lilladher says retail investors need not worry about the 10% long-term capital gains tax because equities can still deliver inflation-beating post-tax returns. He expects corporate earnings to recover and sees a favorable medium-term outlook for Indian equities, though he says the RBI may struggle to maintain a neutral monetary stance. Bodke notes strong domestic investment through SIPs, considers equities more attractive than gold over longer periods, and identifies insurance and retail-focused private financial firms as promising sectors.

Montclair State University celebrated mascot Rocky the Red Hawk’s 16th birthday with free bagels, candy and a party in the Student Center Ballrooms. Students took photos with Rocky and received cupcakes and other gifts. The event also collected donations for a local food pantry and featured a speech from university president Susan Cole, cake and a prize raffle. Rocky ended the day by distributing leftover treats around campus.

This AMD Geode CS5535 revision A3 specification update lists silicon issues affecting interrupts, DMA, IDE/UDMA, ACPI power management, clocks, USB, UART, LPC, SMBus, GPIO, and other functions. Reported effects range from debug-only failures to corrupted data, missed interrupts, failed transfers, and system hangs. The document describes conditions, implications, and available workarounds, including changing access sizes or operation order, disabling clock gating, avoiding certain DMA modes, and adjusting delay settings. Some issues have no resolution.

Police bodycam footage shows officers arresting 20-year-old Emily Weinman on a New Jersey beach after she passed a breathalyzer test but refused to give her last name during questioning about alcohol. An officer said he slammed her to the ground after she tried to kick police, though the alleged kick is not visible in the footage. Weinman accused officers of hitting and choking her. The officers were reassigned to desk duty pending an investigation, and Weinman faces several charges.

A Legislative Analyst’s Office report says Gov. Jerry Brown’s proposed 5 percent raise for 27,000 correctional union employees has a weak justification because the state shows no apparent recruitment or retention problems. Union members and the Legislature must approve the one-year contract. The administration estimates it would cost $338 million over two years, but the analyst warns that overtime and pension contributions could raise the cost.

The study compared interdisciplinary research in highly impactful medical journals—those in the top 10% of medical journal rankings—with other journals. It used networks of disease-related concepts indexed in PubMed articles from 1999, 2010 and 2022, adjusting for differences in sample size. Less impactful journals showed stronger integration between medical concepts, while impactful journals showed more distinct knowledge clusters. Cancer-related research played a prominent role in connecting distant topics. Differences between the journal groups clustered around particular topics, but those topics changed over time. Both groups shared a stable core of closely connected medical concepts.

A new study concludes that a mass grave beside St. Wystan’s church in Repton contains more than 250 members of the Viking Great Heathen Army, buried in the winter of 874. Earlier carbon dating had suggested the bones were too old, but researchers found that the Vikings’ seafood-rich diet had skewed the results. Corrected dates match the recorded invasion. The site also contains a furnished double grave and four burials that researchers suggest may have been child sacrifices.

Police expanded a nationwide search and offered a $50,000 reward for Steve Stephens, accused of posting a Facebook video of himself fatally shooting 74-year-old Robert Godwin Sr. in Cleveland. Godwin appeared to have been chosen at random while collecting cans on Easter Sunday. Stephens blamed a former girlfriend and spoke of gambling problems, but police said they did not know what prompted the killing. His cellphone was last detected Sunday near Erie, Pennsylvania. Investigators said Godwin was the only victim linked to Stephens, despite his claim to have killed others. Family and community members gathered Monday to remember Godwin.

Camp America offers people over 18 the chance to work at summer camps across the United States and travel afterward. Applicants do not need specific qualifications, though coaching, horse-riding and lifeguarding skills are valued. The programme recommends applying early and holds UK recruitment fairs in January and February. One former worker described busy days of children’s activities and said the job was fast-paced. The £599 package includes fees, medical insurance, return flights and 30 days for travel; participants also receive $650–$1,200 in pocket money.
Agriculture-related shares rose by up to 13% on Wednesday after the government raised paddy’s minimum support price by Rs 200 per quintal and approved prices for 14 kharif crops.

Researchers at Aarhus University found that concentrating milk on farms using reverse osmosis did not worsen bacterial counts, free fatty acid levels or protein breakdown. Milk powder made from concentrated milk had the same quality and durability as powder made from ordinary milk, though concentrated milk took about ten minutes longer to coagulate for cheese. On-farm concentration could reduce water transport, but its profitability depends on factors including herd size, distance to the dairy, energy use and equipment costs.

Nested virtualization is unsupported under SEV-ES and SEV-SNP. SNP isolation restricts host interrupt injection to a #HV doorbell. The document defines common OS notification information while leaving driver-specific communication flexible.

Assistant U.S. Attorney Will Rosenzweig was fired by email while observing Rosh Hashanah, after conservatives publicized blog posts attributed to him that criticized President Trump. Rosenzweig is among several federal prosecutors dismissed by the Justice Department; three others in South Florida had worked with former special counsel Jack Smith.

The lecture compares plasma models used to interpret spectra. Complete thermodynamic equilibrium is rare; local thermodynamic equilibrium uses collisional balance, coronal equilibrium uses collisional excitation and radiative decay, and non-local thermodynamic equilibrium requires modeling the relevant processes. Predicting a spectrum involves calculating ionization and excited-state populations, transition strengths, radiation transport when needed, and detector response. Ratios of strong, isolated spectral lines can help estimate temperature.

The lecture also explains characteristic X-ray lines, including K-shell transitions, and how absorption edges allow materials to filter selected X-ray energies. X-ray images can be made with inexpensive pinholes, whose resolution is limited by geometric blur and diffraction, or with bent crystals that focus selected wavelengths. Film and reusable image plates record time-integrated images; gated cameras capture short intervals, while streak cameras record position over time.

In a note to the U.S. government, the British Foreign Secretary agrees with President Wilson’s desire for a lasting peace but argues that its durability depends on its terms. He says the Allies’ proposed territorial changes would better reflect national aspirations and that ending Turkish rule over other peoples would serve peace. Territorial changes alone, however, would not prevent another war if Germany retained its militarized political system and capacity for surprise attack. He argues that treaties cannot adequately protect states while Germany remains willing to violate them.

CompareCards lists credit cards from its partners with introductory 0% APR offers, typically lasting 12 to 18 months, alongside cash-back, travel-reward and sign-up bonuses. The offers differ in whether the introductory rate covers purchases, balance transfers or both; balance-transfer fees and higher variable APRs may apply afterward. The passage advises reviewing each card’s terms before applying and says compensation from listed companies does not influence its ratings or reviews.

The author compares choosing a content marketing partner to dating. She recommends finding someone whose approach aligns with yours, comparing several candidates, checking references and results, defining your needs, and starting with a trial period. The right partner should make your work easier and be enjoyable to work with.
A thermal alarm puts the system in Faulted Standby and removes power. The PMC cannot detect the alarm in Standby; after a delay, the system powers up and returns to Standby if the alarm persists.

New York Attorney General Schneiderman announced the arrests of Guilderland Town Judge Richard Sherwood and financial advisor Thomas Lagan. They allegedly stole $4 million from family trusts they oversaw and face felony charges of grand larceny, fraud and criminal possession of stolen property.

The article argues that mining stocks’ weak response to gold’s rally signals a potential decline in precious metals. It says the U.S. Dollar Index is testing a bullish breakout while stocks show bearish signals, drawing a comparison with 2008. A reader comment disputes the technical analysis. The page also includes advertisements and trading-risk disclosures.

A play-action pass is designed to look like a run but is always a pass. The quarterback fakes a handoff while the offense sells the run, drawing defenders toward the line of scrimmage and creating space for receivers. It can be especially effective after a team establishes its running game or in short-yardage and goal-line situations where a run is expected. Double Post and Bubble Y Over are examples of play-action pass concepts. Unlike play action, a run-pass option allows the quarterback to choose a run or pass after the snap.

The Federal Circuit affirmed a $250,000 Public Safety Officers’ Benefits Act award to the estate of Christine Roberts, whose son died in the line of duty. Roberts filed a claim but died before the government paid it. The majority held that eligibility is determined when the officer dies, so her later death did not extinguish her entitlement. The dissent argued that the statute does not clearly authorize payment to estates and would have deferred to the agency’s rule limiting payment to living recipients.

Jaroslaw Buczkowski pleaded guilty to drink-driving after police stopped him for driving up to 70mph in Boston’s 40mph zones on New Year’s Day. His breath-alcohol reading was 83 microgrammes, more than twice the legal limit. He received a 20-month driving ban, a £350 fine and £120 in costs and charges.

Resolute Marine Energy (RME) developed Wave O™, a prototype system intended to use ocean waves to desalinate seawater for communities with costly water and weak electric grids. RME planned a pilot with South Africa’s Ugu municipality, where about 61,000 households lacked safe drinking water, but needed $6 million to complete testing and the pilot.

RME had to choose among three approaches: generate electricity for a desalination plant, use hydraulic power to produce water, or develop an integrated system producing both water and electricity. Each involved different funding, technical, pricing, and partnership trade-offs. RME was also exploring wave-generated electricity for remote Alaskan communities, raising questions about whether the small company should pursue both markets.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on October 25, 2022, announcing that it had issued a press release with financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2022. The release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed under Section 18 of the Exchange Act.

In the AEGEAN study of people starting apixaban for atrial fibrillation, drug-taking compliance exceeded 94% across groups at measured visits. Mean adherence at 24 weeks was about 92% in both the standard-care and additional-education groups, with no significant difference; adherence declined over time but remained comparable across groups at 48 weeks. Persistence was about 91% at 24 weeks and 85%–88% at 48 weeks, without significant group differences. Safety outcomes were generally similar across groups. The additional educational program did not improve adherence or persistence.

Jeff Smith joined KBC Networks in March 2018 as Midwestern regional sales manager. He will support system integrators and distributors across the region. He brings nearly three decades of security sales and system integration experience, including roles at American FiberTek, Alarm Detection Systems and Convergent Technologies.

The passage argues that digital startups in Indonesia need strong business models and financial management to compete and remain viable. Using interviews and observations involving 120 respondents, the study applies a canvas model to identify customers, value propositions, channels, relationships, revenue, resources, activities, partnerships and costs. It also outlines steps for developing a lean canvas and presents “Beautiful Memories,” a startup model connecting customers with photographers, video editors, decorators and souvenir providers.

The speaker says rest and team depth have helped during the playoffs. Defending Sidney Crosby requires all five players on the ice, with forwards contributing defensively. Pittsburgh’s speed makes it dangerous throughout games; despite giving up some odd-man rushes, the team benefited from strong saves by Pekks.

Apple shares fell 6% on June 9 and 12, 2017, and were lagging the S&P 500 as the index reached new highs. Unlike during Apple’s 2012 correction, forward earnings estimates had not deteriorated: fiscal 2017–2019 consensus EPS estimates had risen since May 31, while revenue estimates had slipped slightly. The author notes that Apple’s earlier major corrections reached 45% and 37%, and that its total return since February 2015 trailed the SPY’s. Despite describing Apple’s valuation as reasonable, the author is concerned about the stalled breakout, high expectations for the next iPhone release, and the possibility of further relative underperformance.

The US Department of Transportation has proposed barring seven Chinese passenger airlines from using Russian airspace on flights to and from the US. It says the change would address an advantage over US airlines, which must avoid Russia because of sanctions. Flight tracking data identified two potentially affected routes, both from New York; rerouting them could add hours of flight time and fuel costs. China’s foreign ministry said the ban would hinder travel and exchanges.

Steven Ma credits former geometry teacher Linda Brandt with helping him recognize his potential after he struggled in school. Now CEO of Thinktank Learning, he is offering Lodi High School students two $15,000 scholarships in her name. Brandt said the scholarships could help students whose finances might otherwise prevent them from attending college.

Colombian police say kidnappings have fallen 92% since 2000, with 188 people abducted in 2016. Police attributed the decline to improved security and a peace deal with the Farc, which they said carried out no kidnappings that year. Most 2016 abductions were attributed to common criminals. Peace talks with the ELN were delayed over its refusal to release a hostage before negotiations.

CoSn₂ shows a change in resistivity below 25 K without corresponding specific-heat or magnetic anomalies. X-ray diffraction reveals weak superlattice reflections and a small distortion that lowers its tetragonal symmetry to monoclinic. Angle-dependent magnetoresistance changes from nearly fourfold to twofold symmetry on cooling. Calculations suggest a possible electronic instability, while polarization-dependent ARPES shows orbital-selective anisotropy suggestive of nematic behavior; its origin remains unconfirmed. ARPES and calculations also identify band crossings associated with a nodal loop.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2022 reports quarterly revenue of $16.93 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.26 billion, up from $11.96 billion and $1.14 billion a year earlier. At June 30, Tesla had $68.51 billion in assets and $18.32 billion in cash and cash equivalents. Operating cash flow for the first six months of 2022 was $6.35 billion. The filing discusses supply-chain disruptions, inflation, digital-asset impairments, debt, compensation awards, commitments and ongoing litigation.

The passage describes a causal Bayesian network designed to support clinical diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). It distinguishes suspected disease from formal diagnosis and estimates probabilities using risk factors, symptoms, cognitive and biomarker tests, and other causes of cognitive impairment. Its structure follows medical reasoning patterns; its parameters draw on published research, clinical judgment, and a US Alzheimer’s dataset. Example scenarios show how probabilities change when symptoms, test results, or alternative conditions are entered. The authors present the model as a complement to clinician evaluation, not a replacement. Key limitations include grouping distinct non-AD conditions together, biases in the dataset, and uncertain estimates of misdiagnosed or undiagnosed cases. The preprint has not been peer reviewed and should not guide clinical practice.

Pennsylvania regulators approved a permit for the Meadville Area Water Authority to install water fluoridation equipment, but it cannot add fluoride until it receives a separate operations permit. The system has been designed, and the authority may discuss bids and construction timing at its July 18 meeting. No completion timeline has been set.

This May 24, 2001, collection covers energy and business developments involving Enron. California regulators reported evidence that generators varied plant output to increase electricity prices, while the companies cited business reasons for changing output. Brazil sought major cuts in electricity use to avoid blackouts. India appointed a federal representative to negotiations over Enron’s Dabhol power dispute; panel chair Madhav Godbole briefly resigned after criticism but agreed to continue. Other reports examine the potential industry effects of a shift in U.S. Senate control, Central European gas markets, Endesa’s planned asset sale and Dynegy’s interest in acquisitions.

Toronto Const. Ken Lam arrested Alek Minassian after a van attack that killed 10 people and injured 15. Video shows Lam confronting the suspect, who pointed a black object at him and claimed to have a gun. Lam did not fire; he used a baton and handcuffed Minassian. Police said there was no evidence Minassian was armed. He was charged with 10 counts of first-degree murder and 13 counts of attempted murder. Police leaders and experts praised Lam’s restraint and training.

Susan Ann Vansickle sued road overseer Brown for malicious prosecution after he caused her arrest for obstructing a highway; the criminal case was later dropped. The court upheld the exclusion of evidence about the arresting officer’s conduct, a later trespass judgment, and proceedings concerning another road. It allowed evidence of Brown’s verbal guidance from the county court and his testimony about his good faith to bear on malice, not the road’s legality. The court held that probable cause requires an honest belief in guilt supported by reasonable grounds, and that waiving a preliminary examination is prima facie evidence of probable cause. Because malicious prosecution also requires malice, the judgment for Brown was affirmed.

Apple Inc. reported that on August 8, 2022, it issued $5.5 billion in senior unsecured notes across four series: $1 billion at 3.250% due 2029, $1.5 billion at 3.350% due 2032, $1.75 billion at 3.950% due 2052, and $1.25 billion at 4.100% due 2062. Interest is payable semiannually beginning February 8, 2023. The notes rank equally with Apple’s other unsecured, unsubordinated debt.
Holmer’s net-front play drew a penalty. The team remained confident it could make the game competitive after scoring twice against Hasek and hoped to build on that.

AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine offloads page migration in systems with multiple memory tiers. It requires an enabled IOMMU and can migrate pages targeted by DMA or protected by Secure Nested Paging. Commands use a driver-managed ring buffer and can move up to 128 pages at once. PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO migrates hypervisor-owned pages and updates IOMMU mappings; PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST migrates SNP guest pages using a Pre-Migration destination state. Software must observe page-alignment, mapping and access restrictions. The guide also describes initialization, interrupts, firmware reload, performance guidance and error reporting.

This qualitative study examined how eight Technology teachers in South Africa’s Ehlanzeni District teach education for sustainable development. Interviews showed that teachers understood resource preservation, renewable energy and environmental impacts, and identified opportunities in design, recycling and collaborative learning. Classroom observations, however, found little explicit teaching of sustainability; demonstrations predominated over collaboration. The study recommends integrating sustainability throughout Technology Education through practical projects, responsible resource use, critical thinking and collaborative problem-solving. Its scope was limited to two circuits in one district and qualitative methods.

Nearly seven months after launch, the model Yield Hog Dividend Growth Portfolio is down about 2 per cent including dividends, but its annualized income has risen 6.7 per cent, from $4,094 to $4,369. Seventeen of its 22 holdings have increased their dividends. The author plans to use most of the portfolio’s cash to buy eight more TransCanada shares, citing its roughly 5-per-cent yield and dividend-growth plans. He will not add to Enbridge because of uncertainty over project funding and its proposed Line 3 replacement.

U.S. stocks rebounded Wednesday after a selloff driven by political turmoil in Italy, as hopes of avoiding an election improved sentiment. Energy shares led gains as crude oil prices rose more than 2.4 percent, while bank stocks also recovered.
