At 1:13 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 1.18 percent, the S&P 500 1.22 percent and the Nasdaq 0.83 percent. Traders said reduced expectations for U.S. interest rate hikes also supported stocks.

Jesse Williams says he chooses roles that represent Black people positively, challenge him as an actor, offer varied characters, and let him learn something new. In Prime Video’s “Hotel Costiera,” he plays a fixer at an Italian luxury hotel and also served as a producer. The role took him to Italy and required him to learn Italian.

A planned randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in Bangkok will assign 90 women with metastatic breast cancer receiving chemotherapy to Ganja Oil, Metta Osot or placebo for 90 days. It will assess chemotherapy-related symptoms, quality of life, adverse effects, microbiome changes, cytokines, bacterial metabolites, and cannabis pharmacokinetics and pharmacogenetics. Participants will provide blood, saliva, stool and skin samples before and after treatment.

EUR/USD is consolidating, with a possible downside target of 1.0554. GBP/USD breakout targets are 1.2700 upward or 1.2345 downward. USD/CHF may correct before rising to 1.0067. USD/JPY may rebound from 112.81, then break toward 115.30 or 112.00. AUD/USD may rise before falling, while USD/RUB may correct upward. Gold may rebound before falling toward 1185. Brent’s breakout targets are 59.90 upward or 54.40 downward.

Jonathan Huberdeau scored with 7.7 seconds remaining to give the Florida Panthers a 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. Aleksander Barkov and Aaron Ekblad also scored for Florida, while Danny DeKeyser scored both Detroit goals. Huberdeau’s winning goal stood after a goalie-interference challenge.

The passage argues that UK businesses should pay living wages and fair delivery charges, citing high fees for Inverness customers. It calls for criminal charges rather than negotiations over wages and fees.

A punter kicks the ball after an offense fails to advance, aiming to improve field position and give the coverage team time to stop a return. Effective punts require leg strength, accuracy, hang time and touch, including the ability to place the ball inside the opponent’s 20-yard line. Punters may also hold for field goals and extra points or run or throw on fake punts. By forcing opponents to begin drives farther from the end zone, punters help their defense and influence scoring opportunities.

The passage describes a cloud microservices architecture that lets applications request functions through a uniform API without specifying whether software or hardware will perform them. Accelerators register their capabilities, connection methods and configuration details with a service discovery function. A microservices driver uses that information to select an available instance or provision a new one, including a configurable FPGA. Message forwarders can connect microservices into processing chains so data passes between them without repeatedly returning to the application. The architecture also describes unified addressing, telemetry and load balancing across service instances.

Soccer position numbers began in 1920s England, assigned from back to front in a 2-3-5 formation. The later W-M formation shifted players’ roles while retaining their numbers, establishing “number 9” for a central striker and “number 10” for a set-back attacker. From the 1960s, changing formations loosened the link between jersey numbers and positions. In 2012, U.S. Soccer began standardizing position names and numbers around a 4-3-3 formation, with defined attributes for each role.

A poster says they tested an in-store Meijer deal that stacks a new mPerks account’s 5% discount with a $50 PS4 Pro coupon, reducing the $349.99 price to $282.50. They did not buy the console or post a receipt.

Studies show that many millennials save for retirement and often start younger than previous generations, but they tend to invest more conservatively and report greater unease about stocks. The passage warns that avoiding stocks could limit long-term retirement growth, noting that stock-market returns exceeded money-market account returns over the periods cited. Financial experts advise putting investment risk in perspective and accepting some risk while investing wisely.

A collection of May 2001 news reports examines Enron and President Bush’s energy plan. One report says Enron Chairman Kenneth Lay pressed for open access to electricity transmission and fewer regulatory barriers, priorities reflected in parts of the plan. Other reports say the plan favors conventional energy production and infrastructure, drawing praise from some energy businesses and criticism over consumer relief, renewable energy and environmental impacts. Japanese utilities opposed Enron’s proposal to separate electricity generation and transmission. Separate reports note Enron’s lease of Mumbai office space and its planned withdrawal from the Dolphin gas project.

Micro E-mini S&P 500 futures, launched by CME in 2019, are one-tenth the size of E-mini contracts and trade electronically on CME Globex. Each MES contract is worth $5 times the index value, with a minimum price movement of 0.25 index points, or $1.25. Quarterly contracts settle in cash. Traders can use them to speculate, diversify, or hedge, but leverage increases the risk of losses. The passage reports a high of 4808.25 in January 2022 and a low of 2174.00 in March 2020. It also discusses a mean-reversion strategy, though its backtest uses E-mini rather than Micro E-mini contracts and excludes risk-management parameters.

Janata Congress Chhattisgarh announced 11 candidates for next year’s assembly elections. Party leader Ajit Jogi said more candidates, including six sitting MLAs, would be named later to avoid jeopardising their assembly membership. He said the early announcement would give candidates time to prepare. BJP vice president Sunil Soni called the list a “Congress B team,” while Jogi identified farmers, women, unemployment and Naxalites as election issues.

The speaker values a teammate’s playoff experience and big goals. The team approaches overtime confidently, focusing on its own game rather than fearing a loss. After giving the opponent too much respect, the team has played differently over the last two games. The speaker focuses on the next shot and enjoys close overtime games.

Google laid off more than 100 employees in design-related roles in its cloud unit, including user-experience research and platform teams. Some design teams were halved, and some affected employees have until early December to find another role at Google. The cuts come as the company reduces headcount while prioritizing AI investment.

China’s official manufacturing PMI rose to 49.8 in September, its strongest reading since March, but remained below the 50 threshold for growth. RatingDog’s private manufacturing PMI reached 51.2, above forecasts. Official non-manufacturing activity edged lower, while RatingDog’s services reading fell to 50. Economists are watching an October Politburo meeting for signals on Beijing’s response to the economic slowdown.

A July 17, 2001, news roundup covers California’s electricity crisis. Gov. Gray Davis expanded state power purchases and oversight of the grid, prompting concerns about costs and public accountability. Lawmakers remained divided over plans to rescue Southern California Edison, while officials considered whether a larger state bond issue would require another rate increase. Other reports describe a newly opened peaker plant, calls to investigate energy consultants’ stock holdings, and Edison’s work with churches to enroll low-income customers in electricity discounts. Nationally, Bush administration officials promoted their energy plan and placed greater emphasis on conservation.
NVIDIA’s November 15, 2018 Form 8-K announces its results for the quarter ended October 28, 2018. It includes a press release and CFO commentary as exhibits, both furnished rather than filed.

The MOVE Index measures U.S. interest-rate volatility using prices of one-month options. The passage finds that high MOVE readings do not generally signal a good time to buy bonds. A TLT strategy tested from 2002 held bonds when MOVE was below its historical mean and sold when it rose above it. The strategy was not highly profitable, but its maximum drawdown was about half that of buy-and-hold; avoiding high volatility hurt returns in 2008 and helped in 2022.

Wickes, B&Q and Homebase will close on Christmas Day and operate reduced hours on other festive dates. Wickes opens 10am–5pm on Boxing Day and 10am–4pm on New Year’s Day. B&Q generally opens 10am–4pm on Christmas Eve, Boxing Day and New Year’s Day, with regional exceptions. Homebase opens 10am–5pm on Boxing Day and 10am–4pm on New Year’s Day, except in Scotland and Eire, where stores will be closed. Customers are advised to check local store hours before visiting; the passage gives no specific Argos hours.

On-field vision helps soccer players make quick decisions, find passes, anticipate attacks and defend effectively. The passage recommends constantly scanning for teammates, opponents and space; lifting the head after controlling the ball; watching for teammates making runs; and communicating what players see. Familiarity with teammates and regular practice can strengthen these habits. Coaches can also encourage a first touch away from the body to give players more time and a better view, and use passing drills that require players to look up before receiving the ball.

A NatWest report identified eight emerging scams, including smartphone malware, fake World Cup ticket and wedding websites, social-media-based fraud, Brexit-proof investment claims, money mules, dating-app catfishing and solicitor impersonation. It advised consumers to verify requests for personal information, update security software and avoid links or files from unknown people.

On March 15, 2021, NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted a fiscal 2022 variable cash compensation plan for eligible executive officers. Awards depend on achieving specified revenue goals, with threshold, base and stretch levels. Unless the committee decides otherwise, participants must remain employed through the payment date. At base-level achievement, named executives’ target awards range from $250,000 to $2 million.

The June 6, 2001 VentureWire newsletter reports Napster’s licensing deal with MusicNet, the resignation of Comdisco Ventures’ CEO, Charter Growth Capital’s renaming to Focus Ventures, and Movaz’s $62 million financing. It also covers other investments, company closures, acquisitions, product launches and executive appointments.

Pakistan’s Bureau of Statistics expects to complete inflation-index rebasing by June 2018 and introduce the new base in fiscal year 2018–19. The current 2007–08 base has become outdated, and the process was delayed by the population census. The bureau also plans separate rural, urban and total consumer price indices.

A Citizen experiment found that OMICS International accepted absurd conference submissions about underwater birds and flying pigs for a fee. Afterward, other journals sent unsolicited publication invitations referencing the bird abstract. Some also cited a separate fake paper that had never been published, suggesting that submission details and contact information were circulating among publishers.

Hucknall and Linby Dolphins finished fifth of eight teams at a novice gala for nine- to 11-year-olds despite injuries and illness. Katie Hill earned three runner-up finishes, and the boys’ U10 medley relay won.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week and was set to rebound on Monday, though the passage warns that a deeper correction remains possible. Oil declined after OPEC+ announced another production increase, while tariff uncertainty and weak economic data raised demand concerns. The author advises careful position management amid earnings, valuation and seasonal risks.

Mats Zuccarello said the team played well in its first two games but must limit mistakes. He remains confident, hopes home fans will provide a boost, and says the focus is on winning the next game. He emphasized shared effort across the team.

Gianluca Vialli says Juventus must prevent the Camp Nou atmosphere from building during their match against Barcelona, recalling how Chelsea lost control there in 2000. He expects Sergio Busquets and Lionel Messi to pose greater challenges than in the first leg. Vialli praised Juventus’s first-leg performance and Buffon’s saves, and said Juventus must defend compactly, make effective transitions and take their chances.

The passage argues that XLP, an ETF tracking large-cap S&P 500 consumer staples companies, is useful for trading because of its low volatility, mean-reverting behavior, and diversification potential. It describes three short strategies whose backtest covered 418 trades, with an average gain of about 0.4% before costs and a 75% win rate.

Chesterfield residents sent messages of support to Craig Burr, 33, after he threatened to jump onto the A617 Hasland bypass. He was taken to hospital and later released. Burr spoke publicly about his struggles with mental illness and thanked people for their kind words. The Derbyshire Times said it would keep in contact with him. NHS advice in the article urges people experiencing depression, anxiety or suicidal thoughts to seek help.

DAWN-PLASMA was a multicenter, randomized, open-label phase 2 trial comparing convalescent plasma plus standard care with standard care alone in adults hospitalized with COVID-19. Its primary endpoint was the percentage of patients alive without mechanical ventilation on Day 15; secondary endpoints addressed clinical status, ventilation, safety and other outcomes. Between May 2020 and January 2021, 489 patients were randomized 2:1 to plasma (326) or control (163). In the plasma group, the median time to first transfusion was five hours, and 294 patients received all four planned units. Ethics committees approved the study, and informed consent was required.

Diversification aims to reduce portfolio risk by combining investments whose returns respond differently to market conditions. Common mistakes include overlooking holdings when assessing asset allocation, owning so many investments that costs and monitoring difficulties outweigh the benefits, buying products without understanding them, choosing assets that do not suit financial goals or liquidity needs, and failing to rebalance as allocations drift. Investors should account for all holdings, understand their investments, align them with their goals, review allocations periodically, and consider diversification within asset classes.

European shares rose on Wednesday with little reaction to Britain’s formal start of Brexit proceedings. The STOXX 600 gained 0.4 percent to its highest close in nearly 16 months, while Germany’s DAX rose 0.4 percent. Auto stocks advanced on Daimler’s sales outlook and supplier upgrades. London Stock Exchange and Deutsche Boerse shares gained despite EU regulators blocking their merger. Banks slipped, although Deutsche Bank rose amid optimism about its cash call. Scout24 and Aurelius fell sharply.

The passage says buying SPY after weakness and shorting after strength in the last trading hour appeared to work well from January 2010 to August 2012. Trades entered at the next day’s open and exited at 11:30. Buying at the close increased drawdowns; targets and stop-losses did not improve results.

The speaker says Holik’s return to New Jersey helped the team reach the Stanley Cup finals. Despite losing the previous game, the team hopes to respond as it did in earlier series. The speaker expects a difficult game in the opponent’s arena and says the ice may affect the team’s speed. Describing a goal against, the speaker says the shot rose past his glove. He acknowledges the opponent’s momentum but says one road win would restore home-ice advantage.
AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) will shut down on December 15. The company cited changes in how people communicate, while users shared nostalgic memories on social media.

The study developed UZEP, a cloud-based distance education platform designed to help universities move quickly to online teaching during emergencies without providing their own servers. It integrates virtual classrooms, learning management, assessments, material sharing and reporting, and was used by 12 Turkish universities in the fall 2020 semester. Expert, administrator, lecturer and student evaluations generally found it easy to use and functional. They also identified shortcomings in communication, collaboration, reporting and assessment tools. The authors plan further improvements and note that the evaluation relied on self-reported questionnaires conducted during the pandemic.

The passage describes devices and methods for assessing tissue viability and burn depth using electrode-based capacitance measurements converted to sub-epidermal moisture values. These measurements can help distinguish non-viable tissue from surrounding damaged tissue and map their boundaries. Proposed devices indicate boundaries with lights, skin markings, or projected images. Repeated measurements may also track wound progression, healing, and responses to treatment.

Apple appointed Monica Lozano to its board effective January 4, 2021, and to its Audit and Finance Committee. She will receive a $100,000 annual retainer and an initial grant of 281 restricted stock units. Apple reported no transactions with Lozano requiring disclosure under Regulation S-K.

Wound Care Advantage, podiatric surgeon Dr. David G. Armstrong, the Southwestern Academic Limb Salvage Alliance (SALSA), and Gen1 Research launched Advanced Discovery, a research alliance focused on wound care. It will evaluate diagnostic and treatment approaches through a network of wound and hyperbaric treatment centers, drawing on clinical data from more than 42,000 patients and 880,000 wound assessments. Gen1 will provide administrative and research infrastructure. The alliance aims to improve healing outcomes and reduce treatment costs.

The passage describes methods for reducing wireless transmission latency by preparing data blocks, assembling MAC protocol data units, and performing some physical-layer processing before an uplink grant arrives. A wireless transmit/receive unit may receive or determine transmission parameters in advance, then use a grant to select and transmit prepared blocks. It may also derive transmission or reception settings from parameters used to decode downlink control information. The passage describes flexible 5G radio resources, scheduling, and acknowledgment feedback for individual data blocks.

CompareCards lists credit cards with introductory 0% APR periods, cash-back or travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses. The featured offers vary in duration, eligible purchases, balance-transfer fees, and APRs after the introductory period. The passage explains that low-interest cards can reduce borrowing costs, while variable APRs may change with prevailing rates. CompareCards says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not influence its ratings or reviews.

Union fund trustees sued Waterworks under ERISA to compel an audit, arguing that its contribution reports and payments showed it was bound by a collective bargaining agreement. Waterworks said a union representative had agreed it would not be bound by that agreement, and Waterworks never signed the reports’ acceptance clauses. The court found a genuine factual dispute about the parties’ agreement and the meaning of Waterworks’ conduct. It denied both parties’ motions for summary judgment.

The Sansa Fuze may display “unknown artist/album” when a song’s ID3 tags or WMA metadata are missing; the information can be added through the song’s properties on a computer. The player supports microSD and microSDHC cards and can be reset by holding its power button up for about 10 seconds. The manual provides SanDisk support contacts and describes a one-year limited warranty for the original purchaser, including service procedures and exclusions. Its software license permits personal use with a SanDisk product, restricts modification and redistribution, disclaims software warranties, and prohibits use in high-risk applications.

NVIDIA’s annual report for the fiscal year ended January 30, 2022 describes its Graphics and Compute & Networking segments, which serve gaming, data center, professional visualization and automotive markets. NVIDIA uses third parties to manufacture its semiconductors. It terminated its planned acquisition of Arm because of regulatory challenges and expects a $1.36 billion charge in fiscal 2023. The report highlights risks from competition, supply constraints, uncertain demand, international operations and cybersecurity, including a February 2022 breach in which proprietary information was stolen.

EEM options can provide exposure to rising or falling markets, but trading them carries risks from adverse price movements, time decay, limited liquidity and volatility. The passage describes strategies including calls, puts, covered options and spreads. It recommends understanding option pricing, accounting for fees, backtesting ideas and managing risk through position sizing and hedging. Leverage can magnify both gains and losses; trading costs, deposit requirements, margin rules and bid-ask spreads vary by broker and contract.

The court immediately suspended E. Nkem Odinkemere from practicing law until further order, restricted disbursement of funds held in his New Jersey accounts, and required compliance with rules for suspended attorneys.

Army pilot and engineer Sungi Cho founded P6 Gear after developing the 3D-printed Warbelt Hanger to improve gear storage. He later launched the MOLLE Backer, a mount compatible with hard and soft MOLLE systems. After leaving the Army for an MBA at MIT Sloan, Cho continued production with fifteen printers and two part-time employees.

With Backer sales steady at about 1,800 units a month, Cho considered outsourcing production to an injection-molding manufacturer. Injection molding offered lower plastic and scrap costs and would eliminate 40 monthly hours spent operating Backer printers, but required an $11,487 mold and a $0.75-per-unit manufacturing charge. Cho needed to assess its financial viability alongside non-financial factors.

Two weather systems are forecast to bring only a dusting of snow to Connecticut over the next 48 hours, while much of Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont could receive close to a foot, with more in the mountains.

South Korea restored 46 public services after a suspected battery explosion caused a fire at a Daejeon data centre, disrupting hundreds of government platforms. Authorities are restarting 551 of 647 affected platforms, though passport and welfare services remain unrestored. The president called for stronger safeguards and backup plans.
Rosalind G. Brewer informed Amazon.com, Inc. on January 26, 2021, that she would resign from its Board of Directors effective February 16, 2021.

A retrospective study of 266 glioblastoma patients evaluated whether MRI-based deep learning could predict pTERT mutation status before surgery. A ResNet model combining diffusion-weighted imaging and apparent diffusion coefficient maps achieved 85.2% slice-level accuracy (AUC 0.934) and 86.6% patient-level accuracy in the test set, outperforming conventional structural MRI. Using the entire tumor gave the best results; adding clinical characteristics did not improve performance. The authors noted the study’s small sample size and retrospective design.

Antipsychotics can cause metabolic syndrome, increasing the risks of cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes. This scoping review will examine modifiable and non-modifiable determinants of antipsychotic-induced metabolic syndrome in community-dwelling adults, previous non-pharmacological interventions, and preferred settings and timing for their delivery. Researchers will search published and grey literature, screen studies, and synthesise the evidence using scoping-review guidance. Patients and carers will be consulted. The review aims to identify knowledge gaps and inform future research.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with an integrated analog front end and reference. They provide programmable high and low input alarms with hysteresis, plus AVDD alarms with fixed typical trip points of 5.3 V and 4.7 V.

Their multiSPI interface supports standard SPI and source-synchronous data transfer, single or dual data outputs, and multiple devices in a daisy chain. Data frames use a 32-bit shift register; writes require at least 32 clocks, while shorter frames can read selected output bits. Nine configuration registers control functions including alarms, input range, output data, reset, and power saving. The devices operate in RESET, acquisition, and conversion states and offer NAP and power-down modes.

The passage also describes an eight-channel industrial input module using an ADS8681W and a differential multiplexer, along with power-supply decoupling and PCB layout recommendations.

The Trump administration moved day-to-day management of career and technical education programs from the Education Department to the Labor Department while retaining Education Department oversight. Supporters say the shift could better align programs with jobs and reduce administrative burdens. Critics worry limited staffing and an emphasis on short-term training could weaken support for schools and narrow students’ paths to advancement. Its effects on students remain uncertain.

The Colorado Court of Appeals affirmed a judgment that Shelter Mutual owed no underinsured motorist payment to the Breits after a third-party insurer paid its $100,000 policy limit. The court held that Shelter’s two policies unambiguously prohibited stacking their $100,000 coverage limits and that the doctrine of reasonable expectations did not apply. It denied Shelter’s request for appellate fees.

A pilot study in Kisumu, Kenya, examined the acceptability of self-administered intravaginal 5-fluorouracil (5FU) among 12 women living with HIV who had received treatment for high-grade cervical precancer. After eight applications over 16 weeks, all participants said they were confident they had used the cream correctly and would prefer it to their previous ablation or excision treatment if it were available as primary treatment. They valued its convenience, privacy and reduced pain, but some reported side effects, difficulty measuring doses, limited privacy at home and challenges with required condom use. The small, single-site study found high acceptability; larger studies are needed to assess effectiveness.

The ANC’s Free State provincial congress had not yet begun after repeated postponements. It is expected to elect new leadership, with Ace Magashule and Thabo Manyoni available to contest the chairperson position, though Manyoni was not expected to attend. Following a court order, 28 of 29 required branch meetings had been rerun.

The Metallurgy & Materials Society of CIM announced its 2018 award recipients, who will be recognized on October 15 in Columbus, Ohio. Honorees include Sam Marcuson, Priti Wanjara, Jun Song, Xinjin Cao, Georgios Kolliopoulos and Shauna Litke. An Acousto Ultrasonic-Echo testing technique developed by Afshin Sadri and Hatch’s NDT team received the Innovation Award.

The Ministry of Education will fund a $28.5-million replacement for Walnut Park Elementary in Smithers. The more than 50-year-old school sits on unstable land, and upgrading it would cost more than replacing it. A two-storey school for 440 students will be built beside the existing building, which will then be demolished. The new school will include space for StrongStart and a neighbourhood learning centre and will meet LEED gold standards. The goal is to open it for the 2020–21 school year.

A withdrawn, non-peer-reviewed preprint compared six machine-learning models for pancreatic cancer diagnosis using synthetic data. All achieved about 76% accuracy, but sensitivity was very low: Random Forest and Decision Tree detected no positive cases, while SVM had the highest sensitivity at 1.90%. SuperLearner had the highest precision at 66.67%. The study identifies class imbalance as a major limitation and calls for improved methods and validation with real-world clinical data before clinical use.

Pupils aged eight to 10 from Richardson Dees Primary School have transformed an unused rooftop space at The Forum shopping centre into a garden. They grow flowers, fruit, vegetables and herbs, and plan to share the harvest with classmates and families. School staff say the project teaches gardening, encourages healthy eating and builds confidence and responsibility.

Iranian President Hassan Rouhani warned that Iran could abandon the 2015 nuclear deal within hours or days if the United States continued imposing sanctions. Amid disputes over Iranian missile activity and US sanctions, he accused President Donald Trump of showing that Washington was an unreliable negotiating partner.

CompareCards lists credit cards with introductory 0% APR periods, cash-back or travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses. The featured offers vary in duration, eligibility, balance-transfer fees, and the variable APR charged after the introductory period. The passage advises comparing both short-term offers and longer-term interest rates. CompareCards says it evaluates cards using a data-driven rating system and that compensation from listed companies does not influence its ratings or reviews.

After Laura Shaner died following complications with dialysis treatment, her husband David sued for wrongful-death damages. David died during the litigation without a will or known heirs. The trial court dismissed the claim for survivor damages, and the Court of Appeals affirmed. The Indiana Supreme Court reversed, holding that the claim did not end with David’s death and did not require an heir. It remanded the case for the trial court to determine whether a proper party could continue the claim.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July, bringing its year-to-date gain to 7.8%, but fell 1.6% on the first day of August. Longer-term trend indicators remain healthy, while weakening short-term breadth and seasonal increases in volatility and credit spreads signal caution. Investors are increasing their exposure to tech stocks, and US electricity demand reached a new high.

Kim Jong Un’s planned June summit with Donald Trump remains uncertain as the US seeks terms for North Korea’s denuclearisation. Kim has met twice each with South Korean President Moon Jae-in and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Moon says Kim worries whether the US would guarantee his regime’s security after denuclearisation. North Korea objected to US officials’ references to Libya, prompting Trump to cancel the summit, though he later indicated it might proceed. Kim has said he is open to “complete denuclearisation”, but its meaning remains unclear. Analysts say he seeks sanctions relief, economic development and security for his leadership.

The S&P MidCap 400, formed in 1991, tracks 400 mid-sized U.S. companies and is market-cap weighted. Its E-mini futures contract trades on CME Globex under the symbol EMD, represents $100 times the index value, and is financially settled. The passage reports that the index tends to perform better in winter and spring. Of two backtested strategies, a volatility strategy performed poorly, while an overnight strategy produced modest results but worked better on SPY and QQQ. Futures trading carries substantial risk because leverage magnifies losses from adverse price movements.

Apple appointed Alex Gorsky to its board on November 9, 2021, and assigned him to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. He will receive a $100,000 annual retainer and an initial grant of 486 restricted stock units. The board also amended Apple’s bylaws to increase its size from eight to nine directors.

Tyreek Hill returned to the Dolphins’ facility Friday to encourage teammates three days after season-ending surgery on his dislocated left knee. Miami faces a rare game without him. Coach Mike McDaniel said Jaylen Waddle and other players will take on greater roles, but replacing Hill will require contributions across the team.

A Russell 2000 Death Cross occurs when its 50-day moving average falls below its 200-day average. Rob Hanna found that the S&P 500 rose in 21 of 25 cases since 1988, though drawdowns were often substantial. The most recent cross was in 2022, after which the S&P 500 fell. The passage cautions that the signal may be less reliable for the S&P 500 than for the Russell 2000.

The lecture contrasts tournaments with cash games: tournament blinds rise, players cannot rebuy after elimination, and survival affects payouts; cash games offer fixed stakes and more freedom to join, leave, or rebuy. The instructor then focuses on preflop decisions, reviewing approximate hand equities and explaining that suited cards are especially valuable when a hand is behind.

In tournaments, rising blinds can make preflop all-ins profitable even with weak hands. The instructor recommends generally going all-in or folding with fewer than about 12 big blinds when antes are present, while adjusting for position, opponents’ calling ranges, and stack sizes. A small-blind example illustrates exploitative play and Nash equilibrium ranges. The lecture also emphasizes calculating pot odds before calling an all-in, choosing raise sizes that do not give opponents overly favorable odds, and avoiding small raises that offer opponents unnecessary options.

A July 17 news roundup reports that James Fallon will lead Enron Broadband Services as Kenneth Rice moves to another corporate role. The unit lost $102 million in the second quarter and will join Enron Wholesale Services as it cuts expenses. EnronOnline’s chief executive expects trading volume to grow and says it can coexist with a rival exchange. Representative Henry Waxman urged a Justice Department review of White House aide Karl Rove’s contacts with companies in which he owned stock, including Enron; the White House said Rove acted appropriately. Other items cover a proposed Mississippi power plant, donations for Houston flood relief, and Maharashtra’s planned judicial inquiry into the Dabhol power project.

The device provides active-high input-voltage and AVDD alarms through a configurable multifunction pin. Input thresholds are programmable; AVDD thresholds are 4.7 V and 5.3 V. Both alarms are enabled by default when alarm functionality is turned on and can be disabled separately. Alarm flags update after each conversion and can be read from the pin, ALARM_REG, or the data output. Active flags clear after a conversion; tripped flags clear when ALARM_REG is read.

John Mellencamp performed “Easy Target,” a song about racial inequality, on “The Late Show With Stephen Colbert,” then knelt and raised his fist in support of Black Lives Matter. He called kneeling a protest against racial and social injustice.

With the Broncos out, local writers, residents and officials offer predictions for Super Bowl 52 between the Patriots and Eagles. Most pick New England, citing Tom Brady, Bill Belichick and the team’s record of comebacks. Others favor Philadelphia’s offense and predict an upset. Several expect a close game, though predicted scores vary widely.

The 60/40 portfolio allocates 60% to stocks and 40% to bonds, relying on their often-divergent movements to reduce risk. The passage reports an 8.8% historical annual return since 1926 but notes that both assets fell amid inflation in 2022. It argues against abandoning the strategy after a poor year and discusses alternatives, including trend-following, gold, international equities and tail-risk strategies.

The Ichimoku strategy uses five indicator components to assess support and resistance, trend direction, and momentum. Traders may use cloud breakouts, line crossovers, and the Chikou Span to generate or confirm signals. The passage recommends backtesting and forward-testing strategies before trading because signals may be unreliable. Its backtests found that the strategy reduced time in the market and many drawdowns, but generally underperformed risk-adjusted buy-and-hold returns.

The Rhode Island Supreme Court affirmed Andrew Bucci’s conviction for giving legal advice to Robert Oliva while suspended from practicing law. Recorded conversations provided sufficient evidence that Bucci advised Oliva about his criminal cases. The court held that the offense did not require proof of payment. It declined to review Bucci’s challenge to his six-month sentence because he had not first raised it in Superior Court.

The lecture explains how demand estimates, observed prices, and assumptions about firm conduct can be used to recover marginal costs. Jointly estimating demand and supply can improve demand estimates and provide restrictions for testing conduct models.

In the automobile market, the BLP random-coefficients model captures differences in consumer tastes and substitution patterns that a simple logit model misses, though it omits factors including used cars, dealerships, negotiated prices, and financing.

Nevo’s cereal-market study compares model-based markups under different conduct assumptions with accounting estimates. Its preferred specification rejects joint profit maximization across brands but does not reject separate brand pricing or pricing based on actual firm ownership. A logit model would yield a different conclusion.

The lecture also examines whether diversified investors’ ownership of competing firms weakens competition. Although measures of shared ownership have risen, a cereal-market study rejects common-ownership conduct models in favor of firms maximizing their own profits.

The Great Recession hurt U.S. casual dining, though some investors expected demand to improve by 2016. Bloomin’ Brands, which opened its first Outback Steakhouse in 1988, had 1,335 company-owned and 166 franchised restaurants across four brands by June 2016. About 85% were in the U.S. The passage compares Bloomin’ with 13 publicly traded restaurant companies and presents valuation, income, and balance-sheet data. Bloomin’ reported $4.3 billion in trailing revenue and $60 million in net income.

Microsoft reported $50.1 billion in revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2022, up 11% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 6% to $21.5 billion, while net income fell 14% to $17.6 billion; the prior-year quarter included a $3.3 billion tax benefit. Intelligent Cloud revenue grew 20%, Productivity and Business Processes revenue grew 9%, and More Personal Computing revenue declined slightly. Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 24% to $25.7 billion. Extending the estimated useful lives of server and network equipment increased quarterly operating income by $1.1 billion. Microsoft ended the quarter with $107.3 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments.

A seed producer in South Sudan’s Gbudue state urged the government to restrict seed imports after the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) brought in maize seeds rather than buying locally. The producer, GAIS, said it had applied for an FAO tender but was not inspected. Gbudue’s agriculture director said he would investigate the imports. FAO said it also supports local growers through seed fairs and purchasing, and had previously supported GAIS. It said the government granted a waiver for 2018 maize seed imports because local production was low and conflict had displaced producers.

A University of Liverpool study of 38 healthy adults found that higher musical aptitude was associated with lower hallucination proneness and greater integrity of the corpus callosum. Statistical analysis indicated that corpus callosum microstructure mediated the relationship between musical aptitude and hallucination proneness. Researchers suggested studying whether musical training could benefit patients with psychosis.

The Assam Higher Secondary Education Council will release the 2018 Class 12 results on May 31 at 9:30 am. Students can check them at ahsec.nic.in or resultsassam.nic.in, or through SMS and apps. Exams ran from February 23 to March 22. Students need at least 20 marks in each subject to pass; scores of 70 percent or above earn a distinction.

Losing a spouse can put the surviving partner’s health at risk: stress may weaken immune defences, while grief can disrupt eating, rest and attention to symptoms. But illness or death soon afterward may also be coincidental, especially when someone has existing health problems. George H.W. Bush was hospitalized with sepsis after his wife’s funeral and was reported to be recovering; doctors not involved in his care could not say whether stress played a role.

Using resting-state MRI data from 112 people with early psychosis and 55 healthy controls, the study compared group-based and individualized definitions of cortical regions for measuring functional connectivity. Both approaches found widespread lower connectivity in patients. Individualized regions were more functionally homogeneous and identified about 9% fewer disrupted connections. The methods differed substantially in which specific connections and regions they implicated, but produced broadly consistent findings at the network level. The authors conclude that group-based definitions may inflate estimated connectivity differences in psychosis.

The Japanese mobile game Tabikaeru has become popular in Taiwan. Players provide supplies for a traveling frog but cannot control its journeys. Local psychologists say caring for the frog offers a sense of companionship, while the game’s simplicity helps players relax. Related online searches and sales of frog-themed items have risen.

Asian shares edged higher Tuesday, supported by optimism about global growth and stronger-than-expected Chinese bank lending, despite an expected U.S. interest-rate increase. Wall Street also rose, led by technology and energy stocks. Investors awaited Federal Reserve and European Central Bank meetings; a JPMorgan economist said stronger U.S. growth forecasts could raise the prospect of four Fed rate hikes in 2018, while the ECB was likely to maintain its low-rate stance. The euro has gained against the dollar this year despite widening U.S.–German yield spreads. Bitcoin reached a record high, and oil prices firmed after a North Sea pipeline shutdown.

Coach Quenneville said playoff energy and performance can fluctuate, making the pursuit of the trophy demanding. He praised his players’ preparation and said a top scorer was getting chances despite not producing. Defensemen’s ice time depends on how each game unfolds, while line changes aim to improve balance. He credited the penalty killers but emphasized avoiding penalties against a strong power play. He expects the team to improve in the next game, led by its captain, after four tight games in the finals.

Jacob Rees-Mogg’s speech at the University of the West of England was interrupted when protesters entered the hall and scuffles broke out. Footage showed him trying to calm those involved. He said he was not injured or physically threatened. Security and police attended, and his speech went ahead, with Rees-Mogg speaking about free speech. The university condemned the disruption and said it would work with police to identify the protesters.

The lecture reviews how linear-system solvers underpin nonlinear equation solving and implicit ODE methods, and how conditioning, initial guesses, and iteration counts affect results and computational cost. It introduces functionals, then explains numerical integration as fitting a function from sampled values using basis functions. Interpolation fits every sampled point, while fitting fewer parameters may be preferable when data are noisy. The professor compares polynomial bases and quadrature methods, highlighting limitations of polynomial interpolation and the efficiency of Gaussian quadrature. Finally, nested quadrature for multidimensional integrals is shown to become rapidly more expensive as the number of dimensions grows.
The figure shows a graphical user interface; broken lines are not claimed.

An exploratory case study with Getinge AB developed local open-source and cloud-based GPT-4o systems to summarize changes in order intake and net sales. Both produced useful drafts, but neither was reliable enough for formal financial reporting without human review. The local system offered greater data control but required more engineering effort and sometimes hallucinated or missed trends. GPT-4o was easier to integrate and produced more concise summaries, yet sometimes omitted key information or violated reporting constraints. Major challenges included preparing varied data, protecting sensitive information, and enforcing precise output rules. The study’s conclusions are limited by its single-company setting and evaluation by two experts.

The passage discusses school shootings and the challenges schools face during emergencies, including anxious parents, communication problems, traffic, and pickup restrictions. It urges families to plan how they will reunite with their children after a disaster and whom they authorize to pick them up. It also calls for schools to conduct disaster drills that address situations in which phones and other services fail.

Syrian state media reported that government forces captured al-Sukhna, Islamic State’s last major town in Homs province. The advance brings them closer to Deir al-Zor province, where Islamic State holds most territory despite a government-held pocket in the provincial capital.

Google is adding team updates to Search and Google Play Newsstand during the NBA and NHL playoffs. Search will show team-provided posts for NBA, NHL and MLB teams; Newsstand will feature playoff news, scores, analysis and videos. The features are rolling out globally in English, with team information available in the U.S. and Canada.

Hong Liu reviews the Hawking–Page transition, then introduces entanglement entropy as the von Neumann entropy of a reduced density matrix. For a pure state, it vanishes when two subsystems are unentangled, and the subsystems have equal entanglement entropies. For mixed states, the entropy can also contain classical correlations.

In local many-body systems, ground-state entanglement entropy generally follows an area law, dominated by interactions near a region’s boundary. Subleading terms can reveal topological order, while entanglement entropy in conformal field theories can characterize degrees of freedom.

Liu then presents the Ryu–Takayanagi proposal: in a holographic theory, a region’s entanglement entropy equals the area of a corresponding minimal surface in the gravity geometry divided by four times Newton’s constant. He demonstrates its strong subadditivity, reproduces the known result for a two-dimensional conformal field theory, and explains how it recovers black-hole entropy when the region becomes the entire system.

The passage lists New York City real estate developments, including air-rights transactions in Midtown and the Upper East Side, a Fifth Avenue retail lease, an office move to Astor Place, a planned Williamsburg project and a Staten Island foreclosure. It also mentions the Salmagundi Club and investment in Knotel.

Pennsylvania State Police are investigating after workers from the Ruth Steinert Memorial SPCA found a pit bull dead in a partially buried cage in woods near Minersville. SPCA workers estimate it had been there about two months and believe it starved. The SPCA is offering a reward for information and asks anyone with information to contact state police in Frackville.

The passage identifies four challenges for quantum optics and strong-field physics: generating high-photon-number quantum light, creating entangled light-matter states in complex materials, measuring and using those states, and simulating strong-field dynamics on quantum platforms. All require further development of quantum field-theoretical treatments. Advances in theory, attosecond measurement, structured and squeezed light, novel materials, and cold-atom and trapped-ion simulators are helping address these challenges. The proposed research aims to make quantum-state generation more reproducible, tunable, and scalable, with potential applications in metrology, nonlinear optics, quantum information, and simulation.

The speaker says the team is one loss from elimination and must focus on winning its next game rather than looking ahead. Playing at home brings a supportive crowd and the last line change, but the team must keep the same disciplined, physical approach while avoiding penalties. He praises a young player for responding well after two penalties and commends the goalies for staying prepared in a difficult situation. He also says training and smart positional play help him handle heavy ice time.

The multicenter, open-label DAWN-plasma trial compared standard care plus high-antibody-titer convalescent plasma with standard care alone in hospitalized adults with COVID-19. Among 489 randomized patients, plasma did not improve survival without mechanical ventilation at day 15 (83.7% versus 84.1%) or any secondary endpoint. Adverse and serious adverse event rates were similar between groups. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 19 of 320 plasma recipients; no transfusion-related acute lung injury was reported.

Australian shares ended seven days of gains on May 2, with the S&P/ASX 200 down 0.1 percent as banks fell after ANZ’s earnings missed expectations. The central bank held rates at 1.5 percent. Materials stocks also declined, while Woolworths gained on strong sales. New Zealand’s S&P/NZX 50 rose 0.5 percent, led by industrials and utilities.

Matt Damon asked for prayers for his 74-year-old father, Kent, who has multiple myeloma. Damon said his father’s illness has been a slow process and has canceled appearances to be with him, including an October awards ceremony in England.

A prospective study of 16 patients with Fanconi anemia tested whether cancer-gene mutations in saliva and plasma could signal oral lesions or carcinomas before diagnosis. Among 14 patients with clinical follow-up, mutations were detected before diagnosis in six of seven who developed lesions or tumors, with lead times of 23–630 days. The reported test accuracy was 92%. The authors say larger, longer studies are needed to determine whether this approach enables earlier diagnosis.

At a two-day seminar on assessment and evaluation in Srinagar, Education Minister Syed Mohammad Altaf Bukhari urged academicians to build students’ confidence and improve evaluation. He raised concerns about students’ heavy workloads and lower marks percentages, which he said limit admissions outside Jammu and Kashmir. He also called on teachers to encourage students’ creative potential. Cluster University Vice Chancellor Sheikh Javaid urged improvements to bring education in line with national and international standards.

JPMorgan restricted credit-card cryptocurrency purchases, citing monitoring, repayment and fraud risks. Capital One and Discover also prohibit them. Credit-card networks and providers may now treat digital-currency purchases as cash advances, with higher costs.

Yankees shortstop Anthony Volpe played through a partially torn shoulder labrum for most of 2025 without going on the injured list. After struggling during the season and postseason, he said no decision has been made about offseason surgery.

STAT’s D.C. Diagnosis newsletter says determining which party would “win” a government shutdown depends on how winning is defined. It also notes that Virginia’s wild ponies received their annual health checkup in September.

This illustrated atlas connects research with clinical practice in periodontal and peri-implant plastic surgery. It covers treatment planning, surgical procedures, case studies, systematic reviews, multidisciplinary decisions, and decision trees for soft tissue augmentation.

The passage explains common football blocking terms. Trap blocks leave a defender initially unblocked before another blocker kicks him out; kick-out blocks similarly move an edge defender to widen a running lane. Base blocks are one-on-one, while drive blocks push a defender off the line in the run game. Reach blocks establish outside leverage, and down blocks use a favorable angle against an inside defender. Log blocks seal a defender inside, with the ball going outside. Pulling moves a blocker around a teammate to a new blocking position. Veer blocks aim to reach linebackers. Combo blocks move from a first-level defender toward a second-level defender; double teams are their initial two-blocker phase, and scoop blocks are backside combinations. Cut blocks target a defender’s legs, while crack blocks bring a perimeter player inward to block an interior defender.

Mental health experts continue to call for barriers on major Lower Mainland bridges, citing research on their effectiveness. Five bridges accounted for half of jumping suicides from 1991 to 2007. Burrard Bridge crisis phones have helped at least four people.

This January 2025 ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States* covers the Soviet Union from January 1983 to March 1985. The Office of the Historian says the ebook preserves the printed volume’s content while adding search and offline access; it recommends citing document numbers rather than page numbers. The series is intended to provide an accurate, comprehensive documentary record of major U.S. foreign policy decisions and diplomatic activity. Its governing statute sets standards for selection, editing, agency access to records, and publication timing. Most sources for this volume came from the Department of State and the National Archives and Records Administration.

FDA drug regulator George Tidmarsh wrote on LinkedIn that voclosporin, a lupus nephritis drug approved in 2021, has significant toxicity and no demonstrated direct clinical benefit. His comments prompted investor speculation about a past run-in with the drugmaker’s largest investor.

Researchers found closely related beneficial bacteria in pollen from nearby plants and in a honeybee hive’s pollen stores. Many were Streptomyces that produced compounds inhibiting bee and plant pathogens. The findings suggest pollen-borne bacteria help defend hives and could offer new approaches to protecting bees and crops.

The study lasted about 33 months, with participants enrolled for up to 26 months. In Phase 2/3, two 30-µg doses of BNT162b2 were 95% effective against COVID-19 from seven days after Dose 2 through December 3, 2020, regardless of past infection. The reported antibody responses after BNT162b2 boosters and BNT162b2SA doses met the study’s comparisons with responses after two BNT162b2 doses.

Most reported medical problems were mild or moderate. Injection-site pain, tiredness and headache were common; these reactions generally resolved quickly. Serious medical problems were uncommon, though researchers considered some in Phase 2/3 possibly vaccine-related. No participants died in Phase 1. Deaths occurred in Phase 2/3, but researchers did not believe BNT162b2 caused them.

In a February 2, 2021 Form 8-K, Amazon announced its fourth-quarter and full-year 2020 financial results and said Jeffrey P. Bezos would become Executive Chair in the third quarter of 2021. Andrew R. Jassy, then CEO of Amazon Web Services, would succeed him as CEO and President.
Five days after Stephen Paddock killed 58 people and injured hundreds at a Las Vegas concert, authorities said they had found no clear motive or known link between him and the Islamic State group.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture includes the GA102 and GA104 GPUs used in GeForce RTX 30-series cards and professional RTX A6000 and A40 products. Compared with Turing, GA10x adds double-rate FP32 processing, second-generation RT Cores with faster ray-triangle testing and motion-blur acceleration, and third-generation Tensor Cores supporting new data types and structured sparsity. The passage describes gains of up to 2× in ray tracing and up to 1.9× in power efficiency at the same performance level.

GA10x also introduces GDDR6X memory on selected GeForce cards, PCIe 4.0, and RTX IO for GPU-based loading and decompression. Its display and video features include HDMI 2.1, AV1 hardware decoding, and hardware encoding. The RTX A6000 and A40 each have 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, expandable to 96 GB across two GPUs using NVLink.

The rupee recovered from the previous day’s losses, gaining 43 paise to close at 67.43 against the US dollar. Traders unwound dollar positions amid easing political uncertainty in Italy, expectations of strong Indian GDP growth and a weaker dollar. The rupee also rose against the pound and yen but fell against the euro. India’s March-quarter and 2017–18 GDP data are due tomorrow.

Four U.S. Navy-trained dolphins arrived in Mexico to help locate the fewer than 30 remaining vaquita porpoises. Starting Oct. 12, experts plan to capture them and place them in a protected enclosure, hoping eventually to breed and release them. Experts say the effort is risky because vaquitas have never been held in captivity. Illegal fishing nets remain a major threat, and a conservationist urged stronger protection of their habitat. Separately, Mexico announced a fishing ban around the Revillagigedo Islands.

Value investing buys undervalued stocks with strong fundamentals; growth investing buys stocks with high growth potential, regardless of current valuation. The passage describes value as generally less volatile and more likely to pay dividends, while growth offers greater potential appreciation alongside greater risk. Its backtests found that growth outperformed value in the periods examined, but cited longer-term data showing value ahead since 1926. It also reports that a weekly strategy rotating between value and growth based on short-term momentum outperformed either factor alone in a backtest beginning in 2000, with lower volatility and drawdown. The trading rules are available only to Silver members.

Manuel and Esther Kay sued CIT for liquidating collateral they had pledged to secure their corporations’ debts. The court held that interest continued to accrue during the corporations’ bankruptcy proceedings because those proceedings were dismissed without discharging the debts. The Kays’ guarantees covered that interest, and CIT could apply their collateral to the factoring debt and outstanding term loan. CIT’s settlement with another guarantor did not reduce Mr. Kay’s liability. The court also dismissed two claims added in an amended complaint as time-barred. It granted CIT partial summary judgment but could not determine the exact remaining balance on the record.

At CinemaCon, Sony Pictures chairman Tom Rothman told theater owners the studio is committed to both global franchises and original films for varied audiences. Quentin Tarantino and Leonardo DiCaprio appeared to discuss the still-unfilmed “Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,” set in 1969. Sony also previewed “Venom,” “The Girl in the Spider’s Web” and “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse,” and announced a “Jumanji” sequel for December 2019. Stars promoted “Holmes & Watson,” “Miss Bala” and “White Boy Rick,” with Gina Rodriguez emphasizing the importance of Latino moviegoers.

The speaker accepts the Democratic presidential nomination and praises vice-presidential nominee Senator Barkley. He credits Democrats with rising farm income, wages and national income, and supports international cooperation and a bipartisan foreign policy. He criticizes the Republican-controlled 80th Congress for failing to address prices, housing, education, health care and civil rights, among other issues, while passing tax and labor laws he opposes. He announces a special congressional session for July 26 to seek action on these measures, arguing that the Republicans’ response will test their platform promises. He urges Democrats to unite and win the election.

The passage examines how local and non-local magnetic correlations affect electronic bands in paramagnetic iron, CrO₂, CrTe₂ and CrSb using DFT+DMFT. Near their magnetic transition temperatures, non-local correlations substantially increase band splitting in iron and CrO₂. In CrTe₂ and CrSb, whose d states are closer to half filling, local correlations already produce strong splitting; non-local effects are small in CrTe₂ but increase splitting in CrSb. The resulting dispersive bands have no definite spin polarization. The authors note that their density-density approximation overestimates magnetic transition temperatures.

The passage lists archival records from March and early April 1983 concerning U.S.–Soviet relations. It identifies memoranda and Moscow telegrams, their sources, classifications, circulation, and drafting or clearance details. Several records indicate that Shultz, Reagan, or Hill saw particular documents. The final entry notes Reagan’s initials on a report summarizing British Foreign Minister Pym’s rebuttal to a Gromyko press conference.

The passage presents Assesly.AI, a computer science lab management system that generates distinct questions from faculty-selected topics and difficulty levels. Students complete coding tasks and an AI-led viva; faculty can monitor performance and override automated grades. The system uses a synthetic dataset of about 10,000 machine-learning and AI questions to fine-tune a Code Llama question generator, while an XGBoost-based evaluator scores submissions. Reported results show close alignment between AI and faculty grades, with a Pearson correlation of 0.914, a cross-validation RMSE of 3.37 marks, and an R² of 0.861. Larger grading errors occurred mainly in sequence-heavy labs.

Berkshire Hills Bancorp reported first-quarter 2018 core earnings of $0.65 per share, up 18% year over year, and GAAP earnings of $0.55 per share. Its core return on assets was 1.04%, and its efficiency ratio remained below 60%. Loan growth was 4% annualized, while average deposits rose 3% from the fourth quarter. The company completed its Commerce systems integration in March and reported positive customer reception and stronger-than-expected deposit retention.

For the second quarter, management projected core earnings of about $0.70 per share, GAAP earnings of about $0.65 per share, and noninterest income growth of roughly 10%. It maintained its full-year target of 17%–20% core earnings-per-share growth. Management said its priority was to improve growth and profitability across its existing markets rather than seek acquisitions.

CLSA raised its Arvind price target from Rs 440 to Rs 538, retaining a buy rating. It expects the proposed brands-and-retail demerger and a shift toward less capital-intensive textiles businesses to create value.

The Triangle Game uses wing shooters and inside screens to create scoring opportunities. It works best with physically strong players who can set and use screens; wing shooting helps spread the defense. The offense includes skip passes, back screens, back cuts and lob passes. Players adjust to defensive positioning with post seals, shots, ball reversals, slips and cuts, or releases from double teams. Late-game options include staggered and cross screens, a point isolation, and single-double and side screens.

The speaker urges Congress to regulate large corporations engaged in interstate commerce through national action, arguing that state supervision is inadequate. The goal is to prevent monopolies, unfair discrimination, fraudulent overcapitalization, and other harmful practices—not to eliminate corporations, wealth, or legitimate enterprise. The speaker recommends a reasonable, effective law under Congress’s commerce power and, if that proves insufficient, a constitutional amendment.
Tesla Motors filed a Form 8-K reporting that it published a press release on July 2, 2015, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The release was furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01.

A June 2001 collection of news reports covers California’s energy crisis, including proposed wholesale price caps, investigations into alleged market manipulation, and plans to rescue Southern California Edison. Other reports describe expected awards of Saudi gas projects to ExxonMobil and Shell; negotiations over Enron’s Dabhol power project in India; Fitch’s negative outlook for India; foreign companies buying shares in their Indian affiliates; former Enron executive Thomas E. White becoming secretary of the Army; and construction of a Mississippi power plant involving an Enron subsidiary.

The paper studies boundedness of Bergman-type projections on tube domains over symmetric cones and their products. It defines weighted analytic spaces, mixed-norm Bergman spaces, and the Bergman projection and its reproducing kernel. It also announces a sharp decomposition theorem for a Bergman space on a tube domain and poses related problems for harmonic function spaces. The preliminaries introduce symmetric and irreducible cones, their determinant functions, and associated Jordan algebras.

The passage describes two ways to defend the Zipper offense. In the NBA-style “show and recover” approach, defenders steer the point guard toward the weaker hand, disrupt cutters using down screens, then recover to deny passes, drives, and shots. The “SOS” approach aims to disrupt the offense by trapping the point guard near the sideline, then rotating as passes leave the ball handler’s hands. Both approaches emphasize coordinated coverage of the low post and passing lanes.

GEM reconstructs a shared 3D protein density from noisy cryo-EM particle images using 3D Gaussians. It projects the Gaussians into 2D, compares the projections with observed images, and limits gradient calculations to Gaussians affecting each pixel. On four datasets, GEM achieved resolutions better than 3 Å while using less memory and training faster than the compared methods, with reported speedups of up to 48×.

Labour MP Ben Bradshaw called Conservative MP Johnny Mercer’s claim that Jeremy Corbyn posed a greater threat to the UK than ISIS, Russia or North Korea “absurd.” Mercer and Labour MP Luke Pollard also opposed reports that Plymouth-based warships HMS Albion and HMS Bulwark could be withdrawn from service. Pollard warned that losing them alongside HMS Ocean would damage naval capabilities and local jobs. The Ministry of Defence said no decisions had been made and described discussion of the options as speculation.

A computational study of ethylene formation from two methylene units on gold surfaces found that layer thickness affects adsorption, reaction pathways and energetics. Reactants and products bind more strongly to a gold monolayer than to three layers. The monolayer reaction is more favorable and has a much lower activation energy (4.78 versus 52.10 kJ mol−1); the three-layer pathway involves more fragment rotation.

AMD’s TMPM guidance recommends moving at least 16 pages per command, with peak performance at 128 pages, keeping the command ring buffer supplied, and requesting completion interrupts at the end of command sequences rather than after every command. System activity can reduce performance.

The guide describes driver initialization, queue control, interrupts, firmware reload, and page-migration commands. Ring-buffer and argument pages, along with specified IOMMU structures, cannot be migrated. Page moves require aligned physical addresses, and software must prevent conflicting page-table updates during TMPM operations.

PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO can migrate eligible pages used by DMA devices and update IOMMU host page-table entries; PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST migrates SNP guest pages but does not support DMA to those pages during migration. Firmware reload requires operations to stop and the ring buffer to be torn down; the replacement firmware must be the same or a newer version. Command and migration-entry errors are reported through status fields, while ring-buffer and hardware errors may require software intervention.

Coach Sutter said both teams played well, but his team needed to finish more of its chances against the New York Rangers. He said momentum rarely carries beyond a game and that the team’s preparation depends on its schedule, not its morning skate. He described one player as consistent and effective in his role, called Jeff Carter a top player, and compared a veteran’s big-game experience and consistency to Martin Gelinas.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July, bringing its year-to-date gain to 7.8%, but fell 1.6% on the first day of August. The passage describes the longer-term market trend as healthy while warning that short-term technical indicators are weakening. It also notes a seasonal rise in volatility and credit spreads, growing portfolio concentration in tech stocks, and record-high US electricity demand.

Microsoft announced that, beginning in fiscal 2016, it would report financial results in three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Its financial statements for the quarter ending September 30, 2015, would reflect the change, with prior periods adjusted accordingly. Recast fiscal 2015 revenue was $93.58 billion, compared with $86.83 billion in 2014; operating income was $18.16 billion, compared with $27.76 billion. The recasting does not change previously reported net income, earnings per share, assets, or stockholders’ equity.

In his November 1979 campaign announcement, Reagan called for a long-range diplomatic strategy and a North American accord with Canada and Mexico. He criticized government policies, declining defense strength, industrial competitiveness, and currency stability, while urging leadership that would strengthen individual liberty, family, and other institutions. In a later statement on Carter’s State of the Union address, Reagan criticized Carter’s response to the crises in Afghanistan and Iran, arguing that his warnings to the Soviet Union were too vague and that grain embargoes and an Olympic boycott were inadequate.

At its June 10, 2015 annual meeting, Amazon.com shareholders elected ten directors and ratified Ernst & Young LLP as auditor for 2015. They rejected proposals on proxy access, political contributions, sustainability reporting, and human rights risks.

At NVIDIA’s June 2, 2022 annual meeting, stockholders elected 13 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor, increased authorized common shares from 4 billion to 8 billion, and added 51.5 million shares to the 2007 Equity Incentive Plan’s reserve.

Ray Whitney said the team remains in a good position despite a tough loss. He cited a bad start and penalties, but said they must move on to the next game. He defended the goaltender, saying the team wins and loses together. If an injured player cannot play, others will have to fill in. Whitney said each game stands on its own.

The North Carolina Aquarium at Pine Knoll Shores hosted “Suds for Sharks” with Crystal Coast Brewing Company to fund research into where sand tiger sharks gather and develop a system for local divers to catalogue them.

ICRA said the 2018–19 budget’s 20.8 percent increase in infrastructure outlay to Rs. 5.97 lakh crore would boost the rural economy through investments in roads, housing, sanitation, irrigation and water supply. It also called for deeper bond markets to finance infrastructure and said NHAI may need to monetise assets to fund highway development.

At a news conference in Accra marking the African Union Day of the African Child, Ghanaian officials reaffirmed their commitment to child protection, citing education initiatives and new child welfare and justice policies. The Gender Ministry said it was working with other ministries to address children loitering on streets. A UNICEF representative called for protection from violence, abuse and exploitation, and equal opportunities for all children.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 1, 2017, reports net sales of $45.4 billion, up 7% from a year earlier, and net income of $8.7 billion, up from $7.8 billion. Services sales rose 22%, while Greater China sales fell 10%. For the first nine months of fiscal 2017, net sales were $176.7 billion and net income was $37.6 billion. At quarter-end, Apple reported $345.2 billion in assets and $132.4 billion in shareholders’ equity. During the quarter, it repurchased $7.5 billion of shares and paid $3.4 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents.

Former headteacher Christine Wright, featured in Channel 4’s *The Great British Skinny Dip*, disputed reports that she was fired or disciplined after someone told her employers she was a naturist. She said she experienced prejudice and was eventually granted early retirement on health grounds. Wright now works for British Naturism, helping address prejudice against naturists. The documentary follows the group’s efforts to attract people to public skinny dips and challenge misconceptions.

On-balance volume (OBV), introduced by Joseph Granville in 1963, measures buying and selling pressure by adding volume when prices close higher and subtracting it when they close lower. Differences between OBV and price trends may suggest weakening trends or potential breakouts. A backtest on the S&P 500 ETF applied a five-day RSI to OBV with a buy threshold of 30. It produced 337 trades, a 0.55% average gain per trade, a 73% win rate, a 24% maximum drawdown and a 2.09 profit factor. The article concludes that volume alone has limited value for trading strategies.

The lecture introduces systems of nonlinear equations as root-finding problems, using vapor–liquid coexistence as an example. Because exact solutions are often unavailable, iterative methods use the function norm and step norm to assess convergence, though either criterion can be misleading. Numerical results should also be validated against experiments, analytical results, or solutions obtained in other ways.

The Jacobian describes how a vector-valued function changes near a point. A nonzero Jacobian determinant at a root guarantees that the root is locally unique. Newton–Raphson uses the Jacobian to solve a linearized system and update an initial guess. It can converge rapidly when started near a locally unique root, but poor guesses or singular and ill-conditioned Jacobians can cause difficulties.

A first-year student deleted social media apps to focus on revision and in-person interaction but found the change lonely and difficult to sustain. The passage cites research linking greater social media use with a higher likelihood of depression and describes how idealized posts can affect mental health. Despite briefly returning to Twitter and occasionally checking Facebook, the author is trying to limit phone use and spend more time on creative activities and revision.

Tesla’s October 2, 2017 Form 8-K furnishes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 under results of operations and Regulation FD disclosure. The report states that the information is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act and is signed by Chief Financial Officer Deepak Ahuja.

The Supreme Court will consider whether Congressman Michael Bost has standing to challenge Illinois’s rule counting mail ballots received up to 14 days after election day if postmarked by election day. Lower courts found that his alleged vote dilution was shared by all voters, while his additional campaign costs were self-imposed and his electoral concerns speculative. Bost argues that those costs and potential harm to his electoral prospects establish standing. He also urges a broader rule allowing candidates to challenge rules governing their elections. The United States supports standing for Bost in this case but opposes his proposed blanket rule.

The study evaluated the Happy Ring’s sleep tracking in 36 healthy adults across 77 nights, comparing it with laboratory polysomnography, the at-home Dreem headband, and other wearables. Its personalized and generalized algorithms achieved sleep-wake detection accuracies of 0.92 and 0.91, respectively, in both settings. The personalized approach improved wake detection and sleep-stage classification relative to the generalized approach and other devices studied, though sleep-stage agreement remained moderate. Limitations included a small, generally healthy sample, use of a commercial device for home recordings, and undisclosed aspects of the algorithms.

Oil prices were little changed Monday after concerns about weaker Chinese demand drove early losses, while potential supply disruptions in Libya helped prices recover. Libya’s National Oil Corporation opened an investigation into security violations at the Sharara field, and workers at the Zueitina export terminal threatened to block a tanker over pay demands. Brent traded at $51.73 a barrel and U.S. crude at $48.62. China’s refinery runs fell more sharply than expected in July, adding to concerns about demand.

The Winston County Library is holding June reading programs for ages 3–5, first through fifth grades, and sixth through twelfth grades. Activities include performers, workshops and awards days; the older groups can win $50 Wal-Mart gift cards. Additional shows for children are scheduled in July. Local businesses sponsor the programs, and the Louisville Banker’s Association funds reading prizes.
The Hanover Insurance Group expects to release its second-quarter financial results after the market closes on August 1, 2018, and webcast a discussion at 8:00 a.m. ET on August 2 at hanover.com.

The author accepts the scientific consensus on climate change but, as a non-scientist, questions whether warming could also increase economic activity and CO2 emissions. They argue that independent research cannot replace climate scientists’ expertise, while suggesting that scientists’ reliance on facts and models is less persuasive than skeptics’ messaging. The post then notes a California law restricting handheld phone use while driving and promotes the author’s app, WhenHub, as a way to reduce texting on trips to meetings.

Gladstone Investment Corporation (GAIN) is a business development company that invests in debt and equity of privately held, medium-sized businesses. As of March 31, its portfolio covered 35 companies across 17 states and 18 industries. In fiscal 2017, net investment income rose 8.2%, and net asset value rose 8% to $9.95 per share. GAIN pays a monthly dividend of $0.064 per share, representing an annualized yield of about 8.3%, and also makes supplemental payments. Its fiscal 2017 distribution coverage ratio was 132%. The passage attributes its distributions to investment income and capital gains.

A woman died after an Uber self-driving vehicle struck her in Tempe, Arizona. The vehicle was in autonomous mode with an operator behind the wheel. Uber suspended its North American tests and said it was cooperating with authorities.

Suncor will release its fourth-quarter financial results on February 7, 2018, and hold a webcast reviewing them on February 8. CEO Steve Williams and CFO Alister Cowan will provide remarks, followed by a Q&A.

Congress MP Jyotiraditya Scindia will lead a 72-hour satyagraha in Bhopal starting Wednesday. About 2,000 farmers and party supporters are expected to join the protest over farmers’ killings and the state government’s policies.
