Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in chemistry for developing metal-organic frameworks. These porous structures can store gases and other chemicals, collect water from air, capture carbon dioxide and extract forever chemicals.

At Puerto Cortés in Honduras, Sergio Romero visits the Avontuur, a 97-year-old schooner. Unlike the port’s fuel-burning cargo ships, it sailed from Europe through the Caribbean using wind power, collecting and delivering small cargo along the way.

Andrew Lo uses an auction of an undisclosed iPod and book to show how limited information affects prices. He then discusses the government’s takeover of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, explaining their role in mortgage financing, the pressures they faced as the housing market declined, and the potential costs of guaranteeing their obligations.

The lecture defines an asset as a sequence of present and future cash flows. To value those flows, Lo treats money received at different times like different currencies: each amount must be converted into today’s dollars before the amounts can be added. He introduces net present value and discount rates drawn from markets, initially assuming known cash flows and frictionless conversions.

The incoming president expresses gratitude for the public’s confidence while acknowledging the responsibilities of office. He credits self-government, the Constitution, and the people’s judgment with the nation’s prosperity and urges the preservation of an informed citizenry and a strong Union. He calls for coastal defenses, moderate armed forces, and a well-trained militia; constitutionally sanctioned roads and canals; support for domestic manufacturing; and friendly relations with Indian tribes. He also advocates paying the national debt, ensuring accountability for public funds, preserving peace through fair dealings with other nations, and promoting harmony among the states.

The November 7, 2000, VentureWire reports Broadcom’s acquisition of SiByte for up to $2 billion, Alta Partners’ plans for a roughly $300 million fund, Furniture.com’s shutdown, and eStellarNet’s $30 million financing. It lists numerous other funding rounds, acquisitions, executive appointments, and venture-capital developments. Divine interVentures laid off 18 staff members, while cooking site Foodoo ceased operations after failing to secure further funding.

A CUPA-HR report finds that dedicated full-time Title IX staffing increased from 2019–20 to 2023–24, but 56% of surveyed institutions still had no such position. Title IX staff are most often located in human resources or student affairs, and dedicated positions are most common at doctoral institutions. Women hold 77% of Title IX positions; median salaries for these roles exceed the median for higher education professionals overall. The report recommends that institutions reassess Title IX responsibilities and staffing as regulations change.
The speaker says the team needs to play together and act on its discussions. Despite key injuries, other players have stepped up; Griz and Z’s return remains uncertain.

Berkshire Hathaway sold its 10.6 million General Electric shares in the second quarter, exiting an investment Warren Buffett made during the 2008 financial crisis that generated more than $1 billion in profit. The sale coincided with GE’s leadership transition and a nearly 20% decline in its shares this year. Berkshire also bought Synchrony Financial shares and increased its holdings in Bank of New York Mellon and Apple. Other filings showed Appaloosa Management exited an S&P 500 fund, George Soros bought a Nasdaq-100 fund stake, and Viking Global Investors purchased Wells Fargo shares.

A Dueitt Middle School teacher is on administrative leave while Spring ISD investigates an allegation that he used a racial slur to describe African American students. A parent reported the incident, and other students confirmed hearing the remark. The parent praised the district’s response.

Gary Allen Darnell, 45, a convicted sex offender, was arrested Thursday in Grafton after allegedly offering fishing poles to children near the river. He was charged with felony loitering within 500 feet of a park. Prosecutors plan to seek the maximum penalty if he is convicted.

SOS side-screen defense varies by screen location. Below the free throw line, defenders trap the ballhandler before the screen, then rotate to deny passes and cover the post. Above it, they use an aggressive contact switch to prevent quick shots and middle penetration, followed by pass denial and pressure on the ballhandler. The “All Out” approach traps the point guard before a screen or pass, then rotates to match up or trap a post pass. Rotations occur as the ball leaves the passer’s hands.

His Majesty asks the United States to formally recognize his kingdom as sovereign and independent. He argues that foreign consuls and naval commanders have already treated it as such, while its government has developed written language, schools, laws, a representative monarchy, and courts. He also contends that the islands’ independence serves commercial nations because they are a center for whaling and a valuable Pacific stop for ship repairs and supplies.

Whitman Howard raised its Produce Investments price target from GBX 210 to GBX 240 and maintained a buy rating. Shore Capital and Numis Securities also reiterated buy ratings. Shares reached GBX 187 on Thursday, up 0.54%. The company declared a GBX 5.03 dividend payable December 5. Produce Investments grows, sources, packs and markets potatoes, daffodils and flowers.

A February 2024 questionnaire surveyed 65 kindergarten teachers in Piraeus about visual arts education. Most viewed visual arts as important for children’s creativity, imagination, emotional expression and social skills, although 89.2% had no specialized training. Teachers described using varied materials and approaches, particularly free exploration. They identified classroom management and limited resources as barriers. The study recommends targeted training and better supplies and spaces, while noting that its online questionnaire limited deeper understanding of teachers’ views.

A German Ambassador said Germany was willing to state its peace terms confidentially, including restoring Belgium and Russian territory, preserving French independence, and indemnifying Belgium. He claimed Britain hesitated to state its terms because its allies’ demands were infeasible, while lesser terms would cause disagreement, and suggested American pressure might prompt Britain to disclose them.

In a separate response, Greece welcomed the U.S. peace initiative but said violations of its neutrality, disarmament, a blockade, and restricted communications prevented it from taking a more active role. Greece expressed hope for the initiative’s success and willingness to join future efforts to secure a stable peace and states’ sovereignty.

At Camp Lejeune, Task-Force-Southwest Marines practiced using Instant-Eye drones before a planned Afghanistan deployment, while 2nd Law Enforcement Battalion trained with grenades. The Marine Corps presented 91-year-old Iwo Jima veteran Lee Anderson with a Purple Heart.

Hampton and Newport News police apprehended a 15-year-old after a January 31 robbery at a Tinee Giant store. A witness reported following a Ford SUV and seeing someone inside fire shots. Police found the teen near the SUV with a handgun. He faces firearm and tobacco charges but has not been charged with the robbery.

The passage argues that although college faculty have long skewed left politically, “viewpoint diversity” has no consistent definition. It says the Trump administration is offering federal grant advantages to universities that adopt specified policies, while students increasingly consider campus politics when choosing colleges. The author warns that tying funding to the administration’s agenda could undermine, rather than foster, a diversity of ideas.

The coach praised Corey Perry’s success in major junior hockey, playoff experience and effectiveness with the puck. He said extra players practice with the team so they can learn what is expected in pressure situations. A player with a hand injury remains unavailable pending medical clearance and an assessment of his readiness. Looking ahead to Ottawa, the coach emphasized a strong start, composure despite the home crowd, and moving on quickly after each game. He said the team’s leadership, willingness to sacrifice and commitment to its system have helped it overcome adversity, and urged players to make the most of their Stanley Cup opportunity.

Three University of Dayton students reported a man entering their bedrooms early Wednesday at separate residences. One said he tried to restrain her before she escaped. The man reportedly entered through windows or an unsecured door. University police are collecting evidence and investigating.

A Sarasota couple was arrested after accepting an intercepted package containing carfentanil, a synthetic opioid the DEA says is 10,000 times more potent than morphine. Detectives also found more than 7 grams of fentanyl and other drugs in their home. Both face drug charges and were released on bond.

On November 18, 2022, Amazon entered into a 364-day unsecured revolving credit agreement providing up to $10 billion in borrowing capacity, with an option to extend it for another 364 days. The initial interest rate is the Secured Overnight Financing Rate plus 0.45%, with a 0.05% fee on undrawn funds. Borrowings will support general corporate purposes, including its commercial paper program. The agreement has no financial covenants.

The speaker describes growing national prosperity, citing abundant harvests, expanding agriculture and commerce, and strong subscriptions to the Bank of the United States. On the western frontier, peace efforts with Indian tribes continue alongside military operations against hostile groups. The speaker urges fair treatment, regulated land transfers, equitable trade, and penalties for violations of tribal rights.

The distilled-spirits tax has been implemented, though some discontent and possible need for revisions remain. A permanent government district has been designated along the Potomac, and the census indicates a population near four million. Loans have been arranged in Holland, debt subscriptions have largely met expectations, and existing revenues appear sufficient for current purposes. Congress is asked to consider spending needs, the remaining debt, militia and defenses, postal routes, a mint, uniform weights and measures, and the sale of public lands.

The passage describes a display device with sensing lines around its display area and, in some embodiments, its bending area. During testing, changes in line resistance caused by cracks or other damage can produce visible differences in pixel brightness. Static electricity discharge elements, including capacitors connected to the sensing circuitry, protect its switching elements and help prevent false defect detections.

Amazon selected Fidelity Investments as the new recordkeeper for its 401(k) plan. During the expected January 2–week of January 12, 2020 blackout period, participants will be unable to make certain account changes, take loans, or request withdrawals or distributions. Amazon also notified its Section 16 officers and directors of related trading restrictions.

Alexander Zverev reached the French Open third round after a five-set win over Dusan Lajovic, moving closer to his first Grand Slam quarterfinal. Grigor Dimitrov and Kei Nishikori also recovered from two-sets-to-one deficits, while Novak Djokovic beat qualifier Jaume Munar in straight sets. Dominic Thiem led Stefanos Tsitsipas when darkness halted their match. In the women’s draw, top-ranked Simona Halep overcame a slow start to beat Alison Riske, and Petra Kvitova and Elina Svitolina advanced in straight sets.

Editors of the *Foreign Relations* series have access to retired State Department records and conduct research in restricted records at the Reagan Library and other agencies. The volume’s published material is declassified, though some comes from documents that remain partly classified. State Department records will become available at the National Archives after transfer, declassification, and processing. Scanning for the Remote Archive Capture project sometimes made it unclear whether attachments accompanied original documents. Documents are arranged chronologically by Washington time and reproduced as closely as possible, with editorial changes and omissions marked. Footnotes identify sources, original classification and drafting details, and relevant background.

A cross-sectional study of 225 tenth- and eleventh-grade students at an Istanbul science high school found a weak positive correlation between physical activity and self-esteem. Students reporting regular exercise had higher self-esteem, as did males and students reporting greater school success. Height was weakly correlated with self-esteem; BMI was not. Because the study examined a specific school population, it did not establish whether physical activity causes higher self-esteem.

The ADS868xW has an AVDD alarm and an input alarm with programmable thresholds and hysteresis. In the thermistor example, hysteresis helps prevent noise near temperature limits from causing incorrect alarms. The device uses separate AVDD and DVDD supplies; decoupling capacitors improve power-supply rejection. NAP and power-down modes reduce consumption at lower throughput rates. PCB guidance emphasizes separating analog and digital signals, clean supplies, short ground connections, and close placement of bypass and reference capacitors. The passage also provides support and documentation information, ESD precautions, revision history, packaging notes, and TI’s disclaimers.

The passage describes methods for decoding wireless control and data channels after beam failure recovery, before updated channel-status information arrives. A user equipment may temporarily assume a quasi-co-located relationship with the newly selected beam or use only the channel’s own reference signal. Once updated configuration is received, it uses that configuration. The methods aim to reduce signaling overhead and improve performance.

The commentary recommends five ways to help children move beyond one-word answers and develop curiosity: ask specific, open-ended questions; engage with their questions; model asking questions; show how to find answers when you don’t know; and listen closely, clarify what they mean and ask follow-ups. It argues that genuine interest and attention can give children more confidence to ask and answer questions.

Researchers who tested blood samples from more than 2,800 people in Toronto found evidence consistent with celiac disease in about one per cent, with an estimated 90 per cent of cases undiagnosed. The findings align with studies in other countries, but blood tests alone cannot confirm the disease; a biopsy is the diagnostic standard. Testing should occur while a person is eating gluten to avoid false negatives. Researchers say studies in other provinces are needed to determine whether the findings represent Canada as a whole.

The passage describes a system that uses automated insulin delivery records to update basal insulin settings for manual or open-loop use. It calculates the proportion of insulin delivered as basal doses and, if that proportion exceeds a threshold, determines a modified basal dosage for a subsequent period. The system may account for meal boluses, time-of-day patterns, glucose readings and hypoglycemia risk before sending instructions to an insulin pump.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point to 1%–1.25% and said it expects to begin gradually reducing its $4.5 trillion balance sheet this year. U.S. stocks reacted modestly: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell, while the Dow slipped after reaching an intraday record. Weak May inflation and retail-sales data sent Treasury yields and the dollar lower. Oil settled down 3.7% after a report showed rising gasoline supplies and crude production, weighing on energy shares. Gold rose, while European stocks slipped and Asian markets closed mixed.

Schneider Electric introduced a prefabricated Edge Module for deploying computing infrastructure at cell tower sites and other remote locations. The self-contained module combines power, cooling, software and IT components, with configurable racks and power options. Its EcoStruxure platform supports remote monitoring and control, while optional security features include locks, cameras and card readers.

The court affirmed dismissal of former alien enemies’ suit to recover property seized during World War I. Public Resolution No. 53 postponed delivery of property under the Trading with the Enemy Act while Germany remained in arrears. Applying a Supreme Court ruling, the court held that Congress could suspend the right to recover seized property and that the plaintiffs’ allegation of an illegal seizure did not change the result.

The passage defines internal pull states and describes boot-configuration pins shared with GPMC functions. At reset, BTMODE[10] selects GPMC pin-mux options for XIP boot modes, BTMODE[9:8] determines Ethernet PHY mode during EMAC boot, and BTMODE[4:0] determines the ARM boot configuration. After reset, these pins function as GPMC multiplexed data/address pins.

At its developer conference, OpenAI introduced a preview SDK for building third-party apps that run inside ChatGPT. Demonstrations showed Canva and Zillow responding to chat requests, while distribution remains limited to select partners. CEO Sam Altman said OpenAI plans to add in-chat purchasing, but the company did not disclose revenue-sharing terms. OpenAI also unveiled AgentKit for building AI agents and announced broader availability and new tools for its Codex coding model. The announcements reflect its effort to attract developers and make ChatGPT a platform for interacting with other apps amid competition from rival AI providers.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Friday as stronger-than-expected job and wage growth raised inflation and interest-rate concerns, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since January 2014. The Dow lost 665.75 points, or 2.54 percent, its largest point drop since December 2008. The S&P 500 fell 2.12 percent and the Nasdaq 1.96 percent; all three indexes posted their biggest weekly losses in two years. All S&P 500 sectors declined, though Amazon gained after its earnings report.

Tail risk refers to rare, extreme outcomes that occur more often than a normal distribution suggests. Investors may hedge against severe losses to protect their portfolios and avoid selling during downturns. The passage discusses put options, foreign assets, cash, diversified portfolios, trend following, and Cambria’s TAIL ETF as possible hedges. These approaches involve trade-offs: protection can reduce drawdowns, but its ongoing cost can lower long-term returns. The authors’ experience buying puts illustrates how difficult it can be to maintain a hedge while waiting for a crisis.

Photographer Mark Bickerdike has completed a years-long project documenting Ricky’s School of Rock in Linthwaite, photographing more than 50 RockJam gigs. During the school’s 10-week courses, pupils learn songs as a band before performing for friends and family. Founder Ricky Comiskey said the performances build confidence and that some pupils have gone on to form bands, including one featuring Bickerdike’s son.

Jordan L. Couch explains how generative AI creates content and agentic AI supports analysis and decision-making. He describes legal uses including document review, research, drafting, and client communication, while cautioning that AI is not the best tool for every task and that nuanced judgment may remain with humans.

The Minnesota Wild signed Kirill Kaprizov to an eight-year, $136 million extension through the 2033-34 season. Its $17 million annual average and total value are NHL records. Kaprizov scored 25 goals and had 31 assists in 41 regular-season games last season despite missing 40 games with an injury. The new contract begins next season.

Real Madrid will face Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League last 16 as Madrid seek a third consecutive title. Other ties include Barcelona–Chelsea, Manchester City–Basel, Bayern Munich–Besiktas, Juventus–Tottenham, Manchester United–Sevilla, Liverpool–Porto and Shakhtar Donetsk–Roma.

The thesis examines digital services for event management and proposes a mobile application to help attendees access event information and services. Researchers assessed 200 event-management websites, including 17 Croatian and 183 foreign sites, against 103 criteria covering content, social media, support, multimedia, and technical performance. The findings identify room for improvement among Croatian organizations, particularly in user experience and social media presence. The authors recommend faster-loading websites, relevant multimedia, and more mobile applications. The study is limited to websites from selected countries; future research should consider customers’ perspectives.

A qualitative study used four focus groups with 18 pre-service physical education teachers from Quebec universities to examine anticipated teaching challenges and preparation needs. Participants identified classroom management and students’ lack of motivation as their main concerns. Specific motivational challenges included differing student needs and interests, designing engaging activities, encouraging participation, managing disengagement, and gender differences. They wanted more guidance on planning and implementing motivational strategies, clearer links between course content and student motivation, and more opportunities to practise. The authors note that the small, Quebec-only sample is not representative of all pre-service physical education teachers.

A Tom Thomson sketch that had been given away as a gag gift sold for $481,250 at a Toronto auction after experts authenticated it. The 118-work auction raised $14.1 million. Paul-Emile Borduas’s “Figures schematiques” led sales at $3.6 million, setting an artist auction record; works by Lawren Harris and Jack Bush also exceeded expectations.

The lecture develops the correspondence between boundary operators and gravity fields in AdS. For a scalar field, its mass determines the scaling dimension of the dual operator through the field’s behavior near the boundary. The lecture discusses the BF bound, which permits some negative mass-squared values without instability, and the boundary conditions needed for quantization. Normalizable modes represent states of a boundary theory; non-normalizable modes act as sources that deform the theory. In standard quantization, the scalar’s dimension is \(\Delta\); alternative quantization exchanges the roles of the two boundary modes and gives dimension \(d-\Delta\). Massless, negative-mass-squared, and positive-mass-squared scalars correspond respectively to marginal, relevant, and irrelevant operators in standard quantization. Finally, the lecture relates the boundary theory’s generating functional to a gravity partition function, evaluated using classical solutions in the semiclassical limit.

Lindsay Gottlieb said a Southwest Airlines employee asked her to prove she was the mother of her biracial 1-year-old son during a flight from Denver to Oakland. She offered his passport but said the employee requested a Facebook post instead. Gottlieb suspected her son’s skin color prompted the questioning. Southwest apologized and said its policy requires age verification for children flying on a parent’s lap, but domestic travel does not require matching last names.

Box beat first-quarter expectations with an adjusted loss of 7 cents per share, revenue of $140.5 million and billings of $116.7 million. It added about 3,000 paying customers, bringing its total to 85,000. Its second-quarter forecasts also exceeded analysts’ estimates, but shares fell 4.6% after hours.

OPEC and non-OPEC producers plan to announce a strategy in June for exiting oil supply cuts, UAE Energy Minister Suhail al-Mazroui said, stressing that the pact would not necessarily end then. He said it was too early to specify the strategy. Russia has called for a gradual exit, and its energy minister estimated withdrawal could take three to six months. Producers are cutting supply by about 1.8 million barrels per day.

The VIX measures implied volatility in S&P 500 options and generally moves opposite to the stock market. The passage describes using it as a mean-reversion indicator: rising VIX may signal buying stocks, while falling VIX may signal selling. One proposed strategy buys SPY or ES when the VIX crosses its upper Bollinger Band and exits after two up days. The author recommends backtesting such strategies.
Nigeria’s annual inflation fell to 16.25% in May from 17.28% in April, while monthly inflation rose to 1.88%. Food inflation eased slightly to 19.27%.

The paper presents an algorithm for computing Nash equilibria in multiplayer imperfect-information games. It extends the sequence-form representation to a nonlinear complementarity problem, then solves it as a quadratically constrained feasibility program. On three-player Kuhn poker with dominated actions removed, it found an essentially exact equilibrium in 2.47 seconds. Gambit’s applicable logit quantal-response method took 43 seconds and produced an approximation. The new algorithm could not solve the full game within 24 hours, while logit tracing produced a solution in several minutes. Tests on random strategic-form games also found the new formulation faster than a prior direct mixed-integer approach.

Nicholas T. P. Simmonds won a judgment for 117 acres and rents, which the appellate court affirmed. The court held that an old land-certificate transfer was admissible, sufficiently identified the certificate, and carried a conclusive presumption of the agent’s authority. It upheld the exclusion of a third party’s ownership affidavit, a later augmentation certificate, and testimony about the defendant’s character for truth. The court found the jury’s verdict supported by the evidence.

Thomas Scullun contracted to command the bark *Cape Horn Pigeon* for a share of the voyage’s net proceeds. The vessel cleared San Francisco for a whaling voyage on December 7, 1891, and Scullun swore that its cargo manifest was accurate and its cargo intended for whaling. A Russian naval lieutenant detained the vessel in 1892 after suspecting it had visited bays closed to foreign fishing. Scullun gave a different account of the reason for the arrest. An investigation found no grounds for confiscation, attributed the arrest to a misunderstanding, and returned the vessel to its owners.

Dusty Baker believes former Giants second baseman Jeff Kent belongs in the Baseball Hall of Fame. Eligible since 2013, Kent has received about 15 percent of votes, below the 75 percent required. Over 17 seasons, he hit 377 home runs, had eight 100-RBI seasons and won the 2002 National League MVP award.

Burlington College’s final president blamed a $10 million land purchase championed by Jane Sanders for the college’s closure. Federal authorities are examining donations used to secure the loan. Moore also criticized a woodworking-school agreement involving Sanders’ daughter.

The passage describes a digital assistant with an auditory interface for exploring media, including on devices with limited or no display. Users can refine a media request by speaking during playback. The assistant can play related media while giving a verbal response, suggest another item after a non-affirmative response, and request more input after repeated non-affirmative responses. It can also combine the preference profiles of multiple users who are physically present to select media. The passage describes methods, software, devices, and client-server implementations, and states that these features can reduce user inputs and improve efficiency.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth summoned hundreds of generals and admirals from around the world to argue for changes to a military he called soft and “woke.”
QuantifiedStrategies.com offers TradingView strategies that customers can select for translation into Pinescript. Visitors can request strategies or availability notifications. Trading involves risk.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2019 reports net sales of $59.7 billion, up 17% from a year earlier, and net income of $3.56 billion, up from $1.63 billion. Operating income rose to $4.42 billion. North America and AWS reported operating income of $2.29 billion and $2.22 billion, respectively, while International reported a $90 million operating loss. Operating cash flow was $1.85 billion, compared with a $1.79 billion outflow in the prior-year quarter. The filing also discusses lease-accounting changes, contractual commitments, tax disputes, and legal proceedings.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 GPU architecture and CUDA 11 features for AI and high-performance computing. A100 has 108 streaming multiprocessors, third-generation Tensor Cores supporting additional numeric formats, and 2:4 structured sparsity that doubles Tensor Core compute throughput by skipping zeros. Its memory system includes 40 GB of HBM2, a 40 MB L2 cache, and controls for caching frequently reused data. Asynchronous copies and barriers, along with accelerated CUDA task graphs, reduce data-movement and execution overhead.

Multi-Instance GPU can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, and improved fault handling support multi-GPU and shared deployments. The passage also covers decoding and optical-flow hardware, the eight-GPU DGX A100 system, and NVIDIA’s software tools.

The circuit must output a logic-high alert when the amplifier output exceeds 1.1 V. Place a low-ESR 0.1 µF ceramic bypass capacitor close to each device’s supply pin to prevent ringing and false triggers. The device supports single or split supplies; keep inputs within the recommended range and minimize output-to-input coupling.

The 20-day EMA strategy buys when price rises above the EMA and sells when it falls below. In a backtest on SPY, it produced low returns and a significant drawdown. Adding an undisclosed indicator improved returns but not drawdown. The basic strategy performed better in a Bitcoin backtest.

A Qualcomm blog post that was later removed revealed an upcoming Asus Zenfone AR, reportedly the second consumer-facing Google Tango phone and the first to also support Daydream View. It uses a Snapdragon 821 processor. Pricing and availability were not disclosed; more details were expected at CES. Asus also teased another Zenfone with a “world’s best processor.”

The IMF’s Ukraine mission chief said the country’s pension system is unsustainable, runs at a loss and supports 30 percent of the population. He urged reforms, including fewer early retirements and stronger collection of pension taxes, but did not explicitly demand a higher retirement age. Ukraine’s government opposes raising the age, an unpopular measure that would face parliamentary resistance. Pension reform is part of broader changes sought as Ukraine seeks further IMF funding.

Iron sulfate heptahydrate, also called ferrous sulfate heptahydrate or copperas, is water-soluble and produced during titanium dioxide manufacturing. It is used to treat iron deficiency and iron chlorosis, purify water, remove phosphates from sewage, reduce chromium ions in cement, and supply iron in agriculture. Its moisture can make crystals stick together, while acidic liquid may damage storage containers.

The lecture explains the asymptotic equipartition property: for long sequences from a discrete memoryless source, typical sequences contain nearly all the probability, have roughly equal probabilities, and number about \(2^{nH(X)}\). This makes entropy central to source coding.

It then introduces Markov sources, whose outputs depend on state transitions. For ergodic Markov chains, steady-state probabilities are unique and approached from any initial state. Coding blocks while using the previous state can bring the expected length close to the conditional entropy \(H(X\mid S)\).

Finally, the lecture describes LZ77 as a universal compression algorithm that needs no predefined probability model. It encodes the length and location of the longest match in a sliding window, or sends a symbol uncompressed when needed. For Markov sources, its asymptotic bits per symbol approach \(H(X\mid S)\); window size also affects processing demands and adaptation to changing statistics.

The Toronto Raptors beat the Portland Trail Blazers 130-105 on Friday, ending Portland’s four-game winning streak. DeMar DeRozan scored 35 points and matched his career high with six 3-pointers as Toronto made a season-high 19. Damian Lillard scored 32 points and became the fastest player in Trail Blazers history to reach 10,000 career points.

Speaking to West Point cadets near the end of his presidency, Bush said the Cold War’s end created opportunities for democracy but did not eliminate threats. He argued that the United States should lead internationally without becoming the world’s policeman. Military force, he said, requires judgment, achievable goals, and attention to costs and human consequences; he cited Iraq and Somalia as cases for intervention and explained his caution over Yugoslavia. He emphasized the need for a capable military, praised the volunteer force’s leadership and training, and urged cadets to value service, duty, honor, and country.

A Manhattan grand jury indicted Harvey Weinstein on first- and third-degree rape charges and a first-degree criminal sexual act charge involving two women. Weinstein did not testify before the grand jury on his lawyers’ advice. Manhattan District Attorney Cyrus Vance Jr said the case would be tried in court.

The passage argues that the Okhotsk Sea should be treated as open sea, not subject to exclusive jurisdiction. It cites a treaty protecting navigation, fishing, and trade in the Pacific, and an arbitration decision finding that Russia had limited its Bering Sea jurisdiction to cannon-shot range from shore. It also cites legal authorities who held that seas connected to oceans remain open to other nations, even when bordered by one state.

The passage establishes a hierarchy of quantum replica advantage: for a broad class of observables, estimating nonlinear properties of a quantum state requires exponentially many samples with at most \(k\)-replica measurements, but is efficient with \((k+1)\)-replica measurements. Its main tool is an indistinguishability principle for ensembles assembled from Haar-random states. The principle also yields lower bounds for spectrum and rank testing under bounded-replica measurements. An upper bound shows that fewer than \((k+1)\) replicas can match the lower bound’s dependence on state dimension, though not its efficient sample complexity.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs and related technologies. GDDR6X uses PAM4 signaling and transition-avoidance encoding to reach data rates of 19.5 Gbps and peak bandwidth of 936 GB/sec. RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move loading and decompression work from the CPU to the GPU.

Ampere GPUs feature improved shading, ray tracing and AI processing, support high-resolution displays, and include hardware video decoding and encoding. GA10x also supports AV1 hardware decoding. The passage outlines GeForce RTX 30-series cards and the A40 and RTX A6000 professional GPUs, including their memory, performance and virtualization features. Error Detection and Replay on the GDDR6X interface retries failed memory transmissions and can help users identify when overclocking performance has plateaued. The final sections provide testing notes and NVIDIA’s specification, warranty and liability terms.

Coach Quenneville praised his team’s season-long consistency, four dependable lines, improved defense and goaltending. He said Johnny contributes through his two-way play despite lower scoring, Bolly handles defensive responsibility while offering offensive skill, and Dunks can sustain heavy minutes. He also praised Shaw’s competitiveness and Corey’s steady goaltending alongside Ray Emery. Quenneville said the team responded well to playoff adversity against Detroit and has continued to improve. He discussed lineup changes, matchups, rest between games and two overtime too-many-men penalties. He also expressed appreciation for coaching in Chicago and being part of the Blackhawks organization.

Vertex Resource Group acquired an Edmonton-area hydro-vac services business for $4.3 million. The 11 additional units double Vertex’s hydro-vac fleet and expand its services into the Edmonton region. The transaction closed June 30, 2018, and the acquired business began operating as Vertex. Based on historical financial information, Vertex expects the acquisition to add approximately $5 million in annual revenue, though it cautions that this estimate is subject to risks and uncertainties.

A *Texas Monthly* article forwarded among Enron employees traces the company’s rise from a pipeline operator to a major energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. It describes Skilling’s emphasis on rapid growth, aggressive recruiting and performance rankings, and short-term profits. By 2001, Enron faced criticism over California’s energy crisis, costly projects, a struggling telecommunications business and its accounting practices. Its stock fell, Skilling resigned after six months as CEO, and Lay returned, promising a greater focus on Enron’s core business.

The lower 32kB of flash supports higher erase/program endurance for EEPROM emulation; this applies to all flash on devices with 32kB or less. Erase and write limits and program-time measurements are defined.

Addressing the Foreign Service Institute, the speaker says its students’ task abroad is to work for peace. He credits NATO’s collective military strength and political unity with deterring war in the Atlantic community. NATO should adapt to changing circumstances, he argues, but reform should come through consultation among its members rather than isolation or independent action. The United States will work with its allies to preserve and strengthen NATO’s deterrent. He calls for continued unity and human solidarity, which he says offer hope for reconciliation between Western and Eastern Europe.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2019 Form 10-K describes its software, cloud services, devices, gaming, and advertising businesses. It reports three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Its strategy focuses on productivity, the intelligent cloud and edge, and personal computing, supported by investments in AI, infrastructure, and research. Microsoft completed its GitHub acquisition in October 2018 and employed approximately 144,000 people as of June 30, 2019. The filing identifies risks including intense competition, cloud execution, cybersecurity, data privacy, product quality, intellectual property disputes, and regulatory compliance.

The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card offers 0% introductory APR for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 16.99%, 23.49%, or 28.74%. It has no annual fee and includes cellphone protection, but offers no ongoing rewards. Balance transfers cost 5% (minimum $5), and foreign transactions incur a 3% fee. It is aimed at people paying off debt or financing a large purchase.

A penalty-kick shoot-out determines a winner when competition rules require one after a tied match. Eligible players from each team alternate five kicks from the penalty mark, unless the result becomes mathematically certain sooner. If still tied, teams continue in paired sudden-death kicks until one scores and the other misses. Players must each kick before anyone takes a second turn, and teams must have equal numbers of eligible participants. The referee oversees the procedure, coin tosses and results. The passage advises coaches to prepare kickers and goalkeepers through practice, establish a kicking order, account for substitutions and fatigue, and support players before and after the shoot-out.

On June 24, 2020, Tesla entered a 90-day agreement under which CEO Elon Musk would provide up to $100 million in directors’ and officers’ indemnity coverage from his personal funds when Tesla could not indemnify it. Tesla will pay Musk $972,361 and may pay more based on a discounted, prorated market insurance quote it intends to obtain while evaluating longer-term coverage options.

Sony says the Xperia XZ Premium will receive Android Oreo later in 2017, though it has not confirmed a date. The update will add a 3D scanning app, smile-detecting predictive capture, and a 10-frame-per-second burst mode that tracks moving subjects.

The court affirmed the dismissal of Patrick Sutherland’s challenge to a parole denial. It held that the Board could rely on information in his presentence report because he had not timely challenged it, and found that the Board considered the required factors and acted rationally.

The author maintains a bullish view of AGNC Investment, citing its 14%+ yield, three consecutive quarters of positive net interest income and the potential for rate cuts to lower financing costs and raise mortgage-backed securities values. AGNC trades above book value. The author discloses a long position in AGNC and Annaly.

The President calls for reforms to improve American life in the 1970s. He prioritizes a just peace in Vietnam, reduced U.S. involvement in other nations’ affairs, and negotiations with the Soviet Union and Communist China. At home, he urges welfare and government reform, broader opportunity, a balanced budget to curb inflation, stronger action against crime, environmental protection, and a national growth policy. He argues that material progress must be matched by moral leadership and public involvement.

The passage surveys Nassim Nicholas Taleb’s writings and trading ideas, emphasizing randomness, rare high-impact events, and the limits of forecasting. It explains his barbell strategy as combining low-risk holdings with smaller, high-risk positions intended to benefit from extreme events. It also describes antifragility as benefiting from shocks and “skin in the game” as bearing the consequences of one’s decisions.

Andrea Conti’s agent says the wing-back wants to join Milan and considers his time at Atalanta over. He called for the clubs to find a solution and argued that coach Gian Piero Gasperini should not block a transfer.

Coach Vigneault said the Stanley Cup Final loss was disappointing but praised his team’s effort in three overtime games and both goaltenders’ play. He said he would take time to reflect. Before the game, he said the team needed to improve on its previous performance, retain more puck possession and trust its power play despite missed chances.

Japanese developers plan to send a small, remote-controlled swimming robot into Fukushima Dai-Ichi’s Unit 3 containment vessel in July. It will use cameras and a radiation detector to assess damage and search submerged areas for melted fuel. Earlier inspection robots became stuck or failed amid high radiation. The findings are needed to plan safe fuel removal.

Malawi Heath Equity Network urged the government to deploy internal auditors to all 28 district councils, citing research that found their absence hindered financial management. A government official said deployment plans were advanced and called on councils to support the auditors. The research also found poor coordination between councils and NGOs and civil society organizations, and that rural residents were excluded from annual budget preparation.

Coach DeBoer said playing at home offers advantages, but the team must limit distractions and improve its support, puck possession and attack. He credited Pittsburgh’s speed and depth for creating matchup problems. Despite the team’s position in the series, he said it remains confident, expects momentum to shift, and will make lineup decisions on game day.

Donald Trump said U.S.–Canada trade would only be “tweaked,” but the passage notes Canada’s much greater dependence on that trade. Despite a cordial White House meeting with Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, concerns remain over agricultural disputes, softwood lumber and the potential effects of U.S. tax and regulatory changes. Trudeau avoided confrontation, while Trump spoke warmly of Canada. The leaders announced a council for women entrepreneurs and issued a joint statement supporting cooperation on trade, security and other issues.

Initial coin offerings (ICOs) raise money by selling crypto tokens, often before a network is functional. About $25 billion was raised from June 2017 to June 2018, but fundraising later slowed. Many offerings were based only on an idea, and most tokens offered in the third quarter of 2018 lacked published source code.

Gensler recommends evaluating whether a token has a viable use case, then examining the white paper, code, team, backers, community, supply policy and token distribution. He notes that buyers often expect profits, while issuers may retain tokens for later sale. Most offerings in the cited data used Ethereum, and many raised little money or failed. US securities regulators were increasingly addressing unregistered offerings.

Armed police responded to reports that a man threatened two people with a firearm at Shackleton Court in Newton Heath on Monday afternoon. After a search lasting several hours, a 26-year-old man was arrested and remained in custody.

The Santa Cruz County Board of Supervisors selected assistant county administrative officer Carlos Palacios to replace retiring County Administrative Officer Susan Mauriello. Palacios, a former Watsonville city manager, will be the county’s first Latino in the role. He will oversee 2,400 staff and an annual budget of about $720 million.

A preliminary investigation found Chicago stockyards and packing houses unclean and their food-handling methods dangerous to health. The existing law and inadequate funding prevent effective federal inspection of prepared meat products entering interstate commerce. The author urges Congress to enact the Beveridge amendment, enabling the Department of Agriculture to inspect meat throughout preparation and enforce sanitary conditions. He proposes funding inspection through a fee on each slaughtered animal, capped at 8 cents per head. Allegations involving chemicals and tainted meat remain under investigation.

The DAWn-plasma trial compared standard care plus high-antibody-titer convalescent plasma with standard care alone in adults hospitalized with COVID-19. In the primary analysis, 83.7% of plasma recipients and 84.1% of controls were alive without mechanical ventilation on day 15, a difference that was not statistically significant. No significant differences were found in secondary outcomes or adverse events. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 6.0% of plasma recipients; no TRALI cases were reported.

The passage studies when modal µ-calculus formulae can be defined or separated by simpler modal-logic formulae. ML-separability is ExpTime-complete over all models and binary trees, PSpace-complete over words, and 2-ExpTime-complete over trees of bounded outdegree at least three. It also gives algorithms for constructing separators. Modal logic has Craig interpolation over all models, words, and binary trees, but not over trees of outdegree at least three; interpolant existence there is coNExpTime-complete. In the graded setting, graded-modal-logic definability and separability are ExpTime-complete, while separation by ordinary modal logic is 2-ExpTime-complete.

A&O Shearman associate Ashley Hollis won “Big Brother” after concealing her profession and presenting herself as a social media marketing manager. She said she drew on Elle Woods and her attorney skills to prepare her winning speech. Hollis plans to give a substantial portion of her $750,000 prize to her parents and is considering buying a home.

The study analyzes 34 English-language Scopus publications from 2017–2023 on STEAM education and gamification. Publication output increased, reaching eight papers in 2022. Computer science accounted for 37.7% of the papers, and Thailand had the most publications and citations. The most-cited article received 30 citations. Common keywords included gamification, STEAM education, and computational thinking. Factorial analysis grouped topics around teaching methods, student-centered learning environments, and educational technologies. The passage reports potential benefits for student motivation and engagement but notes that findings vary and further research is needed.

Four Libyan National Army fighters have been killed and 10 wounded in Benghazi so far in December, amid continued clashes in Khreibish five months after commander Khalifa Haftar declared victory in the city.

Tharisa presented its planned phased transition from open-pit to underground mining as its open-pit resources are depleted, starting with the west mine. CEO Phoevos Pouroulis said the move follows years of planning and supports the company’s vision for an integrated mining complex. He also noted that Tharisa has remained profitable over the past 11 years despite volatile markets.

CEO Fran Horowitz says Abercrombie & Fitch aims to be a lasting lifestyle brand rather than chase trends. Since taking over in 2017, she has increased employee input and clothing quality. Abercrombie’s sales nearly doubled to $2.6 billion from 2019 to 2024, and combined sales with Hollister are expected to exceed $5 billion this year. Partnerships with Macy’s and the NFL are intended to attract new customers and raise brand awareness.

During COVID-19 emergency remote teaching, the authors adapted a Freirean, dialogue-based activity for 19 physics teacher education students using Discord. Students examined conflicting views on reopening schools, researched sources, and collaboratively produced an infographic for social media. An analysis informed by Cultural-Historical Activity Theory found that Discord’s text and voice channels helped students discuss their experiences, move between groups, and organize work independently. The authors identify students’ familiarity with the platform, the relevance of the topic, and collective production as factors supporting participation and autonomy.

Muskogee veteran Rodney Orton relies on a mobility scooter because of breathing problems, but his broke down. The VA initially told him he would need an evaluation, with the next appointment six weeks away. After a Problem Solvers reporter contacted the VA, staff found a suitable scooter in local inventory and delivered it to Orton’s hospital room the next morning.

The passage describes an electronic wagering game with a stop-based bonus feature. A base-game outcome can trigger a bonus wheel, which may lead to a secondary jackpot wheel. When a selected stop awards a credit prize, the player may receive that prize and the stop can be changed to a jackpot award for future play. These changes may persist between bonus rounds or players; some implementations reset them after a jackpot is awarded. The passage also describes alternative bonus-game formats, including reels, dice, and grids.
Some dogs are strongly drawn to toys in ways that may parallel human behavioral addictions.

A study of an introductory physics lab compared physical equipment, a pre-built simulation, and simulations students created and validated with generative AI to learn about electric potential. Both simulation groups scored significantly higher than the physical-equipment group on conceptual questions immediately after the lab and reported more positive attitudes. The two simulation groups had similar overall conceptual scores, while no significant differences appeared on later midterm or final exams. The authors note that the study covered one topic at one institution and that AI service limits affected some students.

In a Stanford dining-hall study involving nearly 28,000 students, vegetables with appetizing labels were chosen 25 percent more often than plainly labeled versions and 35–41 percent more often than health-labeled versions. Students also served themselves more. The passage suggests using appealing names and flavorful preparations at home to encourage vegetable consumption.

A Hubble image shows the filament-filled Tarantula Nebula and the bubble-shaped Honeycomb Nebula. Research suggests the Honeycomb’s appearance results from interactions between two supernovae and the viewing angle.

This AMD Geode CS5535 silicon revision A3 specification update lists hardware errata affecting DMA, IDE/UDMA, interrupts, clock gating, power management, register access, USB, LPC, SMBus, and other functions. Reported effects range from debug-only failures to corrupted transfers, missed interrupts, unreliable wake events, and system hangs. The document describes conditions and implications for individual issues and gives workarounds where available, including avoiding certain access patterns or features, disabling clock gating, changing driver procedures, and adjusting register settings. Some issues have no resolution or are described as having no operational impact.

The lecture describes electroweak unification by expressing weak and electromagnetic currents in terms of left- and right-handed particle components. A neutrino and a left-handed electron form a doublet whose weak-isospin currents include charged and neutral components. A hypercharge current adds a contribution from right-handed particles. The charged W bosons are combinations of two weak-isospin fields, while mixing the third field with a hypercharge field produces the photon and Z boson. The resulting picture combines weak and electromagnetic interactions.

To get started with Abalone, avoid rushing into attacks and plan moves to protect your counters. Gain control of the centre for greater mobility, then look for opportunities to attack. Splitting an opponent’s counters into smaller groups can make them easier to push off the board, but watch for counterattacks.

Dillon Gabriel remains the Browns’ starter, while Shedeur Sanders and Bailey Zappe are candidates for the backup job. Coach Kevin Stefanski said there is no single requirement for Sanders to earn the role and emphasized his development. Receiver Jerry Jeudy praised Sanders’ professionalism.

A cross-sectional study of 1,067 older Amish adults examined blood-based Alzheimer disease biomarkers. Participants with Alzheimer disease had higher p-tau181 and lower Aβ42/p-tau181 than cognitively unimpaired participants. After adjustment, p-tau181 was associated with Alzheimer disease among APOE ε4 carriers, while no biomarker showed a significant overall association with the disease. Models using all biomarkers or Aβ42/p-tau181 best distinguished Alzheimer disease from cognitive unimpaired status. Clustering by Aβ42/Aβ40 and p-tau181 identified distinct biomarker profiles, including one with more APOE ε4 carriers. The authors note that the study was cross-sectional, lacked brain imaging or cerebrospinal fluid confirmation, and requires longitudinal validation.

The passage describes an automated cryogenic storage system that stores samples in insulated vaults and transfers individual samples between vaults and portable cryogenic devices. A robotic handling module moves samples quickly through a controlled environment to keep them below a specified temperature threshold. Rotating shelves and a vertical shuttle present sample trays for transfer, while a controller tracks sample locations and can verify identities using barcodes. Refrigeration and humidity-control features maintain storage conditions, and the passage also describes procedures for recovering from jammed trays.

The coach said the team’s puck pursuit wears down opponents and that its speed, balanced lines and persistence have been strengths throughout the playoffs. He praised Sid’s complete game and leadership, Phil’s scoring and chemistry with his line, and the veteran players’ role in helping younger teammates. He said Conor’s minutes are being managed to preserve his quickness and that Conor has grown more comfortable with each call-up. Geno is generating chances, while Bryan will be a game-time decision. The coach also emphasized defending San Jose’s puck possession and said patience and opportunity are important to player development.

The President reports national progress and stronger prospects for peace, citing international agreements, diplomacy, and a planned naval arms conference. He urges restraint in rising defense costs. Although the stock-market crash has disrupted employment and agricultural prices, he says the banking system remains sound and describes efforts to sustain wages and expand construction. He reports improving farm conditions, supports cooperative marketing, and seeks a limited, flexible tariff revision. Citing projected budget surpluses, he recommends temporary income-tax reductions.

The message also proposes expanded public works, improvements to transportation and aviation, banking and utility oversight, and conservation measures. It calls for stronger public health services, better federal prisons and veterans’ administration, and broader government reorganization. To address crime and unsatisfactory prohibition enforcement, the President recommends changes to enforcement agencies and court procedures while emphasizing citizens’ responsibility to obey the law.

The passage describes deuterated heterocycle-fused gamma-carbolines designed to limit metabolic breakdown while retaining receptor-binding activity. It proposes their use in pharmaceutical formulations, including sustained-release injections and oral delivery systems, for central nervous system disorders such as schizophrenia, depression, anxiety and sleep disorders, alone or with other medicines. In mouse studies, three deuterated compounds formed less amide metabolite than a non-deuterated comparator and showed substantially similar receptor-binding profiles. Rat studies found that one deuterated compound produced less of a key metabolite after oral dosing. In dogs, sublingual dosing of that compound produced higher parent-drug exposure than the comparator.

Alex Ovechkin says an award means a lot after a difficult year that included a move from left wing to right wing. He thanks his teammates, coaches and family, and credits Adam Oates with helping him adjust. Ovechkin says he played through a broken foot during the playoffs, later confirmed by an MRI, and that his foot is improving.

The “Triangle Rotation” offense attacks the zone in a Triangle & Two defense through three-player rotations, while two shooters provide options when inside rotations fail. Its plays include elbow penetration, a baseline cut, a weakside lob and side screens. Effective execution requires zone-attack fundamentals, coordinated timing and defensive recognition. Teams are advised to scout opponents, watch for adjustments and vary alignments to target weaker defenders.

The passage reports that metal-organic frameworks won the chemistry Nobel. It also says former FDA vaccine regulator Peter Marks joined Eli Lilly to oversee molecule discovery and infectious diseases after resigning from the agency in March.

Michael Johnson has been named president of John Carroll University, becoming its first lay leader in its 131-year history. The Babson College provost will begin a five-year term July 1, replacing retiring president Rev. Robert Niehoff. Johnson previously taught at the University of Michigan and served as a dean at Cornell. He will also join John Carroll’s faculty.

A cross-sectional study at Hemen Medical Center in Addis Ababa surveyed third-trimester pregnant women about labor epidural analgesia (LEA); 230 questionnaires were analyzed. Although 78% had heard of LEA and 47% believed it relieved labor pain, only 14.3% were willing to consider it during delivery. Concerns included maternal side effects, fetal safety, interference with labor, and cost. Education, family income, perceived fetal risks, and beliefs about pain relief were significantly associated with willingness to use LEA. The authors recommend more antenatal education and counselling, while noting that the single-center, cross-sectional design limits the findings.

An analysis of 49 studies involving 266,939 people found that regular physical activity was linked to lower odds of developing depression across all age groups. Researchers called for policies that support physical activity and further study of how different activities affect depression risk.

Two government studies exposing rodents to high levels of cellphone radiation found a small increase in rare heart tumors in male rats, but no significant problems in female rats or mice and no clear evidence of brain tumors. Researchers said the exposure far exceeded typical cellphone use and the findings do not directly establish a human risk. Federal regulators said current cellphone safety limits are adequate. Earlier studies of cellphone users found little evidence of cancer risk, though some critics remain concerned.

A systematic review of 18 empirical studies assessed the accuracy and validity of ChatGPT’s responses in education. ChatGPT often produced coherent, well-structured writing and passed various undergraduate assessments, but its performance varied across disciplines. It struggled with complex scientific and calculation problems, sometimes gave incorrect answers confidently, and often lacked depth, reasoning, or relevant detail. The study recommends validating its responses, guiding students in constructive use, redesigning assessments to discourage cheating, and establishing institutional policies. The review was limited to accessible, eligible studies found in selected databases through 26 October 2023.

Intercontinental Exchange, the New York Stock Exchange’s parent company, is investing $2 billion in prediction market Polymarket at a $9 billion valuation. ICE will distribute Polymarket’s data, and the companies will collaborate on tokenization initiatives. Founded in 2020, Polymarket gained prominence during the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Its daily trading volume has since fallen from a post-election peak of nearly $400 million to $40 million–$80 million in early October.

Four Down is an isolation offense often used for a period’s final shot. Four players line the baseline, leaving space for the ballhandler to drive or shoot. If defenders help, the ballhandler can pass to an open post or corner shooter. Corners move out to relieve pressure and may take over the isolation role. Late-clock options include a mid screen for the ballhandler, staggered baseline screens for shooters, and a misdirection play combining a handoff with a weak-side double screen.

The passage describes the UC1825B-SP controller’s current sensing, operating supply range, converter topologies, and tests conducted at 48-V input. It emphasizes PCB layout practices to reduce noise and EMI, including component placement, short power traces, and separate power and signal grounding. It also provides documentation, handling, packaging, and legal notices.

Zacks Investment Research downgraded Caesars Entertainment from buy to hold. Across analysts, the stock had an average buy rating and a $14.39 consensus price target. Shares traded at $13.00 on Monday, down 0.76%. Caesars reported a quarterly loss of $0.21 per share, missing the $0.26 earnings estimate, and $1 billion in revenue, below the $2.11 billion estimate. Hedge funds and other institutional investors owned 76.68% of the company’s stock.

Steven Kean forwarded a collection of February 2001 articles on California’s electricity crisis. They report warnings of summer shortages and possible blackouts across the West, a dispute over contracts for small generators that could delay construction, and concerns among California businesses. Other articles describe Gov. Gray Davis’s response, California’s comparatively low per-capita electricity use, and a drop in Western spot power prices as plants returned to service. Lawmakers expressed reservations about Davis’s proposal to buy utilities’ transmission lines.

Manhattan Community Board 7 sought planning documents under the Freedom of Information Law for its review of a proposed development on the Penn Central railyards. After the Planning Department denied its request, lower courts ordered disclosure. The Court of Appeals held that the board lacked capacity to sue, a question distinct from whether it had standing. The City Charter neither expressly authorized the suit nor implied that authority through the board’s advisory land-use role; its provisions and legislative history indicated otherwise. Although the document request had been withdrawn, the court addressed the recurring issue, reversed the lower courts, and dismissed the petition.

Cboe’s bitcoin futures launched Sunday with strong interest and orderly trading despite sharp price swings that triggered a five-minute halt. Nearly 3,700 contracts had traded by early Monday afternoon, with about 20 firms participating. CEO Ed Tilly said the launch could help build confidence in cryptocurrency products, including options and ETFs, though Cboe will wait for several contract settlements before pursuing new derivatives. Three fund managers renewed requests for bitcoin ETFs, which U.S. regulators have so far denied or delayed.

The 2-3 zone protects the basket and limits dribble penetration, making it useful against poor outside shooting and strong low-post players, but vulnerable to good outside shooting. Two guards defend above the free-throw line, a central post defender stays between the ball and basket, and two baseline defenders cover corners and weakside rebounding. All defenders shift with passes. Adjustments address corner passes and ball reversals; a 1-1-3 variation changes guard alignment. Teams can trap in the corner, at the point, or against a strong wing shooter. Against a dominant post player, defenders add pass denial, backside support, and double- or triple-teams.
The FT Premium Subscription includes the Lex column, EM Squared, the daily FT ePaper, economics commentary, macroeconomic summaries and exclusive weekly emails.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition device. After power-up or reset, it requires a register-write initialization sequence and a free-running sampling clock. Users can configure analog input ranges, bandwidth, common-mode settings, and output lanes through banked registers accessed by SPI, including with multiple devices in a daisy chain. Speed-boost mode converts one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS while the other six channels remain idle. The passage also describes power-down controls, test patterns, averaging, calibration settings, an ATE application example, power-supply and board-layout guidance, and TI support and product disclaimers.

PPL Corporation shares closed Wednesday up $0.19 at $37.65 despite a net outflow of $29.88 million. Analysts’ consensus rating was “Hold,” with a $38.94 price target. In its latest quarter, PPL reported earnings of $0.52 per share, above estimates, while revenue of $1.73 billion fell short. The company paid a quarterly dividend of $0.395 per share. Insiders sold 47,163 shares over the preceding three months, and hedge funds and other institutional investors owned 71.01% of its stock.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on April 26, 2018, announcing its first-quarter 2018 financial results. The filing includes the results press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

FreeNAS 11 follows the troubled version 10 release. Based on FreeBSD 11-STABLE, it adds bhyve virtual-machine hosting, S3 compatibility, messaging integrations and boot-service controls. Docker support is deferred, while a new Angular interface remains in beta.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with an integrated analog front end, programmable gain amplifier, ADC driver, and buffered reference. They support single-ended and differential inputs, bipolar and unipolar ranges, and straight-binary output. An external 4.096V reference can be selected; the REFCAP pin requires decoupling capacitors and must not drive external loads.

Programmable input alarms use high and low thresholds with hysteresis. An AVDD alarm monitors fixed thresholds of 4.7V and 5.3V. The multiSPI interface supports standard SPI, single- or dual-output data, source-synchronous transfers, and daisy-chained devices. Operation cycles through reset, acquisition, and conversion states, with NAP and power-down modes available to reduce consumption.

The passage also describes configuration registers, data-transfer frames, power-supply decoupling, PCB layout guidance, and an eight-channel industrial input-module example using the ADS8681W with a differential multiplexer.

A genomic study of locally acquired SARS-CoV-2 infections in Vietnam found that public health measures contained sporadic Alpha variant clusters in early 2021, but Delta variant lineage AY.57 dominated a nationwide outbreak from May onward. Of 1,303 genomes sequenced, 1,222 were Delta, including 1,212 AY.57. Analysis placed AY.57’s introduction in northeastern Vietnam in early 2021 and found that it later spread across the country, forming localized clusters. The outbreak coincided with a sharp rise in viral genetic diversity; by the end of 2021, Vietnam had reported more than 1.7 million infections and 32,000 deaths.

The passage proposes smartphone-based wellness services for people aged 60–75 as a preventive response to Europe’s ageing population. The services would support daily routines across physical, intellectual, social and emotional wellness without relying on regulated health-care data. Finland’s BeWell program is developing services with users through an adaptable platform supported by cloud-based analysis; the authors argue that commercial viability is needed to sustain them. A survey of 101 respondents in the Åland Islands found interest in wellness and confidence among many mobile-app users, offering preliminary support for the approach. The authors plan a larger study to validate these findings.

JPMorgan Chase cut its DeVry Education Group stake by 9.6% in the third quarter, leaving 499,104 shares worth $11.5 million. Other institutional investors reported increased or new holdings. DeVry’s quarterly earnings of $0.39 per share missed estimates by $0.02, while revenue of $449.9 million exceeded estimates and rose 1.9% year over year. The company paid a $0.18-per-share semiannual dividend in December. Analysts’ consensus rating was “Hold,” with an average price target of $26.11.

Patrick Kane, Brent Seabrook and Bryan Bickell discussed Chicago’s overtime win over Boston, which tied the series with two of the remaining three games in Chicago. They credited contributions throughout the lineup, including Seabrook’s winning goal and goals from Kane and Jonathan Toews. Bickell emphasized physical play and creating space for his linemates. The players said they needed to improve defensively and on the penalty kill, while expressing confidence in goaltender Corey Crawford. They also spoke about their pride in the Blackhawks’ jersey and history.

Ostersunds, led by Graham Potter after three promotions and a domestic cup win, drew Arsenal in the Europa League last 32. Napoli face RB Leipzig, while Borussia Dortmund meet Atalanta, Atletico Madrid face Copenhagen, and Celtic play Zenit.

Chinese textile firms are increasingly sending materials to North Korean factories for low-cost garment production, according to traders and businesses in Dandong. They say the finished clothes are often labelled “Made in China” and exported worldwide, sometimes without buyers knowing where they were made. Textiles were North Korea’s second-largest export in 2016 and were not covered by the U.N. sanctions described in the passage, although coal exports were banned. Chinese firms also employ North Korean garment workers in China at wages below those of Chinese workers. A Dandong factory owner said those workers keep about a third of their pay, with the rest going to North Korean government handlers.

The speaker is in the finals for the third time with a different team and hopes to win the trophy after previous losses. They credit their team’s hard work and strong season, praise the city’s enthusiastic fans, and expect a tight series against the experienced Flyers.

Glenner Town Square, a daycare program for people with Alzheimer’s and dementia, opened in Chula Vista in April 2018. Its 8,500-square-foot, 1950s-style indoor downtown has 13 interactive storefronts designed to spark long-term memories. Glenner also operates centers in Hillcrest and Encinitas that it plans to convert to Town Square projects. The passage lists other licensed adult day programs for cognitively impaired people across San Diego County.

This systematic review examined nine human studies involving 2,526 participants and found associations between marijuana use or endocannabinoid supplements and changes in gut and oral microbiota across several clinical conditions. Reported findings included microbiota changes among people with HIV, increased *A. muciniphila* with OEA supplementation in an obesity trial, and links between exercise-related endocannabinoid increases and reduced inflammatory markers. Some marijuana users reported respiratory symptoms. The studies varied in condition and design, and some had risks of bias; the authors could not conduct a meta-analysis and called for further research.

Ben Rice was raised in Cohasset, Massachusetts, near Boston, but grew up a Yankees fan. He played baseball at Noble and Greenough School and attended Dartmouth, where pandemic disruptions limited him to 110 college plate appearances. The Yankees selected him in the 12th round of the 2021 MLB Draft, partly on the strength of his summer-league performance. In 2025, Rice hit 26 home runs in 138 games while playing first base, catcher and designated hitter.

The speaker says America’s economy and confidence have improved, citing lower inflation, tax cuts, and job growth, while acknowledging that many people remain unemployed. He sets out four goals: sustain economic growth, develop new frontiers, strengthen shared values, and build lasting peace.

He calls for bipartisan deficit reduction through spending restraint and closing tax loopholes, along with tax-code reform and changes to the budget process. He directs NASA to develop a permanently manned space station within a decade and proposes environmental initiatives. He also urges improvements in education, action against crime, and greater opportunity for families and communities.

On foreign policy, he supports a strong military, cooperation with allies, efforts to promote democracy, and reductions in nuclear arms. Addressing the Soviet Union, he says nuclear war must never be fought.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate for the third consecutive quarter, to 1–1.25 percent, citing strong job growth and moderate economic growth. It lowered its inflation forecast for this year to 1.6 percent, while some officials projected unemployment could fall below 4 percent.

A mathematical model and simulations examined screening and immediate isolation in a semi-isolated community without vaccines or medications. Screening controlled transmission under some conditions, but delays reduced its effectiveness. Daily screening controlled simulated outbreaks at reproduction numbers of 3 and 6, but not 8. Less frequent or less efficient screening and greater influx of infections increased case numbers, supporting the importance of frequent screening and strict border control.

Tom Brady’s agent says the quarterback intends to return to the Patriots in 2018 and play into his mid-40s, despite missing the start of voluntary workouts. Brady has two years left on his contract, which Patriots owner Robert Kraft says is not an issue.

CoreWeave’s shares have rebounded amid bullish AI sentiment and major OpenAI and Meta deals. The deals diversify its customer base, but Microsoft remains a significant revenue concentration risk. Rising competition, debt-funded spending and a high valuation raise concerns that optimism is fully priced in.

More than 130 Joppatowne High School seniors received diplomas at the school’s 45th commencement ceremony. Principal Pamela Zeigler said about 95 percent of the 138-member class planned to enter college, technical school, the military or law enforcement. Graduate Amya Hill, whose family traveled to celebrate, plans to study nursing at Albany State University. Student speakers urged classmates to pursue their goals and keep moving forward. State Sen. Robert Cassilly cited two people who died while serving or helping others.

Exact-diagonalization calculations for half-filled second moiré bands of approximately 2°-twisted bilayer MoTe₂ identify an intermediate superconducting phase between a ferromagnetic Chern insulator and a non-Abelian fractional spin Hall insulator as intervalley interactions are screened. Binding energies, pair-density spectra and superfluid stiffness support intervalley pairing. The predicted superconductor has time-reversal-symmetric, nodal extended s-wave pairing and undergoes a continuous transition to the fractional spin Hall insulator. Calculations using generalized Landau levels indicate that non-uniform quantum geometry helps stabilize the intermediate phase.

MultiChoice says Netflix is putting pressure on DStv Premium in South Africa. Overall subscriptions grew, but Premium lost 41,000 subscribers and average monthly revenue per customer fell. The company is pursuing a standalone streaming package, though it still needs entertainment-content streaming rights. It also warns that excessive pay-TV regulation could cost South African jobs.

A letter attributed to fired federal prosecutor Michael Ben’Ary says a false social media post apparently prompted his dismissal during a terrorism prosecution involving the 2021 Afghanistan airport bombing. The letter argues that Justice Department leaders are prioritizing punishment of the president’s perceived enemies over national security.

The Tampa coach declined to analyze the previous game publicly, saying he would do so with the team. He said the players felt good after the flight and that Tampa’s focus was on extending the series. He described battles and timely plays as key, and said anticipation of winning the Cup may have contributed to Tampa’s struggles in its previous home game. He expected Calgary to face similar pressure in its home elimination game.

OptumCare offers 12-week “Brainsaver” classes at three Valley locations. The classes combine physical and cognitive exercises, stress reduction, education, socialization and nutrition. The approach is believed to help keep Alzheimer’s disease at bay. Participants range from their mid-50s to late 80s.

A federal shutdown appeared more likely after President Trump met with congressional leaders ahead of a funding deadline.
