Vice President JD Vance said the country was “headed to a shutdown,” while Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer said the parties remained far apart. Republicans want a temporary bill maintaining current funding; Democrats want it to include protections for key measures, especially an extension of enhanced Obamacare tax credits. Each side blamed the other for the impasse.

Over-the-counter (OTC) trading takes place directly between parties through decentralized dealer networks rather than a centralized exchange. It covers stocks, bonds, derivatives, commodities and some cryptocurrency trades. OTC markets give companies that do not meet exchange requirements access to capital and allow parties to customize contracts. Compared with exchanges, they generally have less transparency and liquidity, creating counterparty, fraud and price-manipulation risks. The passage cites a study of 10,000 OTC stocks from 2001 to 2010 in which the average stock lost 27%, and cautions against investing in or short-term trading of OTC stocks.

After discovering that friends hesitated to ask about her religion, Moina Shaiq launched “Meet a Muslim” in Fremont, California. She now answers questions about Islam at venues across the Bay Area and beyond, aiming to counter stereotypes. Similar outreach efforts have resurged amid anti-Muslim incidents, and Shaiq has faced threats at an event. Supporters say such conversations help people understand one another, while critics argue that policy change would be more effective.

Turing Tensor Cores accelerate deep-learning matrix operations and add INT8 and INT4 modes for inference. They also power DLSS, which combines details from multiple frames using fewer input samples than TAA.

The disclosure describes configuring a guard period for sounding reference signal (SRS) transmission, particularly when antenna switching occurs near other uplink transmissions. A base station can configure SRS resources and a guard period whose length may depend on subcarrier spacing. If the guard period overlaps an uplink channel, its priority relative to that channel follows the priority of the SRS. The passage also describes ways to signal guard-period positions, handle collisions with PUCCH, PUSCH, or other SRS resources, and adjust or drop affected transmissions.

Coach Quenneville credited the Blackhawks’ leadership, commitment and consistent approach. He said Scott Darling earned playing time through strong performances, while Corey Crawford has been solid since returning. He praised several players’ playoff progress, encouraged Patrick Kane to shoot more, and said the team must play faster and treat its next game as a must-win.

Zsolt Lakatos was arrested after failing to attend the end of his trial and hiding for eight days. He had been sentenced in his absence to 13 years for wounding with intent after shaking his four-month-old son on two occasions. Lakatos said he panicked at the prospect of prison. He admitted breaching bail and received an additional 10-day sentence. His son, now in foster care, suffered catastrophic brain injuries and will require lifelong care.

Astronomers say Oumuamua, the first confirmed interstellar object detected in our solar system, probably came from a binary star system and was ejected as planets formed. Discovered in October, the reddish asteroid is moving away from Earth and the sun. Another team reported that it is tumbling through space, possibly after a collision.

A review of eight articles identified empathy, mindfulness, compassion, and critical inquiry as core dimensions of holistic education relevant to Indian higher education. The authors found these dimensions consistent with Indian educational philosophies and contemporary policy goals. They propose culturally grounded assessment tools to guide curricula, while noting that the review drew on only two databases.

Cover 0 is a man-to-man defense with no safety providing help over the top. It lets a defense pressure the quarterback, often with six rushers, while assigning defenders to eligible receivers. Its clear assignments can help against runs, run-pass options, screens, and short routes. The risk is that a defender beaten in coverage has no deep help, leaving the defense vulnerable to big plays, draws, quarterback scrambles, and crossing or pick routes. Variations include rushing five while leaving a “rat” defender to watch crossing routes and the quarterback, or dropping a defensive lineman into coverage.

Soybean May futures rose as supplies declined and crushing demand remained strong, supported by soy meal exports. The report expects soybean prices to rise; refined soy oil and CPO may rebound, though ample supplies and cheap imports could pressure prices.

Tesla Motors filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release on January 3, 2016, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The disclosure was furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01. General Counsel Todd A. Maron signed the report on January 4, 2016.

A University of Maryland study followed 1,099 college students and found that those who sustained energy drink consumption were more likely to use cocaine or prescription stimulants non-medically and to be at risk for alcohol use disorder at age 25. Researchers accounted for several factors, including prior substance use. Declining consumption was not associated with increased risk.

Consumer advocates reported a HealthCare.gov glitch that incorrectly told some applicants no plans were available in their area. An administration official said it had been resolved, though advocates said it had persisted after an earlier assurance. Enrollment for 2018 coverage ends Dec. 15 in the 39 states using HealthCare.gov, with heavy traffic expected. Hurricane-affected residents can request an extension to Dec. 31, and many states with their own websites have later deadlines. Despite a shorter sign-up period, interest remains brisk. It is unclear whether applicants unable to finish by the deadline will receive extra time.

The Nationals’ competition for the fifth starter spot may continue beyond opening day after they signed Jeremy Hellickson to a minor league contract. He joins A.J. Cole and Erick Fedde in the mix, but Washington may give him more time to build arm strength. Cole will make the team, either as a starter or reliever, while Fedde is likely headed to the minors. Max Scherzer will start opening day, followed by Stephen Strasburg, Gio Gonzalez and Tanner Roark.

Tesla announced lower-cost versions of its electric vehicles: the Model 3 Standard at $36,990 and the Model Y Standard at $39,990, with an estimated 321-mile range. Both omit features found in pricier variants, including AM/FM radio; the Model Y Standard also lacks Autosteer. Tesla estimates availability in December–January for the Model 3 and November–December for the Model Y. Tesla shares closed down 4.45% on the announcement day.

VentureWire’s November 14, 2000 issue reports that Apax plans to invest $600 million in Israeli companies, New Edge Networks is cutting 135 jobs, KSolutions raised $50 million, and Cisco acquired wireless chipmaker Radiata for $295 million in stock. It also covers numerous venture funding rounds, company closures and layoffs, product launches and name changes, acquisitions, executive and board appointments, venture capital personnel changes, and two corrections.

On April 6, 1917, President Woodrow Wilson proclaimed a state of war between the United States and Germany and issued regulations for non-naturalized German males aged fourteen and older, designated “alien enemies.” They were required to obey the law and avoid aiding the enemy; those who complied were to be left undisturbed in their lawful lives. The regulations prohibited possession of weapons and certain communications equipment, restricted access to military sites and designated areas, and controlled entry and departure. Violations or suspected threats could lead to seizure of property, relocation, arrest, or detention.

John Ortiz appealed his simple-assault conviction, arguing that the trial court made several evidentiary errors. The appellate court held that asking him to demonstrate how he drew and opened his pocket-knife was proper cross-examination of his self-defense account. It found that testimony about alleged threatening letters concerned a collateral issue and affirmed the judgment.

The passage describes AI-based graphics features including Ray Reconstruction, DLAA, and Blackwell neural shaders. It outlines neural shaders for material rendering, texture compression, indirect lighting, translucent skin, and facial rendering, along with APIs that let graphics shaders access Tensor Cores. It also lists specifications for the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products. NVIDIA states that the specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability for certain uses.

Devanna Cornitcher, 25, was found stabbed to death in a Chester apartment. Police arrested her boyfriend, Alonzo Carter, who reportedly claimed self-defense. Her two children were present; her 6-year-old daughter told investigators she witnessed the killing.

Machine-learning models trained on sleep-quality data predicted depressive symptom severity across three independent cohorts and in a small longitudinal sample. Adding anxiety improved predictions and mediated the association between sleep quality and depressive symptoms; brain structure and function measures did not improve prediction. Predicting sleep quality from depressive symptoms was less robust. The authors note that the findings do not establish causality and call for larger longitudinal studies.

The speaker says early power plays and penalty kills are difficult when players are not fully prepared. Despite frustration with the team’s effort, they expect improvement in two home games and want to handle the puck better against strong defenders.

This section lists diplomatic records from January 1 to March 8, 1945, concerning consultations on unresolved Dumbarton Oaks questions, Yalta decisions, submitted views, and invitations to 39 United Nations governments. A circular telegram reports that nine American republics submitted memoranda on the Dumbarton Oaks proposals. The Secretary of State said further meetings and a forthcoming conference would help them understand one another’s views before a general conference on international organization.

In a dispute over damage to Juan Archibeque’s wheat, the court held that appeals from a justice of the peace are tried anew in district court, which has no strictly appellate jurisdiction. The justice’s transcript establishes that the case was properly appealed but does not govern the new trial. The jury found for Jose Maria Miera after hearing conflicting evidence about which animals caused the damage. Finding no clear weight of evidence against the verdict, the court affirmed the judgment and denial of a new trial.

The Base Cross Offense uses a smaller player’s baseline screen to free a post player for a shot or strong post-up. It can begin with a pass, dribble, UCLA high-post, or Hawk entry. Players read the defense and counter with cuts, adjustments to the screen, mismatches, a lob pass, or ball reversal into weakside screening. Its success depends on solid screens, post skills, spacing, timing, and coordinated defensive recognition. Coaches are advised to teach its components through drills and adjust entries and player positions to the defense.

Des Moines Public Schools Superintendent Ian Roberts resigned effective immediately after ICE arrested him Friday and Iowa revoked his educator license. ICE said Roberts, a Guyanese citizen, was in the U.S. unlawfully and subject to a final removal order. His attorney said Roberts believed his immigration case had been closed and is seeking to reopen it and stay his removal. Roberts remains in custody. The arrest has also prompted questions about the district’s hiring checks; district officials said he submitted required employment-eligibility documentation.

Kirkpatrick argues that the Carter administration helped replace U.S.-friendly autocrats in Iran and Nicaragua with less friendly revolutionary leaders, without adequately considering the consequences. She calls for a realistic policy toward non-democratic governments threatened by Soviet-sponsored subversion. In her view, Carter’s preference for leftist challenges over rightist autocracies overlooks that traditional autocracies are generally less repressive, more open to liberalization, and more compatible with U.S. interests than revolutionary ones. She cites governments in Asia as examples and argues that, although traditional rulers preserve inequality and poverty, they usually leave established social patterns intact.

A motorist wanted on a warrant led police on a two-hour chase from Kansas into Missouri. After spike strips flattened all four tires, he crashed. Officers found drugs and loaded weapons; he was hospitalized for suspected methamphetamine ingestion.

Markets turned risk-off after a week of strong but uneven earnings, weaker-than-expected job growth and sharp downward revisions to prior payroll figures. GDP exceeded expectations, though tariff-related distortions complicated its interpretation and personal spending was weak. The Fed signaled patience amid uncertainty about inflation and changes in the labor force, while markets raised their expectations for rate cuts. Major indexes fell from record highs, with weakening volume and market breadth prompting the author to warn of a possible tactical pullback.

In a study of the nocebo effect, volunteers reported more pain after using a fake cream presented as expensive than after using one presented as cheap. Researchers also found differences in activity in pain-related brain regions. They suggest the findings could help clinicians discuss medications in ways that minimize negative side effects.

The Alabama Court of Civil Appeals denied James F. Robertson III’s petition for a writ ordering a default judgment in his divorce case. He had not established that the required publisher’s affidavit proving service by publication was filed with the trial court, so he had no clear legal right to the judgment.

In soccer, defenders are “goal side” when they position themselves between an opponent and the goal they defend. Beginners can be taught to keep opponents in front of them, move toward forwards without getting too close, and run past opponents before turning if caught behind them. Practice should cover positioning across the field, adjusting to an opponent’s movement, and checking the goal’s location. Drills can progress from slow movements without a ball to faster movements with one. Defenders must not block opponents or extend their arms.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2018 Form 10-K describes its GPU and Tegra Processor businesses, which serve gaming, professional visualization, datacenter and automotive markets. The company uses a fabless manufacturing model and reported 11,528 employees as of January 28, 2018. Its cash and marketable securities totaled $7.11 billion at fiscal year-end. The filing identifies risks involving competition, cybersecurity, product defects, suppliers, demand forecasting, international operations and regulation. NVIDIA paid $341 million in dividends during fiscal 2018 and had repurchased 251 million shares under its repurchase program through January 28, 2018.

The NHS Patient Charter brings together patients’ legal rights, NHS pledges and patient responsibilities. It covers access to care based on need, safe and effective treatment, informed consent, privacy, involvement in decisions and explanations when waiting-time standards are missed. Treatment funding decisions should be fair and evidence-based. Patients can raise complaints, seek review and receive openness when care goes wrong. In return, they are asked to look after their health where possible, follow or discuss treatment plans, participate in screening and vaccination, and treat staff and other patients respectfully.

In a U.S. appeal concerning the appraised value of imported fishing equipment, the importer conceded that two outside-packing charges were dutiable. The judge found no evidence that a separate 26.557-yen deduction was improper and determined the values using the specified invoice deductions.

The Sensex rose 270 points to 29,683.87 on Tuesday, ending a two-day losing streak, while the Nifty climbed above 9,200. Metal and banking shares gained. Asian markets were mixed amid North Korea tensions, and the rupee strengthened slightly.

A WMCC vocational class built cabinets and countertops for Kidder United Methodist Church’s kitchen. The church, city of Kidder and Caldwell County Emergency Management plan to use the church as a disaster relief center once the kitchen meets the necessary specifications. The church paid for materials, while the prison provided labor, giving students experience building something for community use.

Conrad Lapp signed a Colorado promissory note for his financially troubled company without his wife’s signature. After the note went into default, the couple moved to Washington, where the creditor sued. The Washington Supreme Court reversed lower courts’ dismissal of the claim against the marital community. Applying the most-significant-relationship test, the majority held that Colorado law governed and that property reachable under Colorado law, including Mr. Lapp’s wages and acquisitions, remained available to satisfy the debt in Washington. The dissent argued that Washington law should govern which property could satisfy the judgment and would protect the couple’s community property.

The St. Louis Court of Appeals affirmed the circuit court’s judgment, following its decision in *Century Realty Co. v. Frankfort Marine, Accident and Plate Glass Insurance Company* because the cases involved the same facts and principles.

Simulation-based inference can produce biased or overconfident posteriors when a simulator differs from the real data-generating process. The proposed method, FMCPE, uses scarce high-fidelity calibration data to correct a posterior estimator trained on abundant simulations. Two jointly trained flows map real observations into the simulator’s domain and refine the resulting parameter posterior. Across two synthetic and two real-world tasks, FMCPE outperformed the NPE and MFNPE baselines, particularly with small calibration sets. Severe misspecification in high dimensions may still require more calibration data.

Cryptocurrency trading involves buying and selling digital assets on online platforms. The passage describes strategies including day, swing, trend-following, range, breakout, arbitrage, grid, sentiment-based and fork trading. It says trend following has performed better than mean reversion in its backtests; one Bitcoin strategy averaged a 7% gain per trade but experienced a 66% drawdown. Prices can be affected by demand, sentiment, regulation, macroeconomic events, forks and halvings. Risks include volatility, scams, exchange failures, lost private keys, fees and slippage. The passage recommends choosing a strategy suited to one’s goals and risk tolerance and backtesting it before committing money.
Apple offers free battery replacements for eligible 13-inch MacBook Pro models without Touch Bar built between October 2016 and October 2017. Owners can check eligibility using their serial number.
The passage lists South Carolina news items, including Mayor Tecklenburg’s first year, a $38 million State Ports Authority office sale, a cardiac-care test program in Charleston, and new state laws.

The SD Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 describes card capacities, interfaces, performance, initialization, data transfer, and protection. SDSC cards support up to 2 GB, SDHC cards more than 2 GB through 32 GB, and SDXC cards more than 32 GB through 2 TB. It defines read/write and ROM cards, speed classes, standard and UHS bus modes, and host-controlled command and block-data transfers.

Hosts initialize cards by checking operating conditions, identifying each card, and obtaining its relative address. UHS-I uses a voltage-switch sequence for 1.8 V signaling; UHS-II has a separate interface and initialization sequence. The specification also covers reads, writes, erase, discard, and full-user-area logical erase. Protection methods include a mechanical write-protect switch, internal write protection, password locking, and optional Card Ownership Protection.

A panel of investors discusses financing options for startups, including customers, grants, crowdfunding, angels, accelerators, and venture capital. They emphasize choosing capital suited to a company’s stage, goals, and needs, while considering dilution, investor relationships, and the pressure that comes with large funding rounds. Convertible notes can be quick and inexpensive but remain debt until they convert, creating risks if a company struggles. The panel advises entrepreneurs to check investors’ references, align expectations about success, structure early investments carefully, and address major risks as early as possible.

Arthur James Balfour argues that the Central powers used brutality to intimidate neutral nations and that a peace based on their success would undermine treaties and international law. He says durable peace requires reducing sources of unrest, discrediting aggressive methods, and creating sanctions to support international agreements; in his view, these goals depend on Allied success. A subsequent report says Greece accepted an ultimatum without reservation, including the immediate release of political prisoners and Entente demands for internal control. Another note acknowledges Persia’s support for the President’s peace note and its request for U.S. assistance in protecting Persian rights at a future peace conference.

DS-STAR is a data science agent that analyzes files in varied formats, then generates Python solutions through sequential planning, execution, and LLM-based verification. If a plan is insufficient, it adds steps or backtracks to correct errors. It outperformed the best alternatives on DABStep, KramaBench, and DA-Code, achieving 45.2%, 44.7%, and 38.5% accuracy, respectively. Ablation studies found that file analysis and plan correction improved performance.

A study of 173 women aged 25 to 50 who usually drank less than a litre of water daily found that adding half a litre at breakfast promoted weight loss. The passage also cites studies linking water consumption to increased calorie burning and says some clinical studies associate low-carb, high-protein diets with faster weight loss.

The Yankees and Red Sox will meet in a best-of-three AL Wild Card series in New York beginning Tuesday, Sept. 30. New York is the No. 4 seed and Boston the No. 5 seed. ESPN will televise the series. Boston leads their previous postseason series meetings 3-2.

This bibliography lists major American foreign-policy statements from 1945, with dates and publication references. It includes addresses and messages by Presidents Roosevelt and Truman and statements by Grew, Stettinius, Hull, and Byrnes. Topics include the Yalta and Potsdam conferences, the United Nations, Germany’s and Japan’s surrender, atomic energy, world cooperation, and U.S. policy in China.

The passage argues that AI could support personalized learning, but prescribed curricula and standardized assessments leave students little control over what and how they learn. It proposes dividing school time between required curriculum and student-directed learning, with teachers providing guidance and support. Using panarchy theory, the authors suggest that small, voluntary learning programs within schools could test this approach and gradually influence wider education systems. Examples in China and Australia show such programs taking different forms, though some remained extracurricular or ended after a year.

As the Scripps National Spelling Bee nearly doubled in size under a new wild-card program, longtime associate pronouncer Brian Sietsema took over for Jacques Bailly during two groups of preliminary rounds so Bailly could rest his voice. More than 500 spellers competed, and 41 semifinalists were selected using written spelling and vocabulary test results. Among the competitors, Rebekah Zeigler advanced beyond her previous onstage limit, Reagan Remmers was reinstated after judges accepted her spelling of a homonym, and Daniel Doudna described how pausing between letters helps him avoid mistakes.

“Sell the rip” means selling an asset or opening a short position when its price appears overvalued, in anticipation of a correction. It is a short-term approach based on mean reversion and can use indicators such as RSI and Bollinger Bands. The passage cautions that short-selling prices that continue to rise is risky and that selling strong growth stocks may forgo further gains. An initial RSI-based SPY backtest showed 391 trades and a 75% win rate but excessive drawdowns; revised exit rules reduced drawdowns and improved the equity curve. The passage says the approach has been less effective in some periods and markets.

The speaker credits the team’s defensive depth, including Matt Irwin and Yannick Weber, for its regular-season and playoff success. He says working with Shea has offered lessons and describes how his approach to playoff preparation has changed over time. The team earned its place through hard work and difficult stretches. Although the playoffs require serious work across the organization, the group enjoys playing in June. He says both teams are hungry and prepared to compete for the Cup.

Amazon completed its acquisition of Whole Foods Market on August 28, 2017, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. Eligible Whole Foods shares were converted into the right to receive $42 each in cash, while equity awards received cash payments or were canceled under the merger terms. Total consideration was approximately $13.55 billion, financed with debt proceeds. Amazon said it would file Whole Foods’ financial statements and pro forma financial information later.

The passage describes ADS868xW data-transfer protocols, configuration registers, and an industrial input-module example. The device defaults to SPI-00-S after power-up or asynchronous reset; register settings select other SPI modes, dual-output operation, or source-synchronous output. Its nine configuration registers control functions including power, output data, input range, and alarms. The application example combines an ADS8681W ADC with an eight-channel differential multiplexer and discusses programmable alarm hysteresis, power-saving modes, supply decoupling, and PCB layout.

Most federal judges who responded to a New York Times survey criticized the Supreme Court’s use of its emergency docket in cases involving Trump administration policies. Of 65 respondents, 47 said the court had not used the docket appropriately, and 48 said lower courts lacked sufficient guidance. Among 54 judges asked about public perception, 42 said the orders had harmed it. The newspaper noted that respondents may not represent the judiciary as a whole. A published critique argued that dissatisfied judges and judges in districts hearing challenges to Trump policies may have been more likely to respond.

The article examines how dance education can incorporate social studies and support holistic learning. A survey of 91 US dance educators found that their teaching addressed every social studies concept surveyed, most often individual development and identity, and people, places and environments. Educators interpreted these connections both explicitly and implicitly, with substantial variation in how they understood curriculum and pedagogy. The study’s small, non-random US sample and restricted survey questions limit generalisation. The author calls for further research, professional development and education policy that supports interdisciplinary teaching.

Colorado’s Prescription Drug Affordability Board voted to cap what state government agencies and commercial health plans pay for Amgen’s arthritis drug Enbrel at $600 per unit. The limit amounts to about $30,350 per person annually, compared with roughly $53,000 paid by the average state insurance plan in 2023.

The Martingale trading strategy increases the size of a losing position, typically doubling it, in hopes that a later win will recover earlier losses and earn a profit equal to the initial stake. Its potential losses grow rapidly during a losing streak, and stocks can fall to zero. It differs from planned averaging down and from adding only the original position size after a loss. In a SPY backtest, a benchmark strategy returned 8.68% annually with a 23% maximum drawdown; a modified strategy that increased exposure after a further RSI decline produced an undesirable result. The passage does not recommend Martingale trading.

Turkish officials said the state of emergency would be extended for three months from April 19, subject to parliamentary approval. Deputy Prime Minister Numan Kurtulmus cited terror threats, particularly from the group the government blames for the failed July 2016 coup.

The Dolphins earned their first win of the season against the Jets, but receiver Tyreek Hill suffered a feared dislocated left knee and was taken to a hospital. Darren Waller caught two touchdowns for Miami. The Jets fell to 0-4 after committing three turnovers and 12 penalties; their fumbles led to 14 Dolphins points.

China will expand its trade-weighted currency basket from 13 to 24 currencies in 2017, reducing the US dollar’s weighting from 26.4 to 22.4 per cent. The change is intended to shift attention from the yuan’s exchange rate against the dollar alone. The yuan fell about seven per cent against the dollar in 2016. Chinese officials say the dollar’s strength, rather than yuan weakness, is the issue.

Astronomer Hector Socas-Navarro proposes searching for large swarms of satellites around distant planets as evidence of alien societies. Unlike searches for radio or laser signals, this approach would not require aliens to transmit toward Earth at the right time. A dense satellite belt could slightly dim a star’s light before and after its planet transits. Astronomers could look for this pattern in existing exoplanet data, though the proposal’s chances of success may be low.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated July 28, 2022, reporting that it issued a press release on its financial results for the third fiscal quarter ended June 25, 2022. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri.

IMI plc has a consensus “Hold” rating from 18 research firms: two rate it sell, 12 hold and four buy. The average 12-month price target is GBX 1,027.29. BNP Paribas recently raised its target to GBX 1,400 and rated the stock “outperform.” IMI designs, manufactures and services products that control fluid movement.

GSK said chief commercial officer Luke Miels will succeed Emma Walmsley as CEO on Jan. 1. Walmsley’s tenure included spinning off Haleon and focusing on specialty drugs and vaccines, though investors have questioned GSK’s strategy. AstraZeneca plans to list its ordinary shares in New York while keeping its London and Stockholm listings, giving U.S. investors easier access. The passage also says AstraZeneca and Novartis are opening direct-to-consumer sales channels in the U.S.

Police and Crimestoppers warn that fraudsters exploit busy Christmas shopping to pass counterfeit banknotes, harming shoppers and businesses. More than 237,000 fake notes, notionally worth over £4.88 million, were removed from UK streets in the first half of 2017. Crimestoppers and the Bank of England have launched a scheme to help businesses check notes at the point of sale. Crimestoppers asks anyone with information about counterfeit notes to report it anonymously.

The September 19, 2000, VentureWire reports that Pseudo.com shut down and laid off 175 employees, Broadbase agreed to acquire Servicesoft for approximately $645 million, and Enfrastructure launched with more than $100 million in funding. It also covers funding rounds, executive and board appointments, acquisitions, new ventures, and corrections to earlier reports.

Inconsistent vaccine supplies have disrupted foot-and-mouth disease vaccination in Zimbabwe, allowing the virus to spread in affected provinces. Active infections are reported in Chipinge South, Mwenezi, Chivi and Chiredzi. Veterinary staffing, funding and infrastructure shortages, damaged fences and uncontrolled cattle movements have weakened disease control. Without effective control zones, more cattle require vaccination; affected and in-contact animals need vaccination every four months after an outbreak.

Arnoldi constructs an orthogonal basis for Krylov subspaces. For symmetric matrices, it produces a symmetric tridiagonal matrix whose Ritz values can approximate low eigenvalues of a large matrix.

Conjugate gradients solves symmetric positive definite linear systems by choosing updates with orthogonal residuals and search directions that are orthogonal in the matrix-defined inner product. Each iteration requires one matrix-vector multiplication, two inner products, and a few vector updates. Its convergence estimate depends on the matrix’s condition number. The method also minimizes a quadratic energy whose minimum solves the linear system; its search directions avoid the slow progress that can occur with steepest descent.

For problems that are not symmetric positive definite, the lecture introduces minimum residual methods, which use Arnoldi and are more expensive. Whether conjugate gradients or a direct method is faster for a particular large problem requires numerical comparison.

Cheltenham Town face another battle to keep midfielder Harry Pell after an unnamed League Two club approached him ahead of the 2018/19 season. A £200,000 move to Blackpool fell through last summer when he could not agree personal terms. Pell, 26, is under contract until the end of next season and has made more than 120 starts for Cheltenham.

Four Nebraska editorials address education, history and tourism. UNL is expanding agricultural research and facilities through a strategic plan that emphasizes interdisciplinary work. Buffalo County’s new Family History Center will preserve records and display exhibits, with supporters seeking funds for an additional wing. Lincoln Public Schools is urged to maintain small classes despite budget concerns, particularly for students needing additional support. In Alliance, Carhenge is expected to draw eclipse visitors; once threatened over zoning, the car-built monument has become a prominent attraction.

Stone tools found at Attirampakkam in southeast India date to between 385,000 and 172,000 years ago, earlier than previously believed for this tool-making technology in India. The discovery raises questions about earlier migration from Africa, but no human remains were found, and researchers do not know who made the tools.

Researchers trained four neural network architectures on 500 simulated thoracic aortic aneurysms to identify two combined causes: impaired elastic fiber integrity and dysfunctional cellular mechanosensing. Adding distensibility maps to dilatation maps roughly halved prediction errors across all networks. UNet achieved the best overall accuracy. The study used synthetic data based on a single initial vessel geometry and did not model unstable growth, dissection or rupture.

The passage describes an industrial data services platform that registers industrial assets, hierarchical asset models, and available data service applications. Asset owners select applications to process data collected by gateways from industrial device tags. Structured tags for states, rates, cumulative quantities, and events include configurable metadata. Gateways use asset models to organize this data, while application servers can combine models and generate contextualized visualizations. The passage also describes secure gateway communication with a cloud-based application server.

A cross-sectional study of 346 samples at a Chennai tertiary care hospital found positive cultures in 264 (76.3%); 75.4% of these contained Gram-negative bacteria. E. coli (28.8%) and Klebsiella species (26.9%) were the most common organisms. Among E. coli isolates, resistance was high to cefotaxime, cefuroxime and polymyxin B, while sensitivity was higher to amikacin and gentamicin. The authors recommend local resistance surveillance, diagnostic testing and antimicrobial stewardship. The study’s short duration, sample size and single-hospital setting limit its generalizability.

The Sansa Fuze manual describes the player’s music, video, photo, FM radio, and voice-recording features, along with microSD expansion and its rechargeable battery. It explains how to charge and operate the player, transfer and play media, manage files, customize settings, and troubleshoot problems. It warns that formatting deletes all content and that disconnecting during a transfer can damage the device. The manual also provides support information, a one-year limited warranty, and software license terms.

Ari Ne’eman compares the Trump administration’s autism claims with Soviet research practices observed by a U.S. disability panel in 1963, arguing that political assumptions shaped both. He says rising autism diagnosis rates are more plausibly explained by broader diagnostic criteria, shifts from other diagnoses, and improved access to assessment than by a recent epidemic. He also contrasts Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s approach with his family’s role in expanding disability services and criticizes proposed cuts to those services.

The Sixth Circuit affirmed the judgment, finding no error in the trial court’s instruction about an inconsistency between a jury interrogatory answer and the general verdict, and finding substantial evidence to support the verdict.

The President approves a bill establishing a lawful process to resolve disputed electoral votes in the 1877 presidential election. Congress will address single returns directly; a tribunal will review double returns, with its decisions standing unless both Houses agree otherwise. He argues that the process can avert an irregular contest over the presidency and help restore public confidence, peace, and economic activity. Although the bill addresses only the recent election and may be imperfect, he says the dispute shows the need for permanent legislation.

The study compares digitalization, measured by the Digital Economy and Society Index, with sustainability indicators and cultural dimensions across 28 EU countries. From 2014 to 2017, higher digitalization generally correlated with stronger economic and social performance and progress toward sustainable development goals. Its relationship with environmental measures was mixed: one measure showed a significant negative correlation, while another showed no significant relationship. Digitalization also correlated with several cultural dimensions, including lower power distance and uncertainty avoidance and higher individualism and indulgence. The authors note that correlations do not establish causation and that the EU-only sample and limitations of sustainability indices constrain the findings.

The Astros beat the White Sox 7-1 on Sunday for their sixth straight win, completing a three-game sweep in which they outscored Chicago 27-2. Jose Altuve’s go-ahead single sparked a five-run seventh inning, Lance McCullers Jr. allowed one run over six innings, and Evan Gattis hit his first homer of the season. Houston next faces the Angels.

The passage specifies SD memory card lock and ownership-protection procedures, including password handling, COP unlocking, force erase, and error reporting. It describes application-specific commands, CMD6 function switching and power limits, initialization, addressing differences among card capacities, bus clock and CRC rules, command formats, responses, status fields, and timeouts. It also defines speed-class performance concepts for recording, including allocation and recording units and FAT updates.

Joe Hadzima surveys legal issues startups should recognize and discuss with advisers, emphasizing that legal outcomes depend on specific facts. He covers intellectual property ownership and protection through trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and patents. Patent decisions involve commercial value, disclosure deadlines, filing costs, and the option of provisional applications. He also explains MIT’s technology licensing process and the importance of securing rights before seeking investment.

For technology startups seeking financing, Hadzima describes Delaware corporations, tax elections, and the potential tax consequences of delaying founder stock issuance. He urges founders to address equity splits, vesting, employee compensation, and departures early. Finally, he warns against making securities offers without appropriate legal guidance and outlines convertible notes and venture-financing terms, including liquidation preferences and anti-dilution provisions.
A UPS fire at a Lucknow hospital forced the evacuation of more than 50 patients and attendants. No injuries were reported. ICU patients were transferred, and officials ordered a fire-safety probe.

Defending champions India face Bangladesh in the Champions Trophy semi-final at Edgbaston on 15 June. Bangladesh reached the match after beating New Zealand by five wickets. Star Sports will broadcast the match from 3 PM IST, with streaming on Hotstar.

After their Toronto home tripled in value, Sarah Blakely and her husband sold it for more than $1 million and moved to a larger Ottawa home they expect to own mortgage-free. Other Toronto sellers are moving to cheaper markets or downsizing, while high prices have pushed buyers into nearby communities and drawn interest to Nova Scotia.

Despite a 33.2 per cent annual rise in the Greater Toronto Area’s average sale price last month, agent Josie Stern says buyers are pulling back as they await possible government affordability measures. She says it remains a seller’s market but warns that cashing out carries risks. A Vancouver agent, where sales changed after a foreign buyers’ tax, advises Toronto owners considering a sale to act before the market shifts.

LeBron James became a billionaire in 2022 through NBA earnings, endorsements and business ventures, including investments in sports, media and restaurants. He owns luxury homes and cars and funds educational initiatives in his hometown of Akron. James has played in the NBA with his son Bronny. Although he has hinted at retirement, he has not announced plans to leave the league; a teased 2025 announcement turned out to be a Hennessy advertisement.

St. Jude researchers found that the kinases Mst1 and Mst2 regulate dendritic cell subsets that activate T cells. Using the NetBID algorithm to analyze biological data, they identified Hippo signaling as a regulator of dendritic cell function. CD8α+ dendritic cells were more metabolically active than CD8α- cells, and altering their metabolism affected T cell priming. Mst1/2 also promoted IL-12 production through NF-κB signaling. The findings may inform strategies to shape immune responses in cancer and immune disorders.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 27, 2021, announcing a press release on its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 26, 2020. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri signed the report.

A Roman pottery fragment found on Chapel St Leonards beach is the third Roman artefact discovered there in recent months, following a coin and brooch fragment. Experts say it may have eroded from a Roman site beneath the sand. Lincolnshire County Council urges residents to report coastal finds.

The passage compares the 2018 Baku Declaration of the Non-Aligned Movement with the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting communiqué, focusing on their implications for India and the Global South. Both warn against protectionism and support resolving outstanding trade issues. The Baku Declaration also calls for an end to Israel’s occupation of Palestinian territory and urges tolerance and respect for diversity. The Commonwealth communiqué addresses the economic vulnerability of small states and calls for the safe return of Rohingya refugees from Bangladesh to Myanmar.

The author welcomes these positions but argues that neither document adequately confronts inequalities in global economic governance. The passage also questions India’s commitment to independent policymaking and criticizes its response to Rohingya refugees.

A qualitative study examined 22 Norwegian physical education teacher education students’ experiences with flipped learning in dance and motor-learning units. Students watched instructional videos before class, then participated in activities and discussions. Interviews identified five themes: expectations, simple input, deep learning, a supportive learning environment, and challenges. Students generally reported greater preparation, engagement, motivation, and understanding, and valued being able to replay videos and prepare for practical activities. Challenges included technical problems, the inability to ask questions while preparing, and additional time demands. The authors conclude that students viewed flipped learning as useful for their studies and future teaching. They note that their initial focus on motivation and learning may have missed other perceptions and that collecting data from multiple institutions might have strengthened the study.

The Federal Circuit reversed a judgment for Jean Melchior in his patent infringement suit against Hilite. The majority held that Danckert anticipated claims of one cam-phaser patent and that Danckert combined with Shirai rendered the remaining asserted claims obvious. It rejected Melchior’s proposed requirement of a “direct transfer in a closed line” because the claims did not contain that limitation. Judge Newman concurred in the judgment of no liability but concluded that the patents’ validity was supported and infringement had not been established.

The Alabama Supreme Court answered a certified question concerning insurance coverage for claims against two city employees accused of sexually abusing detainees. It held that a policy covering civil-rights violations while defining insured employees as those acting within the scope of their duties is neither ambiguous nor illusory: civil-rights violations can occur within that scope. The court also held that its earlier Titan decisions did not control because they involved different policy language and a law-of-the-case ruling.

Call to the Pen outlined a weekly minor league baseball coverage schedule and named 19-year-old Braves pitcher Mike Soroka its top performer after he went 2-0 with a 0.77 ERA in two AA starts. Other highlights included Kyle Tucker’s seven-RBI game, Jose Medina’s three-home-run game, strong starts by Dane Dunning and Josh Staumont, and a combined no-hitter by Kane County. Ian Happ led the minors in home runs, Jorge Mateo in stolen bases and Mike Clevinger in strikeouts. Manager Phillip Wellman earned his 1,000th win.

Nobel Prize-winning biochemist Peter Agre will give a free public talk May 9 at the University of Louisville on science, human rights, diplomacy and disease. Agre discovered aquaporins and has led U.S. scientists on international visits to foster scientific collaboration.

The study examined daily outdoor temperatures and COVID-19 hospitalizations in Tomsk, Russia, during the early-2022 Omicron wave. The authors report that temperature drops exceeding 3°C coincided with hospitalization increases after a one- to two-day lag. They hypothesize that cold air may worsen illness by affecting infected patients’ airway epithelium, while acknowledging that other factors can also contribute to hospitalization surges. They propose further study of humidity, air pollution, and other influences.

Peter Joseph Saville, a dentist who cared for thousands of patients in Worthing over more than four decades, died at home on June 27 aged 90. His family remembered him as kind, generous and full of life. After serving as an army dental surgeon, he moved to Worthing with his wife, Josephine, in 1954. He was active in local sports clubs, the Catholic church and charitable work. He is survived by Josephine, their six children and eight grandchildren.

The study demonstrates a chirality-selective thermal switch made from ferromagnetic [Co/Pt] multilayers and chiral α-SiO₂. Laser-induced demagnetization generates chiral phonons that transfer heat into α-SiO₂. Reversing the [Co/Pt] magnetization changes the apparent thermal conductivity of chiral α-SiO₂ by about 7%, with the effect reversing between left- and right-handed crystals; non-chiral SiO₂ shows negligible change. The thermal on/off ratio rises from 1.07 at room temperature to 1.2 at 50 K. Molecular dynamics simulations support a role for phonon angular momentum in the chirality-dependent heat transfer.

The passage says US stocks have often performed reasonably well during wars, with a study finding lower volatility during conflicts and an association between higher defense spending and lower volatility. It cites a recovery in stocks after Pearl Harbor and after Iraq’s invasion of Kuwait. These examples involved wars outside US territory; the passage contrasts them with severe market losses and closures in countries affected by war at home. It also says gold and commodities can rise amid uncertainty and disrupted supply chains, though commodities have had poor long-term returns compared with stocks.

Students from several Pennsylvania communities received academic honors, took on leadership roles and participated in service projects. Molly Noon was inducted into Misericordia’s occupational therapy honor society, and Abigail Kauffman received Immaculata’s senior leadership award. Three Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine students matched with residencies: Roni Dermo in obstetrics-gynecology, Cassandra Graeff in pediatrics and Elizabeth Helwig in psychiatry. At King’s College, Hayley Hammer joined a psychology honor society, Lyle Luckenbill was elected student government treasurer and Molly McMullen completed a marketing and communications internship. Gregory Schuettler joined a graduate honor society at Kutztown. Susquehanna’s Ashley Machamer presented research, while Kelsey Miller became a sorority president. Shelby Weikel participated in an occupational therapy pinning ceremony, and Wilkes students Rachael Krell and Shana Noon joined service trips abroad.

Gold prices were steady on Tuesday as investors awaited Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen’s congressional testimony for clues on interest rates. Spot gold was $1,225.06 an ounce, while U.S. futures edged higher. SPDR Gold Trust holdings rose, and a survey showed U.S. inflation expectations at their highest since mid-2015.
The Steelers enter Week 5 alone atop the AFC North after being the division’s only Week 4 winner. They have a Week 5 bye, while the Bengals host the Lions and the Browns face the Vikings.

Effective school-based mental health programs rely on collaboration among families, educators, school staff and community providers, while adapting to local needs. Teachers help identify students who may need support, and clinicians’ presence in schools makes care easier to access. Baltimore providers promote their services to students and families; Maryland expanded in-school care after transportation, childcare and stigma limited attendance at outside appointments. Minnesota adapted the model with funding that covers clinicians’ work beyond counseling. Its programs now reach most public schools and draw on insurance and state funding.

Digital media brand The Debrief, launched in 2014 for young women, has announced it is closing because it cannot “see a viable future”. Its work included an investigation into hormonal contraceptives and mental health and a campaign against letting agency fees. The award-winning website said many writers would likely contribute to sister publication Grazia.

Two Connecticut Army veterans have filed a proposed class-action lawsuit alleging the Army gave potentially thousands of service members less-than-honorable discharges without adequately considering PTSD and other mental health conditions. The suit says Army discharge review boards inconsistently apply a required liberal standard to such claims. The Army declined to comment on pending litigation.

An episode of STAT’s “The Readout LOUD” discusses a rebound in biotech stocks and sentiment, Peter Marks’ new role at Eli Lilly, a biotech’s effort to revive a rare disease drug shelved by AstraZeneca, and fundraising by China-focused Expedition Therapeutics.

The Economist’s “Carrie Bradshaw index” compares typical studio rents with local median wages to assess whether single renters can afford to live alone without spending more than 30% of gross income on rent. Fifty-nine cities met that threshold, down from 62 last year. New York was the least affordable for the third year running; coastal cities generally ranked worse than Sun Belt and Midwestern cities.

Jaime Smith’s guide offers practical advice for community college students planning to transfer to four-year institutions, including keeping course records, weighing fit over prestige, and checking housing costs and major requirements. The reviewer praises its clear organization and varied case studies, but recommends consulting local transfer advisers about credit limits, scholarships and course choices. The main criticism is that the book understates the benefits of completing an associate degree before transferring, which can help protect credits and provide a credential if a student later leaves school. Overall, the reviewer finds the guide useful and accessible.

Martin Brodeur said his team kept its approach after playing well without winning its first three games of the series. He credited strong performances and favorable bounces for the win, while noting the team managed only three shots in the second period before improving in the third. Looking ahead to the next game in New Jersey, he said the team would take the series one game at a time.

In four survey rounds in Rakai, Uganda, the proportion of recently medically circumcised men reporting sex before the recommended 42-day abstinence period fell from 45.1% in 2013–2015 to 14.9% in 2018–2020. Across the surveys, early sex resumption was more common among married men, men with multiple sexual partners, and men with primary rather than post-primary education. The study relied on self-reported behavior, which may have been underreported.

Banks and Jardine stocks drove the Straits Times Index’s movements during the week. The index gained 72 points, or 2.2 per cent, while Friday’s trading reached $1.3 billion. Singapore’s private residential property prices rebounded for the first time in four years, prompting OCBC Investment Research to maintain its positive sector outlook. Maybank Kim Eng said full-year GDP growth could exceed existing forecasts. Nomura retained a “buy” recommendation on Keppel, despite expecting continued challenges for its offshore and marine business.

In a randomized crossover study of 32 people with alcohol use disorder, seven days of mifepristone was compared with placebo during a laboratory procedure involving yohimbine, alcohol cues and alcohol administration. No serious adverse events occurred. Mifepristone reduced craving at the first alcohol-cue exposure, urge and cue-elicited salivation, but did not reduce alcohol consumption. Craving reductions were significant only among participants with a lower family history density of alcoholism and were not mediated by increased cortisol. Limitations included the absence of a yohimbine-placebo condition and the small number of female participants.

Seagate’s new 12TB Barracuda Pro, IronWolf and IronWolf Pro drives are shipping worldwide, with prices from $390 to $440. Barracuda Pro targets internal PCs, while IronWolf models target NAS systems. The Pro models offer sustained transfer rates up to 250MBps and five-year warranties; standard IronWolf offers 210MBps and a three-year warranty.

CVS Health’s stock fell amid health care reform uncertainty, Walgreens’ partnership with Prime Therapeutics, and CVS’s departure from the Tricare pharmacy network. The author argues that the Walgreens deal and Tricare loss will not significantly affect CVS’s revenue, citing the scale of CVS Caremark’s business. The passage points to CVS’s acquisitions of Omnicare and Target pharmacies as sources of growth. Using a discounted cash flow model, the author estimates CVS shares’ intrinsic value at $116.32, compared with a closing price of $80.07, and concludes that the market has overlooked the company’s prospects. The author discloses a long position in CVS.

Ronald Gabler appealed his aggravated-assault conviction, arguing that his trial counsel was ineffective for not investigating the victim’s medical evidence and not objecting to testimony about Gabler’s character. The court held that counsel’s approach to the medical evidence was a reasonable trial strategy and that the evidence would not likely have changed the verdict. It also found no prejudice from the character testimony, noting that Gabler had put his character in issue. The court affirmed the denial of his motion for a new trial.

A man was taken into custody after a possible pipe bomb explosion in a subway passage near New York’s Port Authority during Monday morning’s rush hour. Police said no one besides the suspect was injured, though media reported several injuries. Trains bypassed nearby stations, and some subway lines were evacuated.

TMPM commands can migrate up to 128 pages per command, including nonadjacent pages from multiple guests. Migration entries and commands must be order-independent. PM_SUCCESS means all pages migrated; PM_PARTIAL_SUCCESS requires checking per-page status; other return codes mean none migrated. Pages marked PM_RMP_NOTEXCLUSIVE may be retried after the conflict resolves.

The lecture introduces loop diagrams in QED, which include vacuum fluctuations and require integration over internal momenta. These integrals can diverge; renormalization provides a way to obtain physically sensible predictions. Loop corrections change the relationship between measured masses, charges and fields and the parameters in the QED Lagrangian, while preserving gauge symmetry and the photon’s zero mass. The lecture derives the electron’s tree-level magnetic-moment factor, \(g=2\), from the nonrelativistic Dirac equation, then describes Schwinger’s loop correction and its agreement with experiment.

Researchers analyzed RNA from 38 granulomatous myositis muscle biopsies and compared it with samples from other myopathies and controls. They found elevated IFNγ signaling, inflammatory cytokines, and macrophage-associated genes concentrated in granulomas. A GM-specific gene set correlated with disease-activity markers; CHIT1 was the most significantly upregulated gene. A machine-learning classifier achieved 98.6% accuracy. The study lacked infectious and genetic granulomatous muscle disease samples, and most markers were assessed only at the RNA level.

York Capital Management Global Advisors acquired 564,015 Varian Medical Systems shares in the second quarter, valued at approximately $58.2 million and representing about 0.61% of the company. Analysts’ average rating was “Hold,” with a $94.94 average price target. Varian reported quarterly earnings of $1.04 per share, above the $0.95 estimate, and revenue of $662.4 million. Insiders sold 54,787 shares during the quarter.

In this study of 20 participants each with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD), Parkinson’s disease with RBD (PD+RBD), or neither condition, iRBD patients had a higher proportion of phasic REM sleep. Patients with PD+RBD had fewer, shorter sawtooth-wave bursts. Both patient groups showed a shift in sawtooth-wave activity toward higher frequencies. Transitions into REM sleep were longer in iRBD than in controls and longest in PD+RBD. The study’s small size and differences in medication use limit interpretation; whether these features predict disease progression remains unknown.

Apple’s 2021 Form 10-K covers the fiscal year ended September 25, 2021. The company designs and sells smartphones, computers, tablets, wearables, accessories and related services. It had approximately 154,000 full-time equivalent employees; direct and indirect channels accounted for 36% and 64% of net sales, respectively. The filing discusses risks including COVID-19, competition, supply shortages, cybersecurity, regulation and litigation. In the Epic Games case, a court ruled for Apple on nine of ten counts but found that certain App Store guidelines violated California law; both parties appealed. As of September 25, $60.9 billion remained available under Apple’s share repurchase program.

Apple reported third-quarter 2022 net sales of $83.0 billion, up 2% from a year earlier, while net income fell to $19.4 billion from $21.7 billion. Higher Services and iPhone sales were partly offset by lower Mac and Wearables, Home and Accessories sales. For the first nine months, net sales rose 8% to $304.2 billion and net income rose to $79.1 billion. Apple repurchased $21.7 billion of stock during the quarter. It reported that weaker foreign currencies hurt quarterly sales and that COVID-19-related disruptions had caused supply shortages.

Elina Svitolina won her fifth title of 2017 at the Rogers Cup in Toronto, defeating Caroline Wozniacki 6-4, 6-0 in the final after beating four top-ten opponents during the tournament. The victory made her the first woman to win three Premier 5 titles in one season and lifted her to world number four. Svitolina said she had arrived with an injury and no expectations, and felt exhausted by a demanding schedule. Now 5-0 in finals this year, she credited her focus on one match at a time and said she was looking ahead to Cincinnati and the US Open.

The N.C. Wildlife Resources Commission is accepting public comments through April 8 on 2018–19 migratory game bird seasons and will choose dates April 26. Proposed changes include compensatory hunting days, a possible dove season extending to Jan. 31, and elimination of the Southern James Bay Canada goose hunt zone. The Commission also seeks feedback on brant season options.
The speaker made a timely save after a breakdown, then held the puck until play stopped. With two chances to finish the playoff, the team hopes to do so in Jersey but expects a tough game.

Micron shares have risen 44% this year ahead of Thursday’s fiscal second-quarter earnings, raising expectations. Analysts recently set $100 price targets, citing improving DRAM prices and milder-than-expected NAND declines. Morgan Stanley cautioned that strong business trends may already be reflected in the stock, which has remained in overbought territory.

Apple reported that on November 15, 2019, it issued €1 billion of 0.000% notes due in 2025 and €1 billion of 0.500% notes due in 2031. Interest is payable annually beginning November 15, 2020. The notes are senior unsecured obligations.

Indian markets were expected to open flat Tuesday, with SGX Nifty slightly lower, while other Asian markets edged up. On Monday, the Sensex and Nifty rose for a third consecutive session. Analysts recommended buying Adani Enterprises, Tata Global, PC Jeweller and ONGC, each with specified targets and stop losses.

The lecture compares linear feedback with minimum-time bang-bang control for a bounded double integrator. It reviews Pontryagin’s minimum principle, then derives the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation from dynamic programming and uses it to derive linear quadratic regulator (LQR) feedback through the Riccati equation. Finite-horizon LQR feedback varies with time; the infinite-horizon solution uses a steady-state gain. The lecturer explains that the HJB sufficiency theorem requires a smooth value-function gradient, unlike the minimum-time example, and says later lectures will use algorithms for problems that resist analytical solutions.

The passage lists diplomatic correspondence dated August 1894 through March 1895. In a letter to Mr. Gresham, Mr. Heard describes about forty members of a Korean religious sect kneeling outside the palace to petition the king. The sect, founded in 1859, had grown to thousands of adherents despite persecution and its founder’s execution in 1864.

Hedge funds are privately offered investment pools for accredited investors and institutions, managed with the aim of maximizing returns and minimizing risk. They may use short selling, leverage, derivatives, and systematic or discretionary strategies. Common approaches include long/short equity, event-driven investing, global macro, relative value, and fixed income arbitrage; some funds focus on niches such as real estate or cryptocurrency. The passage emphasizes combining strategies with low correlations to reduce drawdowns. Potential benefits include diversification and access to professional managers, while risks include illiquidity, leverage, fees, and unsuccessful strategies. Minimum investments typically range from $100,000 to $500,000.

A June 2001 collection of news reports covers energy issues involving Enron and other companies. Democrats sought wholesale electricity price caps in the West, while California officials investigated whether power trading and plant shutdowns had inflated prices. Lawmakers considered plans to rescue Southern California Edison, including charges for large businesses. In India, officials worked to resolve a payment and pricing dispute involving Enron’s Dabhol power plant, as Fitch moved India’s rating outlook to negative. Other reports covered proposed Saudi gas projects, foreign companies buying their Indian affiliates, former Enron executive Thomas E. White becoming Army secretary, and construction of a Mississippi power plant involving an Enron subsidiary.

Energy Central’s January 25, 2002 dispatch compiles electric-power and gas-industry news. Much of its coverage concerns Enron’s collapse, Ken Lay’s resignation, Andersen’s document destruction, congressional investigations and related lawsuits. Other stories address Pacific Gas & Electric’s bankruptcy plan, utility finances, power projects and energy policy.

This 1894 *Foreign Relations of the United States* ebook, generated in May 2018, includes correspondence on the Chinese-Japanese War. The Office of the Historian says the downloadable edition preserves the printed content while adding search and reading features. It recommends citing document numbers rather than page numbers.

The court found that counsel was ineffective for failing to challenge the Board’s registration determination. The Board should not have required registration because Olin’s California offense did not qualify.
Solid lines depict the interface design; dashed and gray portions are excluded.

Two Canadian studies of university students found that a higher facial width-to-height ratio was associated with greater sex drive and more permissive attitudes toward infidelity. The passage cautions that the findings show a correlation, not proof that wide-faced people cheat, and that the student samples limit firm conclusions.

Emma Watson won Woman of the Year at London’s ELLE Style Awards for her acting and gender-equality campaigning, including her work with HeForShe. Other winners included Debbie Harry for Style Icon, Riz Ahmed for Actor of the Year, Sasha Lane for Breakthrough Actress, and Christine and the Queens for Album of the Year.

The October 18, 2000 VentureWire reports venture funding, acquisitions, product launches and leadership changes. Highlights include Jamcracker raising more than $100 million, Broadcom’s $264 million agreement to acquire Allayer, SonicWall’s $258.9 million agreement to acquire Phobos, and Edgix’s $50 million financing round.

Femtosecond laser irradiation produced periodic surface ripples about 260 nm apart on niobium thin films. As the ripples formed, film thickness and lattice parameter decreased, alongside modest reductions in critical temperature and upper critical field. Unlike these largely orientation-independent changes, critical current became anisotropic: it was generally higher along the ripples than across them, and treated films outperformed pristine films under some field and temperature conditions. Time-dependent Ginzburg–Landau simulations support an explanation in which thickness undulations hinder vortex motion across the ripples.

This non-peer-reviewed preprint introduces PHIVE, an unsupervised, physics-informed model for quantifying metabolites in whole-brain MRSI and estimating uncertainty. Using 7T data from 12 healthy volunteers, the researchers trained PHIVE on eight subjects and tested it on four. Compared with LCModel, PHIVE produced broadly similar metabolite maps and generally lower measurement variability, though some estimates, particularly for mIns, differed. PHIVE fitted a whole-brain dataset in 6 milliseconds, versus 2 hours for LCModel, and generated CRLB, epistemic, and aleatoric uncertainty maps. The authors note limitations including the small sample, lack of ground-truth concentrations, and absence of separate frequency-correction preprocessing.

Fossil Group shares fell 2.39% in the most recent session and last closed at $7.77. Eight analysts’ 12-month price targets average $6.63, ranging from $4 to $15. Of 10 recommendations, five are Hold, three Underperform, one Outperform and one Sell. The stock’s 14-period average true range is 0.71, and its relative strength index is 41.16. Fossil’s market capitalization is $378.94 million, with 48.77 million shares outstanding.

The passage calls for expanded defense research, restored U.S. intelligence capabilities, stronger international broadcasting, and closer consultation with allies. It argues that military force should be a last resort and criticizes the Carter administration’s foreign policy. An editorial note then describes a May 1980 interview in which Ronald Reagan said the Iranian hostages’ detention could not be separated from broader concerns about threats to the United States and the safety of Americans abroad.

Regular exercise, a healthy weight, and strength and flexibility work can help protect knees from injury and wear. Low-impact activities such as cycling and swimming support knee health while limiting impact. If knee pain persists or limits mobility, a physiotherapist can assess it and recommend exercises; physiotherapy may aid recovery and help delay or avoid surgery. Knee surgery is most often needed by people over 50 and may improve quality of life when rehabilitation alone is insufficient, though it carries risks, including infection and deep vein thrombosis. Physiotherapy and regular recommended exercises can also support recovery after surgery.

Trust Co. of Vermont increased its United Technologies stake by 2.3% in the third quarter to 115,963 shares, valued at $11.78 million. Other investors also raised their holdings; institutions and hedge funds owned 78.26% of the company’s stock. United Technologies reported quarterly earnings of $1.76 per share and revenue of $14.40 billion, both above consensus estimates. It paid a $0.66-per-share quarterly dividend in December. The stock had a consensus “Hold” rating and an average price target of $112.82.

While welcoming French President Emmanuel Macron to the Oval Office, President Donald Trump praised their “special relationship,” brushed dandruff from Macron’s shoulder in front of reporters and called him “perfect.”

Actors Daisy McCrackin and Joseph Capone were allegedly kidnapped from McCrackin’s Los Angeles home and held for ransom. Court documents say Capone was assaulted and confined in a bathtub without food, while McCrackin was taken to banks and forced to write a cheque. She escaped and alerted police. Keith Andre Stewart, Johntae Jones and Amber Neal were arrested and face charges including kidnapping and assault.

This study compared behavioural changes in 26 people with behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), 21 with semantic dementia (SD), and 18 healthy controls using caregiver questionnaires, cognitive tests and, for a subset, MRI. Behavioural changes were common in both conditions but generally more severe in bvFTD; no behaviour measured was more prevalent in SD. Semantic memory and executive-function tests distinguished the conditions better than behavioural measures. Apathy was associated with poorer executive function and anterior cingulate cortex atrophy, while caregiver and patient apathy ratings often differed. The authors found no association between questionnaire-rated behavioural change and social-semantic knowledge or anterior temporal lobe volume.

The passage warns that violent demagogues and wealthy corruptionists alike threaten popular government and may work together against equal justice. It urges limits on railroad employees’ hours, broader adoption of an eight-hour workday where practical, enforcement of the federal eight-hour law, and summer half holidays for government employees. It also calls for an investigation of women’s and children’s labor and an immediate, strong child-labor law for the District of Columbia and the Territories.

Invictus MD Strategies received $5.78 million from warrant and option exercises during its fiscal year beginning February 1, 2018. It expects to use the proceeds for construction and operations and projects cannabis cultivation capacity of 262,000 square feet by the end of 2018 and 846,000 by the end of 2019. The company also granted 120,000 incentive stock options. These capacity projections are forward-looking and subject to risks.

In a year-end *Wall Street Week* program, Louis Rukeyser reviewed 2000’s markets: the Dow fell just over 6%, the S&P 500 more than 10%, and the Nasdaq more than 39%. Economic growth slowed, while unemployment remained near 4%. Panelists debated whether weaker consumer confidence, corporate earnings and Federal Reserve interest-rate decisions would shape 2001. Rukeyser reported that the four guests’ 2000 investment portfolios had gained despite the market declines. They offered Dow and Nasdaq forecasts and investment selections for 2001; the transcript also lists predictions and selections from the program’s other panelists.

The Education Department restarted loan forgiveness for IBR borrowers with 25 years of on-time payments. Eligible borrowers may opt out by Oct. 21; a government shutdown could delay processing before a tax exemption expires Dec. 31.

Brent Honeywell pitched six scoreless innings, allowing four hits and striking out seven without a walk, as Triple-A Durham beat Columbus 11-0. Pitching coach Kyle Snyder praised Honeywell’s command and adjustments. Brad Boxberger struck out all three batters he faced in the seventh, and Ryne Stanek and Adam Kolarek completed the shutout. Shane Peterson drove in two runs and finished a triple short of the cycle.

Four Verticals sends four receivers downfield to stretch the defense and create one-on-one matchups or openings in zone coverage. It can work against man coverage and Cover 3, but Cover 4 and soft zones make favorable throws harder to find. Receiver routes adjust to the safety alignment, while the tailback checks protection before becoming a check-down option. The quarterback identifies coverage before the snap, looks off safeties, then seeks a favorable deep throw or checks down. Variations from 3x1 and empty formations preserve the receivers’ landmarks while offering different options.

Founded in 2004, Yunnan Lucky Air grew rapidly as a low-cost carrier, carrying 1.2 million passengers and earning US$104.3 million in revenue in 2007. Its Yunnan tourist routes were profitable, but government controls over pricing, fuel, landing fees, and aircraft leasing limited its cost advantage as competition increased.

Lucky Air considered e-commerce as another competitive advantage. Its website supported fully online booking and payment, but consumers bought only 1% of its total tickets directly through it; agents remained its main sales channel. Low Internet use in Yunnan, limited online payment options, and security concerns constrained online sales. The company weighed further investment in its website and customer services against other options, including tour packages, while facing limited funds and growing competition.

The President announces that 100,000 more American troops will leave South Vietnam between May 1 and December 1, bringing total withdrawals to 365,000. He says training South Vietnamese forces and operations in Cambodia and Laos have enabled faster withdrawals and reduced American casualties. He seeks a complete withdrawal, preferably through negotiations, and calls on Hanoi to release prisoners of war. He rejects announcing a final withdrawal date, arguing it would weaken negotiations and endanger remaining troops. He says the war should end in a way that gives South Vietnam a chance to determine its future and honors Americans who served and died.

Lattice Semiconductor shows early signs of a revenue rebound, supported by data center demand, while automotive and industrial markets remain weak. Management sees opportunities in high-end data center chips and emerging markets. Inventories are normalizing, cash generation is strong, and the company has no debt. The author raises the target price to $70 but maintains a HOLD rating because of the stock’s valuation and limited margin of safety.

Researchers identified a new genus and species, the duckbilled clingfish (*Nettorhamphos radula*), from two museum specimens collected off Southern Australia, one in 1977. Its broad snout and unusual jaw contain an estimated 1,800–2,300 tiny teeth, about ten times as many as other known clingfish. CT scans and 3-D prints let researchers examine its anatomy without dissecting the only known specimens. The fish has not been observed in the wild, so the function of its backward-pointing teeth remains uncertain.

During Lehigh’s Dec. 12–20 finals, crowded libraries make finding quiet study space difficult for some students. Students use academic buildings, cafes and reserved study rooms as alternatives, while some arrive early to secure seats. Lehigh is extending hours at several buildings, and Fairchild-Martindale Library will stay open around the clock for most of the exam period.

The statistical analysis plan specifies descriptive ECG summaries, including QTcF thresholds and changes from baseline, and descriptive analysis of treatment-induced or treatment-boosted antidrug antibodies without statistical tests. It records changes to efficacy analyses and provides rules for data presentation, calculations, missing dates, and SAS quality control. Appendices list planned tables, figures, and listings covering patient characteristics, plasma glucose recovery, adverse events, safety assessments, immunogenicity, and pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic measures.

Tesla Motors’ 2015 annual report describes its electric vehicles, energy storage products, manufacturing, sales and service operations, and business risks.
