Tesla delivered more than 107,000 Model S vehicles worldwide by December 31, 2015, began Model X deliveries in 2015, and planned to unveil the lower-priced Model 3 in 2016. It also began producing Tesla Energy storage products.

Tesla sold vehicles through its own network, which had 208 sales and service locations and 584 Supercharger stations worldwide at year-end. It manufactured vehicles and components in California and the Netherlands and was developing a Nevada Gigafactory for battery production.

The report identifies risks including production delays, dependence on suppliers, uncertainty about demand, manufacturing costs, product defects, competition and regulatory restrictions on direct vehicle sales.

The Trump administration’s 2018 Nuclear Posture Review calls for modernising the US nuclear arsenal, including limited low-yield options and a future nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile. Officials said the changes are intended to strengthen deterrence amid threats from Russia, China, North Korea and Iran, while maintaining commitments to allies. The policy reaffirms arms control and non-proliferation goals, retains the moratorium on nuclear testing, and says the US will not threaten compliant non-nuclear states party to the Non-Proliferation Treaty with nuclear weapons.

Ultraprocessed foods are engineered for appeal, and studies suggest they can trigger cravings, overeating and brain responses resembling those associated with addictive substances. Researchers still have questions about who is most affected and whether these foods should be classified as addictive. Proposed responses include clearer labeling, healthier school meals and stronger regulation.

The federal government and provinces and territories agreed to a two-year plan for sharing tax revenue from legalized marijuana. Provinces and territories will receive 75 per cent and decide with municipalities how to cover local costs. Ottawa will receive 25 per cent, capped at $100 million annually, with any excess going to provinces and territories. Finance Minister Bill Morneau estimated tax revenue of up to $400 million over the first two years. Ministers will review the arrangement in December 2018. Provinces may also add their own markups.

Researchers at ANU and the Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris found that sodium and potassium form clusters or channels in alumino-silicate glass rather than distributing randomly. These microscopic arrangements, along with other elements, influence the glass’s flexibility and resistance to fractures. The findings could help manufacturers develop more durable phone screens, and ANU plans to work with industry partners.

The study introduces AMR-EnsembleNet, which combines a sequence-aware 1D convolutional neural network with XGBoost to predict antibiotic resistance from genomic SNP data. Tested on 809 *E. coli* isolates across four antibiotics, it performed best overall for cefotaxime and gentamicin, matched the highest ciprofloxacin accuracy, and trailed Random Forest for ceftazidime. SHAP analysis of XGBoost identified influential SNPs mapped to known resistance-associated genes.

The dollar rose broadly on Monday as traders unwound bearish bets amid a pause in U.S.–North Korea rhetoric. The dollar index gained 0.3%, and the currency rose against the yen and Swiss franc. Rising U.S. and global stocks also supported the dollar. Investors awaited Tuesday’s U.S. retail sales report for clues on inflation.

Saskatoon staff recommend a $1.2-million, two-year plan to remove and replace about 1,000 black ash trees damaged by cottony ash psyllids. Insecticides have not stopped the trees’ decline. Funding has been identified for the first year, but not the second.

The speaker pledges to continue his predecessor’s reforms of railroads and industrial combinations while seeking clearer laws that protect legitimate business and prevent monopolies. He calls for prompt tariff revision to provide revenue and protect domestic production, recommending a graduated inheritance tax if import duties prove insufficient. He urges economical government without cutting necessary spending on agriculture, conservation, infrastructure, and national defense.

He supports a strong army and navy alongside efforts to resolve international disputes peacefully. He calls for federal enforcement of treaty protections for foreign nationals, banking reform, postal savings banks, expanded foreign trade, and completion of the Panama Canal. He also advocates improved relations between the South and other regions, enforcement of constitutional voting protections, and progress for Black Americans. On labor, he supports further worker-safety measures while retaining courts’ power to issue injunctions in industrial disputes, with safeguards against abuse.

All 15 economists and analysts in a Bloomberg survey expect Moody’s to keep South Africa’s debt at investment grade when it announces its decision Friday. The rand and business confidence have improved since Cyril Ramaphosa succeeded Jacob Zuma, but weak growth, missed budget targets and plans to allow land expropriation without compensation remain risks. A downgrade would leave South Africa’s debt rated junk by all three major agencies and could trigger substantial investment outflows.

The study examines how water- and ethanol-assisted rolling, drying, and optional annealing affect electrospun polyacrylonitrile nanofiber yarns. Liquid treatment increased fiber packing and alignment, improving stiffness, strength, and peak load while reducing ductility. Water-treated yarns generally outperformed ethanol-treated yarns; annealing increased stiffness and strength but further reduced failure strain, without significantly increasing peak load over water treatment alone. Peak load correlated with both alignment and packing density. A stochastic constitutive model reproduced the observed stress–strain behavior and linked fitted parameters to image-based measures of yarn structure.

Physicists developed a way to make mixtures of oil, water, and alcohol self-organize into layered droplets. By confining the liquids in droplets or thin straws, they made separation move inward from the edge. Adjusting the separation speed and timing controls the layers’ structure and release. The method could help develop medicines containing water- and oil-soluble ingredients.
OnePlus is rolling out Android Nougat with OxygenOS 4.0 to the OnePlus 3 and 3T. The update adds redesigned notifications and settings, multi-window support, and notification replies.

Milky Tea announced that HyperBrawl Tournament would enter Steam Early Access in June 2017. The arena game combines fast-paced handball with player-versus-player combat. It features 10 warriors, 10 weapons, six arenas, eight skill-building mini-games, and local or online matches for up to four players.

Gary Gensler describes finance as the pricing, allocation and movement of money and risk through institutions such as banks, insurers, asset managers and exchanges. He distinguishes primary from secondary markets and explains that ledgers and payment systems record and transfer value. Financial regulation, he says, has long addressed stability and public protection, while finance has continually adapted to new technologies.

Gensler identifies liquidity, funding, settlement and model risks as major sources of trouble for financial firms. He attributes the 2008 crisis to a combination of weak mortgage underwriting, predatory lending, easy credit, leverage, interconnected derivatives, poor risk management and incentives that rewarded gains without comparable penalties for losses. He says banks now hold more capital but are also more concentrated.

For potential blockchain applications, Gensler emphasizes records of value, settlement, data-intensive processes, legacy systems and areas with substantial economic rents.

The Fifth Circuit affirmed Jose Verastegui’s convictions and concurrent 120-month sentences for being a felon in possession of a firearm and unlawfully reentering the United States. It found no abuse of discretion in the upward departure or the non-Guideline sentence. His challenges to a sentencing adjustment and to the constitutionality of the relevant firearm and reentry statutes were foreclosed by precedent.

Enjifit launched its free iOS app on July 3, 2018, to connect users with nearby workout partners and personal trainers based on their goals and interests. Users can message others, set workout reminders and post sessions for others to join. A paid PRO subscription lets trainers and nutritionists feature their services. An Android version is planned.

The nuclear force binds nucleons and is described as a residual strong interaction between quarks in different hadrons. Evidence from scattering, binding energies, and nuclear structure shows that it is short-range, strongly repulsive below about 0.5 femtometers, and dependent on spin and angular momentum. After electromagnetic effects are removed, it appears independent of whether the interacting nucleons are protons or neutrons. Comparisons of mirror nuclei support this charge independence and can help study unstable nuclei.

Pepsi Nigeria’s No Shakin’ Carry Go campaign will send 10 people on an all-expenses-paid, three-day VVIP trip to November’s One Africa Music Fest in Dubai, with opportunities to meet Pepsi stars. Entry details will appear on Pepsi’s social media accounts.

Tech megacaps lost $770 billion in market value Friday after President Trump threatened higher tariffs on Chinese imports. Nvidia, Amazon and Tesla each fell about 5%, while the Nasdaq dropped 3.6% and the S&P 500 fell 2.7%—their worst days since April. After the close, Trump announced a 100% tariff on China and November export controls on critical software, sending the three stocks lower in extended trading.

An Accenture survey of 1,300 investors found that clients across age and wealth groups preferred hybrid wealth management, combining low-cost robo advisers with human expertise for complex situations. Respondents also said online tools they once considered optional are now expected.

The passage describes a model that estimates a scene’s depth map from a single color image. It is trained on monocular video, stereoscopic image pairs, or both by generating synthetic frames and reducing reconstruction errors. Training can account for occlusions and motion, use upsampled depth features, and discount static image features. The trained model can help place virtual content in a location-based game according to the depth of a captured scene.

Kennesaw State won the 2017 ASUN Championship by one shot over Lipscomb, finishing at 1-under 863 and securing its seventh consecutive NCAA Regional berth. Jake Fendt and Pablo Rodriguez-Tabernero tied for second individually at 2 under. Lipscomb’s Dawson Armstrong won the individual title at 6-under 210, becoming the school’s first ASUN men’s individual champion. Jacksonville and North Florida finished third and fourth; all four leading teams were expected to reach regionals.

Amazon.com closed a $12.75 billion sale of notes on April 13, 2022, with maturities from 2024 to 2062 and interest rates from 2.730% to 4.100%. The aggregate public offering price was $12.719 billion, and estimated net proceeds were approximately $12.692 billion before offering expenses.

Pupils appealed to President Mnangagwa to suspend the November 2018 public examinations, saying election-related teacher absences and a shortened term had limited their preparation. Education Permanent Secretary Dr Sylvia Utete-Masango did not disclose his response. She said schools should arrange holiday lessons in consultation with education officials. Schools will close on July 26 for the July 30 elections and reopen a week early on September 4 to make up for lost time.

North Wales Police are seeking witnesses after a man tried to force a woman into a car on Sisson Street in Rhyl at 8.25am. She escaped unharmed, and the man was seen entering a silver vehicle. Police said no child was involved, correcting an earlier council warning.

An interviewer questions six hockey prospects—James van Riemsdyk, Kyle Turris, Patrick Kane, Sam Gagner, Keaton Ellerby, and Karl Alzner—about their development, influences, teams, and NHL draft prospects. The discussion also covers college plans and World Junior experiences. The event ends with congratulations and wishes for the draft in Columbus.

Episode four of UFC 216 Embedded follows fighters shopping, training, preparing for weigh-ins and visiting a children’s cancer center before media day interviews and faceoffs ahead of two title fights on October 7.

The Clock (1-3-1) offense attacks a Diamond & One defense by placing the star player in the middle, where the chaser may be less prepared to defend the post. Corner passes trigger basket cuts and rotations, while dribble clears create back cuts and opportunities for ball reversal. From the high post, the star can drive, pass to teammates near the basket, or kick the ball out for an outside shot. The resulting inside triangle can provide a three-on-two offensive rebounding advantage. Effective execution requires coordinated movement, defensive recognition, timing, and adjustments to opponents’ matchups and defensive changes.

The Texas Supreme Court has proposed ending the American Bar Association’s final say over whether law school graduates qualify for the Texas bar exam. Public comments are due Dec. 1, with changes proposed for January. The court says it does not plan to impose additional accreditation requirements.

The authors argue that education initiatives often stall because leaders develop programs without also developing clear, trustworthy explanations of them. Communities may interpret reforms through past experiences of top-down control, data misuse and technology replacing teachers. They recommend framing, testing and refining narratives with teachers, students and families before scaling an initiative, while explaining its benefits, mechanisms and safeguards.

Attacking runs are off-the-ball movements into open space that give a teammate with the ball a passing option and help advance an attack. Effective runs require recognizing space, choosing a suitable route, separating from a defender, timing movement to avoid offside, and coordinating the run with an accurate pass. Players can communicate their intentions verbally, with hand signals, or through eye contact. The passage recommends teaching runs through demonstrations and drills that gradually add passes, defenders, and unrestricted play.

Using blood exome data from 454,803 UK Biobank and 173,585 Geisinger participants, researchers identified clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) mutations in 27,331 and 12,877 people, respectively. CHIP became more prevalent with age and was associated with heavy smoking.

Genetic analyses identified 27 common-variant loci, 24 of them novel, plus rare-variant and gene-burden associations. Genetic effects differed across CHIP mutation subtypes; variants at the TCL1A locus, for example, increased DNMT3A-CHIP risk but reduced TET2-CHIP and ASXL1-CHIP risk. CHIP was distinct from mosaic chromosomal alterations, although some genetic risk factors were shared.

In longitudinal analyses, carriers with high variant allele fractions had elevated risks of blood cancer, lung cancer, cardiovascular disease and death. These risks varied by mutation subtype: TET2-CHIP drove the observed cardiovascular association, while DNMT3A-CHIP was not associated with incident lymphoid cancer. An IL6R variant’s previously reported protective cardiovascular association in CHIP carriers did not persist in the full cohort. The study lacked serial samples to track clone changes over time.

After its 2015 Pluto flyby, NASA’s New Horizons mission was extended to study Kuiper Belt objects. Its first target, 2014 MU69, was expected to be reached on January 1, 2019, making it the farthest object encountered by a spacecraft. Observations suggested it might be an elongated body or two closely joined objects. A public naming campaign gave it the temporary nickname “Ultima Thule,” meaning “beyond Thule.” A formal name would be submitted after the flyby, depending on what the object proved to be.
Akure-based lawyer Morakinyo Ogele gave the EFCC seven days to publicly apologize to The Sun newspaper’s management for invading its premises and sought N1 billion in compensation.

Police in Guilford and Milford are investigating a series of car break-ins and thefts along the Connecticut shoreline. Guilford police say groups of youths have taken property and cars with keys left inside, sometimes fleeing recklessly when caught. Milford police are seeking two suspects accused of using credit cards stolen from cars. Residents are urged to lock vehicles, leave outdoor lights on and call 911 about suspicious activity.

The Aces lead the Mercury 3-0 in the WNBA Finals after a 90-88 Game 3 win, despite Phoenix rallying from 17 points down. A’ja Wilson scored 34 points and had 14 rebounds. Las Vegas has relied on varied defensive schemes, timely bench contributions and its experienced core. The Aces can win the championship with a Game 4 victory Friday.

The coach said penalty kills and a goal deflected off a defenseman changed the game, though he felt his team played well despite the loss. He expressed confidence in Pekka and the defensemen, praised Freddy’s goal, and said the next game would be important. He said the team’s previous playoff experience, consistent preparation, and attention to opponents’ speed would help it respond. He also described Filip as a leader and difference-maker.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week amid tariff concerns and was set to rebound slightly on Monday. Oil also declined as OPEC+ announced another production increase. The article warns that the stock-market rebound may be temporary and urges careful position management as earnings and economic risks build.

An International Whaling Commission report said Japan’s Antarctic hunt killed 333 minke whales, including 122 pregnant females and 114 not yet adults. Japan defended the program as research despite a 2014 court ruling against it.

Output capacitance should be the larger value calculated for load-transient voltage deviation or voltage ripple, with derating for aging, temperature, and DC bias. The design requires at least 1.3 mF; approximately 2.3 mF was used to help mitigate radiation-induced transients. An optional inductor-and-ceramic-capacitor filter can reduce ripple, with a resistor added if high-frequency peaking occurs. Cycle-by-cycle current limiting begins near 35 A, about 45% above the peak inductor current at maximum load.

After Philadelphia’s sickness declined, Congress could meet there safely, though the president suggested allowing future postponements. Envoys had departed for negotiations with France, but continuing attacks on American shipping led him to urge stronger commercial and national defenses. Spanish troops remained on U.S. territory, the boundary survey had not begun, and foreign agents were accused of encouraging Indian hostility. He reported progress and delays in commissions handling boundary and compensation claims under treaties with Britain and Spain. He also sought reimbursement for consuls who assisted captured sailors, revisions to consular law, and funding for treaty obligations. He urged Congress to limit public debt by relying on taxes rather than loans and to act together amid instability in Europe.

The passage outlines two defenses against the Power Offense’s continuous screening. The NBA-style “show and recover” approach has defenders step out to force shooters wide, then return to screeners while teammates chase shooters and deny passes. The “All Out SOS” approach seeks to disrupt the offense by pushing the ballhandler toward the sideline, switching on screens and trapping a shooter on the wing. Defenders then rotate to deny post passes and reversals, adjusting if the ball leaves the trap.

The speaker expressed disappointment at losing in the Stanley Cup Finals but said the team had a great run. They cited missed offensive chances, praised Bryan’s season and Mike’s coaching, and said the organization had improved and would return.

A collection of July 2001 news reports covers several energy-market disputes. California Secretary of State Bill Jones called for an investigation into possible conflicts of interest involving state energy consultants who owned power-company stock; the state was reviewing their transactions. The London Metal Exchange fined Enron Metals £190,000 for repeated trading-rule breaches. A California Senate committee was considering dropping a contempt charge against Enron as the company moved toward providing records for an electricity-pricing investigation. Other reports describe opposition to a California utility bill, calls for Dutch generators to disclose plant outages, refund claims among Northwest utilities, and India’s rejection of a proposal for a state utility to buy Enron’s stake in Dabhol Power. A separate report says Terremark warned investors it needed additional financing.

The Bulls lost their sixth straight game Saturday, falling 113-103 to the Clippers while shooting 36.1 percent. Zach LaVine scored 21 points, and Paul Zipser added 16. With Nikola Mirotic traded and Kris Dunn and Lauri Markkanen out, coach Fred Hoiberg said the team is using makeshift lineups. Management remains active in trade discussions, but any move would focus on the future rather than immediate help.

The passage presents a method for generating quantum-correlated phonon pairs in an optomechanical crystal nanobeam cavity. Simultaneous Stokes and anti-Stokes interactions create the pairs through an effective four-wave-mixing process. A second red-detuned pulse retrieves them, and the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality verifies their quantum correlations. The approach addresses the challenge of generating nonclassical phonon pairs through optical control.

Marian Hossa looks forward to a difficult Stanley Cup Final against a team with strong defense and many experienced players. He says friendship with a longtime friend and neighbor will be set aside during the series. His team must stay disciplined, avoid turnovers and keep moving against a large, skilled opposing defenseman. Hossa praises his coach’s communication and trust, and says rolling four lines has helped the team conserve energy. He also says the lockout gave him time to recover, regain his fitness and return to his usual level of play.

In Fairfax County, parents can appeal second-graders’ gifted-program decisions using privately funded tests. AP data show that only 3 percent of students admitted through appeals are black or Hispanic, though they comprise a third of the school population.

Since Florida’s 2023 takeover of New College, state spending has risen while graduation and retention rates have fallen and the college has dropped nearly 60 places in national liberal arts rankings. Critics question the cost—roughly $134,000 per student—and worry that changes to the college are eroding its distinctive character. President Richard Corcoran has challenged the rankings’ peer-assessment measure. Amid concerns about possible closure, former administrator Nathan Allen is advocating privatization, an idea drawing mixed reactions from faculty and alumni.
SFS addresses priority runtime concerns in AMD firmware, not x86 processor code. Its non-persistent updates bridge BIOS releases and require a specified PI release and base firmware level.

April 6 deal reports included Seven & i’s planned $3.3 billion purchase of Sunoco stores and petrol stations, Shandong Gold’s $960 million investment in Barrick’s Veladero mine, and MGM’s roughly $1 billion acquisition of the rest of Epix. Cardinal Health was nearing a deal for Medtronic’s medical supplies business, while Fincantieri reached a preliminary agreement for a stake in STX France. Old Mutual and Bank Hapoalim explored sales, and Unilever announced plans for shareholder rewards following Kraft Heinz’s takeover approach.

SGB is working with a University committee on a proposed humanities grant program, potentially matching funding for student events. It is also advocating for more study space and a possible reflection room during Hillman Library’s multiyear renovation, which begins on the fourth floor this summer. Students can vote for SGB president and board members on Feb. 21; the Elections Committee hopes to increase turnout. The board also considered funding requests from five student organizations, approving some in full or in part and denying Mosaic’s request.

SpaceX’s Falcon 9 is scheduled to launch Monday from Kennedy Space Center after a nearly month-long delay. Its Dragon spacecraft will deliver about 6,400 pounds of experiments and supplies, including mice and ice cream, to the International Space Station.

Asia-Pacific stocks fell Thursday as investors took profits after the Federal Reserve raised rates, outlined plans to shrink its balance sheet and maintained its projected pace of rate increases. Weak U.S. inflation and retail-sales data weighed on yields and the dollar. Australian stocks fell 1%, pressured by slower Chinese credit growth and declines in commodity and oil shares following a slump in crude prices. Markets in Hong Kong, South Korea and Japan also declined.

The speaker sees the home game as a chance to bring the cup to Vancouver and says the team must give its all without regrets. They expect an emotional night with the fans, plan to play physically within the rules rather than worry about officiating, and feel confident heading into the do-or-die game.

A weak U.S. jobs report and sharply revised earlier figures weighed on USD/JPY, which fell 2.25% on Friday. The Bank of England is expected to cut rates to 4.0% on Thursday as the UK economy loses momentum; GBP/USD remains near May’s support level. BTC/USD also declined alongside equities and found support around 112,000. The outlook identifies key price levels for all three pairs while noting that economic uncertainty, tariffs and Federal Reserve policy could affect markets.

Gold and silver prices fell in early U.S. trading Monday, with December gold at $1,288 an ounce and September silver at $16.995. Profit-taking after gold’s nine-week high, a stronger dollar and easing fears of imminent U.S.–North Korea conflict weighed on gold, while global stocks mostly rose. U.S. officials emphasized diplomacy, and China banned key North Korean imports. Despite Monday’s declines, the report said gold and silver bulls retained a near-term technical advantage.

HNA Group co-founder and co-chairman Wang Jian died Tuesday at 57 after a fall in southern France during a business trip. The Chinese conglomerate has recently sold assets as regulators tighten lending controls and press companies to reduce debt.

The TPS7H500x-SP series comprises radiation-hardness-assured PWM controllers that use fixed-frequency, peak-current-mode control for space-grade DC-DC converters. The passage presents a TPS7H5001-SP synchronous push-pull GaN converter design with a 500-kHz switching frequency and 5-V output. It describes component choices for timing, the transformer, switches, output filtering, current limiting, and compensation. The design uses approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance, partly to mitigate radiation-induced transients.

The controllers require a regulated 4–14 V supply and input bypassing. Layout guidance emphasizes separating sensitive signals from switching noise, minimizing switching loops, and placing bypass and compensation components close to the controller. TI states that application information must be validated by customers and provides related documentation, revision history, packaging information, and disclaimers.

Coach Sutter said his team’s path to the Stanley Cup was different this year, with new players, lineup changes and a need for depth and resilience. He praised the players’ consistency through a long playoff run and congratulated the New York Rangers on their season. He also recalled Drew saying he would win both an Olympic gold medal and the Stanley Cup, and said third-period statistics alone do not show how a team played.

In a discussion of the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals, Dr. Pasvolsky said membership depended on accepting common principles and obligations, and that nations remained bound by obligations even if they ceased to participate. He said the organization’s authority could be reconsidered during a transitional period and that Assembly decisions did not require unanimity.

A subsequent State Department telegram opposed regional blocs directed against other states and exclusive spheres of influence. It said proposed security zones would be acceptable only if they upheld the organization’s principles, preserved states’ independence, and supported regional peace and security. Regional arrangements would remain subject to Security Council oversight, and enforcement action would require its authorization.

AOL Instant Messenger will shut down on December 15 after 20 years. Launched in 1997, AIM helped make the internet a place to socialize, but it lost relevance as users moved to smartphones, messaging apps, and social networks.

After a heavy playoff loss, the speaker said the team made mistakes and gave its goalie too little help. The opponent scored several goals in a row, including on power plays, taking away momentum. The team tried to regroup in the third period and must respond with a better effort at home.

The study used a sub-pixel shift-and-add algorithm to combine electron backscatter diffraction patterns captured with a 256 × 256-pixel direct electron detector. Tests on single-crystal silicon showed that the reconstructed pattern contained finer diffraction features and more than doubled the signal-to-noise ratio, from about 30 to 70. It outperformed a single pattern captured at an equivalent dose and required no hardware modification. The approach relies on the patterns sharing a common crystal orientation and lattice, which may complicate its use on less uniform samples.

The S&P 500 real estate sector became a separate sector in 2016. It includes real estate companies and some REITs, but not mortgage REITs. The passage says it has 31 stocks and represents about 2.9% of the index; XLRE and VNQ are two ETFs tracking the sector. A VNQ strategy backtest showed a 6.43% annual gain versus 3.7% for buy and hold, excluding reinvested dividends. A second, undisclosed strategy averaged 0.74% per trade with an 80% win rate. The authors argue that sensitivity to external factors, particularly interest rates, limits the value of backtesting, while the sector may offer traders diversification.

The Allies pledge to continue the war to victory. In its note, Belgium welcomes President Wilson’s wish for peace but rejects the idea that both sides seek the same ends. It cites Germany’s violation of Belgian neutrality and its treatment of civilians, and says peace must provide reparation and future security. Belgium thanks Americans for relief efforts and support. A separate dispatch reports that Greece accepted an ultimatum in principle after receiving guarantees against aggression by the Provisional Government.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Friday as stronger-than-expected January hiring and the largest wage gain in more than eight years raised inflation and interest-rate concerns. The 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since January 2014. The Dow fell 665.75 points, or 2.54 percent, its biggest point drop since December 2008. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined, and all three indexes recorded their worst weekly losses in two years. All S&P 500 sectors fell; disappointing earnings weighed on several major companies, while Amazon rose after its earnings report.

Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board faces a £30m deficit, with agency staff costs rising from £33.1m to £40.4m over 11 months. Recruitment remains difficult, and mental health and learning disabilities services are expected to exceed budget by £8.6m. The Welsh Government has said it will not bail out boards and expects Betsi Cadwaladr to keep its deficit within £30m.

The speaker wants faceoffs restarted more quickly, especially after a team has used its timeout. He says two talented players have created chances despite inconsistent scoring and does not want to pressure them to score. Line matchups will depend on how the games unfold. He is disappointed by retaliatory penalties and says he will act to stop them. Both teams remain motivated for the next Finals game, and he welcomes playing at home. He doubts altitude training offers an advantage given the teams’ travel schedules. Killing six penalties disrupted his team’s flow, though he believes it can play better. He attributes strong responses after losses to returning to focused play and praises Stevenson’s power-play work and Corky’s penalty killing.

The passage collects quotations criticizing taxation, corporate tax breaks and banks’ use of debt. It also comments on patriotism, education, political divisions and the failure to act against wrongdoing.

Recruiters warn that AI-generated job descriptions can repeat poorly written postings and miss details specific to a company or team. They recommend defining the role through internal discussion and using AI to refine, rather than replace, that work.

Prime Minister Bill English said the Government would not give the Reserve Bank authority to use debt-to-income ratios and saw no need for additional tools. Property Institute chief executive Ashley Church welcomed the decision, arguing the ratios would disadvantage first-home buyers. He also supported English’s call for a timeframe to remove loan-to-value restrictions and urged other parties to state their positions. Church said building more houses and supporting infrastructure was the solution to housing problems.

Astronomers discovered MOA-2016-BLG-227Lb through gravitational microlensing observations made in 2016. The planet has an estimated mass of 2.8 Jupiter masses and orbits about 1.67 AU from a likely M- or K-dwarf star in the Galactic bulge, approximately 21,000 light-years away. Researchers recommend further observations to better characterize the system.

The report finds that California newcomers often need specialized instruction and support for basic needs, but schools lack consistent resources, expertise and data to serve them. In 2020–21, California enrolled 151,996 Title III Immigrant Students, or 2.5 percent of K–12 students; 67 percent were socioeconomically disadvantaged. Newcomers’ English proficiency, prior schooling and circumstances vary, yet they are often treated as a single group within English learner policy. The report describes gaps in curricula, funding and social services, including a federal immigrant-student grant that did not support 77.6 percent of newcomers. It recommends identifying newcomers and students with interrupted formal education in state data, strengthening state coordination, developing instructional resources, adjusting funding for late arrivals and supporting research and federal action.

Red Same, Red Opposite and Red Rover are short-interval SOS half-court disruptions intended to change tempo, create easy baskets and disrupt an opponent’s set offense. Each traps the ballhandler near the sideline hash mark; the main difference is who joins X1 in the initial trap: X3 in Red Same, X2 in Red Opposite, and the designated X4 or X5 in Red Rover. Other defenders form a Triangle I. When the ball is passed out, defenders rotate as it leaves the passer’s hands. Subsequent rotations follow SOS rules, including coach-selected Base Go I or Base Go Red rotations if O2 penetrates to the free-throw line extended.

A New York court dismissed a charge that a homeowner occupied an extension without a certificate of occupancy. Although the bedroom addition was intended for use, the prosecution did not prove anyone had occupied it. The court held that the existing certificate still permitted occupancy of the original house, but the extension could not be used for living purposes until the certificate was amended or a new one obtained.

Apple is in late-stage talks to acquire the talent and technology of Prompt AI, an 11-person computer vision startup. Prompt’s Seemour app analyzes home security camera footage, but its CEO said the business model was not working. The company plans to retire the app and delete users’ data. Executives said investors would recover some money but not their full investment. Prompt’s talent and technology are likely to join Apple’s HomeKit division.

The University of Toledo tweeted that it would change its mascot from Rocky the Rocket to Shrek if the post received 500,000 retweets, then deleted it after about 100,000. A university official said the tweet was meant as fun and that, at most, the school might have dressed Rocky as Shrek.

The coach said his team had generated shots and offensive-zone time in the first two games, but Detroit won both by scoring timely goals around the net. He questioned a disputed play that preceded a goal, while acknowledging the referee’s judgment. For the next game, he wants his team to execute better, pursue loose pucks, improve support on faceoffs and dictate the pace rather than focus solely on needing a win. He said players remained level-headed and followed their usual routine. The staff was also weighing power-play options involving Phil Boucher and fresh players.

Reagan argues that the United States should uphold its principles, help refugees fleeing Communism, and promote freedom abroad. He then reports on George Bush’s visits to Japan and China. Reagan says a future Reagan-Bush administration would strengthen ties with Japan, an important trade and security partner, and carefully develop diplomatic relations with China. He describes Bush’s meetings in both countries as valuable exchanges of views.

ING no longer expects another Bank of England rate cut this year but expects further easing in 2026 as inflation falls and taxes rise. It says markets, which price in little more than one 25-basis-point cut by next April, underestimate the cuts to come.

Students, parents and alumni honored Sister Kevin Berdis as Holy Family School prepares to close after 99 years. The closure ends her 19 years as principal. The diocese plans to open Mother Teresa Academy in January.

PBOC adviser Huang Yiping proposed widening China’s annual growth target to 6–7 percent from last year’s 6.5–7 percent, saying a broader range would give policymakers more room for reforms if employment remains stable. He cited inefficient “zombie companies” supported by banks and the government. Officials are also prioritizing financial risks and structural reform amid slowing growth and rising debt. Xi Jinping’s longer-term goal is average growth of at least 6.5 percent through 2020, though a person familiar with private discussions said he is open to slower growth if meeting the target proves too risky.

The passage compares credit cards offering introductory 0% APR periods, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses. It notes that regular variable APRs and balance-transfer fees may apply after promotional periods. CompareCards says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not affect its ratings or reviews.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on February 17, 2020, reporting an update to its guidance for the quarter ending March 28, 2020. The update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

An Enron email forwards a California class-action complaint against seven electricity generators and traders. The complaint alleges they manipulated wholesale markets in 2000, inflating prices and overcharging customers. It seeks damages, restitution and an injunction.

The World Long Drive Association’s inaugural Atlantic City Boardwalk Bash will take place June 4–5 at Atlantic City Country Club in partnership with New Jersey CRDA. Golf Channel will air live coverage on June 5 from 6–8 p.m. ET. The Open Division includes world No. 1 Justin James and Will Hogue, who is seeking his third straight victory. The Women’s Division features 2018 winners Alexis Belton and Phillis Meti and defending world champion Sandra Carlborg. Preliminary rounds will determine who advances to single-elimination match play.
A car bomb and 10 militants attacked a ministry compound in Kabul, killing at least one policeman and wounding five. Afghan forces subdued the attack. Daesh claimed responsibility.

Residents of Oshiyie have petitioned the Inspector General of Police over unrest linked to an 18-year chieftaincy dispute between two factions. Family head Paul Ameni Annoh alleges assaults, property destruction and unfair arrests, and says the violence has displaced residents and disrupted families. The dispute is before a traditional council arbitration committee. The petition asks the police to address the alleged attacks and handling of investigations.

Toshiba Group announced that its turbine shipments have reached a total output capacity of 200,000 MW, with a next target of 300,000 MW. Toshiba JSW shipped a Made-in-India supercritical steam turbine rotor in 2015.

Tour de France organisers will deploy more than 30,000 security personnel for the race, which starts Saturday, amid hostility toward Chris Froome following his clearance in a doping investigation. UCI president David Lappartient urged spectators to respect the decision and ensure Froome can compete safely. Security plans include 23,000 police, 6,000 firefighters and thousands of private agents, with particular attention to crowded mountain finishes. Froome, a four-time champion, is seeking a fifth Tour victory and a Giro–Tour double.

The Trump administration is considering selling parts of the $1.6 trillion federal student loan portfolio while seeking to shut down the Education Department. The law permits sales only if they do not cost taxpayers money. Borrower advocates criticized the discussions, citing concerns about losing federal loan protections.

Bald eagles, once rare around La Crosse, now gather along the Mississippi River each spring. After DDT was banned in 1972 and habitat received protection, the local population grew from one nesting pair to more than 300. Younger eagles lack the adults’ white heads and are sometimes mistaken for other birds.

The passage promotes a custom essay writing service, claiming it offers affordable, high-quality papers without plagiarism concerns. It describes essay writing as time-consuming and says students can order essays quickly.

Backtesting applies trading strategies to historical data to assess potential profitability and risk without risking real funds. Reliable results require representative data, realistic trading costs and slippage, and testing across different market conditions. Including delisted or failed assets helps address survivorship bias; diverse datasets, out-of-sample testing and sensitivity analysis help limit overfitting. Traders can use performance metrics and methods such as forward testing to refine strategies. Backtesting tools should suit the strategy and provide usable features, accurate data and performance analysis. Because markets change, favorable backtesting results cannot guarantee future success.

The second annual Addiction & Recovery Awareness MusicFest will offer a sober entertainment option on July 7 at the Carroll County Agriculture Center. The event will feature local musicians and speakers on addiction and recovery. Proceeds will support nonprofits that help people access treatment. Organizers also hope the festival will provide fellowship and support for people in recovery.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s RTX Blackwell architecture and GeForce RTX 50 Series. GDDR7 memory has always-on, single-bit error correction, while fifth-generation Tensor Cores add FP4 and FP6 support. Fourth-generation RT Cores, Mega Geometry, Linear Swept Spheres and improved Shader Execution Reordering target more efficient ray tracing. Other additions include a GPU-based AI Management Processor, 4:2:2 video support, updated encoders and decoders, DisplayPort 2.1b, and power-management changes.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for image reconstruction. The passage also describes neural shaders for materials, texture compression, lighting, skin and faces; outlines the GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and associated RTX 50 Series products; and includes NVIDIA’s specification disclaimers.

Assistant U.S. Attorney Will Rosenzweig was fired by email while observing Rosh Hashanah, after conservatives publicized blog posts attributed to him that criticized President Donald Trump. Rosenzweig had worked on economic crimes in Florida’s Southern District since 2020. The Justice Department has also fired three prosecutors in the district who previously worked with former special counsel Jack Smith.

The passage describes dry, free-standing electrode films for energy storage devices that use a non-fibrillizable binder with particles about 0.5–40 µm in size, optionally alongside a fibrillizable binder such as PTFE. It describes solvent-free fabrication methods that reduce binder particle size, mix the materials, and calender them into films. In an example using graphite anodes, jet-milling carboxymethylcellulose from about 70 µm to about 10 µm reduced film defects, increased tensile strength from 0.936 N to 1.74 N, and raised first-cycle efficiency from 90.2% to 90.9%.

The court held that corporate creditors take priority over stockholders’ personal gains from corporate assets. Allen was liable for the unpaid 40 percent credited on 75 bonus shares and for the $15,904.59 he realized from second-mortgage bonds issued without valuable consideration. It also held that liability under the statute is measured by shares held when the creditor’s motion is filed after notice, not when execution against the corporation is returned unsatisfied. Because Allen then held 24 shares rather than 741, the judgment was reversed and remanded.

PDT Partners increased its Northwest Natural Gas stake by 1.4% in the second quarter to 19,969 shares worth $1.195 million. Institutional investors and hedge funds owned 63.32% of the stock. Analysts’ consensus rating was “Hold,” with an average price target of $66. Insiders sold 13,202 shares worth $879,666 over three months. Northwest Natural Gas reported quarterly earnings of $0.10 per share, above the $0.06 estimate, and revenue of $136.24 million. The company raised its quarterly dividend to $0.4725 per share.

The 3-3-5 defense uses three defensive linemen, three linebackers and five defensive backs, emphasizing speed, pressure and flexible coverage. Teams use it as either a base defense or a sub package. From the same pre-snap alignment, it can disguise Cover 1 and Cover 3 and send blitzers from several positions. Its vulnerable edges can be attacked by outside runs, while passing offenses can target seams; trips formations can also leave fewer defenders in the box. Common blitzes include the Sam blitz, which sends a linebacker off the edge, and the SAW blitz, which sends two linebackers. Joe Lee Dunn is credited as the defense’s inventor, and the passage names several coaches and teams that have used it.

Tesla’s 2019 Form 10-K describes two business segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. Its products include electric vehicles, solar systems and battery storage, supported by direct sales, charging, service and financing offerings. The report describes manufacturing in California, Nevada, New York and Shanghai, and plans for a factory near Berlin. It also discusses regulation, competition and risks involving production ramps, global expansion, demand, suppliers and battery-cell production.

New York’s early intervention providers have not received a substantive pay raise in three decades. Reimbursement for a standard visit averaged $69 in 2022, down from $79 in 1994, while providers also face unpaid travel, preparation and reporting work. Many have left for better-paying jobs, contributing to delays in services for young children with developmental delays and disabilities, particularly in rural areas. One family described losing access to both in-person and virtual services as providers became unavailable.

New York authorized a 5% increase for in-person services in 2024, but it remains pending federal approval. A separate 4% increase for underserved areas was approved in late September, though its implementation is unclear. Advocates warn that Medicaid cuts could make it harder to improve pay and retain providers.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week and more than 3% from Thursday’s high. A Monday rebound is expected, but the article warns that a broader correction remains possible amid earnings, tariff uncertainty and stretched valuations. Oil also declined after OPEC+ announced another production increase.
Xavier Pulido appealed an October 20, 1989 judgment of the Supreme Court, Kings County. The appeal was dismissed.

A survey of 2,000 British adults found that the average Brit wakes three times a night, while one in 10 wakes seven to 10 times. Reported causes include needing the toilet, discomfort, partners’ snoring or movement, phone use, nightmares and anxiety. Psychologist Robert Stewart said sleep hygiene and sleep cycles affect sleep quality, and recommended a consistent bedtime routine and a comfortable, quiet sleeping environment.

A January 2002 collection of reports covers Enron’s bankruptcy and investigations into its accounting, possible insider trading and Andersen’s destruction of documents. Lawmakers said an employee had warned Kenneth Lay about accounting concerns months before Enron’s collapse. Enron’s proposed trading-unit deal with UBS Warburg offered no upfront cash but would give Enron and its creditors a share of profits, subject to court approval. The reports also describe scrutiny of Enron’s contacts with Bush administration officials, financial pressure on its Indian power venture, negotiations over its Indian gas assets and credit concerns across the energy-trading sector.

Anthropologist Donald Blakeslee identified carved limestone boulders in the Norwoods’ backyard as Wichita shrines. Pouring water into one boulder’s basins showed how it flowed through carved channels. Blakeslee connects the shrine to Wichita beliefs about water moving between the sky, this world and the underground. Another boulder has depressions where women drank water while praying for successful pregnancies. Wichita tribal leader Gary McAdams described water as central to prayers, births, preparations for important events and cleansing after deaths.

Windy conditions postponed a planned Fourth of July drone light show at Travis Air Force Base in Northern California until July 5, weather permitting. Intel’s 500 drones cannot fly in the forecast 30 mph winds. California fire officials view drone shows as a safer alternative to fireworks in wildfire-prone areas. Fourth of July drone shows in Arizona remained scheduled.

U.S. adults generally eat more protein than recommended, but protein sources differ in essential amino acids and digestibility. Studies cited in the passage found greater muscle protein synthesis from animal foods than from equivalent servings of plant foods, raising particular concerns for older adults. Researchers suggest dietary guidelines should account for protein quality and differing needs. People can improve the quality of plant-based diets by combining complementary foods, adjusting portions and preparing legumes to aid digestion, while reducing meat consumption.

The coach said a talented rookie has benefited from focusing on details rather than scoring and from reduced minutes during his first professional season. He said Sid helps young players feel comfortable and confident. The team believes it can score but must defend well, avoid forcing plays and move the puck out of its zone efficiently. Its lineup depth lets coaches adjust combinations for balance and favorable matchups. The coach praised the group’s resilience, Nick’s shot blocking and penalty-kill work, and Willie’s speed and forechecking. Coaches use video and observations throughout a series to identify improvements and adjust plans. He said Phil and Geno are most effective together when they win puck battles and play well without the puck, while separating them spreads scoring threats across lines.

The author argues that Apple’s current valuation exceeds what its earnings, EBITDA and free-cash-flow growth support. Historical comparisons of valuation multiples with growth rates place current multiples above modeled levels; the P/E relationship is weak, while the EV/FCF model is the strongest. Although an earlier discounted cash flow analysis found $190 per share reasonable for the long term, the author concludes that buying at the current price is a poor decision.

The article surveys how logic, automata and circuit complexity help explain the expressive power of transformers. Unique hard attention transformers with positional embeddings recognize some regular languages and palindromes, but their languages form a strict subset of AC0 and exclude PARITY and MAJ. Average hard attention transformers can recognize MAJ and are bounded by TC0; a subclass without positional embeddings has a complete characterization through letter counts. Verification is decidable for masked unique hard attention without positional embeddings, but nonemptiness is undecidable for average hard attention without them. The article also notes unresolved relationships with practical softmax transformers and distinguishes a language’s expressibility from its trainability.

The passage describes three unusual animal relationships. Pearlfish shelter inside sea cucumbers, though some eat their hosts’ gonads. Gobies guard pistol shrimp while the shrimp maintain a shared burrow and clean the fish. Arid bronze azure butterfly larvae mimic queen ants chemically, gaining entry to bearded sugar ant nests, where they eat the ants’ young.

The state government has formed an 11-member committee to study liquor prohibition in six states and report in three months. It has made no final decision on a ban. Members of a village-level prohibition group will join the committee. The government will not add liquor shops but will operate outlets unsold at auction.

An April 2001 collection of news articles reports that Sycamore Networks cut its revenue forecast as sales to Williams declined and rivals gained business; its agreement with Enron Broadband Services had generated less spending than initially announced. Enron’s Dabhol Power Company planned to brief lenders amid a payment dispute with Maharashtra. Enron-owned Azurix planned to sell its water businesses, while a Nevada regulator sought to delay Sierra Pacific’s purchase of an Oregon utility from Enron. Other reports describe weak bandwidth trading, cuts at Enron’s broadband unit, and an Enron-linked power project for an aluminium smelter.

The lecture examines persistent gender gaps in earnings and career advancement. Women’s labor-market outcomes have improved, but substantial gaps remain. Studies discussed find that blind auditions increased women’s representation in orchestras; physicians reduced referrals to female surgeons more after bad outcomes and increased them less after good ones; and couples are less common when wives earn slightly more than husbands. The lecture also describes earnings declines for women after childbirth and a study in which gender-neutral tenure-clock extensions lowered female tenure rates while raising male rates. Finally, women were more likely to accept non-promotable tasks and, partly for that reason, more likely to be asked to do them. The lecture emphasizes biased beliefs, gender identity norms, and task assignments as possible contributors to gender inequality.

Moldova’s economy grew 1.1% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2025, reversing a first-quarter contraction. Construction, energy and ICT drove the rebound. The central bank cut its benchmark rate to 6% in August to support lending and demand. Inflation, fiscal constraints and currency volatility remain risks, while sustained growth depends on reforms and international financing.

The strategy switches monthly between SPY and TLT, holding whichever performed better the previous month. TLT may provide a safe haven when stocks weaken, but it did not protect against losses in 2022, when both assets fell sharply. A backtest from 2003 reported a 9.2% compound annual growth rate with dividends reinvested; its maximum drawdown rose from 22% before 2022 to 41%. The test used month-end trades and excluded taxes, slippage, and commissions.

Researchers co-designed a community-based approach to identify people with probable, undiagnosed Long Covid in three areas of England and interviewed 23 participants. They found that limited awareness, uncertainty about symptoms, reluctance to seek care, and difficulties presenting fluctuating, multisystem symptoms hindered access to healthcare. Participants described perceived discrimination, expectations of dismissal, and feelings of shame or reduced self-worth. Some sought support outside the NHS; many valued social support and wanted more accessible, attentive healthcare and dedicated Long Covid services. The authors recommend raising awareness, reducing stigma, listening to patients and helping people access support. They note that participants’ symptoms could have other causes and that the study did not include people under 29.

The passage describes operation and programming of the ADS868xW 16-bit ADCs. A rising CONVST/CS edge starts conversion; a falling edge begins a data-transfer frame. The host can use the RVS pin or wait for the maximum conversion time before starting another operation. Valid write commands require at least 32 SCLK cycles, while shorter frames can read selected output bits.

The devices provide nine configuration registers and support SPI-compatible and source-synchronous read protocols, with optional dual-output operation. Output data can include conversion results, register data, fixed patterns, flags, and parity bits. Programmable features include input ranges, alarms, reset behavior, and NAP and power-down modes. The passage also presents an eight-channel industrial input design and recommendations for power-supply decoupling and PCB layout.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture improves memory performance through GDDR6, larger L2 caches and compression, delivering about 50% more effective bandwidth than Pascal in the cited GPU comparison. Its display and video features support 8K output, HDR, improved encoding and decoding, while VirtualLink provides single-connector VR headset connectivity. NVLink increases bandwidth for two-GPU SLI.

Turing combines rasterization with real-time ray tracing. Dedicated RT Cores accelerate bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle tests, while denoising reduces the rays needed for effects such as shadows and reflections. Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement. Other rendering features include mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading and multi-view rendering. The passage also describes TU104 and TU106 GPUs and a workload-based RTX-OPS metric.
The Ninth Circuit dismissed the appeal by agreement of the parties’ counsel and ordered the mandate issued immediately.

New York City’s education spending rose 40 percent since 2008-09 to $25,087 per pupil, the highest among the nation’s 100 largest school systems in fiscal 2015. In 2015-16, employee benefits and pensions accounted for 30.3 percent of operating expenses, and teacher salaries for 23.4 percent. Despite higher spending, national test scores showed limited gains or declines from 2009 to 2015, and only half of 2016 graduates were deemed ready for college or careers. Critics cited pension costs, inadequate spending oversight, educators without permanent posts and mixed results from the Renewal Program.

Index Markets Research’s report examines the global polyolefin (POF) shrink film market, including its size, trends, competition, manufacturing costs and production capacity. It covers regional production, consumption, revenue, market share and growth from 2012 to 2022, with analysis by product type and applications such as food, beverages, pharmaceuticals and consumer goods. The report also includes forecasts, investment analysis and recommendations for companies.

In 1886, the United States opposed a proposed Hawaiian loan backed by kingdom revenues, citing privileges under its reciprocity treaty. In 1887, Bayard declined to approve a proposed Hawaiian–Samoan political alliance. Britain then proposed a joint declaration guaranteeing Hawaii’s neutrality and equal access to its ports. Bayard replied that existing U.S.–Hawaiian treaties made further guarantees unnecessary and that the Pearl Harbor concession did not impair Hawaiian sovereignty. In 1888, Britain protested the United States’ exclusive use of Pearl Harbor as a coaling and repair station, arguing that it conflicted with Britain’s treaty rights, despite assurances that the concession conveyed neither territory nor property rights.

Jon Jones wants to fight former UFC heavyweight champion Brock Lesnar rather than current champion Stipe Miocic, citing greater public interest, a larger payday and a more favorable matchup. His trainer, Mike Winkeljohn, supports that choice, saying Miocic would be a harder fight and Jones would need more skills and weight before facing him.

The passage describes features and support information for the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 microcontrollers. An independent watchdog can reset the device if software fails to service it, while a windowed watchdog can generate a reset or interrupt. The devices also provide a real-time clock, general-purpose and advanced timers, configurable input/output functions, and a Serial Wire Debug interface. A read-only factory region stores device identification, capabilities, and trim data. TI gives typical circuit recommendations for decoupling, reset, crystal, and open-drain connections, and lists development resources, revision changes, packaging guidance, and product disclaimers.

The speaker says success in different situations, including the power play, requires everyone’s commitment, positioning and awareness of the puck and other players. In the playoffs, teams must regroup after each game despite heightened emotions and competition. The speaker is comfortable taking faceoffs when needed and enjoys playing with a steady defenseman who has improved offensively. Reaching the finals is exciting for the speaker and their family in Slovakia, though the speaker wishes for a better game result.

A prolonged heat wave has broken temperature records across parts of Canada, the United States, Europe and the Middle East. Montreal officials linked at least 11 deaths to the heat, and one heat-related death was reported in the U.S. Records included 37 C in Montreal, 33.2 C in Scotland and a nightly low above 42.6 C for 51 hours in Quriyat, Oman. A climate scientist linked the duration and severity of heat waves to climate change.

The double-down strategy adds a position equal in size to a losing stock position after its price falls, lowering the average entry price in hopes of breaking even sooner if the price recovers. It differs from Martingale, which doubles the added trade size after each loss, and from the repair strategy, which uses call options. In the passage’s backtests, doubling down improved the average gain per trade for SPY but increased the average loss per trade for HYG. The passage warns that prices may keep falling and that focusing on the average entry price rather than the odds of success can reflect trading bias.

The passage lists agreements signed in Honolulu in 1836 and 1839, then presents an 1842 presidential message on U.S. relations with the Sandwich Islands and China. The President describes the islands as an important stop for American vessels, supports their independence, and recommends an allowance for the U.S. consul there. He also notes that a treaty has opened four Chinese ports to British merchants and says the United States should determine whether it can arrange access for its own commerce.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs add PCIe 4.0 and, on supported models, third-generation NVLink. The full GA102 has 84 streaming multiprocessors, 112 ROPs and a 384-bit memory interface. Compared with Turing, GA10x doubles peak FP32 processing per multiprocessor and ray–triangle intersection testing rates; its third-generation Tensor Cores support additional data types and structured sparsity. Other features include hardware-accelerated ray-traced motion blur, GDDR6X memory with up to 936 GB/sec peak bandwidth, and RTX IO for GPU-based asset decompression.

The passage also describes support for high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and NVENC video encoding. It positions the RTX 30-series for gaming and the A40 and RTX A6000 for professional and data-center workloads. Two A40 or RTX A6000 GPUs can be connected with NVLink for 96 GB of combined GPU memory.

A low-side current-sensing circuit amplifies the voltage across a shunt resistor and uses a comparator to signal when the amplifier output exceeds 1.1 V. The passage recommends close supply bypassing, a stable supply, and careful trace routing to prevent ringing, inaccurate comparisons, and oscillation. It also describes documentation updates, support resources, ESD precautions, packaging information, and TI’s terms and disclaimers.

The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card offers 0% introductory APR for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 16.99%, 23.49%, or 28.74%. It has no annual fee and includes cellphone protection, but offers no ongoing rewards. Balance transfers incur a 5% fee ($5 minimum), and foreign transactions incur a 3% fee. The review presents it as an option for paying down debt or financing a large purchase.

The newly announced Oppo R15 and Vivo X21 phones may offer clues to the OnePlus 6, since the brands’ past models have shared similar designs. Leaks suggest the OnePlus 6 could have a notched 19:9 display like the Oppo R15, while the Vivo X21 UD raises the possibility of an under-display fingerprint sensor. The OnePlus 6 is expected to use a Snapdragon 845 processor, rather than the chips in the Oppo R15 models. Its final design and features remain unconfirmed.

Apple entered an underwriting agreement on September 10, 2015, to issue €1 billion of 1.375% notes due January 17, 2024, and €1 billion of 2.000% notes due September 17, 2027. Interest is payable annually, and the notes rank equally with Apple’s other unsecured, unsubordinated debt. The filing includes the underwriting agreement, note documents, a legal opinion and an earnings-to-fixed-charges calculation.

Changes to the FAFSA placed some financial data under IRS privacy rules, leaving colleges uncertain about what they can share with scholarship providers. The resulting delays have slowed scholarship decisions, including awards for Native Forward Scholars Fund students who began fall classes without knowing their funding. A survey found some financial aid offices had limited or ended data-sharing. New Education Department guidance says colleges may share FAFSA data with scholarship providers with student consent, but providers say questions about security standards and practical access remain.

Christmas Bird Counts record birds and species within 15-mile circles, contributing to a century-long database of early-winter bird populations. Sheridan’s count is Dec. 14, and Story-Big Horn’s is Dec. 23. Birders of all skill levels, including backyard watchers, can participate.

The passage calls for removing the tariff on anthracite coal and reducing any duty that fosters a harmful monopoly. It advocates limited legislation to make the monetary system more flexible, with banks helping provide sufficient currency that remains convertible into gold. It also urges passage of an immigration law. On labor and capital, it argues that corporations and unions should be judged by their conduct, respect others’ rights, and act lawfully and fairly. Employers and workers should seek mutual understanding, while government should reject class animosity and judge people on individual merit.

An analysis of 500 global ICT firms from 2005 to 2016 finds that highly R&D-intensive firms faced declining marginal ICT productivity as internet-driven free services, easy copying, and standardization lowered technology prices. The paper argues that these firms can adapt to an IoT-based economy through digital business strategies that use soft innovation resources, develop self-propagating functionality, and address value not captured by GDP.

Nuclear binding energy is the difference between the mass of a nucleus and the summed masses of its constituents. Binding energy per nucleon is generally 7.5–9 MeV, with a maximum near iron; both fusion and fission can release energy by moving toward more energetically favored nuclei. The semi-empirical Weizsager formula models binding energy with five terms: volume, surface, Coulomb, neutron–proton asymmetry, and pairing. The dominant volume term reflects the short range of the nuclear force. Surface effects and electrical repulsion reduce binding energy, while asymmetry and whether proton and neutron numbers are even or odd also affect it.

The passage records Colonel Alfred McCormack’s appointment to a State Department research and intelligence post and the September 1945 order ending the Foreign Economic Administration. Its functions were divided among four federal departments and the Reconstruction Finance Corporation, while the State Department received additional responsibilities for surplus property abroad. It also lists 1945 documents on Lend-Lease, international finance and trade, including the December signing of agreements establishing the International Monetary Fund and International Bank for Reconstruction and Development.

Researchers found that an Apple-granted permission allowed Uber’s iPhone app to record users’ screens, even when other apps were in the foreground. Uber said the permission had supported Apple Watch map rendering and was removed from newer app versions. The passage reports no evidence that Uber used it to capture screens.

Medical professionals warn that daily drinking, including sharing a bottle of wine each night, can increase health risks. A report cited in the passage says 27% of New South Wales residents aged 55 to 64 drink at “risky levels.” Experts recommend alcohol-free days and no more than two standard drinks on most days. They also warn that common servings can contain more than one standard drink, and that the daily limit cannot be averaged across a week.

In December 1842, John Tyler noted growing U.S. trade with China and argued that new ports could increase demand for American products. He urged Congress to fund a commissioner in China to protect American citizens and their property and communicate with local authorities. In a separate letter, Hawaiian representatives said Kamehameha III had followed an 1826 agreement with the United States for sixteen years despite receiving no notice that the United States had approved or ratified it.

An overlap sends a fullback past a midfielder, usually near the sideline, to create an unmarked attacking option. The fullback may receive the ball and cross, or pass back if covered. In an underlap, the fullback runs inside the midfielder, often to receive the ball and shoot. Both runs depend on available space; adding a runner can instead crowd an attack.

The US government has auctioned the 106-meter superyacht Amadea, seized in Fiji in 2022. The buyer and sale price have not been disclosed. The government had been paying nearly $1 million a month to maintain it. An ownership dispute remains unresolved: a man who claims the yacht is his has appealed a ruling that he could not block its forfeiture, potentially complicating the buyer’s use of the vessel.

The passage presents a nine-compartment SEIR-like model of SARS-CoV-2 spread with time-dependent transmission rates estimated from reported daily infections. It defines the rates relative to transmission by mildly infectious individuals and specifies other model parameters. Under stated assumptions, it establishes existence, uniqueness and non-negativity of model solutions, then analyzes the continuity and differentiability of the map from transmission rates to solutions.

The court affirmed dismissal of Ross Nelson’s suit to enforce a March 1892 agreement to purchase Puyallup allotment land from John and Chekudakai Salerhand. It held that restrictions on alienating the land were valid, were not impliedly repealed by legislation conferring citizenship, and had not been removed when the agreement was made. The agreement was therefore void.

Rigel Pharmaceutical shares rose 0.25% in the most recent session and closed at $4.01. Six analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $5.83, ranging from $5 to $7. One analyst rated the stock Buy and five rated it Outperform. Its 14-period ATR was 0.24, RSI was 46.26, and market capitalization was $599.66 million. Trading volume was 2.33 million shares, above its 1.42 million-share average.

An April 2001 collection of news reports covers Enron’s dispute with Maharashtra over unpaid electricity bills and power tariffs, its plan to cut about 250 broadband jobs, and its request to delay a vote on a proposed Florida power plant. It also reports Enron’s energy-management agreement with J.C. Penney and its exposure to PG&E’s bankruptcy. Other articles discuss online movie technology and the prospects for combining media content with distribution networks.

Liverpool beat Roma 5-2 at Anfield in the first leg of their Champions League semi-final, but two late away goals left the tie open. Mohamed Salah scored twice against his former club without celebrating and set up goals for Sadio Mane and Roberto Firmino. Firmino also scored twice. Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain left the field on a stretcher after injuring his knee, further limiting Liverpool’s midfield options. Liverpool will take a three-goal lead to Rome for the second leg.

Speaking at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo, the president welcomes foreign representatives and describes expositions as sources of education, invention and friendly competition. He says advances in transportation and communication have connected nations, expanded trade and made cooperation and arbitration more important. Citing American prosperity and growing production, he calls for reciprocal trade arrangements, wider markets, more American ships, an Isthmian canal and a Pacific cable. He closes by urging mutual respect, friendship and peace over commercial hostility and war.

The strategy buys SPY after the S&P 500 falls for three consecutive days, entering at the third day’s close and exiting the next morning. A backtest reported 661 trades, a 0.13% average gain, a 65% win rate, and an 8% maximum drawdown, excluding slippage and commissions. Exiting at the next day’s close raised the average gain to 0.24% but lowered the win rate to 61% and increased drawdown to 17%. A later modified version reported a 0.35% average gain and 10% maximum drawdown; in 2022, it averaged 0.3% across 35 trades.

Kyocera’s DuraForce PRO won an iF Design Product Award in the Industry/Skilled Trades category, less than a month after receiving a CES Innovation Awards honor. The rugged phone features a Super Wide View HD Action Camera and fingerprint scanner, meets IP68 and Military Standard 810G certifications, and is available through Verizon Wireless, AT&T and Sprint.

In mice, researchers found that peroxisomes in brown fat can generate heat through the protein ACOX2, providing an alternative to the previously known mitochondrial pathway. Mice lacking ACOX2 had poorer cold tolerance and insulin sensitivity and gained more weight on a high-fat diet; mice producing more ACOX2 showed the opposite effects. Researchers are exploring whether dietary or drug interventions could activate this pathway, but its benefits in people remain untested.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Blackwell graphics features and GPUs. RTX Neural Texture Compression reduces texture memory use; a demo uses 333 MB instead of 1,110 MB. Stochastic Texture Filtering reduces sampling artifacts. Neural Radiance Cache estimates indirect lighting from partially traced rays, while RTX Skin models subsurface scattering and RTX Neural Faces uses generative AI to produce more natural-looking faces.

The GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs underpin the GeForce RTX 5090, 5080 and 5070, respectively; the RTX 5070 Ti also uses GB203. The passage lists their chip specifications but does not include the referenced comparison tables. NVIDIA’s notices limit warranties and liability, require customers to verify suitability, and reserve the right to change specifications.

The speaker says home ice offers little advantage because Carolina has played well on the road. The team is enjoying the atmosphere but expects its experience to keep players focused. They know Carolina will not quit and believe they must play hard to have a chance to win.

The speaker says his focus is winning four games to bring the Stanley Cup to Buffalo. He respects Eddie Belfour, with whom he competed for a starting job, but is concentrating on Dallas’s scoring threats rather than its goalie. He feels ready for the next game and expects teammates and officials to handle players who interfere with him. He also recalls admiring a Russian national-team goalie as a child, though that goalie spent little time working with him in Chicago.

U.S. new-home sales rose 4 per cent in March to an annualized 694,000, driven largely by a 28.3 per cent surge in the West. First-quarter sales were 10.3 per cent above a year earlier. The median new-home price rose 4.8 per cent to $337,200.

The Hammes Company’s five-story, 94,000-square-foot headquarters at 210 E. Knapp St. has taken shape, though its facade remains unfinished. The Brookfield-based firm plans to move about 80 employees there later this year and lease the remaining space. The privately financed project, including a 360-space parking garage, is expected to cost $27 million to $30 million. Its classical design has drawn both criticism and praise. Hammes also plans a second office building north of the site, with its size dependent on market demand.

Microsoft reported $24.09 billion in revenue and $5.20 billion in net income for the quarter ended December 31, 2016, compared with $23.80 billion and $5.02 billion a year earlier. Diluted earnings per share rose from $0.62 to $0.66. The company completed its $27.0 billion acquisition of LinkedIn on December 8. Commercial cloud annualized revenue run rate exceeded $14 billion, while Azure revenue grew 93% year over year. At quarter-end, Microsoft held $122.78 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments.

Boston entered Game 2 of the 2025 AL Wild Card Series leading New York 1-0 in the series. Ben Rice’s two-run homer put the Yankees ahead, but Trevor Story tied the game with a two-run hit. The Yankees regained the lead when Jarren Duran dropped Aaron Judge’s hit, allowing Trent Grisham to score.
