Apple’s 2018 Form 10-K covers the fiscal year ended September 29, 2018. The company designs and sells devices, software and services worldwide, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, operating systems, digital content and support services. Net sales were $265.6 billion and net income was $59.5 billion. International sales accounted for 63% of net sales, while indirect channels accounted for 71%. Apple had approximately 132,000 full-time equivalent employees. The filing identifies risks including competition, supply constraints, reliance on outsourcing partners, legal and regulatory matters, data security and economic conditions.

JAMB is considering a mock exercise before its examination and plans new ICT facilities. Registrar Ishaq Oloyede said the changes aim to improve service and curb operators defrauding candidates, though examination hitches remain possible. The board sought stakeholders’ feedback on its processes at an ICT retreat.

The S&P 500 Equal Weight Index assigns each of its 500 companies a 0.2% weight at quarterly rebalancing, unlike the traditional S&P 500, which weights companies by market capitalization. Its tracking ETF, RSP, has historically outperformed the market-weighted SPY, though not in the last decade. The passage attributes the longer-term difference to faster growth among smaller companies and notes that RSP has a higher expense ratio.

An October 2001 news digest reports that a partnership organized by Enron CFO Andrew Fastow earned millions from Enron transactions, prompting conflict-of-interest questions and a shareholder lawsuit. Enron reported a $618 million third-quarter loss, a $1.01 billion investment write-off and a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity. NewPower amended its agreement with Enron subsidiaries to reduce its cash-collateral requirements temporarily. Other articles note Enron’s lobbying spending, planned staffing cuts at Enron Metals in Europe, and a December court hearing on a petition by Enron-promoted Dabhol Power Company in India.

An immigration judge rejected Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia’s request to seek asylum, leaving a 2019 removal order in place. He was mistakenly deported to El Salvador in March despite a provision barring his return there, then brought back to face immigrant-smuggling charges. A federal judge has temporarily blocked the administration from deporting him to another country while she considers whether its proposed process is legal.

Czech utility CEZ will buy back 463.1 million euros of its 470.2 million euro convertible bond linked to MOL shares. It plans to sell 7.56 million MOL shares for 141.4 billion forints ($490 million) to pay bondholders, retaining about 0.1 percent of MOL. The transactions are expected to settle around April 4.

Ken Research projects Thailand’s frozen foods market to grow at a 5.9% compound annual rate from 2017 to 2022. The report cites export demand for seafood and meat, demand from hotels and restaurants, and interest in healthy snacks, vegetarian meals and processed fruits. It also notes manufacturers’ plans to expand production capacity and government fishery improvement initiatives.

This study examines jets launched into the extended envelopes of blue and red supergiants, where a stalled jet may produce high-energy neutrinos and a cocoon-driven electromagnetic transient. Across 39,000 one-dimensional models, breakout time scales linearly with stellar radius. A relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulation of a blue supergiant shows strong shocks at the jet head, within the jet, and around its cocoon. After the engine shuts off, the internal collimation shock fades while the cocoon shock strengthens. The jet has not choked by the simulation’s end at 30 seconds, though the study estimates choking about a minute after launch. Future work will examine particle acceleration and observable signals.

An online survey of 15,131 adults residing in Spain during the first COVID-19 lockdown examined intentions to follow preventive measures after confinement. Self-efficacy, expected outcomes, and existing adherence were the strongest predictors; information-seeking, prior experience, and perceived vulnerability also contributed. Intentions varied modestly but significantly by region, and pandemic severity affected some associations. The study notes limitations from non-probability online sampling and the reliability of some measures.

The passage proposes weighting transition-count estimates in an expectation-maximization algorithm to reduce uncertainty in Markov model transition probabilities. Weights are selected by a grid search that minimizes variance in a chosen model output. In a fictitious three-state comparison of SuperDrug and placebo, the method reduced variance in the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio by 15.2% across 5,000 bootstrap samples, with similar mean estimates. The authors caution that pooling data from dissimilar studies could introduce bias and call for validation using clinical or real-world data.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines GDDR6 memory, larger L2 caches and improved compression; the passage reports approximately 50% higher effective bandwidth for the RTX 2080 Ti than the GTX 1080 Ti. Its display and video features include 8K output, HDR processing, updated encoding and decoding, and single-connector VR support through VirtualLink. TU102 and TU104 use NVLink for two-way SLI.

Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle tests. Combined with rasterization and denoising, they support real-time hybrid rendering of effects such as reflections and shadows. Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement. Other graphics features include mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading and multi-view rendering.

The passage describes the TU102, TU104 and TU106 GPUs, the Tesla T4, and RTX-OPS as a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering.

The lecture uses a union-bound estimate to compare signal sets with baseline schemes. It defines effective coding gain as the performance gap at a fixed error probability and relates it to nominal coding gain and the number of nearest neighbors. In the power-limited regime, 4-QAM and a two-point subset show no gain over 2-PAM, while a four-point, three-dimensional constellation yields about 1 dB.

Orthogonal signal sets approach the Shannon limit as their size grows, but their spectral efficiency falls sharply and decoding is computationally costly. Simplex and bi-orthogonal sets are also introduced. The lecture then applies the gain framework to the bandwidth-limited regime and previews binary block codes, for which binary signaling incurs little loss in the power-limited regime.

A cat’s tail can signal attention, friendliness, defensiveness or aggression, but its body language also matters. Sudden dashes between rooms may reflect arousal, frustration, fear or pent-up energy. Cats are most active at dawn and dusk and often sleep during the day.

The lecture explains how rapidity divergences in a Sudakov form-factor calculation require a regulator and renormalization-group evolution in both the scales μ and ν. Soft and collinear contributions favor different ν scales, while the physical form factor is independent of the cutoffs. Evolution is path-independent because μ and ν are independent parameters.

Higgs transverse-momentum production provides another example requiring evolution in both scales and involving transverse-momentum-dependent PDFs. The lecture then compares Drell–Yan kinematic regimes: inclusive production allows hard radiation; the endpoint limit permits only soft outgoing radiation; and an isolated regime permits initial-state collinear jets and ultrasoft radiation. Their factorization formulas therefore differ.

For isolated Drell–Yan, the factorization formula contains beam functions describing initial-state radiation. A beam function measures both large and small momentum in a proton matrix element and can be separated into perturbative matching coefficients and a standard, nonperturbative PDF.

The guide describes AMD’s optional Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which helps move pages between memory tiers while preserving guest physical addresses. TMPM requires an enabled IOMMU and can pause DMA during migration or move protected SNP guest pages. Commands can migrate up to 128 pages, with per-page status reported for partial success. AMD reports better bandwidth with commands containing at least 16 pages and maximum performance at 128. Some IOMMU structures, ring buffers, and argument pages cannot be migrated. Host software must also avoid modifying referenced IOMMU page-table entries during TMPM operations.

The May 8, 2001 State Bar of Michigan e-Journal summarizes court decisions across nine practice areas, including criminal, employment, environmental, family, and real-property law. It also contains attorney referral listings, classified advertisements, job openings, and links to bar information and archived issues.

The speaker considers Rome’s hit fair, supports Aaron, and hopes Horton recovers. They say special teams hurt the team’s momentum, particularly a power play that moved the puck but not players. The team intends to bounce back in the next game.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week after retreating from a record high, though futures pointed to a Monday rebound. The passage says the decline may be a consolidation or the start of a deeper correction, with earnings and economic risks in focus. Oil prices also fell after OPEC+ announced another production increase, while tariffs, weaker economic data and possible sanctions on Russian oil added uncertainty.

Blackwell includes architectural improvements intended to improve neural shader performance and efficiency. GPU shaders evolved from fixed-function operations to programmable vertex, pixel, geometry, compute, and ray-tracing techniques. Blackwell introduces developer-created neural shaders, some of which also run on earlier GPUs.

Wauwatosa East High School marked 77 years of theater with *Encore! Encore!* and the reopening of its renovated Dale K. Hidde Theatre. Conceived by Jennifer Lato, Amanda Marquardt and Kate Sarner, the production draws on past Tosa East Players performances, with music and dance from shows including *Sweet Charity*, *Tarzan* and *West Side Story*. Students worked across the production. The passage presents the show as an example of the value of arts education. Performances continue through April 2.

The euro edged up against the dollar on Wednesday, but trading remained subdued ahead of U.S. tariffs on Chinese imports taking effect July 6. The yuan gained 0.8 percent, extending a rebound after China’s central bank signaled it would seek to keep the currency stable. Investors also awaited Federal Reserve meeting minutes and U.S. jobs data. The yen rose on safe-haven demand, the Australian dollar gained after retail sales data, and the Mexican peso strengthened following reassuring remarks from its newly elected president.

The paper presents a multi-criteria model for locating ambulance stations that maximizes population reached within five and ten minutes while requiring every road segment to be reachable within 15 minutes. In a Southwest German case study, researchers evaluated potential sites for outdated stations and found 16 Pareto-optimal solutions. Prioritizing five-minute coverage favored urban locations; prioritizing ten-minute coverage spread stations more evenly, including into rural areas. Because the model assumes ambulances are at their stations when needed, its results were used as an initial decision aid and examined further through expert discussion and simulation.

A short squeeze occurs when a heavily shorted stock rises, forcing short sellers to buy shares to cover their positions and pushing the price higher. Losses for short sellers can theoretically be unlimited. The passage describes squeezes as rare, usually lasting less than a month, and difficult to predict or backtest; its tests found no viable strategy based on high short interest. It cites GameStop and Volkswagen as examples. Market-driven squeezes may occur naturally, but manipulating a stock to cause one is illegal. Suggested exit tactics include monitoring momentum and using stop-loss or trailing-stop orders.

The statistical analysis plan specifies plasma glucose sampling times and defines the pharmacodynamic endpoint as the area under the glucose effect curve above baseline from 0 to 30 minutes. It outlines analyses of glucose recovery, concentrations and treatment-group summaries. Safety analyses cover exposure, rescue glucose, injection-site tolerability, adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings and immunogenicity. Appendices set presentation, programming and quality-control requirements and provide planned tables, figures and listings.

Police said a handgun apparently fired one round from inside a backpack at a Los Angeles middle school, striking two 15-year-old students in the head and wrist. Doctors expect both to recover fully. A 12-year-old girl was arrested and faces firearm-related charges. Detectives are investigating where she got the gun.

Business Insider examines literary references across 25 Taylor Swift songs, from allusions to Robert Frost, Shakespeare and F. Scott Fitzgerald to parallels with works by Charlotte Brontë and Sylvia Plath. The article describes how Swift uses these references to explore love, heartbreak, reputation and identity. Her newest single, “The Fate of Ophelia,” rewrites the tragic ending of Shakespeare’s character.

The study compared convalescent plasma plus best supportive care with standard care, assessing clinical status, mechanical ventilation, death, sustained improvement and intensive care use. Analyses used an intent-to-treat Full Analysis Set, multiple imputation for missing clinical status data, and regression models adjusted for study period and site.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 25, 2016, reports net sales of $42.4 billion, down 15% from a year earlier, and net income of $7.8 billion, down from $10.7 billion. Lower iPhone sales and average selling prices drove much of the sales decline, while Services sales rose 19%. For the first nine months of fiscal 2016, net sales were $168.8 billion and operating cash flow was $49.7 billion. At quarter-end, Apple held $231.5 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. It repurchased $10.0 billion of stock and paid $3.2 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents during the quarter.

A study of 43 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy analyzed brief resting-state SEEG recordings to identify seizure-onset zones (SOZ) and predict treatment outcomes. Information flow predominantly traveled from non-SOZ to SOZ regions across multiple frequencies. SOZ electrodes had more negative 1/f power slopes, which the authors interpreted as suggesting lower excitability. Greater within-frequency information-flow asymmetry was associated with seizure-free outcomes. A random forest model identified SOZ electrodes with 85% accuracy and predicted seizure outcomes with 77% accuracy using clinician-identified SOZ, or 72% using model-estimated SOZ. The authors note that the recordings were brief and that the analysis used clinically identified SOZ rather than the broader epileptogenic zone.

The articles focus on California’s power crisis, including 15-day federal settlement talks over the state’s demand for $9 billion in refunds from electricity suppliers. The mediator expects a smaller amount, while suppliers dispute the overcharge claims and say utilities owe them money. Expanded federal price controls have also weighed on energy stocks, including Enron’s. Other reports describe challenges for foreign investors in Poland’s liberalizing power market, Larsen & Toubro’s bid for a 51% stake in an Indian power project, and Rolls-Royce’s plans for captive power plants in India.

Ric Flair is resting after surgery Monday, his representatives said, without providing details. He was placed in a medically induced coma before surgery after being hospitalized over the weekend. His representative requested prayers and support.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines rasterization, RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, and Tensor Cores for AI-assisted graphics and inference. The Tesla T4 targets data-center and edge inference; the passage reports substantially higher inference performance and energy efficiency than CPU-based systems. Turing also adds GDDR6 memory, larger caches, improved compression, enhanced video and display capabilities, and NVLink support on some GPUs.

For graphics, Turing supports hybrid rendering, using ray tracing for effects such as reflections and shadows alongside rasterization. Its NGX features include DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and super-resolution. Mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading, and multi-view rendering provide additional ways to improve rendering efficiency, including for VR. The passage describes the TU104 and TU106 GPUs and concludes with product specifications, limitations, and legal notices.

The President urges Congress to address a Treasury deficit estimated at $14 million, warning that temporary measures will not restore public credit or sustain government operations and defenses. Congress has authorized $5 million in Treasury notes, but a pending loan bill would still leave a $2.5 million deficit. He recommends raising import duties, in some cases above 20 percent, and funding a debt approaching $15 million. Higher duties would suspend the distribution of public-land proceeds to the states under existing law. He proposes pledging those proceeds to secure the loan and using any surplus to reduce the debt, arguing that restoring federal credit is the government’s most urgent financial need.

The lecture contrasts Riemann integration, which partitions the time axis, with Lebesgue integration, which groups function values and measures where they occur. It explains why countable sets, including the rationals, and some uncountable sets have measure zero, allowing Lebesgue integration to handle functions that Riemann integration cannot. It defines measurable functions and the L1 and L2 classes, noting that a time-limited L2 function is also L1. For time-limited L2 functions, Fourier coefficients are finite and Fourier series converge in energy rather than necessarily at every point. Segmenting a function and expanding each segment provides a basis for discussing voice compression; Fourier transforms are introduced for the next lecture.

Rockford High School’s television production class was named the 2018 Station of the Year by the Michigan Association of Broadcasting. At the March 7 Great Lakes Media Show, students earned awards in 11 of 12 programming categories, including eight first-place finishes. The Rockford Board of Education recognized the team on March 12.

Louise Worrell says she cannot afford the £1,800 cost of her 13-year-old daughter’s school trip to South Africa, especially with payment due by February. She says the cost excludes lower-income families. Other parents described expensive trips and said their children felt embarrassed or upset over requests for payment.

Sonali Bendre said tests prompted by a persistent pain revealed high-grade cancer. She is undergoing treatment in New York and says she is determined to fight it. Her family, friends, fans and television actors have offered support and wishes for her recovery.

The paper presents variadic nominal anti-unification, a technique for finding structural similarities between expressions that contain variable binders and functions with arbitrary numbers of arguments. Its rule-based algorithm computes generalizations, records differences, and shows how to reconstruct the inputs. The paper proves termination, soundness, and completeness, and illustrates the method with code clones, including changed or deleted statements. It also identifies excessive nondeterminism and limited control over selected similarities as obstacles to practical use.
Amazon.com, Inc.’s April 24, 2015 Form 8-K attaches its 2014 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1. Senior Vice President David A. Zapolsky signed the filing.

Google updated the Drive API to let developers add Team Drives functionality to their apps. A G Suite Dev Show video covers creating Team Drives, adding members, creating folders, and uploading files. These features are available in Drive API v2 and v3.
The speaker says the team should shoot more and skate faster. Sitting back in the third period gave opponents too much time and space.

Marshall University Joan C. Edwards School of Medicine, Marshall Health and Cabell Huntington Hospital have welcomed four specialists as assistant professors of internal medicine: geriatrician Pavithra Indramohan, infectious disease physicians Peimei He and Elie Khalil, and endocrinologist Yara Tovar Marmolejo. All are accepting new patients and referrals. Indramohan practices at Hanshaw Geriatric Center; the other three practice at Marshall Internal Medicine.

Warrensburg Central School District will hold a March 20 information session on grades 3–8 ELA and math testing. Grades 7–8 will pilot online exams, while grades 3–4 will use paper tests. Assessments will last two days instead of three.

The guide describes the optional Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which moves pages between physical memory tiers while preserving guest physical addresses. It can coordinate with IOMMUs to migrate pages during DMA and can migrate protected SNP guest pages. Commands can move up to 128 pages and report per-page results. TMPM requires an enabled IOMMU; certain IOMMU structures, ring buffers, and argument pages cannot be migrated. The guide also covers mapping requirements, performance recommendations, firmware reload procedures, and debugging.

The speaker calls for fair treatment of Japanese people and other foreigners, recommends allowing Japanese immigrants to become naturalized citizens, and urges Congress to strengthen federal authority to enforce aliens’ treaty rights. Turning to Cuba, the speaker says an insurrection left its government unable to maintain order. After attempts to reconcile the factions failed and the Cuban president resigned, the United States established a provisional government and sent troops. Insurgents disarmed, peace returned, and the provisional government planned to oversee elections.

The study surveyed 14 high school teachers and university lecturers and 53 university students about AI in education, then tested three chatbots on programming tasks. Participants reported using AI to explain concepts, debug code, generate practice tasks and save time; 91% viewed its educational integration positively. They also raised concerns about incorrect answers, overreliance, cheating and reduced critical thinking. In beginner programming tests, ChatGPT answered 46 of 50 items correctly, compared with 37 for Microsoft Copilot and 32 for Gemini. ChatGPT completed all four complex tasks after additional prompts; the other tools could not fully complete the C programming task. The study concludes that prior knowledge and critical thinking are needed to identify errors and use these tools effectively.

The ADS868xW devices use 32-bit input commands for register configuration. Writes are synchronized to SCLK and execute on the rising edge of CONVST/CS. Half-word commands operate on 16 bits and ignore the least significant address bit. Output in the next frame depends on the preceding command and configuration: it can contain register data, a fixed pattern, or the latest 16-bit conversion result. Configurable flags and parity can be appended.

The multiSPI interface supports four SPI-compatible protocols for writing and several read options, including single or dual SDO and source-synchronous output. SPI-00-S is the default after power-up or asynchronous reset. Nine configuration registers control functions including interface modes, output data, input range, alarms, reset, and power.

An application example combines an ADS8681W with an eight-channel differential multiplexer for industrial inputs. The passage also describes programmable alarms and hysteresis, NAP and power-down modes, power-supply decoupling, and PCB layout recommendations.

Sterling Bank and Tata Africa Services have partnered to offer SMEs financing for commercial vehicles and spare parts. The scheme aims to help businesses acquire operational vehicles and improve deliveries. Customers are expected to contribute 20–80% of a vehicle’s cost, while bank funding depends on borrowing capacity.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on February 1, 2018, reporting that it issued a press release and data sheet on its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 30, 2017. The documents are attached as exhibits.

The article argues that mining stocks’ weak response to a gold rally signals a potential decline in precious metals. It also says a technical pattern points to a stronger U.S. dollar and that recent stock-market weakness could deepen. The author compares the conditions to 2008. The page includes promotions, reader comments and trading-risk disclosures.
Casey Paul Baumgart broke his cousin’s leg by kicking her after she tried to stop him driving drunk. He pleaded guilty to grievous bodily harm and received an 18-month wholly suspended sentence.

The passage describes systems for automatically generating orthodontic treatment plans tailored to a patient and a dental professional’s preferences. A preference database links users’ written instructions to clinical behaviors, using historical treatment data, machine learning, text-similarity searches, and analysis of consistent practices over time. The system applies matching preferences to patient information and proposed plans, which users can review and modify. Monitoring accepted plans and revisions can help update preferences and assess the accuracy of automatic planning.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The FAULT pin supports external protection: a sustained voltage above 0.6 V typically stops switching, and operation resumes after the fault clears, a frequency-dependent delay, and soft-start. Thermal shutdown stops switching above 175°C typically and restarts the power-up sequence below 160°C typically. Programmable slope compensation mitigates subharmonic oscillation, while Type 2A or 2B frequency compensation can be used.

A TPS7H5001-SP synchronous push-pull design example uses GaN devices, 500-kHz switching, a 5-V output, and approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance. The controllers require a regulated 4–14-V supply and at least 0.1 µF of input bypass capacitance. Layout guidance emphasizes separating noisy switching paths from sensitive signals, minimizing switching-loop areas, and placing bypass and compensation components close to the controller.

The President calls for lasting peace based on self-determination, a common guarantee of protection rather than entangling alliances, government by consent, freedom of the seas, and limited armaments. In Italy, the foreign minister finds the address idealistic and difficult to implement, though he receives it without apparent disfavor and asks about a specific peace-preservation plan. Spain’s minister says the Senate address made a better impression than the earlier peace note and expresses interest in cooperation, while seeking prior consultation. Hungary’s Count Tisza welcomes efforts toward peace but says opponents’ proposed terms conflict with those efforts and with the Central Powers’ position.

A study examined how users prompt ChatGPT, how its communication style adapts, and how its responses affect users’ perceptions and attitudes. In an experiment with 937 U.S. adults, researchers analyzed 747 relevant conversations. They found that 19.1% of users employed at least one prompting strategy, with use associated with education level and party affiliation. Issue controversy affected ChatGPT’s communication styles and citation counts, while users’ prompting styles remained consistent. Users rated more cognitively complex responses less favorably but showed more positive issue-specific attitude changes after receiving them.

Three-year-old Liam Radcliffe left Barassie early years nursery in Ayrshire unnoticed and walked half a mile home along a busy road. Staff had not realised he was missing when his mother brought him back. Following the incident, the nursery said it would alarm the main door, padlock the gate and add a staff member. South Ayrshire Council confirmed additional security measures were in place.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on May 26, 2021, announcing results for the quarter ended May 2, 2021. The report includes a press release and commentary from Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

The passage argues that judges should be open to fair, informed criticism, which can improve decisions and help hold life-tenured judges accountable. Unjust attacks should be answered, but forbidding criticism may drive people toward more intemperate attacks on the judiciary. It also calls for each region to address its own faults, for stronger public conscience and more effective enforcement against corruption, and for action against lynching. It condemns mobs that torture accused criminals as reducing themselves to the criminal’s level.

BG Group agreed to buy Enron’s offshore Indian oil and gas interests for $388 million, subject to government approval and agreement that BG can operate the fields. Analysts described the price as favorable, while partner ONGC sought operatorship. Enron was separately trying to sell its stake in the troubled Dabhol power project, whose operator missed a $24 million interest payment. Other articles reported a rise in Enron shares, a California utility settlement affecting creditors including Enron, and former Enron executive Thomas White’s appointment as the Pentagon’s homeland security liaison.

A vehicle-code stop in Chino led Chino Hills sheriff’s investigators to more than $200,000 in property believed stolen since at least 2006 and stored in six units. Mark William Ellis, 36, was arrested and has pleaded not guilty to charges in the case. Authorities confirmed more than 50 vehicle burglaries and identified 40 victims. About $63,000 in property has been returned, and detectives are seeking additional victims.

This archive log lists Enron messages created from September 2000 through July 2001, primarily concerning California’s energy crisis, electricity and gas markets, utility finances, legislation, regulatory proceedings, and Enron’s responses.

Centana Growth Partners has raised $250 million for its first fund to invest in financial services startups, with plans to invest $5 million to $30 million per company. Founded in 2015, it has invested in four companies, including One and Jumio.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% year to date, but slipped 1.6% on the first day of August. The article says the longer-term uptrend remains healthy while weakening short-term technical indicators, rising volatility and credit spreads, and seasonal pressures warrant caution. It also notes growing investor concentration in technology stocks and record-high U.S. electricity demand.

BioRecall is a pilot study designed to combine lifestyle and environmental survey responses with genetic, biological and clinical data from the Central Finland Biobank. It will invite 1,386 eligible, genotyped donors with type 2 diabetes who have consented to research contact. Participants will complete an electronic questionnaire covering health, behaviours, work and residential surroundings, with immediate feedback on selected lifestyle measures. Postal codes will link responses to environmental data. The study has ethics and biobank approval; with consent, collected data will be returned to the biobank for future research. The pilot is limited to one biobank and has no formal sample-size calculation or detailed statistical analysis plan.

Obamacare changed Medicare, employer-sponsored insurance, individual coverage and Medicaid. It lowered some Medicare costs, provided free preventive services, restricted insurers’ pricing and benefit limits, subsidized individual policies, and expanded Medicaid in participating states. President-elect Trump and congressional Republicans vowed to repeal the law, beginning with spending and revenue provisions. A full repeal would likely raise costs for many Medicare beneficiaries, restore the prescription-drug coverage gap, remove some coverage requirements and subsidies, and leave millions of low-income Americans uninsured. It would also end the requirement that most Americans obtain insurance. Higher-income Medicare enrollees could benefit from repeal, and Trump has said he may retain coverage for children on their parents’ plans until age 26.

Hong Liu introduces a course on holographic duality, graded through five problem sets and a final paper. He describes the duality as two descriptions of the same quantum system: quantum gravity in dynamical spacetime and a field theory in fixed spacetime. The lecture explores how gravity might emerge from a nongravitational system and explains why the Weinberg–Witten theorem rules out massless spin-2 particles in certain field theories. Holographic duality avoids this restriction because gravity and the field theory occupy different spacetimes. Liu concludes with a proof of the theorem based on Lorentz symmetry and particle states.

The Supreme Court is reconsidering several previously relisted petitions and has relisted nine more. Four concern whether the federal ban on firearm possession by unlawful users of controlled substances violates the Second Amendment. Another asks whether judicial estoppel can bar a personal injury claim that a debtor failed to disclose in bankruptcy, even without evidence of bad faith. Four newly relisted petitions were filed by prisoners without lawyers. The court also denied review in several earlier relisted cases, prompting opinions from some justices.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 GPU architecture for deep learning and high-performance computing. Its Tensor Cores support formats including TF32, BF16 and FP64, while 2:4 structured sparsity doubles Tensor Core compute throughput by skipping zero-valued weights. The A100 also increases HBM2 bandwidth and L2 cache capacity compared with V100, and adds asynchronous data transfers, cache controls and compression to improve efficiency. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide an A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 and CUDA 11 features support multi-GPU scaling and application development. Eight A100 GPUs power the DGX A100 system.

Anthony Rizzo homered and drove in two runs with a ninth-inning single as the Chicago Cubs beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 7-0. The game was overshadowed by Rizzo’s hard slide into catcher Elias Diaz in the eighth inning. The Pirates challenged the play, but the call stood; manager Clint Hurdle was ejected for arguing. Diaz remained in the game but disputed that the slide was legal. Spot starter Mike Montgomery allowed two singles over 5⅔ scoreless innings.

Ahead of the PlayStation 3’s November 2006 launch, Sony faced competition from Microsoft’s Xbox 360 and Nintendo’s lower-priced Wii. Sony also intended the PS3’s Blu-Ray player to advance its video format against HD-DVD, though the console’s $599 price could limit sales. The passage traces how Atari, Nintendo and Sony shaped the console market through game quality, licensing, technology and software selection. It describes an industry increasingly dependent on hit games, acquired development studios and online services. Microsoft emphasized a unified Xbox Live service, while Nintendo sought a broader audience with accessible games and motion controls. Sony entered the launch with the PS2 still dominant, but faced uncertain demand, competitors with distinct strategies and continuing public concern about violent games.

The passage describes the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 microcontrollers’ power management, clocks, DMA, event routing, memory, GPIO, analog functions, communication interfaces, watchdogs, RTC, timers, and debug features. It specifies a 12-bit ADC operating at up to 1.6 Msps, up to 45 GPIO pins, and flash endurance of up to 100,000 program/erase cycles in selected regions. It also gives typical circuit recommendations, identifies development resources, summarizes documentation revisions, and provides packaging and ordering information.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 29, 2020, announcing its third-quarter 2020 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures.

Researchers used DNA-PAINT super-resolution microscopy to visualize individual strands in DNA origami nanostructures and assess how well they assemble. Assembly remained robust across varying conditions, but a strand’s likelihood of incorporation depended on its target position, and some sites remained unoccupied. The findings can help optimize DNA nanostructures, while the method may also enable direct measurement of labelling efficiency in biological samples.

The paper studies modal extensions of lattice-based logics, interpreting necessity as the greatest lower bound of values in accessible worlds. It shows that a normal extension is regular—necessity holds exactly when a formula holds in every accessible world—when its designated values form a filter whose greatest lower bound is designated. It also relates modal validities to lattice properties, including conditions under which axiom K holds for different definitions of implication. A twist-algebra example applies these results to paraconsistent semantics. The authors identify extensions to models with different logics across worlds and the finite-model property as topics for further research.

Golfweek named South Carolina golfers Katelyn Dambaugh to its All-America First Team and Ainhoa Olarra and Ana Pelaez as honorable mentions. The honors gave Dambaugh a program-record five for her career; she also won the 2017 SEC individual title. Olarra recorded five top-10 finishes, while Pelaez set a school freshman scoring-average record and won the NCAA Columbus Regional.

The passage introduces a Bayesian approach to dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) that combines transfer-operator methods with Gaussian process regression. The proposed modification of extended DMD uses kernel methods to model nonlinear dynamical systems from noisy measurements and provide uncertainty estimates for multi-step predictions. It aims to address the computational cost of kernel-based DMD through sparse dictionary learning and hyperparameter optimization. The formulation treats the embedded Perron–Frobenius operator probabilistically, using an operator-valued kernel to handle outputs in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. The authors note that the method inherits some limitations of extended DMD.

Baidu is adding NVIDIA Tesla P40 GPUs and deep learning software to Baidu Cloud. Its Autonomous Driving Unit is developing Level 4 technology, aiming to commercialize autonomous driving by 2018 and reach mass production by 2020.

The professor emphasizes that business planning is dynamic and that entrepreneurs should ask why an opportunity matters, why now, and why their team is suited to it. Bob Jones argues that businesses must identify who will pay, what those customers want, and how to reach them. His nutrition bar for dialysis patients failed after he consulted clinicians but not the patients who would buy and eat it. For a later diabetes product, he spoke with patients and parents, addressed their fear of nighttime low blood glucose, and built demand that helped secure retailers without slotting fees. Jones recommends testing basic products, focusing on motivated customer segments, and selling benefits rather than product features.

The speaker credits strong games from Ron Francis, Sami Kapanen and Arturs, along with a simple system, sustained puck possession and good goaltending, for the win. The team entered the third period tied and scored in overtime. The speaker was pleased for Aaron, who played well against an organization where he had spent considerable time. The team celebrated its first Stanley Cup Finals win but expects a difficult series.

The American Indian College Fund announced a $600,000 Strada Education Network-funded study of the economic and social impact of five North Dakota tribal colleges and universities. The project will examine graduates’ employment, survey 5,000 College Fund scholars about the value of an education rooted in Native American values, and pilot research on colleges’ roles in preserving language and culture. The College Fund plans to share the results with state and federal policymakers when the project concludes in September 2019.

Satish Gupta identifies housing finance and liquor as sectors receiving astrological support and argues that planetary positions can help time investments. He promotes an early release of his Samvat 2074 sector predictions, citing past gains in chemical and dye stocks. Moneycontrol.com states that the investment views are the author’s own and advises readers to consult certified experts before investing.

This non-empirical literature review examines how AI affects inclusive education, which seeks to meet the needs of all students. It reports that AI can support personalized learning, accessible tools, feedback, assessment, and administrative work, but cannot replace educators’ guidance and emotional support. Barriers include inadequate training and resources, inaccessible materials, bias, cost, privacy concerns, and overreliance on technology. The paper recommends accessible syllabi, assistive technologies, educator development, and involving teachers in AI design and evaluation. Because the review included no fieldwork and did not focus on marginalized groups’ experiences, it calls for further empirical research.

The study develops a machine-learning interatomic potential for YBa₂Cu₃O₇−x, trained on density functional theory data that include defects. It reproduces structural and oxygen-defect properties more accurately than a previously used classical potential. In simulations, it captures an orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition near 800 K, compared with approximately 1000 K in experiments. The transition involves oxygen moving from CuO chains, and to a lesser extent apical sites, into sites between the chains. The authors find that entropy drives this disordering, while thermal expansion lowers the energy needed to form oxygen Frenkel pairs. Their simulations conserve oxygen content, unlike heated experimental samples, which can lose oxygen.

Following the arrest of two Black men at a Philadelphia Starbucks, The Black Star Project organized National Eat at a Black Coffee Shop Day for May 29, 2018, when Starbucks planned to close more than 8,000 U.S. stores for diversity training. More than 400 Black-owned coffee and tea shops were expected to participate, promoting Black-owned businesses and economic development in Black communities.

Cadillac sold 35,020 vehicles globally in September 2017, up 16.5% year over year and extending its growth streak to 16 months. Year-to-date sales reached 256,613, up 20.9%. September sales rose 37.6% in China and 1.1% in the United States. The XT5 remained the brand’s best-selling model.

On November 29, 2016, NVIDIA’s board amended its bylaws to allow proxy access and revise advance-notice requirements for director nominations. Stockholders holding at least 3% of voting power for three years, individually or in groups of up to 20, may include eligible nominees in annual meeting proxy materials, subject to bylaw requirements. Beginning with the 2018 annual meeting, other director nominations generally require notice 90 to 120 days before the prior meeting’s anniversary. The amended bylaws took effect immediately and were filed as Exhibit 3.1.

This study examined blood pressure and cognitive change in 2,284 older Black and White adults from three aging cohorts. Participants were grouped by normal, high, or variable systolic blood pressure and assessed across five cognitive domains. Rates of decline were generally similar between Black and White participants with normal blood pressure. White participants with high blood pressure showed faster decline in global cognition and some domains than Black participants with high blood pressure; those with variable blood pressure showed faster decline in global cognition and all five domains. The analyses did not account for medication adherence or comprehensive medication histories.

AMD shares rose more than 20% in premarket trading after it announced a multiyear deal to supply OpenAI with AI chips, beginning with its MI450 series. OpenAI could acquire up to 10% of AMD’s equity if production and performance milestones are met. Analysts see substantial revenue potential but warn that manufacturing complexity, supply constraints and sustained demand pose risks.

Ions’ charge allows much stronger confinement than is typical for neutral atoms. Because static electric fields cannot confine ions in every direction, ion traps generally use dynamic confinement. Penning traps combine electrostatic and magnetic confinement, while RF or Paul traps rapidly alternate confining and anti-confining forces; the resulting micromotion produces a net restoring force.

Both ions and neutral atoms are used in clocks, quantum information, and quantum simulation. For ion-based quantum computation, the Cirac–Zoller gate uses the shared center-of-mass motion of trapped ions as a data bus: information from one ion is transferred to that motion, used to control a phase operation on another ion, then transferred back. The gate requires ground-state cooling and becomes slower as systems grow.

Judges sanctioned lawyers in two cases involving faulty citations. In Puerto Rico, opposing firms will share $24,492 in fees after lawyers filed motions with at least 55 defective citations; the lawyers denied using AI, but the judge said the number of errors suggested otherwise. In California, a lawyer was fined $10,000 for AI-generated fake quotes and irrelevant cases. The fine goes to the court, which denied fees to opposing counsel because they failed to detect the errors.

Audi, BMW, Volkswagen and Volvo have discontinued several manual-transmission models locally, following earlier cuts to the BMW M3 and M4 and Volkswagen GTI. The passage attributes the shift to demand for automatics. Porsche says it will retain manuals, while Jaguar SA has added manual F-Type versions.

Mourning President Franklin Delano Roosevelt, the speaker pledges to carry forward his ideals and asks Americans to remain united. He vows to continue fighting Germany and Japan until their unconditional surrender and to punish war criminals. He calls for a just, lasting peace through international cooperation, a strong United Nations Organization, and the San Francisco Conference. He also promises continued efforts to improve the lives of ordinary Americans and urges trade with other nations to raise living standards.

A University of Birmingham academic and the city council attributed the weekend’s flash flooding to unusually heavy rainfall overwhelming drains, rather than drain blockages. A grate at Pebble Mill Road and Pershore Road was photographed blocked on Tuesday. A yellow weather warning was issued for Thursday, with thunderstorms, heavy rain, lightning and hail possible.

The passage discusses proposed efforts to increase Congo product supplies, with Belgium agreeing to facilitate them. U.S. officials sought commodity and civilian-requirements data for joint allocation boards and considered a provision limiting Congo export-duty increases. Signing of a proposed tripartite agreement was postponed; negotiations ended without an agreement, while existing arrangements handled supplies and purchases. The passage also lists diplomatic topics concerning Bulgaria, Czechoslovakia, and Finland.

Charlie Javice, founder of financial-aid startup Frank, was sentenced to 85 months in prison for defrauding JPMorgan Chase in its $175 million acquisition of the company. A jury found her and Frank’s chief growth officer guilty of fraud and conspiracy after Frank’s customer count was inflated with fabricated identities. Javice was also ordered to pay forfeiture and restitution and will remain on bail during her appeal.

Stranger Things cast members will reportedly receive raises for season three: Winona Ryder and David Harbour to $350,000 per episode, four younger cast members to $250,000, and three actors playing teenagers to $150,000. Millie Bobby Brown reportedly negotiated separately. Netflix declined to comment.

The strategy rotates monthly among SPY, TLT, and EEM, holding whichever ETF performed best in the previous month. A backtest beginning in 2003 reported an 11% compound annual growth rate, excluding commissions and slippage. Its maximum drawdown was 22% before 2022, when the portfolio fell 41% from its peak. The article says performance has been weaker in the last five to six years and suggests a tax-deferred account because of frequent rotation.

The S&P 500 fell more than 3% from Thursday’s record high before a projected Monday rebound. The article says this could be a brief bounce amid broader consolidation or a potential downtrend, and urges careful position management as earnings and economic risks build. Oil also declined after OPEC+ announced another production increase, though possible U.S. sanctions on Russian oil could affect supply.

Ineos shut down the 450,000-barrel-per-day Forties Pipeline System after a crack widened, warning repairs could take weeks. The pipeline carries nearly 40 percent of UK North Sea oil production and is central to the Brent crude benchmark. Brent rose nearly 2 percent on Monday, above $64.50 a barrel. The outage could force North Sea production cuts, tighten Atlantic Basin supply and increase demand for U.S. crude.

Returning Scripps National Spelling Bee competitors Erin Howard, Cameron Keith and Naysa Modi reached this year’s final round after extensive preparation. Erin studied trademarked words after misspelling one last year; Cameron says experience has made him calmer. Naysa is competing for the fourth time. Her father says their work together has strengthened their relationship and that the effort is driven by a love of words, not just winning.

The Michigan Court of Appeals affirmed a divorce judgment granting both parents shared legal custody, with the father receiving physical custody of the two older children and the mother receiving physical custody of the younger twins. It held that courts should consider sibling bonds, but each child’s best interests control when keeping siblings together would conflict with those interests. The trial court did not abuse its discretion in separating the children.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) lets customers apply selected AMD firmware and settings updates at runtime without a BIOS reflash or system reset. Patches are non-persistent, must be reapplied after reboot, and do not update x86 code or run-once boot code. Packages target specific firmware and patch levels, require AMD signature verification, and can optionally require customer co-signing. Customers enable SFS in BIOS and are responsible for testing, validation, and deployment. The AMD Security Processor verifies and executes applicable packages, then reports their status and version levels.

The passage examines artificial intelligence as an alternative or supplement to education, particularly when disruptions such as the COVID-19 pandemic require distance learning. It describes AI-supported teaching, AI-led classrooms and simulation-based learning, including systems that adapt to individual students. Potential benefits include personalized instruction, wider access and lower costs and risks. The authors also raise concerns about privacy, manipulation, social isolation, psychological effects and educator unemployment, and call for further research and discussion.

The passage contrasts weakening U.S. economic data with strong corporate earnings. July added 73,000 jobs, while May and June figures were revised down by 258,000. S&P 500 second-quarter earnings growth rose to 11.2% as more companies reported results. After July’s eleventh consecutive positive year, the passage notes that August through October has historically been weaker. It says the S&P 500 reached the 9.1% average annual price-return mark and suggests market weakness could follow, while cautioning that an economic slowdown does not necessarily mean a recession.

FCA survey data shows that 70% of adults planning to access defined contribution pensions within two years said providers had not asked about their plans. Sixty-seven per cent had not received advice from an adviser at their pension provider. Among those who had not taken advice, 40% felt able to decide on their own. Twenty-eight per cent had little or no idea of their expected annual retirement income.

Most Southeast Asian stock markets closed lower on Thursday amid concerns that a reduction in U.S. Federal Reserve stimulus could trigger regional capital outflows. Investors were also cautious ahead of a meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Indonesian shares bucked the trend, closing at a record high, while Philippine shares fell after earlier reaching a five-month high. Vietnam and Thailand were closed for holidays.

Marco Gonzales allowed no earned runs in 6 2/3 innings as the Seattle Mariners beat the Texas Rangers 2-1 on Monday. Seattle scored twice in the sixth on RBI singles by Nelson Cruz and Kyle Seager after a Texas defensive miscue. Texas scored on a passed ball. Edwin Diaz earned his 19th save. The Mariners have won nine of their last 10 games, including seven of eight in which they scored three runs or fewer.

Taxify will launch in Sydney on Tuesday, its first entry into Australia, with half-priced fares for one month. It has registered more than 4,000 drivers and says it will take a 15 per cent commission. The app operates in 20 countries.

El estudio analiza la aplicación del neuromarketing al sector audiovisual español mediante 18 entrevistas a consultoras, representantes del sector, neurocientíficos y académicos. Concluye que su uso es incipiente y se concentra principalmente en Atresmedia y Mediaset España, que lo emplean para estudiar contenidos y publicidad. La investigación requiere equipos multidisciplinares y afronta limitaciones éticas, tecnológicas y de interpretación de datos. Aunque las productoras muestran interés, los costes y la escasa cultura de investigación dificultan su adopción. Los entrevistados prevén una evolución positiva, condicionada a que se demuestre su eficacia.

State officials broke ground on the Mauka Concourse at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport. The $220 million project will add gates for larger aircraft and 260,000 square feet of passenger space. Completion is expected by the end of 2020.

The author argues that cleaner classroom air could improve student outcomes at relatively low cost. After schools near a California gas leak received air purifiers, their students’ test scores rose compared with those at similar schools outside the installation area. Other cited research links air cleaners and ventilation improvements to lower absenteeism and better academic performance, though the author says larger trials are needed. The passage urges schools to maintain or pilot air cleaners and monitor outcomes, particularly in communities more exposed to pollution and poor ventilation.

Index Markets Research’s global plastic granules report covers market size, trends, forecasts, competition, production capacity and manufacturing costs. It examines production, consumption, revenue and growth across North America, China, Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan and India for 2012–2022, with 2022 forecast. It segments the market by plastic type and applications, including plastic products and clothing, and includes analyses of market opportunities, challenges and investment prospects.

Research describes sudden, potentially irreversible changes in six Australian ecosystems, including kelp forests, alpine forests and mangroves. Gradual climate change combined with extreme weather events is overwhelming ecosystems’ resilience, even in areas with little human disturbance. These changes can reduce resources and services such as fisheries, carbon storage and water supply. Collapse is difficult to predict, and interventions may be costly and less effective as extreme events become more frequent. The researchers suggest that many apparently healthy ecosystems may be near a tipping point.

A retrospective study used survey and electronic health record data from nearly 100,000 All of Us participants aged 50 or older to predict healthy aging, defined using comorbidities, cognitive impairment, mobility, and age. Of three models tested, XGBoost performed best, with an AUROC of about 0.795 in the primary cohort. Its predictive values were similar across race and gender groups. Health insurance type was the strongest predictor, followed by employment status, substance use, and insurance coverage. The authors caution that their definition of healthy aging is limited and that volunteer selection and unmeasured factors may affect the findings.

The Bengals will start Joe Flacco against the Packers on Sunday, one day after acquiring him from the Browns in a trade involving 2026 draft picks. Cincinnati has lost three straight games with Joe Burrow recovering from foot surgery; Jake Browning will return to a backup role. Flacco faced Green Bay earlier this season in a Browns victory. Coach Zac Taylor said Flacco will take all the practice reps as the Bengals prepare for Sunday.

On October 22, 2001, U.S. stocks rose on better-than-expected earnings, while Enron shares fell about 21% after the SEC requested information about transactions involving partnerships run by its chief financial officer, Andrew Fastow. Enron said it would cooperate and that its board, auditors and attorneys had reviewed the arrangements. Shareholders filed lawsuits alleging conflicts of interest and financial losses tied to the partnerships. Separately, UniPrime announced a letter of intent for an interest in a wind-park lease owned by an Enron subsidiary.

IES Holdings’ shares have nearly doubled year to date, outperforming other infrastructure and Russell 2000 stocks. Data-center projects are helping offset weakness in its residential division, while backlog has surpassed $2 billion. The author suggests waiting for a pullback, citing the stock’s extended valuation, weak free-cash-flow yield and increased insider sales.

The study simulated replacing car trips in Italy’s Asti province with four battery-electric vehicle models under four charging policies, using 10.1 million cleaned trips from 10,441 users. Fast charging when battery charge fell below 25% performed best: with the largest-battery model, 95% of users could complete at least 99% of their trips, and 72% could complete every trip. Overnight charging made the smallest model suitable for 35% of users and produced the highest average battery charge after trips. The simulations assumed charging was available at qualifying parking events and did not account for costs, temperature-dependent consumption or changing charging rates.

Institute manager Kevin Deery was frustrated after a third consecutive draw, against Larne at Drumahoe. He said his side created enough chances to win but missed opportunities and made poor decisions in both boxes. Institute remain in the top six with 13 games left, and Deery said he believes their form will improve.

Virginia beat North Carolina 71-63 to win the ACC Tournament, ending the event’s two-year run at Barclays Center. The passage also covers North Carolina’s rivalry game with Duke, Marvin Bagley III’s play for Duke, and Clemson’s win over Boston College.

Iamgold Corp (NYSE:IAG) shares were unchanged in the most recent session and last closed at $4.90. Analysts’ average 12-month price target was $7.65, with estimates ranging from $6.25 to $9.05. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation was 2. Its 14-period average true range was 0.2, and its relative strength index was 30.76. Iamgold had a market capitalization of $2.29 billion and 468.31 million shares outstanding. Trading volume in the previous session was 7.92 million shares, compared with an average of 4.66 million.

The Maui News reported that former councilmember and mayoral candidate Mike Victorino struck two teenagers with his car on April 13. Both sustained nonlife-threatening injuries. Police said speed and alcohol were not factors. Police said the teens were outside a crosswalk, but one teen’s mother said he told her they were in one.

A February 6, 2002 collection of news reports covers congressional investigations into Enron’s collapse. An internal investigator testified that executive-run partnerships concealed losses, inflated earnings and enriched insiders, while lawmakers questioned Enron’s leaders and auditor Arthur Andersen. Congress subpoenaed former chief executive Kenneth Lay, and Jeffrey Skilling was expected to testify. Other reports describe employees’ retirement losses, shrinking bankruptcy financing, back taxes owed by Enron’s broadband unit and a dispute over the Enron Field naming rights.

Linebackers line up behind the defensive line and help stop both runs and passes. They often relay defensive calls and need toughness, athleticism, intelligence, tackling ability, and the versatility to shed blocks, rush passers, and cover receivers. Common roles include Sam, Mike, Will, and Jack. The passage highlights Ray Lewis, Chuck Bednarik, and Lawrence Taylor as notable linebackers. Although the value of inside linebackers has declined as NFL offenses have spread out and passed more, versatile linebackers remain valuable for their ability to disrupt offenses in multiple ways.

The Canadian dollar rose to nearly 75.50 U.S. cents Wednesday as strong economic data raised expectations of a Bank of Canada interest rate hike. The loonie has fluctuated this year, reaching a low of 72.73 U.S. cents on May 4. Lower oil prices and a widening gap between Canadian and U.S. interest rates have weighed on it, while economic growth has supported it. Recent comments from bank officials suggested a rate hike could come sooner than expected, though Governor Stephen Poloz also highlighted challenges facing exporters. CIBC now expects a hike in the fourth quarter rather than in 2018.

At a Board of Governors meeting, student leaders said the new on-campus stadium’s tailgating lot had been underused and outlined plans to raise awareness and add pre-game programming. Attendance was 37,583 at the first game and 27,038 at the second. Stadium entry and concession congestion improved by the second game. Officials reported 50 cars towed from campus gameday lots each weekend. First-game transit use exceeded projections, with 7,000 riders instead of 5,000, and post-game traffic was not overwhelmed.

Allen Iverson said in an interview about his memoir “Misunderstood” that his divorce from Tawanna Turner was the lowest point of his life. He said it prompted self-reevaluation, including recognition that alcohol was a problem. Iverson confirmed that he and Turner are back together.

District and Sessions Judge Nasir Khan Yousafzai sentenced Shehzado to death and fined him Rs. 200,000 in a murder case. In separate murder cases, brothers Ajab Khan and Fateh Khan received 25-year sentences and Rs. 200,000 fines each; Dilbar Khan received 25 years and a Rs. 105,000 fine.

The Great Southern Storm have named a 45-player initial colts squad for next month’s carnival in Kulin. Glynn Verbruggen replaces Phil Gilbert as coach. The squad includes State 16 players Heath Spinks and Jacob Blight, with North Albany contributing the most players. Training sessions on June 4 and 11 will precede selection of the travelling team.

This study tested whether role-taking exercises or literacy materials could reduce the influence of age, gender, ethnicity, and attire on trust and risk-taking in social engineering scenarios. In an online experiment, 139 participants assessed strangers offering mobile hotspots before and one week after an intervention or no intervention. Neither approach significantly changed trust or risk-taking across the persona characteristics, and word-of-mouth responses remained largely stable. Issue involvement changed, but post hoc comparisons found no significant differences between specific groups. Participant feedback suggested the exercises encouraged reflection. The authors note that hypothetical scenarios and the intervention’s short duration may have limited its impact and recommend testing longer, more immersive approaches.

The passage argues that Germany’s influence in Central Europe depends on its ability to direct the region’s peoples and resources toward its foreign policy. It distinguishes opposition to German-led political control from opposition to economic or cultural unity. The alliance linking Berlin, Vienna, Budapest, Sofia, and Constantinople rests on shared political interests and, after the war, debts to Germany. The passage identifies commercial exclusion as a powerful means of obtaining German concessions, since Germany would need raw materials and markets to resume industry. It also proposes using nationalist discontent in Austria-Hungary to weaken its dependence on Berlin, while offering its rulers a path to preserve the empire rather than dismember it.

Peggy Mahoney forwarded an Energy Central forum email asking whether federal policy should encourage natural gas exploration and production to meet future electricity demand. The email also published varied responses to an earlier question about San Diego electricity price spikes. Contributors disagreed over market manipulation and price caps, citing supply shortages, market design, regulation and barriers to new generation.

Chipotle launched queso on Sept. 12, but customers criticized its price and taste. A spokesman said 63% of test-market tasters reported they would visit more often and that Chipotle had no plans to lower the price because the queso costs more to make.

Texas will replace STAAR in 2027-28 with tests at the beginning, middle and end of the school year, while banning certain practice tests. The law aims to reduce testing pressure and give teachers faster results, but parents, educators and experts worry three exams could increase stress and testing time. They also question whether strict testing-day rules will apply to all three exams. The end-of-year test will continue to affect school ratings, while a study of changes to those ratings is not due until 2029-30. Some educators want more teacher input and less restrictive testing conditions.

The passage introduces LAPIS, an MLIR-based compiler framework designed to combine performance, portability and productivity for computational science and AI/ML. It lowers Python-based programs to Kokkos C++ code that can be integrated into scientific applications. Its contributions include a Kokkos dialect, accelerator-aware memory management, linear algebra operations, loop-mapping passes and a C++ emitter. The authors report performance comparable to hand-optimized implementations for selected operations across AMD and NVIDIA GPUs and Intel CPUs, and demonstrate coupling scientific simulations with machine-learning code.

The passage presents a construction of strong pseudorandom unitaries in the quantum Haar random oracle model. The construction uses two calls to a Haar-random unitary and remains indistinguishable from an independent Haar-random unitary even when adversaries can query both unitaries and their inverses. Its security analysis uses path-recording isometries, an approximate database-merging isometry, and a query-by-query comparison.

Paul Clement is set to become Swansea manager after Bayern Munich gave him permission to speak to the club. Swansea hope to finalise a deal until 2019 and provide a £30million transfer budget. The club is 19th in the Premier League after parting with Bob Bradley.

CEMEX grew from a Mexican cement company into a global building-materials supplier through acquisitions between 1992 and 2007. Its “CEMEX Way” combined standardized processes and technology with practices learned from acquired companies, using post-merger integration to drive continuous improvement. Acquisitions in Spain, the Americas, Asia and Europe expanded its operations; the RMC and Rinker deals also increased its presence in ready-mix concrete and aggregates. Although growth rewarded shareholders through 2007, CEMEX’s share price fell sharply in 2008 amid the global downturn, credit crisis and debt associated with the Rinker acquisition.

The May 23, 2001, State Bar of Michigan e-Journal summarizes decisions across bankruptcy, civil rights, criminal, family, insurance, property and other areas of law. The rulings include a decision that a state student-loan agency lacked sovereign immunity in a bankruptcy discharge proceeding, affirmance of several criminal convictions and parental-rights terminations, and reversal of a zoning variance granted by a circuit court. The issue also contains legal-practice listings, classified advertisements, job openings and notices of bar events.

Springfield, Massachusetts, police officer Conrad Lariviere faces disciplinary action after commenting “Hahahaha love this” on Facebook about a car striking counter-protesters at a white nationalist rally in Charlottesville, Virginia. Heather Heyer was killed and 19 others were injured. Lariviere apologized and said he is not racist. Police Commissioner John Barbieri initiated an internal investigation, and the mayor condemned the comment.

A federal judge dismissed Drake’s lawsuit against Universal Music Group over Kendrick Lamar’s “Not Like Us,” ruling that its accusation was nonactionable opinion in a heated rap battle. Drake plans to appeal.

Williams & Connolly said hackers used a zero-day attack to access a small number of attorney email accounts. The firm found no evidence that confidential client data was taken from elsewhere in its systems and said it has blocked the suspected nation-state-affiliated attackers.

The passage describes video-output pins carrying the eight most significant bits of G/Y/YC, B/Cb/C, and R/Cr data. Their functions vary by video mode: RGB uses color data, YUV444 uses luma and chroma data, Y/C multiplexes chroma data, and BT.656 does not use the B/Cb/C signals.

The 1956 Hungarian revolt grew from discontent with Communist rule, economic failures, repression and hopes for greater independence from Soviet control. After Budapest protests on 22–23 October, revolutionary councils demanded nationalism, neutrality and the withdrawal of Soviet troops. Imre Nagy became prime minister, and Soviet forces briefly left Budapest while preparing an invasion. The Suez crisis diverted world attention as Soviet troops surrounded the city and attacked on 3–4 November. Organized resistance had collapsed by 30 November. About 25,000 Hungarians and 7,000 Soviet soldiers were killed. The passage describes the revolt’s repression as a turning point for the Soviet Union and NATO.

The DAWN-PLASMA study was a multicenter, randomized, open-label phase 2 trial comparing standard care plus convalescent plasma with standard care alone in adults hospitalized with COVID-19. Its primary endpoint was the proportion of patients alive without mechanical ventilation on Day 15. Secondary endpoints addressed clinical status, ventilation, safety and other outcomes. Participants were allocated 2:1; those receiving plasma were given 800–1000 mL in four units, with the first dose within 12 hours of randomization. Patients already receiving mechanical ventilation were excluded. Ethics committees approved the protocol, and informed consent was required. Five patients withdrew consent and one failed screening before intervention; all six were replaced. No patients were lost to follow-up after intervention.

Coppin State University in Maryland has expanded enrollment through its Expand Eagle Nation program, which offers in-state tuition to students from qualifying states and territories and the District of Columbia. The number of students from those places rose from 81 in 2023 to 195 in 2024; this fall, 416 of the 1,000 incoming students qualify. Overall enrollment is up 26 percent. Officials also increased recruitment and advertising, developed transfer partnerships, and expanded housing options to accommodate growth.

The TPS7H500x-SP series comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The passage describes programmable enable and undervoltage lockout, output voltage, soft start, switching frequency, duty-cycle limits, dead time, leading-edge blanking, and slope compensation. Controllers can use an internal oscillator, an external clock, or primary-secondary synchronization; supported outputs vary by device. Protection features include pulse skipping, cycle-by-cycle current limiting with hiccup restart, an external fault input, and thermal shutdown.

A synchronous push-pull converter example using the TPS7H5001-SP specifies 500-kHz switching, 5-V output, and selected power-stage and control components. The passage also provides supply-bypassing and PCB-layout guidance to reduce noise and improve reliability.

Indianapolis Public Schools is seeking public input on a proposal to close three of its seven high schools by the 2018–2019 school year. A task force found that all seven are under capacity and recommended operating four for flexibility. Public meetings will continue through May; administrators expect to recommend specific closures in June, with a board vote in September.

Remote sensing change detection is challenged by environmental variation, limited annotated data, and methods that rely mainly on visual information. The proposed Language-Guided Change Detection model combines bi-temporal image features from a SAM2 encoder with text features from CLIP. Multi-level adapters refine visual features, a text fusion attention module aligns them with language cues, and a visual-semantic decoder produces change masks. The paper reports improved detection accuracy and generalization.

The White House said it was not defending Roseanne Barr’s racist tweet, which led ABC to cancel her sitcom. Trump and press secretary Sarah Sanders instead accused ABC and other media outlets of a double standard over derogatory comments about him. Sanders also criticized networks for not airing Trump’s remarks on a “right to try” bill.

With Democrats taking control of Congress and the presidency, the speaker calls for restoring national life to principles of justice and fair play. While praising the nation’s prosperity and moral strength, he condemns waste, industrial harm, and government serving private interests. He proposes reforms to tariffs, banking, industry, agriculture, conservation, and protections for health and labor. He urges careful, nonpartisan change that preserves what is good and asks citizens to support the work ahead.

Before the team’s final on-field practice until training camp, Kyle Shanahan said the offense and defense had both played well the previous day, though both had areas to improve. He said his father watches film and offers ideas but is not on staff. Shanahan plans to take time off with his family before camp. He called play-action important for creating explosive plays, easing pressure on the offense and keeping defenses honest.

A federal judge dismissed Spencer Elden’s lawsuit over Nirvana’s 1991 album cover, ruling that the image of him as a naked baby underwater is not child pornography. The judge said nudity was the only factor that could support Elden’s claim and compared the image to a family photo of a bathing child.

A July 2001 roundup of energy articles covers competing legislative plans to prevent Southern California Edison’s bankruptcy, PG&E’s lawsuit seeking payment for power contracts seized by California, and criticism of a proposed SDG&E rescue. It also reports that California sold surplus power at a loss as demand fell, Contra Costa County approved energy-efficiency upgrades, electricity costs contributed to higher consumer prices, and Duke Energy’s quarterly profit rose 27%.

The lecture explains post-flop poker decisions through example hands. It recommends betting strong hands for value, bluffing with weak hands that have useful draws, and often checking middle-strength hands. Whether to call or raise depends on the board, an opponent’s likely range, position, and effective stack size; shorter stacks can justify committing chips with weaker hands. The speaker also discusses when to bet into the preflop raiser, how implied and reverse implied odds affect calls, and why a bluff should account for both its chances of improving and the strong hands it could represent.

Cervical cancer affects the neck of the womb and is linked to high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV). Precancerous changes often have no symptoms but can be detected through Pap screening and treated. Symptoms of cancer may include bleeding after sex, abnormal vaginal discharge and pelvic pain. A cervical tissue biopsy confirms diagnosis. Early-stage cancer can be cured with surgery or radiotherapy; late-stage treatment aims to prolong life and may include radiotherapy and chemotherapy. HPV vaccination and regular screening can help prevent cervical cancer. The passage reports a high burden in Nigeria, where structured screening programmes are lacking.

The passage examines how artificial intelligence could change higher education teaching, research, administration and external relationships. Based on document analysis and the authors’ teaching experience, it describes potential uses including personalized learning, tutoring, grading, research analysis and administrative support. It also identifies challenges involving equitable access, privacy, ethics, costs, training, institutional policies and AI’s limitations. The authors call for AI literacy, teacher preparation and participation across institutions in decisions about AI, while maintaining academic freedom.
Estimating quantum-state purity and higher-order moments supports Rényi entropy calculations, entanglement and coherence measures, and randomness certification.

The speaker was surprised and grateful when Pat put him back in the lineup after two weeks out. Nervous about returning, he focused on helping the team and credited his teammates for their hard work. He called winning three cups in nine years special and said Pat’s demanding, focused coaching kept the team from becoming complacent.

Ottawa’s coach says the team is better than it has played in its first two games against Anaheim, but must prove it. He cites turnovers, poor positioning, lost faceoffs and too little puck possession as problems, while saying the goaltender has given Ottawa a chance to win.
