He plans to use the fourth line more, adjust the attack and draw energy from the home crowd. Chris Neil has the day off because his wife is having a baby.

An analysis of 2023–24 campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at 100 top-grossing law firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms found that 92.45% went to Democrats, up from a roughly 6-to-1 Democratic-to-Republican ratio in 2017–20. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb had the highest Democratic share at 99.7%, while Nelson Mullins had the lowest at 66.4%.

The passage describes systems and methods for synchronizing a rotating LIDAR sensor with one or more cameras. Camera sensing rows are aligned with the LIDAR’s rotation axis and can be read in a rolling-shutter sequence timed to the LIDAR’s direction and rotation. The resulting image pixels and LIDAR measurements can be matched by capture time and viewing direction, then combined to represent the scanned environment, including as a colored 3D point cloud.

The lecture examines parity, time reversal, and charge conjugation in complex scalar and Dirac theories. Time reversal must be anti-linear and anti-unitary to reverse the sign of \(i\) in the Schrödinger equation. For complex scalar fields, parity and time reversal reverse momentum, while charge conjugation exchanges particles and antiparticles; applying parity twice restricts its phase to \(+1\) or \(-1\).

For Dirac fields, the transformations also act on spinor components through matrices. Parity requires a matrix proportional to \(\gamma^0\), and the lecture describes conditions for charge-conjugation and time-reversal matrices. It then introduces fermionic path integrals using anti-commuting Grassmann variables, whose squares vanish. Functions of one such variable have only constant and linear terms; with the stated integration rules, integrating them gives the linear coefficient.

U.S. stock futures rose Thursday as strong early earnings and rebounding oil prices supported markets. Of 57 S&P 500 companies reporting, 75.4 percent beat expectations, while quarterly profits were estimated to rise 10.8 percent. Tensions between North Korea and the United States and France’s close presidential race tempered investors’ appetite for risk.

Quantbot Technologies increased its Zoe’s Kitchen stake by 114.5% in the second quarter to 17,056 shares, worth about $203,000. Other institutional investors also increased holdings, and a company director bought 3,100 shares in August. Analysts’ consensus rating was “Hold,” with a $17.55 target price. Zoe’s Kitchen reported quarterly earnings of $0.06 per share, above estimates, while revenue of $74.30 million fell short of estimates.

Darren Osborne was sentenced to life in prison with a minimum term of 43 years for driving a van into worshippers near a Finsbury Park mosque in London last June, killing Makram Ali and injuring nine others. He was found guilty of murder and attempted murder. Ali’s family welcomed the verdict.

Several hedge funds reduced healthcare holdings in the second quarter as the sector gained 6.7%, outpacing the S&P 500, while Republican efforts to replace the Affordable Care Act faltered. Jana Partners and Third Point cut healthcare stakes; they and Omega Advisors also sold energy holdings as that sector fell 7%. Hedge funds gained 1% overall. Quarterly filings may not reflect current holdings.

The appellate court affirmed Bradford Washington’s convictions under both indictments. It found his challenges to the detective’s testimony and the jury instruction on consciousness of guilt unpreserved and, in any event, without merit. It also rejected his claim that the prosecutor changed the prosecution’s theory during summation. Washington raised no independent challenge to his conviction on the second indictment.

Facebook is introducing a Trending News section in its iOS and Android apps. Available through Explore, it ranks stories by how many publications share them and lets users view headlines, videos, photos, and related Facebook posts.

The passage describes an electronic cigarette with a coil-less atomizer made from one or more woven fiber tubes. The tubes carry liquid from a supply to an electrically heated section by capillary action, eliminating a separate wick. They may have various shapes, materials, diameters and arrangements. Electrical leads or contacts power the heating section, whose resistance can be controlled by selectively coating other sections. The passage also describes example device configurations and a manufacturing process.

Apple’s August 19, 2022 Form 8-K reports that, on August 17, its Compensation Committee approved an executive cash incentive plan with payouts based on performance goals. The same day, its board adopted amended bylaws addressing board meeting notice, shareholder nominations and proposals, special meetings, proxy cards, and emergency procedures.

A Massachusetts bankruptcy court denied Randall Fincke’s motion to reconsider its finding that an October 2002 Access Cardiosystems business plan falsely stated that patent counsel had advised the company its product did not infringe known patents. The court found that only Joseph Zimmel’s October and November 2002 stock purchases were sold “by means of” that misstatement; it rejected the investors’ claims concerning other investments. It awarded Zimmel $1.5 million plus 6% interest from May 25, 2007, and awarded Access $281,534.62 for Fincke’s fiduciary-duty breaches, plus 12% interest from July 6, 2004. Both awards include costs and postjudgment interest.

The passage argues that *Wall Street* remains a memorable film about finance because it combines Bud Fox’s rise under Gordon Gekko with a vivid portrayal of 1980s excess. It credits Michael Douglas’s Oscar-winning performance with making Gekko an enduring symbol of financial success and greed. The film’s cautionary story and Gekko’s charisma, the author argues, keep it from becoming a simple lecture against money.

The Ohio Supreme Court affirmed the constitutionality of a law requiring one year of state residency before filing for divorce or annulment, with an exception for actions seeking alimony alone. The court held that the requirement did not penalize interstate travel and was the least restrictive way to ensure Ohio’s divorce laws applied only to residents. It retained the case despite the appellant’s later satisfaction of the residency requirement because dismissing it could create jurisdictional problems. A concurring justice agreed on the facts but said different circumstances might warrant re-examination.

The proposed BIRDS workshop aims to connect digital library practitioners, who understand collections and user needs, with researchers who have computational expertise. It seeks to identify practical challenges and foster collaborations on effective access paths and research systems. The planned full-day, in-person program includes a keynote, scientific speed-dating, a panel and breakout discussions on topics such as language models, OCR and interface evaluation. No paper submissions are required. Organisers expect about 25 participants and plan to publish a SIGIR Forum report on the workshop’s discussions and outcomes.

Amazon’s 2016 Form 10-K describes its North America, International, and AWS segments, which serve consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, and content creators. For 2016, net sales rose 27% to $135.99 billion, operating income reached $4.19 billion, and net income was $2.37 billion. AWS generated $12.22 billion in sales and $3.11 billion in operating income; the International segment recorded a $1.28 billion operating loss. Operating cash flow was $16.44 billion, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $26.0 billion at year-end. Amazon employed approximately 341,400 people. The filing highlights risks involving competition, expansion, international operations, fulfillment, security, regulation, taxes, and payments.

A modified Google Camera app enables HDR+ on Android phones with Snapdragon 820, 821 or 835 processors, though results may differ from Pixel photos. Amazon is offering refunds for faulty solar-eclipse glasses. HBO is refusing hackers’ ransom demands despite further leaks, including upcoming *Curb Your Enthusiasm* episodes. Waymo patented technology to soften car bodies before pedestrian collisions, but it remains only a patent.

Tesla’s 2022 Form 10-K describes two business segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. Its products include electric vehicles, Powerwall and Megapack batteries, and solar systems. The filing discusses manufacturing, sales, charging, service, financing, technology and government regulations. It also identifies risks involving supply chains, production expansion, competition, product defects, financing, staffing and cybersecurity. Tesla reported 127,855 full-time employees worldwide as of December 31, 2022.

Evelyn Montiel helped run her family’s East Oakland ice cream business while excelling in high school. She became the first in her family to attend college but dropped out after a difficult start. Students Rising Above helped her transfer to USC and find internships. After graduating during the recession, she returned to the family business until the organization connected her with a finance job interview. She now works as a broker and remains close to her family and its business.

The September 26, 2000 VentureWire reports private-company funding, partnerships, closures, acquisitions and personnel changes. Highlights include $100 million raised by Chiaro Networks, $109 million raised by Novalux, a European joint venture between Bertelsmann and iSyndicate, Miadora’s closure, and Sun Microsystems’ $50 million Asian investment program.

The Simons Observatory uses SMuRF electronics to read out nearly 31,000 detectors on its large-aperture telescope. Its room-temperature RF cables experience daily temperature changes that can cause phase drift resembling detector signals. Measurements of off-resonance tones found temperature-correlated drifts of a few picoseconds over a day-night cycle. An analytical estimate indicates that the resulting noise is within the readout noise budget and is not expected to affect the telescope’s mapping speed.

Molecules in optical cavities require computational methods that account for electron–photon coupling, which is weak but non-local. The sinc basis offers an orthonormal, systematically improvable representation suited to extended interactions. Although direct two-electron integral calculations scale as O(N⁴), rapidly decaying off-diagonal terms may permit sparse or low-rank approximations.

On November 27, 2001, Dynegy confirmed talks to restructure its proposed Enron acquisition amid reports that the price could fall by more than 40%, to about $5 billion. Enron was also seeking new funding and extended debt maturities. Credit concerns had led many energy firms to restrict trading with Enron, while bankers struggled to raise additional financing. Moody’s said Enron’s investment-grade rating would remain unchanged that day. Investors and analysts remained uncertain whether the merger would proceed, and some warned that its collapse could lead to Enron’s bankruptcy.

Retired Justice Anthony Kennedy’s memoir reflects on his approach to judging and several major cases. He emphasizes humility, good faith and clear reasoning, while rejecting originalism and pragmatism as complete guides to constitutional interpretation. He defends his reasoning in cases involving campaign finance, same-sex marriage, a presidential election and flag burning. He also recounts Justice Antonin Scalia apologizing for the personal tone of his dissent from the same-sex marriage ruling shortly before Scalia’s death.

Kennedy says his personal opposition to abortion did not determine his judicial decisions, and he disliked being called a “swing justice.” He argues that presidents should defer to Supreme Court rulings and opposes cameras in the courtroom. The memoir also describes an unsettling meeting with Vladimir Putin, a ransacking of Kennedy’s home that police suspected might relate to a case, and his family’s reaction to their children’s music.

NVIDIA’s fiscal 2017 Form 10-K, for the year ended January 29, 2017, describes two reporting segments—GPU and Tegra Processor—and platforms serving gaming, professional visualization, datacenter and automotive markets. The company uses third parties to manufacture, assemble and test its products. It reported 10,299 employees, including 7,282 in research and development, and $6.80 billion in cash and marketable securities at year-end. Its risk disclosures address competition, reliance on suppliers and major customers, product defects, cybersecurity and international operations. NVIDIA paid $261 million in dividends during fiscal 2017 and reported $2.73 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization.

The DAWN-plasma trial compared standard care alone with standard care plus four units of high-antibody-titer convalescent plasma in adults hospitalized with COVID-19. The open-label, multicenter trial randomized 320 patients to plasma and 163 to control. On day 15, the proportion alive without mechanical ventilation was similar in both groups (83.7% versus 84.1%). No statistically significant differences were found in secondary outcomes, including mortality, or in serious adverse events. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 19 plasma recipients (6.0%); no TRALI cases were reported.

Using 2009–2020 nationally representative survey data from 32,498 US adults, researchers identified four dietary patterns: American, Prudent, Legume, and Fruit/Whole Grain/Dairy. The American pattern was the most common and had the lowest diet-quality score. It was more prevalent among adults with cardiovascular disease, more social risk factors, and SNAP participation. Greater socioeconomic vulnerability was also associated with more alignment with the Legume pattern and less with the Prudent and Fruit/Whole Grain/Dairy patterns. Associations varied somewhat by race and ethnicity. The study’s cross-sectional design limits causal conclusions.
Microsoft reported that co-founder Bill Gates resigned from its board of directors effective March 13, 2020. The Form 8-K includes a press release announcing his plans.
A study finds that biased online images shape AI chatbots’ perceptions of women as younger and less experienced than men.

Wham is a run play in which a tight end or fullback kicks out a defensive lineman instead of a guard. It can create quick, unexpected running angles, but requires careful coordination and a sufficiently powerful blocker. Against both 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, the fullback identifies and kicks out a lineman while the tailback runs behind the block. Variations include an RPO that blocks the nose tackle and a shotgun play that uses a pulling guard to influence a defender.

A cross-sectional study of 148 members of 30 households with an HCV-positive patient in Rwanda’s Huye district found 16 participants (10.8%) positive on rapid testing and ELISA confirmation. Unprotected sex and histories of HIV or HBV were significantly associated with positive results; blood transfusion and awareness were not. Only 9 participants (6.1%) answered HCV transmission questions correctly. The authors recommend household screening, education and patient follow-up, while noting that the study cannot establish where infections originated.

The June 4, 2001, State Bar of Michigan e-Journal summarizes Michigan and Sixth Circuit decisions involving securities fraud, civil rights, contracts, criminal law, employment, family law, litigation, and torts. It also includes fields-of-practice listings, classified advertisements, and links to editorial content, news, bar events, and archived issues.

President Donald Trump nominated Travis Hill to chair the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, pending Senate confirmation. Hill, a former senior Treasury adviser, would oversee deposit insurance and bank assessments as lenders face tighter credit conditions and concerns about smaller banks.

Santa Barbara County sheriff’s detectives are investigating a Tuesday morning robbery at the Summerland Antique Collective. A man bound two employees with duct tape, stole cash and merchandise, and fled. A customer found the employees about 20 minutes later; neither appeared seriously injured.

Iqaluit-Tasiluk MLA George Hickes says some Nunavut public servants have been discouraged by senior managers from speaking to their MLAs, reviving a concern he raised in 2014. He urged employees to bring forward concerns without fear of repercussions, especially when complaint processes fail. Minister David Akeeagok said no law or directive bars such contact and that employees have protections under the Public Service Act. Hickes said constituent feedback is essential to MLAs’ work.

The Chamber of Mines of Namibia will hold the Mining Expo & Conference on April 25–26 at the Windhoek Show Grounds, under a theme focused on increasing mining’s economic impact. Nedbank Namibia’s Corporate and Investment Banking team will present its mining-finance services and host a networking lounge. Investment banker Dominic Shikola said the team provides funding solutions for mining projects and will discuss investment opportunities. He said mining contributes about 11 percent of Namibia’s GDP.

The speaker praises a skilled player’s composure under pressure and his important playoff goals. The team aims to pressure opponents’ defense, believing it will pay off as the series continues. Despite overcoming deficits as an eighth seed, it remains focused on one game at a time. Defensive adjustments and stronger five-on-five play have built confidence, but the team is not claiming control of the series.

The passage introduces Construction Defining Functionality (CDF), a framework that relates a function’s syntactic rules, semantic interpretations, and logical outcomes through three mappings. It classifies structures by whether those mappings remain stable and compositionally coherent or exhibit semantic explosion. The passage uses 2SAT and 3SAT to illustrate the distinction: it describes 2SAT as supporting local, implication-based reasoning and 3SAT as involving non-local clause interactions. It argues that 3SAT’s syntax causes exponential semantic growth and computational intractability.

An October 18, 2001 Commissioner.COM fantasy football report lists NFL player news, injury updates, and roster advice. For Luccis Losers, it reports that Charlie Garner has apparently overtaken injured Tyrone Wheatley as Oakland’s lead back, while Duce Staley is expected to start but split carries. The email also includes sports promotions.

The speaker says an offensive-zone faceoff turnover led to a penalty and a power-play goal that shifted the game. Both teams played sloppily, and his team missed chances to score first and sustain its momentum. He describes the fights and physical play as part of playoff hockey, stresses faceoffs and puck possession, and says the team must respond in the next game. He also discusses lineup chemistry and the flexibility of using seven defensemen.

European shares rose on Wednesday despite Britain formally beginning Brexit proceedings. The STOXX 600 gained 0.4 percent to its highest close in nearly 16 months, while Germany’s blue-chip index also rose 0.4 percent. Daimler gained on expectations of record first-quarter Mercedes-Benz sales. Shares in London Stock Exchange and Deutsche Boerse rose after EU regulators blocked their proposed merger. Banks underperformed the broader market. Engie and 3I Group gained following analyst upgrades, while Scout24 fell on disappointing results and its outlook. Aurelius slumped more than 35 percent as investors remained unconvinced by its response to a short-seller’s report.

Expired patents have helped make desktop 3D printers inexpensive, while industrial systems remain costly because they serve demanding applications. Scott Crump’s 1992 patent underlies FDM-like desktop printers and Stratasys industrial machines. Other methods include stereolithography and powder bed fusion, which is used to produce metal parts. Industrial additive manufacturing uses a wide range of materials and can produce large parts or high quantities without molds. NASA uses metal printing for propulsion components, while GE uses it to make lighter, longer-lasting engine parts and reduce part counts. The annual Wohlers Report surveys the industry, including equipment, software, and materials.

Paulo Dybala has resumed training and expects to play against Barcelona in the Champions League quarter-final return leg. He scored twice in the first leg and chose to renew his Juventus contract until 2022.

An open-label randomized trial in Cambodia compared 14-day primaquine regimens for preventing *Plasmodium vivax* recurrence. After artesunate treatment, G6PD-normal patients received 3·5 mg/kg, 7·0 mg/kg, or no primaquine; G6PD-deficient patients received no primaquine. Patients stayed in a malaria transmission-free town during 90 days of follow-up. Recurrence occurred in 24·4% of the low-dose group, 4·7% of the high-dose group, and 81·4% of the no-primaquine group. Both primaquine regimens were well tolerated in G6PD-normal patients. The authors recommend the 7·0 mg/kg regimen for infections acquired in Cambodia, while noting the study’s small sample size and single-centre design.

Sebi will allow debt issuers to request reviews of ratings, with each request considered by a credit rating agency committee whose members are mostly independent. Agencies must disclose ratings that issuers do not accept on their websites for 12 months and publish half-yearly summaries of rating actions within 15 days of each period’s end.

Melinda Rosetti-Spence was sentenced to 10 years in prison for embezzling about $266,600 from Mississippi cancer charity Pink Hearts Fund while serving as its volunteer treasurer. She pleaded guilty to writing 132 checks to herself in 2016. A judge ordered her to repay about $181,000; her family is paying the balance.

At the UN Climate Summit, Xi Jinping pledged to cut China’s greenhouse gas emissions by 7 to 10 percent by 2035, expand wind and solar capacity to 3,600 gigawatts, increase renewables’ share of the energy mix, and make electric vehicles mainstream. China invested $625 billion in clean energy last year, nearly a third of the global total, and its large-scale adoption of renewable technologies has helped lower prices. The passage notes that its promised emissions cuts are slower than those achieved by several industrialized countries.

The U.S. has frozen about $18 billion for New York City infrastructure projects, including the Second Avenue Subway extension and Hudson River Tunnel, while it reviews whether contracts used unlawful diversity criteria. A $300 million payment has already been suspended. Local leaders warn that the freeze could delay construction, threaten jobs and raise costs. Funding could resume if the projects are cleared, but violations could require renegotiation or lead to lost funds.
LG plans to release webOS TVs later this month. LG says Sky’s TV guide will be compatible at launch, letting users browse Sky content through webOS and control viewing with the LG remote.

English councils will receive refunds after a Ministry of Justice error caused them to be overcharged £2.50 per council tax liability order application since 2013-14. The overcharges totalled about £9m a year. The ministry said it would reduce the fees and announce a refund scheme soon.
STAT’s personnel update reports that enGene hired Hussein Sweiti as chief medical officer. He previously served as global medical head of oncology clinical development at Johnson & Johnson.

The Council of Regional Accrediting Commissions is encouraging colleges to use AI to improve transfer-credit evaluations, saying accreditation standards do not prevent its use. Manual evaluations can be slow and inconsistent, contributing to lost credits, repeated courses and delayed completion. A 2024 survey found that 58 percent of adults who tried to transfer credits lost some. AI could identify more course equivalencies, give students faster information and reduce administrative work. A 59-institution pilot is testing that approach. The council recommends applying credits toward degree completion unless required learning outcomes are not met. Experts caution that AI’s reliability at scale needs scrutiny and say it should support, not replace, human decisions.

A 2,100-year-old chalk bowl fragment engraved with the Hebrew name “Hyrcanus” was found in 2015 beneath Jerusalem’s Givati parking lot, near an ancient ritual bath and the remains of the Akra fortress. Although two Hasmonean kings bore the name, it was also common at the time, so researchers cannot determine who owned the bowl.

At Apple’s March 1, 2019 annual shareholder meeting, eight directors were elected. Shareholders ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the 2019 auditor and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. Proposals on proxy access amendments and a board diversity policy were rejected.

Bollinger Bands use a moving average and upper and lower bands to track price volatility. Widening bands indicate higher volatility; narrowing bands, or a “squeeze,” may precede a breakout. Traders use band touches, breakouts and measures such as %B to assess potential trends and overbought or oversold conditions. The passage describes several strategies but warns that signals can be delayed or false and recommends confirmation and risk management. Its reported tests found some promise in gold, mixed results in stocks and no useful strategy for stock indices.

The passage examines holiday-related trading patterns in the S&P 500. Its backtests find the strongest pre-holiday results around Independence Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, while other holidays show weaker or absent effects. It describes these gains as small and not guaranteed. Post-holiday tests found little benefit from holding over a holiday but better returns on the second trading day afterward. A strategy using an additional, undisclosed variable also showed positive historical results.

Cryotherapy exposes people to temperatures as low as 180 degrees below zero for three minutes. Enthusiasts claim it aids recovery, pain and mood, but the passage cites limited scientific support. The FDA has not approved it and warns of frostbite, burns and eye injuries. At Michigan facility Polar Brrr, staff supervise sessions, participants can stop at any time, and people with heart problems or hypertension must consult a doctor first.

The passage collects reports on Alexa and home speakers: Amazon is developing an AI chip for Alexa, its Alexa Super Bowl ad led YouTube views that Sunday, and it announced Alexa integration with a talking fish. It also mentions speaker discounts, Echo Dot holiday sales, a delayed Apple speaker, CES products, and an Alexa device playing music while its owner was away.

Scottish councils can raise basic council tax rates by up to 3% as the long-running freeze ends. Bills for properties in bands E to H will rise regardless of local decisions because of changes to how those bands are calculated. This affects nearly 700,000 homes, or 26% of households, and is expected to raise £100m annually for local spending.

The impact varies by area: 56% of East Renfrewshire homes are in the affected bands, compared with 18% in East Ayrshire. Council tax bands are based on 1991 property values, and one analysis suggested 57% of properties would change band if revalued. Councils also face disputed government funding plans, including an additional £160m agreed during budget negotiations.

A report by Lucas Chancel and Thomas Piketty says India’s income inequality has risen sharply since the 1980s. The top 1% now receives 22% of national income, its highest share since income tax began in 1922, up from 6% in the early 1980s. The paper links the reversal of earlier declines in inequality to pro-business policies and says recent growth has disproportionately benefited the top 10%.

Russia is increasingly targeting Ukrainian drone pilots with missiles, bombs and other weapons, according to Ukrainian soldiers and operators, who say pilot casualties have risen sharply. Drones’ roles in strikes, reconnaissance and targeting make their operators valuable. Ukrainian forces also target Russian pilots, while their own operators use stronger shelters, deeper positions and frequent moves for protection.

The passage recommends six to eight glasses (1.2 liters) of water daily, noting that food provides some water. Drinking too much too quickly can rarely cause dangerous water intoxication; one researcher advises drinking according to thirst. In a 12-week study, participants who drank water before meals lost more weight on average than those who did not.

A collection of October 2001 reports describes Enron’s falling shares and bonds after investment losses and disclosures about partnerships run by its former finance chief prompted an SEC inquiry. Moody’s downgraded Enron’s debt, and the company sought new bank credit after drawing on existing lines. U.S. trading partners reported largely normal dealings, while some European firms paused trading over credit concerns. Other articles discuss broader corporate credit deterioration, power producers, and Enron’s impact on Houston.

AMD’s specification defines the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) so SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests can communicate selectively with hypervisors while limiting exposure of encrypted guest register state. It specifies GHCB layout, protocol negotiation, feature advertisement, guest exits, page-state changes, SNP guest requests, AP booting, interrupt handling, and restricted injection. SEV-SNP guests must register a shared GHCB page before using it for VMGEXIT. The agreement limits use of the specification to product planning, design, and feedback; retains AMD’s rights; provides the specification “as is”; and requires compliance with export laws.

The passage presents Doublethink, a Bayesian model-averaging method for testing whether variables or groups of variables have direct effects on an outcome while accounting for uncertainty about which other variables belong in the model. Under its assumptions, it links posterior odds to adjusted p-values and controls both the Bayesian false discovery rate and the frequentist familywise error rate.

Applied to 1,912 variables in UK Biobank, it identified individual and grouped signals associated with COVID-19 hospitalization. Grouping correlated variables recovered signals for age, sex, deprivation and obesity that were weaker for individual measures. Compared with 127 published studies, the analysis supported some commonly studied risk-factor categories but found no significant direct-effect evidence for diabetes, cardiovascular disease or hypertension; it also highlighted categories less often studied.

The authors caution that direct effects do not establish total or indirect effects. Results also depend on measured variables, data preparation, prior choices and large-sample approximations, while computation was intensive.

Teams should prepare for defensive, even, and offensive jump balls according to their likelihood of controlling the tip. On defensive jumps, players prioritize preventing an easy basket, anticipate the tip, deny passes, rotate, and box out; alignments can leave one or two defenders back. On even jumps, players seek inside position and use coordinated rotations. With a clear advantage, teams can use set plays to direct the tip toward a teammate and create a scoring chance, while maintaining defensive balance. If no good shot develops, they move into their regular offense.

The passage traces how reusable algorithms, object-oriented design patterns, and open source software shaped software development. It presents distributed-system patterns as technology-independent blueprints that help developers learn from others, use a shared vocabulary, and build reusable components.

For containers on one machine, sidecars add functionality, ambassadors broker external connections, and adapters provide consistent interfaces. The passage then describes multi-node systems, including replicated services that use load balancing for availability and scale. Caching can improve their capacity and response times, while readiness checks keep unprepared instances from serving requests. Sharded services divide data among machines when one cannot hold it all. Sharded caches use memory more efficiently than replicated caches, but losing a shard can affect performance; replicating each shard can improve resilience.

A U.S. official told Mr. Toivola that an alleged Finnish Legation statement blaming Soviet-Finnish peace rumors on “Anglo-American machinations” would, if genuine, be a mistake; he said the U.S. government had no role in the rumors. The Finnish Minister sought clarification on whether U.S. travel restrictions applied to American citizens working with Finnish diplomatic offices, noting that Finland’s travel rules generally applied equally to foreign diplomats. The British Embassy reported that a Soviet representative had discreetly offered to contact Finland about peace, suggesting better terms might be available now than later. A U.S. memorandum discussed British and American support for a firmer stance toward Finland’s current policy.

Research and Markets forecasts that global industrial hybrid stepper motor revenue will exceed $1 billion by 2022. The report cites demand for automated industrial equipment and a trend toward miniaturized motors, while identifying competition from servo and conventional stepper motors as a challenge.

The speaker celebrates winning the Stanley Cup, crediting Fleury’s saves, Malkin’s Conn Smythe performance and teammates’ sacrifices more than his own two goals. He says the team wanted to win for injured captain Sidney Crosby, whom he calls the heart and soul of the Penguins. He also praises Fleury as a winning goaltender and credits Mario with keeping the team in Pittsburgh.

Merck CEO Ken Frazier resigned from President Trump’s American Manufacturing Council, saying he was taking a stand against intolerance and extremism after the white supremacist rally in Charlottesville. Trump responded by criticizing Merck’s drug prices. His earlier, vague condemnation of “hate” had drawn backlash for not specifically denouncing white nationalism.

At the opening of the public inquiry into the Grenfell Tower fire, relatives and survivors paid tribute to the 72 victims and called for answers. Ahmed Elgwahry described speaking by phone with his mother and sister as they died. Others questioned fire-safety decisions, including instructions to remain in their apartments. The inquiry will examine what led to the fire and recommend ways to prevent similar tragedies.

Taylor Wimpey and Connect Group both have forecast dividend yields of 7.1%. The passage argues that Taylor Wimpey’s payout is affordable, supported by cash generation and housing demand, though special dividends may not last indefinitely. Connect’s payout is also covered by cash flow, but its debt and negative net tangible asset value raise concerns that a trading slowdown or tighter lending could put the dividend at risk.

A 2017 survey of 462 people found broad satisfaction with Regina Police Service: 79 per cent rated its service very good to excellent. Nearly 25 per cent felt it was insensitive to their ethnic group, particularly Indigenous respondents. Police planned reconciliation training in response.

Researchers compared surgically excised nerves from 22 people with Morton’s neuroma with 11 control nerves using RNA sequencing and tissue staining. They identified 3,349 differentially expressed genes, including increased immune-response and decreased nervous-system-development signatures. Neuroma samples showed demyelination and higher densities of intraneural T cells and CD163+MARCO+ macrophages. Estimated macrophage proportions and expression of the macrophage-associated gene MARCO correlated with paroxysmal pain, while stained CD68+ macrophage density correlated with burning pain. The findings associate persistent neuroinflammation with chronic neuropathic pain in Morton’s neuroma. Limitations include varied control-nerve locations, unequal sex distributions and a small sample.

Baseline out-of-bounds plays give the defense a five-on-four advantage but require different positioning from ordinary half-court defense because the ball starts behind the basket and cutters move toward it. The passage presents four approaches: jam opponents without switching, jump-switch to deny passing lanes, trap the inbound pass, and use combination defenses such as box-and-one, diamond-and-one, or triangle-and-two. Each begins by protecting the basket against quick cuts or lobs; defenders then pressure the inbounder and adjust after the pass.

Diffusion models and flow matching are presented as special cases of learning stochastic dynamics between distributions. The Schrödinger bridge problem seeks a stochastic process connecting two distributions while remaining close to a reference process; iterative proportional fitting (IPF) solves it through alternating updates. Existing IPF methods require samples from both distributions. The authors propose IPF methods for cases where one or both distributions are specified by queryable, unnormalised energy functions. They report low-cost bridges on synthetic examples comparable to sample-based IPF, an improvement from learning diffusion coefficients alongside drift, and an application to data-free image-to-image translation.

Overnight trading involves buying at the close and selling at the next day’s open or close. The passage describes SPY backtests since 1993 of one-day strategies based on seasonal patterns, weekdays, mean reversion and options expiration. It argues that combining strategies with limited overlap can improve risk-adjusted returns and reduce drawdowns. Diversifying across asset classes, time frames and strategy types may help, although constructing an uncorrelated portfolio is difficult. The authors caution that backtests are approximations and that trading at the close can be cumbersome.

SpaceX is scheduled to launch an unmanned Dragon spacecraft from Kennedy Space Center at 12:31 p.m. ET, carrying about 6,400 pounds of supplies to the International Space Station. The rocket’s first stage is expected to return for reuse. This will be NASA’s last resupply mission using a brand-new Dragon craft.

This collection of May 26–27, 2001 news reports focuses on Enron and energy policy. Kenneth Lay promoted further deregulation as a solution to California’s power crisis at a private meeting with prominent Californians, while Senator Dianne Feinstein sought hearings into possible improper influence on federal energy regulators. Reports also describe Californians conserving electricity, a worsening payment and contract dispute between Enron’s Dabhol project and an Indian utility, and Enron’s participation in a Saudi gas venture. A change in Senate control could improve prospects for temporary wholesale electricity price limits in the West.

The coach described a one-goal hockey game decided by an early goal, questioned a five-minute penalty, and said his team missed key scoring chances. He emphasized skating speed over physical play, improving matchups at home, and maintaining the team’s style. He also said the team had recovered from earlier playoff losses and would make roster decisions within its financial limits.

The speaker credits the team’s progress to mutual support, defensive depth and learning from experienced players such as Ray Bourque. Against New Jersey’s forwards, he emphasizes respecting their strengths, limiting their space and maintaining position rather than chasing big hits. He says reaching the finals took determination amid pressure and feels especially meaningful after a long absence. Despite that excitement, the team must focus on how to play and keep things simple.

Syrian opposition spokesman Salim al-Muslit said the HNC wants direct negotiations in Geneva on a political transition, with no role for President Assad. The HNC has named a 22-member delegation but has not received an agenda for the talks, due to begin February 23.

A Northern California jury convicted Gonzalo Curiel of killing two young siblings in 2015 and torturing their older sister. The sister testified about the abuse. Curiel, who was a minor at the time, was tried as an adult. His former girlfriend, Tami Huntsman, pleaded guilty to murder. Both were scheduled for sentencing the following week.

Dr. Pasvolsky said “peace-loving states” was chosen as a membership criterion to emphasize the organization’s purpose. Under the Dumbarton Oaks proposal, the Security Council would recommend new members, while the Assembly would decide whether to admit them. Mexico’s ambassador called for an organization built around cooperation and lasting peace, while acknowledging that admission was complicated. Pasvolsky explained that Chapter IV identified principal organs: the Security Council for peace and security, the Assembly for conditions conducive to peace, and the International Court of Justice for legal issues. Discussion of Chapter V covered the number of national delegates and the Assembly’s powers. Pasvolsky said the Assembly could discuss peace and security and make recommendations, but the continuously sitting Security Council would have primary responsibility for action.

Small-sided soccer games use fewer than 11 players per team on smaller fields, giving players more touches and involvement. In practice, they develop tactical and technical skills through fast-paced games tailored to players’ ages. In youth competition, U.S. Soccer’s standards apply from U6 through U12 and vary team sizes, equipment, game times and rules by age. Starting at U9, build-out lines affect restarts and offside calls; offside does not apply before U9. The standards also ban headers, punts and goalkeeper drop kicks.

The passage describes metal-assisted delayed fluorescent emitters based on platinum(II), palladium(II), and iridium(III) complexes containing benzo-imidazo-phenanthridine or related structures. It explains how a small singlet–triplet energy gap enables delayed fluorescence alongside phosphorescence and proposes the compounds for OLED displays and lighting. It also provides device configurations, synthesis examples, and emission measurements for selected compounds.

The passage describes analyte monitoring systems that place a sensor beneath the skin to measure substances such as glucose. Conventional systems may require separate sterilization of the sensor and electronics because radiation can damage electronics, while gaseous chemicals can damage sensor chemistry. The disclosed one-piece designs use internal or external collimators to direct sterilizing radiation toward the sensor and insertion sharp while shielding sensitive electronics. Seals can preserve a sterile region around the sensor and sharp, allowing delivery in a single package without final user assembly.

On March 3, 2015, Tesla Motors’ board amended its 2010 Equity Incentive Plan to prohibit repricing equity awards and changed its bylaws to require majority voting in uncontested director elections, while retaining plurality voting for contested elections. Neither amendment required stockholder approval.

The writer describes a pregnant, suicidal girl who was detained after seeking an abortion and later released following a second psychiatric assessment. Drawing on her grandmother’s psychiatric treatment and her own depression diagnosis, the writer questions how mental illness is defined and treated. She argues that psychiatric interventions can help but that their limitations and uncertainties deserve greater public attention.

Ann Schmidt circulated a collection of November 2000 news articles mentioning Enron. They cover the growing weather-risk market, including Enron’s planned European trading sites; a shareholder lawsuit challenging Enron’s proposed $7-per-share Azurix buyout; and California generators’ mixed response to proposed federal electricity-market reforms. Enron said uncertainty had led it to reconsider planned California generation capacity. Other articles report a train derailment that reduced flows through Enron’s Transwestern gas pipeline, natural-gas price movements, Enron’s place among C.I. Global Fund holdings, and a Houston arena referendum debate.

Amazon elected Andrew R. Jassy to its board effective July 5, 2021, when he becomes president and CEO. The company approved a 61,000-share restricted stock unit award vesting over ten years, security arrangements, and an indemnification agreement. Jassy joined Amazon in 1997 and has led Amazon Web Services since its inception.

Brewers outfielder Jackson Chourio left Saturday’s NL Division Series opener after moving awkwardly while beating out an RBI single. He had three hits in the first two innings, including a two-run single during Milwaukee’s six-run first inning. The Brewers won 9-3 over the Cubs. Chourio underwent an MRI for a hamstring injury, and manager Pat Murphy said the team did not yet know when it would have an update.

The passage presents a theoretical study of magnetic systems coupled to an optical cavity. When cavity photons couple directly to a quantum-critical spin mode, the coupling needed for a superradiant phase transition vanishes at the matter’s quantum critical point. The resulting state shows stronger intrinsic squeezing and light–matter entanglement than the Dicke model. Large-spin calculations and one-dimensional numerical simulations support this phase behavior. Coupling to a non-critical mode instead produces competing magnetic and superradiant orders and a tricritical point. An XY-model analysis further examines the effect, and the authors identify magnetic materials that could be used to test the proposal.

The passage describes a reconfigurable power station designed to extend the operating range of unmanned aerial vehicles by autonomously exchanging depleted swap cartridges for energized ones. It uses communications and landing-zone markers to guide compatible vehicles to land, then secures them while a mechanism transfers cartridges between the vehicle and modular power bays. The station can store and replenish different cartridge types, supply power to a landed vehicle, exchange data, and monitor system and environmental conditions. The described approach may also apply to other unmanned vehicles.

The Inquiry is compiling newspaper analyses, biographical profiles, treaty obligations, nationality briefs, and charts of international organization plans and events. By mid-January, it expects material on Central Powers newspapers, Poland, and five priority regions. By February 1, it expects biographical and nationality briefs and geographic studies. The regional materials will cover history, political participation, restrictions on subject populations, government structures, and maps and analyses of terrain, transport, climate, minerals, agriculture, and forests.

The lecture constructs a succinct non-interactive argument (SNARG) from batch arguments (BARGs) and somewhere-extractable hashes. BARGs provide short proofs for many statements with semi-adaptive soundness: a cheating prover may choose statements after seeing the common reference string but must fix the location of a false statement beforehand. Somewhere-extractable hashes hide a designated index and statistically prevent conflicting openings there; repetition extends this to multiple locations. The professor also explains why a proposed homomorphic-encryption construction needs decryption at each layer to handle malformed ciphertexts.

In the SNARG construction, the prover hashes the values of a verification circuit’s wires and supplies a BARG showing that every gate is consistent and the output is 1. The verifier checks the BARG. Succinctly described gate statements keep verification from scaling with circuit size; soundness analysis is deferred until after the break.

JM Smucker sued Trader Joe’s, alleging its frozen crustless peanut butter and jelly sandwiches copy Uncrustables’ trademarked crimped edge and packaging color, causing consumer confusion. Smucker seeks the disposal of Trader Joe’s sandwiches and marketing materials and payment of profits from their sales. Trader Joe’s did not respond to a request for comment.

Opposition legislators walked out of the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly over alleged attacks on Kashmiri students outside the state, accusing the government of failing to prevent them. The government said Haryana police had registered a case and arrested three people after two students were attacked there. Opposition members also questioned an all-party meeting on panchayat elections, while the government said its outcome would be considered by the cabinet. BJP legislators called for recognition of the Army’s sacrifice and rescue work in north Kashmir.

Orbitronics uses orbital angular momentum generated by effects including the orbital Hall and orbital Rashba-Edelstein effects. Experiments study it through magnetic torques, magnetoresistance, orbital pumping and direct imaging. Orbital angular momentum must generally be converted to spin angular momentum to exert torque on conventional magnets, and conversion efficiency depends strongly on the materials used.

Experiments have reported long-range orbital transport and substantial torques, but the contributions of generation, transport, conversion and interfaces remain difficult to separate. Long orbital relaxation lengths also remain theoretically unresolved, with conflicting calculations.

Orbital torque could provide an alternative write mechanism for magnetic memory using relatively low-resistance light metals. Practical devices still need stronger torque, compatibility with high tunneling magnetoresistance and thinner material layers. Other potential applications include THz emitters and computing devices.
Boddie’s habeas corpus application was denied; five judges concurred.

A November 2001 collection of articles focuses on Enron’s financial crisis and proposed acquisition by Dynegy. Investors awaited an Enron filing for details of its debts, while trading partners limited their exposure and analysts warned that regulatory review of the deal could be lengthy. Enron was seeking buyers for Wessex Water and its stake in India’s Dabhol power project. Other articles examine the repayment risks of zero-coupon convertible bonds, a corporate bond boom driven largely by refinancing, and investment-fund performance.

Former Cubs pitcher Ryan Dempster says Kyle Hendricks’ success feels personally gratifying. The Cubs acquired Hendricks from Texas in a 2012 trade for Dempster, who had rejected a proposed trade to Atlanta. Hendricks later started the Cubs’ Game 7 World Series victory and was set to start Game 1 of their playoff series against the Nationals.

American detainee Christian Beasley escaped from Bali’s overcrowded Kerobokan prison Monday, apparently by cutting through a ceiling and climbing over a wall. Another American inmate was caught trying to escape. Officials are investigating possible guard involvement at the understaffed prison, which holds nearly 1,600 inmates despite being built for about 300.

Jason Ku surveys representational origami, contrasting traditional designs built from precise creases with works that rely more heavily on shaping and wet-folding. He describes Akira Yoshizawa’s influence and highlights designers whose work combines artistic expression, complex structures, texture, and mathematical planning.

Ku then explains tree theory: a designer reduces a subject to connected flaps of chosen lengths, allocates space for them on a sheet, folds a base, and shapes the result. Circles and constant-width “rivers” represent flaps and the distances between them; different arrangements can produce the same tree. He examines a complex dragon’s crease pattern and demonstrates both TreeMaker and a hand-designed crab to show how structural constraints and artistic choices interact.

The coach says his team has stayed with its game plan through two losses to Detroit and has generally refocused quickly after frustrating moments. Although he believes his team has generated chances and outshot Detroit, Detroit has won more loose pucks and scored more goals around the net. He says every line must improve its net-front play, protect its own goalie and keep creating chances against strong defense and goaltending. Returning home may allow different matchups for Sidney Crosby. He praised Pascal’s speed and puck pursuit, and said the team has discussed maintaining composure with Geno and other emotional players. His focus remains on execution rather than referees, bounces or previous results.

HHH defended excluding women from the Greatest Royal Rumble, saying WWE must respect cultural differences while remaining engaged to help bring change. He cited a women’s match in Abu Dhabi as an example and said WWE hopes women will compete at a future event in Saudi Arabia.

The World Health Organization reported 503,484 suspected cases and 1,975 deaths in Yemen’s waterborne disease outbreak since late April. Although its spread has slowed, about 5,000 people are still affected daily. War-damaged infrastructure, poor sanitation and limited healthcare have worsened the crisis, and WHO called for a political solution.

In an April 26, 1879 proclamation, President Rutherford B. Hayes warned people not to enter or settle in Indian Territory west of Arkansas without permission. He said unauthorized occupants would be removed under federal law, with military assistance if necessary.

The speaker credits an overtime goal that tied the Stanley Cup Finals series to his teammates’ effort and a fortunate rebound. He says the team raised its level after disappointing performances in the first two games and drew inspiration from goaltender Jiggy’s leadership. Traded from Chicago to Anaheim, he values the chance to play meaningful minutes with supportive teammates and a coach who believes in him. He credits his family for support and says the team must bring its best game to New Jersey.

The Second Circuit held that Red Star could not limit its liability after its tug pushed an oil-laden barge onto a charted rock in the Hudson River. Red Star’s failure to designate a captain, account for a pilot’s unfamiliarity with the river, and require a lookout amounted to negligence within its knowledge and willful misconduct under the pollution statute. The court ordered judgment for Pittston and the United States for their damages, affirmed dismissal of claims against the United States, and remanded.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 GPU architecture and its support for HPC and AI workloads. A100 has 40 GB of HBM2 memory delivering 1,555 GB/s of bandwidth, a 40 MB L2 cache, third-generation Tensor Cores, and memory protected by error-correcting code. Its memory, compression, asynchronous copy, barriers, and cache controls are designed to improve data movement and compute efficiency.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink provides up to 600 GB/s of total bandwidth per GPU, while PCIe Gen 4 supports 31.5 GB/s per direction on x16 connections. The passage also covers hardware JPEG and video decoding, optical-flow acceleration, CUDA 11 features, and structured sparsity.

DGX A100 combines eight A100 GPUs in a system specified to deliver up to 5 PFLOPS of AI performance.

Tooth-bleaching products range from over-the-counter strips to dentist-supervised treatments. The FDA does not require premarket approval for these cosmetic products, while the ADA’s seal indicates independent review of safety and effectiveness. Over-the-counter products can work as directed but may cause temporary sensitivity or gum inflammation. Custom trays from a dentist cost about $400; faster, more dramatic in-office bleaching can exceed $1,000 and is rarely covered by insurance. Dentists recommend a checkup first because discoloration can signal oral problems. Cleaning may reduce surface stains, while bleaching can lighten deeper stains; some permanent discoloration requires a crown or veneer. All bleaching results need eventual touch-ups, and the ADA says there is no evidence that popular “natural whitening” remedies work.

A December 13, 2000 email circulated news reports mentioning Enron. Colombia set a June 30 deadline for selling power generator ISAGEN after legal challenges delayed the privatization; Enron had been named among potential bidders earlier in the year. Enron chairman and chief executive Kenneth Lay said he would not take a job in a Bush administration. The email also included Dow Jones updates on markets, companies and economic policy.

AMD disclaims warranties and liability for this publication and its products, grants no intellectual property license, and may change specifications without notice. Its products are not intended for life-support or other applications where failure could cause serious harm.

The FDA indicated it would approve Epidiolex, a purified CBD medicine, for seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut and Dravet syndromes in patients aged 2 and older. Three studies found it effective, with risks the FDA considered acceptable for these severe conditions. Unlike widely sold CBD products whose claims often lack evidence, Epidiolex has undergone testing and would be manufactured to consistent standards. It contains no THC.

The Single/Double basketball offense uses a double baseline screen and a single down screen to free a shooter, who can choose either route while another player moves opposite. Players counter defensive reactions with curls, fades, back cuts, slips, drives, and post or wing mismatches. If the initial screens do not produce a shot, the offense can continue through motion, side screens, or drive-and-kick actions. The passage also emphasizes offensive rebounding, coordinated screen execution, defensive recognition, practice, and adjustments to opponents.

After a sleepover near Milwaukee, 12-year-old Payton Leutner crawled out of the woods with 19 stab wounds. Surgeons saved her life. Police found her missing friends, Morgan Geyser and Anissa Weier, walking near Interstate 94 with a knife in one girl’s bag. During questioning, they described a months-long plan to kill Payton, saying they wanted to become “proxies” for Slender Man, a fictional horror character. At the hospital, Payton wrote to ask whether police had caught them.

The passage argues that the HTC-made Pixel 2 and LG-made Pixel 2 XL feel less consistent in design and build than last year’s Pixels, despite having mostly similar specifications. The smaller phone has larger bezels, sharper edges and louder but tinnier speakers; the writer finds the XL’s curved edges and overall build more polished. The writer says these differences are difficult to discern from Google’s marketing and considers them a setback for its “Made by Google” design vision.

The passage describes ultrasonic fingerprint sensors placed beneath displays, including OLED displays. The sensors transmit waves through the display and use reflections from fingerprint ridges and valleys to form images. Proposed designs use acoustically transmissive light-blocking, electrical-shielding, adhesive and stress-isolation layers to protect display performance and support sensor removal or replacement. Flexible substrates, acoustic-impedance layers and foam or air backing are also described, along with manufacturing methods and sensor configurations.

The passage proposes a planar, two-frequency Paul trap that confines Ca ions and electrons in the same space. Laser-cooled Ca+ ions would be photoionized to produce electrons whose states range from ion-bound to trap-bound, allowing optical investigation of their transitions and coupling. The design aims to align the ion and electron trapping fields without relying on a magnetic field. It also addresses electrode geometry, field symmetry and heating, while noting constraints on ion trapping strength and preparation of specific electron states.

OHL and Acciona announced dividends of €0.349 and €3 per share, respectively. Gas Natural abandoned its northern Italian LNG project. An unverified report says Thailand’s Minor is the sole bidder for HNA’s NH Hotel stake. Dogi may change its name, while Parques Reunidos reported a narrower first-half loss.

On April 30, 2018, a California court preliminarily approved a settlement in *In re Apple Inc. E-Book Derivative Litigation*. It scheduled a July 20 hearing to review the settlement and related payments. Apple attached the settlement notice to its Form 8-K.

Zacks Investment Research downgraded Time Warner from buy to hold, citing potential pressure from weaker advertising spending and currency headwinds despite strong earnings and investments in content and technology. Analysts’ overall rating was Hold, with a consensus price target of $97.87. Time Warner reported fourth-quarter earnings of $1.25 per share and revenue of $7.90 billion, both above expectations. AT&T agreed to acquire the company for $85.4 billion, prompting Time Warner to suspend share repurchases. The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.4025 per share, payable March 15.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell’s features for gaming, video, displays and power efficiency. AMP schedules work to reduce response delays and game stuttering. Blackwell adds hardware support for 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, improved AV1 and HEVC encoding, faster H.264 decoding, and DisplayPort 2.1b. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster clock adjustments and quicker entry into deep sleep.

DLSS 4 adds Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also supports neural shaders for applications including texture compression, lighting, materials, skin and faces. The passage lists specifications for the GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and their GeForce RTX 50-series products, followed by NVIDIA’s legal notices.

The President describes Cuba’s prolonged war as a humanitarian crisis that has damaged American trade, endangered citizens, and strained relations with Spain. He condemns Spain’s reconcentration policy, notes that American relief has saved lives, and says efforts to secure peace have failed. A naval inquiry found that an external mine destroyed the *Maine* but did not assign responsibility. Rejecting immediate recognition of Cuban independence, he asks Congress to authorize measures, including military and naval force if necessary, to end hostilities and establish stable government in Cuba, and to fund continued food relief. He adds that Spain has just ordered a suspension of hostilities, whose terms are not yet known.

Electronic Arts has a consensus “Buy” rating from 28 research firms and an average 12-month price target of $121.55. Its shares reached $120.09 in Friday trading. In its latest reported quarter, the company earned $0.36 per share, above the $0.14 analyst estimate, on revenue of $775 million. Insiders sold 197,096 shares over the preceding 90 days, while institutional investors and hedge funds owned 93.84% of the stock.

Enderby kennel operator Shalah Dawn Nelson pleaded guilty to causing a neighbour’s dog to remain in distress after tying an elastic hair band around its testicles in December 2016. The dog required surgery. Two related Criminal Code charges were stayed. Nelson was fined $1,000, ordered to pay $850 restitution and placed on 12 months’ probation.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition device with configurable output format, analog input settings, and two- or four-lane SDR or DDR interfaces. It requires a continuous sampling clock; a synchronization pulse aligns channel sampling across multiple devices. Features include internal or external voltage references, output randomization, data averaging, test patterns, and a speed-boost mode that samples one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS. Configuration registers are accessed through SPI, including in a daisy-chain arrangement. The passage also describes initialization, power control, an ATE application example, and power-supply and board-layout recommendations.

Delhi will host a Human Library at Innov8, Connaught Place, on June 18 from 2 pm to 7 pm. Visitors can “borrow” people for around 20-minute conversations to learn from their experiences. The event will feature 11 categories, including cancer survivors and people recovering from drug abuse. Founded in Copenhagen in 2000, the Human Library movement has spread to 80 countries.

The article argues that mining stocks’ weak response to a gold rally signals a potential decline in precious metals. It says gold remains below resistance, while the USD Index is testing a breakout that could precede further gains. It also describes bearish signals for stocks despite a pause in their decline. The author compares the combination of stronger gold, a rising dollar, weaker stocks and weak miners to 2008.

According to a Bloomberg report, YouTube may launch a music service called Remix next March to compete with Spotify. Warner Music Group reportedly supports it, while talks with other labels and artists continue.

A small study comparing 10-year-old boys, untrained men and endurance athletes during strenuous cycling found that the boys’ muscles resisted fatigue at a rate similar to the athletes’ and recovered quickly. Researchers linked this partly to children’s less-developed anaerobic systems and faster clearance of lactic acid. They cautioned that the findings do not mean children are as fit as endurance athletes. The results may help guide youth sports training; whether the observed muscle changes are related to disease risk later in life remains unknown.

Daniel Ricciardo was third fastest in the Japanese Grand Prix’s first practice session and said his Red Bull’s balance was good. He attributed lost straight-line speed partly to downforce rather than solely to the engine. Red Bull skipped the wet second session to save tyres for possible rain in qualifying; Ricciardo called for changes to wet-tyre allocations.

Bleacher Report named Braves legend Chipper Jones a “wildest” candidate for Atlanta’s open manager position, while calling the idea “very wishful thinking.” Jones spent all 19 of his playing seasons with the Braves and managed a side in the 2025 Futures Game. The outlet named Walt Weiss its “best candidate.”

Jenny Han worked at Olive Garden, as a nanny, and as a school librarian before her young-adult novels led to Netflix and Amazon adaptations. She says reading books and observing young readers as a librarian helped her understand her audience, and she would not change her career path. Her adaptations attracted millions of viewers, and *The Summer I Turned Pretty* is set to receive a movie sequel. The passage also describes business leaders who held other jobs before building successful companies.

Goals-of-care discussions are often documented inconsistently in electronic health records. This study trained classifiers to identify them in notes from patients with serious illness. An ensemble trained with active learning achieved reported F1 scores of 0.557 for individual utterances and 0.629 for notes. In the test set, it identified 13 of 18 notes containing a discussion and incorrectly flagged 13 notes. Active learning improved performance while requiring annotation of 30% of the general-note utterances available for training. The authors note that performance remains moderate and that the classifier does not account for surrounding utterances.

Vleeschauwer planned to leave for the Congo via the United States on May 15, while Joseph Jennen was authorized to negotiate a United States–United Kingdom–Belgian Congo agreement. The British Foreign Office proposed assuring Belgium that Britain and the United States would try to meet the Congo’s essential supply needs, subject to wartime limits. Winant and Biddle favored separate, parallel communications to Allied governments, and the State Department agreed. Officials also proposed drafting the agreement’s general provisions before Congo production and trade schedules were ready.

The lecture explains matching and renormalization in heavy quark effective theory (HQET). Heavy-to-light currents acquire a spin-independent anomalous dimension; heavy-to-heavy currents also depend on the heavy quarks’ relative velocities. Using dimensional regularization for both ultraviolet and infrared divergences can simplify matching to QCD. At first order in inverse heavy-quark mass, the HQET Lagrangian has kinetic and magnetic corrections. Reparameterization invariance fixes the kinetic term’s Wilson coefficient at one to all orders, while the magnetic term’s coefficient has an anomalous dimension.

USD/JPY fell 2.25% on Friday after weak US employment data, putting its recent upward trend in question. GBP/USD remained under pressure ahead of a Bank of England decision; markets expect a rate cut despite inflation near twice the bank’s target. BTC/USD also declined, finding support near 112,000. The outlook identifies key support and resistance levels for all three pairs, while noting that Federal Reserve signals, economic uncertainty and tariffs could affect their direction.

President Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron celebrated the Franco-American alliance at the Trump administration’s first state dinner Tuesday. Trump voiced hope for a stronger friendship, while Macron cited recent U.S. and French airstrikes on Syria as part of their shared history. Melania Trump oversaw the dinner’s details. The 123 guests included senior officials, business leaders and athletes; some Democrats attended despite a report that they had been excluded.

Travis Stork decided to become a doctor after working at a free clinic following college. On “The Doctors,” he discusses health issues including obesity and heart health. He recommends gradual changes, such as walking more and choosing whole grains, rather than focusing on rapid weight loss. For Super Bowl snacks, he suggests nachos made with bean-based or whole-grain chips and healthier toppings. He also encourages couples to cook healthy meals and exercise together, noting the value of support.

The Diamond & One uses four zone defenders and a fifth “chaser” to deny passes to a designated opponent. It is best suited to an odd or one-guard front offense. The alignment protects the middle but leaves the corners vulnerable; the passage recommends switching to a Box & One if that becomes a problem. Defenders shift with the ball while the chaser maintains denial. Against a strong post player, the chaser and low-post defender can double-team or trap, with outside defenders covering passing lanes.

Kano Governor Abdullahi Ganduje launched the distribution of 10,000 free delivery kits across the state’s 44 local government areas. The N145 million programme aims to reduce infections during childbirth. Ganduje said the government had trained 1,936 traditional birth attendants, upgraded more than 300 health facilities and planned incentives for pregnant women who visit clinics. A World Health Organization representative commended the state’s efforts to improve maternal health.

The professor says the midterm did not clearly distinguish students’ performance and that the final will determine most grades. The course then shifts from block codes toward convolutional codes, motivated by the difficulty of decoding capacity-approaching block codes efficiently.

A rate-1/2 convolutional encoder illustrates two useful properties: it is linear and time-invariant, and it has finitely many states. The professor defines convolutional codes using Laurent sequences, which have a definite starting time, and shows how generating functions describe encoder outputs. Rational impulse responses permit finite-state realizations. Equivalent encoders generate the same code, allowing a simpler polynomial encoder to be chosen. For the example code, both a weight argument and a state-transition diagram establish a free distance of five. The next lecture will address trellis diagrams, catastrophicity, and Viterbi decoding.

Zambia’s parliament suspended 48 opposition MPs for 30 days without pay after they boycotted President Edgar Lungu’s speech, saying they did not recognise him as leader. Their party called the suspensions unconstitutional. Its leader, Hakainde Hichilema, faces treason charges that Amnesty International has called “trumped up.”

TMPM format and migration-list errors are reported in commands or list entries; ring-buffer errors appear in PM_STATUS. Hardware errors appear in command status or MCA. On timeouts, clients should log an MCA and assess recovery. Hardware errors may render all pages in a batch unrecoverable.

In *Ward v. Yorba*, the court affirmed a judgment reforming a land-sale contract to require Ward to convey only his interest, rather than a good and perfect title. Evidence showed that this reflected the parties’ agreement. Yorba knew the relevant title facts when he contracted, so his claim of mistake failed. Ward’s disputed claim and possession provided sufficient consideration for the $4,750 agreement.

The passage highlights the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and a 12-month 0% introductory APR on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It also includes cell phone protection, subject to a deductible. The passage lists offers from Capital One Quicksilver and Citi Double Cash, and notes that advertiser compensation may affect which offers appear and where, but not product ratings. Approval is not guaranteed.

The passage lists headlines about a businessman whose phone stopped a bullet in the Istanbul nightclub attack, Rosie O’Donnell’s criticism of Trump, love-life predictions, missing Fort Bliss soldiers, healthy-aging tips and Ivanka Trump’s New Year celebration.

Teurlings Catholic High announced three appointments: Robert Boudreaux as director of institutional advancement, overseeing development and communications; Maria Latiolais Hanes as development director while continuing her admissions duties; and Rev. Dustin Dought as chaplain. Boudreaux, Hanes and Dought are Teurlings alumni. Father Hampton Davis will remain the school’s chancellor.

The passage describes a backtested SPY mean-reversion strategy that uses the Relative Strength Index (RSI) to guide trades. It reports a 0.57% average gain per trade, a 75% win rate, a 23% maximum drawdown, and a 2.3 profit factor. It says an undisclosed additional indicator reduced trades from 470 to 377 while increasing total returns.

A cryptic tweet from PlayStation Russia prompted guesses about next-generation hardware, PlayStation Now launching in Russia, cross-play, and network or store changes. The passage offers no confirmation of what the message means.

Apple options give buyers the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell Apple shares at a set price before expiration. Their prices are affected by the stock price, time to expiration, volatility, interest rates and company news. Traders use calls, puts and combinations such as covered calls, protective puts and straddles to speculate or hedge. The passage describes Apple options as liquid and volatile, but warns that leverage, time decay and market moves can cause substantial losses. It also notes trading costs and taxes, recommends backtesting strategies, and advises most traders to consider trading Apple stock before options.

A qualitative case study examined AI integration in a university digital photography course through interviews with 38 students and one instructor. Participants reported that AI provided personalized feedback, helped develop technical skills, improved time efficiency, and supported course design and assessment. They also identified inaccurate or contradictory outputs, unequal access to tools, and risks of passivity and over-reliance. The authors recommend AI literacy training, critical evaluation of AI outputs, human-led feedback, and equitable access. Because the study covered one course and instructor, used no control group, and relied on qualitative data, its findings may not generalize or establish that AI caused the reported outcomes.

At its March 4, 2022 annual meeting, Apple shareholders approved the 2022 Employee Stock Plan, which permits equity awards and limits issuable or transferable shares to 1,274,374,682 under its share-limit formula. They elected nine directors, ratified Ernst & Young as Apple’s 2022 auditor, and approved an advisory resolution on executive compensation. Shareholders also approved proposals for a civil rights audit and a report on concealment clauses, while rejecting four other shareholder proposals.

The Education Department is uncertain whether a government shutdown would interrupt this week’s rule-making meetings on graduate loan caps and income-driven repayment. Officials first said the meetings would be delayed and resume online, then said they might continue in person. The department plans to furlough nearly 87 percent of employees while retaining rule-making staff. Experts warn that staffing losses could complicate an already tight timeline for rules taking effect July 1, 2026.

Montreal officials report 11 heat-related deaths, with four more reported in the Eastern Townships. Urgences-Santé says ambulance calls have risen 30 per cent and urges residents to reserve 911 for emergencies. Heat warnings remain in effect across parts of Ontario, Quebec and Atlantic Canada.

The passage reports that the FDA approved a second generic version of mifepristone and that Amgen said its cholesterol-lowering drug Repatha reduced the risk of heart disease death, heart attacks, and strokes in a 12,000-patient trial.

Tyson Foods has a consensus “Buy” rating from 17 brokerages and an average 12-month price target of $72.96. Shares traded at $70.66 on Friday. In its latest quarter, the company reported earnings of $1.28 per share, above the $1.18 estimate, and revenue of $9.85 billion, up 4.8% from a year earlier. Tyson announced a quarterly dividend of $0.225 per share, payable December 15th. CFO Dennis Leatherby sold 145,100 shares, while director Mikel A. Durham bought 2,809 shares. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 71.89% of the stock.

NuVasive will host an AANS workshop on April 30 about single-position lateral surgery, 3D-printed implants and LessRay radiation-reduction technology. Attendees can also explore spine solutions at Booth #529 and meet spokesperson Archie Manning, who will discuss his experience with NuVasive’s XLIF procedure. The company cautions that forward-looking statements in its announcement are subject to risks and uncertainties.

Researchers found that bacteria associated with colorectal tumors can produce 2-methylisocitrate (2-MiCit), a molecule that makes cancer cells more vulnerable to the chemotherapy drug 5-fluorouracil.
