Tests in worms, human cancer cells and a fly model showed anti-cancer effects. 2-MiCit disrupts cancer-cell metabolism and causes DNA damage; a modified version was even more effective at killing cancer cells. The findings suggest a potential route to treatments based on microbial molecules.

The speaker says younger players benefit from watching experienced teammates and credits demanding coach Hitchcock with helping him develop. He values winning over individual scoring and says the team’s success comes from everyone doing their job. The team communicates, keeps its play simple, works in the corners and scores through hard work near the net.

Reno County Jail booking activity for October 5–6, 2017, lists six people with alleged offenses including drug possession, probation violations, failure to appear and obstruction. The sheriff’s office notes that the information is not criminal history.

The passage lists diplomatic correspondence on wartime representation by neutral countries, relief work and civilian deportations in Belgium, and other issues. It introduces January 1917 papers on Allied and Central Powers’ responses to peace initiatives. The first documents deny a report that President Wilson planned a second peace note, report an upcoming Allied conference in Rome, and relay an unconfirmed possibility that Allied troops would withdraw from Saloniki.

The Allies deplore the war’s harm to neutrals but deny responsibility for it. They reject the American note’s apparent equivalence between the belligerent groups, blaming Germany and Austria-Hungary for the war and accusing the Central powers and their allies of abuses. In response to President Wilson’s request, they outline aims including restoration and compensation for invaded countries, territorial restitution, liberation of peoples under foreign rule, and agreements to secure Europe against future attacks. They say detailed terms must await negotiations and deny seeking the German people’s destruction, instead calling for peace based on liberty, justice and respect for international obligations.

The passage describes an automated system that retrieves storage bins, uses a programmable robotic device to grasp objects, and places them in destination bins arranged along the device’s path. Conveyors and bin-removal mechanisms move bins between storage and processing areas. A perception system selects grasp points using object shape, surface orientation, and past grasp results. A computer tracks bin locations and directs object distribution according to a manifest. The passage also describes box tray assemblies and configurations with multiple processing stations.

Biomedical imaging often involves low-quality, low-resolution or misaligned data, creating needs for restoration, super-resolution, registration and fusion. The passage argues that separate specialist models are inefficient when tasks and degradations overlap. It introduces Orochi, a generalist model trained on data from over 100 studies using multi-scale sampling and self-supervised learning across task-specific degradations. Its hierarchical Mamba architecture aims to reduce training and inference costs, while three fine-tuning options offer different levels of efficiency. The authors report that its lightest tuning option achieves performance comparable to existing specialist models.

The North Carolina Court of Appeals vacated a preliminary injunction barring Paul Alton Vaughn from operating a used car lot that the Town of Knightdale alleged violated its zoning ordinance. The town’s verified complaint was the only evidence presented and alleged irreparable harm without specific supporting facts. The court held that municipalities seeking preliminary injunctions must meet Rule 65’s requirements; the town’s conclusory allegation did not allow the trial court to assess whether an injunction was warranted.

A Japanese representative urged Korea to reform its government and economy to preserve its independence and maintain friendly relations with Japan. Mr. Sill reported that Japan demanded Korea clarify whether it was tributary to China; Korea replied that it exercised sovereign rights and independence in domestic and foreign affairs. A cited earlier letter from Korea’s king called Korea a dependency of China while affirming its control over those affairs. Mr. Ye Sung Soo reported that Japan refused to withdraw its troops and sought political changes. He asked the United States to help avert conflict and secure the withdrawal of Japanese and Chinese troops.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2019 reports revenue of $30.6 billion, up 14% from a year earlier, and net income of $8.8 billion, up 19%. Nine-month revenue rose 15% to $92.1 billion. Revenue grew across all three segments, while third-quarter commercial cloud revenue rose 41% to $9.6 billion. Microsoft acquired GitHub in October 2018 and reported it within Intelligent Cloud. At March 31, total assets were $263.3 billion, including $131.6 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments.

On August 16, 2018, Tesla subsidiaries amended two vehicle lease warehouse agreements, extending borrowing availability to August 16, 2019, and maturity to September 2020. The shared lender commitment remains $1.1 billion.

The court unanimously affirmed Frank Dellipizzi’s convictions for first-degree robbery and sexual abuse. It found the evidence sufficient to support the sexual abuse conviction. The court cautioned against wording in the jury instruction on intent that could suggest a shift in the burden of proof, but concluded that the charge as a whole did not shift that burden.

The speaker celebrates winning the Stanley Cup after years of waiting and repeated second-round exits. They credit the team’s hard work, unity and commitment to its system, even when facing setbacks. They praise a teammate’s playoff performance and say sharing the victory with the organization, family and fans is special.

Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt received more playing time in Week 5 after a strong week of practice, according to head coach Dan Quinn. He set season highs with 14 carries, 16 touches and 28 snaps, producing 150 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns. A report said his lack of experience had previously limited his workload.

The swinging gate is an unconventional football formation, usually used after a touchdown, that lets an offense attempt a quick run or pass or shift into an extra-point kick. The offensive line typically lines up away from the snapper, creating an unusual look for the defense. Common plays include a side snap to a runner and a quick pass to the opposite side. NFL extra-point rules limit its usefulness because kicks and two-point attempts start at different yard lines. To defend it, teams must match their personnel to the offense’s blockers, cover eligible receivers and protect space near the snapper.

The passage argues that a canal would benefit U.S. industry, defense, and tropical American countries, and says nations maintaining order and meeting their obligations need not fear U.S. interference. It describes an agreement allowing the Commercial Pacific Cable Company to use government soundings and lay a cable to China via Hawaii and the Philippines, subject to conditions Congress could change. It praises Puerto Rico’s administration and reports that peace, amnesty, and civil government had been established in the Philippines, though trouble with the Moros persisted. It credits military and civil authorities while acknowledging and condemning instances of cruelty by troops.

FINRA reported that margin debt reached a record $665.7 billion in January, fell to $645.1 billion in February, and edged up to $645.2 billion in March. FINRA warned that investors trading on margin may underestimate the risk of brokers liquidating their portfolios during market declines. Margin debt remained 55% above its July 2007 peak in March. The passage notes that earlier spikes preceded market crashes, but suggests the current decline in leverage could be more gradual.

Palladium rose about 8.5% as precious metals rallied, breaking above a level the author says now provides support. The author expects a broader commodities supercycle and notes that gold surpassed $4,000.

On March 4, 2020, NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted a fiscal 2021 variable compensation plan for eligible executive officers. Cash awards depend on fiscal 2021 revenue goals at threshold, base and stretch levels; participants generally must remain employed through the payment date. At base-plan achievement, target awards range from $250,000 for Debora Shoquist and Timothy Teter to $1.5 million for CEO Jen-Hsun Huang.

Secondary endpoints measure plasma glucose recovery—a rise of at least 20 mg/dL from baseline—within 10, 15, 20 and 30 minutes after injection. Patients receiving IV glucose before recovery are classified as not recovered. Recovery rates for dasiglucagon and placebo will be compared using a test stratified by age group and injection site. Glucose changes will be analyzed by treatment, age group and injection site, with adjusted means and 95% confidence intervals reported.

Flir reported fourth-quarter revenue of $474.7 million and adjusted earnings of $0.52 per share. It forecast 2017 revenue of $1.78 billion to $1.83 billion and raised its quarterly dividend to $0.15 per share.

The passage describes a statistical analysis plan for a trial assessing plasma glucose recovery and safety. It specifies analyses of adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings and anti-drug antibodies, including rules for missing adverse-event information. It also outlines efficacy analyses of time to glucose recovery and glucose levels, changes from the protocol, presentation standards for tables, figures and listings, and SAS programming quality-control requirements. Appendices provide planned outputs and example table and figure specifications.

Hello Wood’s Pebl Grand is a prefabricated tiny cabin with an asymmetrical, spaceship-like exterior and a minimalist interior. Starting at €73,000 ($86,247), it includes a king-size bed, kitchenette, dining nook, and bathroom; an upgraded model adds an infrared sauna and panoramic window. Built in Hungary, it typically takes two to three months from deposit to installation and can serve as a home or hospitality space.

The dollar and U.S. Treasury yields fell after President Donald Trump said the dollar was too strong and favored low interest rates. Tensions over North Korea pushed the cost of insuring South Korean government debt to a 9½-month high. Asian stocks were mixed: shares outside Japan rose, while Japan’s Nikkei and Australian stocks declined. South Korean stocks and the won gained after the central bank held rates steady and raised its growth outlook. China reported a wider March trade surplus, including with the United States. Oil prices slipped on concerns about rising U.S. supply.

Mutual funds’ investment in software stocks reached a record Rs 70,773 crore in April, or 7.37% of equity assets, up from Rs 64,265 crore in March. Industry experts linked the increased allocation to rupee depreciation, which benefits IT firms earning much of their revenue in dollars.

Panthers quarterback Cam Newton posted an apology for a sexist remark about a female reporter’s question. The passage suggests the video might help him avoid discussing it after Sunday’s game in Detroit, but reporters may press him for answers.

At a pre-budget meeting with economists, Finance Minister Arun Jaitley said India averaged 7.5% growth from 2014-15 to 2016-17 and that growth in the second quarter of 2017-18 reversed a recent decline. He said the fiscal deficit fell from 3.9% of GDP in 2015-16 to 3.5% in 2016-17, with 3.2% budgeted for 2017-18.

Economists recommended continued fiscal consolidation, a tax-reform roadmap, greater infrastructure and SME investment, and increased disinvestment. Other suggestions covered pensions and maternity benefits, crop insurance, rural employment and income, bank recapitalisation, labour reforms, digital payments and social protection.

The passage describes football offensive formations, noting that coaches may use different names for the same alignment. Basic formations include the I, split backs, and Twins; spread formations include Ace, Trips, Empty, Quads, and Bunch. It distinguishes backfield sets such as shotgun, pistol, and single back from formations describing the full offense. It also covers older formations, including the Wishbone, Flexbone, Double Wing, T, Wing-T, Power I, and Single Wing, alongside less common looks such as the Wildcat, Emory and Henry, Swinging Gate, and unbalanced formations. The alignments offer different ways to support running, passing, misdirection, or difficult defensive matchups.

The passage lists telegram records from September through December 1942 and reproduces two January 1942 documents. In a January 3 note, the State Department asked Finnish Legation staff to inquire before traveling beyond Washington and nearby suburbs, and Finnish consular personnel before traveling outside their districts. In a subsequent call, the Department clarified that the requirement covered officially notified Legation staff and honorary consuls. It also acknowledged that the Finnish Consul General in New York would not need to inquire about travel within his nationwide consular district.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its approach to real-time graphics. Hybrid rendering uses rasterization for efficient visibility processing and ray tracing for effects such as reflections and shadows. RT Cores accelerate ray tracing through bounding-volume traversal and intersection tests, while denoising reduces the rays needed per pixel. Tensor Cores support NGX features, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and super-resolution. Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, and Multi-View Rendering offer ways to improve rendering flexibility or efficiency, including for VR. The passage also outlines TU104 and TU106 GPUs, proposes RTX-OPS as a hybrid-rendering workload metric, explains basic ray-tracing techniques, and includes NVIDIA’s product disclaimers.

Before the game, the speaker emphasized getting pucks and players to the net, managing emotions, and preparing to face a hard-working opponent. He discussed line matchups, praised his goalie and a defensively strong player, and said the team was ready to play after a long break. Afterward, he said the opponent was quicker, hungrier and better at managing the puck. His team failed to engage physically, turned the puck over and struggled in a matchup involving the Bylsma line. He rejected the layoff as an excuse.

The passage describes a phase-stable colloidal suspension made by adding water to a never-dried, α(1→3)-glucan-containing press cake and mechanically dispersing it. The method does not require chemical or enzymatic pretreatment, dissolution, precipitation, or high-pressure homogenization. The resulting gel forms a three-dimensional network, thickens water, and can form films and coatings. Proposed uses include paper and packaging coatings, binders, molded products, and dried powders. In the reported examples, suspensions made from dried glucan showed phase separation and little viscosity increase.

Saudi Arabia’s stock index fell 0.6 percent on Monday as Dar Al Arkan dropped 9.9 percent after a sharp rise since mid-November. Analysts considered the stock above fair value. Saudi cement shares remained strong ahead of the expected 2018 state budget. Qatar’s index rebounded 1.2 percent from near six-year lows, while Dubai’s rose 0.6 percent as Emaar Development gained but remained below its IPO price.

A 2015 study found that older adults who volunteered regularly were less likely to develop high blood pressure; other findings linked volunteering to reduced stress and loneliness. Virginia Cooperative Extension’s Master Food Volunteer training begins April 18 at the Brambleton Center. Applications are due April 3, and the $90 fee has need-based scholarships available.

SEV-TIO lets SEV-SNP guests bind trusted devices and use them in private address space. Its guest request can exchange device information and return measurements, certificates, and attestation reports through shared data pages; a nonce can trigger fresh device measurements.

Secure AVIC uses a private APIC backing page per vCPU. Termination and unsupported-event requests provide guest–hypervisor signaling. SEV-ES and SEV-SNP AP booting must account for measured, encrypted register state; the SEV-SNP AP Creation feature lets guests provide VMSA pages and supports vCPU hotplug. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

For guests using Restricted Injection, a shared #HV doorbell page communicates interrupts and non-maskable events. The passage specifies its configuration and host and guest responsibilities for presenting, acknowledging, validating, and completing interrupts.

On the first trading day of 2017, Delhi gold held at Rs 28,300 per 10 grams amid closed global markets. Silver fell Rs 100 to Rs 39,300 per kg on reduced industrial demand, while MCX February gold rose Rs 83 to Rs 27,528.

Duke extended men’s basketball coach Jon Scheyer’s contract through the 2030–31 season, adding two years to his previous deal. In three seasons, Scheyer has won 89 games and led Duke to the 2024 Elite Eight and last season’s Final Four. Duke also won both ACC titles in 2024–25.

Weaker-than-expected US employment data and downward revisions weighed on USD/JPY, which fell 2.25% on Friday. GBP/USD remained under pressure ahead of Thursday’s Bank of England decision; markets expect a 25-basis-point rate cut amid slowing UK growth and rising unemployment. BTC/USD also fell alongside equities, finding support near 112,000. The outlook identifies key support and resistance levels for all three pairs and notes that Federal Reserve signals, tariffs and economic uncertainty could influence market sentiment.

Virgin Galactic’s VSS Unity completed its second rocket-powered test flight on May 29, 2018. Its motor fired for 31 seconds, lifting it to 114,500 feet—above its April test altitude of 84,271 feet—before it glided to a landing at Mojave Air and Space Port.

Vincent Bollore told the European Commission he expects to gain sole control of Vivendi after its April 25 shareholders meeting. His 20.65% stake carries 29% of voting rights; the Commission has until April 24 to approve.

Mick Schumacher says he is not ready for Formula One and needs to improve. After leaving Formula 4 without a title, he is focusing on learning and competing in his first European F3 season. He has no F1 plan but welcomes interest from Mercedes and Ferrari and is adjusting to media attention.

The appellate court upheld the father’s custody of the younger daughter despite finding that he had obstructed the mother’s contact and alienated the children from her. It ruled that visitation with the younger daughter should not depend solely on the child’s wishes and remitted the matter for prompt consideration of court-ordered visitation. The court also upheld the suspension of the mother’s child support payments.

New State Quad senators say residents are confused and concerned about asbestos despite notices on dorm doors and in housing documents. University officials say asbestos in some ceiling insulation poses a risk through long-term exposure when disturbed, and that ceilings have not recently been disturbed. Some RAs alleged they were discouraged from discussing asbestos with residents; Residential Life denied this and said RAs should refer questions to staff with more expertise. A Facilities Management official proposed an online FAQ, while some RAs called for clearer communication.

The passage specifies mechanical and electrical requirements for Socket 940 and its mating 940-pin ceramic µPGA package. The socket supports lidded and lidless packages; its LCP base and cover must meet flatness, marking, and inspection requirements. Copper-alloy contacts have nickel plating and gold-plated mating areas, while tin-lead solder balls attach the socket to a PCB. A stainless-steel lever enables toolless actuation; insertion and extraction forces with the lever open must not exceed 2 kgf, and the socket must retain integrity after 50 actuation cycles.

Each contact is rated for 1.5 A, and initial and final circuit resistance must not exceed 25 mΩ per contact with Kovar pins. The passage also sets limits for inductance, capacitance, impedance, propagation-delay skew, dielectric withstanding voltage, and insulation resistance.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 26, 2020 reports net sales of $111.4 billion, up 21% from a year earlier, and net income of $28.8 billion, up from $22.2 billion. Sales grew across all product and service categories and geographic segments. Operating activities generated $38.8 billion in cash; Apple repurchased $24.0 billion of stock and paid $3.6 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. At quarter-end, it held $195.6 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. The filing also discusses debt, tax and legal matters, and continuing effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on operations.

The Charlottesville attack prompted educators to consider how to address racism and white supremacy. Derek Weimer, who taught the man charged in the attack, said he felt he had failed to steer his former student away from white supremacy. Facing History and Ourselves encourages teachers to use historical moral choices to discuss bigotry and injustice. The passage offers classroom resources, including identity charts, diverse books, historical materials, lesson plans and media-literacy activities.

SPARK, a three-year study seeking families of 50,000 people with autism, aims to identify genetic markers and better understand how autism runs in families. More than 25,000 people with autism and their families were participating as of early April. Families can submit cheek swabs from home or attend collection events. Researchers hope the findings will support studies of treatments for people with specific genetic markers; prevention is not the study’s aim.
Strix described its first half of 2025 as mixed. Its Billi business maintained double-digit growth, supported by new products and geographic expansion.

Global QYResearch’s 2018 report outlines the Geiger-Mueller counters market by product type, application and region. Its table of contents covers historical sales and revenue, supplier profiles, manufacturing costs, distribution, market factors and forecasts through 2022.

Microsoft reported $20.45 billion in revenue and $4.69 billion in net income for the quarter ended September 30, 2016, compared with $20.38 billion and $4.90 billion a year earlier. Diluted earnings per share fell from $0.61 to $0.60. Revenue grew in Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud, supported by Office 365 and Azure, while More Personal Computing revenue declined, mainly because of lower phone and gaming revenue. Operating income fell 10% to $5.23 billion.

At September 30, Microsoft held $136.93 billion in cash and short-term investments and had $60.15 billion in long-term debt. It had agreed to acquire LinkedIn in a $26.2 billion transaction, subject to closing conditions.

The court dismissed the plaintiff’s appeal from the order, affirmed the judgment dismissing his personal-injury complaint, and awarded costs to the defendant. It found that the jury’s verdict that the defendant was not negligent fairly reflected the evidence.

The Passing Game is a basketball offense based on continuous ball and player movement rather than set plays. It involves all five players and uses purposeful cuts, screens, spacing and passing to create shots while controlling tempo. Players need patience, teamwork, shooting and passing skills, defensive awareness, and a commitment to offensive rebounding. Variations include three-, four- and five-person alignments, with adjustments for zone defenses. Its freedom and unpredictability can make it difficult to defend, but selfish play, poor shot selection, weak off-ball skills and offensive rebounding problems can disrupt it.

Santander UK CEO Mike Regnier will step down in the first quarter of 2026 as the bank prepares to integrate TSB, which it acquired earlier this year. Santander has begun searching for a successor, aiming to appoint one early next year. The incoming CEO will oversee the merger of operations, systems and staff amid integration and regulatory risks.

This systematic review examined 39 studies of digital leadership in education. Only 11 defined the concept, and the review describes it as an evolving practice that combines technology use, organizational culture, and interaction between leaders and followers. Research on its effects focused mainly on teachers, particularly technology integration, with less attention to students. Ten studies examined influencing factors, including leaders’ experience and digital literacy, infrastructure, school culture, policies, and training. The review calls for more research on these factors, student learning, digital security, and followers’ roles.

The passage argues for using existing channels to test Soviet intentions before expanding U.S.-Soviet dialogue. It opposes major concessions on arms control and regional issues, warning that premature negotiations could create expectations of progress without meaningful Soviet flexibility. It also objects to proposed initiatives on Afghanistan, Namibia and Angola, and government-to-government trade contacts. It calls for discussions covering human rights and arms control, with Soviet positions on INF serving as a test of their intentions, and opposes a summit absent a major Soviet move. In a subsequent memorandum, Clark agrees with Shultz on several policy areas but questions his proposal for substantially increased dialogue.

Fitch assigned expected ‘BB(EXP)’ ratings to two Telenet subsidiaries’ senior secured term loans, subject to final documentation. The loans will partially refinance existing debt without increasing leverage. Fitch cited Telenet’s strong market position and stable cash flow, while noting that its high leverage target constrains the rating. It expects the impact of cable wholesale regulation to be manageable and describes Telenet’s liquidity as strong, with no debt maturing before 2022.

In NCAA football, targeting is forcible contact aimed at an opponent beyond a legal tackle, block or play on the ball. The foul carries a 15-yard penalty and automatic disqualification. A foul in the second half also brings a suspension for the first half of the next game; three targeting fouls in a season trigger a one-game suspension. Adopted in 2008 for player safety, the rule added disqualifications in 2013 and mandatory video review in 2019. Unlike the NCAA rule, the NFL’s comparable unnecessary-roughness rule does not require automatic disqualification.

Keith Chegwin, 60, died at home on 11 December after a long battle with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), his family said. IPF scars the lungs, making breathing less efficient, and usually worsens over time. About 6,000 people are diagnosed annually in the UK. Symptoms include breathlessness, a persistent cough, fatigue and clubbing of the fingers and toes.

Halcon Resources shares fell 0.18% in the most recent session and closed at $5.43. Ten analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $10.56, ranging from $6 to $14. The stock’s average brokerage recommendation was 1.57. Its 14-period Average True Range was 0.27, and its Relative Strength Index was 51.45. Halcon had a market capitalization of $868.2 million, with 2.42 million shares traded in the previous session.

Will Ma analyzes a deep-stacked cash-game hand in which he calls with eight-seven suited, misses his draws, then bluffs after his opponent checks the river. By narrowing the opponent’s possible hands from each betting decision and counting their combinations, he argues that the bluff is profitable under his assumptions.

He then discusses why poker attracts money and remains difficult: players can overestimate their skill, struggle with gambling self-control, fall behind as strategies evolve, and underestimate luck and variance. He emphasizes judging decisions rather than results, maintaining honest confidence, and playing for enjoyment even when losing money.

Adm. Harry Harris will become U.S. ambassador to South Korea rather than Australia, Foreign Minister Julie Bishop said. Acting Secretary of State John Sullivan told her that appointing an ambassador to Australia would be a priority for the next secretary of state. The post has been vacant since September 2016. Australian figures expressed concern about the delay, while Bishop emphasized the countries’ strong relationship.

Facebook shares fell 6.8% in midday trading Monday, on pace for their largest percentage decline in four years, as U.S. and U.K. regulators criticized the company for allowing Cambridge Analytica to access user data without express permission. The drop erased almost $40 billion in market value. Analysts saw heightened public-relations and regulatory risks but differed on the likely business impact. Some expected Facebook to withstand the scrutiny, while others warned that measures to restore trust could reduce engagement or frustrate advertisers. The broader tech sector also declined.

In 2016, the Rams traded several draft picks to the Titans for the No. 1 pick, which they used on Jared Goff. Goff and return specialist Pharoh Cooper later made the Pro Bowl, while Tennessee turned its picks into several players, including four starters. Both teams reached the playoffs in 2017. The passage gives the Rams a slight edge but says the trade’s long-term outcome remains uncertain.

The speaker says the coach decides when they play and that the team will not change its game despite tough calls. They expected a fast opponent with a strong forecheck. After focusing on each shift and coming back to win, they will prepare for the next game.

The author says an early supplement business succeeded through publicity and sales outside conventional stores. In 2010, the author listed the nootropic supplement Excelerol on Amazon, gaining reviews and overnight sales without advertising. Amazon initially brought new customers and revenue, but policy changes and the risk of account suspensions exposed the company’s dependence on the platform. After years of adapting, the author now leads a team that advises businesses on selling through Amazon.

The Vintage Optical Shop sells authentic vintage eyeglasses and sunglasses online. New email subscribers can receive a one-time $20 coupon for their next purchase, along with updates about new arrivals, sales and specials. The store says its eyewear dates from the 1850s to the 1980s.

The speaker credits teamwork and lessons from veterans, including Ray Bourque, for winning a championship against a strong opponent. He says winning for Bourque was especially meaningful and praises Patrick, whose family hosted him, as a mentor. He also credits the organization and home-ice advantage, and looks forward to celebrating with family and friends.

Experiments and simulations examined DNA droplet coarsening in a self-stirring active fluid compared with a passive fluid. Active flows transported droplets independently of their size and accelerated collision-driven coalescence. Although mean droplet radius grew with nearly the same power-law exponent in both fluids, droplet number declined faster in the active fluid. Unlike passive droplets, active droplets did not maintain a constant relative size distribution: many small droplets coexisted with a few exceptionally large ones.

Simulations linked these differences to collision rates. When collisions preferentially occur between large droplets, size distributions lose self-similarity and the relationship between the two coarsening exponents becomes nonlinear. The authors identify the scaling of the collision kernel as a shared control parameter across different forms of droplet motion. They note that system size and droplets approaching the active-flow length scale require further study.

The passage describes NVIDIA A100 features for AI and high-performance computing. SECDED ECC protects HBM2 memory, caches and register files. A100 has a 40 MB L2 cache, 2.3 times V100’s L2 read bandwidth, cache residency controls and compute data compression. Third-generation Tensor Cores, improved data sharing, asynchronous copies and barriers are designed to improve compute and data-fetch efficiency.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide an A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/s total bandwidth per A100; the GPU also supports PCIe Gen 4 and SR-IOV. Other features include hardware JPEG decoding, optical flow acceleration, improved atomics and five video decoders. CUDA 11 adds support for features including task graphs, asynchronous copies, barriers and L2 residency controls. The passage also describes the eight-GPU DGX A100 system and A100 support for fine-grained structured sparsity.

Researchers analyzed whole-blood RNA sequencing from 390 people with rare diseases or unaffected family members to identify widespread splicing abnormalities. Excess intron retention in genes containing minor introns identified four individuals with RNU4ATAC-related disease. A fifth had rare variants in RNU6ATAC, which the researchers propose as a disease-gene candidate requiring further evidence. The findings suggest that transcriptome-wide splicing patterns can aid rare-disease diagnosis and variant interpretation, although technical factors, particularly processing batch, can affect outlier detection.

Trump accused major homebuilders of sitting on 2 million empty lots and urged Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to help spur construction. Housing deregulation advocate Bryan Caplan disputed his diagnosis, arguing that zoning rules and permit delays, not coordinated withholding by builders, are the main obstacles. He said mortgage financing cannot overcome local restrictions. A cited survey found that 64% of single-family builders reported a shortage of buildable lots.

During a six-month study abroad in Buenos Aires, the writer initially worried about facing discrimination but felt welcomed. Police officers and strangers helped when the writer got lost, and conversations about their ethnicity led to friendships with Argentines. Although the writer encountered few people of African descent, those meetings brought a sense of connection. The experience changed the writer’s outlook and prompted them to encourage other African American students to study abroad.

Emma Stone has reportedly agreed to represent Louis Vuitton for two years in a deal worth between $6 million and $10 million. The brand also approached Ryan Gosling, who declined. Stone said she grew to enjoy the weightlifting and protein shakes she used to prepare for her role as Billie Jean King in *Battle of the Sexes*.

AGESA is an AMD BIOS procedure library for initializing AMD hardware. The passage describes its host interface, wrapper and binary-module integration, UEFI drivers, build options, boot-stage procedures, configuration parameters, and error reporting. Host environments supply required platform settings, establish the specified execution environment and stack, and handle call-outs and returned errors.

Sprint and the Sprint Foundation will provide free devices and wireless service to 180,000 low-income high school students in more than 1,300 schools across 32 states this school year. The five-year 1Million Project aims to connect 1 million students without home internet. Participants receive a device and 3GB of high-speed data monthly for up to four years. Sprint plans to contribute about $2.16 billion in service, support and staffing.

BiondVax announced a $2.8 million investment from Marius Nacht’s Angels High Tech Investments in exchange for shares representing a 19.99% stake. BiondVax said the investment would support development and commercialization of its universal influenza vaccine candidate as it plans to enter Phase 3.

The Enforcement Directorate told the Delhi High Court that Nirav Modi was using Firestar Diamond International’s plea to stay money-laundering proceedings to hinder its investigation into the alleged PNB fraud. The ED said the plea was premature and that Modi had not responded to investigation summons.

Korea asked foreign representatives to help resolve the presence of Chinese and Japanese troops on its soil. China had entered by invitation to help quell a rebellion; Japan had entered without invitation. Korea said the need for both forces had ended and proposed their simultaneous withdrawal. Representatives of the United States, Britain, Russia, and France submitted that proposal to Chinese and Japanese authorities. Sill reported growing tensions near Seoul, persuaded an American admiral to delay his departure, and expressed concern for the safety of 80 Americans there. Denby reported that complications between China and Japan had overshadowed the Korean insurrection.

Vijay Mallya denied allegations that he diverted loans and said he has evidence to defend himself in India’s extradition case against him. He is wanted over Kingfisher Airlines’ default on loans worth nearly Rs 9,000 crore. A London court extended his bail until December 4 and set a case-management hearing for July 6. It tentatively scheduled the final hearing for December 4, subject to review. Mallya’s lawyers said they had not received the final evidence and expected a second extradition request from India.

On March 17, 2016, Apple agreed to issue $3.5 billion in senior unsecured notes: $750 million at 2.250% due 2021, $1.25 billion at 3.250% due 2026, and $1.5 billion at 4.650% due 2046. The notes add to series issued in February 2016. Interest is payable semiannually beginning August 23, 2016.

The speaker says the team expects a loud crowd and remains focused despite winning two games, since four wins are needed. He credits Marty’s playoff performance and says the team’s experienced leaders help maintain focus. After a loss, he says the opponent got breaks, while his team made mistakes, including one on the final goal. He declines to blame the goaltender and says faceoffs have been a season-long concern, worsened by Joe Nieuwendyk’s absence.

Milford are favourites against St. Naul’s in the 2017 Intermediate final, a year after losing the decider. Milford have competed well in Division One and reached the final by beating Cloughaneely and Aodh Ruadh. St. Naul’s, who play two divisions below Milford, have won just one of eight finals in the past 30 years. They reached this final after a replay win over Gaeil Fhánada. Both teams have key players back, including Milford’s Cathal McGettigan and Gary Merritt and St. Naul’s captain Stephen Griffin.

On November 1, 2001, reports said the SEC had made its inquiry into Enron’s partnerships with former CFO Andrew Fastow a formal investigation. Standard & Poor’s cut Enron’s long-term rating to BBB and warned of possible further cuts. Enron obtained $1 billion in credit backed by pipeline assets, while its shares closed at $11.99, down about 14%. Major gas and power trading partners largely continued business with Enron, though some tightened credit requirements. Competing exchanges had seen little shift from EnronOnline.

The authors argue that mainstream climate education emphasizes scientific knowledge, technological fixes, and sustainable development while neglecting colonial histories, Black and Indigenous knowledge, and the unequal burdens of climate change. They describe “climate coloniality” as the persistence of colonial power in climate impacts and proposed solutions, including resource extraction for green technologies. Using contrapuntal reading to examine dominant and marginalized perspectives, they propose decolonial educational ecologies that center historically marginalized knowledge, question growth-based solutions, and attend to local contexts, reparative justice, and relationships with the more-than-human world.

The author argues that the brain does not store or retrieve information like a computer. Instead, experiences change the brain in ways that enable later behavior. He traces the information-processing view to a history of metaphors for human intelligence and uses a dollar-bill drawing exercise to illustrate the difference between recall and recognition. He describes alternative approaches that explain behavior without internal representations, and argues that each person’s unique experiences make brain activity difficult to model. He also criticizes predictions about downloading minds and research projects built on the computer metaphor.

The passage argues that historical discrimination and “base plus” budgeting have left public universities with persistent funding inequities. Flagship institutions often receive more state funding per student while serving fewer students from marginalized or low-income groups. It says that increasing allocations, making college free, or tying funding to outcomes will not resolve unequal institutional resources. Instead, states should first distribute education funding according to student and institutional need, account for outside revenue, and fund other university activities separately. Once distribution is equitable, states can address whether overall funding is adequate.

Mike Francesa is expected to return to WFAN’s weekday afternoon slot early next month after approaching parent company Entercom and accepting a significant pay cut from his previous salary of about $3 million, according to sources. The decision was made above WFAN vice president Mark Chernoff, who opposed his return. Francesa is expected to host from 3 to 6:30 p.m., with Chris Carlin, Maggie Gray and Bart Scott moving to 1 to 3 p.m. His return follows an unsuccessful discussion about joining SiriusXM and has drawn criticism from some colleagues. Sources said WFAN will still spend less on salaries than it did before Francesa’s retirement.

Revolution Lighting Technologies will release its first-quarter 2017 financial results before markets open on May 2, 2017, and discuss them in an 11 a.m. ET conference call and webcast. A replay will be available through May 16. The company designs and sells LED lighting solutions for industrial, commercial and government markets.

The passage reports a solution-processed CsPbBr3 perovskite polariton laser that operates under continuous electrical pumping. A microplate in an optical microcavity uses single-walled carbon nanotube electrodes. A two-stage cooling protocol forms a rectifying p-i-n structure that improves charge injection. At 8 K, the device reaches polariton lasing at a threshold of 60 µA, approximately 2.8 kA cm−2.

Analyzing 34.4 million papers from 1900–2020, the study uses persistent homology to identify papers that create structural gaps in networks of scientific concepts. These papers account for 0.84% of the sample and, compared with other papers, receive fewer citations initially but more over 20 years; they are also more likely to be highly cited and disruptive. They tend to come from smaller, younger, newer, and more geographically proximate teams.

The passage describes a driving instrument for drilling tissue or placing implants while measuring torque, force and penetration depth in real time. A controller processes sensor signals into displays of torque, power and energy. The passage states that accumulated energy can indicate regional tissue strength and screw pullout strength, while a drop in power can signal when to stop penetration. An adjustable guide supports depth control, and force sensors monitor pressure on the tool and guide. These features are intended to help users select implants and avoid unintended penetration, inaccurate depth measurements and repeated radiographs.

Simon Paul Pearson, 28, admitted stealing £759 of outdoor furniture from Bath’s Locksbrook Inn on February 2 and entering three other local businesses intending to steal. Bristol Crown Court sentenced him on April 18 to 20 weeks in jail, suspended for 18 months.

A study of 971 adults with asthma found that those eating more than four servings of cured meat weekly were 76 percent more likely to report worsening symptoms than those eating one serving or less, after researchers adjusted for several other factors. Body mass index accounted for 14 percent of worsening symptoms. Because the study was observational and relied on participants’ recollections, it cannot establish that cured meat caused the changes.

The defendant withdrew his motions and agreed that the court would determine restitution after reviewing the probation report. On appeal, he challenged his counsel’s effectiveness during Grand Jury proceedings and the lack of a restitution hearing. The court found no support for the counsel claim and noted that he had consented to the restitution procedure. It found his remaining claims meritless.

The speaker says the team must treat its next game as a chance to win and avoid further games and injury risks. They expect their opponent’s best effort, remain confident despite uneven play, and value contributions from anyone who helps them win. Prior experience has made them more relaxed about the crowd and focused on the game.

A forwarded collection of November 2001 articles reports that Enron widened its third-quarter loss to $664 million and warned that a credit downgrade could require repayment or collateral on a $690 million note. A further downgrade could trigger billions in additional obligations. Enron also warned of a possible $700 million fourth-quarter charge, while bankers questioned whether its proposed Dynegy merger would proceed. Representative John Dingell requested an investigation of Arthur Andersen’s audits of Enron and Waste Management; Andersen had not completed its review of Enron’s latest filing.

World number one Dustin Johnson says fatherhood has improved his golf by giving him a new perspective as he prepares to defend his US Open title days after the birth of his second son. He missed the Masters after injuring his back and says he is still working to regain his best form. Despite missing the cut at Memorial, Johnson believes Erin Hills suits his game.

The speaker says Belfour struggled while dealing with a cold and breathing problems, but expects him to play well tomorrow. He attributes the loss chiefly to poor puck handling, neutral-zone turnovers and low energy, which gave a strong counterattacking opponent too many chances. The team needs to control the puck, spend more time in the offensive zone and adjust its game plan. Lags will not play tomorrow after feeling sore following a skate.

The passage describes LLMs’ potential to generate research data, analyze social-science material, and help develop hypotheses, while noting concerns about bias, authenticity, misinformation, and the validity of AI-generated theories. It argues for human oversight and AI governance that balances innovation with safety through cooperation among industry, academia, and policymakers, alongside mechanisms for users and developers to report emerging risks.

GBP/USD fell back to around 1.2965 after Friday’s brief rally. A widening US-UK 10-year yield spread could favor the dollar, though stronger-than-expected UK inflation could lift the pair above 1.30. Weaker core inflation could put 1.2935 support at risk. US retail sales are expected to rise 0.4% in July.

The speaker says they are close to clinching, but the final win feels distant and may be the hardest. The team believes things must go right and moves on quickly after wins. Despite advice from experienced teammates, the speaker says it is hard to stay calm until the final buzzer.

The passage distinguishes biological sex from gender identity. It describes how the SRY gene on the Y chromosome helps direct testis development, while mutations or its presence on an X chromosome can affect sexual development. The author says gender identity remains poorly understood, suggests genes may play a role, and notes that any involvement of genes on the X or Y chromosomes is uncertain.

Aspire Music Group has sued Cash Money Records, alleging it withheld profits and copyright royalties owed under a 2008 agreement covering Drake’s first six solo albums. Aspire also disputes payments made to Drake under a 2013 deal and seeks a court-supervised accounting to determine its claim.

Sports Illustrated’s Matt Verderame proposes that the Bears trade a 2026 second-round pick to the Titans for defensive lineman Jeffery Simmons. Chicago has struggled against the run and generated just five sacks through three games. Simmons has two sacks and 17 pressures in 2025, though Tennessee may be reluctant to trade him.

The President argues that congressional reconstruction laws have hindered reunification and calls for their repeal, along with laws he says restrict executive authority. Citing rising expenditures and debt, he urges spending cuts and a plan to repay federal obligations. He also advocates restoring specie payments and ending the use of small-denomination paper notes.

The message reviews land, pension, patent, military, naval, and postal affairs, including proposed reductions in Army spending. It reports on treaties, mediation efforts, and disputes involving countries in the Americas, Europe, and Asia, while supporting possible territorial acquisitions. Finally, the President proposes constitutional amendments for direct election of the President, Vice-President, and senators; presidential succession; and limited terms for federal judges.

The speaker called the game disappointing, citing too many mistakes and a slow start after time off. They also noted positives, including drawing penalties, maintaining composure and a mostly good power play.
The Manischewitz Company invited Adam Sandler to write a Passover song, offering him a product-stocked hotel suite for inspiration and free products for life if he accepts.

Prime Minister Andrew Holness said Jamaica will intensify efforts against crime by splitting the police’s western operational area in two and stationing a Jamaica Defence Force battalion in Montego Bay. The Government also plans legislation for long-term security operations in high-crime areas, including searches for guns, contraband and criminals. Holness said Jamaica has invested in maritime border control and sought international assistance, but must solve its own crime problem.

Idera Pharmaceutical shares fell 5.81% in the most recent session and closed at $1.62. Three analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $4.67, ranging from $4 to $5. The passage reports two Buy and four Outperform recommendations, with none at Hold, Underperform or Sell. Idera’s 14-period average true range was 0.1, and its relative strength index was 38.63. Its market capitalization was $346.31 million, with 213.77 million shares outstanding.

Personal financial planning spans more than investments, including cash flow, risk, taxes, retirement and health care. The passage urges readers to assess four factors: whether their financial beliefs are biased, whether they recognize gaps in their knowledge and seek help, how regularly they review their plans, and how well they adapt to change. Greater self-awareness and objectivity can support better financial decisions.

U.S. NAVCENT commander Vice Admiral Kevin M Donegan met Pakistan’s naval chief to discuss naval cooperation and Indian Ocean security. He praised Exercise AMAN-17 and Pakistan Navy’s maritime security role.

The passage describes container patterns for distributed systems. **Ambassador containers** route application requests to sharded storage, broker connections across environments, or split traffic for experiments while applications connect through localhost. **Adapter containers** give heterogeneous applications consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks without modifying their images.

For multi-node systems, replicated load-balanced services improve availability and scale; readiness probes identify instances able to serve requests. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharded services divide data among machines, using routing keys and hashing functions; replicating shards improves resilience. Scatter/gather systems distribute work across nodes and combine their results, though overhead and slow or failed nodes can limit performance.

The passage also compares microservices with monoliths and discusses function-as-a-service. Microservices allow independent development and scaling but complicate debugging and design. Functions simplify deployment and automatic scaling, while their decoupling, limited suitability for long-running work or memory-heavy applications, and sustained-request costs create trade-offs.

Amazon’s compensation committee approved a one-year leave of absence for Senior Vice President Jeffrey M. Blackburn beginning in the first quarter of 2020. Forfeiture of his restricted stock unit awards will be suspended during the leave.

Ali Allouche, a 17-year-old undergoing treatment for bone cancer, has begun a food-focused trip across the United States with his mother, Jennifer Danko. Inspired by Anthony Bourdain’s “Parts Unknown,” they will travel in stages around his treatment schedule. Bourdain has offered to help, and a fundraiser for travel and meals has raised $31,400 toward a $35,000 goal. Danko says planning the trips has given them something to look forward to.

Laboratory tests of 25 ultra-high-frequency detector modules for the Simons Observatory measured more than 36,000 transition-edge sensors. The modules met requirements for yield, optical efficiency, and noise. Nineteen modules will be installed in the observatory’s telescopes in Chile: 13 have already been deployed, with six more planned for an upgrade.
The White House said U.S.–North Korean talks at the demilitarized zone have been positive and it expects the Trump–Kim summit to take place on June 12.

The article argues that mining stocks’ weak response to gold’s rally signals a potential broader decline. It also points to a bullish pattern in the U.S. Dollar Index and bearish signals for stocks. A reader comment disputes the analysis.

The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to temporarily withhold $4 billion in foreign aid while Congress considers a request to rescind the funds. In the consolidated lawsuits, which include the American Bar Association as a plaintiff, the Court said its emergency ruling was preliminary, not a final decision on the merits. Justice Elena Kagan dissented, joined by Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Ketanji Brown Jackson, arguing that the Court should not resolve such consequential, unsettled issues through an emergency application.

Grove Academy, Slough’s first all-through school, expects to move from its temporary site to the Chalvey Community Centre and Chalvey Early Years Centre site within two to three years. The centres will be temporarily housed nearby before receiving new premises in Ladbroke Road. The school will not be built on Chalvey Recreation Ground. Its designs await planning approval.

The free Fantastic Fountain Square Home Tour will take place June 16–17, 2018, from noon to 5 p.m. in Indianapolis. Visitors can tour newly built homes on Woodlawn, Cottage and Laurel streets. Maps, guided tours, food and prizes will be available.

Erik Demaine presents a cell-probe lower bound for dynamic connectivity: inserting or deleting edges and querying connectivity requires logarithmic time per operation in the worst case, even when every component is a path. The proof represents paths as perfect matchings between columns of vertices and reduces connectivity to verifying compositions of permutations. It uses a bit-reversal operation sequence and a balanced tree over time. An information-theoretic argument shows that queries must access information written by earlier updates; a separator encoding extends the argument from computing a composition to verifying one. The resulting bound matches the logarithmic performance of dynamic-tree data structures.

In Sparkman v. Brown, the court held that a cash-sale buyer who took possession without paying did not acquire title. Because the defendant neither paid nor tendered payment and there was no evidence the seller waived the cash requirement, the directed verdict for the plaintiff was affirmed.

An April 10 news digest centers on Enron’s dispute with Maharashtra over unpaid bills for power from its Dabhol plant. Dabhol issued a political force majeure notice, while India’s government agreed to seek conciliation. Other reports cover E.ON’s planned takeover of Powergen, American Airlines’ acquisition of TWA assets, and a Houston board’s choice of Montgomery Watson over Enron affiliate Azurix for water-plant contract negotiations.

After Vernon Clausing’s medical license was revoked, he continued distributing prescription-only drugs through his clinic and from his home. A jury convicted him of unlawful delivery and possession with intent to deliver legend drugs. On appeal, Clausing challenged the jury instructions, charging document, admission of testimony, and prosecutor’s closing remarks. The court held that the instructions accurately distinguished dispensing drugs, which requires a licensed practitioner, from delivering drugs lawfully prepared for a patient with a valid prescription. It found the charging document sufficient and the remaining instructions proper. Any error in admitting testimony about the validity of prescriptions issued before license revocation was harmless, and the prosecutor’s remarks were not misconduct. The convictions were affirmed.

After adopting a mission to democratize financial services, PayPal discovered that many of its own hourly and entry-level employees struggled financially. A 2019 survey found that nearly two-thirds of customer service respondents ran out of, or nearly ran out of, money between paychecks.

PayPal launched an Employee Financial Wellness Initiative that raised wages where appropriate, reduced U.S. healthcare premiums, granted stock to employees who had not previously received it, and offered financial coaching. A subsequent survey showed improved financial wellness and a higher share of respondents intending to stay at PayPal. Customer service turnover fell from 19.4% in 2019 to 7.3% in 2020. PayPal later added access to earned wages before payday and sought to encourage other companies to assess their workers’ financial wellness.

In 34 patients undergoing thalamic deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery, researchers recorded local field potentials and hand tremor to assess neural signals that might support self-adjusting stimulation. Low-frequency signal power correlated moderately with tremor, while coherence between neural signals and hand acceleration correlated strongly. Neural signals identified postural tremor with an area under the curve of approximately 0.7, including during DBS. High-frequency stimulation reduced low-frequency signal power. Computational modeling showed that electrode location and the distribution and proportion of tremor-related cells substantially affected simulated signal power, potentially contributing to differences between participants.

A review of 73 sources examines how climate-related displacement affects K–12 learners in lower- and middle-income countries. Disasters, economic hardship, and health effects disrupt education in learners’ home regions; after relocation, costs, enrollment rules, discrimination, and limited support create further barriers. Girls face additional pressures from household responsibilities and gender bias. The study calls for sustained financial assistance, simpler enrollment, academic and mental health support, gender-sensitive policies, and more research on long-term outcomes.

The passage introduces **popular dimension**, the minimum number of matchings needed in a set that is at least as popular as any alternative matching. It proves that the dimension is 2 for house allocation in all cases, 1 for marriage with unweighted agents and strict preferences, and 2 for roommates under those same conditions. When weights or preference ties are allowed, the dimension for marriage and roommates is between 2 and 3; determining the exact value remains open. Polynomial-time algorithms establish the stated upper bounds.

Industrial simulations and data analysis are becoming more complex, increasing demand for computing power and forcing some manufacturers to trade accuracy for speed. In an IDC survey of 200 industrial decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, 81% viewed high-performance computing (HPC) as a game changer for product and process innovation. Respondents expected demand for high-performance calculations to rise substantially over the next two years.

HPC can accelerate calculations, support more detailed analysis, and enable new products and services. Its challenges include security, costs, energy use, limited capacity, and shortages of expertise. Many surveyed enterprises use or plan to use external infrastructure. IDC identifies public-cloud and hybrid HPC as ways to improve scalability and flexibility, while noting that cloud use still requires skilled personnel. It recommends choosing an operating model based on each enterprise’s needs and establishing a shared data strategy.

President Buhari said Nigerians were reporting improved electricity supply, but his hometown of Daura was experiencing a 10-day blackout after a windstorm toppled a power tower and 16 poles. A former state official said businesses were closing during Ramadan. The local electricity distributor said repairs were underway and promised restoration within 48 hours. Infrastructure damage has also caused prolonged outages elsewhere.

The passage describes two all-optical thermometry models that use photoluminescence from silicon-vacancy centers and Raman signals from fluorescent diamonds. Trained on measurements from a subset of eight diamonds at 25–85 °C, the models predict temperatures for previously unseen diamonds. Multi-feature regression achieved 1.7 K accuracy with seven training diamonds, about 26% better than the best single-feature model. A two-stage model achieved 0.7 K accuracy and 0.6 K·Hz⁻¹/² resolution with seven diamonds and seven temperature set points, but required more calibration data. Both models select useful spectral features automatically. The authors caution that predictions outside the calibrated temperature range may be unreliable.

In *Mock v. Watson*, the court affirmed an order setting apart a widow’s interest in her deceased husband’s land despite debts against his estate. It held that her statutory interest attaches during marriage when the husband possesses the land and is not subject to his estate’s debts. Provisions allowing land sales to pay debts apply only to the estate’s interest, not the widow’s.

April 27 news reports say Dabhol Power Company’s board authorised management to issue a notice to terminate its power purchase agreement with the Maharashtra State Electricity Board, but no notice had been issued. The decision followed disputes over unpaid bills, penalties and power tariffs. MSEB paid Rs 134 crore toward its March bill under protest. Maharashtra sought renegotiation, while lenders differed over termination.

A self-driving Uber vehicle struck and killed Elaine Herzberg, 49, as she walked outside a crosswalk in Tempe, Arizona, on Sunday night. The vehicle was in autonomous mode with a human operator behind the wheel. Uber suspended testing in the U.S. and Canada and said it was cooperating with police.

After the September 11 attacks, U.S. energy companies evacuated offices, halted much of their trading and increased security at power plants, pipelines and refineries. Electricity, gas and refined-product deliveries generally continued. Oil and gasoline prices rose amid fears of supply disruption, while the New York Mercantile Exchange remained closed on September 12. Enron said it would resume North American gas and power trading that day by phone and online until noon Houston time. Separate reports covered security precautions at Enron’s Indian operations and a payment dispute that was limiting its Dabhol unit’s ability to repay debt and maintain its idle plant.
HDFC Mutual Fund plans to wind up HDFC FMP 378D March 2014 (1), subject to unit-holder approval. Its assets fell below Rs 10 crore after a second maturity extension, making it unviable to manage.

The passage describes the quarterback as the leader of a football offense who handles the ball on every play, communicates plays, adjusts to defenses, and passes, runs, or hands off the ball. It emphasizes preparation, decision-making, accuracy, leadership, footwork, athleticism, and arm strength as valuable skills. Quarterbacks’ body types and responsibilities have evolved, but their central role in moving the offense and protecting the football remains. The passage also highlights Otto Graham, Peyton Manning, Dan Marino, Joe Montana, and Tom Brady as notable quarterbacks.

Josephine Slosson’s will validly exercised a power of appointment over a trust fund established by her father. Because she disposed of the fund by will, her children could not elect to take under their grandfather’s will, and the beneficiaries’ interests were subject to transfer tax. Payments from the fund to her creditors were also taxable. The court modified the tax order to exclude $682.04 that Alice Slosson had advanced to pay creditors, and otherwise affirmed it.

Thai Prime Minister Prayuth Chan-ocha said Thailand has no trade with North Korea and complies with U.N. resolutions. His remarks came ahead of a U.S. envoy’s visit to Bangkok to discuss increasing pressure over North Korea’s weapons programs. The United States had previously urged Thailand to close North Korean companies operating there.

Carol Christ, 73, is UC Berkeley’s first woman chancellor. A former Berkeley professor and administrator who later led Smith College, she takes office amid sexual harassment scandals, free speech disputes, a student housing shortage, a $110 million budget deficit and scrutiny of UC finances. Christ says she will prioritize the low share of Black students, foster discussions across groups about sexual harassment, and organize debates between speakers with differing views. She plans to work with Berkeley and Oakland on housing, homelessness and safety, while pursuing philanthropy and administrative cuts to reduce the deficit. She also hopes to restore a sense of community on campus.

The UC1825B-SP is a high-frequency PWM controller for current- or voltage-mode power supplies. It supports input voltage feed-forward and includes current limiting, shutdown, soft start, undervoltage lockout, and high-current totem-pole outputs.

A soccer penalty kick is a shot from the penalty mark, 12 yards from goal, awarded for certain fouls by defenders in their own penalty area. The kicker must be identified, wait for the referee’s signal and kick the stationary ball forward. The goalkeeper must remain on the goal line until the kick, while other players stay outside the penalty area and arc.

The passage advises coaches to select prepared, confident kickers in advance and train them regularly. Kickers should develop a consistent routine, prioritize accuracy and sufficient pace, manage distractions and practice under game-like conditions. Lower corners are generally recommended targets. If the goalkeeper blocks the shot, the kicker may play the rebound; if it rebounds from the post or crossbar, another player must touch it first.

Zimbabwean nurse and epidemiologist Chenai Mathabire received an International AIDS Society prize for research showing that a rapid tuberculosis test could be used at health centers in Malawi and Mozambique. Her team found that the urine-based test produced results in less than an hour, could be administered after a few hours of staff training and could allow HIV-positive patients with TB to begin treatment the same day. Conventional tests often took days or longer, delaying care for patients who could struggle to return to clinics. Some Doctors Without Borders health centers adopted rapid testing after the findings were published. Mathabire continues to work for the organization.

Options expiry is when a contract becomes void. In the US, the passage places expiration on the third Saturday of the month, with trading usually ending the preceding Friday. It reports slightly higher volatility on expiry days, particularly quarterly “quad witching” days. Its stock and ETF backtests—not options backtests—report an average 0.3% gain for SPY during expiration weeks, 0.7% per trade for an XLV strategy, 0.46% for an overnight SPY strategy, and 0.18% per trade for an expiry-day SPY short strategy.

The passage includes comments on a playoff game, with players discussing a strong opponent, an improved first period and time to catch up. Another speaker describes moving from Toronto to Detroit, praises the team effort—including contributions from its five Russian players—and thanks Jimmy Devellano and Scotty Bowman for the opportunity. The speaker says Detroit improved throughout the playoffs and won the Stanley Cup series in four straight games.

A study tracking 33,908 Norwegian adults for 11 years found that those who did not exercise were 44 percent more likely to experience depression than those exercising one to two hours weekly. Researchers estimated that small amounts of exercise could have prevented 12 percent of reported depression cases.
Irish soccer player Megan Connolly posted a video of her frightening ride in Myrtle Beach. The clip went viral, drawing reactions from teammates and friends.

Accepting the Democratic presidential nomination, the speaker thanks his supporters and pledges to uphold the party platform, including civil and economic rights. He says his religious affiliation will not influence his public decisions and asks voters to judge him on the issues. He criticizes Richard Nixon and Republican leadership while arguing that Democrats must offer more than attacks. Citing international tensions and domestic problems involving farming, housing, racial discrimination, health care and automation, he calls for a new generation of leadership. His “New Frontier” is a call for courage, innovation and sacrifice to meet challenges in science, peace and poverty, and to demonstrate that a free society can compete with communism.

Provincial Liberal leader Andrew Wilkinson blamed Premier John Horgan’s taxes for higher gas prices and called for a lower gas tax. Horgan said a nine-cent overnight increase reflected company profits, not taxation, and called for examining prices and expanding domestic refining.

Google is adding three phones to its Project Fi service: the $199 moto G6, $740 LG G7 ThinQ and $899 LG V35 ThinQ. Fi uses cellular networks and Wi-Fi, charging $20 monthly for calls and texts plus $10 per gigabyte of data up to 6GB, without charging for unused data. Its limited phone selection, which excludes iPhones and Samsung phones, may constrain growth. Google has not disclosed how many customers use Fi.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 27, 2022, reporting that it had issued a press release about its fourth-quarter financial results for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022. The press release is attached as an exhibit.

The court affirmed a judgment denying the Wilson appellants damages from a head-on collision. The jury found that Wilson negligently drove into King’s lane and that this was the sole proximate cause of the collision. The appellants’ challenges to the jury instructions were waived because they made no timely objections or proper requests. Their challenge to opposing counsel’s argument also failed because they did not object when it was made, and any harm could have been cured by an instruction.

Plymouth Studio School is expected to close after the summer term in 2018, subject to government approval. The sports-focused school has 155 students despite being built for 300, making it financially unviable, according to MP Johnny Mercer. A recent Ofsted inspection rated it “inadequate.” The local authority is consulting on support for affected families and alternative school places.

North Tyneside’s cabinet unanimously backed moving ahead with a devolution deal for Newcastle, Northumberland and North Tyneside. The proposed authority would receive £600m over 30 years and could bring 10,000 jobs. Mayor Norma Redfearn said councils south of the Tyne could ask to join after it is established. Newcastle’s leader rejected concerns that the authority would be under-powered, citing its investment per resident and provisions for health, housing and disability support. If approved, the authority is expected to form in summer 2018, with a mayoral election in May 2019.

NVIDIA describes Blackwell power-saving features that can reduce power use by up to 50% during small-language-model inference. DLSS 4 adds Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three frames per rendered frame, and transformer-based models intended to improve image quality and stability. Blackwell also supports neural shaders for applications including texture compression, lighting, materials, skin and faces. The passage lists specifications for the GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs and their GeForce RTX 50-series products. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability under the conditions described.

The speaker says coach Bylsma restored the team’s confidence and that a successful road trip followed by trades marked a turning point. They hope to win a ring. They praise Sid for leading through his play and commitment to the team’s system, and Jordan for contributing offensively and defensively. They also credit other talented players for their effort and leadership, and call the organization’s continued success remarkable despite losing significant players after a cup run.

David Levine assigns Mankiw chapter 10 and homework on how monetary and fiscal policy shift the IS and LM curves, including examples from recent economic events. Three optional articles examine France’s contested 35-hour workweek, a Latin American stock-market rally amid hopes for renewed growth, and Japan’s economic slump. The Japan article attributes the slump chiefly to unresolved bad loans and policy mistakes, and argues that lasting recovery requires structural reform.

The May 23 newsclips focus on a dispute over Enron’s Dabhol Power Company electricity contract with Maharashtra. Renegotiation panel chairman Madhav Godbole resigned after Sharad Pawar criticized the panel’s approach; Chief Minister Vilasrao Deshmukh refused to accept his resignation, and a meeting was cancelled. Dabhol had issued a preliminary termination notice amid disputes over unpaid bills and power tariffs. The articles also report risks to Indian lenders, Enron’s valuation of its India businesses, and the central government’s decision to await conciliation proceedings.

The International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons won the 2017 Nobel Peace Prize for highlighting the humanitarian consequences of nuclear weapons and advancing a treaty to prohibit them. The UN treaty was adopted in July with support from 122 nations, but the five nuclear-armed permanent members of the Security Council did not join the negotiations. The Nobel Committee cited the continuing threat of nuclear weapons, while ICAN said the prize would help raise awareness of the treaty.

Assembly Republican Leader Chad Mayes stands by his vote to extend California’s cap-and-trade program, saying it showed Republicans could address climate change and helped prevent stricter regulations. He regrets missing the bill-signing ceremony, which he attributes to a scheduling conflict. Conservative critics say he betrayed party principles and helped Democrats, and Republican groups have called for his resignation as leader. Assemblyman Jay Obernolte is challenging him for the post, which only the caucus can take from him. Other Republicans who supported the bill have also faced criticism, raising questions about future bipartisan cooperation on climate policy.

Pragyan ’18 began on March 1 with an inauguration featuring aerospace engineer Dr BN Suresh. The festival included guest lectures, workshops, a human library, technology exhibits and performances. Exhibits included Hyperloop India, InMoov and KalamSat. Pragyan also held technology outreach and social responsibility events throughout the year.

The court granted Arthur Heine’s motion to dismiss a bigamy indictment. Although his first marriage remained valid, the court held that his second marriage, performed by a justice of the peace when he was 19, was invalid under New York’s Domestic Relations Law.

The University of Maine canceled its annual floating offshore wind summit, citing changing federal policies and priorities. After a $12.5 million federal grant was suspended, the university launched an experimental turbine. It has no plans to revive the summit but plans private meetings.

The passage describes the Santa Claus rally as stronger stock-market performance around Christmas and the turn of the year. Its backtests report positive average returns for the S&P 500, German and European stock ETFs, an emerging-markets fund, and India’s NIFTY 50 index. It notes that returns have weakened in some recent periods and that past results do not guarantee future performance. Christmas Day is not a US trading day; trading on surrounding days depends on the calendar.

Darfon America showcased upgrades to its H200 and H300 energy storage systems and H5001 hybrid inverter at Intersolar North America 2018. The H200 adds battery options and capacity of up to 30kWh; the H300 is now available in a 10kWh configuration. The H5001 adds security and installation improvements. All three models have upgraded inverter fans and improved handling of in-rush overload. They are available through authorized distributors.

Mary Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell and Shimon Sakaguchi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine for work on regulatory T cells, which prevent the immune system from attacking the body. When these cells fail, autoimmune disease or harmful inflammation can result. Brunkow and Ramsdell also traced a fatal autoimmune disease in male mice to a mutation.

Drew Doughty said his team is not discouraged by two straight losses, having dealt with adversity before. He said the opponents are executing their system better, so his team must adjust, get in front of the goalie and pursue rebounds. He acknowledged that thoughts of family, friends and the Cup distracted some players before a game, but said they would be better prepared. He cited the Cup’s return as motivation and praised his communication and relationship with Rob.

The passage describes component choices for a TPS7H500x-SP push-pull converter. To reduce GaN FET reverse-conduction losses, the design uses approximately 25 ns of dead time. It also specifies roughly 50 ns of leading-edge blanking, a 7.5 ms soft-start, a 2.5 transformer turns ratio, and a 40 µH primary inductance.
