The selected GaN FET ratings are 170 V for the primary switches and 80 V for the synchronous rectifiers.

The design uses a 0.47 µH output inductor and approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance, including additional capacitance for radiation-induced transients. Cycle-by-cycle current limiting begins at roughly 35 A, and Type 2A compensation targets a 10 kHz crossover frequency. The passage also gives power-supply and PCB-layout guidance to reduce noise and switching losses, followed by documentation, revision, packaging, and disclaimer information.

The speaker is excited to play in a hostile environment in his hometown but says the team must stay focused and treat it like any other road game. He feels confident at the net, credits his teammates’ play, and expects Edmonton to be ready.

The Federal Reserve raised short-term interest rates by a quarter point to a range of 1% to 1.25%, its third increase since December. It upgraded its forecasts for economic growth and unemployment this year but lowered its inflation forecast to 1.6%. The Fed also plans to begin reducing its $4.5 trillion in holdings later this year, initially by $10 billion a month, if the economy develops as expected. Most Fed officials anticipate at least one more rate increase this year.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2019, reports second-quarter net sales of $63.4 billion, up 20% from a year earlier, and net income of $2.6 billion. For the first six months, net sales were $123.1 billion and net income was $6.2 billion. AWS second-quarter sales rose 37% to $8.4 billion. Operating cash flow for the six months was $11.0 billion, while investing activities used $15.7 billion. Amazon reported $191.4 billion in assets at June 30, 2019.

Volkswagen’s U.S. unit asked a Virginia judge to delay its first consumer fraud trial for at least six months, arguing that a lawyer’s comments in a Netflix documentary linking the company’s monkey diesel-fume tests to Hitler and the Holocaust could prejudice jurors. The lawyer, who represents more than 300 diesel owners, called the motion a delaying tactic. The trial concerns a man who bought a 2014 diesel Jetta. About 2,000 owners opted out of Volkswagen’s 2016 settlement, and most are pursuing additional compensation.

The passage describes a device with an ARM Cortex-A8 subsystem and a C674x DSP. The ARM subsystem includes an interrupt controller, clock controller, trace support, and connections to DDR memory and other modules. The DSP has configurable caches and memory, eight functional units, and instructions for arithmetic, multimedia, and signal-processing operations. A system MMU remaps DSP memory accesses and can optionally handle selected EDMA transfers.

Other modules provide video acceleration, face detection, interprocessor mailboxes, and hardware spinlocks. The passage also outlines memory maps, package pins, multiplexed boot and peripheral functions, reset behavior, and power-supply requirements.

NATO’s 2017 annual report shows increased defense spending and deployments, Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg said. The alliance deployed multinational battle groups to the Baltic states and Poland, strengthened its Black Sea presence and cyber defenses, and welcomed Montenegro as its 29th member. Stoltenberg cited Russia’s military activities and the Salisbury nerve-agent attack as major concerns, while saying NATO does not seek a new Cold War. He also said NATO plans to expand its training mission in Afghanistan and launch a new training mission in Iraq.

Scalping seeks small profits from price changes over seconds or minutes. The passage argues that most scalpers lose money because they face better-equipped competitors, market noise, slippage, and transaction costs. It says short-term backtests may not reflect real trading, while automation is necessary but introduces risks. The authors recommend seeking strategies on longer time frames or considering diversified long-term investing instead.

Becton, Dickinson has paid dividends since 1962 and increased them by more than 10% in 12 of the past 13 years. The passage projects continued dividend growth, citing fiscal 2017 GAAP earnings guidance of $7.90–$8.00 per share and a falling dividend payout ratio. It says costs from the 2015 CareFusion merger temporarily reduced profits, while a favorable court ruling boosted first-quarter 2017 earnings. Identified risks include manufacturing problems, higher interest rates and competing products. The author discloses a long position in BDX.

James Madison returns a bill funding roads, canals, and waterway improvements without his signature. He argues that Congress’s enumerated powers, including those over interstate commerce and the general welfare, do not authorize the projects, and that state consent cannot grant Congress that power. Although he recognizes their potential benefits, he says the Constitution’s division of federal and state powers must be preserved and suggests obtaining the necessary authority through constitutional amendment.

Density functional theory calculations examined three previously unstudied o-MAX phases, Mo₂A₂AlC₃ (A = Zr, Nb, Ta). Negative formation energies, phonon spectra and elastic constants indicate chemical, dynamic and mechanical stability. The compounds are metallic, brittle and mechanically anisotropic, with mixed ionic, covalent and metallic bonding. Mo₂Nb₂AlC₃ has the highest calculated stiffness, fracture toughness and Vickers hardness; Mo₂Ta₂AlC₃ has the lowest calculated minimum thermal conductivity. Their thermal properties and reflectivity suggest potential applications as thermal barrier coatings and solar heat-shielding layers.

The passage argues that Celtic’s Ibrox victory showed their superiority over Rangers. It says Rangers manager Mark Warburton has made mistakes but has not received the financial backing promised by Dave King. Celtic’s Champions League income and successful signings, including Moussa Dembele and Scott Sinclair, have widened the gap. The writer urges King to fund Rangers and Celtic to invest while ahead, both to compete more effectively in Europe and to extend their domestic lead.

QuantifiedStrategies.com offers free articles, videos, and courses on trading strategies, indicators, backtesting, and seasonal trading. It emphasizes backtested results, statistics, and data rather than opinions, and provides resources for beginners and experienced traders.

The passage describes methods for managing the reduced processing time available with short or configurable transmission time intervals in wireless communications. A wireless device may report its processing capabilities, limit timing advance, and report when its processing needs approach those capabilities. It may also defer or omit uplink transmissions when insufficient processing time is available. The passage further describes example wireless networks, devices, and timing procedures.

The report examines the global silyl modified polymer market’s historical, current and projected revenue, growth, trends and competitive landscape. It covers major manufacturers, regional markets, product types and applications, including construction and automotive uses. It also assesses market drivers, risks, production, pricing and investment feasibility, drawing on primary and secondary research.

The passage proposes a philosophical framework for ethical generative AI use in education. Drawing on Anders and Foucault, it examines how technology can shape human agency, power, and perceptions of truth, while noting AI’s potential errors and biases. Freire’s humanizing education and Arendt’s concept of action supplement Bloom’s taxonomy to assess not only what students learn, but why they use AI. The framework favors critical AI use that helps students reflect, engage with others, and act meaningfully over use limited to completing tasks. Classroom examples include researching local politics and developing student-directed research. The authors call for continued pedagogical adaptation and research into difficult ethical cases.

India’s trucking industry is expected to change substantially by 2027 as population growth, urbanisation, stricter emissions standards and a proposed Goods and Services Tax reshape demand and long-distance transport. Trucks are expected to become larger, faster, more powerful, connected and efficient, though this will require major infrastructure investment. Government policy remains unpredictable, while electric and self-driving trucks are described as decades away from India’s roads.
Tesla reported that Jerome Guillen, its President of Heavy Trucking, departed the company on June 3, 2021. The Form 8-K was signed on June 7 by Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn.

The passage describes a device that uses a processor, streaming engines, and a matrix multiplication accelerator to perform computational primitives. The streaming engines deliver data from memory, while the accelerator formats inputs and outputs and uses buffered load, store, and execute operations. Examples include matrix and vector operations, convolution, Fourier and cosine transforms, correlation, and permutations. The passage also describes configurations for different data sizes and notes that processor and buffer designs may vary.

Cowen shares rose 19 percent after CEFC China agreed to buy a roughly 20 percent stake for $100 million and provide $175 million in debt financing. CEFC will appoint three directors; the deal requires regulatory and government approvals.

Apple narrowly overtook Samsung in fourth-quarter smartphone sales, selling 77 million iPhones to Samsung’s 76.8 million, according to Gartner. Holiday demand helped Apple, while Samsung’s Galaxy Note7 recall hurt its sales and brand. Samsung could regain the lead after launching a new flagship phone in March; Apple is expected to unveil new iPhones in September. Samsung remained ahead for the full year. Huawei, Oppo and BBK ranked third through fifth in the fourth quarter, as Chinese brands gained ground at home and expanded abroad.
An 80-year-old man was treated on the floor at Gujranwala DHQ Hospital because no beds were available. Separately, local PML-N workers celebrated Yaum-e-Takbeer and praised Nawaz Sharif.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU uses the Ampere architecture to accelerate AI, HPC, and data analytics workloads. Its third-generation Tensor Cores support additional data types, while structured sparsity can double Tensor Core throughput. Compared with the V100, the A100 has more memory bandwidth, a larger L2 cache, and higher NVLink bandwidth. Multi-Instance GPU technology partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances for separate workloads. PCIe Gen 4, improved error handling, asynchronous copy and barriers, and CUDA task graph acceleration support multi-GPU scaling and application efficiency.

Gunmen attacked U.N. peacekeeping sites in Timbuktu and Douentza, Mali, on Monday, killing nine people and wounding eight. U.N. forces killed six attackers in Timbuktu and two in Douentza. The U.N. is investigating whether the attacks were connected. Mission chief Mahamat Saleh Annadif called them terrorist acts.

The Treasury Department recommended easing several Obama-era financial regulations, including a requirement to disclose CEO-to-worker pay gaps. Its proposals would simplify rules for public offerings and derivatives and let small companies raise more through crowdfunding without going public. Supporters say the changes could encourage growth, while critics warn that weakening post-crisis safeguards could increase financial risks. Some proposals require congressional action, but many could be implemented by regulators.

The National Institute of Standards and Technology now recommends long, memorable passwords instead of complicated ones with special characters or regular expiration dates. Adviser Paul Grassi says longer passwords are harder to break, while older rules frustrated users without substantially improving security. Password managers remain useful but are not necessary, he says.

The passage argues that LLMs can mimic and sometimes predict human responses, but their outputs are not reliable samples from human populations or calibrated Bayesian beliefs. Order sensitivity, low response variance, subgroup errors, and limited generalization can undermine synthetic-agent research. It recommends treating agents as task-specific predictors, validating them against human data, stress-testing their limits, and fully disclosing simulation methods.

Arizona ammunition dealer Douglas Haig was charged with manufacturing armor-piercing bullets without a license after unfired bullets bearing his fingerprints were found in the Las Vegas shooter’s hotel room. Records do not say whether they were used in the attack, which killed 58 people. Haig said he sold the gunman 720 tracer rounds beforehand, noticed nothing suspicious and had no role in the shooting.

Raja Jackson, son of former MMA fighter Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, faces felony and misdemeanor battery charges after allegedly attacking wrestler Stuart Smith at an August event in Los Angeles. Smith reported serious head and jaw injuries, a cut lip and lost teeth. Jackson was arrested in September and faces up to four years in prison on the felony charge, with prosecutors expected to seek a sentencing enhancement.

A study of 71 Anganwadi centers in rural Mewat, India, found widespread gaps in preschool infrastructure, hygiene, learning resources and worker preparation. Only 23 centers had safe building structures, and three had functional toilets and clean drinking water. Many workers lacked the required educational qualification or knowledge of child development, and most relied on repetition and memorization rather than activity-based teaching. The authors recommend improving facilities and learning resources, training Anganwadi workers, engaging parents and communities, and strengthening monitoring to improve equity in early childhood education.

In the final “Friday Burrito” of 2000, Gary Ackerman argues that the electricity industry should focus its public message on consumers’ concerns about rising bills. He discusses California’s power prices, utility credit problems, SCE’s call for re-regulation, and the CPUC’s decision to reconsider rate-stabilization applications. He reports that Energy Secretary Richardson ordered additional power sales to California and that WPTF supported a Power Exchange emergency filing. The newsletter also announces a February WPTF meeting and closes with a holiday message.

Static benchmarks and potential training-data contamination make it difficult to assess how AI models will perform on unforeseen tasks. The passage calls for dynamically generated evaluations with adjustable difficulty and analysis of individual capabilities, alongside assessments of cultural values and safety. It presents DyVal as a framework that uses directed acyclic graphs to generate varied, computable test samples with known answers for tasks such as mathematical and logical reasoning.

The passage lists silicon issues in the AMD Geode CS5535 Revision A3. Detailed examples include PIT and DMA deviations, a debug port that hangs the system, UART accesses that fail during certain DMA modes, and PCI I/O addresses at or above 10000h that can cause hangs. It also describes missed PIC interrupts, USB over-voltage protection requirements, PRD prefetch hazards, and UDMA write CRC errors after certain host terminations. Recommended measures include avoiding affected features or access patterns, using external USB protection, defining PRD tables before operations, and enabling UDMA I/O blocking. The ATAC SSMI feature generates an SSMI during DMA but fails to block the IDE I/O; the passage says this has no operational impact.

Micro E-mini Nasdaq 100 futures track the Nasdaq 100 Index at one-tenth the size of E-mini contracts. Traded electronically on CME Globex under the symbol MNQ, each contract is worth $2 per index point, with a minimum outright price movement of 0.25 points, or $0.50. Contracts expire quarterly and are cash-settled. The passage describes a trading strategy and backtest but does not disclose the strategy’s rules. It notes that leverage can magnify losses and that, unlike futures, related CFDs have no fixed expiry.

After Toll bought a Denver home from Mrs. McKenzie, he learned that her two minor daughters owned half of it. Mrs. McKenzie and Casey, the mortgage holder, agreed to perfect his title at their expense. The court held that subsequent probate proceedings gave Toll merchantable title despite departures from their agreement. It affirmed the judgments with modifications: Mrs. McKenzie and Casey must pay specified costs, and Toll must pay the mortgage balance less Casey’s obligations under the agreement, after which Casey must release the trust deed.

Host environments must define an execution environment, then include and call these assembly routines to establish or destroy the stack. The routines execute without a stack; including them in C requires care.

Orthopaedic surgeon Dr Sushrut Babhulkar and Maharashtra veterinary doctors plan to fit a prosthetic limb to Sahebrao, an eight-year-old tiger whose paw was amputated after a poacher’s trap injured it in 2012. They will first assess and treat a painful neuroma, then consider a silicone prosthesis. Babhulkar plans to seek help from Germany’s AO Foundation and use a portable X-ray to minimize the tiger’s stress.

The 6-quart Instant Pot Ultra is on sale for the first time, priced at $120 at Amazon and Sur La Table instead of its usual $150. Compared with the DUO models, it adds customizable temperature, pressure and time settings, cooking-status information, and a quick-release button. Prices may change.

The passage lists 13 suggested uses for hydrogen peroxide, including oral hygiene, hair lightening, cleaning produce and household surfaces, removing stains, soaking feet, treating ear infections, soaking plant seeds, and disinfecting reusable bags. It gives mixing or application instructions for several uses and cautions against frequent mouth rinsing and applying it to fabrics without testing first.

Muhammad Iqbal Khan recalls his son Mashal’s love of learning and their last meeting before he returned to college. Days before his death, Mashal publicly criticized problems at his university. On April 13, a crowd of students chased him, and someone shot him. His father says several people have been arrested. He calls for justice and for students to be able to attend school without fear.

Leveraged ETFs use debt and derivatives to amplify an index’s daily gains and losses; inverse ETFs move against the index. The passage favors short-term trading because costs, daily rebalancing and volatility decay make long-term holding risky. It suggests assessing risk through drawdowns and performance ratios, and managing exposure through diversification and market monitoring. In the cited backtests, leveraged QLD produced higher returns than unleveraged QQQ but suffered substantial drawdowns, including one exceeding 55% in a less robust strategy.

UnitedHealth Group has named Duke Health’s former chief data scientist, Michael Pencina, its chief AI scientist. At Duke, Pencina advocated greater oversight and transparency for health care AI tools and co-founded a group developing standards for their testing and oversight.

Former Trump aide Sebastian Gorka endorsed John McCann in New Jersey’s 5th District Republican congressional primary, citing his support for Trump’s “America First” agenda. McCann faces former Bogota mayor Steve Lonegan, a former Trump critic who now supports him. The winner will face Democratic Rep. Josh Gottheimer in November.

The passage profiles Indian entrepreneurs behind seven app-based startups: Sachin and Binny Bansal’s Flipkart, Vijay Shekhar Sharma’s Paytm, Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal’s Snapdeal, Bhavish Aggarwal’s Ola Cabs, Deepinder Goyal and Pankaj Chaddah’s Zomato, Ritesh Aggarwal’s OYO Rooms, and Shashank ND’s Practo. Their businesses span e-commerce, payments, transport, food services, accommodation and healthcare. The passage presents them as examples of India’s changing entrepreneurial landscape.

For a featured FIFA 18 Ultimate Team Squad Battle, Lewandowski, Robben, Vidal and Kimmich selected 99-rated versions of themselves alongside players including Messi, Brazilian Ronaldo, Vieira, Matthaus, Maldini, Alaba and Neuer.

Accern rated Friday’s coverage of Celyad SA somewhat positive, with a sentiment score of 0.19, but said it was somewhat unlikely to affect the share price in the next few days. Recent analyst ratings were mixed. Celyad shares fell 5.15% on Friday to $60.7025. The Belgium-based company develops stem cell therapies for cardiovascular disease.

The passage describes TLV322x open-drain outputs, which support external pull-ups from 0 to 5.5 V, logic-level translation, and combining multiple outputs. It recommends pull-up currents of 100 µA to 1 mA and warns against shorting an output to a voltage source. It also covers ESD protection, TLV321x power-on reset behavior, comparator propagation delay, and external hysteresis to reduce output chatter. A low-side current-sensing example and layout guidance emphasize supply bypassing and limiting coupling between inputs and outputs. TI states that application guidance must be validated by customers and provides packaging information and resource disclaimers.

This June 4, 2001, collection covers Enron and energy developments. Reports describe Karl Rove’s stock holdings in Enron and other companies, Saudi Arabia’s agreements with nine oil firms on natural-gas projects worth at least $25 billion, and a dispute over Enron’s Dabhol power project in India. Indian and foreign lenders were due to meet as the dispute raised concerns about investment and India’s credit outlook. Other items cover Indian power-sector reforms, criticism of Enron’s performance in Nigeria, a UK gas-electricity trade involving Enron, and electricity deregulation in Japan. Two columns discuss energy consumption and the prospect of falling prices.

Namibia’s defence minister said budget cuts prompted temporary compulsory leave for some soldiers to save on utilities and food while prioritizing training and transport. He said the remaining 70% of troops can respond to threats, those on leave can be recalled, and national sovereignty remains guaranteed.

Kanawha County deputies arrested Zachary Steele, 21, after he allegedly punched his father, stole his parents’ vehicle and fled police. A deputy used a less-lethal bean bag to subdue him. Steele faces domestic battery and fleeing charges.

JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, a longtime Bitcoin critic, said blockchain is real and that stablecoins and JPMorgan’s deposit token have practical uses. He said the bank’s private blockchain could replace some outdated systems, but cautioned that blockchain will not replace everything. Dimon declined to comment on Bitcoin.

Three students obtained breach-of-contract judgments against their school’s former operators and Technology Education Corporation (TEC), which bought the school after the students graduated and filed suit. The Ohio Court of Appeals held that TEC did not assume liability for their claims: the asset purchase terms excluded pre-purchase liabilities, and awareness of the pending suit did not imply an assumption. Continued operation of the school did not make TEC a mere continuation of the seller without evidence of continuity in the corporate entity. The court also found insufficient proof of the students’ underlying claims. It reversed the judgment against TEC and remanded the case.

The passage describes an endpoint agent designed to prevent ransomware from encrypting files. A mini filter driver inserts virtual honeypot files and folders into protected directory listings and redirects attempts to open them to a small set of real honeypot files. The agent monitors file operations, including writes, deletions and renames, and can deny access, terminate a process or issue alerts according to policy. The approach aims to detect ransomware before it modifies users’ files while limiting storage use and disruption.

The passage summarizes safety findings for BNT162b1, BNT162b2, BNT162b2SA, and placebo across study phases. Injection-site reactions and systemic events recorded within seven days were generally mild or moderate and short-lived. Injection-site pain was the most common local reaction; tiredness and headache were the most common systemic events. Phase 1 doses of 10, 20, and 30 µg were well tolerated, but the 100-µg BNT162b1 dose was stopped after Dose 1 because of reactions or systemic events. The 30-µg BNT162b2 dose was selected for Phase 2/3.

Medical problems were mostly mild or moderate, and serious medical problems were uncommon. Researchers considered some serious problems in Phase 2/3 possibly related to BNT162b2, but did not consider the reported serious problems in the Phase 3 BNT162b2SA and lower-dose booster groups vaccine-related. No one died in Phase 1. Deaths occurred in Phase 2/3 from different causes; researchers did not believe BNT162b2 caused them.

One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has announced conditional support for the Government’s media law reforms, potentially ending a political deadlock. The changes would remove restrictions on cross-media ownership and the reach of TV broadcasters. In exchange, the Government has agreed to seek greater transparency of ABC staff wages, investigate its balance and regional commitment, and provide an extra $12 million for community radio. Labor and the Greens oppose the reforms, arguing they would weaken media diversity.

Germany, France, Britain, Spain and Italy warned the Trump administration that provisions in House and Senate tax bills could violate international rules and favor U.S. companies. Their finance ministers objected to taxes on payments to foreign affiliates and cross-border financial transfers, as well as a Senate measure they said could subsidize exports.

U.S. stocks rose after ADP reported 263,000 private-sector jobs added in March, well above expectations. The Nasdaq briefly hit a record high, and all 30 Dow stocks gained. Investors also awaited minutes from the Federal Reserve’s March meeting and a meeting between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Amazon reached a record high, while Panera Bread surged on a $7.16 billion buyout deal.

Students at Atlanta’s Ron Clark Academy danced in a viral video after learning they would see “Black Panther.” Teachers plan to use the film and comics in lessons on imperial history, African art, math, science and gym.

A Research Report Insights analysis projects the global corrugated packaging market to grow at a 4% annual rate from 2014 to 2020, reaching US$173.6 million. It identifies e-commerce, rising shipments, growing end-user industries, low cost and sustainability as growth drivers. Low durability and slow adoption in some industries may restrain growth. The report highlights production in China, India and Japan and says major companies are seeking to expand in emerging markets.

A bibliometric analysis of 2,295 Web of Science publications maps primary science education research using bibliographic coupling and keyword analysis. It identifies themes in digital technology, equity and teacher competence, cognitive support, dialogic teaching, and computational thinking. The study describes a shift toward inquiry-based, student-centered instruction and proposes a framework linking pedagogy, technology, and cultural responsiveness. It recommends broader database coverage, including non-English research, and further study of how these approaches work in diverse classrooms.

The microbiota helps regulate digestion, metabolism and immune responses, and its composition changes over the day. In mice, molecules released by gut microbes altered daily patterns of liver gene activity and the liver’s response to an acetaminophen overdose. Antibiotics or changes in feeding times also changed these patterns. The findings suggest that microbiota rhythms may affect how drugs are processed and could help explain health risks associated with eating at unusual times. Their implications for human treatment and disease prevention remain under investigation.

The Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO), introduced by Tushar Chande, measures momentum using the difference between sums of higher and lower closes divided by their combined sum. It ranges from −100 to +100; readings above +50 indicate overbought conditions and below −50 indicate oversold conditions, though their reliability depends on the trend. Traders can combine CMO signals with trend indicators or use them at support and resistance levels in sideways markets. The passage reports that a nine-day CMO strategy backtested on SPY had strong risk-adjusted returns with a five-day maximum holding period, while longer holding periods reduced returns. It recommends backtesting settings for each strategy and asset.

Under GST, e-way bills will be required to transport goods consignments worth more than Rs50,000; they are optional below that value. The GST Council exempted 153 items, including cooking gas for households, PDS kerosene, jewellery, currency, food items and used household effects. Transport by non-motorised conveyance is also exempt. The requirement will take effect after the permit software is ready, likely by October. E-way bills are intended to help authorities track goods and inter-state commerce and check tax evasion.

Center for Diagnostic Imaging Miami offers imaging and preventive screening services, including X-rays, PET and CT scans, MRI, ultrasound, mammograms, and nuclear medicine. Its Total Body Scan includes CT scans of the head, neck, chest, abdomen, and pelvis, cardiac calcium scoring, and a physician consultation within 24–48 hours. The center also offers screenings for breast, ovarian, and prostate cancer.

Sterling edged up 0.2 percent against the dollar and euro on Tuesday ahead of Britain’s formal launch of EU exit talks on Wednesday. Analysts said the move would be largely symbolic for investors, who were more focused on the EU’s response and Britain’s economy. Stronger inflation and interest-rate expectations have recently supported the pound, but uncertainty over negotiations and a possible Scottish independence referendum remain concerns.

Large multi-omics datasets, public GWAS resources, and computational methods have advanced genetics research. The authors previously derived 2,024 multi-organ AI endophenotypes covering brain patterns, neuroanatomical heterogeneity, and biological age gaps. Their genetic relationships with diseases across organ systems remain largely unexplored. This study uses publicly available UK Biobank, FinnGen, and Psychiatric Genomics Consortium GWAS data to examine the genetic architecture of those endophenotypes and 525 disease endpoints, while comparing statistical methods.

A man on the Cambridge Mill roof surrendered to negotiators after several hours, during which police closed nearby roads and he moved along the roof. He was taken to Cambridge Memorial Hospital for a mental health assessment; charges are pending. Police are investigating items recovered nearby as possibly stolen, while restaurant staff are assessing damage and how he entered the building.

The passage argues that employers’ liability laws should make employers responsible for the unavoidable risks of their industries, including accidents involving federal employees. It also supports compulsory investigation of labor disputes by a federal conciliation and arbitration commission. Citing extensive strikes, lockouts, and losses from 1881 to 1900, it argues that impartial hearings could prevent disputes or help settle them. The commission’s decisions would not be legally binding, but could shape public opinion.

The Massachusetts Court Probation Department seeks clarification on Michelle Carter’s stayed sentence, including how to supervise her during her appeal and what would happen if she violated probation conditions. The motion is scheduled for August 21; Carter is not required to attend.

Energy Central’s January 30, 2002, professional dispatch compiles electric power and gas industry news. Leading stories cover President Bush’s support for withholding Vice President Cheney’s energy task-force records, Enron’s appointment of Stephen Cooper as acting CEO, a proposed joint New York–New England electricity marketplace, and Rhode Island electricity legislation. Other items address Enron investigations, energy markets, utility finances, renewable energy and international developments.

Food scientist Paul Dawson tested how double-dipping affects bacteria in shared dips. Double-dipped chips added about 1,000 more bacteria per milliliter to water than single-dipped chips. Among three dips tested, double-dipped salsa initially had more bacteria than chocolate syrup or cheese dip, though its count fell after two hours. The passage warns that sharing contaminated dip can spread disease.

In 2015, Quest Diagnostics’ two national customer service centers were struggling after a rushed consolidation of 20 regional centers. Many experienced representatives had not relocated, and the new centers inherited inconsistent systems and procedures. High turnover and absenteeism contributed to costly staffing gaps, long waits, transferred calls, and lost customers. Leaders identified step-based pay, career paths, supervisor development, and workforce planning as immediate priorities. Newly hired executive director MaryAnn Camacho began observing calls and speaking with employees while considering how to improve service, operations, and the workplace.

The passage describes SD Memory Card physical interfaces, operating modes, initialization, data transfer and protection features. UHS-I uses a 4-bit SD bus and supports up to 104 MB/s after a successful switch to 1.8 V signaling. UHS-II adds a separate interface with modes up to 624 MB/s and a multistep initialization sequence; compatible cards can also initialize through the SD bus interface. ROM cards are read-only and treat write and erase commands as illegal.

Hosts control communication through commands. Initialization checks voltage compatibility, card capacity and card identity before data transfer. The passage also specifies block reads and writes, erase, discard, write protection and password-based locking. Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password that restricts force erase and password-clearing operations. CMD6 selects functions including bus speed, driver strength and power limit.
Kapil Sibal said he had forgiven Arvind Kejriwal after Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia apologised for baseless allegations against him and his son, which had prompted a defamation suit.

After Hawaii’s king ratified a reciprocity treaty, he sent a commissioner to negotiate a commercial treaty with Japan, which the American minister opposed. In 1868, President Johnson urged Senate attention to reciprocity and anticipated that Hawaiians might voluntarily seek admission to the United States. Reports described growing support for annexation in Honolulu, but domestic reconstruction delayed consideration. A U.S. protest against the importation of laborers failed to curb the trade. In 1871, Minister Henry A. Pierce urged renewed consideration of annexation. President Grant forwarded Pierce’s dispatch to the Senate without taking a position and requested its views.

Two more chances for snow are forecast this week. A storm late Monday night through Tuesday is expected to bring snow, then a wintry mix and rain, before ending with light snow or snow showers. Arctic air follows, with highs mostly in the 20s and 30s and another chance of snow Friday.

Eric Whitcomb, a 49-year-old Circle K cashier, was shot and killed near the Lake Elsinore store early Wednesday at the end of his shift. The cause of the shooting was unknown. Investigators were reviewing surveillance footage, and the gunman remained at large.

Xiao Yan, 23, from Guizhou, China, has congenital melanocytic nevus. After a mole began hurting, doctors planned to remove it and placed four gradually expanding balloons in her face to grow skin for a graft. Her family is raising funds for treatment, expected to continue five more months.
An adapter container can run a representative query and expose an HTTP health check for MySQL without modifying or maintaining the MySQL base image.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020, reports revenue of $5.99 billion, up from $4.54 billion a year earlier. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $16 million, compared with a $702 million loss. At quarter-end, Tesla reported $37.25 billion in assets and $8.08 billion in cash and cash equivalents. Operating activities used $440 million in cash. Tesla reported COVID-19-related production suspensions and delivery challenges, and disclosed ongoing litigation concerning its SolarCity acquisition, Model 3 production, CEO compensation and a potential going-private transaction.

The speaker says the team stayed composed after conceding and benefited from strong individual efforts, including Sergei’s goal. An early scoring chance came when the puck deflected off Kolzig’s foot to Holmer. The team played a solid first period but did not add a second goal.

The Money Flow Index (MFI) combines price and volume to measure money flowing into and out of a security. It ranges from 0 to 100; traders use overbought, oversold and divergence signals to identify potential reversals. Its default lookback is 14 days, but the passage recommends backtesting settings for each market. A reported strategy using MFI signals performed well in backtests on Pepsi and SPY, including a combined 15% annualized return, but performed poorly on gold.

The passage describes systems for recognizing objects in video and images. They select and partition frames, use machine-learning analysis to identify products, and assess recognition accuracy with likelihood metrics. Recognized products can be displayed with product and merchant information in a digital shopping cart, where viewers may review or purchase them. Recognition settings can be adjusted using feedback or accuracy analysis.

A content analysis examined 273 studies on modern physics education in Turkey published from 2000 to 2023. Research was concentrated between 2010 and 2019, focused most often on atoms, and commonly used quantitative designs and undergraduate or high school samples. Studies reported both improvements in learning and persistent misconceptions. Many provided limited information on validity and reliability or insufficient discussion of their findings. The authors recommend broader research methods, larger samples, varied analyses, and more detailed reporting.

The Nanocrystal Glass Market report examines current and future challenges, production costs and processes, pricing, sales, revenue, supply, consumption, trade, and competitors. It includes company profiles, project SWOT and investment feasibility analyses. Firms covered include AGC Asahi Corporation, Glass Apps, Hitachi Chemicals, SmartGlass International Ltd, Pleotint, and RavenBrick. The report segments products into single- and multi-crystal glass and provides consumption figures by type and application.
An infographic reports that 49% of employees are dissatisfied with their recognition and that greater appreciation could improve effort, manager relationships, and retention.
The appellate court affirmed the Spokane County Superior Court judgment.

The passage presents a group-theory and density-functional-theory method for identifying atomic magnetic multipoles in altermagnets. In MnF₂, in-phase octupoles and 32-poles remain after dipoles cancel; in CrSb, the lowest-order uncompensated collinear multipole is a 32-pole. Spin-orbit coupling produces noncollinear spin-density multipoles whose magnitudes grow linearly with its strength. In KMnF₃, fluorine-octahedral rotations induce altermagnetism and an in-phase 32-pole. The authors connect these multipoles to possible macroscopic responses, including piezomagnetism.

President Donald Trump said his administration would use the government shutdown to permanently cut programs popular with Democrats, though he did not identify them. The administration has frozen or canceled funding for infrastructure and climate projects and is considering further clean-energy cuts. The shutdown began Oct. 1 after Congress failed to agree on funding; Democrats are seeking health-care protections in any bill.

The speaker says both teams defend well as units, with goaltending and shot-blocking contributing. Their team has momentum but must work each shift to keep it. Physical play and sound positioning have helped produce wins and turnovers. The opponent’s depth, speed and quick puck movement make matchups difficult. The speaker also notes that finals experience can make daily demands easier to handle and praises a teammate’s size, skill, penalty killing and willingness to do less-noticed work.

Using CiteSpace to analyze literature from 2012 to 2023, the study compared research on open and vocational education in China and other countries. Chinese research increasingly focused on integrating and coordinating the two forms of education after 2016. Research elsewhere emphasized adult vocational skills and, increasingly after 2018, online learning. The study proposes further quantitative research on educational integration and its implications for policy and practice.
Jellyfish blooms have killed significant numbers of farmed salmon at three Galway sites, the Marine Institute says. It is monitoring the situation and says there is no public health risk.

Three men faced federal charges over an ISIS-inspired plot to bomb and shoot people at crowded New York City locations, including Times Square, the subway and concert venues, in summer 2016. The Justice Department said they had pleaded guilty to terror charges. All face possible life sentences if convicted.

The passage describes a system that compares outputs from two or more independent monitoring systems to verify computer-vision-based interactions. In retail, it can compare detected items or shopping activity with data from RFID tags, smart shelves, carts, checkout systems, user applications, or customer profiles. Discrepancies can prompt checkout controls, worker inspections, alerts, operational changes, or updates to the monitoring systems.

The 1-3-1 zone defense pressures passing lanes and can shift to match the ball or create traps. Its vulnerabilities include corner shots and weakside rebounding, though corner passes can also create trapping opportunities. Defenders must move together and anticipate passes. In the basic alignment, the wings cover the sides, a baseline defender covers the corners, and a middle defender protects the area between the ball and basket. A compact “three in a line” variation keeps a big defender near the basket while the wings cover the corners. Traps can be applied at the top or in the corners, and the alignment can extend into half-court or full-court pressure.

The passage describes a screen display method that automatically minimizes other application interfaces when a user operates one interface. It covers both floating windows over a full-screen interface and side-by-side interfaces that switch to full-screen display. Minimized interfaces may appear as floating balls, application icons, contact avatars, or video pop-up windows. Selecting an edit box can trigger minimization, while loss of input focus can restore the previous layout. The method can also position minimized interfaces away from the cursor and handle multiple floating windows.

A cross-sectional study at the University Teaching Hospital of Butare compared lipid profiles of 150 people receiving antiretroviral therapy with 49 HIV-negative controls. Among treated participants, 32% had high triglycerides, 15.3% high total cholesterol, 8% high LDL cholesterol, and 19.3% low HDL cholesterol. The study reported significant differences in lipid profiles between the groups and recommended routine lipid testing to help assess cardiovascular risk.

The passage describes ways to trade Chinese stocks through an international broker or funds such as the liquid FXI ETF. It estimates 7,323 listings across China’s three main exchanges, though some companies may be listed on more than one. It notes political risks and says Chinese stocks have returned little since 2007 despite earlier gains. Three backtested FXI strategies, including two short strategies, produced a combined 431 trades, a 0.5% average gain per trade, a 64% win rate and an 11.5% compound annual growth rate.

Stan Bowman and coach Quenneville credit the players, coaches and organizational stability for reaching the final. They praise Jonathan’s competitiveness and preparation, and the team’s resilience through injuries and losses. Bowman says salary-cap changes will bring new players and larger roles for young players, though the team is focused on its next game against Tampa. They also describe Brad’s improvement at center and emphasize developing young players gradually alongside experienced teammates.

Apple reported second-quarter fiscal 2021 net sales of $89.6 billion, up 54% from a year earlier, and net income of $23.6 billion, up from $11.2 billion. Sales rose across every product and service category and geographic segment. At March 27, 2021, Apple had $337.2 billion in assets and $69.2 billion in shareholders’ equity. It repurchased $19.0 billion of stock during the quarter. COVID-19 continued to affect its stores and operations.

Missouri legislation would let K–12 public school students take online courses at no cost to their families if the governor signs it. The program aims to expand access to courses that small, rural or financially troubled schools may not offer. Schools and the state would oversee course quality, while critics cite poor outcomes at full-time virtual schools and concerns about virtual charter schools.

German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schaeuble urged the European Central Bank and other central banks to follow the U.S. Federal Reserve in moving away from ultra-loose monetary policy, warning it encourages risk-taking and asset bubbles. ECB policymakers said the euro zone outlook had improved but it was not yet time to withdraw support, amid uncertainty over France’s election.

A large teddy bear nicknamed Big Ted visited Warwick East State School on the last day of classes as part of a Blackbird and Finch promotion. Students and staff cuddled the bear, which also appeared at local events and the Uber Markets.

The passage contrasts deterministic software pseudorandom generators, whose sequences can be predicted if their seed and model are known, with hardware generators that use a physical source of randomness. It states that AMD’s “Zen” architecture includes a cryptographic coprocessor for generating secure random numbers and that the AMD Secure RNG library provides a software API to access them.

East Whittier City School District completed about $6 million in summer upgrades funded by bond Measures R and Z. Work included a new playground at La Colima Elementary to replace one with safety hazards, improvements at three other elementary schools, and painted lunch shelters at four schools. About $88 million remains for planned plumbing, drinking fountain, window, door and other upgrades.

A cross-sectional study in Bangalore evaluated spot urinary protein-to-creatinine ratios in adults with urinary tract infections. Of 80 recruited patients, 46 were analyzed. Twelve had normal or mild proteinuria, 16 moderate proteinuria, and 18 severe proteinuria. Urinary creatinine was lower than the reference interval across all groups, while urinary protein and the protein-to-creatinine ratio were highest in the severe group. The authors propose the ratio as a useful marker for assessing possible kidney impairment in these patients and call for longitudinal studies.

The speaker says he trusted goalie coach Bob Essensa and made a split-second decision on a play. He welcomed goals from several players, saying the team needs contributions from everyone. Although a win helped build momentum, the team remains behind in the series and must bring the same effort to the next game. He also says a former player’s enthusiasm for winning still affects the team.

TSLA options give traders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell shares at a specified price by a set date. Strategies discussed include long calls, long puts, covered calls and spreads. Options can provide leverage and help manage risk, but they are complex and can produce substantial losses. The passage recommends choosing a strategy based on risk tolerance, goals and market outlook; understanding its risks and potential returns; and using backtesting, quantified analysis and a trading plan. Fees, liquidity and tax implications vary by trade and circumstances.

The passage argues that Russia could not claim jurisdiction over the open waters of the Okhotsk Sea, citing an arbitration ruling that rejected British sovereignty over the Bay of Fundy. It says Russian documents acknowledged limits on jurisdiction and that the *Cape Horn Pigeon* was seized outside even Russia’s claimed boundary. According to the passage, Russia did not claim an exclusive right to regulate whaling there but justified the seizure on its commander’s suspicions. The author argues that Russia is responsible for resulting damages unless it establishes a wrongful act by the vessel’s occupants.

The passage describes patterns for building distributed services. Ambassador containers can route requests to storage shards, broker connections across environments, or split traffic for experiments while applications connect through localhost. Adapter containers give heterogeneous applications consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks without changing their images.

Multi-node patterns include replicated load-balanced services for availability and scale, with readiness probes to keep unprepared instances from receiving requests. Caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharding distributes data across machines; choosing a suitable shard key and using consistent hashing can improve routing and limit disruption when shard counts change. Replicating shards helps maintain capacity during failures and upgrades.

Scatter/gather distributes parts of a request across leaf nodes and combines their results, but overhead and slow or failed leaves can limit its benefits. Event-driven functions simplify deployment and automatic scaling, while introducing monitoring challenges and limitations for long-running work, memory-intensive services, and sustained request traffic.

United Airlines beat Q1 2017 earnings estimates and maintained Q2 guidance after a passenger-removal scandal. It projected up to 3% growth in passenger revenue per available seat mile and pre-tax margins of 10% to 12%, down from the prior year. The author considers the stock undervalued, recommends buying on further dips, and discloses a long position in UAL.
The speaker says the game feels faster and more intense, sees home ice as the series’ main source of momentum, and emphasizes playing a solid game rather than talking.

Ernesto Guevara, Che Guevara’s youngest son, runs La Poderosa Tours, offering Harley-Davidson motorcycle trips through Cuba. His wife handles bookings, and the tours attract riders from around the world, including the United States. Six- and nine-day options cost about $3,000 to $6,000. The company is named after the motorcycle Che rode through South America as a young man.

President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said Turkey and its Syrian rebel allies would extend their offensive against the Kurdish YPG eastward from Afrin and could enter northern Iraq to target the PKK near Sinjar. Turkish-backed forces took Afrin on Sunday after Kurdish forces withdrew alongside fleeing civilians. The EU and United States expressed concern about the humanitarian situation, while monitors and Syrian Kurdish officials reported looting. The YPG vowed a guerrilla campaign. An eastward offensive could bring Turkish forces into contact with US troops supporting the YPG-led Syrian Democratic Forces. Turkey also plans to establish governing structures in Afrin and allow some refugees to return.

Amazon.com elected Daniel P. Huttenlocher to its board and appointed him to its Leadership Development and Compensation Committee, effective September 7, 2016. Huttenlocher is Dean and Vice Provost of Cornell Tech and a director of Corning Incorporated. He received an award of 1,131 restricted stock units, scheduled to vest in three equal annual installments beginning November 15, 2017, subject to continued board service.

The President explains his objections to a bill funding public works. He argues that the Constitution does not authorize a general federal system of internal improvements, though particular works may be permissible when necessary to an enumerated power, such as national defense. He says the federal government’s longstanding support for lighthouses and other navigation aids does not establish authority for every proposed river and harbor project. Because the boundary of that authority remains unsettled, he urges caution in making appropriations. He recommends federal funding only for works necessary to established federal powers, separate bills for each project, and federal jurisdiction over permanent works. Other improvements, he argues, should be left to states or private enterprise.

Documents show Hajdu’s department prepared speaking points and media lines about new Canada Summer Jobs eligibility requirements. An applicant guide said the rules aimed to prevent funding organizations whose mandates or projects may not respect individual human rights, including access to safe and legal abortions. After applications closed, officials said demand exceeded the budget and faith-based groups faced the same criteria as other applicants. Religious organizations objected to the wording, but Hajdu did not promise to change it. She later said hundreds of faith-based groups received funding in 2018.

Justice Hyeladzira Ajiya Nganjiwa failed to halt his trial on 14 counts of alleged corrupt enrichment and providing false information to EFCC officials. He pleaded not guilty. His lawyer sought a stay pending an appeal challenging the trial court’s decision to hear the case.

A study found that two grape-derived compounds promoted resilience against stress-induced depression in mice by affecting inflammation and synaptic plasticity. Researchers suggest the compounds could be developed into treatments, but the findings reported here are from mouse models.

The Henry James Review will move to Creighton University after editor Susan M. Griffin retires in spring 2019. Greg Zacharias, director of Creighton’s Center for Henry James Studies, will become editor. The journal will complement the center’s work on James’s letters and offer students research opportunities.

Japan’s financial regulator conducted a surprise inspection of Coincheck after hackers stole $530 million in digital currency. The regulator said it had warned the exchange about security flaws before the theft; those flaws had prevented Coincheck from receiving official approval, though it was allowed to operate pending registration. Coincheck said it would repay customers about $425 million, but the regulator had not confirmed it had sufficient funds. The regulator also ordered all cryptocurrency exchanges in Japan to report on their system risk management.
A lengthy rain delay moved Mariners-Tigers ALDS Game 3 from FS1 to MLB Network and FS2. The series is tied 1-1, with Logan Gilbert scheduled to start for Seattle and Jack Flaherty for Detroit.

A collection of May 20, 2001 articles covers President Bush’s energy plan, disputes over electricity deregulation and environmental rules, and low residential enrollment in Texas’s deregulation pilot. Qatar reported progress on gas-export talks with Kuwait and Bahrain, while its energy minister said OPEC was unlikely to change output in June. Enron’s potential withdrawal from the Dolphin gas project remained unconfirmed. In India, Enron-backed Dabhol Power Company issued a preliminary notice to terminate its power-purchase agreement with Maharashtra’s electricity board, while leaving open the possibility of further talks.

A federal judge said she was “99 percent sure” she would dismiss mail fraud charges against Dallas County Commissioner John Wiley Price even if a jury convicted him. Judge Barbara Lynn also questioned whether prosecutors had proved an exchange of payments for official favors between Price and political consultant Kathy Nealy. Dismissing the mail fraud charges would substantially reduce Price’s potential sentence. Closing arguments were scheduled to begin Tuesday.

Former NFL quarterback and Fox Sports broadcaster Mark Sanchez was arrested at an Indianapolis hospital Saturday after being stabbed in a downtown confrontation. Police said he faces three possible misdemeanor charges: battery with injury, unlawful entry of a motor vehicle and public intoxication. Prosecutors will make the final charging decision. Fox Sports said Sanchez is stable and recovering; he will miss Sunday’s broadcast.

Devon and Cornwall Police has been charged under the Health and Safety at Work Act over the 2012 death of Thomas Orchard, who died seven days after being detained in Exeter. During his detention, officers restrained him and placed an Emergency Response Belt across his face. He was later found unresponsive in a cell. Three staff members were acquitted of manslaughter in 2017, and misconduct hearings have been announced for six officers and staff. Orchard’s family welcomed the prosecution and called for changes in police treatment of people with mental health vulnerabilities. The force is due in court on May 24.

The passage describes an autonomous-vehicle system that uses a machine-learned model to decide whether to yield to perceived objects, traffic signals, or gaps in traffic. It combines sensor, map, and predicted-trajectory data to assess features such as required acceleration, signal timing, and available intersection space. A motion planner then generates and executes a trajectory consistent with the yield decision. The model can be trained on labeled driving logs or simulated scenarios.

At the signing of the Americans with Disabilities Act, the speaker thanks the people with disabilities, advocates, lawmakers, officials, and organizations who helped make it law. He describes the act as a major step toward equality and independence, prohibiting discrimination by covered employers and expanding access to public places, transportation, and telephone services. He urges Americans to remove physical and social barriers and asks businesses to give qualified people with disabilities opportunities to work. He concludes that the law aims to bring down a longstanding wall of exclusion.

The lecture introduces link-cut trees for maintaining a forest of rooted trees under edge insertion, deletion, and queries. They support finding a tree’s root and aggregating weights along a root-to-vertex path. The presented version stores preferred paths in splay trees and uses an access operation to make these paths available for queries and updates. Heavy-light decomposition helps prove that the operations take logarithmic amortized time. A more complex version achieves logarithmic worst-case time.

Research described in the passage links more time outdoors with a lower chance of children developing myopia, or nearsightedness. In one study, about 14 hours outdoors per week lowered the estimated chance of needing glasses for children with two nearsighted parents from about 60 percent to about 20 percent. The evidence presented does not identify reading, screen use or other close work as important causes. Outdoor time appears to have little effect on prescription changes in children already nearsighted. Researchers suspect brighter outdoor light may slow abnormal eye growth, but the mechanism remains uncertain. Children spending time outdoors should use sunscreen and sunglasses.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 18, 2018, attaching its 2017 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Senior Vice President David A. Zapolsky.

A multiple-case study examined how eight Internet-of-Things startups developed products, using twelve interviews and the SEMAT Essence framework. The startups combined software, hardware and business expertise but often relied on external partners to fill skill gaps. Their minimum viable products ranged from simulations of the intended user experience to functional prototypes and versions focused on quality. Common practices included rapid prototyping, reuse of components, outsourcing and iterative development. Hardware complexity, manufacturing and external dependencies could lengthen development cycles and complicate Agile practices. The authors note that the findings may not generalize beyond similar early-stage startups.
The Foothills Audubon Club will present *Saving Species*, a program on global wildlife conservation, January 9, 2017, at 7 p.m. at Berthoud Community Center. Admission is free.

CompareCards compares credit cards with introductory 0% APR offers, cash-back or travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses. The listed offers have different promotional periods, regular variable APRs, and balance-transfer fees. The site says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not affect its ratings or reviews, and advises applicants to confirm terms before applying.
The drawings show eight views of a centrifugal pump. Broken lines indicate portions excluded from the claimed design.

RCMP Cpl. Marcus Hirschfield broke both legs when a pickup struck his cruiser on an icy road near Spruce Grove on Feb. 14, 2013. Rescuers took 90 minutes to free him before a STARS Air Ambulance helicopter transported him. After three months in hospital, he continues physiotherapy and has returned to duty. Hirschfield shared his story to encourage support for STARS, which relies on donations and lottery proceeds for two-thirds of its funding. With five weeks remaining, only 60 per cent of tickets for its 2017 Alberta lottery had sold.

Postpartum bleeding occurs after both vaginal and C-section deliveries as the placental site heals and sheds tissue. After a C-section, bleeding may initially resemble a heavy period but should lessen daily and usually stop within four weeks. Call a doctor if it lasts more than six to eight weeks, soaks a pad hourly for two hours, includes large clots, or is accompanied by dizziness, shortness of breath, a racing heart, or fever. C-section recovery also calls for limited activity, hydration, and avoiding heavy lifting.

After his suspension, Dolphins linebacker Lawrence Timmons returned to the starting lineup and played every snap against the Saints. He said he was not at his best but expects to improve. He trained during his time away from the team.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 30, 2019, announcing a press release on its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 30, 2019. The release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

An analysis found that about 30% of Scotland’s A-roads and 35% of B-roads were flagged for inspection or repair between 2015 and 2017. England’s reported figures were lower, though the data was collected differently. Scotland spent more per person on roads than the UK average. Experts cited colder, wetter weather as a factor. Politicians disputed road-maintenance funding, while the Scottish Government said its trunk-road maintenance budget had risen.

Microsoft reported that directors Charles H. Noski and Helmut Panke will retire from its board on December 4, 2019, and will not seek re-election at that day’s annual shareholders meeting. Both have served since 2003.

The Second Circuit vacated a preliminary injunction barring Hood from selling dairy products to chain warehouses outside Jackson Dairy’s exclusive distribution territory for shipment to stores within it. The court held that Jackson had not shown irreparable harm because monetary damages could compensate its alleged losses. A concurring judge would also have reversed because Jackson had not shown that Hood breached the distribution agreement.

A study of 2,324 university students in eight countries found that people who experienced more of the emotions they wanted reported greater life satisfaction and fewer depressive symptoms, even when those emotions were unpleasant. Most wanted more pleasant and fewer unpleasant emotions, but some wanted less love or empathy or more anger or hatred. Researchers said further study is needed to determine whether experiencing desired emotions causes greater happiness.

The Commodity Channel Index (CCI) compares a security’s price with its average price to identify momentum and potential overbought or oversold conditions. Developed by Donald R. Lambert in 1980 for commodities, it is now used for other securities. The passage favors short lookback periods and oversold signals for stocks, while noting that CCI lags prices and cannot reliably time reversals. In a backtest on the SPY ETF, a nine-day CCI with a buy threshold of −90 produced a profit factor of about 1.8, an average gain of 0.55% per trade, and a maximum drawdown of 23%. The passage cautions that the result may reflect curve fitting.

CompareCards lists credit cards with introductory 0% APR offers, cash-back or travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses. Promotional periods, balance-transfer fees, and rates after the introductory period vary by card. The site says it receives compensation from listed companies but that this does not influence its ratings or reviews.

Apple’s 2016 Form 10-K describes its products, services, operations and risks for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2016. Apple sold devices, software and services worldwide through direct and third-party channels, which accounted for 25% and 75% of net sales, respectively. International sales accounted for 65%. R&D expense was $10.0 billion, and Apple had approximately 116,000 full-time equivalent employees. The filing identifies risks including intense competition, component shortages, reliance on outsourced manufacturing, legal proceedings, cybersecurity and currency fluctuations.
Subgroup analyses found no significant interactions in adherence at 24 or 48 weeks. From Weeks 24 to 48, interactions were significant for atrial fibrillation type and sex.

At Microsoft’s November 30, 2016 annual shareholders meeting, 6.89 billion of 7.78 billion eligible shares were voted in person or by proxy. Shareholders re-elected all 11 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as fiscal 2017 auditor, and approved amendments to the Articles of Incorporation and the French Sub Plan. They rejected a proposal to amend the proxy access bylaw. The filing includes the amended and restated Articles of Incorporation as an exhibit.

Personal trainer Liz Letchford says eccentric exercises—slowly lowering during a movement—can increase strength but also cause soreness. Examples include lowering from a pull-up or taking six to eight seconds to lower in a push-up. She says stronger muscles increase energy needs and metabolism, and recommends strength training and a healthy diet for a “lean” appearance.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on January 31, 2019, announcing its fourth-quarter and full-year 2018 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

KMT Chairwoman Hung Hsiu-chu said she would step down on June 30, before her term ends on Aug. 20, and appointed Lin Cheng-tse acting chairman. Following a dispute over Central Committee nominations, she urged chairman-elect Wu Den-yih to take office soon and fill party vacancies, particularly on the committee managing KMT assets amid ongoing lawsuits.

The speaker says the team is eager to move past its toughest game and prepare for tonight by skating, competing and managing the puck. Everyone wants to win, and adjustments must follow an assessment of what went wrong. The speaker also looks forward to seeing McGill contacts and describes a longtime competitor and leader as having earned his standing.

IDC’s December 2021 survey of 200 industrial decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland found that 81% of respondents already using HPC intend to implement HPC-based business models. HPC as a service (HPCaaS) can provide scalable access to current technology without upfront infrastructure investment, though cloud-based HPC still requires skilled personnel. IDC views simulation, modeling, and data analytics as important to manufacturing innovation and digital transformation. It recommends a shared data strategy, choosing an HPC operating model suited to each enterprise, and considering scalability, security, energy efficiency, and external expertise.

Pneumococcal disease causes substantial illness and death, particularly among young children and older adults. In China, PCV13 and PPV23 are available but are not part of the national immunization program, and uptake is 3%–9%. Sinovac’s preservative-free PPV23 was approved in 2020 for people aged two years and older. A phase 4 trial in China compared its immunogenicity, tolerability and safety with Pneumovax in children, adults and older people.

Inflation reduces purchasing power as prices rise. The passage attributes it to money supply growth, increased demand, higher production costs and expectations of future price increases. It says high inflation can raise business costs, reduce consumer spending and investment, and prompt interest-rate increases, making stocks more volatile. Value stocks may fare better than growth or dividend stocks. The passage reports a poor 60-year S&P 500 backtest under its inflation-based trading approach, while suggesting companies can pass higher costs to consumers over the long term.

In January 2017, ADX recorded Dh406 million in net foreign investment. Its index rose 0.03 per cent to 4,548, while listed local companies’ market capitalisation fell 1.32 per cent. Trading value increased to Dh7.741 billion from Dh3.576 billion in December. Real estate accounted for the largest share of trades.

The President submits a treaty with Nicaragua for Senate ratification to build an interoceanic canal. He argues that railways cannot adequately connect the U.S. coasts and that the canal would shorten sea voyages, expand trade, strengthen national unity, and improve transportation and defense. Under the treaty, Nicaragua would provide territory and retain its sovereignty, while the United States would fund construction. The canal would be open to all nations on equal terms, with possible preferences for the two countries’ coastal trade. The proposed route uses Lake Nicaragua and the San Juan River; the treaty also provides for a $4 million loan to Nicaragua for related improvements. The President urges prompt approval and suggests that the Army Engineer Corps build the canal.

The coach says his team has played consistently despite being described as under the radar. He credits Stanley Cup veterans Mike Commodore and Cory Stillman as important contributors: Commodore has handled major defensive duties, while Stillman has scored and helped teammates. Proud to be a U.S.-born coach, he cites his parents, former coaches and colleagues as influences on his character and coaching. He also praises an unnamed defenseman who returned from injuries to provide consistent play, leadership, speed and experience.

Lackawanna County Prison counselor Kimberly A. Rupp faces a misdemeanor retail theft charge after police said she tried to leave a Dickson City Walmart with $206.77 in unpaid merchandise. She was charged with felony retail theft in November over an alleged $3,194 theft from Kohl’s. She was released on $10,000 unsecured bail.

The All Progressives Congress in Ekiti State has chosen Chief Adebisi Adegboyega Egbeyemi as Kayode Fayemi’s running mate for the July 14, 2018 governorship election. Egbeyemi, a lawyer and former chairman of Ado-Ekiti Local Government, has served in the Ondo State House of Assembly and as commissioner for education, justice and attorney general. He is an APC leader in Ekiti State.

Lake Louise ski resort pleaded guilty to charges under the Species At Risk Act and Canada National Parks Act after employees cut trees along a ski run in 2013. The Crown alleges at least 39 endangered whitebark pines were felled. Sentencing arguments, including expert evidence on the number of trees and environmental impact, were delayed until July 9 because an earlier court date was unavailable. Judge Heather Lamoureux expressed frustration with the delay.

Huawei says it aims to become the world’s top PC vendor by 2022, following the release of three new MateBook devices. Analyst firm TBR says a recovering PC market, Huawei’s cash reserves, existing customers and extensive retail network could support its expansion. Challenges include established competitors, difficulty securing channel partners and concerns affecting its prospects in the US.

Bibliotherapy uses books and discussion to help readers address problems or support development. This systematic review examined 35 studies of bibliotherapy in educational settings. The studies generally reported improvements in socio-emotional skills, academic outcomes, self-esteem, hope, resilience, anxiety, and depression, though some outcomes were not significant. Reported challenges included limited practitioner awareness and training, lack of time and resources, and readers’ reluctance or difficulty reading. Small samples, inconsistent reporting, and varied methods limited the findings; the methods also prevented a meta-analysis.

After losing two games in the opponent’s building, the team responded by playing physically, moving its feet and controlling the puck better. The speaker stayed with his game plan and said the line changes were manageable. The team won but remained focused on the next game.

A jury convicted Joseph Percoco on three counts involving conspiracy and solicitation of bribes. COR Development executive Steven Aiello was convicted of conspiracy but acquitted of bribery; colleague Joseph Gerardi was acquitted, and jurors remained deadlocked on charges against CPV executive Peter Galbraith Kelly Jr. Percoco’s attorney may seek an appeal, while Aiello’s attorney plans to challenge the verdict. Sentencing is scheduled for June 11 for Percoco and June 14 for Aiello. Governor Cuomo said violations of public trust are unacceptable.

SimulRAG uses scientific simulators to ground long-form answers to scientific questions. Its retrieval interface converts questions into simulator parameters and outputs into text; its generator breaks answers into claims and selectively verifies uncertain claims that fall within simulator boundaries. On climate and epidemiology benchmarks, SimulRAG produced 30.4% more unique true claims and a 16.3% higher proportion of true claims than the best RAG baseline. The authors note that it assumes questions relate to available simulators.

The passage proposes VN-HGCN, a heterogeneous graph model that uses type-level virtual nodes and a central node to connect distant nodes within four steps, without predefined meta-paths. It combines feature transformation, node-level aggregation and attention-based type-level aggregation to learn node representations. Node-classification experiments on ACM, DBLP and IMDB show strong results against several comparison models, while a perturbation experiment suggests virtual nodes improve access to long-range information. Performance was generally stable across tested parameter settings, though it declined when the model exceeded four layers.

Cardiac surgery commonly causes postoperative hyperglycemia, while insulin treatment also risks hypoglycemia. Researchers developed GLUCOSE, a distributional offline reinforcement-learning model that recommends hourly insulin doses during the first postoperative day. Trained on 6,148 patients and externally validated on 649, it showed higher estimated performance than observed clinician dosing. Doses closer to its recommendations were associated with more time in the target glucose range. In expert evaluations, its recommendations were rated comparable to or better than clinicians’ for safety, effectiveness, and acceptability. The findings are retrospective and require prospective clinical trials.

After reports of a fox snarling, snapping and foaming at the mouth near Wood River Road, an ADF&G biologist warned it may have rabies. Residents should avoid unusual foxes, keep dogs’ rabies vaccinations current and report sightings to ADF&G.

Cleveland construction manager Khalil Ewais tried to resign in 2015, citing low pay and duties beyond his job description, but stayed after supervisors promised staffing changes and continued efforts to secure a raise. Federal agents later seized City Hall records concerning his side business, Pioneer Engineering, several properties and paving contractor Burton Scot. Authorities have not disclosed the reason for the raid. Ewais had told the city his outside work would not interfere with his job and said in a 2017 audit that he had no financial interest in city transactions.

FAANG stocks outperformed the market in 2017, prompting concerns about valuations and the sustainability of their gains. Morgan Stanley remains positive on their competitive strengths but expects returns may moderate. It warns that advertising and consumer spending could expose the group to cyclical pressures, including a possible recession. The bank sees a wide range of outcomes for individual stocks in 2018.

The speaker argues that postwar readjustment requires shared sacrifice and attention to domestic economic problems, especially farmers’ access to credit and cheaper transportation. He urges Congress to expand agricultural lending, coordinate rail, water, and road transport, improve railway efficiency, and create an impartial labor tribunal whose decisions can protect essential service.

He supports flexible tariffs, stronger enforcement of prohibition, alien registration and screening, immigrant education, and constitutional amendments addressing child labor and tax-exempt securities. He also calls for consideration of conservation, reclamation, energy, consumer prices, and national-defense planning.

In foreign affairs, he favors cooperation, consultation, and arms limitation while opposing international commitments that would surrender American decision-making or assume responsibilities other nations must bear themselves.

A forwarded essay by Arundhati Roy calls for an immediate end to the U.S. bombing of Afghanistan. Roy condemns the September 11 attacks and the Taliban’s brutality but argues that war kills civilians, threatens food deliveries and may fuel further terrorism. She criticizes U.S. food drops, questions support for the Northern Alliance, and warns that expanded surveillance threatens civil liberties.
