The essay also raises concerns about arms and oil interests and urges accountability for the September 11 attackers without continuing the war.

An analysis of 2023–24 campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at 100 top-grossing law firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms found that 92.45% went to Democrats, totaling about $52 million versus $4 million for Republicans. The Democratic-to-Republican ratio rose from roughly 6-to-1 in a previous analysis to 12-to-1. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb had the highest Democratic share (99.7%); Nelson Mullins had the lowest (66.4%).

The Missouri Court of Appeals affirmed an order requiring Max Gibson to remove a provision allowing him to use the cash value of life insurance policies held in a trust securing maintenance payments to his former wife, Annetta. The court held that the provision could impair the security promised in their property settlement agreement. It rejected Max’s objections concerning the agreement Annetta pleaded, venue, and the availability of a claim against his estate. Because Max had not fulfilled the agreement, the court also affirmed the award of Annetta’s attorney fees and costs under its terms.

USD/CAD remains range-bound between 1.2968 and 1.3211, with a neutral intraday bias. A break above 1.3387 would shift the bias upward toward 1.3598, while a move below 1.2968 would turn the outlook bearish. The broader move from 1.4689 is viewed as a correction.

On a mostly dry Suzuka track, Bottas set the fastest time in the sole practice session, ahead of Hamilton, Vettel, Verstappen and Ricciardo. Bottas damaged his car after running wide, ending his session, while Raikkonen crashed at Degner; both incidents caused red flags. Alonso received a 25-place grid penalty after an engine change, joining Bottas and Sainz among drivers with penalties.

The 52-week high strategy buys stocks trading near their highest closing price of the past year. The passage says academic research found that such stocks tend to outperform those farther from their highs. However, the article’s backtests using SPY as a proxy for the S&P 500 did not produce a strategy it considered worthwhile.

A New York Times report said actress Rose McGowan reached a previously undisclosed $100,000 settlement with Harvey Weinstein in 1997 following an episode in a hotel room. The agreement did not admit harassment. The report also described allegations by Ashley Judd. McGowan declined comment, and Weinstein said he would take a leave of absence.

The lecture examines information-flow tracking as a way to detect Android apps sending sensitive data over the network, a risk that ordinary permissions do not adequately address. TaintDroid labels data from sources such as GPS and contacts, propagates those labels through Dalvik operations, files, and interprocess messages, and checks data at the network interface. It uses conservative labels for arrays and files but cannot track some flows through branches or automatically inspect native code. The reported overhead is 3%–5% in memory and roughly 3%–29% in CPU use.

The lecture also discusses the costs and false positives of lower-level tracking, more expressive programmer-defined labels, and TightLip, which compares a process with a version reading scrubbed data to identify possible leaks without modifying the application.
The US Energy Department approved nearly $67 million for 85 nuclear research projects aimed at improving safety, efficiency and energy independence.

The “Chase” offense attacks a Box and One defense, in which four defenders guard zones while a chaser denies the star player the ball. It uses screens, cuts and passes to free the star or create shots for teammates, including isolating the star in the middle against the chaser. Options include a shuffle cut, screen-and-roll, base screen, give-and-go and single/double-screen continuity. Effective execution requires coordinated screening, post play, timing and defensive recognition. Teams should scout defensive matchups and adjust their alignments and entries during the game.

The Patient Charter sets out patients’ legal rights, NHS pledges and patients’ responsibilities. It covers access to care, quality and safety, appropriate treatments, consent, privacy, choice, openness when care goes wrong, and routes for complaints and redress. Care is generally free at the point of use, with some exceptions. Patients are expected to look after their health where possible, respect others, discuss difficulties with treatment plans, and take part in vaccination and screening programmes.

Some diet trends discourage fruit because it contains carbohydrates and natural sugars. Dietitian Samantha Rigoli says fruit is nutrient-dense and should be eaten daily. People trying to lose weight can use the glycemic index to choose fruits that raise blood sugar more slowly, such as apples and berries.

Lorna Gibson reviews biomimetic cellular materials, including wood-derived ceramics, fiber-reinforced printed honeycombs, bone-like metal foams, tissue scaffolds, density-graded concrete, and plant- and animal-inspired shell-and-foam structures. She explains that foam cores can reduce weight while helping prevent local buckling. In a review session, she discusses how foam stress–strain data are used to construct energy-absorption graphs and answers questions about helmet-foam calculations. She also outlines the upcoming test topics and permitted cheat sheet.

A 10-year-old student reported that youths in a black car tried to abduct her near PGI on Tuesday. Police investigated, but nearby residents reported seeing nothing. No complaint was filed, though police lodged a precautionary report.

The Cahokia Creek Watershed Planning project will develop plans for two watersheds in western Madison County to address flooding, storm water infrastructure and water quality. HeartLands Conservancy gathered public input at open houses in Edwardsville and Glen Carbon to identify priorities and help seek funding. The project is part of Madison County’s storm water planning and is a partnership with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.

California’s recreational cannabis rollout has been slower and more complicated than expected, with licensed dispensary sales through February 2018 below state projections. Experts cite limited local licensing, widespread unlicensed activity and taxes that raise prices and strain retailers. One analyst cautioned that Colorado also fell short of initial revenue projections before collections stabilized and later exceeded them.

This Brazilian case-control study aimed to examine risk factors for long COVID among healthcare workers, including vaccination. It included symptomatic workers aged 18 or older with RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein from March 2020 to July 2022, with 180 days of follow-up. Cases had symptoms lasting more than four weeks without another explanation; controls recovered within four weeks. The passage notes that healthcare workers face frequent occupational exposure and that further research is needed on vaccine effectiveness against long COVID in this group.

Belgium’s 18-10 upset of Spain gave Romania an automatic place at the 2019 Rugby World Cup and sent Spain into a playoff against Portugal. World Rugby is examining the appointment of a Romanian referee after Spanish players confronted the officials. The loser of a subsequent series against Samoa will join Canada and two other teams in a four-team repechage for the final World Cup berth.

Tropical moisture left by Alberto is bringing heavy showers and thunderstorms to Alabama today. A flash flood watch covers much of central Alabama until 7 p.m., with saturated ground increasing the flood risk. Storms will be more scattered tomorrow, though some in north Alabama could bring small hail and gusty winds. Scattered afternoon storms continue through the weekend; drier weather is expected early next week.

A collection of November 22, 2001, reports describes Enron’s worsening financial crisis. Its shares fell 28% to $5.01 despite a three-week extension on a $690 million debt payment and additional credit. Analysts questioned whether its planned acquisition by Dynegy would proceed, while Enron sought to restructure debt and sell assets. The stock’s collapse devastated employees’ retirement savings, particularly because a temporary plan freeze prevented them from changing investments. Reports also covered falling Enron bonds and reviews or potential sales of businesses in Japan, India and Britain.

At its May 23, 2017 annual meeting, NVIDIA stockholders elected 12 directors for one-year terms, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, favored annual advisory votes on compensation, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor for the fiscal year ending January 28, 2018.

U.S. stocks stayed near record highs Wednesday while Treasury yields rose after stronger-than-expected retail sales and higher inflation. Consumer prices were up 2.5 percent from a year earlier, giving the Federal Reserve more room to continue gradually raising interest rates. Fed Chair Janet Yellen cited a strengthening job market and modestly higher inflation. Higher bond yields weighed on dividend-paying stocks, particularly utilities. The dollar rose against the yen, euro and pound, while major stock indexes in Europe and Asia were mixed to higher.

Soccer coaches should prepare players for changing field surfaces, dimensions, weather, lighting, balls, markings, and other match conditions. Before each match, coaches and players should inspect the field and equipment, address hazards, and determine whether play is safe. Training should cover how conditions affect ball movement, footing, tactics, and communication, while players should continue playing until the referee’s whistle. Severe weather and serious hazards may require postponing or abandoning a match.
The speaker says a bruise will not prevent him from playing tonight. He praises a young player’s offensive instincts and says both teams should keep their play simple despite unusual bounces.

Jean Munoz circulated May 2001 news coverage of California’s electricity crisis. State Controller Kathleen Connell planned to release details of long-term power contracts amid concern that rising prices could exhaust planned bond funding sooner than expected. Reports described investigations into allegations that generators reduced output to raise prices; the companies denied manipulating the market and cited aging plants and maintenance needs. Governor Gray Davis criticized the Bush administration’s energy plan and sought federal price relief. Other coverage examined expected summer blackouts, planned-outage proposals, electricity rate increases, new power plants and conservation efforts. A poll found declining confidence in California’s direction.

A player must return to Boston for further examination. The speaker questioned some officiating decisions but said the team did not play well enough to win, particularly offensively and on second chances. He said players often play hurt during the Stanley Cup playoffs and that the team must adjust if Z and Griz are unavailable. Possible changes include better puck support, stronger defensive boxing out, adjustments to an unproductive line and, if two defensemen are out, using seven defensemen. He said the team needs to respond after the loss by creating inside chances and preventing opponents from getting second chances.

The Senate again rejected competing Republican and Democratic funding bills, leaving the government shutdown unresolved. Republicans seek funding through Nov. 21 at current levels, while Democrats demand health-care funding, including an extension of enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies. The White House has warned of possible federal worker layoffs and questioned furloughed workers’ back pay, though House Speaker Mike Johnson said federal law requires payment when they return.

China’s first-quarter 2017 GDP grew 6.9%, above expectations and the government’s 6.5% target. The passage questions the reliability of GDP and industrial production figures, noting that March’s 7.6% industrial-production growth followed nearly two years of unusually steady readings and coincided with stronger exports. Retail sales rose 10.9% in March, while fixed-asset investment remained subdued despite continued state-owned enterprise spending. The author argues that these improvements may be temporary and that sustained industrial acceleration would be needed to establish a stronger growth trend.

The Delaware Supreme Court reversed a decision denying PNC Bank employee Cheryl Tickles workers’ compensation benefits. Tickles slipped on ice in a PNC parking lot after using an employee-only ATM before her shift. The court held that the parking lot was part of her place of employment and that using the ATM to obtain lunch money was an incidental act in preparation for work. It remanded the case for further action.

A study comparing polysomnography recordings from 20 people with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD), 20 with Parkinson’s disease and RBD (PD+RBD), and 20 controls found increased phasic REM sleep in iRBD and fewer, shorter sawtooth-wave bursts in PD+RBD. Both patient groups showed a shift in sawtooth-wave characteristics toward higher frequencies. Transitions from non-REM to REM sleep were longer in iRBD than in controls and longest in PD+RBD. The study concludes that RBD-related REM sleep changes extend beyond muscle-tone abnormalities; whether these features predict disease progression remains unknown.

The speaker was concerned when Paul lay on the ice after a hit, but his return and goal lifted the team. After several tough years, the team values its chance to win the Stanley Cup and share it with longtime teammates. An overtime winner gave them another opportunity, and they feel ready for the next game.
Moody’s said Saudi Arabia’s strong fiscal position supports its A1 rating and stable outlook, but flagged oil dependence, difficult reforms and a projected 2017 contraction and budget deficit.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines a unified L1 cache and shared-memory design, larger L2 caches, GDDR6 memory, and improved compression to increase performance and effective bandwidth over Pascal. Tensor Cores support AI workloads and NGX features such as DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. Dedicated RT Cores accelerate ray tracing, which the passage describes using alongside rasterization and denoising for real-time rendering.

Turing also introduces mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading, and expanded multi-view rendering. Its display and video features include 8K output, enhanced encoding and decoding, and VirtualLink connectivity for VR headsets. NVLink supports two-way SLI on certain GPUs. The passage describes TU102, TU104, TU106, and the inference-focused Tesla T4, and presents NVIDIA’s RTX-OPS metric for hybrid-rendering workloads.

The passage argues that forex trading is difficult and risky, particularly because leverage can turn small currency movements into major losses. It also cites volatile and hard-to-predict exchange rates, limited long-term gains compared with stocks, unreliable risk-management systems, scams, counterparty risk, and the temptation to overtrade in a 24-hour market. The authors say their forex strategies often fail testing and warn against trading strategies that lack backtested results.

The lecture models the mechanical behavior of honeycombs. For hexagonal cells, it relates in-plane compression to elastic buckling, plastic yielding, and brittle wall fracture, then derives a fracture-toughness relationship that depends on cell size. In tension, elastic moduli are unchanged, buckling does not occur, and the plastic plateau stress is approximately the same as in compression. Triangular honeycombs deform mainly through axial forces, making their modulus proportional to wall thickness divided by cell length rather than its cube, as in bending-dominated hexagonal cells. Out-of-plane loading also primarily stretches or contracts cell walls, producing stiffer, stronger behavior. The lecture estimates out-of-plane elastic constants and strengths for buckling, yielding, and brittle failure, and concludes by introducing wood and cork as future examples.

Lake Havasu City recorded Arizona’s highest temperature, 128 degrees, on June 29, 1994. Many of the state’s other extreme temperatures occurred along the Colorado River, which provides little cooling. State Climatologist Nancy Selover attributes the region’s heat to limited monsoon moisture, intense sun, rocky terrain that retains heat, and a lack of irrigated agriculture.

Brazil has a well-established financial market regulated by the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM). Traded assets include stocks, commodities, derivatives, currencies and bonds. The passage discusses trading strategies, analysis tools, taxes and risks, including volatility, currency fluctuations and limited liquidity. A described strategy backtest recorded 250 trades, averaging a 0.75% gain per trade, with a 67% win rate and a 19% maximum drawdown.

The coach says the team should set aside past results, prepare for the opening shift and play hard. After retiring, he spent a year away from hockey before trying coaching at Jacques Lemaire’s invitation. He finds satisfaction in players’ success and sees coaching as teaching them to improve. He says the team must avoid retaliation and unnecessary penalties, stay focused and disciplined, and prioritize winning against an opponent with a strong power play.

Wall Street’s main indexes had their worst week in two years as rising bond yields and inflation fears overshadowed improving earnings forecasts. The S&P 500 fell 3.9 percent, although fourth-quarter results overall have exceeded expectations. Following the U.S. tax overhaul, estimated S&P 500 profit growth rose to 17.7 percent for the first quarter and 18.2 percent for 2018. Analysts also cited global growth and a weaker dollar as support for earnings. Investors are watching upcoming reports to see whether strong profits can offset concerns about interest rates and stock valuations.

US officials told CNN that advisers close to Donald Trump had frequent campaign-era communications with Russians known to US intelligence. The contacts concerned investigators, particularly amid Russian cyberactivities targeting Democratic organizations. Trump and Obama were briefed, but investigators had not determined the conversations’ intent and were examining whether Trump associates coordinated the release of damaging information about Hillary Clinton’s campaign.

After Pfizer agreed with the Trump administration to lower drug prices, other pharmaceutical companies pressed by Trump are seeking similar deals. Some hope to announce agreements as soon as this week, according to industry representatives and lobbyists.

The speaker says Nashville sought more offense while relying on strong goaltending and defense. He credits scouting and player development in Milwaukee with helping the team remain competitive after major trades and withstand playoff injuries. He says P.K. Subban has improved after an adjustment period, and that clear communication about his hockey goals and off-ice activities has made the relationship a good fit. He attributes the team’s success to contributions across the organization, expresses excitement about reaching this point, and praises the atmosphere at Nashville games.

The court held that transferring a chancery suit to the law side did not give the Livingston County court jurisdiction over defendants served only in Washtenaw County. Their appearance and answer in chancery, and counsel’s remarks about the transfer, did not waive their objection to jurisdiction in the law action. The court granted a writ requiring dismissal.

The U.S. Embassy in Nigeria shared transformation photos of Folake, a woman living with HIV who received antiretroviral treatment through PEPFAR at a supported Lagos clinic. The World AIDS Day post drew comments about her recovery and HIV stigma.

Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy (SUDEP) is strongly associated with poorly controlled generalized tonic-clonic seizures, particularly during sleep and when a patient is prone. Because intervention may be needed within minutes, the study developed Korus, an inflatable mattress designed to detect body position and reposition a patient. In testing with 10 control subjects, manually controlled cells moved subjects from prone to a recovery position in every attempt, taking an average of 21.75 seconds. Prone-position detection was 96.8% accurate. The authors state that further development is needed before the system can autonomously intervene after a seizure.

This course examines how proof systems have evolved from classical proofs to interactive, randomized, and cryptographic proofs. The lecture defines interactive proofs as protocols between a potentially unbounded prover and a polynomial-time randomized verifier, with completeness for true claims and soundness against false ones. It contrasts them with NP proofs and non-interactive randomized proofs, and notes that interactive proofs can establish membership in any PSPACE language.

The lecture then introduces the sum-check protocol. To verify a claimed sum of a multivariate polynomial, the prover sends successive univariate polynomials, while the verifier checks their degrees and sums and chooses random field elements. A final check evaluates the original polynomial. The protocol has perfect completeness and soundness error at most \(md/|F|\), where \(m\) is the number of variables, \(d\) is the degree per variable, and \(F\) is the field.

The passage describes a landing device that guides a delivery drone without an image-capturing function onto a landing portion. Cameras on the landing portion identify the drone’s position, while a distance sensor helps control its descent. The device checks the drone’s identification before taking control, receives its package, and lowers the package into a residence. An opening-and-closing structure protects the equipment when not in use. Proposed variations include emergency and portable landing devices, weather observation, and integration with residential ventilation.

NVIDIA’s annual report for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2021 describes its Graphics and Compute & Networking segments, serving gaming, professional visualization, data center and automotive markets. The company completed its approximately $7 billion acquisition of Mellanox in April 2020 and announced a planned $40 billion acquisition of Arm, subject to regulatory and other approvals. NVIDIA uses third parties to manufacture its semiconductor products and reported 18,975 employees as of January 31, 2021. The report identifies risks including competition, supply constraints, uncertain demand, cybersecurity, COVID-19 disruptions and challenges in completing or integrating acquisitions.

The Michigan Supreme Court affirmed a directed verdict for Marquette after a pedestrian claimed injury from poultry crates obstructing a sidewalk. It held that the city’s charter exempted it from liability for obstructions left by an occupant of the premises, despite the state’s general liability law. The court also held that a later local act did not repeal the exemption and that it was not invalid as class legislation.

A New York grand jury indicted Harvey Weinstein on rape and criminal sex-act charges involving two women. Weinstein, who surrendered to police Friday, is free on $1 million bail and confined to New York and Connecticut. His attorney said Weinstein would plead not guilty, seek dismissal of the indictment and decline to testify before the grand jury because he lacked time to prepare. Manhattan District Attorney Cyrus Vance said the investigation remains ongoing and urged others with relevant information to come forward.

An Enron email circulated articles on California’s energy crisis. The state had avoided summer blackouts amid conservation, mild weather and added generation, but financial risks remained. Lawmakers were debating a rescue for Southern California Edison while PG&E was in bankruptcy. Other reports examined utility credit, state borrowing and concerns that long-term power contracts could exceed future market prices. Governor Gray Davis faced criticism over his emergency actions despite the improved power supply.

Rabbi Aaron Brafman, longtime menahel of the Yeshiva of Far Rockaway, died at 73 after years of declining health. A former student and teacher at Yeshivah Torah Vodaath, he became menahel in 1970 and was known for his dedication to students and the wider community. He is survived by his wife, siblings, eight children and many grandchildren.

The PGA848 is a programmable-gain instrumentation amplifier with eight gain settings from 0.5 to 100V/V. Its DA_IN pins allow external capacitors to shape noise or customize output-stage attenuation, but resistor tolerance, leakage, and excessive current must be considered. The passage describes an example circuit driving a 16-bit, 1MSPS ADS8860 ADC, including input, feedback, and ADC charge-reservoir filters. It specifies supply and reference arrangements, layout practices to limit noise and leakage, and cautions that supplies above 40V can permanently damage the device. TI states that application information must be validated by customers and provides simulation resources, documentation references, and product disclaimers.

Using data on more than 200,000 stars observed by both Gaia and the RAdial Velocity Experiment, University of Toronto researchers calculated that the Sun orbits the Milky Way’s center at 240 km/s. Combining this result with the proper motion of Sagittarius A*, they estimated the distance to the galactic center at 7.6–8.2 kiloparsecs, or about 24,788–26,745 light years. They expected later Gaia data to improve the precision of these measurements.

Enrique Marquez Jr. has agreed to plead guilty to federal charges related to buying the rifles used in the 2015 San Bernardino attack, which killed 14 people and injured 22. He also admits conspiring with attacker Syed Rizwan Farook to plan earlier attacks that never occurred. Prosecutors say there is no evidence Marquez participated in or knew in advance about the San Bernardino attack. He faces up to 25 years in prison.

The passage highlights the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card’s unlimited 2% cash rewards, $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and $0 annual fee. It offers 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 18.99%, 23.99%, or 28.99%. Other benefits include cell phone protection and Visa Signature Concierge. The passage also lists Capital One Quicksilver and Citi Double Cash offers. Motley Fool Money says it receives advertising compensation but that compensation does not influence its product ratings.

Venezuelan Temporary Protected Status holders urged the Supreme Court to leave in place a federal judge’s final ruling that blocked the Trump administration from ending their protections. The Court had previously paused the judge’s preliminary order. The administration argues that earlier action requires the final ruling to be paused too. The challengers say the final ruling rests on a fuller record and different legal grounds, and warn that lifting it would harm families.

Costamare’s share price fell sharply from 2014 to 2016 amid weak global trade and shipping demand. The author argues that improving demand and higher charter rates could support a recovery. Management reported chartering 16 ships since the previous quarter, with none laid up, and said the idle fleet stood at 1.8%. Costamare has $1.2 billion in contracted revenue and has reduced net debt from $1.7 billion in 2013 to about $1 billion. The author owns CMRE shares and expects the stronger market and balance sheet to benefit the company.

Bitcoin fell below $8,000 on Friday before recovering slightly, after India’s finance minister said the government would act to prevent cryptocurrencies from being used for illegitimate financing or as part of the payment system. Indian authorities have repeatedly warned about digital currencies, and reports that banks suspended some exchange accounts have added to traders’ concerns. India accounts for an estimated 2% to 3% of global cryptocurrency trade, but industry figures see potential for growth. A government committee is studying cryptocurrencies, and the finance minister said India would await its report before taking action. He also said the country would examine using blockchain technology in its digital payment systems.

Amazon.com’s 2022 Form 10-K describes operations across North America, International, and Amazon Web Services, serving consumers, sellers, enterprises, content creators, and advertisers. Amazon employed approximately 1.54 million people at year-end. The report identifies risks including competition, international regulation, fulfillment and inventory challenges, security breaches, litigation, and taxes. In 2022, operating activities provided $46.8 billion in cash, while cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $70.0 billion at December 31.

The coach said the team was disappointed after losing the Stanley Cup Final to a better opponent that deserved to win. He praised the players’ hard work and resilience, the staff’s contributions and the fans’ support. Though the loss hurts, he called it an outstanding season and said the team would appreciate its run in a few days.

John Ternus, Apple’s 50-year-old senior vice president of hardware engineering, is reportedly a leading candidate to succeed CEO Tim Cook, particularly after chief operating officer Jeff Williams stepped back from operational duties. Ternus joined Apple in 2001 and has worked on major products including the iPhone, iPad, AirPods, Mac and Vision Pro. His growing public profile and broader role in product decisions have fueled succession speculation. Apple has not announced a successor.

Tesla’s 2020 Form 10-K describes two business segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. It covers electric vehicles, solar products, battery storage, related services, manufacturing, sales, financing and regulation. Tesla reported 70,757 full-time employees worldwide at December 31, 2020. The filing highlights risks involving COVID-19, production and factory expansion, suppliers and battery cells, competition, product defects, regulation and financing.
The time off has helped the team prepare for tomorrow’s game. They hope to avoid returning to Dallas down in the series and expect adjustments against the opponent’s strong shot blockers.

The passage describes a neural bridge that decodes a user’s neural activity to identify intended movements and sends electrical signals to a limb, prosthetic, or other device. It can adjust stimulation using subsequent neural activity and movement feedback, and interleave signals to produce compound movements. In an experiment, a participant with a paralyzed limb used the system to initiate, sustain, and stop discrete and rhythmic thumb movements through thought alone, achieving 77.4% overall accuracy across movement and rest states.

This case study examined education for students with visual impairment in Yangon through interviews, focus groups, observations, and documents. Students received primary education at special schools, then attended regular schools for lower secondary education while retaining support from the special schools. Participants valued the special schools’ Braille instruction, life-skills training, supplementary study, and sense of security. They also valued opportunities at regular schools to develop social skills and understanding between students with and without disabilities. Limitations included little coordination between schools, bullying, limited friendships across student groups, and poor awareness of educational opportunities. The study recommends stronger cooperation between special and regular schools and attention to students’ wider needs.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit data acquisition device. A shared SMPL_CLK and SMPL_SYNC synchronize channel sampling across multiple devices. It offers an internal or external voltage reference, configurable two- or four-lane SDR or DDR data output, output randomization, averaging, test patterns, and a speed-boost mode that samples one channel pair at up to 8MSPS. Registers are configured through SPI, including in daisy-chain arrangements. Initialization requires a free-running sampling clock after power-up or reset. The passage also describes an ATE application, power-supply decoupling and PCB layout recommendations, and cautions concerning documentation, handling, and use of TI resources.

This list of papers covers 1917 diplomacy before and after the United States entered the war. Its topics include peace proposals and responses, Germany’s resumption of unrestricted submarine warfare, the severance of U.S. relations with Germany, and the U.S. declaration of war on April 6. It also covers neutral seamen, submarine attacks, and Latin American governments’ responses, including severed relations with Germany, declarations of war, and proposals for an American states conference.

On August 1, 2016, Microsoft entered an underwriting agreement to issue $19.75 billion in senior unsecured notes across seven series, with interest rates from 1.100% to 3.950% and maturities from 2019 to 2056. Interest is payable semiannually beginning February 8, 2017. Microsoft may redeem the notes under certain circumstances described in the prospectus supplement.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs improve shading, ray tracing and AI performance over Turing. Second-generation RT Cores accelerate ray-traced motion blur, while third-generation Tensor Cores support DLSS, new data types and structured sparsity. GDDR6X increases memory bandwidth, and RTX IO uses GPU decompression to reduce CPU work when loading assets. The passage also describes the A40 and RTX A6000 for professional and data-center workloads, support for high-resolution displays, AV1 hardware decoding and video encoding, and memory error detection for GDDR6X overclocking.

A study of mortality in India used verbal autopsies for 20,453 people reported dead in a household survey and statistical adjustments to estimate causes of death in 2020–2021. It estimates that the annual all-cause death rate was 81.19% higher than in 2018–2019. SARS-CoV-2 accounted for 17.93% of deaths and 33.15% of excess deaths; cardiovascular disease accounted for 23.15% of excess deaths. SARS-CoV-2 death rates rose with age and spiked near the end of the 2020 lockdown and during the second COVID wave. The authors caution that reporting delays, survey non-response and possible cause-of-death misclassification limit the estimates.

The 3-4 defense uses three down linemen, four linebackers and four defensive backs. Its outside linebackers can rush the passer or cover receivers, allowing varied blitzes and coverages that can disguise the defense’s intentions. Its larger linemen must control two gaps. Spread offenses can expose the base alignment by drawing linebackers into coverage and leaving a five-man box vulnerable to runs; trips formations can also create coverage problems. The passage describes several blitzes and coverages and links the defense to coaches including Bill Parcells, Bill Belichick, Nick Saban and Kirby Smart.

Iran’s parliament gave initial approval to a bill responding to new US sanctions by allocating over $260 million each to its missile program and the Revolutionary Guards’ Quds Force. The bill also calls for support for Iranians affected by sanctions. It requires another parliamentary vote and clerical approval to become law.

Blackwell can gate entire clock trees, including the memory clock tree, to reduce dynamic power. Separate GPU-core and memory power rails enable independent voltage control and shutdown of idle regions, boosting performance and reducing leakage power.

In a study of 342 newborns in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea, 21.1% had low birth weight and 7.3% were preterm. A foot length below 7.7 cm identified low-birth-weight babies with 84.7% sensitivity and 69.6% specificity, and preterm babies with 88.0% sensitivity and 61.8% specificity. Researcher and volunteer measurements were similar on average but varied for individual babies. The authors describe foot-length measurement as a feasible way to identify vulnerable newborns, while noting that the study covered only one province and that its use could increase referrals.

The passage describes MSPM0G microcontroller features and design guidance. Five operating modes—RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN—trade performance for lower power consumption through two power domains. The devices include clock and power management, DMA, event routing, flash, SRAM, GPIO, analog peripherals, timers, watchdogs, and UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD interfaces. Security features include AES acceleration, key storage, firewalls, CRC, and a true random number generator.

It also covers debug and bootloader access, factory identification data, recommended external components, development tools, documentation, revision changes, packaging, and TI’s application and warranty disclaimers.

The lecture extends two-level full factorial experiments from two factors to any number of factors. It explains how contrasts or regression estimate main and interaction effects, and how ANOVA tests whether those effects are significant. A sheet-metal bending example shows why replicated runs are needed to estimate noise and assess significance; residual checks can reveal problems with a fitted model. Additional experimental points and replicates can test for curvature or lack of fit, though a center point is not meaningful for an unordered factor such as material type. The lecture closes with nuisance factors: randomizing runs can reduce their systematic influence, while blocking can protect estimates of main effects by confounding a nuisance effect with an interaction. This idea leads into fractional factorial design.

A Berliner Testament lets spouses name each other sole heir, with children generally inheriting after both parents die. This can protect the surviving spouse financially, but its binding provisions may prevent unilateral changes even if circumstances change or one spouse dies. Couples can include clauses allowing more flexibility. They should also consider inheritance tax, since naming one sole heir may use tax allowances less effectively than distributing the estate among several heirs.

This preprint compares models for forecasting annual fatal opioid overdoses by census tract in Massachusetts and Cook County, Illinois. It introduces “best possible reach,” a metric for assessing how well forecasts identify areas for targeted interventions. Model rankings differed from those based on conventional error measures, while a simple historical-average model performed competitively in both locations. The findings may not generalize beyond the two study areas.

Delta executives expect premium-cabin revenue to surpass coach revenue for at least a quarter or two next year. Last quarter, premium ticket revenue rose 9% to nearly $5.8 billion, while main-cabin revenue fell 4% to just over $6 billion.

Researchers are exploring ways to enhance memory, intelligence and brain function. One team hopes to develop a memorization pill by studying people with exceptional memories and has engineered fruit flies with photographic memories. Others are searching for genes linked to intelligence, though success is uncertain. Researchers are also developing deep brain stimulation devices that could monitor brain activity and respond to patterns associated with conditions such as panic attacks or depression.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures recent gains and losses on a 0–100 scale. CFD traders use it to identify potentially overbought or oversold assets and develop mean-reversion or trend-following strategies without owning the underlying assets. Common thresholds are 70 and 30, though shorter day-trading time frames may use 85 and 15. Settings depend on the asset, time frame and market conditions. Two SPY strategy backtests reported average gains of 0.86% and 0.67% per trade; the latter had smoother drawdowns. The passage emphasizes backtesting, combining RSI with other indicators, and managing risks associated with leverage and trading costs.

Former Langley City mayor and Liberal MLA Peter Fassbender is considering running for mayor again. He expects to decide by late July or early August. Two incumbent city councillors have already declared their candidacies.

The Supreme Court will review whether a Texas man’s plea-agreement waiver bars his appeal of a sentencing condition requiring him to take prescribed mental health medication. The 5th Circuit dismissed his appeal based on the waiver, although the trial judge had told him he had a right to appeal.

The passage describes how a host BIOS integrates AGESA software. The host must establish a stack, prepare configuration headers, call AGESA through a dispatcher or bridge, and implement a router for AGESA call-outs. It outlines UEFI build files and platform options, stack and Cache-as-RAM requirements, and initialization across SEC, PEI, DXE, and later boot stages. Documented procedures cover processor and memory initialization, configuration, data-table generation, and suspend and resume. The host must also provide required services, including memory-buffer allocation and deallocation.

The speaker accepts the nation’s trust with gratitude and a sense of responsibility. He says the country’s recent prosperity has been disrupted by the unjust actions of warring powers despite its impartial neutrality. He pledges to seek peace, defend national independence, uphold the Union and Constitution, protect individual rights, limit spending and military forces, and encourage commerce, agriculture, science, and education. He draws confidence from his predecessors, fellow citizens, other branches of government, and divine guidance.

Yankees rookie Cam Schlittler pitched eight scoreless innings against Boston in Game 3 of the AL Wild Card series, striking out 12 without a walk. Scout Matt Hyde, who first saw him at Northeastern, called the performance “unbelievable.”

The court affirmed a judgment awarding real estate brokers a commission for procuring Mrs. Tallman as a purchaser for the Thuros’ property. George Thuro could not defeat the brokers’ claim by refusing to be bound by the sale contract, and whether Mrs. Tallman had authority to sign for her husband was immaterial. Any difference between the brokers’ pleading and proof did not prejudice the defendants. The court also found no reversible error in its refusal of requested instructions or its rulings on the replication.

Montecito Union School District agreed to pay $7.5 million to settle a lawsuit brought by two brothers who alleged that a former principal sexually abused them in the 1970s. The district admitted no liability. The settlement equals about 40% of its 2025–26 budget, and the superintendent said a hiring freeze, reductions through attrition and redirected repair funds would help cover the cost. The case was filed after California removed the statute of limitations for such claims in 2019. A proposal to restore a time limit stalled weeks before the settlement.

Barry Ritholtz argues that percentage-based labels for market dips, corrections, crashes, and bull and bear markets lack a sound basis and do not help investors manage risk or deploy capital. He proposes defining long-term markets through economic trends, volatility, and changes in what investors will pay for corporate earnings. Secular bull markets feature favorable economic shifts and rising earnings multiples; secular bear markets feature tougher conditions, greater volatility, and falling multiples. He estimates that rising price-to-earnings ratios accounted for about three-quarters of the 1982–2000 bull market’s gains.

The 100% tariffs on branded drugs that President Trump said would begin Wednesday did not take effect. A White House official said the administration would prepare tariffs on companies that neither build in the U.S. nor reach drug-pricing agreements, but gave no timeline. Officials are also calling pharmaceutical executives frequently to pursue deals ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

The passage describes defenses against a high-post split offense followed by down screens. A basic NBA approach has defenders sag toward the high post to block cuts and handoffs, then show and recover on down screens to avoid mismatches from switching. The more aggressive SOS approach pressures and denies the high-post pass, switches on cuts and screens, denies passes to shooters and low-post players, and traps passes to the wing or low post.

On February 11, 2015, NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K announcing results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 25, 2015. The filing includes a press release and CFO commentary as exhibits; both are furnished rather than filed.

A survey of 333 teachers in Türkiye examined their knowledge of and views on using the metaverse in education. Teachers saw potential for engaging, practical learning, especially in science, mathematics and information technology, and expressed interest in training. Although 78.1% reported prior experience, their accounts mostly involved virtual reality or three-dimensional worlds rather than the metaverse as currently described. Their main concerns were technical problems, addiction, unequal access and data security. Participants viewed schools and other stakeholders as largely unprepared. The study recommends teacher training, stronger infrastructure, suitable content and gradual implementation.

A Box & One defense uses four zone defenders and one player dedicated to denying an opponent the ball. The “Flash/Back Door” offense attacks its vulnerable middle with a baseline post flash, creating shot, high-low pass, and wing back-cut opportunities. If these produce no good shot, the offense can flow into Single/Double Screen action. Variations use a baseline screen for the star player or an entry pass and point back cut. Effective execution requires coordinated screens, post-ups, defensive recognition, and timing; scouting helps players anticipate defensive reads and adjustments.

Deutsche Bank is looking to sell its 8.8 percent stake in Dubai-based Abraaj, sources said, as its own restructuring and Abraaj’s investor dispute add urgency to a plan considered for some time. Four investors are investigating alleged misuse of money in an Abraaj healthcare fund; Abraaj denies wrongdoing. Valuing Deutsche’s stake is difficult because Abraaj has not disclosed its debt. Facing cashflow pressure, Abraaj is considering asset sales and has cut jobs, suspended new investments and made management changes.

This study compared Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) with an explainable convolutional neural network for detecting technical and procedural outliers in plantar pressure data. Experts labeled 1,031 recordings, including 233 outliers; synthetic augmentation produced a dataset of 2,798 samples. In nested cross-validation, the machine-learning approach outperformed SPM in binary outlier detection, achieving an average F1-score of 0.99 and Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.96, versus 0.93 and 0.78 for SPM. Sixteen experts rated explanations from both approaches positively, with no statistically significant differences across the assessed attributes. More ratings favored the machine-learning explanations than SPM or a combined presentation. The authors note potential bias from synthetic samples and call for further evaluation of explanation methods.

The speaker says a doctor confirmed his MCL has healed and his knee feels strong. Another tear is not painful but will need surgery after the series; a brace will help meanwhile. After working on his recovery, he says he is ready to play tomorrow and hopes another player heals quickly enough to return to the series.

A speaker describes the emotional experience of watching his baby’s birth. Discussing hockey, he says an elbow to teammate Dino’s head motivated the team to play harder and win. He also describes the game as fast, says players try to be clean, and hopes the league reviews the Drury hit.

The preprint introduces LUKB DT, a web tool that constructs disease trajectories from electronic medical records by identifying exposure-associated diseases, testing the temporal order of disease pairs, and validating those pairs. In a UK Biobank COVID-19 case study, it identified 527 validated disease pairs; the resulting trajectories mainly involved SARS-CoV-2-related conditions and subsequent medical care. The authors note that incomplete diagnostic data and trajectories assembled from disease pairs may limit how closely the results reflect patients’ experiences.

The Supreme Court will hear Lt Col Prasad Shrikant Purohit’s bail plea and a challenge to co-accused Pragya Singh Thakur’s bail on August 17. The Bombay High Court denied Purohit bail but granted it to Thakur. A victim’s father says she could influence witnesses. Six people died in the 2008 Malegaon blast.

H. B. Fuller VP Traci L. Jensen sold 5,397 shares on October 2 for $315,184.80. The company reported quarterly earnings of $0.65 per share, below the $0.67 consensus estimate, while revenue of $562.87 million exceeded expectations. It announced a $0.15 quarterly dividend payable November 2. Analysts’ average rating was “Hold,” with a $57.40 consensus price target. Institutional investors owned 92.37% of its stock.

NVIDIA’s May 7, 2015 Form 8-K includes a press release and CFO commentary on results for the quarter ended April 26, 2015. It also announces plans to wind down Icera modem operations in the second quarter of fiscal 2016, while remaining open to a sale. If no sale occurs, NVIDIA estimates restructuring charges of $100 million to $125 million, primarily in fiscal 2016.

David Ellison praised CBS News while saying he wants it to become a more trusted news source. His appointment of Bari Weiss as editor in chief has raised questions about the network’s direction. Ellison rejected claims that CBS News would serve Trump-aligned interests and said he wants to appeal to center-left and center-right Americans, but did not specify what changes he plans.

Children with language vulnerabilities may need tailored support, but providing varied, consistent examples of grammatical forms during everyday activities is demanding for therapists and educators. The researchers developed TalBot, which combines a conversational robot with a large language model to lead a word-guessing game. Tests with preschool children and educators indicate that it can manage turns and respond to some mispronunciations and speech-recognition errors.

The researchers plan to extend TalBot to teach morphology by generating targeted language examples and modeling them for children and educators. Laboratory, preschool, and feasibility studies will assess its language output, children’s skills, and user experiences. Data protection, ethical risks, cost, and practical adoption remain concerns.

The Grand Erie and Brant-Haldimand-Norfolk Catholic school boards are discussing a single high school sports league across Brantford, Haldimand and Norfolk. The proposal aims to give schools consistent rules and equal playing opportunities. No decision or timeline has been set, and officials say longer travel distances must be considered.

NVIDIA appointed Stephen C. Neal to its board on March 30, 2019. He received grants of 1,419 restricted stock units vesting over three years and 139 units vesting on May 15, 2019, plus a $10,890 cash retainer. NVIDIA also entered into an indemnity agreement with him.

Scotland will abolish local authority burial and cremation fees for children under 18, with the Scottish government providing £500,000 to cover the cost. Most councils already waive fees for children under 16. The change brings Scotland into line with England and has been welcomed by the Church of Scotland.

The TPS7H5001-SP push-pull design uses Type 2A frequency compensation targeting a 10-kHz crossover, with selected RCOMP, CCOMP, and CHF values of 40.2 kΩ, 15 nF, and 47 pF. Seven 330-µF output capacitors provide approximately 2.3 mF; a 102-kΩ resistor sets slope compensation. TPS7H500x-SP controllers operate from 4 V to 14 V and require at least 0.1 µF of input bypass capacitance. Layout guidance emphasizes separating sensitive signals from switching noise, minimizing high-current loops, separating analog and power grounds, and placing bypass and compensation components near the controller. The passage also provides documentation, revision, packaging, and handling information.

Young people choosing college courses need not know exactly what they want to do for life: career plans can change. Technological advances will reshape many industries, making it important to develop skills that employers or customers value. The writer advises workers to seek fair pay for what they offer and to expect some days of drudgery. Life outside work matters too.

Cover 2 is a zone coverage with five defenders covering short routes and two safeties splitting deep coverage. It helps defend quick passes, receiver screens and outside runs, but is vulnerable to multiple deep routes and certain running plays, particularly against 2x2 or trips formations. Variations can change which defenders cover the deep halves or disguise the coverage with a one-high safety look.
Emirates reversed its decision to discontinue its in-flight Hindu meal option after customer feedback, saying it would retain the option to help Hindu passengers identify and request it.

The study analyzes author-supplied keywords from 1,076 articles published in the *Information Systems Education Journal* between 2003 and 2024. Using co-occurrence analysis and term maps, it examines five time periods and the full collection. Topics shifted from curriculum and assessment in 2003–2007 toward pedagogy and student issues in 2008–2012, cybersecurity and analytics in 2013–2017, COVID-19-related concerns in 2018–2022, and artificial intelligence in 2023–2024. Pedagogy and curriculum remained central across the full period. The authors note that relying solely on author-supplied keywords and the effects of special issues may limit the findings.

The passage describes AGESA host-environment integration, UEFI initialization, build configuration, and service procedures. Binary builds route AGESA call-outs through a host-implemented router. UEFI support spans SEC, PEI, DXE, and runtime execution; PEIMs initialize processors and memory, coordinate resets, and publish status interfaces, while DXE drivers generate tables and control GPU VGA decoding.

The host must establish a stack before calling procedures that require one. For applicable x86-64 APUs, provided macros establish and remove a pre-memory Cache-as-RAM stack; APUs with a Platform Security Processor instead use PSP-initialized DRAM. The passage also lists build files, environment variables, platform options, and Cache-as-RAM restrictions. Additional services create and release parameter structures, report processor and memory information, update MMIO mappings, and read event-log entries.

Ryan Carter said the team made no significant changes but would learn from its last game. He cited careless turnovers, poor execution and a passive start, while noting they still had chances to win. The team plans to review video, restore its forecheck and play its game. He said timely hits can energize a home crowd.

Leicester City manager Craig Shakespeare said Sunday’s 4-2 defeat at Everton, his first since taking charge, would not affect the team’s confidence before Wednesday’s Champions League quarter-final at Atletico Madrid. He said he rotated the squad with upcoming fixtures in mind and blamed poor defending at corners for the defeat. Captain Wes Morgan will miss the Madrid match with a back injury.

US employers added 200,000 jobs in January, exceeding forecasts, while annual wage growth reached 2.9%, its fastest pace since 2009. Unemployment remained at 4.1%. The report strengthened the case for a Federal Reserve rate increase in March, and Treasury yields rose following its release.

Dr. Harris L. Rittenberg’s family dental practice has served children and adults at the same location for over 50 years. Rittenberg has practiced there for over 25 years and participated in a program restoring smiles for domestic violence victims. Dr. Brittany Jones has joined the team.

FERC extended NYISO’s Automated Mitigation Procedures through April 30, 2002, rather than the October 31 extension NYISO requested. It directed NYISO to file a comprehensive mitigation proposal by March 1, 2002, effective May 1. The proposal must address concerns about unnecessary mitigation, treatment of small bids and energy-limited resources, possible barriers to new generation, and coordination with other mitigation measures. FERC also urged NYISO to collaborate with PJM and ISO-NE. Enron had opposed the extension.

Laredo Petroleum shares rose 0.72% in the most recent session and closed at $9.80. Analysts’ average 12-month price target was $13.54, with estimates ranging from $9.50 to $17. Of 24 recommendations, five were Buy, five Outperform, 12 Hold and two Underperform. The stock’s ATR-14 was 0.45, its RSI was 39.08, and its market capitalization was $2.35 billion.

Lowe’s is leaving NASCAR after 18 seasons as Jimmie Johnson’s only Cup Series anchor sponsor. Johnson says a replacement could sponsor the final years of his Cup career. He plans to keep racing afterward and has mentioned the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Rolex 24 at Daytona and, if IndyCar adopts cockpit halos, the Indianapolis 500.

The passage describes a method for placing a model, such as an advertisement, into a video. A three-dimensional reference model is positioned on a plane in one frame, and its feature points are used to calculate the camera pose. The plane is tracked across later frames to calculate their camera poses. The reference model is then replaced with the target model and projected into each frame to generate a new video. The disclosure also describes an apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for implementing the method.

The passage describes three alternatives to traditional text messaging: Music Messenger lets users send songs; WhatsApp offers free messaging across smartphones, including media sharing and customization; and Facebook Messenger provides media sharing, HD video chats, group conversations, and customizable emojis and text colors.

The strategy buys the S&P 500 at the close when it opens at a five-day low but closes above its opening price, then sells at the next open. The passage reports a historical average overnight return of 0.04%. In tests from 2005 onward, the strategy averaged 0.26% per trade, or 0.17% excluding its largest winner.

New York’s Excelsior Scholarship covers SUNY and CUNY tuition for eligible students, but not fees, housing or books. Its introduction has prompted more students to consider public colleges and raised concerns among smaller private colleges about enrollment. In response, some private colleges have reduced tuition or expanded scholarships and graduation guarantees. Students and families are weighing those offers alongside cost, academic programs and campus fit.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 27, 2017, announcing its first-quarter 2017 financial results. The filing includes a press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

Apple filed a Form 8-K on July 26, 2016, reporting that it had issued a press release and data sheet on its third-quarter financial results for the period ended June 25, 2016. Both documents are attached as exhibits.

The Federal Reserve proposed easing the Volcker Rule, which bars banks from using depositors’ money for risky trading on their own behalf. The changes would apply the strictest requirements to banks that do the most trading, a move Fed officials say would reduce uncertainty. The proposal follows other efforts to loosen financial regulations, including a rollback of parts of the Dodd-Frank law. Consumer advocates warn that weakening the rule could revive risky practices, while a banking attorney says banks’ proprietary trading desks are unlikely to return.

Lotte Chemical plans to list its Malaysian subsidiary, Lotte Chemical Titan Holding, in the third quarter of 2017. Sources say the IPO could raise $1 billion to $1.5 billion, though pricing remains undetermined. Proceeds would fund petrochemical projects in Indonesia and Malaysia. The listing was postponed from last year following investigations into alleged fraud at Lotte Group.

The lecture introduces Bitcoin as a way to study blockchain’s technical foundations. It explains how hash functions help link blocks and reveal tampering, Merkle trees summarize transactions, and public and private keys enable digital signatures. Bitcoin uses a timestamped, append-only transaction ledger; mining rewards provide incentives, while network consensus determines which blocks are added. Updating the software also requires consensus across the decentralized network.

The offside trap is a defensive maneuver in which backs move upfield together just before an opponent passes, aiming to leave a leading attacker offside. If successful, it can win possession without a challenge; if one defender moves late or an onside attacker plays the ball, it can leave the goalkeeper exposed.

The trap requires a coordinated back line, awareness of attackers and a clear signal from one designated defender. Coaches should weigh its risks against their players’ ability and the opponent’s style: teams using through balls are more vulnerable than those using quick, short passes. The trap can be used during open play or free kicks, but requires repeated practice, effective communication and selective use.

A North Korean missile exploded shortly after launch near Sinpo on Sunday. US officials described it as medium-range but did not identify the model. Weapons expert John Schilling said the early failure could indicate a new system still in development and doubted speculation that US hacking caused it. Separately, Pentagon chief Jim Mattis ordered a review of the US nuclear deterrent.

A hockey player from Brick, New Jersey, recalls hearing about Jim Dowd, describes an exciting game decided by a shootout, and says he chose New Hampshire over Michigan to stay close to home while pursuing an NHL career.

Equity represents corporate ownership and can provide returns through dividends or capital gains. Shareholders have residual claims, voting rights and limited liability. Public markets help companies raise capital, while short selling can make prices more informative. The lecture distinguishes newly issued securities from those traded in secondary markets and describes how technology has increased trading.

The dividend discount model values stock using expected future dividends and risk-adjusted discount rates. With constant dividends and rates, price equals D/r; with perpetual dividend growth, it equals D/(r−g). Growth expectations can strongly affect prices, but forecasting dividends, risks and discount rates is difficult. Companies generally avoid raising dividends unless they expect to sustain them.

In 2006, SunPower produced the world’s most efficient commercially available solar cells as demand for photovoltaic power grew rapidly. Interest in solar power was driven by environmental concerns, energy independence and public subsidies, but solar electricity remained substantially more expensive than conventional power. Rapid industry growth also strained silicon supplies and raised prices.

Founded in 1987, SunPower moved from research into commercial manufacturing through a partnership with Cypress Semiconductor. Its back-contact cell design increased efficiency and improved appearance, though it required a more complex manufacturing process. SunPower expanded into modules, secured long-term silicon supply, invested in wafer production and acquired a large-scale installer.

The company faced larger established manufacturers and emerging technologies. CEO Tom Werner’s central challenge was how to turn SunPower’s efficiency advantage into a lasting competitive edge while deciding how much to emphasize module pricing, process improvements and installation costs.

This protocol describes a systematic review of observational cohort studies on how Rapid Response Team services are introduced or redesigned. It will examine reasons for change, implementation methods and time frames, and measures of success. Researchers will search multiple databases, screen and extract data independently, assess risk of bias, and report mainly narrative findings with simple statistics. Potential limitations include variation in team structures and outcome reporting, and a lack of relevant studies. The review has no external funding and does not require ethical approval.

Asia-Pacific equities gained in April as risk appetite rose amid French election results, easing North Korea concerns and strong corporate earnings. India led regional gains this year, while China lagged. New Zealand and Indian shares had the highest valuations; South Korean and Hong Kong shares were cheapest.

The ADS868xW is a 16-bit SAR ADC with high-impedance analog inputs, an integrated programmable gain amplifier, filter, ADC driver, and selectable internal or external 4.096V reference. Its input protection withstands up to ±20V when properly powered and ±15V when AVDD is floating; external protection is still needed for surges, ESD, and electrical fast transients.

The device supports single-ended and differential inputs, programmable input ranges, and alarms for user-set input thresholds and fixed AVDD thresholds. Its multiSPI interface supports standard SPI and source-synchronous data transfer, single or dual outputs, and daisy-chaining. It has RESET, acquisition, and conversion states, nine configuration registers, and NAP and power-down modes. The passage also provides an eight-channel industrial input module example and recommendations for supply decoupling and PCB layout.

Enron replaced CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeff McMahon to restore investor confidence as the SEC examined transactions with partnerships Fastow had run. Investors and analysts questioned the deals, Enron’s disclosures and possible liabilities. Enron shares fell 17% to $16.41 on October 24, while other energy-trading stocks also declined. Shareholder lawsuits alleged misleading disclosures and conflicts of interest; Enron denied wrongdoing.

Air cargo containers let commercial airlines and military forces move goods quickly without unloading and reloading them between locations. Airlines use aircraft-specific containers on passenger and cargo aircraft. Demand for fast transport and advances in lightweight, durable containers support market growth, while a global economic slowdown and higher aviation fuel costs hinder it. The passage identifies more commercial cargo aircraft and military transport needs as potential sources of future demand. It segments the market by container type, aircraft type, end user, and region.

A geoarchaeological study of Karnak Temple, based on sediment cores and pottery, found that the site emerged as an island between ancient Nile channels. Regular flooding likely prevented permanent occupation before about 2520 BCE. As the channels shifted and silted up, the temple expanded over roughly 3,000 years. Researchers suggest its island setting may have influenced its selection because it resembled an Egyptian creation myth.

Microsoft’s Cortana voice assistant works on Windows 10 desktops, laptops and tablets, and is also available on Android and iOS, though the passage says it works less efficiently there. It integrates with the Edge browser, searches local and cloud files, and can learn a user’s voice. It also offers location-based reminders and entertainment features such as jokes and songs.

NVIDIA entered an underwriting agreement on March 26, 2020, to issue $5 billion in unsecured senior notes maturing in 2030, 2040, 2050 and 2060. The offering generated approximately $4.97 billion in net proceeds, intended for general corporate purposes, potentially including debt repayment. Interest is payable twice yearly. The notes may be redeemed before maturity, and specified change-of-control and ratings-downgrade conditions would require NVIDIA to offer to repurchase them.

The passage argues that Chinese family education places too much emphasis on grades and discipline while neglecting children’s moral development, independence and individual interests. It calls for more equitable higher-education resources, guidance toward personal interests, and an emphasis on generosity and contribution to society. It also recommends drawing on traditional Chinese moral education, spending time in nature, and using shared activities to strengthen parent–child relationships. The passage presents religious belief as a source of ethical guidance and stresses parents’ influence on children’s behavior, particularly mothers’ influence.

The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card offers 0% introductory APR for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 16.99%, 23.49%, or 28.74%. It has no annual fee and includes cellphone protection, but offers no ongoing rewards. Balance transfers incur a 5% fee ($5 minimum), and foreign transactions incur a 3% fee. The review presents it as an option for paying down debt or financing a large purchase.

The speaker praised the team’s mental toughness and composure in a difficult game, saying a greater effort around the net led to a rebound goal. A player scored in overtime after taking on extra minutes and playing both wings because of an injury. The speaker said playoff games have been close, Toni Lydman decided after consulting trainers to play, and the team needs to improve at five-on-five rather than focus on special teams.

Former Ford CEO Mark Fields said US automakers expanded EV production without adequately considering consumer demand, which has fallen short of their expectations. A company announced a $1.6 billion charge to realign EV capacity with demand. Industry figures disagreed on whether the expiration of federal incentives would slow US EV sales.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. Output voltage is programmed through a resistor divider referenced to 0.613 V, while a capacitor sets soft-start time. Switching frequency ranges from 100 kHz to 2 MHz and can be set by an RT resistor, an external clock, or synchronization between two controllers.

Depending on the device, the controllers provide one or two primary switching outputs and synchronous-rectifier outputs. They support programmable duty-cycle limits, dead time, leading-edge blanking, slope compensation, and frequency compensation. Protection features include pulse skipping, cycle-by-cycle current limiting followed by hiccup operation, external fault shutdown, and thermal shutdown.

The passage gives a 500-kHz, 5-V synchronous push-pull converter design example using the TPS7H5001-SP, including component selections for its transformer, GaN switches, output filter, current sensing, and compensation. It also recommends a regulated 4–14-V controller supply, close bypass capacitors, short switching loops, separation of analog and power grounds, and routing sensitive signals away from noisy traces.

The speaker says he created several scoring chances in a loss but failed to capitalize and hopes to do better next game. He describes the opponent as fast and hardworking, and says his play has fluctuated during the playoffs but is improving. He praises Dave’s scoring, defensive work and leadership. The team aims to keep the puck deep and cycle it to wear down opposing defensemen.

The Timberwolves host the NBA-best Rockets on Sunday, with both teams playing the second night of a back-to-back. Minnesota is sixth in the West after losing to San Antonio on Saturday; Karl-Anthony Towns scored 23 points. Houston beat New Orleans behind James Harden’s 32 points and leads Golden State by 2½ games. The Rockets have won all three meetings with Minnesota this season, each by 18 points.

Engineers at UC San Diego developed ultrasound-powered nanorobots that swim through blood and remove bacteria and their toxins. The robots are gold nanowires coated with fused platelet and red blood cell membranes, which bind bacteria and neutralize toxins. In tests with MRSA-contaminated blood, treated samples had three times less bacteria and toxins than untreated samples after five minutes. The proof-of-concept work remains at an early stage; researchers plan animal tests and are exploring biodegradable materials.

At its December 13, 2022 annual meeting, Microsoft shareholders re-elected all 12 directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as auditor for fiscal 2023. They rejected six shareholder proposals concerning diversity and inclusion, hiring people with arrest or incarceration records, retirement fund investments and climate change, government use of Microsoft technology, military products, and tax transparency. Of 7.46 billion shares eligible to vote, 6.41 billion were voted.

The article backtests two trend-following strategies and one momentum strategy on BTC-USD data from 2015 to April 2021, excluding commissions, slippage and taxes. It reports that all three beat buy-and-hold, though substantial drawdowns remained. A 100-day versus 250-day moving-average strategy returned a 115% CAGR, compared with 94% for buy-and-hold, and had a 65% maximum drawdown. The momentum strategy compared the current close with the close 25 days earlier. The article attributes the strategies’ results to Bitcoin’s large price swings but notes that future results are not guaranteed.

The speaker says the team played strongly and killed most early penalties, but still has much work ahead. They expect Jersey to respond strongly despite the playoff setting. Practices are mainly for loosening up; the team’s focus is limiting top scorers through back pressure and defending at the blue line.

Brett Veach will lead his first draft as Chiefs general manager without a first-round pick, but with one second-round and two third-round selections. After several trades that helped address salary-cap concerns, he says he may trade up for a player he likes. Kansas City is expected to prioritize defensive needs, particularly pass rusher and cornerback, while potentially adding support for new starting quarterback Patrick Mahomes II. Recent drafts have produced standouts including Tyreek Hill and Kareem Hunt, though some defensive picks have disappointed.

The court discharged the defendant’s late challenge to a reference because the referees had completed their review and agreed on a report, with no allegation of misconduct or refusal to hear evidence.

The passage describes convolutional neural networks trained to classify nucleotides as donor splice sites, acceptor splice sites, or non-splicing sites. It details architectures using dilated convolutions, residual blocks, skip connections, and surrounding sequence context. To detect aberrant splicing, the systems compare splice-site scores for reference and variant sequences and classify variants when the differences exceed a threshold.

Football kickers score extra points and field goals, handle kickoffs and attempt occasional onside kicks. Their accuracy can decide close games and influence whether coaches attempt field goals on fourth down. Kickoffs also help limit returns, while onside kicks can give a team another possession. The role demands accuracy, lower-body power, consistent technique and flexibility. The passage highlights Justin Tucker, Morten Andersen and Adam Vinatieri for their kicking records and careers.

The May 31, 2001 VentureWire newsletter reports that Insight Capital closed a $740 million fund, Rho Ventures closed a $435 million fund, and Quake Technologies raised $30 million. It says Whitney & Co. plans to spin off its international offices. Other coverage includes startup financing, PaperExchange’s closure of European operations, partnerships, acquisitions, and executive and board appointments.

Stifel downgraded GrubHub from Buy to Hold after its shares gained more than 200% in a year, citing elevated valuations despite an encouraging outlook. It raised its price target to $110 and increased 2019 revenue and earnings estimates, partly reflecting the expected benefits of GrubHub’s Yum! Brands partnership.

Nobel Prizes celebrate major discoveries and draw public attention to science, but their categories and three-person limit leave many fields and contributors unrecognized. Established through Alfred Nobel’s will and first awarded in 1901, the prizes typically go to scientists at well-funded institutions; winners have predominantly been white men from wealthy regions. Barriers in scientific careers and a tendency to recognize lab heads can further limit who receives credit. Despite these shortcomings, scientists interviewed in the passage say the prizes help show how science changes lives.

The study develops a machine-learning method to predict ionic dielectric constants by separately modeling Born effective charges and phonon properties, then combining them analytically. Trained on 928 oxides, it substantially outperformed a model that predicted ionic dielectric constants directly. Screening 8,717 oxides identified 38 high-κ candidates with favorable dielectric constants and band gaps. Ten have been synthesized, and all five with reported dielectric measurements showed high values. Ionic contributions exceeded 90% of the total dielectric constants for the identified candidates.

North Carolina agencies are discussing whether to test backyard vegetables near Chemours’ Fayetteville plant for GenX and related chemicals, following residents’ concerns and a Dutch study that found the chemicals in vegetables near another Chemours factory. No decision on testing has been made. Results from fish tests near both plants are expected within months. GenX’s effects on humans are unknown, and there are no federal health standards for it. The chemical has also been detected in wells near the Fayetteville plant and in treated drinking water downstream in Wilmington.

Backtests of SPY, GLD, and TLT entered after two consecutive days of higher highs and higher lows and exited after 1–10 bars. The pattern produced weak short-term returns and was not reliable as a standalone long or short trading signal. Testing three or four consecutive days did not improve results.

The coach said the team is focused on the next game rather than the opponent’s injured player. After a long flight, practice was limited to loosening up, not systems work. He wants players to enjoy the moment without losing focus, an approach he says has helped them handle pressure.
