An **ambassador** brokers external communication, including sharded storage access, service discovery, and request splitting. An **adapter** converts differing monitoring, logging, or health-check interfaces into consistent ones. Reusable containers need parameters, stable APIs, and documentation.

Across machines, replicated load-balanced services provide redundancy and scale; readiness probes identify instances able to serve requests. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate replicated layers. Sharded services distribute subsets of requests or data across machines, increasing storage capacity but making shard failures and changes to shard count consequential. Replicating shards can improve resilience. Effective sharding depends on choosing a request key and a deterministic, uniform mapping function; consistent hashing reduces remapping when the number of shards changes.

Crystal morphology affects the safety and performance of energetic materials, but common prediction models do not fully capture observed shapes or growth kinetics. The passage introduces an open-source kinetic Monte Carlo method that uses intermolecular interaction parameters to simulate crystal growth. It represents lattice sites and their interactions as a graph, identifies surface sites available for adsorption or evaporation, and uses event rates to evolve the crystal over time. Applied to PETN, the method shows excellent agreement with attachment-energy model predictions and experimental observations.

Teams should have a practiced corner-kick defense that players can take up immediately. Each player needs a clear role, while the goalkeeper remains in charge and communicates when claiming the ball. Defenders should attack and clear the ball, then move forward and look for a quick counterattack. Zone defense assigns areas and is easier to introduce to youth players, but zones can be overloaded. Man-to-man defense assigns attackers to defenders, who must track them closely. A mixed approach combines zonal positions near goal with marking elsewhere. Coaches should rehearse positioning, communication, varied corner kicks, clearances, and transitions, and may adjust the plan after scouting opponents.
NVIDIA’s combined L1 cache and shared memory improves performance and simplifies tuning. A100 increases capacity to 192 KB/SM from V100’s 128 KB/SM.

The Mid Screen offense uses an on-ball screen near the center of the court to free the point guard for a drive, pull-up jumper, pass to the rolling post, or kick-out pass to a wing shooter. The ballhandler and screener adjust to defensive responses such as switches, traps, and defenders going over or under the screen. If the initial action does not produce a shot, it can lead into other offensive continuities. Variations include screen-and-pop, Horns, post isolation, and a high-post passing game. Effective execution requires coordinated timing, defensive recognition, practice, and scouting.

With Casey Mittelstadt’s college season over, he could join Rochester on an AHL contract or amateur tryout, including for the playoffs. An NHL entry-level deal beginning this season would prevent that move but could use up its first year. Signing a contract would end his NCAA eligibility.

Self-driving technology is advancing in stages. Levels 1 and 2 automate some driving functions but require full driver attention. BMW expects its 2021 iNext to offer Level 3, which permits drivers to look away but requires them to take over within seconds. Level 4 allows more time and can stop the car if needed; Waymo already operates limited Level 4 cars. BMW expects fully driverless Level 5 capability near the end of the next decade.

The passage presents a GaN-based synchronous push-pull converter design using the TPS7H5001-SP. It targets a 5-V output at 500 kHz, with approximately 25-ns dead time, a 2.5 transformer turns ratio, a 0.47-µH output inductor, and approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance. It describes component selection for current limiting, soft-start, filtering, and frequency compensation, noting that some values may require adjustment during testing. The TPS7H500x-SP controllers operate from a 4-V to 14-V supply. Layout guidance emphasizes separating sensitive signals from switching noise, minimizing switching loops, and placing bypass components close to the controller.

A Devils player described getting past Zubov for a shot and defending two-on-one chances. He said the team wants to take advantage of its position against Dallas on Thursday rather than extend the series. He cited his experience in Finnish finals and said he has grown more comfortable playing Dallas, whose speed, cycling and support make them difficult to defend. He also said the Devils have improved their line changes through communication and discipline.

Schools and districts that perform well in reading usually perform well in math, too. A nationwide analysis found 140 districts with outstanding results across subjects and grade levels, versus 14 that excelled in one subject but underperformed in another. In Mississippi, school-level reading and math scores had a 0.87 correlation, and schools with strong reading growth generally had strong math growth. Florida showed similar patterns. The passage notes that proficiency scores may reflect students’ socioeconomic status and that growth measures depend on how states calculate them.

The passage describes a proposed system for detecting abnormal cardiac activity, including atrial fibrillation, from cardiac and motion data collected by devices such as smart watches. It assesses signal quality, extracts cardiovascular features, transforms the data into tensors, and uses convolutional, bidirectional recurrent, and attention networks to classify time windows. It can report classifications, identify windows associated with abnormalities, and estimate the proportion of time spent in abnormal cardiac activity.

A retrospective study of 2,514 women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy found that 13% received a new hypertension diagnosis after a blood pressure check 15–90 days postpartum. Higher systolic blood pressure, older age, and severe preeclampsia or eclampsia were associated with greater risk. Nearly 40% of women diagnosed with a hypertensive disorder during the study period had no documented blood pressure check in that postpartum window at either health system. The authors recommend more consistent screening and early management of cardiovascular risk factors.

JPMorgan Chase has deployed its generative AI platform to 200,000 employees and reports more than 175 AI use cases across customer service, research, fraud detection and risk management. It plans to spend roughly $18 billion on technology this year. The bank says automation has improved productivity, but transparency, compliance, security, legacy systems and costs remain challenges.

Wandera’s analysis of 50,000 moderately to heavily used iPhones and iPads found that batteries lasted an average of 96 minutes on iOS 11, compared with 240 minutes on iOS 10. Older devices may experience worse drain. An iOS 11.0.1 update improved battery life to 159 minutes, while iOS 11.0.2 had not yet been tested. Wandera advises against reverting to older software for security reasons. Users can conserve battery by limiting background app refresh and location access or using low power mode.

More than 250 Connaught Public School students played tunnel ball simultaneously, surpassing the existing record of 120, pending Guinness verification. The event raised $10,000 for schoolyard improvements, including a playground and basketball court.

An October 29, 2001 collection of news reports describes Enron’s falling shares after Moody’s downgraded its long-term debt to Baa2 and warned of further cuts. Enron sought additional bank credit after drawing about $3 billion the previous week. Disclosures about partnerships linked to its former chief financial officer prompted an SEC inquiry, shareholder lawsuits and concerns about its financial reporting. Some European energy firms restricted trading with Enron over credit concerns. A separate Moody’s report warned that U.S. corporate credit quality was likely to worsen.

This CS5535 specification update lists several issues and workarounds. Reading Port 60h can incorrectly clear AuxOutputFull; interrupts are recommended for USB keyboard and mouse PS/2 emulation. UDMA tACK settings do not change IDE_DACK timing, but the fixed timing meets requirements. WORD-aligned PRDs can hang ATAC, so drivers should use DWORD alignment. The LPC controller may abort transactions with LPC-to-ISA bridges; a programmed PLD can provide a workaround. SMB NEGACK status can behave inconsistently, requiring two writes when clearing it. GLPCI counts other bus retries toward its retry limit. After suspend, atomic GPIO high-bank writes can clear unselected bits; use read-modify-write. An abnormal low-battery standby transition may leave LOWBAT_FLAG unset. Sleep control delays should be set below PM_SED to avoid leaving signals in the Sleep state.

U.S. consumer confidence rose to 128.7 in April from 127.0 in March, nearing February’s 18-year high. Analysts cited a strong labor market and tax cuts, but some cautioned that sluggish real income growth could limit consumer spending.

NEC’s Satellite Operation Center is scheduled to be fully operational in April and will operate the ASNARO-2 radar satellite using its GroundNEXTAR system. Designed to handle multiple satellites, the center will support NEC’s planned distribution of ASNARO-2 images with JEOSS starting in September.

A survey found that 71 percent of Washington homeowners worry about a housing bubble, though its small state-level sample limits its significance. King County’s median home price rose 18.6 percent year over year to $658,000 in July 2017, while listings declined. Real estate experts said strong buyer credit and equity make a collapse unlikely, but prices and inventory may level out.

Several business leaders challenge the idea of work-life balance, though their views differ. Jeff Bezos favors “work-life harmony,” arguing that happiness at home and performance at work reinforce each other. Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman and LinkedIn cofounder Reid Hoffman say building an exceptional company demands extensive commitment. Scale AI cofounder Lucy Guo describes working long hours but urges people to make time for loved ones. Zoom CEO Eric Yuan says balance is difficult, yet puts family first when work and family conflict. Alibaba cofounder Jack Ma has praised China’s 72-hour “996” schedule.

Undefeated McEachern and Harrison kicked off Friday night in Kennesaw, Georgia, after both teams had a bye week. McEachern, No. 1 in The Sporting News’ NEXT 25 bubble rankings, is seeking consideration for the High School Football Top 25. Harrison hopes a win will raise its profile in Georgia.

Astronomers and citizen scientists using LOFAR discovered RAD J131346.9+500320, the most distant and powerful known odd radio circle. Its two intersecting rings may be linked to galactic superwinds rather than black hole mergers. The team also identified two giant galaxies with radio rings, suggesting interactions between plasma jets and their surroundings may shape such structures.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. They support several converter topologies and switching frequencies up to 2 MHz. Type 2A or Type 2B frequency compensation can be used; Type 2A adds a capacitor for high-frequency noise attenuation. Switching stops above a typical junction temperature of 175°C and restarts below 160°C.

A synchronous push-pull design example using the TPS7H5001-SP and GaN devices specifies 500-kHz switching, a 5-V output, approximately 25-ns dead time, and a 2.5 transformer turns ratio. It uses a 0.47-µH output inductor and approximately 2.3 mF of output capacitance. The passage also provides guidance on current limiting, compensation, power-supply bypassing, and PCB layout to reduce noise and switching losses. TI states that customers must validate their application designs.

Peter Marks, the former top FDA vaccine regulator ousted by RFK Jr., has joined Eli Lilly to oversee molecule discovery and infectious diseases. His move drew criticism over the revolving door between regulators and industry.

Precise ring-buffer halting requires the halt command to be last in the queue; precise error halting requires queuing one command at a time. Interrupt status can be cleared only when no entries remain or processing is paused. Software must encode page-migration addresses appropriately when memory encryption is enabled.

The firmware provides capability queries and commands to move hypervisor-owned or SNP guest pages. Hypervisor page moves can update IOMMU mappings for pages used by DMA devices, but require software to prevent CPU access and later update CPU page tables. Guest page moves require specified page states, do not support DMA during migration, and change the source and destination states. Commands validate addresses, page states, sizes, and access before copying data and updating mappings or metadata.

Command and migration-entry errors are reported in their status fields; ring-buffer errors appear in PM_STATUS. Hardware errors may also be reported through MCA, and errors during a batch can leave its pages unrecoverable.

The passage presents a Bucketized Hysteresis Controller for pacing budgets in real-time advertising auctions. Pacing adjusts a bid multiplier to align spending with a desired rate. Unlike the existing variable-step controller, the proposed method assigns spending-rate errors to bands and uses larger bid adjustments for larger errors and smaller adjustments for minor errors. The authors also describe a framework for selecting parameters and report improvements over the existing system in auction experiments.

A February 2002 energy-news roundup reports that Enron’s pipelines and power operations were providing steady income during its bankruptcy, while it sold assets and considered a smaller headquarters. FERC disclosed 25 contacts with Enron officials; Chairman Pat Wood denied that the company had improperly influenced decisions. Other reports say Enron Japan’s creditors might recover little, and Enron-related overseas power plants had received $1.2 billion in U.S. government-backed loans. BG Group planned to increase investment in India after buying Enron assets, though a dispute over field management remained unresolved. The Senate prepared to debate energy legislation, while California’s governor considered delaying a ban on the gasoline additive MTBE.

In Windows 10, change the mouse pointer’s size and color under Settings > Ease of Access > Mouse. For more pointer shapes and sizes, use the Pointers tab in Control Panel’s Mouse settings. To close all Safari tabs on an iPhone, press and hold the Tabs button, then select “Close xx Tabs.” If the tab view is already open, press and hold Done instead.

Louisiana sued the Citizens’ Bank’s Banking Department for a banking license fee. The bank’s president objected that the department was not a separate corporation and that he could not be cited on its behalf. The court held that the suit had not properly cited the Citizens’ Bank, reversed the lower judgment, and dismissed the suit as a nonsuit. It left the remaining issues open.

Canadian Pacific Railway says changes in Vancouver and North Dakota will let it move imported goods to Detroit in five days, up to 48 hours faster than Canadian National Railway. The faster service runs through Chicago and could lower shippers’ costs by allowing quicker reuse of containers.

NASA released Dawn’s closest-ever images of Ceres, showing the bright, sodium-carbonate-rich Vinalia and Cerealia Faculae in Occator Crater. Taken in June from roughly 21–24 miles above the surface, the photos may help scientists investigate how the deposits formed. Dawn’s extended mission also aims to study Ceres’ interior and composition. The spacecraft has orbited Ceres since 2015 and, as its mission nears an end, is expected to remain in orbit to avoid contaminating the dwarf planet.

ISDA’s May 16, 2001 press report compiles articles on derivatives and related markets. Witnesses urged the IRS to broaden proposed hedging rules from risk reduction to risk management. BIS data showed slower growth in outstanding over-the-counter derivatives in late 2000. The report also covered FAS 133 compliance and proposed accounting guidance, a Chicago exchange venture for single-stock futures, and debate over a proposed capital charge on credit derivatives. Other articles described proposed UK rules for building societies, arbitrage opportunities in credit default swaps, Lightrade’s network expansion, and ISDA’s finalized credit-derivatives restructuring supplement.

Guyana’s Office of Climate Change opened a three-day greenhouse gas inventory workshop to prepare for its Third National Communication to the UNFCCC, due in 2019. The workshop aims to train national experts to collect emissions data and prepare future inventories, strengthening Guyana’s climate reporting and informing its green development agenda. The communication’s mitigation, baseline, and vulnerability and adaptation components will be addressed later.

As Britain’s river coarse-fishing season begins, Roger Poole advises anglers to reassess swims, tactics and baits rather than rely on what worked in March. After the close season, which allows fish to spawn, he recommends trying different baits alongside the rivers’ abundant natural food. Petworth and Bognor Angling Club hopes to attract more young anglers; National Fishing Month runs from July 27 to September 2, with more than 250 UK events. Poole reports active tench in ponds and chub in rivers, and suggests experimenting with tackle and location on the Rother and Arun.

The Horns offense uses high-post screens that can create easy layups or open shots if defenders are caught on the screen. The passage recommends steering the ballhandler toward their weak hand or the less threatening screener rather than switching a smaller defender onto a post player. In a show-and-recover defense, one defender pressures the ballhandler while another briefly steps out, then returns to the rolling screener as teammates help and deny passes. The “SOS” approach disrupts the offense earlier by trapping the point guard, then rotating to defensive positions when the ball is passed.

A source told ESPN that Napheesa Collier tore three ankle ligaments and a shin muscle in a collision with Thomas, requiring at least six weeks of recovery. The Mercury eliminated the Lynx in Game 4. Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve was ejected and suspended for her reaction to the play.

Nashville police arrested Travis Reinking without firing a shot after a manhunt following a Waffle House shooting that killed four people. James Shaw Jr. had wrestled the rifle from Reinking, who fled. Police said Reinking complied when ordered to the ground and was carrying a handgun and ammunition in his backpack. The passage contrasts his arrest with police treatment of Black people, citing the violent arrest of Chikesia Clemons after a dispute at an Alabama Waffle House.

Euro zone stocks reached their highest level in over a year on Monday after manufacturing activity rose at its fastest pace in over five years. Thin holiday trading accompanied gains in Italian, German and French shares, while yields on several lower-rated euro zone bonds fell. The euro slipped as the dollar strengthened. Markets showed little reaction to a deadly Istanbul nightclub attack, though the Turkish lira weakened. China’s manufacturing sector expanded for a fifth month, and bitcoin rose above US$1,000 for the first time since late 2013.

NEC Display is extending warranties from three to five years on four P-series 24/7 digital signage displays. Coverage applies from first shipment for the P404, P484 and P554, and to P703 purchases from August 1, 2017.

The Internal Bar Strength (IBS) indicator measures where a closing price falls within the day’s high–low range: (Close − Low)/(High − Low). Low values signal potential short-term mean reversion. The passage reports strong historical backtest results for stocks and broad stock indices, particularly during volatile bear markets, but poor results for many commodity-related stocks and other asset classes. Filters may improve results, though they risk curve fitting. Execution near the close is important; delaying entry until the next open reduced backtested returns.

High School Sports Talk broadcast from the Nike Elite Youth Basketball League session in Hampton, with Matt Hatfield hosting and guests including Chris Duhon, Jalen Lecque, David Teel, Cam Bacote, Bryan Kersey, Ed Miller and Keyontae Johnson.

University of Alabama student Kelsey Hall wore a Christmas tree costume to class after her Twitter challenge received 30,000 retweets, far exceeding her 1,000-retweet goal. She said the attention was stressful.

The passage promotes a book and functional-food lifestyle program for high cholesterol. It argues that treatment should address each patient’s underlying causes rather than focus only on lowering cholesterol, and says the book describes 14 causes and related approaches. It claims the program could eliminate the need for lifelong statin use, but provides no supporting evidence for that claim.

Alpha Theory’s analysis of client portfolios identifies biases that can reduce returns: failing to reassess positions after large price gains, building promising positions too slowly, holding positions without explicit price targets, and diversifying into lower-return holdings. Its research found that more disciplined sizing and concentrated portfolios tended to perform better. For 2016, it estimated that clients would have improved returns by 5.1% if they had used suggested optimal position sizes.

The author recalls watching construction of the original Tappan Zee Bridge and describes crossing the newly opened first span of its replacement, the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge. Project director Jamey Barbas explained the 3.1-mile crossing, designed to last 100 years without major maintenance, and the cranes, floating concrete plants and coordinated deliveries used to build it. The project also included educational outreach and environmental planning. About 7,000 people contributed nearly 9 million work hours.

Showstoppers Theatre’s summer production of *Foiled Again!*, directed by founder Radu Azdril, gives young actors speaking roles and instruction in performance and theater production. No experience is required. Performances are at La Colina Junior High School in Santa Barbara. Admission is $7, and children 12 or younger enter free.

The lecture compares factorial experimental designs with adaptive one-factor-at-a-time experiments for improving engineering systems. Factorial designs help estimate effects but can require many trials; smaller fractional designs risk confounding interactions with main effects. In studies of several systems, adaptive experiments often produced greater improvements, particularly when experimental error was low, interactions were substantial, or engineers chose informed starting points. Crossing adaptive experiments with noise-factor designs also improved robustness in the examples presented. The lecturer noted that adaptive methods require sequential feedback and provide less information about why improvements occur, while factorial designs remain useful for parallel experiments and precise effect estimates. He also advocated spreading lower-cost robustness studies across more potential quality problems.

NVIDIA reported first-quarter fiscal 2016 revenue of $1.15 billion, up 4% from a year earlier. Operating income rose to $176 million, while net income fell to $134 million from $137 million; diluted earnings remained $0.24 per share. GPU revenue was $940 million and Tegra Processor revenue was $145 million. At April 26, 2015, NVIDIA held $4.79 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. During the quarter, it repurchased $53 million of shares and paid $46 million in dividends. In May, NVIDIA announced plans to wind down or sell its Icera modem operations and expanded its share repurchase authorization.

A teardown of Google Wallet version 20 suggests upcoming fingerprint unlocking, a switch from its separate Payments PIN to a Google Account PIN, and a possible option to access the app without a PIN. These changes are speculative and may not be available yet.

A fake WhatsApp link claims PM Narendra Modi is offering Rs. 500 in free mobile recharge. The site asks for a mobile number, operator and state, then prompts users to share the link with 15 friends. The passage warns that the link may be a phishing attempt and advises against clicking or sharing it.

The article says markets turned risk-off despite strong corporate earnings, as weak jobs data, uncertainty over tariffs and slower consumer spending raised doubts about growth. July payrolls increased by 73,000, below expectations, and the prior two months were revised sharply downward. GDP grew 3%, above forecasts, but import volatility complicated its interpretation. The Fed held to a patient, data-dependent stance, while markets increased their expectations of rate cuts. Major indexes fell, and weakening volume and market internals pointed to a possible tactical pullback.

The 2-1-2 zone defense protects the middle and positions defenders near the basket for rebounding, but its compact shape leaves it vulnerable to outside shooting. It is used mainly against poor outside-shooting teams or high-post offenses. As the ball moves, defenders shift to pressure it, cover the high and low posts, prevent return passes, and maintain weakside rebounding positions.

Zach Parise said the team must focus on winning tonight and trying to bring the series back to New Jersey. He praised Quick’s confident play and the opposing defense’s ability to limit chances, but said his team could move the puck better, spend more time in the offensive zone and put more pressure on Quick. He said lineup changes may provide a different element and cited past comebacks as reason to believe the series can turn around.

The passage studies ground states of classical Heisenberg and XY spins with bilinear and biquadratic interactions on an isosceles triangular plaquette. It reduces the search for ground states to minimizing the plaquette energy over allowed spin angles, identifies collinear, coplanar, and noncoplanar configurations, and presents phase diagrams for selected interaction parameters. The plaquette results can be used to construct ground states on lattices made of identical isosceles triangles.

AMZN options let investors speculate on stock-price movements or hedge existing positions. Strategies described include buying calls or puts, writing covered or naked options, and trading spreads. Buyers gain the right to buy or sell stock at a set strike price before expiration; sellers take on the corresponding obligation. Options offer leverage but carry risks, including losses, expiration without value, limited liquidity, and margin calls. Naked calls can expose sellers to unlimited losses.

Call prices generally rise when AMZN shares rise, while put prices generally rise when shares fall. Volatility also affects premiums. The passage recommends understanding the risks and using spreads to limit them. It says trading costs, capital and margin requirements, expiration dates, and execution speeds vary by broker. Platform selection should consider fees, execution speed, and research tools; tax treatment depends on the trade.

Bank of New York Mellon reduced its Greenlight Reinsurance stake by 8.7% in the second quarter, leaving it with 193,448 shares worth about $4.04 million. Several other institutional investors increased their holdings in the first quarter. Greenlight Reinsurance reported a quarterly loss of $0.96 per share, slightly better than analysts expected, while revenue fell short of expectations. Insiders sold 6,468 shares over the preceding three months.

Frickley Athletic have added midfielders Jason Yates, Josh Nodder and Danny Patterson, defender Joe Austin, wide player Tom Dugdale and utility player Danny Swales as they build their 2017-18 squad. Wide player Tyler Williams is staying, while striker Jacob Hazell is returning after a spell at Scarborough.

Offensive guards line up between the center and tackles and play key roles in both running and passing. They block defensive tackles and blitzing linebackers to protect the quarterback, while also creating running lanes through double teams, lateral movement, and lead blocks. The position demands strength, agility, technique, and communication to handle varied defensive pressures.

Early offense has three phases: a quick push before defenders organize, a direct flow into offensive actions if the push produces no advantage, and continuity play that maintains pressure and court balance. Players should practice converting breakaways and outnumbered situations, advancing the ball by pass when possible, choosing shots according to the defensive setup, rebounding misses, and avoiding charges. The passage describes flow sets and several continuity options—including Flex, passing game, mid screen, side screen, and inside triangle—that use screens, cuts, drives, and passes to create shots.

A KPMG survey of 130 leaders at large U.S. organizations found that AI-agent deployment rose from 11% to 42% in six months, while employee resistance fell from 47% to 21%. KPMG’s AI program lead said familiarity has eased fears but created “cognitive fatigue” because most enterprise AI still requires human oversight. Leaders are assessing AI through productivity, profitability and quality improvements, while 56% expect to reshape entry-level recruiting within a year.
The court denied Atkins’s application to vacate its prior decision, finding he had not established ineffective assistance of appellate counsel.

SanDisk’s agreement grants a limited license to use the software for personal use with SanDisk products and services on one computer or device at a time. SanDisk and its licensors retain ownership. Users may not modify, reverse engineer, lease, or embed the software in another product. The software is provided without warranties, and SanDisk limits its liability to the amount paid for its use. SanDisk may terminate the license for violations, after which all copies must be destroyed. The software is not intended for high-risk activities. The agreement specifies California and U.S. law, Santa Clara County courts, and compliance with export rules. The device should not be discarded with unsorted household waste; users should consult local waste authorities.

Costco members can buy gold, silver, and platinum online or at select warehouses, subject to availability and purchase limits. Executive members receive 2% rewards on eligible purchases. Online orders typically ship in three to five days; in-store buyers fill out a pickup slip and pay at the front office. Precious metals cannot be returned or receive post-purchase price adjustments. The passage also cautions that interest charges can offset gains and that reselling may be difficult.

The American Red Cross says its blood supply is still recovering from March winter storms. More than 270 canceled blood drives nationwide left over 9,500 donations uncollected, including 1,287 in Connecticut. It urges people to donate when travel is safe.

Acordis Technology & Solutions will attend and sponsor the Jewish Federation of Broward County’s Men’s Nite Out on May 9, 2018, at The Signature Grand in Davie, Florida. Reggie Jackson will speak, and the event is open to professionals seeking to network.

The passage examines how first-year architectural design education might inform STEM education. Using studio observations and student interviews at BUU Faculty of Architecture, the study identifies four prominent elements: tackling open-ended problems, researching problem situations in depth, communicating ideas visually, and learning through critique. Students described abstract thinking as a course goal and reported difficulties with design, drawing, models, presentations, and time. The authors recommend giving STEM students opportunities to develop their own solutions to authentic problems, with hands-on exploration at primary and secondary levels and stronger project requirements at high school and undergraduate levels. They also recommend technical drawing instruction and, for undergraduate project courses, studio-style critique and jury assessment.

AI is increasingly used in higher education to personalize learning, support research, identify students needing help, and streamline administration. The passage reports that 86% of surveyed students use AI in their studies. It describes applications across disciplines and opportunities to expand access, collaboration, and workforce preparation. It also identifies risks involving academic integrity, data privacy, algorithmic bias, faculty resistance, and unequal access to technology. The paper recommends faculty training, student involvement, infrastructure investment, ethical safeguards, and policies that keep AI complementary to human teaching.

The North Dakota Supreme Court reversed an order suppressing evidence in Denise Hahne’s driving-under-the-influence case. The district court had found that motorists lacked a safe, legal way to avoid the sobriety checkpoint. The Supreme Court held that checkpoints need not provide an escape route as a matter of law, though avoidability may be considered when assessing their constitutional reasonableness. It remanded the case for that assessment.

The OECD warned that trade barriers and high oil prices could threaten global growth by weakening confidence, investment, jobs and household incomes. It forecast growth of 3.8% this year and 3.9% next year.

The team stuck to its game plan despite trailing, stayed composed, kept shooting and scored past Belfour. The speaker said players would focus on hockey despite Dr. McMullen’s possible sale of the team, and that facing the same player twice felt unusual.

The 13/48 strategy uses crossovers between 13- and 48-period exponential moving averages as bullish or bearish signals. It is intended for trending markets but risks unreliable signals in choppy markets. In an S&P 500 backtest, it returned 5.1% annually versus 7.2% for buy and hold.

Alan Brister sought a refund after the IRS used his 1989–1992 tax overpayments to recover withholding credits claimed on his 1985 and 1986 returns. The government conceded that its 1993 adjustments fell outside the usual three-year limit but argued that the limit did not apply to false returns filed with intent to evade tax. The court found clear and convincing evidence that Brister knowingly claimed withholding Solar Roofing had not paid. It held that the exception applied even though the false credits increased his refunds rather than directly reducing tax owed. The court entered judgment for the United States.

The lecture examines when the Fiat–Shamir transformation preserves soundness. In the random oracle model, a prover can repeatedly query the oracle until a favorable challenge appears, defeating protocols with non-negligible soundness error. Sequential repetition makes that error negligible but remains vulnerable because the prover can extend successful transcripts one round at a time.

For public-coin protocols with negligible soundness error and a constant number of rounds, Fiat–Shamir is sound in the random oracle model. The proof turns a successful Fiat–Shamir adversary into an adversary against the interactive protocol by guessing which oracle queries it will use; the success probability falls by a polynomial factor for constant rounds. This applies to the four-round Kilian–Micali protocol. Random-oracle soundness, however, does not guarantee security with a concrete hash function.

The lecture also contrasts sequential and parallel repetition of a specific Hamiltonian-cycle zero-knowledge protocol. Sequential repetition remains zero knowledge, but parallel repetition does not for the specified construction: a simulator for a verifier using a sound Fiat–Shamir hash would contradict that soundness.

This qualitative study used interviews with 21 faculty members and 26 students to examine how distance education affects equality of educational opportunity. Participants identified flexible learning times, self-paced study and access to information as benefits. They also cited financial constraints, limited technology access, internet problems and unsuitable learning environments as sources of inequality. Suggested improvements included better internet infrastructure, support for technology access, digital literacy training and guidance tailored to students’ needs.

Microsoft’s August 3, 2017 Form 8-K reports its early adoption of new revenue-recognition and lease accounting standards effective July 1, 2017. The revenue standard materially affected its income statements and balance sheets, chiefly by changing when certain software license revenue is recognized. The lease standard materially affected balance sheets through recognition of operating-lease assets and liabilities. Neither standard affected reported cash flows. Exhibit 99.1 provides restated financial information for fiscal 2016 and 2017.

The passage develops quasi-Monte Carlo methods to estimate expected quantities of interest from a nonlinear tumor-growth model with uncertain diffusion and proliferation. The model represents invasion, proliferation, and treatment effects. The authors establish well-posedness, prove error estimates for uniform random fields, and report supporting numerical experiments, including a log-normal test case. They do not analyze spatio-temporal discretization error.

The Commonwealth Fund ranked New Jersey’s healthcare system 25th, down two places and behind every other Northeastern state. It scored well on access to care but needs improvement in preventive care, elderly readmissions and treatment costs.

In May 2007, Deputy Mayor Victor Reinoso had to recommend a chancellor for Washington, DC Public Schools before Mayor Adrian Fenty took control of the struggling system. Reinoso had grown frustrated with slow, consensus-driven decisions during his time on the school board. After Fenty’s election, he assembled a reform team, commissioned a review documenting poor achievement and management problems, and helped draft legislation placing the schools under mayoral control.

Reinoso sought a leader willing to rethink public education, prioritize teaching and student achievement, and make difficult changes. He considered experienced superintendents Rudy Crew and Clifford Janey, as well as Michelle Rhee, founder of The New Teacher Project. Shortly before his recommendation was due, controversy arose over unattributed material in an education plan submitted to the DC Council.

The lecture defines entanglement as a state that cannot be factored into states of two subsystems. For entanglement to serve as a resource, those subsystems must also be separately addressable and measurable. Two-photon polarization and dual-rail states provide examples, while Bell states are maximally entangled.

The professor describes a probabilistic purification protocol: Alice and Bob apply controlled-NOT operations to two copies of a partly entangled state, then measure selected qubits. A favorable result leaves the remaining pair in a Bell state. Entanglement is measured by the entropy of one subsystem’s reduced density matrix; a Bell state has an entropy of one bit.

The lecture then introduces a proposed method for entangling atoms through emitted photons. It explains how Hong-Ou-Mandel interference at a beam splitter can help identify measurement outcomes needed for probabilistic atomic entanglement.

A November 25, 2001 Commissioner.COM fantasy football report provides NFL injury updates and Week 11 lineup advice. It reports that Muhsin Muhammad and Reggie Wayne are expected to miss games, Olandis Gary is out for the season, and Terrell Davis is scheduled to return December 2. The Luccis Losers–Team Chick matchup is listed at 0–0.

Mesh is a short-to-intermediate passing concept used across many offenses. Its crossing routes can create confusion against man coverage, where receivers keep moving, while against zone coverage they can settle in open spaces. The quarterback’s base progression is flare, shallow drag, deep drag, then fullback arrow, with a corner route available on a favorable pre-snap look. Zone blitzes and simulated pressure can disrupt the play by forcing a quicker throw. Variations add a running back rail route or a sit route that provides a stationary target against zone coverage.

Culp reported fiscal 2017 sales of $309.5 million, down 1.1%, while record pretax income rose to $29.7 million. Fourth-quarter sales were $77.4 million and net income was $6.2 million. Mattress fabrics achieved record annual sales and operating income, despite production changes and mattress-industry disruption. Upholstery fabrics sales fell 6% for the year amid a soft residential furniture market, though hospitality and performance fabrics contributed to profitability.

The company ended the year with $54.2 million in cash and investments and announced a special dividend of $0.21 per share. It expects first-quarter fiscal 2018 sales to be comparable to the prior year and pretax income of $7.8 million to $8.4 million, including relocation expenses. Management expects operational savings later in fiscal 2018 and is exploring acquisitions, particularly in hospitality textiles.

The speaker expects Scotty to return to coaching next year but says Scotty must decide how much time to devote to hockey and family. The speaker credits Scotty’s success to his exceptional energy and passion for the game.

Chris Lattner, creator of Apple’s Swift programming language, has joined Google Brain to work on artificial intelligence. He previously led Tesla’s Autopilot program but left after about six months. Google sees AI as important to its cloud computing business.

The passage specifies the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) protocol for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests. These features encrypt guest register state; the GHCB lets guests selectively share information needed to handle non-automatic exits. The specification defines the GHCB’s shared-page layout, protocol negotiation, feature advertisement, MSR requests, guest and hypervisor responsibilities, and error handling.

It also covers page-state changes, SNP guest requests, AP creation and booting, interrupts, and restricted injection through an #HV doorbell page. Later revisions add support for APIC ID lists, multiple VMPL levels, trusted I/O requests, Secure AVIC, and other protocol updates. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported under the described specification.

Channel 4 chief executive Alex Mahon called its 28.6% gender pay gap “unacceptable” and pledged to improve it. Women make up 59% of staff but hold only 34 of the 100 highest-paid jobs. Mahon aims for an equal split in those roles by 2023. The national average pay gap is 17.4%.

CTPNet is a framework for multivariate long-term time series forecasting that models dependencies across channels, within downsampled subsequences, and between subsequences. It combines temporal-query multi-head attention, an encoder, and efficient Transformer-based representation learning. The reported benchmark results show that CTPNet outperforms the compared methods on many forecasting measures.

The passage describes sealing designs for high-pressure flow devices, including plug valves and fluid ends. Seals mounted in grooves in the device body engage mating components, shifting erosion from the body to parts that are simpler and less expensive to repair or replace. The fluid end embodiments include grooves for plugs, valve seats, and a stuffing box sleeve, with radial, axial, or crush seals.

On February 26, 2020, Microsoft filed a Form 8-K reporting that it had issued a press release updating revenue guidance for its More Personal Computing segment for the quarter ending March 30, 2020. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The speaker was disappointed not to score immediately but felt they were playing well in other areas. They stayed positive and kept working, confident goals would come. Although scoring now feels good, winning remains their priority.

NBA commissioner Adam Silver said the 2026 All-Star Game will remain at the Clippers’ Intuit Dome despite an investigation into whether the team circumvented salary cap rules involving Kawhi Leonard’s endorsement deal with Aspiration. Silver said All-Star planning is separate from the investigation.

The passage argues that generative AI challenges traditional university assessments, particularly essays and online exams, while offering opportunities for feedback and more authentic tasks. It recommends assessment designs that develop critical thinking and responsible AI use, supported by training for students and educators.

In a UK postgraduate immunology course, students used ChatGPT to draft essay outlines, evaluated them with peers, then wrote their essays without further AI assistance. In a survey of 20 students, 57.9% reported previous generative AI use and 5% felt very confident using it. Students valued the outlines as a starting point but found them generic and sometimes questionable in accuracy. The passage concludes that AI should complement, not replace, human teaching and assessment, with academic integrity and AI literacy remaining central concerns.
A 34-year-old Mission man was arrested after a pickup truck struck a vehicle, barricades and a bus stop in Maple Ridge. A woman and her son sustained non-life-threatening injuries.

The Louisiana Supreme Court affirmed Ray Jones Jr.’s first-degree murder conviction for the death of his infant son and his sentence of life imprisonment without parole. The court held that two incriminating statements Jones made at the hospital were voluntary and did not require Miranda warnings. It also found that his statement to police was not the product of interrogation; even if admitting it was error, the error was harmless. The court further held that the trial judge did not abuse his discretion by limiting an irrelevant line of cross-examination.

A qualitative study interviewed 10 higher education leaders and four industry leaders in Mauritius about micro-credentials. Participants generally saw value in using them to recognise skills and support professional development, but differed in their understanding of micro-credentials and badges. They favoured flexible integration with existing credit systems while raising concerns about assessment, quality and employer recognition. The study recommends phased implementation within a national framework that links assessed competencies to university credits and recognised qualifications.

The passage describes a system for mapping ground elevation around a mobile agricultural machine. A pose sensor measures its position and orientation as the machine travels, and the system uses those measurements and machine dimensions to assign estimated elevations to a virtual point cloud. Elevation estimates are weighted by their distance from the sensor and combined in a georeferenced map as the machine moves. The map can be updated on later passes and used to control subsystems, including harvester header height and sprayer boom height.

From April 1, Scotland will make disclosing or threatening to disclose someone’s intimate images a criminal offence punishable by up to five years in prison. The law addresses the ease of sharing private images online. Justice Secretary Michael Matheson said it aims to deter abuse and harassment.

Matthew Shashy, 29, of Montgomery, was sentenced to four years of probation after a federal jury convicted him of impeding, intimidating, and interfering with Maxwell Air Force Base personnel. On January 3, 2017, he fired a shotgun three times toward the base’s Day Street entrance and drove away. Police later identified him, and he surrendered after barricading himself inside his home.

In a Phase 2 trial of 48 children with multiple food allergies, adding omalizumab to oral immunotherapy improved outcomes. After 36 weeks, 83 percent of children given omalizumab could eat two-gram portions of at least two allergenic foods, compared with 33 percent given placebo. The omalizumab group also had fewer adverse events during part of treatment. Larger studies are needed to confirm the findings.

Archaeologists searching a gap beside Dublin’s City Hall did not find a rifle that Easter Rising rebel Willie Halpin reportedly dropped there to avoid surrendering it. The Dublin City Council-funded excavation found roof fragments, including one with a bullet hole, along with bottles and pottery. Consultant archaeologist Franc Myles said the rifle may have been removed in the years after the Rising. Halpin’s family and Lord Mayor Nial Ring had pressed for the search.

Brookfield Infrastructure Partners has delivered 20% annualized returns since 2008, and its adjusted AFFO rose from $352 million in 2012 to $926 million. It currently yields 4% and aims to raise distributions 6–9% annually. The author considers that target aggressive, noting currency and economic risks. Issuing units at current valuations can fund investments that increase AFFO per unit, but a falling unit price could limit that strategy. Despite expecting lower returns than in the past, the author views the distribution as secure and projects roughly 10% total returns.

Credit bureaus grew from records that helped businesses assess customers seeking credit. Today, companies like Equifax collect extensive financial information without people opting in, making it difficult to opt out. Lawmakers have struggled to regulate them for fifty years.

Former Western University professor John Knight left $5.25 million to LHSC’s ovarian cancer research team in memory of his wife, Mary, who died of the disease. Announced at Victoria Hospital near Valentine’s Day, the gift will support researchers, equipment and collaborations focused on understanding how ovarian cancer spreads. The hospital named its A-block first-floor lobby the Mary and John Knight atrium.

Based on its holdings’ average analyst targets, the Vanguard Mid-Cap Growth ETF has an implied target price of $145.80, or 9.77% above its recent $132.83 price. Holdings Sensata Technologies, Global Payments, and Markel have implied upside of 11.37%, 10.34%, and 10.26%, respectively. The passage notes that investors should research whether these targets remain justified.

Tanzania has launched the Tanzania Business Clinic to help companies and sectors address obstacles to doing business. Based in Dar es Salaam with branches at Sido offices nationwide, it will provide guidance on business practices and regulations. The initiative accompanies a government blueprint for regulatory reform, scheduled for implementation in 2018/19, after Tanzania ranked 137th of 190 economies in the World Bank’s Doing Business 2018 report.

Julia Banks won the marginal Melbourne seat of Chisholm for the Liberals in 2016 after nearly 20 years of Labor representation. Amid questions about whether she held dual Greek-Australian citizenship, voters interviewed in the electorate were largely unaware of the issue; several said they would consider voting Liberal again if a byelection were held. A politics lecturer said a byelection would likely favour Labor, while a Labor strategist said the party could regain the seat in a tight race.

Former Facebook executives Chamath Palihapitiya and Sean Parker expressed concern about social media’s effects on society. Palihapitiya said Facebook’s feedback loops undermine discourse and foster misinformation, though he believes the company also does substantial good.

In a May 24, 1870 proclamation, President Ulysses S. Grant warned against illegal military expeditions from U.S. territory targeting Canada. He said participants would forfeit government protection and directed U.S. officers to prevent the expeditions and arrest those involved.

Soccer teammates use hand signals and other non-verbal cues to coordinate passes, runs, defensive positioning, substitutions, throw-ins, and set pieces. Signals can direct a teammate where to move or receive the ball, organize a defensive wall, or indicate a pre-arranged play. Head nods, ball movements, and runs over the ball can also start plays. Coaches and players may develop additional signals when crowd noise makes spoken communication difficult.
An 11-year-old boy faces months of surgery after a relative’s dog attacked him at home on June 20. He has undergone skin grafts to his face and surgery to recreate his lips.

The passage describes SD memory card initialization, bus-speed selection, data transfer, and protection. UHS-I operates in SD mode; compatible hosts and cards negotiate 1.8V signaling through ACMD41 and switch voltage with CMD11. CMD6 selects speed, driver strength, and power limits. UHS-II cards can initialize through either a UHS-II or legacy SD interface.

Hosts use CMD8 and ACMD41 to establish operating conditions, then CMD2 and CMD3 to identify cards. In transfer mode, commands govern reads, writes, erase, DISCARD, and full-user-area logical erase. Locked cards restrict data access; CMD42 manages passwords and optional Card Ownership Protection. The passage also specifies command behavior, error handling, and host responsibilities during these operations.

The May 22, 2001 VentureWire reports that Kodiak Venture Partners closed a $290 million fund, Mercury Interactive acquired Freshwater Software for $147 million, Celetron raised $48 million, and TVM held a first close on a life-sciences fund. It also covers numerous financing rounds, acquisitions, leadership changes and venture-capital appointments. AgWeb and Ironmax reported staff cuts, while Rx.com stopped filling prescriptions.
GPT-5 drew criticism for glitches, inaccurate charts, an unfriendly tone, and unmet expectations. Sam Altman says it was misunderstood and has changed his attitude to AGI.

In a randomized Indian study of 920 children aged 2–17, two doses of SII-NVX-CoV2373 produced antibody responses non-inferior to those in adults, with more than 98% seroconversion after the second dose. Responses were also observed against Delta and Omicron variants. Adverse events were mostly mild; no vaccine-related serious adverse events were reported. The study did not assess vaccine efficacy.

NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture introduces a GPU-based AI Management Processor to schedule AI and graphics workloads with less reliance on the CPU. It adds hardware support for 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, improved NVENC and NVDEC performance, and DisplayPort 2.1b. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster clock adjustments, and quicker entry into deep sleep states.

DLSS 4 adds Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also supports developer-created neural shaders for applications including texture compression, lighting, materials, skin, and faces. The passage describes the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products, followed by NVIDIA’s specification and liability notices.

Poor document management can waste time, money and office space, hinder customer service, and expose sensitive information. The passage recommends tracking printing costs and improving workflows by scanning, storing and sharing documents through cloud services. It describes Xerox tools for mobile access, routing scanned documents, restricting printing and notifying staff when toner is low.

A qualitative study at North-West University examined the experiences of 17 distance-learning students and four lecturers in Physical Education teacher training. Students valued lecturers’ responsiveness, practical videos and course content, and many reported greater confidence and appreciation of Physical Education. Challenges included limited prior knowledge, inadequate technology skills or internet access, assignment administration delays, and the lack of immediate feedback on practical skills. The study recommends more face-to-face contact, student technology training, practical videos, online interaction and improved administration.

ITV cycling presenter Matt Barbet’s Home Roads podcast launches on iTunes and Acast on June 8. He rides guests’ local routes while discussing their cycling careers and personal lives. The first four episodes feature Alex Dowsett, Sarah Storey, Nicolas Roche and David Millar, with more guests to follow.

A city court will rule tomorrow on Congress leader Shashi Tharoor’s anticipatory bail plea in the case concerning his wife Sunanda Pushkar’s death. Police opposed bail, citing flight risk and possible influence over witnesses. Tharoor’s lawyers said he had cooperated with the investigation and had not been arrested. Charged with cruelty and abetment of suicide, he has been summoned to appear on July 7.

The 200-day moving average tracks an asset’s average closing price over 200 trading days and is used to identify long-term trends. A strategy of buying above it and selling below it can reduce drawdowns by avoiding bear markets, but false signals and repeated trades can cause it to lag buy-and-hold when markets rise. In a backtest from March 2009, the strategy had an 8.5% annualized return versus 12.8% for buy-and-hold, with a lower maximum drawdown. The article favors the simple moving average for its simplicity and says backtesting is needed to assess specific variations.

Passports may be issued only to U.S. citizens, but citizenship alone does not guarantee one. Applicants must satisfactorily establish U.S. domicile and an intention to return and fulfill the duties of citizenship. Expatriation depends on the circumstances; living abroad, even indefinitely, does not establish it if the person intends to return and maintains allegiance. Permanent foreign residence and domicile can nevertheless bar a passport. Officials weigh an applicant’s ties to the United States, reasons for remaining abroad, and conduct against stated plans to return. Citizens in countries where the United States exercises extraterritorial jurisdiction may receive passports during prolonged residence if their pursuits are legitimate and do not harm friendly relations.

The passage describes NVIDIA A100 improvements in memory bandwidth, L2 caching, compression, interconnects, fault handling, and GPU programmability. Its Multi-Instance GPU feature partitions one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources, while Compute Instances further divide compute capacity. Third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, and CUDA 11 features—including task graphs, asynchronous copies, barriers, and L2 residency controls—support communication and execution efficiency. The passage also covers hardware JPEG and video decoding, optical flow acceleration, improved atomic operations, and DGX A100 systems that combine eight A100 GPUs. An appendix explains neural-network pruning and the fine-grained structured sparsity supported by A100.

The lecture reviews hinged dissections, including constructions for polyominoes and related shapes, methods for obtaining continuous folding motions, and possible software and physical implementations. It describes connected, shape-changing robots and a dissection that converts one rectangle into another. A more detailed construction gives a pseudopolynomial bound on the number of pieces when polygon vertices lie on a grid. The lecture closes with three-dimensional dissections: equal volume alone is insufficient, but matching volume and Dehn invariant are sufficient in three and four dimensions. Efficient algorithms for comparing these invariants and finding dissections remain open questions.

Mud Bay, a Pacific Northwest pet-store chain, built its business around knowledgeable service, healthy products and fair prices. In 2014, its leaders launched a Good Jobs Vision to improve employee pay, benefits and ownership while simplifying operations and strengthening customer service. By 2017, average hourly store wages had risen, employee turnover had fallen from 48% to 31%, and sales had grown substantially. Lower prices and higher costs, however, reduced profit margins, while efforts to standardize processes and create time for continuous improvement remained incomplete.

As Mud Bay prepared its 2018 budget, its COO proposed closing stores at 8 p.m. instead of 9 p.m. Monday through Saturday to improve employees’ schedules and save labor costs. One co-CEO supported the proposal; the other worried about customer inconvenience and lost sales. The planning team reviewed sales data before deciding.

New Caledonian crows and kea parrots were better at choosing tools for a task after exploring them beforehand, suggesting they learned the objects’ properties through play. Researchers found no evidence that the birds deliberately sought information about the objects. A separate report warns that wildlife selfies posted on Instagram are fueling cruel treatment of Amazon animals.

The passage specifies how SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests use the GHCB protocol to handle non-automatic exits. Hardware raises a #VC for such exits in an SEV-ES guest; the guest supplies required state through the GHCB and uses VMGEXIT to communicate with the hypervisor. Both sides mark valid GHCB fields and clear the validity bitmap before each exchange.

Supported events include I/O, MSR and MMIO access; page-state changes; SNP guest requests; AP creation; doorbell, IPI and timer operations; APIC ID discovery; Secure AVIC backing-page management; and termination. The passage also describes error reporting, AP boot and reset procedures, NMI handling, and the #HV doorbell protocol for interrupt delivery under Restricted Injection. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported under the stated specification.

Irish software engineer Joan Jordan was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 2010 and struggled to find work afterward. She now works 15 hours a week with the European Patients’ Academy after eight years away from employment. Jordan has written a book offering advice from people living with MS. For World MS Day, she is speaking at the launch of an MS Ireland report recommending ways to improve MS research.

The speaker said the win was enjoyable and praised the team’s third period despite playing with five defensemen. He highlighted the forwards’ support, several players’ speed and physical play, and a line that created scoring chances. He expected scoring to be difficult against strong goaltenders and sought clarification about contact initiated by the opposing goalie. He described Boston as a physical opponent, said Manny was day to day and not skating, and declined to discuss lineup decisions. Reflecting on his coaching career, he said he was excited to compete for the Stanley Cup. He said the team had used its time off well and would continue preparing one game at a time.

The passage describes memory address obfuscation that maps logical data addresses to physical memory locations using selectable logic operations. Mapping functions may vary across devices or over time and can operate alongside wear-leveling, making data-movement patterns harder to reverse-engineer. A memory controller uses the selected mapping to locate data when processing access commands.

The Saskatchewan Roughriders have given returner Christion Jones extended practice reps as an emergency defensive back ahead of Thursday’s game against Hamilton. Jones, who has practised at both receiver and defensive back, says he is ready to play wherever needed. He leads the CFL with 531 combined yards and ranks third in punt- and kickoff-return average. Head coach Chris Jones says the team has limited his offensive and defensive work to protect his return game, but would use him at defensive back if needed.
Camel engravings at Jebel Misma indicate that people were present in the once-verdant Nefud region more than 12,000 years ago.

A secondary analysis of Nigeria’s 2021 Malaria Indicator Survey found that 56% of households owned at least one insecticide-treated net, but only 25% had enough for all members. About 41% of children under five and 50% of pregnant women slept under a net the previous night. Ownership and use varied by region and household wealth; use among children also varied by age and residence. The authors recommend expanding distribution and health education to address disparities and move toward Nigeria’s 80% usage target.

The author argues that schools’ emphasis on transferable skills and critical thinking neglects the background knowledge needed to understand texts and think about subjects. Internet searches cannot replace sustained study, and treating memorization as outdated undervalues learning. The passage cites grade inflation and fewer graduation testing requirements as signs of retreat from knowledge, while describing content-rich curricula as a partial response. It warns that some approved curricula do not build knowledge sequentially and that AI could either support or weaken instruction.

Celebrity chef Mario Batali is taking leave from his businesses following misconduct allegations by four women. He apologized, saying much of the reported behavior matched his actions. He was also taken off ABC’s “The Chew.”

HMD Global opened an Android 8.1 beta for the Nokia 8 but had not released its kernel modifications 136 days after promising to do so. The passage says this violates GPLv2 and has drawn criticism from developers. HMD cited security reasons for keeping the phone’s bootloader locked.

Researchers analyzing 39 fossils from roughly 560-million-year-old rocks off Newfoundland say remains once considered decomposed organic matter may be early spongelike animals. Pores and upright tubes suggest they filtered food from water. Some specimens reached nearly 53 centimeters. The creature’s spiky appearance inspired a name honoring punk rocker John Lydon; researchers say it may be related to modern sponges.

A University of Queensland study found that Black Mamba, Western Green Mamba and Jamesons Mamba venoms can cause limp paralysis followed by painful spasms after antivenom treatment. The researchers also found geographic differences in venom effects, complicating treatment and highlighting the need for more specialized antivenoms.

The Sansa Fuze manual covers safety, operation, media transfer, playback, settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, and software licensing. It advises moderate headphone volume, warns against headphone use while driving or cycling, and gives cleaning, battery, and disposal precautions. The player supports music, video, photos, voice recording, and, where available, FM radio; a microSDHC slot provides additional storage. The manual explains charging, controls, transferring files with Windows Media Player or Sansa Media Converter, and managing playback and presets. Formatting deletes all player content. It also describes SanDisk’s one-year limited warranty and restrictions on software use.

NVIDIA reported first-quarter fiscal 2023 revenue of $8.29 billion, up 46% from a year earlier. Net income fell 15% to $1.62 billion, including a $1.35 billion charge after the planned Arm acquisition was terminated over regulatory challenges. Gaming revenue was $3.62 billion and Data Center revenue was $3.75 billion.

As of May 1, 2022, NVIDIA held $20.34 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. It returned $2.10 billion to shareholders through repurchases and dividends during the quarter. The filing identifies demand-forecasting difficulties, supply constraints, inflation, cryptocurrency-market volatility, COVID-19 disruptions in China and the war in Ukraine as business risks.

The player described an intense physical game and a play that helped set up Recchi. He said he was glad to contribute to two goals but remained focused on winning the next game at home. He also appreciated his family attending the Stanley Cup finals and praised Cory’s puck movement and playmaking.
The speaker saw the cheering as support ahead of Detroit, said the team was going there to gain ground, and preferred reacting to players’ tendencies over categorizing them.

This systematic review examines AI in higher education assessment, grading, and feedback through the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge framework. Drawing on 20 studies, it finds that AI can reduce grading workloads, standardize assessments, and provide timely, personalized feedback. However, concerns remain about algorithmic bias, data privacy, transparency, and AI’s ability to evaluate subjective work such as creativity and critical thinking. The review calls for careful validation, ethical safeguards, and integration that supports rather than replaces educators’ judgment.

The passage lists ten memorable Birmingham City away days from 2007 to 2017. Highlights include a win at Bristol City that secured Championship survival, a late draw at Bolton that also kept the club up, promotion-clinching victory at Reading, and a dramatic Europa League win at Club Brugge. It also recalls wins at Wolves, Fulham, Derby, Tottenham, Crystal Palace and Shamrock Rovers.

Ray Lewis, Brian Urlacher and Randy Moss entered the Pro Football Hall of Fame on their first ballot; Terrell Owens entered on his third. Brian Dawkins, Bobby Beathard, Jerry Kramer and Robert Brazile completed the class.

Best Buy’s Techtober sale offers the Acer Swift 16 AI for $800, a $450 discount. It has 16 GB of RAM, 1 TB of storage, a 16-inch 120-Hz OLED display, and an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V processor. It lasted 13 hours in a YouTube playback test, though the reviewer found its 0.79-inch chassis somewhat bulky.

On April 20, 2010, explosions on the Transocean-owned Deepwater Horizon rig killed 11 workers and injured 17. The rig sank, and nearly five million barrels of oil spilled from BP’s Macondo well into the Gulf of Mexico before it was capped on July 15.

The passage examines BP’s history of cost cutting and decentralized management, earlier safety failures, and maintenance problems on the rig. It describes decisions made while closing the over-budget well: BP chose a casing design with fewer barriers to gas flow, used fewer centralizers than Halliburton’s model recommended, circulated drilling mud only briefly, and did not run a cement bond log. Investigations into the disaster’s causes were still ongoing in early 2011.

The spill damaged Gulf wildlife and shorelines and disrupted coastal businesses and drilling. BP established a $20 billion fund to compensate eligible people and organizations affected by the spill.

The passage lists January 2017 @ThingsExpo blog posts and event coverage on IoT, M2M, WebRTC, data platforms, blockchain, security, mobile technology, Microsoft and Scrum. It reports Onalytica rankings for @ThingsExpo in IoT and M2M discussions, and announces a call for papers for the June 2017 New York @ThingsExpo.

The U.S. Department disapproved of Mr. Allen’s request that the American consul-general in Shanghai help transfer Kim Ok-kiun’s murderer to Korean justice, saying the consul-general’s jurisdiction extended only to U.S. citizens. In Korea, rebels defeated government troops and captured Chon-ju. Mr. Sill warned that the rebellion threatened Americans in Seoul and renewed his request for a U.S. ship at Chemulpo, though Admiral Skerrett said none was immediately available. At the Korean king’s request, China sent troops and ordered three warships to Chemulpo, promising to withdraw the troops when hostilities ended.

The lecture examines how limited attention affects decisions and learning. Change-blindness and listening experiments show that people can focus on selected information while missing other information. Stock-market reactions to previously reported EntreMed news and confusion between two companies named Zoom illustrate inattention even in high-stakes settings.

Chetty and co-authors tested whether shoppers overlook sales taxes added at checkout. When grocery-store tags displayed after-tax prices, sales fell 8.8%; their estimate suggests consumers respond to sales-tax changes about one-quarter as much as to other price changes. Evidence from beer purchases likewise found much weaker responses to less-visible sales taxes than to taxes included in posted prices.

The lecture then considers why important information may remain unnoticed. Indonesian seaweed farmers knew several features of their methods but generally did not know their pod sizes. Participating in trials alone had little effect; receiving summarized trial results changed farming behavior substantially. The example illustrates how beliefs about what matters can determine what people notice and learn.

Ann Schmidt circulated January 19 news reports on California’s power crisis and Enron. California avoided further morning blackouts, but PG&E and Southern California Edison faced mounting debt and defaults. The state approved $400 million for power purchases, while Energy Secretary Bill Richardson ordered natural-gas suppliers to continue sales. Enron’s Ken Lay opposed wholesale price caps. Other reports covered Pennsylvania regulators’ rejection of comparisons with California, EOTT Energy Partners’ quarterly distribution, expanding bandwidth markets, and Enron’s ten-year energy management agreement with Owens-Illinois, covering 53 facilities and projected purchases exceeding $2 billion.

In his inaugural address, the President urges Americans to face the economic crisis without fear and calls for honest, vigorous action. He describes unemployment, lost savings, failing farms and weakened trade, and criticizes financial practices that put profit above public trust. His immediate priority is putting people to work through government projects, alongside agricultural support, foreclosure prevention, coordinated relief, lower government costs and stricter oversight of banking and currency. He places domestic recovery ahead of restoring world trade while advocating respect for other nations. He asks Congress to act quickly and says he will seek broad executive powers if the emergency persists and Congress fails to act.

The MACD and RSI strategy combines two momentum indicators: MACD is primarily used to analyze trends, while RSI identifies overbought and oversold conditions. Traders can use one indicator to confirm signals from the other, but the passage notes that the combination may be redundant and does not work for all assets. A backtested version using a third, mean-reversion filter reported 235 SMH trades from 2001 onward, averaging a 0.88% gain per trade with a 73% win rate. The passage recommends setting clear rules and backtesting them.

After President Trump declined to label China a currency manipulator, analyst Sean King suggested he might also reverse his withdrawal from the Trans-Pacific Partnership. Japan is pursuing the deal with the remaining countries, while King said its text remains valid until February 2018 and members might offer concessions to bring the U.S. back.

The flexbone is a run-heavy offense derived from the wishbone that uses option plays, misdirection and backs positioned near the line of scrimmage. It requires a decisive quarterback, versatile backs and receivers who can block, and athletic linemen. Its multiple running threats can create defensive confusion, control possession and wear down opponents. Its limited passing game makes late comebacks difficult, while option plays require extensive practice and can be harder to execute in bad weather. Common runs include the triple option, midline option and rocket toss; passes include play-action routes, toss boot and four verticals. Navy, Army and Air Force use forms of the offense, and it remains common at lower college and high school levels.

Unbeaten Mississippi State (8-0) faces No. 25 Cincinnati (7-2) on Tuesday in its first road game of the season. Cincinnati’s turnovers could benefit MSU, which forces 17 per game. The Bearcats pose a stronger rebounding challenge than MSU’s previous opponents, averaging 13.2 offensive rebounds. Cincinnati has recently relied on a seven-player rotation, while MSU could have eight or nine regular contributors and expects guard Eli Wright back from suspension.

The Nifty50 gained 29.65 points, or 0.28%, on Tuesday, helped by short covering. Rollovers are expected to dominate Wednesday’s trade, with resistance at 10,650–10,695 and support at 10,585 and 10,510. Indicators remain bullish, but Nifty has not broken out of its trading range. Low volatility and an elevated put-to-call ratio warrant caution.

A Protestant church in Magdeburg is experimenting with a Twitter service to engage people who cannot easily attend worship and to encourage participation online. Pastor Ralf Peter Reimann sees social media as a way to connect Christians as church attendance declines. The service echoes how printed pamphlets spread Martin Luther’s ideas during the Reformation. Participants’ reactions are mixed: some share prayers, while others find the service hectic or prefer traditional worship.

The Larry Swedroe Portfolio allocates 30% to stocks—including U.S. and international small-cap value stocks and emerging markets—and 70% to bonds. It emphasizes evidence-based investing, diversification, low-cost funds, a long-term perspective, and periodic rebalancing. Small-cap value stocks offer potential returns but carry greater volatility and risk of loss. A backtest beginning in 2012 reported a 3.71% annual return, below the passage’s stated longer-term historical return.

Jeff Carter called his first playoff overtime goal a special moment that gave his team a two-game lead. He credited Penner’s screen in front of Martin Brodeur, while Drew Doughty described skating into open ice and shooting through a defender on his own goal. Doughty said the team must refocus for the games in Los Angeles, where he expects the Devils to play desperately and the home crowd to be loud.

Berkshire Hathaway set a share-repurchase ceiling of 110% of book value in 2011, then raised it to 120% in 2012, when it repurchased about $1.3 billion in shares. It made no repurchases from 2013 through 2016, although its share price came close to the threshold several times. The author argues that the fixed ceiling has become more conservative as book value increasingly understates Berkshire’s intrinsic value, and says repurchases should be considered if the price-to-book ratio returns to the low-to-mid 120% range.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 GPU architecture for deep learning and high-performance computing. Its third-generation Tensor Cores support TF32 by default, faster FP16 or BF16 mixed-precision training, and accelerated FP64 computation. In tests of a mixed-precision iterative solver, TF32 was the fastest and most robust Tensor Core mode.

A100’s 2:4 structured sparsity can halve the storage and bandwidth needed for pruned weights and double Tensor Core compute throughput by skipping zeros.
