The GPU also has 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, higher memory bandwidth than V100, and features intended to improve data movement and Tensor Core utilization.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances with dedicated compute and memory resources. Other features include third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, hardware JPEG and video decoding, and an optical flow accelerator. CUDA 11 supports A100 features such as asynchronous copies, barriers, task graphs, and L2 cache residency controls. The passage also describes DGX A100 systems, which combine eight A100 GPUs for scalable AI workloads.

European shares fell for a fifth straight day and were headed for their biggest weekly loss since November 2016, pressured by rising bond yields, a stronger euro and disappointing bank results. Deutsche Bank shares dropped after a larger-than-expected annual loss, while Caixabank and Sabadell also fell following earnings. Germany’s DAX had lost more than 5 percent in eight sessions. Investors awaited U.S. payroll data, while a fund manager warned that higher funding costs could force leveraged trades to unwind.

A free five-week chronic pain self-management course starts in Montrose in May for Angus residents aged 18 or over. Delivered by Pain Association Scotland, it covers topics including stress, pacing, flare-ups, relaxation and medication. To book, call 01307 474889 or email achppatientcourses.tayside@nhs.net.

The passage recounts three accounts of children said to have lived apart from human society: Jean de Liège, who reportedly spent sixteen years in the woods; an Irish youth described as having lived among sheep; and a Texas “Wolf Girl” allegedly seen with wolves. It notes that many such stories are hoaxes or unverified, and that Jean’s reported excessive hair growth has no known basis in living wild. The passage leaves open whether similar cases exist today.

The Florida appellate court reversed summary judgment for George Johnson, Jr. and his surety, Personal Service Insurance Company. Langston was injured while riding in Johnson’s vehicle, which Fred Johnson was driving. The court held that Florida law could make the owner liable if Fred drove with his consent and negligently caused the injuries. Applying Ohio law to the bond, the court concluded that Personal Service would be liable under it if Langston obtained a judgment against the owner. The case was remanded for further proceedings.

For NMI injection, the hypervisor must intercept #DB rather than IRET and wait for the guest’s “NMI Complete” message before injecting another NMI. SEV-ES guests can use hardware debug-register virtualization when supported; otherwise, DR7 reads and writes are intercepted and handled using a cached value. This specification does not support SMM or nested virtualization.

For SNP isolated guests, a shared #HV doorbell page carries pending interrupts and non-maskable events, plus an EOI assist. The host presents ready interrupts according to emulated APIC behavior, while the guest atomically acknowledges events, validates vectors, and completes EOIs. Guests should execute HLT with interrupts disabled and check interrupt state upon resuming. The doorbell page is configured through GHCB VMGEXIT requests.

The paper examines how an Australian university developed an Arts Specialism to address limited arts training for pre-service primary teachers. Using education policy sociology and critical discourse analysis, it traces the influence of government requirements, professional organisations and university staff on the curriculum. Introduced in 2019, the specialism adds four courses covering dance, drama, media arts, music and visual arts, with experiential and school-based learning. Student feedback describes gains in teaching confidence and knowledge. Implementation has faced COVID-19 disruptions, staffing and resource demands, and persistent curriculum time constraints. The paper calls for continued collaboration, expansion to other institutions and research on graduates’ teaching practice.

U.S. homebuilder sentiment fell three points to 68 in April, though it remained favorable. Measures of current sales, expected sales and prospective buyer traffic also declined. New-home sales rose in February to their fastest pace since July, while mortgage rates have recently edged lower.

The passage argues that iPhones trade some Android features for stronger security, though they remain vulnerable to malware and other attacks. It highlights iOS 10.3.1 protections including encryption, two-factor authentication, automatic data erasure after failed login attempts, iCloud backups, built-in anti-malware measures, app permissions, and remote location, locking, and erasure through Find My Phone. It also credits Apple’s control of its hardware and software, along with regular updates, for its security advantage over fragmented Android devices.

Last-shot situations require preparation, simple plays and decisions based on the clock, court position and defense. The passage recommends holding for the final shot of a period when fewer than 30 seconds remain and the score is within eight points, because that possession and the first possession of the next period can create a significant scoring swing. Teams should put the ball in their best player’s hands, pursue offensive rebounds, practice timed scenarios and long passes, and know how to intentionally miss a free throw. Coaches should preserve and track timeouts and prepare different plays for different amounts of time remaining.

As North Korea’s missile and nuclear tests heighten tensions with the United States, Canadians who served in the Korean War and foreign-policy experts differ on Canada’s potential role. Veteran John Bishop doubts Canada could change the situation. Former ambassador Marius Grinius says Canada’s restricted diplomatic engagement with North Korea cost it valuable access and influence. Veteran Doug Finney urges action to prevent further suffering, while scholar Tina Park says Canada has a responsibility to address crimes against humanity in North Korea.

October 2025 features a supermoon on October 6 and two meteor showers. The Draconids, from comet 21P Giacobini-Zinner’s debris, peak around October 8 but may be obscured by moonlight. The Orionids, from Halley’s Comet debris, peak on October 21, when a new moon should improve visibility.

An exponential moving average (EMA) gives greater weight to recent prices than a simple moving average, so it responds more closely to price changes. In backtests on SPY, short-period EMAs performed best for mean-reversion strategies, while long-period EMAs performed best for trend-following. The EMA can help identify trends and potential support or resistance, but it lags prices and can produce false signals.

Taylor Swift’s records span country music, awards, charts, streaming and touring. She became the youngest artist to write and perform a No. 1 country song and, at the time, the youngest Grammy album of the year winner. She later became the first artist to win that Grammy four times. She holds records for American Music Awards, Billboard Digital Song Sales No. 1 hits and Grammy song of the year nominations. “The Life of a Showgirl” set Spotify’s single-day album streaming record, while “The Fate of Ophelia” set its single-day song record. Her Eras Tour grossed a record $2 billion.

The lecture explains how permutation matrices reorder equations to reduce numerical error or memory use during Gaussian elimination. A sparse-matrix model of a Plinko board illustrates diffusion and introduces eigenvectors as directions that a matrix stretches by an eigenvalue. Eigenvalues are roots of a matrix’s characteristic polynomial; corresponding eigenvectors lie in a null space. Examples distinguish algebraic multiplicity from the number of independent eigenvectors. When a matrix has a complete set of eigenvectors, eigendecomposition diagonalizes it, simplifying systems of equations and decoupling linear differential equations. Matrices without a complete set require other transformations.
April the giraffe’s livestream became YouTube’s second-most-watched live channel, with over 232 million views. Her calf’s birth drew 1.2 million simultaneous viewers and 14 million viewers that day.

The passage describes SD Memory Card write, erase, protection, and command behavior. CRC checks protect transfers; failed checks discard write data, while address, block-length, misalignment, and write-protection errors can prevent programming. Hosts can improve multiple-block writes with pre-erase settings and check how many blocks were written. ERASE, DISCARD, and full user area logical erase (FULE) use specified command sequences and have different effects on data.

Write protection may be mechanical, internal, or password-based. Password locking restricts data access, while optional Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password and changes force-erase behavior. The passage also defines application-specific commands, function switching through CMD6, initialization with CMD8, capacity-dependent addressing, clock control, CRC methods, timeouts, and command formats. SDHC and SDXC memory access uses fixed 512-byte blocks and block addresses; SDSC uses byte addresses and a block length set by CMD16.

Editors of the *Foreign Relations* series have access to retired State Department records and research restricted materials at the Reagan Library and other agencies. The volume’s printed material is declassified, though some comes from documents that remain partly classified or may not yet be fully available. Scanning for the Remote Archives Capture project sometimes left editors unable to verify whether attachments accompanied original documents. Documents are arranged chronologically by Washington time and transcribed to preserve the originals as closely as possible. Editorial notes identify corrections, omissions, withheld material, and other changes; wholly withheld documents are listed in chronological order.

The paper studies how to allocate a limited resource across periods with uncertain demand. It solves a static allocation problem using demand quantiles and bisection, then proposes a sequential policy that updates future-demand distributions after each observation and re-optimizes the remaining allocations. The sequential policy is a heuristic, not a guaranteed global optimum. It matches the static solution when demands are independent. In simulations with correlated, jointly log-normal demands, it earns more revenue than the static and roll-forward methods and approaches a noncausal oracle bound.

Five-year-old Lyla Carreyn is home after receiving a kidney from her 4K teacher, Beth Battista. She had a difficult-to-treat infection after surgery and still needs more than 15 medications daily and lab tests three times a week.

Drawing on stories, interviews, and observations from Arizona, Idaho, and Utah, the authors examine how anti–critical race theory measures affect Native content in teacher education. Using Tribal Critical Race Theory, they argue that these measures compound longstanding omissions of Native histories, perspectives, and sovereignty from curricula. Examples include an Idaho district suspending tribal-history training, Arizona’s failure to implement Native-history instruction laws, and resistance to Native content in teacher education courses. The authors call for public education that teaches Native histories and recognizes tribal sovereignty as part of a critical democratic education.

On September 4, 2020, Tesla completed a $5.0 billion sale of common stock, before commissions, through its previously disclosed at-the-market offering program. Final settlement was expected by September 9.

Research across more than 150 firms found that technologically mature “digital leaders” outperformed “digital laggards” on three-year revenue and enterprise-value growth measures. Conversations with a subset of those firms suggest that culture is important to digital transformation and often difficult to change.

Digital leaders tend to encourage learning and thoughtful experimentation, share data across teams, use metrics to set and assess goals, and align employees around common objectives while allowing flexibility in how they work. Laggards more often restrict data access, rely on individual judgment, set poorly grounded goals, and emphasize short-term results and established processes. Even leaders face tensions, including regulatory constraints and excessive analysis.

The paper identifies four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—reflecting different combinations of technology and culture. It concludes that organizations can build on their strengths while changing the beliefs and daily practices that shape data use.

Researchers analyzed 8.3 million U.S. survey responses from September 2020 through May 2021 to estimate mask-wearing by county and month. They used statistical models to address small samples and adjusted for demographic imbalance and estimated response bias, assuming masking reports were biased similarly to vaccination reports. Estimated masking varied substantially across counties, was generally higher in urban than rural areas, peaked in January 2021, and was lowest in May. Reports about community masking closely approximated the adjusted self-reports. The authors caution that remaining biases and the untested vaccination-bias assumption limit the precision of county estimates.

A systematic review of information systems journals from 2000 to 2017 narrowed 292 articles to 28 for detailed analysis. The authors identified 12 dimensions of digital transformation, six of digital business strategy and ten of organizational capabilities. They propose a framework linking the three concepts, with external collaboration across digital platforms common to all. The review found that publication activity rose from 2009, while studies focused mainly on several industries and the US and Europe. The authors suggest the framework can guide organizations in developing capabilities for digital transformation.
NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on May 9, 2017, announcing results for the quarter ended April 30, 2017. It furnished a press release and commentary from Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

At his second inauguration, the speaker says the war’s course is familiar but its outcome remains uncertain. He identifies slavery as the cause of the conflict: insurgents sought to preserve and expand it, while the government sought to restrict its expansion. Neither side expected so long or consequential a war. He considers whether the war is divine judgment for slavery and calls for perseverance, care for veterans and their families, national healing, and a just, lasting peace.

Sven Henrich agrees with Alan Greenspan’s warning of stock and bond market bubbles. He argues that a chart comparing 10-year Treasury yields with the S&P 500 shows a broken trend line and a possible, unconfirmed head-and-shoulders pattern. Henrich says continued rising yields and falling stocks could signal a multi-year bear market, though he does not predict an immediate collapse. He says bulls need yields to fall, while the chart is nearing critical support.

The lecture introduces walking-robot control as a problem of periodic motion and impacts. The Van der Pol oscillator illustrates a stable limit cycle: trajectories approach the same orbit without synchronizing in time. Poincaré maps address this by converting limit-cycle stability into fixed-point stability on a discrete return map.

Passive dynamic walkers show that gravity and inertia can produce walking without motors or controllers. A rimless-wheel model explains how energy gained while descending a slope can balance energy lost in ground impacts, producing a stable rolling limit cycle. More detailed compass-gait and knee models can also walk passively under suitable initial conditions, though the compass gait is less robust.

A study at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka tested 147 imipenem-resistant gram-negative bacterial isolates collected from January to June 2020. Using the disc potentiation test, researchers detected KPC in 39 isolates (26.53%), MBL in 66 (44.89%), and both enzymes in 36. Resistant isolates were most numerous among patients over 60, while enzyme-positive isolates were most prevalent in the ICU. Acinetobacter baumannii had the highest detection of both enzymes. The authors call for stronger monitoring and infection control.

The passage describes a gold trend-following strategy that holds gold when its price is above a 12-month moving average and cash when it is below. In a backtest using monthly spot prices from 1971, $100,000 grew to $10 million, compared with $4 million from buying and holding. The strategy made 26 trades; commissions and slippage were excluded. The authors attribute its results to avoiding major drawdowns, but note that futures results could differ and past performance offers no guarantee.

The Florida appellate court reversed the financial provisions of Kenneth and Sharon Kaylor’s divorce judgment, finding that the combined alimony, child support, housing costs, and other obligations exceeded Kenneth’s ability to pay and surpassed Sharon’s stated expenses. It remanded the case for an award based on her needs and his ability to pay. All other provisions were affirmed.

The passage describes the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 microcontrollers. They use an Arm Cortex-M0+ CPU operating up to 80 MHz and provide RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN power modes. Described features include dual 12-bit ADCs, a DAC, comparators, DMA, flash, up to 128 KB of SRAM, and communication interfaces including UART, I2C, and SPI; CAN-FD is available only on MSPM0G351x devices. The passage also covers clocks, timers, security, debug and bootloading, analog-reference requirements, and recommended power-supply connections. It lists changes in the April 2025 revision and provides packaging, development-tool, and support information.

The coach liked the team’s recent power plays but said puck confidence and careful management of defensive minutes remain important. He praised Sean’s leadership after his return and said younger players have responded well without much guidance. Against Detroit, the team struggled to move through the neutral zone, establish a forecheck and generate offense. The coach said players sometimes pressed for chances and lost position against a strong defensive team. He plans to use the two days before the next game to reset emotionally and consider tactical options, while continuing to approach the series one game at a time.

OpenAI agreed to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs over several years, starting with 1 gigawatt in the second half of 2026. AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million shares, potentially giving it a 10% stake if fully exercised and deployment and share-price milestones are met. AMD shares rose 23.71% Monday on the news.

The study uses thematic content analysis of 29 Scopus articles to examine curriculum literacy: educators’ ability to understand, evaluate and implement curricula. It reports growing research interest, with recent attention to digital tools, artificial intelligence and learning disabilities; studies are concentrated in social sciences and in Australia, the United States and Türkiye. The reported relationship between digital literacy and curriculum literacy is positive but weak. The study identifies training, time and bureaucratic constraints as barriers and recommends more teacher training, digital resources, interdisciplinary research and inclusive curricula.

Government policy and COVID-19 have accelerated digitalization in Vietnamese higher education, though progress varies among institutions. Before the pandemic, many universities lacked the infrastructure, funding, digital skills and experience needed for online learning. Since then, institutions have expanded learning management systems, online teaching, digital materials and shared resources, supported by national policies and databases.

Challenges remain, including uneven resources, fragmented oversight, the cost and quality of digital materials, and gaps in staff and student skills. The paper recommends clearer policy guidance, greater investment and partnerships, leadership and lecturer training, and stronger digital-skills training and online services for students.

The passage describes AGESA procedures for early system initialization and related services. A stackless, register-based routine establishes a pre-memory stack and cache configuration on all processor cores; another disables the pre-memory stack when main memory becomes available and flushes cache lines. The host must use these procedures to create and remove the stack region. AmdCreateStruct allocates and initializes structures using pre-memory, post-memory, or host-provided storage and requires an established stack. Other services return DIMM data-eye results, a processor core’s APIC address, and the execution-cache size available before main memory. The passage also lists dependencies, affected registers, and status codes.

Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. Median age was 74 years, and 59.9% of subjects were male. Most had atrial fibrillation (96.4%); hypertension was the most common listed stroke and bleeding factor (87.2%). Mean CHADS2 and CHADS2-VASc scores were 2.1 and 3.6, respectively.

Nasdaq 100 E-mini futures track the Nasdaq 100 index and are traded electronically on CME Globex for hedging or speculation. Each contract is worth $20 per index point, expires quarterly and is cash-settled. Regular trading runs from Sunday evening to Friday afternoon, with a daily one-hour break. Trading requires a funded futures brokerage account. The passage describes a volatility strategy backtested on historical data but does not disclose its rules or performance metrics. It reports an all-time high of 16,676.50 in November 2021 and a low of 797.50 on October 3, 2002. Leverage makes large price movements a significant risk.

Tube UK supplied ten audio systems for five carnival floats and five city-centre stages at the 2017 Manchester Day celebrations, commissioned by Manchester City Council and produced by Walk the Plank. A nine-person crew installed and removed the systems in one day. Four floats used battery-powered sound systems, while another used an onboard generator. The stages provided parade commentary and music, including a finale in Cathedral Gardens attended by more than 2,000 people.

The speaker describes winning the Cup after repeated playoff comebacks and says he was especially happy for Alex and the team, who had endured criticism. He recalls urging Alex to adapt his training and take on more responsibility, then praises his strong start to the season. Lifting the Cup with Alex was meaningful to him, his family, and the people who supported his coaching career. He praises Kuzy’s play and says Holtz benefited from a reset and a break before returning to the playoffs. He says he is happy in Washington and in a good place personally.

The speaker credits Kesler and Hansen for a play that led to his goal. He says the team has gained confidence but must carry its effort into the next game. After a difficult summer, he values the chance to pursue the Stanley Cup and credits Manny’s advice to keep his game simple.

Pets at Home’s Burton store will open an hour early on Sunday, October 8, for an autism-friendly shopping hour organised with the National Autistic Society. It will dim lights, lower sounds and share autism information with staff. More than 340 UK stores, including Uttoxeter, are taking part.

The UC1825B-SP supports several power-converter topologies. Its PCB layout guidance recommends low-EMI inductors, feedback traces away from noise sources, capacitors and compensation components close to the IC, and short, thick power traces. Ground planes, carefully arranged switching-current loops, and separate power and signal grounding help reduce EMI and support correct operation. The passage also provides documentation resources, ESD precautions, packaging information, and TI disclaimers.

Federal authorities charged 29-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht with starting a New Year’s Day fire that they say smoldered underground before reigniting in high winds on Jan. 7. The resulting Pacific Palisades blaze killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,000 homes and buildings. Investigators say the original fire was intentionally lit and ruled out several other possible causes. Rinderknecht was arrested in Florida and faces charges including malicious destruction by fire.

A bear trap occurs when a price drop appears to signal a downtrend but quickly reverses, potentially causing traders to lose money on short positions or sales. The passage suggests checking technical indicators, fundamentals and market conditions rather than reacting to price alone, and backtesting a disciplined strategy. It also reports results for a strategy that buys breakdowns and sells on strength, while warning that leverage can increase risk.

Samsung’s Chromebook Pro, due in April, and Chromebook Plus are 2-in-1 devices designed to run Android apps from the Google Play Store. Both have touchscreens, built-in digital pens, 4 GB of RAM, 32 GB of storage, two USB-C ports and support for 4K streaming. The Plus starts at $449.99; the Intel-powered Pro starts at $549. Early reviews of the Pro are mixed, while some reviewers see the new Chromebooks as potential competitors to Windows devices. Google also announced improved ChromeVox accessibility features for its latest Chromebooks.

Rihanna and French President Emmanuel Macron co-hosted a Senegal conference raising hundreds of millions of dollars for education in developing countries. Macron pledged 200 million euros toward a 3.1 billion euro goal, calling education a response to extremism in West Africa. Rihanna, a Global Partnership for Education ambassador, urged leaders to contribute.

Orca submitted a T cell therapy for FDA approval. The passage also reports that doctors licensed in every state are helping fuel telehealth prescribing, announces Damian Garde’s return to STAT, and lists other biotech and drug-policy headlines.

Meizu’s M5s, an updated version of the M5, will go on sale in China on February 20. It has a 5.2-inch HD display, an octa-core processor, 3GB RAM, 13-megapixel rear and 5-megapixel front cameras, and a 3,000mAh battery with fast charging. The 16GB and 32GB versions cost 799 and 999 yuan, respectively. An international release is unconfirmed.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its graphics, video, and compute features. Improved memory compression and GDDR6 provide approximately 50% more effective bandwidth than comparable Pascal GPUs. Turing adds support for 8K displays, updated video encoding and decoding, single-cable VR connectivity through VirtualLink, and NVLink for two-way SLI on supported GPUs.

Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests. Combined with rasterization, denoising, and RTX software, they enable real-time effects such as reflections and shadows. Tensor Cores support NGX features, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and resolution upscaling. Other additions include mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading, and multi-view rendering.

The passage also outlines TU104, TU106, and Tesla T4 configurations, explains the workload-based RTX-OPS metric and basic ray-tracing methods, and ends with product disclaimers and trademark notices.

Global stocks traded in narrow ranges Monday as investors awaited new developments after months of volatility, including concerns about U.S.-China trade. European markets and U.S. futures were largely flat, while most Asian markets declined. Markets reacted little to North Korea’s announcement that it would suspend nuclear and missile tests and close its nuclear test site ahead of planned talks. Oil prices were mixed, the euro fell and the dollar rose against the yen.

The MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 are 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers operating at up to 32 MHz, with up to 64 KB of flash and 8 KB of SRAM. They operate from 1.62 V to 3.6 V and support temperatures from −40°C to 125°C. The passage describes configurable pin functions, five operating modes, clocks, memory, debugging, and peripherals including a 12-bit ADC, comparator, timers, DMA, UART, SPI, and I2C. It also provides electrical specifications, application and layout guidance, and packaging information.

The passage lists records on the organization and work of “The Inquiry” from 1917 to 1918. In a memorandum, Breckinridge Long proposes a discreet bureau to prepare issues for the Peace Conference, supported by regional experts, supplied with relevant literature, and directed by the Secretary of State.

Amazon expanded Prime-exclusive Whole Foods discounts from Florida to 12 more states, aiming for nationwide availability by summer’s end. Benefits include 10% off sale items and free two-hour delivery on orders of $35 or more.

Paddington’s Four in Hand Hotel will remain a pub after the Good Beer Company bought it for $7 million. More than 12,000 people signed a campaign opposing its proposed residential conversion, and Woollahra Council protected its facade. The previous owners had sought to sell the property as a residence. New operator John Azar said he hopes to add more craft beers.

Jonathan Toews describes the series as tightly contested despite no overtime games and says both teams are confident. He emphasizes work ethic, defensive support, penalty killing and focusing on the next shift rather than the final result. Kimmo Timonen praises his teammates’ dedication but says the team must improve after Corey’s strong performance helped secure the previous win. Trevor van Riemsdyk stresses learning from mistakes and moving on quickly. All three focus on Saturday’s game.

Jamaican goalshooter Romelda Aiken will play her 150th national league match when the Queensland Firebirds face Collingwood on Sunday. Despite approaches from rival clubs, she says she has always found it easy to stay with the Firebirds. Since joining in 2008, Aiken has won three MVP awards and helped the club win three championships. She says she is working to expand her game and will keep playing while she can give her best.

Northwestern and Texas A&M named interim presidents, while Winston-Salem State, Lee University and SUNY Geneseo announced leaders. Other headlines address student loan caps and AI-assisted credit transfers.

The Western Association of Schools and Colleges Senior College and University Commission has removed diversity, equity and inclusion language from four areas of its accreditation standards. The revisions took effect this week after public comment. Other accrediting agencies have suspended or are considering dropping DEI standards following a Trump directive.

In a single-center retrospective study of 264 patients with acute ischemic stroke, 120 received tenecteplase and 144 received alteplase. Tenecteplase was associated with shorter onset-to-treatment, door-to-needle, and door-to-puncture times; more patients met target treatment times. More tenecteplase patients showed neurological improvement at 24 hours (64.17% versus 50%), and their hospital stays were shorter (6 versus 8 days). Intracranial hemorrhage rates did not differ significantly. The authors note that treatment was not randomized and that longer-term outcomes require further study.

The lecture proves three limits: \(1/n^p\to0\) for \(p>0\), \(p^{1/n}\to1\) for \(p>0\), and \(n^{1/n}\to1\). It then defines the limsup and liminf of a bounded sequence using the suprema and infima of its tails. These limits always exist, and each is the limit of some subsequence, establishing that every bounded sequence has a convergent subsequence. Finally, a bounded sequence converges exactly when its limsup and liminf are equal; their common value is its limit.

Henrico County economic development director Gary McLaren says the $750 million Facebook data center will benefit the county. He credits White Oak Technology Park’s existing water, sewer, fiber and dual-feed power infrastructure, developed for a former semiconductor plant, with helping attract the project. Henrico also cut taxes on computer equipment to compete for data centers. McLaren says the Facebook deal more than offsets the resulting tax break for existing centers, but declined to provide figures. He says an $863,000 water-sewer connection credit creates no new taxpayer liability. McLaren hopes the project attracts more data centers and says Henrico’s willingness to fast-track it influenced Facebook.

The study combines guided diffusion with machine-learning and DFT screening to design candidate superconducting crystal structures. From 200,000 generated structures, the workflow identified 773 novel candidates with DFT-calculated critical temperatures above 5 K, a 2.3% hit rate among unique structures. Of 18 candidates selected for synthesis, nine showed superconductivity above 4.2 K, but generally at lower temperatures than predicted. X-ray diffraction showed that the predicted structures generally did not form; samples were mostly disordered solid solutions or mixtures of known phases. The authors identify incomplete reference data and difficulty predicting synthesizability as key limitations.

The passage describes the Sandwich Islands as strategically important to the United States and opposes their transfer to another maritime power. It calls for information on Hawaii’s population, economy, resources and debt, while instructing the American representative to explore annexation sentiment without committing the government. After King Lunalilo died in 1874, unrest over David Kalakaua’s election prompted American forces to land at Hawaiian authorities’ request; British forces also landed. Later that year, Kalakaua visited the United States partly to promote a reciprocity agreement, despite opposition to the visit from the English and French commissioners.

The study examines digitalization in education through semi-structured responses from 20 private-sector education managers, analyzed using content analysis. Participants reported adapting through online and hybrid training, digital platforms, and revised content. They identified benefits including access regardless of time or place, wider participation, and time and cost savings. Challenges included technical and financial constraints, limited digital literacy, reduced interaction, and difficulties with practical activities. The study recommends developing digital content and skills while retaining face-to-face education.

The disclosure describes a method for channel state information (CSI) reporting during beam operation. A user device measures at least two CSI reference-signal resources, generates multiple CSI reports—including one based on more than one resource—and reports at least one. The passage also describes beamforming approaches and existing periodic and aperiodic CSI reporting procedures.

U.S. diplomats reported a critical dispute between Japan and China over their troops in Korea. Japan said it sought Korean administrative reforms and stability, denied territorial ambitions, and would not withdraw its troops until future order was assured. China was described as conciliatory and sought foreign help to reach a peaceful settlement. The United States expressed concern, offered friendly good offices, and told Britain it could not join another power in an intervention. China later asked the United States to urge the powers to seek Japan’s withdrawal from Korea.
Birmingham City successfully appealed Maikel Kieftenbeld’s red card in their 2-1 win over Bristol City. He will not serve a three-match ban and is available to play against Bolton Wanderers.

The Zimbabwe Yadzoka/Mayibuye iZimbabwe campaign is urging Zimbabweans abroad to return home to register and vote in the 2018 general election. Its leader, Victor Chimhutu, said the campaign would begin in several cities abroad and organise protests against President Robert Mugabe. He also called for opposition parties to form a coalition against Zanu PF.

Crook County Medical Services District’s nursing home received a Women’s Choice Award for extended care following what CEO Nathan Hough called an outstanding annual survey. The district has purchased a wheelchair-accessible patient transport van with grant and donated funds, and is preparing family rooms for end-of-life care. A renovation of the emergency department and CT scanner area is expected to begin this month and be completed by September. The project will move imaging equipment closer to emergency care and create an updated trauma room.

This bibliometric study analysed 487 English-language Web of Science articles on mathematics and mathematics education in special education published from 1980 to 2023. Publications increased notably in 2017, and most appeared in special education journals. Students and children were common research subjects, while collaboration between author groups was limited. The USA and United Kingdom were prominent in country collaboration networks. The study recommends more research involving teachers and families, greater use of digital tools, and stronger collaboration across institutions and countries. Its findings are limited to Web of Science data.

New Brunswick’s recreational marijuana stores will operate as CannabisNB, an NB Liquor subsidiary overseeing 20 stores in 15 communities. The legal age for possession and consumption will be 19. Public smoking will be banned, users may carry up to 30 grams, and cannabis kept at home must be locked away.

Rent-A-Center shares rose 3.63% in the most recent session and closed at $9.99. Seven analysts’ price targets averaged $10.79, ranging from $5 to $15. Recommendations included three buys, five holds and one underperform. The stock’s 14-period ATR was 0.42, and its RSI was 58.84. Market capitalization was $567.33 million; previous trading volume was 1.01 million shares, below the 1.71 million average.

Amazon’s two best-selling espresso machines, the Ninja Luxe Cafe Premier and Breville Barista Express, are each $100 off ahead of Prime Big Deal Days on October 7–8. The Ninja is at its lowest reported price and offers a built-in grinder and scale, plus cold-brew and drip-coffee options. The Breville is a long-standing best seller, though its discount is not its lowest recorded price.
Self-reported cognitive difficulties among U.S. adults ages 18 to 39 nearly doubled from 2013 to 2023. The reasons are unknown.

SynDoc is a framework for extracting key information from domain-specific documents in zero-shot settings. It generates and verifies synthetic question-answer data, uses that data to adapt a discriminative “warmer” model, and iteratively feeds the warmer’s retrieved information to a generative multimodal model. Experiments on financial forms, receipts, exam papers, and a multi-domain dataset found gains on several domain-specific tasks, though added information sometimes introduced noise and cross-domain results were mixed.

JAXA launched the world’s smallest rocket capable of placing a micro-satellite in orbit from Uchinoura Space Centre. Carrying a three-kilogram Earth-imaging satellite, the launch followed a failed 2017 attempt and tested low-cost launches amid growing private-sector demand.

The lecture constructs spacetime models for compact spherical bodies. In Schwarzschild coordinates, the vacuum exterior yields the Schwarzschild metric; Birkhoff’s theorem says this exterior also applies to time-varying bodies that remain spherically symmetric. For a static perfect-fluid interior, Einstein’s equations give a mass function and the Tolman–Oppenheimer–Volkoff equation for relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium. The gravitational mass differs from the baryonic mass because of gravitational binding energy. An equation of state, central density, and matching at the surface complete the model.

Lead tests exceeded the threshold at two Hamilton-area schools, including one test taken after flushing the water system. A local daycare is using bottled water and a filter after excessive lead was found at one site. More than 640 Ontario schools and daycares failed required tests over two years. Lead exposure can harm young children’s intellectual development.

Australian financial intelligence agency AUSTRAC is suing Commonwealth Bank of Australia, alleging nearly 54,000 breaches of money-laundering and counter-terrorism financing rules. Its claim cites a case involving Jizhang Lu, who pleaded guilty to helping launder A$3.2 million through a meat export company using fake purchase receipts. AUSTRAC alleges A$17.7 million in crime proceeds was deposited at CBA on the company’s behalf in 2015. CBA says it will fight the lawsuit and attributes most alleged breaches to an ATM coding error, while acknowledging other allegations are unrelated to that problem.

ISDA’s April 30, 2001 press report compiles six articles. One advises smaller derivatives customers to prioritize limits on early termination rights in ISDA Master Agreements to protect liquidity. Another attributes Brazil’s looming electricity rationing to low rainfall, underinvestment, incomplete deregulation and transmission constraints. Banking groups criticize proposed U.S. capital charges on merchant banking investments. Analysts expect U.S. dollar swap spreads to narrow further, while euro spreads may stabilize or widen. In a speech, Alan Greenspan discusses the benefits of paying down federal debt and the adjustments declining Treasury issuance would require. Enron is offering a structured note tied to weather in 19 U.S. cities.

The speaker appreciates reaching the Stanley Cup Finals after a long road and hopes the team can win the Cup. Goalie coaches helped him improve without forcing him to change his style. A year earlier, he was focused on recovering from hip surgery, not reaching the finals. This season, the team learned to win in different ways, earning the third seed in the East and advancing through the playoffs.

Nova Scotia is seeking public feedback until Oct. 27 on a proposed minimum cannabis age of 19, sales through a Crown corporation, where use should be allowed and drug-impaired driving. The consultation comes ahead of planned federal legalization by July 1, amid concerns about the timeline.

In a randomized, single-blind trial among Beijing construction workers exposed to SARS-CoV-2, 1,123 participants who tested negative at baseline received SA58 nasal spray or placebo. Symptomatic COVID-19 occurred in 7 of 824 SA58 recipients versus 14 of 299 placebo recipients, corresponding to an estimated protective efficacy of 80.82%. Estimated efficacy against SARS-CoV-2 infection was 61.83%; sequenced positive samples were Omicron BF.7. Reported adverse events were mild, with no serious adverse events. The study ended early, had short follow-up, and primarily enrolled healthy adults, so the authors recommended further evaluation.

Kalai reviews the Fiat–Shamir paradigm, which replaces verifier challenges with a hash function to remove interaction. She focuses on a parallel-repeated zero-knowledge protocol for proving that a graph has a Hamiltonian cycle. Although its soundness under Fiat–Shamir was known in the random-oracle model, the lecture presents a construction intended to establish soundness with an explicit hash function.

The construction uses commitments made from public-key encryption. A secret key acts as a trapdoor that identifies which verifier challenge could let a cheating prover succeed. The hash function uses fully homomorphic encryption to evaluate an encrypted circuit without exposing the trapdoor. In the soundness analysis, a specially chosen circuit avoids the challenge a cheating prover needs. The proof presented relies on circular-secure fully homomorphic encryption; Kalai notes that follow-up work removes that requirement.

Kalai says the technique also supports noninteractive zero-knowledge proofs and applies beyond this protocol, including to GKR and batch arguments.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPUs add support for 8K displays, HDR processing, improved video encoding and decoding, and single-connector VR headsets through USB-C and VirtualLink. TU102 and TU104 use NVLink for two-way SLI.

Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests. Combined with rasterization and denoising, they enable real-time hybrid rendering of effects such as reflections and shadows. Tensor Cores support NGX features, including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion, and resolution upscaling.

The architecture also introduces mesh shading, variable-rate shading, texture-space shading, and expanded multi-view rendering to improve rendering flexibility and efficiency. The passage describes TU104 and TU106 configurations, the Tesla T4, and RTX-OPS as a workload-based performance metric. It concludes with product-use limitations, warranty disclaimers, and trademark notices.

Cisco announced it will participate in two webcast investor conferences in San Francisco: the Goldman Sachs Technology and Internet Conference on February 16 with CEO Chuck Robbins, and the Morgan Stanley Technology, Media & Telecom Investor Conference on February 28 with David Goeckeler.

The author raises Netflix’s price target to $160.73 but lowers the recommendation from High Conviction Buy to Buy, citing reduced upside and heightened expectations risk. The author still favors holding the stock long term. The key measure for the coming quarter is whether Netflix projects 52 million international subscribers by Q2 2017, which underpins the revenue outlook. The author raises the annual revenue estimate to $11.285 billion and diluted earnings-per-share estimate to $1.16, while viewing subscriber growth as a greater concern than profitability.

The April 16 articles cover rising Western electricity costs and Enron’s role in energy and bandwidth trading. A third proposed bandwidth trading agreement offers an option to waive firm-delivery terms, reflecting disagreement between traders and carriers. Sierra Pacific suspended its dividend amid high power costs, sending its shares down 8.3%; it still hoped to buy Enron’s Portland General Electric unit. California investigations and lawsuits alleged abuses by power wholesalers, while the companies denied wrongdoing. Independent power producers expected strong first-quarter earnings despite unpaid California utility bills and possible refunds. Seattle City Light spent a record $92 million on power in March, including $25.5 million from Enron, as drought increased its reliance on costly market purchases.

Update packages must match a system’s firmware and patch levels. Updates run alongside normal traffic with minimal disruption. SEV and SEV/ES virtual machines must restart after SEV firmware updates; SEV/SNP virtual machines can continue operating.

West Midlands Police has formed a task force to investigate 28 recent offences in which separate groups of thieves targeted people in their homes and stole jewellery worth tens of thousands of pounds. In one Birmingham raid, burglars threatened a newborn baby and held knives to women’s throats. Police have made one arrest and urged residents to protect valuables and report suspicious activity.

Autoliv plans to spin off and list its electronics business in the third quarter of 2018, with a cash injection from the parent company. Its airbags and seatbelts business will retain the Autoliv name.

Aspetuck Land Trust offers three guided walks: a hawk walk at Trout Brook Valley Preserve on April 22, a spring wildflower walk there on April 23, and a stone wall walk at Poindexter Preserve on April 29. Each hike is limited to 30 people; email [email protected] to reserve.

Apple filed a Form 8-K on October 27, 2015, reporting that it had issued a press release and data sheet for its fourth fiscal quarter ended September 26, 2015. Both documents are attached as exhibits.

British police declared a major incident after a man and woman were found unconscious in Amesbury and hospitalized in critical condition with suspected exposure to an unknown substance. Police are testing to identify it, and counterterrorism officers are assisting because of the earlier nerve-agent poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal nearby. Authorities have cordoned off locations the pair visited; public health officials say a significant risk to the public is not currently believed likely.
PPP official Taj Haider said Bilawal Bhutto Zardari would begin campaigning in Punjab next week, starting in South Punjab. He urged authorities to ensure fair and transparent elections.

An audit of 74 tuberculosis-related deaths at Kitwe Teaching Hospital, Zambia, from June 2018 to June 2019 found that 67.6% of patients were male, 81.1% were HIV-positive, and 83.8% lived in high-density areas. Common presenting symptoms included cough, fever and diarrhea. Anemia and signs of multi-organ involvement were also documented. The retrospective review relied on existing files, some of which were missing or incomplete. The authors recommend earlier recognition of clinical instability among admitted patients and a prospective study of mortality predictors.

The Amazon’s 2024 fires affected 3.3 million hectares and released an estimated 791 million tons of carbon dioxide, roughly Germany’s annual emissions. For the first time in the study’s 2022–2024 analysis, fire-driven forest degradation overtook deforestation as the main source of emissions. Researchers used satellite data and simulations to assess the damage, including record degradation emissions in Brazil and fires affecting over 9% of Bolivia’s remaining intact forest. They call for stronger fire prevention, forest protection and support for local and Indigenous stewardship.

Dell Technologies will expand its use of Salesforce’s CRM and sales and marketing apps across its nearly 40,000-person global sales team. Its customer contact centers will gain access to Salesforce’s AI-powered Service Cloud Einstein, while the companies will use Dell Boomi to share data. Dell said the partnership will also support its roughly 200,000 channel partners. The agreement extends a relationship that includes Salesforce’s commitment to use Dell infrastructure and laptops.
The portable fan design is shown from multiple angles; broken-line portions are excluded from the claimed design.

Canada’s S&P/TSX composite reached a record high Wednesday amid gains in energy, financial, technology and health care stocks. The Senate had passed a cannabis bill the previous day. U.S. markets were mixed, while the Canadian dollar fell to 75.22 cents US amid interest-rate and trade concerns.

The passage describes a nanosecond pulsed electric field system for electrotherapy, including tumor treatment. Its pulse generator uses stacked switches in Marx generator stages to produce high-voltage pulses with adjustable duration; circuits can be combined to increase voltage or current. A controller uses feedback from measurements such as pulse voltage, current, width, energy, and tissue temperature to adjust the power supply or pulse generator toward selected treatment settings and limits. Electrode designs deliver the pulses to tissue.

The patent application describes an orthopedic surgical system that uses mixed-reality visualization to support joint repair. It can display patient-specific bone models, implants and surgical plans for preoperative planning, intraoperative guidance and tracking, and postoperative review. The disclosure also covers surgical-item manufacturing, patient monitoring, predictive analytics and education. Examples include guidance for shoulder and ankle procedures, tools for selecting and tracking surgical items, and simulated range-of-motion assessment.

The passage describes peripheral memory-map references, TILER extended addressing, and terminal functions. TILER adds a 4-GB address range for rotated and mirrored frame-buffer views; only the HDVPSS and ISS subsystems can access the full range, while other masters can access one view through a 512-MB base-map region. Terminal-function tables document pin assignments, electrical characteristics, and multiplexing. Boot-configuration pins are sampled at reset to set GPMC and watchdog-reset behavior, then function as GPMC data/address pins.
SpaceX launched NASA’s TESS satellite from Cape Canaveral on April 18. TESS will search nearby stars for planets suitable for follow-up observations. The Falcon 9 booster landed on a drone ship.

The Uzbek sum gained about 9% against the dollar on the black market in a week as exchange-rate liberalisation appeared imminent. Uzbekistan has ended mandatory foreign-currency sales by exporters, but has not announced when it will align exchange rates and lift remaining restrictions. Officials and foreign businesspeople say currency controls hinder investment.

The speaker says defensive mistakes put the team behind early, despite strong pressure and chances to tie the game later. After returning to play, they felt good and said the team must defend better and sustain its third-period effort. They expect a tough next game but are confident about returning home.

The passage describes eight Vanguard retirement funds: four LifeStrategy funds with different income and growth objectives, a Target Retirement Income Fund, and Target Retirement funds for 2040, 2050 and 2060. The target-date funds shift toward more conservative allocations as retirement approaches. A five-fund portfolio backtest from 2007 to 2023 grew $10,000 to $23,317, with returns below the S&P 500 Total Return index. The passage advises investors to read each fund’s prospectus to assess whether it fits their goals.

The speaker praises the nation’s progress but warns that rising crime and weakened confidence in justice threaten self-government. He calls for reform of federal courts and law enforcement, stronger enforcement of the eighteenth amendment, and citizens’ refusal to support illegal liquor. He proposes a national commission to investigate the justice system.

On economic policy, he favors regulating private enterprise rather than government ownership, alongside cooperation to strengthen employment and public welfare. He urges broader educational opportunity and better-organized public health services. Abroad, he advocates disarmament and peaceful settlement of disputes while opposing commitments through the League of Nations. He plans to call a special session of Congress on agricultural relief and tariff changes, and asks citizens to share responsibility for the country’s progress.

The Boring Company sold all 20,000 of its $500 novelty flamethrowers. After some customs agencies objected to the name, Elon Musk proposed renaming the short-range device “Not a Flamethrower.” Purchases include a fire extinguisher and serial number.

The Back Cut offense attacks the Diamond & One defense’s weak corners and middle through drives, post entries, back cuts, and screens that create shots, layups, and putbacks. Its options include feeding cutters or the star player, passing to the corner for a shot or baseline drive, and using single or double screens to free the star. Effective execution requires coordinated screening, post play, timing, and defensive recognition. The passage recommends scouting defensive tendencies, adjusting to changes, and varying alignments and entries.
Tesla’s November 1, 2017 Form 8-K reports that it posted third-quarter 2017 financial results in a shareholder letter, attached as Exhibit 99.1. CFO Deepak Ahuja signed the report.

Plex is rolling out free podcast support in beta on iOS, Android, Roku and Plex Web, with no subscription or media server required. Users can add podcasts to their home screen, get listening suggestions and adjust playback speed. An Android and iOS update also adds customizable navigation and default locations for content across multiple servers.

Italy’s business lobby, Confindustria, has lowered its 2025 growth forecast, citing U.S.–EU tariffs and a strong euro. It expects exports to stagnate through 2026, leaving investment and household consumption to support growth. The Italian government is preparing to revise its forecasts as policymakers weigh weak demand, public debt and EU budget constraints.

Senator Leila de Lima rejected Francis Tolentino’s election protest, saying a recount in precincts he selected found no vote recovery or irregularities in the 2016 Senate race. Tolentino, who placed 13th behind De Lima, wants former elections chief Andres Bautista summoned as a witness. De Lima accused Tolentino of delaying the case and urged him to accept his defeat.

Authorities are investigating a fire that destroyed South Carolina Judge Diane Goodstein’s beachfront home and injured at least three family members. They have found no evidence that it was intentionally set or that an explosion preceded it. Goodstein recently blocked a voter-data transfer, but the state supreme court reversed her order.

Care Compliance Expert says it aims to improve elder care, particularly dementia care and health and safety in care homes. The company says it advises on care standards and has been consulted by government organizations about regulatory changes.

France reached the World Cup quarter-finals with a 4-3 win over Argentina, led by two goals from Kylian Mbappé and supported by his teammates. They now face Uruguay, whose strong defence and Luis Suarez pose a tougher challenge. Edinson Cavani may miss the match through injury, and France are described as favourites to reach the semi-finals.

Scientists documented what they call the first modern case of “river piracy” after meltwater from Canada’s Kaskawulsh glacier abruptly shifted from the Slims River to the Alsek River in May 2016. The Slims became shallow, while the Alsek grew deeper and faster. The change redirected water toward the Pacific Ocean instead of the Bering Sea. Researchers say the glacier’s retreat caused the shift and calculate only a one-in-200 chance that it occurred without human-caused global warming.

Lexington County authorities are searching for a woman suspected of making more than 60 baseless 911 calls between March 25 and April 14, mostly from the Saint Andrews area. The sheriff’s department released a recording in hopes someone will recognize her voice. Officials say the calls could delay real emergencies and put deputies and drivers at risk. They ask anyone with information to contact Crimestoppers.

At a Tripura election rally, CPI(M) leader Prakash Karat said the February 18 Assembly polls would signal India’s political direction. He described the contest as one between the Left Front and BJP, expressed confidence in a Left Front victory, and accused the BJP-IPFT alliance of conspiring to prevent it. He also criticized the BJP-led central government’s budget and praised the Tripura government’s record.

The passage gives schematic guidance for MSPM0 devices: place 10µF and 0.1µF decoupling capacitors near the supply pins, pull NRST up to VDD, use an external resistor when SYSOSC frequency correction is enabled, place a 0.47µF capacitor near VCORE, and add pullups for open-drain outputs. It distinguishes experimental X devices from qualified MSP production devices and lists TI development tools, documentation, and support resources. The April 2025 revision updates device features and electrical specifications. The remaining sections cover mechanical and ordering information, handling precautions, and TI’s resource and warranty disclaimers.

SpaceX plans to launch its first previously flown rocket for NASA on Tuesday, carrying a reused Dragon capsule with nearly 5,000 pounds of space station supplies. NASA says the launch risk is comparable to that of a new rocket. The booster will attempt to land at Cape Canaveral after launch from a rebuilt pad.

Dengue lacks a direct-acting antiviral. This first-in-human Phase 1 study evaluated the safety and pharmacokinetics of AT-752, an oral dengue-virus polymerase inhibitor, in 65 healthy participants. Single doses up to 1500 mg and multiple doses up to 750 mg three times daily were well tolerated, with no serious adverse events. Food and Asian ethnicity had no substantial effect on dosing considerations. At 750 mg three times daily, levels of the metabolite AT-273 exceeded the in vitro antiviral target throughout treatment.

Fort Bend ISD crews and contractors worked overnight to repair air-conditioning problems at Quail Valley Elementary and Marshall High School after a three-day weekend and high temperatures. Marshall students said the school was unusually hot Tuesday, but the AC was working the next day.

Two clinical trials found that oral GLP-1 drugs helped people with obesity lose weight: participants taking 25-milligram semaglutide lost nearly 14 percent of their body weight on average, while those taking the highest dose of orforglipron lost about 11 percent. Both pills caused gastrointestinal side effects similar to other GLP-1 drugs. Daily pills could be easier to manufacture and use than refrigerated injections, but their cost and availability remain uncertain, and longer-term safety studies are needed.

The passage defines night trading as holding a position from the market close until the next open, rather than trading after hours. It says nearly all S&P 500 gains since 1993 occurred overnight, while buying at the open and selling at the close produced no gain. It reports similar overnight tendencies in gold and gold miners. Although overnight returns are small and holding positions carries added risk, the passage argues that trading rules may help overcome slippage and commissions. It cites a combined backtest of three close-to-close strategies with 950 trades averaging a 0.33% gain.

The March 2011 earthquake, tsunami and nuclear emergency disrupted Japan’s automotive industry and its global supply chains. Nissan sustained damage at six production facilities, and about 50 critical suppliers were impaired. Its existing emergency plan and risk-management structure guided a rapid response: the company coordinated information across regions, allocated scarce parts, adjusted production and empowered managers to act quickly. Nissan later announced plans to increase production in the Americas, reduce reliance on Japanese-made components at foreign factories and examine supply risks beyond its first-tier suppliers.

A collection of March 7–8 articles covers California’s electricity crisis. The state was negotiating a rescue of PG&E that could include buying its transmission lines for at least $7 billion, while questions remained about how to recover state power-purchase costs. Long-term contracts had not eliminated concerns about summer shortages, blackouts and high spot-market prices. Other reports described plant closures over unpaid bills, disputes over utility layoffs and blackout obligations, and opposition to proposed power plants. State officials approved a temporary plant at San Francisco International Airport.
On January 29, 2020, Tesla filed a Form 8-K announcing that it had posted its fourth-quarter and full-year 2019 financial results on its website. The update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

Paleontologists monitoring construction of Los Angeles’s Metro Purple Line extension have recovered Ice Age fossils since work began in 2014, including remains of rabbits, camels and bison. Their most notable find is an intact juvenile mammoth skull with both tusks attached. The skull is being studied and displayed at the La Brea Tar Pits and Museum. California environmental laws require scientists at certain construction sites, and subway work continues elsewhere when fossils are excavated.

Annealing hot-pressed n-type Bi₂Te₂.₆Se₀.₄ at 723 K for 100 hours improved its thermoelectric performance. Te and Se volatilization altered carrier density and mobility and introduced defects that reduced lattice thermal conductivity. The treated sample reached a peak ZT of 1.06 at 373 K and an average ZT of 0.99 from 300 to 423 K, suggesting a practical route to improved cooling materials.
NTT Docomo installed smartphone wipes in some Tokyo Narita Airport restrooms until March 15. The wipes advertise its Wi-Fi and translation app; cited studies found germs on phones.

The provisional government in Cuba will end after peaceful elections and the inauguration of a new government. The passage urges Cubans to preserve justice and order, warning that fraudulent elections or continued insurrection could prompt renewed U.S. intervention. It also describes the Third International Conference of American Republics, held in Rio de Janeiro, where delegates reached broadly supported conclusions on trade, communication, and cooperation. During the conference, the U.S. Secretary of State visited several South American countries to convey a message of peace and friendship and received warm welcomes.

Stocks fell in early Tuesday trading as banks and healthcare companies declined. Goldman Sachs missed earnings forecasts, while Johnson & Johnson and Cardinal Health also dropped. Bond prices rose, and the 10-year Treasury yield fell.

The study develops weighted metrics for evaluating software accessibility, with a focus on users with visual impairments. It expands ISO 25023 measures into perceptiveness, operability, understandability, and localization. Applied to the Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University website, the method produced an overall accessibility score of 0.67916, classified as “excellent” on the study’s scale. The assessment identified missing subtitles, audio descriptions, and input assistance, along with limited alternative text and weaknesses in structured navigation.

HIV prevention and treatment disparities persist among minoritized populations, partly because of social and structural determinants such as stigma, housing instability, and limited access to care. This protocol describes a U.S. systematic review of barriers and facilitators to implementing structural interventions for HIV evidence-based interventions, along with implementation strategies and adjunctive interventions.

A search identified 8,098 records before deduplication. Natural language processing screening is complete, and title and abstract review is underway. Eligible studies will undergo two-reviewer screening, data extraction, and coding using established implementation frameworks. The researchers plan to summarize findings by intervention type, population, setting, and outcomes, then share them through publications, conferences, and a literature-review dashboard. The review aims to identify evidence gaps and inform efforts to expand equitable access to HIV interventions.

The Supreme Court agreed to hear five cases in its 2025–26 term. One challenges Hawaii’s ban on carrying a handgun onto private property open to the public without the owner’s permission. Two concern lawsuits seeking compensation under a 1996 law for property confiscated in Cuba. Another asks how much compensation a Michigan estate is owed after a tax foreclosure sale. The fifth concerns whether federal law bars a state-law claim against a broker accused of negligently selecting a motor carrier or driver.

Kit Kat’s November 14, 2001 social update announces Boaka Bar’s November 30 grand opening and lists Houston-area nightlife, dining, charity, networking, and sports events scheduled through New Year’s.

The Supreme Court allowed Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook to remain in office while it considers in January 2026 whether President Donald Trump has legal cause to remove her. Trump cites mortgage-fraud allegations, which Cook denies; she has not been charged. The order leaves her able to participate in upcoming Fed interest-rate decisions.

The passage calls for agricultural public lands to be reserved for resident settlers, criticizes land laws that have enabled large acquisitions, and promises enforcement against unlawful fencing. It urges Congress to address grazing-land needs, potentially with an expert commission. For Alaska, it seeks laws encouraging permanent settlement, protection of forests, game, and salmon fisheries, and congressional representation and investigation. It advocates the eventual absorption of Indians into the wider population while adapting policy to tribes’ differing circumstances, including pastoral village life where farming allotments are unsuitable.

This study examined mentalizing, attachment, and personality pathology in 109 psychiatric inpatients and community participants. Self-mentalizing deficits were associated with impaired self and interpersonal functioning and all five maladaptive personality trait domains. Correct mentalizing about others was associated specifically with fewer interpersonal functioning difficulties. Mentalizing also moderated some relationships between insecure attachment and interpersonal difficulties, Negative Affectivity, and Detachment. The authors suggest that self- and other-oriented mentalizing may have distinct clinical relevance. Because the study was cross-sectional and used a small, heterogeneous sample and different assessment methods, its findings cannot establish causality and require replication.

Schaeffler converted an Audi RS3 into the electric 4ePerformance using four Formula E motors producing a combined 1,180 horsepower. It says the car reaches 124 mph from a standstill in seven seconds. Two motors power each axle, enabling all-wheel drive and torque vectoring, while two battery packs provide 64 kilowatt-hours of capacity.

Mod-Cam, the first-light instrument and testbed for the Fred Young Submillimeter Telescope, was used to assess thermal stability and detector noise in its 280 GHz module. At a controlled temperature of 100 mK, the detector stage’s RMS fluctuation over eight hours was 3.2 × 10⁻⁵ K. Measurements of aluminum and titanium-nitride detectors indicate that the resulting equivalent optical power fluctuations are 0.20 fW and 0.11 fW, respectively, at a 5 pW load. The study concludes that thermal fluctuations make a negligible contribution to detector noise.

NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K on May 25, 2022, announcing results for the quarter ended May 1, 2022. It furnished a press release and CFO commentary as exhibits, signed by Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress.
In an experiment, 6-year-olds doing repetitive tasks worked harder and stayed more focused when they pretended to be Batman or Dora the Explorer. Children who focused on themselves took more breaks.

Denmark’s Systemic Risk Council urged restrictions on interest-only and variable-rate mortgages for most borrowers in Copenhagen and Aarhus whose debt exceeds 400% of pretax income. It recommended exempting about 15% of loans. The government has three months to adopt the proposal or publicly explain its refusal.

In Finder.com’s survey, 78.3% of respondents said they had made a money mistake. The most common was overspending on leisure activities, cited by almost 64%. Women reported this more often than men, while men more often regretted bad investments and gambling. About one in five respondents regretted dropping out of college. Millennials were most likely to report leisure overspending, and baby boomers were most likely to regret bad investments.

The passage proposes using active learning to prioritize candidates generated by AI in scientific screening workflows. In a search for metal-organic frameworks, the method identified an average of 604 high-performing candidates per 1,000, compared with 281 without active learning, while adding about 0.6% to computational costs. The approach can also balance discovery of stable candidates with exploration of new designs.

Erik Demaine introduces Advanced Data Structures and its topics, then focuses on temporal data structures in the pointer-machine model. Persistence preserves earlier versions: partial persistence permits updates only to the latest version, full persistence permits updates to any version, and confluent persistence permits versions to be combined. Functional data structures go further by never modifying existing nodes.

For pointer-machine structures with a constant number of incoming pointers per node, partial and full persistence can be achieved with constant amortized overhead per change. The lecture explains how modification records, back pointers and node splitting support these results. Confluent persistence is harder: its general transformation has overhead that can grow with the number of updates, while a logarithmic-overhead result requires combined versions to have no shared nodes. Functional search trees and deques illustrate more restrictive approaches. Several improvements remain open problems.

The Missouri Supreme Court will hear two cases asking whether the Missouri Human Rights Act covers discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity, neither of which is explicitly named in the law. In one case, a transgender student alleges sex discrimination after his school district barred him from boys’ restrooms and locker rooms; lower courts dismissed his suit. In the other, state employee Harold Lampley alleges workplace discrimination based on perceived gender stereotypes, while co-worker Rene Frost alleges discrimination and retaliation over her friendship with him. An appeals court allowed their claims after the state Human Rights Commission denied them. The state argues that courts cannot extend the Act to sexual orientation or gender identity without explicit statutory language.

Seasonal weakness, thin trading and institutional rebalancing are described as pressures on markets. The analysis watches bond yields, the dollar, gold and July trading ranges for signs of market direction. It notes a bullish divergence in TLT despite its post-auction decline and says a weaker dollar could benefit commodities. The passage also includes market headlines, stock-screening promotion and trading-risk disclosures.

The speaker says his status for tonight is doubtful, though his injury has improved since he was hurt against Ottawa two weeks ago. He is preparing in case he must play but does not want to be a liability. He feels included by his teammates and expects skating to show whether he can play.

Researchers found that pianists can alter perceived timbre through precise key movements. Using sensors to measure performances by 20 pianists, they identified movement features linked to timbral differences. In listening tests, 40 participants recognized the intended timbres even when volume and tempo were controlled. The findings could inform music education and research into motor control and perception.

Professor Noelle Selin explains that mercury travels globally through the atmosphere, accumulates in food chains and poses health risks, particularly as methylmercury. She describes how scientific assessments, domestic policies and negotiations led to the 2013 Minamata Convention. The treaty addresses emissions, mercury-containing products, trade and artisanal gold mining, but allows exemptions and phased reductions. Selin notes that enforcement relies largely on cooperation and capacity building, and estimates that the treaty may prevent mercury levels from rising rather than reduce them immediately.

The passage describes KaviKrishna’s community-based tuberculosis research and care programme in rural northeastern India. It combines an indigenous temple communication network, telemedicine, student volunteers and regular patient follow-up with laboratory testing to screen patients, trace contacts and monitor relapse and drug resistance.

The authors describe methods for culturing and identifying *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*, testing drug susceptibility, detecting viable but non-culturable bacteria, analysing stem cells and sequencing bacterial genomes. They report evidence from earlier studies and mouse models that dormant bacteria can persist in bone marrow stem cells and later reactivate. Preliminary, unpublished findings suggest that the stem cell niche may also be involved in multidrug-resistant TB evolution. The authors propose that community participation and genomic surveillance could help develop locally tailored TB control programmes.

Jim Cramer has reversed his positive view of Snap, citing negative reactions to Snapchat’s redesign and concern that falling user engagement could drive away advertisers. Although Snap shares lost their gains following fourth-quarter results, he says the stock remains too expensive and risky for now, but he would consider buying at a lower price.

The passage describes patterns for building containerized distributed systems. Ambassadors broker service connections or split requests for experiments, while adapters give applications consistent interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks without modifying their containers. Microservices separate functions behind APIs, enabling independent development and scaling but making debugging and design harder.

Replicated, load-balanced services improve availability and capacity; readiness probes keep unprepared instances from receiving traffic. Caching and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharding divides data among servers, with careful key selection and consistent hashing limiting disruption when shards change. Scatter/gather distributes work across nodes and combines their results, though overhead and slow nodes can limit performance. Function-as-a-service simplifies deployment of event-driven code but presents challenges for monitoring, long-running work, memory-intensive services, and sustained request volume.

Assistant U.S. Attorney Will Rosenzweig was fired by email while observing Rosh Hashanah, after conservatives publicized blog posts attributed to him that criticized President Donald Trump. Rosenzweig had worked in the Southern District of Florida since 2020. The Justice Department has also fired three prosecutors in that district who previously worked with former special counsel Jack Smith.

The class examined digital identity as a collection of attributes, claims, credentials and third-party attestations, distinguishing a person’s identity from the tools used to verify it. Gensler discussed authentication and authorization, including how certificate authorities and public-key cryptography help browsers verify websites.

The discussion identified identity theft, data breaches, forged credentials and outdated records as problems for identity-management systems. Estonia’s e-identity system and India’s Aadhaar were presented as non-blockchain state projects; Aadhaar’s benefits and reported failures prompted debate.

Self-sovereign identity was described as giving people more control over their credentials and how they are used. Blockchain could support verification and decentralized public-key records, but distributing personal data, updating records, protecting private keys and achieving adoption pose challenges. The class also discussed digital-identity initiatives and MIT’s blockchain-backed diplomas.

Major banks closed over 1,000 branches between January 2015 and January 2017, with 141 more reported shut or due to shut in 2017.
