As mobile-only banks grow, a survey of 9,076 Which? members suggested that more than half of under-40s would consider an account, compared with fewer older respondents. Competitive savings rates may attract customers, but an app crash and the lack of in-person service highlight potential drawbacks.

A confidential memorandum proposes commissioning experts to prepare secret, indexed briefs and supporting documents on history, commerce, international law, and other issues for U.S. peace negotiators. One person would oversee the assignments, instructions, review, and printing. A second memorandum asks how far the United States should participate in decisions on European boundaries and colonial possessions, and what principles should guide territorial settlements. Colonel House writes to Secretary Lansing that he hopes to discuss the planned work and finds Lansing’s memorandum helpful for organizing it.

A video of Tennessee middle schooler Keaton Jones describing bullying at school went viral after his mother recorded it. Celebrities, including LeBron James and Mark Ruffalo, publicly supported him; Ruffalo invited him to an *Infinity War* premiere.

Stocks fell Friday, surrendering some weekly gains. The S&P/TSX composite was down 81.78 points, while the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. U.S. payrolls fell by 33,000 in September as hurricanes disrupted employment, but stronger-than-expected wage growth helped lift the U.S. dollar. Costco shares fell after a decline in gross margins, and energy stocks weakened amid lower oil prices and renewed oversupply concerns.

The Supreme Court said the CBI-led investigation into the larger conspiracy behind Rajiv Gandhi’s assassination appeared to have made little headway and could continue indefinitely. It added the Centre as a party to convict A G Perarivalan’s plea to suspend his sentence until the probe concludes and scheduled a hearing for January 24. Perarivalan, whose death sentence was commuted to life imprisonment, says he has spent 26 years in prison.

Insecticides India plans to invest Rs 200 crore over three years to expand plants in Gujarat and Rajasthan and add synthesis and export facilities. It expects 10–15 percent revenue growth this fiscal if monsoon rains are favorable, supported by new products. Its 2017–18 net profit rose 41 percent to Rs 83.97 crore.

Antonio Vasquez and Hector Perez were convicted of possessing burglar’s tools but acquitted of attempted petit larceny and resisting arrest after evidence that they abandoned an attempt to steal a bicycle. They sought to set aside the conviction because the jury was not instructed that renunciation was a defense to possessing burglar’s tools. The court denied the motion, holding that the renunciation statute permits that defense for attempted crimes but not for possession of burglar’s tools. The court noted that the Legislature could consider amending the statute.

The ADS868xW devices use a multiSPI interface for commands and data transfer. They support standard SPI and source-synchronous read protocols, single- or dual-bit outputs, and single-device or daisy-chain connections. Data transfers use 32-bit frames; frames shorter than 32 clocks cannot write commands. The devices have RESET, acquisition, and conversion states, with conversions initiated by a rising CONVST/CS edge.

Nine configuration registers control communication, output data and flags, input ranges, alarms, reset, and power-saving modes. The output can contain conversion results, register data, or fixed patterns. An example industrial input module combines an ADS8681W with an eight-channel differential multiplexer. The passage also describes programmable alarm thresholds and hysteresis, power-supply decoupling, and PCB layout recommendations.

South Carolina Congressman Trey Gowdy, known for joking about his hair with Sen. Tim Scott, announced in January 2018 that he would not seek re-election and hoped to return to law. The passage contrasts his prominent role in the Benghazi hearings with his later support for Robert Mueller’s Russia investigation. Gowdy disputed claims that a House Intelligence Committee memo he co-wrote undermined the investigation and said evidence showed Russia wanted to harm Hillary Clinton’s candidacy. Although he defended the firing of Andrew McCabe, he warned President Trump against trying to stop Mueller.

OSCAR is a one-shot method for identifying each outcome label’s Markov Boundary from an individual event sequence. It uses two Transformer-based probability models and parallel conditional-independence tests to produce interpretable event–label graphs and indicators of changes in label likelihood. On vehicle diagnostic data with 29,100 event types and 474 labels, OSCAR achieved 55.26% precision, 31.37% recall, and 40.02% F1 in 11.7 minutes; comparison methods did not finish within three days. Its theoretical guarantees depend on strong assumptions, including causal sufficiency, bounded lagged effects, and models that perfectly estimate the relevant probabilities.

The speaker is disappointed that the team lost after holding two two-goal leads in the third period. They remain optimistic, credit their supportive home fans and say the team must learn from its mistakes, stick to its game plan and focus on the next game.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 28, 2020, reporting that it had issued a press release on its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 28, 2019. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

The Trump administration will allow businesses to deny employees contraceptive insurance coverage on religious or moral grounds. Reproductive rights advocates condemned the change to Obamacare; conservative Christian activists praised it.

As major equity indices reach new highs, the author challenges calls for drastic action, arguing that patient, low-activity investing has historically produced better results than reacting to bearish warnings. The passage also promotes the author’s investment service and discloses holdings in the tickers discussed.

After his team was swept by Detroit in the Stanley Cup finals, the speaker said he was disappointed but proud of its progress. He described several close games and said Detroit’s experience, depth and goaltending helped it capitalize on mistakes. He praised Steve Yzerman’s playoff MVP award, Olaf Kolzig’s play and Detroit’s tribute to Vladi and a masseur after an accident. He also welcomed growing local support and said the loss would help his team learn and return stronger.

For large sparse systems, matrix–vector multiplication is fast, but direct elimination can be too costly, motivating iterative methods with simpler preconditioners. The lecture introduces Jacobi, Gauss–Seidel, successive overrelaxation, and incomplete LU, which limits fill-in during factorization. In stationary iteration, the error is repeatedly multiplied by an iteration matrix; convergence requires all its eigenvalues to have magnitude below one, and the spectral radius governs the rate.

For a tridiagonal example, Jacobi converges slowly because some eigenvalues lie close to one, requiring on the order of \(n^2\) iterations for a fixed error reduction. Weighted Jacobi improves the treatment of high-frequency errors, while Gauss–Seidel uses newly computed values immediately and roughly matches two Jacobi steps. Low-frequency errors remain slow to decay, motivating multigrid.

A reversal day is a sharp change in a stock or market’s direction after an extended trend. Bullish reversals follow downtrends; bearish reversals follow rallies. Potential causes include shifts in sentiment, economic conditions, and company news. Traders may look at price trends, volume, and technical indicators. In the article’s gold backtests, the bullish strategy showed gains but few trades, while the bearish strategy produced losses.

This qualitative study interviewed 45 teacher candidates at a private university about a special education course delivered remotely. More than half reported satisfaction with the course, and most recommended distance education, citing convenience and affordability. However, 58% preferred face-to-face instruction, and participants reported internet, system, and material problems that hindered learning. Many considered attendance important for success. Participants suggested improving the system, internet infrastructure, and technical support.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture adds native HDR processing, improved video encoding and decoding, and VirtualLink support for connecting VR headsets through one USB-C connector. NVLink increases bandwidth between supported GPUs for two-way SLI.

Turing combines rasterization with real-time ray tracing. Dedicated RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests, while denoising reduces the rays needed for effects such as shadows, ambient occlusion and reflections. Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow-motion video and super-resolution.

Other rendering features include mesh shading to reduce CPU draw-call bottlenecks, variable-rate shading to adjust work across an image, texture-space shading to reuse shading results, and multi-view rendering for VR and other applications. The passage also describes the TU104 and TU106 GPUs, an RTX-OPS metric for hybrid-rendering workloads, and NVIDIA’s product disclaimers.

This April 16, 2001 news digest covers energy, technology and Enron. Sierra Pacific suspended its dividend amid high power costs but continued pursuing its purchase of Enron’s Portland General Electric. Articles described growing interest in wind and solar power, an uncertain technology-stock rally, online layoff rumors and movie-copying software. In Maharashtra, a committee recommended renegotiating the costly Dabhol power agreement. Enron also reported restarting its Texas MTBE plant after scheduled maintenance.

Cocoa futures are contracts to buy or sell 10 metric tons of cocoa at a pre-agreed price on a future date. They trade on ICE as CC, with physical delivery, and on CME Globex as CJ, with financial settlement. Contracts expire in March, May, July, September and December. The minimum price change is $1 per metric ton, or $10 per contract. The passage says cocoa futures tend to perform better in summer; a strategy backtest reported 96 trades, a 74% win rate and a 2.3 profit factor. It identifies adverse price movements, leverage and limited liquidity as major trading risks.

Health savings accounts (HSAs) let people with high-deductible insurance save and invest money tax-free for eligible medical expenses. Republican lawmakers have renewed interest in them as they consider replacing the Affordable Care Act, but participation remains limited. Upfront costs and psychological barriers make saving difficult, even for some who can afford it. Research suggests that people with HSAs use less health care, though whether their health improves is unclear; one study found lower prescription drug costs but more emergency room visits, particularly among lower-income families. Unclear medical prices also complicate planning. HSAs may help people who can cover daily expenses and still save.

A cross-sectional study of 243 officers at Ghana’s Nsawam Medium Security Prison found a 9% prevalence of burnout. High emotional exhaustion affected 42.0% of officers, high depersonalization 32.5%, and low personal accomplishment 68.7%. Officers most often identified irregular shifts, heavy workload, and limited training and development opportunities as causes of burnout. Burnout was more likely among female officers and those with postgraduate degrees than among officers with diplomas or certificates. Shift allocation was associated with emotional exhaustion, and rank with depersonalization. Talking to colleagues was the most commonly reported coping strategy.

The SD Card Association provides this subset of its full specification on a non-confidential, “as-is” basis. It disclaims warranties and liability, grants no implied licenses, and notes that implementation may require a license.

MLPs outperformed the S&P 500 in the final four days of 2016, despite a slight decline in the Alerian MLP Index. For the year, the index gained 18.3%, while its equal-weight version returned 22.5%. December’s 4.4% gain extended the index’s run of positive quarters to three. SunCoke Energy Partners was the top-performing distribution-paying MLP for the year, and Ferrellgas Partners was the biggest loser. Plains GP Holdings filed to sell up to $500 million in common units, while Shell Midstream Partners announced acquisitions of interests in Gulf of Mexico pipelines.

The S&P 500 Information Technology sector accounts for more than a quarter of the index’s market capitalization and includes software, services, hardware, and semiconductor companies. ETFs tracking it include VGT and XLK. The passage presents two mean-reversion technology-sector strategies: the first reports 245 trades, a 10% CAGR, and an 18% maximum drawdown; the second reports 212 trades, a 9.5% CAGR, and a 15% maximum drawdown. It cautions that technology strategies may correlate strongly with the broader market and offer limited diversification.

The article credits Morgan Tsvangirai with strengthening Zimbabwe’s opposition and forcing a 2008 presidential runoff. It argues that later electoral losses, a party split and illness make it necessary for him to step aside as MDC Alliance leader while remaining an adviser.

The authors argue that Stanford’s mandatory Program in Writing and Rhetoric does not adequately teach academic writing. They criticize its broad course topics, limited instruction in source analysis, high grades, and what they see as a liberal political bias. They propose allowing experienced writers to place out, offering courses with other political perspectives, and rejecting a proposed PWR minor. Instead, they suggest a more standardized, rigorous, source-based writing course designed by experienced humanities professors.

For Fire Prevention Week, Montecito fire crews plan to teach 800 elementary school children emergency preparedness and fire safety. Activities scheduled for Oct. 3–6 were canceled because of predicted inclement weather and will be rescheduled; other activities remain scheduled. Parents are encouraged to practice emergency plans with their families.

The M8 shown has provisional headlights, standard brakes and different wheels from the earlier model. BMW has not confirmed specifications, but the passage points to a CLAR platform, a twin-turbo V8 and all-wheel drive. It positions the car against high-end rivals and notes that the original M8 never entered production.

Ottawa police say a woman claiming her car had broken down lured a driver to O’Toole Road on Saturday evening, where she and two men allegedly attacked him and stole his wallet. The victim was treated in hospital. Police are seeking information about the suspects and their dark-coloured, older four-door sedan.

Vertigo’s iOS app now lets Apple Music and Spotify Premium subscribers share songs and playlists across the two services. Users can also host live listening sessions with video, photos, chat, and audio commentary. The app requires paid subscriptions and pays royalties to rights holders for shared songs. The passage suggests Vertigo could provide social features that Apple Music lacks.

At the Code Conference, Aileen Lee, Megan Smith and Sukhinder Singh Cassidy discussed diversity in tech. Lee said men often receive opportunities for being “good guys,” while women and people of color face greater scrutiny. She called for removing bias from business processes. The panel discussed board diversity, and Smith said women of color are most left out.

StockX is adding BAPE and PALACE to its streetwear marketplace, which launched with Supreme merchandise in 2017. At launch, it expects to offer more than 4,000 BAPE products and 3,000 PALACE products. StockX says it physically inspects and authenticates products and uses anonymous transactions and real-time pricing. Launched in 2016, the company also sells sneakers, watches and handbags.

Glen Campbell’s family says music comforts him as he lives with late-stage Alzheimer’s disease. His daughter Ashley says he sometimes smiles and sings along. His album “Adios,” recorded in 2012, was released June 9.

The study tested a streamlined workflow for reviewing optical genome mapping (OGM) results in VIA software using 10 myeloid malignancy cases, each reviewed repeatedly by independent technologist–director teams. OGM identified every finding reported by standard-of-care testing and additional variants in five of six positive cases. Key guideline variants were unanimously classified as Tier 1A, while classification and reporting of other variants varied. Technologist reviews averaged 25.2 minutes for negative cases, 28.5 minutes for simple cases, and 47.3 minutes for complex cases.

Brazilian stocks rose Thursday as Vale shares rallied on record first-quarter iron ore output for the period, despite a quarterly decline. Steelmaker Usiminas also gained after reversing a loss. The real remained volatile amid geopolitical and election concerns, though French polls eased some investor worries.

In October 2022, the reporter used a Eurail pass for eight train rides across Germany, Austria, Italy, and Switzerland. The pass cost $477, and upgrades and overnight-train fees brought the total to $560. They preferred trains to flying for the comfortable seats, easier boarding, sleeper accommodation, scenery, and lower carbon footprint.

President Donald Trump warned Iran against restarting its nuclear program if the 2015 nuclear deal collapses, while French President Emmanuel Macron urged him to keep the United States in the agreement. Trump criticized the deal for not addressing ballistic missiles or Iran’s role in regional conflicts, but said the two leaders were close to understanding each other. Iran has said it could expand its nuclear program if the deal ends. Their talks also covered steel tariffs and U.S. forces in Syria.

A football holder catches the snap and quickly places the ball at the kicker’s preferred spot and angle, turning the laces away. Precise, consistent placement helps kickers maintain their rhythm on field goals and extra points; mistakes can cost points. Holders often have other roles, such as punter or backup quarterback, and may pass or run during fake kicks.

Rio Blanco County’s senior 4-H livestock judging season ended at the Colorado 4-H June conference. Macy Collins placed third overall as an individual, and Marryn Shults placed seventh. Shults, Jilly Bumguardner and Tatumn Kennedy made up the senior team. Collins also earned a place on the Colorado State 4-H Livestock All State team. A member of Rio Blanco County’s 2015 state champion team, she will attend Hutchinson Junior College on a full academic and judging scholarship.

The Daily Examiner is replacing its metered digital model with subscriber-only premium stories, while keeping public-safety information and some local stories free. Existing subscribers retain unlimited access. Subscriptions include the app, a daily newsletter, breaking-news alerts and access to other News Corp sites; print and digital-only options are available. Sign up online or by phone.

Thailand recorded 390 road deaths during Songkran week, down 11 per cent from the previous year after a junta road-safety campaign. Drunk driving caused 28 per cent of accidents, and authorities seized 5,600 motorbikes and 1,800 cars from drivers over the limit. Junta chief Prayut Chan-O-Cha said the death toll remained unacceptable.

The EU plans to urge development banks to align lending more closely with the Paris Agreement, shift financing from fossil fuels toward climate projects, and attract private investment. The proposal, led by Germany and France, faces U.S. opposition over concerns that climate targets could distract from economic growth and poverty reduction.

The Supreme Court of Canada unanimously upheld a ruling that sensitive records from residential school abuse compensation claims should be destroyed after 15 years. The court said the 2006 settlement agreement’s assessment process was intended to be private and confidential. The records concern more than 37,000 claims.

Eric Thames hit a two-run homer in the fifth inning to give the Milwaukee Brewers a 2-0 win over the Minnesota Twins on Tuesday. Brewers starter Junior Guerra pitched five scoreless innings, Josh Hader allowed no hits in three innings of relief, and Corey Knebel struck out the side in the ninth for his ninth save. Minnesota managed two hits and fell to 1-7 on its road trip.

Olean’s Common Council unanimously authorized Mayor Bill Aiello to apply for a $10 million state Downtown Revitalization Initiative grant. The proposed area stretches from Olean General Hospital to the Allegheny River and from Franchot Park to about Seventh Street. Proposed projects include building redevelopment, business incubators, theater options and park improvements. Aiello said the city could also qualify for more than $2 million in Buffalo Billion assistance. Jamestown Community College’s John Sayegh supported the application and offered to work with the city on upgrades to its Cutco Theater.

A December 2000 memorandum surveys power-sector restructuring worldwide from June through November. European markets are opening amid utility consolidation, while Central and Eastern Europe pursue privatization. Asian governments are resuming reforms, though independent power producers face contract and financing problems. Latin American privatizations have slowed amid economic pressures and drought. African and Middle Eastern countries are expanding private generation and planning regional transmission links.

At Kevin Mallory’s espionage trial, prosecutors alleged that the former CIA officer gave a Chinese agent classified information, including details about human assets, in exchange for $25,000. They cited messages on a phone given to Mallory by the Chinese and documents found at his home. Mallory’s lawyers said he intended to feed the Chinese false information and had contacted the CIA about a suspicious job offer. Two witnesses confirmed he contacted them before an airport inspection that prosecutors said prompted his cover story. Mallory faces up to life in prison.

An IDC survey of 200 manufacturing decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland examines simulation, modeling, data analytics, and high-performance computing (HPC). Respondents link these technologies to faster product development, improved quality, more efficient processes, and innovation. IDC argues that integrating data across departments into a single source of truth is essential to realizing these benefits.

Eighty-one percent of respondents view HPC as a game changer for product and process innovation, but users face security concerns, costs, energy consumption, limited computing capacity, and skills shortages. Many favor external infrastructure or cloud-based HPC for its scalability and flexibility. IDC recommends evaluating operating models against each enterprise’s needs while prioritizing data integration, security, energy efficiency, and access to expertise.

The passage contrasts earlier challenges of creating and preserving the United States with the present task of protecting it from external threats. It argues that democracy survived a domestic crisis while constitutional government, rights, and free elections endured. The nation must improve citizens’ security and opportunity, but its future depends most on preserving its spirit of freedom. The speaker calls for national defense and continued dedication to democracy.

The speaker says Detroit played sound defense and gave up few chances. After Detroit scored first, a brief letdown helped it build a two-goal lead. The speaker felt the game was otherwise fairly even, but said their power play generated little, the team needed to improve, and they personally could have played better.

This AMD Geode CS5535 Revision A3 specification update lists hardware errata, their effects, and available workarounds. Clock gating can cause missed PIC interrupts, lost GLIU statistics-counter ASMIs, and unreliable UART CEIR and USB controller operation. Other issues affect IDE and UDMA transfers, PRD prefetching and alignment, ACPI register access, keyboard emulation, LPC and SMBus transactions, GPIO writes after suspend, and sleep and wake behavior. Some faults can hang the system or corrupt data; others have limited or no expected operational impact. Recommended measures include disabling clock gating in affected domains, using specified access sizes and alignment, changing driver procedures, and applying software or hardware workarounds where available.

A study of Indonesian ICT companies found that digital customer experience and electronic word of mouth positively affected brand image. Brand image improved supply chain image, which in turn improved sustainable supply chain performance. The analysis used 315 valid employee questionnaires and supported all seven proposed relationships and mediation effects.

Apple Inc. reported that it issued $14 billion in senior unsecured notes on February 8, 2021, across six series maturing from 2026 to 2061. Interest rates range from 0.700% to 2.800%, with interest payable semiannually beginning August 8, 2021.

The passage describes a hybrid gas turbine engine that uses an electric motor to supplement thrust, allowing the engine to be sized for efficient cruise operation. During descent, the engine core can shut down or run at a minimum temperature, reducing fuel use and emissions. Stored electricity can power aircraft systems and an electric compressor when engine bleed air is insufficient. The fan may also windmill to generate electricity, or the motor may drive it to provide thrust or overcome engine drag.

IDC describes high-performance computing (HPC), simulations, modeling, and data analytics as tools for manufacturing enterprises facing competitive pressure and digital transformation. Cloud-based HPC can provide access to current technology and flexible capacity, while data analysis can support product development, operational improvements, and new digital offerings. IDC recommends a shared data strategy, evaluating on-premises, cloud, and hybrid HPC against business needs, and considering scalability, security, energy efficiency, and external expertise. The white paper draws on a December 2021 survey of 200 decision makers at industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

The passage argues that hopes for peace after 1945 gave way to fear and costly armament as the United States and Soviet Union followed opposing paths. It calls on the new Soviet leadership to demonstrate peaceful intentions through deeds, including an honorable Korean armistice, respect for other nations’ independence, and verifiable disarmament. The United States says it is ready to pursue European settlements, arms controls, and international aid funded by disarmament savings. It urges nations to redirect resources from weapons toward food, housing, health, and development.

A federal judge dismissed Spencer Elden’s lawsuit over Nirvana’s 1991 album cover, which shows him naked underwater as a baby. The judge ruled that the image was not child pornography, finding that nudity alone did not make it sexually suggestive.

NVIDIA reported fiscal 2023 third-quarter revenue of $5.93 billion, down 17% year over year, and net income of $680 million, down from $2.46 billion. Data Center revenue rose 31%, while Gaming revenue fell 51%. Gross margin declined to 53.6%, primarily reflecting a $702 million inventory charge. For the first nine months, revenue rose 9% to $20.92 billion, but net income fell to $2.95 billion. NVIDIA recorded a $1.35 billion cost after terminating its planned Arm acquisition. It repurchased $8.99 billion of shares during the nine months and held $13.14 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities on October 30, 2022.

Myrna LaPlante supports the current National Inquiry into Murdered and Missing Indigenous Women and Girls and says she would withdraw her family’s story if the commission were reset. She supports extending its deadline by two years. The Assembly of First Nations has called for chief commissioner Marion Buller to resign. Some Saskatchewan families agree, citing poor communication, disrupted plans and inadequate support during the Saskatoon hearings.

Donna Adelson, 75, was sentenced to life in prison for the 2014 murder of her former son-in-law, Florida State University law professor Dan Markel, plus 30 years for conspiracy and solicitation. She denied involvement, prompting the judge to warn that he could consider her “utter lack of remorse.” Prosecutors alleged the killing was motivated by the family’s desire to move Markel’s ex-wife and children to South Florida. Adelson’s husband also maintained her innocence.

Jean Munoz’s July 31 IEP news digest covers California’s electricity crisis. Articles criticize Gov. Gray Davis’ long-term power contracts and proposed Southern California Edison bailout, report a preliminary SEC inquiry into advisers’ energy-stock trading, and describe conflict-of-interest allegations involving his spokesman and consultants. Other reports cover San Francisco public-power ballot measures, federal limits on California’s potential electricity refunds, and developments in power deregulation in Texas and Maryland.

Singapore’s special education system evolved from separate, welfare-run schools toward a national continuum that includes support in mainstream schools. A shift toward inclusion began in 2004, followed by national disability plans, expanded support services and teacher-training programs. About 80% of students with special needs now attend mainstream schools.

The National Institute of Education prepares special-school teachers and Special Educational Needs Officers, while mainstream teachers receive training to support students with special needs. Remaining concerns include lower salaries for special-school teachers, limited mainstream options for students with higher support needs, and shorter preparation programs for special educators.

Uber has launched a nationwide in-app panic button that lets riders call 911. The app displays their real-time location; in several pilot cities, it automatically sends dispatchers location and vehicle details.

Sony’s A7Riii firmware update fixes a “Set File Name” issue and improves camera stability. The updater does not support macOS High Sierra (10.13), which may prevent some Mac users from installing it. The passage suggests using an earlier supported Mac version or running Windows as workarounds.

The passage suggests improving mortgage borrowing power by paying off debt, adding a co-signer, changing loan programs, putting more money down, or changing jobs within a similar field. It says lenders consider monthly debt payments relative to pre-tax income, making debt reduction especially useful. Co-signers share responsibility for the mortgage, while a larger down payment may help less than paying off debt. Borrowers should research which options fit their circumstances.

The lecture concludes its discussion of PDEs with a drug-patch diffusion assignment to be solved using COMSOL and finite volumes. The drug’s low diffusivity can produce sharp concentration gradients, so students are urged to test mesh and boundary choices for convergence rather than trust a computed result. Finite-volume equations balance fluxes across control-volume boundaries; the resulting system is linear and sparse. For time-dependent flow, the CFL number relates time-step size to spatial resolution and flow speed.

The lecture then introduces probability as a way to describe fluctuating measurements and physical quantities. Coin flips illustrate joint and conditional probabilities, double counting, and Bayes’ theorem. For continuous variables, probability densities must be integrated over a range to obtain probabilities; cumulative distributions give the probability of a value at or below a specified threshold.

The New York Times reported that U.S. agencies intercepted calls between Russian intelligence officials and members of Trump’s 2016 campaign, including Paul Manafort. Officials told the newspaper they found no evidence the campaign worked with Russians to influence the election. An official said the FBI interviewed former national security adviser Michael Flynn about his contact with a Russian official; Flynn left his post amid concerns he had misled administration officials. Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called for an independent investigation. Several Republican senators withheld support for labor secretary nominee Andrew Puzder pending questions about taxes on a former housekeeper unauthorized to work in the United States. Linda McMahon and David Shulkin were sworn in to lead the Small Business Administration and Veterans Affairs, respectively.

A 1968 study found that doctors disagreed when assessing stomach-ulcer X-rays and sometimes gave different diagnoses for the same image. An algorithm based on the doctors’ descriptions of their methods performed better than any individual doctor. The author questions how the algorithm handled disagreements and received image data, while considering what the results mean for experts’ roles in diagnosis.

Which? found that after November’s base rate rise, 48% of the instant-access savings accounts and ISAs it examined had no rate increase within five weeks, while 21% received the full increase. By the end of 2017, 53% of standard variable-rate mortgage providers examined had raised rates for existing borrowers. Which? called this “double standards”; UK Finance said rates reflect factors beyond the base rate.
United Way of Northwest Illinois will launch the Imagination Library for Carroll County children ages 0–5 on March 28, 2018, at Mt. Carroll Township Public Library.
Wave-like clouds resembling Asperitas were seen over the Bristol area on Monday morning, including in Thornbury, Filton and Monmouthshire. The Met Office said how they form remains uncertain.

D-branes become dynamical through open-string fluctuations. Their tension is their ground-state energy per unit volume and, at weak string coupling, scales as \(1/g_s\). A cylinder diagram describing closed-string exchange between two D-branes can also be viewed as a one-loop diagram of open strings connecting them. The lecture presents this as channel duality.

The low-energy dynamics of a D-brane’s gauge and scalar fields can be described by the Dirac–Born–Infeld action; the scalar fields describe brane motion. For coincident D-branes, open strings ending on different branes add matrix-valued fields, yielding a \(U(n)\) gauge symmetry and Yang–Mills theory. Separating the branes makes strings stretched between them massive and breaks the gauge symmetry into factors associated with the separated groups of branes.

Hickory Tussock Moth caterpillars, found around Belleville from July to September, have venomous hairs that can cause skin irritation and, occasionally, allergic reactions. People who touch them should wash the affected area and may use calamine lotion or cortisone for itching; more serious reactions warrant medical attention. Local experts advise observing the caterpillars without touching them and say they are generally not a health hazard.

The passage describes features of the MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 microcontrollers, including low-frequency timekeeping, voltage reference, comparator, security, CRC, UART, I2C, SPI, watchdogs, real-time clock, timers, input/output control, and serial-wire debugging. It also covers factory-stored device information, recommended decoupling and reset components, development resources, product nomenclature, revision changes, and packaging guidance. TI states that application designs must be validated by customers and that its design resources are provided “as is.”

The passage describes a mean reversion strategy backtested on SPY or the S&P 500 using Internal Bar Strength and Relative Strength Index signals. It mentions equity curves for the original and inverted strategies since January 2000 but provides no numerical results.

The passage describes options trading in META as buying contracts that grant the right to buy or sell an asset at a specified price by a set date. It outlines account opening, order placement, a stated $100 minimum deposit that may vary by broker, and a one-contract minimum trade size. It lists strategies, broker-provided charts and research tools, and possible fees. Options can provide exposure without owning shares, but leverage and adverse market moves can cause substantial losses.

The report says the global nuclear medicine market grew from $3.5 billion in 2013 to $4.2 billion in 2016 and projects $5.89 billion by 2021. It profiles manufacturers including GE Healthcare, Bracco Imaging, Mallinckrodt, Lantheus Medical Imaging and Bayer. It examines market size, pricing, revenue and consumption across regions, product types, diagnostic and therapeutic uses, and sales channels.

Atossa Genetics shares fell 12.06% in the most recent session, closing at $0.70. One analyst rated the stock Outperform and set a 12-month price target of $2. Its 14-period ATR was 0.09, weekly volatility was 37.88%, and RSI was 73.41. The company’s market capitalization was $17.25 million. Trading volume reached 29.13 million shares, compared with an average of about 3.7 million.

The passage traces how U.S. jobs came to be labeled “unskilled.” Early classifications applied the term mainly to manual work and were influenced by workers’ identities; later definitions emphasized education, experience, and job tasks. Across farm, factory, service, and other occupations, many workers faced low pay, hazardous conditions, and limited protections, even when their jobs required judgment, endurance, or specialized knowledge. Women, immigrants, and people of color were disproportionately represented in these jobs.

Technology changed or eliminated some jobs while expanding low-paid service, warehouse, and gig work. Government regulation, worker organizing, and employer practices sometimes improved wages and conditions, though protections remained uneven. During Covid-19, many workers in jobs labeled “unskilled” were deemed essential. The passage identifies job quality, rather than automation-driven job loss, as a central concern for the future of work.

The Gann Fan is a technical analysis tool that draws angled lines from significant price highs or lows to identify potential support, resistance, reversals, and breakouts. Its central 45-degree line represents a 1:1 relationship between price and time. Traders may use it alongside other indicators and risk-management measures. The passage cautions that Gann angles are not reliably predictive and says a meaningful backtest was not possible because the strategy’s rules are too subjective.

Cover 1 assigns defenders man-to-man, with a free safety covering the deep middle and sometimes another defender protecting shorter routes over the middle. It lets defenses support the run or blitz but leaves perimeter matchups vulnerable. Offenses can attack outside the safety’s help with pick plays, double moves, and routes that let receivers catch the ball in motion. The passage illustrates these approaches with plays from Ohio State, Oklahoma, Georgia, and a red-zone scissors combination that produces a touchdown.

Eric Hirsch, EdReports’ founding CEO, will step down at the end of the school year after leading the curriculum-review organization since 2014. EdReports has published more than 1,100 reviews and become a resource for states and districts selecting materials. The organization has recently revised its scoring process and expanded into pre-K reviews amid criticism of its approach to reading instruction and standards. As its board searches for a successor, questions include how AI could support curriculum and how schools can better connect materials with teacher training, assessment and additional instruction.

S&P Global Platts said it will begin publishing low-sulphur marine gasoil and diesel prices at several Asian bunkering ports on June 1, 2017. The assessments cover fuels with no more than 0.1 percent sulphur and respond to rising sales and expected tighter global sulphur limits.

Motley Fool Money highlights the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card’s unlimited 2% cash rewards, $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. The passage also lists cell phone protection and compares offers from Capital One and Citi. Motley Fool Money says it receives advertising compensation but that compensation does not influence its product ratings.

Steve Mitchell, a fifth-generation farmer at Boglily Farm, uses social media to promote The Buffalo Farm and its buffalo meat. The business won the 2016 Scotland Food & Drink Excellence Award in the Meat category, which Mitchell says strengthened its credibility with major customers. The awards are now accepting entries for 2018.

A white van drove along sidewalks on Toronto’s Yonge Street, striking pedestrians between Finch Avenue and the Mel Lastman Square area. Witnesses described people being hit and others trying to help the injured. Police took the van and driver into custody, closed part of Yonge Street and asked witnesses to submit information. Police said the motive was unknown. Sunnybrook Hospital received 10 patients: two were pronounced dead, five were in critical condition and three were in serious condition. North York General Hospital received four patients. Public Safety Minister Ralph Goodale said available information suggested no connection to national security.

The passage says that many South Americans mistakenly viewed the Monroe Doctrine as a claim of U.S. superiority or a right to protect other republics. Secretary Root sought to dispel this impression, affirming equal sovereignty, mutual prosperity, and cooperation against international wrong. His remarks were reportedly acclaimed in South America, where he received warm hospitality. The passage also raises concern that foreign powers might use force to collect debts from American republics and occupy their territory.

Christine Milligan was surprised to be asked whether her family wanted to override her daughter Cassidey Ouellete’s organ-donor registration after Ouellete died in a car accident. Ontario’s Trillium Gift of Life Network says families rarely overturn a donor’s decision, but the option allows for cases where the person later expressed regret. Families did so in about 10 per cent of cases in 2016. Milligan wants a bill reintroduced that would let only donors revoke registration and would automatically register Ontario residents unless they opt out. Trillium’s CEO questions presumed consent, citing public preference for an opt-in system and a lack of evidence that presumed consent increases donors.

The speaker praises a player’s positioning and decision-making and says his family enjoys living in Carolina, where team spirit and public support have grown. He expects Canadian fans to support Edmonton but hopes his team will win and bring a cup to a southern market. He says winning can help attract children to hockey, recalls coaching kids in Tampa, and enjoys the game’s increased scoring. He hopes to finish his career in Carolina and says the team’s depth made him believe it could challenge despite lacking big names.

The United States withdrew from U.N. negotiations on a nonbinding global migration compact, saying the process could undermine its sovereignty and immigration laws. U.S. Catholic bishops urged the administration to reconsider, arguing that participation would let the country shape international cooperation while protecting vulnerable migrants. Pope Francis called for solidarity with migrants and refugees. Supporters of the withdrawal warned that the compact could interfere with U.S. law; U.N. officials said countries would decide how to implement it. The bishops maintained that nations may control their borders but also have obligations to migrants and the wider common good.

An AI tool called Waldo scanned more than 430,000 cannabis-related Reddit posts and flagged over 28,000 as potentially describing harmful or unexpected side effects. Researchers verified such experiences in 86 percent of a sample of 250 flagged posts. In earlier testing, Waldo produced fewer false positives than ChatGPT but did not outperform human reviewers. Researchers say social media scanning could help public health workers identify problems, though its usefulness for other products remains uncertain and privacy protections would be needed.

Edmonton officials called a road-salting pilot successful, citing $4.2 million in operating savings and 68 per cent less sand use. Chemical engineer Arthur Potts said it was too early to judge, warning that liquid calcium chloride could damage vehicles, concrete and bridges, potentially costing vehicle owners far more than the city saved. He criticized the lack of local corrosion testing. Officials had not yet provided environmental or collision data. A committee was considering whether to continue the program next winter; a request for new equipment funding could follow in the fall.

Indian Railways will display “if no bill, your food is free” on trains serving paid food by March 31 to curb overcharging. IRCTC is publicising the policy and deploying inspectors to check prices and billing. More than 7,000 overcharging complaints were recorded between April and October last year; Railways has also fined caterers and terminated contracts over such complaints.

The government shutdown has worsened a longstanding U.S. air traffic controller shortage: controllers are expected to work without pay, some are calling out sick, and staffing has fallen by 50% in some areas. Training is lengthy and costly, and about a third of trainees leave the program. Controllers earn an average of $144,580 annually, but applicants must meet strict requirements, and fewer than 10% are accepted into training.

Hascall Steel Company provides steel products and processing services for industrial applications. Its inventory includes cold reduced, blanked, slit, flat-rolled, hot-rolled, aluminized and coated steel. The company processes steel to customer specifications, conducts quality testing in an in-house laboratory and says it has served customers for over 45 years.

The passage describes NVIDIA A100 features for HPC and AI. Its mixed-precision Tensor Cores accelerate iterative-refinement solvers; in 37 matrix tests, TF32 achieved a 2.0× geometric-mean speedup over an FP64 solver. A100’s 2:4 structured sparsity lets Sparse Tensor Cores skip zero values, doubling compute throughput while reducing weight storage and bandwidth.

A100 also provides 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, faster NVLink, and hardware support for asynchronous copies and barriers. CUDA 11 adds support for these features, along with task-graph acceleration and L2 cache residency controls. Multi-Instance GPU can divide one A100 into as many as seven isolated GPU Instances to run separate workloads. The eight-GPU DGX A100 combines these capabilities for AI and HPC workloads.

SanDisk’s one-year limited warranty applies only to the original purchaser and excludes third-party software, misuse, unauthorized repairs and other specified damage. For eligible claims, SanDisk may repair or replace the product or refund its purchase price; it disclaims responsibility for lost data and limits its liability.

The device uses Microsoft digital rights management, which may revoke its ability to obtain new licenses for protected content. The software license permits personal use on one device at a time and restricts modification, reverse engineering and redistribution. The software is provided without warranties, and the license may be terminated for violations. The product and software are not intended for uses where failure could threaten life or cause serious harm. The device should not be discarded with unsorted household waste.

Researchers created nanoscale synthetic packets that release their contents when exposed to a specific wavelength of light and reseal when the light is turned off. Their polymer layers include materials already used in medical products. The researchers envision targeted drug delivery and other applications, and are exploring packets that respond to different triggers.

A team from King Edward VI Grammar School in Louth finished second in the national schools University Challenge finals at the University of Lincoln. They beat St Ivo and Nottingham High School before losing to Southend High School for Boys, 315–280.

In a February 28, 2019 Form 8-K, Tesla announced a $35,000 Model 3 Standard and a $37,000 Standard Range Plus. It said it would move sales online, close many stores, lower vehicle prices by about 6% on average, expand service and offer firmware upgrades. Tesla did not expect a first-quarter profit but said second-quarter profitability was likely.
The judgment was reversed and a new trial ordered because no decision was issued and the trial court unduly restricted evidence supporting the plaintiff’s accounting claim.

A maternal and newborn health training program in Maharashtra used a training-of-trainers model to develop local trainers in Palghar district. Eight trainers from an earlier Pune pilot supported a six-step process: screening candidates, training and assessment, staggered induction, supervised teaching, expert quality checks, and virtual refresher sessions. The resulting 32 Palghar trainers trained 505 health providers over 18 months. Among 463 providers with complete assessments, post-training scores improved significantly for clinical knowledge, abdominal palpation, newborn resuscitation, and eclampsia management. Palghar trainers reported greater clinical competence, teaching confidence, and professional recognition. The authors recommend sustained support and opportunities for trainers, and call for evaluation of long-term competency, application in care, and costs.

Dark matter is supported by astrophysical evidence, but its nature remains unknown. Cold dark matter fits several observations, while unresolved problems and the absence of confirmed particle detections motivate alternative models. This review describes the ESCAPE Dark Matter Test Science Project’s open tools and workflows for comparing collider, direct-detection and indirect-detection constraints. It also discusses how gravitational lensing and dwarf spheroidal galaxies constrain dark matter, and calls for integrating astronomical analyses with particle-physics results.

T-Tamer is a model-agnostic framework for balancing objectives such as accuracy and latency in cascaded inference. It treats model routing and stopping as costly exploration over directed acyclic graphs. The passage shows that no-recall strategies cannot guarantee a constant-factor approximation to the offline optimum, while T-Tamer’s recall-based dynamic indexing policy is online-optimal and computable in polynomial time for directed lines, their transitive closures, and trees. Experiments on vision and NLP classification workloads report favorable accuracy–latency trade-offs.

The S&P 500 closed near record highs at 6,715, but tech weakness and valuations above pre-2000 levels raised questions about the rally’s sustainability. The index remained above 6,620 support as investors watched Fed policy and government shutdown headlines.

At a February 2017 town hall in Nevis, Minister Mark Brantley said the Team Unity government had strengthened cooperation between the federal government and the Nevis Island Administration. The coalition launched in 2013 and won the 2015 election. Brantley said Nevis had received $62.2 million from the Sugar Industry Diversification Foundation and $51.16 million in federal budgetary support in less than two years, compared with $17.3 million in support from 2006 to 2015. He described the funding as progress toward a fair share of national resources for both islands.

In September 1900, the United States and Russia agreed to arbitrate indemnity claims arising from Russian actions against four American vessels. The United States argued that the seizures violated international law and treaty rights, that some crews were wrongfully imprisoned, and that any awards should include interest. One claim concerned the whaling bark Cape Horn Pigeon, seized in the Sea of Okhotsk in 1892, taken to Vladivostok, held until the whaling season ended, and released without trial.

The speaker describes an older hockey player as hardworking, intelligent and helpful. He was a Russian elite who linked defense and offense and performed in major tournaments. The speaker says later generations lacked his influence.

USD/JPY fell 2.25% after weak US employment data, with a break below 146.45 potentially extending losses. Markets expect the Bank of England to cut rates to 4.0% on Thursday as UK economic momentum weakens; GBP/USD remains near May’s support. BTC/USD also declined on weaker US data, finding support around 112,000. Fed signals and upcoming policy announcements could influence all three markets.

The speaker says their team lost 2–1 despite sustained pressure and late chances to tie the game. They felt nervous at the start of their first finals game but settled down, and said the team would focus on one game at a time.

The Delhi High Court sought responses from the Centre and Jammu and Kashmir on whether the state’s High Court judges take an oath to uphold the Indian Constitution. It did not decide the merits of a petition challenging a 1954 constitutional order that requires a Presidential order before constitutional amendments apply to Jammu and Kashmir. The petitioner argues that the requirement encroaches on Parliament’s amendment powers. The court also said the petitioner should consider approaching the Jammu and Kashmir High Court.

Hundreds of advocates protested at Wells Fargo’s annual shareholder meeting in Des Moines, calling for its executives and board to resign over alleged discriminatory practices and investments in private prisons, guns, and fossil fuels. The protest followed a $1 billion penalty for mortgage practices. A report cited more than $4.6 billion in Wells Fargo financing for fossil fuel projects from 2015 to 2017.

Keeping a healthy weight, staying active, and strengthening and stretching the muscles around the knees can help reduce injury risk. Low-impact activities such as cycling and swimming support knee health while limiting impact. Persistent knee pain that restricts movement warrants assessment by a physiotherapist; tailored exercises can aid recovery and sometimes avoid surgery. Knee surgery may improve quality of life when rehabilitation alone is insufficient, but it carries risks. Recommended physiotherapy exercises can also support recovery after surgery.

The passage describes the ADS868xW’s SPI connections, daisy-chain operation, device states, programming, and application guidance. Daisy-chained devices share CONVST/CS and SCLK, pass data between devices, and use an optimal transfer frame of 32 clock edges per device. The device operates in RESET, acquisition, and conversion states; CONVST/CS controls transfers and conversions, while RVS can indicate when conversion is complete.

The multiSPI interface supports four standard SPI protocols, single- or dual-output data, and source-synchronous reads. Nine configuration registers control functions including reset, power, input range, alarms, and output data. An example eight-channel industrial input module combines the ADS8681W with a differential multiplexer. The passage also covers programmable alarm thresholds and hysteresis, NAP and power-down modes, supply decoupling, and PCB layout recommendations.

The UK Government has launched a six-week consultation on updating Package Travel Regulations for online bookings. It says the proposals could protect an additional 10 million package holidays by clarifying refund rights and making the business assembling a package responsible for the entire trip, including services provided by third parties. Consumer group Which? supports closing gaps in protection.

Japan’s economy grew at an annualised 4 percent in the second quarter, beating expectations and extending its expansion to 18 months. Household spending rose 3.7 percent, helped by durable-goods purchases. The data is volatile and subject to revision, while wage growth and inflation remain below the goals of Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic programme.

The disclosure describes absorbent cores for diapers, incontinence products, sanitary napkins and panty liners. Substantially interconnected channels distribute fluid across the core faster than surrounding absorbent material, with the aim of improving absorption, dryness and comfort. The channels may form a U-bend with diverging ends and remain visible after use. An acquisition and distribution layer can further aid fluid distribution. A proposed manufacturing process uses a vacuum mold with a three-dimensional insert to form channels substantially free of absorbent material.

A collection of November 2001 news reports says Enron widened its third-quarter loss to $664 million and warned that a credit downgrade could require it to repay or secure a $690 million note. A further downgrade could trigger billions in additional obligations, while declining asset values could reduce fourth-quarter earnings. Bankers questioned whether Dynegy’s planned acquisition would proceed, and a congressman requested an investigation of auditor Arthur Andersen.
Amber Rose says she is relieved she had breast reduction surgery in January, going from a 36H to a 36DDD after pain and difficulty exercising. She also had cellulite treatment.

Fourth of July fireworks may worsen air quality across parts of Southern California through Thursday, according to the South Coast Air Quality Management District. Sensitive groups should limit outdoor exertion. A heat wave expected later in the week may further worsen air quality by increasing ozone levels.

The writer argues that Ohio’s district boundaries favor parties and reduce representatives’ accountability. She urges support for the Fair Districts Fair Elections plan, which would use a bipartisan commission to draw districts and keep communities together.

The author argues that the U.S. immigration debate needs more honesty, not more proposed solutions. Their plan calls for keeping refugee families together for hearings, expanding legal immigration to meet labor needs, applying asylum laws equally, and using technology rather than a wall to secure the border. It would continue deportations while allowing discretion, offer earned legal status to some longtime undocumented immigrants and DACA recipients, and strengthen employer verification and penalties. The author also proposes investing in job creation in Mexican states that send immigrants to the U.S.

Residential development has resumed along New Jersey’s Gold Coast after the 2008 real estate downturn, driven by demand for homes near the waterfront and transit to New York City. In Jersey City, projects include Toll Brothers’ 242-unit condominium building at 10 Provost Street and Ironstate’s luxury rental buildings at 235 Grand and Columbus. In Hoboken, Toll Brothers plans a building at 1425 Hudson Street, while Bijou Properties and Intercontinental Real Estate are building 424 rental units, a public gym and a park at 700 Jackson Street. JMF Properties plans residences, shops and commercial space at Bayonne’s former military terminal.

Facing a $4 million funding shortfall, the 22nd District Agricultural Association board unanimously rejected bids for the Surfside Race Place remodel and a required storm-water treatment plant. The plant’s lowest bid was $14.6 million, above its $10.5 million estimate. Higher construction costs also reduced the remodel’s projected return on investment to about 3 percent. Directors will re-evaluate the proposed multipurpose venue while prioritizing the storm-water project. The district must decide by June 27 whether to sign documents for an approved $18.5 million loan.

The passage identifies information technology, energy, utilities, and materials as the worst sectors to invest in based on measures from a JP Morgan study of Russell 3000 stocks from 1980 to 2015. Telecom, information technology, and energy had the most catastrophic losses, while utilities had the fewest but weak long-term excess returns. Overall, 40% of stocks suffered catastrophic losses, and a minority of strong performers drove positive index returns.

The Affordable Care Act’s shortened sign-up season ends Dec. 15 for consumers in 39 states using HealthCare.gov, with a last-minute surge expected to test the website and call center. The deadline is midnight Pacific time, though hurricane-affected residents can seek an extension through Dec. 31, and many states with their own exchanges have later deadlines. Despite higher listed premiums, increased subsidies may lower costs for some consumers. It remains unclear whether the Trump administration will grant extensions to people unable to finish applications by the deadline.

The passage develops a statistical method for inferring a distribution of physical parameters from repeated observations of a computer model’s outputs. Because different parameters can produce the same output, observations alone do not determine a unique distribution; a prior specifies how probability is assigned among those parameters. Using disintegration of measures, the paper establishes conditions for a unique prior-conditioned solution and an explicit density formula. It also states that the density is almost everywhere continuous, that the uniform-prior solution has maximum entropy under specified conditions, and that a sampling-based numerical estimator is asymptotically unbiased and strongly consistent. The resulting distribution can be used to assess parameter combinations and forecast other model outputs.

The passage describes published AMD AGESA interfaces for processor initialization, memory setup, late-boot configuration, suspend, and resume. It warns that unpublished internal procedures may change or disappear. It specifies execution-cache allocation rules, platform and device configuration parameters, required host functions for memory buffers, resets, SPD reads, and processor tasks, and optional functions for platform-specific adjustments. It also describes four customization mechanisms and build options that remove unused code or set motherboard-specific values. Many procedures require a stack and must run at particular points in the boot sequence.

Colorado State beat Wyoming 78-73 in the 226th Border War and, after Boise State lost to New Mexico, took sole possession of first place in the Mountain West. The win ended CSU’s four-game losing streak against Wyoming. Prentiss Nixon scored seven late points to secure the victory, while Emmanuel Omogbo had 19 points and 16 rebounds. Despite foul trouble and shooting 21-for-34 on free throws, the Rams won their fourth straight game. They play New Mexico next Tuesday.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) lets customers apply AMD firmware updates at runtime, but patches do not persist across reboots and must be reapplied. The AMD Security Processor (ASP) verifies AMD signatures; customers can opt in to SFS and require an additional OEM/ODM signature by supplying a public key during early boot. Updates must match the system’s firmware and patch levels, and multiple packages must be applied sequentially. Before executing a patch, the ASP protects its memory region and validates the required signatures. SFS can change values, firmware images, or parts of firmware packages. SEV updates prevent rollback without a reboot, while SNP-enabled systems require specified update pages to be HV-FIXED.

Bitcoin’s price rose sharply in 2017, alongside growing trading activity in India. Indian technology pioneer Vijay Mukhi claimed that tax evaders may be using Bitcoin to conceal unaccounted money, linking the rise to demonetization and the Panama and Paradise Papers disclosures. He urged the government not to ban cryptocurrency but to act against such flows. Zebpay co-founder Sandip Goenka said the exchange follows identification requirements and attributed rising prices to limited supply and growing demand. The passage describes Bitcoin as a speculative, unregulated investment and advises investors to understand its technology and risks.

Isaiah Silva, Courtney Love’s former son-in-law, is suing Love and others, alleging they conspired to kill him to recover Kurt Cobain’s guitar. Silva kept the guitar under his divorce settlement with Frances Bean Cobain. His complaint alleges that three men entered his home in June 2016 and tried to reach him. Love has not filed a response.

The Broncos snapped a two-game losing streak with a 28-3 win over the Bengals, led by a strong defensive performance and Bo Nix’s season-high 326 passing yards. Denver also had its first 100-yard rusher in 37 regular-season games. Without injured Joe Burrow, Cincinnati struggled offensively and suffered its second straight lopsided loss.

The Education and Training Inspectorate found that some Northern Ireland schools inappropriately excluded pupils from published exam results, improving their reported performance and league-table positions. In 2015–16, schools ruled about 2,900 pupils ineligible, a number the inspectorate said was too high. It also identified examples of good practice in helping pupils choose exams.

Pfizer CEO Albert Bourla joined President Trump to announce a drug pricing deal aimed at lowering prescription prices. Their relationship, formed during Pfizer’s Covid vaccine development, helped ease investor concerns and gave the industry a favorable moment at the White House.

In a study of older adults averaging 75 years old, participants completed walking and cognitive tasks and reported their mood and energy levels. Those reporting greater cognitive fatigue walked more slowly and took shorter strides later in a follow-up walking test; no gait change appeared in the first 30 seconds. Reported physical fatigue was not associated with gait changes. Researchers said further study is needed.

CBSE released the JEE Main 2017 answer keys and Paper 1 recorded responses on jeemain.nic.in. The keys for online and offline exams were available from April 18 to 22. Candidates could download their responses, check their marks and challenge the keys through the website.

WWE signed five-year linear TV deals keeping “Raw” on USA Network and moving “Smackdown Live” to Fox. The company remains open to distributing its flagship shows on digital platforms in the future, which could help it reach younger viewers, attract sponsors and drive traffic to its other digital properties and subscription service.

MBIA shares fell 2.43% in the latest session, closing at $8.85. The passage reports an average brokerage recommendation of 3 and an industry rank of 208 out of 265. Analyst ratings include one Buy, one Outperform and two Holds. MBIA’s 14-period ATR was 0.43, its RSI was 45.15, and weekly and monthly volatility were 3.59% and 4.49%. Trading volume was 3.04 million shares, above the 1.7 million average.

A federal judge dismissed Spencer Elden’s lawsuit over Nirvana’s 1991 album cover, which shows him naked underwater as a baby. The judge ruled that the image was not child pornography, finding that his nudity alone did not make it sexually suggestive.

The passage examines reducing battery drain in HF-band RFID and NFC by adjusting a reader’s magnetic field to the power a passive transponder needs. Its PTF-Determinator estimates the power-transfer relationship during card detection, then scales the field. In a digital-business-card case study, transmission energy fell by up to 80% in simulation and 26% on existing hardware. Cutting off power beyond a set distance saved up to 75% in measurements but disconnected the transponder. Dynamic adjustment during communication and support for multiple transponders remain subjects for future testing.

The World Bank raised its 2025 China growth forecast from 4.5% to 4.8%, citing government stimulus, stronger investment and industrial output, and a modest export recovery. It expects growth to slow in 2026 as fiscal constraints and global pressures weigh on demand. Property-sector weakness, local government debt, demographic pressures and declining productivity remain longer-term challenges.

The speaker says captaining Edmonton was an honor and praises Rod’s leadership and the team’s shared belief. He is excited, though nervous, to return to Edmonton after eight and a half years there. He also praises the team’s young players and expects a loud, physical final between two confident teams. Rather than name a favorite, he says his team believes it can win by playing its own game.

The U.S. Department of Energy awarded the University of Wyoming nearly $10 million to study whether 50 million tons of carbon dioxide from coal-burning plants can be stored underground north of Gillette. Emissions regulations and demand for cleaner energy threaten Wyoming’s coal industry.

The speaker says the team should focus on one period and one game at a time rather than the larger picture. After a long stretch of hockey, they hope to clear their minds by reading and spending time with family. Despite playoff adversity, they aim to stay levelheaded and play their best in the next home game.

The passage first argues that liberal idealism does not require apologizing to the Third World, supporting opponents of the United States, or renouncing military force. An editorial note then describes Ronald Reagan’s November 1979 presidential candidacy announcement. Reagan rejected claims that the United States was in inevitable decline, blamed its difficulties on failed leadership, and called for new goals. On foreign policy, he urged continued support for allies, negotiations with the Soviet Union that served the national interest, resistance to aggression, and continued American leadership.

Singapore’s Smart Nation vision aims to improve daily life through technology and help citizens solve problems using available information. Initiatives include sensor networks, digital identity plans, support for start-ups and technology training for older people. The passage argues that these efforts have yet to produce a widely felt success story. It points to Estonia’s digital identity system and Beijing’s widespread cashless payments as examples of everyday use. To encourage adoption in Singapore, the author suggests enrolling bank customers in PayNow by default while allowing them to opt out.

A Trump administration report calls for increasing breastfeeding through WIC, other policies and access to donor human milk, but does not mention federal paid parental leave. Although 84 percent of U.S. parents who give birth begin breastfeeding, 60 percent of those who start say they stop earlier than planned. Experts say paid leave, better postpartum and insurance support, medical training, and enforcement of workplace protections could help parents continue breastfeeding. They also urge attention to racial and economic disparities and warn that proposed cuts to food and health programs could undermine support for families.

Former Finnish Foreign Minister Erkko told U.S. Minister Schoenfeld that most Finns favored leaving the war, but that Finland needed a favorable moment, assurance against Russian entry, and reliable overseas supplies. He also reported growing friction between Finnish and German troops. The U.S. Secretary of State instructed Schoenfeld to question Finland about German forces’ use of its territory; an internal memorandum said the démarche would also warn Finland of risks from its association with Germany. When Finance Minister Pekkala asked about U.S.–Finnish relations, Schoenfeld said Finland’s position needed prompt clarification.

President Trump announced a deal under which Pfizer will offer Medicaid drug prices similar to those in other countries and sell some medicines directly to consumers at discounts. Pfizer also agreed to launch new drugs at prices comparable to those abroad. In exchange, it will receive a three-year exemption from certain tariffs if it follows through on a $70 billion U.S. investment announcement. Many agreement details remain confidential, and its effect on most patients is uncertain. Trump said more drugmaker deals are forthcoming.

The writer plans to speak at Otago schools about mental health, drawing on personal experience with depression rather than professional qualifications. They hope that speaking openly will encourage young people to seek help, reduce stigma and address New Zealand’s youth suicide statistics. The passage urges others to share their experiences and directs anyone needing support to a GP, mental health provider or helpline; it advises calling 111 if someone is in danger.

A study evaluated a brief, personalized sleep-education module in a chronic disease self-management app for adults aged 40 or older with chronic conditions and low health literacy. Of 286 participants, 195 had scores suggesting insomnia and were included in the reported analysis. Their self-reported sleep quality improved modestly over the study and three-month follow-up. Socioeconomic status, health literacy, and number of health conditions were also associated with sleep quality. The authors note that other app modules may have influenced responses, sleep was measured only by self-report, and the sample limits generalizability.

The speaker praises a player’s puck handling and physical play, and says the goalie has proved he can handle pressure and win. Repeating as champions is a driving goal, strengthened by Hossa’s determination. In Pittsburgh’s loud arena, the team expects a tough game and must be patient, disciplined and careful with the puck. The speaker says momentum comes from plays during a game, not previous results, and praises a two-way leader’s ability to play against Crosby.

Severe storms are moving through the Houston area Monday morning, bringing damaging winds, quarter-size hail, heavy rain and possible isolated tornadoes. The worst weather is expected to move east of Houston by 9 a.m.

The 4-2-5 defense combines elements of the 4-3 and 3-3-5, using four linemen, two linebackers and five defensive backs. Its six-man box supports run defense, while the extra defensive back provides coverage against spread formations. It relies on athletic players, particularly a hybrid Sam linebacker who can cover, defend the run and rush the passer.

The alignment supports varied coverages and pressure packages, including six-man Cover 0 blitzes, Cover 4 and Cover 3 Sky. Its weaknesses include an unbalanced alignment that offenses can attack away from the Sam and smaller personnel that may struggle against larger running attacks. The passage highlights Gary Patterson’s successful use of the defense at TCU and Greg Etter’s pressure-oriented defenses at Carthage College.

Adoree’ Jackson said the Titans had never practiced the final pass play directed at him, but coach Mike Mularkey said they had practiced it, just not the previous week. The article questions using a rookie cornerback with no career receptions on a crucial fourth down when the team had other pass-catching options.

The lecture examines pleat folding and the three-dimensional forms created by alternating mountain and valley creases. A simulation models how paper’s tendency to stay flat or bent produces these forms and supports sculptural designs. The professor explains why a concentric-square “hyperbolic paraboloid” cannot fold properly with only its original creases, while a triangulated version can be constructed and verified computationally. The lecture also discusses curved creases, open questions about inflated paper forms, and efforts to recreate David Huffman’s origami designs.

Max Correa, an Appalachian State freshman with no ties to Kansas, is running for governor of the state, which has no minimum age requirement for the office. His campaign aims to appeal to younger voters. Correa proposes communal settlements to help students pay tuition and making Narcan more affordable and available by offering state-owned property to pharmaceutical companies. If elected, he says he would move to Topeka and study part-time at the University of Kansas.

Napheesa Collier criticized WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert over officiating, player pay and league leadership, and alleged Engelbert made dismissive comments about young stars. Engelbert disputed Collier’s characterization of their conversations. The remarks come amid collective bargaining negotiations, following Collier’s injury and the Lynx’s playoff elimination.

Daniel Jones, a British expatriate arrested after a Siem Reap pool party, received a one-year suspended sentence for using photos deemed pornographic to promote the event. He denied that sex or nudity occurred and apologised for causing offence. Having spent one month and 22 days on remand, he may appeal; his immediate release was unclear.

To mark its 50th anniversary, Algoma Public Health partnered with Healthy Kids Community Challenge Sault Ste. Marie on Get Active Algoma, a GooseChase contest encouraging family and community activities away from screens. Missions run through May 31, 2018, with prizes including a $600 bike voucher.

The passage describes Blackwell graphics features and GPUs. Stochastic Texture Filtering reduces sampling artifacts and can provide higher-order filtering with one point sample. Neural Radiance Cache uses real-time neural inference to improve indirect lighting without fully tracing every ray. RTX Skin brings subsurface scattering to real-time path tracing, while RTX Neural Faces uses generative AI to produce more natural-looking faces.

It lists full-chip specifications for the GB202, GB203 and GB205 GPUs, associated with the GeForce RTX 5090, RTX 5080 and 5070 Ti, and RTX 5070, respectively. NVIDIA states that specifications may change, disclaims warranties and limits liability, and places responsibility for suitability and testing on customers.

Launched by CME Group in 2019, Micro E-mini futures are one-tenth the size of corresponding E-mini contracts, with lower margin requirements intended to make futures more accessible to traders with smaller accounts. They trade on CME Globex and cover indexes and other assets. Traders use them for speculation, diversification, or hedging; price drivers and seasonality depend on the underlying asset. The passage describes an overnight strategy backtest using the older Nasdaq 100 E-mini because Micro E-mini history is shorter, but does not disclose the strategy’s rules. It also warns that leverage can magnify losses from adverse price movements.

Retired lawyer Marcel Strigberger recounts recycling his decades-old law schoolbooks while decluttering. The books prompted memories of cases and property-law concepts, but he decided he no longer needed them. He kept one thick volume to use as a stand at his desk.
