Kay Frazier, 50, died two days after an artery ruptured during surgery to remove a large clot blocking blood flow to her brain, an inquest heard. The clot’s cause is unknown. Frazier had married American prisoner Gary Frazier after exchanging thousands of letters with him. The coroner has not returned a verdict.

Van Buren forwards correspondence about Alexander McLeod’s detention in New York over the 1837 destruction of the steamboat *Caroline*. British minister Henry Fox regrets the President’s refusal to seek McLeod’s release, warns of serious consequences if he is harmed, and calls the destruction an act of self-defense. Secretary of State John Forsyth replies that the United States has presented Britain with evidence and demanded redress, and declines to debate the incident further.

An international team tested quantum correlations in a superconducting processor with up to 73 qubits. A 73-qubit state had energy measurements far below the classical limit, while states of up to 24 qubits passed a stricter test requiring all qubits to participate in the correlations. The results demonstrate a way to verify quantum behavior in large systems and could inform quantum communication and algorithms.

Assuming the presidency amid business depression, the speaker calls for adequate revenue, restrained spending, a protective tariff and careful review of currency laws. He pledges to maintain the value of silver at par with gold while seeking international bimetallism. He also urges the enforcement of laws, continued civil-service reform, improvements to immigration and education, and revival of the merchant marine. In foreign affairs, he favors peace, non-interference and arbitration, including a pending treaty with Great Britain. Citing the Treasury’s condition, he announces an extraordinary session of Congress for March 15, 1897, and closes by appealing for national unity.

The goalie says opponents deliberately fell on him and pushed teammates onto him, creating danger. He wants his teammates to be more aggressive in front of Eddie without retaliating, and says referees should penalize deliberate contact. He expects the same tactics in coming games. He feels comfortable playing the puck at home in Buffalo, where the bounces are more predictable than in Dallas. He says his groin is fine and the team must be smart about its aggression.

Advanced attacking runs use observation and planning to create opportunities several passes ahead. Individual runs exploit defenders’ positioning and attention through blind-side, inverted, overlapping, third-attacker and late runs. Planned runs include routes for set plays, receiving crosses and fast breaks after a change of possession. Supporting runs offer back-pass and square-pass options or help switch play to the other side of the field. Effective runs depend on well-timed passes, awareness of offside positions and varied movement that defenders cannot easily anticipate. Players are encouraged to complete their runs even though only one can receive the ball, and to study opponents’ defensive tendencies.

A single-institution study interviewed 21 medical students about 34 mistreatment incidents; 12 incidents were reported. Students’ decisions reflected personal, situational, reporting-system, and institutional-climate factors. Fear of repercussions, uncertainty about what counted as mistreatment, bystander inaction, unclear reporting procedures, and expectations that reports would have little effect discouraged reporting. A sense of justice and clearly severe incidents could motivate it. The authors recommend clearer, more trustworthy reporting systems, bystander training, and changes to institutional culture, while noting that the volunteer sample limits generalizability.

A research paper argues that the Eldgjá eruption of 939–940 CE may have encouraged Iceland’s conversion to Christianity. The eruption produced a vast lava flood, and its ash reduced sunlight, lowered temperatures and hindered agriculture. Researchers suggest that descriptions of fire and darkened skies in the tenth-century poem Völuspá reflect memories of the eruption and portray the pagan gods as doomed. They also note that a later account of Iceland’s conversion, officially dated to 999/1000 CE, links the debate to volcanic activity.

Honor launched the Honor 9i in India on October 5 for Rs. 17,999. The phone has a 5.99-inch FullView display, dual front and rear cameras, a Kirin 659 processor, 4GB RAM, 64GB storage and a 3,340mAh battery. In a brief hands-on review, its cameras performed well under bright indoor lighting and apps loaded quickly, but the reviewer said further testing was needed.

The passage argues that the United States should retain its coal lands and lease them to private operators under a royalty system, with oversight of consumer prices and transportation rates. It describes recent federal laws regulating railroads, food, and meatpacking as advances, while recommending time to assess their effects before expanding them. It also calls for stronger national oversight of interstate corporations, including greater disclosure and limits on overcapitalization. The passage argues that regulating abuses, rather than opposing consolidation itself, would protect the public, preserve individual initiative, and reduce demands for government ownership or socialism.

Energy Central’s January 24, 2002 newsletter covers electric power and gas news, including investigations into Enron and Arthur Andersen, utility rates, energy policy, power projects, financial results and international markets.

The October 19, 2000 Haas alumni jobs bulletin lists openings at 14 employers, including Kaiser Permanente, the University of Michigan, the United Nations Foundation, Micron, Informatica, PG&E and Fremont Group. Roles span business analysis, finance, fundraising, marketing, strategy, research and sales. Expanded postings provide responsibilities, qualifications and application details. The bulletin also invites alumni to submit job openings and cautions that Haas has not researched the listed companies or search firms.

Delta expects premium-seat sales to surpass main-cabin sales in 2026, a year earlier than previously forecast. In the quarter ended Sept. 30, premium revenue rose 9% to nearly $5.8 billion, while main-cabin sales fell 4% to about $6 billion. Corporate travel revenue rose 8%. Delta reported adjusted revenue of $15.2 billion and earnings per share of $1.71, both above forecasts, and projected full-year adjusted earnings per share of about $6.

The speaker says Darren protected Nick without harming Rod Brind’Amour. Drawing on Hartford’s hockey history and the Stars’ reception in Dallas, he hopes fans will embrace the team here. He also considers a physical, defensively strong line that can score important to team success.

Michelle Bishop’s research asks Indigenous community members connected to D’harawal Country in south-west Sydney to envision education grounded in Indigenous knowledges rather than reforming colonial-controlled schooling. Thirty-five people completed an anonymous survey, and more than 15 took part in face-to-face yarns. Bishop uses story to bring their perspectives together while protecting participants who wished to remain anonymous. The resulting story, “Our Education, Our Way,” contrasts harms experienced in schools with a vision of Aboriginal-controlled education centred on Country, Elders, storytelling, culture, relationships, belonging and young people’s futures.

Crystal Palace came back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at home with Leicester City. Robert Huth and Jamie Vardy scored for Leicester before Yohan Cabaye and Christian Benteke equalised. Palace remained above the relegation zone on 35 points from 32 games, two points behind Leicester.

The passage calls for a special congressional appropriation to strengthen enforcement of the antitrust law. It argues that tariff cuts would not effectively regulate trusts and could harm their weaker domestic competitors. Instead, it favors direct regulation and a stable protective tariff, with carefully considered adjustments that preserve American wages and business interests. It proposes reciprocity treaties or legislation to expand markets and lower duties where appropriate, with expert review of tariff schedules before changes are made.

Printed Circuit Broker Elmatica has established a temporary South African department following increased business and demand for technical support. Sales rose 245 percent compared with 2016, and the company plans a permanent team.

The speaker expects a close, emotional game between similarly styled teams. They say their team must correct earlier errors and lapses in intensity, build on the chances created in the final seven minutes, and avoid retreating into a defensive shell.

The passage describes a trend-following strategy that buys the S&P 500 when its price crosses above the 200-day moving average and sells when it crosses below. It uses price alone and, in the passage’s backtest, largely avoided the 2008–09 downturn. A monthly version using a ten-month moving average returned 6.3% annually since 1960, versus 7% for buy-and-hold, excluding dividends.

Construction crews on the $1.8 billion Las Vegas stadium have exceeded hiring and subcontracting goals. Minorities, women and military veterans performed 54 percent of work hours, above the 38 percent goal. Qualified small businesses received $91 million in subcontracts, surpassing the 15 percent goal. About 225 workers have been hired, with 500 expected by fall. The 65,000-seat stadium remains on schedule for completion in summer 2020.

The authors examine how English as a Second Language, World Language, and Bilingual Education developed as distinct U.S. fields with differing goals and assumptions about learners. Using Valdés’ framework of language curricularization, they describe revisions to teacher education courses that emphasize translanguaging, multilingual instruction, and attention to learners’ linguistic backgrounds. A planned third phase would prepare World Language and Bilingual Education candidates to critically analyze bilingual programs and address inequities. The authors identify institutional constraints and collaboration as factors shaping this work. They advocate historically informed, culturally and linguistically responsive teacher education across disciplinary boundaries, rather than a single curriculum for all language teachers.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2015 reports revenue of $21.7 billion, up from $20.4 billion a year earlier, while net income fell to $5.0 billion from $5.7 billion. Nine-month revenue rose to $71.4 billion, but net income declined to $15.4 billion. The company reported $95.4 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments at March 31. It recorded $1.3 billion in nine-month restructuring charges under a plan to eliminate up to 18,000 positions, and acquired Minecraft developer Mojang for $2.5 billion.

Motley Fool Money highlights the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and a 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It also lists cell phone protection and recommends good-to-excellent credit, while noting approval is not guaranteed. The passage compares offers from Capital One and Citi and discloses that Motley Fool Money receives advertising compensation, which it says does not influence its product ratings.

The passage compares investing a lump sum immediately with dollar-cost averaging, which spreads purchases over time. It argues that lump-sum investing generally performs better, while gradual investing may reduce fear and discourage attempts to time the market. In an S&P 500 backtest from 2000 through 2019, lump-sum investing returned 6.02% annually versus 5.5% for dollar-cost averaging. Reversing the order of the period’s returns left lump-sum results nearly unchanged but reduced dollar-cost averaging’s annual return to 1.9%, illustrating its sensitivity to the sequence of returns.

The professor introduces a course on coding for communication over additive white Gaussian noise channels. The course examines major code classes and decoding methods, with the goal of approaching channel capacity. Weekly problem sets are intended for practice, while a midterm and final account for most of the grade.

Using deep-space and telephone channels as examples, the lecture defines signal-to-noise ratio and presents Shannon’s capacity formula: bandwidth times log₂(1 + SNR). Coding constrains long sequences to reduce errors, though Shannon’s existence proof does not provide a practical method. The lecture also outlines how pulse amplitude modulation converts a continuous-time channel into a discrete-time model and defines spectral efficiency as bits per second per Hertz.

The passage describes how AGESA integrates with a host environment for binary and UEFI builds. Binary builds route core call-outs through a host-implemented function, while UEFI initialization spans SEC, PEI, DXE, and run-time phases. It outlines build files and configuration options, required stack and Cache-as-RAM procedures, and initialization steps for processors, memory, graphics, and system information tables. It also describes service functions for structure allocation, hardware information, MMIO mapping, and event logs, along with procedures for suspend and resume. The host environment must provide required call-outs for memory allocation, deallocation, and system resets.

The passage presents nine Vanguard ETFs covering U.S. and international stocks, real estate, and bonds as options for a diversified passive portfolio. A buy-and-hold backtest of a portfolio using these ETFs, rebalanced annually from 2007 to 2023, grew $10,000 to $19,318 but returned less than the S&P 500 Total Return index, partly because of its bond allocations. The passage advises investors to read each fund’s prospectus to assess whether it fits their goals.

Weber State University canceled its Unity Conference, themed around censorship, after organizers told presenters to remove references to DEI, diversity, equity and inclusion from their slides. Faculty members withdrew rather than alter their presentations. University officials said the event’s sponsor, the Student Access and Success division, was subject to Utah’s HB 261 restrictions on nonacademic programming; academically sponsored events are exempt. Leaders acknowledged that the requirements could have been communicated earlier and said they are considering moving future conferences under Academic Affairs or a college.

Eilish McCready founded Fearless, a Glasgow theatre school offering small, inclusive drama classes without the pressure of end-of-year performances. She aims to help children, including shy children and those with additional needs, build confidence and social skills. Parents say the classes have helped two boys with autism and a girl who was previously reluctant to speak in front of others.

Evercore will release its second-quarter 2018 financial results on July 25 and host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Executives will review the results and take questions. A live webcast and 30-day archive will be available on Evercore’s website.

The speaker reports continued prosperity and progress in carrying out legislation. Measures aim to preserve peace with Indian nations while protecting settlers and treaty rights. A new Creek treaty confirmed existing commitments, though a proposed land purchase failed. The United States has taken possession of several posts evacuated by Britain, while treaty commissions and implementation of the Spanish boundary agreement remain underway. American prisoners in Algiers have been freed.

The speaker urges the gradual creation of a navy, limited public manufacture of essential military supplies, support for agriculture, and the establishment of a national university and military academy. He also calls for a review of federal officers’ compensation, stronger militia and harbor defenses, and faster repayment of the public debt. Revenues are improving, but French actions are injuring American trade in the West Indies. He seeks friendly relations with France while upholding the nation’s rights and honor. Addressing Congress for the last time, he praises the success of the government and wishes for its preservation.

An April 23, 2001 news roundup covers PG&E’s utility bankruptcy after California power costs surged, a proposed coal-fired plant in Colorado, and planned U.S.–Saudi oil talks. Several reports focus on Enron’s Dabhol power project in India: unpaid bills prompted meetings with lenders and possible discussion of terminating its agreement with Maharashtra’s electricity board. Other items cover an Indian power project’s proposed capacity reduction, ONGC’s dispute of Enron’s gas-reserve claims, questions about Karnataka’s electricity supply, and proposed changes to Spain’s electricity market.

A study found that online images, videos and text portray women as younger than men, especially in prestigious jobs. People exposed to occupational images shifted their estimates of workers’ ages. ChatGPT likewise generated younger, less experienced resumes for women than for men, then scored those resumes lower. The researchers argue that addressing biases separately can miss their combined effects.

Michael Gayed’s strategy rotates weekly between SPY and the utilities ETF XLU based on their past performance. Utilities tend to outperform when interest rates fall and underperform when rates are expected to rise. Although Gayed reported strong long-term returns, a backtest from 1999 found that the strategy lagged the market overall. It outperformed buy-and-hold before the paper’s 2014 publication but has lagged by more than five percentage points annually since. The passage says it may be too soon to conclude that the strategy has stopped working.

The collection of October 2001 news reports focuses on Enron’s falling share price and concerns about transactions involving partnerships formerly run by CFO Andrew Fastow. After Enron disclosed an SEC inquiry, CEO Kenneth Lay defended Fastow and said the company had sufficient liquidity, but analysts questioned its financial disclosures. Enron said it expected asset sales to cover about $3.3 billion in notes coming due, though it might issue stock if proceeds fell short. Other items mention an Enron shareholder investigation, proposed tax refunds, and energy assets in India.

Winter offshore fishing targets sailfish, dolphin, wahoo and kingfish, with live bait recommended. Sailfish are found around 160-foot depths and kingfish around 90 feet. Inshore, jacks and tarpon gather near beaches and the ICW, while sheepshead bite shrimp or clams in the channel.

Researchers are exploring grape pomace, a wine-industry waste that can pollute water and soil, as a source of antioxidants, oils and dietary fiber for commercial products. They are developing methods to extract useful compounds while removing pesticides. In tests, pomace-derived phenolic compounds slowed oxidation and extended the shelf life of fatty foods. The team is also investigating uses in dietary supplements, cosmetics and animal feed.

Game is selling a 500GB Xbox One S bundle with Forza Horizon 3, Tekken 7, Halo 5 and Gears of War 4 for £249.99. The passage says this is £47.11 less than the items’ combined Amazon UK prices. It also praises the console’s 4K upscaling and UHD Blu-ray playback.

This study ran at 153 locations in six countries from April 2020 to February 2023. It tested initial doses and boosters of BNT162b1, BNT162b2, and BNT162b2SA, with placebo comparisons. In Phase 2/3, BNT162b2 was 95% effective against COVID-19 from seven days after the second dose through the December 2020 monitoring period. Reported antibody responses after BNT162b2 and BNT162b2SA doses met the comparisons described in the study.

Most reported injection-site reactions and systemic events were mild or moderate and short-lived. Serious medical problems were uncommon; researchers considered some possibly related to BNT162b2. No one died in Phase 1. Deaths in Phase 2/3 occurred from different causes and were not considered caused by BNT162b2.

The Rams are seeking permission to interview Jaguars interim coach Doug Marrone for their head coaching vacancy. Marrone went 1-1 after replacing Gus Bradley, and the Jaguars may also consider making him their permanent coach.

Cassini completed the first of five close passes over Saturn’s clouds before its planned final descent on September 15. The passes could provide data on Saturn’s atmosphere, auroras, composition and day length. Low fuel and concern that Cassini might otherwise crash into Titan or Enceladus prompted the decision to end its 20-year mission at Saturn.

Plasma diagnostics infer properties such as density, temperature, velocity, and magnetic field from a plasma’s effects on measurable signals. Historical examples involving ZETA, tokamaks, and the National Ignition Facility show why adequate diagnostics matter for interpreting experiments and advancing fusion research. Measurements can be limited by sparse spatial or temporal coverage, line integration, instrument response, and uncertain physical models. Understanding these limitations helps experimentalists assess uncertainty, computational researchers validate simulations, and theorists formulate testable predictions. The course focuses on enduring measurement principles rather than particular instruments and surveys diagnostics used across plasmas with widely varying temperatures, densities, and magnetic fields.

Amazon reported first-quarter 2015 net sales of $22.7 billion, up 15% from a year earlier, and operating income of $255 million, up from $146 million. It recorded a $57 million net loss, compared with $108 million in net income in first-quarter 2014. North America sales rose 24% to $13.4 billion, AWS sales rose 49% to $1.6 billion, and International sales fell 2% to $7.7 billion, primarily because of unfavorable exchange rates. Operating activities used $1.5 billion in cash during the quarter, compared with $2.5 billion a year earlier. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $13.8 billion at March 31, 2015. The filing also discusses acquisitions, contractual commitments, and ongoing legal and tax disputes.

As Tesla ramped up production of its mass-market Model 3 in 2017–18, delays and accelerating cash burn raised questions about whether it needed more capital. Tesla had repeatedly funded expansion through stock and debt offerings while struggling to turn a profit or generate positive operating cash flow. Its long-term debt had grown substantially, partly through the SolarCity acquisition. Analysts questioned whether investors would fund another raise, but CEO Elon Musk said Tesla would not need an equity or debt offering in 2018 apart from standard credit lines.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture introduces GDDR6 memory, larger caches and improved compression, delivering approximately 50% more effective bandwidth than Pascal in the comparison cited. It adds support for 8K displays, updated video encoding and decoding, and single-connector VR connectivity through VirtualLink. NVLink increases bandwidth between GPUs used for SLI.

Turing combines rasterization with real-time ray tracing, using RT Cores to accelerate ray intersection tests and denoising to reduce the rays needed. Its Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement. Mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading and multi-view rendering provide additional ways to manage rendering work. The passage also describes TU104 and TU106 GPUs, an RTX-OPS workload metric, and limitations and disclaimers governing NVIDIA’s specifications.

The passage describes surgical systems that connect instruments, imaging and robotic systems through modular hubs and cloud-based networks. Its principal method controls an ultrasonic device by measuring transducer impedance, comparing it with a stored reference, and using the result to characterize the end effector’s state or function, or tissue in contact with it. A control circuit then adjusts transducer power. The passage also describes interchangeable generator, smoke-evacuation, suction, irrigation, and imaging modules.

Hurricane Harvey may have damaged up to a dozen wildlife habitats along the Texas Gulf Coast, eroding marshes and nesting sites. Agencies are still assessing the damage. An endangered prairie chicken refuge saw heavy losses, and oyster beds were damaged. A National Wildlife Federation scientist said climate change may be increasing storm intensity.

The study uses Seoul metropolitan smart card data to identify transit-mode hierarchies from passenger transfers. It classifies transfers before and after the midpoint of a trip as ascending and descending, then calculates each mode’s relative hierarchical position. The analysis covers 10,264,700 trip chains from November 12, 2019. Within Seoul, the hierarchy was consistent across both phases: walking, community bus, urban bus, light rail, and metro. For trips between Seoul and Gyeonggi or Incheon, intercity bus ranked highest. The positions of metro, intercity bus, and urban bus varied by region.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Tuesday as the 10-year Treasury yield touched three per cent and investors weighed company-specific concerns. Canada’s S&P/TSX fell less steeply, supported by gold and materials shares. Barrick Gold rose more than three per cent after better-than-expected earnings.

This study used Unpaywall and Shareyourpaper to assess open access and self-archiving permissions for 1,897 clinical trial results publications from German university medical centers, published between 2010 and 2020. It found that 54% were openly accessible and 46% were closed-access. Of the 871 closed-access publications, 736 (85%) had permission to archive an accepted or published version in an institutional repository, usually after a 12-month embargo. Only 16% of publications estimated to have a self-archiving option were accessible solely through a repository. The authors conclude that self-archiving could substantially broaden access, while noting that their estimates depend on the coverage and accuracy of the tools used.
Natural gas settled at $3.27/MMBtu, with export demand offset by North American oversupply. The passage also describes Traders Union’s broker reviews and ratings.

The passage criticizes Ontario Premier Kathleen Wynne for telling students that if they do not vote, older white people will. It argues that her remark unfairly divides voters by age and race, cites commentators who call it identity politics, and says she should encourage participation across all groups rather than portray one group’s votes as a threat.

Global stocks rose after Federal Reserve chair Janet Yellen said U.S. interest rates could rise as soon as next month, citing a stronger job market and modestly higher inflation. European markets gained, and Asian markets finished mostly higher. Bond yields and bank shares rose. Higher Chinese inflation raised concerns about tighter credit, though analysts saw no sign of an imminent policy change. The dollar strengthened, while crude oil prices fell.

After a speeding teenage driver drove through a poorly marked T-intersection into a bayou, two passengers drowned. Michael Hill’s father sued the Morehouse Parish Police Jury, which knew the intersection was dangerous but had not replaced a missing warning sign. The appellate court upheld the jury’s liability and the $150,000 general damage award, but changed the fault allocation to 65% for the driver and 35% for the police jury.

In the opening lecture of *Blockchain and Money*, Gary Gensler frames blockchain as a way to verify and move data across decentralized networks without relying on a central intermediary. He traces relevant developments in internet payments and cryptography, then describes blockchain’s time-stamped records, cryptographic security, and consensus protocols. Bitcoin demonstrated peer-to-peer electronic cash, but Gensler says blockchain’s potential to change finance remains uncertain. He identifies possible opportunities in payments and financial inclusion alongside challenges involving scalability, privacy, interoperability, governance, and regulation. The course will examine technical fundamentals, economics, and financial applications, weighing skeptical and optimistic perspectives through critical reasoning.

The passage describes renewed interest in psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy. A pooled analysis of six Phase II trials found that 54% of patients receiving MDMA-assisted therapy no longer met PTSD criteria. The FDA designated it a breakthrough therapy for PTSD, and a Phase III study reported its safety and efficacy in people with severe PTSD.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 28, 2016, announcing its fourth-quarter and full-year 2015 financial results. The filing includes the announcement press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

Browns coach Kevin Stefanski has not decided whether rookie Shedeur Sanders will be the backup quarterback after Cleveland traded Joe Flacco and a 2026 sixth-round pick to Cincinnati for a fifth-round pick. Sanders is listed as No. 2 on the team’s unofficial depth chart, but Stefanski said he would decide later in the week, citing player development. Dillon Gabriel made his first start last Sunday, while Deshaun Watson remains on the physically unable to perform list.

Digital laggards often restrict data access, rely on individual judgment, and set poorly understood goals that are weakly grounded in data. This can discourage measurement and innovation. Digital leaders generally provide broader data access, use measurable goals to track progress, and connect team objectives to company strategy while allowing flexibility in how goals are achieved. A retail company’s shift to sales reports updated three times daily illustrates how improved data systems can support more timely decisions.

Digital leaders can also struggle with inconsistent attitudes toward data or excessive analysis. The passage identifies four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—and argues that successful transformation requires changes in both technology and organizational beliefs and practices.

The Bank of England will keep its £5 polymer note in circulation and issue the £10 note in September despite objections to trace amounts of animal fat. It will consult on plant-based alternatives for future notes and decide by summer 2017.

A University of Michigan survey of more than 2,000 older Americans found that 21% of women and 10% of men in their 50s and early 60s met criteria for ultra-processed food addiction, compared with 12% of women and 4% of men aged 65 to 80. Addiction was associated with reported overweight status, poorer health and social isolation. Researchers suggest that early exposure to ultra-processed foods and the marketing of diet-focused products to women may help explain the generational difference.

Ireland’s exposure to exchange rates affects tourism, trade and households. A favourable euro-dollar rate has helped attract US visitors, while weak sterling discourages UK visitors and benefits Irish importers buying from the UK. Since the Brexit referendum, sterling has weakened against the euro, while the euro has strengthened against the dollar. The outlook remains uncertain, with ECB decisions and Brexit influential. The passage recommends hedging for UK importers and exporters, but says tourism firms have few practical ways to protect against currency movements.

Apple Inc. reported that Bob Iger resigned from its Board of Directors on September 10, 2019. The Form 8-K was signed on September 13, 2019, by Katherine Adams, Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary.

This qualitative grounded-theory study examines career transitions among lecturers and education personnel at Indonesian state higher education institutions. Using interviews with civil servants holding both primary and campus-management roles, it finds that adaptation involves reciprocal interactions among situation, self, support, and strategies. Transitions change behavior, roles, learning, and perceptions; competing duties can reduce performance in primary roles. Informants drew support from colleagues and family and used both competence and managerial career anchors. The findings are limited to transitions within institutions and cannot be generalized.

Qarlinngua, meaning “like pants” in Inuktitut, is a sea arch about 80 to 90 kilometres southwest of Arctic Bay, Nunavut. A hunter’s photo prompted doubts about its authenticity, but local sources confirmed it exists. The formation is reachable only by boat during a brief summer window. Geologists say wind and water eroded the layered rock into an arch, though they disagree on how soon it might collapse. A local company has taken tourists there, and Nunavut’s tourism department hopes to promote it.
The court affirmed, with costs, a judgment for New York City in its case against Collis P. Huntington.

The speaker felt comfortable returning to play after a CT scan showed his injury had healed enough, though he tired in the third period and experienced cramps after extensive travel. He said his main concern was being hit from behind into the boards, and doctors advised that his current risk would change little by September. Grateful to rejoin the team, he said they need better execution and more passion in their chance to win the Stanley Cup at home. His family supported the decision to play.

At a parade marking the 105th anniversary of Kim Il-sung’s birth, North Korea displayed new ballistic missiles and warned it was ready to respond to nuclear attacks. The parade took place amid speculation about another nuclear test and warnings from China that conflict could break out.

NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2021 revenue of $3.87 billion, up 50% year over year, and net income of $622 million, up 13%. Data Center revenue rose 167% to $1.75 billion, while Gaming revenue rose 26% to $1.65 billion. NVIDIA completed its $7.13 billion acquisition of Mellanox on April 27, 2020; Mellanox contributed approximately 14% of quarterly revenue. Gross margin fell to 58.8%, partly reflecting acquisition-related charges. NVIDIA said COVID-19 had affected several markets and could negatively affect future demand and supply.

The passage describes a method for training an image detection model using labeled source-domain images and target-domain images that lack target-object labels. A detection component learns to identify lesions, while an adaptive component classifies image domains. Training adjusts model parameters using detection and domain-classification losses, optionally with gradient inversion to reduce domain-related differences in extracted features. In the colorectal example, the resulting model detects polyps and, when present, their types and locations. The approach is intended to use unlabeled images from other hospitals without requiring physicians to label their polyps.

This bibliometric study analyzed 324 English-language, open-access Scopus journal articles on mathematics anxiety published from 2013 to 2023. Using VOSviewer and Biblioshiny, it examined research trends, related topics, journals, authors, countries, and affiliations. Publications generally increased, peaking at 56 in 2022. Mathematics anxiety was linked to cognitive and psychological topics, including achievement, skills, motivation, and self-efficacy. Frontiers in Psychology published the most articles on the theme, Garcia-Santillan had the most publications, the United States produced the most research, and the University of Barcelona was the leading affiliation. The study was limited to Scopus-indexed articles.

Teams should prepare for defensive, even, and offensive jump balls based on their likelihood of controlling the tip. On defensive jumps, players should anticipate the tip, deny passes, rotate into open spots, and protect the basket; alignments can keep one or two defenders back. On even jumps, players should box out and rotate together on a predetermined signal. With a strong jumping advantage, teams can use set plays to direct the tip toward a teammate and create a scoring opportunity. Offensive plays should maintain defensive balance and flow into a set or motion offense if no good shot is available.

A collection of May 2001 energy reports focuses on Enron’s influence in Washington and its dispute over India’s Dabhol power project. FERC Chairman Curtis Hebert said Enron’s Kenneth Lay offered continued support if he changed his deregulation views; Lay disputed that account. In India, Maharashtra’s electricity board moved to cancel its Dabhol power-purchase agreement over alleged performance failures, while Dabhol disputed the board’s authority and sought payment of outstanding bills. Other reports cover California’s energy crisis, Portland General Electric’s rising revenues and costs, Australian investment plans in India, and a federal hearing into allegations that El Paso manipulated California natural-gas prices.

Apple has removed several ICE-monitoring and documentation apps, including ICEBlock, Eyes Up, and DEICER, from its App Store. ICEBlock developer Joshua Aaron says he plans to fight the removal, while Eyes Up developer Mark says he has appealed twice and will keep appealing. Eyes Up and DEICER remain available through Google Play and other channels. US attorney general Pam Bondi has claimed such tools endanger ICE officers; Apple has not responded to WIRED’s requests for comment. Legal experts interviewed by WIRED say the apps publish speech protected by the First Amendment, while digital rights researchers warn that Apple’s control over iPhone app distribution gives it decisive power over availability.

Tropical Depression 02W made landfall in the eastern Philippines on April 15, 2017, then weakened to a remnant low as it crossed the country. NASA’s Terra satellite observed its clouds over the South China Sea on April 17. Wind shear and drier air were expected to prevent re-intensification.

Alberta’s education minister said parents could potentially pay school bus fees despite legislation eliminating them for eligible students. Rocky View Schools faces a $1 million transportation shortfall and has surveyed parents about alternatives, including longer commutes and changed bus stops. The board plans to contact the ministry and may delay its April 12 decision.

The study developed resting-state functional connectivity classifiers to distinguish people with schizophrenia spectrum disorder from healthy controls. Using 1,015 participants for development and 683 for independent validation, the LASSO classifiers achieved 79.6% and 77.3% accuracy, respectively. Researchers identified 47 important functional connections; group differences persisted in the validation dataset for 44 of them. A voting approach improved sensitivity in validation but did not significantly change specificity or overall discrimination. Performance varied across sites and disease-severity groups.

The Supreme Court considered whether the double jeopardy clause permits separate convictions and sentences under Sections 924(c) and 924(j) for the same conduct. Barrett and the federal government argued that Congress did not clearly authorize both punishments: Section 924(c)’s “in addition to” language refers to an underlying crime, while its consecutive-sentence provision does not establish a separate offense. Court-appointed attorney Charles McCloud argued that the provision, together with the statutes’ structure and purpose, indicates congressional intent to allow both. Justices questioned which statutory language establishes that intent and whether the penalty scheme matters.

The passage describes TI’s mechanical, packaging, and ordering information, which may change without notice. It explains product status, preproduction parts, RoHS values, lead finishes, moisture sensitivity ratings, and part markings. TI says some information relies on third parties and may not be fully verified. Its design resources are provided “as is,” and developers are responsible for selecting products, testing applications, and meeting applicable requirements. TI limits its liability and subjects products to its applicable terms of sale.

The $170 Jabra Elite 65t earbuds offer strong sound quality, a comfortable fit, ambient-sound controls and Alexa access on Android, with iOS support planned. Alexa handles Amazon Music, skills and voice shopping, but cannot start calls, send messages, provide navigation or set reminders. Voice controls for music are limited, and calls can be difficult in noisy settings. The earbuds last five hours per charge, with ten more hours from the case, and lack a lost-earbud tracker. The review concludes that their Alexa experience falls short of a smart speaker’s.

After the Las Vegas country music festival shooting killed 58 people and injured more than 500, debate grew over concert safety and gun control. Country musician Charlie Daniels called the shooting an anomaly and said people should not let fear keep them from concerts. He supports regulating bump stocks but opposes broader gun restrictions, arguing they would leave people defenseless.

Digital leaders respond to changing markets by taking considered risks, experimenting, and using data and feedback to learn and improve. They plan experiments to limit costly risks and invest in employees’ critical thinking skills for long-term success.

Shohei Ohtani started Game 1 of the Dodgers’ 2025 NLDS against the Phillies, his first postseason pitching appearance. He entered with a 2.87 ERA and 62 strikeouts in 47 innings across 14 regular-season games. In the first inning, he struck out Trea Turner and retired Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper. Ohtani struck out in his first at-bat. Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said he hoped Ohtani could pitch into the seventh inning.

Using Mauna Loa solar-radiation records, the author compares two-year periods after the El Chichon and Pinatubo eruptions with other years. Maximum and average sunlight were lower after the eruptions; average radiation fell by about 24.5 W/m². The author estimates that changes in cloud cover offset roughly 7 W/m² of the reduction. Temperature records from Mauna Loa and several other Hawaiian stations showed no corresponding cooling, which the author says remains unexplained. An examination of wind-speed data found no clear difference between eruption and non-eruption periods.

The speaker welcomes Winnipeg’s new NHL team, citing passionate fans, strong crowds during his time there and confidence in Mr. Chipman’s organization. He recalls a whiteout at the old arena and enjoying games at the MTS Centre. He says he now distinguishes Daniel and Henrik by appearance and speech, with Henrik speaking up more. Against goalies such as Thomas, he plans to choose carefully between shooting for rebounds and passing for tap-ins.

Energy sector exposure can be gained through individual stocks or ETFs such as XLE and VDE. The S&P 500 energy sector includes oil and natural gas companies and related service providers. The passage describes the sector as difficult to trade because commodity prices are hard to predict, but potentially useful for diversification. It reports two undisclosed XLE strategies: one averaged 0.61% per trade across 198 trades, with a 13% maximum drawdown; the other averaged 0.21% across 335 trades, with an 8% maximum drawdown and a 3% annual return.

The Hawk offense combines wing isolation, a guard’s cut off a high-post screen, a weakside post-up and a down screen. The passage describes two defensive approaches. In the basic NBA “show and recover,” defenders help against dribble penetration, force cutters wide around screens, then recover to their assignments. The “SOS” disruption instead traps the ballhandler on the wing and uses switches, help positions and rotations to contest cuts, screens and passes out of the trap.

AMD is returning to high-end graphics cards with the Radeon RX Vega 56 and Vega 64, positioned against Nvidia’s GTX 1070 and GTX 1080 respectively. AMD says the Vega 64 is not intended to beat the GTX 1080 Ti. The Vega 56 is priced $50 below the GTX 1070 in the US, though UK pricing may be less favorable. AMD also points to cheaper, more available FreeSync monitors, its new Enhanced Sync feature, and efforts to improve minimum frame rates.

Snap shot a mare at Francis’s direction while it trespassed in an oat field. Both were convicted and fined $50. The court held that trespassing and crop damage did not justify wounding the animal; the owner could instead remove or hold it without unnecessary injury. The convictions were affirmed.

Canada’s big five banks fell 4.6%–7.5% from their February highs, while three of five smaller lenders fell by double digits. Comparing ten financial stocks on volatility, earnings yield, dividend yield, payout ratio and dividend history, the author ranked MCAN Mortgage first, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce second and Atrium Mortgage third. MCAN and Atrium maintained or increased their dividends and yield over 7%. Smaller lenders may offer higher yields but have lower trading liquidity and less diversified businesses than the big five banks.

Old paper £10 notes will cease to be legal tender in the UK on 1 March and will no longer be accepted by retailers. Afterward, they can be exchanged at banks, building societies, post offices or the Bank of England, though ID may be required. The replacement polymer notes feature Jane Austen, improved security and a tactile feature.

A safety is a defensive back who usually plays deep as the last line of defense against big plays. Safeties cover passes, support run defense, tackle and communicate with teammates. Free safeties often roam deep, while strong safeties generally play closer to the line and have a larger role against the run. Effective safeties can prevent touchdowns, create turnovers and help cornerbacks in coverage. The passage names Troy Polamalu, Ed Reed and Ken Houston among notable safeties.

The Second Circuit affirmed Samuel Israel III’s conviction and twenty-year sentence. It found no basis for the trial judge to recuse herself and rejected Israel’s challenges to his sentence, including claims concerning medical needs, cooperation credit, and its length.

The report examines how conflict disrupts children’s education, focusing on Syria. It cites displacement, damaged schools, poverty, scarce learning materials and psychological trauma as barriers to attendance and learning. Interviews describe children studying in unsafe spaces with limited books, tutoring and support, while families and educators create informal learning opportunities. The proposed “Hope Initiative” combines immediate measures, including psychological support and temporary learning spaces, with longer-term plans to sustain education in conflict zones.

Residents of San Andrés Hueyapan, Morelos, are anxious about renewed activity at nearby Popocatépetl after the September 19 earthquake damaged homes in the town. Although many residents consider the volcano less frightening than earthquakes, officials advised people to keep documents and clothes ready in case of an eruption. Recent eruptions brought ashfall to nearby communities.

The Great Barrier Reef recovered from five major die-offs over the past 30,000 years, according to research based on ocean-floor fossils. It survived past sea-level changes by shifting seaward or landward, but researchers warn that this may not be enough to withstand today’s rapid warming, acidification and other stresses. Successive bleaching events have damaged the reef; a 2016 heatwave killed nearly a third of its coral. Whether human-induced climate change will hasten another die-off remains uncertain.
Primatologist Jane Goodall died on October 1 at 91. Her legacy includes stories of living chimps and enduring skeletons.

Sean “Diddy” Combs was sentenced to 50 months in prison and fined $500,000 after a jury convicted him of two counts of transporting people across state lines for prostitution. The jury acquitted him of sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy. Combs apologized to his victims and family at sentencing, but the judge said his good works did not erase his abuse of women. Combs also faces civil lawsuits alleging sexual assault and other violence, which he denies.

Backtests found that futures expiration weeks outperformed random weeks for both DAX 40 and Euro Stoxx 50, with average gains of 0.39% and 0.3%, respectively. December performed best for both contracts. The expiration-week test bought at the prior week’s close and sold at expiration week’s close.

The following week performed poorly for DAX 40, averaging a 0.1% loss. That test used 100% margin rather than a futures backtest, buying at expiration Friday’s close and selling one week later, without commissions or slippage. The passage says markets are more volatile during expiration week because of “pin” risk.

The UC1825BEVM-CVAL uses an RCD clamp to limit switch-node voltage. A recommended clamp factor of 1.5 allows about 50% overshoot. Starting resistor and capacitor values depend on transformer parasitic inductance and allowable clamp-voltage variation during a switching cycle.

A railroad apprentice’s military service delayed his training, and the railroad assigned him journeyman seniority in North Little Rock from January 23, 1958. The District Court found that, but for his service, he probably would have gained that seniority on November 3, 1955. The Supreme Court held that uncertainty about future work availability did not defeat his seniority claim. It reversed the Court of Appeals and remanded the case.

U.S. stocks rose Monday, led by technology and semiconductor shares, despite uncertainty over a potential government shutdown. Investors continued to expect a modest Federal Reserve rate cut, while analysts warned that delayed economic data could complicate policy decisions and increase volatility.

Travel may reduce stress and offer other health benefits, but it can be expensive. To control costs, set a budget based on what you can afford and use travel websites to compare deals. Choose a credit card without foreign transaction fees, carry a backup, and check overseas phone charges. Traveling in the offseason, booking early, watching airline offers, considering trip insurance, and seeking local discounts can also help stretch a vacation budget.

The passage describes silicone elastomer compositions containing dispersed hydrophilic carbon black particles. Its methods treat the particles with a silicone-compatible dispersant, mix them into a hydrophobic silicone pre-polymer, and cure the mixture by addition or condensation. Amino-silicone, silicone-acrylate, and silicone-epoxy dispersants are described, along with optional particle size reduction. The resulting compositions may be used in articles such as printing transfer members and sealants.

The ARM Cortex-A8 subsystem controls device configuration, peripherals, and external memories. It includes an interrupt controller, SIMD and floating-point capabilities, separate instruction and data caches, and debug support. Real-time trace connects to a 32KB Embedded Trace Buffer and requires compatible tools to interpret captured data.

Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko appeared at a Kiev news conference less than a day after police reported his murder, revealing that Ukrainian authorities had staged it to thwart an alleged plot against him. The Ukrainian Security Service said a man had been detained for allegedly arranging the killing on behalf of Russian security services. Its chief said the suspect was also tasked with obtaining weapons and explosives for attacks in Ukraine. Babchenko, a Kremlin critic who fled Russia after receiving death threats, apologized to his family and friends, who had not known about the plan.

The passage describes a PGA848 circuit driving an ADS8860 ADC. Three filters reduce input interference, set bandwidth, and provide charge for ADC sampling. The front end has a nominal 318kHz bandwidth, falling to 277kHz at the high end of feedback-resistor tolerance, while remaining flat within –0.1dB to 41kHz. A buffered 2.5V reference shifts the signal to ADC midscale; changes to its bypass capacitance require a stability check. The PGA848’s nominal supplies are ±15V, and voltages above ±20V permanently damage it. Layout guidance emphasizes matched input paths, close supply bypassing, separation of sensitive traces, and minimizing leakage, parasitic capacitance, and thermal effects. The passage also lists simulation tools, documentation, support resources, and handling and legal notices.

A new study put PortMiami’s economic impact at more than $41 billion and linked it to 300,000 direct and indirect jobs. The port handled 8.9 million tons of cargo and a record 5.1 million cruise passengers last year. The Miami Herald questioned whether the study inflated its figures, but Miami-Dade Mayor Carlos Gimenez defended them. A planned $247 million Royal Caribbean terminal is projected to generate $500 million annually.

At Congress’s request, President James Madison recommended the third Thursday in August 1812 as a day of public prayer and repentance. Amid war, he urged Americans to seek divine protection, guidance for their leaders, blessings on their arms, justice among nations, and the restoration of peace.

The July 4 forecast for southwestern California calls for rising temperatures through Friday, with an excessive heat watch from Friday morning through Saturday evening. Friday highs reach 99–115°F in many inland areas and 112–117°F in the San Diego County deserts. High surf advisories cover Orange and San Diego coastal areas from Wednesday evening through Friday evening. Temperatures generally ease after the weekend, while some mountain and desert areas have a slight chance of thunderstorms.

The Blue Ridge Poison Control Center warns of springtime risks from poisonous plants, mushrooms, black widow spiders and snakes. It discourages self-treatment and recommends appropriate clothing, checking boots and staying aware of surroundings.

The author argues that IEX’s speed bump improves execution for large buy-side orders but has not fulfilled its ambition to disrupt stock trading; its market share remains below 3%. In the author’s view, the speed bump adds costs and depends on the SEC’s national market system, which shields exchanges from competition based on execution quality. To serve all traders and gain a larger market share, the author says IEX must move beyond the speed bump, balance buy- and sell-side interests, and build a trading vehicle that bypasses the national market system and attracts liquidity.

ESPN grew into a major Disney business through cable affiliate fees, advertising, live sports rights, and an extensive network of channels and digital products. By 2024, declining cable subscriptions, rising rights costs, changing viewing habits, and competition from streaming and technology companies were putting that model under pressure.

Disney launched ESPN+ in 2018, planned to offer ESPN’s flagship networks directly to consumers in 2025, and announced Venu Sports, a joint streaming venture with Fox and Warner Bros. Discovery, for fall 2024. These moves could help ESPN reach fans directly but also risk accelerating the decline of its cable revenue. The passage presents ESPN’s central challenge as growing a profitable streaming business while managing costly sports rights, retaining audiences, and navigating an increasingly fragmented market.

U.S. employers added an estimated 200,000 jobs in January, while unemployment held at 4.1 percent and average hourly wages rose 2.9 percent from a year earlier. Economists cited a tightening labor market and January minimum-wage increases in 18 states as possible contributors to higher pay. Job growth in 2017 was similar to 2016, while unemployment among African-Americans rose from 6.8 percent in December to 7.7 percent in January. Analysts cautioned against drawing broad conclusions from one monthly report, noting that job estimates are revised.

Competitive Capabilities International and R&G Global Consultants partnered to develop Stable Operations TRACC, a data-driven product for improving manufacturing operations across multiple sites. CCi says clients can increase capacity by 15 to 20 percent within six months of implementation. Cargill was the first client to deploy it and helped facilitate the partnership.

A Coronation Street suicide storyline prompted the writer to discuss their own past suicide attempt and share Cheryl Fialka’s account of her husband John’s suicide 33 years ago. Cheryl says he left no note or apparent warning signs, and she still lives with grief and anger over his death.
IT Central Station users praise Oracle Exadata’s smart scan and HPE Vertica’s columnar storage, but cite Exadata’s patching process and Vertica’s documentation as areas needing improvement.

The passage examines barriers to women’s education in rural Pakistan and Azad Jammu and Kashmir. It reports a female literacy rate of 51.9% nationally and 40.8% in rural areas. Survey interviews with literate and illiterate women identified poverty, household responsibilities, patriarchal attitudes, limited family support, early marriage, distant schools, inadequate transport and facilities, and language and curriculum difficulties. Both groups considered women’s education necessary and expressed hope for the future. The passage recommends public-awareness seminars, media campaigns, compulsory-education legislation, and open and distance education.

The Pakistan Super League plans a February 22 draft to replace foreign players unwilling to play the March 5 final in Lahore. The cricket board has promised top-level security, but a bombing that killed 13 people has renewed concerns. Pakistan has not hosted a major Test-playing country since the 2009 attack on Sri Lanka’s team.

After her 20-year marriage ended, the author realized she knew little about the couple’s finances. With help from a friend and financial planner, she gathered records, set a budget, and planned for retirement. She found steady work and learned to manage major purchases and household decisions herself.

Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke is visiting Maine to review the Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument. The author describes Maine’s inland wilderness as underappreciated and argues that the monument, created from a private donation of more than 87,000 acres and supported by a $40 million endowment, will preserve the land and benefit the rural economy. Gov. Paul LePage wants the designation repealed, while Sens. Susan Collins and Angus King and Rep. Chellie Pingree support retaining it. The author hopes Zinke’s visit will persuade him to preserve the monument.

LifeCLEF 2014 evaluated plant species identification from multiple images of the same plant. Its dataset contained 60,962 images of 19,504 observations across 500 species, with seven view types. Ten research groups submitted systems. IBM AU’s combined Fisher Vector, convolutional neural network and segmentation approach achieved the highest observation-level score, 0.471. Combining images from one observation generally improved identification, while leaf scans and flowers produced the strongest image-level results. The paper concludes that scaling identification to much larger floras remains difficult.

The passage describes the device’s memory mapping, terminal functions, boot configuration, pin multiplexing, and electrical connections. TILER provides an additional 4-GB address range for rotated and mirrored frame-buffer views, fully accessible only to the HDVPSS and ISS subsystems. Boot settings are sampled from BTMODE pins at reset; they determine boot order and options for GPMC, EMAC, and other modes. PINCNTL registers select multiplexed pin functions, while terminal tables document pin roles, pull states, and supply voltages. The passage also advises keeping unused inputs from floating, connecting supply pins to their required voltages, and selecting external pull resistors where needed.

Tesla appointed Joseph Gebbia to its board effective September 25, 2022. He waived cash compensation until further notice and equity compensation until July 2023, pending new board determinations. He was not appointed to a committee, and Tesla reported no related-party transactions requiring disclosure.

The CAG’s 2015/16 report found widespread procurement and contract-management failures, including improperly managed projects, purchases made without competitive quotations, delayed projects and contracts awarded without required approvals or valid agreements. It also found weak asset management: 37 buildings at 12 Tanzanian embassies needed major repairs, and ten embassy plots remained undeveloped.

At NVIDIA’s May 20, 2015 annual meeting, stockholders elected 12 directors to one-year terms, approved named executive officer compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the independent accounting firm for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2016.

An offensive switch is an exchange of positions between two attacking soccer players intended to free a runner for a pass by confusing defenders or forcing them to choose whom to cover. Switches may be called aloud or arise naturally during play, and can occur with or without the ball. In a lateral switch, players cross diagonally toward opposite touchlines; in a vertical switch, they exchange positions toward opposite goal lines. Players should verbally acknowledge a return to their original positions when doing so will not compromise play.

West Tennessee will remain mild and dry Friday evening before clouds increase Saturday. Tropical Storm Nate is moving north-northwest toward the Yucatan Channel. If it follows its forecast path, parts of West Tennessee could receive heavy rain Saturday evening through Sunday morning, though the risk of severe weather is low.

Dr. Edith Mbagwu recommends using SMART goals to make weight-loss resolutions easier to maintain. Goals should be specific, measurable, attainable, realistic and time-based. She suggests choosing clear exercise and eating plans, tracking progress in ways that motivate you, setting manageable smaller goals, reassessing them periodically and making time for healthy habits.

MatterMech is a 4,800-question benchmark across eight nanomaterial synthesis subdomains, developed from academic papers using multi-agent refinement and human quality checks. It evaluates 14 large language models through multiple-choice and text-infilling tasks. Models performed better at selecting explanations than reproducing precise concepts, while larger models generally performed better. Principle-guided prompting improved accuracy and reduced output length compared with automatic chain-of-thought prompting. The authors also release MatterDB, a collection of 31,735 papers paired with extracted synthesis mechanisms. Limitations include the lack of expert annotations during benchmark construction and its static coverage of an evolving field.

An EF-0 tornado touched down near Broad Run in Fauquier County on August 11, producing 75 mph winds and a mile-long damage path. It lasted two minutes. No one was injured, nor was anyone injured in an EF-1 tornado in Salisbury, Maryland, four days earlier.
The speaker urges the team to play aggressively despite the risk of mistakes, keep shooting despite blocked attempts, and look for chances near the net. Winning matters more than who scores.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 29, 2019 reports quarterly net sales of $53.8 billion, up 1% from a year earlier, and net income of $10.0 billion, down from $11.5 billion. Higher Wearables, Home and Accessories and Services sales were partly offset by lower iPhone sales. Nine-month net sales were $196.1 billion, compared with $202.7 billion a year earlier. Apple reported $322.2 billion in total assets and repurchased $49.2 billion of common stock during the nine months.

A survey of 294 university students studying German or English examined problems with pandemic-era distance education. Students considered it less successful than face-to-face foreign language teaching. Internet interruptions, low motivation, limited participation and insufficient interaction were prominent concerns; teacher-related problems were reported less often. Students without home internet or a separate study room reported more problems. The authors recommend training for students and teachers and a hybrid approach combining face-to-face and distance education.

Dereck James Harrison pleaded guilty to kidnapping and murdering Utah train worker Kay Porter Ricks in Wyoming in May. Prosecutors agreed not to seek the death penalty; sentencing is scheduled for May 17. Harrison said his father killed Ricks while they were fleeing police after kidnapping a woman and her daughters. Harrison is already serving at least 30 years in Utah prison for that kidnapping.

In prepared Senate testimony, Fed Chair Janet Yellen said she expects moderate economic growth, further job-market improvement and inflation to rise gradually to 2 percent. Further rate increases would likely be appropriate if employment and inflation develop as expected, but policy is not preset. She warned that delaying tightening could require rapid rate increases and risk recession. Yellen cited uncertainty about fiscal policy, productivity and developments abroad. She noted lower unemployment, stronger wage growth, improving business sentiment and a late-year pickup in investment. She urged policies that improve productivity and support sustainable federal finances.

Jaguar Animal Cmn (NASDAQ:JAGX) shares fell 1.75% in the most recent session and closed at $0.21. One analyst projected a 12-month price target of $1.25. The stock’s 14-period Average True Range was 0.04, with weekly volatility of 18.93%, monthly volatility of 22.08% and an RSI of 55.65. Its market capitalization was $22.14 million, with 103.76 million shares outstanding. Previous-session volume was 8.06 million shares, below the 10.47 million average.

The lecture explains why quantizing the Dirac field with commutators gives an energy unbounded below and bosonic particle exchange. Using anticommutators instead produces a lowest-energy vacuum and fermionic excitations that obey the Pauli principle. The resulting particle and antiparticle states have spin one-half, equal mass, and opposite conserved U(1) charge. The lecture then relates Dirac-field correlation functions to scalar-field correlation functions and derives the momentum-space Feynman propagator. It closes by introducing chiral and Majorana fermions as ways to reduce the number of independent components of a Dirac spinor.

This exploratory study examined whether a mitochondrial polygenic score (MGS) and lifestyle or environmental factors were associated with Parkinson’s disease age at onset in 486 patients with LRRK2-associated disease and 9,259 with idiopathic disease. Higher MGS was associated with earlier onset in LRRK2-associated, but not idiopathic, Parkinson’s disease. MGS interacted with coffee and caffeinated soda consumption in LRRK2-associated disease, and with caffeinated soda consumption and workplace pesticide exposure in idiopathic disease. These interactions were associated with earlier onset among exposed patients with higher MGS. The analyses were not corrected for multiple testing, and the authors noted limitations involving cohort differences, questionnaire data and the genetic variants available for scoring.

On November 21, Enron said it had secured the remaining $450 million of a $1 billion credit line and received an extension until mid-December on a $690 million debt obligation. Enron and Dynegy reaffirmed their commitment to their planned merger, while Enron sought to restructure debt. Shares of both companies fell amid concerns about Enron’s liquidity, and Goldman Sachs downgraded both stocks.

The passage describes the ADS868xW device’s data transfers, configuration, and an industrial input-module example. A transfer frame begins when CONVST/CS falls and ends when it rises. Frames with at least 32 SCLK cycles can carry valid 32-bit commands; shorter frames can read output bits but cannot perform valid writes. A frame’s output depends on the preceding command and output settings, and can include conversion data, register data, a fixed pattern, and selected flags.

The multiSPI interface supports four SPI-compatible protocols, single- or dual-line output, and source-synchronous reading with a configurable clock source. Nine configuration registers control identification, power, transfer protocols, output formatting, input range, and alarms. The application example combines an ADS8681W ADC with an eight-channel differential multiplexer and describes programmable alarm thresholds and hysteresis. The passage also gives recommendations for supply decoupling and board layout, and describes NAP and power-down modes.

U.S. stocks closed modestly lower Tuesday, recovering from steeper losses as tensions involving Russia, Syria and North Korea weighed on sentiment. Investors moved toward safe-haven assets, and the CBOE Volatility Index closed above 15 for the first time since Election Day. The Dow fell 0.03 percent, the S&P 500 0.14 percent and the Nasdaq 0.24 percent. Investors were also preparing for corporate earnings reports, with analysts expecting first-quarter S&P 500 earnings to rise 10 percent from a year earlier.

The passage describes methods for detecting beam failure in wireless communications. A user equipment sets measurement periods using the periodic reference signals it actually assesses, rather than all configured signals, so each period is expected to contain a relevant measurement. It reports a beam-failure instance when all assessed signals in a period fail a quality threshold; consecutive instances can trigger beam-failure recovery. If no reference signal is transmitted during a period, proposed approaches either leave the consecutive-instance count unchanged or count the period as a failure instance, rather than resetting the count.

The passage introduces MOTO, a framework for mapping transition-state networks around a local energy minimum. It combines multi-objective selection of starting configurations, Hessian–vector-product minimum-mode following to locate index-1 saddles, and bidirectional descent to verify connectivity. Benchmarks on atomistic spin systems show accuracy comparable to an explicit-Hessian method with lower memory use and faster computation. In a Pd/Fe/Ir(111) spin model, MOTO identifies meron- and antimeron-mediated transitions involving skyrmions, antiskyrmions and chiral droplets. It also maps low-barrier rearrangements of a Ni heptamer on Ni(111). Performance depends on suitable exploration masks and optimization settings.
DoLE-6 is preparing job fairs, skills training and worker profiling to assist an estimated 17,000 Boracay workers if the proposed closure proceeds.

James Damore’s memo argued that innate differences between women and men help explain women’s underrepresentation in tech. The passage challenges that view, citing research suggesting that cognitive traits often overlap, brains combine characteristics associated with both sexes, and experience can change brain structure and performance. It says spatial-skills training can improve performance, while stereotypes can affect anxiety, performance and brain activity. It also argues that training and empowerment may help counter those effects.

Hospitals are pausing Medicare-funded hospital-at-home admissions as a waiver allowing inpatient care at home nears its Sept. 30 expiration. Without congressional action, patients must be discharged or returned to medical centers by midnight Tuesday. Leaders say losing the programs’ capacity will worsen hospital crowding, while repeated funding uncertainty has discouraged expansion. A bipartisan five-year extension is under consideration.

A mixed-methods study of 67 EFL pre-service teachers and three educators at a southern Vietnamese university found that most trainees reported substantial opportunities to learn CALL-related skills, though opportunities varied by skill. Educators identified barriers to ICT integration, including limited confidence and resistance to change, student disengagement, unreliable infrastructure, slow technical support, and a lack of formal institutional guidelines. The study calls for educator professional development, administrative support, and clearer policies. Its small, single-institution sample limits generalisation.

NVIDIA reported first-quarter fiscal 2018 revenue of $1.94 billion, up 48% from a year earlier, and net income of $507 million, up from $208 million. Diluted earnings were $0.79 per share. GPU revenue rose 45% to $1.56 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue rose 108% to $332 million. Growth was driven by gaming, datacenter and Tegra products. As of April 30, 2017, NVIDIA held $6.21 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. It paid $82 million in dividends during the quarter and settled $605 million in convertible-note principal.

Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson injured his hamstring against Kansas City in Week 4 and did not return. He missed practice Wednesday and Thursday and was considered doubtful for Week 5 against Houston. Reports suggest he could miss two to three weeks, with one source saying he is not expected back until after Baltimore’s Week 7 bye.

In Flinn’s Estate, the court held that stock owned by the testator had its intact value fixed at his death, when the trusts took effect, rather than when the trustee received it. Stock distributed later by the separately incorporated Booth & Flinn Company was instead valued when the executors received it. The court also accepted daily averaging of annual earnings to estimate undistributed earnings at the date of death. It affirmed the lower court’s decree with the stock-valuation modification.

The authors argue that global citizenship education does not adequately explain international conflict, the conditions for cooperation among states, or how citizens can influence either. They propose supplementing it with realism, regionalism and institutionalism to help young people understand power, security, economic integration and international organisations. Cooperation depends on states’ interests and the issues involved, though established institutions can also provide opportunities for civic engagement. Teaching should retain attention to environmental and social issues while adding military and economic security, historical examples, and ways young people can influence their country’s foreign policy.

The speaker says the team needs to calm down after taking too many penalties. Effective penalty killing requires patience, coordinated pressure and strong defensive play. Coach Mike Ramsey helps the team make adjustments, but the opponent’s skilled players make mistakes costly. The speaker says the best approach for the next game is to avoid penalties.

A study at a Caribbean university introduced Sibelius music notation software to 24 pre-service teachers in a traditionally taught music course. Questionnaire responses and an assignment suggested that the software could be integrated into the course and support students’ understanding: 20 students submitted compositions, with overall assignment accuracy of 90%. Most students were neutral about whether the software motivated them, and many preferred traditional teaching or wanted more training. The authors recommend continued, gradual use of music technology alongside training and technology-based assessments.
The court affirmed dismissal of Gracy’s habeas corpus writ; Manning dissented.

Astronomers used James Webb Space Telescope infrared images, alongside Hubble data, to identify the dust-obscured red supergiant that exploded as supernova SN2025pht in galaxy NGC 1637. It is JWST’s first confirmed detection of a supernova progenitor. The star’s unusually dense, apparently carbon-rich dust may help explain why red supergiants are rarely seen before they explode.

The passage collects messages following the November 11, 1918 armistice. President Wilson announced its signing and called for American aid in establishing just democracy. Edward House celebrated the end of autocracy. Secretary of State Robert Lansing congratulated Britain and France, while French, Japanese, and Greek representatives welcomed the armistice and acknowledged American contributions. Greece expressed hope for national unity and a Society of Nations. Wilson also praised British Prime Minister Lloyd George’s approach to the work ahead.

The writer plans to send most reports by 1pm after readers favored accuracy over speed. They also discuss a company in which they hold a short position: CEO Oozi Cats resigned after an independent review found evidence of a US indictment that had been knowingly withheld from advisers.

The passage proposes the “Simplified Egg and Changing Yolk Model” to explain ventricular repolarisation on ECGs. In the model, a signal spreading through an asymmetrical heart shape produces the T-wave, while damaged regions can alter ST segments and T-wave shapes. The authors argue that repolarisation begins at the Q-wave and recommend measuring from Q-wave onset to T-wave peak (QTp) rather than using the corrected QT interval (QTc). They note that flat T-waves prevent either measurement and call for further research to refine and validate the model.

The passage describes methods and systems for creating virtual game environments from 3D scans of physical scenes. Scanned objects can be converted into virtual toy construction models, with properties such as shape, size, and color used to define game features. Recognized objects can also influence the environment’s theme or become interactive virtual objects. The passage further describes computational methods for converting surface meshes into colored voxel representations and using those representations to build virtual models.

Gbenga Ogundele and his wife, Moji Popoola, were sentenced to 234 and 18 months in federal prison, respectively, for conspiring to commit wire fraud and money laundering in an online dating scam. From 2011 to 2015, conspirators used fabricated stories to obtain millions of dollars from victims and moved the money through bank accounts to conceal its source. Ogundele was also convicted of aggravated identity theft. Both were ordered to forfeit funds; Popoola must also pay restitution. Several co-conspirators were convicted or pleaded guilty.

The UAE announced the Mars 2117 Project, aiming to build an inhabitable human settlement on Mars by 2117. The project will involve international research institutions and focus on faster travel to and from Mars. The UAE also plans to send the Arab world’s first spacecraft to Mars on a scientific mission in 2021.

Maria Saliagas, who has multiple sclerosis, says Delta employees in Amsterdam tied her to a regular wheelchair with a blanket because a chair with supportive straps was unavailable.
