Her son says the blanket left bruises. Delta said it contacted the family to address their concerns. The family says it wants a policy change, not just the 20,000 SkyMiles it was offered.

Ipswich striker Martyn Waghorn returns to Sunderland on Saturday, crediting former youth coach Kevin Ball with helping him turn his career around when he nearly left the club at 15. Waghorn departed Sunderland in 2010 without scoring but has since played for several clubs, including Rangers. Ball now serves as a Sunderland ambassador.

This study examines leaders of education-related undergraduate programmes in England’s further education colleges, using a lifelong learning ecology framework. An online questionnaire completed by 70 programme leaders, including 14 in colleges, was followed by 11 interviews, including four with college-based leaders. The findings describe college programme leaders as central to student learning and support, while managing administrative requirements and relationships with higher education partners. Small teams, poorly defined roles, competing institutional demands and limited time or support for scholarship constrain their work. The authors argue that stronger opportunities for research, academic networks and external partnerships could help these leaders improve provision for students and communities.

This unreviewed study protocol proposes using Danish registry data from 1995–2022 to describe trends in three surgical treatments for infection following primary total hip replacement—DAIR, one-stage revision and two-stage revision—and the risk of a second revision after each. It will include adults undergoing primary total hip replacement, excluding hemiarthroplasty and simultaneous bilateral procedures. The authors note that infections are surgeon-reported and the findings may not generalize beyond Denmark. The project received no external funding.

Truck traffic through Ponca, Arkansas, has risen sharply as drivers follow GPS routes through the Ozark Mountains. Local officials report seven truck crashes on a two-mile stretch of Arkansas 43 in the past 2½ years. Drivers have struggled with a steep descent and sharp curves; a trucker died in an earlier crash. The state Highway Department plans to install signs warning drivers about the steep, winding road.

The passage describes a floor cleaner that dispenses cleaning fluid and vacuums used fluid into a recovery tank. The tank includes a removable strainer, a baffle that redirects incoming fluid, a float that closes the suction outlet when fluid reaches a set level, and a removable filter. Other described features include a steerable body, a removable brushroll cover, a hydrophobic brushroll, squeegees that direct fluid and debris toward suction, and lights that illuminate the cleaning-fluid spray.

Australia was dominating the Philippines in a FIBA World Cup qualifier in Bulacan when RR Pogoy shoved Daniel Kickert, Kickert struck back, and a brawl followed. The game ended by default with Australia ahead 89–53. Both teams’ organizations apologized for their roles. The article argues that the Philippine team’s escalation and subsequent responses damaged its reputation, and calls for further action beyond an apology as FIBA sanctions loom.

Leam Richardson downplayed a brief tunnel clash between Wigan’s Ivan Toney and Fleetwood’s Nathan Pond, saying there was little in it. Toney could start Tuesday’s FA Cup replay against AFC Fylde, with Wigan aiming to secure a third-round trip to Bournemouth.

The “Give & Go” offense uses a 2-1-2 spread to keep the ball with two primary handlers. A pass triggers a basket cut; if the cutter is unavailable, the receiver dribbles out and repeats the action. Denied wings or posts can back cut, while wings can drive against soft defense. The post or weakside players provide passing outlets when the main action is blocked. Weakside players can exchange positions or set stationary screens to occupy helping defenders.

This study used Q methodology to examine 21 Turkish public-school teachers’ views of culturally responsive education. Their responses formed three perspectives, labelled unification, student support and teacher support. Teachers generally viewed cultural diversity as accepted in the Turkish education system, but identified continuing inequalities and gaps in support for students and teachers. They disagreed about measures against discrimination, whether different cultures are seen as a threat, and whether classrooms reflect society’s diversity. Participants declined to explain their strongest responses, limiting the analysis. The study recommends strengthening teacher development, inclusive classroom practices and opportunities for students to express and experience their cultures.

The passage describes electronic devices with display and touch sensor layers beneath transparent and opaque enclosure walls. Displays may extend across front surfaces and curved sidewalls, while touch sensors may also cover rear and other opaque surfaces. Foldable versions may use flexible walls and hinges to support displays and touch input across bend regions. The layers may be attached with adhesive or formed as coatings, with features intended to reduce bending damage.

Gary Antonacci’s dual momentum strategy combines absolute momentum, an asset’s performance over time, with relative momentum, its performance against peers. It favors buying assets that are rising and outperforming others; in markets where short selling is practical, it may short assets that are falling and underperforming. One ETF approach compares assets monthly and moves into bonds when the stronger asset has negative absolute momentum. A backtest described in the passage returned 6.75% annually with a 30% maximum drawdown, versus 9.2% and roughly 55% for the S&P 500. The passage cautions that simulated results do not indicate future returns.

Progressive reported February 2018 net earned premiums of $2.20 billion, up 19% year over year, and an 87.8% combined ratio, an improvement of 2.6 percentage points. Net income fell 4% to $129 million. The company also expanded coverage for an Uber subsidiary and raised $1.08 billion in net proceeds from securities offerings. The author estimates intrinsic value at about $48 per share using current figures, or $50–$54 using projected 2018 figures, and considers the stock slightly overvalued. The author projects a 2018 dividend of $0.76–$1.85 per share.

The Break, a longtime restaurant and billiards hall in Birmingham’s Five Points South, is set to be demolished for high-rise apartments. Some residents hope the development will revive the area, while others worry about rising rents and want more affordable housing. No closure date has been set.
Neiman Gracie criticized Dillon Danis’ trash talk and lack of professional MMA experience. Danis declined a proposed fight at Bellator 180, where Gracie will instead face Dave Marfone.

A study of more than 10 million US students found that a half-degree rise in average annual temperature corresponded to a 1% drop in exam scores. This raises concerns about UK exams held in June, when temperatures can exceed the threshold at which negative effects begin. Changing the academic year would be complicated, but annually adjusted grade boundaries may protect pupils from long-term disadvantage.

The advance-decline line is a market-breadth indicator that cumulatively tracks the difference between advancing and declining stocks. It can help confirm an index trend or signal a potential reversal when it diverges from the index. A related volume line tracks the difference between shares traded in advancing and declining stocks. In the passage’s SPY backtest using the NYSE advance-decline indicator, 229 trades averaged a 0.6% gain, but results were inconsistent and the profit factor was 1.55. The authors did not find a successful strategy.

The passage describes a family of compounds for organic light-emitting devices and methods for preparing them. The compounds can be used in several organic layers, including electron transport layers. In tests of 15 devices using the compounds as electron transport materials, driving voltages were 3.76–3.91 V and current efficiencies were 5.19–5.46 cd/A. Seven comparison devices showed 3.96–4.13 V and 4.89–5.18 cd/A. The passage also reports longer device lifetimes for the tested compounds.

The passage calls for forward-looking AI regulation that balances innovation with risks such as misinformation, deepfakes and bias. It identifies limited communication between governments and industry, differing national rules, and risks discovered only after deployment as obstacles. It recommends cooperation among policymakers, researchers and companies, alongside channels for developers and users to report problems so guidelines can be updated promptly and transparently.

A July 2001 energy-news roundup focuses on failed talks over California’s demand for $8.9 billion in electricity refunds. A federal judge indicated that refunds could be far lower, while Gov. Gray Davis said the state would pursue the full amount in court if necessary. Other reports cover Calpine’s gas-reserve purchases, Edison International’s finances, risks to California’s transmission grid, Texas’s electricity-market plans, and energy legislation in Congress.

The speaker says their team needs to attack the net more aggressively but not gamble. Detroit has limited shooting lanes, though Ronnie Francis hit the post. Both goaltenders and defenses have played well, and enthusiastic home fans energize the team.

Hervey Bay dive operators disagree on whether tourism will suffer after the ex-HMAS Tobruk settled on its side when scuttled. Dive Hervey Bay owner Glenn Bowman says limited access for general divers could halve projected income, while Hervey Bay Dive Centre owner Ed Gibson says tours can be adjusted and tourism should thrive. Both expect a spectacular dive. Queensland Parks and Wildlife says the wreck is in the correct location and that an inspection report will help determine the next steps.

Global Ferronickel’s subsidiary PGMC renewed a contract to supply Guangdong Century Tsingshan Nickel with 1.5 million wet metric tons of medium-grade nickel ore at prevailing 2018 market prices. PGMC targets six million wet metric tons in shipments this year, weather permitting. Global Ferronickel reported 2017 income of P779.7 million and revenue of P5.8 billion.

The passage examines business ventures launched by celebrities and heiresses. Millie Mackintosh closed her fashion company amid debts, while Ella Mills closed two of her three delis, though her separate Deliciously Ella business was profitable. Trinny Woodall’s make-up company reported a loss but gained new investment. Petra Ecclestone applied to wind up her handbag firm, and Tamara Ecclestone’s haircare company continued to report losses. Alexa Chung’s fashion label also reported losses but received investment. Kate Rothschild wound up her record label, and Sadie Frost’s lingerie business was dissolved, though its swimwear brand remains on sale.

This May 2018 ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States: Diplomatic Papers, 1942, Volume II, Europe* preserves the printed volume’s content while adding searchable, offline access. The preface describes the series as the official record of U.S. foreign policy and sets out principles of comprehensive documentation, historical objectivity, and transparency about deletions. It also identifies the staff responsible for compiling and editing the volume.

Salem residents are traveling to Woodburn for bottled water after officials announced that cyanotoxins from a Detroit Lake algae bloom had contaminated the drinking water. Salem stores are running short, and neither the city nor Oregon’s Office of Emergency Management plans water distribution points. The city warned sensitive groups, including young children and pregnant women, not to drink the water. Several nearby communities are also affected; new test results are expected Thursday.

European stocks fell Friday amid a global sell-off, with Frankfurt’s DAX down 1.7 percent, Paris’s CAC 40 down 1.6 percent and the STOXX 600 down 1.4 percent. Deutsche Bank shares dropped after it reported losses linked to US tax reforms. Traders awaited US jobs data.

The Supreme Court is preparing for its 2025–26 term and reviewing petitions accumulated over the summer. Venezuelans asked the justices to preserve a court order temporarily protecting their status in the United States, while the Trump administration has asked the court to decide a birthright-citizenship case. The passage also reports that a government shutdown could curtail lower-court operations but largely spare the Supreme Court. Other items cover calls to revisit a ruling on the death penalty for child rape, a dismissed college-athlete NIL lawsuit, and the court’s history under Chief Justices Roberts and Burger.

NVIDIA’s February 9, 2017 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release announcing results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 29, 2017. The release and CFO commentary by Colette M. Kress are furnished as exhibits.

The paper presents Bolt, a tool for learning finite-trace temporal logic formulas that separate positive from negative traces. Bolt enumerates small formulas, then uses a beam-search algorithm for Boolean Set Cover to combine them into larger formulas. The authors also introduce a benchmark suite of more than 15,000 tasks. With a 60-second timeout, Bolt solved 14,374 of 15,595 tasks, compared with Scarlet’s 11,468, and returned smaller formulas on average. A GPU algorithm solved more tasks than Bolt on the subset it could process. An ablation study found that Boolean Set Cover helped Bolt solve more difficult tasks.

American football offenses aim to advance the ball into the end zone or, when in range, kick a field goal. The quarterback directs plays, passes or hands off the ball, and may change a play before the snap with an audible. Running backs carry the ball, catch passes and block. Tight ends combine receiving and blocking; attached tight ends line up beside the offensive line, while sniffers often play off the line and help block runs.

The five offensive linemen—two tackles, two guards and a center—protect the quarterback and create running lanes. Tackles block on the outside, guards block between the tackles and center, and the center alerts teammates to defensive issues. Wide receivers primarily run routes and catch passes, but also block. The passage distinguishes split ends, flankers and slot receivers by their typical alignments and roles.

A study led by Cornell researcher Adam Anderson found that participants could identify six basic emotions from eye expressions alone. Narrowed eyes were associated with states such as suspicion and disapproval, while open eyes were linked to states such as fear and curiosity. Eye openness was the feature most closely related to these judgments, and the eye region conveyed emotions more reliably than other facial areas. The findings support the theory that expressions first served sensory functions and later became means of communicating emotions.
End a job interview promptly and confidently with a brief handshake and thanks. Avoid pleading for the job or asking when the employer will respond.

Brendon Naidoo, who faces multiple fraud charges over an alleged foreign-exchange trading scheme, was granted R50,000 bail by the Alexandra Magistrate Court. He must report to Sandton Police twice weekly and is expected back in court on May 5.

Karnataka’s education department has dropped plans for this year’s government-school summer camps because of insufficient funds and teachers’ SSLC evaluation and election duties. Started in 2017–18, the free camps offered lessons and activities to help students improve their skills. Last year, 7,049 schools participated.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics for experiments with superconducting circuits demonstrating quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantisation on a macroscopic scale.

A town-commissioned study warns that moving Vegreville’s 236-employee federal immigration processing centre to Edmonton could cost the town up to 420 residents and lower home prices by 30 per cent. The town also expects local schools to lose about 130 students.

The Indiana Court of Appeals affirmed Anthony Davis’s and Eric Simmons’s convictions for Class A felony conspiracy to deal in cocaine. Although two individual sales involved less than three grams each, the court found sufficient evidence of an agreement to deal in more than three grams. It held that Simmons’s acquittal on a separate dealing charge did not make the verdicts irreconcilable. The court also upheld Davis’s forty-year sentence based on his criminal history.

Job interviews range from conventional to elaborate or deliberately quirky. Some self-described “disruptors” ask unusual questions or riddles instead of traditional ones. The passage urges candidates to take control when asked whether they have questions.

Construction began on Fort Buford near the Missouri and Yellowstone rivers in 1866. Soldiers faced poor food, scurvy, interrupted supplies, boredom and alcohol-related problems, though the post had a well-stocked library. Sitting Bull surrendered to fort officials in 1881. A museum opened in its former headquarters in 1963, and other parts of the post have since been restored.

The passage provides power, reset, clocking, timing, and peripheral guidance for a TI digital media processor. It recommends filtering PLL and analog supplies, placing small decoupling capacitors near power pins, and ensuring capacitance does not disrupt power sequencing. It describes power-on, warm, watchdog, software, test, and local resets, including pin behavior and optional PCIe and EMAC Switch reset isolation. Clocking guidance covers DEV and AUX inputs, oscillators, external clocks, PLL limits, and module frequencies. The passage also outlines interrupt controllers, EDMA, debugging and JTAG, Ethernet, GPIO, memory interfaces, HDMI, video processing, and I2C, with associated electrical timing and PCB-layout requirements.

Flippy, a burger-flipping robot developed by Miso Robotics, is working at a Caliburger restaurant in Pasadena. It can reportedly grill 150 burgers per hour and uses sensors and artificial intelligence to improve its technique. Human coworkers still place patties on the grill, add cheese and toppings, and wrap orders. Caliburger has exclusive use of Flippy for six months and plans to expand its use after a trial. Each unit currently costs about $60,000. Miso says the robot is meant to work alongside staff, though a cited report identifies fast food as vulnerable to automation.

John Essey’s sensor-equipped home illustrates how connected devices can automate household tasks. Carnegie Mellon researcher Gierad Laput and his team developed a single wall-mounted sensor that detects multiple activities, offering an alternative to costly smart appliances or numerous separate sensors. It could have uses in homes and businesses. Internet security expert Bruce Schneier warns that companies may use data from such devices for profit and that device makers are not prioritizing security.

The passage describes device reset behavior, clock generation, peripheral capabilities, electrical timing, and PCB layout requirements. PCIe reset isolation allows the subsystem to reset independently; EMAC switch isolation can preserve network traffic during certain resets. DEV and optional AUX clocks feed PLLs, while tables specify clock and module frequency limits. The device includes interrupt controllers, EDMA, debugging interfaces, Ethernet, GPIO, memory controllers, HDMI, video processing, imaging, I2C, and DCAN. It also provides timing specifications and routing guidance for interfaces including HDMI, GPMC, and DDR2/DDR3.

Deutsche Telekom, Nokia and the Hamburg Port Authority will test 5G across an 8,000-hectare port area. The trial will assess network slicing under live industrial conditions for uses including traffic-light management, real-time environmental data processing and virtual-reality monitoring of infrastructure.

Since 2000, 12 albums have spent at least 10 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. Taylor Swift and Morgan Wallen each have three on the list, while Adele has two. Adele’s “21” led for 24 weeks, and Swift’s “The Tortured Poets Department” for 17.

Vermont prosecutors dismissed attempted murder and aggravated assault charges against Jack Sawyer, 18, after the state Supreme Court ruled that preparation alone did not establish an attempted crime. Sawyer, who pleaded not guilty, still faces criminal threatening and weapons charges over an alleged plot to shoot students at his former high school. Prosecutors want his bail to remain at $100,000. The case prompted Vermont to enact new gun restrictions, which cannot be applied retroactively to Sawyer.

On October 22, 2001, stocks rose on better-than-expected earnings, while Enron shares fell 21% after the SEC requested information about transactions involving partnerships run by its chief financial officer. Enron pledged cooperation and said its board had approved the arrangements. Shareholders filed suits alleging conflicts of interest and concealed losses. Separately, UniPrime signed a letter of intent involving an Enron subsidiary’s wind park lease.

Apple’s fiscal third-quarter 2021 net sales rose 36% year over year to $81.4 billion, with growth across every product and services category and geographic segment. Net income increased to $21.7 billion from $11.3 billion, and diluted earnings per share rose to $1.30 from $0.65. For the first nine months, net sales totaled $282.5 billion and operating cash flow was $83.8 billion. Apple repurchased $22.5 billion in shares during the quarter. The filing also discusses debt, financial instruments, tax and legal proceedings, and continuing uncertainty about COVID-19’s impact on operations.

With two wins remaining, the speaker says the team will keep focusing on one playoff game at a time. He praises a teammate’s hard play and leadership, and says poor ice and glass have made him more cautious about leaving the net. He recalls bringing the Stanley Cup to a children’s cancer hospital. He also warns that a talented opponent requires close attention. Although his team has more offensive skill than before, he expects the next game against an experienced opponent to be a difficult challenge.

Clio’s $1 billion acquisition of legal research platform vLex in June expands its software to cover more stages of legal practice and law firm management. CEO and co-founder Jack Newton discusses the company’s growth, its plans and AI ahead of the Clio Cloud Conference, scheduled for Oct. 16–17 in Boston.

The Secretary and Dobrynin agreed to review the status of bilateral agreements at their next meeting. They also discussed arms control, regional issues, nonproliferation and human rights. The Secretary preferred that INF and START negotiations remain in Geneva but was open to discussing them with Dobrynin; he insisted that regional and human rights issues remain on the agenda. In a separate memorandum, Clark told President Reagan that prospects for improving US-Soviet relations were uncertain. He argued that restored US strength might encourage Soviet negotiation and judged that the Soviets would not risk military conflict.

A non-peer-reviewed study examined 150 Enterobacteriaceae isolates from untreated wastewater in western Uttar Pradesh during 2020–2021. E. coli accounted for 62% and K. pneumoniae for 24%. Of all isolates, 74% resisted at least one antibiotic; 79.3% of resistant isolates produced extended-spectrum β-lactamases. Multidrug resistance was observed in several species, and colistin resistance was reported in Pantoea. The authors recommend wastewater surveillance and further study of resistance genes.

Dolphins wide receiver Tyreek Hill dislocated his left knee after a catch against the Jets and was taken to a hospital for evaluation. Coach Mike McDaniel confirmed the injury is season-ending. Further tests will determine the extent of the damage and Hill’s recovery timeline, but he is not expected to return in 2025.

A study of Turkey’s science curriculum and interviews with eight science teachers found that science education supports citizenship through scientific literacy, environmental awareness, and connections to everyday life and society. Teachers said it develops critical thinking, inquiry, problem-solving, and responsibility, but overcrowded classrooms, inadequate resources, and exam-focused teaching limit these benefits. The authors recommend making citizenship goals more explicit in the curriculum and supporting teachers in addressing environmental and socio-scientific issues.

Veteran tackle Byron Bell said he agreed to a deal with the Green Bay Packers. He previously played for Carolina, Tennessee and Dallas. Bell adds competition at right tackle, where Bryan Bulaga, Jason Spriggs and Kyle Murphy are recovering from injuries.

UFC 216 is set for Saturday in Las Vegas, where the city is recovering from a mass shooting that killed 58 people. The UFC has pledged $1 million to victims and their families. Tony Ferguson faces Kevin Lee for the interim lightweight title, with the winner potentially facing Conor McGregor. In the co-main event, Demetrious Johnson will seek a record 11th consecutive title defence against Ray Borg after their earlier bout was postponed because Borg fell ill.

Teams should practice simple out-of-bounds plays for baseline, sideline and full-court situations. The first priority is to inbound successfully, then get the ball to a strong scoring option. Effective plays depend on timing, communication, precise execution and reading the defense. Players should also know the throw-in rules: the ball must be released within five seconds, and the inbounder generally must remain at the designated spot. After a made basket, the inbounder may move along the baseline. Coaches should test players’ rule knowledge rather than assume they know it.

A 2024 study of future preschool and primary school teachers at the University of Belgrade examined their conceptions of robots through drawings and written responses. Of 143 students, 121 depicted robots accurately; 22 misconceptions mostly involved mistaking conventional electronic devices for robots. Animal-shaped robots were the most common depiction, and educational and assistive uses were the most frequently identified functions. Most participants had encountered robots in person, often at the faculty. The authors recommend more purposeful use of educational robots in teacher training, alongside attention to children’s safety, privacy and equal access.

The passage argues that Education 4.0 calls for personalized, skill-based teaching and assessment, and presents digital games as a way to support engaging, competency-based learning. It describes stealth assessment as using evidence from gameplay and machine-learning algorithms to assess learners’ skills continuously, provide feedback and tailor subsequent tasks. Developing these tools requires evidence-centered design and collaboration across disciplines. The passage also notes barriers to wider use, including development complexity, uncertain validity and reliability, possible cognitive load, and the need to set appropriate game difficulty.

The Medina City School District has a permanent 5.2-mill substitute levy on the May 8 ballot to replace an expiring five-year operating levy. At a rally organized by Kids First Medina, supporters said homeowners would pay the same amount for the levy, while an expiring bond issue would slightly lower tax bills. The district says the levy would maintain programs and support French classes and free all-day kindergarten.

The speaker is excited and nervous about reaching a long-awaited opportunity, having previously come closest while playing with New Jersey. They say those feelings have stayed with them since childhood and emphasize maintaining the team’s usual routine rather than overthinking the occasion.

An Ernakulam court convicted migrant labourer Muhammed Ameerul Islam of raping and murdering a 30-year-old Dalit law student at her home in Perumbavoor on April 28, 2016. He was acquitted of charges of destroying evidence and offences under the SC/ST Act. The court will announce his sentence tomorrow. Islam was arrested in Tamil Nadu 50 days after the killing, and 100 witnesses were examined during the trial.

Neutrinos come from the Sun, cosmic-ray interactions in the atmosphere, accelerators, nuclear reactors, supernovae, and Big Bang relics. Oscillation experiments use neutrino energy and travel distance to study how neutrino flavors change. Early solar experiments detected fewer electron neutrinos than expected, while the SNO experiment found that the total neutrino count agreed with predictions, providing evidence of flavor change. Atmospheric measurements also showed a disappearance of muon neutrinos. Accelerator experiments compare measurements near and far from a beam source to study neutrino appearance or disappearance. Reactor experiments study the disappearance of electron antineutrinos, including through inverse beta decay.

The paper argues that AI policy is largely absent from computer science curricula despite its growing impact on AI development. Comparing US and EU approaches, it highlights shifting regulations, the difficulty of translating policy into technical requirements, and cross-border effects. It proposes a classroom framework that examines AI policies through socio-political, translational, and technical perspectives, alongside questions of scope, power, and agency.

APU students attended The GIG, a formal dance held Feb. 10 at the La Cañada Flintridge Country Club. Organized by the Office of Communiversity, the “La La Land”-themed event featured two dance floors: one with a DJ and another with a live jazz combo. Students also enjoyed cartoons, photography, piano playing and views of the city. Several attendees praised the music, venue and distinct atmospheres.

During normal play, a penalty kick is a restart: once the kicker touches the ball and it clearly moves forward, it is in play. Other attacking players must initially remain behind the penalty mark, at least 10 yards from it, outside the penalty area and inside the field. They should be ready to pursue a save or rebound without entering early. The kicker may touch the ball again only after another player has touched it; a rebound off the goal does not qualify. If the goalkeeper secures the ball, attackers should switch to defense. Procedural violations can result in a retake or an indirect free kick.

Amazon entered a three-year agreement on May 20, 2016, for an unsecured revolving credit facility of up to $3 billion, replacing its 2014 agreement. No borrowings were outstanding. At its May 17 annual meeting, shareholders elected all ten director nominees and ratified Ernst & Young as auditor. Proposals on sustainability reporting, human rights, and political contributions were rejected.
Nigerians abroad sent $21.9 billion home in 2017, up 12% from $19.64 billion in 2016, according to the World Bank. It was the highest remittance total in Sub-Saharan Africa.

An Italian man shot six African migrants in Macerata on Saturday in what police called a racially motivated attack. Police arrested Luca Traini, 28, who also fired at local Democratic Party offices without injuring anyone there. The shooting followed the discovery of an Italian teenager’s dismembered body and the arrest of a Nigerian migrant in connection with her death. The Democratic Party said Traini had been a Northern League candidate. League leader Matteo Salvini distanced himself from the shooting but blamed mass immigration for tensions; other political leaders condemned the violence and called for calm.

The study develops a multiscale model linking atomic interactions at the GaN–liquid Ga interface to crystal growth rates. Simulations show that liquid Ga forms ordered interfacial layers and lowers barriers to nitrogen-adatom migration compared with a clean GaN surface. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations predict diffusion-controlled, layer-by-layer growth under typical molecular-beam epitaxy conditions. A model using calculated free-energy profiles, nitrogen diffusivity and solubility predicts facet-dependent growth rates of 0.01–0.04 nm/s without fitted parameters; microscopy measurements support the predicted trends. The authors note limitations involving impurities, the interatomic potential, simplified transport assumptions and experimental averaging across facets.

Rutgers historian Mark Bray says he and his family are trying to temporarily move to Spain after receiving death threats, including one that disclosed their home address. The threats followed renewed online criticism of Bray, who wrote a book about antifa, and a student petition calling for his removal. Bray says their first attempt to leave failed when their United Airlines reservations disappeared after check-in; he has been rebooked. He reported the threats to police, and Rutgers says it is gathering information. Bray plans to remain in Spain until the end of the academic year.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs with an integrated programmable gain amplifier, antialiasing filter, ADC driver, and buffered internal or external 4.096V reference. They support single-ended and differential inputs across programmable bipolar and unipolar ranges, with straight-binary output.

Programmable alarms monitor input voltage and the AVDD supply. The multiSPI interface supports standard SPI and source-synchronous data transfers, single- or dual-bit outputs, and multiple devices in a daisy chain. Nine configuration registers control input ranges, reference selection, alarms, data output, reset, and power-saving modes.

The passage also describes conversion states, command frames, reference and supply decoupling, PCB layout guidance, and an eight-channel industrial input module example using the ADS8681W with a differential multiplexer.

USD/JPY fell 2.25% after weak US employment data, putting key support levels in focus. Markets expect the Bank of England to cut rates by 25 basis points to 4.0% on Thursday despite inflation remaining above target; GBP/USD faces resistance near 1.3360 and support at 1.3135. BTC/USD fell alongside equities and found support near 112,000, with its next direction potentially influenced by Federal Reserve signals. The passage also includes stock-screening promotions and warnings that trading carries substantial risk.

At the National People’s Congress, Xi Jinping urged China not to become complacent, called socialism essential to its future, and pledged to oppose separatism. The session removed presidential term limits, confirmed his second term, added his political philosophy to the constitution, and approved a new anti-corruption agency.

On April 7, 2015, NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted a fiscal 2016 plan offering eligible executive officers cash bonuses based on the company’s achievement of specified revenue targets. Target bonuses are $1 million for Jen-Hsun Huang, $275,000 for Colette M. Kress, $475,000 for Ajay K. Puri, $200,000 for David M. Shannon, and $150,000 for Debora Shoquist. Unless the committee decides otherwise, participants must remain employed through the payment date to receive an award. The plan is filed as Exhibit 10.1.

The United States and Mexico signed a treaty of peace, friendship, limits, and settlement on February 2, 1848. After both governments ratified it, they exchanged ratifications on May 30. President James K. Polk made the treaty public on July 4, calling for its faithful observance.

Australia’s Sino Gas & Energy agreed to put Lone Star’s A$530 million takeover offer to shareholders, citing risks surrounding its Chinese gas projects. The A$0.25-per-share offer is a 19 percent premium to Tuesday’s close. Some analysts and investors questioned the board’s unanimous recommendation. A vote requiring 75 percent approval is expected in late August or September.

The United States paid a gross award of $473,151.26, including $172,962.35 in interest. In September 1900, Secretary of State John Hay certified copies of documents concerning the bark *Cape Horn Pigeon*. They include a record of its owners as of July 1892, its registration and specifications, and a certified crew list for a whaling voyage.

At Mobile World Congress, researchers and companies presented graphene technologies for future 5G networks: flexible microwave transmitters and receivers, a cooling pump for base-station receivers, and high-speed optical photodetectors and modulators. The projects promise lower costs or greater efficiency than existing technologies, but commercial use still faces manufacturing challenges, including consistent material quality and high production yields.

Financial markets faced repeated bouts of turbulence in 2018 over technology valuations, emerging markets and Italian politics. So far, the declines have been less severe than those in past crises. Federal Reserve interest-rate increases have added pressure by pushing up U.S. Treasury yields and prompting investors to reassess asset valuations. China’s steady growth and stronger U.S. banks have provided some stability, but George Soros warned of a possible major crisis. Strategist Hao Hong advised investors to reduce risk, saying it was too early to tell whether a larger crisis was imminent.

The S&P 500 fell more than 3% from Thursday’s high to Friday’s close, though futures pointed to a rebound on Monday. The article says the decline may be a consolidation after gains since April, but a deeper correction remains possible. Oil prices also fell after OPEC+ announced another production increase, while potential U.S. sanctions on Russian oil could offset added supply. With earnings reports ahead and concerns about demand, tariffs and valuations, the author recommends careful position management.

In soccer, the second defender supports the first defender by staying goalside, behind and toward the middle of the field, at a distance that allows them to respond if the first defender is beaten. They adjust as play moves and announce their arrival. Because they can see the field, they tell the first defender when to contain the attacker or attempt a tackle. Practice progresses from stationary positioning to movement, then half-speed and full-speed play with communication. If the first defender is beaten, the support defender may take over.

This study compared air- and bone-conduction auditory brainstem response (ABR) and auditory steady-state response (ASSR) thresholds in 50 infants with normal hearing or conductive hearing loss. At 500 Hz, both methods showed higher air-conduction thresholds and larger air-bone gaps in the hearing-loss group, but ASSR results were more variable and less clearly separated the groups. No conductive hearing loss was observed at 2000 Hz. The authors conclude that ABR remains the preferred diagnostic method for young infants and that ASSR needs further study across frequencies and degrees of hearing loss.

Ethereum trades near $4,450 after rebounding from $4,100. The passage identifies $4,800 as resistance and $4,300 as support; a break above $4,800 could lead to $5,200. On-chain outflows totaled $84 million.

RS Components compared the past year’s wealth increases of five Forbes billionaires with annual salaries. Jeff Bezos’s wealth rose the most, by $39.2 billion, followed by Bernard Arnault’s $30.5 billion; Bill Gates’s rose the least, by $4 billion. At those rates, Bezos’s wealth increased by the average US salary of $56,516 in 46 seconds, while Arnault’s did so in 59 seconds.

The Committee to Protect Journalists urged Russian authorities to investigate threats against Novaya Gazeta and its reporter after the newspaper reported that gay people were being tortured and killed in Chechnya. Chechen officials denied and criticized the report.

A collection of May 31, 2001 articles reports that Enron’s Dabhol plant stopped generating electricity after its sole customer, Maharashtra’s electricity board, stopped ordering power amid a dispute over tariffs and unpaid bills. Enron said the plant remained operational and it was open to negotiations. Other articles cover contrasting approaches to wind-park development in Spain, California proposals concerning power-grid control and Edison’s debt, BP’s expected role in a Saudi gas project, and the use of younger employees to mentor executives in internet skills.

NVIDIA’s Turing architecture combines rasterization, ray tracing and AI in a hybrid rendering model. RT Cores accelerate bounding-volume traversal and ray–triangle tests, while denoising reduces the rays needed for real-time shadows, ambient occlusion and reflections. NVIDIA reports ray-tracing performance about ten times faster than software-based tracing on Pascal GPUs.

Turing Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow motion and super-resolution. Mesh shading aims to reduce CPU draw-call bottlenecks; variable rate shading adjusts shading effort by region; texture space shading reuses shading results; and multi-view rendering processes multiple viewpoints in one pass. The passage also describes VR applications, TU104 and TU106 GPUs, and RTX-OPS as a workload-based performance metric. NVIDIA states that the specification may change and provides the information without warranties.
Microsoft’s October 24, 2018 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2018. The release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Oprah Winfrey told Vogue she experienced six weeks of depression after her 1998 film *Beloved* underperformed at the box office. She said practicing gratitude helped her and taught her not to place all her hopes on a film’s commercial success.

Amazon’s fall Prime Day sale has ended, but WIRED’s October 9, 2025 update lists deals still available across tech, home, kitchen, and other products. Its reviewers say they selected the deals from products they have tested and approved.

The study examined legal frameworks for inclusive education and awareness of those frameworks in three Addis Ababa resource centers. Using document reviews and interviews with 15 participants, it identified global, African, and Ethiopian policies supporting the education of students with disabilities. Ministry of Education experts and itinerant teachers showed greater policy awareness than school principals and classroom teachers. The study concludes that, despite a favorable legal environment, uneven awareness can hinder implementation. It recommends policy-focused professional development, stronger integration of inclusive education frameworks into teacher training, and monitoring of practitioners’ policy awareness.

Surmodics VP Charles W. Olson sold 1,201 shares on December 22 for $31,226 and retained 27,386 shares. The company reported quarterly earnings of $0.26 per share and revenue of $18.20 million, both above analysts’ expectations. Institutional investors own 87.45% of its stock. Recent analyst reports included two downgrades in November. Surmodics provides surface modification and in vitro diagnostic technologies to the healthcare industry.

Energy Central Direct’s March 5, 2002 edition compiles gas and electric power news, restructuring headlines, and top and most-requested stories. Topics include Enron’s collapse, energy deregulation, utility rates, gas prices, pipelines, nuclear power, and environmental policy. Highlights include the U.S. Supreme Court’s decision upholding a federal electricity open-access order and Jordan’s extension of a natural-gas pipeline tender deadline.

Xiaomi launched the Mi Band 3 in Shenzhen as the successor to the Mi Band 2. It has a 0.78-inch OLED display, call and app notifications, motion tracking, health features, and claimed 20-day battery life. It is waterproof to 50 metres and costs 169 yuan.

Yoga offers physical and mental benefits, including flexibility, balance, concentration and stress relief. Styles vary: Ashtanga is physically demanding; Vinyasa links movement and breath; Iyengar emphasizes alignment; hot yoga uses heated rooms; and Yin, Restorative and Kripalu offer gentler approaches. Athlete-specific classes address the demands of particular sports. The passage recommends choosing a style based on personal goals and training needs, with gentler practices for those who train hard. It also announces a free Outdoor Yoga Picnic on June 21.

Dundee & Angus College hairdressing and beauty therapy students won seven golds, eight runner-up places and six third places at the Scottish AHT Competition finals. Darcie Westland was named Student of the Year in her first competition. Other wins included team bridal, ladies’ evening style, men’s barbering, commercial nail art and a Strictly Come Dancing-themed team presentation.

The government shutdown prevented the release of September’s federal jobs report and weekly jobless claims. Alternative data suggest slow employment growth but a broadly stable labor market: unemployment was estimated at 4.3%, job postings declined, and hiring remained uneven, with health care stronger than other fields. Private payrolls fell, while state claims data indicated little change and consumer spending continued to grow.

Amazon’s April 28, 2016 Form 8-K reports its first-quarter 2016 financial results announcement. It also describes a change in how stock-based compensation and other operating expense or income are allocated to segment results. Consolidated results are unaffected. The filing includes a press release, non-GAAP information, and historical segment data.

The President submits a report on Texas but says the Executive has not recognized its independence. Although Texas has expelled Mexican forces, Mexico threatens another invasion. He argues that U.S. policy requires clear evidence that a new government can maintain its sovereignty before recognition. Because Texas seeks admission to the Union, premature recognition could appear to serve U.S. territorial interests. He recommends continued caution and consultation with Congress, especially if recognition could lead to war.

Chefs’ Warehouse is presented as a growth investment despite its 33.3x forward P/E. The passage forecasts 16.7% annual EPS growth through 2028 and a $79.3 price target by fiscal 2027, implying 36% upside. It cites revenue growth, expanding margins, pricing power, and luxury restaurant and hotel clients as strengths.

Classical Maxwell solvers cannot capture photon correlations or entanglement, while exact quantum models become costly for complex systems. The passage introduces a stochastic Bloch-vector approach intended to connect quantum emitter dynamics with spatially and temporally resolved electromagnetic fields. It uses stochastic differential equations to represent fluctuations and proposes a complex, non-symmetric diffusion matrix to account for asymmetric noise correlations. The approach is validated against experiments using the Mollow spectrum of a driven two-level system.

The speaker accepts Chris Pronger’s one-game suspension for a hit to Dean McAmmond’s head and expresses regret that McAmmond was injured. He argues that Chris Neil’s hit on Andy McDonald also warranted a hearing, despite McDonald not being injured. He does not blame officials for missed calls, saying the league can still impose discipline. He describes his team as physical, not dirty, and calls for limiting blows to the head without removing body contact from hockey.

The cost of hedging against Czech crown volatility reached a nine-month high amid speculation that the central bank would soon remove its currency cap. Czech new car registrations rose 14.2% year-on-year in the first quarter. Prague prosecutors cleared the way for an extradition hearing for a Russian accused of hacking LinkedIn.

Regional reports said RWE was considering selling its stake in a Hungarian power plant, while Croatia’s kuna fell amid uncertainty over Agrokor’s debt. Czech press reports said pipeline operator Mero sought more oil through the TAL pipeline, the cabinet approved an 80 million crown bid for insolvent miner OKD, and Prague Airport planned capacity investments of 27 billion crowns. Reuters said it had not verified the press reports.

Saudi Arabia has approved the University of New Haven’s plan to open a Riyadh campus next fall. The university hopes to enroll 13,000 undergraduate and graduate students within a decade, offering English-language programs in business, engineering and applied sciences. Officials say the campus will support Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 economic goals.

The university has worked with the Saudi royal family since the late 1990s. Its later partnership with King Fahd Security College drew calls to end it after Saudi agents killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi, but the university continued the relationship. The Riyadh campus still needs approval from the university’s U.S. accreditor.

The passage specifies the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) protocol for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests. These features protect guest register state while allowing guests to share selected information with a hypervisor through a decrypted GHCB and VMGEXIT requests. It describes protocol negotiation, feature advertisement, supported exits, page-state changes, SNP guest requests, AP creation, trusted I/O, Secure AVIC, and termination. It also covers SMP booting, NMI and debug-register handling, and Restricted Injection through a shared doorbell page. System Management Mode and nested virtualization are not supported.

The speaker says extended time defending hurt their scoring chances. They fault their team’s slow forechecking, praise the opponent’s backchecking, and say a second-period opportunity to gain momentum did not work out.

At NASA Glenn in Cleveland, researchers use the Glenn Extreme Environments Rig to recreate Venus’s extreme surface conditions. After 80 days in the chamber, rock and mineral samples showed substantial chemical changes. Engineers also tested a computer chip that operated for 21 days, a step toward longer missions to Venus. Scientists hope such missions will help explain how Venus developed a runaway greenhouse effect and allow comparisons with Earth’s climate. They are also interested in Venus’s cooler upper atmosphere, where microbial life may be possible.

The President tells the Senate that he retained California’s existing military commandant as civil governor because Congress had not established a government there, but gave him no new authority or compensation. He sent officials to California and New Mexico and encouraged their people to seek statehood if they could meet constitutional requirements, while instructing federal agents not to influence their constitutions or domestic policies. He recommends admitting California if its proposed constitution qualifies. He argues that statehood could reduce disputes over involuntary servitude and that Congress should not impose unwanted conditions on California’s domestic institutions. Because Texas claims part of New Mexico, he considers a territorial government before the boundary is settled inexpedient. He urges Congress to avoid unnecessary controversy and preserve national harmony.

Viridor has begun building a £252 million resource recovery centre at Avonmouth to turn Somerset’s non-recyclable household waste into electricity. Expected to operate fully in 2020, it could power 44,000 homes and reduce landfill use. The facility will be monitored by the Environment Agency and will coincide with expanded kerbside recycling collections.

The author argues that the OxyChem deal benefits Occidental Petroleum more than Berkshire Hathaway by reducing Occidental’s leverage, sharpening its exploration and production focus, and potentially improving its growth and valuation. The author says the acquisition is immaterial to Berkshire’s operations and finances.

Andrew Triggs allowed one run over six innings, and Mark Canha homered as Oakland beat Texas 3-2 for its fourth straight win. Jed Lowrie and Matt Olson added RBI doubles. Adrian Beltre drove in both Rangers runs but injured his left hamstring, leaving his status for Wednesday uncertain.

The S&P 500 fell 2.36% last week and closed Friday at its lowest level since early July. Futures suggested a rebound, but the article warns it could be temporary and that a deeper correction remains possible. Oil also declined amid tariff uncertainty, a stock sell-off and planned OPEC+ production increases. Earnings, weaker economic data and trade policy are among the risks investors are watching.

A small study found that women preferred the body odor of men who ate more fruits and vegetables, while men who ate more carbohydrates smelled less appealing. Researchers assessed the men’s diets and skin color, then asked women to rate their sweat after exercise. Eating meat did not change attractiveness ratings, though it made odor more intense. An expert explained that body odor arises when skin bacteria metabolize compounds in sweat. The study did not assess same-sex couples.

Martin James Cooper, 66, was convicted of 30 historical child sex offences against eight children in his care at Warminda Hostel between 1978 and 1983. Victims described a culture of fear, violence and sexual abuse. He was acquitted of abusing another person. A judge denied bail and remanded him in custody pending sentencing.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on January 26, 2017, reporting that it had issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2016. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Maya Kodes, an interactive virtual pop star created by Montreal’s Neweb Labs, has released a song, performed 30 concerts and gained 5,500 Facebook followers. She will launch her first EP with a livestream performance on June 13; a Toronto show is expected this year.

The study compares machine-learning potentials trained from scratch, used without modification, and fine-tuned from a bulk-trained foundation model to predict material surfaces. Across gold, ruthenium oxide, and bismuth vanadate, fine-tuning produced lower energy and force errors than training from scratch with the same data and generally yielded more physically reasonable diatomic potentials. Fine-tuning on gold alone, however, worsened predictions for other metal surfaces. Multi-head fine-tuning on bulk and gold-surface data improved predictions for those metals and better preserved bulk performance, but required substantially more training time and slightly reduced accuracy on gold.

Japanese Apple blog Mac Otakara reports that the rumored tenth-anniversary iPhone may have an Apple Watch-inspired polished steel frame between glass panels, an under-display Touch ID sensor, and vertically arranged dual cameras. The sensor claim is disputed, and the camera’s purpose remains uncertain. The reported design is unconfirmed.

The coach said Modano’s ligament injury could not be worsened by contact, but he would play against Buffalo only if he could handle faceoffs and his other responsibilities. He described Modano’s defensive work as difficult to replace. He also discussed Belfour’s recovery from a serious back injury, praised Curtis Brown’s play, and argued that Hasek should not obstruct loose pucks outside the crease. After the game, he credited early penalty kills and committed defense with energizing the team. He said Hull’s injury could require lineup changes and praised the team’s pride and effort.

The article argues that higher education human rights teaching should address the risk of retraumatising students while empowering them to advocate for human rights. Drawing on an interdisciplinary literature review, it recommends that educators examine their values and biases, design safe and inclusive learning activities with students, and use reflection and dialogue. Its proposed trauma-informed approach integrates learning about, through and for human rights, including opportunities to engage with practitioners and survivors.

The study analyzes 134,354 earnings press releases from 2006–2023 to predict announcement-day stock returns. Press-release text and earnings surprises explain similar shares of return variation; FinBERT performs best among the text models, while topic models aid interpretation. A strategy using both signals earns no profit after market open, but advance access improves identification of the best- and worst-performing stocks.

An IDC survey of 200 manufacturing decision makers in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland examines simulation, modeling, data analysis, and high-performance computing (HPC). Respondents use these technologies to support innovation, product quality, and faster development, but outdated infrastructure, slow calculations, and fragmented data limit their use. Eighty-one percent view HPC as a game changer for product and process innovation. Among current HPC users, external infrastructure is widely used or planned. Key challenges include security, costs, energy consumption, and sustainability.

A UCLA study estimates that food and waste from U.S. dogs and cats generate the equivalent of 64 million tons of carbon dioxide annually, comparable to emissions from 13.6 million cars. The researcher urges owners to consider pets’ climate impact but does not recommend vegetarian diets. Another scientist notes that pet food largely uses livestock byproducts that might otherwise be wasted. While some dogs reportedly do well on meat-free diets, veterinarians warn that plant-based diets can leave pets, especially cats, short of essential nutrients.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point to 1–1.25 percent, its fourth increase in 18 months. Credit card borrowers and people with home equity lines or some adjustable-rate mortgages are likely to pay more. Fixed mortgage and auto loan rates have changed little, while savings rates have risen only modestly. Higher U.S. rates can attract overseas investment and draw capital from developing countries. The Fed indicated it expects one more increase this year if the economy remains strong.

U.S. Treasury prices fell and yields rose after a jobs report showed stronger wage growth despite the first monthly job loss since 2010. Traders largely attributed the losses to hurricanes and focused on wages as a possible sign of inflation. Yields later pared their gains amid concerns about Catalonia. Expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate increase and upcoming Treasury auctions also influenced the market.

The forwarded news collection mentions Enron in three contexts: talks to back Renard Euell’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve oil bid ended without a deal, and his award lapsed; Enron Broadband Services invested in Artesia Technologies; and Enron chairman Ken Lay supported a proposed Houston basketball arena. The arena articles examine its public costs and potential benefits, while a Houston Chronicle editorial urges voters to approve it.

The NHL’s 30 existing teams must submit expansion-draft protection lists by Saturday. Vegas will then select one player from each team, announcing its choices June 21. Teams may protect either seven forwards, three defencemen and a goalie, or eight skaters and a goalie; players with two or fewer seasons of experience are exempt. Readers are invited to choose Calgary Flames protections and predict Vegas’s selection.

At Apple’s February 13, 2018 annual meeting, shareholders elected eight directors and approved the appointment of Ernst & Young as auditor, executive compensation, and an amended non-employee director stock plan. They rejected proposals on proxy access amendments and a human rights committee.

The author argues that Siri should let users teach it words, pronunciations, nicknames, and custom commands. They say Siri’s current contact-based nickname features are limited and suggest that user-taught terms could make interactions more fluid and expand Siri’s vocabulary.

Notre Dame received two gifts totaling $205 million. Matthew and Joyce Walsh gave $150 million to its School of Architecture, which will bear their names. A gift from Francis and Kathleen Rooney will endow an institute focused on scholarship and dialogue about American democracy.

Students returned to North Park Elementary School in San Bernardino a week after Cedric Anderson fatally shot his estranged wife, teacher Karen Smith, and 8-year-old Jonathan Martinez before killing himself. A 9-year-old student was wounded. Families and staff offered support as the school reopened with tighter security and counselors available.

Amsterdam’s Buiksloterham district is taking an experimental approach to docklands regeneration. De Ceuvel, a temporary hub of renovated houseboats, uses plants to clean polluted soil while reusing waste and generating solar power. A local points system rewards offices that produce surplus energy. The project is intended to prepare the site for future use at a fraction of the cost of mechanically removing polluted soil. It also offers an alternative to luxury redevelopment that prices out local residents, as the wider area pursues sustainable, inclusive development.

Peel police are seeking three unidentified men filmed attacking a 29-year-old autistic man at Square One’s bus station in Mississauga on March 13. Investigators believe the suspects recently travelled to the Greater Toronto Area from British Columbia’s Lower Mainland and are asking people there to review the video. The victim remains shaken, and police are requesting information from the public.

The passage reports that RSI mean-reversion strategies performed poorly in tests on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Dogecoin. RSI momentum strategies performed better; one Bitcoin example outperformed buy-and-hold with smaller drawdowns.

Twenty-seven days into Kilauea’s eruption, fast-moving lava threatened more homes in Leilani Estates and Lanipuna Gardens, while officials urged Kapoho residents to leave before lava could cut off a road. Volcanic haze reached Guam, prompting warnings for people with respiratory problems and for mariners and pilots. On Hawaii’s Big Island, officials warned of high volcanic gas emissions, worsening air quality and falling volcanic glass fibers. Since May 3, at least 40 homes have been destroyed, more than 2,000 acres covered by lava and about 200 people housed in emergency shelters.

Arkansas inmate Don Davis had his last meal as courts considered whether his execution could proceed. The state sought U.S. Supreme Court intervention after its highest court issued stays, while a federal appeals court reversed a separate ruling halting eight executions.

The manuscript presents quantitative criticalism as an approach to education research that combines quantitative methods with critical perspectives and a commitment to social justice. It argues that numbers and research decisions are not neutral, so scholars should examine their positionalities, account for systemic oppression, and involve communities throughout the research process. The authors identify tensions involving statistics’ history, identity categories, small samples, generalizability, and the lack of a clear threshold for criticality. Examples using critical race theory, queer theory, and intersectionality show ways to address these tensions while acknowledging methodological limits. The manuscript calls for ongoing reflection, collaboration, and attention to how research informs policy and practice.

SpinGPT is a language-model agent for three-player Spin & Go poker. Its training combined supervised learning on 320,000 professional-player decisions with offline reinforcement learning using solver-generated hands. The supervised model achieved 80% exact accuracy on held-out professional decisions and, after an all-in adjustment, won against Slumbot in a mismatched heads-up benchmark. The final model achieved 78% tolerant accuracy on solver decisions and beat the supervised model over 10,000 hands. The authors note that the final model has not been tested against Slumbot or specialized Spin & Go opponents and can make numerical errors.

The MACD histogram shows the difference between the MACD and signal lines; its position relative to zero indicates bullish or bearish momentum. The passage describes a mean-reversion strategy that enters at the close and exits a long position on the first day the close exceeds the previous day’s close, with the reverse rule for shorts. Across 77 ETFs, it generated 6,669 trades, with long positions performing better than short positions. A backtest on the leveraged Nasdaq 100 ETF QLD reported 85 trades, an average gain of 2.2% per trade, 10.4% annual returns, and a 19% maximum drawdown while invested 5% of the time.

Feature phones remain popular as secondary devices and alternatives to smartphones. The passage lists options ranging from the Rs 799 Intex Yaari, which handles basic calls, to the Rs 4,799 Nokia 230, presented as a premium choice. The Nokia 216 offers internet access and long battery life; the Samsung Metro 350 has a 2MP camera. The upcoming Nokia 3310 is expected to cost around Rs 4,000. The Micromax X408, Samsung Guru E1200 and Nokia 105 are described as simple or backup phones.

The passage lists habits it says can undermine weight-loss efforts, including drinking from plastic bottles, relying on protein bars or meal replacements, drinking calories, emotional eating, inadequate sleep, and repeating the same exercise routine. It advises eating balanced meals with whole grains and healthy fats, replacing artificial sweets with fruit, and avoiding overly strict or rapid dietary changes. It also recommends adjusting routines to individual needs, judging progress by consistency rather than the scale, and responding to setbacks without self-criticism.

A global learning crisis, worsened by school closures, climate change, conflict and economic slowdown, is leaving young people without skills needed for work. In 2023, 20 percent of youth worldwide were not in employment, education or training; two-thirds were young women. Employers also report skills shortages, while many young workers in lower-income countries have qualifications that do not match their jobs. The Global Partnership for Education supports foundational learning and 21st-century skills through financing, policy dialogue and partnerships. Its work includes education investments in Lesotho and Ghana, curriculum reforms in Kenya, and teacher training on socio-emotional skills in El Salvador.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture adds support for 8K displays, HDR, improved video encoding and decoding, and single-cable VR headset connectivity through VirtualLink. NVLink increases bandwidth for two-way SLI on supported GPUs. Turing’s RT Cores accelerate ray tracing, while hybrid rendering combines ray tracing with rasterization; denoising reduces the rays needed for real-time effects. Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS, inpainting, slow motion, and image upscaling. Mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering offer developers ways to improve rendering efficiency and flexibility. The passage also describes TU104 and TU106 configurations, an RTX-OPS workload metric, ray-tracing techniques, and NVIDIA’s specification and liability notices.

Onesmo Rupil began using drugs as a teenager and was discontinued from the University of Dodoma in 2013 after substance abuse affected his studies. He says heroin addiction led him to steal students’ laptops to buy drugs. After imprisonment and rehabilitation, he recovered and now manages a sober house in Mwanza serving about 30 young people. Dr Kassian Nyandindi says marijuana abuse can damage the brain and that many young people sent for rehabilitation develop mental disorders.

Researchers developed an automated system that combines FHIR-encoded clinical guidelines with patient data standardized to the OMOP Common Data Model to monitor adherence to six intensive care recommendations. It was deployed across five university hospitals, covering 82,015 intensive care episodes from January 2020 to May 2023. In validation against expert assessments, the system achieved 97.0% accuracy, compared with 86.6% for physician reviewers, and processed more than 2,000 patient days per second. Most system errors involved relevant information recorded as unstructured text and unavailable in the standardized data. Observed adherence varied by hospital and recommendation. Limitations included retrospective validation, possible bias in expert assessments, and evaluation of only six recommendations.

After a tough series against Colorado, the speaker says fatigue is no excuse in the Stanley Cup Final against New Jersey. New Jersey’s defensive play, quick transitions and line chemistry pose a challenge. The team will rely on its coaches to choose matchups and must spread out scoring, get more pucks to the net and battle for opportunities in an important game tomorrow.

NVIDIA provides the specification and related materials “as is,” without warranties of accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose. It may change the specification or discontinue products without notice, and customers should verify current information before ordering. Customers are responsible for testing product suitability; use in specified high-risk applications is at their own risk. NVIDIA disclaims liability for misuse and customer designs. The specification grants no intellectual property licenses, and reproduction requires written approval. Products are sold under NVIDIA’s standard terms unless otherwise agreed.

A 2018 paper by Nicholas Lewis and Judith Curry estimates climate sensitivity from observed warming and climate forcing since the 19th century. Using globally complete temperature data, it reports a median equilibrium climate sensitivity of 1.66°C and a transient climate response of 1.33°C, compared with 3.1°C and 1.9°C for 31 climate models. The authors conclude that many models’ higher estimates are inconsistent with historical warming and that projected future warming would be 30–45% lower than the models’ central projections. They find that the potential biases they examined are minor with globally complete data.

Former Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen said interest rates should rise gradually to prevent the U.S. economy from overheating while allowing inflation to reach the Fed’s 2 percent goal. She said February’s gain of 313,000 jobs exceeded a sustainable monthly pace of 90,000 to 120,000. Her successor, Jerome Powell, is expected to continue gradual rate increases.

The statistical analysis plan specifies treatment-group summaries and plots for plasma glucose, pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic measures. Safety analyses use the safety set and cover insulin and trial medication administration, rescue glucose, injection-site tolerability, adverse events, laboratory results, vital signs, ECG findings and immunogenicity. It defines adverse-event classifications, missing-data handling and ADA incidence, and lists planned tables, figures and listings. Appendices set presentation, calculation, SAS programming and quality-control requirements. Changes from the protocol include revised primary-efficacy analysis wording, added sensitivity and supportive analyses, and revised terminology for secondary efficacy time points.

The study surveyed 100 Bayburt University sports sciences students about the grades 5–8 Physical Education and Sports Curriculum. Respondents generally viewed its learning outcomes positively and said its content was meaningfully ordered. Many were undecided about scientific accuracy and aspects of the content. Most reported that teaching activities used concrete materials, while 60% disagreed that teaching processes used varied methods. The authors recommend further research and more curriculum-focused training for prospective teachers.

Arizona expanded its targeted Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) voucher program to universal eligibility in 2022. The Grand Canyon Institute reports that enrollment reached 87,602 by the third quarter of FY2025. It estimates that nearly three-quarters of universal participants had not attended, or would not have attended, district or charter schools, although about 90% of new universal entrants in FY2025 came from those schools. Participation remains higher in wealthier ZIP codes, but the gap has narrowed. GCI estimates that no more than 40% of ESA students used funds for private-school tuition in FY2023 and that unspent account balances reached $360 million by the end of FY2024. It estimates the universal program’s net state cost at about $350 million in FY2025.

In an August 5, 2016 Form 8-K, Tesla Motors corrected a supplemental footnote in its second-quarter update. The increase in operating lease vehicles not recognized in automotive cost of sales was $241.253 million for the three months ended June 30, 2016, and $600.351 million for the six months, rather than $97.247 million and $456.345 million. Reported cost of revenues and the GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation were unaffected.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Blackwell RTX architecture and GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs. Mega Geometry uses cluster-based acceleration structures and partitioned scene updates to support detailed real-time ray tracing. Blackwell also adds hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres, improves Shader Execution Reordering, and uses an AI Management Processor to schedule GPU workloads.

Other features include 4:2:2 video encoding and decoding, DisplayPort 2.1b, and power-management changes. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and anti-aliasing. Neural shader technologies address materials, texture compression, indirect lighting, skin, and faces. The passage lists specifications for the GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti, and 5070 products, followed by NVIDIA’s legal notices.

The passage describes methods for fabricating three-dimensional vertical NOR-type memory string arrays. A two-step etch forms narrow word-line stacks while reducing ribboning and improving structural stability; sacrificial layers are then replaced with metal word lines. Deposited dielectric, charge-storage, and semiconductor layers form memory transistors with vertical source and drain regions connected to global interconnects. Staircase structures provide word-line contacts. Alternative embodiments use dielectric pillars or stacked masks to support or define the word-line stacks.

Coeur Mining shares fell 0.68% in the most recent session, closing at $8.75. Eight analysts’ price targets averaged $10.25, ranging from $8.50 to $12. Analyst recommendations included one Buy, six Outperform and two Hold. The stock’s 14-period average true range was 0.31, its RSI was 62.01, and its market capitalization was $1.6 billion. Previous-session trading volume was 2.21 million shares, below the 3.42 million-share average.

S&P 500 earnings grew 11% in the second quarter, and more than half of companies beat forecasts. Even so, analysts have cut 2017 and 2018 earnings estimates, though by less than is typical. Goldman Sachs expects 2018 forecasts to fall further, citing overly optimistic expectations for energy earnings. BlackRock found that U.S. stocks reacted weakly to earnings and sales beats, while misses drew sharper sell-offs. Its strategist said second-half earnings growth would be harder to sustain but still expected solid fundamentals and returns.

InnerDancer Performing Arts hosts dances on the second Saturday of each month at Vista’s Gloria McClellan Adult Activity & Resource Center for teens and adults with developmental disabilities. Founded in 2009 by former professional dancer Caroline Bossmeyer, the nonprofit promotes adaptive, inclusive dance. The two-hour events cost $12 and offer opportunities for exercise and socializing.

A January 26, 2001, email compiles articles mentioning Enron. They cover California’s power crisis and its deregulation policies; renewed interest in wind energy, including Enron projects; and Enron’s higher profit forecast and rising share price. Two articles address a dispute over payments and contracts between Enron’s Dabhol Power and Maharashtra’s electricity board. A Houston Chronicle column reports employee concerns about Enron’s new comparative performance-ranking system. Other pieces discuss Wall Street trading, President Bush, and a columnist’s four-month fellowship.
Microsoft’s July 22, 2020 Form 8-K reports that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2020. The release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Chance the Rapper served as grand marshal of Chicago’s Bud Billiken back-to-school parade and helped distribute free backpacks. He previously donated $1 million to Chicago Public Schools.
Russell Vought, director of the Office of Management and Budget, plans to bypass Congress’s budgetary powers to advance the Trump administration’s agenda.

The passage proposes Digital Ecosystems as software systems that use biological principles to address complex, changing problems. Its architecture combines a peer-to-peer network of migrating agents with evolutionary algorithms that assemble agents into applications for local user requests. Network connections adapt according to successful agent migrations, allowing habitats with similar needs to share solutions. The authors emphasize balancing diversity, stability, self-organisation and responsiveness to users. They describe a simulation based on a network of small and medium-sized enterprises to examine whether the system exhibits characteristics of biological ecosystems.

President Donald Trump called the government shutdown an “unprecedented opportunity” to cut federal agencies and projects he associates with Democrats. His administration froze about $18 billion for New York City infrastructure projects and canceled $8 billion for climate projects in Democratic-leaning states. Trump plans to discuss further cuts with budget director Russell Vought, while the White House says federal layoffs could number in the thousands. The shutdown began after Congress failed to pass a funding bill; Democrats seek an extension of enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits.

The lecture develops a nonrelativistic effective field theory for low-momentum two-nucleon scattering using contact interactions. Summing its bubble diagrams reproduces the effective-range expansion without specifying a potential. Measured scattering lengths are unusually large, however, so dimensional power counting must be revised: the leading contact interaction is treated to all orders. Offshell momentum subtraction and power-divergence subtraction both track a power-law divergence and yield this revised counting. The renormalization group then determines how the fine tuning enhances higher-derivative operators. The lecture relates the revised expansion to interacting fixed points, additional symmetries and a deuteron bound-state pole.

The D.C. Circuit vacated the Nuclear Regulatory Commission’s transfer of regulatory authority to New Jersey.
