It found that the NRC had not adequately explained how the transfer would avoid disrupting Shieldalloy’s pending Newfield facility decommissioning process or why retaining federal jurisdiction over its materials was not an appropriate alternative. The court remanded without resolving Shieldalloy’s other compatibility challenges.

The paper evaluates whether large language models can translate physics problems into differential game logic models that capture continuous motion and discrete transitions. Its pipeline uses prompting, parser feedback, and symbolic checks against expected solutions. Across 20 kinematics benchmarks, OpenAI o3 achieved 70% top-five accuracy with few-shot prompting, compared with 45% for GPT-4.1 and 20% for GPT-4o. The six problems no model solved produced models too complex for the checker to verify, highlighting limitations in symbolic reasoning and model representation.

European shares fell for a fifth consecutive day and were set for their biggest weekly loss since November 2016, pressured by rising bond yields, a stronger euro and disappointing bank results. Deutsche Bank, Caixabank and Sabadell shares declined after reporting earnings. Bank of America Merrill Lynch’s “Bull & Bear” indicator issued a sell signal, though its strategists remained constructive on stocks over the longer term. Investors awaited U.S. payroll data.

Researchers collected more than 15,000 minutes of psychiatric interviews from 1,160 outpatients at the Shanghai Mental Health Center to study speech-based markers of depression, anxiety, and other diagnoses. They used a fine-tuned large language model to identify clinical concepts and assessment-scale components in transcripts, then combined these with linguistic and acoustic features. An ensemble machine-learning pipeline predicted diagnostic groups and major symptoms with moderately high accuracy. The authors report that these features may help distinguish diagnostic groups and identify disclosed symptoms.

AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine offloads copying pages and updating mappings between physical memory locations. It requires an enabled IOMMU and supports migration of pages targeted by concurrent DMA, as well as protected SNP guest pages.

PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO migrates pages that may be used by DMA and updates IOMMU host page-table entries; PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST migrates SNP guest pages but does not support DMA to those pages during migration. Commands can process up to 128 pages and are submitted through a driver-managed ring buffer. Software must observe page-state, address-alignment, and access restrictions. Completion and errors are reported through command and per-page statuses, ring-buffer status, and interrupts. The guide also describes driver initialization, performance recommendations, firmware reload, and error handling.

Writing from snowy Suffolk, Mark Valladares criticizes ministers’ suggestions that the UK could renege on its Brexit agreement, citing Ireland’s foreign minister on the commitments made. He previews Liberal Democrat contributions in the House of Lords, an award supporting young by-election campaigners, a piece on the Samaritans, and a musical feature themed “goodbye.” He also invites readers to submit contributions.

Theo Walcott scored in the 51st minute to give Everton a 1-0 Premier League win over Newcastle on Monday. The match was even through the first half. It was Walcott’s third goal for Everton since joining in January.

Former Aberdeen manager Steve Paterson suggested holding Neale “Tattie” Cooper’s funeral at Pittodrie, saying many would want to honour him. Cooper, 54, was part of Aberdeen’s 1983 European Cup Winners’ Cup team and had recently reunited with teammates. He died in hospital on Monday after being admitted to intensive care following a fall. Thousands of fans have paid tribute; the club said it would follow his family’s wishes.

Cover 0 sends every defender not assigned to man coverage on a blitz, pressuring the quarterback to throw quickly while leaving receivers in one-on-one matchups. Offenses can counter with quick routes, favorable matchups, and picks or rubs that create separation. The passage illustrates these approaches with double slants, a running back seam route, a bunch formation, a slant-rub, and motion before a slant-flat play.

FlowMotion ONE is a smartphone video stabilizer that uses sensors and motors to reduce shaking. It can be worn on existing camera mounts or used with a joystick handle or extension pole. Founded in 2015 by four outdoor enthusiasts, FlowMotion raised over $600,000 from more than 2,700 Kickstarter backers against a $30,000 goal. The company has offices in Palo Alto and Trondheim and has received awards in Norway, Finland, Germany and the United States.

A study of Demographic and Health Survey data from 21,322 women in Benin and Cameroon found that 9.5% and 46.1%, respectively, had heard of cervical cancer. Among those who had, 51.4% in Benin and 59.7% in Cameroon had heard of cervical screening. Older age, higher education and internet use were associated with greater cervical cancer awareness in both countries; greater wealth was also associated with awareness in Cameroon. Screening awareness was associated with age, education and some media use. The authors call for stronger awareness programmes and note that the cross-sectional, self-reported data cannot establish causality.

An Oklahoma veterinarian removed 21 pacifiers from Dovey, a dog whose owners noticed missing pacifiers after having a baby. Dovey had eaten less and vomited before an X-ray suggested seven to nine pacifiers. The veterinarian said Dovey was doing well after surgery.

SARS-CoV-2 RNA shed in feces can be detected in wastewater, making wastewater monitoring useful for COVID-19 surveillance. Conventional virus-concentration methods often require large samples and centrifuges, limiting their use in some laboratories. This study evaluates how processing conditions affect RNA detection and compares Nanotrap particle concentration using 10 mL samples with automated processing and with conventional methods using larger samples. Wastewater was collected in Atlanta from June to August 2021 through grab sampling and 24-hour Moore swab passive sampling.

The Wisconsin Poison Center recorded 59 kratom-exposure calls from January 2010 through September 2022, with calls generally increasing over time. About half involved other substances. Agitation and rapid heart rate were the most commonly reported symptoms; seven people were admitted to critical care. One patient died with kratom identified as contributory. The authors recommend better documentation of kratom exposure and education about its use alongside other substances and safe storage around children.

A December 2000 Enron news roundup reports that lenders agreed to lower interest rates on loans to its Dabhol power project in India, while critics challenged the project’s costs and agreement. Other articles cover rising natural gas prices, applications to supply electricity in Texas, The New Power Company’s certification to market gas in Georgia, and competition among online energy-trading platforms, including EnronOnline and Dynegydirect.

In this 48-week open-label trial, 1,112 patients taking apixaban for nonvalvular atrial fibrillation were randomized to standard information or additional education. Adherence was measured electronically, with an interim analysis at 24 weeks. Investigator-directed treatment interruptions were excluded; interruptions exceeding 30 consecutive days counted as permanent discontinuation.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and was up 7.8% year to date, but fell 1.6% on August’s first trading day. The passage describes a continuing market uptrend alongside early warnings: weakening short-term technical indicators, seasonally rising volatility and credit spreads, and increasing concentration in tech stocks. Medium- and longer-term trend indicators remained healthy.

In a reader mailbag, Ben Baby says a blowout loss to No. 1 Alabama would not make Florida a must-win for Texas A&M coach Kevin Sumlin, but it would leave less room for error as A&M tries to finish 8-4. He says A&M has not announced throwback uniforms, though its field will honor former coach Gene Stallings and the 1967 team. He also answers questions about fall weddings, stadium music, North Texas football, Arsenal and burritos.

A suspected Swiss spy arrested in Germany was under investigation in Switzerland over stolen banking data. An oversight body rejected allegations that Swiss prosecutors helped him spy or exposed his identity in case files. Whether he was authorized to spy on German tax inspectors remains unclear. The Swiss government confirmed that its intelligence service assisted a related investigation until May 2014. Parliamentary committees are reviewing the case.

Two-year-old Laylah Washington died after being shot in the head while riding with her mother and brothers in Memphis. Her mother reported being followed after an argument with another driver in a parking lot. No arrests have been made; police are seeking a black Chevrolet Impala.

Dustin Brown and Anze Kopitar credit their team’s resilience to years together, mutual trust and close relationships off the ice. They say the team has repeatedly overcome poor starts, though it would prefer to avoid them, and is focused on the next game rather than reflecting on past success. Brown says its style makes it difficult to beat in a playoff series. They also discuss Drew Doughty’s growing leadership, Gaborik’s smooth transition into the group and Justin’s focus in big games. Brown says a matchup between New York and Los Angeles heightens interest in hockey.

The passage describes wireless communication methods for managing duplicated data transmission across two paths of a radio bearer. A terminal can report the data volume on one path to reduce signaling overhead, while a radio access network can control whether duplication is activated. The described implementations also address path selection, message formats, handling data when duplication is deactivated, and communications apparatuses that perform these methods.

Microsoft reported revenue of $37.2 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2020, up 12% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 25% to $15.9 billion, and net income rose 30% to $13.9 billion, or $1.82 per diluted share. Revenue grew in all three segments, led by 20% growth in Intelligent Cloud; commercial cloud revenue rose 31% to $15.2 billion. The COVID-19 pandemic increased demand for cloud services, Surface, and Gaming while reducing search advertising spending. A change in equipment useful-life estimates increased quarterly net income by $763 million. Microsoft also agreed to acquire ZeniMax Media for $7.5 billion in cash.

Britain’s FTSE 100 fell 0.2 percent on Friday and was on track for its worst week in nearly six months. BT shares dropped more than 5 percent after earnings raised concerns about growth and its pension scheme, while AstraZeneca fell 1.7 percent on a disappointing profit outlook. Mining and oil shares gained as commodity prices rose. Mid-cap outsourcer Capita rebounded more than 5 percent after a Morgan Stanley upgrade, following a profit warning and dividend suspension earlier in the week.

HMP Northward holds more than 220 men despite a capacity of 212. Authorities plan to move risk-assessed, low-risk inmates to a separate section of the Immigration Detention Centre, potentially freeing about 22 places. Prison Director Steven Barrett said overcrowding threatens safety and access to rehabilitation, and called the transfer the most viable short-term option. Officials say they are reviewing security measures to keep inmates separate from migrants. The centre is already at capacity, and nine asylum-seeking detainees began a hunger strike this weekend.

Environment Canada issued a special weather statement for Edmonton and areas south and east to the Saskatchewan border, warning that funnel clouds could form Wednesday afternoon. They are usually not dangerous near the ground, but could intensify into weak landspout tornadoes. Reported sightings included one near a Namao school, where students were gathered inside as conditions were monitored. Environment Canada advised people to prepare to take shelter if funnel clouds develop nearby.

Melissa Jennings alleged that UNC soccer coaches made inappropriate sexual comments and inquiries while she was on the team. The court found that the alleged conduct did not meet the standards for her Title IX, constitutional sexual-harassment, or privacy claims. It granted the defendants summary judgment, denied Jennings’ motions to strike the amended answer and affidavit exhibits, and denied the defendants’ motion to submit evidence under seal.

Treasury minister Mel Stride said fish fingers would be safe during Brexit talks after Labour’s Mel Onn urged continued customs arrangements to prevent delays to Great Grimsby’s time-sensitive fish-processing industry and protect its 5,000 jobs.

The passage describes a data intake and query system for analyzing large volumes of machine-generated data. Forwarders collect data, while indexers parse it into timestamped events, store it, and create indexes to support searches. Retaining raw data and applying field-extraction rules at search time lets users refine how they analyze events. The system can operate on-premises or in the cloud and can search external data through processes that translate queries and return results. Inverted indexes also support filtering, grouping, and counting events by criteria such as time, host, source, and source type.

The agreement governs software use; unenforceable provisions do not invalidate the rest. California and U.S. federal law apply, disputes belong in Santa Clara County courts, exports must comply with applicable laws, and amendments or waivers require signed writing.

A federal judge in Illinois dismissed a lawsuit alleging that the College Board and 40 private colleges conspired to inflate tuition by considering both parents’ finances when awarding aid. The judge found that the plaintiffs had not plausibly alleged an agreement among the institutions.

This study reviews information technology and management strategies for language education in Indonesia, identifying 151 strongly relevant Scopus papers. It highlights challenges including limited teacher training, unequal access to devices and internet, reduced student interaction, and difficulties with remote assessment. Automatic speech recognition, task-based activities, and games can support pronunciation, vocabulary, and engagement. The study recommends teacher development, accessible digital platforms, language-support tools, mobile learning, and inclusive IT policies. It concludes that technology can improve language education when it supports teaching methods and addresses students’ needs.

At a human-trafficking training session in Oshakati, Prosecutor-General Martha Imalwa said trafficking generates $32 billion annually worldwide and cited suspected cases involving children in Namibia. Her office sought UN assistance to train officials to detect, investigate and prosecute trafficking and assist victims. Police Inspector-General Sebastian Ndeitunga said police recorded 25 cases from 2010 to 2017, with 14 still under investigation.

In a randomized, placebo-controlled trial among healthy adults exposed to SARS-CoV-2 within 72 hours, SA58 nasal spray reduced laboratory-confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 by an estimated 80.82% and SARS-CoV-2 infection by 61.83%. Adverse events were mild, with no serious events reported. The study ended before reaching its target enrollment, and follow-up was short. The authors recommend further evaluation in high-risk populations.

The passage describes an airway management system intended to assist rescuers during intubation, including rapid sequence intubation. Sensors measure airway gases, airflow, physiological signals and positioning information so a monitoring device can identify procedure steps and provide context-sensitive guidance, timers and alerts. After endotracheal tube placement, the system can assess whether ventilation reaches the lungs using measurements such as end-tidal CO2, transthoracic impedance and acoustic signals. It can also compare later measurements with initial or updated baselines to monitor whether the tube remains properly placed. Feedback may appear on a patient monitor, portable device or wearable device.

California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed SB 53, requiring major AI companies to disclose plans for mitigating risks from advanced models and report serious safety incidents. The law also protects whistleblowers, provides for civil penalties, and begins development of a public computing cluster for AI research. Supporters say it advances transparency without placing disproportionate burdens on startups. Critics argue its penalties are weak or that state-by-state regulation could hinder smaller firms and entrench larger companies.

Kevin Love faces an uncertain start to his fourth straight NBA Finals with Cleveland after suffering a concussion against Boston. His season also included a broken hand and a public disclosure that he has long dealt with anxiety and panic attacks. Love said criticism and trade rumors since joining the Cavaliers had made him guarded, but sharing his struggles brought messages of support and helped him connect with others. Despite the challenges, he said his time in Cleveland has been worth it.
Black Sabbath guitarist Tony Iommi announced his BIMM Birmingham Scholarship at a May 25 Q&A and emphasized perseverance in music.

Researchers at the University of California, Irvine and other institutions developed a satellite-based drought severity index using NASA GRACE gravity data. Unlike assessments based mainly on precipitation, it incorporates changes in terrestrial water storage, including groundwater. The index provides globally consistent monitoring, including where ground measurements are difficult to obtain. Its 2002–2014 data set is planned for extension, and U.S. comparisons showed significant agreement with other drought indices.

Tropical Storm Nate was forecast to cross the eastern Yucatan Peninsula Friday evening, enter the Gulf of Mexico and approach the northern Gulf Coast Saturday evening. Forecasters expected it to become a hurricane Saturday night into Sunday. Pensacola was within the forecast cone, and Escambia and Santa Rosa counties faced possible heavy rain, flooding, tornadoes and tropical-storm-force winds. A tropical storm watch covered much of Northwest Florida’s Gulf Coast. Several schools, events and public areas announced closures or cancellations. Florida declared a state of emergency in 29 counties, while officials urged residents to gather supplies and follow local updates.

A May 24, 2001, collection of news articles covers energy markets and Enron. California regulators reported evidence of electricity price manipulation, while generators disputed the allegations. Brazil sought a 20 percent cut in power use amid shortages. India appointed a federal representative to negotiations over Enron’s Dabhol power dispute; panel chairman Madhav Godbole withdrew his resignation after receiving government support. Other reports examine a possible shift in U.S. Senate control, Central European gas markets, Endesa’s planned asset sale and Dynegy’s interest in acquisitions.

The summer box office was dominated by three well-received superhero films: *Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2*, *Wonder Woman* and *Spider-Man: Homecoming*. Other genres produced isolated hits, including *Despicable Me 3*, *Girls Trip*, *Dunkirk* and *Baby Driver*, while many animated films, comedies and big-budget franchises disappointed. The author argues that this pattern raises concerns about variety at multiplexes, though it reflects only one summer.

Long-short equity strategies buy stocks expected to rise and short stocks expected to fall, seeking returns from both positions while limiting risk. Hedge funds often use a long bias, though losses remain possible and leverage increases risk. The passage gives portfolio examples and describes a Coca-Cola–Pepsi backtest with a 3.8% annual return and about 11% maximum drawdown.

Ryan ToysReview, launched in 2015 when Ryan was four, features him testing toys. By 2017, the channel had over 10 million subscribers and reportedly earned $11 million, placing him among Forbes’ ten highest-paid YouTube stars. His parents say they will stop making the videos when Ryan no longer enjoys them.

The study presents an AI-assisted inverse-design workflow for two-dimensional Dion–Jacobson perovskites. It uses compact, invertible fingerprints to represent organic spacers, machine learning to predict energy levels, synthesis-feasibility screening, and DFT validation. Starting from 21 reported spacers, the researchers explored millions of hypothetical candidates and identified 56 promising spacers with targeted energy-level alignments. The predicted perovskites have not been experimentally validated, and the feasibility screening does not capture all synthesis conditions.

Most federal judges who responded to a New York Times survey criticized the Supreme Court’s use of emergency orders in cases involving Trump administration policies. Of 65 respondents, 47 said the Court had not used the emergency docket appropriately, and 48 said lower courts lacked sufficient guidance. Among 54 who answered, 42 said the orders harmed public perception of the judiciary. The newspaper acknowledged that respondents might not represent all federal judges; a published critique argued that dissatisfied judges may have been more likely to respond.

Quarter Circle Games announced The Peterson Case, a first-person horror game for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC. Set near Roswell in 1947, it follows Detective Franklin Reinhardt as he investigates a missing family and an unearthly presence. No release date was announced.

The passage describes a PGA848 circuit driving an ADS8860 16-bit, 1MSPS SAR ADC from single-ended or differential inputs. The PGA848 uses ±15V input-stage and 5.3V output-stage supplies; a REF6250 provides the ADC’s 5V reference, while an OPA192 buffers a 2.5V midscale voltage for the PGA848 REF pin. Three filters address input interference, bandwidth, and ADC charge kickback. Nominal bandwidth is 318kHz, with –0.1dB flatness to 41kHz. The passage also gives REF-buffer stability, power-supply, and PCB-layout recommendations, warns that supplies above 40V damage the device, and lists simulation tools, documentation, and product notices.

Zacks Investment Research upgraded Teck Resources from “hold” to “buy” and set a $25 price target, implying 8.84% upside from its then-current price. The stock had an average “Buy” rating and a $31.18 consensus target. Teck reported quarterly earnings of $0.73 per share and revenue of $2.82 billion, both above analyst estimates. Institutional investors and hedge funds owned 46.80% of its shares.

After federal agents destroyed Diane Monson’s medical marijuana plants, she and Angel Raich challenged Congress’ authority to regulate their in-state activity, which California law permitted. The Supreme Court ruled 6–3 that federal regulation was necessary to protect the interstate marijuana ban. Dissenting justices warned that the decision left little meaningful limit on federal power over local activity. Raich later lost another challenge. Marijuana has since been widely legalized by states, while its federal classification remains unchanged.

After three women who accused President Trump of sexual assault shared their stories on television, a reporter asked Sarah Huckabee Sanders whether she had experienced sexual harassment. Sanders declined to discuss her personal history but said she and the White House empathized with those who had.

This Texas Instruments passage describes features of the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 microcontrollers. It covers a calibrated temperature sensor, configurable internal and external voltage references, comparators, a DAC, AES and key-storage security features, a random-number generator, and CRC and math accelerators. Communication peripherals include UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD. It also describes real-time clocks, watchdogs, timers, analog connections, pin functions, serial-wire debugging, and a UART- or I2C-based bootloader.

The passage gives application guidance for supply decoupling, reset and oscillator components, the VCORE capacitor, and open-drain pullups. It also outlines factory identification data, development resources, documentation, revision changes, packaging information, and TI’s product disclaimers.

The passage highlights the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, which offers unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases within three months, and a 0% introductory APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It also provides cell phone protection of up to $600, subject to a deductible. The passage lists Capital One Quicksilver and Citi Double Cash offers for comparison. Motley Fool Money discloses that it receives advertising compensation, which may affect offer placement but not its product ratings.

Flu activity remains high in 42 states, and 53 children have died from influenza this season. H3N2 is the most common strain; a Canadian report found the vaccine 17 percent effective against it. Health officials still recommend vaccination for everyone six months and older and prompt antiviral treatment for those who get sick.

The University of Minnesota Morris occupies the site of a former Indian boarding school, where Native children were pressured to abandon their languages and cultures. A former boys’ dormitory now houses the campus’s multi-ethnic resource center. In an April 11 talking circle, Native students discussed the school’s lasting trauma, including its effects on their families and their experiences in higher education. A state-law tuition waiver for Native students dates to the land’s transfer to Minnesota. About 20 percent of Morris’s roughly 1,800 students are Native American.

The passage describes a head-mounted display’s passthrough feature, which uses camera images and a 3D model to show users their physical surroundings from their own viewpoints. Inaccurate depth estimates can cause physical and virtual objects to occlude each other incorrectly. The proposed approach identifies objects in camera images with instance segmentation masks, assigns each object a representative depth, and gives its padded border a farther depth. Rendering uses these values to improve occlusion. The passage also describes depth estimation using a video encoder for resource-limited devices.

Bitcoin rose more than a third to about $9,300, with buy orders accounting for over 92% of market activity. Analysts said easing regulatory concerns and strong buying pressure could support further gains. They identified $10,000 as a key resistance level; one forecast put Bitcoin at $11,500 if it breaks above that threshold.

A Karnataka education department survey of over 36 lakh Class 4–9 students found that more than 10 lakh in government and aided schools need remedial classes, including about 4.5 lakh in mathematics and science. Teachers have been given remedial measures and will counsel students when distributing marks cards.

The Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 describes SD Memory Card capacity classes, interfaces, bus protocols, commands, registers, performance classes, and hardware requirements. It defines SDSC cards up to 2 GB, SDHC cards above 2 GB through 32 GB, and SDXC cards above 32 GB through 2 TB. Cards may be read-only or read/write, with user and protected areas. The host controls card initialization and data transfers through commands and responses. The specification also covers UHS-I, UHS-II, SPI mode, content protection, write protection, cache, self-maintenance, and command queues.

The speaker says Ryan Smyth embodies the Oilers and should remain with the team. The Oilers believed their core could succeed in the playoffs, so they added players including Michael Peca, Chris Pronger and Dwayne Roloson, whose experience and save percentage addressed a need in goal. Despite a late-season slump, the speaker praises the team’s defensive play and expects an exciting series against Carolina. He also recalls Ray Whitney’s childhood ties to the Oilers and says local fans follow playoff hockey beyond their own team.

Auckland Airport resumed international terminal screening after Police and Aviation Security located a woman whose knife had been detected during screening before she entered the terminal. The breach caused long queues and delayed at least four flights.

A study of malaria samples collected in southern Zambia from 2018 to 2023 found that the *Plasmodium falciparum* Pfk13 P441L mutation, a candidate marker of artemisinin resistance, rose from 0% prevalence in 2018 to 7.2% in 2023. It appeared in 6% of 501 samples overall, exceeding the WHO’s 5% threshold for concern. The mutation’s effect on treatment remains uncertain; the authors call for therapeutic studies, genomic analysis, and continued surveillance.

U.S. stocks rose Monday after a volatile week, while New York Fed President William Dudley said another rate increase was likely in 2017. Eurozone factory output fell, Chinese data signaled a slowdown, and Japan reported stronger-than-expected growth. Canada outlined its NAFTA goals, and oil and gold prices declined.
Nintendo announced Mario Kart Tour, a smartphone app expected to launch between April 2018 and March 2019. The company has not shared further details about the game.

A survey of 93 special education teachers in rural remote Midwestern districts identified financial incentives, support, job-related conditions, and rural recruitment initiatives as factors in attracting and retaining teachers. Financial incentives were cited most often for attraction (96%), while support was cited most often for retention (70%). Teachers who reported greater support and job satisfaction were more likely to plan to stay. Respondents also recommended reducing paperwork and caseloads, providing relevant professional development, and recruiting local candidates. The study’s small geographic scope and reliance on self-reported data limit how broadly its findings may apply.

Tyreek Hill’s surgery to repair a dislocated knee and multiple torn ligaments, including his ACL, went well, his agent said. He is not expected to need another surgery and aims to return at the start of the 2026 season. The Dolphins must replace his production after a 1-3 start.

The speaker hopes to play a tight road game and return with home-ice advantage. They say the team must move past being outplayed and acknowledge it failed to execute despite expecting the opponent’s strong start.

BAE Systems agreed to sell Qatar 24 Typhoon fighter jets, including training and support, for £5 billion. The broader £6 billion deal includes missiles and guided bombs and is the largest Typhoon export agreement in a decade.
USD/JPY rose to 114.17 after North Korea’s missile test, then eased. The Nikkei gained 0.5%. Traders expected consolidation, with bids at 113.85–75 and offers at 114.20–30. No U.S. data was due.

Thomas Fisher sought an accounting from Merrill Lynch partners for $6,500 paid to Fuller, Rodney & Co. in commodity transactions, arguing that Merrill Lynch had succeeded to that firm’s liabilities. The court found that Merrill Lynch assumed only selected customer accounts, not Fisher’s, and that Fisher offered no competent evidence of a merger or assumed liability. The record showed no court ruling denying his proposed discovery request. Holding that summary judgment was available in the accounting action, the appellate court affirmed judgment for defendant Homer Hargrave.

An online survey of Tokyo metropolitan residents found that longer commutes were associated with insomnia and daytime sleepiness, while smaller homes were associated with insomnia, even after adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic factors. For a 95 m² home, commutes exceeding 52 minutes reached the study’s insomnia cutoff.

Microsoft’s fiscal 2016 Form 10-K describes its strategy to develop productivity services, cloud platforms, and more personal computing. It reports three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Microsoft operated in over 190 countries, spent $12.0 billion on research and development, and employed approximately 114,000 people as of June 30, 2016. The filing also describes phone-business restructuring and risks involving competition, cloud execution, cybersecurity, regulation, intellectual property, and global operations.

Iso is a downhill running play in which a fullback leads through a gap to block a linebacker while the tailback follows. Its strengths are quick, direct yardage and simple execution, but it depends on powerful linemen and a capable fullback. Blocking assignments vary against 3-4 and 4-3 defenses. Variations include shotgun Iso and weakside Iso.

A soccer defender facing a ball carrier should stay goal side in a balanced stance, with one foot forward, knees bent, and weight on the balls of the feet. This helps the defender react, slow or redirect the attacker, and prepare to tackle. On the right side of the field, the left foot generally leads; on the left, the right foot leads. This positioning aims to force attackers toward the sideline. Practice should cover all three field positions and progress from slow movements without a ball to faster movements with one. Defenders must not use their arms to impede opponents.

NASA’s Suomi NPP satellite captured an infrared image of the northern lights over northern Canada on December 22. Auroras occur when charged particles from the sun interact with Earth’s magnetic field and atmospheric gases, producing light of different colors. The strongest displays occur roughly every 11 years.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K on January 29, 2015, announcing its fourth-quarter and full-year 2014 financial results. The filing includes the earnings press release and information about non-GAAP financial measures as exhibits.

GBPJPY quotes the British pound against the Japanese yen and is a minor cross pair formed from GBPUSD and USDJPY. Its movements can sometimes correlate strongly with USDJPY, increasing the risk of holding both positions. The passage identifies the Asian and London sessions as the best times for intraday trading. It describes forex trading as difficult and recommends backtesting strategies for positive expectancy and diversification. A backtest put GBPJPY’s average daily movement in 2022 at around 175 pips.

Microsoft reported revenue of $32.5 billion for the quarter ended December 31, 2018, up 12% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 18% to $10.3 billion, and net income was $8.4 billion, compared with a $6.3 billion loss in the prior-year quarter that included a substantial tax charge. Commercial cloud revenue rose 48% to $9.0 billion. Revenue increased across all three business segments. Microsoft also acquired GitHub during the quarter in a $7.5 billion stock transaction.

The passage explains how to use the Sansa Fuze’s thumbwheel, connect it to a computer, transfer and play music, audiobooks, videos, and photos, and use FM radio and voice recording. It covers playlists, media conversion, settings, file deletion, firmware updates, and troubleshooting. It warns that disconnecting during a transfer can damage the player and that formatting deletes its content. The final sections provide support information, a one-year limited warranty, and software license terms governing use, transfer, warranties, and liability.

The study compares eight educational leadership models, outlining their strengths and limitations. It concludes that no single style can address changing school needs. Instead, principals should combine structured management, a focus on teaching and learning, innovation, shared decision-making, ethical practice and situational flexibility to improve schools.

Malacañang said President Rodrigo Duterte would investigate allegations against Development Academy of the Philippines President Elba Cruz, including improper restructuring, threats of mass termination and frequent foreign travel. Spokesman Harry Roque said the Presidential Anti-Corruption Commission was still awaiting appointments. Duterte also planned to fire urban poor commission officials over alleged unnecessary trips and missed meetings.

Douglas Kneale, the University of Windsor’s provost, will become interim president and vice-chancellor on July 1, after Alan Wildeman’s term ends June 30. He will serve until the board selects a successor; the presidential search committee will resume its work in the coming year.

The SD Physical Layer Simplified Specification defines card capacities—SDSC up to 2 GB, SDHC above 2 GB through 32 GB, and SDXC above 32 GB through 2 TB—along with voltage ranges, bus speeds, performance classes, and read-only and read/write cards. It describes host-controlled communication, command and response formats, card initialization, and block read, write, erase, discard, and full-user-area logical erase operations. UHS-I uses 1.8 V signaling for higher-speed modes and reaches 104 MB/s; UHS-II modes reach 624 MB/s. The specification also covers write protection, password-based locking, and optional Card Ownership Protection using a Force Erase Password.

Ipswich mayoral by-election candidates have received almost $60,000 in donations under new rules requiring disclosure within seven business days. Andrew Antoniolli has received $46,400, including the campaign’s largest gift, $15,000 from Plencove. Paul Tully has declared $10,968, but has not disclosed who funded two billboards. Greens candidate Brett Morrissey has received $1,330 from local supporters; most other candidates have no declared donations.

The passage describes methods for making electronically generated binaural sound seem to originate from a sound source, such as an image on a display, even when the sound is processed to a different location. For nearby sources, it proposes using far-field head-related transfer functions to position sound behind or near the source, often along the listener’s line of sight. It also describes adjusting volume, tracking device and head movement, and assigning separate sound positions to multiple sources. Portable devices can switch between binaural and mono or stereo sound in response to detected actions, including rotation, changes in facial detection, sensor obstruction, distance changes, and changes in audio output or battery state.

The study investigates whether exchange bias in RuO₂/Fe heterostructures indicates intrinsic altermagnetism. Neutron diffraction found no detectable magnetic ordering in sputtered RuO₂ films. Reflectometry and microscopy instead identified field-history-sensitive magnetic moments and an iron-oxide reaction layer, including magnetite, at the RuO₂/Fe interface. Exchange bias appeared in Fe-based samples but not RuO₂/Ni samples; it also appeared in Fe/Ru samples without RuO₂. The authors conclude that interfacial chemical reactions, rather than intrinsic magnetic ordering in RuO₂, drive the observed exchange bias.

The lecture reviews orthonormal expansions in infinite-dimensional L2 spaces, where successive projections converge to a projection and the residual is orthogonal to the expansion functions. It discusses Fourier-series functions and prolate spheroidal functions, which concentrate energy within specified time and frequency intervals.

The lecture then turns to communication systems, separating discrete encoding from modulation. Modulation maps symbols to numerical signals and then to waveforms. Pulse-amplitude modulation (PAM) uses real-valued signal constellations and a filter to form waveforms; standard PAM signals are equally spaced around zero. Delay and attenuation are treated separately from waveform design.

To recover transmitted signals without intersymbol interference, the receiver filters and samples the waveform. Nyquist’s criterion requires the combined transmitter and receiver filter to equal one at zero and zero at every other sampling interval. Filters with suitable band-edge symmetry satisfy this criterion. A raised-cosine filter provides a practical alternative to the slowly decaying sinc function.
Strange Brigade launches August 28 on PS4, Xbox One and PC. The 1–4-player supernatural adventure offers a free weapons pack with pre-orders and a Deluxe Edition with a season pass.

BioSafe Systems hired Carleton Birk as operations manager at its East Hartford headquarters and four technical sales representatives: Tenaya Becker in Southern California, Ester Mastronardi in Canada, Patrick Clark in Eastern Pennsylvania, and Kyle Pickles in Central California. The new hires bring experience in manufacturing operations, horticultural sales, agricultural products, agronomy, and water-treatment services.

The paper develops a probabilistic model of how listeners comprehend conversational implicatures under relevance theory. It distinguishes explicatures, derived by enriching an utterance’s logical form, from implicit premises and conclusions supplied through context. The model uses ProbLog to represent contextual knowledge and evaluate interpretations against listeners’ expectations of relevance. It rejects interpretations that fail those expectations, then compares the remaining interpretations using changes in proposition probabilities and the size of their knowledge bases. Candidate interpretations are constructed manually, and the model focuses on listeners rather than speakers.

The coach said a lopsided win boosted confidence but counted as only one win in a series his team still trailed. He praised the penalty kill and said the power play maintained momentum. He expressed concern for Horton, who was in the hospital after what he described as a late blindside hit, and said the league should address it. He rejected some of his own players’ conduct in an emotional, physical game. Looking ahead, he emphasized better puck management, fewer turnovers, rest after travel, and using the home crowd’s support.

Mary Meeker’s annual survey found global internet usage growth slowed to 7% from 12%, while smartphone sales stalled. The internet has 3.6 billion users. Voice technology improved, and e-commerce grew 16% in 2017 to reach 13% of retail sales. She also reported historically low unemployment and 7 million job openings.

Georgia Institute of Technology researchers demonstrated ransomware that could take over a simulated water treatment plant, shut valves, increase chlorine levels and display false readings. No ransomware attacks on industrial process controls have been reported, but researchers warn that weak passwords, security policies and connected systems could leave facilities vulnerable. They recommend stronger passwords, fewer connections and intrusion monitoring.

Researchers trained three convolutional neural networks to classify CT, MRI, PET and X-ray images drawn from 102 datasets. ResNet-18 performed best on unseen datasets, achieving 96% accuracy and 86.17% balanced accuracy. Performance was weaker on some bone X-ray datasets. The authors propose extending the approach to 3D scans. The preprint has not been peer reviewed.

The passage explains how to connect and transfer files to a Sansa c200, use Sansa Media Converter for photos, and safely disconnect the player. It covers music and photo playback, FM radio, voice and radio recording, playback options, and device settings. Troubleshooting addresses supported formats, transfer modes, playback rights, firmware, and song information. It also provides technical support details, a one-year limited warranty, software license and digital-rights notices, and disposal instructions.

This collection of July 2001 reports covers several energy and economic issues. One article argues that California’s public utilities charged the state more for electricity than private suppliers; another describes a legislative investigation and Enron’s challenge to subpoenas. Enron sought a government buyout of its Dabhol stake after the company rejected Indian states’ proposed power prices. Reliant and Peoples Energy reported higher quarterly profits. Other reports describe venture-capital interest in energy technology, Brazil’s electricity conservation plan, an analyst’s positive long-term view of Enron, and Buenos Aires’ plan to pay some workers with a new provincial currency.

Korea requested Chinese troops during a southern rebellion, but Korean forces captured the rebel leaders and retook Chon-ju before the Chinese troops arrived. Japan also sent troops, saying they were needed to protect its subjects and legation. After the rebellion was suppressed, Korea asked China to withdraw, but China and Japan each refused to leave while the other remained. Sill and European representatives protested the reported Japanese encampment on Chemulpo’s foreign settlement. Amid fears of bloodshed, the United States instructed Sill to work to preserve peace, and an American admiral promised to remain until tensions eased.

The passage argues that mass formal schooling harms many students through personal violence and systemic structures, economic hierarchies, and curricula that foster obedience and dependence. Educational pacifism holds that such harm is unjust because most students are innocent and should not be treated merely as means to educational ends. The author presents Montessori education as an alternative centered on freedom, harmonious activity, and lasting peace, while noting that Montessori schools can reproduce harmful practices through testing, coercion, and inequality. The author urges Montessori educators to reject educational harm in both principle and practice.

The DAX 40 is Germany’s main equity index, comprising 40 large or liquid stocks; it expanded from 30 companies in 2021. The passage describes futures, CFDs and ETFs as ways to trade it. DAX futures offer full, Mini and Micro contracts, but their leverage creates margin-call and loss risks. The passage highlights the DAX’s liquidity and different trading hours and movements from US markets as potential diversification benefits. It reports backtests of two overnight futures strategies, averaging 0.22% and 0.23% per trade, respectively.

The Blue Jays and Yankees begin their best-of-five ALDS on Oct. 4. Toronto earned the top seed on a tiebreaker and won their season series 8-5. Games 1, 2 and 5 are scheduled for Toronto; Games 3 and 4 for New York. Fox and FS1 will air the first two games, respectively; broadcasts for Games 3–5 are undetermined.

The lecture introduces underactuated robotics as the study of systems whose control inputs cannot produce acceleration in every direction. Tedrake contrasts conservative, energy-intensive control in ASIMO and aircraft with passive walkers and animals that exploit their dynamics. Using a two-link arm, he explains that a fully actuated system can use feedback to replace its nonlinear dynamics with simpler ones. Removing the shoulder motor makes the arm underactuated and turns control into a harder problem. Walking, jumping, flying and some manipulation tasks also lack complete control authority. The course will develop models and control methods for these systems, progressing from pendulums and walking robots to higher-dimensional systems, uncertainty and unknown models. Its tools include optimal control, dynamic programming, policy search, motion planning and reinforcement learning.

Education researchers see cautious signs of recovery after deep federal cuts: the Education Department plans to reinstate 20 research contracts, 10 regional education labs have a temporary reprieve, and officials are seeking input on modernizing the Institute of Education Sciences. Hiring for assessment jobs has also raised hopes. Researchers warn, however, that severe staffing shortages and reduced reporting could undermine data quality and the usefulness of national tests.

Cement and real estate shares rose 2%–5% despite a weaker market after Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced incentives for rural and urban housing following demonetization. At 10:13 am, the Sensex was down 0.39%. The accompanying table shows most listed stocks had fallen between November 8 and December 26, then gained by December 30.

Saving a penalty kick is difficult, but training can improve a goalkeeper’s chances. Goalkeepers must understand Law 14, including where they may stand and how violations affect the kick. The passage recommends coaching that combines physical practice, mental preparation, observation of kickers’ cues and research into opponents’ tendencies. It generally favors waiting to read and react rather than diving early. Coaches should support goalkeepers and prepare teammates for rebounds and other outcomes, since play can continue after a penalty kick. Any attempt to unsettle a kicker must remain within the rules.

Tor developer Nick Mathewson explains how Tor uses volunteer relays and layered encryption to help users separate their identities from their online activities. He distinguishes anonymity from unlinkability and unobservability, and describes uses by individuals, researchers, companies, and law enforcement, as well as misuse.

Tor prioritizes interactive web use, so it does not conceal traffic timing and volume well enough to defeat an attacker observing both ends of a connection. Its clients build circuits through relays, while directory authorities publish a shared, signed list of available nodes. Hidden services let people publish content without revealing the server’s location.

Mathewson discusses challenges including abusive traffic, websites that block Tor users, applications that reveal identifying information, hostile exit nodes, denial-of-service attacks, and censorship. He outlines work on hidden services, cryptography, path selection, congestion control, network scaling, and defenses against traffic analysis.

Metagenomic binning groups DNA fragments by genome, often using embeddings derived from k-mer profiles. The passage argues that deterministic embeddings struggle when sequences are shared across genomes or distinct sequences have similar k-mer profiles. It proposes UNCERTAINGEN, a lightweight probabilistic approach that represents each fragment as a distribution to capture this ambiguity. The authors describe a contrastive-learning framework with closed-form pairwise likelihoods, present theoretical results on distinguishability and uncertainty, and report improvements over deterministic k-mer and language-model embeddings on real metagenomic datasets.

A scoping review examined barriers and facilitators to belonging in graduate occupational therapy, physical therapy, and medical education. Of 202 identified studies, nine were included. The review found three recurring factors: institutional environments, relationships with faculty and peers, and students’ perceptions of their identities and academic abilities. Bias, microaggressions, and unwelcoming spaces can undermine belonging, particularly for students from historically minoritized identities. The authors recommend more accessible and representative spaces, supportive mentoring, and efforts to address bias. They also call for more research specific to occupational therapy education.

Jeff Davis Parish schools began the year Friday after summer preparations that included campus work, staff meetings and bus-driver training. Educators planned to use the existing curriculum to address students’ academic needs while meeting state requirements. The parish’s on-time graduation rate rose three percentage points to 92.5%, ranking fourth in the state.

An early power-play goal and Donovan’s second goal gave the team confidence after a poor previous game. The speaker describes Jarome as a leader on and off the ice, whether or not he wears the captain’s “C.” Players also recognize contributions such as Saprykin blocking a shot and turning it into a goal with a green hard hat awarded in the dressing room.

To limit St. Louis, the team aims to deny him time and space. The speaker praises Kiprusoff’s consistency and his response to a difficult loss, while wins over Colorado strengthened belief that the team could beat top opponents. Against a strong forecheck, the team needs to move the puck out of its defensive zone more effectively. The speaker credits Darryl with holding players accountable, preventing long slumps, building mental toughness and adding valuable players, while emphasizing the team’s shared effort and quiet leaders.

Actress Allison Mack was released on a $5 million bond to await trial on sex trafficking and conspiracy charges. Prosecutors allege she recruited women into a secret society within Keith Raniere’s Nxivm organization. Mack has pleaded not guilty and is under house arrest, with no contact allowed with Nxivm associates. Raniere, also charged with sex trafficking, denies harming anyone.

The Supreme Court declined to hear Alex Jones’ appeal in a Sandy Hook defamation case and a challenge by Colorado parents to school practices concerning children’s gender identity. It also denied review in cases involving Section 230 immunity for Grindr, alleged juror misconduct in a death penalty case, and California fines imposed without a jury trial. Justices issued separate statements about the Colorado, death penalty, and jury-trial cases. The court sought the solicitor general’s views in two other cases and added no cases to its oral argument calendar in Tuesday’s order list.

This study evaluated reinforcement-learning agents for autonomous navigation during mechanical thrombectomy across five tasks and ten patient-specific vascular simulations. The world model-based TD-MPC2 agent achieved a 65% mean success rate, compared with 37% for the model-free SAC agent, but took longer to complete procedures. The authors conclude that further optimization and testing are needed before clinical deployment.

Los Angeles County agreed to pay nearly $12 million to the family of cyclist Milton Olin Jr., who was fatally struck by a sheriff’s deputy. The family’s attorneys allege the deputy was distracted and want prosecutors to reconsider the case.

SCS General Contractors sought payment for work on three Mississippi restaurants operated by bankrupt Barnhill’s Buffets. It claimed equitable liens on the leaseholds and landlords’ property interests and alleged that Dynamic Management was Barnhill’s alter ego. The bankruptcy court granted summary judgment to Wells Fargo, finding that any equitable lien on the leaseholds was extinguished when Barnhill’s filed for bankruptcy and that no lien attached to the landlords’ property interests without their written consent. The court ordered the escrowed sale proceeds released to Wells, while SCS retained an unsecured claim in the bankruptcy case. It also granted Dynamic summary judgment because SCS had not produced sufficient evidence for its alter-ego claim, denied SCS’s request for more discovery, and dismissed the unopposed claims against Spirit Finance.

Although many Westerners are reluctant to eat insects, the UN estimates that about two billion people do so regularly. Edible insects provide nutrients and are more ecologically sustainable than other animal proteins. Research found that most primates retain genes associated with digesting insect exoskeletons, which cooking also makes easier to digest. Roasted grasshoppers have sold well at Seattle Mariners games.

The report describes the global household sewing machines market from 2013 to 2023, covering historical data and forecasts by region, machine type, and home or light-commercial use. It outlines production, demand, revenue, pricing, trade, growth factors, challenges, and competition, and lists major manufacturers including Brother, Singer, Janome, Necchi Macchina, and Bernina International.

The author urges the Department of Education to strengthen the Institute of Education Sciences while preserving its role in identifying effective education practices. Recommendations include setting research priorities with educators and policymakers, speeding studies and data reporting, restoring programs that support states and districts, and making findings easier for teachers to use. The author argues that these changes would make federal education research more responsive and effective.

LG unveiled its G7 ThinQ smartphone in South Africa, where it faces strong competition from dominant brands. The device has a bright screen, AI camera modes, a dedicated Google Assistant button and a Snapdragon 845 processor. It is expected in shops in early June, starting at about R13,999.

After a thief stole Navy veteran Gerard Ah-Fook’s handcycle from his Tucson porch, Randy Sooter saw the news report and gave him a handcycle he had bought while recovering from ankle surgery. Ah-Fook, a competitive paracyclist, thanked him. Police are still searching for the stolen bike.

The passage proposes a diplomatic offensive to divide Germany’s allies and strengthen Allied unity. It urges recognition of Bulgarian, Serbian, and Italian claims; assurances against dismembering Austria-Hungary; and different postwar treatment of Germany depending on whether it democratizes. It also calls for stated war aims, support for a league of nations, Allied economic coordination, and attention to French morale. The proposed peace terms require Germany to evacuate and restore Belgium and northern France, leave Luxemburg for negotiation, and undo the 1871 settlement concerning Alsace-Lorraine.
Devro shares have risen almost 25% since January. First-half sales rose 11% to over £125m, supported by demand in Russia and Asia; its Chinese plant is expected to reach full capacity by year-end.

The passage describes an AI-assisted activity training system for smart mirrors, display devices, or gyms. Users select activities and settings through voice commands, which a language-processing model interprets. A virtual assistant presents guidance while cameras and an AI model assess performance against target parameters and provide real-time visual, audio, or haptic feedback. The system also supports custom training circuits, connected devices, and sharing activity content.

The October 31, 2000 VentureWire reports that Trinity Ventures closed a $540 million fund, Sun Microsystems planned $100 million in wireless investments, BigWords.com shut down, and Internet consultancy Concrete laid off 15% of its staff. The issue also covers venture funding, acquisitions, leadership appointments, and new investment programs.

Entrepreneurs in The Oracles share ways to reduce distractions and improve focus: act urgently on clear goals, set aside uninterrupted time for deep work, and decline opportunities that do not fit current priorities. They recommend tackling one important task at a time, pursuing work that holds genuine interest, and using routines, breaks, and sleep to sustain concentration. Scheduling time for different responsibilities can help avoid divided attention. For organizations, they advise defining each person’s purpose and measurable goals, then assessing new projects against them.

Strength training can build muscle, strength and endurance, but poor technique, repetitive movements and increasing intensity too quickly can cause injuries, including rotator cuff injuries, hamstring strains, herniated discs, tendonitis and tennis elbow. To reduce the risk, warm up with dynamic movements, use proper form, work within your limits and increase intensity gradually. Cool down after exercise, allow time to recover and avoid pushing through pain. If pain persists despite rest, consult a doctor; a qualified instructor can help you start a routine safely.

The University of North Texas expects more than 3,400 students to receive degrees during fall 2017 commencement ceremonies on Dec. 15 and 16. Bachelor’s ceremonies will take place across both days, with a master’s and doctoral ceremony at 7 p.m. Dec. 15. Events will be held at the UNT Coliseum and Murchison Performing Arts Center in Denton. Graduates attending the New Orleans Bowl can RSVP for a separate ceremony in New Orleans at 6:15 p.m. Dec. 15.

Microsoft reported the settlement of debt exchange offers on March 17, 2021, issuing $6.25 billion of 2.921% notes due 2052 and $1.935 billion of 3.041% notes due 2062. It revised its earlier press release to correct the 2062 notes amount. Interest is payable semiannually, beginning September 17, 2021.

The Supreme Court appointed senior counsel Amarendra Sharan to examine material submitted by Pankaj Kumud Chandra Phadnis in support of a fresh inquiry into a possible larger conspiracy behind Mahatma Gandhi’s assassination. The bench said the material appeared insufficient to order an inquiry but asked Sharan to assist the court. Phadnis challenged a 2016 Bombay High Court ruling and alleged British involvement.

Amazon’s 2017 Form 10-K reports operations in three segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services. It serves consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, and content creators through retail, technology, and other services. Net sales rose to $177.9 billion in 2017 from $136.0 billion in 2016; net income rose to $3.0 billion from $2.4 billion. Amazon acquired Whole Foods Market in August 2017 and included its results from the acquisition date. The company employed approximately 566,000 people at year-end. It identified risks including intense competition, international regulation, fulfillment and inventory challenges, security breaches, and tax liabilities.
The speaker said the team lost third-period leads through soft plays against Detroit but saw positives to build on. They did not blame Olie for the goals and said the team would bounce back at home.

Five-year-old Angel has CLOVES syndrome, a rare condition that has caused her feet to swell and made walking painful. Humanitarian Moira Kelly brought her from Pakistan to Australia 18 months ago for treatment. After recovering from severe malnutrition, Angel is preparing for a free double amputation by surgeon Professor Tony Pennington. She hopes to wear shoes and dance.

A forwarded collection of news articles reports that Enron discussed backing Renard Euell’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve oil bid, but no deal was completed and his award lapsed. Another bidder forfeited his award, while a third transferred his interest to Hess Energy Trading. Enron Broadband Services invested in digital asset manager Artesia Technologies. Houston Chronicle articles debate the proposed publicly financed Rockets arena, including its costs and potential benefits; Enron chairman Ken Lay supported the proposal.

Graph limits describe sequences of graphs using graphons: symmetric, measurable functions from the unit square to [0,1]. A graph can be represented as a graphon by turning its adjacency matrix into a function. Homomorphism densities, defined for graphons by integrals, agree with those of their associated graphs. A sequence converges when its homomorphism densities converge for every fixed graph.

To compare graphs or graphons, cut distance uses the cut norm and allows measure-preserving rearrangements. The lecture states three main results: convergence of homomorphism densities is equivalent to being Cauchy in cut distance; every convergent sequence has a limit graphon; and the space of graphons, after identifying those at cut distance zero, is compact.

At its May 31, 2016 annual meeting, Tesla Motors stockholders elected Brad W. Buss and Ira Ehrenpreis as Class III directors and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the company’s 2016 auditor. A stockholder proposal concerning supermajority voting provisions was not approved.

West Virginia Attorney General Patrick Morrisey renewed a partnership with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission to check stores for recalled products and recall notices. State investigators have conducted more than 40 checks since 2015 and plan 25 more between February and September.

The passage documents AGESA integration into a host environment. In the binary build model, the host must provide a call-out router, establish a stack before procedures that require one, and implement required services such as buffer allocation, deallocation, and system reset. It describes UEFI build files, configuration options, and drivers for processor, memory, reset, and late initialization. AGESA entry procedures cover early processor setup, memory initialization, transfer of hand-off data, graphics configuration, generation of system information tables, and preparation for suspend. Separate procedures restore memory and processor state during resume. The host environment supplies platform-specific settings, manages memory and saved context, and observes restrictions on cache controls during Cache-As-RAM operation.

The CBEC directed central CGST officers to verify transitional credit claims regardless of whether taxpayers are administered by the Centre or states, saying the officers have the relevant legal jurisdiction and records. Taxpayers have claimed Rs 1.6 lakh crore in credits since GST began, though a preliminary enquiry found only 5–7% of claims invalid. An expert warned the move could cause Centre–state litigation. The CBEC also plans to amend the law to exclude credit for earlier cesses.

The passage describes flexible stripline circuits used to read out detector arrays in FYST’s Mod-Cam and planned Prime-Cam instruments. Measurements found that the stripline’s thermal conductivity agrees with calculated values; despite using more circuits, a Prime-Cam readout harness is estimated to impose less heat load at 4 K than Mod-Cam’s. Crosstalk tests identified the SMP-SMA transition boards, rather than the stripline, as the main source of elevated crosstalk. Simulations indicate that redesigned boards should meet project requirements.
Tesla Motors filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release on October 2, 2015, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The release was furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01, not deemed filed.

Police arrested Jason A. Clifford, 37, after witnesses reported he threatened people while trying to break into southeast Portland apartments. Officers found him in an apartment with a slungshot. Two others there were arrested on outstanding warrants but were not believed involved.

The author expects AMD shares to rise after its Q1 2018 earnings announcement and describes three options strategies expiring May 4: buying a $10 call for $60, buying a $10–$12 call spread for $50, or selling a cash-covered $10 put for $56 while reserving $1,000. Combining the spread and put yields a $6 net credit, but requires buying 100 shares at $10 if the put is assigned. The spread caps gains above $12. The author cites AMD’s product line, processor demand, potential market-share gains and large short position as reasons for optimism.

The Inverted Hammer is a single candlestick with a small lower body and a long upper shadow. In a downward price swing, it can signal a potential bullish reversal; the passage says its implications depend on market context and may be bearish in overbought conditions. Traders are advised to seek confirmation from other indicators, backtest strategies, and manage risk. The passage notes that the pattern can produce false signals.

Violet Brown, a Jamaican who recently turned 117, is believed to be the world’s oldest living person following Emma Morano’s death. Researchers say her birth certificate documents her age, but Guinness World Records has not confirmed a new title holder. Brown, a former sugarcane farmer, credits hard work and her Christian faith for her long life.

WIRED reviews sound machines for adults, children, pets, and travel. Its featured options include the compact LectroFan Classic, which plays fan and colored noises; the Snooz and Yogasleep Dohm, which use real fans; Hatch models with lights and app controls; and portable machines from Momcozy and other brands. Many offer white, pink, or brown noise, nature sounds, and timers, while some can play continuously. The passage notes that certain Hatch features require a subscription and advises keeping sound machines away from babies’ sleeping areas and within recommended volume limits.

President Donald Trump will direct U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer to determine whether to investigate Chinese practices that allegedly force U.S. firms to transfer intellectual property. A potential investigation could take up to a year and lead to tariffs or other trade restrictions, though officials said the dispute could be resolved through negotiations. The announcement comes as Trump presses China to do more on North Korea, but an administration official said the trade action is unrelated.

A UC Davis study of 50,921 California firearm deaths from 2000 to 2015 found that gun homicides declined, largely alongside reductions in gang violence and homicides of Black men. The homicide rate fell from 4.19 per 100,000 people in 2000 to 3.13 in 2014, then rose slightly in 2015. The study recorded 24,922 firearm homicides and 23,682 gun suicides.

Digital laggards often set goals that employees see as unrealistic or disconnected from strategy. This discourages measurement and shifts attention toward proving effort and following process, limiting innovation. Digital leaders use transparent, data-driven goals to align teams with company strategy while allowing flexibility in how they work. Excessive analysis, however, can slow decisions and discourage judgment. A strong data culture depends on consistent beliefs, values, and daily practices around learning, risk-taking, transparency, and measurement. Organizations may be data novices, insight ready, tech enabled, or data reliant; each can build on its strengths to improve.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU, built on the Ampere architecture for AI, high-performance computing, and data analytics. Compared with the V100, it offers third-generation Tensor Cores supporting additional data formats, higher memory bandwidth, a larger L2 cache, and faster multi-GPU connections through third-generation NVLink. Its structured sparsity feature can double Tensor Core throughput by skipping zero values.

Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) can divide one A100 into up to seven isolated GPU instances, allowing multiple workloads to share the device with dedicated resources. CUDA 11 adds support for features including asynchronous copies, barriers, task graphs, and cache controls. The passage also describes DGX A100 systems, which combine eight A100 GPUs with networking and software for larger deployments.

A forwarded December 2000 update surveys electricity-sector privatization and restructuring across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Africa, and the Middle East. It describes expanding competition and foreign investment alongside regulatory, financial, and supply challenges. Mark Schroeder says its EU overview is useful but incorrectly calls Spain’s power pool mandatory, overlooks municipal generation in Denmark and transitional anti-competitive arrangements in the Netherlands, and omits Poland from its Central and Eastern Europe discussion.

European shares rebounded Monday after U.S.–North Korea tensions drove their worst weekly losses of the year. The STOXX 600 rose 0.7%, led by recovering banks, while RWE and Fiat Chrysler also gained. Quarterly results showed energy and basic materials outperforming expectations, while consumer cyclical and industrial firms mostly missed.

A 2015 survey of 3,066 American workers found that many faced tight deadlines, hazardous conditions or hostile workplaces. Women reported unwanted sexual attention, while young men reported verbal abuse. Most respondents also found their work meaningful, and more than half described their boss as supportive.

The study tested a handheld lab-on-chip device for detecting YAP1 nucleic acid and AR-FL and AR-V7 mRNA in blood plasma from patients with prostate cancer. After RNA extraction, the device detected markers within 15 minutes and matched the corresponding benchtop assay results. In the 13-patient cohort, YAP1 detection was associated with more advanced cancer stage and higher PSA at diagnosis; AR-FL and AR-V7 were detected in high-risk or metastatic patients. Larger studies are needed to assess prognostic value, and the RNA extraction method is not yet suitable for point-of-care use.

In his final State of the Union address, the President reviews gains in health care, civil rights, education, conservation, employment and economic growth, while stressing that longstanding problems remain. He urges Congress to fund existing commitments and expand housing, Social Security, medical care, job training and crime prevention. He recommends continued fiscal restraint and a temporary extension of the surtax. Abroad, he calls for nuclear arms agreements, economic assistance and negotiated peace in Vietnam and the Middle East. He closes by thanking congressional colleagues and asking them to support President-elect Nixon.

Compass Minerals went public in December 2003 after two years as a stand-alone company. CEO Michael Ducey faced questions about how to meet investor expectations. Salt was produced through rock mining, mechanical evaporation, and solar evaporation; its major U.S. uses included highway deicing and industrial applications. Deicing demand varied with winter weather, while high transport costs made production location important. Road salt was also raising freshwater chloride levels and could face regulation. Compass Minerals’ North American Salt subsidiary was the third-largest U.S. salt producer, selling general trade salt, highway deicing salt, and salt for chemical uses.

The passage models the sale of one expiring item as a Stackelberg game: a time-sensitive seller commits to a non-increasing price schedule, while buyers with private valuations arrive stochastically and choose when to purchase. It introduces value-based threshold strategies to establish and verify buyer equilibria with continuously distributed valuations. The analysis finds a constant price optimal in thin markets and a linear discount near-optimal in thick markets. Numerical simulations support these policies and show that optimal schedules shift with the seller’s time sensitivity.

At Microsoft’s December 4, 2019 annual shareholders meeting, 6.61 billion of 7.63 billion eligible shares were voted. Shareholders elected all 13 director nominees, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as auditor for fiscal 2020. They rejected proposals concerning employee representation on the board and a gender pay gap report.

The Missouri Court of Appeals vacated and remanded the Davids’ divorce judgment because a mathematical error overstated Diane’s property award. It found no abuse of discretion in awarding the farm to Joseph rather than Diane, who had primary physical custody of their children. It also rejected Diane’s claims that the court was bound to divide property equally and had erred by not considering taxes on liquidating retirement funds, an issue first raised on appeal. The trial court must reconsider the property distribution using the corrected figures.
The speaker says the opponent’s neutral-zone play and backchecking have limited space. Their team will review its power play and try adjustments, hoping to regain its form and tie the series.

Tesla’s 2016 Form 10-K describes two business segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. Tesla sold Model S and Model X vehicles and planned to begin volume production and deliveries of the lower-priced Model 3 in the second half of 2017. Following its November 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, it also offered solar energy systems alongside Powerwall and Powerpack battery products. The report describes Tesla’s manufacturing facilities, direct sales and service network, charging infrastructure, financing, regulation and competition. It warns that production delays, supplier dependence, battery and product defects, rising costs and uncertain demand could harm its business, particularly as it scales Model 3 production.

The Ghana Red Cross Society is appealing for ambulances, saying it has personnel to operate them and support healthcare delivery. Its donated ambulance has broken down, and the Society is seeking a replacement engine. The World Bank funded first-aid posts along accident-prone highways. Ghana has 55 functioning ambulances out of 155, while the government has begun processes to provide 275 more.

The toss play sends a quarterback’s toss to a tailback running toward the defense’s edge. It is simple to teach and gets the ball to the perimeter quickly, but it depends on a fast tailback and mobile offensive line and is vulnerable to edge pressure. The passage outlines blocking assignments against 3-4 and 4-3 defenses and two variations: Flexbone “Rocket Toss,” which uses a wingback in motion, and Single Back Toss G Pull, which uses a pulling guard as the lead blocker.

The speaker is excited to play in the Stanley Cup Final and says the team must work hard, stay disciplined and improve its power play against a talented opponent. They plan to play patiently, avoid turnovers and create traffic in front of the opposing goaltender. The speaker praises linemates Krejci and Lucic and says the team can regroup if it has an off night.

The passage describes the TMS320DM8127 digital media processor’s architecture, memory, peripherals, pin functions, and data-manual revisions. Its ARM Cortex-A8 manages device configuration, while the code-compatible C674x floating-point DSP has configurable 32KB L1 program and data memories and 256KB of L2 RAM/cache. A system MMU handles DSP accesses to external memory. Other modules support video processing, face detection, processor communication, and synchronization. The manual also details memory maps, boot modes, electrical specifications, timing, and multiplexed pins.

The May 22, 2001 VentureWire newsletter reports that Kodiak Venture Partners closed a $290 million fund, Mercury Interactive acquired Freshwater Software for $147 million, Celetron raised $48 million, and TVM reached a first close on a life-sciences fund. It also covers numerous other financings, acquisitions and executive appointments. AgWeb and Ironmax reported staff cuts, while Rx.com stopped filling prescriptions.

Mark Palmer forwarded a class-action complaint against seven electricity generators and traders, noting that a reporter expected an Enron suit to look similar. Filed by San Diego resident Pamela Gordon, the complaint alleges the defendants manipulated California’s wholesale electricity market in 2000, inflating prices for consumers. It seeks damages, restitution, disgorgement of profits and injunctive relief.

The speaker says the team has improved its discipline and is allowing fewer power plays. They describe the playoffs as a battle of attrition and credit the coach with keeping players focused on the next game. The team aims to defend the front of its net better, create more traffic in front of the opposing goalie, and build on the confidence gained from an earlier series.
