Three George Washington University Alpha Phi members are being removed from the sorority after a Snapchat photo with a racist caption circulated online. The chapter apologized and acknowledged problems involving privilege and a lack of diversity. Students called for a university response, and administrators began investigating. The university provost called the image disturbing and hurtful.

After winning a fourth presidential term, Vladimir Putin is expected to pursue a post-Soviet ideology that could strengthen his legitimacy at home and offer an alternative to Western liberal democracy. The passage argues that his earlier promise of prosperity has weakened amid economic stagnation and corruption, and urges the West to challenge the Kremlin’s emerging vision while maintaining its own positive one.

Create Sheffield is a new partnership of education, arts, culture and voluntary organisations that aims to give children and young people up to age 25 more opportunities to experience the arts. It plans to list cultural activities, develop learning resources and support young makers. Organisers say arts participation can improve attainment and career prospects, while school performance pressures have reduced creative subjects. Membership begins in September, with annual fees ranging from £125 to £5,000.

Oregon’s four-year high school graduation rate is among the nation’s lowest, with one in four students not graduating on time. Students receive about 165 instructional days annually, compared with a national average of 180. State school board member Kim Sordyl argues that more school days could improve graduation rates, while Representative Diego Hernandez says lawmakers have not studied the link and should consider other factors and classroom quality. A high school principal also emphasizes attendance and instructional time.

A preliminary USGS study projects that Nate could erode 70 percent of sandy beaches from the Florida Panhandle to southeast Louisiana and remove about half their protective dunes. More than 90 percent of Louisiana beaches are likely to erode.

EON Resources opened a special conference call to discuss $45.5 million in funding and a related farmout agreement. After a forward-looking statements disclaimer, CEO Dante Caravaggio began the company overview.

Copper’s widespread industrial use makes its price a possible signal of economic activity, but the passage finds no concrete evidence that it reliably predicts stocks. A strategy that bought SPY for a week when copper’s preceding four-week return was positive performed reasonably in a backtest since 2000, with smaller drawdowns than buy-and-hold. However, it stagnated from 2008 to 2016, and copper’s returns showed little correlation with subsequent SPY returns. The strategy’s performance may have been due to luck.

An Anaheim player says the team lost both games in New Jersey without scoring because it has not played its usual style or managed the puck well enough to sustain offense. He credits the Devils’ defense and goaltending, while saying Anaheim must make better passes through the neutral zone, create more chances and limit New Jersey’s opportunities. Back at home, he hopes line matchups and crowd support will help, but says the focus is on playing better in the next game.

Serious medical problems were uncommon across the study phases and dose groups. In Phase 1, two participants reported them; researchers did not consider either related to the vaccine. In Phase 2/3, no single serious problem occurred in at least 1% of participants after the initial doses or a 30 µg booster. After that booster, 65 of 22,470 participants reported serious problems. Researchers considered some problems in participants aged 16 or older possibly vaccine-related. One participant reported a serious problem after an additional booster, which researchers did not consider vaccine-related.

NVIDIA reported revenue of $1.43 billion for the quarter ended July 31, 2016, up 24% from a year earlier. Net income rose to $253 million from $26 million, and diluted earnings per share rose to $0.40 from $0.05. Growth was driven by gaming, datacenter, professional visualization and automotive revenue. GPU revenue reached $1.20 billion, while Tegra Processor revenue was $166 million. Gross margin increased to 57.9%. NVIDIA ended the quarter with $4.88 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities. During the first half of fiscal 2017, it spent $509 million on share repurchases and paid $124 million in dividends.

Coach Quenneville said his team started well but lost momentum by slowing down and failing to get the puck behind Boston. He praised the goaltender’s overtime play and Johnny’s season-long contributions. Looking ahead, he emphasized maintaining home-ice momentum, improving each game and playing to the team’s strengths. He expects a challenging series against Boston, though he said each game could be different.

Finance Minister Kemi Adeosun said the government planned to release N750 billion this week for 2017 capital projects, bringing total releases to N1.2 trillion. A delegation of 30 French firms visited Nigeria to assess investment opportunities in sectors including infrastructure, banking and agriculture, with many considering partnerships with Nigerian firms.

Mean reversion trading seeks to profit when prices move back toward an average after unusually large rises or falls. The passage presents three previously published strategies involving XLP, FXI and the S&P 500, though it does not provide their trading rules in the text. It says mean reversion tends to work better in stocks than commodities and, in the authors’ experience, performs particularly well during volatile bear markets. Unlike trend following, mean reversion typically has many small winners and occasional large losers.

The passage describes a respiratory mask system for delivering therapy through a seal held against the patient’s face by headgear. Its frame includes a gas inlet and may include a diffuser-equipped outlet vent. A yoke connects the headgear to the frame, with embodiments using channels, clips, magnets, latches, or interlocking features. The passage also describes nasal seals and optional self-adjusting headgear.

The passage describes a building network for optically switchable windows and other devices. Daisy-chained trunk lines, including coaxial cables, use passive circuits to carry high-speed data and potentially power. Connected window controllers and digital architectural elements may provide wireless connectivity, displays, sensors, and processing. Sensor data can inform automated control of window tinting, HVAC, lighting, and security.

From 1950 to 2022, the S&P 500 reached an all-time high on 8.3% of trading days, averaging nearly 21 highs per year. The passage describes a strategy that buys when the index is within 5% of its peak and sells when it falls more than 5% below it. A backtest reported 3.20% annual growth, 43.2% time in the market, and a 33.75% maximum drawdown. The passage says earning interest on cash while out of the market substantially improved results.

A study found hydrogen sulfide, a gas associated with the smell of rotten eggs, in Uranus’s cloud tops using light captured by the Gemini North telescope. Scientists say the discovery may clarify how and when the planet formed.

Patanjali’s Kimbho messaging app disappeared from Google Play Store a day after its launch, though it remained on Apple’s App Store and accessible to existing users. Promoted as an Indian alternative to WhatsApp, it offered messaging, group chats and calls. Analyst Faisal Kawoosa said its roughly 5,000 installations and user-reported issues made competing with WhatsApp difficult. The launch followed Patanjali’s introduction of Swadeshi Samriddhi SIM cards.

In a Dutch birth cohort of 7,784 participants, mistimed and unwanted pregnancies were associated with small increases in mother-reported psychosocial problems in children aged 5–6, after accounting for co-occurring risks. Maternal bonding problems partly explained these associations; maternal distress partly explained associations involving mistimed pregnancy. No significant associations remained in adolescence.

The President informs Congress that trespassers, chiefly from British provinces and acting without provincial authorization, have cut timber in territory disputed by Maine and Great Britain. Maine sent a land agent to stop them; trespassers seized him and two assistants, and Maine then dispatched an armed posse. New Brunswick demanded the party’s withdrawal and prepared troops. The President rejects the British claim that an agreement grants Great Britain exclusive jurisdiction pending settlement. He supports efforts to stop the trespassers but opposes using federal forces to help Maine occupy the territory. He favors negotiation or arbitration, while saying federal aid would be warranted if New Brunswick occupied the territory militarily. He urges the release of arrested agents, the peaceful disbanding of Maine militia, and congressional consideration of measures before its recess.

Witting said Finland’s failed 1940 effort to secure a defense agreement with Sweden, followed by growing Soviet forces near Finland, contributed to its acceptance of a German transit agreement. He said recent fighting on the Finnish front resulted from Soviet offensives, but Finland could not readily restrain Germany because it depended on German supplies. Schoenfeld concluded that Finland hoped to avoid interfering with Allied supplies to Russia but expected military necessity might force cooperation with Germany. A Swedish diplomat doubted Finland could or wished to end hostilities with the Soviet Union and said he would not press the issue for fear of worsening German displeasure with Sweden.

The speaker welcomed Manny’s return and praised his leadership. They said the team must move past its playoff win and focus on Boston. They also recalled early NHL milestones against the Bruins and described staying ready during a play involving Hank.

The passage describes an organic light-emitting display with a through hole surrounded by pixels. Data lines curve around the hole and can be placed in different layers to reduce the surrounding non-display area. A dam, encapsulation layers, and optional passivation layers help limit moisture penetration. Alternative embodiments vary the data lines’ layers and positions. Proposed uses include phones, smart watches, and vehicle dashboards.

In a speech to Michigan graduates, the speaker calls for a “Great Society” that uses national prosperity to improve life, end poverty and racial injustice, and expand opportunity. He identifies three priorities: making cities better places to live, protecting natural beauty from pollution and development, and improving access to and the quality of education. He proposes White House meetings to develop responses and calls for cooperation between national and local leaders. He urges the graduates to help build a society that values equality, peace, community, and the life of the mind and spirit.

The May 17, 2001 issue of VentureWire People reports executive appointments and promotions at venture-backed firms across management, sales, finance, technology, operations and venture capital. It also lists executive job openings, including CFO, general partner, engineering, business development and sales roles.

The Box and One defense uses four players in a box zone and a chaser who denies a designated opponent the ball. The baseline defenders shift like a 1-2-2 zone, while the outside defenders shift like a 2-3 zone. Against even or odd fronts, defenders push the ball away from the chaser’s side and adjust to passes while protecting the post and elbow areas. Strong denial aims to limit the star scorer’s touches and disrupt set plays.

The Bengals acquired quarterback Joe Flacco and a sixth-round pick from the Browns for a fifth-round pick. Cincinnati has lost three straight games while Joe Burrow is on injured reserve, and replacement Jake Browning has thrown eight interceptions in parts of four games. Flacco started Cleveland’s first four games before Dillon Gabriel replaced him. The trade could move Shedeur Sanders into the Browns’ No. 2 quarterback role.

The passage demonstrates how to backtest a SPY trading strategy in Python using yfinance for historical data, pandas for calculations, and matplotlib for charts. The strategy enters when SPY’s closing price is above both its simple and exponential moving averages, with the signal applied the following day. Returns are compounded only while the strategy is invested. Its accumulated return was 804.82%, compared with 1505.31% for buy and hold, so it underperformed.

The coach said his team controlled much of the game against Buffalo but became conservative while protecting its lead, allowing Buffalo to rally. He credited Hasek with keeping Buffalo in the game, while stressing that Buffalo’s other players contributed. To improve, his team must sustain its play in contested areas, win more loose pucks and create second and third scoring chances. He was encouraged by the power play’s opportunities and said lineup changes were being considered. He expects a competitive series between two resilient teams and said his players are determined to play better in the next game.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) applies update packages only when their firmware and patch-level requirements match the system. Customers may co-sign packages with a 2048- or 4096-bit RSA key; the public key must be supplied before BOOT_DONE and cannot be changed afterward. Packages can change values, replace firmware images, or update firmware components. Updates are non-persistent across reboots and may be applied during boot or system operation.

A deployment agent sends an aligned command buffer and package to the ASP. The ASP protects the package memory, verifies applicable customer and AMD signatures, runs the patch, updates patch-level information, and returns a status. No updates apply until all package components pass validation. SEV updates prevent rollback to earlier images; reverting one requires a reboot.

Dane Gudauskas described a recent XXL Cloudbreak swell in Fiji as his most intense surfing experience. Despite stormy winds and difficult conditions, he paddled into a huge wave while others were towing in. He was wiped out and broke his board, and said he felt the effects of the ride for days afterward. He also credited local water-safety crews for helping make the session as safe as possible.

The #HV doorbell page aligns with APIC interrupt handling. It defines PendingEvent in bytes 0–1 and NoEoiRequired in byte 2; bytes 3–63 are reserved. Its backing page must be host-owned, with guest accesses using C=0.

Heard reported that Seoul was quiet and investigators found no evidence of Tong Hâk gatherings in the south, so he released a delayed ship. Later, reports described thousands gathering at Po-eun and threatening to march on Seoul. The government sent troops to block their route, while Heard asked that the U.S.S. Alert remain nearby. He doubted the group posed a direct danger to foreigners but noted the risk of unrest and possible political involvement.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022, reports third-quarter net sales of $127.1 billion, up 15% year over year. Operating income fell to $2.5 billion from $4.9 billion, while net income was $2.9 billion. For the first nine months, sales rose to $364.8 billion, but Amazon recorded a $3.0 billion net loss, including a $10.4 billion valuation loss on its Rivian investment. AWS sales and operating income increased, while North America and International reported operating losses. Amazon acquired MGM in March 2022 and reported $34.9 billion in cash and cash equivalents at September 30.

Biocon India grew from enzyme manufacturing into generic drugs and contract research by building on capabilities it had developed, an approach it called “earn as you learn.” Its subsidiary Syngene served pharmaceutical research clients, while Clinigene, launched in 2000, began offering clinical lab services and studies as Biocon considered becoming a fully integrated drug discovery and development company.

India’s growing pharmaceutical outsourcing market offered Clinigene opportunities, but moving into higher-value clinical trials would require investment and expertise. Managing Director Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw also faced concerns that rapid growth could strain Biocon’s collaborative culture and expose it to ethical, reputational, and financial risks. She had to weigh expanding Clinigene, limiting it to lower-risk services, or acquiring a clinical services firm.

The crude oil Friday seasonality strategy buys at Thursday’s close, anticipating a Friday price rise. It performed better when Thursday was a down day, particularly when USO fell at least 0.75 times its 25-day average high–low range. Historical data from April 2006 to the present show 56.96% P/L across 98 trades, including 60 winners, with an average profit of 0.58% per trade.

Police cited Dylan Kennedy on Aug. 6 for speeding and marijuana possession and charged him with possession of drug paraphernalia. On Aug. 5, Caton Preston was charged with underage alcohol possession and forgery involving a fake license; three children received trespassing warrants. Police destroyed 75 pounds of unused prescription drugs and investigated a smashed mailbox. The report lists 204 total calls.

The ADS868xW family comprises single-channel, 16-bit SAR data-acquisition devices with an integrated analog front end and a single 5V analog supply. They support differential or single-ended inputs across nine programmable bipolar and unipolar ranges, including up to ±12.288V, with input impedance of at least 1MΩ. Integrated features include a programmable gain amplifier, antialiasing filter, ADC driver, selectable internal or external 4.096V reference, and input overvoltage protection.

The devices provide programmable input alarms and fixed AVDD alarms, as well as NAP and power-down modes. Their multiSPI interface supports standard SPI, source-synchronous transfers, single- or dual-output data, and daisy-chaining. The passage also describes configuration registers, reference and supply decoupling, PCB layout guidance, and an eight-channel industrial input-module example.

The passage describes portable ground stations for vertical-takeoff aerial vehicles. Each station can extend a landing pad, retract a landed vehicle into a protective casing, and charge it. Optional features include a centering mechanism, homing aids, windbreakers, alternative power supplies, and modular equipment. Deploying multiple stations may extend vehicle operating range, while a control server may coordinate stations and vehicles.

The speaker reports rapid national growth, flourishing commerce and adequate revenue, while noting unresolved disputes with several foreign powers. The government seeks reciprocal trade, settlement of claims from wartime seizures, clearer maritime rights and an agreement with Britain to suppress the slave trade. Treasury receipts are expected to cover expenditures, and the speaker expresses hope that the public debt can be paid within ten years.

The address describes progress on fortifications, naval protection, and surveys for roads and canals, while calling for stronger action against piracy. It also discusses negotiations with Indian tribes, proposes voluntary relocation and education for tribes within the states, and recommends changes to the federal courts as the Union expands. Other proposals include a Pacific military post and provision for Lafayette in recognition of his Revolutionary service. The speaker urges protection of American interests, respect for the independence of neighboring states, and cooperation between national and state governments.

The Sri Lankan rupee fell for a third session on Wednesday, closing at 158.60/75 per dollar as importer demand exceeded remittance inflows. It is down 3.4 percent this year. Moody’s warned that dollar strength could increase Sri Lanka’s credit risk and reduce reserves, while the IMF cited debt and refinancing vulnerabilities. Foreign investors continued to sell government securities.

An Uzbek court convicted Uzbek-born U.S. citizen Zokir Aliyev of calling for the government’s overthrow and participating in an extremist group, imposing a $67 fine for offences dating to 1999. Detained in June and released after six days, Aliyev denied involvement with the Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, saying he had attended opposition meetings in Turkey.

Mali’s gold exports are falling as major mines wind down or close. At Sadiola, a proposed $380 million plant modification would allow processing of hard-rock reserves containing 3.4 million ounces of gold and could extend the mine’s life by 10 years. Negotiations over the investment appear to have stalled, though the reason is unclear. Sadiola’s future matters to Mali’s gold production, government revenue and employment: the mine currently employs about 1,000 people, most of them Malian. The proposed expansion would use existing infrastructure and connect the mine to Mali’s power grid.

The study measured near-infrared spectra of cryogenic water ice, epsomite, halite, and mixtures of their grains to support analysis of Europa’s surface. Water ice strongly influenced mixed spectra, especially when its grains were small; halite–ice mixtures were nearly indistinguishable from pure ice. Linear and intimate spectral models reproduced water-ice measurements comparably but could not consistently match both absorption features and surrounding reflectance. Modeling of epsomite mixtures was less conclusive because published epsomite optical constants may not represent cryogenic conditions accurately. The authors emphasize quantitative spectral analysis to estimate material abundances and grain sizes, and plan to update the epsomite optical constants.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs and related technologies. RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move compressed data from SSDs to GPUs for decompression, aiming to improve game loading, streaming, and professional rendering workflows. Ampere GPUs add faster shading, ray tracing, and AI processing, support high-resolution displays and AV1 hardware decoding, and include hardware video encoding. The A40 targets data-center graphics and compute workloads, while the RTX A6000 targets professional workstations; both support configurations with up to 96GB of combined GPU memory. The passage also outlines GeForce RTX 3090 and 3070 specifications and describes Error Detection and Replay for GDDR6X memory overclocking. It concludes with NVIDIA’s warranty, liability, and usage notices.

The passage describes NVDA options as a way to seek leveraged returns while emphasizing their complexity and risks. It covers strategies including calls, puts, spreads and collars, and says option prices depend on the stock price, time to expiration, implied volatility, dividends and market conditions. For purchased options, losses are limited to the premium paid. It recommends evaluating each strategy’s risks and using hedging, diversification and position sizing to manage them.

The 2018–19 Budget has no separate section for women, unlike the previous two budgets. Economists interviewed said it largely treats women in their existing household and economic roles rather than addressing barriers to work. Some welcomed the proposed health insurance cover for vulnerable families, support for small businesses and sanitation efforts. Others questioned the insurance scheme’s funding and effectiveness, citing limited growth in health allocations and a cut to the National Health Mission. They also raised concerns about reduced maternity-entitlement funding and the expansion of LPG connections when some recipients cannot afford replacement cylinders. Overall, they saw mixed potential benefits but little change in the Budget’s approach to women.

The speaker is glad to play near family in Quebec. They credit the team’s success to preparation, hard work and resilience, while acknowledging some luck. They expect a tough road game against an opponent eager to defend its home ice, but believe their team can compete by matching that intensity and following its game plan. They expect a loud atmosphere and say the first ten minutes will be crucial.

Responding to the Senate about alleged forcible resistance to federal law in Boston, the President says unofficial accounts support the main facts but official information is lacking and some details are disputed. He argues that the incident does not reflect the views of most Bostonians. He reviews Massachusetts’s 1843 restrictions on state officials’ involvement in fugitive-slave cases and on the use of state jails, and says federal law requires the marshal to arrange another place of confinement if needed. He proposes clarifying laws on the use of militia, the Army, and the Navy to enforce federal law, and pledges to suppress forcible opposition.

In a separate April 25, 1851 proclamation, he warns against a planned expedition from the United States to invade Cuba, then a Spanish colony. He says participants risk prosecution and loss of government protection, and calls on citizens and officers to prevent the expedition.

The speaker argues that a government divided between slave and free states cannot endure and that a policy intended to end slavery agitation has instead intensified it. He contends that the Nebraska bill and Dred Scott decision have advanced slavery’s spread and warns that a future court decision could prevent states from excluding it. He rejects reliance on Senator Douglas, whose stated indifference to whether slavery is voted down or up makes him unsuitable to oppose its expansion. He urges Republicans to remain firm, expressing confidence that they will prevail.

Tottenham reportedly plan to offer £28m for Ajax defender Davinson Sanchez, below Ajax’s £40m valuation. Chelsea and Real Madrid may make rival bids. Ajax want to retain Sanchez, but he reportedly wants to leave for Premier League and Champions League football.

USB-A and USB-C describe connector shapes, not speeds or features. A connection’s data-transfer speed and charging power depend on every device, port, and cable in the chain; the slowest component limits performance. Because USB version names can be confusing, the passage recommends checking stated speed and wattage ratings.

USB4 uses USB-C and supports speeds up to 40 Gbps, while USB4 Version 2 has a potential maximum of 120 Gbps but is not yet widely adopted. USB-C can also support USB Power Delivery and DisplayPort Alternate Mode for charging and audio-video output. Thunderbolt uses the USB-C connector but has stricter certification requirements. Thunderbolt 4 supports speeds up to 40 Gbps; Thunderbolt 5 raises bidirectional bandwidth to 80 Gbps and power delivery to 240 watts.

The stick concept is a quick passing play designed to give the quarterback fast options on both sides of the formation. The tight end often runs the primary route, adjusting it to man or zone coverage. The quarterback reads the flat defender: if the defender stays inside, he can throw the arrow route; if the defender widens, he can throw the stick route. A backside slant provides another option. The concept works against man, Cover 3, and Cover 4, but Cover 2 can make the arrow route risky. Variations include a condensed formation with stick routes on the outside and “Sticko,” which uses a tight end double move.

Henry J. Adams III pleaded guilty to armed bank robbery after helping plan the crime, serving as a lookout, and arranging transportation. The district court sentenced him to 140 months, above the guideline range of 84 to 105 months. The Tenth Circuit affirmed, holding that his role did not warrant a minor-participant reduction. It also found the sentence reasonable: the district court had imposed an upward variance based chiefly on Adams’s extensive history of repeated offenses, rather than a guidelines departure.
Shares of Walgreens, CVS and Rite Aid fell Friday after reports that Amazon was considering selling prescription drugs online. Amazon declined to comment.

The speaker calls on Congress to accelerate tax cuts, limit spending, strengthen Medicare, expand health coverage, promote domestic energy and cleaner technology, and support mentoring and addiction treatment. He proposes $15 billion over five years for AIDS relief in Africa and the Caribbean. Describing counterterrorism and homeland-security efforts, he seeks funding for defenses against biological attacks and closer coordination of threat intelligence. He identifies Iran and North Korea as security concerns and argues that Iraq has failed to disarm and is concealing prohibited weapons. He says the United States will seek further U.N. consideration but will lead a coalition to disarm Saddam Hussein if he does not comply.

The study classified the value conveyed by 3,637 unique words in reading texts from Turkish primary-school textbooks. Experts identified 172 words as positive, 159 as negative and 3,306 as neutral. The authors found no observable relationship between grade level and the values conveyed by words. They recommend classifying textbook words by value and using corpus-based methods to select texts.

Assistant U.S. Attorney Will Rosenzweig was fired by email while observing Rosh Hashanah, after conservatives publicized blog posts attributed to him that criticized President Trump. Rosenzweig had worked in the Southern District of Florida since 2020. The Justice Department has also fired three prosecutors in that district who previously worked with former special counsel Jack Smith.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed summary judgment for AMCO Insurance Company. It found no genuine factual dispute that AMCO investigated George Morello’s claim unreasonably or improperly withheld or delayed benefits. His related claims also failed, and the district court did not abuse its discretion in denying reconsideration.

Weekly trading uses weekly price action to identify trends, ranges, and support and resistance levels. Traders may use weekly charts for longer-term positions, combine them with daily charts for broader market context, or trade breakouts and reversals around previous weekly highs and lows on lower timeframes such as H4. Neither weekly nor daily charts are universally better; the passage recommends backtesting a strategy across timeframes. Its example weekly ETF rotation strategy reported 15.1% annual returns and a 43% maximum drawdown, excluding slippage and commissions from its average gain per trade.

The lecture connects graph theory and additive combinatorics through Schur’s theorem: every finite coloring of the positive integers contains a monochromatic solution to \(x+y=z\). A proof uses Ramsey’s theorem for monochromatic triangles, and Schur’s theorem shows why a modular strategy for proving Fermat’s Last Theorem fails.

The lecture then surveys results on arithmetic progressions in colored or positive-density sets, including van der Waerden’s, Roth’s and Szemerédi’s theorems, their extensions to multidimensional and polynomial patterns, and the Green–Tao theorem on progressions in the primes. It describes approaches using graph theory, Fourier analysis, ergodic theory and hypergraph regularity. Finally, it introduces a graph question connected to Roth’s theorem: how many edges can a graph have if every edge lies in exactly one triangle?

NVIDIA reported revenue of $5.66 billion for the quarter ended May 2, 2021, up 84% from a year earlier. Net income rose to $1.91 billion from $917 million, and diluted earnings per share rose to $3.03 from $1.47. Gaming and Data Center revenue increased to $2.76 billion and $2.05 billion, respectively. NVIDIA had $12.67 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at quarter-end. Its proposed $40 billion acquisition of Arm remained subject to regulatory approvals. The company expected supply constraints, primarily in gaming, to continue into the second half of the fiscal year. Its board declared a four-for-one stock split, conditional on shareholder approval.

Infiniti’s Q Inspiration concept will influence a new electrified vehicle platform and up to five models planned over the next five years. The vehicles will be built in China at an unconfirmed location. The four-door coupe concept’s sculpted design will carry over to models with other body styles.

SOS pressure defense relies on repeated practice, player commitment and positive coaching. Its on-ball sequence is Set, which pressures the ballhandler to dribble; On, which guides the dribbler toward a sideline or baseline checkpoint; and Smother, which pressures passes and shots after the dribble stops. Off-ball actions are Snuggle to deny passes, Off to prevent a return pass on a cut, and Strike to provide weakside help. A weakside defender closes out to Set when their opponent receives a crosscourt pass.

PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO and PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST each process 1–128 migration entries. PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO moves hypervisor-owned pages in SNP-enabled systems and can move pages used by DMA devices, updating IOMMU host page-table entries to their new physical locations. Software must prevent CPU access during migration and update CPU host page tables afterward. It does not directly migrate 2M pages.

PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST moves SNP guest pages and requires RMP enforcement. Source pages must be Guest-Valid or Guest-Invalid, and destinations must be Pre-Migration. Afterward, destinations inherit the source states, while sources become Pre-Migration. Concurrent DMA is unsupported. A separate command marks the end of a sequence and can signal completion.

Command and entry errors are reported through status fields; ring-buffer errors use PM_STATUS. Hardware errors may also be reported through the Machine Check Architecture, and a hardware failure can make an entire batch unrecoverable.

School districts are adding cameras, GPS tracking, navigation and student check-in systems to buses. Districts and vendors say the tools help parents track rides, support drivers, improve safety and make routes more efficient. Kansas City Public Schools’ new bus contract includes these features, while districts elsewhere use similar systems. The technology brings upfront and subscription costs, and student privacy advocates question how location and video data are protected. Districts and vendors describe safeguards including encryption, separate storage and routine video deletion.

Under GST, e-way bills will be required for goods consignments worth more than Rs 50,000, but the GST Council has exempted 153 items, including household LPG, PDS kerosene, food products, jewellery and currency. Non-motorised transport and certain port transfers are also exempt. The permits, intended to help track goods and curb tax evasion, will take effect after the required software is ready.

A passenger train broke down in freezing weather, and its brakeman suffered frostbite while flagging the rear of the train. A jury found $12,000 in damages but deemed the accident unavoidable, and the district court entered judgment for the railroad. The appeals court held that the locomotive’s failure to function while in use violated the Boiler Inspection Act regardless of negligence. Because the jury found the breakdown caused the brakeman’s injuries, the court reversed and directed entry of a $12,000 judgment for him.

A Digit report says Xiaomi will not launch the Mi A2 in India. A Xiaomi spokesperson said no phone exists by that name but confirmed plans for more Android One phones. The passage says it remains unclear whether the Mi 6X will launch in India under another name. Xiaomi is also preparing to launch the Redmi S2, potentially called the Redmi Y2 in India.

Fiat Chrysler reportedly rejected an offer from an unidentified Chinese automaker because it considered the financial terms insufficient. FCA had previously pursued deals with General Motors and Volkswagen, though CEO Sergio Marchionne later expressed reluctance to sell. Several Chinese automakers have reportedly shown interest in FCA. Their interest may reflect a government push to acquire foreign assets and a desire to enter the U.S. market through FCA’s established brands and distribution network.
The FBI arrested Jerry Drake Varnell, 23, after he allegedly tried to detonate a van he believed contained explosives outside an Oklahoma City bank. He faces a federal charge.

A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to reverse layoffs of 532 Voice of America journalists and staff, finding that officials had violated his April order to maintain the broadcaster. He warned Kari Lake and other officials that they risked contempt as Voice of America continued broadcasting only about an hour a day.

Mazabuka’s sugar industry drew migrant workers to southern Zambia, where mobility, poverty and sex work contributed to a severe HIV epidemic. At its peak, treatment was unavailable and local hospitals and graveyards were overwhelmed. Testing, HIV knowledge and access to drugs have since improved. Zambia still has an estimated 250 new infections daily, but new infections have fallen 27 percent since 2010 and AIDS-related deaths 11 percent. The local NGO DAPP uses door-to-door outreach, rapid testing, condoms and community leaders in its “Total Control of the Epidemic” campaign, which has reached more than 1.5 million Zambians.

Heart attacks and strokes in the UK have fallen by 30% over two decades, but remain a major health hazard. Medicines that lower cholesterol and blood pressure have helped. The passage also recommends maintaining a healthy weight, quitting smoking, exercising, and eating more soluble fibre while limiting salt and ready-prepared foods. It says many reported statin side effects may reflect the nocebo effect. Other cholesterol-lowering medicines are available for people whose cholesterol is not adequately controlled.

A review of 3,395 publicly available computing-course syllabi from India’s top 100 ranked engineering institutions found AI ethics content in 75 courses (2.21%) across 22 institutions. Of those 75 courses, 60% covered ethics in one session and 7% were dedicated to it. Privacy and data governance were the most common topics; generative AI concerns and social justice received less attention. More than 90% of the courses listed no dedicated AI ethics teaching materials, and none documented assessments explicitly focused on the subject. The authors call for clearer learning goals, teaching resources and assessment methods. They caution that limited public access to syllabi and the focus on top-ranked institutions prevent conclusions about all Indian computing programs.

North American stocks ended a volatile week with sharp losses. The Dow fell 666 points on Friday, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Strong U.S. wage growth raised concerns about inflation and further interest rate hikes, as bond yields rose. Weak corporate earnings added pressure. In Canada, the S&P/TSX fell 1.6 per cent on Friday and about four per cent for the week, weighed down by falling oil and gold prices and losses in marijuana stocks.

Police investigating Aaron Marks’s murder in Ballina have seized a white Holden Commodore and are examining it for forensic evidence. They are asking its passengers to come forward and say the driver is assisting with enquiries.

CBS’s legal drama “Doubt” premieres Wednesday, Feb. 15, following “Code Black.” Katherine Heigl stars as Sadie Ellis, a defense attorney who falls for a client accused of a decades-old murder. The series follows his case alongside other matters at her New York firm. The review calls the show formulaic and sometimes implausible, but praises its likable cast and evenhanded treatment of issues.

American football developed from rugby and soccer, with Walter Camp credited for shaping its early rules. It is not an Olympic sport, though flag football has been considered for the 2028 Games. Each team fields 11 players; professional and college games last four 15-minute quarters.

The offense has four downs to advance ten yards. A touchdown earns six points, followed by an opportunity for one or two more; a field goal earns three points, and a safety earns two. Possession can change through interceptions, fumbles or failed fourth-down attempts. The passage also explains penalties, catches, special teams and field positions, and highlights Tom Brady, Jerry Rice, Jim Brown and Lawrence Taylor as notable players.

Callum Knott, 21, took his aunt’s car without permission in Ollerton on November 20 and abandoned it when the battery died. He admitted taking the vehicle and driving without a licence or insurance. He received a 12-month community order, an 80-hour unpaid work requirement and a four-month driving ban.

Cover 2 uses five underneath defenders and two deep safeties to limit quick passes and deep throws, with cornerbacks defending the flats. Offenses can attack it by stretching cornerbacks and linebackers with route combinations, sending multiple receivers vertically to pressure the safeties, or targeting the open middle of the field. The passage illustrates these approaches with plays from Ohio State, Oregon, Michigan, Ole Miss and TCU, while noting that some examples faced different coverage or had a score called back.
Alfred King was re-elected president of the East Demerara Football Association at its annual general meeting, where a new executive was chosen.

Curaleaf and other cannabis stocks rallied on renewed hopes of U.S. cannabis rescheduling after a post by Trump about CBD. Curaleaf reported in-line Q2 2025 results and announced an expansion into Turkey. The author maintains a Hold rating because of sector uncertainty.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2020 reports quarterly revenue of $6.04 billion, down from $6.35 billion a year earlier, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $104 million, compared with a $408 million loss. At June 30, Tesla held $8.62 billion in cash and cash equivalents and had $38.14 billion in total assets. COVID-19 temporarily disrupted manufacturing and suppliers, but all manufacturing facilities had resumed operations by the end of the quarter. The filing also discusses debt, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation and risks to future operations.

Camarilla pivot points, introduced by Nick Scott in 1989, provide day traders with four support and four resistance levels for identifying intraday prices, entries, exits and risk. Trading approaches vary with market conditions. The passage encourages backtesting, noting that a backtest of ordinary pivot points found no “super profits” but did not directly test Camarilla pivots.

The MOSAIC case-control study collected blood samples from 2,513 people with and without lung cancer to develop a machine-learning classifier using proteins, RNA and metabolites. Of these, 1,225 subjects were used for training and 398 for validation. In the validation set, the classifier achieved 89% sensitivity and 89% specificity across all lung cancer stages; sensitivity was 80% for stage I disease. The authors say the findings require validation in a prospective study of the intended high-risk screening population. The study was funded by PrognomiQ, Inc.

Intels Nigeria CEO Andrew Dawes says the company is partnering with the Federal Government to invest in port infrastructure. Responding to monopoly allegations, he says Intels has invested billions of dollars in concessioned terminals and pays substantial fees to the government. Although oil and gas cargo has fallen 70 percent from several years ago, Intels plans to continue long-term investment at a slower pace. Dawes says its Phase 4B facility can receive a full floating production, storage and offloading vessel, while the Badagry deep seaport project is progressing with partner APM Terminals.

The Supreme Court paused a federal judge’s ruling that barred Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem from ending Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelans. The Court had previously paused the judge’s preliminary order; its three Democratic appointees opposed Friday’s decision. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented, arguing that the Court should not intervene without a demonstrated time-sensitive need.

The coach credited a hard-working line for playing tough minutes and earning recognition in the playoffs. He emphasized puck possession, commitment to a familiar system and the team’s consistent work ethic, while acknowledging that a close Stanley Cup Final win depended partly on favorable bounces and a decisive shot by Sammy Pahlsson. He discussed countering an opponent’s lineup changes, limiting fourth-line minutes because of health and inexperience, and waiting for medical clearance before considering an injured player’s return. He described the team’s pregame routine and said his comments about Getzlaf were minor, not public criticism. Looking back, he said the team resolved to improve after the previous year’s conference-final loss, with Chris Pronger’s acquisition reinforcing that goal.

Long-standing concerns about research fraud, peer review, publishing costs and incentives to produce large numbers of papers have become part of the Trump administration’s criticism of scientific publishing. HHS secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and NIH director Jayanta Bhattacharya have proposed changes involving journals, public access and publishing fees. Scientists and former journal editors acknowledge problems, including pharmaceutical industry influence, but question whether the proposed measures will address them. Some warn that restricting where federally funded scientists publish or creating a government journal could undermine credibility. Others say fee caps alone could shift costs to readers and libraries. They argue that meaningful reform also requires changes to how research and scientists are evaluated.

The paper proposes a method for studying which companies survive in a digital business ecosystem. It constructs a simulated ecosystem from observed statistical properties, assigning companies products to buy and sell and lists of trusted and mistrusted partners. A neural-network-inspired model tracks company fitness through decay, self-reinforcement, beneficial buyer–seller matches, and competition between sellers of similar products. Preliminary experiments examine survival under different parameters and include a case in which a monopoly emerges. The authors identify further work on competition for scarce purchases, the introduction of new companies, and linking model parameters to measurable data.

Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts is offering voluntary buyouts to about 750 employees aged 55 or older with at least 10 years at the company. The insurer is seeking to reduce its workforce amid rising health care costs and steep losses.
Seeking Alpha asks users to enable JavaScript and cookies, and disable ad-blockers.

Lookout researchers found more than a thousand Google Play apps containing SonicSpy spyware. It can record audio, take photos, send messages and calls, retrieve device data, and respond to more than 73 remote commands. A recent example, Soniac, offered messaging through a customised Telegram app while hiding its icon and connecting to attacker infrastructure. Lookout said the account behind Soniac had posted two other SonicSpy apps, neither of which remains available.

The passage describes a graphics-rendering system that detects eye saccades and reduces rendering work during periods of saccadic masking. It may skip or repeat frames, lower resolution or detail, or adjust frame rate to save power or free processing capacity. Sensors detect eye movement, while calibrated models may help predict saccade duration. The technique can be used in virtual- or augmented-reality devices.

Max Hayes High School auto collision students spent 18 months repairing a Cleveland police cruiser damaged during the 2016 Cavs championship celebrations. With donated materials, they restored a vehicle the city had planned to scrap, saving about $10,000. The cruiser will return to service.

Manjot Kalra scored an unbeaten, match-winning century in the 2018 Under-19 World Cup final as India won its fourth title. Initially aggressive, he adjusted his approach after Shubman Gill’s dismissal to stay at the crease. The innings brought Kalra attention and comparisons with established Indian cricketers, but the passage notes that previous Under-19 final centurions did not go on to play for their senior national teams. Coach Rahul Dravid hoped the victory would be a cherished memory rather than the defining achievement of the players’ careers.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2017 reported revenue of $28.9 billion, up from $25.8 billion a year earlier, and a net loss of $6.3 billion versus net income of $6.3 billion. The quarter included an estimated $13.8 billion net charge related to U.S. tax legislation. Operating cash flow was $7.9 billion. At quarter-end, Microsoft reported $256.0 billion in assets and $78.4 billion in stockholders’ equity. The filing also describes its early adoption of new revenue-recognition and lease accounting standards.

UOB strategists say GBP’s bearish phase remains intact, but weak downward momentum makes a near-term fall to 1.2900 unlikely. They see scope for a gradual rise toward 1.3040/45; a break above 1.3060 would end the bearish phase.

Police arrested 40-year-old Nannette Perkins at her Taylorsville home after receiving a tip. She is suspected of robbing at least six Salt Lake City-area banks, including five in under two hours, while wearing pajama bottoms.

The passage argues that student newsrooms, like local news outlets, inform their communities about important issues and events. It warns that news deserts and media consolidation limit access to diverse information, and says student journalism helps students make informed decisions and encounter different perspectives.

The study developed strategies to improve vocational education in Thailand using survey data, interviews with exemplary institutions, and expert review. Curriculum development had the highest priority for improvement, followed by collaboration networks and personnel. The resulting six strategies address management, competency-based curricula, teaching, staff development, partnerships, and graduate quality. Experts rated the strategies highly suitable and feasible. The researchers recommend prioritizing curriculum development and adapting implementation to each institution’s needs.

The passage explains how to build and backtest an RSI strategy for DOT on a five-minute chart using TradingView’s Pine Script. It uses a 14-period RSI: enter long when RSI rises above 35, enter short when it falls below 65, and close positions when it crosses 50. Users can make these thresholds adjustable in the strategy settings and review results such as net profit, drawdown, and win rate. Standard backtests use the chart’s displayed history; Pro accounts or higher can run deep backtests on available historical data. The passage cautions that RSI alone has not performed consistently.

American Mint offers a 24k gold-layered Band of Brothers Men’s Ring honoring those who fought and sacrificed for liberty. Available in sizes 8–14 with a jeweler’s box, it costs $129.90 for a limited time while supplies last.

The QQQ mean-reversion strategy exits when the close exceeds the previous day’s high or close. Since January 2000, it has produced a roughly 12.4% compounded annual growth rate, with less drawdown than buy and hold. Future performance is uncertain.

A total solar eclipse on August 21 will cross the United States from Oregon to South Carolina, drawing millions of viewers and dedicated eclipse chasers. Writer David Dickinson plans to see his first total eclipse in North Carolina, though clouds could obscure it. He warns that viewers need proper eye protection during the partial phases; only during totality is it safe to look directly at the sun. Another total eclipse will cross the United States on April 8, 2024.
Cancer cells transfer mitochondria to neighboring fibroblasts, fueling growth and altering gene activity.

The London breakout strategy trades price moves above or below the Asian session’s range, usually during the first three hours of the London forex session. Traders use the Asian session’s high and low, or its opening and closing prices, to define that range. Custom indicators can display entry, stop-loss and take-profit levels. In the passage’s EUR/USD backtest, buying breakouts above the range lost money, while buying breakouts below it produced average gains near zero. The author concludes that the strategy needs additional parameters or risk management for EUR/USD.

The study used a BERT-based classifier and manual annotation to assess English-language PubMed publications on healthcare AI from 2019–2021. It classified 385 of 7,062 publications (about 5%) as mature. Radiology had the most mature models; image data and deep learning predominated, while text and tabular data were less represented. Mature publications were concentrated in a few countries, particularly the United States and China. The authors identify opportunities to use more varied data and models across healthcare specialties and regions.

The passage presents a study of antiferromagnetic domain-wall dynamics driven by spin-orbit torque. Using a continuum model with damping and spin torque, alongside spin-lattice simulations, it examines precession, propagation and periodic motion between two positions. It also considers the magnetic moment generated by time-dependent Néel order. For spin polarization along the third axis, the simulations reach a steady state in which the spins precess at a constant angular frequency, given in the model by −β/α.

Inverted Vertical Bridgman growth produced MnBi₂Te₄/(Bi₂Te₃)ₙ crystals whose layer spacing, manganese content, and magnetic behavior varied along the ingot. Turbulent flow supported pure MnBi₂Te₄ growth; subsequent MnTe precipitation reduced manganese content and initiated mixed-layer growth. Stationary flow promoted ordered stacking, while the cessation of flow coincided with structural disorder and manganese depletion in septuple layers. Septuple-layer spacing increased as MnTe supersaturation decreased. Samples with pure or closely spaced MnBi₂Te₄ layers showed antiferromagnetic transitions at 26 K and 13.5 K. Samples with layers separated by 4–5 or 7 ± 2 Bi₂Te₃ quintuple layers showed ferromagnetic-like behavior near 9–11 K. The findings emphasize control of melt composition and flow during synthesis.

Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia (MEN) is a hereditary cancer syndrome involving tumors in two or more endocrine glands. Its three main types are associated with variants in MEN1, RET, and CDKN1B. The study classified variants from IndiGen, ClinVar, and Mastermind and created MAPVar, a searchable database of 3,280 MEN-linked variants. Based on two likely pathogenic RET variants in IndiGen, the authors estimated that nearly 1 in 341 people in India may carry a MEN-linked pathogenic RET mutation, although they noted limited supporting evidence for one variant. MAPVar identified variants in seven GUaRDIAN patient cases. A sequencing panel covering the three genes identified pathogenic mutations in three additional cases.

California’s Department of Fish and Wildlife re-approved Newhall Ranch after reviewing revised plans to address greenhouse gas emissions and protect the endangered unarmored three-spine stickleback, as directed by the state Supreme Court. State air regulators found an adequate basis to conclude the project would add no net emissions. Construction changes will avoid water contact, eliminating the need to collect and relocate the fish. The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors is expected to consider re-approving the project’s first two villages in July.

A Nigerian bank support worker warns that fraudsters at ATMs may ask people to withdraw money transferred from stolen phones or hacked accounts. When the account owner reports the transfer, the recipient may have their account frozen, BVN flagged, or face police action. The worker describes two cases involving 40,000 and 50,000 naira, including one in which an 18-year-old was held at gunpoint. The warning urges people not to accept such requests.

Tesla agreed on February 13, 2020, to sell 2,650,000 common shares in a public offering. Underwriters exercised an option to purchase 397,500 additional shares. The offering closed February 19, generating approximately $2.31 billion in net proceeds. Certain holders also waived registration rights related to the offering.

Young African entrepreneurs are developing ways to make agriculture more resilient to climate change while creating jobs. In Rwanda, Habona turns waste into cooking fuel and fertiliser. In Malawi, an organisation funds women science students who train rural farmers in irrigation and climate-resilient farming. In Kenya, UjuziKilimo uses soil sensors to advise farmers on crops and inputs. The initiatives were showcased at a summit focused on young people’s role in African agriculture. A U.N. Environment Programme official said agricultural supply chains offer further opportunities for income and employment.

Bar Harbor Bankshares reported $14.9 million in net income for 2016, including $2.7 million in acquisition and system-conversion charges. Assets rose to $1.8 billion, loans grew 14 percent, and non-interest income increased 38 percent. Fourth-quarter diluted earnings were 42 cents per share.

A collection of November 2001 reports describes Enron’s worsening finances. The company widened its third-quarter loss to $664 million and warned that a credit downgrade could require it to repay or secure a $690 million note. A further downgrade could trigger billions more in obligations, while declining asset values could hurt fourth-quarter results. Bankers questioned whether Dynegy’s planned acquisition would proceed amid Enron’s financial problems and shareholder lawsuits. Enron’s accounts remained under review, and Representative John Dingell sought an investigation of auditor Arthur Andersen.

The Supreme Court heard arguments over whether the federal government can be sued for intentionally failing to deliver mail. Texas landlord Lebene Konan alleges postal workers withheld mail to her property as part of racial harassment. A district court dismissed her lawsuit, but an appeals court allowed claims against the Postal Service and the United States to proceed, finding that intentional nondelivery falls outside a statutory exception for mail “loss,” “miscarriage,” or “negligent transmission.” Justices debated those terms and whether allowing the suit would prompt many more mail-delivery lawsuits. A decision is expected by early July.
Staff at Aiken County’s Silverbluff Audubon Center are rooting for the Philadelphia Eagles in the Super Bowl because bald eagles nest there. A nesting pair has been at the center since 1994.

In rebuttal testimony for Indicated Electric Generators, R. Thomas Beach urges the California Public Utilities Commission to adopt the Comprehensive Settlement Agreement rather than SCGC and TURN’s proposal. He argues that unbundling SoCalGas transmission, as under PG&E’s Gas Accord, would promote statewide consistency, city-gate competition, lower generator rates, and reduced risks. Beach disputes SCGC and TURN’s cost analysis, saying it overstates demand-charge impacts and overlooks options for generators to avoid or reduce those charges.
All four analysts pick Dariush over Evan Dunham at UFC 216, citing his all-around skills. Three predict a unanimous decision; one predicts a second-round submission.

Radford University held September forums for two finalists for Vice President for Student Affairs, a position vacant since Dr. Irvin Clark’s departure after the spring 2017 semester. Dr. Thomas C. Segar, a vice president at Shepherd University, emphasized student success, belonging and support. Dr. Ann Marie Klotz, a dean at the New York Institute of Technology, emphasized mentorship, adapting programs to students’ needs and using social media to share Radford students’ stories.

VOT broadcasts to Tibet on three shortwave frequencies—about 11.510, 9.510 and 15.565 MHz—and advises frequent retuning. Its ASIASAT 7 satellite service, listed as “MOMO,” broadcasts continuously, alternating 30-minute Mandarin and Tibetan segments.

Australia and Germany finished the first day of their 2018 Davis Cup tie level at 1-1. Alexander Zverev beat Alex de Minaur in five sets to give Germany the lead, before Nick Kyrgios defeated Jan-Lennard Struff 6-4, 6-4, 6-4. The tie continues with doubles on Saturday, followed by reverse singles on Sunday.
Jacob Allen sued Richard and Hannah Knight for his unpaid inheritance; the jury awarded his share and court costs.

Threats between Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un prompted a global market sell-off and renewed volatility amid fears of nuclear conflict. Raymond James strategist Jeffrey Saut said markets could pull back but expected the long-term bull market to continue. He considered war unlikely, though he said a conflict could push oil to $150 a barrel. Chantico Global’s Gina Sanchez also warned of heightened market volatility.

Microsoft announced on July 8, 2021, that it would redeem all €1.75 billion of its outstanding 2.125% notes due December 6, 2021, on September 6, 2021. The redemption price is the principal plus accrued and unpaid interest. The Form 8-K includes a press release but is not itself a notice of redemption.

A mouse study found that black tea extract changed gut bacteria, increasing microbes associated with lean body mass and decreasing those associated with obesity. Researchers suggest black tea may support weight loss through the gut microbiome, while green tea also acts in the liver.

Although many U.S. universities prioritize global learning, only about one percent of their students study abroad. This article offers a framework for developing sustainable education abroad programs around three interdependent priorities: learning objectives, operational planning, and finances. It addresses program design, safety, staffing, travel logistics, budgeting, and funding, then describes adaptable business models led by external organizations, faculty, or students. The authors emphasize aligning educational goals with available resources while reducing costs and expanding access.

Police say Parker Hogan, 19, helped his roommate Michael Buskey plan his May 8 suicide, then removed items from the scene. Hogan pleaded not guilty to charges related to the death and to falsifying evidence. He posted bail and is due in court in July.

The 179-megawatt Switch Station 1 and 2 solar plants near Las Vegas were commissioned Dec. 11, 2017. Their output is dedicated to Switch data centers in Reno and Las Vegas, though it could meet the electricity needs of 46,000 Nevada homes.

The speaker adjusted to seeing the puck around Zdeno and credited teammates with keeping shots to the sides. They praised Timmy’s early saves and Tico’s goal, said practice helped them stay sharp after a layoff, and planned to focus on Saturday after winning the first game of a seven-game series.

This qualitative case study interviewed four experienced Anadolu University academics about how advanced technologies may affect open and distance education. Participants predicted that artificial intelligence, blockchain, virtual and augmented reality, the metaverse, and brain-computer interfaces could change teaching, assessment, services, and management. They described possibilities including personalized learning, AI assistants, recognition of prior learning, and more automated administration. They also raised concerns about investment costs, employment, technological readiness, reduced face-to-face communication, and psychological and cultural effects. The study recommends testing AI assistants, blockchain applications, and adaptive content, while conducting larger-scale research across universities and regions.

The passage describes a neuromodulation system that uses programmable electrodes to create a substantially linear electric field across neural tissue. Its target multipole progressively distributes current among anodes and cathodes to enhance modulation of dorsal horn or dorsal root tissue while reducing dorsal column activation. A programming interface may let users adjust the field’s orientation, length, width and strength, or define a target using an anatomical region or pain area. The system may also move the target multipole across an electrode array and use search methods to optimize the field.

Hartman reports that Andropov’s foreign policy largely continues Brezhnev’s hard line, though relations with the United States remain a Soviet priority. He urges greater emphasis on arms control to reduce the risk of nuclear war and improve relations, while maintaining a strong defense. He argues that the U.S. zero-zero position in intermediate-range nuclear force negotiations should change because Soviet proposals and propaganda are shifting European pressure toward the United States and could jeopardize planned deployments. He describes those deployments as primarily a political commitment to Europe’s defense.
Analyst Ming-chi Kuo expects 38mm and 42mm Apple Watch Series 3 models with or without LTE. He forecasts 17.5–18 million Apple Watch sales next year, including 2.8–3.6 million LTE units.

John Bryant sued New York’s correctional department, Sing Sing prison, and Officer Hernandez under Section 1983 after an allegedly false ammunition report prompted a roughly twenty-day lockdown. Bryant alleged restrictive conditions, intrusive cell searches, and inadequate inmate pay. The court dismissed the claims against the department and Sing Sing because, as state entities, they have Eleventh Amendment immunity. The claim against Hernandez could proceed if he was properly served.

A Senate committee criticized the Supreme Court of Canada’s trial-delay deadlines as unrealistic and proposed 50 recommendations to speed up criminal trials. Senators warned that the deadlines could lead to tens of thousands of charges being dismissed next year.

The Grand River Conservation Authority plans to spend $1.8 million over five years using LiDAR to digitally map the Grand River floodplain and most Speed and Conestogo river floodplains. Combined with new forecasting software, the detailed maps will help predict downstream flooding in near real time and identify threatened properties. Many existing maps are more than 40 years old.

Engineers demonstrated an optical method that rapidly screens the crystalline structure of natural and synthetic proteins, including strands produced by living bacteria. The method uses ultrafast lasers during flow cytometry to measure proteins before heating changes their structure, then separates selected proteins. This proof-of-concept approach screens samples in milliseconds without killing living cells. A grant will support equipment to increase screening capacity.

The Government is consulting on stronger powers to hold directors accountable after insolvencies such as Carillion and BHS. Proposals include reversing asset stripping to recover money for workers, disqualifying directors who sell struggling companies, and expanding Insolvency Service powers. Frank Field welcomed greater accountability, while Shadow business secretary Rebecca Long-Bailey said the Government should have acted sooner.

The passage proposes a method for assessing the probability that a prospective e-commerce interaction will fail to meet a trusting agent’s criteria. Because risk changes over time, the agent divides the assessment period into time slots. It determines past FailureLevels from its own interactions or relevant, trustworthy recommendations, then uses a Gaussian distribution to predict the probability of each future failure level. An example compares two prospective logistics agents. Assessing the consequences of failure, the other component of risk, is left for future work.

The speaker says the next game is a must-win but emphasizes focusing on performance rather than the result. The team shares a desire to win the Cup and plans to review defensive play, limit shots and improve along the boards. Detroit’s strong lines may make matchups less important.

A memorial football match for Aidan Sutherland, who died from diabetes complications shortly after turning 20, will take place at Stark’s Park on Sunday. Organised by his friend Ben Graham, it will raise awareness of diabetes and support the Diabetes Research and Wellness Foundation. Friends, former teammates and professional players will take part. Events begin at noon, with kick-off at 1pm.

A qualitative case study interviewed ten special education teachers in Kazakhstan about distance education for students with disabilities. Teachers reported using online lessons, videos, homework and other digital activities. Seven preferred formal education, and six found distance education insufficient for meeting students’ individual learning needs. They identified family anxiety, limited technology and communication, and weak teacher–student and peer interaction as problems. The study recommends improving technological infrastructure, tailoring learning materials, supporting families through online seminars, and organizing activities to strengthen social interaction.

Cincinnati upset No. 14 Iowa State 38–30 after building a 31–7 halftime lead, handing the Cyclones their first loss of the season. The result leaves the Big 12 title race wide open, echoing last season’s unpredictable conference results.

The speaker says the team learns from difficult conversations and corrects mistakes during games. They describe finding a position in front of the net during a six-on-five play, express excitement about returning to the fans, and stress discipline. They credit contributions from the full lineup and say the team’s depth has helped it handle injuries.

Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and epilepsy are associated with increased risk of each other, and seizures in AD are linked to faster cognitive decline. An analysis of brain transcriptomic data from three AD cohorts compared a subtype marked by synaptic plasticity dysfunction and more severe cognitive impairment with other sporadic AD cases. Sixteen epilepsy-associated genes were dysregulated across all three cohorts: 15 were downregulated, while CERS1 was upregulated. The subtype was also enriched for epilepsy-related synaptic and ion-channel pathways. In one cohort, dysregulation appeared in early AD but was more pronounced in later stages. The findings identify shared molecular features, but do not establish whether epilepsy-related changes precede AD pathology or follow it.

The passage highlights Amazon Prime Day toy discounts, including a 20-inch Bigfoot Squishmallow for more than half off, a 32-piece Magna-Tiles set for $35, and a retired Lego dried-flower centerpiece. Other deals include discounted Squishmallows, Play-Doh, building toys, a Melissa & Doug ice cream counter, a Crayola coloring station, and a rock tumbler kit.

In his farewell address, the President thanks Americans for the opportunity to serve and expresses gratitude for his administration’s cooperation with Congress. He calls for sustained efforts toward peace and liberty, urging balance in national priorities rather than costly responses to each crisis. While affirming the need for strong defenses, he warns against unwarranted influence from the military-industrial complex and against government or scientific elites dominating research and public policy. He also urges Americans to protect future generations’ resources, pursue disarmament, and resolve international differences through mutual respect rather than war.

In a prospective study of 103 patients with cerebral cavernous malformations, researchers examined genetic variants and plasma inflammatory markers as potential biomarkers of symptoms. PTPN2 rs72872125 CT and VDR rs7975232 CC were associated with an asymptomatic presentation. A combination of PTPN2 rs72872125 CC and GM-CSF levels showed modest ability to distinguish symptomatic patients. Among 42 patients followed for four years, four had symptomatic events; FCGR2A rs1801274 GG was associated with these events. Two VDR variants were associated with the timing of first symptoms. This preprint has not been peer reviewed.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs use 2:4 structured sparsity to halve weight storage and double sparse Tensor Core math throughput, with virtually no inference accuracy loss in the evaluations described. Enhanced DLSS and third-generation Tensor Cores enable higher-performance ray-traced gaming, including 8K at 60 fps in many titles on the RTX 3090. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling and delivers up to 936 GB/sec of peak bandwidth. RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move game-asset decompression from the CPU to the GPU, reducing I/O bottlenecks.

The passage also describes the A40 and RTX A6000 for data-center and professional workloads, support for high-resolution displays, hardware AV1 decoding and video encoding, and memory Error Detection and Replay for overclocking. NVIDIA states that specifications may change and disclaims warranties and liability as detailed in the document.

The passage describes a model of methane bubble growth in soft aquatic mud. It couples dissolved-methane diffusion with sediment elasticity and fracture mechanics, treating large bubbles as gas-filled cracks that expand and fracture the surrounding sediment. Numerical simulations of mature bubble shapes and sizes agree with analytical solutions across the tested fracture toughness values. The model applies to individual bubbles; methods for translating its results into properties of gassy sediments remain to be developed.

The passage says uranium prices have risen from their November 2016 low, while analysts generally expect demand to grow as nuclear power expands. The World Nuclear Association reports about 440 operating reactors, with more than 160 planned and over 300 proposed. Negative sentiment remains a factor for investors. The author views the Global X Uranium ETF’s recent decline as a possible correction rather than the end of its advance, but notes short-term weakness and the need for April’s low to hold as support.

Amazon has patented a system that could let a malfunctioning delivery drone release components to control its descent. The proposed system would use flight and terrain data to direct falling parts toward preferred locations, such as water or open fields. Weather and equipment failures are among the problems it addresses. The patent does not mean Amazon will use the system.

Elizabeth C. Dillingham delivered six $3,000 checks in December 1980. The recipients cashed them in January 1981, when she gave them six additional $3,000 checks. The Tax Court held that the December gifts were completed in 1981, when the bank paid the checks, not when Dillingham delivered them. The estate had not proved unconditional delivery, so the court declined to apply the relation-back doctrine. Under Oklahoma law, Dillingham retained control over the funds until payment. The parties had agreed that a 1981 gift date would preclude the claimed annual gift-tax exclusions and leave the estate-tax assessment unbarred by the limitations period.

This study examined a teacher education course combining collaborative inquiry and panoramic camera recordings to help teacher education students diagnose junior high school students’ learning problems and refine teaching activities. Twenty-two participants completed preparation and four cycles of lesson planning, teaching, observation, discussion, and revision. Observation-report scores improved across the cycles, and participants reported statistically significant gains in perceived instructional design capabilities. The study concludes that the approach is feasible for teacher education, while noting that it did not establish whether participants’ proposed instructional adjustments effectively addressed students’ learning problems.

Social media platforms are using A.I. to identify content that may violate their standards, including offensive language and images. But algorithms can misread context and intent, make errors as language changes, and reproduce biases in their training data. A.I. can help prioritize posts for review and make moderation faster, but human reviewers remain necessary to judge whether content violates standards. The passage also raises concern that ethical considerations may lag behind the technology’s development.

The President reports peace with other nations and pledges strict neutrality in foreign conflicts. He describes friendly relations with Britain, restored diplomatic relations with France, and the suppression of a planned invasion of Cuba. He asks Congress to strengthen laws against the African slave trade and supports protected, equally accessible routes between the Atlantic and Pacific.

Anticipating deficits from the Mexican War and territorial acquisitions, he recommends borrowing, economy, tariff revision, and an agricultural bureau. He urges consideration of California’s admission, preparations for governing and surveying western territories, improved Pacific communications, and stronger frontier defenses. He also recommends postal reforms and legislation for the next census. He closes by emphasizing the separation of governmental powers and the preservation of the Union.

Connecticut municipal lobbyists asked Gov. Dannel P. Malloy to ease costly state mandates and give towns more ways to control expenses amid a budget stalemate. Their proposals include changes to binding arbitration, prevailing-wage requirements and the municipal retirement system, fewer barriers to sharing services, and a larger share of land-transfer fees. Malloy called the meeting productive and said the lack of a budget was creating uncertainty. A municipal lobbyist said towns were not seeking to preserve current state-aid levels, but Senate President Pro Tempore Martin Looney disputed that account. Lawmakers remained divided over municipal aid while addressing an estimated $3.5 billion deficit.

To obtain warranty service, contact SanDisk and return the product as instructed in tamper-resistant packaging, freight prepaid, with tracking confirmation. SanDisk may repair, replace or refund it. The warranty excludes lost data and limits liability, subject to applicable law.

Downloading, installing or using the software signifies acceptance of its license. The license permits personal use with a SanDisk product on one device at a time and restricts modification, reverse engineering and distribution. The software is provided without warranties, and SanDisk disclaims liability for high-risk uses. The license may be transferred only with the product and agreement, and SanDisk may terminate it for breach. California law governs the agreement.

The passage describes a computer-based method and system for planning orthodontic treatment and manufacturing appliances.
