It measures a patient’s tooth positions, malocclusions and movement constraints, then generates multiple treatment plans with different correction options, including extractions and interproximal reduction. Interim tooth positions are evaluated and revised to address conditions such as openbite, crossbite, molar and canine malocclusions, and overjet. A dental professional may select a plan, after which the system generates treatment stages, appliance models and fabrication instructions. The appliances can be made by direct or indirect fabrication and worn sequentially to reposition teeth.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2018, reports quarterly revenue of $6.82 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $311.5 million, compared with revenue of $2.98 billion and a $619.4 million loss a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2018, revenue was $14.24 billion and the loss attributable to common stockholders was $1.12 billion. At September 30, Tesla held $2.97 billion in cash and cash equivalents and reported $10.90 billion in unpaid debt principal. Its January 2018 adoption of a new revenue standard changed the accounting for certain vehicle sales with resale value guarantees.

A French observational study examined COVID-19 convalescent plasma (CCP) in 112 patients with hematological malignancies and compared outcomes among patients with B-cell neoplasms who did or did not receive CCP. Ninety-day survival after transfusion was 64.9% overall and 77.5% among patients with B-lymphoid neoplasms. In the main weighted comparison, CCP was associated with a 63% lower risk of death among patients previously treated with anti-CD20 therapy who survived 16 days after hospitalization. Inflammatory markers decreased after transfusion, and few transfusion-related adverse events were reported. The authors note that the retrospective comparison cannot establish a causal treatment effect and call for confirmation in a randomized trial.

The passage lists silicon-revision A3 issues for the AMD Geode CS5535 companion device, affecting DMA, interrupts, power management, clocks, and peripheral access. Detailed issues include PIT command and count-loading deviations, a debug port that hangs the system, incorrect DMA priority rotation, and thermal-alarm recovery limitations. It advises against using the debug port and relying on the affected PIT behavior. It also states that the PMC Sleep Clock option must be enabled when certain other sleep options are used, even if the clock is disabled at the GPIO.

Apple reported that on September 12, 2017, it issued $5 billion in senior unsecured notes: $1 billion due 2019 at 1.500%, $1 billion due 2022 at 2.100%, $2 billion due 2027 at 2.900%, and $1 billion due 2047 at 3.750%. Interest is payable semiannually beginning March 12, 2018. The filing includes the underwriting agreement, note forms and a legal opinion.

Diana Containerships reported a quarterly loss of $0.66 per share, narrower than the $0.77 loss analysts expected. Revenue was $5.40 million, below the $7.50 million estimate and down 63.8% year over year. Renaissance Technologies increased its stake by 94.4% in the fourth quarter, while Zacks Investment Research upgraded the stock from “sell” to “hold.”

A March 2001 news digest covers Enron’s activities and energy-market developments. Enron reported a $7 million bonus for Chairman Kenneth Lay, while CEO Jeffrey Skilling projected 2001 revenue of $160 billion to $170 billion and said California’s electricity rate increase could ease shortages. Enron’s Japan venture submitted plans for a gas-fired power plant; in India, Enron withdrew from a power-project bid while its wind-power subsidiary sought approval for a new venture. Other reports discuss Texas electricity deregulation, Enron’s stake in a gas project supplying the United Arab Emirates, and its call for changes to U.S. export financing.

May Baxter-Thornton of Newport and Emma Lewis of Swansea have joined the Independent Inquiry into Child Sexual Abuse’s victims and survivors panel. Both experienced child sexual abuse and will advise the inquiry on reaching and listening to Welsh victims and survivors. They pledged to ensure those voices inform its work.
The Louisiana Supreme Court granted a writ of review in *Chappuis v. Sears Roebuck & Co.* and ordered the Court of Appeal to submit the case record and notify counsel.

Roanoke College’s first president, David Bittle, planted a tulip poplar that stood for over a century before damage made it hazardous. Its wood became the Bittle Tree of Life Cross in Antrim Chapel. Reverend Chris Bowen proposed the symbolic cross, and retired professor George Arthur made it.

The passage describes a media playback system in which a playback device uses digital audio data to identify content while playing it. The device sends a portion of the data to an identification system, receives related information, and passes it to a control device for display. Identification may be requested by the control device or triggered by changes in the audio data. The passage also describes playback zones, audio sources, and ways to process data before identification.

Steve Yzerman said the Lightning set no timeline for building the team. He emphasized drafting, developing home-grown players and giving them time to mature, while using trades and free agency where helpful. He credited the scouting and development staffs and said attracting players depends on offering a strong program and a chance to win.

Coach Cooper said the team’s earlier setbacks helped shape its response to adversity during the playoffs. He credited the players’ character and recalled how coaching several of them together in the minors helped their development. Both described Steven Stamkos as a leader who has accepted different roles and put the team first. Yzerman said his role during the playoffs is chiefly to support the coaches and players.

Electric Resistance Welding (ERW) steel pipe is used to transport petroleum, gas, and other liquids and vapors under varying pressures. Made from hot-rolled coil, it is used in several industrial sectors and urban gas networks. Production controls wall thickness to ±0.2 mm and removes inner and outer burrs. Pipe ends are prepared to API or GB/T9711.1 standards.

In one letter, Beth Utton disputes Rep. Ken Buck’s description of health care as a commodity and argues that it is a right best served by Medicare for all. In another, Bonnie New criticizes a headline and Denver’s settlement with the family of a teen killed by police. She says the teen was driving a stolen car toward an officer and argues that the officer had a right to defend himself.

A Deloitte survey found that consumer concern about self-driving car safety fell from 73% last year to 49%. Respondents cited the brands developing the vehicles as a source of confidence, and trusted traditional car manufacturers more than technology companies to implement the technology. Most preferred engine-powered cars to electric ones, citing range, price and charging infrastructure. The UK government is launching an inquiry into autonomous-vehicle safety.

The passage describes the presidential election cycle theory, which links U.S. stock market performance to the four-year presidential term. Citing Yale Hirsch’s *Stock Trader’s Almanac*, it says pre-election years have historically performed best, election years second best, and midterm years have often been weak until the fourth quarter. It also notes that the theory does not reliably predict every election cycle. Election-related policy uncertainty may affect sectors such as healthcare and energy, while congressional control can shape legislation. The passage recommends monitoring policy effects, staying invested, and rebalancing portfolios.

New Jersey Governor Chris Christie signed a law strengthening protections for people with developmental disabilities and increasing families’ involvement in their care. Proposed after Stephen Komninos died in a group home, it allows twice-yearly unannounced inspections and requires prompt injury notifications and at least two family meetings annually.

The passage describes display devices that combine a backlight, spatial light modulator, polarisers and retarders to control viewing angles. A directional waveguide can direct light from selected sources into viewing windows, while passive or switchable liquid-crystal retarders reduce off-axis image visibility in a privacy mode. Control systems may coordinate the light sources, display images and retarder voltage to switch between privacy and wide-angle modes. Described applications include autostereoscopic, multi-viewer, privacy and automotive displays.

The Browns have not ruled out drafting Oklahoma quarterback Baker Mayfield first overall, according to an ESPN report. General manager John Dorsey says Cleveland remains open to all options, while coach Hue Jackson says four top quarterbacks are still in contention.

This literature review examines Christian and global education through Mortimer J. Adler’s perennialism and posthumanist thought. It presents enduring values, rather than instant achievement, as central to education. Adler’s concept of docility calls for learners to consider trusted teachers’ guidance while continuing to exercise judgment. The researchers argue that education should respect children’s capacities and curiosity, support women’s access to education, and avoid blaming children for institutional failures. They conclude that education management should extend beyond administration to address learners’ intellectual and personal development.

Jefferies raised its Ferguson Plc price target from GBX 5,170 to GBX 5,240 while maintaining a hold rating. Across analysts cited, the stock has an average buy rating and a GBX 5,265.71 average price target. Ferguson shares rose 0.68% to GBX 5,200 on Thursday. The company distributes plumbing, heating and building products.

The May 30, 2001 VentureWire People newsletter reports executive appointments across technology companies and a venture capital firm. It also lists senior-level job openings in sales, marketing, finance, product management and venture capital.

Intel’s Management Engine (ME) is an always-on component in many Intel CPUs with access to storage and networking. Researchers presented an exploit that allows arbitrary code to run on the ME, but it requires physical access and affects versions above 11. Intel offers a detection tool, while disabling the ME depends on the computer manufacturer; System76 and Dell offer some systems with it disabled. The me_cleaner tool can render the ME inactive while keeping a computer functional. The passage says no remote network exploit is known and argues that the ME’s closed-source design makes its security difficult to assess.

On July 18, 1877, President Rutherford B. Hayes ordered those involved in violence and obstruction of the law along West Virginia’s Baltimore and Ohio Railroad to disperse by noon the next day. He also warned others not to aid them.

Ed Sachse began his career running a window-washing business as a Detroit teenager. After studying accounting at Michigan State University, he worked for Arthur Andersen and later moved to Los Angeles, where he entered commercial real estate brokerage. He founded a property management and brokerage company in 1993. Sachse kept the business running while undergoing treatment for stage 4 non-Hodgkin lymphoma, then faced layoffs during the Great Recession. Kennedy Wilson bought his company after he approached it seeking new business. He now oversees the firm’s brokers and 21 million square feet of properties across the United States.

Venezuelan Temporary Protected Status holders asked the Supreme Court to leave in place a federal judge’s ruling that bars the Trump administration from ending their protections. Judge Edward Chen ruled in September that Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem had acted unlawfully in terminating Venezuela’s 2023 TPS designation and its extension. The administration argues that an earlier Supreme Court order pausing Chen’s preliminary ruling requires courts to pause his final ruling too. The challengers say the earlier order did not prevent a final judgment, which rests on different legal grounds and a more developed record.

The passage describes an optical waveguide display whose field of view is limited when diffracted light cannot be retained by total internal reflection, particularly across different wavelengths. The proposed apparatus coats the waveguide’s reflecting surfaces with a material having a refractive index at or below about 1.0. This lowers the critical angle for total internal reflection, allowing more input light to propagate to an output grating and potentially widening the field of view. The passage also describes metamaterial coatings, multilayer arrangements for different colours, and optional protective layers.

The MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 use an Arm Cortex-M0+ CPU running at up to 32 MHz, with instruction caching, a system timer, and interrupt management. Five operating modes—RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN—provide decreasing power consumption; SRAM contents are lost in SHUTDOWN.

The devices include clock and power-management modules, flash and SRAM, DMA, GPIO and pin multiplexing, a 12-bit ADC, temperature sensing, voltage reference, comparator, UART, I2C, SPI, watchdogs, real-time clock, timers, security features, and serial-wire debugging. The passage also describes application-circuit recommendations, development resources, device nomenclature, revision changes, and packaging information.

Nicola Sturgeon called Theresa May’s proposed 8 June election a political miscalculation, saying Conservatives hoped to exploit Labour’s disarray to secure a larger majority, pursue a hard Brexit and impose deeper cuts. She said it would let Scottish voters reject the Conservatives and reinforce the mandate for a second independence referendum. Scottish Conservative leader Ruth Davidson said a Tory vote would support stronger Brexit negotiations and oppose another referendum.

Genworth Financial shares fell 0.37% in the most recent session and closed at $2.70. Two analysts set a 12-month price target of $3, while five analysts rated the stock Hold. Its average brokerage recommendation was 3. The stock’s 14-period average true range was 0.1, its relative strength index was 42.86, and weekly and monthly volatility were 2.81% and 3.58%. Genworth’s market capitalization was $1.39 billion, with 515.35 million shares outstanding. Previous trading volume was 2.14 million shares, below the 3.43 million average.

Sheffield Lord Mayor Magid Magid called Donald Trump a “wasteman,” declared him banned from the city and named July 13 Mexico Solidarity Day ahead of Trump’s UK visit. Magid said he wanted to show solidarity with Mexicans and criticized Trump’s policies on immigration, climate change and other issues. At 28, Magid is Sheffield’s youngest Lord Mayor and its first from the Green Party.

Researchers are studying how memories form, where they are stored, and whether they can be changed. Findings on “face cells” and the learning-related protein CREB suggest that activating certain neurons before learning may influence where memories are stored. A team at MIT created a negative association with a harmless situation and later reversed it to a positive one.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says rights holders react differently to AI video than to still images because video feels more lifelike. After Sora-generated videos featuring familiar characters spread online, he announced plans to give rights holders more control over character generation. Altman says most rights holders he has spoken with want restrictions rather than exclusion, and predicts they may eventually welcome more AI-generated content.

After scratching a hand on a nail, the author developed sepsis, spent three months in a coma and took another year to recover. Sepsis occurs when the body’s response to an infection becomes uncontrolled and can cause organ failure. It affects more than 30 million people worldwide each year and kills an estimated 6 million; many survivors experience lasting symptoms. Warning signs can include mottled skin, severe breathlessness, shivering or muscle pain, and not urinating all day. The passage urges immediate emergency care if sepsis is suspected. There is no specific cure, though research into new treatments is promising. Greater public and medical awareness could save lives.

La-Z-Boy outperforms Stanley Furniture on 12 of 14 factors compared. It has higher revenue and earnings, positive profitability, greater institutional ownership and a 1.6% dividend yield; Stanley Furniture reports losses and pays no dividend. Stanley Furniture has lower share-price volatility and greater insider ownership. La-Z-Boy has three hold ratings, one buy rating and a $30.33 consensus price target, while Stanley Furniture has no reported analyst ratings.

The passage presents a face-anonymization system for scientific experiment videos that blurs students’ faces while keeping instruments and actions visible for assessment. It combines a modified YOLOv8 model for detection and segmentation, face tracking, and training-data processing designed to reduce accidental blurring of objects. Evaluated on a dataset drawn from 51 experiment videos, the system achieved 96.02% facial-blurring accuracy at 22.67 frames per second, with an over-blur rate of 0.0159 on the full dataset. The authors identify precise edge classification during real-time processing as an area for further research.

The lecture reviews renewal theory before applying it to countable-state Markov chains. The strong law and elementary renewal theorem describe long-run renewal rates, while Blackwell’s theorem describes the limiting probability of a renewal at an allowable time. For an arithmetic renewal process, the professor uses this result to derive the limiting distributions of age and of the interval surrounding a given time, explaining why observed intervals tend to be longer than typical inter-renewal intervals.

Unlike finite-state chains, countable-state chains can lack a steady-state distribution. In the random-walk and birth-death examples, states may be visited again with probability one even though their long-run probabilities approach zero. The lecture defines first-passage probabilities and recurrence, then treats successive returns to a recurrent state as a renewal process. It distinguishes positive recurrence, with finite expected return time, from null recurrence, with infinite expected return time.

The passage argues that trade deficits reduce US demand and can raise unemployment, though budget deficits or bubbles can offset that effect. It rejects the claim that the dollar’s reserve-currency role requires trade deficits, saying some countries hold dollars to strengthen their trade competitiveness. It also argues that US companies chose to invest in China despite its technology-transfer conditions.

The speaker says the team is excited to play for the Stanley Cup after beating three strong opponents and is unconcerned with outside perceptions. He calls Mike Peca hockey’s best all-around player and credits the team’s success to physical play and strong-skating forwards who forecheck effectively. He says the layoff allowed players to relax and refocus, while adversity in earlier rounds has prepared them for the series against Dallas.

The passage describes a QQQ mean-reversion strategy that buys when the two-day RSI falls below 10 and exits when the close exceeds the previous day’s high. It reports a 10.01% return versus 6.39% for buy-and-hold and says the strategy performed well during four bear markets. Adding an unspecified second indicator reportedly raised CAGR to about 12.7%, with 232 trades, 75% winners and a 19.5% maximum drawdown.

SD Memory Cards are designed for emerging audio and video devices, with content protection, higher capacity and faster performance. They allow non-secure access to users’ own content and may support additional security systems. SDIO cards add I/O functionality while remaining compatible with SD Memory Cards; non-SDIO hosts should ignore them without disruption. SD Memory Cards use a 9-pin interface operating at up to 208 MHz.
In HS mode, the ADS7828 holds the clock LOW until conversion completes. A repeated START retains HS mode; a STOP returns it to F/S mode.

JD Wetherspoon’s plans a 1,600-square-metre gastropub on Dublin’s Lower Abbey Street, linking a former bank and chapel. The Circuit Licensing Court granted a drinks and restaurant licence, subject to planning permission. The venue is expected to open between 2019 and 2022. The company already operates pubs in Ireland and says its drink prices have risen in recent years.

The BGF China Flexible Equity Fund gives investors access to both mainland and offshore Chinese stocks through one strategy. It is a concentrated, long-only fund that selects 20 to 50 companies across markets, sectors and company sizes. Helen Zhu manages the fund with support from 10 China-focused research analysts.

An Alberta Education survey of nearly 10,000 people, half of them teachers, found calls for more practical skills and emphasis on reading, writing and math in a planned K–12 curriculum overhaul. Most respondents said the drafts supported literacy, numeracy and critical thinking, but social studies drew strong, divided feedback, including concerns about its treatment of Indigenous topics and world history. Alberta Teachers’ Association president Greg Jeffery said teacher preparation would be crucial. The government aims to finish writing the K–4 curriculum by December and higher grades by 2022, but has not set a classroom rollout date.

The lecture compares auction formats using an independent private values model. In second-price sealed-bid and ascending button auctions, bidders can bid or remain in until their true value; the winner pays the second-highest value. In first-price sealed-bid auctions, bidders shade their bids below their values. Under the model’s assumptions, both formats yield the same expected seller revenue. A broader revenue equivalence theorem applies when the highest-value bidder wins and the lowest-value type receives no surplus.

The lecture also explains why auction design still matters: risk aversion, correlated values, reserve prices, and costly bidder entry can change outcomes. In common-value auctions, bidders account for the “winner’s curse”—winning can indicate that other bidders had less optimistic information.

An empirical study of offshore oil leases illustrates asymmetric information. Firms already drilling nearby have better information about drainage tracts than outside bidders. The study develops predictions about bidding, profits, and tract values, then compares them with auction data; the lecture presents the results as evidence that asymmetric information discourages outside bidders.

Brad Vis has been chosen as the Conservative candidate for Mission-Matsqui-Fraser Canyon in next year’s federal election. He lost the riding to Liberal Jati Sidhu by just over 1,000 votes in 2015. Vis criticized Liberal spending, while the riding association said it would seek residents’ concerns across the constituency.

This September 2022 ebook edition of *Foreign Relations, 1981–1988, Volume I* provides the full text in a portable, searchable format that can be used offline. The *Foreign Relations* series documents major U.S. foreign policy decisions and diplomatic activity. Its statutory standards require comprehensive, accurate, objective documentation and publication within 30 years of the events recorded. Government agencies must provide historians access to relevant records. Most sources used for this volume have been declassified and are available at the National Archives.

This study examined 81 students in face-to-face tour guiding programs at Istanbul universities who experienced emergency distance education during the Covid-19 pandemic. Using interviews, questionnaires and thematic analysis, it found that students generally preferred face-to-face education for practical training, communication and opportunities to express themselves. They considered distance education insufficient for tour guiding, citing limited field practice, motivation and communication problems, and technical difficulties. They also valued its flexible scheduling, recorded lessons and reduced travel. Most reported understanding their distance courses despite preferring face-to-face learning. The authors suggest practical courses and stronger communication systems for distance education, while noting that the study’s qualitative findings are limited to Turkish tour guiding students’ emergency education experiences.

A data-driven culture can align employees with company goals and help teams collaborate through shared metrics, data models, and transparent access. Digital leaders reinforce learning, risk-taking, transparency, and measurement through consistent leadership beliefs, stated values, and daily practices. Digital laggards may recognize the importance of data culture but struggle to change entrenched habits and align behavior with ambitions.

Organizations fall into four patterns: data novices lack supporting culture and systems; insight-ready firms lack analytical capabilities; tech-enabled firms lack a culture of experimentation; and data-reliant firms may let data discourage critical thinking. Each can build on its strengths and target areas for improvement.

The speaker says he felt good but the Devils outplayed and outskated his team, especially in the second period. He does not blame the time off for the defeat. He says his team must match the Devils’ intensity, use its speed, shoot more and create traffic in front of the net. He views the loss as a chance to learn and says the team must respond in the next game.

Amazon’s 2015 Form 10-K reports net sales of $107.0 billion, up 20% from 2014, and net income of $596 million, compared with a $241 million loss. Its reportable segments were North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (AWS); AWS sales rose 70% to $7.9 billion. Operating cash flow reached $11.9 billion, and Amazon employed approximately 230,800 people at year-end. The company describes risks involving competition, international operations, fulfillment, security, taxes, and regulation.

A mixed-methods study of 388 students at six Indonesian universities found significant positive correlations between multilingual learning and cultural awareness. Indonesian was the most common mother tongue, while Javanese was the most studied local language and English the most studied foreign language. The study recommends culturally inclusive materials, intercultural collaboration, educator training, and technology-supported learning.

A December 2000 memorandum surveys electricity-sector restructuring and privatization from June to November across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. It reports expanding competition, utility unbundling, and foreign investment, while noting regional obstacles including regulatory delays, financial problems, and drought-related power shortages.

This 1917 *Foreign Relations of the United States* supplement chiefly covers the period when the United States was neutral, with some topics extending beyond April 6 to preserve continuing discussions or related developments in other countries. The ebook aims to preserve the printed edition while offering searchable, offline access; it recommends citing document numbers rather than page numbers. The preface explains the editorial use of brackets and parentheses and notes that faulty translations were corrected without significantly altering texts used at the time.

The passage proposes a method for a trusting agent in a digital business ecosystem to estimate the probability of not receiving the full benefit of resources invested with a prospective agent. It assesses failure against the interaction’s desired outcomes, using past interactions or recommendations to estimate failure before the interaction and predict it for later time slots. An Amount Invested Curve represents resources at stake over each slot; a Factual Amount Invested Curve incorporates the prospective agent’s predicted failure. The probability of lost resource benefit is read from that curve at the initially agreed investment amount. The resulting estimates can help the trusting agent choose whom to interact with.

Jeong-Suk Cha, 77, provides much of the round-the-clock care for her son Alex, 48, who has cerebral palsy and spinal cord damage. Despite help from family and personal support workers, the work strains her health. Alex has waited 13 years for a bed at Participation House, which has 40 spaces and 60 to 90 people waiting.

His sister Jin coordinates his care and is pressing for more residential housing for adults with complex physical disabilities. The family says long-term care with seniors is not a suitable alternative for Alex. A recently filed $100-million class-action lawsuit alleges that Ontario denies services to developmentally disabled adults through inconsistently administered wait lists.

The Shuffle offense, traced to Bruce Drake at Oklahoma, uses constant movement and a rotating five-player pattern to create scoring opportunities. It relies on passing, spacing, screening, rebounding and ball possession rather than extensive dribbling. Its sequence emphasizes a screened cut to the basket, followed by passes to a player coming off a screen or flashing into the middle. Players adjust their cuts and screens to defensive reactions, including switches and passing-lane overplay.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs add PCIe 4.0 support and improve FP32 processing, cache capacity, and shared-memory bandwidth over Turing. Their second-generation RT Cores accelerate ray tracing and motion blur, while third-generation Tensor Cores support additional data types and structured sparsity. GDDR6X increases memory bandwidth, and RTX IO uses GPU-based decompression to reduce CPU work when loading assets. The passage also describes DLSS, high-resolution display support, hardware video decoding and encoding, and the A40 and RTX A6000 GPUs for professional and data-center workloads.
The speaker says Philadelphia’s arena and fans can give the team an advantage. He also praises his team’s calm, quiet goalie for making big saves despite opponents’ attempts to disrupt him.

In the AEGEAN study, 1,162 subjects were randomized to standard care or an additional education program while initiating apixaban. Mean adherence at 24 weeks was 91.64% and 91.88%, respectively, with no significant difference. Adherence declined over time, but neither adherence nor persistence differed significantly between groups through 48 weeks. Safety outcomes were generally similar across groups. The study concluded that adherence and persistence remained high through 48 weeks and that the education program provided no additional benefit.

On November 6, 2017, an NVIDIA subsidiary exercised an option to buy its new Santa Clara campus property from Wachovia for approximately $350 million, terminating related lease and financing agreements upon completion. NVIDIA expected to take title in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2018. The filing also furnishes a November 9 press release and CFO commentary on third-quarter and first-nine-month fiscal 2018 results.

At its final 2017 meeting, the Brunswick school board took an initial step toward placing a renewal of its $4.67 million emergency levy on the May ballot. The renewal would not increase taxes. The board also authorized up to $10 million in notes for a new middle school and other improvements, and revised fiscal 2018 appropriations to reflect increased grant funding. Members thanked recent donors and recognized Lisa Durichko, who is leaving the board after 12 years. No action followed an executive session. The board’s organizational meeting is scheduled for Jan. 8.

The player said he had several scoring chances before converting in the Stanley Cup Final. He stayed in Finland to gain experience and win two championships before pursuing the NHL. After the team’s first Finals win, he called for more shots and continued effort. He chose the Sharks because they showed early interest and offered strong leadership.

The Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal temporarily barred penalties for operators that fail to meet Trai’s tariff-reporting requirements, while allowing Trai to request details of customer-retention discounts. Airtel and Idea challenged Trai’s new rules, which require reporting new tariffs within seven working days and permit penalties for delayed reporting and predatory pricing. Vodafone challenged the rules in the Madras high court. Incumbent operators say the rules limit their ability to compete and unfairly benefit Reliance Jio.

SD cards have a user area and an authentication-protected area. Their capacity classes are SDSC (up to 2 GB), SDHC (over 2 GB to 32 GB), and SDXC (over 32 GB to 2 TB); hosts supporting larger cards must also support smaller ones. Speed Classes 2, 4, 6, and 10 specify minimum transfer rates, while Class 0 specifies none.

The host controls communication through commands, responses, and CRC-protected data blocks. Cards are initialized and identified before entering data-transfer mode. UHS-I uses the SD bus and can reach 104 MB/s; UHS-II adds an interface with modes reaching 624 MB/s. The passage also specifies procedures for voltage switching, tuning, reading, writing, erasing, discarding, and logically erasing the full user area.

Write protection can involve a mechanical switch, internal protection, or password locking. Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password that restricts force erase and password-reset operations.

Researchers found that jets from the Phoenix cluster’s central black hole may help turn hot gas into cold fuel for star formation, rather than only suppressing it. Observations showed cold-gas filaments extending 20,000 light years from the black hole and aligned with bubbles in the hot gas. The finding may help explain why the cluster’s central galaxy produces about 1,000 stars a year.

Five Gor Mahia players—Kenneth Muguna, Meddie Kagere, Musa Mohammed, Jacques Tuyisenge and George Odhiambo—are shortlisted for the 2017 Kenyan Premier League Most Valuable Player award. The other nominees are Massoud Juma, Patrick Matasi and Lawrence Juma. With the league’s awards postponed, the Sports Journalists Association of Kenya will hold its own gala on December 18, covering eight categories, including MVP, goalkeeper, defender, midfielder and coach of the year. Prizes have not been announced.

A secondary analysis of 2,192 participants in the NuMoM2b cohort examined whether placental biomarkers measured in the first two trimesters were associated with retained placenta or postpartum hemorrhage requiring transfusion. Sixty-seven participants (3.1%) had one of these outcomes. Second-trimester sEng, β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A and sFlt-1 levels were higher in this group; PlGF did not differ. Among participants without preeclampsia, higher second-trimester β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A and sFlt-1 remained associated with these outcomes. The authors recommend further study of the biomarkers for risk screening. Limitations include the small number of affected participants and the absence of direct blood-loss measurements or a general hemorrhage diagnosis.

Shared patterns give distributed systems developers a common vocabulary, helping them share knowledge and discuss implementations without wasting time on different names for the same concept. The term “sidecar container” illustrates how a shared name lets developers focus on using a concept to solve a problem.

Retired firefighter-paramedic Luis Garcia spent nearly $40,000 of his savings on 800 doses of Narcan, a drug that can reverse opioid overdoses. He travels Florida giving away doses and training residents, business owners and law enforcement officers to use them. At a February 2018 event in Stuart, he distributed about 50 doses after training sessions. Garcia said he had responded to roughly 3,000 overdoses during his firefighting career.

The Steelers have won eight straight games, including a 39-38 victory over the Ravens. They host the Patriots in Week 15, potentially with the AFC’s No. 1 seed at stake. Shannon Sharpe questioned Pittsburgh’s chances, citing its close recent wins, Ryan Shazier’s injury and Tom Brady’s play.

The passage defines oversold markets as those that have fallen significantly over a set period and says they often rebound in the short term, though this does not predict long-term returns. A backtest of an S&P 500 strategy using a low three-day RSI reported an average gain of 0.64% per trade and a 75% win rate. The passage cautions that rebounds are not certain and that the strategy worked less well before 1990.

U.S. home prices rose 0.9% over the latest quarter, while annual growth reached 6.1%, its highest rate since February 2015, according to Clear Capital. Quarterly growth slowed slightly in the Midwest, increased in the Northeast and held steady in the South and West. San Jose and Hartford each recorded 0.3% quarterly declines, while Portland was the fastest-growing major market. Prices in 16 of the 50 largest metro markets have surpassed housing-bubble peaks; record-high markets account for about a third of national housing stock. Clear Capital projects annual price growth of 2–3% in 2017.

A secondary analysis of the Democratic Republic of Congo’s first year of COVID-19 vaccination found slow, uneven rollout. Sixteen of 26 provinces began immunization activities, and about 1.03% of the population was fully vaccinated by March 2022. The country administered only 8% of the vaccine doses it had received. The study describes vaccine hesitancy, logistical difficulties, competing disease outbreaks and health-system constraints, while noting limitations in the aggregated data.

A late surge of London IPO activity, including Beauty Tech Group’s £300 million debut and potential listings by Shawbrook and Princes Group, has raised hopes of a market revival after just three listings earlier in 2025. The deals span several sectors, but analysts say strong demand and post-listing performance will determine whether the rebound lasts. Norway’s Visma is reportedly considering a London float in 2026.

After touring flood damage in the Grand Forks area, the speaker praised residents, rescue workers and Grand Forks Air Force Base personnel for their response. He announced full federal funding for direct emergency assistance, expanded disaster coverage to counties in Minnesota and South Dakota, and requested another $200 million from Congress for relief and rebuilding. He acknowledged urgent housing and other needs, urged residents to support one another, and assigned FEMA Director James Lee Witt to lead a long-term rebuilding plan.

The government sought to postpone Watson and O’Hearn’s trial after immigration officials deported a key witness despite a request to retain him for testimony. The district court denied a continuance, citing the case’s age, potential speedy-trial concerns, government negligence, and the likely delay in obtaining testimony abroad. It denied the deposition request as moot. The First Circuit dismissed the government’s appeal, holding that these case-management orders did not directly exclude evidence and therefore were not appealable under the Criminal Appeals Act.

Tesla’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2019 reported revenue of $6.35 billion, up from $4.00 billion a year earlier. Net loss attributable to common stockholders was $408.3 million, compared with $717.5 million. At quarter-end, Tesla held $4.95 billion in cash and cash equivalents and had $31.87 billion in total assets. The filing also describes its adoption of a new lease accounting standard and its May 2019 acquisition of Maxwell Technologies for $207.2 million.
Tesla filed a Form 8-K on April 26, 2021, announcing that it had posted its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2021. Its First Quarter 2021 Update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

The November 28, 2000 VentureWire newsletter reports that ReplayTV is shifting to technology licensing and cutting staff, NetCom Technologies raised $75 million, Access Point Telecommunications laid off about 35% of its workers, and Rational Software acquired Catapulse for $405 million. It also covers numerous funding rounds, acquisitions, product launches, leadership changes, and venture capital news. Corrections clarify that Walker Digital remains in business, Promptu raised $25.4 million in its Series B round, and SoftWatch expects revenue growth of 250%.

This Foreign Relations volume documents Reagan administration policy toward the Soviet Union from January 1983 to March 1985. It focuses on efforts to implement the four-part agenda codified in January 1983: arms control, human rights, regional issues, and bilateral relations. Editorial notes supplement the documents, while related volumes cover other aspects of U.S.-Soviet relations. A declassification review completed in 2019 withheld one document in full and excised material from 33 others. The volume also documents how officials assessed Soviet leaders, though Reagan held no high-level meeting with Yuri Andropov or Konstantin Chernenko.

The passage describes a lumber-to-gold ratio strategy based on Michael Gayed’s use of the ratio as a risk-on/risk-off indicator. In the authors’ modified backtest, WOOD and GLD serve as proxies for lumber and gold. Rotating between stocks and long-term Treasuries produced 11.4% annual returns since 2008, with a 2.2% average gain per trade, but suffered a 35% drawdown. Rotating between stocks and gold performed worse, returning 8.7% annually.

Robert Putnam popularized the concept of social capital through his work on Italian democracy and his book *Bowling Alone*. He links civic participation to northern Italy’s stronger performance relative to the south and argues that declining participation in American groups contributed to social problems. The passage contrasts his emphasis on civic membership with another measure, generalized trust, noting a study that found trust—but not civic membership—associated with economic growth. It also distinguishes “bridging” ties across groups from “bonding” ties within groups. Putnam’s research suggests ethnic diversity often does not increase social capital, a finding the passage says nationalists have adopted.

The passage introduces a local, graph-neural-network-based Boltzmann Generator for sampling equilibrium configurations of crystalline materials. Trained on small systems, it transfers to systems exceeding 1,000 particles while reducing training costs and improving sampling efficiency relative to global architectures. Its free-energy estimates closely match molecular-dynamics reference results for several crystal structures, including ice and Lennard-Jones systems. Conditioning the model on thermodynamic states and interaction parameters also enables evaluation of phase stability across different conditions.

The passage describes augmented reality systems that track a user’s head and physical objects so virtual content can remain positioned relative to the real world. It outlines a head-mounted display supported by sensors, local processing and optional cloud resources, with electromagnetic, camera, depth-sensing and inertial data used for localization. Proposed embodiments also retrieve virtual content identified by sensor information, including QR codes, and share content between users after an invitation is accepted. The detailed description discusses ways to improve tracking accuracy and latency while reducing device size and power consumption.

The article argues that mining stocks’ weak response to a gold rally signals a possible broader decline in precious metals. It also cites a bullish chart pattern for the US Dollar Index and bearish signals for stocks, comparing current conditions to 2008. A reader comment disputes the article’s technical analysis.

Hola Publishing International has expanded its Spanish-language publishing services in Mexico, offering print-on-demand orders of 25 to 1,000 books and global distribution in print and e-book formats. Authors retain full rights to their books. The company says producing books in Mexico reduces shipping costs and allows a 60-day print turnaround.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture and its graphics features. RT Cores accelerate ray tracing by handling bounding volume hierarchy traversal and ray–triangle intersection tests, while denoising and hybrid rendering reduce the work needed for real-time effects. Turing Tensor Cores support NGX features including DLSS image enhancement, inpainting, slow-motion video, and resolution upscaling. Task and Mesh Shaders offer more flexible geometry processing; Variable Rate Shading adjusts shading effort by region; Texture Space Shading reuses shading results; and Multi-View Rendering processes multiple viewpoints in one pass. The passage also outlines VR applications, TU104 and TU106 GPU configurations, and RTX-OPS as a workload-based hybrid-rendering metric. It concludes with explanations of ray-tracing techniques and NVIDIA’s product disclaimers.

At its May 22, 2019 annual meeting, Amazon shareholders elected all 10 director nominees, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as 2019 independent auditor, and approved named executive officer compensation in an advisory vote. All 12 shareholder proposals were rejected.

SOS disruptive defense pushes wing ball handlers toward corner or baseline checkpoints to deny middle penetration and limit offensive space. Before the checkpoint, defenders pressure a stopped dribbler without trapping. Dribble penetration inside it triggers an automatic “Base Go I” trap; “Base Go Red” instead initiates an early sideline trap. Non-trapping defenders rotate into helpside and pass-denial positions, then match up as passes leave the passer’s hands. Against side screens below the free-throw line, defenders trap the ball handler before the screen is set and cover the post’s roll. The all-out variation traps the point guard before a screen or pass, with a secondary trap available on a pass to the rolling post.

In an American University address, the speaker calls for a practical, lasting peace built through cooperation, agreements and peaceful dispute resolution rather than nuclear confrontation. He urges Americans to reconsider their attitudes toward peace, the Soviet Union and the cold war, emphasizing shared interests despite deep differences. He supports stronger international institutions, communication and arms control. He announces upcoming Moscow talks on a comprehensive nuclear test ban and says the United States will not resume atmospheric tests unless another state does. He also links peace abroad to freedom and equal rights at home, while affirming that the United States will defend its interests and work to prevent war.
The desk lamp design is shown from multiple views; dashed lines indicate portions excluded from the claimed design.

Indiana University of Pennsylvania President Michael Driscoll paused an Academic Integrity Board investigation and allowed senior Lake Ingle to return to a class after Ingle was barred for speaking during a discussion about transgender issues. Driscoll also appointed a faculty member to monitor and mentor the class.

Just Patios offers customisable carports designed to protect vehicles from harsh Australian weather and corrosion. Its Flat/Skillion, Raised Flyover and Gable designs can accommodate various vehicles and home styles. The company provides installation and assistance with property-boundary regulations. It serves Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast, and its products carry 15-year warranties.

TQQQ options include calls and puts, with strategies such as buying either type or writing covered calls and puts. They offer potential returns and hedging opportunities but carry substantial risk, especially when leverage is used. The passage recommends backtesting, assessing liquidity and trading costs, and setting risk limits. Taxes, broker requirements, and regulations vary by circumstance and jurisdiction.

Mark Mobius said a 30 percent U.S. stock market correction is possible, warning that ETF outflows and automated selling could accelerate a downturn. He also said emerging markets face further downside, though selective opportunities remain. Economist Paul Krugman warned of a possible self-reinforcing emerging-market currency crisis.

University at Albany chemists synthesized manganese diboride, a potential solid-rocket fuel ingredient that releases over 20% more energy by weight and about 150% more by volume than the aluminum currently used in boosters. It remains stable until exposed to an ignition agent. Researchers make it by heating manganese and boron to 3,000°C and rapidly cooling the material, creating a strained atomic structure that stores energy. Related boron-based structures may also have uses in catalytic converters and plastic breakdown.

In his inaugural address, the President celebrates the peaceful transfer of power after violence at the Capitol and calls for national unity. He urges Americans to confront the pandemic, economic hardship, racial injustice, climate change and extremism while defending democracy and truth. He pledges to serve all Americans, respect peaceful disagreement, repair alliances and honor those who died in the pandemic.

The passage describes techniques for time-aware networks that support time-sensitive applications through precise clock synchronization and scheduled traffic. PTP and gPTP distribute timing information from a selected grandmaster through network devices, while gate control lists schedule when traffic-class queues may transmit. It identifies limitations of storing large gate control lists in network interface hardware, including silicon area, power consumption, and programming time. A proposed design stores the lists in host memory and prefetches entries through a dedicated channel to support precise scheduling with less on-chip memory. For end stations hosting multiple transmitting applications, the passage proposes presenting each application as a virtual end station connected to a virtual bridge, allowing centralized network management to configure their shared physical link.

A trading gap is a price range with little or no trading, often between one day’s close and the next open. Gaps can be faded or followed, but their profitability has declined. In 25 years of S&P 500 futures data, same-day fill rates fell as gap size increased: roughly 60% for 0.1% gaps, 42–43% for 0.5% gaps, and 28–33% for 1% gaps. The passage stresses reliable backtest data and notes that a high fill rate does not necessarily make a strategy profitable.

A review of 10 trials involving 77,917 people at high risk of heart problems found no significant reduction in heart-related deaths, heart attacks, strokes or artery-reopening procedures among those taking omega-3 supplements. Participants were followed for an average of 4.4 years. The researchers noted differences in trial designs and missing participant data as limitations. Other experts said the supplements may still be a reasonable option because they are inexpensive and generally safe.

Boscov’s reported record sales in 2017 and increased sales at its physical stores, including in downtown Wilkes-Barre. Shoppers credited familiar staff, convenience and a hometown atmosphere. Downtown officials said the store supports nearby businesses, while two other local department stores are closing. Boscov’s plans to open a 47th store in Connecticut.

Early-season European football has seen a series of disciplinary incidents. Cristiano Ronaldo received a five-match ban for pushing a referee, while red cards for Chelsea, Newcastle and Lille players contributed to opening losses. Meanwhile, players including Virgil van Dijk and Diego Costa are involved in transfer disputes, and Tottenham’s Danny Rose apologized after criticizing his pay and the club’s recruitment. UEFA is set to launch a respect campaign later this month.

Bayard received an “unmodified” audit rating, with two minor findings: a $700 budget deficit in a new federal grant fund and $64 in mileage-reporting errors. The City Council unanimously supported Santa Clara’s effort to manage and restore historic Fort Bayard, despite one councilor’s concerns about the village’s capacity. Santa Clara’s plan includes renting office space to the U.S. Forest Service. The council also discussed restoring the Bayard train depot’s exterior; the city owns the building, but the railroad owns the land beneath it.

Barry “The Hatchet” Vagnoni has been a Philadelphia Eagles fan since 1954. He and his wife, Dawn, plan to host more than 100 fans for Super Bowl LII in their 2,000-square-foot Eagles-themed room, which has 16 televisions and extensive memorabilia. Guests must wear Eagles gear and follow family-friendly rules; food and drinks are free. Vagnoni, who watched the Eagles win the 1960 championship with his late father, says he will be thinking of him during the game.

The passage argues that rapid technological and social change requires schools to rethink teaching while critically assessing new developments. It describes how the Net generation, blended learning and artificial intelligence are changing how students learn. The authors propose a shift from digital to generative pedagogy, in which teachers work with generative AI as a partner rather than merely a tool. They say teachers’ roles will increasingly emphasize relationships and values, while questions about educational content, assessment and authority remain unanswered.

Registration is open for Horses4Heroes’ Saturday day camps through May 19, Spring Break Camp March 26–30, and 10 weeks of summer camp beginning May 29. The Las Vegas nonprofit offers the camps for children ages 5–13 at its equestrian center in Floyd Lamb Park. Activities include horseback riding, farm animals and outings. Reduced rates are available to eligible service members and community professionals. Teens ages 14–17 can volunteer as counselors. Camp registration is available online.

A 2018 FTSE Russell survey of 256 advisors found that 79% of U.S. respondents were aware of smart beta, but only 35% were very familiar with it. Nearly half cited insufficient understanding as a barrier to use. U.K. advisors also raised concerns about performance and limited track records.
Pro wrestling legend Ric Flair, 68, was hospitalized for routine monitoring, his representative said Saturday. On Monday, she said he faced “tough medical issues” and asked for prayers.

The President returns a bill doubling Andrew J. Hill’s pension without approval. The Pension Bureau had rejected the increase because his existing pension matched his assessed disability, and the President argues that Congress should rarely override such decisions. He says he approved 81 other pension bills despite insufficient proof, while others will become law without his approval because he lacked time to review them fully. This bill also misnames its intended beneficiary, whom the records identify as Alfred J. Hill.

Xu Yan said police prevented her from leaving her Beijing neighbourhood but could not explain who authorized the restriction. Her husband, human rights lawyer Yu Wensheng, was detained in January and charged with inciting subversion after calling for constitutional reforms and open presidential elections. German Chancellor Angela Merkel met privately with Xu during a recent Beijing visit.

The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card offers 0% introductory APR for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, followed by a variable APR of 16.99%, 23.49%, or 28.74%. It has no annual fee and includes cellphone protection, but offers no ongoing rewards. Balance transfers incur a 5% fee ($5 minimum), and foreign transactions incur a 3% fee. The review presents it as an option for paying down debt or financing a large purchase, while noting that its fees and lack of rewards may make other cards a better fit for some users.

ChatGPT can help traders develop strategies, code indicators and algorithms, and analyze market sentiment, news, and historical data. Traders should check generated code for errors, backtest strategies, and validate predictions with other sources before using them. ChatGPT does not automate trading by itself or identify which strategy will be most profitable. In the passage’s Amibroker example, it produced plausible rules but code with many errors.

Both Mi 8 variants feature a Snapdragon 845, 6GB of RAM, a 6.21-inch AMOLED display, dual-frequency GPS and dual 12-megapixel rear cameras. Xiaomi also unveiled the Mi 8 SE, featuring a Snapdragon 710, dual rear cameras and a 20-megapixel selfie camera, starting at 1,799 yuan.

The mid screen is a common offense in which a big player screens for a smaller ballhandler, creating risks of dribble penetration and post mismatches. The passage describes two defenses. In the NBA’s preferred “show and recover” approach, the ball defender pushes the dribbler toward the sideline while the screener’s defender steps out, then returns to the post as teammates deny passes and provide help. “All Out SOS Disruption” instead traps the ballhandler before the screen, forcing the offense away from its planned routes. Defenders then rotate as the ball is passed and match up using SOS defensive principles.

Cell2Text generates natural-language cell descriptions from single-cell RNA-seq profiles by connecting Geneformer gene-level embeddings to an instruction-tuned language model. Trained on one million CELLxGENE cells, it describes cell identity, tissue, disease associations, and pathway activity. Fully fine-tuned models outperformed the evaluated classification baselines on cell type, tissue, and disease prediction, and achieved high biomedical semantic similarity to reference descriptions. Their cell-type predictions also showed strong ontology-based similarity. Pathway results were competitive, though the LightGBM baseline performed better.

The NES Classic Mini, originally priced at $60, has been resold for more on eBay. A person claiming to work for a Nordic retailer says Nintendo has ended production and that final shipments may arrive by April or May. A Norwegian retailer also expects final shipments, but it remains unclear whether the reported stock shortage extends beyond Norway.

The volume documents Shultz’s efforts to pursue dialogue with the Soviet Union despite bureaucratic resistance and crises in 1983, including the KAL 007 downing, the Euromissiles dispute, and concerns over Reagan’s Strategic Defense Initiative. After the Soviets left INF negotiations, the administration worked through 1984 to restart arms control talks. Shultz and Gromyko agreed in January 1985 to negotiations on START, INF, and defense and space issues. The volume also credits the officials and institutions involved in preparing and reviewing its documents.

The November 9, 2000 Haas alumni jobs bulletin lists 20 openings across executive management, technology, finance, marketing, nonprofit administration and consulting, with expanded descriptions and application details. It also announces a Women in Leadership Conference and a Big Game barbecue, and advises readers to research listed employers and search firms.

In a randomized, double-blind study of 171 adults, researchers compared intranasal oxytocin, oral oxytocin and placebo during gentle stroking touch and medium-pressure massage. Both oxytocin treatments increased the perceived pleasantness of gentle stroking and responses in orbitofrontal and posterior superior temporal brain regions, but had no comparable effect during massage. Increases in plasma oxytocin mediated the effects on pleasantness ratings. The findings suggest that oxytocin selectively enhances responses to touch targeting C-touch fibers, with similar effects from oral and intranasal administration.
Bandai Namco announced Super Robot Wars X for PS4 and PS Vita. It launches March 29, 2018, in Japan and April 26 in Southeast Asia with English subtitles. Japan will also receive a Premium Edition.

The passage describes a smart gateway platform for industrial data analytics. Users select a model template tied to a business objective and map its data inputs to tags on industrial devices. The platform collects the relevant data, normalizes and contextualizes it, adds metadata describing relationships between inputs, and sends the structured data to an analytics system. The templates encode domain expertise to focus analysis on data relevant to the selected objective. Analytics may run at device, system, enterprise, or cloud level and produce insights, recommendations, notifications, or control actions.

The address reports abundant harvests, flourishing commerce, higher-than-expected revenue, and peaceful foreign relations. Negotiations with Britain have begun on commerce and other unresolved matters, while the existing commercial convention will continue for at least eight years.

Relations with Spain remain unsettled over claims and boundaries. The address attributes violence and unlawful activity in Florida to weak Spanish authority, adventurers, and conflict involving the Seminoles. It defends U.S. actions at Amelia Island and General Jackson’s pursuit into Florida, while stating that Pensacola and St. Marks were ordered returned to preserve friendly relations with Spain.

The war between Spain and South American provinces continues; the United States intends to maintain its existing course. The address also reports strong Treasury receipts, growing land sales, progress on defenses and the Navy, and territorial cessions obtained through treaties with several Indigenous tribes. It proposes further consideration of protections for domestic manufactures, frontier posts, policies concerning Indigenous communities, and the governance of the District of Columbia. Illinois has joined the Union.
Christopher Koziana, 29, of Essex was charged with impaired driving after his vehicle struck a gas meter on Ridge Road, causing a leak. He was uninjured.

The passage describes a patent application for novel cationic lipids used with other lipids to form nanoparticles that deliver therapeutic nucleic acids into cells. The proposed formulations aim to protect nucleic acids from degradation and improve intracellular delivery and tolerability. Described payloads include mRNA, antisense oligonucleotides and plasmid DNA, which may increase protein expression or reduce target gene expression. The passage also outlines lipid structures, nanoparticle compositions, administration methods, and techniques for preparing and modifying nucleic acids.

A study led by University of Texas at Austin researchers warns that hydroelectric dams in the Amazon basin could trap nutrient-rich sediment, disrupt river and floodplain ecosystems, and affect rainfall and storm patterns beyond the region. Of 428 proposed dams, 140 are built or under construction. Using a new vulnerability index, researchers identified major risks on the Marañon, Ucayali and Madeira rivers. Two recently built Madeira dams were followed by a 20 percent drop in average sediment concentration. Researchers warn that the cumulative effects of planned dams could reduce sediment reaching the Atlantic Ocean and alter regional climate.

Microsoft reported revenue of $36.9 billion for the quarter ended December 31, 2019, up 14% from a year earlier. Operating income rose 35% to $13.9 billion, and net income rose 38% to $11.6 billion. Commercial cloud revenue increased 39% to $12.5 billion, while Azure revenue grew 62%. All three reporting segments recorded higher revenue, though gaming revenue declined. At December 31, Microsoft held $134.3 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments. Operating cash flow for the quarter was $10.7 billion.

Inconsistent environment maps can cause deterministic robot planners to produce oscillating trajectories. This work proposes using successive maps as world hypotheses when computing search costs, while requiring the final path to avoid obstacles in the most recent map. Of four methods examined, Goal-Edge Graph Revision Hypothesis (GEGRH) combines rerouting with graph revision; the other methods were overly conservative, computationally impractical, or less effective. Across 221 planning problems using field-test data, GEGRH produced shorter paths and planned faster than the conservative Valid in Every Hypothesis method for both two- and three-map conditions. Case studies also show that GEGRH can perform worse when rerouting consumes the limited planning time.

President Trump condemned white supremacists, neo-Nazis and the KKK on Monday after violence in Charlottesville left one woman dead. His statement followed criticism from Democrats and Republicans of his earlier remarks blaming violence “on many sides.” Trump also criticized Merck CEO Ken Frazier, who resigned from a presidential manufacturing council over Trump’s initial response.

After Toronto eliminated the Yankees from the 2025 playoffs, a projected 2026 lineup named Steven Kwan as leadoff hitter and Josh Naylor at first base. The prediction suggests New York could move on from Trent Grisham and Paul Goldschmidt.

Ray Dalio recommended holding as much as 15% of a portfolio in gold, calling it a diversifier and a hedge against monetary debasement and geopolitical uncertainty. He compared current conditions to the early 1970s as gold rose above $4,000 an ounce.
John Howendobler was jailed after calling police shortly before 1:30 a.m. Friday to report choking his wife. She told officers he woke suddenly from sleep and began choking her.

Matthew Lane, a 19-year-old Massachusetts college student, pleaded guilty to hacking PowerSchool and extorting it after stealing records of more than 60 million students and 10 million educators, prosecutors say. They seek seven years in prison and more than $14 million in restitution. Prosecutors and cybersecurity firm Cyble describe a pattern of cyber activity dating to 2021, contrasting Lane’s reserved offline demeanor with attention-seeking online personas. PowerSchool paid a ransom, but some affected districts later received further extortion demands.

Veeco Instruments published a slide deck for its M&A call with Axcelis Technologies. The passage also includes Seeking Alpha transcript information, article headlines, and chart data spanning September 29 to October 3, 2025.

Gartner analysts Stephen Kleynhans and Michael Silver argue that Microsoft is making Windows 10 Pro less suitable for enterprises. Microsoft extended support for certain Windows 10 releases from 18 to 24 months and offered a paid 12-month extension, but limited both options to Enterprise and Education editions. Pro users remain on the 18-month support cycle. The analysts recommend that businesses using Pro monitor support deadlines and budget for Enterprise.

South Sudan’s only mental health facility had severely inadequate conditions, but calls for funding went unheeded until civil war drew attention to trauma. The passage argues that mental health care is often overlooked despite its links to other health problems. Low-income countries have few psychiatrists and spend little on mental health, often directing funds to institutions rather than outreach and prevention. It calls for more trained professionals, community-based services and efforts to reduce stigma, without waiting for conflict to prompt action.

President Trump announced a deal for AstraZeneca to offer discounted prescription drugs through TrumpRx and prices for Medicaid patients comparable to the lowest charged in other countries. AstraZeneca also pledged to invest $50 billion in US drug research, development, and manufacturing over five years. The deal follows a similar agreement with Pfizer.

Apple reported first-quarter fiscal 2019 net sales of $84.3 billion, down 5% from a year earlier, and net income of $20.0 billion, compared with $20.1 billion. iPhone sales fell 15%, while Services rose 19% and Wearables, Home and Accessories rose 33%. Greater China sales declined 27%. Apple generated $26.7 billion in operating cash, repurchased $8.2 billion of stock and paid $3.6 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. The filing also describes tax matters, supply risks and ongoing litigation.

Shriram Transport Finance said its promoters are in talks with SVL Group to ensure payment of dues by the stipulated date. Its shares fell 11.83% amid concerns that an Rs 870 crore guarantee for SVL debentures maturing in June 2019 could be invoked. The company said SVL has sufficient resources and cited an alternative settlement mechanism if needed.

Liverpool jewellery business Say it with Diamonds has opened its first city-centre store in Cavern Walks. Founded on Instagram in 2016 by friends Charlotte Donoghue and Steph Porter, it sells jewellery, including engagement and wedding rings, with a focus on affordable luxury.

The passage describes methods for vacuum-forming fiber-based containers intended to replace single-use plastics. A closed-loop system monitors and replenishes additives in a fiber slurry, while moisture, oil and vapor barriers and strength additives are selected for produce containers, meat trays, oven-safe food containers and beverage lids. Ribs, shelves and rolled edges improve container rigidity. Directional rinse nozzles create larger produce-container vent holes, and a retractable piston releases lids with negative-draft locking rings from their molds.

Microsoft reported fiscal third-quarter 2021 revenue of $41.7 billion, up from $35.0 billion a year earlier, and net income of $15.5 billion, up from $10.8 billion. Diluted earnings per share rose to $2.03 from $1.40. Revenue increased across all three business segments, while commercial cloud revenue rose 33% to $17.7 billion. Microsoft completed its $8.1 billion acquisition of ZeniMax in March and announced an agreement in April to acquire Nuance for $19.7 billion, including net debt.

Founded in 2010, Spartan Race became a leading obstacle course race provider, with one million participants at roughly 130 events in 2016. As founder and CEO Joe De Sena considered an initial public offering in 2017, he asked whether a new revenue recognition standard would affect the company’s financial statements.

The standard requires companies to identify contracts and performance obligations, determine and allocate transaction prices, and recognize revenue when obligations are satisfied. Spartan needed to assess how those rules applied to race entries, annual passes, merchandise, sponsorships, training certifications, and international licensing royalties.

Co-operative Group reported a £132 million pretax loss in 2016 after writing off its 20 percent stake in the struggling Co-operative Bank. Operating profit rose 32 percent to £148 million, supported by growth in supermarkets, funeral services and insurance. Supermarket like-for-like sales rose 3.5 percent. The bank is for sale, though sources said most bidders were interested only in specific assets.

The South Dakota Department of Agriculture asks producers who suspect dicamba-related crop damage to complete a survey on its website. The department will use responses to evaluate the products’ impact statewide. Producers can also complete the survey at the department’s Dakotafest booth in Mitchell on Aug. 15–17.

MotoGP heads to Austin after Argentina, where Maverick Viñales won and Marc Márquez crashed while leading. Márquez has won every MotoGP race held at the Circuit of the Americas, but Viñales leads the 2017 standings with 50 points. The Grand Prix of the Americas race is scheduled for Sunday at 14:00 local time.

Maryland coach D.J. Durkin credited his team’s receivers, offensive line and running backs, and emphasized third-down execution after Maryland converted nine of 16 attempts last week. Ohio State is developing plays featuring both Mike Weber and J.K. Dobbins. Linebacker Chris Worley is probable Saturday, while Dre’Mont Jones and Erick Smith will miss the game.

McLaren’s new 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged M840T V8 succeeds the 3.8-liter M838T and will debut in the 720S. The 720S produces 720 PS and, according to McLaren, reaches 200 km/h in 7.8 seconds and completes a standing quarter mile in 10.3 seconds. McLaren says response, efficiency and emissions have improved; full specifications are due in March.

Philadelphia City Council will consider amended bills for “Rebuild,” a $500 million, seven-year plan to renovate up to 200 parks, recreation centers and libraries. The amendments address council’s concerns about hiring opportunities. The Kenney administration hopes work can begin once legal challenges to the project’s beverage-tax funding are resolved.

In an inaugural address, the speaker thanks the outgoing administration and pledges to return power from Washington to the American people. He describes poverty, lost jobs, closed factories and deteriorating infrastructure, promising an “America First” approach to trade, immigration and foreign affairs. He calls for rebuilding infrastructure, bringing back jobs, buying and hiring American, strengthening borders, and working with other nations against terrorism. He urges national unity and action, promising to make America strong, wealthy, proud and safe again.

James Hodgkinson of Illinois opened fire during a congressional baseball practice in Alexandria, Virginia, wounding Rep. Steve Scalise and others before dying after a shootout with police. Scalise remained in critical condition after surgery. The FBI is investigating Hodgkinson’s activities and motives. Rep. Claudia Tenney’s office reported receiving a threatening email after the shooting.

NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2018 revenue of $2.64 billion, up 32% from a year earlier, and net income of $838 million, up 55%. Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.33 from $0.83. Growth came from gaming, datacenter and professional visualization GPUs, as well as Tegra processors. For the first nine months, revenue was $6.80 billion and net income was $1.93 billion. NVIDIA held $6.32 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at October 29, 2017. During those nine months, it spent $909 million on share repurchases and paid $250 million in dividends.

The ADS7828’s SAR conversions are sensitive to electrical transients, so TI recommends clean, well-bypassed power, careful reference routing, and a clean ground connection. Supply noise can directly affect digital results when the external reference is tied to the supply. The passage also describes part-status and marking conventions, packaging and assembly dimensions, and TI’s disclaimers. TI says its resources are provided “as is,” may change without notice, and leave application design, testing, and compliance to developers.

The speaker says Calgary has become more defensive, while his team is focused on maintaining momentum and responding to losses. Special teams are especially important in a series with few scoring chances. He describes the league as difficult to score in and says his team will keep working to create offense. He declines to discuss injuries, praises a player’s development and defensive play, and expresses concern about blows to the head against defenseless players. With the seven-game series tied, the focus is on the next game.

The passage describes assay panels and methods for detecting cancer-associated DNA methylation patterns in cell-free DNA. Probes target genomic regions that are differentially methylated in cancer and are designed to limit off-target capture. The methods convert unmethylated cytosines, enrich and sequence selected DNA fragments, and use classifiers trained on cancer and non-cancer samples to assess cancer presence, stage, or type. It also describes selecting target regions by comparing methylation patterns across samples and designing probes for those regions.

Henry Grivi sought a writ requiring the Superior Court to remove a presiding judge’s report from the McAdoo divorce case file. The report criticized Grivi’s handling of the case but acknowledged that the alleged irregularity did not affect the decree. The court held that the report concerned the attorney’s conduct, not an issue in the divorce case, and that the judge lacked jurisdiction to place it in that file. It ordered the writ issued.

The passage describes a reconfigurable hardware-switch pipeline that separates packet header fields into two vectors. A parser sends fields that may be matched or modified to a match-action unit and sends unused fields directly to a deparser. The deparser recombines both vectors with the payload. Compiler-generated configuration determines how fields are parsed and assigned. This separation reduces match-action resource use and allows the parser to reach deeper headers without sending more data to the match-action unit.

The passage describes clock-frequency limits and configuration requirements for PLLs, SYSCLKs, and device modules, including a 960 MHz setting for PLL_USB when USB is used. It outlines interrupt controllers, timing and board-routing considerations, and the features of DCAN, EDMA, debugging, Ethernet, GPIO, memory, video, I2C, and imaging interfaces. It also provides electrical timing references and PCB design guidance for HDMI and DDR2/DDR3, emphasizing signal routing, termination, keepout regions, and bypass capacitors.

Andrew Ladd was an effective playoff player in Carolina, while Dustin Byfuglien’s net-front play presents a challenge despite the team’s strong defense. The speaker says repeated setbacks have strengthened the team’s belief in itself, and past coaching experience may help a roster with little Finals experience. He is grateful for the coaching opportunity and praises Mike Richards’s effort and leadership. Chicago’s speed and transition game will require careful puck management. The team’s goaltending has relied on Ray Emery, Brian Boucher and Michael Leighton, who returned effectively after injury.

The lecture reviews Poisson processes as arrival, interarrival, and counting processes with memoryless waiting times and stationary, independent increments. Independent Poisson processes combine into one whose rate is the sum of their rates; randomly splitting a Poisson process produces independent Poisson processes. These properties are applied to a last-come, first-served queue. For non-homogeneous processes, interval counts remain Poisson, though interarrival times are not exponential. Conditional on a fixed number of arrivals by time \(t\), arrival times have the distribution of ordered uniform random variables. The lecture ends with the observation that an interval containing an arbitrarily chosen time tends to be longer than an average interarrival interval.

Poland plans to invest 20 billion zlotys ($5.5 billion) to connect its fuel pipelines to NATO’s Central Europe Pipeline System. The project includes about 300 kilometres of pipeline and new storage facilities to strengthen military supply chains. NATO has committed 60 million zlotys for planning and design.
