Graham became wary of politics after Watergate but continued ministering to presidents until his health declined.

Shares of state-owned oil marketing companies fell 3–4% amid reports that BPCL and IOC may each buy about 26% of GAIL for roughly Rs19,500 crore. Investors are concerned about limited synergies and pressure on the companies’ balance sheets. Marketing margins have also weighed on sentiment, though they have recovered from December-quarter lows. Upcoming state elections could constrain fuel-price increases, but relatively stable crude prices may help preserve margins. Improved marketing and refining margins support expectations for March-quarter earnings, while a GAIL purchase could unsettle investors.

A child accidentally pricked himself with a discarded syringe while looking for frogs near Quentin Pool in Coventry. His family awaits blood test results, and his aunt has urged the council to clear the area.

Budget Blinds Serving Bothell offers custom blinds, shades, shutters and draperies in Bothell, Washington, and surrounding areas. The company helps customers select window coverings and provides installation services, including options for customers on a budget.

The coach described a tight, physical Stanley Cup Finals matchup with limited scoring space. He had not seen either disputed replay but said the team responded to the second ruling by scoring. He praised the team’s offensive chances, Pronger’s play and several players’ physical efforts, while saying neutral-zone play and traffic in front of the opposing goaltender could improve. He said Jeff Carter was regaining his timing after breaking both feet. Despite the series position, the coach said the team remained loose and confident, drawing on its experience overcoming setbacks. He expected the home crowd’s energy to help, provided the team combined it with execution.

The passage describes a strategy that switches monthly between the S&P 500 and gold: it holds stocks when their price ratio is above its 20-month moving average and gold when it is below. In a backtest ending July 2020, the strategy achieved 9.9% annualized growth and a 22% maximum drawdown, versus a 55% maximum drawdown for the S&P 500. Both assets contributed roughly equally to gains. The test excluded dividends.

Researchers surveyed pregnant women attending their first antenatal care visits in four Zambian districts from September 2021 to September 2022, testing 8,304 samples with matched questionnaires for SARS-CoV-2 antibodies. Overall, 63.8% were seropositive. Seroprevalence rose to nearly 100% in Lusaka, Chipata, and Chongwe, but peaked at 77.2% in Chadiza before declining. Most antibody responses were classified as infection-induced rather than vaccination-induced. Estimated SARS-CoV-2 exposures substantially exceeded reported COVID-19 cases in every district. The authors found that antenatal care can support serosurveillance, while noting that the selected participants may not represent the wider population and that waning antibodies may have affected estimates.

PointState Capital LP bought 6.06 million Peabody Energy shares in the second quarter for approximately $148.1 million, giving it a 6.26% stake. Institutional investors and hedge funds owned 97.98% of the company. Major shareholder Discovery Capital Management sold 12.8 million shares for $346.88 million in August. Analysts’ average rating was “Buy,” with an average target price of $35. Peabody reported a quarterly loss of $0.18 per share, missing the $0.89 consensus estimate, while revenue rose 21% year over year to $1.26 billion.

Researchers analyzed circulating tumor cell (CTC) DNA from 29 patients with metastatic colorectal cancer. Among the 28 patients with microsatellite-stable disease, greater CTC genomic diversity, measured by MATH score, and non-silent BCL9L mutations were associated with shorter overall survival. MATH scores from a custom 55-gene panel also predicted survival, while scores from two commercial panels did not. The authors note that the small cohort limits generalizability and that larger studies are needed to validate the findings.

The passage describes activated alumina use in oil and gas, water treatment, plastics, and healthcare. It identifies Asia Pacific as a major market, driven by industrialization and demand for clean water, while also describing North America as dominant. European growth is linked to healthcare uses. Applications include catalysts, desiccants, fluoride adsorbents, and bioceramics. Listed suppliers include BASF, Honeywell, and Sumitomo Chemical.

Saks Fifth Avenue is marking 10 years since launching its 10022-SHOE salon with more than 75 exclusive shoe styles, in-store installations and made-to-order customization programs. The New York flagship’s 30,000-square-foot footwear floor can hold 200,000 pairs, and the concept has expanded to 25 other locations and a stand-alone store in Greenwich, Connecticut. Saks executives say the department has broadened from dress shoes and pumps to include sneakers and other lifestyle footwear.

Kerala has directed state and affiliated universities to reserve two seats for qualified transgender students in undergraduate and postgraduate courses and prevent discrimination. Its Samanwaya programme offers continuing education, with shelter homes planned in four districts to reduce dropouts. A state survey found nearly 40% of transgender respondents dropped out between classes 7 and 10.

Mr. Otori pressed for a council to consider Japanese proposals, but the Korean government said it could not accept them during Japan’s military occupation. The King appointed a separate council, which decided to abolish needless taxes. Efforts to arrange neutrality for Chemulpo failed over Japanese conditions. Sill also reported naval arrivals, Chinese departures, and a Korean foreign-office appointment. Acting Consul-General Gardner reported that Japanese soldiers assaulted him and obstructed his party on public roads. Otori investigated and relayed a Japanese military report denying the assault and describing the foreigners as entering a bivouac despite a sentinel’s objections.

BerkeleyGW extends quantum many-body GW calculations to large materials systems on NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs. Its advances include portable GPU implementations, optimized self-energy kernels, full-frequency GW, GW perturbation theory for electron-phonon coupling, and a stochastic-deterministic method that reduces computational cost. Tests showed strong scaling to all 9,408 Frontier nodes and 9,600 Aurora nodes. The off-diagonal kernel reached 1.069 ExaFLOP/s on Frontier and 707.52 PetaFLOP/s on Aurora in double precision. Applications included silicon defects, a boron nitride moiré bilayer, and lithium hydride defects in systems of up to 17,574 atoms.

U.S. and global stocks reached record closing highs on Thursday, supported by optimism about U.S. tax reform and economic growth. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed at records for a fourth straight day, while MSCI’s global index also hit a high. Strong U.S. trade and jobless-claims data helped lift the dollar and weighed on gold. Oil prices rose as signs that Saudi Arabia and Russia would limit production outweighed record U.S. exports.

A federal judge ordered Alabama to release records about its lethal injection protocol after news organizations sought access following Doyle Lee Hamm’s aborted execution. The state may withhold security-sensitive identifying information and must identify it to the judge by June 7.

A federal judge temporarily halted deportation proceedings against about 50 Indonesian Christians in New Jersey who are seeking legal status. The order followed an ACLU lawsuit after immigration enforcement actions prompted some to seek church sanctuary. Among them is Harry Pangemanan, who helped rebuild more than 200 homes after Superstorm Sandy. The judge ordered further briefs.

The ASP checks memory protection and signatures, runs the SFS patch, updates the patch level, and reports status. A version command returns firmware and patch levels; an update command loads, verifies, and executes a package, applying no updates until validation is complete. Packages must match the system’s firmware and patch levels. Updates run alongside x86 and DMA traffic with minimal intended disruption. SEV and SEV/ES virtual machines must stop and restart for an SEV firmware update; SEV/SNP virtual machines can continue operating.

Toronto police say Nnamdi Ogba, 26, was fatally shot while walking to his car after visiting friends at a west-end housing complex. Investigators say he did not know the two attackers and believe they targeted someone in the neighbourhood out of vengeance. Police released security footage showing the suspects and a vehicle believed to be a newer Nissan Rogue, and asked residents to help identify those responsible.

The paper introduces ABXLAB, an open-source framework that modifies web content to test how choice cues affect AI agents. In more than 80,000 shopping trials across 17 language models, agents showed strong sensitivity to ratings, prices, product order, and persuasive nudges, often exceeding responses in a human comparison group. Explicit user preferences also sharply shifted agent choices. The authors caution that the binary shopping tasks limit how directly the results apply to other settings.

A player who was dazed after hitting the boards is fine and expected in tomorrow’s lineup. The speaker says the team did not play well enough to win its last game against the Devils: its passing and power play faltered under pressure, despite a strong penalty kill. The team plans to refocus, stay disciplined and avoid using Forsberg’s absence as an excuse. The speaker expects a better performance in New Jersey and says referees missed high-sticking incidents on both sides because the plays happened quickly.

First Solar’s cadmium telluride panels had long given it a manufacturing cost advantage, but the company reported a $39 million net loss in 2011 as revenue growth slowed. Falling silicon prices strengthened crystalline-silicon competitors, while Chinese production, weaker demand, and reduced European subsidies pressured panel prices. First Solar had expanded into utility-scale solar systems and maintained lower debt than major competitors. Facing excess industry capacity and declining prices, manufacturing executive Tymen deJong questioned whether its cost advantage and systems business could sustain the company.

For the DAWn-Plasma study, nasopharyngeal swabs are collected at screening and day +6 for routine viral qPCR. Laboratories are asked to retain residual material, refrigerate it at 4°C for no more than 24 hours, then freeze it at −80°C if possible or −20°C until batch transport to Leuven for later quantitative PCR analysis. The passage also lists related publications and figures and tables covering trial outcomes, biomarkers, antibody titers, and adverse events.

In his message to Congress, the President reports a financial crisis and a dispute with Spain over the seizure of the *Virginius* and the execution of 53 passengers and crew. Spain has agreed to return the vessel and survivors, salute the U.S. flag, and pursue proceedings concerning punishment and indemnity. He also reports generally friendly foreign relations, treaty and boundary developments, and claims awards involving Britain.

The President urges economy as revenues decline, while asking Congress to consider a more flexible currency and progress toward specie payments. He recommends measures concerning transportation, tariff laws, coastal armaments, naval readiness, and postal services. He also calls for legislation on expatriation, Utah’s courts, involuntary bankruptcy, claims against the government, and civil-service reform.

Other recommendations include a territorial government for Indians in Indian Territory, a census in 1875, support for improvements in Washington, Colorado’s admission as a state, general amnesty for those still under disabilities from the rebellion, and stronger protection of the civil rights of formerly enslaved people.

Week 6 reshaped the conference and playoff races. UCLA stunned Penn State 42-37, exposing its defense and sharply reducing its projected playoff chances. Florida beat Texas 29-21 behind a strong performance from quarterback DJ Lagway, while Texas continued to struggle against higher-ranked opponents. Alabama survived Vanderbilt after two costly Commodores turnovers, and Miami defeated Florida State, whose turnovers and offensive struggles damaged its ACC title hopes. In the Big 12, Texas Tech strengthened its position with a dominant win over Houston, while Cincinnati handed Iowa State its first loss.

Tesla announced on January 30, 2019, that Chief Financial Officer Deepak Ahuja intends to retire after a brief transition period and then serve as an advisor. Tesla intends to appoint Zachary Kirkhorn, its Vice President of Finance, Financial Planning and Business Operations, as his successor.

Alan Oppenheim uses a programmable digital filter to demonstrate sampling, aliasing, and discrete-time filtering. When a sinusoid’s input frequency rises above half the sampling frequency, the recovered output frequency decreases; near that point, the nonideal smoothing filter also produces beating. He then demonstrates a digital low-pass filter whose equivalent continuous-time cutoff is one tenth of the sampling frequency. Sinusoidal sweeps and audio show that changing the sampling rate changes the effective cutoff frequency.

Derby City Council gave Sun Waa takeaway a one-star food hygiene rating after a November 2017 inspection found rice left at room temperature for six hours, an obstructed handwashing basin, food debris and other hygiene problems. Council officers later revisited the business and reported significant improvements. The manager said inspectors would return in March to reassess its rating.

Tarren Joseph Titus, 23, pleaded guilty to possessing hydromorphone and violating probation after a 2017 police raid in Sarnia. A judge praised his efforts to leave drug abuse behind and sentenced him to three months of house arrest, followed by a year’s probation, with counseling and a requirement to avoid drugs. He received time served for the probation violations.

Researchers studying marginalized young adults with mental health challenges say how young people understand their symptoms and their causes influences their engagement with treatment. Poverty, discrimination and stigma can shape these narratives and complicate access to care. The researchers argue that providers should listen to young adults’ accounts and work with them on treatment, rather than relying only on symptom-based assessments. Their ongoing studies examine whether narrative patterns persist over time and relate to health behaviors.

With a chance to win the Stanley Cup, Jonathan Toews says the team is focused on the next game rather than the excitement around it or whether it plays at home or on the road. He and Brad Richards say playoff experience helps the group prepare, while Toews credits coaching adjustments, player leadership and recovery habits. Kris Versteeg says his new line built chemistry and is ready to contribute. The players expect another close game against Tampa Bay and say they must remain patient and play better than they did in the previous game.

The NRA told members that YETI had cut ties with its foundation. YETI disputed the claim, saying it had ended an outdated discount program for multiple organizations and offered the foundation an alternative. Some NRA supporters called for a boycott or destroyed YETI products, while YETI said it remained committed to the Second Amendment.

Sixteen-year-old Murad Rahimov, who immigrated from Uzbekistan and recently became a U.S. citizen, has dreamed of working for NASA since childhood. After hearing his story on NPR, a listener connected him with his brother, NASA astrophysicist Jeremy Schnittman. Schnittman gave Murad and his mother a private tour of Goddard Space Flight Center and discussed his black-hole research with Murad. Now an accelerated high school student, Murad hopes to attend Caltech, become an astronaut and lead a Mars mission.

BBC Radio 4 presenter Anita Anand was temporarily removed from *Any Answers* because she had publicly supported equal pay and the programme was due to discuss the BBC’s gender pay dispute. Julian Worricker presented instead. Critics said the decision questioned women journalists’ impartiality. The BBC said editors assess whether presenters who campaign publicly on a subject can cover it impartially. Presenter Jenni Murray had also stepped aside from a discussion of the dispute.

The passage lists asparagus, broccoli, citrus and other fruits, legumes, avocado, lady’s finger, nuts and seeds, cauliflower, beetroot, carrots, and corn as sources of folate (vitamin B9). A cup of boiled asparagus provides 33% of the daily recommended value; a cup of avocado provides about 28%. A cup of broccoli, cauliflower, or beetroot provides about 14%, while a cup of raw carrots provides almost 5%.

A benchmark of 15 Mendelian randomization methods using real-world GWAS summary data assessed type I error, estimation accuracy, replicability, and power. Egger, weighted-mode, and MR-APSS generally controlled type I error across population stratification, pleiotropy, and family-level confounding scenarios. MR-APSS gave the most accurate estimates in tests with known effects; MR-APSS and CAUSE produced consistent estimates across LDL-C datasets, although CAUSE’s p-values were often deflated. Most methods were sensitive to instrument-selection thresholds, with looser thresholds increasing error or bias. Family-based GWAS data improved type I error control. The authors recommend negative controls, multiple instrument-selection thresholds, and independent datasets, while noting limitations in their accuracy and power evaluations.

Four Hungarian winemakers describe women’s growing acceptance in a formerly male-centred profession. Zita Kovács says she now receives respect as a winemaker after initially being mistaken for a hostess. Zsófi Laposa credits technological development with opening the field to women. Krisztina Csetvei combines winemaking with raising her young daughter, while Andi Gere jointly manages her family winery with her father.

MSPM0C1105/6 are ultra-low-power 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ MCUs operating at up to 32 MHz, with up to 64 KB flash and 8 KB SRAM. They support -40°C to 125°C operation, integrate analog, timer and communication peripherals, and are supported by development kits, software, reference designs and training.

Pusa, 63, a former Nagaland minister and legislator and sitting All India Congress Committee member, was buried in his native village of Viswema. Political leaders offered condolences and attended his funeral.

The speaker calls Detroit the strongest opponent so far, citing its offense, goaltending and a strong line led by Kris Draper. With officials calling many infractions, his team must avoid unnecessary penalties, make better power-play decisions and improve on faceoffs to gain possession. He says his line struggled to find a rhythm in the penalty-filled previous game and needs to generate more offense. The team is setting aside ticket requests and other distractions to focus on the next game, while looking forward to playing before its loud home crowd.

Several deals announced Monday suggest mergers among junior gold miners may be picking up after a slow start to 2018. Hecla Mining proposed a US$462 million cash-and-share acquisition of Klondex Mines that would add three Nevada mines and raise Hecla’s annual gold production to about 370,000 ounces. Alio Gold proposed a $128 million acquisition of Rye Patch Gold, while Anaconda Mining offered to buy Maritime Resources. Canada’s metals and mining sector has recorded six mergers so far this year, compared with 19 at the same point in 2017. Leagold’s chief executive expects further consolidation as junior miners seek to diversify and manage risk and financing costs.

The passage describes articles, especially footwear, that use optical elements to produce structural color through interactions with visible light rather than relying solely on dyes or pigments. Optical elements may be applied to footwear uppers, soles or cushioning components and may include multilayer reflectors or filters, textured surfaces, primers and protective layers. Their materials and structures can be selected to produce colors that remain relatively constant or change with viewing angle. The passage also describes methods for making and attaching these elements and measuring the resulting colors.

India’s 21 state-run banks posted a record combined loss of 853.7 billion rupees in the fiscal year ended March 2018, as bad-loan provisions rose following stricter central bank rules. Gross non-performing loans reached 8.96 trillion rupees. A planned 2.11 trillion-rupee recapitalization may leave some banks with little funding for growth after they meet provision and capital requirements.

A Zillow analysis found that U.S. homes with central air conditioning sold for 2.5% more than comparable homes without it—about $5,500 for a typical home. The sale premium was highest in San Antonio at 5.8%. Rentals with central air commanded 2.8% more, or about $40 per month. The analysis covered homes sold or listed for rent in the 35 largest metro areas from June 2017 through May 2018.

IWM options trading involves calls, which grant the right to buy shares, and puts, which grant the right to sell them at an agreed-upon price by expiration. Investors use options to speculate on price movements or hedge risk. Strategies include buying calls or puts, selling covered calls, and buying protective puts; available orders include market, limit, stop, and trailing stop orders. Trading can result in the loss of the entire investment, while short calls may carry unlimited risk. The passage recommends researching contracts, monitoring market information, backtesting strategies, and limiting risk. Broker requirements, minimum balances, and fees vary.

Gov. Kay Ivey announced the voluntary Alabama Sentry Program, which will train approved administrators at schools without resource officers to keep secured firearms on campus for responding to active shooters. Participants need approval from their superintendent, school board and county sheriff, and must obtain an approved weapon, ammunition and protective vest. Ivey described the program as an interim measure while the state works to add school resource officers.

The Bank of England warned that high AI stock valuations and gains concentrated among major U.S. technology companies could lead to a sharp correction affecting global markets, including the UK. It cited potential limits in power, semiconductor and data infrastructure, and urged investors to exercise caution.

Plum School District officials are starting 2018-19 budget discussions early in hopes of avoiding a third consecutive tax increase. The district begins this school year more than $4 million in debt after approving a $66 million budget with a property tax increase. Tuesday’s workshop will also address recruiting tuition-paying Chinese students, elementary construction and redistricting, and the process for closing Regency Park Elementary School.

The passage describes a system for tracing digital assets through blockchain transactions and assessing transaction risk. It combines transaction records, intelligence labels, and on- and off-blockchain data with machine learning to classify address behavior and assign risk scores. Automated graph searches trace asset flows under user-defined constraints, while an interactive journey board supports manual investigation. Reports identify suspicious addresses and summarize tracing results. Depending on the assessed risk, the system may alert users, block transactions, freeze assets, suspend accounts, or approve transactions.

An Infosys Finacle survey of 100 financial services professionals found that more than 80% of global bankers expect commercial blockchain adoption by 2020. Over half of financial institutions are investing or plan to invest this year, with average project spending expected to be about $1 million. Expected uses include cross-border payments and digital identity management. Private blockchains were preferred by 69% of banks.

A pump-and-dump scheme involves promoters buying a stock or coin, spreading misleading information to drive up its price, then selling to later buyers before the price falls. The passage says these schemes target thinly traded penny stocks in OTC markets and low-volume cryptocurrencies. They are illegal in regulated stock markets and often leave later investors with losses. A cited study found an average return of −28% for investors in the schemes it examined. The passage advises caution with sudden, unfounded price increases and recommends avoiding suspected schemes.
The Eighth Circuit dismissed Pink C. Jenkins’s appeal against the United States on the government’s motion and with Jenkins’s consent.

Orbital ATK’s Q2 2017 sales rose 3% to $1.12 billion, and adjusted earnings beat expectations. However, GAAP earnings per share fell 3%, operating margins narrowed, and free cash flow turned negative. Management cited strong new orders, raised its full-year sales and earnings guidance, and maintained its free-cash-flow forecast. Argus Research upgraded the stock from hold to buy with a $120 price target, citing potential cash-flow growth and increased defense spending. The author disagrees with the buy rating, arguing that the stock’s 44% rise over the past year has left it too expensive relative to its cash flow and expected growth.

The passage describes paging methods for beam-based wireless systems, where an idle user device cannot predict which beams will carry paging information. A base station and terminal calculate a paging occasion containing resources for one or more preset beams or ports, then transmit and receive paging control information or a paging message during that occasion. The occasion may be determined using a discontinuous reception cycle, paging interval, device identifier, or offset. The nodes may also use configured or signaled quasi-co-location relationships with other sweeping signals to identify paging resources. Corresponding apparatuses, systems, and software are described.

When Jill Medvedow became director of Boston’s Institute of Contemporary Art in 1998, it had limited funding, no permanent collection, inadequate space and about 25,000 annual visitors. She sought to broaden its audience and educational work while pursuing a new waterfront home. After the ICA won a Fan Pier site in 1999, she built political and donor support, strengthened the board and involved the public in selecting architects Diller + Scofidio. Despite permitting, development and construction setbacks, the new building opened in December 2006. The ICA welcomed more than 280,000 visitors in its first year and recorded combined attendance above 450,000 in 2008 and 2009.

The study proposes “whole human pedagogy” as a decolonial framework for education abroad built on embodiment, emotions, belonging, and becoming. Interviews with 17 U.S.-based education abroad practitioners found that they viewed students as whole people and described practices involving physical experience, emotional reflection, reciprocal relationships, and personal transformation. The findings offer preliminary support for the framework as a way to guide program design, professional development, and future research. Because participants were recruited for their interest in the approach, the study does not establish how common these practices are.

Sean “Diddy” Combs was sentenced to four years and two months in prison and fined $500,000 for transporting people across state lines for sexual encounters. Convicted in July under the Mann Act, he was acquitted of sex trafficking and racketeering charges. The judge cited Combs’ power and resources in explaining how the conduct continued for years. Combs apologized and asked for leniency; prosecutors urged serious prison time.

Amazon announced four new Echo devices with Alexa+, three Kindle Scribe tablets including a color-screen model, new Fire TVs and a Fire TV Stick powered by its Vega operating system. Alexa+ is rolling out in the US; it is free for Prime subscribers and costs $20 a month for others. New Ring cameras offer 2K or 4K video and features including face recognition, customizable greetings and a neighborhood search tool for lost dogs. Amazon also announced 2K Blink cameras and an accessory that combines footage from two cameras into a 180-degree view.

In 1892, U.S. minister Mr. Stevens reported revolutionary plans, opposition to the heir’s succession, growing support for annexation, and a political deadlock between Hawaii’s queen and legislature. He proposed either annexation or a customs union with other U.S. arrangements. Naval reports corroborated his accounts, and both sources reported the queen’s dethronement in January 1893. The report describes U.S. policy toward Hawaii from 1820 to 1893 as friendly and protective, distrustful of foreign intervention, and at times open to annexation. Its appendix provides selected correspondence but excludes private claims and notes other archival materials.

NGC 5949 is a dwarf barred spiral galaxy about 44 million light-years away, with roughly one-hundredth the Milky Way’s mass. Discovered by William Herschel in 1801, it offers astronomers a nearby target for studying unresolved questions about dwarf galaxies.

The passage describes container patterns for building modular services. **Sidecars** extend applications without changing them, adding capabilities such as HTTPS, configuration updates, monitoring, or Git-based deployment. Reusable sidecars need parameters, stable APIs, and documentation. **Ambassadors** broker an application’s external connections, including routing to storage shards, discovering services, and splitting experimental traffic. **Adapters** give applications consistent monitoring, logging, or health-check interfaces.

For multi-node systems, the passage contrasts microservices with monolithic applications and describes replicated, load-balanced services for availability and scale. Caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. **Sharding** divides data among servers; shard-key selection and consistent hashing affect routing and the impact of resizing. Replicated shards can improve resilience and handle uneven load. Finally, **scatter/gather** distributes work across multiple processes and combines their partial results to serve a request faster.

Theratechnologies announced a US$50 million offering of convertible unsecured senior notes due June 30, 2023, with an underwriter option to purchase up to US$7.5 million more. The notes bear 5.75% annual interest and are convertible into common shares at US$14.85 per share. The company intends to use the proceeds for payments under an EMD Serono agreement, Trogarzo approval and commercialization in Europe and other jurisdictions, and general corporate purposes. Closing is expected around June 19, 2018, subject to regulatory approvals.

Education researchers see cautious signs of recovery after deep federal cuts: the Education Department plans to reinstate 20 research contracts, 10 regional education labs may resume work, and it is hiring for assessment roles and seeking input on modernizing the Institute of Education Sciences. Researchers also welcome Amber Northern’s appointment to advise on reform.

Optimism remains limited. Severe staffing shortages threaten data quality and research, while reduced reporting could make National Assessment of Educational Progress results less useful. Experts also question whether the understaffed department can carry out a new, extensive college admissions data collection.

The Supreme Court dismissed Pradyuman’s father’s plea to cancel bail granted to the Pinto family, owners of Ryan International School. The CBI cleared an arrested bus conductor and held a class 11 student responsible for Pradyuman’s murder.

The Ultimate Oscillator, developed by Larry Williams in 1976, measures price momentum across 7-, 14-, and 28-period timeframes. It combines buying pressure relative to true range using a 4:2:1 weighting, producing a value from 0 to 100. Readings below 30 are considered oversold and above 70 overbought. Trading signals require divergence between price and the oscillator, followed by confirmation.

In the passage’s SPY backtest, a strategy using the default settings and fixed buy and sell thresholds performed poorly. Optimizing the indicator periods produced more favorable results across many settings. One example had 355 trades, a 0.77% average gain per trade, a 78% win rate, and a 25% maximum drawdown.

Automation could threaten millions of jobs, including truck driving, though the passage says the cited AI and robotic workers have not yet caused layoffs. It explores three possible responses: brain interfaces that might improve humans’ ability to work with information, exosuits that reduce physical strain, and skills that complement or support machines. Brain augmentation remains years away, while exosuits are being developed and tested. Author Tom Davenport urges workers to develop new skills but expects a difficult transition, especially for some occupations.

President Trump denied a New York Times report that he watches four to eight hours of television daily. The Times stood by its reporting, citing interviews with 60 people. Trump also criticized other media outlets over the weekend for publishing what he called “fake news.”

The Minnesota Court of Appeals remanded an order increasing Richard Berg’s child support from $145 per child to $516 monthly for two children. Although his net monthly income had risen from $1,246 to $1,721 and the increase could be within the trial court’s discretion, the trial court had not made the specific findings required to justify it.

Meb Faber’s Tactical Asset Allocation strategy uses market timing to invest across U.S. and foreign stocks, U.S. bonds, U.S. REITs, and world commodities. It can be implemented with five index ETFs, allocating 20% to each asset when it has an entry signal and holding cash otherwise. The passage reports a 13.24% drawdown in its backtest and says the approach can be applied to other portfolios.

A fast-moving lava flow from Hawaii’s Kilauea volcano crossed Highway 132, destroyed electrical equipment and cut power to coastal neighborhoods. Officials said 71 homes have been destroyed since the eruption began on May 3, and warned Kapoho-area residents to evacuate as lava threatened to isolate them. Authorities rescued at least one person trapped by molten rock. The eruption has displaced thousands, opened 24 lava-spouting fissures and sent ash, gases and volcanic glass across parts of the island. Lava also covered two plugged wells at a geothermal plant; officials said they were stable and had released no dangerous gases.

The Canadian dollar was little changed at C$1.2857 against the U.S. dollar on Monday as investors awaited a Federal Reserve rate decision and a speech by Bank of Canada Governor Stephen Poloz. It fell 1.3 percent last week after the central bank struck a more dovish tone than expected. Speculators trimmed bullish bets, oil edged higher, and Canadian bond prices rose slightly.

BidaskClub upgraded Rapid7 from “hold” to “buy.” Across the analysts cited, the stock has an average “buy” rating and a $20.19 consensus price target. Rapid7 reported quarterly revenue of $47.44 million, up 27.3% year over year, and a loss of $0.26 per share; both results beat analysts’ estimates. Its net margin and return on equity remained negative. Company insiders sold 93,770 shares over the preceding 90 days, while institutional investors owned 71.01% of the stock.

Iranian Revolutionary Guards commander Qassem Soleimani said the Guards were ready to prevent regional oil exports if U.S. pressure halted Iranian oil sales, endorsing President Hassan Rouhani’s remarks about disrupting neighbouring countries’ shipments.

Amazon’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2017, reports third-quarter net sales of $43.7 billion, up from $32.7 billion a year earlier. Operating income fell from $575 million to $347 million, while net income was $256 million, compared with $252 million. For the first nine months of 2017, net sales rose to $117.4 billion, but net income declined to $1.2 billion.

Amazon acquired Whole Foods Market for approximately $13.2 billion, net of cash acquired, and Souq for approximately $579 million. It issued $16.0 billion in senior notes in August, primarily to fund the Whole Foods acquisition. At September 30, total assets were $115.3 billion, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $24.3 billion. AWS operating income increased, while the International segment’s operating loss widened.

The University of Agriculture Faisalabad approved Rs3.28 billion in non-development accounts for 2015–16. Its vice chancellor said the university had introduced 48 degree programs, enrollment had exceeded 25,000, and student financial assistance had reached Rs700 million. He urged greater investment in agricultural research and highlighted water scarcity, malnutrition and post-harvest losses as major challenges.

Richard Mosse’s *Heat Maps* documents refugee camps across Europe, North Africa and the Middle East with a military-grade thermal camera. Its large-scale images render people indistinguishable, prompting questions about surveillance, privacy and how refugees are represented. Mosse assembled the panoramas from hundreds of frames during a three-year project marked by difficult access and complex equipment. He intends the unsettling work to challenge viewers’ assumptions about the refugee crisis.

A double bottom forms when two lows reach roughly the same support level, with a high between them. It is considered a bullish reversal pattern and is complete when price breaks above the resistance level, or neckline. Aggressive traders may look for a reversal at the second low; conservative traders wait for a breakout. The passage cautions that the pattern is difficult to quantify and that cited research relied on manual identification.

Emperor penguins are classified as near-threatened, and a 2014 study projected a 19 percent population decline by 2100. A new remote-monitoring system combines minute-by-minute photographs with weather data to track a colony. It found penguins huddling in warmer conditions, suggesting they may have less body fat and difficulty finding food. Researchers differ on whether climate change or commercial fishing is responsible. Experts praised the system as a cost-effective way to study colonies in harsh Antarctic conditions.

President Donald Trump said the U.S. would impose an additional 100% tariff on Chinese imports and export controls on “critical software” starting Nov. 1. He described the measures as retaliation for China’s new rare-earth export controls. China accounts for around 70% of the global rare-earth supply, and its new licensing requirements are set to begin Dec. 1.

Mark Palmer forwarded Enron colleagues a California class-action complaint against electricity generators and traders. The complaint alleges they manipulated wholesale electricity markets in 2000, inflating prices and overcharging customers by approximately $4 billion. It seeks damages, restitution, and injunctive relief.

India urged the UN Secretariat to disclose cases of serious misconduct by UN personnel and how immunity affected efforts to prosecute them. Legal adviser Yedla Umasankar said reluctance to waive immunity could damage the UN’s credibility. The UN publishes data on sexual misconduct allegations in peacekeeping operations but not a comprehensive record of serious misconduct across the organisation. Umasankar cited jurisdictional complexities and countries’ varying ability or willingness to prosecute, and called for measures to address crimes committed abroad.

A host termination near the end of a UDMA read can leave corrupted state. If an IDE device then terminates a UDMA write, the ATAC may fail to restart the CRC for the resumed portion, causing CRC errors. The passage recommends using the UDMA I/O blocking feature associated with bit 8 of the ATAC Error MSR.

The court fined Pomeroy $6,000 and the New York Central and Hudson River Railroad Company $108,000 for six offenses each. The passage proposes that judgments be overturned or new trials granted for procedural errors only when those errors cause a miscarriage of justice. It argues that courts must retain the power to issue injunctions against violence and intimidation, while avoiding injunctions that unfairly restrict lawful labor activity. It also calls for scrutiny and public criticism of judges who misuse that power or fail to use it when necessary.

On February 14, 2019, NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K announcing its results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 27, 2019. The filing includes a press release and commentary from CFO Colette M. Kress as exhibits.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed dismissal of antitrust and related claims brought by Innofood and Sea Breeze against Mitsubishi entities and a Mexican government-controlled salt producer. The plaintiffs challenged the producer’s alleged decision to end other distribution contracts and sell its salt exclusively through Mitsubishi. The court held that the decision concerned Mexico’s sovereign control over its natural resources and that granting relief would require a U.S. court to judge its validity, so the act of state doctrine barred the claims. The court declined to decide whether a commercial exception exists, finding it inapplicable here.

This AMD Geode CS5535 revision A3 specification update lists hardware issues affecting DMA, UART, LPC, PCI, USB, IDE, ACPI, interrupts, clock gating, power management, and other controllers. Reported effects include discarded writes, invalid reads, missed interrupts, failed transfers, register corruption, and possible hangs. Recommended measures include using single-transfer DMA, avoiding unsupported accesses and clock-gating settings, aligning IDE descriptor tables, and applying specified software or circuit workarounds. Several issues are described as having no operational impact or requiring no resolution.

In a prospective study of 22 patients undergoing transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) placement, researchers analyzed blood metabolites before and after the procedure and monitored hepatic encephalopathy (HE) for up to one year. Peripheral blood metabolites changed most between the immediate post-procedure sample and discharge, with bile acids contributing substantially. Greater changes in hepatic-vein metabolites after TIPS were associated with later HE, suggesting that preexisting intrahepatic shunting may affect risk. Lower levels of three conjugated bile acids after TIPS were associated with more severe HE. Glycerophosphocholine and bilirubin-related metabolites also fluctuated. The authors propose further studies to validate these associations and assess potential biomarkers or treatments.

The study uses interferometric second-harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry to image crystalline orientation and distinguish antiparallel domains in chemical-vapor-deposited hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). Across ten growth conditions, SHG intensity varied by up to three orders of magnitude, far more than Raman intensity. Imaging and phase measurements found antiparallel domains and boundaries even in films that appeared unidirectionally aligned. A mixed-domain model attributes the large SHG reductions to destructive interference between antiparallel domains. Combining SHG intensity, orientation and phase measurements with Raman intensity and linewidth provides a scalable approach to assessing hBN crystalline quality, potentially applicable to other non-centrosymmetric two-dimensional materials.

The speaker accepts the presidency despite doubts about his qualifications and a wish to remain in retirement. He asks for divine guidance for the new government and credits providence in the nation’s progress. Rather than propose specific measures, he expresses confidence in Congress’s judgment, urges it to uphold morality and the public good, and leaves it to consider constitutional amendments that protect rights without weakening the government. He declines personal compensation beyond necessary expenses and closes by praying for wise decisions.

U.S. stocks rose on March 30, 2017, after revised data showed fourth-quarter GDP grew at a 2.1 percent annualized rate, supported by consumer spending. Financial shares led gains, while higher oil prices and an 8.8 percent rise in ConocoPhillips lifted energy stocks. The Dow gained 0.33 percent, the S&P 500 rose 0.29 percent, and the Nasdaq added 0.28 percent to close at a record high. Investors also looked ahead to first-quarter earnings, while Lululemon shares fell 23.4 percent after it forecast a decline in comparable sales.

James T. Hodgkinson shot Rep. Steve Scalise and several others at a congressional baseball practice in Alexandria, Virginia, before police fatally shot him. Authorities said Hodgkinson had apparently lived in a van in northern Virginia since March and was frequently seen alone with a computer at a nearby YMCA. He had expressed grievances online about President Donald Trump and Republicans, but investigators had not determined a motive. The FBI was tracing his weapons and seeking information about his activities in Alexandria.

The passage describes container and distributed-system patterns. Adapter containers add monitoring, normalize logs, and provide health checks without modifying application images. Microservices separate components behind APIs, enabling independent development and scaling while making design and debugging harder.

Replicated, load-balanced services provide availability and scale; readiness probes keep unprepared replicas from receiving traffic. Caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination can be added as separate layers. Sharding distributes data across machines, while consistent hashing limits remapping when shard counts change. Scatter/gather distributes a request across workers and combines their results, but overhead and slow workers can limit its benefits. Replicating shards improves reliability.

Function-as-a-service simplifies deployment and automatic scaling for event-driven work, but introduces operational, architectural, and cost trade-offs. Its described uses include request transformation, event handling, and event-based pipelines.

Cashino Bedford won a CHIPS Top Fundraiser award after raising more than £5,400 for powered wheelchairs for children with severe mobility problems. Its operator, Praesepe, has donated £820,000 to the charity over the years.

Ari Guiragos Minassian, Orange County’s only Armenian school, held its 31st annual banquet on April 1 with more than 250 guests. Supporters Aleen and Julian Movsesian offered to match donations, and a $10,000 contribution launched a fund for school technology upgrades. The school honored longtime supporters and volunteers and said the money raised would support projects for the coming school year.

Perplexity AI has made its AI-powered Comet browser free worldwide after initially offering it to Perplexity Max subscribers for $200 a month. Comet can search the web, organize tabs, draft emails and shop; Perplexity says a mobile version and additional assistant features are planned.
At a July 4 event in Baku, US Charge d’Affaires William Gill said continued cooperation could benefit Azerbaijan, the US and the world.

On September 17, 2018, Microsoft’s Compensation Committee approved a new Executive Incentive Plan for fiscal 2019 and later awards. The plan reflects changes to the Internal Revenue Code but does not change the type or amount of executive awards. It permits cash, stock, and performance stock awards.

Exelon is expanding a Delmarva Power job-placement pilot with The Precisionists to Atlantic City Electric and Pepco, aiming to provide steady work for dozens of autistic adults. The pilot employs 12 people, whose attention to detail company leaders praise. Worker Kaylin Morris says the job helped her after a three-year search.

The speaker says players must stay focused despite the extra media demands of the finals. He praises Scott Stevens’ endurance and expects Dallas’s power play to test his team’s penalty killing. Home ice helps with matchups, but he says Dallas can win anywhere. After an opening win aided by improved scoring and timely saves from Marty, he expects Dallas to respond strongly. He also praises the chemistry of Sykora, Elias and Arnott and says he trusts several lines and defensive pairings against Dallas’s players.

At the 2018 Nigeria Internet Governance Forum, NCC Executive Vice Chairman Umar Danbatta said Nigeria had 103 million internet users in May, up from 28 million in 2012. He said the NCC planned to license three more infrastructure companies, bringing the total to seven, to expand broadband access. Speakers discussed the internet’s role in good governance, the approaching 2019 elections and cybersecurity. The passage also reports subscriber gains for MTN, Airtel and Globacom in December 2017, while noting cost, power outages and education as barriers to wider internet access.

James D. Rone injured his hands while descending from a backhoe at an Indiana sewer site and sued Boncar Construction. After the trial court struck his claim under the Illinois Structural Work Act, a jury found for Boncar on his negligence claim. The appellate court held that Rone had waived his appeal of the dismissed claim and that negligence, causation, and contributory negligence were properly left to the jury. It also found no error in refusing two proposed jury instructions and affirmed the judgment.

John LeClair said his team started flat, made poor decisions and failed to pursue loose pucks, allowing the opponent to skate freely. He said they need to work the puck low more often but need not make major changes. Despite the loss, he said they would not panic and would be ready for the next game.

The President informs Congress that Texas seeks to extend its jurisdiction over territory east of the Rio Grande that has been governed as part of New Mexico, and reports Texas’s allegation that U.S. officers obstructed its commissioner. He argues that the treaty with Mexico protects the territory’s inhabitants and that he must enforce those protections if resistance overwhelms civil authorities. He says the executive cannot decide the disputed boundary or establish a government for New Mexico. Urging a prompt settlement, he favors congressional action with Texas’s assent and suggests fair compensation if Texas relinquishes a valid claim.

Lothar Matthaeus said Neymar could improve his chances of winning FIFA’s player of the year award by cutting down on theatrics; Ronaldo dismissed the criticism. Wimbledon player Kyle Edmund and his Swedish coach joked about England’s upcoming World Cup quarterfinal against Sweden. Real Madrid denied reports of agreements to sign Kylian Mbappe and Neymar. A Moscow court fined a British fan for writing “England” on a statue of Russian soccer player Fyodor Cherenkov. Russian police briefly detained activists protesting political repression near a World Cup stadium. Iceland goalkeeper Hannes Halldorsson moved from FC Randers to Qarabag after his World Cup performance.

In the AEGEAN study, patients initiating apixaban for atrial fibrillation had high treatment compliance, adherence and persistence through 48 weeks. At 24 weeks, mean adherence was 91.64% with primary standard of care and 91.88% with an additional educational program; persistence was 91.7% and 91.3%, respectively. Neither measure differed significantly between groups. Adherence declined over time, but there were no significant differences between study groups at 48 weeks. Safety outcomes were generally similar across groups. The study concluded that the educational program provided no additional adherence or persistence benefit.

Balyasny Asset Management acquired 401,837 Avis Budget Group shares in the second quarter, worth about $10.96 million and representing roughly 0.49% of the company. Other institutional investors also increased their holdings. Avis reported quarterly earnings of $0.30 per share and revenue of $2.24 billion, both below analyst estimates. The stock had a consensus “Buy” rating and an average price target of $35.89. Insiders sold 185,708 shares during the last quarter. Avis Budget Group provides vehicle rental and car-sharing services through brands including Avis, Budget and Zipcar.

The passage examines USD/JPY, GBP/USD and BTC/USD after weaker-than-expected US data. USD/JPY fell 2.25% on Friday, with its next move dependent on whether it rebounds above nearby resistance or breaks below support. Markets expect the Bank of England to cut rates on Thursday as UK economic momentum weakens; GBP/USD remains near May’s support level. Bitcoin also fell, finding support around 112,000. The passage says upcoming Fed comments and key technical levels may help determine whether it recovers or declines further.

Opening range breakout strategies trade price moves beyond an early-session high or low. Backtests on major futures found simple versions produced small or negative results. Adding daily-bar filters improved one tested strategy, but the passage cautions against overfitting.

Developed by Jerry Tarkanian at the University of Las Vegas, the Amoeba defense helped UNLV win the 1990 NCAA Championship. It is an aggressive, trapping match-up zone in a 1-1-3 alignment: one defender pressures the ball while four others zone. Quick guards are needed for its outside rotations. Defenders pressure wing and corner passes, trap on corner entries or wing dribbles, and rotate to protect the posts and passing lanes. Against a two-guard front, they match up with the guards and can triple-team a pass into the high post.

Stockholm recorded its warmest New Year’s Eve in at least 157 years, reaching 10.3C. Eskilstuna and Adelsö reached 10.4C, breaking Sweden’s previous record by 0.1 degrees. A meteorologist said temperatures would fall below freezing nationwide by Monday.
The gaming machine design is shown from multiple views; dashed lines indicate portions not claimed.

Augustine Heard reported growing unrest involving the Tong Hâk, whose members sought royal permission to practice their religion and rehabilitation of their executed founder. The King rejected their petition and warned them to abandon their doctrines. Threatening placards targeted American missionaries and Japanese residents, while a Tong Hâk manifesto reportedly called for the extermination of foreigners. Chinese official Yuan promised to protect foreigners and maintain order, and two Chinese warships were expected at Chemulpo. The Japanese consul advised preparations to evacuate women and children, though he said his information came only from rumor. Despite continued agitation, Heard reported no serious incident, and alarm among foreigners remained limited.

Retired lawyer Marcel Strigberger recounts recycling his decades-old law schoolbooks while decluttering. He reflects on memorable cases and legal concepts, briefly regrets discarding a book he later sees listed at a high price, and keeps one thick volume to use as a reading stand.

A study of approximately 1.19 million matched Veterans found that those with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection had higher risks of documented suicide attempts and self-directed violence than uninfected comparators. Over one year, their risks were 1.41 and 1.38 times higher, respectively, with the greatest relative risks in the first 30 days. Unverified suicide deaths did not differ significantly between groups. The authors note possible reporting bias, undetected infections, and unobserved confounding.

The speaker says he feels ready to play tomorrow after missing games and finding it difficult to watch from the sidelines. He credits last year’s playoff experience and the team’s depth for its success, citing players who stepped up when others were out. He expects an interesting series against a similarly deep opponent. He says experience helps him manage playoff nerves, and that the chance to win the Stanley Cup provides motivation that outweighs concerns about fatigue. He also praises Johnny’s poise and improvement in his first playoffs.

A Utah prosecutor ruled that an officer was legally justified in fatally shooting Patrick Harmon, 50, in August after Harmon fled a bicycle stop. The officer said Harmon turned toward him with a knife and threatened to stab him; two other officers reported hearing threats, and a knife was found nearby. Prosecutor Sim Gill said slowed-down body-camera footage showed Harmon pivoting toward officers, making the officer’s fear reasonable. Black Lives Matter organizers condemned the ruling and called for Gill’s resignation, saying the footage appeared to show Harmon being shot as he ran. The Salt Lake NAACP said it would seek more information before deciding what action to take.

Momentum investing buys stocks with strong recent performance and periodically rebalances toward those with the highest momentum. The passage describes an S&P 500 strategy using monthly moving-average crossover signals. In a backtest from 1960 to February 2023, $100,000 grew to $5.575 million, an annual return of 6.6% versus 7% for buy and hold. The strategy was invested 69% of the time and had a maximum drawdown of 26%, compared with 55% for buy and hold. The backtest excluded dividends.
ADP reported a loss of 32,000 private nonfarm jobs in September, the largest decline since June 2020. Education and health services gained 33,000 jobs, while leisure and hospitality lost 19,000.

An overbought market has risen significantly over a defined period. The passage says a backtest found below-average returns in the first few days after overbought conditions, but returns moved toward the long-term average over time. It notes that this short-term pattern does not necessarily make short-selling profitable.

Globe and Mail social media editor Kiran Rana describes social media’s role in spreading news and discussion of sexual misconduct allegations, while warning that echo chambers and abusive comments can distort debate. She also highlights an investigation into the sale of fake Twitter followers. The newsletter profiles Brock University professor Veena Dwivedi, who has faced racism and sexism in academia and now supports young women in STEM.

LifeShare Community Blood Services is urging northeast Ohio residents to donate blood after winter weather, low temperatures and flu reduced donations. Type O blood is most urgently needed, though all types are welcome. Mobile drives are scheduled Feb. 3 in Avon Lake and Feb. 4 in Amherst, Elyria and Grafton. Eligible donors can find more information at lifesharedonor.org or 866-644-5433.

European negotiators are working to reconcile proposals for a major pharmaceutical policy overhaul that could affect drug rollouts and investment, while addressing shortages, antimicrobial resistance and other issues. In the U.S., telehealth has become a growing channel for marketing and prescribing drugs, including branded and compounded medications. A Colorado panel also voted to limit what state health plans will pay for a costly arthritis treatment.

A Pakistani civil-military delegation led by Foreign Secretary Tehmina Janjua arrived in Kabul for the first Pakistan-Afghanistan Joint Working Group meeting. Pakistan proposed cooperation on security, trade, refugee repatriation and connectivity, while reaffirming support for an Afghan-led peace process. Following an Afghan delegation’s visit to Pakistan, Ambassador Aizaz Ahmad Chaudhry said Pakistan opposed violence in Afghanistan and sought relations with the United States based on mutual respect.

The passage describes container and distributed-system patterns. Adapter containers can normalize Redis and Storm logs with Fluentd or add database health checks without modifying application containers. Microservices separate functions behind APIs, allowing independent development and scaling, but complicating design and debugging.

Replicated, load-balanced services improve availability and capacity; readiness probes keep unprepared instances from serving requests. Application-layer additions include caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination. Sharding distributes data across machines, while consistent hashing limits remapping when shard counts change. Replicating individual shards improves resilience and handles uneven traffic.

Scatter/gather sends work to multiple nodes and combines their results to reduce processing time. Its benefits are limited by request overhead, slow nodes, and failures, so shards may also need replication. Event-driven functions simplify deployment and suit transformations, event handlers, and pipelines, but can be difficult to monitor and are poorly suited to long-running processing or large in-memory workloads. Finally, distributed ownership may require master election, though a single orchestrated instance can be simpler when its downtime is acceptable.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. Switching frequency ranges from 100 kHz to 2 MHz and can be set by an RT resistor or an external clock. Two controllers can share a SYNC signal for synchronized or interleaved operation.

Depending on the device, the controllers provide primary switching and synchronous-rectifier outputs, programmable timing and duty-cycle limits, pulse skipping, current limiting with hiccup restart, external fault protection, slope compensation, and thermal shutdown. External gate drivers are recommended. The passage also presents component-selection guidance and a 500-kHz synchronous push-pull converter design using the TPS7H5001-SP and GaN devices. Power-supply and PCB-layout recommendations emphasize bypassing, short switching paths, separated grounds, and keeping noise-sensitive signals away from switching traces.

The passage describes a diabetes management partner interface that lets an analyte sensor system communicate wirelessly with display devices and partner devices, including insulin delivery devices. With authorization, partner devices can modify sensor configuration parameters to meet their requirements. These parameters govern connectivity, device access, calibration, power use, alerts, and analyte data. The system can select operating modes for different device combinations, manage connection permissions and whitelists, and adjust settings when partner devices connect or disconnect. It also describes sharing data and alerts between sensor and partner applications and using sensor data with medicament delivery information to assess device operability.
Tesla filed a Form 8-K on July 22, 2020, announcing that it had posted its second-quarter 2020 financial results for the quarter ended June 30. The update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

William C. Smith, 42, pleaded not guilty to murdering Willard Higgins Jr., 40, who died after a Friday altercation in Troy. Bond was set at $500,000. An autopsy is underway, and a pretrial hearing is scheduled for Dec. 19.

A 2015 survey found that 70 per cent of known kawakawa and donu breeding sites in Fiji had declined or disappeared, while grouper catches had fallen 70 per cent. The 4FJ campaign urges people not to eat, buy or sell the fish during their June–September breeding season.

Israel and Myanmar signed an education agreement to teach the Holocaust and the consequences of intolerance, racism, anti-Semitism and xenophobia in Myanmar. They also plan to review textbook passages about each other’s history, develop programs on each other’s countries and promote academic cooperation. The agreement drew online skepticism amid criticism of Israel’s killing of Gaza protesters and allegations of ethnic cleansing against Myanmar’s Rohingya Muslims.

VentureWire’s November 15, 2000 issue reports that Advanced Technology Ventures is raising an $800 million fund, Qualcomm has committed $500 million to a new venture fund, and IP Communications secured $312 million in financing. Foodbuy.com ended its California operations and cut 22% of its workforce. The issue also covers numerous other funding rounds, company closures, partnerships, acquisitions, leadership appointments, venture-capital developments, and corrections.

The court reversed an order requiring Jane Kursa to provide a further bill of particulars. Although Kursa had delayed, the defendants failed to seek relief within the statutory 10-day period or explain their delay. The motion was denied without costs.

On Friday, major U.S. stock indices fell about 2 percent, with the Dow dropping more than 600 points. Investors feared that rising wages could lead to inflation and faster interest-rate increases. Most analysts viewed the decline as an overdue correction, not a sign of broader economic trouble.

Russia acknowledged that its seizure of the bark Cape Horn Pigeon was unjustifiable but disputed compensation for the vessel’s lost services during detention. The United States offered to settle the claim for $42,000 without waiving the claimants’ rights; Russia rejected the offer and renewed its $2,500 indemnity offer. The claimants argue that the Okhotsk Sea was open to foreign whalers beyond ordinary jurisdictional waters, citing past practice and treaties with the United States and Great Britain. The bark’s captain stated that the arresting commander said he had orders to seize vessels whaling there.

The lecture derives coherent Thomson scattering, which probes collective plasma motion when the scattering wavelength exceeds the Debye length. Scattered-light spectra can show broadened peaks associated with ion acoustic and electron plasma waves; collection over a range of angles adds broadening. The scattered power depends on a spectral density function determined by electron-density fluctuations. A test-particle treatment accounts for electrons and for electrons responding to moving ions, rather than scattering directly from ions. Peaks occur near plasma modes where the dielectric permittivity approaches zero. The lecture then uses the collisionless Vlasov equation to derive susceptibilities, including thermal effects through Landau damping, and discusses their evaluation for Maxwellian distributions.

NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture adds hardware support for Linear Swept Spheres, improving hair rendering speed and reducing geometry memory use. Shader Execution Reordering 2.0 makes ray-tracing workloads more efficient, while the AI Management Processor schedules GPU contexts to reduce CPU involvement and latency.

Blackwell adds hardware encoding and decoding for 4:2:2 H.264 and HEVC video, improves AV1 and HEVC encoding, and supports DisplayPort 2.1b. Power-management changes include finer-grained gating, faster frequency switching, and quicker entry into deep sleep states.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three frames per rendered frame, and transformer-based models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and anti-aliasing. Blackwell also expands shader access to Tensor Cores for neural techniques including material rendering, texture compression, lighting, skin, and faces. The passage describes GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs and their associated GeForce RTX 50-series products.

The passage describes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) protocol for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests. These features encrypt guest register state; for non-automatic exits, the guest uses a shared, 4 KB GHCB to disclose only the state needed by the hypervisor. The specification defines protocol negotiation, hypervisor feature advertisement, GHCB registration for SEV-SNP guests, and VMGEXIT handling.

It also documents requests for page state changes, SNP firmware services, APIC IDs, multiple VMPL levels, and trusted I/O. An extended SNP guest request can return certificate data in shared pages, with certificates identified by GUID.

Blue Bird reported record third-quarter sales and strong margins, supported by bus volumes, pricing and demand. Its 3,900-unit backlog and investments support the author’s Buy rating, despite tariff uncertainty and short-term electric-vehicle risks.

The team is excited to play Saturday and hopes to earn another game. It feels healthy and rested except for Dwayne’s injury, values a player’s physical and offensive contributions, and plans to stick to its game plan.

Massachusetts General Hospital’s Pre-Admission Testing Area (PATA) conducted pre-surgery work-ups for outpatients, but long waits and uneven patient flow had persisted for years. Patients spent an average of two-and-a-half hours in the clinic, often more time waiting than seeing providers. Staff routinely worked past scheduled hours, while limited capacity meant PATA saw only about 65% of surgical outpatients. Work-ups completed or left incomplete on surgery day could delay operating-room schedules.

A task force formed in 2008 to address these problems. Earlier proposals for more space and broader process changes had not succeeded. A 2009 review documented variation in appointment times and identified opportunities to improve efficiency. Task force members proposed longer appointment intervals, additional resources, or lower patient volume, while others urged better use of existing resources. The group planned to use the review’s data to evaluate its options.

A four-year follow-up of 56 males with ADHD used pharmacological MRI to examine stimulant use, resting cerebral blood flow, and responses to a methylphenidate challenge. Researchers found no evidence that stimulant treatment caused lasting age-dependent changes in these measures, unlike effects observed shortly after the initial trial. Greater subsequent stimulant use was associated with lower thalamic resting blood flow in adults and a lower methylphenidate response in the medial prefrontal cortex in adolescents. These associations were present before treatment and were unrelated to reported ADHD symptom severity. Whole-brain responses were associated with noradrenaline transporter distribution. The authors note limitations including sample attrition, assumed adherence to prescriptions, and different MRI scanners across visits.

A cross-sectional survey of 7,264 teachers in 11 schools in Zhengzhou, China, examined personal health literacy, school health literacy environments and health outcomes. Overall, 56.9% of teachers had problematic or inadequate health literacy, and 31.0% perceived their school environment as supportive of health literacy. Lower personal health literacy and less supportive school environments were each associated with poorer self-reported health, more health-compromising behaviours, greater health service use and higher out-of-pocket healthcare costs. Health literacy also varied across teacher characteristics. The authors recommend interventions addressing both individual skills and school environments, but note that convenience sampling limits generalisability and the cross-sectional design cannot establish causality.

The ADS7828 samples an analog input onto an internal capacitor and supports internal or external voltage references. Lower reference voltages reduce LSB size, making offset, gain, and noise errors larger in LSB terms. The device operates as an I2C slave in standard, fast, and high-speed modes; commands select its operating state and initiate conversions, and each 12-bit result is read in two bytes. Reference settling time must be allowed before accurate conversions. Clean, bypassed power and grounding help prevent conversion errors, while external-reference noise can appear in the results. The passage also includes packaging information and TI’s product-resource disclaimers.

Edinburgh-based Vert Rotors has developed VERT.500, an industrial-scale version of its patented compressor, with the Advanced Manufacturing and Automation Centre. Ten times larger than an earlier model, it is designed to provide clean air with less noise and greater energy efficiency. The company says it could reduce noise-protection costs, electricity bills and CO2 emissions for hospitals and other businesses.

Webster Elementary dedicated two recycled-material “buddy benches” to former music teacher Robert Pickell, who died in July after falling through his roof. More than 100 people attended the ceremony. Students wrote goodbye messages, and staff and students planted a tree that will receive a memorial plaque.

Linguistics researcher Martin O’Leary shared charts tracing surprising connections between modern words and Proto-Indo-European roots. His examples link “architect” and “dachshund” to *teks*, “science” and “sh*t” to *sek*, and “blue,” “phlegm,” and “flamingo” to *bhel*. Proto-Indo-European is thought to have originated north of the Caspian Sea and given rise to more than 440 modern languages. With no surviving texts, linguists have struggled to reconstruct it. O’Leary’s charts received thousands of retweets.

The speaker values experienced teammates’ leadership and says communication, speed and effort are important, even when outcomes cannot be controlled. They also describe keeping a teammate involved despite a difficult sacrifice he made for the team.

Retailer listings suggest Intel may mark the 8086 processor’s 40th anniversary with a Core i7-8086K. The rumored CPU has six cores, 12 threads, 12MB of L3 cache and a maximum clock speed of 5GHz—300MHz faster than the Core i7-8700K. It is expected to be overclockable and cost around $480, though full details remain unknown.

Interfacial mobility governs interface migration and influences material microstructure, but extracting it from atomistic simulations is difficult when motion retains memory of slower microscopic processes. Solute interactions can cause sub-diffusive behavior throughout accessible simulation times, challenging conventional memoryless methods. The study uses a computationally efficient two-dimensional kinetic Monte Carlo model with adjustable boundary stiffness, solute binding, and diffusion kinetics. It examines the limits of the capillary fluctuation method, proposes mobility extraction from mean boundary motion, and applies a time-convolutionless approach to characterize memory-affected dynamics.

The S&P 500 fell sharply last week but was set to rebound on Monday. The article warns that the rise could be temporary, with earnings, tariffs, weak economic data and stretched valuations posing risks. Oil also declined after OPEC+ announced another production increase, though potential sanctions on Russian oil could affect supply.
The team needs one more win and must stay focused in Calgary. After a hard-fought road game, they plan to refocus and stick to their game plan.

The passage discusses female genital mutilation in North America, citing charges against a Detroit doctor who denies the allegations. It says reliable Canadian statistics are unavailable, but the Ontario Human Rights Commission reports some evidence of the practice in Canada and of families sending daughters abroad for it. It also describes requests for reinfibulation after childbirth. The author argues that FGM is not a Canadian value and supports screening prospective citizens on that basis.

Researchers tested 105 pet dogs that enjoyed playing with toys and found that 33 showed addictive-like behaviors, such as persisting when a favorite toy was inaccessible and ignoring food to reach it. The behavior was more common among terriers and shepherds. Researchers suspect the dogs seek the excitement of play rather than the toy itself, but caution against equating their behavior with human addiction. An unpublished survey suggests such behavior may be rare.

A simulation of the Netherlands’ first COVID-19 wave combined demographic, mobility, contact, hospital-admission and seroprevalence data to compare national and municipality-level interventions. The model found that reduced mobility contributed most to epidemic control; without it, hospital admissions would have approximately doubled. School closures had little impact in the modeled period. Municipality-level interventions triggered at 0.33% infectious prevalence produced 410 more hospital admissions than the national approach while allowing 167 municipalities to begin interventions later. The authors conclude that local interventions could reduce the societal burden of lockdowns if infection levels can be monitored sufficiently. Limitations include simplified household contacts and movement patterns, and mobility data that could not capture geographic or demographic differences in pandemic-era changes.

On February 7, 2013, leaders of MIT Sloan’s Women in Management club had to decide whether to cancel, shorten, or delay a decision on their sold-out conference scheduled for the next day. After 11 months of planning, they had confirmed 15 speakers, distributed 500 tickets, and raised $38,000 in sponsorships. Forecasts warned of a major snowstorm, but its timing remained uncertain, and MIT had not announced a closure. Vendors were due to begin setup at 2 p.m., after which cancellation costs could rise substantially. The leaders weighed attendee safety, speaker travel, finances, and the club’s reputation. Rescheduling was not considered feasible.

Minutes from the Fed’s September meeting show officials voted 11-1 to cut interest rates by a quarter point, to 4%–4.25%, amid growing concern about a weakening labor market. Most favored further easing, but projections split 10-9 on whether to make two more cuts in 2025. Officials still expected inflation to return to the 2% target. A government shutdown could leave them without key economic data for their October meeting.

The memorandum predicts that peace discussions may begin before hostilities end. It argues that German peace proposals seek to divide the Allies while preserving unity in Central Europe. Suppressing sympathetic opinion may work temporarily but risks deepening divisions; the President’s reply to the Pope instead emphasizes widely shared aims. The memorandum warns that debating territorial peace terms could weaken morale and split the coalition, whose central purpose is to defeat the German army or prompt a change in Germany’s leadership.

Baking soda reacts with acids, while baking powder contains baking soda and a dry acid. They can be substituted in different amounts. Baking powder lasts 3–12 months; sealed, cool baking soda lasts longer. Bubbling tests show whether each is usable.

The paper introduces LLM-proposed Open Taxonomy (LOT), which derives human-readable reasoning features from pairs of model outputs, annotates new traces, and iteratively refines a classifier. Across 12 large reasoning models, LOT distinguishes reasoning patterns by model scale, base family, and specialization, outperforming the comparison methods. It finds that smaller Qwen3 models more often reason circularly, while a code-specialized model sometimes uses Python to solve math problems.
