Modifying smaller Qwen3 models’ reasoning improved GPQA accuracy by 3.3–5.7%. The authors note that LOT may not capture every reasoning difference and that they did not establish whether model attributes cause those differences.

Amazon added Outlook.com calendar support to Alexa, letting users manage events by voice. An update also gives Tap speakers hands-free Alexa activation and support for echo spatial perception. Amazon says Tap retains about eight hours of battery life.

The lecture examines when behavioral mistakes might justify paternalistic policies. Hard paternalism restricts choices or changes prices; soft paternalism aims to influence behavior while preserving choice. The lecturer cautions that policymakers may misunderstand people’s preferences, interventions can harm some people, and nudges do not always work. Examples include retirement-plan defaults, court-date reminders, and the voluntary Save More Tomorrow plan, which increased participants’ savings. Energy-use comparisons illustrate that some people dislike being nudged. Markets may offer help but can also exploit behavioral biases. The lecture concludes that policies should be evaluated for their effects on welfare, including the value of removing obstacles that steer people away from beneficial choices.

Researchers counted daily growth lines in fossilized embryo teeth to estimate that Protoceratops eggs incubated for nearly three months and Hypacrosaurus eggs for six months. These periods were longer than expected and closer to those of reptiles than modern birds. The researchers suggest that prolonged incubation exposed dinosaur eggs and parents to greater risks and may have made it harder for non-avian dinosaurs to recover from the end-Cretaceous extinction.

A study of 10 flights suggests passengers seeking to avoid colds or flu should choose a window seat and stay seated, reducing contact with people moving through the cabin. Researchers found that passengers near a sick person faced the highest risk. A model of a flight with about 150 passengers estimated that one person would be infected by a hypothetical infectious aisle-seat passenger. The study found no cold or flu viruses and observed only one person coughing, so outside researchers cautioned against drawing broad conclusions.

Bob Kloppenburg presents SOS pressure defense as a response to increasingly skilled basketball offenses and as a way to strengthen any defensive system. Its six keys are teaching fundamentals from one-on-one play through team defense; using consistent S-O-S action words; directing ballhandlers toward checkpoints at least 18 feet from the hoop; switching on screens when useful; applying backcourt pressure to disrupt fast breaks; and assigning every defender a clear role. The program emphasizes repeated practice, communication, and coordinated effort to limit scoring opportunities and create turnovers.

Comcast has a consensus “Buy” rating from 23 brokerages and an average 12-month price target of $79.31. Its latest quarterly earnings were $0.89 per share on $21 billion in revenue, both above analysts’ expectations. Revenue rose 9.2% from a year earlier. The company announced a 2-for-1 stock split scheduled for February 20 and raised its quarterly dividend to $0.1575 per share. Institutional investors own 82.03% of its stock.

The coach praised a player’s gritty playoff performance despite a difficult regular season. Facing elimination, he said the team’s motivation comes from wanting to keep playing together, while its experience, discipline and patience give it a chance to win. He reflected on the breaks that helped the team reach this stage and said the series has become a mental test. He praised both goaltenders, the effort of both teams, and Brett Hull’s gritty play. Langenbrunner’s return and other available forwards could add energy.

After Trump issued an order ending birthright citizenship, federal courts temporarily blocked its enforcement. The administration first asked the Supreme Court to limit nationwide injunctions, not to decide whether the order was legal. The Court rejected universal injunctions but left lower courts to consider narrower relief. Lower courts then continued to rule against the order, finding it likely unconstitutional or invalid. The administration has now asked the Supreme Court to review rulings from the 9th Circuit and a New Hampshire district court. It did not request expedited review; if the justices take the cases, arguments will likely occur in 2026.

The Wisconsin Court of Appeals affirmed Andrew Sabo’s convictions for cocaine possession with intent to deliver and firearm possession. It held that a citizen informant’s observations, corroborated by police, supported probable cause for the search warrant. The court also upheld the denial of Sabo’s requests for a hearing on alleged false statements in the warrant affidavit and for disclosure of the informant’s identity.

The passage describes a method for selecting an ingress edge region for customer IPsec traffic on an Internet-based overlay network. A customer router uses DNS to establish a tunnel with an initial edge, which then checks whether another edge is more appropriate and can redirect the router. The selected edge periodically checks its suitability and can stop responding to liveness probes, prompting the router to seek another connection.

WORD and BYTE writes to PMC registers can corrupt later writes because the shadow register retains data in inactive byte lanes while operational registers update at 32-bit granularity. Corruption may affect the same or an unrelated register.

A June 29, 2001, email circulated articles on energy issues. A California Senate committee voted to cite Enron and Mirant for contempt after they withheld documents sought in an electricity-pricing investigation; the citations could be withdrawn if they complied by July 10. California regulators exempted oil refineries from rolling blackouts. Other reports covered Edison International’s new financing, falling Southern California natural-gas prices, criticism of Gov. Gray Davis’s handling of the energy crisis, stalled congressional action on President Bush’s energy proposals, and temporary federal approval of New York wholesale electricity price controls.

Mercedes chief Toto Wolff says rivalry between teammates can help the team succeed if balanced with a positive atmosphere. Hamilton and Bottas won Mercedes’ fourth consecutive constructors’ championship without significant controversy, unlike Hamilton and Rosberg’s bitter but successful partnership. Wolff wants Bottas to challenge Hamilton more next season.

Astronomers observed a rogue planet about 600 light-years away absorbing gas and dust at up to 6 billion metric tons per second, the fastest growth rate recorded for a planet. Observations showed that its rate of accumulation rose as much as eightfold between spring and summer. The prolonged spurt resembles one previously seen only in young stars, suggesting the planet may have had a starlike birth. Researchers plan to observe it again and look for similar events in other rogue planets.

Reinaldo De Jesus Henao was arrested at Coachella after festival-goers traced missing phones. Police allegedly found more than 100 stolen phones in his backpack. Charged on suspicion of grand theft and receiving stolen property, he was released on $10,000 bail.

The lecture derives the solution of inviscid Burgers’ equation from a unit point source: a fan with \(u=x/t\) from \(x=0\) to a shock at \(x=\sqrt{2t}\), and zero elsewhere. Conservation of mass locates the shock; the jump and entropy conditions verify the solution. The professor then explains how a change of variables turns Burgers’ equation with viscosity into the heat equation, yielding a minimization formula as viscosity approaches zero. The lecture also describes numerical experiments on the nonlinear Korteweg–de Vries equation: interacting solitary waves emerge with their shapes unchanged, helping prompt the discovery of its integrable structure. It closes with remarks on unresolved questions about Navier–Stokes solutions.

Baker Mayfield’s college performance and predictive metrics make him the strongest quarterback prospect in the draft, according to the passage. Pro Football Focus ranked him first in the class for accuracy at every passing depth and rated him college football’s top passer under pressure in each of the previous three seasons. Football Outsiders ranked him its fourth-highest quarterback prospect since 1997. Concerns include his height, unnecessary sacks, college offense and off-field conduct, but the passage says he is likely to be drafted in the top five.

AfriForum’s Dr David Klatzow is investigating the possible cause of the Knysna-area fires by gathering information, consulting role-players and assessing the fire’s extent and potential spread by wind.

Amarin Corp ADS shares rose 1.33% in the most recent session and closed at $3.80. Five analysts’ 12-month price targets average $7.60, ranging from $5 to $10; two rate the stock Buy and three rate it Outperform. Its 14-period ATR is 0.2, RSI is 43.29, and market capitalization is $1.03 billion. Previous-session trading volume was 6.36 million shares, versus an average of 1.89 million.

Thruxton’s 50th anniversary meeting will feature historic races, demonstrations and the opening of the £2 million Thruxton Centre by Nigel Mansell and Murray Walker. Karun Chandhok will demonstrate a Williams FW08C, while Niki Lauda’s 1972 Formula 2 March returns to race. The programme also includes 1950s sportscars, Historic Formula Ford and touring cars.

The paper presents NeuroAdapter, which reconstructs images by conditioning a latent diffusion model directly on parcel-wise fMRI signals, without intermediate image or text embeddings. Its IBBI framework uses cross-attention to examine brain parcels’ relative contributions and where regions direct attention in generated images. Across the evaluated datasets, NeuroAdapter reports competitive reconstruction quality, particularly on semantic metrics, while showing more modest gains on low-level metrics. The authors note variability in generated image quality and the need for more consistent decoding.

Chelsea manager Antonio Conte urged his players to focus on Tuesday’s Premier League match at Huddersfield rather than February’s Champions League tie with Barcelona. After Saturday’s loss to West Ham, he said Chelsea could no longer defend their league title and must fight for a Champions League place. Chelsea are third; Huddersfield are 12th.

TI provides technical and design resources “as is,” without warranties, and may change them without notice. Developers are responsible for product selection, application testing, and compliance. Resource use is limited to developing applications with specified TI products. TI disclaims liability and requires users to indemnify it for claims arising from resource use.

The speaker is excited for the next Stanley Cup Final game and says he has moved on from the league’s decision about a recent incident. He respects the league’s decision and says he must avoid bumping the goalie or putting his team down a man. He also discusses former linemates, preparation, family and fantasy baseball.

Theresa May will reportedly ask Cabinet ministers at Friday’s Chequers summit to support a Brexit plan under which the UK would follow some EU rules on goods, ease entry for EU citizens despite ending free movement, and collect customs duties on the EU’s behalf. The proposals aim to preserve trade in goods while allowing independent UK trade deals. Amid Conservative divisions, former minister Phillip Lee accused Brexiteers of planning a leadership challenge. Former party leader William Hague urged ministers to compromise, warning that Parliament could otherwise impose a “watered-down” Brexit.

AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) announced it would shut down on December 15 after operating since 1997. Once a leading U.S. messaging service, its use declined as cell phone messaging and social media grew.

The Bond family sued YMCA of the Rockies after four-year-old Erin was severely injured by a truck it operated. YMCA sought the family’s therapists’ notes and treatment records to contest claims for mental suffering and psychiatric expenses. The Colorado Supreme Court held that the family waived therapist-patient privilege by making those claims, but the trial court erred by ordering disclosure without weighing the potential harm to treatment against YMCA’s need for evidence. It remanded for reconsideration under that balancing standard.

Earth’s total solar eclipses occur because the moon, though about 400 times smaller than the sun, is about 400 times closer, allowing it to cover the sun. The moon is moving away from Earth, and in about 600 million years it will appear too small to produce total solar eclipses.

The Sansa c200 manual explains battery installation, the hold switch, recording, USB file transfers, and safe removal from a computer. It covers music, photo and radio playback; voice and radio recording; playback and display settings; and troubleshooting. Photos require Sansa Media Converter, while supported audio formats include MP3, WAV and WMA. The passage also provides technical support information, a one-year limited warranty, software license terms and disposal instructions.

The passage describes a hosted virtual desktop system that manages computing resources based on user connections. It may detect disconnection or inactivity, then shut down resources according to provider, administrator, or user policies. Usage patterns may inform predictive shutdowns and restarts. Storage volumes can remain available while computing resources are shut down and be reattached when a user reconnects. The system may also track connected and unconnected periods for billing.

After speaking out against the Charlottesville protests, Zendaya used her 2017 Teen Choice Awards acceptance speech to urge young people to stay informed, speak up against injustice and recognize their power as future leaders.

A coach said his team was outskated, lost battles, failed to get shots through and took costly undisciplined penalties. After further medical consultations, doctors and Erik felt his healing was complete. Looking ahead to the final Stanley Cup game in their building, the coach said the team must return to its skating style and would make no excuses for Doug’s absence. He expected a strong performance from Joe despite his difficult recovery from knee surgery. He said both teams were well conditioned and that execution, effort and special teams would matter more than the venue.

Apple’s 2022 Form 10-K, for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, describes its iPhone, Mac, iPad, wearables, accessories and services businesses. Direct and indirect channels accounted for 38% and 62% of net sales, respectively. Apple had approximately 164,000 full-time equivalent employees at year-end.

The filing identifies risks involving competition, component shortages, reliance on outsourcing partners, economic conditions, COVID-19, cybersecurity, regulation, litigation, currency fluctuations and taxes. It also describes an ongoing appeal in Epic Games’ lawsuit concerning the App Store. Apple’s common stock trades on Nasdaq under AAPL.

The put-call ratio compares put and call option volume or open interest and is used as a market sentiment indicator. High readings generally signal fear, while low readings signal complacency, though interpretations vary by market. The passage describes high readings as potential contrarian signals but says its backtest results were unimpressive and that other sentiment indicators, such as the VIX, performed better.

InfoWorld provides Technology of the Year Award winners with guidelines for publicizing their awards. Winners may reference the award in press outreach and order physical awards or reprints through YGS. Use of the award logo requires a purchased license and compliance with rules prohibiting alteration, combination with other graphics, and placement too close to company or product names. Press materials must follow InfoWorld’s naming conventions, identify an awarded subsidiary rather than its parent, and seek approval for changes to the supplied spokesperson quote. InfoWorld editors and reviewers select the annual winners from products tested during the previous year.

The passage highlights UN-supported efforts to improve access to clean water, including a new water system in South Sudan, fundraising in Vietnam, water-harvesting research in Singapore, and village standpipes in Kyrgyzstan. It calls for better coordination on water-related development goals and quotes the General Assembly President urging people to treat water responsibly and prevent future conflict.

The passage reviews AI in higher education, describing potential benefits including personalized learning, tutoring, accessibility, administrative efficiency, and data-informed decisions. It recommends clear institutional goals, reliable infrastructure, faculty training, pilot projects, student involvement, and ongoing evaluation. Responsible use requires privacy protections, bias audits, transparency, equitable access, and human oversight. Challenges include cost, unreliable or biased outputs, cheating, dependence on technology, and possible loss of human interaction or teaching roles. Although the passage supports carefully governed institutional adoption, its author personally recommends that students avoid AI for teaching, learning, and course assignments, while allowing its use in research when outputs are checked for appropriateness, accuracy, and fairness.

The 2018 Chevrolet Equinox’s available 1.6L turbo-diesel is rated at 6.0 L/100 km on the highway in front-wheel-drive models and produces 240 lb-ft of torque. It includes stop/start technology and supports B20 biodiesel. The Equinox offers connectivity and available safety features. It starts at $27,145; turbo-diesel pricing starts at $35,645 when that model goes on sale in the fall.

The passage describes apparatuses and methods for image encoding and decoding using AI. An encoder may down-scale an original image with a deep neural network, encode the result, and transmit image data with information about the down-scaling. A decoder uses that information to decide whether to up-scale the decoded image with a jointly trained network. If AI up-scaling is unnecessary or unavailable, it may output the decoded image or use conventional up-scaling.

The LakeSmart Team is delivering summer Dock Talks to help cottagers and other lake users protect Lake of the Woods and nearby ecosystems. The three-member team shares guidance on shorelines, septic systems, invasive species and safe boating. They will also answer questions at the Matiowki Farmer’s Market on Wednesdays in July and August and offer presentations to lake groups on request.

The lecture relates the large-N expansion of gauge theories to string scattering: Feynman diagrams and string worldsheets are organized by surface topology, with 1/N corresponding to string coupling. A continuum worldsheet picture would require complicated diagrams that dominate at strong coupling, making the correspondence difficult to establish for QCD, though simpler matrix models provide examples.

The lecturer explains how adding quarks introduces surfaces with boundaries, corresponding to open strings, while other matrix symmetries can produce non-orientable surfaces. A string theory describing a large-N conformal field theory would, as a necessary condition, inhabit an anti-de Sitter spacetime with one additional noncompact dimension. The lecture closes by rewriting the Nambu–Goto string action in Polyakov form, which frames string quantization as two-dimensional gravity coupled to scalar fields.

Touch Football Australia and the NRL will launch a nationally televised Touch Premiership on May 18, with men’s and women’s games preceding NRL matches across seven rounds. Teams will align with six NRL clubs. Ipswich players Jake Notley, Jake Hooper and Tayla Rosin may participate. Jillaroos player Ali Brigginshaw said the partnership could raise touch football’s profile and create a pathway to rugby league, though her contract will likely prevent her from playing.

The passage describes a near-eye display that adjusts the luminance of individual light sources according to their position relative to a user’s field of view. Eye tracking can move the highest-luminance region with the user’s gaze, while sources farther from that region emit less light. The approach is intended to reduce power consumption with little or no impact on user experience and can use OLED or micro-LED displays.

Harvey Weinstein was indicted in New York on rape and criminal sex act charges involving two women. He has denied the allegations. His lawyers said he declined to testify before the grand jury because he lacked preparation time and believed political pressure made an indictment inevitable. Weinstein is free on $1 million bail with electronic monitoring. Dozens of other women have accused him of sexual misconduct. Gov. Andrew Cuomo ordered an investigation into District Attorney Cyrus Vance Jr.’s decision not to charge Weinstein over a separate 2015 allegation.

To replace an HDD with a SanDisk SSD, shut down the computer and disconnect power; remove the battery if it is a notebook. In a notebook, transfer any HDD brackets or adapters, connect the SSD in the drive bay, and reassemble. In a desktop, remove the HDD, install the SSD using a mounting adapter if needed, reconnect the SATA cables, and close the case. The old HDD can be kept as a backup.

Leapfrog’s spring Hospital Safety Grades show improved patient safety records at some hospitals. Five hospitals earned an “A” for the first time after previously receiving an “F,” and 46 earned their first “A” since grading began six years ago. Of approximately 2,500 hospitals graded, 30% received an “A,” while 1% received an “F.” Maryland moved out of the bottom five in state rankings, and Washington, D.C., had its first “A” hospital since spring 2013. Leapfrog updates the grades twice a year.

The Boathouse at City Point will open June 17 on Hopewell’s riverfront as the fourth Boathouse restaurant in Central Virginia. It will include indoor dining, a patio, event space and a reservable chef’s table. The restaurant will serve lunch and dinner daily and Sunday brunch, and is considered a cornerstone of riverfront revitalization.

Glibc 2.28 is set to build and run on GNU/Hurd without out-of-tree patches. GNU Guix can run on Android devices, though installation requires substantial work. Node.js v10 was announced alongside npm@6, which adds security features for developers using open-source code.

The PGA848’s linear input range extends to within 3 V of either supply, with common-mode rejection maintained across that range. An example circuit uses it to drive a 16-bit, 1-MSPS ADS8860 SAR ADC, with ±15 V input-stage supplies, a 5.3 V output-stage supply, a REF6250 reference, and an OPA192-buffered 2.5 V REF input. Three filters address interference, bandwidth, and ADC sampling; the circuit has a nominal 318 kHz bandwidth and remains flat to within 0.1 dB at 41 kHz. The passage recommends supply bypassing, matched input paths, and layout measures to limit noise and leakage. Supplies above 40 V can permanently damage the device.

Users can register on ti.com for weekly documentation-update notifications and consult revision histories for details. TI E2E forums offer design help, but contributor content is not a TI specification. The passage warns that electrostatic discharge can damage integrated circuits. Mechanical, packaging, and ordering information is subject to change. TI provides its technical resources “as is” and states that developers are responsible for selecting products and validating their applications.

Madison Realty Capital provided JDS Development Group a $137 million construction loan to fully finance Monad Terrace, a 59-residence waterfront project in Miami Beach designed by Jean Nouvel in collaboration with Kobi Karp Architecture and Interior Design. Residences range from two to five bedrooms. The building incorporates climate-resilience features, including an elevated structure. Construction was underway, with completion estimated for fall 2019. Sales were averaging nearly $2,000 per square foot.

TeraWulf is shifting from bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure hosting through an expanded Fluidstack deal and a $3.2 billion Google commitment. The passage projects $760 million in annual revenue and says planned capacity growth to 1,150 MW by 2030 could raise annual revenue to $1.5 billion.

In a cross-sectional study of 45 people aged 50–74 with biomarker-confirmed mild Alzheimer disease, APOE4 carriers with the BCHE-K variant were diagnosed an average of 6.4 years earlier than APOE4 carriers without it. No comparable difference was observed among APOE4 noncarriers. The authors propose that glial activation may help explain the findings, but the small study requires confirmation in larger, prospective studies. The preprint has not been peer reviewed.

Using airborne lidar, archaeologists identified more than 60,000 previously unknown Maya structures beneath jungle vegetation in Guatemala, including houses, fortifications, causeways and a pyramid. The findings suggest the civilization may have supported far more people than previously estimated, with extensive food production, trade networks and landscape engineering. Researchers say further analysis is needed to understand the discoveries.

Steven Kean asked John Hardy how important Enron’s fight against proposed Export-Import Bank cuts was. Attached reports say Enron and other major exporters were lobbying Congress against a proposed 25% cut to the bank’s operating budget. Other articles mention Enron’s Dutch gas trading, an Enron Wind lawsuit over unpaid California power bills, doubts about approval of Sierra Pacific’s purchase of Portland General Electric, and an unfinished California power contract with Enron.

“The Last Three,” a bronze sculpture of the last Northern White Rhinos, is on display in New York City. Intended to raise awareness, it has drawn both criticism and praise. The subspecies is extinct in the wild.

Smith County legal notices for the week of May 31, 2018, include requests for information about two vehicles; estate land auctions on June 9 and June 23; foreclosure sales on June 13 and June 21; and creditor notices for three estates. Court notices direct Jason Rodgers to respond to an adoption and parental-rights petition and Danny Lee Brown to respond to a dependency-and-neglect petition and attend a July 24 hearing. The passage also links to the Town of Gordonsville budget and three South Side Utility District water reports.

Britain’s exam regulator proposed a record £175,000 fine for OCR after a 2017 *Romeo and Juliet* exam question mistakenly named the Capulets instead of the Montagues. More than 14,000 students received the paper, and 2,735 were graded using other answers.

To investigate the unusually early and severe US RSV surge in autumn 2022, researchers sequenced samples from patients in the Greater Boston Area. The genomes represented multiple pre-existing RSV-A and RSV-B lineages, some also found in Washington. Their divergence did not indicate accelerated evolution. The findings are inconsistent with a single highly transmissible RSV lineage causing the surge. The authors recommend investigating non-viral factors, including changes in immunity during the COVID-19 pandemic.

The lecture examines structures for finite impulse response (FIR) filters. Symmetry in linear-phase FIR filters allows an implementation with half as many multiplications as a general direct form. Frequency-sampling structures use frequency-response samples as coefficients; they can reduce implementation work when many samples are zero and allow components to be shared across a filter bank, but pole-zero cancellation creates practical drawbacks. The lecture also compares structures under finite register length, noting that coefficient quantization makes high-order direct forms more sensitive to pole-location errors than lower-order cascade or parallel sections.

Ultralight backpacking aims for a base weight of 10 pounds or less, excluding worn clothing and consumables. The author recommends first leaving behind items that do not help keep you warm, comfortable, fed, or safe, then considering lighter shelter, sleep systems, and backpacks. Experimenting with options such as quilts and simpler camping routines can reveal what you actually need. The goal is not a rigid weight limit or perfect gear, but carrying less while enjoying the trip.

An analysis of US death certificates from 2014–2020 found a modest increase in cancer mortality during the first year of COVID-19. In 2020, deaths listing cancer as any cause exceeded the expected baseline by 12,000, or 2%, while deaths listing cancer as the underlying cause did not increase. Hematological cancer had the largest increase among cancer types, at 5%; pancreatic and lung cancers showed no excess mortality. Diabetes and Alzheimer’s had substantially larger increases. A demographic model suggested that population age, size and baseline mortality could explain much of the variation across conditions, including the limited increase for cancers with high baseline mortality. The authors note uncertainty in the model and that longer-term cancer outcomes were not assessed.

The passage argues that Russia unlawfully seized the whaling vessel *Cape Horn Pigeon* on the high seas, interrupting its voyage. A Russian inquiry found no grounds for confiscation, and Russia attributed the arrest to a misunderstanding, returned the vessel, and offered indemnity. The owners, officers, and crew claim $45,000 for lost vessel service, estimated from the captain’s previous catches. The passage cites arbitration decisions allowing compensation for profits lost through unlawful detention.

Seven months after announcing he had completed treatment for alcohol addiction, Ben Affleck was photographed smiling as he arrived at a Los Angeles building believed to be an outpatient treatment centre. In his earlier statement, he described treatment as the first of many steps toward recovery and thanked his family, friends and co-parent Jennifer Garner for their support.

The passage presents environmental education as a lifelong, interdisciplinary process that builds awareness, knowledge, attitudes, skills, participation, and the ability to evaluate environmental measures. It argues that these capacities can change behavior and support sustainable development, defined as meeting present needs without compromising future generations’ needs. Environmental education can be integrated across school subjects and into learning outside the classroom. The passage classifies natural and human-made environments, describes their interdependence, and proposes conserving energy and resources, reducing waste, and using clean technologies. It cites community projects and initiatives in Thailand as examples of environmental education and management in practice.

Foreigners entered a bivouac despite a sentinel’s warning and were eventually led out after officers told them to leave. In an exchange of letters, K. Otori denied demanding the dismissal of Korea’s naval instructor and asked C. T. Gardner to correct a telegram saying otherwise; Gardner directed him to seek information through usual channels. A separate passage describes proposed measures with deadlines ranging from ten days to two years. Mr. Gresham then reported that Chinese and Japanese troops remained in Korea despite the suppression of a revolution. Korea sought US help to protect its independence and avert war, while the United States said it would remain neutral and could approach Japan only in a friendly manner.

The passage argues that integrating music with subjects such as mathematics, language, science, technology and the arts can support cognitive, creative, social and emotional development. The study combines a literature review with a qualitative case study based on an interview with one social studies teacher studying in a fine arts music department. The participant reported gaps in earlier music education and in practical training at the department. Recommendations include preparatory classes, differentiated instruction, workshops, micro-teaching, practical psychology courses, and stronger links between music and other subjects. The passage calls for curricula and education policies that support interdisciplinary music education.

A survey of industrial education students assessed their readiness, expertise, and needs in creating educational multimedia. Students reported high overall expertise (3.51/5) and very high demand for learning materials (4.62/5), particularly in areas where they had less experience, such as copyright and educational metaverse creation. The study recommends targeted training but notes that its small, limited sample may not represent all students.

Nabors Industries sold Quail Tools for more than it paid and plans to use the proceeds to reduce debt by 25%. The author says its key U.S. and Saudi markets appear to be at a cyclical trough and that the stock, despite rising 70% from recent lows, remains below historical valuations.

Jean Munoz circulated May 24 news articles on California’s energy crisis. They cover a proposal to use backup diesel generators despite pollution concerns, allegations of electricity price manipulation that generators dispute, and El Paso’s denial that it drove up natural gas prices. Other reports describe Reliant’s offer to lower prices if operating rules change, plans for earlier blackout warnings, a planned Bush–Davis meeting, and a poll showing widespread dissatisfaction with officials’ handling of the crisis.

A review of Anton Shekhovtsov’s *Tango Noir* describes how Russia has cultivated Western far-right activists to undermine confidence in Western politics and present itself as an alternative power. It traces the tactic to Soviet efforts in West Germany and identifies 2008 as a turning point in Russia’s information strategy. Shekhovtsov describes three methods: promoting sympathetic fringe voices, laundering false narratives into mainstream debate, and selectively sourcing coverage. He also maps the groups and officials involved in efforts to influence European politics. The review says these efforts have had limited results, while highlighting the book’s concern about emerging links between Russian paramilitary groups and Europe’s far right.

The stackless assembler procedures use register passing and run on all processor cores. One creates a pre-memory stack, maps it into global address space, sets MTRRs, and creates a UEFI_SEC_PEI_HAND_OFF instance. It can report success, stack reentry, or an unknown processor family. The other removes the pre-memory stack when main memory becomes available, disabling CAR mode without changing MTRR settings.

Florida International University reopened Monday, four days after a pedestrian bridge collapse killed six people. The school planned a moment of silence and a student vigil, while officials supported victims’ families and cooperated with investigators. A nearby road remained closed indefinitely.

The RIAA has certified 179 songs diamond, a designation requiring at least 10 million equivalent units from sales and streams. Elton John’s “Something About the Way You Look Tonight / Candle in the Wind” was the first; Shaboozey’s “A Bar Song (Tipsy)” is the most recent. Drake leads artists with 10 diamond singles, followed by Post Malone with nine.

Alabama faces a challenge containing Texas A&M receiver and returner Christian Kirk. In two games against Alabama, he has 16 catches for 148 yards and a touchdown, plus a 68-yard punt-return touchdown. Kirk is tied for the SEC lead with four touchdown catches this season and has also returned a kickoff for a touchdown.

Hong Kong and Singapore have seen a surge in initial coin offerings as companies seek alternatives to China and South Korea following bans on token sales. Neither city has specific ICO rules, and fundraising through digital tokens remains loosely regulated there. Chinese and South Korean issuers have reportedly moved or planned offerings in Singapore, including Xender, Bithumb and Zikto.

Schools serving multilingual learners have canceled teacher training, suspended hiring and consolidated newcomer centers amid funding uncertainty and Trump administration policy changes. Educators report fewer newcomer students and say some families avoid services because they fear immigration enforcement. Advocates warn that proposed 2026 cuts could further reduce tutoring, translation and other support, while reduced federal oversight could leave states responsible for ensuring schools meet their obligations.

Caroline Hope, a 37-year-old English teacher, died in Glasgow after contracting E.coli during colon cancer surgery in Turkey. Family and friends raised more than £31,000 to bring her back to Scotland for medical care.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 28, 2019 reports net sales of $91.8 billion, up 9% from the prior-year quarter, and net income of $22.2 billion, up from $20.0 billion. Higher iPhone and Wearables, Home and Accessories sales drove the sales increase; Mac and iPad sales declined. Operating cash flow was $30.5 billion. Apple repurchased $20.0 billion of common stock and paid approximately $3.5 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. At quarter-end, it held $207.1 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and reported $103.3 billion in term debt.

North Carolina’s health goal for GenX in water is 140 parts per trillion, a level at which non-cancer effects are not anticipated. A toxicologist cited possible thyroid and reproductive effects and said cancer associations need more research.

Russian cosmonauts Alexander Misurkin and Anton Shkaplerov replaced an electronics box on a communications antenna during an 8-hour, 13-minute spacewalk, setting a Russian duration record. The antenna became stuck and ended up 180 degrees from its intended position. NASA reported that it was still working, while Russian officials considered whether further action was needed. The cosmonauts also released the old electronics box, which NASA said would not intersect with the station and would eventually burn up in the atmosphere.

The passage explains how to clone data from an existing HDD to a SanDisk SSD, then replace the HDD in a notebook or desktop computer. Before installation, shut down the computer and disconnect its power; remove a notebook battery. Reconnect the computer after installing the SSD. If the SSD is not recognized, disconnect other USB devices. The old HDD may be kept as a backup.

Research from Yale’s Budget Lab and the Brookings Institution found no discernible disruption to U.S. employment from AI since ChatGPT’s launch. Recent graduates face a somewhat tougher job market, but the researchers said the evidence does not establish AI as the main cause. They cautioned that their analysis is not predictive and uses a small sample.

Elsewhere, Meta plans to use AI chatbot conversations to personalize ads and recommendations, while OpenAI launched its Sora 2 video model. Thinking Machines Lab introduced a tool for customizing AI models, and Periodic Labs recruited researchers to develop AI for scientific discovery. The share of S&P 500 companies disclosing AI-related risks rose from 12% in 2023 to 72% in 2025.

Bills running back James Cook has 401 rushing yards and five touchdowns through the first month of the season, including more than 100 rushing yards in each of his last three games. Josh Allen called Cook an “all-time teammate” and suggested his new $48 million contract has helped him play more freely. The 4-0 Bills host the Patriots in Week 5.

SOS low-post defense prioritizes aggressive fronting to limit passes and shots inside. On lob passes, a low helpside defender double-teams the post. Base Go is the primary post trap and forces the player toward the baseline; Go Top sends help from the high helpside and forces the player toward the middle. Go Wing uses the wing defender to double-team when the post defender is caught behind. Hold keeps defenders on outside players to deny kick-out passes and three-point shots. Yo-Yo lets a defender leave a non-shooting wing to help in the post. Defenders rotate as passes leave the passer’s hands.

This 2018 ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States, 1894* includes two February 1893 messages from President Benjamin Harrison to the Senate. One transmits a draft of an uncompleted 1854 treaty with Hawaii and related correspondence; the other transmits a report and correspondence on U.S.–Hawaiian relations from 1820 to 1893.

The passage describes an overnight gold strategy that buys GLD, gold futures, or gold-miners ETFs at the close and sells at the next open. In the cited backtests, GDX gained an average of 0.12% overnight but lost 0.09% during the day. GLD’s overnight annual return was 8.4%, compared with 8.2% for buy-and-hold, though its average overnight gain was just 0.04%. The authors also report more selective strategies under testing. They caution that gold and commodity strategies are volatile, difficult to trade, and prone to breaking down.

The Hawaiian cabinet upheld its finance minister’s decision to refer British claimants to the courts. In 1881, Mr. Blaine warned that Hawaii could not grant another power privileges reserved to the United States under the 1875 treaty and stated that the United States favored Hawaiian neutrality. In 1883, the United States declined to join Hawaii’s protest against British and French expansion in Polynesia. A convention concluded in 1884 renewed the reciprocity treaty and granted the United States exclusive rights to establish a coaling and repair station at Pearl River Harbor; opposition delayed ratification until 1887. The passage also describes earlier U.S. interest in the harbor and competing proposals for a cable linking Hawaii to Australia and North America.

A November 5, 2001 news roundup reports scrutiny of Enron’s transactions with partnerships linked to former executives, including a $35 million purchase involving Chewco Investments. The SEC had opened a formal investigation, while investors questioned Enron’s disclosures and debt kept off its balance sheet. Short seller James Chanos had identified warning signs in its filings, and Arthur Andersen faced questions about the clarity of its audits. The AFL-CIO called for governance reforms. Amid falling shares and credit-rating cuts, Enron was considering asset sales, pursuing an exit from its disputed Dabhol power project in India, and discussing a sale of its stake in a Korean gas venture.

Stroke symptoms require immediate action. The American Stroke Association’s FAST acronym identifies face drooping, arm weakness and speech difficulty, followed by time to call 911. Call if any one symptom appears, even if it goes away, and note when it began. Another mnemonic, STR, prompts checking whether a person can smile, talk and raise both arms.

The author criticizes cryopreservation, describing a Frenchman who froze his wife and a British teenager whose body was sent to the US for storage. The passage outlines a proposed method of preserving bodies in liquid nitrogen and says 2,000 people have paid for the service. The author argues that revival is not scientifically credible and that providers exploit fear of death.

Children’s mobile phone ownership varies widely by country and age. After moving from Germany to California, Sara Zaske’s daughter went from having few classmates with phones to being the only one without a smartphone. Surveys cited in the passage report smartphone ownership among 46% of European children ages 9 to 16 and 45% of US children ages 10 to 12. Studies elsewhere also show substantial differences in access and ownership. The American Academy of Pediatrics says there is no single right age for a child’s first phone and recommends limits and supervision for children’s media use.

On World Wetlands Day, Beignet the Nutria did not see his shadow, which his caretaker said predicts a hurricane season without hurricanes in South Louisiana. Beignet serves as an educational mascot for invasive-species awareness.

According to the passage, the five best-performing stock markets since 1900 are Australia, the United States, South Africa, New Zealand, and Denmark. Australia led, with annual U.S.-dollar returns above 6.5%; the United States delivered 6.5% annualized returns after inflation. From 1900 to 2019, global stocks returned 5.2% annually after inflation, compared with 2% for bonds. The passage cites dividends, natural resources, and economic diversification as contributors to market performance. It also notes that a small fraction of stocks generated overall gains and cautions that past performance does not guarantee future results.

The passage supports France’s recovery of Alsace-Lorraine but avoids making it an unconditional U.S. war aim. It endorses justified Italian border changes, a commercially free Trieste, and cultural autonomy for its inhabitants, while rejecting broader Italian ambitions on the eastern Adriatic. For the Balkans, it rejects the Treaty of Bucharest, calls for the evacuation and restoration of occupied states, and proposes a settlement balancing national and economic interests after further inquiry. It also calls for an independent, democratic Poland with adequate access to the sea, while acknowledging difficult borders and risks of economic dependence and internal friction.

South Korean prosecutors raided Korean Air’s headquarters while investigating suspected tax evasion, embezzlement and breach of trust involving Chairman Cho Yang-ho and his family, Yonhap reported. The family has faced increased scrutiny following allegations against Cho’s daughter, and Cho recently stepped down as co-chief executive of affiliate Jin Air.

Robin Chase and Antje Danielson founded Zipcar in 2000 to give urban residents convenient access to shared cars. Chase believed technology could help make car sharing viable despite other ventures’ financial difficulties. Zipcar launched in June with four cars, attracted positive press, and grew to more than 400 members and 10 cars by mid-October.

Reviewing the company’s finances before a $1.3 million funding round, Chase discovered that car use and revenue per trip were far below her estimates. She concluded that daily rentals, which generated half of revenue, would need a 20% price increase for Zipcar to break even. Team members warned that raising prices so soon could violate customers’ expectations and provoke a backlash.

Montreal topped the 2017 QS Best Student Cities ranking, ending Paris’s four-year run in first place. Paris ranked second, London third and Seoul fourth. The ranking considers university quality, affordability, student appeal, access to employers, safety and other factors.

Canada also placed Vancouver tenth and Toronto joint eleventh. QS forecasts that Canada will attract more international students as alternatives to traditional destinations grow. London rose from fifth despite concerns about Brexit’s effect on UK applications. Kuala Lumpur and Surabaya were the most affordable cities, while Stockholm and New York were the most expensive. The passage says international students contributed almost $36bn to the US economy.

International Development Secretary Penny Mordaunt became the first minister to use sign language in Parliament, prompting applause and a signed reply from Speaker John Bercow. She highlighted a July 24 London conference, organised by the UK, Kenya and the International Disability Alliance, to advance disability inclusion.

David Clarkson says the team has played well despite unfavorable bounces and a score he feels did not reflect its performance. He says they need more traffic and better finishing against an outstanding goalie, and will keep pushing and believing they can battle back.

The speaker says the team must be more assertive, disrupt Carolina’s entries and limit its offensive-zone time. Blocked shots, turnovers and playing within individual roles are also important. The speaker reflects on Rem’s recovery and contribution, and says officials should limit unfair faceoff advantages.

An informal review of 13 CFD brokers found that 62%–82% of their retail CFD traders lose money. The passage attributes losses to leverage, spreads and fees, illiquidity, and traders’ lack of experience or a plan. It says a minority make profits by managing risk, controlling costs and following a trading strategy.

The TPS7H500x-SP family comprises radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak-current-mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The passage describes output-voltage programming, soft start, switching-frequency modes, primary and synchronous-rectifier outputs, programmable timing and duty-cycle limits, and frequency and slope compensation. Protection features include pulse skipping, overcurrent limiting with hiccup restart, external fault shutdown, and thermal shutdown.

A TPS7H5001-SP synchronous push-pull design example operates at 500 kHz and produces 5 V. It details component selection for the transformer, GaN switches, output filter, current sensing, and compensation. The passage also provides power-supply and PCB-layout recommendations, including keeping sensitive signals away from switching noise, separating analog and power grounds, and placing bypass components close to the controller.

Consilium Software has launched UniRSM as a replacement for the end-of-sale Cisco Remote Silent Monitoring product. Available worldwide through Cisco SolutionsPlus, it lets supervisors in Cisco Contact Center Enterprise environments monitor and coach agents remotely by phone without a network connection. Features include whisper coaching, monitoring multiple calls per session, high-availability failover, web-based reporting, and Windows and Linux support. Customers can order it through Cisco Commerce.

Lincolnshire County Council leader Martin Hill urged health bosses to detail future service plans after inspectors rated ULHT as requiring improvement overall, despite good ratings in 72% of areas. The trust remains in special measures. Hill welcomed progress but cited recruitment and service concerns. He also sought plans for Grantham A&E, which remains closed overnight because of staffing shortages.

U.S. stocks have risen sharply this year, led by technology and AI companies, but record-high valuations are making investors cautious. The S&P 500’s forward price-to-earnings ratio is near 23, above its 10-year average of 18.7. Analysts disagree on whether earnings and productivity justify current prices. Rising call-option activity and reliance on easier Federal Reserve policy add to concerns about a correction. Upcoming earnings and central bank commentary may test whether the rally is sustainable.

The passage describes an information management system for protecting data, including virtual machine disks, through backups and other secondary copies. It focuses on incremental and differential backups in cloud environments that do not natively support changed-block tracking. The proposed method compares virtual disk images taken at different times, maps the changed blocks, and uses a virtual server agent to extract and back up those blocks. The passage also outlines a system architecture in which storage managers coordinate operations, data agents process source data, and media agents manage secondary storage.

Tarik Skubal tied a Tigers postseason record with 14 strikeouts as Detroit beat Cleveland 2-1 in Game 1 of their AL Wild Card Series. He allowed one run over 7 2/3 innings. Detroit took the lead in the seventh, and its reliever preserved the win by tagging out José Ramírez during a tense ninth inning. The Tigers can advance with a win Wednesday.

The Ravens fell to 1-3 after a 37-20 loss to the Chiefs, raising concerns about their playoff chances. Their defense did not force a punt until the fourth quarter, while Lamar Jackson turned the ball over twice and left with a hamstring injury. The passage says Baltimore needs to win its next two games to reach 3-3.

On June 23, 2020, Amazon amended and restated its credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank and other lenders, extending its revolving credit facility to June 23, 2023. Borrowings will support general corporate purposes, including its commercial paper program.

President Trump’s December 6 recognition of Jerusalem as Israel’s capital drew international and Arab League condemnation. In a Radio Sputnik interview, a speaker argued that Trump sought support from Jewish Zionists and exposed the Israeli-Palestinian peace process as a sham. The speaker called the Arab League weak and suggested Jerusalem residents’ limited response reflected the decision’s lack of immediate effects on the ground. The passage also discusses the revocable residency rights of non-Jewish Jerusalem residents, UN Security Council Resolution 478’s rejection of Israel’s 1980 Jerusalem law, and the speaker’s view that a two-state solution is nearly dead and the focus should shift to equal rights.

An MRI indicated an MCL injury close to a third-degree strain, which the speaker hopes will heal fairly quickly. He says he injured his knee and elbow during a collision at the net and does not blame defenseman Mark Andre. Although frustrated that he cannot play while his team competes for the Stanley Cup, he plans to help however he can. He is confident in goalies Ty and Jussi and says the team remains united despite the setback.
Tesla filed a Form 8-K on October 23, 2019, announcing that it had posted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2019. Its Third Quarter 2019 Update is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

This study analyzed 12 SARS-CoV-2 genomes collected in Esteio, Rio Grande do Sul, in 2021 and compared them with genomes from across the state. All 12 belonged to the Gamma variant; the researchers reported several mutations not previously described in the state, including one not recorded in GISAID. Among 4,706 state genomes collected from March 2020 to May 2022, predominant lineages shifted from B.1.1.33 to Gamma, then Delta and Omicron. Selection analyses found no positively selected sites in the envelope protein, two in the membrane protein and 14 in the nucleocapsid protein. Computational estimates suggested that mutations at selected membrane and nucleocapsid sites could either stabilize or destabilize their protein structures.

Investigating officer Sergeant Marlon Appollis told Jason Rohde’s murder trial that he found no suicide note or object Susan Rohde could have stood on where she was found hanging in a Spier hotel bathroom. He found a note indicating Jason was having an affair. After an autopsy attributed Susan’s death to manual strangulation, Appollis changed the case to murder. Jason denies the charge. The trial was postponed to allow the defence to prepare for evidence about tests on the bathroom door hook.

This study protocol describes a three-arm randomized trial in Singapore involving 150 cancer survivors. It will compare Digital-MindCAN, an eight-week, live online programme combining cancer-specific education and mindfulness practice, with Palouse Mindfulness and a wait-list control. Researchers will assess stress, psychological outcomes and participants’ experiences using questionnaires, physiological measures and focus groups. The passage reports a planned study, not results.

This qualitative study interviewed 20 preschool teachers about sensory education and analyzed their responses by theme. All considered sensory education important for children’s development and reported using sensory activities in daily routines. Most said the preschool program addresses the senses but does not clearly or sufficiently describe sensory education. Teachers also reported inadequate materials and classroom conditions, and almost all wanted training on sensory integration problems. The study recommends teacher training, occupational therapist support, more sensory materials, and greater attention to sensory education in undergraduate programs.

The speaker said the team improved its defensive positioning, protected the front of the net and moved the puck with more composure after rushing plays previously. Despite the heat, they felt stronger as the game went on and welcomed an easier trip home. The team expects a particular line matchup to continue for the rest of the series. After an embarrassing previous performance, players focused on their own improvements and played with more urgency.

Wisconsin’s frack sand industry has rebounded as U.S. crude production has grown, bringing idled mines back into operation. New Texas mines will add competition, but analysts expect rising demand to protect Wisconsin’s market and raise northern white sand prices by 10 to 12 percent this year.

Agilent shares rose about 22% in a month, but the author recommends avoiding them, citing modest revenue and earnings growth and a valuation 15% above the overall market. The author notes dividend growth and a strong cash position, but forecasts a 6.7% annualized return over four years, which they consider insufficient given risks to customer research budgets. Their technical model projects a decline to $53 over three months if shares close below $58.50.

Stanford researchers developed “biofilm lithography,” using blue light to make genetically engineered E. coli stick to illuminated areas and form patterned biofilms overnight. The technique produces designs at 25-micrometer resolution and could help researchers study how bacterial communities grow and interact. Sharp patterns also suggested that many bacteria repeatedly attach to and detach from the culture surface. The team is working to pattern multiple bacterial strains and investigate how biofilms may share antibiotic resistance.

CMD42 requires a block length sufficient for its data structure; otherwise, its result is undefined. Invalid passwords or lengths produce errors, and execution errors set LOCK_UNLOCK_FAILED. CMD42 reports the current lock state; changes can be seen in a subsequent CMD13 response.

The speaker says the team played poorly for two periods but rallied in the third, drawing confidence from earlier comebacks. Despite the win, they say the team must skate better and take fewer penalties to succeed in the seven-game Stanley Cup final. They praise the goaltending, the team’s depth and close locker room, while describing Edmonton as physical and talented. The team has studied Edmonton’s systems, but the speaker says its main focus is improving its own play.

This study examines four higher education projects created or relocated abroad by Russian academics after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine and subsequent repression. Using interviews and project materials, it finds that the initiatives provide intellectual freedom and support for departing scholars and students, preserve academic practices and Russian-language teaching, and pursue educational work despite uncertainty about returning home. The projects also seek international collaboration, but their reconsideration of inherited practices remains limited. The study calls for further research into those practices, the projects’ stated goals and everyday teaching, and their changing relationships with Russia.

The speaker says the team approached its game against Detroit as a single opportunity to win, and the result gave them confidence. They credit the forwards’ defensive effort and the team’s five-man play with helping keep the game close against a fast, dangerous opponent. They expect Detroit to regroup and say their own team should maintain its straightforward approach and focus. The speaker describes early nerves that eased as the game went on, praises captain Ron Francis, and says younger players’ inexperience may help them avoid distractions.

Undernutrition is a major risk factor for tuberculosis (TB). Using results from the RATIONS trial, researchers modeled six months of nutritional support for household contacts of people with TB in India. Per 100,000 contacts, the intervention was projected to reduce lifetime TB cases from 7,718 to 6,749 and TB deaths from 1,529 to 906, averting 13,775 disability-adjusted life years. Its estimated cost was $229 per disability-adjusted life year averted from a healthcare perspective and $184 from a societal perspective, both below the study’s $550 cost-effectiveness threshold. The authors caution that effects may differ in populations with less undernutrition or lower TB incidence.

The speaker says a disputed goal looked inconclusive but trusts the officials’ decision. Despite tough bounces and poor single-game statistics, he remains confident in Pekks. He also credits Milwaukee’s coaches and treatment of players with helping him mature on and off the ice.

External Affairs Minister Sushma Swaraj sought a report from the Indian High Commission in Islamabad after Sikh leader Charnjit Singh was shot dead in Peshawar. Shiromani Akali Dal president Sukhbir Singh Badal urged her to raise concerns about the safety of Sikhs in Pakistan. Police suspected a targeted attack.

Washington Prime Group shares fell 0.27% in the latest session, closing at $7.51. Three analysts’ 12-month price targets averaged $6.77, ranging from $6 to $7.50. The passage reports two hold recommendations and one underperform recommendation. The stock’s 14-period average true range was 0.25, and its relative strength index was 65.19. Washington Prime Group had a $1.41 billion market capitalization and 187.31 million shares outstanding. Trading volume was 3.62 million shares, compared with an average of 3.47 million.

Martin Brodeur says his team is enjoying its playoff run but needs more success in the finals. He wants more traffic near the opposing goalie to create offensive chances. After a recent win, the team hopes to build momentum, keep improving and take the series day by day. He says rest and family time help him focus, and he feels less pressure than earlier in his career.

The lecture examines dynamic optimality: whether an online binary search tree can serve every search sequence within a constant factor of the best offline tree algorithm. Although balanced trees guarantee logarithmic worst-case search time, some sequences admit faster amortized bounds, including sequential access, dynamic finger, entropy, and working-set bounds. No binary search tree is known to achieve the unified bound, and dynamic optimality remains open for splay trees.

A geometric model represents searches and touched nodes as points. A point set corresponds to a valid tree execution exactly when every rectangle spanned by two nonaligned points contains another point. Thus finding an optimal execution becomes finding a smallest satisfying superset. The lecture describes a greedy method for adding points and sketches how to implement it as an online tree, but its optimality is unproved.

An Oregon newborn died from complications of prematurity, and a medical examiner said immediate medical care could have saved her. Her twin survived after receiving care. Deputies are investigating why no one at the home called 911; no charges have been filed.

For a CFT on flat space, temperature is the only scale; on a sphere, physics also depends on the dimensionless product of temperature and sphere radius. Its gravity description admits thermal AdS and, above a minimum temperature, small and large black holes. Comparing free energies shows that thermal AdS dominates at low temperatures, while the large black hole dominates above a critical temperature. The small black hole is never the stable phase. The change at the critical temperature is a first-order Hawking–Page transition.

A toy model of SU(N)-singlet states built from matrix harmonic oscillators illustrates the proposed field-theory explanation: at high temperature, the large number of high-energy states can outweigh their thermal suppression, changing the dominant contribution from order-one-energy states to states with energy of order N squared.

Bemidji Blue Ox won the Region 10C title, defeating Crookston 7-3 after taking an early 5-0 lead. Ben Thoma earned the win with seven innings pitched and seven strikeouts. Bemidji receives a first-round bye in the state tournament and will play the winner of Fort Ripley and Blue Earth on Aug. 27 in Hamburg. Crookston also qualified for the tournament.

Faviola Dadis said Steven Seagal sexually assaulted her during a 2002 hotel-room audition when she was 17. She said she did not report it then because she feared being blacklisted, but recently filed a police report; Los Angeles prosecutors are reviewing her case. Dadis spoke alongside Regina Simons, who has also accused Seagal of sexual assault. Seagal has denied other women’s allegations, and his attorney did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Since August, Dale Capstick and her husband have found about three dozen palm-sized spiders in their Coxheath home. A nearby resident also caught one. A Nova Scotia Museum biologist identified it as a giant house spider and said the species is harmless despite its size. He said insects may attract the spiders indoors and that they may leave when their prey is gone. Capstick hopes they have left after several days without a sighting.

Rushin Shah, Apple’s former head of natural language understanding for Siri, has joined Facebook after five years on the Siri team. He helped develop Siri’s voice recognition, conversational responses and ability to interpret spoken requests. Shah cited a desire for a new challenge and will work on natural language and dialogue understanding at Facebook. His departure comes as Siri faces growing competition and Apple expands the assistant to its HomePod speaker. His successor is unknown.

The podcast explores how investors can balance lower fees against simplicity and convenience. Guest John Robertson discusses indexing options, robo-advisors, and tools for comparing their costs. The episode also considers Vanguard’s new one-fund ETFs, which have a 0.22% management fee. Before switching from index mutual funds, investors should weigh the savings against their portfolio size, the value of automated contributions, their experience trading ETFs, the complexity of their accounts, and whether an ETF matches their target asset mix.

Meizu’s Pro 7 and Pro 7 Plus will receive a 600-yuan price cut in China on December 12, bringing the series’ starting price to 1,999 yuan. Both phones have secondary displays, dual 12-megapixel rear cameras and 16-megapixel front cameras. The Pro 7 has a 5.2-inch main display, while the Pro 7 Plus has a 5.7-inch display and a larger battery.

At Discover 2017, HPE introduced the Edgeline Services Platform and two apps to help customers manage IoT devices and combine IT and operational technology data. The platform runs IoT services where equipment is located rather than in data centers or the cloud. One app aggregates data from OT devices; the other distributes network address translations to smaller networks and can be managed remotely. An analyst said HPE’s single-vendor approach could help customers navigate complex IoT choices.

Researchers used high-resolution imaging and experiments to show that polymyxin B makes active bacteria rapidly produce and shed their protective outer layer. The resulting gaps allow the antibiotic to enter and kill them. Dormant bacteria do not produce the layer, so the drug binds to them but causes little damage. Providing sugar woke dormant cells and made them susceptible after a delay. The findings may help explain recurrent infections and guide treatments that make polymyxins more effective.

The West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals held that firing three at-will hotel employees for refusing polygraph tests violated public policy grounded in privacy rights. It also held that courts, not juries, determine the existence of public policy, and remanded the case. Dissenting justices argued that the relevant statute took effect after the dismissals and that no earlier policy prohibited them.

ESA has inaugurated a 35-meter deep-space antenna at New Norcia in Western Australia. Due to enter service in 2026, it will increase data-download capacity for missions including Juice, Solar Orbiter and BepiColombo, and can support partner agencies. Cryogenically cooled components help it detect weak spacecraft signals, while a 20 kW amplifier transmits commands across vast distances. The antenna cost an estimated €62.3 million to build, with a further €3 million Australian contribution to station upgrades.

Bishop Hassan Kukah urged Nigerian politicians to improve governance and not take the military’s patience with democracy for granted. He criticized the use of religion to excuse misgovernance and called on citizens to question leaders’ promises. Kukah also urged the government to tolerate opposing views and announced a leadership forum on sustaining democracy.

After a loss to Tampa Bay, the speaker said the Stanley Cup final is now a three-game series. Both goalies played well, but the team needs better scoring chances and more decisive finishing. He did not blame the referees and hopes the team will earn its breaks next game.

Austin Police Chief Brian Manley appealed to whoever carried out three package bombings over 11 days to contact authorities before anyone else was hurt. The attacks killed two people and injured two; all victims were Black or Hispanic, and investigators had not ruled out a hate crime. Manley also sought public tips, citing a $100,000 reward in addition to the governor’s $15,000 reward.

The passage describes SD card initialization, identification and data transfer. The host uses CMD8 and repeated ACMD41 commands to establish operating conditions and capacity type, then CMD2 and CMD3 to identify cards and obtain their relative addresses. UHS-I initialization can include a switch to 1.8V signaling and tuning.

During data transfer, the host selects one card at a time. Read and write blocks use CRC checks; writes, erases and related operations can signal busy on DAT0. The passage also defines erase, discard and full-user-area logical erase procedures, plus mechanical, internal and password-based write protection. Card Ownership Protection adds a Force Erase Password and restricts certain password and erase operations.

CMD6 checks or switches card functions, including speed, driver strength and power limit. For memory access, SDSC cards use byte addresses, while SDHC and SDXC cards use block addresses and fixed 512-byte blocks.

UK Chancellor Rachel Reeves has not ruled out tax increases ahead of November’s budget, citing geopolitical instability, U.S. tariffs and higher borrowing costs. Facing a potential fiscal shortfall of up to £30 billion, she is keeping her options open while stressing spending discipline and market credibility.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on January 29, 2020, reporting that it had issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2019. The release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The ADS868xW devices are 16-bit SAR ADCs supporting single-ended and differential inputs across bipolar and unipolar ranges, with straight-binary output. They provide programmable input alarms, fixed AVDD alarms, a multiSPI interface, daisy-chain operation, and reset, acquisition, conversion, NAP, and power-down modes. Nine configuration registers control device operation and output options. The passage also describes an eight-channel industrial input design, power-supply decoupling, and PCB layout guidance.

A May 9, 2001 collection of news reports covers Questia’s decision to cut 139 jobs as it slows book digitization, and mixed U.S. markets ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting. Enron said barriers to competition in Japan’s power market warranted an independent regulator. Reports on Enron’s Dabhol project in India describe its dispute with the Maharashtra State Electricity Board over power costs and payments, preparations for arbitration, and the possibility of terminating their agreement. Other reports cover Williams’ planned entry into European energy trading and Prize Petroleum’s interest in buying Enron’s stake in three Indian offshore fields.

After the parents divorced, Edward lived primarily with his father from age two. His mother sought custody after keeping him beyond a visit. The trial court denied her request, and the appellate court affirmed. It held that the preference for mothers of young children did not require a change in custody: the court could consider Edward’s established home life with his father and his best interests.

This qualitative document analysis reviewed 15 studies on digital storytelling in African higher education and teacher training. The studies report benefits including student engagement, creativity, digital literacy, reflection, cultural understanding, and improved oral and map-reading skills. Digital storytelling also enabled students to express their identities and share cultural knowledge. Its uses ranged from pre-service teacher training to geography education. Reported barriers included limited equipment and electricity, insufficient technological skills, low confidence, and time constraints. The article recommends focusing assessments on narrative content rather than technology alone.

The chapter presents a business process model with three components: business rules describing domain entities, workflow models describing activities, and value models describing exchanges between parties. It examines how controlled languages and logic-based formalisms support reasoning about these components, while identifying difficulties with incomplete information and rule interpretation. It also describes consistency checks between models and compares predicted value exchanges with execution logs. Open issues include identifying when a model needs to change and representing why stakeholders act.

Court documents say Steve Wynn reached a 2006 settlement with a second woman who accused him of sexual misconduct. Wynn recently reported her to the FBI, alleging she threatened to publicize the settlement to extort him. Her attorney denied the allegation, and emails included in the filings did not request money. Wynn resigned as chairman and CEO of Wynn Resorts after other misconduct allegations surfaced, which he has denied.

The lecture introduces ordinary differential equation initial value problems, in which all initial conditions are specified at one value of the independent variable. Higher-order equations can be rewritten as first-order systems for numerical solvers.

Forward Euler advances a solution using its current value and derivative, but its error and computational cost make accuracy difficult to improve. More accurate update formulas estimate the derivative over each step; the lecture describes a second-order Runge–Kutta method and MATLAB’s fourth- and fifth-order solver, which uses their difference to estimate error and adjust step size.

Because numerical solutions repeatedly extrapolate, errors can accumulate or grow. Even a differential equation whose true solution decays can produce oscillations or divergence if the method or step size is unsuitable. The lecture demonstrates this with Forward Euler applied to \(dy/dt=-2y\) and notes that implicit solvers will be discussed next.

Jeremy Corbyn travelled from his Islington home to Westminster in an official diesel Ford Galaxy that emits 189g of CO₂ per kilometre, according to DVLA records. The car waited on double yellow lines for about 40 minutes before the journey. Islington and Hackney had proposed restrictions on diesel vehicles, and Corbyn has called for action on air pollution and a phased reduction in diesel use. Conservative MPs accused him of hypocrisy. The passage says he was advised to accept an official driver for security reasons.

Brazilian power company CPFL Energia launched Envo to serve customers installing home solar systems. Envo will provide equipment, installation and help connecting systems to the grid so customers can sell excess power. CPFL said grid connections for solar projects rose from 7,500 at the end of 2016 to 10,000 by April. Santander Brasil will offer financing, while CPFL did not disclose its investment in Envo.

Labubu, a toy inspired by Hong Kong’s indie toy culture, became a major Gen-Z trend in 2025. Designed by a Dutch artist in Belgium and manufactured by a Chinese company in Vietnam, it went viral with help from a Thai K-pop star.

The professor introduces AMO physics as the study of systems built from atoms, molecules, photons, and electromagnetic fields. The field has expanded from observing individual particles and collisions to controlling single quantum systems, entanglement, and many-body systems, increasingly overlapping with condensed matter physics. Advances in lasers and optical cavities have enabled much of this work.

The course will cover atom–light interactions, spontaneous emission, trapping and cooling, single photons, and quantum gases. As an example connecting these topics, the professor describes atoms in optical lattices: standing waves of light create periodic potentials. Depending on the conditions, these lattices can support laser cooling, precise atomic clocks, studies of tunneling and Mott insulators, atom interferometry, and measurements of many-body systems.

French President Emmanuel Macron named 18 initial recipients of “Make Our Planet Great Again” climate grants, including 13 based in the U.S. Scientists Camille Parmesan and Benjamin Sanderson welcomed the chance to continue their research in France, citing support for climate science there and increasing difficulty securing U.S. funding.

The passage recommends a wide range of shows on HBO Max, from crime dramas, comedies and period pieces to documentaries and reality series. It describes their premises, casts, critical reception and renewal or cancellation status, and notes that many completed series are available to stream in full.

Secretary Stettinius urged governments to approach the proposed international organization flexibly, noting that the Dumbarton Oaks proposals might change. Discussions addressed objections to the name “United Nations” and whether to enumerate principles such as treaty obligations and territorial integrity. In January 1945, he sought to warn six Latin American associated nations that they might be excluded from the initial conference unless they declared war. He also pressed for policy guidance for the Yalta meeting and preparations for a United Nations conference. Security Council voting remained a major unresolved issue.

University of Utah researchers used 133 portable seismometers and new analysis techniques to map the shallow geology around Yellowstone’s Old Faithful geyser. They identified what they believe is its hydrothermal reservoir: a network of cracks about 200 meters across that may hold roughly 300,000 cubic meters of water. The sensors also recorded tremors caused by collapsing bubbles as the reservoir refills; eruptions occur at the end of these tremors, just before a quiet period.
