The team plans further seismic surveys in Yellowstone.

The First Circuit affirmed the denial of Ronald Johnson’s habeas corpus petition, holding that his confession after his 1963 arrest was voluntary. Johnson argued that his injuries, limited education, lack of sleep, police presence, lineups, and absence of warnings made it involuntary. Reviewing the totality of the circumstances, the court found that his will had not been overborne. It did not decide his separate challenges to the trial court’s voluntariness analysis and burden of proof.

The Healthy Davis/Healthy Yolo Together program provided free COVID-19 testing and conducted 770,165 tests among 89,924 Yolo County residents from November 2020 to June 2022. It reached approximately 41.1% of county residents and 78.4% of Davis residents. Daily testing and positive cases peaked during the Omicron period, when frequent testing was also most common; participation declined afterward. Women, adults aged 19–34, and White participants were prominent among frequent testers. The study describes how participation changed over time but could not determine the reasons for those differences.

Worcester paid more than $11 million in employee overtime in 2017, including $4.4 million to police employees. Police officers also received $9.3 million in detail pay, with some earning more from details than their base salaries. City officials said overtime was not due to understaffing, citing specialized police work and emergencies. Of the city’s 223 employees earning over $100,000 in regular pay, only two women were among the top 50 earners.

India’s Supreme Court ordered political parties to stop seeking votes in the name of religion, caste, creed, community or language. The author argues that the order overlooks how identity-based mobilisation has helped marginalised groups gain political representation. While acknowledging the harm of communal appeals, the author says stronger enforcement of existing laws and political contestation are better responses than a judicial ban. The author also argues that voters increasingly consider development alongside identity and that the order will be difficult to enforce because identity remains part of electoral politics.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 1, 2023 reports net sales of $81.8 billion, down 1% from a year earlier, and net income of $19.9 billion, up from $19.4 billion. Lower iPhone and iPad sales were partly offset by higher Services sales. For the first nine months of fiscal 2023, net sales were $293.8 billion and net income was $74.0 billion, both below the comparable 2022 period. Apple repurchased $18.0 billion of common stock during the quarter and reported $28.4 billion in cash and cash equivalents at quarter-end.

This study examined how walking could become an aesthetic experience and a teaching tool for prospective art teachers. Seven participants in a western Türkiye university course took walks, kept visual diaries, photographed their surroundings, examined artworks, and created their own art over 10 weeks in 2023. Classes were held online following the earthquake. Researchers analyzed diaries, course materials, recordings, and interviews thematically. Participants moved beyond viewing walking as simple movement to noticing sensory, personal, and social aspects of places. Their art explored experiences ranging from city sounds to social problems. They reported broader perspectives and new ways to connect daily life, art, and lesson planning, though some struggled to turn their experiences into artworks.

Extreme Networks shares fell 0.46% in the most recent session and closed at $10.87. Five analysts set an average 12-month price target of $16.70, with targets ranging from $15.50 to $18; one rated the stock Buy and four rated it Outperform. The stock’s 14-period average true range was 0.48, and its relative strength index was 45.3. Extreme Networks had a market capitalization of $1.25 billion. Previous-session trading volume was 1.11 million shares, below its average of about 2.6 million.

Flu season in Indiana can last until mid-April; the state reported 278 flu deaths this season. IU Health experts say flu and other illnesses can spread when people touch contaminated surfaces and then their faces. Flu viruses may remain on surfaces for about a day, while norovirus can remain for days or weeks. In a lab demonstration, handwashing made little difference to the bacteria found on a reporter’s hands, indicating she needed to scrub longer and harder. IU Health recommends washing with soap for 20–30 seconds, including under fingernails, to help prevent disease from spreading.

Abraaj raised $1 billion for a health care fund intended to buy and improve hospitals in developing countries. Investors questioned why more than $200 million remained uninvested and sought proof that the money had not funded Abraaj’s operations. Abraaj returned more than $100 million and commissioned an audit; investors requested a separate audit. A World Bank corruption review found no evidence of wrongdoing. The fund’s largest investment, an Indian hospital network, has performed below expectations. Despite the dispute, founder Arif Naqvi is seeking to raise a new $6 billion fund.

The team reviewed video to prepare and plans to review more. They aim to reduce blocked shots by getting the puck to the net faster, while creating screens and pursuing rebounds without bumping opponents.

Amazon’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2018, reports third-quarter net sales of $56.6 billion, up from $43.7 billion a year earlier, and net income of $2.9 billion, up from $256 million. For the first nine months of 2018, net sales were $160.5 billion and net income was $7.0 billion. North America and AWS reported higher operating income, while International reported a smaller operating loss. Amazon acquired Ring and PillPack in 2018. The filing also discusses accounting changes, liquidity, contractual commitments, and tax and legal contingencies.

Indiana is considering outcomes-based contracts with tutoring providers to improve reading among struggling middle school students. State officials have not decided how the contracts would be structured or funded. Under the approach, some provider pay depends on student progress. Its use is growing, but evidence that it improves learning remains limited, and providers face risks when attendance or scheduling affects results. A contracting center reports that about half of its members’ learning goals were met in 2025.

A series of Canadian political resignations amid sexual misconduct allegations sparked debate over due process and #MeToo. The passage argues that parties may hold leaders to high standards when allegations undermine their ability to serve, even before claims are proven in court. It also argues that fairness requires both a presumption of innocence and taking accusers seriously while evidence is assessed. The author says the recent surge in allegations reflects a moment when women are more likely to be believed, and calls for a fair movement that does not preserve past patterns of disbelief.
